dheesh_gita::602.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::602.essence: True discernment reveals that constant change in the world causes unavoidable pain.
dheesh_gita::602.simple_meaning: Wise and discerning people recognize that everything in the world changes and that this causes suffering.
dheesh_gita::602.simple_insight: There is a sober clarity in seeing how constant change brings struggle.
dheesh_gita::602.detailed_meaning: In this teaching moment, the wise and discerning are described as those who truly understand the world's nature. They see that everything changes and so experience the world’s suffering clearly, highlighting the connection between impermanence and pain.
dheesh_gita::602.modern_relevance: You notice how relationships, jobs, and plans shift unexpectedly, bringing discomfort despite your hopes.
dheesh_gita::602.insight: It teaches you to recognize impermanence as the root of emotional struggle, opening the way to acceptance.

dheesh_gita::603.verse_sanskrit:
किन्तु मे ज्ञानिनो भक्ता जीवन्मुक्तगणाः खलु ।
संसारमेतं पश्यन्ति स्वरूपे काऽप्यलौकिके ॥
dheesh_gita::603.verse_hindi: परन्तु मेरे ज्ञानीभक्त जीवन्मुक्तगण इस संसार को कुछ और ही अलौकिक रूप में देखते हैं
dheesh_gita::603.english_translation: But my wise devotees, the liberated beings, see this world as something beyond the ordinary.
dheesh_gita::603.translation_literal: किन्तु (but) मे (my) ज्ञानिनो (wise) भक्ता (devotees) जीवन्मुक्तगणाः (liberated beings) खलु (indeed) । / संसारमेतं (this world) पश्यन्ति (see) स्वरूपे (in form) काऽप्यलौकिके (somewhat supernatural / beyond ordinary) ॥
dheesh_gita::603.speaker: श्री धीश
dheesh_gita::603.essence: Those free and devoted perceive the world beyond ordinary appearances.
dheesh_gita::603.simple_meaning: Those who are wise and devoted, and free from all bindings, see the world as beyond normal appearances.
dheesh_gita::603.simple_insight: Freedom brings a view of the world that feels extraordinary and deeply different.
dheesh_gita::603.detailed_meaning: The teacher explains how devotees who have attained liberation perceive the world not as ordinary but as something transcendent, revealing their deep inner freedom and transformed vision.
dheesh_gita::603.modern_relevance: When you feel truly free inside, everyday situations reveal unexpected depth and meaning beyond surface appearances.
dheesh_gita::603.insight: It shifts your perspective from seeing things as merely external to experiencing their deeper, unseen nature.

dheesh_gita::604.verse_sanskrit:
संसारं मे प्रकृत्यैतं प्रसूतं सर्वथाऽद्भुतम् ।
आकाश इव गान्धर्व पश्यन्तो नगरं मुहुः ॥
dheesh_gita::604.verse_hindi: हे विप्रवरो! ये मेरी प्रकृतिप्रसूत सर्वथा अद्भुत इस संसार को आकाश में गन्धर्व नगर के समान बार बार देखकर
dheesh_gita::604.english_translation: O best of the wise, these wondrous worlds born of my nature are like the Gandharva city in the sky, seen again and again.
dheesh_gita::604.translation_literal: संसारं (world) / मे (my) / प्रकृत्यैतं (from nature this) / प्रसूतं (born) / सर्वथाऽद्भुतम् (wonderful in all ways) / आकाश (sky) / इव (like) / गान्धर्व (Gandharva) / पश्यन्तो (seeing) / नगरं (city) / मुहुः (again and again)
dheesh_gita::604.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::604.essence: The world is a wondrous, repeated vision born from nature’s creative power.
dheesh_gita::604.simple_meaning: These worlds born from my nature are extraordinary and repeatedly seen like the Gandharva city in the sky.
dheesh_gita::604.simple_insight: The world you see is a wondrous, repeating vision originating in nature's play.
dheesh_gita::604.detailed_meaning: The speaker addresses a wise listener, describing the entire manifested world as a miraculous creation born of nature, comparable to the mystical Gandharva city in the sky that appears repeatedly, emphasizing the wondrous, impermanent, and illusory quality of the world.
dheesh_gita::604.insight: It invites you to see the world’s marvel and recurring illusions as nature’s creative expression.

dheesh_gita::605.verse_sanskrit:
मिथ्यैव तत्स्वरूपञ्च जानन्तोऽपि द्विजोत्तमाः।
दर्श दर्श प्रमोदन्ते तद्रूपं कौतुकप्रदम् ॥
dheesh_gita::605.verse_hindi: और उसके स्वरुप को मिथ्या ही जानते हुए भी उस कौतुकप्रद रूप को देख देखकर आनन्दित होते हैं
dheesh_gita::605.english_translation: Even the best of the twice-born know that its nature is false, yet they delight in that fascinating form.
dheesh_gita::605.translation_literal: मिथ्यैव (false indeed) तत् (that) स्वरूपञ्च (nature) जानन्तः (knowing) अपि (even) द्विजोत्तमाः (the best of the twice-born) दर्श (form) दर्श (form) प्रमोदन्ते (delight) तद् (that) रूपं (form) कौतुकप्रदम् (fascinating/giving wonder)
dheesh_gita::605.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::605.essence: Knowing that something is false does not stop you from enjoying its appealing form.
dheesh_gita::605.simple_meaning: Even those who understand that something is not truly real can still enjoy its attractive appearance.
dheesh_gita::605.simple_insight: There is a subtle pleasure in appearances, even when you know they are not ultimately true.
dheesh_gita::605.detailed_meaning: The verse describes how wise people, even those highly learned, recognize that the world’s apparent forms are not ultimately real, but they still find joy in experiencing their fascinating shapes and colors.
dheesh_gita::605.modern_relevance: You might understand a story or image is fictional, yet you still get caught up in its excitement and beauty.
dheesh_gita::605.insight: It teaches you to accept that knowing something is illusory doesn't stop natural attraction or delight in its appearance.

dheesh_gita::606.verse_hindi: वह इस संसार को मृगमरीचिकापवत् अनेक भ्रमयुक्त, इन्द्रजालवत् मिथ्या प्रपञ्चो का मूल
dheesh_gita::606.english_translation: The entire world is like a mirage, full of illusions and false wonders, rooted in unreal appearance.
dheesh_gita::606.translation_literal: मृगतृष्णासमं (like a mirage) / विश्वं (the world) / भ्रान्तिस्तोमसमाकुलम (full of illusions and confusion) / दृष्ट्वेन्द्रजालवन्मिथ्या-प्रपञ्चावलिमूलकम (appearing as false magic, the root of all false appearance)
dheesh_gita::606.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::606.essence: The world appears real but is fundamentally an illusion of false appearances.
dheesh_gita::606.simple_meaning: The world you perceive is like a mirage—full of illusions and false appearances that do not hold true reality.
dheesh_gita::606.simple_insight: You can feel relief knowing much of what you see is not as solid as it seems.
dheesh_gita::606.detailed_meaning: This verse describes the world as a mirage, full of illusions and false wonders like magical tricks. It points to the unreal nature of worldly appearance, encouraging a deeper understanding beyond surface impressions.
dheesh_gita::606.modern_relevance: You scroll through endless social media images that promise joy but feel empty—this verse reminds you to see beyond such illusions.
dheesh_gita::606.insight: It shifts your view from trusting surface appearances to questioning their reality and seeking deeper truth.

dheesh_gita::607.verse_sanskrit:
मम शक्तेर्गुणानाञ्च परिणामस्वरूपकम् ।
तत्र नैव प्रसज्जन्ते पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसि ॥
dheesh_gita::607.verse_hindi: और मेरी शक्ति के ही गुणौ का परिणाम स्वरूप देखकर उसमें फंसते ही नहीं। जल में पद्म पत्र के समान
dheesh_gita::607.english_translation: The lotus leaf does not stick to water, similarly my power's qualities do not adhere to it.
dheesh_gita::607.translation_literal: मम (my) शक्तेः (power's) गुणानां (qualities) च (also) परिणाम-स्वरूपकम् (as consequence-form) तत्र (there) नैव (not at all) प्रसज्जन्ते (stick) पद्मपत्रम् (lotus leaf) इव (like) आम्भसि (in water)
dheesh_gita::607.speaker: Shambhu
dheesh_gita::607.essence: True inner power remains untouched by the qualities and effects it produces.
dheesh_gita::607.simple_meaning: Your inner power's qualities do not cling to you, just as water does not stick to a lotus leaf.
dheesh_gita::607.simple_insight: You can remain unaffected and free despite everything happening around you.
dheesh_gita::607.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shambhu explains that just as a lotus leaf stays dry and clean despite being in water, the qualities arising from the divine power do not cling or bind. This shows the nature of freedom from attachment.
dheesh_gita::607.modern_relevance: You face criticism and challenges daily, yet you can stay clear and unaffected, like water sliding off a lotus leaf.
dheesh_gita::607.insight: It teaches you to observe qualities and situations without letting them stick or disturb your inner balance.

dheesh_gita::608.verse_sanskrit:
तिष्ठन्तोऽपि प्रपञ्चेषु पृथग्भूतास्ततो ध्रुवम् ।
भवितुं ह्येतदेवाऽहर्ये लक्ष्यमुच्चपदं हितम् ॥
dheesh_gita::608.verse_hindi: यह इस प्रपञ्च में रहकर भी  उससे अलग ही रहते हैं।
dheesh_gita::608.english_translation: Even while remaining in this world, they remain distinct and steady, destined to reach the highest goal.
dheesh_gita::608.translation_literal: तिष्ठन्तः (remaining) अपि (even) प्रपञ्चेषु (in the world/manifestation) पृथक्भूताः (separate beings) ततो (thereafter) ध्रुवम् (steadily) भवितुम् (to become) हि (indeed) एते (these) एव (only) अहर्ह्ये (worthy) लक्ष्यम् (goal) उच्चपदम् (highest) हितम् (beneficial).
dheesh_gita::608.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::608.essence: You can live fully in the world yet remain steady and separate from its changes.
dheesh_gita::608.simple_meaning: Some beings live in the world but remain steady and separate from it, aiming for a higher goal.
dheesh_gita::608.simple_insight: You can be present in life but not lost in it.
dheesh_gita::608.detailed_meaning: In this verse, a teaching emerges that certain beings—perhaps enlightened or awakened—live within the ever-changing world yet remain unshaken and distinct from its fluctuations, aiming steadily toward a supreme goal beyond worldly change.
dheesh_gita::608.modern_relevance: You sit in a busy café, surrounded by chatter and movement, yet your mind stays calm and untouched by the noise.
dheesh_gita::608.insight: It teaches you to remain steady and separate in your inner being, even amidst external turmoil.

dheesh_gita::609.verse_sanskrit:
श्रेष्ठानां ब्राह्मणानां हि सर्वत्रैव सुखावहम् ।
परीवारोपमास्तेषां संसारा अखिला अमी। ॥
dheesh_gita::609.verse_hindi: श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणों का यही सर्वत्र ही सुखप्रद हितकर उच्चपद लक्ष्यरूप होना चाहिये । उनके लिये यह समस्त संसार परिवार के समान है
dheesh_gita::609.english_translation: The highest Brahmins should be a source of happiness everywhere; for them, the entire world is like family.
dheesh_gita::609.translation_literal: श्रेष्ठानां (of the best) ब्राह्मणानां (Brahmins) हि (indeed) सर्वत्रैव (everywhere) सुखावहम् (bringing happiness) । परीवारोपमास्तेषां (for them like family) संसारा (the world) अखिला (whole) अमी (is) ॥
dheesh_gita::609.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::609.essence: True greatness is bringing happiness by seeing all as family everywhere.
dheesh_gita::609.simple_meaning: The best people should bring happiness everywhere and treat the whole world like their own family.
dheesh_gita::609.simple_insight: Feeling connected to everyone as family creates a deep, lasting joy within you.
dheesh_gita::609.detailed_meaning: The verse teaches that the highest Brahmins, known for their wisdom and conduct, should spread happiness universally and view all beings as their own family, breaking down barriers and fostering unity.
dheesh_gita::609.modern_relevance: When you treat coworkers, neighbors, or strangers as part of your family, your daily interactions become kinder and more meaningful.
dheesh_gita::609.insight: It shifts your view from separation to unity, encouraging you to act with universal care and joy.

dheesh_gita::610.verse_sanskrit:
देवर्षिपितृसङ्घाश्च तदर्थ बान्धवोपमाः ।
साज्यं वाऽऽदेयमप्यस्ति तेषां नैवेह किञ्चन ॥
dheesh_gita::610.verse_hindi: देवता ऋषि और पितृगण उनके लिये बान्धव हैं। उनके लिये इस संसार में  गृहणीय भी कुछ नहीं ही है और त्याग करने योग्य भी कुछ नहीं ही है
dheesh_gita::610.english_translation: The devas, sages, and ancestral spirits are like relatives to them; for these beings, nothing in this world is truly to be taken or abandoned.
dheesh_gita::610.translation_literal: देवर्षि (devas and sages) / पितृसङ्घाश्च (and ancestral groups) / तदर्थ (for that purpose) / बान्धवोपमाः (like relatives) / साज्यं (to be taken) / वा (or) / आदेयम् (to be abandoned) / अपि (even) / अस्ति (exists) / तेषां (for them) / नैव (not at all) / एह (here) / किञ्चन (anything)
dheesh_gita::610.speaker: Narrator
dheesh_gita::610.essence: Some beings relate closely but do not claim or reject anything in the world.
dheesh_gita::610.simple_meaning: Devas, sages, and ancestors are like family to some, but for them, nothing in this world is truly owned or discarded.
dheesh_gita::610.simple_insight: It feels freeing to realize that clinging and rejecting have no real hold on the divine-like beings.
dheesh_gita::610.detailed_meaning: The narrator explains that beings such as devas, sages, and ancestors are considered like relatives, but for these beings, worldly possessions or renunciations have no real significance. This sets a context about transcendence beyond material attachments, but the verse alone is not a full teaching.
dheesh_gita::610.insight: Recognize that attachment and rejection are constructs not binding to higher beings or your deeper self.

dheesh_gita::611.verse_sanskrit:
पितरौ च कुलं जाति स्थूलदेहेन कुर्वते ।
निखिलां पृथिवीं धन्यां मातृभूमि विशेषतः ॥
dheesh_gita::611.verse_hindi: वह स्थूल शरीर से माता पिता कुल जाति और समस्त पथिवी को और विशेषतः जन्म भूमि को धन्य करते हैं।
dheesh_gita::611.english_translation: Parents bless their family, lineage, and the entire earth, especially their birth land, through their physical body.
dheesh_gita::611.translation_literal: पितरौ (parents) च (also) कुलं (family) जाति (lineage) स्थूलदेहेन (with physical body) कुर्वते (do). निखिलां (entire) पृथिवीं (earth) धन्यां (blessed) मातृभूमि (birth land) विशेषतः (especially).
dheesh_gita::611.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::611.essence: Parents bless family, lineage, and land through their physical existence.
dheesh_gita::611.simple_meaning: Parents bless their family, lineage, and the whole earth especially their birth land through their physical existence.
dheesh_gita::611.simple_insight: Parents' physical presence brings a unique blessing to their family and homeland.
dheesh_gita::611.detailed_meaning: This verse acknowledges how parents, through their physical bodies and presence, bring blessings to their family, lineage, and especially their birth land, emphasizing the importance of their role in sustaining and honoring heritage.
dheesh_gita::611.insight: It highlights how our embodied presence supports and honors our connections to family and place.

dheesh_gita::612.verse_sanskrit:
दैवीच जगतीं सूक्ष्मां सूक्ष्मदेहेन कुर्वते ।
सर्वदा सर्वथा धन्यां ते विमा नैव संशयः ॥
dheesh_gita::612.verse_hindi: हे विप्रो! वे सूक्ष्मशरीर से सूक्ष्मदैवी जगत् को सब प्रकार से सर्वदा धन्य कहते हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
dheesh_gita::612.english_translation: O wise one! The subtle divine being always blesses the subtle world in every way without doubt.
dheesh_gita::612.translation_literal: दैवीच (divine being-only) जगतीं (world) सूक्ष्मां (subtle) सूक्ष्मदेहेन (by subtle body) कुर्वते (does) । सर्वदा (always) सर्वथा (in every way) धन्यां (blessed) ते (them) विमा (without) नैव (not) संशयः (doubt) ॥
dheesh_gita::612.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::612.essence: The subtle divine continuously and unquestionably blesses the subtle world in every way.
dheesh_gita::612.simple_meaning: The subtle divine presence continuously blesses the subtle world in every way without any doubt or interruption.
dheesh_gita::612.simple_insight: You can feel certain that a subtle divine power supports all aspects of the world always.
dheesh_gita::612.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the teacher addresses a wise student, affirming that the subtle divine being constantly and completely blesses the subtle world through a subtle body. This reassurance emphasizes the unwavering, ever-present support from the divine in the subtle realms.
dheesh_gita::612.modern_relevance: Even when things feel invisible or intangible, you can trust that subtle forces support and bless your life continuously.
dheesh_gita::612.insight: This verse shifts your view to recognize unseen, continuous support beyond the obvious, grounding trust in subtle reality.

dheesh_gita::613.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्मानन्दसुसन्दोहसविलासस्वरूपतः।
धन्यं धन्यं पुनर्धन्यं कुर्वते मामसंशयम् ॥
dheesh_gita::613.verse_hindi: और ब्रह्मानन्द सुसन्दोह के सम्यक् विलास स्वरूप से नि:सन्देह मुझे धन्य धन्य करते हैं
dheesh_gita::613.english_translation: And the supreme bliss, perfectly manifested, undoubtedly makes me truly blessed again and again.
dheesh_gita::613.translation_literal: ब्रह्मानन्द (supreme bliss) / सुसन्दोह (perfectly manifested) / सविलासस्वरूपतः (with playful form) / धन्यं (blessed) / धन्यं (blessed) / पुनः (again) / धन्यं (blessed) / कुर्वते (makes) / माम् (me) / असंशयम् (without doubt)
dheesh_gita::613.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::613.essence: Pure joy in devotion makes you unquestionably blessed.
dheesh_gita::613.simple_meaning: The deep, perfect joy of the divine presence fills you with clear, undeniable blessing.
dheesh_gita::613.simple_insight: You can feel truly blessed by recognizing the pure joy within devotion.
dheesh_gita::613.detailed_meaning: In a moment of devotional reflection, the speaker acknowledges how the supreme bliss fully and unmistakably blesses them, highlighting the overflowing joy that devotion brings.
dheesh_gita::613.modern_relevance: When you pause and feel a moment of pure joy and connection, it reminds you how blessed you truly are beyond any doubt.
dheesh_gita::613.insight: It shifts your attention from external achievements to the inner joy that blesses your whole being.

dheesh_gita::614.verse_sanskrit:
हे सर्वज्ञ ! जगन्निवास ! भगवन् ! देवादिदेव ! प्रभो !
हे सर्वादिगुरो ! दयार्णव ! विभो ! विश्वेश ! विश्वम्भर ।
अस्माकं भवतामपारकृपया नूनं तृतीय वरमद्यान्तनयनात्मकं
सुविमलं ज्ञानाक्षि प्रोन्मीलितम् ॥
dheesh_gita::614.verse_hindi: हे प्रभो ! हे भगवन् ! हे सर्वज्ञ ! हे दयार्णव ! हे विश्वेश! हे देवादिदेव ! हे जगन्निवास ! हे सब गुरुओं के आदिगुरु ! हे विश्वम्भर ! हे विभो ! आपकी अपार कृपा से आज हमारा अन्तर्नेत्र रूपी ज्ञाननेत्र जो श्रेष्ठ  निर्मल तृतीय नेत्र है सो निश्चय ही खुल गया है
dheesh_gita::614.english_translation: O Lord! O divine! O all-knowing! O ocean of mercy! O lord of the universe! O highest of gods! O world-resident! O primordial teacher of all gurus! O sustainer of the world! By your boundless grace, today our inner eye of knowledge, the pure and supreme third eye, has surely opened.
dheesh_gita::614.translation_literal: हे (O) सर्वज्ञ (all-knowing) ! जगन्निवास (world-resident) ! भगवन् (divine) ! देवादिदेव (highest of gods) ! प्रभो (lord) ! हे (O) सर्वादिगुरो (primordial teacher of all gurus) ! दयार्णव (ocean of mercy) ! विभो (lord) ! विश्वेश (lord of the universe) ! विश्वम्भर (sustainer of the world) । अस्माकं (our) भवताम् (your) अपारकृपया (boundless grace) नूनं (indeed) तृतीय (third) वरमद्यान्तनयनात्मकं (supreme inner eye) सुविमलं (pure) ज्ञानाक्षि (eye of knowledge) प्रोन्मीलितम् (has opened) ॥
dheesh_gita::614.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::614.essence: Boundless grace opens the pure inner eye of knowledge within you.
dheesh_gita::614.simple_meaning: By the boundless grace of the divine teacher, our pure inner eye of knowledge has opened today.
dheesh_gita::614.simple_insight: There is profound gratitude when clarity and insight arise through a compassionate guide.
dheesh_gita::614.detailed_meaning: In a moment of reverence, the speaker praises the divine teacher by many exalted titles and expresses heartfelt gratitude for the opening of the inner knowledge eye, symbolizing new insight and clarity.
dheesh_gita::614.insight: Acknowledging the role of compassionate guidance helps you recognize moments of sudden clarity and growth.

dheesh_gita::615.verse_sanskrit:
पश्यामोऽद्य भवद्दयोदयवशाद्वारे मणीनां गणान
सूत्रं प्रोतमिवान्तरेण निखिलब्रह्माण्डपिण्डवज्रे।
सर्वेषां कुरुते सदैकविधिनाऽनुस्यूततामाप्तवान
चैतन्यास्तितयोर्विधानमाखिलं शश्वद्भवानित्यहो ॥
dheesh_gita::615.verse_hindi: आप की कृपा के उदय से अब हम देखते हैं कि आप जैसे माला में मणिगण के बीच पिरोया हुआ सूत्र रहता है उसी प्रकार सब पिण्ड और सब ब्रह्माण्डों में एकरूप से सदा अनुस्यूत रहकर अहो! सबके अस्तित्व और सबके चैतन्य का सम्पूर्ण विधान निरन्तर करते हैं
dheesh_gita::615.english_translation: By your grace rising now, we see that just as a string holds together a garland of jewels, similarly all individual beings and all universes remain eternally united and sustained by one continuous order of existence and consciousness.
dheesh_gita::615.translation_literal: पश्यामोऽद्य (We see today) भवद्दयोदयवशाद्वारे (by your grace rising) मणीनां (of jewels) गणान (clusters) सूत्रं (string) प्रोतमिव (woven) अन्तरेण (in between) निखिलब्रह्माण्डपिण्डवज्रे (all-universe-individual-entities-diamond-like) सर्वेषां (of all) कुरुते (makes) सदैकविधिनाऽनुस्यूततामाप्तवान (always one-kind-firmly-connected) चैतन्यास्तितयोर्विधानम् (consciousness-existence-orders) अखिलं (whole) शश्वद्भवानित्यहो (always being, ah!)
dheesh_gita::615.speaker: Suta
dheesh_gita::615.essence: All existence is eternally connected and sustained like jewels strung on one thread.
dheesh_gita::615.simple_meaning: Everything that exists—every being and universe—is connected and continuously sustained like jewels strung on one thread.
dheesh_gita::615.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing all existence is united by a single sustaining order.
dheesh_gita::615.detailed_meaning: Suta describes how, by divine grace, all beings and universes are like jewels strung together on one invisible thread, maintained eternally by a single continuous order of consciousness and existence. This verse celebrates universal unity beyond apparent separateness.
dheesh_gita::615.modern_relevance: You see how your relationships, work, and life connect in unseen ways, all held together by one steady presence.
dheesh_gita::615.insight: It teaches you to sense the invisible unity behind all diversity, feeling connected beyond separation.

dheesh_gita::616.verse_sanskrit:
पश्यामस्तरतो गृहेऽपरिमितान् भूयो यथाऽनन्त ! हे
रन्ध्रद्वारनिविष्टसूर्यकिरणस्तोमेष्वणूनां गणान् ।
ब्रह्माण्डानि तथा तरन्ति च विराडदेहाश्रितानि प्रभोनधिन्ते
विपुलेऽमितानि वियति प्रोद्योतयन्ति ह्यमुम् ॥
dheesh_gita::616.verse_hindi: पुनः हे अनन्त ! जिस प्रकार घर में छिद्ररूप मार्ग से, प्रविष्ट सूर्य किरणों में तैरते हुए अपरिमित अणु समूह को हम देखते हैं उस प्रकार आदि अन्त रहित महाकाश में अनन्त ब्रह्माण्ड समूह आपके विराट देह को आश्रय करके तैर रहे हैं और शोभा को निश्चय ही बढ़ा रहे हैं
dheesh_gita::616.english_translation: Again, O infinite one, just as countless atoms float in sun rays entering through holes in a house, similarly, countless universes swim in the infinite space, residing in your cosmic form, surely enhancing its radiance.
dheesh_gita::616.translation_literal: पश्यामः (we see) स्तरतः (through holes) गृहेऽपरिमितान् (countless) भूयो (again) यथा (just as) अनन्त (infinite) हे (O) रन्ध्रद्वारनिविष्ट (entered through door holes) सूर्यकिरण (sun rays) स्तोमेष्वणूनां (of atoms) गणान् (groups) । ब्रह्माण्डानि (universes) तथा (also) तरन्ति (swim) च (and) विराडदेहाश्रितानि (residing in the cosmic form) प्रभोनधिन्ते (O lord) विपुलेऽमितानि (vast countless) वियति (spread) प्रोद्योतयन्ति (illuminate) ह्यमुम् (this)
dheesh_gita::616.speaker: Narrator
dheesh_gita::616.essence: Infinite universes reside within the cosmic form, like atoms in sun rays.
dheesh_gita::616.simple_meaning: Infinite universes exist within the cosmic form, like countless atoms floating in sun rays through house holes.
dheesh_gita::616.simple_insight: There is vastness within vastness, showing how limitless existence really is.
dheesh_gita::616.detailed_meaning: The narrator describes how countless tiny atoms float through sunlight entering a house, drawing a parallel to infinite universes residing and shining within the cosmic form of the divine, highlighting boundless cosmic scale.
dheesh_gita::616.insight: It expands your sense of scale, inviting awe at the infinite within and beyond you.

dheesh_gita::617.verse_sanskrit:
पश्यामश्च पुनर्वयं तव विरारूपं हि यत्राधना भात्यन्तो
हरितां न चादिरपि तद्देशस्य सन्दश्यते ।
पच्यामश्च पुनर्वयं तब महादेहे महाकौतुकम्
व्याप्तश्वाऽगणितविराड्वपुपि ते सूर्यग्रहोपग्रहैः ॥
dheesh_gita::617.verse_hindi: हम पुनः देख रहे हैं कि आपका विराटरूप जहां इस समय प्रकाशित हो रहा है उस देश की दिशाओं का न आदि और न अनन्त ही दिखाई देता है। हे महाकाल! हम पुनः आपके विराट् देह में महाकौतुक देख रहे हैं। आपके उस विराट् वपु में अनन्त सूर्य और अनन्त ग्रह उपग्रह द्वारा
dheesh_gita::617.english_translation: We see again that your cosmic form illuminates a realm with no beginning or end, filled with countless suns and planets.
dheesh_gita::617.translation_literal: पश्यामश्च (we see again) / पुनः (again) / वयं (we) / तव (your) / विरारूपं (cosmic form) / हि (indeed) / यत्र (where) / अधना (limit/boundary) / भात्यन्तः (shines) / हरितां (directions) / न (not) / च (and) / आदिरपि (beginning even) / तद्देशस्य (of that realm) / सन्दश्यते (is seen) । पच्यामश्च (we see again) / पुनः (again) / वयं (we) / तब (then) / महादेहे (in the great body) / महाकौतुकम् (great wonder) / व्याप्तश्व (pervaded) / अगणित (countless) / विराट् (cosmic) / उपपि (also) / ते (your) / सूर्यग्रहोपग्रहैः (by suns, planets, and satellites) ॥
dheesh_gita::617.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::617.essence: The cosmic form reveals an infinite universe filled with countless suns and planets.
dheesh_gita::617.simple_meaning: You are showing a vast cosmic form where no direction or end can be seen, filled with countless suns and planets.
dheesh_gita::617.simple_insight: The vastness of the divine form inspires awe beyond any human scale.
dheesh_gita::617.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the speaker witnesses Mahakala’s cosmic form, which is so vast it defies normal spatial limits, filled with countless radiant suns and planetary bodies, highlighting the divine's infinite and mysterious nature.
dheesh_gita::617.insight: It invites you to grasp the infinite complexity beyond everyday perception, expanding your sense of scale and wonder.

dheesh_gita::618.verse_sanskrit:
सडघात प्रतिघाततः परिणमन् ब्रह्माण्डमाण्डव्रजः
हान्योऽन्यं परमाणुल्पनिचयेऽनन्तो महाकाल है।
जायन्ते परमाणवश्च निखिला ब्रह्माण्डरूपाः पुनः
नानाकारयुताः प्रभो ! बहुविधाः प्रत्येकमेव क्षणम् ॥
dheesh_gita::618.verse_hindi: परिव्याप्त अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डसमृह आपस के घात प्रतिघात से परमाणुपुञ्ज सम्यक रूप से  परिणत हो रहे हैं और हे प्रभो! कहीं सभी परमाणुपुञ्ज सम्यकय रूप से पुन: घनीभूत होकर
dheesh_gita::618.english_translation: The infinite cosmos forms and transforms through countless collisions of atoms; all atoms continuously emerge and dissolve in diverse forms every moment.
dheesh_gita::618.translation_literal: सडघात (hundreds of collisions) / प्रतिघाततः (through opposing strikes) / परिणमन् (transforming) / ब्रह्माण्डमाण्डव्रजः (cosmic mass) / हान्योऽन्यं (another destroyed) / परमाणुल्पनिचये (in the atomic cluster) / अनन्तो (infinite) / महाकाल (great time) / है (is). / जायन्ते (are born) / परमाणवश्च (atoms also) / निखिला (all) / ब्रह्माण्डरूपाः (cosmic forms) / पुनः (again) / नानाकारयुताः (varied forms) / प्रभो (O Lord) / बहुविधाः (manifold) / प्रत्येकमेव (each indeed) / क्षणम् (moment).
dheesh_gita::618.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::618.essence: The universe is an endless flow of atoms forming and dissolving varied forms every moment.
dheesh_gita::618.simple_meaning: The entire universe is constantly changing as atoms collide and recombine, creating endless new forms every moment.
dheesh_gita::618.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing everything is always becoming something new, nothing stays fixed.
dheesh_gita::618.detailed_meaning: This verse describes the vast cosmic process where countless atoms continuously collide and transform, forming the universe’s countless ever-changing forms. It highlights the impermanence and ceaseless flux at the heart of existence.
dheesh_gita::618.modern_relevance: You watch a city skyline change over years, buildings rise and fall, reminding you that nothing truly stays the same.
dheesh_gita::618.insight: It shifts your view from clinging to permanence toward embracing constant transformation as natural and universal.

dheesh_gita::619.verse_sanskrit:
नक्षत्रावलिभिश्च नूनमखिलः क्वापि ग्रहोपग्रहैः
सूर्याद्योर्ही समावृताः सुमधनाः सन्तः परीणामतः ।
ब्रह्माण्डव्रजसम्भवक्षयविधिर्यत्र प्रभो ! भासते
काले तस्य न दृश्यते कथमपि त्वादिर्न चान्तः परम् ॥
dheesh_gita::619.verse_hindi: नक्षत्रसमूह और सूर्यादि अखिल ग्रहोपग्रहो से आवृत अनेक प्रकार के और अनेक आकृति वाले ब्रह्माण्ड रूपों में अनुक्षण ही परिणत हो रहे हैं। परन्तु हे प्रभो! इन ब्रह्माण्डसमूह की उत्पत्ति और लय का कार्य जिस काल में प्रतिभासित होता है उस काल का किसी प्रकार भी न आदि और न अन्त हमें दिखाई पड़ता है
dheesh_gita::619.english_translation: Countless cosmic forms, covered by clusters of stars and planets, continually arise and dissolve; yet the time of their creation and destruction shows no beginning or end.
dheesh_gita::619.translation_literal: नक्षत्रावलिभिश्च (by clusters of stars) नूनम् (indeed) अखिलः (all) क्वापि (anywhere) ग्रहोपग्रहैः (by planets and their groupings) सूर्याद्योः (from the sun and others) ही (indeed) समावृताः (covered) सुमधनाः (many-shaped) सन्तः (existing) परीणामतः (by transformation). ब्रह्माण्डव्रजसम्भवक्षयविधिः (the cycle of universe's arising and destruction) यत्र (where) प्रभो (O lord!) भासते (appears). काले (in time) तस्य (of that) न (not) दृश्यते (is seen) कथमपि (in any way) त्वादिः (beginning) न (nor) च (and) अन्तः (end) परम् (beyond).
dheesh_gita::619.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::619.essence: Time contains all change yet itself has no beginning or end.
dheesh_gita::619.simple_meaning: Many universes appear and disappear continuously, but the time they happen in has no visible beginning or end.
dheesh_gita::619.simple_insight: There's a vast mystery in how time holds all change without itself changing.
dheesh_gita::619.detailed_meaning: The verse reflects on countless cosmic forms emerging and dissolving, covered by stars and planets. It highlights that while these universes transform, the time in which this happens is boundless—without any perceivable start or end.
dheesh_gita::619.modern_relevance: Watching a clock tick endlessly, you realize moments pass but time itself feels infinite and ungraspable.
dheesh_gita::619.insight: It shifts your view from seeing change as linear to perceiving time as an endless, unmeasurable flow.

dheesh_gita::620.verse_sanskrit:
सार्द्धञ्चव  विरा्डइनन्तवपुपा प्रोतौतयोस्ते तयोः
नान्तो नादिरवेक्ष्यते किमपि चेद्देशस्य कालस्य च ।
द्रष्टुं तर्हि विराडनन्तपुपः शक्तः कथं कोऽप्यहो
आदि चान्तमशेषतः किमुत वै मूढा वताऽस्मादृशाः ॥
dheesh_gita::620.verse_hindi: आपके विराट रूप असीम देह के साथ ही ओतप्रोत उन देश और काल का जब आदि और अन्त कुछ भी हमें दिखाई नहीं पड़ता है तब अहो ! आपके विराटरूप असीम देह का आदि और अन्त निःशेषरूप से देखने में कोई भी किस प्रकार समर्थ हो सकता है और हमारे जैसे मूर्खों की तो बात ही क्या है
dheesh_gita::620.english_translation: Your cosmic form pervades all space and time, with no beginning or end; how could anyone, especially we fools, fully see its endlessness?
dheesh_gita::620.translation_literal: सार्धञ्चव (with vastness) विरा्डइनन्तवपुपा (cosmic infinite body) प्रोतौतयोस्ते (pervades both) तयोः (of the two) नान्तो (no end) नादि (no beginning) अवेक्ष्यते (is seen) किमपि (anything) चेद् (if) देशस्य (of space) कालस्य (of time) च (also) द्रष्टुं (to see) तर्हि (then) विराडनन्तपुपः (cosmic infinite body) शक्तः (able) कथं (how) कोऽपि (anyone) अहो (ah!) आदि (beginning) च (and) अन्तम् (end) अशेषतः (completely) किम् (how) उत (ever) मूढा (fools) वताऽस्मात् (like us) असीशाः (such)
dheesh_gita::620.speaker: Suta
dheesh_gita::620.essence: The infinite cosmic form has no boundaries; full comprehension is beyond anyone.
dheesh_gita::620.simple_meaning: The divine form fills all space and time without edges or limits, and no one can fully grasp its infinite nature.
dheesh_gita::620.simple_insight: There's awe and humility in facing something infinitely vast beyond human understanding.
dheesh_gita::620.detailed_meaning: Suta reflects on the divine's cosmic form that pervades all space and time, having no beginning or end, emphasizing how even wise beings struggle to fully see or understand this endlessness.
dheesh_gita::620.modern_relevance: Standing beneath a vast night sky, feeling the infinite universe overwhelm your mind, you glimpse how little you can truly grasp.
dheesh_gita::620.insight: This verse shifts your mind to embrace humility before the infinite, opening awareness beyond finite limits.

dheesh_gita::621.verse_sanskrit:
भूतस्रष्टरु ! भूतपालक! सदा हे भूतहारिन ! विभो !
अस्माभिनिखिलैरितीक्ष्यत इहानन्तानि भूयोऽपि ते।
ब्रह्माण्डानि पृथक् प्रकट्य प्रकृते: कर्मप्रवाहे पृथक
लीयन्ते प्रकृती स्वयं तव मुहुः सद्यो निविष्टानि च ॥
dheesh_gita::621.verse_hindi: हे सदा भूतस्रष्टा ! भूतः पालक ! भूतहारी विभो ! हम सब यहां फिर भी यह देखते हैं कि अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डसमूह पृथक पृथक रूप में आपकी प्रकृति से कर्म स्त्रोत में अपने आप ही प्रकट होकर अपने आप ही आपकी प्रकृति में सद्यः प्रवेश करके बारबार लय को प्राप्त होते हैं।
dheesh_gita::621.english_translation: O eternal creator, protector, and remover of beings, we see countless universes emerge separately from your nature, then dissolve back into it repeatedly within the flow of natural action.
dheesh_gita::621.translation_literal: भूतस्रष्टरु (creator of beings) / भूतपालक (protector of beings) / सदा (always) / हे (O) / भूतहारिन (remover of beings) / विभो (lord) / अस्माभि (from us) / निखिलैः (all) / ऋतीक्ष्यत (enduring) / इह (here) / अनन्तानि (countless) / भूयः (again) / अपि (also) / ते (your) / ब्रह्माण्डानि (universes) / पृथक् (separately) / प्रकट्य (manifesting) / प्रकृतेः (of nature) / कर्मप्रवाहे (in the flow of action) / पृथक् (separately) / लीयन्ते (dissolve) / प्रकृती (nature) / स्वयं (itself) / तव (your) / मुहुः (again) / सद्यो (immediately) / निविष्टानि (immersed) / च (and)
dheesh_gita::621.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::621.essence: Countless worlds arise and dissolve repeatedly within the natural flow governed by the divine principle.
dheesh_gita::621.simple_meaning: We observe countless universes arising independently from the natural flow of action and dissolving back repeatedly into the original nature.
dheesh_gita::621.simple_insight: Everything arises and dissolves repeatedly in the natural flow, beyond any single control.
dheesh_gita::621.detailed_meaning: The speaker acknowledges the divine as the eternal creator, protector, and remover of beings. Despite this, they witness countless universes manifesting separately from this nature through the natural flow of actions and dissolving back repeatedly. This reflects the ongoing cycle within the natural world governed by the divine principle.
dheesh_gita::621.modern_relevance: You notice how systems around you—like markets or ecosystems—constantly change, emerging and dissolving without your control.
dheesh_gita::621.insight: It shifts your view from fixed outcomes to seeing reality as ongoing cycles of emergence and dissolution within nature's flow.

dheesh_gita::622.verse_sanskrit:
जायन्ते प्रकृतहि पिण्डनिवहास्ते भूतभावोद्भव
कृद्रूपेण चितो जड़ेन सह यो ग्रन्थिविसर्गेण वै ।
तद्रूपाः परमाणुतो हयगणिताः प्रत्येकतो हि स्वतः
कर्मस्रोतसि ते प्रविश्य प्रकृतौ लीयन्त एवं ततः॥
dheesh_gita::622.verse_hindi: उसी कर्म स्रोत में अपने आप ही प्रत्येक परमाणु से भूतभावोद्भवकर विसर्ग द्वारा आपकी ही प्रति से चिजडग्रन्धिरूपी अनन्त पिण्ड प्रकट होते हैं और दूसरी ओर अपने आप ही आप की प्रकृति में प्रवेश करके लय को प्राप्त होते हैं
dheesh_gita::622.english_translation: From that same source of action, infinite material particles emerge by spontaneous release, each bound by inert knots, then dissolve back into nature.
dheesh_gita::622.translation_literal: जायन्ते (are born) प्रकृतहि (from nature) पिण्डनिवहास्ते (clusters of particles) भूतभावोद्भव (arising from material existence) कृद्रूपेण (in the form of knots) चितः (mind) जड़ेन (with inert) सह (together) यो (which) ग्रन्थिविसर्गेण (by knot-release) वै (indeed) तद्रूपाः (those forms) परमाणुतो (from atoms) हयगणिताः (countless as horses) प्रत्येकतो (each) हि (indeed) स्वतः (by themselves) कर्मस्रोतसि (in the stream of action) ते (they) प्रविश्य (entering) प्रकृतौ (into nature) लीयन्त (dissolve) एवं (thus) ततः (thereafter)
dheesh_gita::622.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::622.essence: All forms arise naturally from action and return to nature without your interference.
dheesh_gita::622.simple_meaning: Endless forms arise from the flow of action by natural release and then dissolve back into nature on their own.
dheesh_gita::622.simple_insight: There's peace in knowing all things arise and fade naturally beyond your control.
dheesh_gita::622.detailed_meaning: This verse describes how countless material particles appear spontaneously from the source of action and then dissolve back into nature. It shows the natural cycle of arising and passing away beyond mind or will, revealing the impermanence of forms.
dheesh_gita::622.modern_relevance: Like watching bubbles form and pop in a stream, you can see how situations arise and dissolve beyond your control.
dheesh_gita::622.insight: It shifts your focus from grasping results to witnessing the natural flow of arising and dissolving.

dheesh_gita::623.verse_sanskrit:
पश्यामश्च भवाननन्तनयनो हे विश्वचक्षुः ! क्रमात
पिण्डौघस्य गति प्रपश्यति सदा ब्रह्माण्डपुञ्जस्य च ।
आकृप्याभिमुखं निजस्य नयने धर्मस्य शक्तया
च तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वपलौकिकं हि चकिता बुद्धिर्न पताशम ॥
dheesh_gita::623.verse_hindi: हे विश्वचक्षु ! हम लोग पुनः देखते हैं कि आप अनन्त नेत्र होकर पिण्डसमूह और ब्राह्माण्डसमूह की गति को निरन्तर देखते हो और अपनी धर्मशक्ति के द्वारा क्रमशः उनको अपनी ओर आकर्षित करते जाते हो। इस प्रकार के सब चमत्कारों को देखकर हमारी बुद्धि चकित हो रही है ॥
dheesh_gita::623.english_translation: O all-seeing one! We see you with infinite eyes constantly observing the movements of the individual and cosmic realms, drawing them toward yourself by the power of your dharma. Witnessing such wonders, our minds are astonished.
dheesh_gita::623.translation_literal: पश्यामश्च (we see) / भवान् (you) / अनन्तनयनो (infinite-eyed) / हे (O) / विश्वचक्षुः (all-seeing one) / क्रमात् (in order) / पिण्डौघस्य (of the individual aggregate) / गति (movement) / प्रपश्यति (observes) / सदा (always) / ब्रह्माण्डपुञ्जस्य (of the cosmic cluster) / च (and) / आकृप्य (drawing) / अभिमुखं (towards oneself) / निजस्य (own) / नयने (by the eye) / धर्मस्य (of dharma) / शक्तया (by the power) / च (and) / तं (that) / दृष्ट्वा (having seen) / सर्वपलौकिकं (all miraculous) / हि (indeed) / चकिता (astonished) / बुद्धिः (mind) / न (not) / पताशम (stable)
dheesh_gita::623.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::623.essence: A presence with infinite vision observes and draws all worlds, inspiring awe.
dheesh_gita::623.simple_meaning: The verse describes a divine presence with infinite vision who continuously watches and draws the movements of individual and cosmic realms, leaving the observer's mind amazed.
dheesh_gita::623.simple_insight: You can feel awe when witnessing the vast order beyond ordinary perception.
dheesh_gita::623.detailed_meaning: In this scene, someone addresses a divine figure described as having infinite eyes and the power to observe and attract the motions of both the individual (micro) and cosmic (macro) worlds. This amazes the observer's mind, highlighting the mysterious vastness and order behind existence.
dheesh_gita::623.insight: It invites you to acknowledge a larger order that quietly guides complex systems beyond your usual awareness.

dheesh_gita::624.verse_sanskrit:
पश्याम पुनरप्पनन्ननिखिलब्रह्माण्डपिण्डावले:
श्रोत्रानन्ययुनः शृणोनि सततं भूयो भवान प्रार्थनाम ।
चिच्छतया चितिसंयुताभ विदधना विश्वचेतः क्रमान
सान्निध्यं च यथोचरं निजमहोनस्य दिशन् राजते ॥
dheesh_gita::624.verse_hindi: हे विश्वचेता ! हम फिर भी देखते हैं कि आप अनन्तकर्ण होकर सब अनन्त ब्रह्माण्ड और सब अनन्त पिण्डो  की प्रार्थना निरन्तर श्रवण करते हैं और चितिशति द्वारा उनको क्रमशः उत्तरोत्तर चेतनायुक्त करते हुए और अहो ! उनको आप अपना सानिध्य देते हुए विराजमान हैं
dheesh_gita::624.english_translation: O universal consciousness, you eternally listen to the endless prayers of all infinite worlds, progressively enlivening them with consciousness and graciously granting your presence to each.
dheesh_gita::624.translation_literal: पश्याम (we see) पुनः (again) अप्पननिखिलब्रह्माण्डपिण्डावलेः (all infinite universes and cosmic particles) श्रोत्रानन्ययुनः (eternal listener) शृणोनि (listening) सततं (continually) भूयो (again and again) भवान (you) प्रार्थनाम (prayers) चिच्छतया (by enlivening) चितिसंयुताभ (with consciousness united) विदधना (placing) विश्वचेतः (O universal consciousness) क्रमान (gradually) सान्निध्यं (presence) च (and) यथोचरं (properly) निजमहोनस्य (your own great light) दिशन् (granting) राजते (shining)
dheesh_gita::624.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::624.essence: Universal consciousness eternally listens and enlivenes all infinite worlds with its presence.
dheesh_gita::624.simple_meaning: The universal consciousness listens to endless prayers from all worlds, enlivening them and giving them its presence constantly.
dheesh_gita::624.simple_insight: There is a vast, ongoing connection between the divine and all existence, always attentive and enlivening.
dheesh_gita::624.detailed_meaning: This verse praises universal consciousness as the eternal listener who hears all prayers from infinite worlds and particles. It describes how this consciousness progressively awakens them and grants its presence, highlighting its all-pervading nature amid cosmic vastness.
dheesh_gita::624.insight: It invites recognizing a continuous, conscious connection between all existence and the supreme awareness, beyond time and space.

dheesh_gita::625.verse_sanskrit:
पश्यामश्च भवानन्तरमनायुक्तः मुहत्त्वं गतः
बुद्धे रूपमधिधितो रसमय ! ब्रमाण्डपिण्डावलंः ।
मध्येऽध्यान्मपदे विविच्य परमानन्दान्मकं प्राणिनः
सर्वान दर्शयते गुरो ! निजकृपालेशन लोकाश्रय ! ॥
dheesh_gita::625.verse_hindi: हे रसमय ! हम पुनः देखते हैं कि आप अनन्त रसनायुक्त होकर ब्रह्माण्डसमूह और अनन्त पिण्डसमूह में  बुद्धिरूप से सुह्रद्भाव में रहकर हे लोकाश्रयगुरो! आप सब प्राणियो को अपने कृपाकण से विवेकपूर्वक परमानन्दमय अध्यात्मपद दिखा देते हो
dheesh_gita::625.english_translation: O Rasamaya, you are infinite and inseparable, residing as wisdom within the cosmic and individual universes. You discern and reveal the supreme blissful spiritual state to all beings with compassionate grace, O refuge of the world, O Guru.
dheesh_gita::625.translation_literal: पश्याम (we see) अश्च (also) भवान् (you) अन्तर (within) अमनायुक्तः (inseparable) मुहत्त्वं (infinite) गतः (gone/placed) बुद्धे (in wisdom) रूपम् (form) अधिधितः (residing over) रसमय (Rasamaya) ब्रमाण्डपिण्डावलंः (cosmic and individual universes) मध्ये (in the middle) अध्यान्मपदे (in supreme spiritual state) विविच्य (discerning) परमानन्दान्मकम् (supreme blissful) प्राणिनः (beings) सर्वान (all) दर्शयते (shows) गुरु (teacher) निजकृपालेशन (own compassionate grace) लोकाश्रय (refuge of the world)
dheesh_gita::625.speaker: Narrator
dheesh_gita::625.essence: Infinite compassionate wisdom reveals supreme blissful truth to every being.
dheesh_gita::625.simple_meaning: You exist as infinite wisdom within all things and kindly show every being the highest joyful spiritual state.
dheesh_gita::625.simple_insight: There is a gentle, infinite wisdom patiently guiding all beings toward deep joy.
dheesh_gita::625.detailed_meaning: The verse addresses Rasamaya, a divine figure embodying infinite wisdom within the vast cosmos and individual worlds. It describes how Rasamaya compassionately reveals the supreme blissful spiritual state to all beings, acting as a gracious teacher and refuge.
dheesh_gita::625.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by complexity, there's a quiet inner wisdom patiently guiding you toward peace and joy, even if unseen.
dheesh_gita::625.insight: It shifts your trust from external certainty to the compassionate unfolding of wisdom within all experience.

dheesh_gita::626.verse_sanskrit:
हे तेजोमय ! तेजसाञ्च निवहाना हे खने ! दृश्यत
त्वं स्पर्शेन्द्रियपुज्जकुजनिकरै: स्पृष्ट्वा हानन्तैर्युतः ।
स्वैस्तेजोनिवहैरनन्तगणितब्रह्माण्डपिण्डावर्ली
सर्वा स्वाभिमुखं प्रकृप्य पतनाच्छश्वद्रिभा ! रक्षारी ॥
dheesh_gita::626.verse_hindi: हे सकल तेजों के खनिरूप तेजोमय ! हम पुन: देखते हैं कि आप अनन्त स्पर्शन्द्रिय समूह से युक्त होकर अगणित और अनन्त ब्रह्माण्ड और पिण्डसमूह को अपने तेजों के द्वारा स्पर्श करके सबको अपनी ओर निरन्तर खींच कर हे विभो ! उनका पतन होने नहीं देते हो
dheesh_gita::626.english_translation: O radiant one who is the mine of all light! We see you touching countless worlds and beings with your endless rays, drawing all toward yourself and preventing their fall.
dheesh_gita::626.translation_literal: हे (O) तेजोमय (radiant one) ! तेजसाञ्च (of light mine) निवहाना (being) हे (O) खने (mine) ! दृश्यत (we see) त्वं (you) स्पर्शेन्द्रियपुज्जुजनिकरैः (with countless touch senses) स्पृष्ट्वा (having touched) हानन्तैः युतः (with those that cause fall) । स्वैः (own) तेजोनिवहैः (with rays carrying) अनन्तगणित (countless infinite) ब्रह्माण्डपिण्डावर्ली (worlds and bodies) सर्वा (all) स्वाभिमुखं (towards yourself) प्रकृप्य (drawing) पतनाच्छश्वद्रिभा (not allowing fall, shining always) ! रक्षारी (protector) ॥
dheesh_gita::626.speaker: Narrator
dheesh_gita::626.essence: A radiant source continuously upholds and draws countless worlds, preventing their fall.
dheesh_gita::626.simple_meaning: The radiant being is described as the source of all light, touching countless worlds with endless rays, drawing them to itself and preventing their downfall.
dheesh_gita::626.simple_insight: There is a steady, protective power drawing everything upward and holding it from falling.
dheesh_gita::626.detailed_meaning: The verse portrays a cosmic radiant being as the source of infinite light, touching and sustaining countless worlds and beings with its rays, preventing their destruction or fall. This scene evokes awe at the protective and sustaining power in the cosmos.
dheesh_gita::626.insight: It shows the sustaining power that connects and supports all things, reminding you of unseen forces holding life together.

dheesh_gita::627.verse_sanskrit:
विश्वाधार ! च नामिकाभिरमिताभिस्त्वं युतो दृश्यस
जिघ्रन पुण्यसमूहगन्धममलं ब्रह्माण्डपिण्डावलेः ।
अस्तित्वञ्च विलीनमैव सततं कत्तं हि तस्या निजे
केवल्याभ्युदयौ प्रयच्छसि यथायोग्याधिकारं प्रभो ! ॥
dheesh_gita::627.verse_hindi: हे विश्वाधार ! हम पुनः देखते हैं कि आप अनन्त नासिकायुक्त होकर ब्रह्माण्ड और पिण्डसमूहक के पुण्य पुञ्ज का शुभ आघ्राण ग्रहण करके उनके अस्तित्व को अपने में ही विलीन करने के लिये हे प्रभो! उनको उनके यथायोग्य अधिकारक अनुसार अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस निरन्तर प्रदान करते रहते हो
dheesh_gita::627.english_translation: O foundation of the universe, you unite with infinite nostrils to inhale the pure fragrance of the cosmos and its bodies of virtue, absorbing their existence into yourself, continuously granting their rise and ultimate good according to their rightful merit.
dheesh_gita::627.translation_literal: विश्वाधार (foundation of universe) / च (and) / नामिकाभि-रमिताभि-स्त्वं (with infinite nostrils) / युतो (joined) / दृश्यस (you are seen) / जिघ्रन् (inhaling) / पुण्य-समूह-गन्धम् (fragrance of assemblage of virtue) / अमलं (pure) / ब्रह्माण्ड-पिण्ड-आवलेः (of cosmos and bodies) / अस्तित्वञ्च (and existence) / विलीनमैव (absorbing certainly) / सततं (always) / कत्तं (doing) / हि (indeed) / तस्या (their) / निजे (own) / केवल्या-भ्युदयौ (rise of freedom and good) / प्रयच्छसि (you grant) / यथा-योग्य-अधिकारं (according to rightful merit) / प्रभो (O lord)
dheesh_gita::627.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::627.essence: The cosmic foundation absorbs all pure existence and grants appropriate progress endlessly.
dheesh_gita::627.simple_meaning: The universe's foundation continuously absorbs the pure essence of all beings and grants them progress and ultimate good according to what they deserve.
dheesh_gita::627.simple_insight: There is a continuous, just flow where all existence is embraced and uplifted according to its true worth.
dheesh_gita::627.detailed_meaning: This verse describes the cosmic foundation as a being who merges with the pure essence of the universe, inhaling its goodness and integrating it while granting each entity their deserved growth and ultimate welfare.
dheesh_gita::627.insight: It shows how the universe supports and nurtures all beings impartially based on their rightful merit.

dheesh_gita::628.verse_sanskrit:
भावातीत ! विभो ! गदा त्रिगुणतोऽनीन ! प्रमोऽनुसण
मस्मात्पूर्वमलौकिक गुणमयं भावस्वरूपं नव।
रूपं सर्वमनोहरं सुविमलं दशन्द्रियाप्यायक
मस्माकं हि मनो व्यलीयत तदा सम्पश्यतां सत्वरम ॥
dheesh_gita::628.verse_hindi: हे त्रिगुणातीत ! सदा हे भावातीत ! हे विभो ! हे प्रभो ! इससे पूर्व जब हम दर्शनेन्द्रियो को तृप्त करनेवाले निर्मल और सर्व मनोहर आप के गुणमय और भावमय अलौकिक रूप का दर्शन करते थे तब हमारा मन शीघ्र लयावस्था को प्राप्त हो गया था
dheesh_gita::628.english_translation: O transcendental one beyond the three qualities, before this we saw your pure, delightful, and divine form that satisfies the senses; then our mind quickly dissolved in bliss.
dheesh_gita::628.translation_literal: भावातीत (beyond qualities) / विभो (O lord) / गदा (always) / त्रिगुणतोऽनीन (beyond the three gunas) / प्रमोऽनुसण (mind dissolved) / मम (my) / पूर्वम् (before) / अलौकिक (divine) / गुणमयं (full of qualities) / भावस्वरूपं (essence form) / नव (new) / रूपं (form) / सर्वमनोहरं (all-attractive) / सुविमलं (pure) / दशन्द्रियाप्यायक (satisfying all ten senses) / ममाकं (my mind) / हि (indeed) / व्यलीयत (dissolved) / तदा (then) / सम्पश्यतां (seeing) / सत्वरम (quickly)
dheesh_gita::628.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::628.essence: Seeing pure divine beauty dissolves the mind into bliss beyond qualities.
dheesh_gita::628.simple_meaning: Before this moment, we saw a pure, beautiful form beyond the three qualities that pleased all senses, and our mind quickly dissolved in bliss.
dheesh_gita::628.simple_insight: Seeing something pure and beyond usual qualities can bring a quick peaceful surrender of the mind.
dheesh_gita::628.detailed_meaning: The speaker addresses a divine presence beyond the three qualities (gunas), recalling a moment before the current scene when they saw a divine, flawless form that pleased all senses, causing their mind to dissolve swiftly in bliss.
dheesh_gita::628.insight: It shows how encountering something truly beautiful and pure can quickly calm and absorb the restless mind.

dheesh_gita::629.verse_sanskrit:
अद्यत्वे तु विरादस्वरूपममुकं दृष्ट्वा विशालं तव
बुद्धिर्न: स्थगिता च याति चकिताऽवस्थां विलीनां पुनः।
रूपं नः परिदर्शयाध कृपया ह्येवम्विधं स्वं यतः
सान्निध्य भवतामनुक्षणमहो लब्धुं वयञ्चेश्महे ॥
dheesh_gita::629.verse_hindi: अब तो आपके इस विशाल विराट् स्वरुप का दर्शन करके हमलोगों की बुद्धि भी चकित और थकित होकर लयावस्था को प्राप्त हो रही है। अब कृपा करके आप ऐसे अपने रूप में हमें दर्शन दे कि जिसके अवलम्वन से हम हर समय अहो! आपके सान्निध्य को भी प्राप्त कर सकें
dheesh_gita::629.english_translation: Now, seeing your vast cosmic form, our minds grow stunned and exhausted, fading away. Kindly show us your form in a way we can always feel your presence.
dheesh_gita::629.translation_literal: अद्यत्वे (now) तु (but) विरादस्वरूपममुकं (your vast cosmic form) दृष्ट्वा (seeing) विशालं (vast) तव (your) बुद्धि (intellect) नः (our) स्थगिता (stunned) च (and) याति (goes) चकिताऽवस्थां (astonished state) विलीनां (merged) पुनः (again). रूपं (form) नः (to us) परिदर्शयाध (please show) कृपया (kindly) हि (indeed) एवम् विधं (in this way) स्वं (your own) यतः (from which) सान्निध्य (presence) भवताम् (of you) अनुक्षणम् (constantly) अहो (ah) लब्धुं (to obtain) वयम् (we) च (also) एष्महे (desire).
dheesh_gita::629.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::629.essence: Overwhelming presence can exhaust the mind; steady connection needs a gentler form.
dheesh_gita::629.simple_meaning: Seeing the vast cosmic form overwhelms and exhausts our minds. We ask to see a form that helps us always feel your presence.
dheesh_gita::629.simple_insight: There is confusion and fatigue in facing overwhelming truths, seeking a way to stay connected steadily.
dheesh_gita::629.detailed_meaning: Facing the divine teacher's vast cosmic form, the disciples feel their intellects overwhelmed and fading. They request a gentler form that allows continuous connection, showing their struggle to hold spiritual presence amid awe.
dheesh_gita::629.insight: It shows the need to find accessible ways to experience overwhelming realities steadily, not lose oneself in awe.

dheesh_gita::630.verse_sanskrit:
हे सर्वेश्वर ! भक्तकल्पलतिकारूप ! प्रभो ! पालक !
रूपेणापि विवर्जितो विभुरहो भव्याय भक्तावलेः ।
भक्तानां प्रकृतिप्रतिजनितां स्वीकृत्य वै प्रार्थनां
कल्याणं सगुणं स्वरूपममितं साध्नोति विभदभवान् ॥
dheesh_gita::630.verse_hindi: हे सर्वेश्वर! हे भक्तवाञ्छा कल्पतरु! हे प्रभो हे पालक! आप रूपरहित और विभु होने पर भी अहो! अपने भक्तों के कल्याण के लिये उनकी प्रकृति और प्रवृत्ति जनित प्रार्थना को स्वीकार करके ही नाना सगुणरूप धारण करके उनका कल्याण साधन करते हैं
dheesh_gita::630.english_translation: O Lord of all, wish-fulfilling tree for devotees, protector! Though formless and vast, you accept the prayers arising from your devotees' nature and take countless forms to bless them.
dheesh_gita::630.translation_literal: हे (O) सर्वेश्वर (lord of all) ! भक्तकल्पलतिकारूप (wish-fulfilling tree form of devotees) ! प्रभो (lord) ! पालक (protector) ! रूपेणापि (even by form) विवर्जितो (deprived) विभु (vast) रहो (being) भव्याय (for the glorious) भक्तावलेः (of devotees) । भक्तानां (of devotees) प्रकृतिप्रतिजनितां (arising from nature) स्वीकृत्य (accepting) वै (indeed) प्रार्थनां (prayer) कल्याणं (welfare) सगुणं (with qualities) स्वरूपममितं (limitless forms) साध्नोति (accomplishes) विभदभवान् (you, the lord) ॥
dheesh_gita::630.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::630.essence: The formless divine takes many forms to lovingly respond to sincere devotion.
dheesh_gita::630.simple_meaning: The divine is beyond form but lovingly accepts devotees' natural prayers and appears in many forms to bless them.
dheesh_gita::630.simple_insight: You can trust that your heartfelt prayers are received and met with caring presence.
dheesh_gita::630.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the divine is praised for transcending form yet responding intimately to devotees. Though unlimited and without shape, the divine recognizes the sincere prayers arising from devotees' nature and manifests in various forms to support their well-being.
dheesh_gita::630.modern_relevance: When you feel unseen or unheard, this reminds you that your true self is acknowledged and supported in ways beyond your view.
dheesh_gita::630.insight: It teaches you to trust that genuine care can take many shapes and that your true expressions are always received.

dheesh_gita::631.verse_sanskrit:
विभ्राणो रविरूपमेव सवितः! भक्तान भवांस्तेजसा
आकर्षत्यनिशं विभो ! यतितरां कैवल्यभूमौ ध्रुवम ।
हे नारायण ! विष्णुरूपमभितः स्वीकृस चिद्भावतो ।
ब्रमीभावामिमान निरीक्ष्य नयते तेषां क्रमेणोन्नतिम् ॥
dheesh_gita::631.verse_hindi: हे सवितः! आप ही सूर्य रूप धारण करके तेज द्वारा हे विभो ! भक्तों को कैवल्य भूमि में निरन्तर ही अतिशय आकर्षित करते हैं। हे नारायण ! आप विष्णु रूप धारण करके चिद्भाव द्वारा उनकी क्रमोन्नति का पर्यवेक्षण करके उनको ब्रह्म सभाव प्राप्त कराते हो
dheesh_gita::631.english_translation: O Savita, you who take the form of the sun, constantly attract devotees with your light toward the steady land of freedom. O Narayana, taking the form of Vishnu, you oversee their gradual progress through pure consciousness, leading them to the state of Brahman.
dheesh_gita::631.translation_literal: विभ्राणो (shining) रविरूपमेव (like the form of the sun) सवितः (O Savita) भक्तान (devotees) भवांस्तेजसा (with brilliance) आकर्षत्यनिशं (constantly attract) विभो (O powerful one) यतितरां (to the supreme) कैवल्यभूमौ (on the land of freedom) ध्रुवम (steady) हे (O) नारायण (Narayana) विष्णुरूपमभितः (taking form of Vishnu) स्वीकृस (accepting) चिद्भावतो (from pure consciousness) ब्रमीभावामिमान (to the state of Brahman) निरीक्ष्य (observing) नयते (leads) तेषां (their) क्रमेणोन्नतिम् (gradual progress)
dheesh_gita::631.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::631.essence: A radiant presence steadily draws and guides sincere seekers toward lasting inner freedom.
dheesh_gita::631.simple_meaning: The divine appears as radiant light that constantly draws devotees toward steady inner freedom and watches their gradual spiritual progress.
dheesh_gita::631.simple_insight: You can trust that a radiant presence is gently guiding your steady growth.
dheesh_gita::631.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the divine is invoked in two forms: as Savita (the sun) and Narayana (Vishnu). The radiant light of the sun metaphorically pulls devotees toward the steady land of freedom, while Narayana oversees their gradual evolution through pure consciousness toward Brahman realization.
dheesh_gita::631.modern_relevance: When you feel pulled by a steady inner light amid life’s chaos, it’s a sign your deeper growth is unfolding, even if slowly.
dheesh_gita::631.insight: It teaches you to trust the steady, unseen guiding light that supports gradual spiritual progress.

dheesh_gita::632.verse_sanskrit:
देवीरूपमही धरन हि नयते धर्मस्य शक्त्या भवान
सर्वेषां ह नियामकं परपदं हे शक्तिमन ! तान्सदा ।
अस्तित्वस्य विधायकं च बहु सद्भावेन भक्तान्निजान
हे शम्भो ! शिवरूपतो गमयते निःश्रेयसं निर्भयम ॥
dheesh_gita::632.verse_hindi: हे शक्तिमान् ! अहो ! आप ही देवीरूप धारण करके धर्मशक्ति द्वारा सबके नियामक परमपद में सदा उनको पहुंचा देते हैं। हे शम्भो: आप ही शिवरूप धारण करके सदभाव द्वारा सबके अस्तित्व विधानकारी निर्भय निःश्रेयस पद में अपने भक्तो को अवश्य पहुंचा देते हैं
dheesh_gita::632.english_translation: O Shaktiman, you take the form of the divine feminine and by the power of dharma guide everyone to the supreme state. O Shambho, you take the form of Shiva and lead your devotees with goodwill to fearless ultimate freedom.
dheesh_gita::632.translation_literal: देवीरूपमही (divine feminine form) / धरन (holding) / हि (indeed) / नयते (guides) / धर्मस्य (of dharma) / शक्त्या (by power) / भवान (you) / सर्वेषां (of all) / ह (indeed) / नियामकं (regulator) / परपदं (supreme state) / हे (O) / शक्तिमन (powerful one) / तान्सदा (always them) / अस्तित्वस्य (of existence) / विधायकं (creator/establisher) / च (and) / बहु (with much) / सद्भावेन (goodwill) / भक्तान्निजान (own devotees) / हे (O) / शम्भो (Shambho) / शिवरूपतो (in form of Shiva) / गमयते (leads) / निःश्रेयसं (ultimate freedom) / निर्भयम (fearless)
dheesh_gita::632.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::632.essence: A loving divine presence guides all to fearless ultimate freedom through many forms.
dheesh_gita::632.simple_meaning: The divine takes forms of feminine and Shiva to lovingly guide all beings to their highest fearless freedom.
dheesh_gita::632.simple_insight: You can trust the divine to lovingly lead you beyond fear to true freedom.
dheesh_gita::632.detailed_meaning: This verse praises the divine as both feminine power and Shiva, who through dharma and goodwill guides all beings to the highest state of fearless freedom, ensuring the safety and liberation of devotees.
dheesh_gita::632.modern_relevance: When life feels uncertain and fear grips you, remember a loving force works through many forms to guide you safely to freedom.
dheesh_gita::632.insight: It teaches you to surrender fear and trust a guiding presence that leads toward true fearless freedom.

dheesh_gita::633.verse_sanskrit:
स्वं भक्तांश्च धिया स्वरूपमानिशं सन्दर्य सिद्धेः पते !
दत्ते मुक्तिपदं पर गणपतेधृत्वा स्वरूपं भवान ।
सर्वेषामिह वर्त्तते खलु गुरो ! ह्याद्यो गुरुणां गुरुदेशादस्ति
भवान् हि शश्वदपरिच्छिन्नस्तथा कालत: ॥
dheesh_gita::633.verse_hindi: और हे सिद्धिपते ! आप ही गणपति का स्वरुप धारण करके बुद्धि द्वारा भक्तों को स्वस्वरूप दिखाकर निरन्तर परममुक्तिपद प्रदान करते हैं । हे गुरो ! इस संसार में आप ही सब गुरुओं के आदिगुरु है क्योकि आप सकल देशकाल से निरन्तर अपरिच्छिन्न
dheesh_gita::633.english_translation: O Lord of accomplishment, you embody Ganapati and continuously grant liberation by revealing the true nature to devotees through wisdom. O Guru, you are the original teacher of all gurus, eternally present beyond all realms of time and space.
dheesh_gita::633.translation_literal: स्वं (own) भक्तांश्च (to devotees) धिया (by wisdom) स्वरूपमानिशं (true nature showing) सन्दर्य (continuously) सिद्धेः (of the accomplished one) पते (O lord) ! दत्ते (gives) मुक्तिपदं (liberation state) पर (supreme) गणपतेधृत्वा (holding the form of Ganapati) स्वरूपं (true nature) भवान् (you) । सर्वेषाम् (of all) इह (here) वर्त्तते (exists) खलु (indeed) गुरो (O teacher) ! ह्य (indeed) अद्यो (from the beginning) गुरुणां (of gurus) गुरुदेशात् (original teacher) अस्ति (is) भवान् (you) हि (indeed) शश्वत (eternal) अपरिच्छिन्न (uninterrupted) तथा (thus) कालतः (from time) ॥
dheesh_gita::633.speaker: Suta
dheesh_gita::633.essence: An eternal teacher reveals your true self and grants continuous liberation beyond time and space.
dheesh_gita::633.simple_meaning: You embody Ganapati and continuously show devotees their true nature through wisdom, granting them liberation. You are the original and eternal teacher of all teachers.
dheesh_gita::633.simple_insight: You can trust in an eternal guide who reveals your true self and leads you to freedom.
dheesh_gita::633.detailed_meaning: The narrator praises Ganapati as the supreme teacher who permanently dwells beyond time and space. Ganapati reveals the true nature of devotees through wisdom and grants them liberation, standing as the original guru from whom all others descend.
dheesh_gita::633.modern_relevance: When you feel lost or alone in your search for meaning, remember there is an ever-present guide who reveals your true self and leads you to lasting freedom.
dheesh_gita::633.insight: This verse invites you to recognize and trust the continuous presence of a guiding wisdom that reveals your true nature and grants liberation.

dheesh_gita::634.verse_sanskrit:
त्वं सर्वादिगुरुविभासि सकलालज्ञानस्वरूपे
सदा आदायपिंगणा वयं तव विभो ! ज्ञानाधिविमुइलवमः ।
ब्रह्माण्डेषु प्रवाहयाम इह वै ज्ञानप्रवाहं तथा
सर्वप्वत्र विचक्षणा द्विजगणाः स्नात्वैव मुक्ति ययुः ॥
dheesh_gita::634.verse_hindi: और सर्वादिगुरु होकर ज्ञानस्वरूप में सदा विराजमान रहते हैं और सब ब्रह्माण्डों में हम ऋषिगण हे विभो ! आपके ही ज्ञानसागर की विप्रट कणिका को लेकर ज्ञान स्रोत को इस विश्व में प्रवाहित करते है। इसमें विद्वान् ब्राह्मणगण स्नान करके ही मुक्ति को प्राप्त हुए है
dheesh_gita::634.english_translation: You are the original teacher, always shining as pure knowledge. We, the sages, carry a particle of your wisdom and spread the flow of knowledge across the cosmos. Wise Brahmins attain freedom through purification in this stream.
dheesh_gita::634.translation_literal: त्वं (You) सर्वादिगुरु (original teacher of all) विभासि (shine) सकलालज्ञानस्वरूपे (in the form of all knowledge) सदा (always) आदायपिंगणा (taking a particle) वयं (we) तव (your) विभो (O Lord) ज्ञानाधिविमुइलवमः (knowledge ocean's seed) ब्रह्माण्डेषु (in the universes) प्रवाहयाम (we flow/spread) इह (here) वै (indeed) ज्ञानप्रवाहं (flow of knowledge) तथा (also) सर्वप्वत्र (all over) विचक्षणा (wise) द्विजगणाः (brahmins) स्नात्वैव (by bathing) मुक्ति (freedom) ययुः (attained)
dheesh_gita::634.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::634.essence: Wisdom flows from the divine through sages, guiding the wise to freedom.
dheesh_gita::634.simple_meaning: The divine is the original source of all knowledge. Sages carry a spark of this wisdom and spread it through the world. Wise ones achieve freedom by immersing themselves in this knowledge.
dheesh_gita::634.simple_insight: True wisdom flows from the divine and leads to freedom through sincere purification.
dheesh_gita::634.detailed_meaning: The verse praises the divine as the original teacher who embodies all knowledge. The sages, acting as carriers of this wisdom, spread its flow throughout the cosmos. Wise Brahmins purify themselves through ritual bathing and attain liberation by connecting with this knowledge.
dheesh_gita::634.modern_relevance: You might feel inspired by mentors or teachers who ignite your understanding, helping you share wisdom that transforms others and yourself.
dheesh_gita::634.insight: Recognize that wisdom is a shared flow originating beyond yourself; purification and dedication enable access to freedom.

dheesh_gita::635.verse_sanskrit:
धारोत्पद्य हि देवनायक ! विभो ! सर्गस्थितिध्वंमकृ
द्विश्वव्यापककर्मणोऽपि भवतस्त्वय्येव संलीव्रते ।
सर्वे देवगणाः सदैव भवतामङ्गीभवन्तो मुदा
प्रत्येकं जानिरक्षणक्षयविर्धे ब्रह्माण्डपुञ्जेऽनिशम् ॥
dheesh_gita::635.verse_hindi: हे देवनायक विभो ! सृष्टि स्थिति प्रलय कारिणी विश्व व्यापक कर्म की धारा आप से उत्पन्न होकर भी आप में ही विलीन होती है और सब देवतागण सदा आपके ही अङ्गरूप होकर अहो ! प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्डों में प्रसन्नता से
dheesh_gita::635.english_translation: O divine leader, the cosmic cycle of creation, maintenance, and destruction arises from you and dissolves back into you; all divine beings always exist as your parts, joyfully pervading every universe.
dheesh_gita::635.translation_literal: धारोत्पद्य (stream arising) हि (indeed) देवनायक (divine leader) ! विभो (O mighty one) ! सर्ग (creation) स्थिति (maintenance) प्रलय (destruction) कर्मणः (of action) विश्वव्यापक (universal) अपि (also) भवतः (your) त्वयि (in you) एव (indeed) संलीव्रते (merged) । सर्वे (all) देवगणाः (divine beings) सदैव (always) भवतामङ्गीभवन्तः (become your parts) मुदा (joyfully) प्रत्येकं (each) जानिरक्षणक्षयविर्धे (in birth, preservation, destruction) ब्रह्माण्डपुञ्जे (in the cluster of universes) अनिशम् (constantly) ॥
dheesh_gita::635.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::635.essence: All cosmic actions arise from and merge back into the one source, whose parts joyfully pervade all universes.
dheesh_gita::635.simple_meaning: The endless cycle of creation, preservation, and destruction arises from and merges back into the divine source. All divine beings exist as parts of this source, joyfully present in every universe.
dheesh_gita::635.simple_insight: There is joy in knowing that all cosmic processes flow from and return to the same source.
dheesh_gita::635.detailed_meaning: This verse addresses the divine leader, explaining that all cosmic actions—creation, maintenance, and destruction—originate from and dissolve into the divine. The divine beings remain eternally connected as parts of this source, joyfully pervading all universes, emphasizing unity and cosmic order.
dheesh_gita::635.insight: It invites you to see all change as expressions of one underlying source, dissolving separation and fostering unity.

dheesh_gita::636.verse_sanskrit:
सामञ्जस्यमहो प्रभो ! विदधते कर्मव्यवस्थारताः
उद्भित्स्वेदजरायुजाण्डजगणा भूतत्रजाः सन्ति ये।
सर्व ते च चतुर्विधा हि मनुजानां हे प्रजानां पते !
देवानां त्रिविधास्ताऽसुरगणानां ये च लोका अहो ॥
dheesh_gita::636.verse_hindi: कर्म की व्यवस्था अहर्निश करते हुए हे प्रभो! सृष्टि स्थिति और लय की व्यवस्था का सामञ्जस्य विधान करते हैं। हे प्रजापते ! उद्भिज स्वदेज अण्डज और जरायुज समूह रूपी जो चतुर्विधभूत सङ्घ है वह सब और अहो! जो दैवी मानवी और आसुरीरूपी त्रिविध लोक सृष्टियाँ हैं
dheesh_gita::636.english_translation: O Lord, those engaged day and night in the order of action also govern the harmony of creation, maintenance, and dissolution. O Lord of creatures, all beings born from plants, sweat, eggs, and wombs form fourfold groups. These include the threefold worlds of divine, human, and shadow beings.
dheesh_gita::636.translation_literal: सामञ्जस्यमहो (great harmony) प्रभो (O Lord) ! विदधते (establishes) कर्मव्यवस्थारताः (those engaged in the order of action) उद्भित्स्वेदजरायुजाण्डजगणा (born from plants, sweat, eggs, wombs groups) भूतत्रजाः (fourfold beings) सन्ति (are) ये (who)। सर्व (all) ते (those) च (and) चतुर्विधा (fourfold) हि (indeed) मनुजानां (of humans) हे (O) प्रजानां (of creatures) पते (lord) ! देवानां (of divine beings) त्रिविधा (threefold) स्ताऽसुरगणानां (and of shadow beings) ये (who) च (and) लोका (worlds) अहो (ah!) ॥
dheesh_gita::636.speaker: Narrator
dheesh_gita::636.essence: The universe is sustained by continuous action balancing creation, maintenance, and destruction across many beings.
dheesh_gita::636.simple_meaning: Those who manage all actions continuously also maintain the balance of creation, existence, and destruction. All beings come in four types born from nature, and they belong to three worlds: divine, human, and shadow.
dheesh_gita::636.simple_insight: Everything that exists is part of a balanced, ongoing cycle involving many beings and worlds.
dheesh_gita::636.detailed_meaning: The narrator describes the cosmic order maintained by entities who continuously regulate action and harmony in the universe. These beings arise from natural origins and govern the various categories of life and realms, highlighting the complexity of existence at this moment in the story.
dheesh_gita::636.insight: Understand that life and the universe operate through continuous, interconnected cycles involving diverse beings and realms.

dheesh_gita::637.verse_sanskrit:
त्वत्तो बुबुदवन्महार्णव इह त्वय्येव प्रोद्भय ते लीयन्ते
पितरोऽपि शक्तिमतुलां त्वत्तो गृहीत्वैव च ।
कृत्वा मर्त्यगणोन्नति क्रमगतां साहाय्यमातन्वते
भूतौघस्य चतुर्विधस्य नियमे लोकव्रजस्याप्यलम् ॥
dheesh_gita::637.verse_hindi: वे सब महासमुद्र में बुद्धवत् आप से ही यहां उत्पन्न होकर आप में ही लय को प्राप्त होती हैं और पितृगण आप से ही अतुल शक्ति को लेकर मनुष्यों की क्रमोनन्ति विधान करके चतुर्विधभूतसङ्घ और लोकसमूह की व्यवस्था में भलीभांति सहायता करते हैं
dheesh_gita::637.english_translation: All beings arise from you like the vast ocean, and into you they return; the ancestors draw immense power from you to guide humans’ progress and uphold the order of the fourfold beings and the world’s cycles.
dheesh_gita::637.translation_literal: त्वत्तः (from you) बुबुदवत् (like the ocean) महार्णव (great ocean) इह (here) त्वय्येव (by you alone) प्रोद्भय (arisen) ते (they) लीयन्ते (dissolve) पितरः अपि (ancestors also) शक्तिमतुलां (immeasurable power) त्वत्तः (from you) गृहीत्वैव (taking firmly) च (and) कृत्वा (having done) मर्त्यगण (humans) उन्नति (progress) क्रमगतां (in sequence) साहाय्यम् (aid) आतन्वते (extend) भूतौघस्य (of beings' mass) चतुर्विधस्य (fourfold) नियम (order) लोकव्रजस्य अपि (of the world’s cycle also) अलम् (support).
dheesh_gita::637.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::637.essence: All life flows from and returns to a vast source that sustains cosmic order.
dheesh_gita::637.simple_meaning: Everything emerges from you like a great ocean and returns to you. The ancestors take great power from you to help humans grow and keep the world’s order.
dheesh_gita::637.simple_insight: There is a vast source behind all life that supports progress and balance beyond what we see.
dheesh_gita::637.detailed_meaning: In this verse, a cosmic power is described as the origin and end of all beings. Ancestors, energized by this power, actively assist human evolution and maintain the natural order and cycles of existence. It sets a vast metaphysical scene without prescribing personal action.
dheesh_gita::637.insight: It shows how unseen forces continuously support growth and balance in life’s complex systems.

dheesh_gita::638.verse_sanskrit:
तत्त्वेभ्योऽपि भवानतीतविभवो नूनं चतुर्विशते
यद्यप्यस्ति तथापि धीश ! नु महत्तत्त्वेऽन्तिमे प्राणिनः।
नित्योऽनिर्वचनो विकाररहितो ज्ञानस्य शक्तया स्थितः
सर्वानभ्युदयस्य दर्शयति वै मोक्षस्य मार्ग तथा ॥
dheesh_gita::638.verse_hindi: हे धीश ! यद्यपि चतुर्विंशति तत्व से भी अतीत विभव ही आप हो तथापि आप अन्तिम तत्व बुद्धि में ज्ञानशक्ति रूप से अविकारी अनिर्वचनीय और नित्य स्थित रहकर जीवमात्र को अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस का मार्ग प्रदर्शन कराते हो
dheesh_gita::638.english_translation: O wise one, though you surpass even the twenty-four principles, you remain the final principle—unchanging, eternal, and indescribable, established in the power of knowledge, showing all beings the path of growth and ultimate freedom.
dheesh_gita::638.translation_literal: तत्त्वेभ्यः (from principles) अपि (also) भवन् (you are) अतीतविभवः (beyond past power) नूनं (certainly) चतुर्विशते (twenty-four) यद्यपि (although) अस्ति (there is) तथापि (still) धीश (wise one) नु (indeed) महतत्त्वे (great principle) अन्तिमे (final) प्राणिनः (of beings) नित्या (eternal) अनिर्वचनो (indescribable) विकाररहितः (free from change) ज्ञानस्य (of knowledge) शक्त्या (by the power) स्थितः (established) सर्वान् (all) अभ्युदयस्य (of growth) दर्शयति (shows) वै (indeed) मोक्षस्य (of liberation) मार्ग (path) तथा (also)
dheesh_gita::638.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::638.essence: An unchanging, indescribable wisdom beyond all principles guides every being toward liberation.
dheesh_gita::638.simple_meaning: You are beyond many principles yet remain the final, eternal truth that guides all beings toward growth and freedom.
dheesh_gita::638.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing an eternal, unchanging wisdom guides every life toward its highest good.
dheesh_gita::638.detailed_meaning: A teacher addresses the wise one, acknowledging that although they transcend many cosmic principles, they are the ultimate unchanging reality. This eternal truth, rooted in pure knowledge, reveals the way for all beings to grow and attain liberation.
dheesh_gita::638.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by complex systems or endless rules, remember there is a simple, unchanging wisdom guiding your true progress.
dheesh_gita::638.insight: It invites shifting focus from transient details to the underlying eternal wisdom that directs growth and freedom.

dheesh_gita::639.verse_sanskrit:
ये स्वातन्त्र्यमदेन मोहिततमा जीवाः प्रमादेन वे
मूढ़ा ज्ञाननिधेस्तवेङ्गितमहो निसं तिरस्कुर्वते ।
भ्रान्ता दुःखदजन्ममृत्युगहने संसारचक्रे ध्रुवम
शंयोरभ्युदयाध्वनो हि पतिता दुःखान्यलं भुञ्जते ॥
dheesh_gita::639.verse_hindi: स्वाधीनता के मद से विमोहित जो मूढ़ जीव प्रमाद वश ही ज्ञाननिधि आपके इङ्गित की अहो ! नित्य अवहेलना करते हैं वह अवश्य कल्याणकारी अभ्युदय के मार्ग से व्युत होकर ही दुःखदायी जन्म मृत्युओ के गहन संसारचक्र मे अतिशय घूर्णायमान होकर दुःख भोगते रहते हैं
dheesh_gita::639.english_translation: Those fools, intoxicated by their sense of independence, ignorantly scorn the wisdom you indicate. Lost in error, they stray from the path of true well-being and suffer endlessly in the painful cycle of birth and death.
dheesh_gita::639.translation_literal: ये (these) स्वातन्त्र्यम् (independence) अदेन (by pride) मोहिततमा (most deluded) जीवाः (beings) प्रमादेन (by negligence) वे (they) मूढ़ा (fools) ज्ञाननिधेः (of the treasure of knowledge) तव (your) इंगितम् (indication) अहो (alas) नित्यम् (always) तिरस्कुर्वते (reject) । भ्रान्ताः (confused) दुःखद् (painful) जन्ममृत्यु (birth-death) उत्खने (deep) संसारचक्रे (wheel of worldly existence) ध्रुवम् (certainly) शंयः (path) अभ्युदयाध्वनि (path of well-being) हि (indeed) पतिता (fallen) दुःखानि (sufferings) अलम् (excessively) भुञ्जते (experience) ॥
dheesh_gita::639.speaker: Suta
dheesh_gita::639.essence: Pride in independence blinds you, causing endless suffering away from true well-being.
dheesh_gita::639.simple_meaning: Some beings, proud and unaware, ignore true wisdom and suffer repeatedly in the cycle of life and death.
dheesh_gita::639.simple_insight: There is sorrow in turning away from guidance, even when pride hides it.
dheesh_gita::639.detailed_meaning: The narrator describes how certain beings, blinded by pride in their independence, foolishly reject the guidance offered by the divine teacher. This rejection causes them to stray from the path leading to well-being, trapping them in the painful cycle of repeated birth and death.
dheesh_gita::639.modern_relevance: You might dismiss advice or insight out of pride, only to find yourself stuck repeating painful patterns again and again.
dheesh_gita::639.insight: Recognize that pride can blind you to valuable guidance, prolonging unnecessary suffering.

dheesh_gita::640.verse_sanskrit:
भर्गो विश्वसमर्चितं यदिह ते ह्यास्ते दयासागर !
तन्नो बुद्धिमहर्निशं गणपते ! शक्तचा स्वया सत्वरम ।
संरक्ष्यासत एव कर्मनिवहात् सत्कर्मणि प्रेरयेत्
सियाऽलङ्कृतवामपार्श्व ! भगवस्त्वां सन्नमामो वयमा ॥
dheesh_gita::640.verse_hindi: हे दयासागर! आपका ही जो इस संसार में जगत्पूज्य भर्ग (तेज) है वह हे सिद्धिदेवी से अलङ्कतवाम पार्श्व भगवन् गणपते ! हमारी बुद्धि को अपनी शक्ति के द्वारा असत् कर्म समूह से बचाकर सत्कर्म में शीघ्र प्रेरणा करे। आपको हम अनन्यभाव से प्रणाम करते हैं
dheesh_gita::640.english_translation: O ocean of compassion! The radiant energy worshipped by the world is yours. O Ganapati, adorned by the goddess of accomplishment, protect my intellect swiftly with your power from unwholesome actions and inspire me toward right actions. We bow to you with devoted hearts.
dheesh_gita::640.translation_literal: भर्गो (radiance) / विश्वसमर्चितं (worshipped by the world) / यदिह (here) / ते (your) / हि (indeed) / अस्ते (is) / दयासागर (ocean of compassion) ! / तन् (that) / नो (our) / बुद्धिमहर्निशं (intellect day and night) / गणपते (o Ganapati) ! / शक्तचा (by power) / स्वया (own/self) / सत्वरम् (quickly) / संरक्ष्या (protect) / असत (unwholesome) / एव (indeed) / कर्मनिवहात् (from actions cluster) / सत्कर्मणि (right actions) / प्रेरयेत् (inspire) / सिया (may be) / अलङ्कृतवामपार्श्व (adorned by goddess of accomplishment) ! / भगवस्त्वां (to you, O divine) / सन्नमामो (we bow) / वयमा (we) ॥
dheesh_gita::640.speaker: Devotees
dheesh_gita::640.essence: Asking for inner protection and swift guidance helps your mind stay on the right path.
dheesh_gita::640.simple_meaning: You can pray for your mind to be protected from harmful impulses and inspired toward good actions by a higher compassionate power.
dheesh_gita::640.simple_insight: You feel supported knowing your mind can be guarded and guided toward what is good.
dheesh_gita::640.detailed_meaning: In this verse, devotees invoke Ganapati, the remover of obstacles and source of wisdom, asking him to protect their intellect from harmful influences and lead them swiftly toward right action, recognizing his radiant power and divine presence.
dheesh_gita::640.modern_relevance: When your thoughts spiral into negativity, you can silently ask for inner strength to protect your mind and guide you toward constructive choices.
dheesh_gita::640.insight: It teaches you to seek and rely on protective inner strength to keep your mind focused on positive, skillful actions.

dheesh_gita::641.verse_sanskrit:
उक्त्वर्पयस्तस्थुरिति क्षणं ते रोमाञ्चिता गद्गदकण्ठशब्दाः।
सानन्दजाताश्रुमुखाः स्थिराश्च विहस्य धीशो मधुरं तदोचे ॥
dheesh_gita::641.verse_hindi: इतना कहकर वे ऋषिगण कुछ देर तक आनन्दाश्रयुक्त मुख गद्र गदकंठस्वर रोमाञ्चित और निःस्तब्ध होकर रहे। तदनन्तर भगवान् गणपति जी ने मुस्कराकर मधुर स्वर से कहा
dheesh_gita::641.english_translation: After speaking thus, the sages stood still for a moment, their hair standing on end, voices trembling with emotion, faces filled with joyful tears; then the divine spoke sweetly with a smile.
dheesh_gita::641.translation_literal: उक्त्व (having spoken) / अर्पयत (offered) / स्थिरुति (stood still) / क्षणं (moment) / ते (they) / रोमाञ्चिता (hair standing on end) / गद्गदकण्ठशब्दाः (trembling voice) / सानन्द (with joy) / जाताश्रुमुखाः (faces with tears) / स्थिराः (still) / च (and) / विहस्य (smiling) / धीशः (the divine) / मधुरं (sweet) / तदोचे (then spoke)
dheesh_gita::641.speaker: Narrator
dheesh_gita::641.essence: Profound teaching can evoke silent awe and joyful reverence before continuing.
dheesh_gita::641.simple_meaning: The sages reacted deeply with joy and silence after hearing the teaching, then the divine spoke kindly with a smile.
dheesh_gita::641.simple_insight: Sometimes deep teachings move us beyond words, filling us with silent joy and reverence.
dheesh_gita::641.detailed_meaning: After a profound teaching, the sages are overwhelmed with emotion—joyful tears and trembling voices show their deep connection. Ganapati then responds warmly, continuing the dialogue with kindness.
