dheesh_gita::641.insight: It shows how powerful teaching can create a moment of silent awe and heartfelt connection before continuing conversation.

dheesh_gita::642.verse_sanskrit:
दशायां योगयुक्तायां रूपं मे सगुणं द्विजाः !।
आत्मयुक्तदशायाञ्च विराटरूपं महाद्भुतम् ॥
dheesh_gita::642.verse_hindi: हे भक्त द्विजगण ! योगयुक्त अवस्था में मेरा सगुणरूप, आत्मयुक्त अवस्था में मेरा महदद्भुत विराटरूप और
dheesh_gita::642.english_translation: O devoted twice-born ones! In the state united with yoga, my form is with qualities; in the state united with the true self, I reveal a magnificent, cosmic form.
dheesh_gita::642.translation_literal: दशायां (in the state) / योगयुक्तायां (united with yoga) / रूपं (form) / मे (my) / सगुणं (with qualities) / द्विजाः (twice-born ones) / आत्मयुक्तदशायाञ्च (and in the state united with the true self) / विराटरूपं (cosmic form) / महाद्भुतम् (magnificent)
dheesh_gita::642.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::642.essence: Devotion reveals the divine both as a personal form and as an infinite cosmic presence.
dheesh_gita::642.simple_meaning: When you unite with focused devotion, you perceive the divine's gentle form. When you unite with your true self deeply, you perceive the divine's vast cosmic form.
dheesh_gita::642.simple_insight: Devotion opens your heart to see the divine both intimately and infinitely.
dheesh_gita::642.detailed_meaning: The speaker addresses devoted learners, explaining that through yoga and devotion they perceive the divine in two ways: a personal form with qualities and a vast cosmic form when aligned with the true self. This verse contrasts personal devotion and cosmic understanding.
dheesh_gita::642.modern_relevance: When your heart is open in love, you see the familiar in others; when you connect deeply with yourself, you sense a vast, shared existence beyond appearances.
dheesh_gita::642.insight: It teaches you to embrace devotion both as a personal relationship and as recognition of the vastness within all.

dheesh_gita::643.verse_sanskrit:
कर्मयुक्तदशायान्तु ममोपास्तौ सहायकम् ।
मद्विभूतिमयं रूपं भक्ताः ! स्याच्छ्रतिरित्यहो! ॥
dheesh_gita::643.verse_hindi: कर्मयुक्त अवस्था में मेरा विभूतिमय रूप मेरी उपासना में सहायक होता है। अहो ! यही श्रुति है
dheesh_gita::643.english_translation: In the state of being engaged in selfless action, my divine form of manifestations assists in your worship. This is what the sacred teaching declares.
dheesh_gita::643.translation_literal: कर्मयुक्तदशायान्तु (in the state engaged in action) / ममोपास्तौ (in my worship) / सहायकम् (assist) / मद्विभूतिमयं (my manifestations-filled) / रूपं (form) / भक्ताः (devotees) / स्याच्छ्रतिरित्यहो (may be the shruti, this is declared)
dheesh_gita::643.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::643.essence: Devoted action invites the divine form to support and empower your worship.
dheesh_gita::643.simple_meaning: When you engage in action with devotion, the divine manifestations help support your worship and efforts.
dheesh_gita::643.simple_insight: You feel encouraged knowing the divine supports your devoted actions.
dheesh_gita::643.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the verse teaches that when someone is engaged in selfless, devoted action, the divine form of manifestations aids their worship, reinforcing the power of karma yoga as a path supported by divine presence.
dheesh_gita::643.modern_relevance: When you put your heart into your work or care, you sense an encouraging presence helping you along.
dheesh_gita::643.insight: It shifts focus to seeing your devoted actions as supported and strengthened by a higher presence, making effort feel less alone.

dheesh_gita::644.verse_sanskrit:
स्वाधीनः प्राकृतश्चैव विविधो जीव ईरितः।
गजोऽहं प्राकृते जीव स्वाधीने मानवस्तथा ॥
dheesh_gita::644.verse_hindi: जीव प्राकृत और स्वाधीनरूप से दो प्रकार का कहा गया है। प्राकृत जीवों में मैं हस्ती हूँ और स्वाधीन जीवों  में मैं मनुष्य हूँ
dheesh_gita::644.english_translation: Living beings are of two kinds: natural and self-governed. Among natural beings, I am the elephant; among self-governed beings, I am the human.
dheesh_gita::644.translation_literal: स्वाधीनः (self-governed) / प्राकृतः (natural) / च (and) / ऐव (indeed) / विविधः (various) / जीव (living beings) / ईरितः (are said to be) / गजः (elephant) / अहं (I) / प्राकृते (among natural) / जीव (living beings) / स्वाधीने (self-governed) / मानवः (human) / तथा (also)
dheesh_gita::644.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::644.essence: Living beings differ by nature and self-governance, represented by elephant and human.
dheesh_gita::644.simple_meaning: Living beings exist mainly as natural or self-governed types. Among natural beings is the elephant; among self-governed beings is the human.
dheesh_gita::644.simple_insight: Recognizing different levels of freedom in living beings opens understanding of inner nature.
dheesh_gita::644.detailed_meaning: This verse distinguishes living beings into two broad categories: natural (without self-rule) and self-governed. The speaker identifies with an elephant as a natural being and a human as a self-governed being, suggesting different capacities and freedoms.
dheesh_gita::644.insight: It shifts perspective to see some beings as naturally driven and others as capable of self-direction or choice.

dheesh_gita::645.verse_sanskrit:
अतोऽहं भक्तवृन्देभ्यो मर्त्यदहो गजाननः।
दर्शन एवं प्रयच्यामि प्रादुर्भूय निरन्तरम् ॥
dheesh_gita::645.verse_hindi: इसी कारण हस्ती के सदृश मुख और मनुष्य सदृश शरीर होकर मैं  भक्तों को निरन्तर प्रकट होकर अपना दर्शन देता हूँ
dheesh_gita::645.english_translation: Therefore, with an elephant-like face and a human-like body, I continuously manifest before my devotees to grant them my vision.
dheesh_gita::645.translation_literal: अतः (therefore) अहं (I) भक्तवृन्देभ्यः (to devotees) मर्त्यदहो (with a human-like body) गजाननः (elephant-faced one) दर्शन (vision) एवं (thus) प्रयच्यामि (I give) प्रादुर्भूय (manifesting) निरन्तरम् (continuously)
dheesh_gita::645.speaker: Elephant-faced Deva
dheesh_gita::645.essence: The divine appears in forms meaningful to devotees to reveal itself continuously.
dheesh_gita::645.simple_meaning: The divine takes a special form like an elephant-headed being and appears constantly to those who love and trust it.
dheesh_gita::645.simple_insight: You are always connected; the divine shows up for you in your own way.
dheesh_gita::645.detailed_meaning: Ganapati, the elephant-faced divine figure, explains how he takes a form blending human and elephant features to appear before his devotees. This reveals his compassionate willingness to make himself visible and accessible to those devoted to him.
dheesh_gita::645.modern_relevance: When you feel unseen or alone, remember that the divine can appear in forms and ways just for you, offering guidance and presence.
dheesh_gita::645.insight: It invites you to recognize the divine’s personal presence as a source of comfort and connection.

dheesh_gita::646.verse_sanskrit:
राजयोगोऽस्मि योगानामहमेवंविधोऽपि सन।
चतुर्विधेषु ध्यानेषु पञ्चोपास्तेरहं ध्रुवम् ॥
dheesh_gita::646.verse_hindi: मैं योग में राजयोग हूँ परन्तु हे द्विजश्रेष्ठो ! ऐसा होकर भी मैं चतुर्विध ध्यानों में से पञ्चोपासना के
dheesh_gita::646.english_translation: Among yogas, I am the royal yoga; yet among the four types of meditation, I am surely the fifth worship.
dheesh_gita::646.translation_literal: राजयोगोऽस्मि (I am the royal yoga) योगानाम् (of yogas) अहम् (I) एवम् (thus) विधः (type) अपि (also) सन (being). चतुर्विधेषु (among four types) ध्यानेषु (of meditations) पञ्च (five) उपास्ते (worship) अहम् (I) ध्रुवम् (certainly).
dheesh_gita::646.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
dheesh_gita::646.essence: The highest yoga transcends known meditation forms into a supreme fifth devotion.
dheesh_gita::646.simple_meaning: There are many yogas and meditations, but the highest is the royal yoga, and beyond four meditations, there is a supreme fifth form of worship.
dheesh_gita::646.simple_insight: You are more than any single practice; your true devotion is beyond the usual forms.
dheesh_gita::646.detailed_meaning: The divine teacher declares being the royal or supreme yoga among all yogas. Though there are four known meditation types, the teacher identifies as the certain fifth worship surpassing them, pointing to a deeper, transcendental practice.
dheesh_gita::646.modern_relevance: When you think you have mastered one method, there's always a deeper, richer way to connect and grow beyond what you knew.
dheesh_gita::646.insight: It shifts your view from following fixed methods to embracing a supreme, all-encompassing devotion beyond techniques.

dheesh_gita::647.verse_sanskrit:
पञ्चध्यानयुतं स्थूल-ध्यानमास्मि द्विजोत्तमाः ।
नैवात्र संशयः कश्चित् सत्यं सत्यं ब्रवीमि वः ॥
dheesh_gita::647.verse_hindi: पाँच ध्यान युक्त स्थूल ध्यान ही हूँ इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है मैं आपलोगो से सत्य सत्य कहता हूँ
dheesh_gita::647.english_translation: O best of the twice-born, I am the gross meditation combined with the fivefold meditations; there is no doubt in this. Truly, I speak to you the truth.
dheesh_gita::647.translation_literal: पञ्चध्यानयुतं (combined with five meditations) / स्थूल-ध्यानमास्मि (I am gross meditation) / द्विजोत्तमाः (O best of twice-born) / नैवात्र (there is no) / संशयः (doubt) / कश्चित् (anyone) / सत्यं (truth) / सत्यं (truth) / ब्रवीमि (I speak) / वः (to you)
dheesh_gita::647.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::647.essence: Deep, layered meditation embodies undeniable truth without any doubt.
dheesh_gita::647.simple_meaning: Meditation that includes five layers is the gross form I embody, and this truth is certain without doubt.
dheesh_gita::647.simple_insight: You can trust the power of deep, layered meditation to reveal truth.
dheesh_gita::647.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the speaker declares embodying a comprehensive form of meditation involving five types combined into one gross meditation, assuring listeners of its absolute truth and reliability.
dheesh_gita::647.modern_relevance: When you focus deeply on your practice with many layers, you realize some truths become undeniable and clear.
dheesh_gita::647.insight: It encourages you to embrace meditation as a trustworthy path to clarity and certainty.

dheesh_gita::648.verse_sanskrit:
नरेषु नरनाथोऽस्मि राज्ये तु सचिवाभिधः।
मन्त्रिणां मण्डलं यस्माज्ञानस्यास्ते सहायकम् ॥
dheesh_gita::648.verse_hindi: नरों में मैं राजा हूँ परन्तु राज्य में मैं मन्त्रीरूप हूँ क्योकि मंत्रिमण्डल ज्ञान सहायक है
dheesh_gita::648.english_translation: Among men, I am king; in the kingdom, I am called the minister because the council of ministers aids knowledge.
dheesh_gita::648.translation_literal: नरेषु (among men) नरनाथः (king of men) अस्मि (I am) राज्ये (in the kingdom) तु (but) सचिवाभिधः (called minister) मन्त्रिणां (of ministers) मण्डलं (council) यस्मात् (because) ज्ञानस्य (of knowledge) अस्ते (there is) सहायकम् (helper)
dheesh_gita::648.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::648.essence: True leadership acknowledges the power of those who assist knowledge.
dheesh_gita::648.simple_meaning: I am the king among people, but in the kingdom, I am called a minister because the council of ministers supports knowledge.
dheesh_gita::648.simple_insight: Sometimes, being a leader means serving others who help bring clarity and wisdom.
dheesh_gita::648.detailed_meaning: The speaker declares a dual role: as a king among men and as a minister within the kingdom, emphasizing that the council assists in guiding knowledge. It highlights the value of supporting roles in leadership.
dheesh_gita::648.modern_relevance: You might lead a team but rely on advisors to guide important decisions and bring insight.
dheesh_gita::648.insight: It teaches you to recognize leadership also means honoring those who support your wisdom and decisions.

dheesh_gita::649.verse_sanskrit:
शक्तिष्वहं देवशक्तिरीदृशोऽहन्तु सन्नपि ।
लौकिक शक्तिपुञ्जेऽस्मि सशक्तिमहर्षयः॥
dheesh_gita::649.verse_hindi: शक्तियों में मैं दैवी शक्ति हूँ परन्तु ऐसा होकर भी हे महर्षियो! मैं लौकिक शक्तियो में मै सङ्घशक्ति हूँ
dheesh_gita::649.english_translation: Among powers, I am the divine power, yet among worldly powers, I am the collective power.
dheesh_gita::649.translation_literal: शक्तिष्वहं (among powers I am) / देवशक्तिरीदृशोऽहन्तु (like divine power indeed) / सन्नपि (being even so) / लौकिक (worldly) / शक्तिपुञ्जेऽस्मि (in the cluster of powers I am) / सशक्तिमहर्षयः (with collective power, O great sages)
dheesh_gita::649.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::649.essence: The true self is both the highest divine power and the collective worldly force.
dheesh_gita::649.simple_meaning: The true self is the divine power beyond all, yet also present as the sum of worldly forces.
dheesh_gita::649.simple_insight: You can feel your strength as both transcendent and part of the world at once.
dheesh_gita::649.detailed_meaning: The speaker explains that the true self is not only the supreme divine power but also present within all worldly energies combined. This reveals a layered identity beyond simple separation of divine and worldly realms.
dheesh_gita::649.modern_relevance: When you face challenges, you are not just one force but a combination of deep inner strength and practical worldly power working together.
dheesh_gita::649.insight: It shifts your view to recognize the self as both transcendent essence and active worldly presence simultaneously.

dheesh_gita::650.verse_sanskrit:
आध्यात्मिक्याधिदैव्याधिभौतिक्यः शक्तयोऽखिलाः ।
सङ्घशक्तौ प्रकाशन्ते स्वयमेव यतो ध्रुवम् ॥
dheesh_gita::650.verse_hindi: क्योंकि संघ शक्ति में आध्यात्मिक आधिदैविक और आधिभौतिक इन तीनों शक्तियों का विकास अपने आप ही अवश्य हो जाता है।
dheesh_gita::650.english_translation: Because in collective power, spiritual, divine, and physical energies naturally develop inevitably on their own.
dheesh_gita::650.translation_literal: आध्यात्मिक्याधिदैव्याधिभौतिक्यः (spiritual-divine-physical) शक्तयोऽखिलाः (powers all) सङ्घशक्तौ (in collective power) प्रकाशन्ते (manifest) स्वयमेव (by themselves) यतो (because) ध्रुवम् (inevitable).
dheesh_gita::650.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::650.essence: Collective strength naturally brings together spiritual, divine, and physical powers effortlessly.
dheesh_gita::650.simple_meaning: Spiritual, divine, and physical energies naturally emerge and grow together within collective strength.
dheesh_gita::650.simple_insight: You feel the natural flow when different energies combine as one force.
dheesh_gita::650.detailed_meaning: This verse explains how three kinds of energies—spiritual, divine, and physical—unfold inevitably when combined as a collective power. It reveals the natural harmony and automatic growth in unified strength.
dheesh_gita::650.modern_relevance: When you collaborate with others, your combined efforts spark growth in many unseen ways naturally and automatically.
dheesh_gita::650.insight: It teaches you to recognize that combining different energies leads to spontaneous growth without forced effort.

dheesh_gita::651.verse_sanskrit:
वर्णेषु ब्राह्मणश्चाहमाश्रमेवान्तिमाश्रमः।
वृद्धत्त्वेनैव पृज्येषु सर्ववृद्धेप्वहं द्विजाः ॥
dheesh_gita::651.verse_hindi: मैं वर्णों में ब्राह्मण हूँ और आश्रमों में मैं सन्यासाश्रम हूँ । हे ब्राह्मणो ! वृद्धत्वरूप से पूजनीय सब प्रकार के वृद्धों में
dheesh_gita::651.english_translation: Among the classes, I am the Brahmin; among the stages of life, I am the renounced stage. O Brahmins, among all who are venerable, I am the elder honored for age.
dheesh_gita::651.translation_literal: वर्णेषु (among the classes) / ब्राह्मणश्च (Brahmin and) / अहम् (I am) / आश्रमे (among the stages of life) / एव (indeed) / अन्तिम (the last) / आश्रमः (stage) / वृद्धत्त्वेनैव (by old age itself) / पृज्येषु (among those honored) / सर्ववृद्धेः (all elders) / अहम् (I am) / द्विजाः (O twice-born/Brahmins)
dheesh_gita::651.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::651.essence: The divine represents the highest wisdom and renunciation among castes and life stages.
dheesh_gita::651.simple_meaning: The divine identifies as the highest in caste and stage: the wise Brahmin and the renounced elder respected for age.
dheesh_gita::651.simple_insight: Respect naturally follows true wisdom and the maturity that comes with age.
dheesh_gita::651.detailed_meaning: The divine teacher declares being the essence of the Brahmin caste and the final renounced stage of life, revered like the eldest among all elders. This verse highlights the divine presence in ultimate wisdom and renunciation.
dheesh_gita::651.insight: It teaches to see the highest value in inner wisdom and mature renunciation beyond social roles.

dheesh_gita::652.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वथा ज्ञानवद्रोऽस्मि नात्र कार्य्या विचारणा ।
अध्यात्मलक्ष्यसंयुक्त आर्योंऽहं मानवेपु च ॥
dheesh_gita::652.verse_hindi: सर्वथा में ज्ञानवृद्ध ही है; इसमें कुछ विचार न करो और मनुष्यश्रेणी में मैं अध्यात्म लक्ष्य युक्त आर्य हूँ
dheesh_gita::652.english_translation: I am entirely a knower of knowledge; do not doubt this. Among humans, I am an honorable one united with the goal of spiritual realization.
dheesh_gita::652.translation_literal: सर्वथा (in all respects) / ज्ञानवद्रः (knower of knowledge) / अस्मि (I am) / नात्र (here not) / कार्य्या (to be done) / विचारणा (doubt) / अध्यात्मलक्ष्यसंयुक्त (united with the goal of spiritual realization) / आर्यः (honorable one) / अहं (I) / मानवेपु (among humans) / च (also)
dheesh_gita::652.speaker: Shri Dheesh
dheesh_gita::652.essence: You are already fully connected to true knowledge and spiritual purpose.
dheesh_gita::652.simple_meaning: You are fully knowledgeable and connected to your spiritual goal. There is no need to doubt this truth about yourself.
dheesh_gita::652.simple_insight: You can feel confident and steady knowing your true wisdom is complete.
dheesh_gita::652.detailed_meaning: The speaker, Shri Dheesh, declares to the listener that they are entirely a knower of knowledge. He emphasizes that among humans, he is a noble one focused on spiritual realization, encouraging trust in one's own wisdom without doubt.
dheesh_gita::652.modern_relevance: When you hesitate before a big decision, remember your inner wisdom already holds the answers you need.
dheesh_gita::652.insight: It teaches you to trust your inner knowledge without second-guessing or overthinking.

dheesh_gita::653.verse_sanskrit:
भक्तेषु ज्ञानिभक्तोऽस्मि वेदानां सामनामकः।
किन्तु वेदविभागेपनिषद्रुपभागहम् ॥
dheesh_gita::653.verse_hindi: भक्तगण में मैं ज्ञानीभक्त हूँ। वेदों के बीच में मैं सामवेद हूँ किन्तु वेदविभागों में उपनिषद हूँ
dheesh_gita::653.english_translation: Among devotees, I am a wise devotee; among the Vedas, I am the Sama Veda; among the divisions of the Vedas, I am the Upanishads.
dheesh_gita::653.translation_literal: भक्तेषु (among devotees) / ज्ञानि-भक्तः (wise devotee) / अस्मि (I am) / वेदानां (of the Vedas) / सामनामकः (the Sama Veda) / किन्तु (but) / वेद-विभागे (in divisions of the Vedas) /पनिषद्-रुप-भागः (form of the Upanishads) / अहम् (I am)
dheesh_gita::653.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::653.essence: Devoted love and deep wisdom can coexist harmoniously within you.
dheesh_gita::653.simple_meaning: You can be a devoted person who is also wise. Among sacred teachings, some are songs, others deep philosophy; you can embody both.
dheesh_gita::653.simple_insight: You can embrace both heartfelt love and deep understanding without conflict.
dheesh_gita::653.detailed_meaning: The speaker declares their identity across spiritual layers: among devoted followers, as a wise devotee; among Vedic scriptures, as the Sama Veda known for melody; and among Vedic sections, as the Upanishads representing deep insight. This links devotion and wisdom closely.
dheesh_gita::653.modern_relevance: You might feel torn between your emotional commitments and intellectual pursuits, but you can hold both with equal authenticity.
dheesh_gita::653.insight: It teaches you to recognize that devotion and wisdom are complementary, not opposing, qualities you can integrate.

dheesh_gita::654.verse_sanskrit:
मन्याहारञ्च  योगानामद्रेप्स्मि परन्व्ह्म।
समधिर्निवीकाल्योऽपि निखिलेषु समाधिषु ॥
dheesh_gita::654.verse_hindi: योग के अंगों में मैं प्रत्याहार हूँ परन्तु सब समाधियों में मैं निर्विकल्प समाधि हूँ
dheesh_gita::654.english_translation: Among the limbs of yoga, I am withdrawal of the senses; among all types of samadhi, I am the undivided, formless absorption.
dheesh_gita::654.translation_literal: मन्याहारञ्च (I am withdrawal of the senses) / योगानाम् (of yogas) / अद्रेप्स्मि (I desire) / परन्व्ह्म (among) / समधिर्निवीकाल्यः (undivided samadhi) / अपि (also) / निखिलेषु (in all) / समाधिषु (samadhis)
dheesh_gita::654.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::654.essence: True self is the undivided stillness beyond all sensory withdrawal and mental states.
dheesh_gita::654.simple_meaning: You represent the yogic practice of withdrawing the senses, and at the deepest level, you are the pure, undivided state of complete inner stillness.
dheesh_gita::654.simple_insight: There is a part of you beyond all distractions and separations, peaceful and whole.
dheesh_gita::654.detailed_meaning: This verse reveals the speaker identifying as the essential core of yoga and meditation: withdrawal of the senses (pratyahara) and the highest undivided state of samadhi. It points to the true self beyond all divided mental states.
dheesh_gita::654.modern_relevance: When distractions pull your attention in every direction, remember your true nature is quiet, unified, and untouched by the chaos.
dheesh_gita::654.insight: It shifts your focus from scattered senses to the unified stillness that underlies all experience.

dheesh_gita::655.verse_sanskrit:
मन्त्रयोगेषु मन्त्राऽम्मि प्राणायामो हठे द्विजाः ।
लयप्रिया नयेयोगे राज्योगे विवेचनम ॥
dheesh_gita::655.verse_hindi: हे ब्राह्मणों ! मन्त्रयोग में मैं मन्त्र हूँ, हठयोग में मैं प्राणायाम हूँ, लययोग में मैं लयक्रिया हूँ और राजयोग में मैं विवेचन हूँ
dheesh_gita::655.english_translation: O Brahmins, in mantra yoga I am the mantra, in hatha yoga I am the breath control, in laya yoga I am the absorption practice, and in raja yoga I am the discernment.
dheesh_gita::655.translation_literal: मन्त्रयोगेषु (in mantra yogas) मन्त्राऽम्मि (I am the mantra) प्राणायामो (breath control) हठे (in hatha) द्विजाः (O Brahmins) । लयप्रिया (absorption-loving) नयेयोगे (in laya yoga) राज्योगे (in raja yoga) विवेचनम (discernment) ॥
dheesh_gita::655.speaker: Suta
dheesh_gita::655.essence: The core power behind all yogas is one essence expressed differently in practice.
dheesh_gita::655.simple_meaning: Each form of yoga has a core practice, and you can embody that essence: mantra in mantra yoga, breath control in hatha yoga, absorption in laya yoga, and clear seeing in raja yoga.
dheesh_gita::655.simple_insight: You carry the essential power of every spiritual path within you, no matter which you follow.
dheesh_gita::655.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses Brahmins, explaining how the divine principle appears in different yogas: as mantra in mantra yoga, as breath control in hatha yoga, as absorption in laya yoga, and as discernment in raja yoga. This shows the unity behind diverse practices.
dheesh_gita::655.modern_relevance: When you practice meditation, breathwork, or reflection, you are connecting with the core energy of ancient yogas, uniting diverse techniques through their shared essence.
dheesh_gita::655.insight: Recognize that diverse spiritual practices share a common essence you can directly experience through focused engagement.

dheesh_gita::656.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्मदानञ्च दानेषु तपस्यास यमस्तथा ।
ज्ञानप्रकाशकन्वाञ्च  कर्मयज्ञेषु भो द्विजा: ॥
dheesh_gita::656.verse_hindi: हे ब्राह्मणों ! दानधर्म में मैं ब्रह्मदान हूँ, तपधर्म में मैं यम हूँ, कर्मयज्ञ में ज्ञानप्रकाशक होने से
dheesh_gita::656.english_translation: O Brahmins! Among donations, I am the gift of the supreme reality; among disciplines, I am restraint; among sacrificial actions, I am the illumination of wisdom.
dheesh_gita::656.translation_literal: ब्रह्मदानञ्च (supreme reality-gift and) दानेषु (among donations) तपस्यास (in disciplines) यमः (restraint) तथा (also) ज्ञानप्रकाशकन्वाञ्च (and illumination of wisdom) कर्मयज्ञेषु (among sacrificial actions) भो (am) द्विजाः (O Brahmins)
dheesh_gita::656.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::656.essence: The highest gift, discipline, and action are rooted in truth, restraint, and wisdom respectively.
dheesh_gita::656.simple_meaning: Among all gifts, the highest is giving the supreme reality. Among disciplines, restraint is the best. Among actions done as sacrifice, wisdom shining through is the most important.
dheesh_gita::656.simple_insight: True generosity and discipline come from sharing what matters most and holding yourself gently.
dheesh_gita::656.detailed_meaning: The verse addresses Brahmins, highlighting the highest forms of giving, discipline, and sacrificial action. It elevates giving the supreme reality, practicing restraint, and illuminating actions with wisdom as the true essence of these duties.
dheesh_gita::656.modern_relevance: When you share your deepest truth, control impulses calmly, and act with clear insight, your efforts become meaningful beyond effort alone.
dheesh_gita::656.insight: This verse shifts focus from external acts to the inner quality that makes actions sacred: wisdom and self-restraint.

dheesh_gita::657.verse_sanskrit:
नित्यकर्म्मास्महं नून नात्र कचिद्विवेचना ।
उपस्तियज्ञज्ञानेषु पराभक्तया समन्विता  ॥
dheesh_gita::657.verse_hindi: नित्य कर्म ही  हूँ  इसमें कोई विवचना नहीं है । हे विज्ञ ब्राह्मण श्रेष्ठो ! उपासना यज्ञों मे
dheesh_gita::657.english_translation: I am the constant action itself; there is no question about it. O learned Brahmin, worship and sacrifices are inseparable from devoted knowledge.
dheesh_gita::657.translation_literal: नित्यकर्म्मास्महं (constant action am I) / नून (surely) / नात्र (here not) / कचिद्विवेचना (any doubt) / उपस्तियज्ञज्ञानेषु (in worship and sacrifices with knowledge) / पराभक्तया (with devotedness) / समन्विता (combined)
dheesh_gita::657.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::657.essence: You are inseparable from constant action united with devoted knowledge and worship.
dheesh_gita::657.simple_meaning: You are always engaged in action combined with devoted knowledge; this is a fundamental truth without question.
dheesh_gita::657.simple_insight: You belong to ongoing action joined with sincere devotion and clear understanding.
dheesh_gita::657.detailed_meaning: Speaking to a learned Brahmin, the speaker declares that their essence is constant action united with devoted knowledge and worship, leaving no room for doubt or separation.
dheesh_gita::657.modern_relevance: You move through your daily tasks not as separate from purpose or devotion, but as a living expression of both.
dheesh_gita::657.insight: It shifts your view from separating action and devotion to seeing them as one seamless whole.

dheesh_gita::658.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रहमोपास्तिरह्यो विज्ञा अस्महं ब्राह्मणोंत्मा: !।
मननं ज्ञानयज्ञेषु महायज्ञेप्वकं  तथा ॥
dheesh_gita::658.verse_hindi: मैं अहो ! पराभक्तियुक्त ब्रहमोपासना हूँ , ज्ञानयज्ञों में मैं मनन हूँ और
dheesh_gita::658.english_translation: I am the supreme devotion-filled worship of Brahman, the reflection in acts of wisdom and the essence of the great sacrifice.
dheesh_gita::658.translation_literal: ब्रहमोपास्तिरह्यो (the supreme worship of Brahman) / विज्ञा (with devotion) / अस्महं (I am) / ब्राह्मणोंत्मा: (the soul of the Brahmans) / मननं (reflection) / ज्ञानयज्ञेषु (in the sacrifices of knowledge) / महायज्ञेप्वकं (and the essence of the great sacrifice) / तथा (also)
dheesh_gita::658.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::658.essence: Devotion is the living force at the heart of true worship and wise reflection.
dheesh_gita::658.simple_meaning: The deepest form of devotion is what powers true worship and thoughtful wisdom, uniting action with inner dedication.
dheesh_gita::658.simple_insight: Devotion is not separate from wisdom—it powers and shines through it.
dheesh_gita::658.detailed_meaning: This verse reveals the divine teacher describing devotion as the core of worshiping the supreme reality and the thoughtful reflection within acts of wisdom and sacrifice, showing how heartfelt dedication animates spiritual practice.
dheesh_gita::658.modern_relevance: When you focus deeply on your work or study with heartfelt commitment, that devotion transforms ordinary effort into something meaningful and wise.
dheesh_gita::658.insight: It shifts your view from seeing devotion as only emotion to understanding it as the energizing source of wise, meaningful action.

dheesh_gita::659.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्मयज्ञोऽमि प्रयाग भी विप्रा: ! सर्वयज्ञशिरोमणिः ।
वृक्ताऽरम्यहं सभामध्ये  आचार्य: शिक्षकेषु च ॥
dheesh_gita::659.verse_hindi: हे विप्रों ! महायज्ञों में मैं सर्वयज्ञ शिरोमणि ब्रह्मयज्ञ हूँ। सभा के बीच में मैं वक्ता हूँ और शिक्षकों के बीच में आचार्य हूँ
dheesh_gita::659.english_translation: O learned ones! Among great sacrifices, I am the supreme sacrifice of Brahman. In the assembly, I am the speaker, and among teachers, I am the preceptor.
dheesh_gita::659.translation_literal: ब्रह्मयज्ञोऽमि (I am the Brahman-sacrifice) प्रयाग (in Prayag) भी (also) विप्रा: (O learned ones) ! सर्वयज्ञशिरोमणि: (the crown jewel of all sacrifices) । वृक्ताऽरम्यहं (I am the speaker pleasing) सभामध्ये (in the assembly) आचार्य: (the preceptor) शिक्षकेषु (among teachers) च (also) ॥
dheesh_gita::659.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::659.essence: The speaker claims to be the highest sacrifice and leader among teachers.
dheesh_gita::659.simple_meaning: I am the highest of all sacrifices among great rituals. In gatherings, I speak, and among teachers, I lead as a guide.
dheesh_gita::659.simple_insight: Recognizing the highest role you can play brings confidence and clarity.
dheesh_gita::659.detailed_meaning: Addressing the learned assembly at Prayag, the speaker claims to embody the highest sacrifice and take the lead as the main speaker and teacher, establishing authority and respect in the gathering.
dheesh_gita::659.insight: It encourages embracing your highest role confidently when among peers or experts.

dheesh_gita::660.verse_sanskrit:
उपदेशकवृन्देषु जगत्ययोऽम्यहं गुरुः ।
आत्माऽमस्मि भो विप्रा: ! भृतवृन्देप्ववस्थितः ॥
dheesh_gita::660.verse_hindi: उपदेशकों के बीच मैं जगत्पूज्य गुरु हूँ। हे विप्रो ! भूतगण के अन्तर में अवस्थितम मैं आत्मा हूँ
dheesh_gita::660.english_translation: Among the teachers, I am the revered guru of the world. O wise one, I am the true self present within all beings.
dheesh_gita::660.translation_literal: उपदेशकवृन्देषु (among the groups of teachers) / जगत्ययोऽम्यहं (I am the revered of the world) / गुरुः (guru) / आत्माऽमस्मि (I am the true self) / भो (O) / विप्रा: (wise ones) / भृतवृन्देप्ववस्थितः (present within the groups of beings)
dheesh_gita::660.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::660.essence: The true self is the highest teacher present within all beings and teachers.
dheesh_gita::660.simple_meaning: The true self is the supreme presence found within all beings and is honored as the highest teacher.
dheesh_gita::660.simple_insight: You belong to a deeper presence that connects all beings and teachers alike.
dheesh_gita::660.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the speaker declares being the supreme guru recognized among all teachers, identifying as the true self residing within every living being, addressing the wise to recognize this inner presence.
dheesh_gita::660.modern_relevance: When you feel separate or lost, remember that the same true self connects you to everyone and every teacher around you.
dheesh_gita::660.insight: Recognize your connection to the true self within all beings, shifting identity from isolated self to shared presence.

dheesh_gita::661.verse_sanskrit:
प्राणिपुञ्जेषु चैतन्यमहमेव न संशयः ।
नादः शब्दसमूहेषु वाक्येप्योङ्कार एव च ॥
dheesh_gita::661.verse_hindi: सब प्राणियों में मैं ही निःसन्देह चेतना रूप हैं। मैं शब्दसमूह में नाद और वाक्यसमूह में ओंकार ही हूँ
dheesh_gita::661.english_translation: I am undoubtedly the consciousness in all living beings; in sounds, I am the primal vibration and the sacred syllable.
dheesh_gita::661.translation_literal: प्राणिपुञ्जेषु (in all living beings) / चैतन्यम् (consciousness) / अहम् (I) / एव (indeed) / न (not) / संशयः (doubt) / । / नादः (primal vibration) / शब्दसमूहेषु (in groups of sounds) / वाक्ये (in speech) / अपि (also) / ओङ्कारः (sacred syllable Om) / एव (indeed) / च (and)
dheesh_gita::661.speaker: Shri Dheesh
dheesh_gita::661.essence: Your true self is the universal consciousness and sacred vibration in all life and sound.
dheesh_gita::661.simple_meaning: You are the consciousness present in all living things and the sacred vibration that underlies all sounds.
dheesh_gita::661.simple_insight: You carry the same awareness and sacred essence as everything around you.
dheesh_gita::661.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Shri Dheesh reveals that the same consciousness animates every living being and that this consciousness is also the primal sacred vibration in all sounds, highlighting the unity of life and sound.
dheesh_gita::661.modern_relevance: When you feel separate or alone, remember you share the same awareness and sacred vibration with all life and every sound you hear.
dheesh_gita::661.insight: Recognize your true self as the universal consciousness and sacred essence behind all existence, beyond individual form.

dheesh_gita::662.verse_sanskrit:
इन्द्रोऽहं देववृन्देषु भृगुरस्मि  महर्षिषु ।
यमो नियामकेप्वस्मि पितृमध्येऽर्यमाभिधः ॥
dheesh_gita::662.verse_hindi: मैं देवताओं में इन्द्र, महर्षियों में भृगु, पितरों में  अर्यमा और नियामकों में यम हूँ
dheesh_gita::662.english_translation: Among the deities, I am Indra; among the great sages, I am Bhrigu; among the ancestors, I am Aryama; and among the regulators, I am Yama.
dheesh_gita::662.translation_literal: इन्द्रोऽहं (I am Indra) / देववृन्देषु (among the deities) / भृगुरस्मि (I am Bhrigu) / महर्षिषु (among the great sages) / यमो (Yama) / नियामकेप्वस्मि (I am among the regulators) / पितृमध्येऽर्यमाभिधः (I am Aryama among the ancestors)
dheesh_gita::662.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::662.essence: The true self manifests uniquely in every noble and guiding role.
dheesh_gita::662.simple_meaning: The true self expresses itself as powerful figures in different spheres: as leader among deities, sage among seers, noble among ancestors, and regulator among enforcers.
dheesh_gita::662.simple_insight: You have a unique strength that shines through many aspects of your life.
dheesh_gita::662.detailed_meaning: This verse reveals how the inner being identifies with key figures representing power, wisdom, nobility, and order across different realms, showing the multifaceted nature of the divine presence within.
dheesh_gita::662.modern_relevance: In your life, you wear many hats—leader, wise friend, respected family member, and rule keeper—each reflecting a part of your true strength.
dheesh_gita::662.insight: It teaches you to recognize your inner power as diverse and present in many roles you play.

dheesh_gita::663.verse_sanskrit:
असुरेषु बलिर्यज्ञो जाहव्यस्मि सरित्सु च।
जलाशयेषु सर्वेषु सागरोऽस्मि न संशयः ॥
dheesh_gita::663.verse_hindi: असुरो में मुझको बलि जानो, मैं सरिताओं में जाहनवी और सब जलाशयों में निःसन्देह सागर हूँ
dheesh_gita::663.english_translation: Among the shadowed beings, I am the sacrifice; among rivers, I am the Ganges; among all water bodies, I am surely the ocean.
dheesh_gita::663.translation_literal: असुरेषु (among the shadowed beings) बलि (sacrifice) यज्ञः (sacrifice/ritual) जाहव्यस्मि (I am offered) सरित्सु (in rivers) च (and) जलाशयेषु (in water bodies) सर्वेषु (all) सागरोऽस्मि (I am the ocean) न (not) संशयः (doubt)
dheesh_gita::663.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::663.essence: You are the power behind every sacrifice and the vastness in every water.
dheesh_gita::663.simple_meaning: You are the essence present in every sacrifice, river, and ocean—powerful and all-pervading.
dheesh_gita::663.simple_insight: You carry the strength of sacrifice and the vastness of oceans within you.
dheesh_gita::663.detailed_meaning: The verse portrays the divine presence as the essential power behind sacrifices and all waters. It expresses the idea that the true self or divine force underlies even hostile forces, rivers like the Ganges, and the immense ocean.
dheesh_gita::663.modern_relevance: When you face challenges or feel small, remember you hold the power behind every effort and the vastness that connects all things.
dheesh_gita::663.insight: It shifts your view to see every action and environment as infused with a deeper, unifying power.

dheesh_gita::664.verse_sanskrit:
पुष्पमानन्ददेवस्मि पदार्थेषु महार्षयः!
पवित्रं परमं विप्राः ! तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ॥
dheesh_gita::664.verse_hindi: हे महर्षिगण आनन्दप्रद पदार्थों में मैं पुष्प हूँ। हे विप्रो! तेजस्वियों में मैं परम पवित्र तेजरूप हूँ
dheesh_gita::664.english_translation: O great sages, among blissful substances I am the flower; among the wise, I am the supreme pure light.
dheesh_gita::664.translation_literal: पुष्प (flower) / मानन्द (bliss) / देवस्मि (I am among the gods/beings) / पदार्थेषु (among substances) / महार्षयः (great sages) / पवित्रं (pure) / परमं (supreme) / विप्राः (wise ones) / तेजः (light/energy) / तेजस्विनामहम् (I am of the luminous ones)
dheesh_gita::664.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::664.essence: True brilliance and purity stand out like a flower and a supreme light.
dheesh_gita::664.simple_meaning: Among all joyful things, you are like the most beautiful flower; among wise people, you are the purest bright light.
dheesh_gita::664.simple_insight: You carry a unique brilliance and purity that sets you apart in any group.
dheesh_gita::664.detailed_meaning: The speaker honors great sages as radiant beings and compares their qualities to elements of nature and wisdom, highlighting how among joy and wisdom, the finest and purest essence stands out like a flower or a bright light.
dheesh_gita::664.modern_relevance: When you feel ordinary in a crowd, remember your unique light and purity that shines quietly yet powerfully.
dheesh_gita::664.insight: Recognize your own inner brightness and purity as a unique strength among others.

dheesh_gita::665.verse_sanskrit:
बलं बलवत्तामस्मि कामरागविवर्जितम्।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि जननाय च ॥
dheesh_gita::665.verse_hindi: बलवानों में मैं कामरागविवर्जित बल हूँ और उत्पत्ति के लिये प्राणियों में मैं धर्म विरुद्ध काम हूँ
dheesh_gita::665.english_translation: Among the powerful, I am the strength free from desire and attachment; among beings, I am desire opposed to dharma that causes birth.
dheesh_gita::665.translation_literal: बलं (strength) बलवत्तामस्मि (among the powerful I am) कामरागविवर्जितम् (free from desire and attachment) । धर्माविरुद्धो (against dharma) भूतेषु (among beings) कामः (desire) अस्मि (I am) जननाय (for birth) च (and)
dheesh_gita::665.speaker: Shri Dheesh
dheesh_gita::665.essence: True strength is freedom from desire; craving opposes right purpose and causes rebirth.
dheesh_gita::665.simple_meaning: True strength is acting without desire or craving. Desire that opposes right purpose causes repeated birth.
dheesh_gita::665.simple_insight: You can find power that doesn’t depend on wanting or craving.
dheesh_gita::665.detailed_meaning: The speaker explains that real strength belongs to those who act without desire or attachment. Desire that goes against dharma creates continued rebirth in beings. This reveals the difference between pure inner power and restless craving.
dheesh_gita::665.modern_relevance: You’ve felt powerful when your actions come from clear purpose, not from craving or neediness.
dheesh_gita::665.insight: It teaches you to see strength as freedom from craving, not mere force or control.

dheesh_gita::666.verse_sanskrit:
विद्यास्वध्यात्मविद्याऽस्मि विद्वांसो ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः!।
सत्यमकाशकश्चास्मि वादो वादिगणेप्वहम् ॥
dheesh_gita::666.verse_hindi: हे विद्वान् विप्रवरो ! मैं विद्यासमूह में अध्यात्मविद्या हूँ और वादिगण में मैं सत्य प्रकाशक वाद हूँ
dheesh_gita::666.english_translation: O noble scholar! Among all knowledge, I am the knowledge of the self, and among debates, I am the truth-revealing argument.
dheesh_gita::666.translation_literal: विद्या (knowledge) / स्वाध्यात्मविद्या (self-study knowledge) / अस्मि (am) / विद्वान् (scholar) / ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः (best of Brahmins) / सत्यम् (truth) / आकाश (sky) / च (and) / अस्मि (am) / वादः (argument) / वादिगणे (debate assembly) / प्वहम् (destroyer)
dheesh_gita::666.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::666.essence: True knowledge and powerful argument come from understanding the self and revealing truth.
dheesh_gita::666.simple_meaning: The highest form of knowledge is understanding the true self, and the strongest argument reveals truth clearly.
dheesh_gita::666.simple_insight: There is power and peace in knowing your true self and seeking truth in all things.
dheesh_gita::666.detailed_meaning: A teacher addresses a respected scholar, explaining that among all types of knowledge, the knowledge of the self is supreme, and among all debates, the one that reveals truth shines brightest. This highlights the central importance of self-knowledge and honest inquiry.
dheesh_gita::666.modern_relevance: When you face conflicting opinions or confusion, grounding yourself in your true nature and valuing truth can guide you steadily.
dheesh_gita::666.insight: It teaches you to prioritize self-awareness and honest truth over surface arguments or external knowledge.

dheesh_gita::667.verse_sanskrit:
नारीप्वहं तपोरूपो यज्ञरूपों नरेषु च।
गुणत्रयेष्वहं विप्राः ! गुणाः सत्त्वाभिधानकः ॥
dheesh_gita::667.verse_hindi: स्त्रियों में मैं तपोरूप हूँ और परुषों में मैं यज्ञ रूप हूँ । हे विप्रों ! मैं त्रिगुण में सत्वगुण हूँ
dheesh_gita::667.english_translation: Among women, I am the form of disciplined effort; among men, I am the form of sacred action; and among the three qualities, I am the quality called goodness, O learned ones.
dheesh_gita::667.translation_literal: नारीप्वहं (among women I) / तपोरूपो (am form of disciplined effort) / यज्ञरूपों (form of sacred action) / नरेषु (among men) / च (also) / गुणत्रयेष्वहं (among the three qualities) / विप्राः (O learned ones) / गुणाः (qualities) / सत्त्वाभिधानकः (called goodness)
dheesh_gita::667.speaker: Shri Dheesh
dheesh_gita::667.essence: The divine expresses as effort, action, and goodness across different roles and qualities.
dheesh_gita::667.simple_meaning: The divine expresses itself differently: as disciplined effort in women, sacred action in men, and as the quality of goodness among the three qualities.
dheesh_gita::667.simple_insight: You can recognize the divine qualities within yourself through effort, action, and goodness.
dheesh_gita::667.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the speaker describes how the divine manifests in different forms: disciplined effort (tapas) in women, sacred ritual action (yajna) in men, and as the sattva quality among the three gunas. It reflects the varied expressions of the divine in human nature and qualities.
dheesh_gita::667.modern_relevance: You notice how your steady effort, purposeful actions, and wholesome nature shape who you really are, beyond labels or roles.
dheesh_gita::667.insight: It teaches you to see the divine qualities expressed uniquely in your character and actions, transcending gender or surface differences.

dheesh_gita::668.verse_sanskrit:
भावत्रयेऽध्यात्मभावः शीलेषु विनयोऽस्म्यहम् ।
सदाचारेषु वृद्धानां प्रणतिः पादपद्मयोः ॥
dheesh_gita::668.verse_hindi: त्रिभावों में मैं अध्यात्मभाव हूँ, मैं शील में विनय और सदाचारो में वृद्धो के चरणकमलों में प्रणामरूप हूँ।
dheesh_gita::668.english_translation: Among the three attitudes, I am the spiritual attitude; in virtues, I am humility; in good conduct, I am the respectful bow at the feet of the elders.
dheesh_gita::668.translation_literal: भावत्रयेऽध्यात्मभावः (in three attitudes, the spiritual attitude) / शीलेषु विनयः (in virtues, humility) / अस्मि अहम् (I am) / सदाचारेषु (in good conduct) / वृद्धानां (of elders) / प्रणतिः (the respectful bow) / पादपद्मयोः (at the lotus feet)
dheesh_gita::668.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::668.essence: Humility and respect for elders reveal the spiritual attitude in your virtues and conduct.
dheesh_gita::668.simple_meaning: Among different attitudes, the spiritual attitude is humility; in virtues, it is modesty; in good conduct, it is showing respect to elders.
dheesh_gita::668.simple_insight: You feel grounded and connected when humility and respect guide your actions.
dheesh_gita::668.detailed_meaning: This verse highlights how the divine quality manifests as humility in virtues and as respectful behavior toward elders, emphasizing the importance of reverence and modesty in spiritual life.
dheesh_gita::668.modern_relevance: You pause to listen carefully and respectfully to someone wiser, feeling the strength of humility in a world that often demands loudness.
dheesh_gita::668.insight: It teaches you to recognize humility and respect as expressions of your highest inner attitude, shaping your character and behavior.

dheesh_gita::669.verse_sanskrit:
कारणब्रह्मरूपेण हयेकोऽद्वैतोऽप्यहं द्विजाः।
अनन्तोऽस्मि महाविज्ञाः ! सैत्यमेतन संशयः ॥
dheesh_gita::669.verse_hindi: हे महाविज्ञ ब्राह्मणो! में कारणब्रह्मरूप से एक अद्वितीय होकर भी अनन्त हूँ यह सत्य है. सन्देह नहीं  है
dheesh_gita::669.english_translation: O great knower among brahmins! Though I am one without a second as the cause Brahman, I am infinite; this truth has no doubt.
dheesh_gita::669.translation_literal: कारणब्रह्मरूपेण (as cause Brahman) / हय (I am) / एक (one) / अद्वैतः (without a second) / अपि (indeed) / अहं (I) / द्विजाः (O brahmins) / अनन्तः (infinite) / अस्मि (am) / महाविज्ञाः (O great knower) / सैत्यम् (this truth) / एतत् (this) / संशयः (doubt)
dheesh_gita::669.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::669.essence: You are uniquely one and infinite simultaneously without any doubt.
dheesh_gita::669.simple_meaning: You are fundamentally one and unique, yet infinite; this is an unquestionable truth.
dheesh_gita::669.simple_insight: You can rest in the certainty of your infinite, unique true self.
dheesh_gita::669.detailed_meaning: Addressed to a learned brahmin, the speaker declares that despite being uniquely one in the form of the cause Brahman, they are also infinite. This highlights the non-dual nature of the true self, dispelling any doubt about its vastness and unity.
dheesh_gita::669.modern_relevance: When you feel small or fragmented, remember your true self is both unique and endlessly vast beyond any doubt.
dheesh_gita::669.insight: It shifts perception from seeing yourself as limited and separate to recognizing your boundless unity and uniqueness.

dheesh_gita::670.verse_sanskrit:
अनन्तत्वात्संख्यया मे कार्यब्रह्मस्वरूपतः।
सङ्खयातुं नैव शक्नोति विभूतीः कश्चिदप्यहो॥
dheesh_gita::670.verse_hindi: कार्यब्रह्मरूप से संख्या से अनन्त होने के कारण मेरी विभूतियों की अहो ! कोई भी संख्या नहीं कर सकता।
dheesh_gita::670.english_translation: Because the divine is infinite and the nature of action is absolute, no one can count its manifestations.
dheesh_gita::670.translation_literal: अनन्तत्वात्संख्यया (from infiniteness, by number) / मे (my) / कार्यब्रह्मस्वरूपतः (due to the nature of the action-divine) / सङ्खयातुं (to count) / नैव (not at all) / शक्नोति (is able) / विभूतीः (manifestations) / कश्चिदप्यहो (anyone)
dheesh_gita::670.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::670.essence: The infinite power within you cannot be captured or counted by any number.
dheesh_gita::670.simple_meaning: The true self is infinite and its expressions cannot be counted or limited by any number.
dheesh_gita::670.simple_insight: There is a vastness inside you that cannot be measured or fully known.
dheesh_gita::670.detailed_meaning: The verse explains that the divine nature of action is infinite. No one can count the countless manifestations of this divine power, emphasizing the limitless scope of the true self's expressions.
dheesh_gita::670.modern_relevance: When you try to list or measure all your talents, strengths, or potential, you realize they are too many to count.
dheesh_gita::670.insight: It shifts your mind from trying to limit or quantify your inner potential to embracing its boundless nature.

dheesh_gita::671.verse_sanskrit:
भवतां विप्रवर्याणां कल्याणार्थ हि केवलम।
दिग्दर्शनस्त्ररूपेण किञ्चिद्वो वर्णितं मयाः॥
dheesh_gita::671.verse_hindi: केवल आप विप्रवरों के कल्याणार्थ ही दिग्दर्शन रूप से आपलोगों से यह कुछ वर्णन किया है
dheesh_gita::671.english_translation: I have described this briefly for your welfare, O best among the wise, as a guidance.
dheesh_gita::671.translation_literal: भवतां (your) / विप्रवर्याणां (best among the wise) / कल्याणार्थ (for welfare) / हि (indeed) / केवलम (only) / दिग्दर्शन (guidance) / त्ररूपेण (in three forms) / किञ्चित् (somewhat) / वो (to you) / वर्णितं (described) / मयाः (by me)
dheesh_gita::671.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::671.essence: Brief guidance is given solely for the welfare of the best among the wise.
dheesh_gita::671.simple_meaning: This is a brief description given as guidance for your welfare, addressed to the best among the wise.
dheesh_gita::671.simple_insight: Sometimes guidance is shared simply and briefly, for the well-being of sincere listeners.
dheesh_gita::671.detailed_meaning: The speaker addresses a group considered the best among the wise, offering a concise description meant only to guide and benefit them, not an elaborate teaching.
dheesh_gita::671.insight: Recognize that some teachings are shared briefly and intentionally for the listener's welfare, not for exhaustive explanation.

dheesh_gita::672.verse_sanskrit:
उपदेशश्च में हृद्यं धृत्वा स्त्रहृदयेऽनिशम् ।
ममोपास्तौ रताः सन्तो भजध्वं मोक्षमुत्तमम् ॥
dheesh_gita::672.verse_hindi: आप मेरे हृदयग्राही उपदेश को अपने हृदय में निरन्तर रखकर मेरी उपासना मे रत होकर उत्तम मोक्षपद को प्राप्त हो
dheesh_gita::672.english_translation: Keep my heartfelt teaching constantly in your heart, devoted to my worship, and attain the highest freedom.
dheesh_gita::672.translation_literal: उपदेशश्च (teaching also) में (in me) हृद्यं (heartfelt) धृत्वा (holding) स्त्रहृदयेऽनिशम् (in the heart constantly) । ममोपास्तौ (my worship) रताः (engaged) सन्तो (being) भजध्वं (worship) मोक्षमुत्तमम् (freedom highest) ॥
dheesh_gita::672.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::672.essence: Steady devotion to heartfelt teaching leads you to the highest freedom.
dheesh_gita::672.simple_meaning: Keep this teaching deeply in your heart and stay devoted in worship to reach the highest freedom.
dheesh_gita::672.simple_insight: There is strength in steady devotion that gently opens the way to true freedom.
dheesh_gita::672.detailed_meaning: The teacher urges the student to hold his teaching deeply and continuously in their heart, to remain devoted in worship, promising that this devotion leads to the highest form of freedom.
dheesh_gita::672.modern_relevance: When you remember a trusted guide’s advice and stay committed to your values, it helps you find true ease and freedom in life.
dheesh_gita::672.insight: It invites you to root the teaching in your heart and cultivate devotion as a practice to experience freedom.

dheesh_gita::673.verse_sanskrit:
श्रद्धा वः सात्त्विकी विप्राः ! प्रकृतौ मे चिरं वसेत् ।
ममैव प्रकृतिधृत्वा स्त्रीभावं कामदायिनी ॥
dheesh_gita::673.verse_hindi: हे विप्रों ! मेरी प्रकति पर आपकी  सात्विक श्रद्धा चिरकाल तक बनी रहे। मेरी प्रकृति ही स्त्रीभाव कों धारण करके कामदा,
dheesh_gita::673.english_translation: O wise ones, may your pure faith in me endure long; my nature itself, embodying the feminine aspect, grants desire.
dheesh_gita::673.translation_literal: श्रद्धा (faith) वः (your) सात्त्विकी (pure) विप्राः (wise ones) ! प्रकृतौ (in the nature) मे (my) चिरं (long) वसेत् (may it remain) । ममैव (my own) प्रकृतिधृत्वा (holding nature) स्त्रीभावं (feminine aspect) कामदायिनी (granting desire) ॥
dheesh_gita::673.speaker: Shri Dheesh
dheesh_gita::673.essence: Lasting pure faith in the nurturing divine nature sustains your deepest longing.
dheesh_gita::673.simple_meaning: You are encouraged to keep sincere and pure trust in the divine nature, which expresses as a nurturing, desire-giving feminine aspect.
dheesh_gita::673.simple_insight: You can feel supported by a steady, trusting love that lasts beyond the moment.
dheesh_gita::673.detailed_meaning: The teacher addresses wise listeners, urging them to maintain a long-lasting pure faith in the divine nature. This nature, described as embodying a feminine quality, is the source of fulfilling desire and nurturing energy.
dheesh_gita::673.modern_relevance: When you face uncertainty, relying on steady trust in your inner nature can provide calm and help your deepest wishes grow.
dheesh_gita::673.insight: It teaches you to nurture a lasting, heartfelt trust that supports your hopes and desires.

dheesh_gita::674.verse_sanskrit:
विभ्राणा भगिनीभावार्थसिद्धिप्रदायिनी ।
धरन्ती मातृभावञ्च शक्तिधर्मपदा सदा ॥
dheesh_gita::674.verse_hindi: भगिनी भाव को धारण करके अर्थ और सिद्धि प्रदा और मातृभाव धारण करके सदा धर्म और शक्तिप्रदा
dheesh_gita::674.english_translation: The earth, embodying the spirit of a sister, grants wealth and accomplishment; embodying the spirit of a mother, she always grants dharma and power.
dheesh_gita::674.translation_literal: विभ्राणा (bearing) भगिनीभाव (sisterly feeling) अर्थसिद्धिप्रदायिनी (giver of wealth and accomplishment) । धरन्ती (the earth) मातृभावञ्च (and motherly feeling) शक्तिधर्मपदा (giver of power and dharma) सदा (always) ॥
dheesh_gita::674.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::674.essence: The earth nurtures both material success and moral strength like a sister and a mother.
dheesh_gita::674.simple_meaning: The earth is described as having qualities like a sister who helps achieve wealth and success, and like a mother who always supports righteousness and strength.
dheesh_gita::674.simple_insight: The earth’s nurturing roles show how support can come in many forms, both practical and moral.
dheesh_gita::674.detailed_meaning: This verse praises the earth’s dual nature: as a sister providing material benefit and as a mother offering moral strength and duty. It reflects on how the earth supports life in multiple essential ways.
dheesh_gita::674.insight: It teaches you to see support beyond the obvious, recognizing both practical help and deeper moral strength.

dheesh_gita::675.verse_sanskrit:
भूत्वा मे ज्ञानिनो भक्तान् प्रकृतिस्थान समन्ततः ।
तेभ्यो मुक्तिप्रदं दत्ते विदधाना सुदुर्लभम् ॥
dheesh_gita::675.verse_hindi: होकर मेरे ज्ञानीभक्तो को सब ओर से प्रकृतिस्थ करती हुई उनको सुदुर्लभ मुक्तिपद प्रदान करती है
dheesh_gita::675.english_translation: When my wise devotees remain established in nature from all sides, I grant them the rare state of liberation.
dheesh_gita::675.translation_literal: भूत्वा (being) / मे (my) / ज्ञानिनो (wise ones) / भक्तान् (devotees) / प्रकृतिस्थान (established in nature) / समन्ततः (from all sides) / तेभ्यो (to them) / मुक्तिप्रदं (liberation-giving) / दत्ते (gives) / विदधाना (granting) / सुदुर्लभम् (rare)
dheesh_gita::675.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::675.essence: Steadiness in your true nature invites rare freedom from the divine.
dheesh_gita::675.simple_meaning: Wise devotees who remain steady and natural from all sides receive rare freedom from the divine.
dheesh_gita::675.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing steady trust in your true nature opens a path to freedom.
dheesh_gita::675.detailed_meaning: This verse describes how the divine grants rare liberation to those wise devotees who remain fully established in their natural state. It highlights a moment where being steady in nature becomes the key to receiving freedom.
dheesh_gita::675.modern_relevance: You keep calm and authentic in a chaotic world, and gradually a rare kind of inner freedom begins to emerge.
dheesh_gita::675.insight: It teaches you to remain stable in your natural being, trusting that freedom will come without forcing it.

dheesh_gita::676.verse_sanskrit:
श्रद्धान्वितानां मच्छतौ भक्तानां सुलभो भवेत ।
चतुर्वर्गों न सन्देहो विद्यतेऽत्र द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
dheesh_gita::676.verse_hindi: मेरी शक्ति पर श्रद्धान्वित भक्तों को चतुर्वर्ग सुलभ हो जाता है हे विप्रवरो ! इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
dheesh_gita::676.english_translation: For those devoted to my power with trust, the four goals of life become easily accessible, O best of Brahmins; there is no doubt about this.
dheesh_gita::676.translation_literal: श्रद्धान्वितानां (of those with trust) / मच्छतौ (on my power) / भक्तानां (of devotees) / सुलभो (easy) / भवेत (becomes) / चतुर्वर्गों (the four goals of life) / न (not) / सन्देहो (doubt) / विद्यते (exists) / अत्र (here) / द्विजोत्तमाः (O best of Brahmins)
dheesh_gita::676.speaker: श्री धीश
dheesh_gita::676.essence: Trust in divine power makes life’s highest goals easily reachable without doubt.
dheesh_gita::676.simple_meaning: If you sincerely trust the divine power, the four important life goals become easy to achieve without doubt.
dheesh_gita::676.simple_insight: Trusting deeply brings a sense of ease and certainty about reaching your life’s purpose.
dheesh_gita::676.detailed_meaning: Shri Dheesh assures a highly respected Brahmin that those who place trustful devotion in the divine power will find the four aims of life—dharma, artha, kama, and moksha—accessible and attainable without confusion or hesitation.
dheesh_gita::676.modern_relevance: You feel stuck trying to reach your life goals, but when you truly trust the process beyond your control, things begin to align naturally.
dheesh_gita::676.insight: It teaches you to open your heart with trust, which clears doubts and makes your goals attainable.

dheesh_gita::677.verse_sanskrit:
अत्यन्तं गोपनीया वः श्रावितोपनिपन्मया ।
धीशगीताभिधानेन लोकेष्वेपा प्रचार्यताम् ॥
dheesh_gita::677.verse_hindi: यह मैंने अति गोपनीय उपनिषद् आप लोगो को सुनाया है आप इसको धीशगीता नाम से प्रचार करो
dheesh_gita::677.english_translation: I have taught you a deeply confidential Upanishad; spread it in the world by the name Dheesh Gita.
dheesh_gita::677.translation_literal: अत्यन्तं (deeply) गोपनीया (confidential) वः (to you) श्रावितोपनिपन्मया (taught/heard) । धीशगीताभिधानेन (by the name Dheesh Gita) लोकेष्वेपा (in the worlds also) प्रचार्यताम् (let it be spread) ॥
dheesh_gita::677.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::677.essence: A secret teaching is revealed to be shared openly by name for the world's benefit.
dheesh_gita::677.simple_meaning: A secret teaching has been shared. It is instructed to spread this teaching called Dheesh Gita.
dheesh_gita::677.simple_insight: Some teachings are precious and meant to be shared carefully and widely.
dheesh_gita::677.detailed_meaning: The speaker announces that a highly confidential teaching, an Upanishad, has been imparted to the listeners. They are now instructed to share this sacred knowledge throughout the world under the title Dheesh Gita.
dheesh_gita::677.insight: Recognize the value of sacred knowledge and the responsibility to share it wisely.

dheesh_gita::678.verse_sanskrit:
यया मे निखिला भक्ताश्चतुर्वर्गमवाप्नुयुः ।
एषा नैव प्रदातव्या नास्तिकेभ्यः कदाचन ॥
dheesh_gita::678.verse_hindi: जिससे मेरे सब भक्त चतुर्वग प्राप्त करें। हे विप्रवरो ! अभक्त, नास्तिक
dheesh_gita::678.english_translation: Through which all my devotees attain the fourfold class; this must never be given to the irreverent or deniers.
dheesh_gita::678.translation_literal: यया (through which) / मे (my) / निखिला (all) / भक्ताश्चतुर्वर्गमवाप्नुयुः (devotees attain fourfold class) / एषा (this) / नैव (never) / प्रदातव्या (to be given) / नास्तिकेभ्यः (to deniers) / कदाचन (ever)
dheesh_gita::678.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::678.essence: Only sincere devotion opens the full spiritual path; denial closes it.
dheesh_gita::678.simple_meaning: True devotion leads all sincere followers to their complete spiritual fulfillment. This devotion is not to be granted to those who reject or deny it.
dheesh_gita::678.simple_insight: Devotion is a key that unlocks growth, but only when met with openness and faith.
dheesh_gita::678.detailed_meaning: The verse explains that sincere devotees who fully commit to the path receive complete spiritual blessings. However, those who reject devotion or deny its power cannot receive these benefits. It highlights devotion’s essential role and its exclusivity.
dheesh_gita::678.modern_relevance: When you give your full heart to a cause or belief, it transforms your life, but skepticism or rejection blocks that transformation.
dheesh_gita::678.insight: It teaches you to recognize that devotion requires openness; without it, the benefits cannot reach you.

dheesh_gita::679.verse_sanskrit:
पापिभ्योऽश्रद्दधानभ्यः प्राणिभ्यो ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ।
अभक्तेभ्यः कृतघ्नेभ्यो गुरुद्रोहिभ्य एव च ॥
dheesh_gita::679.verse_hindi: श्रद्धाहीन, गुरु विरोधी, कृतघ् और पापात्मा व्यक्तियों को इसको कदापि नहीं ही देना
dheesh_gita::679.english_translation: The highest Brahmins are never given to those who lack trust, are ungrateful, hostile to their Guru, or harmful to living beings.
dheesh_gita::679.translation_literal: पापिभ्योऽश्रद्दधानभ्यः (to the sinful and faithless) / प्राणिभ्यो (to living beings) / ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः (the highest Brahmins) / अभक्तेभ्यः (to the undevoted) / कृतघ्नेभ्यः (to the ungrateful) / गुरुद्रोहिभ्य (to the ones hostile to the guru) / एव (indeed) / च (also)
dheesh_gita::679.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::679.essence: Trust and respect are essential for receiving true spiritual knowledge.
dheesh_gita::679.simple_meaning: True spiritual knowledge is never granted to those who lack trust, are ungrateful, hostile to their teacher, or harm others.
dheesh_gita::679.simple_insight: You feel the importance of trust and respect as the foundation for receiving true guidance.
dheesh_gita::679.detailed_meaning: This verse warns that the highest spiritual wisdom (represented as the supreme Brahmin) is withheld from people who lack faith, show ingratitude, oppose their teacher, or harm other living beings. It highlights the essential qualities needed to receive true teaching.
dheesh_gita::679.modern_relevance: You hesitate to open your heart to guidance because past disappointments made you skeptical, but growth needs trust first.
dheesh_gita::679.insight: It teaches you to cultivate trust and gratitude as prerequisites to accessing deep wisdom and support.

dheesh_gita::680.verse_sanskrit:
श्रद्धा श्रीगुरुवाश्येषु येषां शास्त्रगणेष्वपि ।
विश्वासः परलोकेषु लक्ष्यमाध्यात्मिकं तथा ॥
dheesh_gita::680.verse_hindi: गुरु और शास्त्रों में जिनकी श्रद्धा है, पर लोकपर जिन का विश्वास है, जिनका लक्ष्य आध्यात्मिक है
dheesh_gita::680.english_translation: Those who have trust in the revered Guru and scriptures, faith in the higher realms, and a spiritual goal.
dheesh_gita::680.translation_literal: श्रद्धा (trust) / श्रीगुरुवाश्येषु (in revered Guru and elders) / येषां (whose) / शास्त्रगणेष्वपि (also in scriptures) / विश्वासः (faith) / परलोकेषु (in higher realms) / लक्ष्यमाध्यात्मिकं (spiritual goal) / तथा (also)
dheesh_gita::680.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::680.essence: Trust in your teacher, scriptures, and higher purpose grounds your spiritual journey.
dheesh_gita::680.simple_meaning: Having trust in the revered teacher and scriptures, faith in higher realms, and a spiritual goal is essential.
dheesh_gita::680.simple_insight: Trusting the teacher and higher purpose feels like a steady light in uncertain times.
dheesh_gita::680.detailed_meaning: This verse highlights that those who have deep trust in their revered Guru and sacred texts, along with faith in the higher realms and a clear spiritual aim, are on a solid foundation for growth and devotion.
dheesh_gita::680.modern_relevance: When doubts crowd your mind, trusting a wise guide and focusing on your deeper purpose can steady you.
dheesh_gita::680.insight: It teaches you to cultivate trust before certainty, anchoring your path in faith toward the true self.

dheesh_gita::681.verse_sanskrit:
मत्परायणता पुण्या वर्तते च निरन्तरम् ।
इयं तेभ्यः प्रदातव्या धीशगीता ध्रुवं द्विजाः ! ॥
dheesh_gita::681.verse_hindi: और जिनमें पवित्र मत्परायणता निरन्तर है हे द्विजो ! उनको यह धीशगीता अवश्य देनी चाहिये
dheesh_gita::681.english_translation: Those who have pure, constant devotion to me should definitely be given this Dheesh Gita, O twice-born.
dheesh_gita::681.translation_literal: मत्परायणता (devotion to me) / पुण्या (pure) / वर्तते (exists) / च (and) / निरन्तरम् (constant) । / इयं (this) / तेभ्यः (to those) / प्रदातव्या (should be given) / धीशगीता (Dheesh Gita) / ध्रुवं (certainly) / द्विजाः (O twice-born) !
dheesh_gita::681.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::681.essence: Pure, constant devotion naturally invites the gift of transformative teaching.
dheesh_gita::681.simple_meaning: People who have steady and pure devotion should receive this teaching without fail.
dheesh_gita::681.simple_insight: Knowing that sincere devotion invites clarity brings reassurance and openness.
dheesh_gita::681.detailed_meaning: A divine teacher instructs that those who maintain pure, unwavering devotion must be given this sacred teaching, emphasizing the importance of readiness and spiritual trust.
dheesh_gita::681.modern_relevance: When you feel deeply committed and open-hearted, the right guidance naturally finds you and supports your growth.
dheesh_gita::681.insight: It shows that sincere, ongoing devotion creates the perfect ground to receive profound wisdom.

dheesh_gita::682.verse_sanskrit:
धीशगीतामिमां पुण्यां पाठयन्ति पठन्ति ये ।
क्लेशकर्मविषाकेभ्यो रहिता आशयेन च ॥
dheesh_gita::682.verse_hindi: इस पवित्र धीशगीता को जो अध्ययन और अध्यापन करते हैं, क्लेश कर्मविपाक और आशय से रहित होकर
dheesh_gita::682.english_translation: Those who study and teach this sacred Dheesh Gita do so free from painful karma and attachment.
dheesh_gita::682.translation_literal: धीशगीतामिमां (this Dheesh Gita) / पुण्यां (sacred) / पाठयन्ति (teach) / पठन्ति (study) / ये (those who) / क्लेशकर्मविषाकेभ्यो (from painful karma and reactions) / रहिता (free) / आशयेन (from attachment) / च (and)
dheesh_gita::682.speaker: Narrator
dheesh_gita::682.essence: Studying and teaching this sacred text works best without pain or attachment.
dheesh_gita::682.simple_meaning: People who study or teach this holy text do so without pain from past actions or personal attachment.
dheesh_gita::682.simple_insight: Learning and teaching shine brightest when free from burden and clinging.
dheesh_gita::682.detailed_meaning: The narrator introduces the Dheesh Gita as a sacred text whose study and teaching are pure and free from the pain of karma and any selfish desire. This sets the tone for the text's transformative purpose.
dheesh_gita::682.modern_relevance: You share or learn something deeply meaningful when you let go of past burdens and personal agendas.
dheesh_gita::682.insight: It encourages approaching learning and teaching with openness, free from personal baggage or expectations.

dheesh_gita::683.verse_sanskrit:
भजन्ते मेऽखिला भक्ता मत्सायुज्यमसंशयम् ।
न च तान् बाधते कश्चित्तापो लोके कथञ्चन ॥
dheesh_gita::683.verse_hindi: वह मेरे सब भक्त मत्सायुज्य को अवश्य प्राप्त होते हैं और उनको इस संसार में किसी प्रकार भी कोई ताप बाधा नहीं देता है।
dheesh_gita::683.english_translation: All my devotees surely attain union with me; no suffering in the world can harm them.
dheesh_gita::683.translation_literal: भजन्ते (worship) मेऽखिला (all my) भक्ता (devotees) मत्सायुज्यम (union with me) असंशयम् (without doubt) । न (not) च (and) तान् (them) बाधते (afflicts) कश्चित् (anyone) आपः (suffering) लोके (in the world) कथञ्चन (in any way) ॥
dheesh_gita::683.speaker: Shri Dheesh
dheesh_gita::683.essence: Complete devotion creates an unbreakable shield against all suffering.
dheesh_gita::683.simple_meaning: Those who fully devote themselves to the divine reach a deep union and remain free from worldly suffering.
dheesh_gita::683.simple_insight: You can feel safe and protected simply through devoted love, no matter what happens around you.
dheesh_gita::683.detailed_meaning: Shri Dheesh assures that anyone who sincerely worships and loves the divine merges with it and is untouched by worldly pains, offering hope amidst hardship.
dheesh_gita::683.modern_relevance: Even when life feels overwhelming and pain seems constant, your devotion can create an unshakable sanctuary inside you.
dheesh_gita::683.insight: It teaches you to anchor your heart in devotion, which protects you from being shaken by external troubles.

dheesh_gita::684.verse_sanskrit:
कल्याणजननीमेतां श्रद्धयैव पठन्ति ये।
एनया येऽथवा यागं गाणपत्यं प्रकुर्वते ॥
dheesh_gita::684.verse_hindi: श्रद्धा के साथ ही इस कल्याण कारिणी गीता का जो पाठ करते हैं अथवा जो इसके द्वारा
dheesh_gita::684.english_translation: Those who read this benevolent teaching with trust, or perform rituals using it,
dheesh_gita::684.translation_literal: कल्याणजननीमेतां (this benevolence-generating) / श्रद्धयैव (with trust alone) / पठन्ति (read) / ये (those who) / एनया (by this) / येऽथवा (or those who) / यागं (ritual) / गाणपत्यं (to Ganapati) / प्रकुर्वते (perform)
dheesh_gita::684.speaker: Narrator
dheesh_gita::684.essence: Trust is the essential starting point that brings the teaching its real benefit.
dheesh_gita::684.simple_meaning: Reading this teaching with sincere trust or performing rituals with it brings benefit.
dheesh_gita::684.simple_insight: Trusting what you study or practice invites the teaching's true help into your life.
dheesh_gita::684.detailed_meaning: This verse introduces that those who read the sacred teaching with sincere trust or perform related rituals, such as to Ganapati, open themselves to its beneficial power.
dheesh_gita::684.modern_relevance: You open a book or start a practice unsure, but trust invites positive change beyond immediate proof.
dheesh_gita::684.insight: It shows that trust is the key that activates the deeper power of spiritual teaching and practice.

dheesh_gita::685.verse_sanskrit:
हवनात्मकमाहोस्वित केवलं पाठरूपकम् ।
तेषा नश्यन्ति भक्तानामाधयो व्याधयोऽखिलाः ॥
dheesh_gita::685.verse_hindi: केवल पाठात्मक वा हवनात्मक गणपतियाग का अनुष्ठान करते हैं उन मेरे भक्तो की सब आधि और व्याधियां नष्ट हो जाती हैं
dheesh_gita::685.english_translation: Those devotees who perform only the ritualistic or textual Ganapati sacrifice have all their ailments and sufferings destroyed.
dheesh_gita::685.translation_literal: हवनात्मकम् (ritualistic) / आहोस्वित (or textual) / केवलं (only) / पाठरूपकम् (scriptural form) / तेषा (of those) / नश्यन्ति (are destroyed) / भक्तानाम् (devotees') / आधयो (ailments) / व्याधयः (diseases) / अखिलाः (all)
dheesh_gita::685.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::685.essence: Sincere devotional ritual, even if formal, can heal all ailments and suffering.
dheesh_gita::685.simple_meaning: Performing devoted rituals, even if only formal or textual, can remove all suffering and illnesses from a devotee.
dheesh_gita::685.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing sincere devotion, even through ritual, can bring healing and relief.
dheesh_gita::685.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the teacher explains that devotees of Ganapati who perform only the ritual sacrifice, strictly following the text or ceremony, experience the destruction of their sufferings and illnesses. It highlights the power of devoted action even when it seems formal or symbolic.
dheesh_gita::685.modern_relevance: When you follow a meaningful tradition or practice with sincere heart, even if you do it mechanically, it can bring unexpected relief from stress and pain.
dheesh_gita::685.insight: It teaches that the heart behind the action matters more than perfection; sincere ritual can heal deeply.

dheesh_gita::686.verse_sanskrit:
संयता ये तपोनिष्ठा भक्तिभावेन कुर्वते ।
पाठस्य श्रवणं सम्यगेतस्याः सार्थक द्विजाः ! ॥
dheesh_gita::686.verse_hindi: हे द्विजो ! जो भक्तिभाव से संयत और तप परायण होकर भलीभांति इसका सार्थक पाठ श्रवण
dheesh_gita::686.english_translation: O twice-born, those who are disciplined, devoted, and dedicated to tapas listen carefully and make this study meaningful.
dheesh_gita::686.translation_literal: संयता (disciplined) / ये (those who) / तपोनिष्ठा (dedicated to tapas) / भक्तिभावेन (with devotion) / कुर्वते (do) / पाठस्य (of study) / श्रवणं (listening) / सम्यगेतस्याः (properly) / सार्थक (meaningful) / द्विजाः (twice-born)
dheesh_gita::686.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::686.essence: Devoted discipline transforms listening into meaningful learning.
dheesh_gita::686.simple_meaning: Listening to teachings with devotion and disciplined effort makes learning meaningful and effective.
dheesh_gita::686.simple_insight: You feel inspired to engage fully and sincerely with what you learn.
dheesh_gita::686.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, the twice-born (students) are urged to approach study with devotion and disciplined effort (tapas). This disciplined, devoted listening makes their study truly meaningful and fruitful.
dheesh_gita::686.modern_relevance: You approach a new skill with focused attention and heartfelt care, making every lesson count.
dheesh_gita::686.insight: It teaches you to combine steady effort with heartfelt devotion to deepen your understanding.

dheesh_gita::687.verse_sanskrit:
गाणपत्यस्य यागस्यानुष्ठानं वैतया सदा ।
काचिद्वाधा न तेषां स्याद्विपत्तिः माणिनां तथा ॥
dheesh_gita::687.verse_hindi: अथवा इसके द्वारा गणपतियाग का अनुष्ठान सदा करते हैं उन जीवों के ऐसे कोई बाधा, विपत्ति
dheesh_gita::687.english_translation: Those who always perform the ritual of Ganapati suffer no obstacles or misfortunes in life.
dheesh_gita::687.translation_literal: गाणपत्यस्य (of Ganapati) यागस्यानुष्ठानं (ritual's performance) वैतया (always) सदा (ever) । काचिद्वाधा (any obstacle) न (not) तेषां (to them) स्याद्विपत्तिः (would be misfortune) माणिनां (to beings) तथा (also) ॥
dheesh_gita::687.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::687.essence: Consistent Ganapati ritual prevents obstacles and misfortunes.
dheesh_gita::687.simple_meaning: Those who regularly perform the ritual for Ganapati do not face obstacles or troubles.
dheesh_gita::687.simple_insight: There is comfort in steady ritual practice protecting from difficulties.
dheesh_gita::687.detailed_meaning: This verse declares that beings who consistently perform the ritual dedicated to Ganapati do not encounter obstacles or misfortunes. It highlights the protective quality of this practice but does not elaborate on its deeper philosophical context.
dheesh_gita::687.insight: It shows the value placed on committed ritual practice as a safeguard against challenges.

dheesh_gita::688.verse_sanskrit:
तादृशी विघ्नशिर्वा नश्येदया नैव सत्वरम् ।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विद्यते ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ॥
dheesh_gita::688.verse_hindi: और विधनसमूह नहीं हैं जो शीघ्र ही दूर न हो सके, हे विप्रवरो ! इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है।
dheesh_gita::688.english_translation: There are no obstacles that cannot be quickly removed, O best of Brahmins! There is no doubt about this.
dheesh_gita::688.translation_literal: तादृशी (such) / विघ्नशिर्वा (obstacles or) / नश्येदया (are destroyed) / नैव (not) / सत्वरम् (quickly) / नात्र (here not) / कश्चन (anyone) / सन्देहो (doubt) / विद्यते (exists) / ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः (O best of Brahmins)
dheesh_gita::688.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::688.essence: No obstacle is truly permanent when met with determined action.
dheesh_gita::688.simple_meaning: Any obstacle you face can be removed quickly if you act with determination. There is no doubt about this truth.
dheesh_gita::688.simple_insight: You can feel assured that no challenge is permanent or undefeatable.
dheesh_gita::688.detailed_meaning: A speaker addresses a respected Brahmin, assuring him that obstacles, no matter how daunting, do not last long when met with proper effort. This builds confidence in taking action without hesitation.
dheesh_gita::688.modern_relevance: You face a sudden problem at work or in life. This verse reminds you that with decisive effort, even big roadblocks can be cleared swiftly.
dheesh_gita::688.insight: It shifts your mindset from fearing obstacles to trusting your ability to overcome them quickly through focused effort.

dheesh_gita::689.verse_sanskrit:
आर्ता जिज्ञासवो भक्तास्तथाऽर्थार्थिन एव वै ।
त्रिविधा एव मे भक्ता एतद्गीताश्रयेण हि ॥
dheesh_gita::689.verse_hindi: मेरे आर्त जिज्ञासु और अर्थार्थी तीनों प्रकार के भक्त ही इस गीता के आश्रय से ही
dheesh_gita::689.english_translation: My distressed, curious, and desire-driven followers are all three types of devotees who take refuge in this Gita.
dheesh_gita::689.translation_literal: आर्ता (distressed) / जिज्ञासवः (curious) / भक्तास्तथा (and devotees also) / अर्थार्थिन् (desire-driven) / एव (indeed) / वै (only) / त्रिविधा (threefold) / एव (indeed) / मे (my) / भक्ता (devotees) / एतत् (this) / गीताश्रयेण (in the refuge of the Gita) / हि (indeed)
dheesh_gita::689.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::689.essence: All kinds of seekers find refuge in this teaching without exclusion.
dheesh_gita::689.simple_meaning: This teaching embraces all kinds of devotees—those who suffer, those who seek knowledge, and those who seek material gain.
dheesh_gita::689.simple_insight: You are accepted whatever your motivation; this path holds space for your journey.
dheesh_gita::689.detailed_meaning: The teacher declares that followers come in three types: those in distress, those seeking understanding, and those desiring worldly benefits. All are embraced by this scripture's refuge, showing its universal accessibility.
dheesh_gita::689.modern_relevance: Whether you come from pain, curiosity, or practical needs, you can find guidance and belonging here.
dheesh_gita::689.insight: Recognize that devotion can arise from many motives—all are valid starting points on the path.

dheesh_gita::690.verse_sanskrit:
स्वमनोरथसाफल्यं लभेरन्नात्र संशयः।
तथैवास्याश्च गीतायाः श्रवणान्मननात्तथा ॥
dheesh_gita::690.verse_hindi: निःसन्देह सफल मनोरथ होंगे और उसी प्रकार मेरे ज्ञानीभक्त भी इस गीता के श्रवण मनन और
dheesh_gita::690.english_translation: There is no doubt that one attains the fulfillment of their own desires, just as my wise devotees do, through listening and reflecting on this Gita.
dheesh_gita::690.translation_literal: स्व (self) / मनोरथ (desires) / साफल्यं (fulfillment) / लभे (attains) / न (not) / अत्र (here) / संशयः (doubt) / तथा (thus) / एव (indeed) / अस्य (this) / अश्च (also) / गीतायाः (of the Gita) / श्रवणात् (by listening) / मननात् (by reflection) / तथा (thus)
dheesh_gita::690.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::690.essence: Focused listening and reflection bring the fulfillment of your true desires without doubt.
dheesh_gita::690.simple_meaning: You will surely achieve your true desires by listening carefully and reflecting on this teaching.
dheesh_gita::690.simple_insight: There is hope and certainty in attentive listening and thoughtful reflection.
dheesh_gita::690.detailed_meaning: This verse assures that those who attentively listen and thoughtfully reflect on the Gita, like the wise devotees, will surely see their true desires fulfilled.
dheesh_gita::690.modern_relevance: You feel stuck, wishing for things to change. This reminds you that deep listening and honest reflection can bring your goals closer.
dheesh_gita::690.insight: It teaches you to trust the process of listening and reflecting as a way to realize your inner aspirations.

dheesh_gita::691.verse_sanskrit:
निदिध्यासनतो नूनं ज्ञानिभक्ताश्च मामकाः।
अपरोक्षानुभूत्या में दर्शन कर्त्तुमीशते ॥
dheesh_gita::691.verse_hindi: निदिध्यासन द्वारा अपरोक्षानुभूति से मेरे दर्शन करने में अवश्य समर्थ होंगे
dheesh_gita::691.english_translation: Those devoted to me through deep meditation and direct experience surely become capable of perceiving me.
dheesh_gita::691.translation_literal: निदिध्यासनतो (through deep meditation) / नूनं (surely) / ज्ञानिभक्ताश्च (the devoted wise ones also) / मामकाः (my own) / अपरोक्षानुभूत्या (through direct experience) / में (me) / दर्शन (perception) / कर्त्तुम् (to do) / ईशते (are able)
dheesh_gita::691.speaker: Unknown
dheesh_gita::691.essence: Deep meditation and devotion unlock direct experience of the divine presence.
