ramacharitamanas::1849.translation_literal: चली (set out) / बरात (wedding procession) / निसान (drums and ceremonial instruments) / बजाई (beating) / मुदित (joyful) / छोट (small) / बड़ (large) / सब (all) / समुदाई (assembly) / रामहि (Ram) / निरखि (seeing) / ग्राम (village) / नर (men) / नारी (women) / पाइ (having obtained) / नयन (eyes) / फलु (fruit / true reward) / होहिं (become) / सुखारी (happy)
ramacharitamanas::1849.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1849.essence: Seeing Ram is itself the fulfillment of the eyes.
ramacharitamanas::1849.simple_meaning: Ram's wedding procession begins, and everyone who sees him feels fulfilled and joyful.
ramacharitamanas::1849.simple_insight: Some moments do not just please the eyes; they make the heart feel it has received its reward.
ramacharitamanas::1849.detailed_meaning: The wedding procession has begun, drums are sounding, and the whole crowd is happy. As Ram passes through the villages, men and women look at him with delight. This is a scene of public joy, not a teaching moment.
ramacharitamanas::1849.modern_relevance: You catch sight of someone entering a room and the whole atmosphere changes. People straighten up, smile, and feel lighter without knowing why. Some presences do that.
ramacharitamanas::1849.insight: It frames Ram's presence as the reward itself, shifting attention from ceremony to blessing.

ramacharitamanas::1850.verse_sanskrit: बीच बीच बर बास करि मग लोगन्ह सुख देत। अवध समीप पुनीत दिन पहुँची आइ जनेत ॥
ramacharitamanas::1850.verse_hindi: बीच-बीच में सुंदर मुकाम करती हुई तथा मार्ग के लोगों को सुख देती हुई वह बारात पवित्र दिन में अयोध्यापुरी के समीप आ पहुँची ॥
ramacharitamanas::1850.english_translation: Stopping at beautiful resting places along the way, giving joy to the people on the road, the wedding party arrived near Ayodhya on the sacred day.
ramacharitamanas::1850.translation_literal: बीच बीच (at intervals) / बर बास (beautiful resting places) / करि (having made) / मग लोगन्ह (to the people on the road) / सुख देत (giving joy) / अवध समीप (near Ayodhya) / पुनीत दिन (on the sacred day) / पहुँची (arrived) / आइ (coming) / जनेत (the wedding party)
ramacharitamanas::1850.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1850.essence: A noble journey blesses everyone it passes.
ramacharitamanas::1850.simple_meaning: The wedding procession paused at pleasant places along the way, bringing happiness to the people it passed, and reached near Ayodhya on an auspicious day.
ramacharitamanas::1850.simple_insight: A blessed journey leaves kindness behind it, not just footprints.
ramacharitamanas::1850.detailed_meaning: Ram’s wedding party is nearing Ayodhya. The procession stops at lovely resting places, and every village it passes feels uplifted by the sight of it. The verse simply marks the procession’s graceful arrival before the celebrations intensify.
ramacharitamanas::1850.modern_relevance: A convoy pulls off at a roadside dhaba after hours on the highway, and the whole group lightens the mood for the staff and travelers around them. Even arrival can carry grace.
ramacharitamanas::1850.insight: It shifts attention from the destination to the way one moves through other people’s lives.

ramacharitamanas::1851.verse_sanskrit: हने निसान पनव बर बाजे। भेरि संख धुनि हय गय गाजे॥ झाँझि बिरव डिंडिमीं सुहाई। सरस राग बाजहिं सहनाई ॥
ramacharitamanas::1851.verse_hindi: नगाड़ों पर चोटें पड़ने लगीं, सुंदर ढोल बजने लगे। भेरी और शंख की बड़ी आवाज हो रही है, हाथी-घोड़े गरज रहे हैं। विशेष शब्द करने वाली झाँझें, सुहावनी डफलियाँ तथा रसीले राग से शहनाइयाँ बज रही हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1851.english_translation: Drums were struck and fine drums played. The great sounds of kettle-drum and conch rose; horses and elephants thundered. Bright cymbals, lovely hand-drums, and sweet shehnai melodies sounded.
ramacharitamanas::1851.translation_literal: हने (were struck) / निसान (drums) / पनव (fine drum) / बर (good/beautiful) / बाजे (were played) / भेरि (kettle-drum) / संख (conch) / धुनि (sound) / हय (horses) / गय (elephants) / गाजे (roared) / झाँझि (cymbals) / बिरव (sound) / डिंडिमीं (small drum) / सुहाई (pleasant) / सरस (sweet) / राग (melody) / बाजहिं (are played) / सहनाई (shehnai)
ramacharitamanas::1851.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1851.essence: The procession announces itself through sound before sight.
ramacharitamanas::1851.simple_meaning: The wedding procession moves forward in a flood of music and celebration. Drums, conches, horses, elephants, cymbals, and shehnais all fill the air.
ramacharitamanas::1851.simple_insight: Joy can be heard before it arrives. Celebration changes the whole world around it.
ramacharitamanas::1851.detailed_meaning: The wedding procession is nearing Ayodhya. This verse lingers on the soundscape: drums, conches, elephants, horses, cymbals, and shehnais. It is a scene-setting verse, building the festive arrival of Ram's barat.
ramacharitamanas::1851.modern_relevance: You hear music from the street before the wedding car turns the corner. Even before anyone arrives, the whole lane knows something joyful is coming.
ramacharitamanas::1851.insight: It slows the scene into pure atmosphere, letting the reader feel the procession's grandeur before the city sees it.

ramacharitamanas::1852.verse_sanskrit: पुर जन आवत अकनि बराता। मुदित सकल पुलकावलि गाता॥ निज निज सुंदर सदन सँवारे। हाट बाट चौहटपुर द्वारे ॥
ramacharitamanas::1852.verse_hindi: बारात को आती हुई सुनकर नगर निवासी प्रसन्न हो गए। सबके शरीरों पर पुलकावली छा गई। सबने अपने-अपने सुंदर घरों, बाजारों, गलियों, चौराहों और नगर के द्वारों को सजाया ॥
ramacharitamanas::1852.english_translation: Hearing that the wedding procession was coming, the city people became joyful and their bodies bristled with delight. They decorated their own beautiful homes, markets, lanes, crossroads, and city gates.
ramacharitamanas::1852.translation_literal: पुर (city) / जन (people) / आवत (coming) / अकनि (hearing) / बराता (wedding procession) / मुदित (joyful) / सकल (all) / पुलकावलि (thrill of joy) / गाता (body) / निज (own) / निज (own) / सुंदर (beautiful) / सदन (homes) / सँवारे (decorated) / हाट (markets) / बाट (roads) / चौहटपुर (crossroads and city squares) / द्वारे (gates)
ramacharitamanas::1852.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1852.essence: Joy spreads fast when a cherished arrival is near.
ramacharitamanas::1852.simple_meaning: The whole city lights up with joy at the arrival of the wedding procession, and everyone decorates their homes and streets.
ramacharitamanas::1852.simple_insight: Shared joy turns an ordinary city into a living celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1852.detailed_meaning: The wedding procession is nearing Ayodhya, and the whole city senses it before it arrives. People are thrilled, their bodies respond with delight, and they rush to decorate every home and street for the sacred event.
ramacharitamanas::1852.modern_relevance: You hear the message that the guests are five minutes away, and suddenly the whole house moves at once. Beds are straightened, lights are fixed, and even the hallway feels festive.
ramacharitamanas::1852.insight: It shows how a shared moment of welcome can transform an entire community into one coordinated act of joy.

ramacharitamanas::1853.verse_sanskrit: गलीं सकल अरगजाँ सिंचाईं। जहँ तहँ चौकें चारु पुराईं॥ बना बजारु न जाइ बखाना। तोरन केतु पताक बिताना ॥
ramacharitamanas::1853.verse_hindi: सारी गलियाँ अरगजे से सिंचाई गईं, जहाँ-तहाँ सुंदर चौक पुराए गए। तोरणों ध्वजा-पताकाओं और मंडपों से बाजार ऐसा सजा कि जिसका वर्णन नहीं किया जा सकता ॥
ramacharitamanas::1853.english_translation: All the lanes were sprinkled with fragrant water. Beautiful squares were filled in here and there. The marketplace was decorated beyond description with arches, flags, banners, and canopies.
ramacharitamanas::1853.translation_literal: गलीं (lanes) / सकल (all) / अरगजाँ (fragrant water) / सिंचाईं (were sprinkled) / जहँ तहँ (here and there) / चौकें (squares) / चारु (beautiful) / पुराईं (were filled in) / बना (made) / बजारु (marketplace) / न जाइ (cannot be told) / बखाना (description) / तोरन (arches) / केतु (flags) / पताक (banners) / बिताना (canopies)
ramacharitamanas::1853.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1853.essence: Beauty prepares the world for what is sacred.
ramacharitamanas::1853.simple_meaning: The whole town is being prepared for the wedding with scented water, filled squares, and rich decorations everywhere.
ramacharitamanas::1853.simple_insight: Some moments deserve full beauty. Care itself becomes part of the celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1853.detailed_meaning: In Ayodhya, the city is being dressed for Ram and Sita's wedding. Streets are washed, squares are prepared, and markets glow with arches and flags. The verse lingers on the joy of collective preparation before the sacred event.
ramacharitamanas::1853.modern_relevance: Before a wedding, neighbors are out early sweeping the lane, hanging strings of lights, and setting up tents. The effort feels bigger than decoration — it says, "Something precious is coming."
ramacharitamanas::1853.insight: It shifts attention from the event alone to the shared devotion shown in preparation.

ramacharitamanas::1854.verse_sanskrit: सफल पूगफल कदलि रसाला। रोपे बकुल कदंब तमाला॥ लगे सुभग तरु परसत धरनी। मनिमय आलबाल कल करनी ॥
ramacharitamanas::1854.verse_hindi: फल सहित सुपारी, केला, आम, मौलसिरी, कदम्ब और तमाल के वृक्ष लगाए गए। वे लगे हुए सुंदर वृक्ष (फलों के भार से) पृथ्वी को छू रहे हैं। उनके मणियों के थाले बड़ी सुंदर कारीगरी से बनाए गए हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1854.english_translation: Fruit-bearing areca, banana, mango, bakula, kadamba, and tamala trees were planted. The lovely trees seemed to touch the earth with their heavy fruit. Jewelled flower-beds were made with exquisite craft.
ramacharitamanas::1854.translation_literal: सफल (bearing fruit) / पूगफल (areca fruit) / कदलि (banana) / रसाला (mango) / रोपे (were planted) / बकुल (bakula) / कदंब (kadamba) / तमाला (tamala) / लगे (appeared) / सुभग (beautiful) / तरु (trees) / परसत (touching) / धरनी (the earth) / मनिमय (made of jewels) / आलबाल (flower-beds) / कल करनी (with beautiful craftsmanship)
ramacharitamanas::1854.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1854.essence: Celebration turns the whole city into an offering.
ramacharitamanas::1854.simple_meaning: The city is being decorated with fruit trees and jewel-like flower-beds for the wedding celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1854.simple_insight: Beauty can be an offering. Even a city can become a sign of joy and welcome.
ramacharitamanas::1854.detailed_meaning: Ayodhya is being prepared for Ram and Sita's wedding. The streets are already washed and adorned, and now trees, fruit, and jeweled flower-beds are arranged everywhere. This is vivid scene-setting, not a separate teaching.
ramacharitamanas::1854.modern_relevance: You help decorate a hall before a wedding, adjusting flowers and lights until everything feels alive. The work itself becomes part of the celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1854.insight: It shifts attention from bare description to sacred preparation: ordinary space is being transformed for joy.

ramacharitamanas::1855.verse_sanskrit: बिबिध भाँति मंगल कलस गृह गृह रचे सँवारि। सुर ब्रह्मादि सिहाहिं सब रघुबर पुरी निहारि ॥
ramacharitamanas::1855.verse_hindi: अनेक प्रकार के मंगल-कलश घर-घर सजाकर बनाए गए हैं। श्री रघुनाथजी की पुरी (अयोध्या) को देखकर ब्रह्मा आदि सब देवता सिहाते हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1855.english_translation: Many kinds of auspicious pots were arranged and decorated in every home. Seeing Raghubar's city, Brahma and the other radiant beings all stood amazed.
ramacharitamanas::1855.translation_literal: बिबिध भाँति (in various ways) / मंगल कलस (auspicious pots) / गृह गृह (in every house) / रचे सँवारि (arranged and decorated) / सुर (radiant beings) / ब्रह्मादि (Brahma and others) / सिहाहिं (stand amazed) / सब (all) / रघुबर पुरी (Raghubar's city) / निहारि (seeing)
ramacharitamanas::1855.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1855.essence: The city itself becomes an offering before the celebration begins.
ramacharitamanas::1855.simple_meaning: Every house is decorated with auspicious pots, and the whole city shines so beautifully that even the radiant beings are amazed.
ramacharitamanas::1855.simple_insight: Beauty can become so complete that it feels larger than human effort.
ramacharitamanas::1855.detailed_meaning: Ayodhya is being prepared for celebration. Homes are dressed with auspicious pots, and the city is being transformed into a scene of wonder. The verse is part of the larger description of that festive splendor, not a separate teaching.
ramacharitamanas::1855.modern_relevance: A neighborhood is lit up for a wedding, every doorway cleaned, every wall brightened, and even the guests pause at the care in it. Some moments are made to be admired.
ramacharitamanas::1855.insight: It shifts attention from ordinary space to sacred celebration and shared wonder.

ramacharitamanas::1856.verse_sanskrit: भूप भवनु तेहि अवसर सोहा। रचना देखि मदन मनु मोहा॥ मंगल सगुन मनोहरताई। रिधि सिधि सुख संपदा सुहाई ॥
ramacharitamanas::1856.verse_hindi: उस समय राजमहल (अत्यन्त) शोभित हो रहा था। उसकी रचना देखकर कामदेव भी मन मोहित हो जाता था। मंगल शकुन, मनोहरता, ऋद्धि-सिद्धि, सुख, सुहावनी सम्पत्ति ॥
ramacharitamanas::1856.english_translation: At that time the royal palace shone brilliantly. Even Kama would be enchanted by its beauty. Auspicious signs, charm, prosperity, delight, and all forms of grace adorned it.
ramacharitamanas::1856.translation_literal: भूप (king) / भवनु (palace) / तेहि अवसर (at that time) / सोहा (shone beautifully) । / रचना (design, construction) / देखि (seeing) / मदन (Kama) / मनु (mind) / मोहा (was deluded, enchanted) । / मंगल (auspicious) / सगुन (good omens) / मनोहरताई (loveliness) । / रिधि (prosperity) / सिधि (success, powers) / सुख (happiness) / संपदा (wealth) / सुहाई (looked lovely, adorned)
ramacharitamanas::1856.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1856.essence: Beauty and auspiciousness filled the palace before the celebration began.
ramacharitamanas::1856.simple_meaning: The palace was dazzling with beauty and auspiciousness. Everything there looked fortunate, graceful, and full of prosperity.
ramacharitamanas::1856.simple_insight: Beauty can feel so complete that it seems to bless the whole space.
ramacharitamanas::1856.detailed_meaning: Ayodhya is being prepared for Ram and Sita’s wedding. The palace shines with decoration, good signs, and overflowing prosperity. This verse is a scene-setting detail, building the mood before the joy of the royal house fully unfolds.
ramacharitamanas::1856.modern_relevance: You walk into a home before a wedding and feel the air change — flowers, lights, careful arranging, and a quiet sense that something blessed is about to happen.
ramacharitamanas::1856.insight: It builds anticipation by showing that outer beauty can mirror inner joy and readiness.

ramacharitamanas::1857.verse_sanskrit: जनु उछाह सब सहज सुहाए। तनु धरि धरि दसरथ गृहँ छाए॥ देखन हेतु राम बैदेही। कहहु लालसा होहि न केही ॥
ramacharitamanas::1857.verse_hindi: और सब प्रकार के उत्साह (आनंद) मानो सहज सुंदर शरीर धर-धरकर दशरथजी के घर में छा गए हैं। श्री रामचन्द्रजी और सीताजी के दर्शनों के लिए भला कहिए, किसे लालसा न होगी ॥
ramacharitamanas::1857.english_translation: And all delight seemed to take on natural, lovely bodies and fill Dasharath's house. Who would not long to see Ram and Sita?
ramacharitamanas::1857.translation_literal: जनु (as if) / उछाह (joy, delight) / सब (all) / सहज (natural) / सुहाए (lovely, pleasing) / तनु (body) / धरि धरि (taking body after body) / दसरथ गृहँ (in Dasharath's house) / छाए (spread, filled) ॥ / देखन (to see) / हेतु (for the sake of) / राम (Ram) / बैदेही (Sita) / कहहु (tell) / लालसा (longing, desire) / होहि (would be) / न (not) / केही (for whom) ॥
ramacharitamanas::1857.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1857.essence: Longing for Ram and Sita makes joy itself seem alive.
ramacharitamanas::1857.simple_meaning: Joy itself seems to fill Dasharath's palace as Ram and Sita are about to be seen. The whole city is alive with eager longing.
ramacharitamanas::1857.simple_insight: Anticipation can feel so complete that even joy seems to have a body.
ramacharitamanas::1857.detailed_meaning: Ayodhya is dressed for Ram and Sita’s sight. The palace is glowing, and the coming darshan has turned the whole atmosphere into living joy. This verse lingers on the public longing before the royal procession arrives.
ramacharitamanas::1857.modern_relevance: You wait outside a hospital room or at a stage door, and the whole crowd changes. No one is casual anymore. Everyone is held by the same hope of seeing someone beloved.
ramacharitamanas::1857.insight: It turns anticipation into a shared, visible mood rather than a private feeling.

ramacharitamanas::1858.verse_sanskrit: जूथ जूथ मिलि चलीं सुआसिनि। निज छबि निदरहिं मदन बिलासिनि॥ सकल सुमंगल सजें आरती। गावहिं जनु बहु बेष भारती ॥
ramacharitamanas::1858.verse_hindi: सुहागिनी स्त्रियाँ झुंड की झुंड मिलकर चलीं, जो अपनी छबि से कामदेव की स्त्री रति का भी निरादर कर रही हैं। सभी सुंदर मंगलद्रव्य एवं आरती सजाए हुए गा रही हैं, मानो सरस्वतीजी ही बहुत से वेष धारण किए गा रही हों ॥
ramacharitamanas::1858.english_translation: The married women came in groups, their beauty surpassing even Cupid’s beloved. They carried all auspicious offerings and sang as if Saraswati herself had taken many forms.
ramacharitamanas::1858.translation_literal: जूथ जूथ (group by group) / मिलि चलीं (came together) / सुआसिनि (married women) / निज छबि (their own beauty) / निदरहिं (disregard, surpass) / मदन (Cupid) / बिलासिनि (his beloved) // सकल (all) / सुमंगल (most auspicious) / सजें (arranged) / आरती (ritual lamp-offering) / गावहिं (sing) / जनु (as if) / बहु बेष (many forms) / भारती (Saraswati)
ramacharitamanas::1858.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1858.essence: Shared joy can make a place feel holy before anything begins.
ramacharitamanas::1858.simple_meaning: Married women arrive in joyful groups, carrying auspicious offerings and singing with beauty and celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1858.simple_insight: Joy becomes visible when a whole community gathers with beauty, song, and blessing.
ramacharitamanas::1858.detailed_meaning: At Dasharath’s palace in Ayodhya, the women of the household gather in groups for Ram and Sita’s sighting and blessing. Their beauty, songs, and ritual offerings turn the palace into a living celebration, setting the mood for the sacred event.
ramacharitamanas::1858.modern_relevance: A home fills with noise before a wedding, women carrying trays, singing, laughing, adjusting veils, and blessing the moment. The atmosphere itself becomes part of the ceremony.
ramacharitamanas::1858.insight: It shifts attention from the central event to the sacred energy created by collective participation.

ramacharitamanas::1859.verse_sanskrit: भूपति भवन कोलाहलु होई। जाइ न बरनि समउ सुखु सोई॥ कौसल्यादि राम महतारीं। प्रेमबिबस तन दसा बिसारीं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1859.verse_hindi: राजमहल में (आनंद के मारे) शोर मच रहा है। उस समय का और सुख का वर्णन नहीं किया जा सकता। कौसल्याजी आदि श्री रामचन्द्रजी की सब माताएँ प्रेम के विशेष वश होने से शरीर की सुध भूल गईं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1859.english_translation: There was a joyful uproar in the royal palace. No one can describe that time or that happiness. Kaushalya and the other mothers of Ram were so overcome with love that they forgot their bodies.
ramacharitamanas::1859.translation_literal: भूपति (king's) / भवन (palace) / कोलाहलु (uproar) / होई (happened) । / जाइ (to go) / न (not) / बरनि (described) / समउ (time) / सुखु (happiness) / सोई (that) ॥ / कौसल्यादि (Kaushalya and others) / राम (Ram's) / महतारीं (mothers) । / प्रेमबिबस (overpowered by love) / तनु (body) / दसा (state) / बिसारीं (forgot) ॥
ramacharitamanas::1859.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1859.essence: Love can be so full that the body disappears from awareness.
ramacharitamanas::1859.simple_meaning: The palace was full of joy, beyond description. Ram's mothers were so overwhelmed by love that they forgot their bodies.
ramacharitamanas::1859.simple_insight: Some happiness is so complete it makes you lose track of yourself.
ramacharitamanas::1859.detailed_meaning: Ram's home is alive with celebration as the marriage joy spreads through the royal palace. Kaushalya and the other mothers are swept up in love for Ram, so absorbed that even bodily awareness falls away.
ramacharitamanas::1859.modern_relevance: A family room erupts when a long-awaited child finally comes home. Nobody is checking their phone or watching the clock. Joy has taken over the whole house.
ramacharitamanas::1859.insight: It shifts attention from outward celebration to the inward effect of love: self-forgetfulness.

ramacharitamanas::1860.verse_sanskrit: दिए दान बिप्रन्ह बिपुल पूजि गनेस पुरारि। प्रमुदित परम दरिद्र जनु पाइ पदारथ चारि ॥
ramacharitamanas::1860.verse_hindi: गणेशजी और त्रिपुरारि शिवजी का पूजन करके उन्होंने ब्राह्मणों को बहुत सा दान दिया। वे ऐसी परम प्रसन्न हुईं, मानो अत्यन्त दरिद्री चारों पदार्थ पा गया हो ॥
ramacharitamanas::1860.english_translation: After worshiping Ganesha and Shiva, they gave abundant gifts to the Brahmins. They became utterly delighted, as if a poor person had obtained all four aims of life.
ramacharitamanas::1860.translation_literal: दिए (gave) / दान (gifts) / बिप्रन्ह (to the Brahmins) / बिपुल (abundant) / पूजि (having worshiped) / गनेस (Ganesha) / पुरारि (Shiva, destroyer of the three cities) / प्रमुदित (delighted) / परम (utterly) / दरिद्र (poor) / जनु (as if) / पाइ (having obtained) / पदारथ (aims/treasures) / चारि (four)
ramacharitamanas::1860.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1860.essence: Reverence and giving turn joy into fullness.
ramacharitamanas::1860.simple_meaning: They honored Ganesha and Shiva, gave generous gifts to the Brahmins, and felt complete joy, like a poor person suddenly receiving everything desired.
ramacharitamanas::1860.simple_insight: Generosity turns celebration into fullness. Giving with reverence makes joy feel complete.
ramacharitamanas::1860.detailed_meaning: In Ayodhya’s celebration for Ram’s birth, the household does not stop at joy alone. The women first honor Ganesha and Shiva, then give gifts to the Brahmins. Their happiness swells so fully that it feels like a starving person suddenly receiving everything.
ramacharitamanas::1860.modern_relevance: You finish a big family ritual, then quietly hand envelopes to the people who helped make it happen. The real joy is not just in the ceremony — it is in giving.
ramacharitamanas::1860.insight: It shifts celebration from self-enjoyment to reverent generosity.

ramacharitamanas::1861.verse_sanskrit: मोद प्रमोद बिबस सब माता। चलहिं न चरन सिथिल भए गाता॥ राम दरस हित अति अनुरागीं। परिछनि साजु सजन सब लागीं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1861.verse_hindi: सुख और महान आनंद से विवश होने के कारण सब माताओं के शरीर शिथिल हो गए हैं, उनके चरण चलते नहीं हैं। श्री रामचन्द्रजी के दर्शनों के लिए वे अत्यन्त अनुराग में भरकर परछन का सब सामान सजाने लगीं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1861.english_translation: Overwhelmed by joy and delight, all the mothers' bodies grew weak; their feet could hardly move. Burning with love for Ram's sight, they began arranging the welcoming ceremony.
ramacharitamanas::1861.translation_literal: मोद (joy) / प्रमोद (great delight) / बिबस (overwhelmed) / सब (all) / माता (mothers) / चलहिं (walk) / न (not) / चरन (feet) / सिथिल (weak) / भए (became) / गाता (bodies) ॥ / राम (Ram) / दरस (sight) / हित (for) / अति (very) / अनुरागीं (loving, devoted) / परिछनि (welcome ceremony) / साजु (arrangements) / सजन (to make ready) / सब (all) / लागीं (began) ॥
ramacharitamanas::1861.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1861.essence: Joy for Ram weakens the body and wakes up service.
ramacharitamanas::1861.simple_meaning: The mothers are so filled with joy that they can barely walk. Their love for seeing Ram makes them prepare the welcome ceremony.
ramacharitamanas::1861.simple_insight: Love can make the body feel weak and still fill the hands with purpose.
ramacharitamanas::1861.detailed_meaning: In Ayodhya, the palace is alive with anticipation for Ram's return. Kaushalya and the other mothers are so flooded with delight that their bodies feel unsteady, yet that same love moves them to prepare the ceremonial welcome.
ramacharitamanas::1861.modern_relevance: You wait outside a hospital room with flowers in your hand, too anxious to sit still. The worry and the hope live in the same body.
ramacharitamanas::1861.insight: It shows how devotion turns emotional overwhelm into careful preparation.

ramacharitamanas::1862.verse_sanskrit: बिबिध बिधान बाजने बाजे। मंगल मुदित सुमित्राँ साजे॥ हरद दूब दधि पल्लव फूला। पान पूगफल मंगल मूला ॥
ramacharitamanas::1862.verse_hindi: अनेकों प्रकार के बाजे बजते थे। सुमित्राजी ने आनंदपूर्वक मंगल साज सजाए। हल्दी, दूब, दही, पत्ते, फूल, पान और सुपारी आदि मंगल की मूल वस्तुएँ, ॥
ramacharitamanas::1862.english_translation: Various kinds of instruments were played. Sumitra arranged the auspicious decorations with delight. Turmeric, sacred grass, curd, leaves, flowers, betel leaf, and areca nut—the basic signs of good fortune—were all set out.
ramacharitamanas::1862.translation_literal: बिबिध (various) / बिधान (kinds, kinds of) / बाजने (instruments) / बाजे (were played)। मंगल (auspicious) / मुदित (joyful) / सुमित्राँ (by Sumitra) / साजे (were arranged)॥ हरद (turmeric) / दूब (sacred grass) / दधि (curd) / पल्लव (leaves) / फूला (flowers)॥ पान (betel leaf) / पूगफल (areca nut) / मंगल (auspicious) / मूला (basic, root)॥
ramacharitamanas::1862.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1862.essence: A joyful welcome begins with careful preparation.
ramacharitamanas::1862.simple_meaning: The house is being prepared for an auspicious celebration. Music, decorations, and ritual items are all arranged with joy.
ramacharitamanas::1862.simple_insight: Joy becomes visible when even the smallest details are prepared with care.
ramacharitamanas::1862.detailed_meaning: In Ayodhya, the celebration for Ram's return is gathering force. The mothers have been overwhelmed by joy, and now the house fills with music and auspicious items as Sumitra helps prepare the welcome. This verse is a scene-setting detail in that larger outpouring of devotion.
ramacharitamanas::1862.modern_relevance: You set out extra plates, flowers, and lights before family arrives after a long absence. The preparation itself carries the love before anyone even walks in.
ramacharitamanas::1862.insight: It shifts attention from the event itself to the loving care that makes the event sacred.

ramacharitamanas::1863.verse_sanskrit: अच्छत अंकुर लोचन लाजा। मंजुल मंजरि तुलसि बिराजा॥ छुहे पुरट घट सहज सुहाए। मदन सकुन जनु नीड़ बनाए ॥
ramacharitamanas::1863.verse_hindi: तथा अक्षत (चावल), अँखुए, गोरोचन, लावा और तुलसी की सुंदर मंजरियाँ सुशोभित हैं। नाना रंगों से चित्रित किए हुए सहज सुहावने सुवर्ण के कलश ऐसे मालूम होते हैं, मानो कामदेव के पक्षियों ने घोंसले बनाए हों ॥
ramacharitamanas::1863.english_translation: Rice, sprouts, turmeric, and tulsi blossoms adorn the scene. The painted golden vessels look so lovely they seem like nests built by Cupid's birds.
ramacharitamanas::1863.translation_literal: अच्छत (unbroken rice) / अंकुर (sprouts) / लोचन (gorochan) / लाजा (puffed rice) / मंजुल (lovely) / मंजरि (clusters of blossoms) / तुलसि (tulsi) / बिराजा (shone) / छुहे (painted) / पुरट (gold) / घट (pots) / सहज (naturally) / सुहाए (delightful) / मदन (Cupid) / सकुन (birds) / जनु (as if) / नीड़ (nests) / बनाए (made)
ramacharitamanas::1863.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1863.essence: A prepared space can itself feel sacred.
ramacharitamanas::1863.simple_meaning: The wedding preparations are filled with auspicious items, flowers, and beautifully painted golden vessels that look like nests made by lovebirds.
ramacharitamanas::1863.simple_insight: Beauty can become a form of blessing when every detail is arranged with care.
ramacharitamanas::1863.detailed_meaning: In Ayodhya, the wedding preparations for Ram and Sita are underway. The women are arranging sacred grains, flowers, and decorated golden pots with joyful precision. The verse lingers on these details to show how fully the whole household is turned toward auspicious celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1863.modern_relevance: You walk into a room before a wedding and notice the flowers, the lamps, the careful placement of every bowl. The feeling is bigger than decoration — attention itself has become devotion.
ramacharitamanas::1863.insight: It trains the eye to notice how careful preparation can carry reverence.

ramacharitamanas::1864.verse_sanskrit: सगुन सुगंध न जाहिं बखानी। मंगल सकल सजहिं सब रानी॥ रचीं आरतीं बहतु बिधाना। मुदित करहिं कल मंगल गाना ॥
ramacharitamanas::1864.verse_hindi: शकुन की सुगन्धित वस्तुएँ बखानी नहीं जा सकतीं। सब रानियाँ सम्पूर्ण मंगल साज सज रही हैं। बहुत प्रकार की आरती बनाकर वे आनंदित हुईं सुंदर मंगलगान कर रही हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1864.english_translation: The fragrance of auspicious signs cannot be described. All the queens prepare every kind of blessing. They make many lamps for the aarti and sing joyful songs of good fortune.
ramacharitamanas::1864.translation_literal: सगुन (auspicious signs) / सुगंध (fragrance) / न (not) / जाहिं (can go) / बखानी (described) / मंगल (auspicious) / सकल (all) / सजहिं (are being arranged) / सब (all) / रानी (queens) / रचीं (made) / आरतीं (aarti lamps) / बहतु (many) / बिधाना (ways) / मुदित (joyful) / करहिं (do) / कल (beautiful) / मंगल (auspicious) / गाना (songs)
ramacharitamanas::1864.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1864.essence: A true welcome begins before the beloved arrives.
ramacharitamanas::1864.simple_meaning: The queens are joyfully preparing auspicious offerings, lamps, and songs for a ceremonial welcome.
ramacharitamanas::1864.simple_insight: Joy becomes visible when love prepares itself with care.
ramacharitamanas::1864.detailed_meaning: In Ayodhya, the royal household is alive with celebration. The queens arrange blessed items, lamps, and songs for the welcoming rites. This verse is part of the festive build-up before the more specific ceremonial action in the next line.
ramacharitamanas::1864.modern_relevance: A home fills with quiet excitement before a long-awaited arrival — flowers on the table, lamps ready, voices soft with happiness. Love often looks like careful preparation before anyone even appears.
ramacharitamanas::1864.insight: It shifts attention from the event itself to the loving preparation that makes welcome sacred.

ramacharitamanas::1865.verse_sanskrit: कनक थार भरि मंगलन्हि कमल करन्हि लिएँ मात। चलीं मुदित परिछनि करन पुलक पल्लवित गात ॥
ramacharitamanas::1865.verse_hindi: सोने के थालों को मांगलिक वस्तुओं से भरकर अपने कमल के समान (कोमल) हाथों में लिए हुए माताएँ आनंदित होकर परछन करने चलीं। उनके शरीर पुलकावली से छा गए हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1865.english_translation: The mothers, carrying golden trays filled with auspicious items in their lotus-like hands, went joyfully to perform the welcoming rite. Their bodies trembled with delight.
ramacharitamanas::1865.translation_literal: कनक (golden) / थार (tray) / भरि (filled) / मंगलन्हि (auspicious things) / कमल (lotus) / करन्हि (hands) / लिएँ (having taken) / मात (mothers) / चलीं (went) / मुदित (joyful) / परिछनि (welcoming rite) / करन (to do) / पुलक (hairs standing on end) / पल्लवित (sprouted / blossomed) / गात (body)
ramacharitamanas::1865.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1865.simple_meaning: The women of the house go out joyfully with trays of auspicious items to welcome the event. Their excitement shows in their bodies.
ramacharitamanas::1865.simple_insight: Joy can be so full it moves through the body before words appear.
ramacharitamanas::1865.detailed_meaning: In Ayodhya, the household women prepare the welcoming ritual for a sacred arrival. Golden trays, auspicious offerings, and delighted faces fill the scene. This verse captures the living pulse of celebration before the next sign appears.
ramacharitamanas::1865.modern_relevance: You are setting out cups, flowers, and sweets before guests arrive, and the whole room feels charged. Anticipation itself becomes part of the welcome.
ramacharitamanas::1865.insight: It shifts attention to the sacredness of preparation, not just the event itself.

ramacharitamanas::1866.verse_sanskrit: धूप धूम नभु मेचक भयऊ। सावन घन घमंडु जनु ठयऊ॥ सुरतरु सुमन माल सुर बरषहिं। मनहुँ बलाक अवलि मनु करषहिं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1866.verse_hindi: धूप के धुएँ से आकाश ऐसा काला हो गया है मानो सावन के बादल घुमड़-घुमड़कर छा गए हों। देवता कल्पवृक्ष के फूलों की मालाएँ बरसा रहे हैं। वे ऐसी लगती हैं, मानो बगुलों की पाँति मन को (अपनी ओर) खींच रही हो ॥
ramacharitamanas::1866.english_translation: The smoke of the incense darkened the sky like monsoon clouds. The gods showered garlands of celestial flowers, as if a line of cranes were drawing the mind toward them.
ramacharitamanas::1866.translation_literal: धूप (incense) / धूम (smoke) / नभु (sky) / मेचक (dark) / भयऊ (became) / सावन (monsoon) / घन (clouds) / घमंडु (mass) / जनु (as if) / ठयऊ (became fixed)॥ / सुरतरु (celestial tree) / सुमन (flowers) / माल (garlands) / सुर (divine beings) / बरषहिं (are raining down) / मनहुँ (as if) / बलाक (cranes) / अवलि (line) / मनु (mind) / करषहिं (draw) ॥
ramacharitamanas::1866.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1866.essence: Celebration can make the whole world feel enchanted.
ramacharitamanas::1866.simple_meaning: Incense smoke darkens the sky, and flowers rain down from the heavens. The whole scene feels like nature itself has joined the celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1866.simple_insight: Joy can be so full that even the sky seems to take part.
ramacharitamanas::1866.detailed_meaning: In Ayodhya, the wedding celebration for Ram and Sita is in full bloom. Incense fills the air, flower garlands fall from above, and the whole scene feels enchanted. This verse adds to the festive atmosphere rather than delivering the main teaching.
ramacharitamanas::1866.modern_relevance: A wedding hall fills with incense, lights, music, and petals. For one brief moment, the room feels larger than life, as if the world itself has entered the celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1866.insight: It turns a ceremonial scene into a living, sensory celebration.

ramacharitamanas::1867.verse_sanskrit: मंजुल मनिमय बंदनिवारे। मनहुँ पाकरिपु चाप सँवारे॥ प्रगटहिं दुरहिं अटन्ह पर भामिनि। चारु चपल जनु दमकहिं दामिनि ॥
ramacharitamanas::1867.verse_hindi: सुंदर मणियों से बने बंदनवार ऐसे मालूम होते हैं, मानो इन्द्रधनुष सजाए हों। अटारियों पर सुंदर और चपल स्त्रियाँ प्रकट होती और छिप जाती हैं (आती-जाती हैं), वे ऐसी जान पड़ती हैं, मानो बिजलियाँ चमक रही हों ॥
ramacharitamanas::1867.english_translation: Beautiful jeweled festoons seem like rainbows stretched across the gates. On the palace terraces, lovely and lively women appear and disappear, flashing like lightning.
ramacharitamanas::1867.translation_literal: मंजुल (beautiful) / मनिमय (made of jewels) / बंदनिवारे (festoons at the gate) / मनहुँ (as if) / पाकरिपु (rainbow) / चाप (bow) / सँवारे (decorated) ॥ / प्रगटहिं (appear) / दुरहिं (disappear) / अटन्ह (on terraces) / पर (on) / भामिनि (women) / चारु (beautiful) / चपल (quick, lively) / जनु (as if) / दमकहिं (flash) / दामिनि (lightning) ॥
ramacharitamanas::1867.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1867.essence: Celebration makes the whole city shimmer.
ramacharitamanas::1867.simple_meaning: The palace is richly decorated for the celebration. Jewels, colors, women on the terraces, and flashes of movement make the whole scene feel alive and radiant.
ramacharitamanas::1867.simple_insight: Joy can fill a place so completely that even motion feels like light.
ramacharitamanas::1867.detailed_meaning: Ayodhya is preparing for Ram's return. The homes and terraces are dressed for celebration, and the city seems to shimmer with beauty and movement. This verse adds to the festive scene rather than delivering the main teaching.
ramacharitamanas::1867.modern_relevance: You walk into a home before a wedding and notice the strings of lights, the bright fabrics, the hurried movement on balconies. The atmosphere itself announces that something precious is about to happen.
ramacharitamanas::1867.insight: It shifts attention from the event itself to the sacred mood a community creates around it.

ramacharitamanas::1868.verse_sanskrit: दुंदुभि धुनि घन गरजनि घोरा। जाचक चातक दादुर मोरा॥ सुर सुगंध सुचि बरषहिं बारी। सुखी सकल ससि पुर नर नारी ॥
ramacharitamanas::1868.verse_hindi: नगाड़ों की ध्वनि मानो बादलों की घोर गर्जना है। याचकगण पपीहे, मेंढक और मोर हैं। देवता पवित्र सुगंध रूपी जल बरसा रहे हैं, जिससे खेती के समान नगर के सब स्त्री-पुरुष सुखी हो रहे हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1868.english_translation: The drums sound like the roar of dark clouds. Beggars, cuckoos, frogs, and peacocks call out. The divine shower fragrant, pure water, and every man and woman in the city feels joy.
ramacharitamanas::1868.translation_literal: दुंदुभि (drums) / धुनि (sound) / घन (clouds) / गरजनि (roaring) / घोरा (terrible, deep)। जाचक (beggars) / चातक (chatak bird) / दादुर (frogs) / मोरा (peacocks)॥ सुर (divine beings) / सुगंध (fragrant) / सुचि (pure) / बरषहिं (rain) / बारी (water) / सुखी (happy) / सकल (all) / ससि (like) / पुर (city) / नर (men) / नारी (women) ॥
ramacharitamanas::1868.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1868.essence: A blessed arrival makes the whole city feel alive.
ramacharitamanas::1868.simple_meaning: Drums boom like thunder, birds and frogs call, and the divine rain fragrant water over the city so everyone feels happy.
ramacharitamanas::1868.simple_insight: Joy spreads through the whole city when the moment turns auspicious.
ramacharitamanas::1868.detailed_meaning: Dawn or celebration fills Ayodhya as Ram's return draws near. The city seems to answer the moment itself: drums thunder, birds cry, and the divine rain blessing over everyone. It is atmosphere, not teaching — a scene of shared delight before entry.
ramacharitamanas::1868.modern_relevance: A neighborhood starts buzzing when the long-awaited guest finally arrives. Doors open, voices rise, and even strangers feel caught in the same relief.
ramacharitamanas::1868.insight: It shifts attention from private expectation to a whole world lit by arrival.

ramacharitamanas::1869.verse_sanskrit: समउ जानि गुर आयसु दीन्हा। पुर प्रबेसु रघुकुलमनि कीन्हा॥ सुमिरि संभु गिरिजा गनराजा। मुदित महीपति सहित समाजा ॥
ramacharitamanas::1869.verse_hindi: (प्रवेश का) समय जानकर गुरु वशिष्ठजी ने आज्ञा दी। तब रघुकुलमणि महाराज दशरथजी ने शिवजी, पार्वतीजी और गणेशजी का स्मरण करके समाज सहित आनंदित होकर नगर में प्रवेश किया ॥
ramacharitamanas::1869.english_translation: Knowing the right moment, Guru Vashistha gave the order. Then Raghu's jewel, King Dasharatha, remembered Shiva, Parvati, and Ganesha, and entered the city joyfully with his retinue.
ramacharitamanas::1869.translation_literal: समउ (time/right moment) / जानि (knowing) / गुर (teacher) / आयसु (command) / दीन्हा (gave) / पुर (city) / प्रबेसु (entry) / रघुकुलमनि (jewel of the Raghu clan) / कीन्हा (made/did) ॥ / सुमिरि (remembering) / संभु (Shiva) / गिरिजा (Parvati) / गनराजा (lord of the hosts) / मुदित (joyful) / महीपति (king) / सहित (with) / समाजा (retinue/company) ॥
ramacharitamanas::1869.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1869.essence: Right timing and reverence turn an arrival into an auspicious beginning.
ramacharitamanas::1869.simple_meaning: At the right moment, Vashistha gives the signal. Dasharatha enters the city with his entourage, remembering Shiva, Parvati, and Ganesha, and feeling joyful.
ramacharitamanas::1869.simple_insight: A good beginning is marked by reverence, timing, and shared joy.
ramacharitamanas::1869.detailed_meaning: The wedding celebration is underway in Mithila. Vashistha sees the proper moment and signals the royal entry. Dasharatha, surrounded by his people, enters with a heart full of auspicious remembrance, setting the tone for the sacred event.
ramacharitamanas::1869.modern_relevance: A family steps out of the car before a wedding, everyone adjusting clothes, checking the time, and pausing for a quick prayer before walking in together. The moment matters because the mood matters.
ramacharitamanas::1869.insight: It frames a major public moment as something entered with timing, reverence, and collective joy.

ramacharitamanas::1870.verse_sanskrit: होहिं सगुन बरषहिं सुमन सुर दुंदभीं बजाइ। बिबुध बधू नाचहिं मुदित मंजुल मंगल गाइ ॥
ramacharitamanas::1870.verse_hindi: शकुन हो रहे हैं, देवता दुन्दुभी बजा-बजाकर फूल बरसा रहे हैं। देवताओं की स्त्रियाँ आनंदित होकर सुंदर मंगल गीत गा-गाकर नाच रही हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1870.english_translation: Auspicious signs appear. The radiant beings shower flowers and beat the drums. Their delighted women dance, singing graceful songs of blessing.
ramacharitamanas::1870.translation_literal: होहिं (are happening) / सगुन (auspicious signs) / बरषहिं (shower) / सुमन (flowers) / सुर (radiant beings) / दुंदभीं (drums) / बजाइ (playing) / बिबुध (radiant beings) / बधू (women) / नाचहिं (dance) / मुदित (delighted) / मंजुल (graceful) / मंगल (auspicious) / गाइ (singing)
ramacharitamanas::1870.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1870.essence: A blessed moment makes the whole world rejoice.
ramacharitamanas::1870.simple_meaning: The scene is filled with auspicious signs: flowers fall, drums sound, and joyful celestial women dance and sing blessings.
ramacharitamanas::1870.simple_insight: Joy becomes visible when the moment is truly blessed.
ramacharitamanas::1870.detailed_meaning: As Dasharath enters the city with Vasishtha's guidance, the arrival itself is treated like a sacred event. Flowers fall, drums thunder, and the radiant beings rejoice. This verse adds to the grandeur of Ram's entry, not a separate teaching.
ramacharitamanas::1870.modern_relevance: A wedding hall falls quiet for a second, then erupts in music as the couple enters. Everyone feels it: this moment matters. The verse captures that shared sense of blessing before words are spoken.
ramacharitamanas::1870.insight: It frames a sacred arrival as something the whole world can celebrate.

ramacharitamanas::1871.verse_sanskrit: मागध सूत बंदि नट नागर। गावहिं जसु तिहु लोक उजागर॥ जय धुनि बिमल बेद बर बानी। दस दिसि सुनिअ सुमंगल सानी ॥
ramacharitamanas::1871.verse_hindi: मागध, सूत, भाट और चतुर नट तीनों लोकों के उजागर (सबको प्रकाश देने वाले परम प्रकाश स्वरूप) श्री रामचन्द्रजी का यश गा रहे हैं। जय ध्वनि तथा वेद की निर्मल श्रेष्ठ वाणी सुंदर मंगल से सनी हुई दसों दिशाओं में सुनाई पड़ रही है ॥
ramacharitamanas::1871.english_translation: Minstrels, bards, and performers sing the glory of Ram, whose radiance fills the three worlds. The cry of victory and the pure words of the Vedas, rich with auspiciousness, are heard in all ten directions.
ramacharitamanas::1871.translation_literal: मागध (minstrels) / सूत (bards) / बंदि (praisers) / नट (performers) / नागर (skilled) / गावहिं (sing) / जसु (glory) / तिहु (three) / लोक (worlds) / उजागर (radiant, made manifest) / जय (victory) / धुनि (cry) / बिमल (pure) / बेद (Vedas) / बर (excellent) / बानी (speech) / दस (ten) / दिसि (directions) / सुनिअ (is heard) / सुमंगल (highly auspicious) / सानी (filled, mixed)
ramacharitamanas::1871.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1871.essence: Ram's glory makes the whole world ring with auspiciousness.
ramacharitamanas::1871.simple_meaning: All around, singers and praise-makers celebrate Ram. Victory cries and sacred words fill every direction with joy and blessing.
ramacharitamanas::1871.simple_insight: Joy becomes communal when devotion is shared aloud.
ramacharitamanas::1871.detailed_meaning: As the wedding celebration builds in Mithila, every kind of praise-singer joins in. The whole city rings with Ram's glory, and even the Vedic chants seem to overflow into the air. It is a scene of rising public joy, not a separate teaching.
ramacharitamanas::1871.modern_relevance: At a wedding hall before the bride enters, the musicians tune up, relatives clap, and the whole room starts humming with anticipation. The feeling spreads before anyone speaks.
ramacharitamanas::1871.insight: It turns attention from private excitement to a shared atmosphere of celebration.

ramacharitamanas::1872.verse_sanskrit: बिपुल बाज ने बाजन लागे। नभ सुर नगर लोग अनुरागे॥ बने बराती बरनि न जाहीं। महा मुदित मन सुख न समाहीं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1872.verse_hindi: बहुत से बाजे बजने लगे। आकाश में देवता और नगर में लोग सब प्रेम में मग्न हैं। बाराती ऐसे बने-ठने हैं कि उनका वर्णन नहीं हो सकता। परम आनंदित हैं, सुख उनके मन में समाता नहीं है ॥
ramacharitamanas::1872.english_translation: Many instruments began to play. In the sky, the radiant beings and in the city, the people were filled with love. The wedding guests were so splendid they could not be described. Great joy overflowed; no room remained in the mind for anything else.
ramacharitamanas::1872.translation_literal: बिपुल (many) / बाज (instruments) / ने (indeed) / बाजन (to play) / लागे (began) / नभ (sky) / सुर (radiant beings) / नगर (city) / लोग (people) / अनुरागे (filled with love) / बने (decorated) / बराती (wedding guests) / बरनि (described) / न (not) / जाहीं (can be) / महा (great) / मुदित (delighted) / मन (mind) / सुख (joy) / न (not) / समाहीं (fit/contain)
ramacharitamanas::1872.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1872.essence: Joy spills past description when the moment is truly blessed.
ramacharitamanas::1872.simple_meaning: The wedding celebration bursts into music and joy. Everyone, from the sky to the city, is caught up in delight, and the wedding guests are too splendid to describe.
ramacharitamanas::1872.simple_insight: Joy can be so complete that ordinary language falls short.
ramacharitamanas::1872.detailed_meaning: At Sita’s wedding, the celebration swells beyond measure. Instruments sound, radiant beings rejoice above, and Ayodhya’s people are swept into the same happiness. This verse lingers on the festive overflow before the bridegroom’s procession is fully seen.
ramacharitamanas::1872.modern_relevance: A wedding hall erupts when the bride appears, and even the most reserved uncle is smiling through tears. Some moments are too full for neat explanation; they simply overflow.
ramacharitamanas::1872.insight: It shifts attention from the event itself to the shared joy that surrounds it.

ramacharitamanas::1873.verse_sanskrit: पुरबासिन्ह तब राय जोहारे। देखत रामहि भए सुखारे॥ करहिं निछावरि मनिगन चीरा। बारि बिलोचन पुलक सरीरा ॥
ramacharitamanas::1873.verse_hindi: तब अयोध्यावसियों ने राजा को जोहार (वंदना) की। श्री रामचन्द्रजी को देखते ही वे सुखी हो गए। सब मणियाँ और वस्त्र निछावर कर रहे हैं। नेत्रों में (प्रेमाश्रुओं का) जल भरा है और शरीर पुलकित हैं ॥।
ramacharitamanas::1873.english_translation: Then the people of Ayodhya bowed to their king. Seeing Ram, they became filled with joy. They offered gems and clothes in tribute. Their eyes filled with tears, and their bodies thrilled with love.
ramacharitamanas::1873.translation_literal: पुरबासिन्ह (city-dwellers) / तब (then) / राय (king) / जोहारे (bowed in reverence) / देखत (seeing) / रामहि (Ram) / भए (became) / सुखारे (filled with joy) / करहिं (they do) / निछावरि (tribute/offering) / मनिगन (gems) / चीरा (cloths) / बारि (water) / बिलोचन (eyes) / पुलक (horripilation) / सरीरा (body)
ramacharitamanas::1873.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1873.essence: True welcome overflows into gifts, tears, and trembling joy.
ramacharitamanas::1873.simple_meaning: The people of Ayodhya greet their king with gifts and reverence. Just seeing Ram fills them with joy, tears, and trembling devotion.
ramacharitamanas::1873.simple_insight: Love becomes visible when the body cannot stay still and the eyes cannot stay dry.
ramacharitamanas::1873.detailed_meaning: Ayodhya is alive with celebration as Ram returns. The city people bow to him, shower him with gifts, and break into tears of joy just from seeing him. This moment shows how deeply the city loves its rightful prince.
ramacharitamanas::1873.modern_relevance: You spot someone you have missed for years at the airport gate. Before any words, your face changes, your hands move, and gratitude spills out without effort.
ramacharitamanas::1873.insight: It shifts attention from formal welcome to the physical signs of genuine devotion and relief.

ramacharitamanas::1874.verse_sanskrit: आरति करहिं मुदित पुर नारी। हरषहिं निरखि कुअँर बर चारी॥ सिबिका सुभग ओहार उघारी। देखि दुलहिनिन्ह होहिं सुखारी ॥
ramacharitamanas::1874.verse_hindi: नगर की स्त्रियाँ आनंदित होकर आरती कर रही हैं और सुंदर चारों कुमारों को देखकर हर्षित हो रही हैं। पालकियों के सुंदर परदे हटा-हटाकर वे दुलहिनों को देखकर सुखी होती हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1874.english_translation: The women of the city, joyful and delighted, perform ārati. Seeing the four handsome princes, they rejoice. Lifting the beautiful curtains of the palanquins, they look at the brides and feel happy.
ramacharitamanas::1874.translation_literal: आरति (waving of lamps) / करहिं (they do) / मुदित (joyful) / पुर (city) / नारी (women) / हरषहिं (rejoice) / निरखि (seeing) / कुअँर (princes) / बर (excellent) / चारी (four) / सिबिका (palanquin) / सुभग (beautiful) / ओहार (curtain) / उघारी (opened) / देखि (seeing) / दुलहिनिन्ह (brides) / होहिं (become) / सुखारी (happy)
ramacharitamanas::1874.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1874.essence: Joy deepens when everyone welcomes the sacred moment together.
ramacharitamanas::1874.simple_meaning: The women of Ayodhya celebrate the wedding procession, wave lamps, and feel joy seeing the princes and brides.
ramacharitamanas::1874.simple_insight: Shared joy grows when a whole city welcomes a sacred moment together.
ramacharitamanas::1874.detailed_meaning: The wedding procession has reached Ayodhya’s palace area. City women gather with lamps, lift the palanquin curtains, and delight in seeing the four princes and their brides. The verse is a joyful scene of public celebration, not a separate teaching.
ramacharitamanas::1874.modern_relevance: You step into a family wedding hall and see strangers smiling like relatives. The music, lamps, and lifted curtains turn a private union into a shared blessing.
ramacharitamanas::1874.insight: It turns attention from individual spectatorship to communal celebration.

ramacharitamanas::1875.verse_sanskrit: एहि बिधि सबही देत सुखु आए राजदुआर। मुदित मातु परिछनि करहिं बधुन्ह समेत कुमार ॥
ramacharitamanas::1875.verse_hindi: इस प्रकार सबको सुख देते हुए राजद्वार पर आए। माताएँ आनंदित होकर बहुओं सहित कुमारों का परछन कर रही हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1875.english_translation: In this way, bringing joy to everyone, they came to the royal gate. The mothers, delighted, along with the daughters-in-law, performed the auspicious welcoming ritual for the princes.
ramacharitamanas::1875.translation_literal: एहि बिधि (in this way) / सबही (to everyone) / देत (giving) / सुखु (joy) / आए (came) / राजदुआर (royal gate) / मुदित (delighted) / मातु (mothers) / परिछनि (welcoming ritual) / करहिं (perform) / बधुन्ह (with the daughters-in-law) / समेत (together with) / कुमार (princes)
ramacharitamanas::1875.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1875.essence: Their arrival blesses everyone before a word is spoken.
ramacharitamanas::1875.simple_meaning: The princes arrive at the palace gate, bringing joy to everyone. The mothers and daughters-in-law welcome them with an auspicious ritual.
ramacharitamanas::1875.simple_insight: Love turns a homecoming into a blessing for everyone present.
ramacharitamanas::1875.detailed_meaning: The princes have reached the royal gate in Ayodhya. The city is overflowing with joy, and the mothers, joined by the daughters-in-law, greet them with the traditional welcoming rite. The verse simply captures that shared happiness.
ramacharitamanas::1875.modern_relevance: You come home after a long trip and the whole house changes mood the moment you walk in. Someone lights a lamp, someone smiles through tears, and welcome becomes its own ceremony.
ramacharitamanas::1875.insight: It shifts attention from the event itself to the warmth it creates in a community.

ramacharitamanas::1876.verse_sanskrit: करहिं आरती बारहिं बारा। प्रेमु प्रमोदु कहै को पारा॥ भूषन मनि पट नाना जाती। करहिं निछावरि अगनित भाँती ॥
ramacharitamanas::1876.verse_hindi: वे बार-बार आरती कर रही हैं। उस प्रेम और महान आनंद को कौन कह सकता है! अनेकों प्रकार के आभूषण, रत्न और वस्त्र तथा अगणित प्रकार की अन्य वस्तुएँ निछावर कर रही हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1876.english_translation: They perform the aarti again and again. Who can describe that love and joy? They offer countless kinds of ornaments, jewels, garments, and other gifts.
ramacharitamanas::1876.translation_literal: करहिं (they do) / आरती (aarti, worship with light) / बारहिं बारा (again and again) / प्रेमु (love) / प्रमोदु (joy) / कहै (can say) / को (who) / पारा (across, to the limit) / भूषन (ornaments) / मनि (jewels) / पट (cloths) / नाना जाती (many kinds) / करहिं (they do) / निछावरि (offering in reverence) / अगनित (countless) / भाँती (ways, kinds)
ramacharitamanas::1876.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1876.essence: Overflowing love turns reverence into generous giving.
ramacharitamanas::1876.simple_meaning: The women keep performing aarti for the four princes and shower them with gifts. Their love and joy are so great that no one can fully describe them.
ramacharitamanas::1876.simple_insight: Love becomes generous on its own. When the heart overflows, giving feels natural.
ramacharitamanas::1876.detailed_meaning: In Ayodhya, the city women are welcoming the four princes with worship, delight, and lavish offerings. The scene is full of celebration, not argument. This verse lingers on the overflowing emotion of the moment.
ramacharitamanas::1876.modern_relevance: A family reunion ends with everyone piling food, gifts, and blessings into one room. Nobody is keeping score. The joy is too full for restraint.
ramacharitamanas::1876.insight: It shifts attention from ceremony itself to the abundance of feeling behind it.

ramacharitamanas::1877.verse_sanskrit: बधुन्ह समेत देखि सुत चारी। परमानंद मगन महतारी॥ पुनि पुनि सीय राम छबि देखी। मुदित सफल जग जीवन लेखी ॥
ramacharitamanas::1877.verse_hindi: बहुओं सहित चारों पुत्रों को देखकर माताएँ परमानंद में मग्न हो गईं। सीताजी और श्री रामजी की छबि को बार-बार देखकर वे जगत में अपने जीवन को सफल मानकर आनंदित हो रही हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1877.english_translation: Seeing the four sons with their brides, the mothers fell into supreme bliss. Again and again they gazed at the beauty of Sita and Ram, feeling their lives in the world had become fruitful.
ramacharitamanas::1877.translation_literal: बधुन्ह (with brides) / समेत (together) / देखि (seeing) / सुत (sons) / चारी (four) / परमानंद (supreme bliss) / मगन (immersed) / महतारी (mothers) / पुनि पुनि (again and again) / सीय (Sita) / राम (Ram) / छबि (beauty) / देखी (having seen) / मुदित (joyful) / सफल (fruitful/successful) / जग (world) / जीवन (life) / लेखी (account/ledger)
ramacharitamanas::1877.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1877.essence: Love can make a lifetime feel fulfilled in one glance.
ramacharitamanas::1877.simple_meaning: The mothers see their sons with their brides and are overwhelmed with joy. Seeing Sita and Ram again and again, they feel their lives have been fulfilled.
ramacharitamanas::1877.simple_insight: Some moments make a whole life feel worth it at once.
ramacharitamanas::1877.detailed_meaning: At Janak's court, the wedding celebrations are reaching their peak. The mothers see the four brothers arrive with their brides, then keep looking at Sita and Ram in wonder. Their joy is so complete that it feels like the purpose of life itself has been fulfilled.
ramacharitamanas::1877.modern_relevance: You catch a glimpse of your child walking in with someone they love, and something in you settles. No applause, no achievement, just a sudden sense that the years meant something.
ramacharitamanas::1877.insight: It shifts attention from ordinary celebration to the rare instant when love makes life feel complete.

ramacharitamanas::1878.verse_sanskrit: सखीं सीय मुख पुनि पुनि चाही। गान करहिं निज सुकृत सराही॥ बरषहिं सुमन छनहिं छन देवा। नाचहिं गावहिं लावहिं सेवा ॥
ramacharitamanas::1878.verse_hindi: सखियाँ सीताजी के मुख को बार-बार देखकर अपने पुण्यों की सराहना करती हुई गान कर रही हैं। देवता क्षण-क्षण में फूल बरसाते, नाचते, गाते तथा अपनी-अपनी सेवा समर्पण करते हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1878.english_translation: The companions keep looking again and again at Sita's face and sing, praising their own good fortune. The radiant beings shower flowers each moment; they dance, sing, and offer their service.
ramacharitamanas::1878.translation_literal: सखीं (companions) / सीय (Sita's) / मुख (face) / पुनि पुनि (again and again) / चाही (looked at) / गान (song) / करहिं (do) / निज (their own) / सुकृत (good deeds / merit) / सराही (praising) / बरषहिं (shower) / सुमन (flowers) / छनहिं छन (each moment) / देवा (radiant beings) / नाचहिं (dance) / गावहिं (sing) / लावहिं (offer) / सेवा (service)
ramacharitamanas::1878.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1878.essence: Beauty so complete turns spectators into worshippers.
ramacharitamanas::1878.simple_meaning: Sita's companions keep gazing at her with joy, while radiant beings shower flowers and celebrate with song and service.
ramacharitamanas::1878.simple_insight: Joy becomes praise when the heart feels it has witnessed something sacred.
ramacharitamanas::1878.detailed_meaning: In Janak's palace, the wedding celebration has reached a height of wonder. Sita's companions cannot stop looking at her, and even the radiant beings above respond with flowers, music, and devotion. The scene deepens the sense that this marriage is blessed beyond ordinary sight.
ramacharitamanas::1878.modern_relevance: At a wedding, everyone falls quiet for a second when the bride enters and the room feels larger than itself. Some moments don't need explanation; they call out gratitude on their own.
ramacharitamanas::1878.insight: It shifts attention from ordinary celebration to reverent witnessing, where beauty naturally becomes offering.

ramacharitamanas::1879.verse_sanskrit: देखि मनोहर चारिउ जोरीं। सारद उपमा सकल ढँढोरीं॥ देत न बनहिं निपट लघु लागीं। एकटक रहीं रूप अनुरागीं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1879.verse_hindi: चारों मनोहर जोड़ियों को देखकर सरस्वती ने सारी उपमाओं को खोज डाला, पर कोई उपमा देते नहीं बनी, क्योंकि उन्हें सभी बिलकुल तुच्छ जान पड़ीं। तब हारकर वे भी श्री रामजी के रूप में अनुरक्त होकर एकटक देखती रह गईं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1879.english_translation: Seeing the four beautiful pairs, Saraswati searched through every comparison. None would do, for all seemed utterly small. So she too, captivated by their beauty, stood gazing without blinking.
ramacharitamanas::1879.translation_literal: देखि (seeing) / मनोहर (beautiful) / चारिउ (four) / जोरीं (pairs) / सारद (Saraswati) / उपमा (comparison) / सकल (all) / ढँढोरीं (searched for) / देत (giving) / न (not) / बनहिं (become fitting) / निपट (utterly) / लघु (small) / लागीं (seemed) / एकटक (unblinking) / रहीं (remained) / रूप (beauty/form) / अनुरागीं (filled with love)
ramacharitamanas::1879.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1879.essence: Beauty beyond comparison leaves even speech silent.
ramacharitamanas::1879.simple_meaning: Saraswati tries to find words for the beauty before her, but every comparison falls short. Even she can only stare in admiration.
ramacharitamanas::1879.simple_insight: Some beauty is so complete that language gives up and reverence begins.
ramacharitamanas::1879.detailed_meaning: In Janak’s court, the assembled mothers and onlookers are overwhelmed by the sight of the royal pairs. Even Saraswati, the goddess of speech, cannot find an adequate comparison. The scene moves from praise into silent wonder.
ramacharitamanas::1879.modern_relevance: You open a photo from a wedding or family gathering, and for a second you just stop. Nothing clever comes to mind. The moment is too full for commentary.
ramacharitamanas::1879.insight: It teaches that some experiences should be received before they are explained.

ramacharitamanas::1880.verse_sanskrit: निगम नीति कुल रीति करि अरघ पाँवड़े देत। बधुन्ह सहित सुत परिछि सब चलीं लवाइ निकेत ॥
ramacharitamanas::1880.verse_hindi: वेद की विधि और कुल की रीति करके अर्घ्य-पाँवड़े देती हुई बहुओं समेत सब पुत्रों को परछन करके माताएँ महल में लिवा चलीं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1880.english_translation: Following the Vedic rule and family custom, the mothers, along with their daughters-in-law, welcomed the sons with offerings and led them into the palace.
ramacharitamanas::1880.translation_literal: निगम (Veda) / नीति (rule) / कुल (family) / रीति (custom) / करि (doing) / अरघ (offering) / पाँवड़े (welcome offering at the feet) / देत (giving) / बधुन्ह (with daughters-in-law) / सहित (along with) / सुत (sons) / परिछि (having welcomed) / सब (all) / चलीं (went) / लवाइ (leading) / निकेत (to the palace)
ramacharitamanas::1880.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1880.essence: Joy becomes complete when love follows proper form.
ramacharitamanas::1880.simple_meaning: The palace women formally welcome the returning princes and escort them inside, following sacred and family customs.
ramacharitamanas::1880.simple_insight: Even joy has a discipline. Love becomes complete when it is expressed with care and respect.
ramacharitamanas::1880.detailed_meaning: In Mithila after the swayamvar, the palace women receive the princes with ritual offerings and family etiquette. The mothers and daughters-in-law welcome everyone properly, then lead the newly gathered group into the palace. The scene shows celebration shaped by order.
ramacharitamanas::1880.modern_relevance: A family reunion finally happens after years apart. Before the hugs and laughter, someone still sets out water, greets the elders properly, and makes sure everyone is received with care.
ramacharitamanas::1880.insight: It turns celebration into a form of respect, showing that joy can still follow right conduct.

ramacharitamanas::1881.verse_sanskrit: चारि सिंघासन सहज सुहाए। जनु मनोज निज हाथ बनाए॥ तिन्ह पर कुअँरि कुअँर बैठारे। सादर पाय पुनीत पखारे ॥
ramacharitamanas::1881.verse_hindi: स्वाभाविक ही सुंदर चार सिंहासन थे, जो मानो कामदेव ने ही अपने हाथ से बनाए थे। उन पर माताओं ने राजकुमारियों और राजकुमारों को बैठाया और आदर के साथ उनके पवित्र चरण धोए ॥
ramacharitamanas::1881.english_translation: Four beautiful thrones stood there, as if Love himself had made them by hand. The mothers seated the princes and princesses upon them and reverently washed their sacred feet.
ramacharitamanas::1881.translation_literal: चारि (four) / सिंघासन (thrones) / सहज (naturally) / सुहाए (beautiful) / जनु (as if) / मनोज (Love/Kama) / निज (own) / हाथ (hand) / बनाए (made) || तिन्ह पर (on those) / कुअँरि (princesses) / कुअँर (princes) / बैठारे (seated) / सादर (with reverence) / पाय (feet) / पुनीत (pure/sacred) / पखारे (washed)
ramacharitamanas::1881.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1881.simple_meaning: Four beautiful thrones were prepared, and the mothers seated the royal couples on them and washed their feet with reverence.
ramacharitamanas::1881.simple_insight: Love becomes visible in small acts of honor and care.
ramacharitamanas::1881.detailed_meaning: In Janak's palace after the wedding, the mothers prepare four splendid seats for the royal couples. They seat the princes and princesses and wash their feet with honor. The scene shows the joy and dignity of the marriage celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1881.modern_relevance: At a wedding, an elder gently washes the couple’s feet before the ceremony begins. The room goes quiet. Honor is not spoken here; it is performed with care.
ramacharitamanas::1881.insight: It shifts attention from spectacle to reverent welcome.

ramacharitamanas::1882.verse_sanskrit: धूप दीप नैबेद बेद बिधि। पूजे बर दुलहिनि मंगल निधि॥ बारहिं बार आरती करहीं। ब्यजन चारु चामर सिर ढरहीं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1882.verse_hindi: फिर वेद की विधि के अनुसार मंगल के निधान दूल्हे की दुलहिनों की धूप, दीप और नैवेद्य आदि के द्वारा पूजा की। माताएँ बारम्बार आरती कर रही हैं और वर-वधुओं के सिरों पर सुंदर पंखे तथा चँवर ढल रहे हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1882.english_translation: Then, according to Vedic ritual, they worshiped the auspicious bridegroom with incense, lamps, and offerings. The mothers repeatedly waved lamps, and beautiful fans and whisk whisks were lowered over the heads of the bride and groom.
ramacharitamanas::1882.translation_literal: धूप (incense) / दीप (lamp) / नैबेद (offering) / बेद बिधि (Vedic method) / पूजे (worshiped) / बर (bridegroom) / दुलहिनि (bride) / मंगल निधि (treasure of auspiciousness) / बारहिं बार (again and again) / आरती (lamp-waving worship) / करहीं (they do) / ब्यजन (fans) / चारु (beautiful) / चामर (whisk whisks) / सिर (heads) / ढरहीं (are lowered)
ramacharitamanas::1882.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1882.essence: Joy bows before union and turns itself into worship.
ramacharitamanas::1882.simple_meaning: The mothers perform wedding worship with lamps, offerings, aarti, fans, and whisk whisks for the bride and groom.
ramacharitamanas::1882.simple_insight: Joy becomes ritual when love is given a form.
ramacharitamanas::1882.detailed_meaning: The wedding celebration continues in Janak’s palace. After seating the princes and princesses, the mothers honor the bride and groom with Vedic worship, repeated aarti, fans, and whisk whisks. The verse shows the overflowing delight of the house, not a teaching point.
ramacharitamanas::1882.modern_relevance: A family kitchen fills with steam, noise, and laughter as everyone rushes to serve the newly married couple. The affection is too full to stay silent; it becomes gesture, ritual, and movement.
ramacharitamanas::1882.insight: It turns celebration into embodied reverence, showing love through repeated acts of honor.

ramacharitamanas::1883.verse_sanskrit: बस्तु अनेक निछावरि होहीं। भरीं प्रमोद मातु सब सोहीं॥ पावा परम तत्व जनु जोगीं। अमृतु लहेउ जनु संतत रोगीं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1883.verse_hindi: अनेकों वस्तुएँ निछावर हो रही हैं, सभी माताएँ आनंद से भरी हुई ऐसी सुशोभित हो रही हैं मानो योगी ने परम तत्व को प्राप्त कर लिया। सदा के रोगी ने मानो अमृत पा लिया ॥
ramacharitamanas::1883.english_translation: Many gifts are being offered. All the mothers glow with joy, as if a yogi has found the highest reality, as if a lifelong sufferer has received nectar.
ramacharitamanas::1883.translation_literal: बस्तु (things) / अनेक (many) / निछावरि (offered as gifts) / होहीं (are happening) । भरीं (filled) / प्रमोद (joy) / मातु (mothers) / सब (all) / सोहीं (shine beautifully) ॥ पावा (has found) / परम (highest) / तत्व (reality) / जनु (as if) / जोगीं (a yogi) । अमृतु (nectar) / लहेउ (received) / जनु (as if) / संतत (continually) / रोगीं (sufferer) ॥
ramacharitamanas::1883.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1883.essence: Joy can feel like healing when longing finally ends.
ramacharitamanas::1883.simple_meaning: The wedding gifts overflow, and the mothers are radiant with joy. Their happiness is compared to a yogi reaching the highest truth and a sick person finally receiving nectar.
ramacharitamanas::1883.simple_insight: Deep relief feels like abundance, not explanation.
ramacharitamanas::1883.detailed_meaning: At Sita’s wedding in Mithila, the celebration has reached full bloom. Gifts are being offered everywhere, and the mothers watching the marriage shine with delight. Tulsidas compares their joy to spiritual fulfillment and healing, making the festive scene feel almost sacred.
ramacharitamanas::1883.modern_relevance: You watch a family finally come together after months of tension. The room is full of gifts, smiles, and tears that feel bigger than the occasion itself. Some moments feel like healing, not just celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1883.insight: It turns ordinary happiness into a sign of deep fulfillment and release.

ramacharitamanas::1884.verse_sanskrit: जनम रंक जनु पारस पावा। अंधहि लोचन लाभु सुहावा॥ मूक बदन जनु सारद छाई। मानहुँ समर सूर जय पाई ॥
ramacharitamanas::1884.verse_hindi: जन्म का दरिद्री मानो पारस पा गया। अंधे को सुंदर नेत्रों का लाभ हुआ। गूँगे के मुख में मानो सरस्वती आ विराजीं और शूरवीर ने मानो युद्ध में विजय पा ली ॥
ramacharitamanas::1884.english_translation: A poor person has found the philosopher's stone. A blind person has gained beautiful eyes. A mute person has found speech through Saraswati. A warrior has won victory in battle.
ramacharitamanas::1884.translation_literal: जनम (birth) / रंक (poor person) / जनु (as if) / पारस (philosopher's stone) / पावा (found) / अंधहि (to the blind) / लोचन (eyes) / लाभु (gain) / सुहावा (beautiful) / मूक (mute) / बदन (mouth) / जनु (as if) / सारद (Saraswati) / छाई (spread/entered) / मानहुँ (as if) / समर (battle) / सूर (warrior) / जय (victory) / पाई (won)
ramacharitamanas::1884.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1884.essence: Joy can make every lack feel healed at once.
ramacharitamanas::1884.simple_meaning: The wedding joy feels like impossible blessings: the poor become rich, the blind see, the mute speak, and the defeated win.
ramacharitamanas::1884.simple_insight: Joy can feel so complete that it seems to repair every lack at once.
ramacharitamanas::1884.detailed_meaning: The wedding celebration in Ayodhya has filled the palace with wonder. After the offerings and praise, the narrator says the mothers feel such joy that it is like every human deficiency has been reversed in a single moment.
ramacharitamanas::1884.modern_relevance: You watch your child walk onstage after months of fear, and suddenly every sleepless night feels redeemed. Some moments make life seem to give back more than it took.
ramacharitamanas::1884.insight: It turns celebration into a vision of total restoration, not just happiness.

ramacharitamanas::1885.verse_sanskrit: एहि सुख ते सत कोटि गुन पावहिं मातु अनंदु। भाइन्ह सहित बिआहि घर आए रघुकुलचंदु ॥
ramacharitamanas::1885.verse_hindi: इन सुखों से भी सौ करोड़ गुना बढ़कर आनंद माताएँ पा रही हैं, क्योंकि रघुकुल के चंद्रमा श्री रामजी विवाह कर के भाइयों सहित घर आए हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1885.english_translation: The mothers’ joy is greater than hundreds of millions of pleasures, because the moon of the Raghu clan, Ram, has returned home after the wedding with his brothers.
ramacharitamanas::1885.translation_literal: एहि (this) / सुख ते (than this joy) / सत कोटि गुन (hundreds of millions times greater) / पावहिं (they receive) / मातु (mothers) / अनंदु (joy) / भाइन्ह सहित (together with brothers) / बिआहि (having married) / घर आए (came home) / रघुकुलचंदु (moon of the Raghu clan, Ram)
ramacharitamanas::1885.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1885.essence: Homecoming with Ram makes ordinary joy look tiny.
ramacharitamanas::1885.simple_meaning: The mothers feel joy beyond measure because Ram has come home after his wedding, together with his brothers.
ramacharitamanas::1885.simple_insight: Some arrivals heal a whole home. When love returns fulfilled, joy multiplies beyond counting.
ramacharitamanas::1885.detailed_meaning: The wedding is complete, and Ram returns to Ayodhya with his brothers. The mothers of the household are overwhelmed with delight. This couplet closes the scene by measuring joy against joy and declaring this homecoming greater than any ordinary happiness.
ramacharitamanas::1885.modern_relevance: You wait at the airport with flowers, then see your child step out after a long separation. The relief is not just happiness — it feels like the house itself has started breathing again.
ramacharitamanas::1885.insight: It shifts attention from private pleasure to shared homecoming as the deepest happiness.

ramacharitamanas::1886.verse_sanskrit: लोक रीति जननीं करहिं बर दुलहिनि सकुचाहिं। मोदु बिनोदु बिलोकि बड़ रामु मनहिं मुसुकाहिं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1886.verse_hindi: माताएँ लोकरीति करती हैं और दूल्हे-दुलहिनें सकुचाते हैं। इस महान आनंद और विनोद को देखकर श्री रामचन्द्रजी मन ही मन मुस्कुरा रहे हैं ॥
ramacharitamanas::1886.english_translation: The mothers observe social custom, and the bride and groom feel shy. Seeing this great joy and playfulness, Ram smiles to himself.
ramacharitamanas::1886.translation_literal: लोक रीति (worldly custom) / जननीं (mothers) / करहिं (perform) / बर (groom) / दुलहिनि (bride) / सकुचाहिं (feel shy) / मोदु (joy) / बिनोदु (playful delight) / बिलोकि (seeing) / बड़ (great) / रामु (Ram) / मनहिं (in the mind) / मुसुकाहिं (smiles)
ramacharitamanas::1886.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1886.essence: Joy becomes complete when it is seen with a calm heart.
ramacharitamanas::1886.simple_meaning: The wedding is filled with joy and playful shyness. The mothers follow custom, and Ram quietly smiles at the scene.
ramacharitamanas::1886.simple_insight: Even sacred joy can be simple, human, and tender.
ramacharitamanas::1886.detailed_meaning: Ram has returned home after the wedding. The mothers carry out the expected customs, the bride and groom grow shy, and the whole household overflows with delight. This verse pauses on Ram's quiet smile amid the celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1886.modern_relevance: At a family wedding, everyone is busy with rituals, teasing, and shy glances across the room. In the middle of all that noise, one calm smile can hold the whole memory together.
ramacharitamanas::1886.insight: It shifts attention from ceremony alone to the quiet awareness that blesses the ceremony.

ramacharitamanas::1887.verse_sanskrit: देव पितर पूजे बिधि नीकी। पूजीं सकल बासना जी की॥ सबहि बंदि माँगहिं बरदाना। भाइन्ह सहित राम कल्याना ॥
ramacharitamanas::1887.verse_hindi: मन की सभी वासनाएँ पूरी हुई जानकर देवता और पितरों का भलीभाँति पूजन किया। सबकी वंदना करके माताएँ यही वरदान माँगती हैं कि भाइयों सहित श्री रामजी का कल्याण हो ॥
ramacharitamanas::1887.english_translation: After honoring the deities and ancestors properly, the mothers' every longing was fulfilled. Bowing to all, they asked for one blessing: may Ram be blessed with his brothers.
ramacharitamanas::1887.translation_literal: देव (deities) / पितर (ancestors) / पूजे (worshipped) / बिधि (properly) / नीकी (well) / पूजीं (worshipped) / सकल (all) / बासना (desires) / जी (of the heart) / की (of) / सबहि (to all) / बंदि (bowing) / माँगहिं (they ask) / बरदाना (boons) / भाइन्ह (with brothers) / सहित (together) / राम (Ram) / कल्याना (well-being)
ramacharitamanas::1887.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1887.essence: Real joy asks for another's well-being first.
ramacharitamanas::1887.simple_meaning: The mothers complete the wedding rites, honor the deities and ancestors, and ask only for Ram's well-being with his brothers.
ramacharitamanas::1887.simple_insight: Love becomes complete when blessing someone else matters more than getting anything for yourself.
ramacharitamanas::1887.detailed_meaning: Ram has returned home married, and Ayodhya is overflowing with joy. The mothers finish the sacred rites, bow to all beings, and ask for nothing personal. Their only prayer is for Ram and his brothers to remain blessed together.
ramacharitamanas::1887.modern_relevance: You finally get the news you waited for, and the first thing you do is call someone else to share it. Joy deepens when it turns outward.
ramacharitamanas::1887.insight: It shifts the heart from receiving blessing to offering it for another's welfare.

ramacharitamanas::1888.verse_sanskrit: अंतरहित सुर आसिष देहीं। मुदित मातु अंचल भरि लेहीं॥ भूपति बोलि बराती लीन्हे। जान बसन मनि भूषन दीन्हे ॥
ramacharitamanas::1888.verse_hindi: देवता छिपे हुए (अन्तरिक्ष से) आशीर्वाद दे रहे हैं और माताएँ आनन्दित हो आँचल भरकर ले रही हैं। तदनन्तर राजा ने बारातियों को बुलवा लिया और उन्हें सवारियाँ, वस्त्र, मणि (रत्न) और आभूषणादि दिए ॥
ramacharitamanas::1888.english_translation: The hidden deities gave blessings. The mothers joyfully filled their laps. Then the king called the wedding guests and gave them vehicles, clothes, jewels, and ornaments.
ramacharitamanas::1888.translation_literal: अंतरहित (hidden) / सुर (deities) / आसिष (blessings) / देहीं (give) / मुदित (joyful) / मातु (mothers) / अंचल (lap/hem) / भरि (filling) / लेहीं (take) / भूपति (king) / बोलि (calling) / बराती (wedding guests) / लीन्हे (took) / जान (vehicles) / बसन (clothes) / मनि (jewels) / भूषन (ornaments) / दीन्हे (gave)
ramacharitamanas::1888.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1888.essence: True celebration includes blessing others and giving freely.
ramacharitamanas::1888.simple_meaning: The unseen deities bless the wedding, the mothers receive the joy, and King Janaka honors the guests with gifts.
ramacharitamanas::1888.simple_insight: Joy deepens when it is shared generously, not kept for oneself.
ramacharitamanas::1888.detailed_meaning: At Sita’s wedding in Mithila, blessings pour in from unseen deities while the mothers gather the joy like offerings in their hems. Janaka then turns to the wedding guests and honors them with gifts, completing the celebration with royal generosity.
ramacharitamanas::1888.modern_relevance: A family wedding finally comes together: the room is glowing, elders are smiling, and the host keeps making sure every guest leaves honored and cared for.
ramacharitamanas::1888.insight: It shows how celebration becomes complete through blessing, gratitude, and generous hospitality.

ramacharitamanas::1889.verse_sanskrit: आयसु पाइ राखि उर रामहि। मुदित गए सब निज निज धामहि॥ पुर नर नारि सकल पहिराए। घर घर बाजन लगे बधाए ॥
ramacharitamanas::1889.verse_hindi: आज्ञा पाकर, श्री रामजी को हृदय में रखकर वे सब आनंदित होकर अपने-अपने घर गए। नगर के समस्त स्त्री-पुरुषों को राजा ने कपड़े और गहने पहनाए। घर-घर बधावे बजने लगे ॥
ramacharitamanas::1889.english_translation: After receiving the command, keeping Ram in their hearts, they all returned happily to their own homes. The king dressed all the men and women of the city in clothes and ornaments, and celebration drums sounded in every house.
ramacharitamanas::1889.translation_literal: आयसु (command) / पाइ (having received) / राखि (keeping) / उर (in the heart) / रामहि (Ram) / मुदित (joyful) / गए (went) / सब (all) / निज निज (their own) / धामहि (homes) / पुर (city) / नर (men) / नारि (women) / सकल (all) / पहिराए (were dressed) / घर घर (house to house) / बाजन (musical instruments) / लगे (began) / बधाए (congratulations/celebrations)
ramacharitamanas::1889.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1889.essence: Ram's presence turns the city into one shared celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1889.simple_meaning: Everyone goes home joyful after the king's order, and the whole city is dressed up for celebration.
ramacharitamanas::1889.simple_insight: Shared joy turns an ordinary homecoming into a festival.
ramacharitamanas::1889.detailed_meaning: The wedding celebration in Ayodhya continues. After the guests receive the king's instruction, they leave with Ram held in their hearts. The city is showered with clothes and ornaments, and every house fills with festive sound.
ramacharitamanas::1889.modern_relevance: A neighborhood feels different after one good piece of news: doors open, people dress up, and even the smallest homes sound brighter.
ramacharitamanas::1889.insight: It shifts attention from private excitement to a whole community sharing one celebration.

ramacharitamanas::1890.verse_sanskrit: जाचक जन जाचहिं जोइ जोई। प्रमुदित राउ देहिं सोइ सोई॥ सेवक सकल बजनिआ नाना। पूरन किए दान सनमाना ॥
ramacharitamanas::1890.verse_hindi: याचक लोग जो-जो माँगते हैं, विशेष प्रसन्न होकर राजा उन्हें वही-वही देते हैं। सम्पूर्ण सेवकों और बाजे वालों को राजा ने नाना प्रकार के दान और सम्मान से सन्तुष्ट किया ॥
ramacharitamanas::1890.english_translation: The king cheerfully gave each beggar whatever each one asked for. He satisfied all the servants and musicians with many gifts and honors.
ramacharitamanas::1890.translation_literal: जाचक जन (beggar people) / जाचहिं (ask) / जोइ जोई (whatever each) / प्रमुदित (delighted) / राउ (king) / देहिं (give) / सोइ सोई (that very thing) ॥ सेवक (servants) / सकल (all) / बजनिआ (musicians) / नाना (various) / पूरन किए (filled completely) / दान (gifts) / सनमाना (honors) ॥
ramacharitamanas::1890.speaker: Narrator
ramacharitamanas::1890.essence: Joy becomes real when it turns into generous giving.
ramacharitamanas::1890.simple_meaning: Beggars received exactly what they asked for, and the king also rewarded the servants and musicians generously.
ramacharitamanas::1890.simple_insight: Generosity becomes complete when it meets need without hesitation or calculation.
