shakti_gita::37.translation_literal: देवीं (Goddess) / ब्रह्ममयीं (embodiment of the supreme reality) / समीक्ष्य (having seen) / पुरतः (before) / त्वेवंविधा (thus in this way) / निर्जरा (without movement) / निप्पन्दा (speechless) / अगिरः (like a fire) / अभवन्निव (became as if) / कियन्मूढाः (somewhat bewildered) / क्षणं (for a moment) / संस्थिताः (stood) / पश्चात् (after) / मोहतो (from delusion) / विमुक्तम् (freed) / अतेयः (beings) / चैतन्यपूर्णाशयाः (full of consciousness) / शान्ताः (calm) / देवगणाः (divine beings) / कृताञ्जलिपुटाः (with folded hands) / देवी (Goddess) / परं (highest) / तुष्टुवुः (praised)
shakti_gita::37.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::37.essence: Encountering the supreme reality brings silent awe followed by awakened praise.
shakti_gita::37.simple_meaning: The divine beings saw the Goddess as the supreme reality, became still and silent briefly, then freed from confusion, fully aware, and praised her with respect.
shakti_gita::37.simple_insight: Witnessing true divine presence can bring deep silence and grateful awakening.
shakti_gita::37.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the divine beings behold Devi as the supreme reality. Overwhelmed, they become motionless and speechless for a brief time. Then, they shed their confusion, awaken to full consciousness, and express their reverence by bowing and praising her.
shakti_gita::37.insight: Experiencing profound truth can temporarily still the mind, then inspire heartfelt gratitude.

shakti_gita::38.verse_sanskrit:
देवि ! प्रपन्नात्तिहरे ! शिवे ! त्वं वाणीमनोबुद्धिभिरप्रेम्या ।
यतोऽस्यतो नैव हि कश्चिदीशः स्तोतुं स्वशब्दैर्भवनी कदाचित ॥
shakti_gita::38.verse_hindi: हे महादेवी ! आप वाणी मन और बुद्धि से अगोचर हैं इस कारण इस संसार में ऐसा कोई भी नहीं है जो शब्द द्वारा आपकी स्तुति कर सकता हो
shakti_gita::38.english_translation: O great Devi! You are beyond speech, mind, and intellect; therefore, no one in this world can truly praise you with words.
shakti_gita::38.translation_literal: देवि (O Devi) / प्रपन्नात्तिहरे (to the surrendered remover) / शिवे (O auspicious one) / त्वं (you) / वाणीमनोबुद्धिभि (by speech, mind, and intellect) / रप्रेम्या (beyond love) / यतोऽस्यतो (therefore not) / नैव (indeed) / हि (certainly) / कश्चिद् (anyone) / ईशः (lord) / स्तोतुं (to praise) / स्वशब्दैः (with own words) / भवनी (O Bhavani) / कदाचित (ever).
shakti_gita::38.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::38.essence: The deepest reality cannot be fully expressed or praised through words or thought.
shakti_gita::38.simple_meaning: The Devi is beyond all forms of expression like speech, mind, and intellect, so no one can fully praise her with words.
shakti_gita::38.simple_insight: There is freedom in knowing that the deepest reality cannot be confined by words or concepts.
shakti_gita::38.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the narrator addresses Devi as beyond ordinary faculties like speech, mind, and intellect. It acknowledges that no one in the world can truly praise her with language because her essence surpasses all forms of expression and understanding.
shakti_gita::38.modern_relevance: When you feel words fail to express your deepest feelings or the vastness of something, this reminds you that some realities lie beyond language.
shakti_gita::38.insight: It teaches you to embrace the limits of language and trust what cannot be fully described or captured.

shakti_gita::39.verse_sanskrit:
परं मनोवेगविमोदिता वयं भावं भवत्या अपि वांगमनोधियाम ।
अगोचरं द्योतयितुं समुद्यताः क्षमस्व नो दोषममुं दयानिधे ! ॥
shakti_gita::39.verse_hindi: परन्तु हम मन के आवेग से आपके मन, वचन और बुद्धि से अगोचर भाष को शब्दों के द्वारा प्रकट करने में प्रवृत्त हुए हैं, हे दयानिधे ! इस अपराध को आप क्षमा करें
shakti_gita::39.english_translation: But we, overwhelmed by the impulses of the mind, have arisen to express the invisible speech of your mind, words, and intellect; O treasure of compassion, please forgive this fault.
shakti_gita::39.translation_literal: परं (but) मनोवेगविमोदिता (overwhelmed by mind's impulses) वयं (we) भावं (feeling) भवत्या (your) अपि (also) वांगमनोधियाम् (mind, speech, intellect) अगोचरं (invisible) द्योतयितुं (to reveal) समुद्यताः (arisen) क्षमस्व (forgive) नो (our) दोषम् (fault) अमुं (this) दयानिधे (treasure of compassion)
shakti_gita::39.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::39.essence: Restless mind can push you to reveal what is beyond words; humility asks forgiveness.
shakti_gita::39.simple_meaning: We got carried away by our restless mind and tried to express your invisible thoughts and words. Please forgive this mistake.
shakti_gita::39.simple_insight: There is humility in admitting when our mind leads us to overstep in expressing what is beyond words.
shakti_gita::39.detailed_meaning: The narrator, overwhelmed by the restless mind, admits attempting to reveal the invisible, subtle speech of the divine mind, speech, and intellect. Addressing the compassionate divine, he asks forgiveness for this possible offense, showing respect and humility.
shakti_gita::39.insight: It teaches you to recognize when your mind pushes you beyond limits and to approach with humility and ask forgiveness.

shakti_gita::40.verse_sanskrit:
अत्र क्षमाप्तावपि कारणं ते महत्यपारास्ति कृपैव मातः! ।
ब्रह्मस्वरूपे ! जगदम्बिकेऽलं दयामयीं तवां  सततं नमामः ॥
shakti_gita::40.verse_hindi: इस क्षमाप्राप्ति में आपको महती अपार करुणा ही कारण है। हे ब्रह्ममयी जगदम्बिके ! आप दयामयी को प्रणाम है
shakti_gita::40.english_translation: Even in forgiveness, the great boundless compassion of the mother is the cause. O Brahman-formed World-Mother, we constantly bow to your merciful nature.
shakti_gita::40.translation_literal: अत्र (here) क्षमाप्तावपि (even in forgiveness) कारणं (cause) ते (your) महत्य (great) अपारास्ति (boundless) कृपैव (by compassion alone) मातः (mother)! / ब्रह्मस्वरूपे (in the form of Brahman)! / जगदम्बिकेऽलं (O World-Mother) दयामयीं (merciful one) तवां (you) सततं (constantly) नमामः (we bow)!
shakti_gita::40.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::40.essence: Forgiveness flows from the mother’s boundless compassion, the supreme reality embodied.
shakti_gita::40.simple_meaning: Forgiveness arises from the vast, limitless compassion of the mother, who embodies the supreme reality. We honor her merciful nature always.
shakti_gita::40.simple_insight: You can feel the power of forgiveness as the warmth of endless compassion.
shakti_gita::40.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Devi explains that forgiveness is not random but stems from her immense compassion. She is the embodiment of the supreme reality, the World-Mother, whose mercy is the true source of forgiveness.
shakti_gita::40.modern_relevance: After someone hurts you, remembering that forgiveness springs from deep compassion can soften your heart and open space for peace.
shakti_gita::40.insight: It teaches you to connect forgiveness with the compassionate nature within and around you, deepening your capacity to forgive.

shakti_gita::41.verse_sanskrit:
परात्परा त्वं परतत्त्वरूपिणी  स्वतीय तत्त्वान्यखिलानि राजसे। 
सच्चिचसाहाय्यत आत्मना पुनदाम्पसरूपं युगलञ्च विभ्रती ॥
shakti_gita::41.verse_hindi: आप तत्त्वातीत परमतत्त्व रूपिणी है, पाप ही पुनः एक ओर से पुरुष और दूसरी ओर से स्त्री रूप धारण करके अपने चित् और सत्भाव की सहायता से युगल दाम्पत्य रूप
shakti_gita::41.english_translation: You are beyond the highest; embodying supreme form, you manifest all your own principles. Through the support of consciousness and existence, you take the paired forms of male and female.
shakti_gita::41.translation_literal: परात्परा (beyond the highest) / त्वं (you) / परतत्त्वरूपिणी (embodying supreme form) / स्वतीय (your own) / तत्त्वानि (principles) / अखिलानि (all) / राजसे (manifest) / सच्चि (consciousness) / असाहाय्यत (with the support) / आत्मना (of self) / पुनः (again) / दाम्पसरूपं (paired marital form) / युगलं (pair) / च (and) / विभ्रती (you manifest)
shakti_gita::41.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::41.essence: The supreme reality transcends form yet manifests as unified opposites.
shakti_gita::41.simple_meaning: You are the supreme reality beyond all forms, expressing all your principles as the union of male and female energies supported by consciousness.
shakti_gita::41.simple_insight: You embody unity beyond division, holding opposites together as one.
shakti_gita::41.detailed_meaning: The Goddess describes her supreme nature as beyond all categories, yet manifesting all principles of existence. She reveals herself as the unity behind male and female forms, supported by consciousness and existence itself.
shakti_gita::41.modern_relevance: You meet people whose identities and energies blend traditionally opposing traits, reminding you that unity can hold what seems divided.
shakti_gita::41.insight: It invites you to see beyond surface dualities and recognize the unified source behind diversity.

shakti_gita::42.verse_sanskrit:
तनोषि शृङ्गारमयीं समन्ता ल्लीलाललामान्वितसृष्टिमेताम् ।
स्वानन्दसन्दोहभरमकाशामनाधनन्तां जगदम्बिकेऽलम् ॥
shakti_gita::42.verse_hindi: धारण करती हुई हे जगदम्बिके अपने परमानन्द की प्रकाशक श्रृंगार लीलामयी अनाद्यनन्त सृष्टि लीला का प्रवाह प्रवाहित करती हैं
shakti_gita::42.english_translation: O Mother of the universe, you sustain this infinite, eternal creation filled with bliss and adorned by the playful flow of divine beauty.
shakti_gita::42.translation_literal: तनोषि (you sustain) / शृङ्गारमयीं (full of graceful beauty) / समन्ता (all around) / ल्लीला (playful flow) / लामान्वित (adorned with) / सृष्टिमेताम् (this creation) / स्वानन्दसन्दोहभरम् (filled with your own bliss) / आकाशाम् (space/sky) / अनाधनन्ताम् (without origin, infinite) / जगदम्बिकेऽलम् (O Mother of the world)
shakti_gita::42.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::42.essence: The infinite universe is sustained as a joyous, playful expression of the divine's bliss.
shakti_gita::42.simple_meaning: The divine mother supports and fills the entire infinite creation with joyful, beautiful energy that flows like a playful dance.
shakti_gita::42.simple_insight: You can feel the universe itself as a joyful, endless dance held by the divine.
shakti_gita::42.detailed_meaning: Devi describes herself as the cosmic mother who sustains and adorns the entire universe. This creation is endless and timeless, filled with her bliss and a graceful, playful energy that moves everywhere.
shakti_gita::42.modern_relevance: When life feels overwhelming, imagine it as a vast dance of joyful energy held by a loving presence sustaining it all.
shakti_gita::42.insight: This verse invites you to see the world as a living expression of boundless joy and beauty, held by the divine source.

shakti_gita::43.verse_sanskrit:
लीलोदयास्ते भवतो भवत्या अक्षीङ्गितै: केवलमेव मातः!।
नानाविधस्यामितसङ्ख्यकस्य, ब्रह्माण्डसङ्घस्य च देवि ! मन्ये ॥
shakti_gita::43.verse_hindi: लीला का उदय और अस्त आपके नेत्र के इंगित मात्र से हुआ करता है, एक मुहूर्त में अनन्त ब्रहाण्डों की
shakti_gita::43.english_translation: The rise and fall of all creation happens at the mere gesture of your eyes, Devi, in a single moment countless universes come into being.
shakti_gita::43.translation_literal: लीला (play/creation) / उदय (rise) / अस्त (fall) / ते (your) / भवतो (of you-male) / भवत्या (of you-female) / अक्षीङ्गितै: (by the gestures of the eyes) / केवलम् (only) / एव (indeed) / मातः (mother) / नानाविधस्य (of many kinds) / अमितसङ्ख्यकस्य (countless) / ब्रह्माण्डसङ्घस्य (of universes' assembly) / च (and) / देवि (O Devi) / मन्थे (I think)
shakti_gita::43.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::43.essence: Infinite worlds arise and dissolve by the slightest movement of your divine gaze.
shakti_gita::43.simple_meaning: Everything that exists arises and fades away by your mere glance, Devi, creating countless universes instantly.
shakti_gita::43.simple_insight: There is awe and wonder in sensing your power to create and dissolve endlessly.
shakti_gita::43.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals her cosmic power: with just a gesture of her eyes, the entire play of creation—endless universes—arises and falls in an instant, showing her as both creator and dissolver of all.
shakti_gita::43.modern_relevance: When you realize how a small action can ripple vast effects, you glimpse the immense power within subtle moments.
shakti_gita::43.insight: It shifts your view from seeing life as random to recognizing the unified source behind all change.

shakti_gita::44.verse_sanskrit:
सर्गस्थितिमयवहारकार्य भवद्विलासस्य तरंगमात्रम्।
कर्त्तेु क्षणेनाखिलमस्यलं त्वं नमोऽस्त्वतस्तेऽखिलशक्तिरूपे ! ॥
shakti_gita::44.verse_hindi: सृष्टि स्थिति और प्रलय कर देना आपके विलास का एक तरंग मात्र है, एक ही क्षण में सब कुछ कर सकती हो इसलिये हे सर्वशक्तिमयी ! आपकों प्रणाम है
shakti_gita::44.english_translation: Creation, preservation, and destruction are but waves of your play; in a moment, you can do everything. Salutations to you, embodiment of all power!
shakti_gita::44.translation_literal: सर्ग (creation) / स्थिति (preservation) / मय (composed of) / व्यवहार (activity) / कार्य (action) / भव (your) / विलासस्य (play) / तरंगमात्रम् (a mere wave) / कर्त्तेु (to do) / क्षणेन (in a moment) / अखिलम् (everything) / अस्यलं (effortless) / त्वं (you) / नमोऽस्त्वतः (salutations to you) / तेऽखिलशक्तिरूपे (in the form of all power)
shakti_gita::44.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::44.essence: The entire cosmic cycle is effortless play by the all-powerful divine.
shakti_gita::44.simple_meaning: All creation, preservation, and destruction are expressions of the divine's playful power, done effortlessly in an instant.
shakti_gita::44.simple_insight: There is freedom in seeing the vast universe as a spontaneous play beyond struggle or control.
shakti_gita::44.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the entire cosmic cycle—creation, maintenance, and destruction—is merely a playful wave of her divine energy. She can perform all these acts effortlessly in a moment, revealing her supreme power and the illusory nature of worldly phenomena.
shakti_gita::44.modern_relevance: When you face overwhelming tasks or change, remember it’s like waves in the ocean—flowing effortlessly from a deeper source beyond your control.
shakti_gita::44.insight: This shifts your view from seeing life as heavy duty to recognizing it as spontaneous, creative play beyond personal effort.

shakti_gita::45.verse_sanskrit:
वं निर्गुणाकारविवर्जिताऽपि त्वं भावराज्याच्च वहिर्गताऽपि ।
सर्वेंद्रिययागोचरतां गताऽपि त्वेका ह्यखण्डा विभुरद्वयाऽपि ॥
shakti_gita::45.verse_hindi: आप आकाररहित, भवातीत, गुणातीत, अखण्ड, अद्वितीय, विभु और सब इन्द्रियों से अग्राह्य होने पर भी
shakti_gita::45.english_translation: You are formless, beyond existence, beyond qualities, indivisible, unique, and supreme, yet beyond all the senses.
shakti_gita::45.translation_literal: वं (you) / निर्गुणाकारविवर्जिताऽपि (even without qualities and form) / त्वं (you) / भावराज्याच्च (beyond the realm of existence) / वहिर्गताऽपि (even beyond going out) / । (.) / सर्वेंद्रिययागोचरतां (beyond the reach of all senses) / गताऽपि (even gone beyond) / त्वेका (alone) / ह्यखण्डा (indeed indivisible) / विभुरद्वयाऽपि (and supreme in duality) / ॥
shakti_gita::45.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::45.essence: You are an indivisible, formless presence beyond all qualities and senses.
shakti_gita::45.simple_meaning: You exist beyond all forms, qualities, and senses. You are indivisible and uniquely supreme beyond anything the senses can perceive.
shakti_gita::45.simple_insight: There is a vastness to you that can't be touched or divided—your true nature is whole and beyond appearances.
shakti_gita::45.detailed_meaning: The Goddess describes herself as beyond all physical form, beyond qualities and existence itself. Despite being supreme and indivisible, she transcends everything that can be sensed, revealing her nature as the ultimate reality beyond the natural world.
shakti_gita::45.modern_relevance: When you feel limited by how others see you or by your own labels, remember your true nature is vast, indivisible, and beyond any surface impression.
shakti_gita::45.insight: It shifts your view from identifying with appearances to recognizing an indivisible and boundless essence beyond all senses.

shakti_gita::46.verse_sanskrit:
स्वभक्तकल्याणविवर्द्धनाय धृत्वा स्वरूपं सगुणं हि तेभ्यः।
निःश्रेयसं यच्छसि भावगम्या विभावरूपे ! भवतीं नमामः ॥
shakti_gita::46.verse_hindi: अपने भक्तों के कल्याण के अर्थ ही सगुणरूप धारण करके भावगम्य होकर उनको निःश्रेयस प्रदान करती हैं, हे त्रिभावरूपिणी! आपको प्रणाम है
shakti_gita::46.english_translation: To bless her devotees, she takes a form with qualities and approachable emotions, granting them the highest good; we bow to the threefold-formed Devi.
shakti_gita::46.translation_literal: स्वभक्तकल्याणविवर्द्धनाय (for the welfare of her devotees) / धृत्वा (holding) / स्वरूपं (form) / सगुणं (with qualities) / हि (indeed) / तेभ्यः (to them) / निःश्रेयसं (highest good) / यच्छसि (you give) / भावगम्या (approachable in feeling) / विभावरूपे (threefold-formed) / भवतीं (to Devi) / नमामः (we bow)
shakti_gita::46.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::46.essence: The divine adopts a caring, approachable form to guide her devotees to their highest good.
shakti_gita::46.simple_meaning: The divine shows herself with qualities and feelings to help her devotees and guide them to their highest good.
shakti_gita::46.simple_insight: You can feel embraced by a caring presence that meets you personally and helps you grow.
shakti_gita::46.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Devi reveals how she takes a form with qualities and emotions to connect with her devotees. She appears approachable to guide them toward their highest welfare, embodying her threefold cosmic nature.
shakti_gita::46.modern_relevance: When you feel lost or alone, imagine a presence that understands you deeply and supports your well-being with care and love.
shakti_gita::46.insight: It teaches you to accept that divine care adapts to your needs, meeting you personally to help you thrive.

shakti_gita::47.verse_sanskrit:
नास्यम्ब ! सीमा तव सत्कृपायाः शक्ता न ये भक्तगणास्त्वदीयाः।
तत्त्वप्रबोधस्य प्रपूर्त्यभावाद्रष्टुं हि ते भावमयस्वरूपम् ॥
shakti_gita::47.verse_hindi: आप की कृपा का पार नहीं है, आपका जो भक्त तत्त्वज्ञान की पूर्णता के अभाव से आपके भावमय रूप के दर्शन करने में असमर्थ है परन्तु
shakti_gita::47.english_translation: Your grace has no limits; those who cannot perceive your expressive form due to incomplete awakening of wisdom still remain your devotees.
shakti_gita::47.translation_literal: नास्यम्ब (no-limit) / सीमा (boundary) / तव (your) / सत्कृपायाः (kindness) / शक्ता (powerful) / न (not) / ये (those who) / भक्तगणास्त्वदीयाः (your devotees) / तत्त्वप्रबोधस्य (of truth awakening) / प्रपूर्त्यभावात् (due to incompleteness) / रष्टुं (to see) / हि (indeed) / ते (they) / भावमयस्वरूपम् (form full of feeling)
shakti_gita::47.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::47.essence: Grace has no limits even when understanding is incomplete.
shakti_gita::47.simple_meaning: Your kindness is limitless. Even if some devotees can’t fully understand your true form because their wisdom is not complete, they are still connected to you.
shakti_gita::47.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing grace is constant, even when clarity is missing.
shakti_gita::47.detailed_meaning: The Goddess speaks to the idea that her compassion and divine presence know no bounds. Some devotees have not fully awakened to the complete truth, so they cannot see her full expressive form, yet her grace remains with them.
shakti_gita::47.modern_relevance: When you feel unsure or unclear about your path, remember that support and kindness can still reach you deeply.
shakti_gita::47.insight: It encourages holding trust in divine grace despite incomplete understanding or spiritual clarity.

shakti_gita::48.verse_sanskrit:
स्वाभाविकैरेव कृपाकटाक्षैः समीहमाना ह्यनुकम्पितुं तान्।
गुणाश्रयायच्छसि दर्शनं स्वं मुक्तिञ्च तेभ्योऽभ्युदयं ददासि ॥
shakti_gita::48.verse_hindi: आप अपनी स्वाभाविक करुणा से उसको कृतकृत्य करना चाहती हैं, उस अपने कृपापात्र भक्त को आप अपने गुणों के आश्रय से दर्शन देकर अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस प्रदान करती हैं,
shakti_gita::48.english_translation: By your natural compassion and gracious glance, you wish to bless those devoted to you; through your qualities, you reveal yourself and grant their liberation and upliftment.
shakti_gita::48.translation_literal: स्वाभाविकैरेव (by natural) कृपाकटाक्षैः (compassionate glance) समीहमाना (approaching) हि (indeed) अनुकम्पितुं (to have mercy on) तान् (them) । गुणाश्रयाय (for the refuge of your qualities) छसि (you give) दर्शनं (vision) स्वं (your own) मुक्तिं (liberation) च (and) तेभ्यः (to them) अभ्युदयं (upliftment) ददासि (you grant) ॥
shakti_gita::48.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::48.essence: Natural compassion reveals the divine’s qualities, granting vision and liberation to devoted ones.
shakti_gita::48.simple_meaning: You naturally feel compassion for your devoted ones and show yourself through your qualities, helping them grow and find freedom.
shakti_gita::48.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing compassion is both natural and transformative for those who trust it.
shakti_gita::48.detailed_meaning: Devi expresses how her natural compassion moves her to bless her devoted followers. She reveals herself through her qualities, offering both a personal vision and their liberation, promising upliftment through devotion.
shakti_gita::48.modern_relevance: When someone offers you kindness without conditions, it feels like a light guiding you through hard times toward growth and freedom.
shakti_gita::48.insight: It invites you to trust in the natural compassion of the divine and to receive its vision and upliftment without resistance.

shakti_gita::49.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञातुं न शक्तास्तव देवि ! तत्त्वं वयं न दैत्या अपि मानवाः के।
परात्परे ! त्वाञ्च दयाम्बुराशे !  वयं नमामस्त्रिगुणस्वरूपे ! ॥
shakti_gita::49.verse_hindi: हे देवि ! आपके तत्त्व को हम देवगण तथा असुर कुछ भी नहीं समझ सकते तो मनुष्यों का तो कहना की क्या है, हे परात्परे! हे दयाम्बुराशे हे त्रिगुणमयी! आपको प्रणाम है
shakti_gita::49.english_translation: O Devi! Neither the gods nor the demons can truly understand your essence, so how can humans? O supreme one, full of compassion and the three qualities, we bow to you.
shakti_gita::49.translation_literal: ज्ञातुं (to know) न (not) शक्ताः (able) त्व (your) देवि (O Devi) ! तत्त्वं (essence) वयं (we) न (not) दैत्या (demons) अपि (even) मानवाः (humans) के (how) । परात्परे (O supreme) ! त्वाञ्च (and you) दयाम्बुराशे (compassionate one) ! वयं (we) नमामः (bow) त्रिगुणस्वरूपे (three qualities form) ! ॥
shakti_gita::49.speaker: Unknown
shakti_gita::49.essence: Devi's true nature is beyond all beings' understanding, inspiring humble reverence.
shakti_gita::49.simple_meaning: Neither gods nor demons can fully understand the true essence of Devi, so humans certainly cannot. She is supreme, compassionate, and embodies the three qualities; we bow to her.
shakti_gita::49.simple_insight: Some truths about the divine are beyond even the highest beings' understanding, inviting humility and reverence.
shakti_gita::49.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the speaker admits that even powerful beings like gods and demons cannot grasp Devi's true nature. The verse expresses deep respect toward Devi, who is described as supreme, compassionate, and embodying the three fundamental qualities of nature, highlighting her transcendence beyond ordinary understanding.
shakti_gita::49.insight: It teaches humility before realities that exceed all knowledge, inviting respect rather than certainty.

shakti_gita::50.verse_sanskrit:
कि वर्णनं तेऽस्ति कृपाम्बुराशे र्येऽज्ञानपाशैर्जड़िता विमुग्धाः।
मातमहत्त्वं परमाद्भुतं ते किमप्यहो नैव विदन्ति भक्ताः ॥
shakti_gita::50.verse_hindi: हे जगन्मातः!आपकी कृपा का कहां तक वर्णन किया जाय, जो आपका अज्ञान पाश से  विजडित विमूढ़ अज्ञ भक्त आप के महत्त्व को कुछ भी नहीं समझता है
shakti_gita::50.english_translation: O Mother of the world! How can your grace be described, when devotees confused by the bonds of ignorance do not truly understand your supreme greatness?
shakti_gita::50.translation_literal: कि (how) / वर्णनं (description) / तेऽस्ति (of you is) / कृपाम्बुराशे (a shower of grace) / र्येऽज्ञानपाशैः (by bonds of ignorance) / जड़िता (bewildered) / विमुग्धाः (confused) / माता (Mother) / महत्त्वं (greatness) / परमाद्भुतं (supreme-wonderful) / ते (your) / किमपि (anything) / अहो (alas) / नैव (not at all) / विदन्ति (know) / भक्ताः (devotees)
shakti_gita::50.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::50.essence: True devotion often struggles to see the divine’s greatness through the fog of confusion.
shakti_gita::50.simple_meaning: Your grace is limitless, but many devotees fail to grasp your supreme greatness because their minds are clouded by confusion.
shakti_gita::50.simple_insight: It’s okay to feel lost; grace is still present even when unseen.
shakti_gita::50.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses her devotees, acknowledging that many are trapped in ignorance and unable to fully perceive her vast grace and supreme significance despite her constant presence.
shakti_gita::50.modern_relevance: You may struggle to feel the support or love meant for you, but that doesn’t mean it’s absent or small.
shakti_gita::50.insight: Recognize that confusion can hide the divine’s presence, but it does not diminish it.

shakti_gita::51.verse_sanskrit:
अनन्यभक्सैव तु केवलं हि भृङ्गायमाणास्तव पादपद्यमे।
विच्योतयस्यम्ब ! न तानपि त्वं स्वदर्शनान्मोक्षखनेः कदापि ॥
shakti_gita::51.verse_hindi: परन्तु आपके चरणकमलों में अनन्य भक्ति से भ्रमर जैसा प्रेम रखता है उसको भी आप मोक्ष-प्रद अपने दर्शन देने से विमुख नहीं रखती
shakti_gita::51.english_translation: But the bees that hold exclusive devotion to your lotus feet, you never deny them liberation by withholding your vision.
shakti_gita::51.translation_literal: अनन्यभक्सैव (exclusive devotion only) / तु (but) / केवलं (solely) / हि (indeed) / भृङ्गायमाणाः (hovering like bees) / तव (your) / पादपद्यमे (at the lotus feet) / विच्योतयस् (withholding) / यम् (which) / अम्ब (O mother) / न (not) / तान् (them) / अपि (even) / त्वं (you) / स्वदर्शनात् (by your own vision) / मोक्षखनेः (of liberation) / कदापि (ever)
shakti_gita::51.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::51.essence: Exclusive devotion naturally draws the liberating vision; it is never denied.
shakti_gita::51.simple_meaning: Those who love you with exclusive devotion are never refused your liberating presence or vision.
shakti_gita::51.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing that sincere love always reaches the freeing grace you offer.
shakti_gita::51.detailed_meaning: Devi describes how beings who hold exclusive, loving devotion to her lotus feet—like bees to a flower—are never turned away from the vision that grants liberation. This reassures that true devotion always finds her grace.
shakti_gita::51.modern_relevance: When you commit yourself fully to someone or something you trust, you find their support and freedom come to you naturally.
shakti_gita::51.insight: It teaches you that wholehearted devotion invites liberating presence rather than pushing it away.

shakti_gita::52.verse_sanskrit:
श्रीविष्णुगौरीशिवधीशसूर्यरूपामु पञ्चात्मकदेवतासु।
यथारुचि तवं प्रकटत्वमेत्य स्थूलासु तान्वै कुरुपे कृतार्थान् ॥
shakti_gita::52.verse_hindi: और विष्णु, सूर्य, गौरी, धीश और शम्भु रूपी पञ्चमूर्तियों में से जैसी उसकी रुचि हो उसी स्थूलमूर्ति में प्रकट होकर उसको कृतकृत्य करती हो।
shakti_gita::52.english_translation: She appears in whichever gross form among the five deities Vishnu, Gauri, Dhisha, Shiva, and Surya pleases, fulfilling their desires.
shakti_gita::52.translation_literal: श्रीविष्णुगौरीशिवधीशसूर्यरूपाम् (in forms of Vishnu, Gauri, Shiva, Dhisha, Surya) / पञ्चात्मकदेवतासु (among the five deities) / यथा (as) / रुचि (pleasure, liking) / तवम् (you) / प्रकटत्वम् (manifestation) / एत्य (thus) / स्थूलासु (in gross forms) / तान् (them) / वै (indeed) / कुरुपे (to the one who does) / कृतार्थान् (fulfilled, satisfied).
shakti_gita::52.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::52.essence: The divine manifests in forms aligned with each being’s unique needs and preferences.
shakti_gita::52.simple_meaning: The divine reveals herself in the form that each of the five great deities prefers, satisfying their needs.
shakti_gita::52.simple_insight: It feels reassuring that the divine meets each being in the way they can relate to and understand.
shakti_gita::52.detailed_meaning: Devi explains how she manifests in visible forms preferred by the five great deities—Vishnu, Gauri, Dhisha, Shiva, and Surya—to fulfill their desires and make herself accessible in ways suited to each.
shakti_gita::52.modern_relevance: When you connect with others, showing up in the way they best understand you creates deeper trust and fulfillment.
shakti_gita::52.insight: It teaches you to adapt your expression to meet others where they are, fulfilling their needs without losing your essence.

shakti_gita::53.verse_sanskrit:
देवेषु राज्येषु यदा कदाचिद् घोरेण देवासुरसङ्गरेण । 
उत्तिष्ठते धार्मिकविप्लवोघो दयामाये ! लञ्च तदैव नूनम् ॥
shakti_gita::53.verse_hindi: जब कभी घोर देवासुरसंग्राम द्वारा दैवीराज्य में धर्मविप्लव उपस्थित होता है तब आप
shakti_gita::53.english_translation: Whenever a severe battle between radiant beings and shadow beings arises in divine realms, then surely the upheaval of righteousness occurs.
shakti_gita::53.translation_literal: देवेषु (among divine beings) / राज्येषु (in kingdoms) / यदा (when) / कदाचिद् (at any time) / घोरेण (terrible) / देवासुरसङ्गरेण (battle of Devas and Asuras) / उत्तिष्ठते (arises) / धार्मिकविप्लवः (upheaval of righteousness) / घो (terrible) / दयामाये (compassionate one) / लञ्च (then) / तदैव (at that time) / नूनम् (surely)
shakti_gita::53.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::53.essence: Severe conflict between opposing cosmic forces disrupts righteousness in divine realms.
shakti_gita::53.simple_meaning: At times, when a fierce conflict happens between radiant and shadow beings in divine realms, the natural order and righteousness are disrupted.
shakti_gita::53.simple_insight: Even the highest realms face disruption when conflict erupts between opposing forces.
shakti_gita::53.detailed_meaning: Suta narrates a cosmic moment where violent conflict between radiant beings (Devas) and shadow beings (Asuras) shakes the divine kingdoms, causing a crisis in righteousness that calls for divine intervention.
shakti_gita::53.insight: It shows that conflict can disrupt even the most sacred orders, highlighting the need for vigilance and restoration.

shakti_gita::54.verse_sanskrit:
मातर्जगन्मङ्गलमाशु कर्त्तुमाकृष्य तेजांस्यमलानि नोऽलम् ।
तैरेव सन्दीपितदिक्समूहै: स्थूल स्वरूपं विमलं दधाना ॥
shakti_gita::54.verse_hindi: जगत के कल्याण के लिये हम सभी के निर्मल तेज को आकर्षण करके दिशाओं को दीपित करनेवाले उस तेज से अपना स्थूल रूप धारण करती हुई,
shakti_gita::54.english_translation: For the welfare of the world, I draw the pure lights of all beings to illumine the directions, assuming my gross form.
shakti_gita::54.translation_literal: मातर्जगन्मङ्गलमाशु (for the mother's world's welfare quickly) / कर्त्तुमाकृष्य (to do, drawing) / तेजांस्यमलानि (pure lights) / नोऽलम् (our) / तैरेव (by them only) / सन्दीपितदिक्समूहै: (illuminated directions groups) / स्थूल (gross) / स्वरूपं (form) / विमलं (pure) / दधाना (holding)
shakti_gita::54.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::54.essence: You manifest as a radiant form by gathering pure energies to illuminate the world.
shakti_gita::54.simple_meaning: You gather the pure energies of all beings to illuminate the world, taking on a visible form for its welfare.
shakti_gita::54.simple_insight: You are both the source of pure light and its visible presence in the world.
shakti_gita::54.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals that for the benefit of all beings, she draws their pure energies to shine across all directions, manifesting a gross form to support the cosmic welfare.
shakti_gita::54.modern_relevance: When you step up to share your talents widely, you become a visible source of light for many who need it.
shakti_gita::54.insight: It teaches you to see your everyday presence as a channel for collective energy, not just personal identity.

shakti_gita::55.verse_sanskrit:
हत्वाऽमुरांस्तान कुरुपे व्यवस्थां देवाधिराज्यस्य विशालसीनः।
एवं कदाचित्किल मर्त्यलोके धर्मस्य जाते बहु विप्लवे हि ॥
shakti_gita::55.verse_hindi: असुरो का निधन करके देवीराज्य की सुव्यवस्था करती है,उसी प्रकार जब कभी मृत्युलोक धर्म विप्लव उपस्थित होता है
shakti_gita::55.english_translation: By killing the Asuras, the great ruler of the divine establishes order; similarly, whenever dharma declines in the mortal world.
shakti_gita::55.translation_literal: हत्वा (killing) अमुरान् (Asuras) तान् (those) कुरु (does) उपे (ruler) व्यवस्थां (order) देवाधिराज्यस्य (of divine kingdom) विशालसीनः (great ruler). एवं (thus) कदाचित् (sometimes) किल (indeed) मर्त्यलोके (in mortal world) धर्मस्य (of dharma) जाते (when arises) बहु (much) विप्लवे (disturbance) हि (indeed).
shakti_gita::55.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::55.essence: Order is restored by removing destructive forces whenever righteousness declines.
shakti_gita::55.simple_meaning: The divine ruler restores order by defeating evil beings whenever moral decline happens in the world.
shakti_gita::55.simple_insight: Order returns when harmful forces are removed and righteousness is restored.
shakti_gita::55.detailed_meaning: Suta narrates how the divine queen restores cosmic order by defeating Asuras (forces of ego and chaos) whenever dharma (righteousness) declines in the world, illustrating the cyclical nature of moral order and disruption.
shakti_gita::55.insight: Recognize that restoring balance sometimes requires confronting and removing destructive influences.

shakti_gita::56.verse_sanskrit:
विभिन्नजीवेष्ववतीर्य मात ईठादसाधूनिखिलानिहत्य।
साधूनवन्ती पुनरेव धर्म राज्यं सुसंस्थापय से तदा त्वंम् ॥
shakti_gita::56.verse_hindi: तो आप विभिन्न जीव शरीर में अवतीर्ण होकर असाधुओ का विनाश और साधुओं को सुख प्रदान द्वारा धर्म का पुनः संस्थापन करती हो,
shakti_gita::56.english_translation: You incarnate in various beings, destroy the wicked, protect the virtuous, and re-establish dharma firmly.
shakti_gita::56.translation_literal: विभिन्नजीवेषु (in various beings) अवतीर्य (having incarnated) मात (you, mother) ईठादसाधून् (the wicked) निखिलानि (all) हत्य (by destroying). साधून् (the virtuous) वन्ती (protecting) पुनर् (again) एव (indeed) धर्म (righteousness) राज्यं (the rule) सुसंस्थापय (firmly establish) से (then) तदा (at that time) त्वम् (you).
shakti_gita::56.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::56.essence: You incarnate to destroy wrongdoing and firmly restore righteousness.
shakti_gita::56.simple_meaning: You take form among many beings to remove harm and protect goodness, restoring order and righteousness.
shakti_gita::56.simple_insight: There is strength in knowing your purpose is to uphold what is right and protect the good.
shakti_gita::56.detailed_meaning: Devi explains how she incarnates in many forms to destroy the wicked and safeguard the virtuous, re-establishing dharma when it falters, affirming her role as protector and restorer of cosmic order.
shakti_gita::56.modern_relevance: When you face injustice or wrongdoing, your true purpose is to stand for what is right and protect those who do good.
shakti_gita::56.insight: It teaches you to see your actions as part of restoring balance by opposing harm and supporting virtue.

shakti_gita::57.verse_sanskrit:
देशो यदा हासमुपैति तं त्वं नेतस्वरूपे ह्यवतीर्य पासि ।
विष्ण्वादिपञ्चात्मकदेवरूपे ! वयं नमामो रणचण्डिके ! त्वाम् ॥
shakti_gita::57.verse_hindi: उसी प्रकार जब देश की अवनति होने लगती है तब नेता रूप में अवतार लेकर उसकी रक्षा करती हो, हे पञ्चदेवमयी ! हे रणचण्डिके ! आपको प्रणाम है
shakti_gita::57.english_translation: Just as a nation declines, you incarnate as a leader to protect it, O embodiment of the five deities! Salutations to you, fierce warrior goddess!
shakti_gita::57.translation_literal: देशो (nation) यदा (when) हासम् (decline) उपैति (comes upon) तम् (that) त्वम् (you) नेतस्वरूपे (in leader form) हि (indeed) अवतीर्य (descending) पासि (protect) । विष्ण्वादि (Vishnu and others) पञ्चात्मक (five forms) देवरूपे (divine form) ! वयं (we) नमामः (salute) रणचण्डिके (fierce warrior goddess) ! त्वाम् (you) ॥
shakti_gita::57.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::57.essence: True protection arises when the divine takes leader form to restore what declines.
shakti_gita::57.simple_meaning: When a nation falls into decline, you appear as a leader to protect it. You embody the power of five divine forms and fierce courage.
shakti_gita::57.simple_insight: Protection comes through a powerful, fearless presence that rises when needed most.
shakti_gita::57.detailed_meaning: Devi speaks here, describing how she incarnates as a leader when a land faces downfall. She takes the form combining five divine aspects, showing fierce strength and protection to restore order.
shakti_gita::57.insight: It reveals how true leadership arises naturally in crisis, embodying courage and multiple strengths to protect what matters.

shakti_gita::58.verse_sanskrit:
त्वं सचिदानन्दमये स्वकीये ब्रह्मस्वरूपे निजविज्ञभक्तान् ।
तथेशरूपे च विधाप्य मातरुपासकान दर्शनमात्मभक्तान् ॥
shakti_gita::58.verse_hindi: आप अपने ज्ञानी भक्तों को सच्चिदानन्दमय ब्रह्मरूप में दर्शन देकर, उपासक भक्तों को ईश्वरी रूप से दर्शन देकर
shakti_gita::58.english_translation: You reveal yourself as the blissful supreme reality to your wise devotees, and as the divine mother to the worshipping devotees.
shakti_gita::58.translation_literal: त्वं (You) / सचिदानन्दमये (blissful supreme reality) / स्वकीये (to your own) / ब्रह्मस्वरूपे (form of supreme reality) / निजविज्ञभक्तान् (to your wise devotees) / । / तथेशरूपे (as divine mother) / च (also) / विधाप्य (revealing) / मातरुपासकान (to worshipping devotees) / दर्शनमात्मभक्तान् (vision to self-devotees) / ॥
shakti_gita::58.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::58.essence: The divine reveals herself uniquely to each devotee according to their devotion and wisdom.
shakti_gita::58.simple_meaning: You reveal yourself differently to your devotees: as the blissful supreme reality to wise seekers, and as the divine mother to those who worship you.
shakti_gita::58.simple_insight: There is warmth in knowing the divine meets each heart in the way it needs most.
shakti_gita::58.detailed_meaning: Devi explains how she appears in two forms: as the blissful supreme reality to devotees with deep wisdom, and as the divine mother to those devoted in worship. This shows her compassionate presence tailored to each devotee's nature.
shakti_gita::58.modern_relevance: You might experience guidance differently from mentors or loved ones, each offering what your heart truly needs to grow or feel safe.
shakti_gita::58.insight: It teaches you to trust that your inner being connects with you uniquely, meeting you where you are on your path.

shakti_gita::59.verse_sanskrit:
निष्कामयज्ञावलिनिष्ठसाधकान् विराटस्वरूपे च विधाप्य दर्शनम्।
श्रुतेर्महावाक्यमिदं मनोहर करोष्यहो “तत्त्वमसीति" सार्थकम् ॥
shakti_gita::59.verse_hindi: और निष्काम यश निष्ठभक्तो को विराट्मूर्ति दर्शन देकर तत्त्वमसि महावाक्य को चरितार्थता करती हैं,
shakti_gita::59.english_translation: And by granting the vision of the cosmic form to practitioners dedicated to selfless sacrifice, the great saying 'That you are' becomes fulfilled.
shakti_gita::59.translation_literal: निष्कामयज्ञावलिनिष्ठसाधकान् (to selfless-sacrifice-devoted practitioners) / विराटस्वरूपे (in cosmic form) / च (and) / विधाप्य (by granting) / दर्शनम् (the vision) / श्रुतेर्महावाक्यमिदं (this great saying from scriptures) / मनोहर (beautiful) / करोष्य (does) / अहो (oh!) / “तत्त्वमसीति" (That you are) / सार्थकम् (meaningful).
shakti_gita::59.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::59.essence: Selfless dedication reveals your true cosmic nature and fulfills the truth 'You are that'.
shakti_gita::59.simple_meaning: When you act without craving personal gain, you can experience your true cosmic nature and realize the truth 'You are that'.
shakti_gita::59.simple_insight: There's freedom in dedicating your actions without wanting results, revealing your vast true self.
shakti_gita::59.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that those devoted to selfless sacrifice receive the vision of her cosmic form. This direct experience fulfills the great scriptural truth 'That you are', confirming the unity between the inner self and the cosmic whole.
shakti_gita::59.modern_relevance: When you give your best without chasing rewards, you discover a deeper connection to something vast and real beyond yourself.
shakti_gita::59.insight: This verse shifts focus from craving outcomes to embracing selfless dedication, opening the heart to recognize your cosmic identity.

shakti_gita::60.verse_sanskrit:
मन्त्रावलीनां सहसेतुभूते ! सृष्टयादिजाते ! प्रभवे ! श्रुतीनाम् ।
अनाद्यनन्तेऽखिलगे ! प्रणम्ये ! नमो भवत्यै प्रणवस्वरूपे ! ॥
shakti_gita::60.verse_hindi: हे मन्त्रों के सेतु! हे सृष्ट्यादिजात! हे श्रुतिप्रभवे ! हे सर्वपूज्ये! हे प्रणवरूपिणी ! आपको प्रणाम है
shakti_gita::60.english_translation: O bridge of mantras! Origin of creation! Source of sacred sounds! Infinite and eternal! I bow to you, embodiment of the primal sound Om!
shakti_gita::60.translation_literal: मन्त्रावलीनां (of mantras) / सहसेतुभूते (bridge made) / सृष्टयादिजाते (origin of creation) / प्रभवे (source) / श्रुतीनाम् (of sacred sounds) / अनाद्यनन्तेऽखिलगे (beginningless, endless, all-pervading) / प्रणम्ये (bowing) / नमो (salutations) / भवत्यै (to you) / प्रणवस्वरूपे (form of Om)
shakti_gita::60.speaker: Unknown
shakti_gita::60.essence: The divine is the infinite source and bridge of all sacred sounds and creation.
shakti_gita::60.simple_meaning: You are honored as the timeless source connecting all sacred sounds and the origin of creation itself.
shakti_gita::60.simple_insight: There is a profound connection between sound, creation, and the divine presence you can sense.
shakti_gita::60.detailed_meaning: The verse addresses the divine as the bridge made of mantras, the primal origin of all creation and sacred sounds, venerating her as infinite and eternal, the embodiment of Om, the primal cosmic vibration.
shakti_gita::60.modern_relevance: When you hear a meaningful song or chant, you can feel a connection to something greater beyond words and time.
shakti_gita::60.insight: It invites you to recognize the power behind words and sounds as a living bridge to the infinite source.

shakti_gita::61.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानस्य साम्राज्यमृषिप्रकाण्डैरस्माभिरम्बाखिलकर्मराज्यम् ।
स्थूलं स्वराज्यं पितृभिश्च नूनं दत्त्वाथ संरक्षयसे स्वशक्तिम् ॥
shakti_gita::61.verse_hindi: आप ही अपनी शक्ति प्रदान करके ऋषियों के द्वारा ज्ञानराज्य का संरक्षण, हम लोगों के द्वारा कर्म राज्य का संरक्षण और पितरों के द्वारा स्थूलराज्य का  संरक्षण कराती हो,
shakti_gita::61.english_translation: You grant your power to the sages who protect the kingdom of knowledge, to us who uphold the kingdom of action, and to the ancestors who guard the physical realm.
shakti_gita::61.translation_literal: ज्ञानस्य (of knowledge) साम्राज्यम् (kingdom) ऋषि (sages) प्रकाण्डैः (great) अस्माभिः (by us) अम्बा (mother) अखिल (all) कर्म (action) राज्यम् (kingdom) स्थूलं (gross) स्वराज्यम् (own kingdom) पितृभिः (by ancestors) च (and) नूनं (indeed) दत्त्वा (having given) अथ (then) संरक्षयसे (you protect) स्वशक्तिम् (your own power)
shakti_gita::61.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::61.essence: One divine power supports knowledge, action, and the physical world through different protectors.
shakti_gita::61.simple_meaning: The divine grants power to sages to protect wisdom, to people to uphold action, and to ancestors to guard the physical world.
shakti_gita::61.simple_insight: Everything we know, do, and inhabit exists because of the divine energy you give.
shakti_gita::61.detailed_meaning: Devi explains how she sustains three realms: sages guard knowledge, humans preserve action, and ancestors maintain the physical world, all empowered by her energy.
shakti_gita::61.modern_relevance: When you rely on your inner strength, you support your learning, your work, and your environment all at once.
shakti_gita::61.insight: Recognize your power as part of a vast system sustaining thought, deed, and matter simultaneously.

shakti_gita::62.verse_sanskrit:
अव्यक्तरूपेऽखिलशक्तिशोभे! व्यक्तेऽगुणे! सगुणेऽसि मातः !।
विमोहिनी जीवततेरविद्या विद्यापि कैवल्यपदा त्वमेव ॥
shakti_gita::62.verse_hindi: हे सर्वशक्तिमयी ! हे व्यक्ताव्यक्त रूपिणी ! हे निर्गुणासगुणा ! आप ही जीवों को मोहित करनेवाली अविद्या, जीवमुक्ति दात्री विद्या और
shakti_gita::62.english_translation: O all-powerful one, who appears both manifest and unmanifest, without qualities and with qualities, you alone are the ignorance that deludes living beings, the knowledge that liberates them, and the state of absolute freedom.
shakti_gita::62.translation_literal: अव्यक्तरूपेऽखिलशक्तिशोभे! (in unmanifest form, shining with all powers) व्यक्तेऽगुणे! (in manifest form, without qualities) सगुणेऽसि मातः! (in manifest form, with qualities, you are the mother) विमोहिनी (deluding) जीवततेर (living beings) अविद्या (ignorance) विद्यापि (and knowledge) कैवल्यपदा (state of absolute freedom) त्वमेव (you alone)
shakti_gita::62.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::62.essence: The one power is both the cause of confusion and the source of liberation.
shakti_gita::62.simple_meaning: You are the power that both confuses and frees living beings. You appear in many forms, with and without qualities.
shakti_gita::62.simple_insight: You can hold opposing forces within yourself and still be whole.
shakti_gita::62.detailed_meaning: Devi speaks as the supreme power manifesting in every form. She is the cause of both ignorance that traps living beings and the knowledge that liberates them, embodying the paradox of existence.
shakti_gita::62.modern_relevance: In moments of confusion and clarity, you embody both the problem and the solution within yourself.
shakti_gita::62.insight: Recognize that what confuses you and what frees you come from the same source within.

shakti_gita::63.verse_sanskrit:
नित्यं तुरीयास्पदसम्प्रतिष्ठा विधायिनी ब्रह्ममयी त्वमेव।
स्वाहास्वधाकारवषटस्वरूपे ! हे देवमातर्भवतीं नमामः ॥
shakti_gita::63.verse_hindi: आप ही तुरीयपद-प्रतिष्टितकारिणी ब्रह्ममयी हैं, हे स्वाहास्वधावषट रूपिणी ! हे देवजननी ! आपको प्रणाम है
shakti_gita::63.english_translation: You alone establish the state beyond the three, embodying the supreme reality. O Swaha-Svadha-Ashat form! O divine mother, we bow to you.
shakti_gita::63.translation_literal: नित्यं (always) तुरीयास्पदसम्प्रतिष्ठा (establishing the state beyond the three) विधायिनी (causing) ब्रह्ममयी (embodying supreme reality) त्वमेव (only you). स्वाहा-अस्वधा-कारवषट-स्वरूपे (in the form of Swaha, Svadha, Karva, Ashat). हे (O) देवमातर्भवतीं (divine mother) नमामः (we bow).
shakti_gita::63.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::63.essence: The supreme divine mother alone embodies the transcendent state beyond all experience.
shakti_gita::63.simple_meaning: You are the supreme being who exists beyond all three states of consciousness, embodying ultimate reality. We honor you as the divine mother in this form.
shakti_gita::63.simple_insight: Recognizing the divine beyond all changing states brings deep reverence and peace.
shakti_gita::63.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the speaker honors the Goddess as the eternal essence beyond waking, dreaming, and deep sleep—the transcendent fourth state (turiya). She embodies supreme reality and manifests through sacred forms like Swaha and Svadha. This moment captures devotion to the divine mother as the source beyond all experience.
shakti_gita::63.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by shifting moods and challenges, remember your true self exists beyond all changing states, steady and whole.
shakti_gita::63.insight: It invites you to see beyond your restless mind and emotions to the unchanging reality within, inspiring devotion and surrender.

shakti_gita::64.verse_sanskrit:
त्वमेव मातः ! प्रतिकल्पमेव सरस्वतीरूपमहो दधाना।
स्वाध्यात्मशक्यर्पिप्रशान्तचित्त माविविधत्से च प्रणोद्य वेदान् ॥
shakti_gita::64.verse_hindi: प्रतिकल्प में आप सरस्वती रूप धारण करती हुई अपनी अध्यात्मशक्ति के द्वारा ऋषियों के अन्तःकरण को प्रेरणा करके
shakti_gita::64.english_translation: You alone, as the mother, take the form of Saraswati in imagination, inspiring the sages' inner hearts with your spiritual power and calming their restless minds.
shakti_gita::64.translation_literal: त्वमेव (you alone) / मातः (mother) / प्रतिकल्पमेव (in imagination only) / सरस्वतीरूपमहो (great form of Saraswati) / दधाना (holding) / स्वाध्यात्मशक्यर्पि (with spiritual power) / प्रशान्तचित्त (calm mind) / म (me) / अविविधत्से (you inspire) / च (and) / प्रणोद्य (inspiration) / वेदान् (the sages)
shakti_gita::64.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::64.essence: The divine inspires and calms the sages’ inner hearts through imagined forms.
shakti_gita::64.simple_meaning: You appear as Saraswati in imagination, using your spiritual power to inspire sages and calm their restless minds.
shakti_gita::64.simple_insight: You can feel the calming inspiration that comes from a deep inner power.
shakti_gita::64.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that she appears as Saraswati in the sages’ imagination, inspiring their inner being with spiritual power that soothes their restless minds, showing her role as the source of wisdom and inner peace.
shakti_gita::64.insight: It shows how inspiration and calm come from deeper spiritual power beyond the restless mind.

shakti_gita::65.verse_sanskrit:
वेदेषु संस्थापयसेज्य मन्त्रशक्तिं हि गायत्रयाधिरूपतस्त्वम् ।
त्वमेव सावित्र्यधिरूपतश्च यज्ञक्रियाशक्तिमथो वितन्य ॥
shakti_gita::65.verse_hindi: वेद का आविर्भाव करती हैं, गायत्री रूप से वेदों में मन्त्रशक्ति प्रदान करती हैं और सावित्री रूप से यज्ञ की क्रियाशक्ति विस्तार करके
shakti_gita::65.english_translation: You manifest in the Vedas, granting mantra power as Gayatri and expanding ritual power as Savitri.
shakti_gita::65.translation_literal: वेदेषु (in the Vedas) / संस्थापयसेज्य (you establish) / मन्त्रशक्तिं (mantra power) / हि (indeed) / गायत्रयाधिरूपतस्त्वम् (as the form of Gayatri) / त्वमेव (you alone) / सावित्र्यधिरूपतश्च (and as the form of Savitri) / यज्ञक्रियाशक्तिमथो (ritual action power you extend) / वितन्य (spreading)
shakti_gita::65.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::65.essence: The divine manifests as mantra and ritual power within the Vedas.
shakti_gita::65.simple_meaning: You are the power behind the Vedas, giving them life as Gayatri and expanding the energy of ritual actions as Savitri.
shakti_gita::65.simple_insight: The divine energy expresses itself through sacred sound and action, connecting knowledge and practice.
shakti_gita::65.detailed_meaning: The Goddess explains her presence in the Vedas as the living power of mantras embodied by Gayatri and as the force energizing rituals in the form of Savitri, revealing her role as source of sacred knowledge and ritual efficacy.
shakti_gita::65.insight: Recognize that sacred knowledge and ritual power come from the same source of living energy.

shakti_gita::66.verse_sanskrit:
तत्साधकेभ्यो मनुजेभ्य आशु निःश्रेयसञ्चाऽभ्युदयं ददासि ।
अतो वयं ज्ञानप्रदेऽतिनम्रा हे वेदमातर्भवतीं नमामः ॥
shakti_gita::66.verse_hindi: मनुष्यों को अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस प्रदान करती हैं। हे वेद जननी ! हे ज्ञानदे ! अति नम्रता पूर्वक आपको प्रणाम है
shakti_gita::66.english_translation: To those who seek, you swiftly grant prosperity and ultimate well-being. Therefore, we humbly bow to you, O Mother of the Vedas.
shakti_gita::66.translation_literal: तत् (that) साधकेभ्यः (to seekers) मनुजेभ्यः (to humans) आशु (quickly) निःश्रेयसञ्च (ultimate well-being) अभ्युदयं (prosperity) ददासि (you give) । अतो (therefore) वयम् (we) ज्ञानप्रदे (giver of knowledge) अतिनम्रा (very humble) हे (O) वेदमातर्भवतीं (mother of the Vedas) नमामः (we bow) ॥
shakti_gita::66.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::66.essence: Sincere seekers quickly receive support toward their highest good from the divine.
shakti_gita::66.simple_meaning: If you sincerely seek, the divine quickly grants you prosperity and your highest well-being.
shakti_gita::66.simple_insight: You can trust that your sincere efforts are met with timely support and growth.
shakti_gita::66.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses sincere seekers, promising that those who seek her guidance will swiftly receive prosperity and ultimate well-being. This verse expresses humble respect toward the divine as the source of knowledge and liberation.
shakti_gita::66.modern_relevance: When you reach out honestly for help or growth, support often arrives faster than expected, guiding you toward your best outcome.
shakti_gita::66.insight: It encourages trusting the process of sincere seeking, knowing that progress and well-being follow naturally.

shakti_gita::67.verse_sanskrit:
अनुष्ठितेन युष्माभिर्ब्रह्मचक्रेण निर्जराः।
युष्माकञ्चैव सदंक्सा प्रसननाऽस्मि न संशयः ॥
shakti_gita::67.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! आपके ब्रह्मचक्र के अनुष्ठान और आप सभी की भक्ति से मैं प्रसन्न हुई हूँ
shakti_gita::67.english_translation: O celestial beings! By your steadfast practice of the Brahma cycle and your devotion, I am truly pleased without doubt.
shakti_gita::67.translation_literal: अनुष्ठितेन (by the performed) / युष्माभिः (by you all) / ब्रह्मचक्रेण (by the Brahma cycle) / निर्जराः (without interruption) / युष्माकं (your) / च (and) / एव (indeed) / सदंक्षा (devotion) / प्रसननाऽस्मि (I am pleased) / न (not) / संशयः (doubt)
shakti_gita::67.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::67.essence: Consistent, heartfelt devotion naturally pleases the divine without doubt.
shakti_gita::67.simple_meaning: The divine expresses joy and trust because of your continuous practice and sincere devotion.
shakti_gita::67.simple_insight: Knowing your steady devotion is deeply valued brings a quiet joy and trust.
shakti_gita::67.detailed_meaning: The goddess addresses celestial beings, acknowledging their unwavering spiritual practice and heartfelt devotion. This recognition shows their efforts are noticed and appreciated, encouraging continued faith and dedication.
shakti_gita::67.modern_relevance: After weeks of daily care for a loved one, you finally feel your effort is truly noticed and valued.
shakti_gita::67.insight: It teaches you that sincere, consistent devotion naturally earns the divine's trust and pleasure.

shakti_gita::68.verse_sanskrit:
पूर्ण कर्त्तुमहं देवा भवतां यदभीप्सितम् ।
सगुणं रूपमास्थाय प्रादुर्भताऽस्मि साम्प्रतम् ॥
shakti_gita::68.verse_hindi: मैं आपकी शुभ इच्छा पूर्ण करने को सगुण रूप में प्रकट हुई हूँ
shakti_gita::68.english_translation: I have manifested in a form with qualities to fulfill your cherished desire.
shakti_gita::68.translation_literal: पूर्ण (complete) कर्तुम् (to do) अहं (I) देवा (O gods) भवतां (your) यत् (which) अभिप्सितम् (desired) । सगुणं (with qualities) रूपम् (form) आस्थाय (assuming) प्रादुर्भत (manifested) अस्मि (am) साम्प्रतम् (now) ॥
shakti_gita::68.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::68.essence: The divine manifests in forms with qualities to fulfill sincere desires.
shakti_gita::68.simple_meaning: The divine takes a form with qualities to fulfill the wishes of those who seek her.
shakti_gita::68.simple_insight: You can feel cared for knowing the divine adapts to meet your heartfelt desires.
shakti_gita::68.detailed_meaning: Devi declares she has assumed a manifest form with qualities to fulfill the sincere desires of the gods, showing her compassionate responsiveness in the moment of need.
shakti_gita::68.modern_relevance: When you deeply long for something, sensing a presence ready to meet your need brings comfort and trust.
shakti_gita::68.insight: It teaches you that the divine meets you where you are, taking forms you can relate to.

shakti_gita::69.verse_sanskrit:
वर्तते भवतां देवा यत्किञ्चिद्वाञ्छितं शुभम् ।
व्याहरन्तु भवन्तस्तव पूरयिष्याम्यहं ध्रुवम् ॥
shakti_gita::69.verse_hindi: आपकी जो इच्छा हो सो प्रकट करें मैं उसको पूर्ण करूंगी
shakti_gita::69.english_translation: Whatever auspicious desire you have, express it; I will surely fulfill it.
shakti_gita::69.translation_literal: वर्तते (exists) भवतां (your) देवा (divine beings) यत्किञ्चिद्वाञ्छितं (whatever wished) शुभम् (auspicious) । व्याहरन्तु (express) भवन्तः (you all) तव (your) पूरयिष्यामि (I will fulfill) अहं (I) ध्रुवम् (certainly) ॥
shakti_gita::69.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::69.essence: Express your heartfelt wishes without fear; they will surely be fulfilled.
shakti_gita::69.simple_meaning: You are invited to express any positive wish you hold, and it will definitely be fulfilled.
shakti_gita::69.simple_insight: There is comfort knowing your heartfelt desires are heard and will be met with certainty.
shakti_gita::69.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Devi offers assurance to those seeking her grace. She invites the devotee to voice any auspicious desire, promising that she will fulfill it without fail, demonstrating her caring and reliable nature.
shakti_gita::69.modern_relevance: You hesitate to ask for help or to express your hopes, fearing they might be ignored. This reveals that your true needs deserve clear expression and will be met with care.
shakti_gita::69.insight: It teaches you to trust in expressing your true wishes without hesitation, knowing they are valued and will be fulfilled.

shakti_gita::70.verse_sanskrit:
महादेवि ! प्रभो ! मातभक्तमानसमन्दिरे।
विहारिणि ! प्रसन्ने ! हे दयापूरिततमानसे ! ॥
shakti_gita::70.verse_hindi: हे जगजननी ! हे भक्त मनोमन्दिर विहारिणी । हे करुणामयी !
shakti_gita::70.english_translation: O great Goddess! O beloved refuge of devoted hearts! O compassionate one, dwelling in the temple of devotees' minds!
shakti_gita::70.translation_literal: महादेवि (great Goddess) ! प्रभो (O lord) ! मातभक्तमानसमन्दिरे (in the temple of devoted minds) । विहारिणि (dwelling) ! प्रसन्ने (O pleased one) ! हे (O) दयापूरिततमानसे (full of compassion) !
shakti_gita::70.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::70.essence: The divine lovingly dwells within the devoted heart as compassion itself.
shakti_gita::70.simple_meaning: The divine presence lovingly dwells within the hearts of those devoted to her, full of compassion and grace.
shakti_gita::70.simple_insight: Feeling the divine near your heart brings comfort and warmth beyond words.
shakti_gita::70.detailed_meaning: The narrator addresses the Goddess as the compassionate divine who resides within the minds and hearts of her devoted followers, highlighting her loving presence as a refuge and source of grace.
shakti_gita::70.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed, remembering a compassionate presence within you can bring calm and reassurance.
shakti_gita::70.insight: It teaches you to recognize the divine as an intimate, loving presence within your own heart and mind.

shakti_gita::71.verse_sanskrit:
विबुधासुरसंग्रागे ह्यसुराणां पराजयः।
अभून्नो विजयो देवि ! तत्वेऽपारकृपाफलम् ॥
shakti_gita::71.verse_hindi: देवासुर संग्राम में दुर्जेय असुरों का पराजय और हमारा जय होना आपकी ही अपार कृपा का फल है।
shakti_gita::71.english_translation: In the battle between the divine and the ego beings, the undefeatable defeat of the ego beings and our victory is the fruit of your boundless grace.
shakti_gita::71.translation_literal: विबुधासुरसंग्रागे (in the battle of divine and asuras) हि (indeed) असुराणां (of the ego beings) पराजयः (defeat) अभून्नः (was) विजयः (victory) देवी (O Devi) तत्वेऽपारकृपाफलम् (is the fruit of your immense grace)
shakti_gita::71.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::71.essence: Victory over ego forces is the result of boundless divine grace.
shakti_gita::71.simple_meaning: The victory over the ego beings in the battle is entirely due to the immeasurable grace of the Goddess.
shakti_gita::71.simple_insight: Victory over inner darkness comes not by force alone but through the divine's compassionate support.
shakti_gita::71.detailed_meaning: During a cosmic battle between radiant beings and ego-driven forces, the Goddess's limitless compassion ensures the ego's defeat and the triumph of the divine order.
shakti_gita::71.insight: Recognize that true victory over inner struggles depends on receiving grace beyond personal effort.

shakti_gita::72.verse_sanskrit:
अथवा भक्तवात्सल्यपरिणामोऽस्वयं तव।
इच्छामः साम्प्रतं त्वेतद्वाङ्मनोबुद्धयगोचरम् ॥
shakti_gita::72.verse_hindi: अथवा आपके भक्त वात्सल्य का फल है। अब हम लोगों की यही इच्छा है कि हमारे मन वचन और बुद्धि से अतीत
shakti_gita::72.english_translation: Or, your devotees’ affection is the cause. Now we desire that this be reflected in our speech, mind, and intellect.
shakti_gita::72.translation_literal: अथवा (or) भक्तवात्सल्यपरिणामोऽस्वयं (devotees-affection-result-is yours) तव (your)। इच्छामः (we desire) साम्प्रतं (now) त्वेतत् (this) वाङ्मनःबुद्धयगोचरम् (speech-mind-intellect-visible)।
shakti_gita::72.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::72.essence: Divine love inspires and shows itself in the devotee’s mind, speech, and intellect.
shakti_gita::72.simple_meaning: Devotees’ loving care comes from the divine. We now want that love to be clear in our thoughts, words, and mind.
shakti_gita::72.simple_insight: You can feel the divine’s love through your own inner being and expression.
shakti_gita::72.detailed_meaning: Suta expresses how the divine’s love for devotees transforms their inner state. This verse reveals a heartfelt wish that this divine affection becomes visible in mind, speech, and intellect.
shakti_gita::72.modern_relevance: When you feel cared for deeply, you want that warmth to shape how you think and speak with others.
shakti_gita::72.insight: Recognize that divine affection can visibly influence your thoughts and communication, deepening your devotion.

shakti_gita::73.verse_sanskrit:
भवत्या यात्स्वरूपं हि वर्चते परमाद्भुतम् ।
ज्ञानं तस्य प्रयच्छ त्वमुपदेशं तथेदृशम् ॥
shakti_gita::73.verse_hindi: जो आपका स्वरूप है उसका ज्ञान हमको प्रदान कीजिये और ऐसे उपदेश दीजिये जिससे हम सब
shakti_gita::73.english_translation: Please grant us the knowledge of your true nature and teach us such instruction.
shakti_gita::73.translation_literal: भवत्या (your) यात् (of which) स्वरूपं (true nature) हि (indeed) वर्चते (shines) परमाद्भुतम् (supremely wondrous) ज्ञानं (knowledge) तस्य (of that) प्रयच्छ (grant) त्वम् (you) उपदेशं (teaching) तथ (such) एदृशम् (like this)
shakti_gita::73.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::73.essence: Trusting openness invites clear knowledge of your true self and transformative teaching.
shakti_gita::73.simple_meaning: Ask sincerely for knowledge of your true nature and for teachings that reveal it clearly.
shakti_gita::73.simple_insight: Trusting in the possibility of knowing your true self invites clear and transformative guidance.
shakti_gita::73.detailed_meaning: In a moment of seeking, the speaker asks the divine (Devi) to reveal her supreme nature and to provide clear teachings that will guide all seekers. This sets the tone for sincere devotion and learning.
shakti_gita::73.modern_relevance: When you feel lost or confused, simply asking for clear guidance invites the clarity you need.
shakti_gita::73.insight: It teaches you to approach the path with trust, opening yourself to receive wisdom beyond doubt.

shakti_gita::74.verse_sanskrit:
तव सानिध्यसम्पातिर्यन विन्देम सच्चरम्।
अमङ्गलं कदाचिनो न भवेच महेम्वार ! ॥
shakti_gita::74.verse_hindi: आपके सानिध्य को प्राप्त कर सके जिससे हे महेश्वरी ! हमारा अमल न हो
shakti_gita::74.english_translation: May I never be deprived of your presence, O Great Goddess! May I never fall into misfortune.
shakti_gita::74.translation_literal: तव (your) / सानिध्यसम्पातिर्य (presence-arrival) / न (not) / विन्देम (may I find) / सच्चरम् (ever) / अमङ्गलं (misfortune) / कदाचिनो (never) / न (not) / भवेच (become) / महेम्वार (O Great Goddess)
shakti_gita::74.speaker: Devotee
shakti_gita::74.essence: The presence of the Great Goddess ensures you never fall into misfortune.
shakti_gita::74.simple_meaning: Being close to the Great Goddess protects me from harm and misfortune at all times.
shakti_gita::74.simple_insight: Feeling the divine near brings safety and peace in every moment.
shakti_gita::74.detailed_meaning: In a moment of seeking protection, the devotee prays to Devi, the Great Goddess, asking never to be separated from her presence, which ensures safety and wards off all misfortune.
shakti_gita::74.modern_relevance: When you feel vulnerable or overwhelmed, sensing a protective presence can help you feel safe and supported.
shakti_gita::74.insight: It teaches you to anchor your trust in the divine presence as a source of resilience and protection.

shakti_gita::75.verse_sanskrit:
अहं हि कारणब्रह्म कार्य्यब्रह्मास्मि चाप्यहम् ।
देवाः ! कारणरूपेण सच्चिदानन्दमय्यहम् ॥
shakti_gita::75.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! मैं ही कारणब्रह्म हूँ और मैं ही कार्यब्रह्म हूँ। कारण रूप से मैं ही सञ्चिदानन्द मयी होकर
shakti_gita::75.english_translation: O radiant beings! I am the cause Brahman and I am also the effect Brahman. As the cause, I am the supreme reality full of existence, consciousness, and bliss.
shakti_gita::75.translation_literal: अहं (I) हि (indeed) कारणब्रह्म (cause Brahman) कार्य्यब्रह्मास्मि (effect Brahman am) च (and) अप्यहम् (also I) । देवाः (O radiant beings) ! कारणरूपेण (as cause form) सच्चिदानन्दमयि (existence-consciousness-bliss filled) अहम् (I) ॥
shakti_gita::75.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::75.essence: The true self is both the origin and the manifestation of all that exists, full of existence, consciousness, and joy.
shakti_gita::75.simple_meaning: You are the origin and the result of everything; the source and the manifestation of reality full of existence, awareness, and joy.
shakti_gita::75.simple_insight: There is a deep unity where the source and outcome are not separate but one vibrant reality.
shakti_gita::75.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals herself as both the ultimate cause and effect of the universe, embodying the fullness of existence, consciousness, and bliss. This shows her identity as the fundamental reality behind all transformation and being.
shakti_gita::75.modern_relevance: When you feel split between who you are and what you become, remember you are both the root and the unfolding together.
shakti_gita::75.insight: It shifts your view from seeing self and world as separate to recognizing their inseparable identity as one whole reality.

shakti_gita::76.verse_sanskrit:
भूत्वैकाद्वैतसत्तायां भासमाना भवामि वै।
सत्सत्तापरिविस्तृसा बहमेव पुनः सुराः!॥
shakti_gita::76.verse_hindi: एक अद्वैत सत्ता में प्रकाशित होती हूँ। पुन: मैं ही मेरी सत्सत्ता के विस्तार द्वारा
shakti_gita::76.english_translation: I shine as one non-dual reality. Again, I am many through the expansion of my true being.
shakti_gita::76.translation_literal: भूत्वै (being as) एकाद्वैतसत्तायां (one non-dual reality) भासमाना (shining) भवामि (I become) वै (indeed). सत्सत्तापरिविस्तृसा (by the expansion of true being) बहमेव (many indeed) पुनः (again) सुराः (beings)!
shakti_gita::76.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::76.essence: One reality shines as many without losing its true oneness.
shakti_gita::76.simple_meaning: The true self is one indivisible reality that appears as many through its own expansion.
shakti_gita::76.simple_insight: You hold both the unity and diversity within yourself without conflict.
shakti_gita::76.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals she is the singular non-dual reality appearing as many beings through the expansion of her true being. This teaches that the divine is simultaneously one and many, beyond ordinary duality.
shakti_gita::76.modern_relevance: You are complex and multifaceted, yet underneath, you remain a single whole, not fractured or divided.
shakti_gita::76.insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate parts to embracing your essential unity with all expressions.

shakti_gita::77.verse_sanskrit:
अहंममोतिवद्वैतभावञ्चैव विमर्म्यहो।
तदा ममैव चित्सत्ता पुरुषे प्रकृतौ तथा ॥
shakti_gita::77.verse_hindi: अहंममेतिवत् द्वैतभाव को  धारण करती हूँ । उस समय मेरी ही चित्सत्ता पुरुष रूप में और प्रकृति रूप में
shakti_gita::77.english_translation: I embody the sense of 'I am' and the perception of duality; at that time, my consciousness exists as Purusha and Prakriti.
shakti_gita::77.translation_literal: अहंममेतिवत् (I-am sense like) / द्वैतभाव (duality feeling) / को (of) / धारण (holding) / करती (do) / हूँ (am) / । (.) / उस (that) / समय (time) / मेरी (my) / ही (only) / चित्सत्ता (consciousness-being) / पुरुषे (Purusha) / प्रकृतौ (Prakriti) / तथा (thus) / ॥ (end)
shakti_gita::77.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::77.essence: Your true being includes both the sense of self and the experience of duality together.
shakti_gita::77.simple_meaning: You hold the feeling of 'I exist' and the experience of separation, yet your true self includes both pure awareness and the natural world.
shakti_gita::77.simple_insight: There is a profound unity in holding both being and duality inside you.
shakti_gita::77.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals that she embodies the root sense of selfhood ('I am') alongside the experience of duality. This unity manifests as her consciousness appearing simultaneously as Purusha (pure awareness) and Prakriti (the natural world). It explains how the divine contains both the unchanging and the changing.
shakti_gita::77.modern_relevance: When you feel torn between your pure awareness and your everyday experiences, remember both coexist within your true self.
shakti_gita::77.insight: It teaches you to recognize your identity as both the changeless observer and the ever-changing world simultaneously.

shakti_gita::78.verse_sanskrit:
सत्सत्ता मकटीभूय निश्चितं विबुधर्षभाः ।
जगदानन्दसत्ताया विलासं सृजतः स्वयम् ॥
shakti_gita::78.verse_hindi: मेरी ही सत्सत्ता प्रकाशित होकर आनन्द सत्ता के विलासरूपी इस जगत की स्वयं प्रगट करती है, हे देवगण! यह निश्चय है
shakti_gita::78.english_translation: My true being manifests as the playful delight of blissful existence itself, creating this world on its own, O exalted beings.
shakti_gita::78.translation_literal: सत्सत्ता (true being) / मकटीभूय (becoming liberation) / निश्चितं (certainly) / विबुधर्षभाः (O best of the wise) / जगदानन्दसत्ताया (of the blissful existence of the world) / विलासं (playful delight) / सृजतः (creating) / स्वयम् (by itself)
shakti_gita::78.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::78.essence: True being freely and joyfully creates all existence by itself.
shakti_gita::78.simple_meaning: Your true self naturally expresses as joyful existence, creating the world effortlessly and delightfully.
shakti_gita::78.simple_insight: There is joy in knowing you are the creative source of all that exists.
shakti_gita::78.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals that her essential true being naturally unfolds as the blissful, playful energy that creates the universe, addressing exalted beings to affirm this cosmic truth.
shakti_gita::78.modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or powerless, remember that your deepest self is a joyful source capable of creating new possibilities effortlessly.
shakti_gita::78.insight: It shifts your view from feeling separate to recognizing yourself as the creative energy behind experience.

shakti_gita::79.verse_sanskrit:
तदाहमेव भूत्वा वै पुरुषो वीजदस्तथा ।
प्रकृतिः क्षेत्ररूपाऽस्मि कार्यब्रह्मणि भासिता ॥
shakti_gita::79.verse_hindi: उस समय मैं ही बीजदाता पुरुष और मैं ही क्षेत्ररूपी प्रकृति वनकर कार्यब्रह्म रूप में प्रकाशित होती हूँ
shakti_gita::79.english_translation: At that time, I alone was the seed-giver Purusha, and I am the nature in the form of the field, shining as the Brahman of the effect.
shakti_gita::79.translation_literal: तदाहमेव (then I alone) भूत्वा (being) वै (indeed) पुरुषो (the Purusha) वीजदस्तथा (was the seed-giver also) । प्रकृतिः (nature) क्षेत्ररूपाऽस्मि (I am in the form of the field) कार्यब्रह्मणि (in the Brahman of the effect) भासिता (shining) ॥
shakti_gita::79.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::79.essence: You are simultaneously the source and the field where creation arises and shines.
shakti_gita::79.simple_meaning: You are the source that plants the seed and the field where everything grows, shining as the cause behind all effects.
shakti_gita::79.simple_insight: Feeling both creator and container empowers you with wholeness and presence.
shakti_gita::79.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals her cosmic identity as both Purusha—the pure awareness planting the seed—and Prakriti—the nature forming the field where creation unfolds, shining as the ultimate cause behind all effects.
shakti_gita::79.modern_relevance: When you realize you are both the intention and the environment shaping your life, you gain deep confidence and creative power.
shakti_gita::79.insight: This verse shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate parts to embracing your unified role as both initiator and space of growth.

shakti_gita::80.verse_sanskrit:
कार्यब्रह्मस्वरूपेत्र विश्वास्मिन जङ्गमे मम ।
वर्त्तते चिद्विलासस्तु स्थावरे सद्विलासिता ॥
shakti_gita::80.verse_hindi: कार्यब्रह्मरूपी इस जगत में, जंगम में मेरा चिद्विलास और स्थावर में मेरा सद्विलास रहता है।
shakti_gita::80.english_translation: In this universe shaped as action and the supreme being, my conscious play exists in the moving and my true presence in the unmoving.
shakti_gita::80.translation_literal: कार्यब्रह्मस्वरूपेत्र (in the form of action and supreme being) / विश्वास्मिन (in the universe) / जङ्गमे (in the moving) / मम (my) / वर्त्तते (exists) / चिद्विलासस्तु (conscious play indeed) / स्थावरे (in the unmoving) / सद्विलासिता (true presence)
shakti_gita::80.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::80.essence: True self is present as conscious energy in movement and stable presence in stillness.
shakti_gita::80.simple_meaning: The divine presence is expressed as conscious activity in all moving things and as true, stable presence in all unmoving things in the universe.
shakti_gita::80.simple_insight: You hold both vibrant life and steady being within you, no matter what changes around you.
shakti_gita::80.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that she embodies the universe as both the dynamic, conscious force within all moving things and as the steady, true presence within all unmoving things, revealing her unity with all aspects of existence.
shakti_gita::80.modern_relevance: When your day brings chaos and calm in turns, you can remember your true self is both the energy in action and the stillness beneath it.
shakti_gita::80.insight: Recognize your nature as inseparable from both change and stability; this balance frees you from feeling fragmented.

shakti_gita::81.verse_sanskrit:
ममानन्दविलासोऽसौ व्याप्नुवन् सच्चिदन्तरम् ।
ममैव परमानन्द सत्तां समनुभावयेत् ॥
shakti_gita::81.verse_hindi: मेरा आनन्द विलास दोनों में व्याप्त रह कर मेरी ही परमानन्द सत्ता का अनुभव कराता है
shakti_gita::81.english_translation: My blissful play pervades pure consciousness and reveals the supreme blissful existence as my own.
shakti_gita::81.translation_literal: मम (my) आनन्द (bliss) विलासः (play) असौ (that) व्याप्नुवन् (pervading) सच्चिद् (pure consciousness) अन्तरम् (within) मम (my) एव (indeed) परमानन्द (supreme bliss) सत्ताम् (existence) सम् (completely) अनुभावयेत् (reveals)
shakti_gita::81.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::81.essence: Your bliss is inseparable from the supreme reality pervading all existence.
shakti_gita::81.simple_meaning: Your true joy flows through pure being and shows the highest bliss as your own nature.
shakti_gita::81.simple_insight: Feel the comfort that your happiness is not separate but fully part of the supreme reality.
shakti_gita::81.detailed_meaning: The Goddess explains that her blissful play fills pure consciousness itself, showing that the supreme blissful existence is not separate but her own true nature.
shakti_gita::81.modern_relevance: When you experience moments of deep joy, recognize they are not just fleeting feelings but a glimpse of your true, unchanging nature.
shakti_gita::81.insight: It shifts your view from seeing joy as temporary to recognizing it as a constant, supreme presence within you.

shakti_gita::82.verse_sanskrit:
अहमेवास्मि भो देवाः ! सर्बेवामीश्वरी परा।
उत्पद्यन्ते निभावाश्च त्रिगुणा मत्त एव हि ॥
shakti_gita::82.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! मैं ही सबकी परमेश्वरी हूँ, तीनों भाव और तीनों गुण मुझसे ही उत्पन्न होते हैं
shakti_gita::82.english_translation: O divine beings! I alone am the supreme sovereign; the three states and three qualities arise from me.
shakti_gita::82.translation_literal: अहमेव (I alone) अस्मि (am) भो (O) देवाः (divine beings) ! सर्बे (all) इश्वरी (sovereign) परा (supreme)। उत्पद्यन्ते (arise) निभावाः (states) च (and) त्रिगुणा (three qualities) मत्त (from me) एव (indeed) हि (certainly) ॥
shakti_gita::82.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::82.essence: All states and qualities arise from one supreme source that is the foundation of everything.
shakti_gita::82.simple_meaning: The supreme divine power alone is the source of all qualities and states of being experienced in the world.
shakti_gita::82.simple_insight: You connect deeply to the origin of all experience and existence.
shakti_gita::82.detailed_meaning: The Goddess declares herself as the supreme sovereign from whom all three states of consciousness and the three fundamental qualities emerge. This establishes her as both the source and the essence of all that exists, highlighting non-duality.
shakti_gita::82.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by changing moods or traits, remember these arise from one unchanging source within you.
shakti_gita::82.insight: Recognizing the unity behind diverse experiences helps you see yourself as connected to a vast, unchanging reality.

shakti_gita::83.verse_sanskrit:
सृष्टिस्थितिलयांश्चैव त्रिगुणैरहमेव वै।
करोमि सततं देवाः ! जगतां नात्र संशयः ॥
shakti_gita::83.verse_hindi: तीनों गुणों से ब्रह्माण्डौ का सृष्टि स्थिति लय कार्य मैं ही करती हूँ हे देवगण ! इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है
shakti_gita::83.english_translation: I alone perform the creation, preservation, and destruction of the universe through the three qualities; there is no doubt about this, O divine beings!
shakti_gita::83.translation_literal: सृष्टि (creation) स्थिति (preservation) लय (destruction) च (and) ऐव (indeed) त्रिगुणैः (by the three qualities) अहम् (I) एव (alone) वै (indeed) करोमि (do) सततं (constantly) देवाः (O divine beings) जगतां (of the worlds) नात्र (here not) संशयः (doubt)
shakti_gita::83.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::83.essence: One constant power alone enacts all creation, maintenance, and destruction without doubt.
shakti_gita::83.simple_meaning: The divine power alone causes the universe to come into being, to exist, and to dissolve through three qualities without any doubt.
shakti_gita::83.simple_insight: There is reassurance in knowing the entire cosmos flows from a single, constant source.
shakti_gita::83.detailed_meaning: The Goddess declares that she alone is responsible for the entire cosmic process of creation, maintenance, and destruction, governed by the three qualities (gunas). This establishes her as the ultimate source behind all universal change, removing any doubt for the divine beings listening.
shakti_gita::83.modern_relevance: When you face constant change around you, remember that a single steady force underlies all beginnings and endings.
shakti_gita::83.insight: Recognize that all phases of change are expressions of one continuous, underlying power.

shakti_gita::84.verse_sanskrit:
मन्येवानुभवस्तेषां विभावैभवति ध्रुवम् ।
नानाब्रह्माण्डसंघ हि स्वगर्भ चाहमेव तम् ॥
shakti_gita::84.verse_hindi: और तीनों भाव द्वारा उनका अनुभव मुझ में ही होता है, हे देवगण ! मैं ही अपने गर्भ में अनन्त कोटि ब्रह्माण्डों को
shakti_gita::84.english_translation: I believe the experiences of the three states arise within me; indeed, I hold countless universes within my womb.
shakti_gita::84.translation_literal: मन्येवानुभवस्तेषां (I believe experiences of these) / विभावैभवति (through the three states they arise) / ध्रुवम् (certainly) / नानाब्रह्माण्डसंघ (countless universes) / हि (indeed) / स्वगर्भ (in my womb) / चाहमेव (I alone) / तम् (that)
shakti_gita::84.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::84.essence: The true self contains all experiences and infinite universes within itself.
shakti_gita::84.simple_meaning: All experiences and countless universes arise and exist within the true self, which is the source and container of all.
shakti_gita::84.simple_insight: You are vast beyond measure, holding limitless possibilities and experiences inside you.
