shakti_gita::84.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals that all experiences from the three states of consciousness emerge within her own being. She claims to contain infinite universes within her womb, expressing her identity as the source and container of all existence.
shakti_gita::84.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by external chaos or internal confusion, remember that all experience arises within you, showing your immense inner capacity.
shakti_gita::84.insight: Shift your view from feeling small or separate to recognizing your vast inner space where all experiences occur.

shakti_gita::85.verse_sanskrit:
सन्धार्य सततं देवाः ! देशकालस्वरूपतः ।
अनाद्यानन्तसत्तायाः कारयेऽनुभवं खलु ॥
shakti_gita::85.verse_hindi: धारण करके देश और कालरूप में अपनी अनादि और अनन्त सत्ता का निरन्तर अनुभव कराती हूँ
shakti_gita::85.english_translation: By sustaining constantly, O gods, I manifest my endless and eternal being in forms of place and time for experience.
shakti_gita::85.translation_literal: सन्धार्य (sustaining) सततं (constantly) देवाः (O gods) ! देशकालस्वरूपतः (in forms of place and time) । अनाद्यानन्तसत्तायाः (of endless and eternal being) कारयेऽनुभवं (I cause experience) खलु (indeed) ॥
shakti_gita::85.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::85.essence: Infinite being sustains itself continuously through all time and place for experience.
shakti_gita::85.simple_meaning: Your infinite and eternal nature is always present, taking shape through every place and time to be experienced.
shakti_gita::85.simple_insight: You can feel connected to something vast that unfolds through every moment and place.
shakti_gita::85.detailed_meaning: The Goddess (Devi) explains that she continuously sustains her boundless, timeless existence by manifesting through all places and moments, allowing beings to experience this eternal reality.
shakti_gita::85.modern_relevance: When life changes around you, you can remember that your core presence flows through every moment and place, unbroken and infinite.
shakti_gita::85.insight: It invites you to see your essential nature as always present and unfolding through changing circumstances.

shakti_gita::86.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्माण्डानान्तु सर्वेषां प्रत्येकं प्रभवस्थिती।
विधातुं प्रलयश्चापि जनये निजगर्भतः ॥
shakti_gita::86.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड में प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड की सृष्टि, स्थिति और लय क्रिया सुसम्पन्न करने के लिये
shakti_gita::86.english_translation: O divine beings! In every universe, the creation, preservation, and destruction processes happen from its own womb.
shakti_gita::86.translation_literal: ब्रह्माण्डानान्तु (universes also) / सर्वेषां (of all) / प्रत्येकं (each) / प्रभवस्थिती (creation and preservation) / विधातुं (to regulate) / प्रलयश्चापि (and destruction also) / जनये (are born) / निजगर्भतः (from their own womb)
shakti_gita::86.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::86.essence: Each universe carries its own cycle of birth, existence, and dissolution within itself.
shakti_gita::86.simple_meaning: Each universe independently undergoes creation, maintenance, and destruction from its own source.
shakti_gita::86.simple_insight: Everything is self-originated and self-sustained in its natural cycle.
shakti_gita::86.detailed_meaning: The narrator describes that every universe is a self-contained system where creation, maintenance, and dissolution come from within itself, emphasizing the autonomous cosmic cycles.
shakti_gita::86.insight: It shifts understanding from external control to recognizing self-contained natural cycles in any system.

shakti_gita::87.verse_hindi: अपने गर्भ से ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और महेशरूपी अनेक त्रिदेवों को उत्पन्न करती हूँ और अपनी ही अंशरूप ब्राह्मी, वैष्णवी और रौद्री
shakti_gita::87.english_translation: From my womb, I generate Brahma, Vishnu, Mahesha and many other Trimurti gods; I am also Brahmi, Vaishnavi, and Raudri as my own aspects.
shakti_gita::87.translation_literal: अपने (from own) गर्भ (womb) से (from) ब्रह्मा (Brahma), विष्णु (Vishnu) महेश (Mahesha) आख्य (named) त्रि (three) देवान (gods) अन्व (along) अनेकशः (many) / ब्राह्मीं (Brahmi) च (and) वैष्णवी (Vaishnavi) रौद्री (Raudri) स्वांशरूपां (own part-forms) सुरर्षभाः (best of gods)!
shakti_gita::87.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::87.essence: The divine source creates all gods and embodies their essential energies as one.
shakti_gita::87.simple_meaning: The Goddess says she creates the three main gods Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesha from herself and is also present as their divine feminine forms.
shakti_gita::87.simple_insight: The divine is both the source and the many aspects that arise from it.
shakti_gita::87.detailed_meaning: Devi describes her cosmic power as the origin of the main gods Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesha, and herself as their feminine energies Brahmi, Vaishnavi, and Raudri, showing her role as both creator and essence.
shakti_gita::87.insight: It teaches you that the ultimate source contains all forms and energies within itself, not separate from its manifestations.

shakti_gita::88.verse_hindi: ये अनेक त्रिविध शक्तियाँ उनको यथाक्रम देकर प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड की सृष्टि, स्थिति और लय क्रिया का
shakti_gita::88.english_translation: These three diverse powers pass from them to perform creation, preservation, and dissolution of each universe.
shakti_gita::88.translation_literal: एता (these) / अनेकशः (many) / त्रिस्रः (threefold) / शक्तीः (powers) / तेभ्यः (from them) / वितीर्य (passing over) / वै (indeed) / ब्रह्माण्ड (universe) / सङ्घ (assembly) / प्रत्येक (each) / सृष्टि (creation) / स्थिति (preservation) / लय (dissolution) / क्रियाः (activities)
shakti_gita::88.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::88.essence: Three fundamental powers from the divine enable every universe’s creation, sustenance, and dissolution.
shakti_gita::88.simple_meaning: Three fundamental powers come from the divine to create, preserve, and dissolve every universe.
shakti_gita::88.simple_insight: You are connected to the deep forces shaping all existence’s cycles.
shakti_gita::88.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that from her emanate three fundamental powers responsible for the ongoing cycle of creation, preservation, and dissolution in every universe, revealing her role as the source of cosmic processes.
shakti_gita::88.modern_relevance: When you face change and cycles in life, remember you embody the same forces that shape the cosmos.
shakti_gita::88.insight: Recognize your connection to the cosmic rhythms of beginning, sustaining, and ending.

shakti_gita::89.verse_sanskrit:
त्रिभिर्देवैर्यथातथ्यं साधयामि यथाक्रमम्।
यूयं सर्वे च भो देवा भावमाश्रित्य मामकम् ॥
shakti_gita::89.verse_hindi: ठीक ठीक साधन कराती हूँ।  देवतागण ! आप सभी मेरे अधिदेव भाव को आश्रय करके
shakti_gita::89.english_translation: I guide you correctly and sequentially, O divine beings! You all should rely on my supreme nature.
shakti_gita::89.translation_literal: त्रिभिः (by three) देवैः (divine beings) यथातथ्यं (properly) साधयामि (I accomplish) यथाक्रमम् (in order) । यूयं (you all) सर्वे (all) च (also) भो (O) देवा (divine beings) भावम् (nature) आश्रित्य (relying) मामकम् (my own) ॥
shakti_gita::89.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::89.essence: A clear, stepwise teaching depends on relying on the supreme nature.
shakti_gita::89.simple_meaning: I teach you step by step with care. You all should depend on my supreme nature.
shakti_gita::89.simple_insight: There is trust in following a clear, guided path supported by a higher power.
shakti_gita::89.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses divine beings, explaining that she guides them carefully and in proper order. She instructs them to rely on her supreme nature, emphasizing the importance of structured spiritual practice under her support.
shakti_gita::89.insight: It highlights the value of relying on a clear guide or inner support when navigating complex paths.

shakti_gita::90.verse_sanskrit:
आधिदैवमजायन्ताध्यात्मिकं च महर्षयः।
आधिभौतिकमाश्रित्य पितरश्चापि जज्ञिरे ॥
shakti_gita::90.verse_hindi: मुझ से ही प्रकट हुए हो । ऋषिगण मेरे आध्यात्म के आश्रय से प्रकट हुए हैं और पितृगण मेरे अधिभूतभाव से उत्पन्न हुए हैं
shakti_gita::90.english_translation: The great sages arose from my spiritual essence, and the ancestors from my material nature.
shakti_gita::90.translation_literal: आधि-दैवम् (from the supreme divine) अजायन्त (were born) आध्यात्मिकं (spiritual) च (and) महर्षयः (great sages)। आधि-भौतिकम् (material) आश्रित्य (depending on) पितरः (ancestors) च (also) अपि (indeed) जज्ञिरे (were born) ॥
shakti_gita::90.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::90.essence: Your spiritual self births wisdom; your material self births lineage.
shakti_gita::90.simple_meaning: Your spiritual nature gives rise to wise insight, while your material nature gives rise to your lineage and heritage.
shakti_gita::90.simple_insight: You carry within yourself both deep wisdom and your natural origins, united yet distinct.
shakti_gita::90.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the great sages come from her spiritual aspect, representing pure awareness, while the ancestors come from her material aspect, the natural world. This shows the dual origins of existence within her.
shakti_gita::90.modern_relevance: You realize your clear thoughts and your inherited habits both shape who you are, each from a different source inside you.
shakti_gita::90.insight: It teaches you to see your inner being as a union of pure awareness and natural existence, each giving birth to different aspects of life.

shakti_gita::91.verse_sanskrit:
असुरा अपि भो देवा वर्तन्ते मद्विभूतयः।
अहमादिश्च सर्वेषां व्यासा चास्मि दिवौकसः ॥
shakti_gita::91.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! असुरगण भी मेरी ही विभूति हैं। मैं सबकी आदि हूँ।
shakti_gita::91.english_translation: O divine beings, the beings of shadow are also my manifestations. I am the origin of all.
shakti_gita::91.translation_literal: असुरा (beings of shadow) / अपि (also) / भो (O) / देवा (divine beings) / वर्तन्ते (exist) / मद्विभूतयः (my manifestations) / अहम् (I) / आदि (origin) / च (and) / सर्वेषां (of all) / व्यासा (origin) / च (also) / अस्मि (am) / दिवौकसः (divine and shadow beings)
shakti_gita::91.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::91.essence: Light and shadow beings both arise as manifestations of the same divine source.
shakti_gita::91.simple_meaning: All beings, whether radiant or shadow, are manifestations of the divine's power, and the divine is the source of everything.
shakti_gita::91.simple_insight: There's a deep belonging in knowing light and shadow alike are part of your origin.
shakti_gita::91.detailed_meaning: Devi declares to the divine assembly that even the shadow beings (asuras) are her manifestations. She reveals herself as the origin and essence of all beings, both radiant and shadow, affirming the unity behind apparent duality.
shakti_gita::91.modern_relevance: You sometimes feel divided between your light and shadow sides, but both come from the same source within you.
shakti_gita::91.insight: It invites you to embrace all parts of yourself as arising from the same divine origin, dissolving inner division.

shakti_gita::92.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वत्र शक्तिरूपेण निखिलं हि चराचरम् ।
नित्याद्वैतदशायान्तु शाश्वतं सुरसत्तमाः ! ॥
shakti_gita::92.verse_hindi: मैं ही शक्तिरूप से सब जगह व्याप्त हूँ। मेरे स्वरूप में मेरी शक्ति नित्य अद्वैत दशा में सदा स्थित है।
shakti_gita::92.english_translation: I pervade everything everywhere as the divine power; my nature is eternally established in the state of non-dual existence.
shakti_gita::92.translation_literal: सर्वत्र (everywhere) शक्तिरूपेण (in the form of power) निखिलं (entire) हि (indeed) चराचरम् (moving and unmoving) । नित्याद्वैतदशायान्तु (eternally in the state of non-duality) शाश्वतं (everlasting) सुरसत्तमाः (the supreme among the divine beings) ॥
shakti_gita::92.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::92.essence: The divine power is everywhere and always present in an unchanging unity.
shakti_gita::92.simple_meaning: The divine power fills everything everywhere, always present in an unchanging, non-dual state.
shakti_gita::92.simple_insight: You can feel the constant, unbroken presence of the divine power in all things.
shakti_gita::92.detailed_meaning: Devi declares that her divine power pervades every moving and unmoving thing, always residing in an eternal, non-dual state. This moment reveals her cosmic nature as both the source and essence of all existence.
shakti_gita::92.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by chaos, remember the unchanging power that flows through all things and holds everything together.
shakti_gita::92.insight: This teaching shifts attention from separation to unity, inviting you to recognize the divine presence everywhere.

shakti_gita::93.verse_sanskrit:
स्वस्वरूपे च मे देवा मच्छक्तिरवतिष्ठते।
स्वरूपे स्वे च मे देवास्तुरीयाया ममैव हि ॥
shakti_gita::93.verse_hindi: मेरे स्वस्वरूप में मेरी ही तुरीया शक्ति
shakti_gita::93.english_translation: In my own true nature, my supreme power resides; in my own form, the supreme reality is indeed mine.
shakti_gita::93.translation_literal: स्वस्वरूपे (in own true nature) / च (and) / मे (my) / देवा (supreme being) / मच्छक्तिः (my power) / अवतिष्ठते (resides) / स्वरूपे (in form) / स्वे (own) / च (and) / मे (my) / देवाः (supreme realities) / तुरीयाया (of the supreme fourth) / मम (my) / एव (indeed) / हि (certainly)
shakti_gita::93.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::93.essence: Your true self is inseparable from the supreme power and ultimate reality.
shakti_gita::93.simple_meaning: Your true self contains the highest power and the supreme reality within itself.
shakti_gita::93.simple_insight: You carry the profound power and ultimate truth inside you already.
shakti_gita::93.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals that her own true form inherently includes the highest power and the supreme reality. This teaching unfolds the non-dual nature of the Goddess as both source and embodiment of all existence.
shakti_gita::93.modern_relevance: When you face self-doubt, remember your true nature holds deep strength and connection to something greater.
shakti_gita::93.insight: Recognize your identity as inseparable from the supreme power, shifting from separation to unity.

shakti_gita::94.verse_sanskrit:
शक्तेर्वलाद्धि जागर्ति सर्वदानुभवः किल।
सच्चिदानन्दरूपस्य त्रिभावस्य न संशयः ॥
shakti_gita::94.verse_hindi: के बल से सत चित्त और आनन्दरूपी तीनों भावों का अनुभव बना रहता है इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं
shakti_gita::94.english_translation: By the power of Shakti, the experience of truth, consciousness, and bliss remains awake without doubt.
shakti_gita::94.translation_literal: शक्तेः (of the power) वलात् (by the force) इति (thus) जागर्ति (remains awake) सर्व (all) दानुभवः (experiences) किल (indeed)। सच्चिदानन्दरूपस्य (of truth-consciousness-bliss form) त्रिभावस्य (of the three states) न (no) संशयः (doubt) ॥
shakti_gita::94.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::94.essence: Your experience of truth, awareness, and bliss remains constantly alive by Shakti’s power.
shakti_gita::94.simple_meaning: The power of Shakti keeps the experience of truth, awareness, and bliss continuously active without doubt.
shakti_gita::94.simple_insight: You can trust that your deepest awareness and joy remain alive and steady by divine power.
shakti_gita::94.detailed_meaning: Devi declares that through her power, the three essential states—truth (sat), consciousness (chid), and bliss (ananda)—are continuously experienced without any doubt, showing her role as both the source and sustainer of pure awareness.
shakti_gita::94.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed, remember your inner awareness and joy remain steady by a power beyond your mind.
shakti_gita::94.insight: It teaches you to recognize that your true self’s experience of awareness and bliss is always active beyond mental fluctuations.

shakti_gita::95.verse_sanskrit:
दशाऽद्वैताऽनुभूयेत मच्छक्तयैव तुरीयया।
तस्या एव तुरीयाया मच्छक्तेर्वलतः खलु ॥
shakti_gita::95.verse_hindi: मेरी तुरीयशक्ति से ही अद्वैत दशा का अनुभव होता है। हे देवगण ! उसी तुरीय शक्ति के बल से
shakti_gita::95.english_translation: Only through my supreme power can the state of non-duality be experienced; O divine beings, it is indeed by that supreme power.
shakti_gita::95.translation_literal: दशाऽद्वैताऽनुभूयेत (state non-duality experienced) / मच्छक्तयैव (by my power alone) / तुरीयया (supreme fourth) / तस्या एव (that indeed) / तुरीयाया (of supreme fourth) / मच्छक्तेः (by my power) / बलतः (by strength) / खलु (indeed)
shakti_gita::95.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::95.essence: True non-duality is experienced only through the supreme power of the divine feminine.
shakti_gita::95.simple_meaning: The experience of complete non-duality or true oneness is possible only through the supreme power of the divine feminine.
shakti_gita::95.simple_insight: There's a special power enabling you to realize the deepest unity beyond all duality.
shakti_gita::95.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Devi declares that the state of non-duality—the supreme state beyond all dual distinctions—is realized only through her unique supreme power called turiya. She addresses divine beings, emphasizing that this power alone enables such ultimate experience.
shakti_gita::95.modern_relevance: When facing overwhelming complexity or division, remember that a deeper, unifying power within can reveal connectedness beyond apparent differences.
shakti_gita::95.insight: Recognize that realizing profound unity requires connecting with a supreme, transcendent power beyond ordinary perception.

shakti_gita::96.verse_hindi: मैं निर्विकल्प समाधि में स्थित आत्माराम जीवन्मुक्त महात्माओं को आदि अन्तरहित विभु
shakti_gita::96.english_translation: I am the supreme being, the beginning and the end, beyond all differences, dwelling in the blissful state of those great liberated beings absorbed in undifferentiated stillness.
shakti_gita::96.translation_literal: निर्विकल्पसमाधिस्थैः (by those established in undifferentiated absorption) / आत्मारामैः (blissful in the true self) / महात्मभिः (by great souls) / जीवन्मुक्तैः (liberated while alive) / प्रतीये (in the supreme being) / अहम् (I) / आद्यन्तरहिते (without beginning or end) / विभौ (in the supreme being)
shakti_gita::96.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::96.essence: The supreme presence is timeless bliss dwelling within fully liberated beings.
shakti_gita::96.simple_meaning: The divine resides as the supreme presence within those who have attained full liberation and blissful union beyond all distinctions and time.
shakti_gita::96.simple_insight: You can rest knowing your true self is timeless, boundless, and blissful within you.
shakti_gita::96.detailed_meaning: Devi declares her identity as the supreme, eternal presence dwelling within great souls who have achieved liberation while alive and remain absorbed in undifferentiated blissful stillness beyond all duality and time.
shakti_gita::96.modern_relevance: When you find moments of deep inner calm where everything else fades, you touch the timeless presence that connects you to something vast and free.
shakti_gita::96.insight: It teaches you to recognize the limitless, unchanging presence within your own deepest stillness as your true nature.

shakti_gita::97.verse_sanskrit:
अद्वैते निर्विकारे हि स्वरूपे चिन्मये सुराः।
ममैव विबुधा नूनं शक्तिः कारणरूपिणी ॥
shakti_gita::97.verse_hindi: निर्विकार अद्वैत चिन्मय रूप में प्रतीत होती हूँ । मेरी कारण शक्ति
shakti_gita::97.english_translation: The radiant beings perceive me as the unchanging, non-dual essence; indeed, I am their causal power.
shakti_gita::97.translation_literal: अद्वैते (in non-dual) निर्विकारे (unchanging) हि (indeed) स्वरूपे (in the form) चिन्मये (of consciousness) सुराः (the radiant beings) ममैव (truly mine) विबुधा (the wise) नूनं (certainly) शक्तिः (power) कारणरूपिणी (the causal form)
shakti_gita::97.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::97.essence: The true self is the unchanging causal power behind all conscious knowing.
shakti_gita::97.simple_meaning: The divine is the unchanging, non-dual essence that wise beings recognize as the cause and power behind all things.
shakti_gita::97.simple_insight: You can feel the calm strength of being the unchanged source behind all change.
shakti_gita::97.detailed_meaning: Devi declares that she is the unchanging, non-dual consciousness perceived by the wise radiant beings, manifesting as the causal power behind creation and existence.
shakti_gita::97.modern_relevance: In moments when everything feels unstable, recognizing yourself as the steady cause beneath all change brings deep calm and strength.
shakti_gita::97.insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as changing phenomena to the unchanging power that enables change.

shakti_gita::98.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां जननी नात्र संशयः ।
मत्सूक्ष्मशक्तिरेवाहो देवी शक्तिं प्रयच्छति ॥
shakti_gita::98.verse_hindi: ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश की जननी है इसमें सन्देह नहीं है और मेरी सूक्ष्म शक्ति ही नाना देवी रूप धारण करके
shakti_gita::98.english_translation: There is no doubt that I am the mother of Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesha, and my subtle power manifests in various forms of the Goddess.
shakti_gita::98.translation_literal: ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां (of Brahma, Vishnu, Mahesha) / जननी (mother) / नात्र (there is no) / संशयः (doubt) / मत्सूक्ष्मशक्तिरेवाहो (my subtle power indeed) / देवी (Goddess) / शक्तिं (power) / प्रयच्छति (gives/manifests)
shakti_gita::98.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::98.essence: The divine mother is the subtle source manifesting all forms of divine power without doubt.
shakti_gita::98.simple_meaning: The divine mother is the source of the three great divine beings, and her subtle power expresses itself through many forms of the Goddess.
shakti_gita::98.simple_insight: You can feel connected to the divine as the origin of all cosmic energy and forms.
shakti_gita::98.detailed_meaning: Devi declares herself as the unquestioned mother of the supreme divine beings Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesha, highlighting her subtle power that manifests widely through various forms of the Goddess, establishing her as the ultimate source of divine energy.
shakti_gita::98.modern_relevance: When you recognize the source within yourself that animates many parts of your life, you feel a deeper connection to your own inner power.
shakti_gita::98.insight: It shifts your view to see all diverse energies and expressions as rooted in one subtle, dynamic source within you.

shakti_gita::99.verse_hindi: ऋषि देवता पितरों को दैवी शक्ति प्रदान करती है।
shakti_gita::99.english_translation: The divine power manifests as many forms of godly beings, the ancestors, and all creation; this gross power is indeed mine.
shakti_gita::99.translation_literal: पितृदेवषिटन्देभ्यो (to ancestors, gods, sages) / नानादेवीस्वरूपिणी (various forms of the goddess) / जगत्सूथूलपपञ्चः (the world’s gross manifestation) / अयम् (this) / स्थूलशक्तेः (of gross power) / मम (mine) / एव (indeed) / हि (certainly)
shakti_gita::99.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::99.essence: The entire physical world and divine beings are manifestations of the same one power.
shakti_gita::99.simple_meaning: The divine power expresses itself through many forms like gods, ancestors, and the entire physical world; this power belongs to me.
shakti_gita::99.simple_insight: You share the same power that creates all beings and the world.
shakti_gita::99.detailed_meaning: Devi declares that the many divine beings, ancestors, and the whole material universe are expressions of her own gross power. She reveals her identity as the source behind the visible creation, establishing her cosmic role.
shakti_gita::99.modern_relevance: When you see the diversity of people, traditions, and nature around you, remember they all arise from the same creative source within you.
shakti_gita::99.insight: Recognize that the variety you see in the world is not separate from your own inner power.

shakti_gita::100.verse_sanskrit:
नानाभेदान समाश्रित्य नानारूपेषु जायते ।
स्थूलप्रपञ्चरूपं हि जगदयस्य स्थ रक्षकाः ॥
shakti_gita::100.verse_hindi: जगत का स्थूल प्रपञ्च मेरी ही स्थूल शक्ति के अनन्त भेदों को आश्रय करके अनन्तरूप में प्रकट हुआ करता है। यह स्थूल प्रपञ्चमय जगत् जिसके रक्षक
shakti_gita::100.english_translation: The gross world arises from my countless diverse aspects and manifests in infinite forms; its protectors belong to this gross realm.
shakti_gita::100.translation_literal: नानाभेदान (from many differences) / समाश्रित्य (depending on) / नानारूपेषु (in many forms) / जायते (arises) / स्थूलप्रपञ्चरूपं (as gross manifold) / हि (indeed) / जगत् (world) / अस्य (of this) / स्थ (stable) / रक्षकाः (protectors)
shakti_gita::100.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::100.essence: The diverse physical world arises from one divine source expressing infinite forms.
shakti_gita::100.simple_meaning: The physical world appears because of the Goddess's many aspects, manifesting endlessly in various forms protected within this realm.
shakti_gita::100.simple_insight: There is a vast unity behind the world's infinite variety, which offers a sense of awe and belonging.
shakti_gita::100.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the entire physical universe is a manifestation of her many diverse aspects, each contributing to the world's infinite forms. This moment reveals the cosmic source behind all creation and its guardians.
shakti_gita::100.modern_relevance: When you look at the complexity around you—people, nature, culture—it all flows from one shared source expressing itself in endless ways.
shakti_gita::100.insight: Recognize that diversity is not separation but many faces of one underlying reality, shifting how you relate to differences.

shakti_gita::101.verse_sanskrit:
यूयं देवगणाः सर्वे स्थूलशक्तेममैव च ।
परिणामस्वरूपं तज्जानीत सुरसत्तमाः !॥
shakti_gita::101.verse_hindi: आप सब हो मेरी ही स्थूल शक्ति का परिणाममात्र हैं हे देवगण! इसको आप जाने
shakti_gita::101.english_translation: You all, O gods, are merely the manifestation of my gross power; know this well, O best of gods!
shakti_gita::101.translation_literal: यूयं (you all) / देवगणाः (gods) / सर्वे (all) / स्थूलशक्तेः (of gross power) / एव (indeed) / च (also) / परिणामस्वरूपं (manifestation) / तज्जानीत (know that) / सुरसत्तमाः (best of gods)
shakti_gita::101.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::101.essence: All divine beings are manifestations of one great power expressing itself.
shakti_gita::101.simple_meaning: All gods are manifestations of the Goddess's gross power; they arise as her expressions.
shakti_gita::101.simple_insight: Recognizing yourself as a part of this vast power brings a sense of connectedness and purpose.
shakti_gita::101.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals to the gods that they are not separate beings but forms emerging from her gross power. This teaching dissolves separation and shows the unity behind divine forms.
shakti_gita::101.modern_relevance: When you feel fragmented or isolated, remember you are part of a greater force expressing through you.
shakti_gita::101.insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate to understanding yourself as a living expression of a larger power.

shakti_gita::102.verse_sanskrit:
अविद्यारूपमाश्रित्य ह्यमेव जगत्सुराः।
उत्पादये पुनश्वाहं विद्यारूपमधिश्रिता ॥
shakti_gita::102.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! मैं ही अविद्यारूप से जगत को प्रकट करती हूँ और मैं ही विद्यारूप धारण करके
shakti_gita::102.english_translation: O divine beings! I manifest the world in the form of ignorance, and I also sustain it by embodying knowledge.
shakti_gita::102.translation_literal: अविद्यारूपमाश्रित्य (in the form of ignorance relying) / ह्यमेव (I alone) / जगत्सुराः (world, O divine beings) / उत्पादये (manifest) / पुनः (again) / अहं (I) / विद्यारूपमधिश्रिता (relying on the form of knowledge)
shakti_gita::102.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::102.essence: The same power creates the world through confusion and sustains it through knowledge.
shakti_gita::102.simple_meaning: The divine power appears as the world through confusion and also supports it through knowledge.
shakti_gita::102.simple_insight: You can hold confusion and clarity together as part of creation’s flow.
shakti_gita::102.detailed_meaning: Devi explains to divine beings that she manifests the world through the veil of confusion (avidya) and also maintains it by embodying clear knowledge (vidya), showing her dual role in creation and liberation.
shakti_gita::102.modern_relevance: When you face confusion and clarity inside yourself, remember both shape your reality and growth.
shakti_gita::102.insight: It shifts how you see experience—not as just confusion or clarity but as both working together.

shakti_gita::103.verse_sanskrit:
जगतोऽस्य लयस्थानं बोधयामि दिवौकसः!।
अहं द्रष्टी च दृश्या च शक्तिः शक्तिमती तथा ॥
shakti_gita::103.verse_hindi: जगत के लय-स्थान को लक्ष्य कराती हूँ।  मैं ही दृश्य हूँ और मैं ही द्रष्टा हूँ। मैं ही शक्ति हूँ  मैं ही शक्तिमान् हूँ
shakti_gita::103.english_translation: I reveal the ultimate dissolution point of the world. I am the seer and the seen. I am the power and the possessor of power.
shakti_gita::103.translation_literal: जगतोऽस्य (of this world) / लयस्थानं (the dissolution place) / बोधयामि (I reveal) / दिवौकसः (O divine beings)! / अहं (I) / द्रष्टी (the seer) / च (and) / दृश्या (the seen) / च (and) / शक्तिः (power) / शक्तिमती (possessing power) / तथा (also)
shakti_gita::103.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::103.essence: You are simultaneously the witness, the witnessed, the power, and the possessor of power.
shakti_gita::103.simple_meaning: The divine reveals that she is the ultimate reality behind the world’s end, the one who sees and is seen, the power itself and its possessor.
shakti_gita::103.simple_insight: There is a deep unity between what watches and what is watched, and the power behind all existence.
shakti_gita::103.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Devi speaks to divine beings, revealing that she embodies the ultimate dissolution of the world. She is both the observer and the observed, the dynamic power and the one who holds that power. This teaches that the true self is the source and witness of all phenomena.
shakti_gita::103.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by chaos or endings, remember you hold the power and witness within you — both creator and observer of your life’s changes.
shakti_gita::103.insight: This verse shifts your view to see yourself as both the presence observing life and the source of its energy and transformation.

shakti_gita::104.verse_sanskrit:
शक्तिशक्तिमतोभेंद तत्वज्ञानविवर्जिताः।
बालिशा एव पश्यन्ति न तत्त्वज्ञानिनो जनाः ॥
shakti_gita::104.verse_hindi: शक्ति और शक्तिमान में भेद तत्त्व ज्ञानविहीन मूर्ख जीव ही समझते हैं परन्तु ज्ञानिगण नहीं समझते हैं
shakti_gita::104.english_translation: Only fools see a difference between the divine power and the powerful; the wise see no distinction.
shakti_gita::104.translation_literal: शक्ति (power) / शक्तिमतः (from the powerful) / अभेन्द (difference) / तत्वज्ञानविवर्जिताः (devoid of true knowledge) / बालिशाः (fools) / एव (indeed) / पश्यन्ति (see) / न (not) / तत्त्वज्ञानिनः (those with true knowledge) / जनाः (people).
shakti_gita::104.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::104.essence: True wisdom sees no divide between divine power and the powerful being.
shakti_gita::104.simple_meaning: Fools without true understanding think the divine power and the powerful are different, but the wise know they are one.
shakti_gita::104.simple_insight: You can feel relief knowing what seems separate is truly united at a deeper level.
shakti_gita::104.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that those without true wisdom see a false split between divine power and its expression, but the wise perceive their essential oneness, revealing the nature of reality beyond appearances.
shakti_gita::104.modern_relevance: When you see conflict or separation between leadership and action, realize this division often comes from misunderstanding deeper unity.
shakti_gita::104.insight: This verse teaches you to shift from seeing separation to recognizing underlying unity in apparent differences.

shakti_gita::105.verse_hindi: शक्ति और शक्तिमान में अभेदज्ञान करनेवाले ज्ञान पारंगत तत्वज्ञानी महापुरुष
shakti_gita::105.english_translation: Those established in non-dual knowledge are the powerful and the possessor of power, deeply immersed in the river of true knowledge, supreme seers of wisdom.
shakti_gita::105.translation_literal: अभेदज्ञानसम्पन्नाः (endowed with non-dual knowledge) शक्तः (powerful) शक्तिमतस्तथा (and possessor of power) तत्त्वज्ञाननदीष्णाटा (immersed in the river of true knowledge) ज्ञानाधिपारदर्शिनः (supreme seers of wisdom)
shakti_gita::105.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::105.essence: Power and the possessor of power are one through non-dual knowledge.
shakti_gita::105.simple_meaning: True power comes from knowing that the power and the one who has it are not separate. Such people deeply understand reality and wisdom.
shakti_gita::105.simple_insight: You feel strong when you realize power and yourself are one, not two.
shakti_gita::105.detailed_meaning: Devi describes those who have mastered the highest knowledge: the unity of the self and power. They are not divided between subject and force but immersed in true wisdom, seeing reality without duality.
shakti_gita::105.modern_relevance: When you fully own your abilities without separating yourself from your strength, you move with confidence and clarity in life.
shakti_gita::105.insight: It shifts your view from seeing power as outside you to recognizing it within your own being.

shakti_gita::106.verse_sanskrit:
सात्त्विकाभेदसज्ज्ञान-बलान्मां प्राप्नुवन्त्यहो।
अहमेव पराभक्तया ज्ञानिनो विबुधर्षभाः !॥
shakti_gita::106.verse_hindi: सात्त्विक अभेद ज्ञान के बल से मुझको ही प्राप्त होते हैं। हे देवगण ! मैं ही
shakti_gita::106.english_translation: The wise and the best of the learned reach me alone through the power of pure, undivided knowledge.
shakti_gita::106.translation_literal: सात्त्विकाभेदसज्ज्ञान-बलान्मां (by the power of pure undivided knowledge) / प्राप्नुवन्ति (reach) / अहो (oh) / अहमेव (I alone) / पराभक्तया (by supreme devotion) / ज्ञानिनः (the wise) / विबुधर्षभाः (best of the learned)!
shakti_gita::106.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::106.essence: Only pure knowledge combined with supreme devotion truly reaches the divine.
shakti_gita::106.simple_meaning: Only those who have pure, undivided knowledge and the highest devotion truly reach the divine.
shakti_gita::106.simple_insight: You can feel assured that sincere knowledge and devotion open the path to the divine.
shakti_gita::106.detailed_meaning: Devi tells the divine beings that the highest sages and wisest learned reach her alone by combining pure knowledge with supreme devotion, highlighting the inseparability of wisdom and loving surrender in spiritual attainment.
shakti_gita::106.modern_relevance: When you deeply understand and care with full sincerity, you connect to what truly matters beyond distractions.
shakti_gita::106.insight: It shifts your focus from fragmented knowledge or lukewarm faith to integrated, devoted understanding as the key to connection.

shakti_gita::107.verse_sanskrit:
सन्निधौ भक्तवर्गस्य प्रादुर्भावमवाप्नुयाम् ।
ब्रह्मेश्वरविरारूप-त्रिभावेषु न संशयः ॥
shakti_gita::107.verse_hindi: ज्ञानी भक्त के सम्मुख पराभक्ति के द्वारा ब्रह्म ईश विराटरूपी त्रिभाव में प्रगट होती हूँ इसमें सन्देह नहीं
shakti_gita::107.english_translation: I certainly appear before the devoted through the three forms of Brahman, Ishvara, and Virat without any doubt.
shakti_gita::107.translation_literal: सन्निधौ (in the presence) भक्तवर्गस्य (of the devotees) प्रादुर्भावमवाप्नुयाम् (I appear) । ब्रह्मेश्वरविरारूप-त्रिभावेषु (in the three forms of Brahman, Ishvara, and Virat) न (no) संशयः (doubt) ॥
shakti_gita::107.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::107.essence: Devotion reveals the divine unmistakably through three cosmic forms without any doubt.
shakti_gita::107.simple_meaning: The divine appears clearly to devoted people in three great forms without any doubt.
shakti_gita::107.simple_insight: Your sincere devotion invites the divine to reveal itself in powerful ways.
shakti_gita::107.detailed_meaning: Devi speaks to the devotees, promising that when sincere devotion is present, she manifests unmistakably in her three cosmic forms: Brahman (supreme reality), Ishvara (lord), and Virat (cosmic body). This assurance encourages deep faith in the power of devotion.
shakti_gita::107.modern_relevance: When you truly open your heart with love and trust, something vast and powerful shows up to meet you in ways you couldn’t expect.
shakti_gita::107.insight: It teaches you to trust that devotion itself invites the divine’s presence in many forms beyond your imagining.

shakti_gita::108.verse_sanskrit:
ते तत्त्वज्ञानिनो भक्ता ज्ञानिनो ये परात्परम् ।
तत्त्वातीतंच में तत्त्वं बुध्यन्ते साधु निर्जराः ! ॥
shakti_gita::108.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! वे तत्वज्ञानी ज्ञानी भक्त जो मेरे तत्त्वातीत परम तत्त्व को भलीभांति जान जाते हैं
shakti_gita::108.english_translation: O divine beings! Those who are wise, devoted, and know the supreme beyond essence truly understand me, the timeless truth.
shakti_gita::108.translation_literal: ते (those) / तत्त्वज्ञानिनो (essence-knowers) / भक्ता (devotees) / ज्ञानिनो (wise) / ये (who) / परात्परम् (supreme beyond) / तत्त्वातीतंच (beyond essence) / में (me) / तत्त्वं (truth) / बुध्यन्ते (understand) / साधु (noble) / निर्जराः (timeless) !
shakti_gita::108.speaker: Shakti
shakti_gita::108.essence: True understanding arises when wisdom and devotion unite to perceive the timeless supreme.
shakti_gita::108.simple_meaning: Those who combine deep wisdom and devoted love truly recognize the supreme, timeless truth that I embody.
shakti_gita::108.simple_insight: There is a profound union when understanding and devotion meet, revealing a truth beyond time.
shakti_gita::108.detailed_meaning: Shakti speaks to divine beings, explaining that those who are both wise and devoted see beyond ordinary essence to grasp her eternal, supreme nature. This teaching highlights the highest realization combining knowledge and love.
shakti_gita::108.modern_relevance: When your thoughtful understanding blends with heartfelt devotion, you recognize timeless truths that guide beyond fleeting appearances.
shakti_gita::108.insight: It teaches you to integrate clear understanding with devoted openness to experience the eternal truth beyond concepts.

shakti_gita::109.verse_sanskrit:
मां कदाचिदनाद्यन्तविराहूपस्य धारिणीम्।
निरीक्षन्ते कदाचित्तु नानाशृंगारमास्वरम् ॥
shakti_gita::109.verse_hindi: मुझे कभी अनादि अनन्त विराट रूप धारिणी देखते हैं, कभी मेरे अनेकों श्रृंगारमय
shakti_gita::109.english_translation: Sometimes they see me as the eternal, infinite, cosmic form; sometimes adorned in many beautiful aspects.
shakti_gita::109.translation_literal: मां (me) / कदाचि (sometimes) / अनादि (without beginning) / अन्त (end) / विराहूपस्य (of the cosmic form) / धारिणीम् (bearer) / निरीक्षन्ते (they see) / कदाचित् (sometimes) / नानाशृंगारम् (various adornments) / आस्वरम् (beautifully decorated)
shakti_gita::109.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::109.essence: You can be both the infinite whole and many beautiful forms without contradiction.
shakti_gita::109.simple_meaning: You are sometimes seen as the endless cosmic presence and sometimes as many beautiful forms adorned differently.
shakti_gita::109.simple_insight: There is freedom in being both vast and richly varied without losing your true self.
shakti_gita::109.detailed_meaning: Devi describes how devotees perceive her: at times as the eternal cosmic force beyond form, at other times as many richly adorned aspects, showing her multifaceted nature and the devotional relationship.
shakti_gita::109.modern_relevance: You shift between feeling like a vast presence and a collection of many roles and expressions in your life and relationships.
shakti_gita::109.insight: It teaches you to accept your changing appearances while recognizing your unchanging essence beneath.

shakti_gita::110.verse_sanskrit:
सगुणं मेऽद्भुतं रूप-मुपासीना निरन्तरम् ।
देवा अनुभवन्त्येव ब्रह्मानन्दमलौकिकम् ॥
shakti_gita::110.verse_hindi: अद्भुत सगुण रूप में मेरी उपासना करते हुए, अलौकिक ब्रह्मानन्द को निरन्तर अनुभव करते हैं
shakti_gita::110.english_translation: The radiant beings continuously worship my wondrous form and experience the supreme bliss beyond the world.
shakti_gita::110.translation_literal: सगुणं (with qualities) मेऽद्भुतं (wondrous) रूप-मुपासीना (form worship) निरन्तरम् (continuously) । देवा (radiant beings) अनुभवन्ति (experience) एव (indeed) ब्रह्मानन्दम् (supreme bliss) अलौकिकम् (beyond the world) ॥
shakti_gita::110.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::110.essence: Devoted worship of the divine form leads to experiencing bliss beyond the world.
shakti_gita::110.simple_meaning: Radiant beings worship the divine form continuously and feel a bliss that is beyond the ordinary world.
shakti_gita::110.simple_insight: Devotion connects you to a bliss deeper than anything worldly.
shakti_gita::110.detailed_meaning: Devi describes how radiant beings (devas) endlessly worship her wondrous form and experience a bliss that transcends the normal world, showing the power of devoted love to access higher states.
shakti_gita::110.modern_relevance: When you focus your heart deeply on what moves you, you can touch a joy that feels beyond daily struggles.
shakti_gita::110.insight: It teaches you that devoted love opens your experience to joy beyond ordinary limits.

shakti_gita::111.verse_sanskrit:
समाधिस्थाः कदाचित्तु तत्त्वातीतं परात्परम् ।
महात्मानश्च मे तत्त्वं सम्प्रत्येतुं समीशते ॥
shakti_gita::111.verse_hindi: और कभी वह महात्मा समाधिस्थ होकर मेरे तत्त्वातीत परमतत्त्व के अनुभव में समर्थ
shakti_gita::111.english_translation: And sometimes that great soul, established in absorbed presence, can realize my supreme reality beyond all truth.
shakti_gita::111.translation_literal: समाधिस्थाः (established in absorbed presence) / कदाचि (sometimes) / तत्त्वातीतं (beyond truth) / परात्परम् (the supreme) / महात्मानः (great souls) / च (and) / मे (my) / तत्त्वं (reality) / सम्प्रत्येतुं (to realize) / समीशते (are able)
shakti_gita::111.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::111.essence: Deep inner stillness allows experience of the supreme beyond all truths.
shakti_gita::111.simple_meaning: Great souls who reach deep inner stillness can experience the supreme reality beyond ordinary truth.
shakti_gita::111.simple_insight: There is a peaceful power in deep presence that opens you to what is beyond words.
shakti_gita::111.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that some great beings, by settling into complete absorbed presence (samadhi), can experience her highest reality that transcends all ordinary truths and concepts.
shakti_gita::111.modern_relevance: When your mind finally quiets in meditation, you can experience something beyond your usual thoughts and beliefs.
shakti_gita::111.insight: It teaches you to cultivate deep inner stillness so you can access truths beyond intellectual grasp.

shakti_gita::112.verse_sanskrit:
अचिन्त्यं केवलाद्वैतज्ञानलोचनगोचरम्।
दशामेतां समासाद्य मद्दता ज्ञानिनोऽमराः ! ॥
shakti_gita::112.verse_hindi: केवल अद्वैत ज्ञानविषयक अचिन्त्य परमतत्त्व के अनुभव में समर्थ होते हैं। इस दशा में पहुंचकर हे देवतागण!
shakti_gita::112.english_translation: Only those with nondual wisdom can experience the inconceivable supreme reality; having reached this state, O radiant beings!
shakti_gita::112.translation_literal: अचिन्त्यं (inconceivable) केवलाद्वैतज्ञानलोचनगोचरम् (only nondual knowledge's eye-visible) । दशामेतां (these states) समासाद्य (having reached) मद्दता (O radiant beings) ज्ञानिनोऽमराः (wise immortals) ॥
shakti_gita::112.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::112.essence: Only nondual wisdom can experience the inconceivable supreme reality beyond thought.
shakti_gita::112.simple_meaning: Only those with pure nondual wisdom can experience the supreme reality that cannot be conceived by the mind.
shakti_gita::112.simple_insight: There is profound freedom in knowing some truths go beyond all thought and cannot be fully grasped.
shakti_gita::112.detailed_meaning: The Goddess explains that only enlightened beings with nondual understanding can perceive the supreme reality beyond all concepts. She calls to the divine radiant beings who have attained this highest state.
shakti_gita::112.modern_relevance: You’ve studied hard and glimpsed a truth too vast to fully explain—this is the moment your insight deepens beyond words.
shakti_gita::112.insight: It teaches you to accept that the deepest reality lies beyond mental concepts and direct experience.

shakti_gita::113.verse_sanskrit:
स्वरूपं मेऽधिगच्छन्ति परमानन्दसागरम् ।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विद्यते विबुधर्षभाः ! ॥
shakti_gita::113.verse_hindi: मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तगण मेरे ही परमानन्द सागर रूप स्वरूप को प्राप्त होते हैं इसमें कुछ भी सन्देह नहीं है
shakti_gita::113.english_translation: My wise devotees attain my own form, the ocean of supreme bliss; there is no doubt about this among the best of the wise.
shakti_gita::113.translation_literal: स्वरूपं (form) मेऽधिगच्छन्ति (attain) परमानन्दसागरम् (ocean of supreme bliss) । नात्र (there is no) कश्चन (anyone) सन्देहो (doubt) विद्यते (exists) विबुधर्षभाः (best of the wise) !
shakti_gita::113.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::113.essence: True devotion and wisdom inevitably lead to experiencing the divine as supreme bliss without doubt.
shakti_gita::113.simple_meaning: Those who are truly wise and devoted reach the form of the divine that is an ocean of supreme joy without any doubt.
shakti_gita::113.simple_insight: You can trust that your devotion leads you directly to profound joy and truth.
shakti_gita::113.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Devi assures that her wisest devotees, through devotion and knowledge, directly experience her pure form as the ocean of supreme bliss. There is no uncertainty among the highest seekers about this truth.
shakti_gita::113.modern_relevance: When your heart fully trusts your path, the deepest joy you seek becomes clearly reachable, removing all hesitation.
shakti_gita::113.insight: It teaches you to fully trust your devotion as a sure path to experiencing profound bliss and truth.

shakti_gita::114.verse_sanskrit:
देवमातर्जगन्मातज्ञारनदे ! ब्रह्मरूपिणि !।
नैवासीद्विदितं किञ्चित्स्वरूपं ते यथार्थतः ॥
shakti_gita::114.verse_hindi: हे देवजननी ! हे जगजननी ! हे ब्रह्मरूपिणी! हे ज्ञानदे ! हम लोगों को आपका यथार्थवरूप कुछ भी विदित नहीं था
shakti_gita::114.english_translation: O divine mother, mother of the universe, embodiment of supreme reality and wisdom, your true nature was never truly known to us.
shakti_gita::114.translation_literal: देवमातर्जगन्मातज्ञारनदे (O divine mother, mother of the world, giver of knowledge) / ब्रह्मरूपिणि (embodiment of Brahman) / नैवासीद्विदितं (never truly known) / किञ्चित्स्वरूपं (any of your true form) / ते (your) / यथार्थतः (in reality)
shakti_gita::114.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::114.essence: The true nature of the divine mother remains beyond what we have known so far.
shakti_gita::114.simple_meaning: We did not truly know the divine mother’s real form or essence before this moment.
shakti_gita::114.simple_insight: There is humility and wonder in realizing the divine’s true nature goes beyond our knowing.
shakti_gita::114.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses the divine mother, acknowledging that despite her being the source of all knowledge and existence, her true nature was unknown to humanity until now. This moment marks a shift toward deeper understanding and devotion.
shakti_gita::114.modern_relevance: You may feel you understand a person or idea deeply, only to realize there is always more beyond your grasp.
shakti_gita::114.insight: It teaches you to embrace not-knowing as the beginning of true trust and devotion.

shakti_gita::115.verse_sanskrit:
महामान्ये ! महादेवि ! महाहङ्कारमोहिताः ।
किंकर्तव्यविमूढा वै अत आस्म पुरा वयम् ॥
shakti_gita::115.verse_hindi: इस कारण हे परममाननीया महादेवी ! हम अहंकार विमोहित होकर पहले किंकर्तव्यविमूढ़ हुआ करते थे
shakti_gita::115.english_translation: O most revered Mahadevi! Because of great ego and delusion, we were once bewildered and confused about what to do.
shakti_gita::115.translation_literal: महामान्ये (most revered) / महादेवि (O Mahadevi) / महाहङ्कारमोहिताः (great ego-deluded) / किंकर्तव्यविमूढा (bewildered about what to do) / वै (indeed) / अत (because) / आस्म (we) / पुरा (once) / वयम् (we)
shakti_gita::115.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::115.essence: Ego and delusion once clouded us, leaving us uncertain about our actions.
shakti_gita::115.simple_meaning: Once, we were confused and lost because of strong ego and delusion, not knowing what to do.
shakti_gita::115.simple_insight: Confusion often arises when the ego blinds clear judgment and action.
shakti_gita::115.detailed_meaning: The narrator addresses the Goddess as Mahadevi, confessing that their past confusion and indecision stemmed from being blinded by ego and delusion. This moment sets the stage for the unfolding teachings on overcoming such inner obstacles.
shakti_gita::115.modern_relevance: You might feel stuck, unsure what to do, when your pride or self-importance clouds your clarity.
shakti_gita::115.insight: Recognize how ego-driven confusion blocks clear choice and action, inviting humility and openness.

shakti_gita::116.verse_sanskrit:
अखण्डच तवाद्वैतं  स्वरूपं त्वन्मुस्वाम्बुजाद।
निशम्याध वयं मातः। शक्तिशक्तिमतोस्तथा ॥
shakti_gita::116.verse_hindi: हे मातः! आज आपके अखण्ड अद्वैत स्वरूप को आपके मुखारविन्द से, सुनकर तथा शक्ति और शक्तिमान में
shakti_gita::116.english_translation: O Mother! Today we have listened to your indivisible non-dual nature from your lotus mouth, realizing both power and the powerful.
shakti_gita::116.translation_literal: अखण्डच (indivisible) तव (your) अद्वैतं (non-duality) स्वरूपं (form) त्वम् (you) मुस्वाम्बुजात् (from the lotus mouth). निशम्य (listening) अध (today) वयम् (we) मातः (O Mother). शक्तिशक्तिमतोस्तथा (power and powerful also).
shakti_gita::116.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::116.essence: The divine nature is indivisible non-duality, both power and the powerful together.
shakti_gita::116.simple_meaning: We have heard today from your own mouth about your indivisible non-dual nature as both power and the powerful.
shakti_gita::116.simple_insight: Hearing the unity of power and the powerful brings awe but needs fuller explanation to grasp deeply.
shakti_gita::116.detailed_meaning: The narrator addresses Devi after receiving her teaching, emphasizing that they have just heard her describe her indivisible, non-dual nature as both the source and the manifestation of power. This verse sets a reflective moment but does not itself teach a standalone insight.
shakti_gita::116.insight: Recognizes the inseparability of source and force but requires more context to understand fully.

shakti_gita::117.verse_sanskrit:
अभेदं ननु विज्ञाय तं तत्त्वज्ञानमूलकम्।
तत्त्वज्ञानप्रसूं दिव्यामन्तदृष्टिमवाप्नुम ॥
shakti_gita::117.verse_hindi: जो तत्वज्ञानमूलक अभेद है उसको जानकर हमने तत्त्वज्ञान जननी दिव्य अन्तर्दृष्टि प्राप्त की है।
shakti_gita::117.english_translation: Knowing the non-duality that is the root of true wisdom, one attains the divine inner vision born of that wisdom.
shakti_gita::117.translation_literal: अभेदं (non-duality) ननु (indeed) विज्ञाय (having known) तं (that) तत्त्वज्ञानमूलकम् (root of true wisdom). तत्त्वज्ञानप्रसूं (born of true wisdom) दिव्यम् (divine) अन्तर्दृष्टिम् (inner vision) अवाप्नुम् (one attains).
shakti_gita::117.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::117.essence: Understanding fundamental oneness awakens a divine inner vision beyond ordinary sight.
shakti_gita::117.simple_meaning: When you understand that everything is fundamentally one without separation, you gain a divine inner insight born from that understanding.
shakti_gita::117.simple_insight: You feel the peace that comes from realizing all is one within you.
shakti_gita::117.detailed_meaning: The Goddess explains that grasping the fundamental oneness underlying everything—non-duality—is the source of true wisdom. This profound knowledge leads to a divine inner vision, a deep insight that reveals beyond surface appearances.
shakti_gita::117.modern_relevance: When you stop seeing divisions everywhere and recognize unity beneath differences, you unlock a clarity that helps you navigate life with calm and confidence.
shakti_gita::117.insight: It shifts your mind from seeing separation to recognizing unity, opening a deeper inner vision.

shakti_gita::118.verse_sanskrit:
साम्प्रतं सफलं विद्यो निजास्तित्वं न संशयः।
इदानीं दयया देवि ! स्वकलावर्णनं कुरु ॥
shakti_gita::118.verse_hindi: अब हम निःसन्देह अपने अस्तित्व को सफल समझते हैं - हे जगन्मातः ! हे देवी! अब आप कृपा कर अपनी कलाओं का वर्णन करें
shakti_gita::118.english_translation: Now we are certain that our true self is accomplished—O Mother of the world! Please graciously describe your divine arts.
shakti_gita::118.translation_literal: साम्प्रतं (now) सफलं (accomplished) विद्यो (is known) निजास्तित्वं (own existence) न (not) संशयः (doubt). इदानीं (now) दयया (with kindness) देवि (O Devi) स्वकलावर्णनं (own arts description) कुरु (do).
shakti_gita::118.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::118.essence: Certainty in your true self opens the way to receive the divine's full expression.
shakti_gita::118.simple_meaning: You have become sure of your true self and now ask the divine mother to reveal her powers.
shakti_gita::118.simple_insight: There is comfort in certainty and a readiness to receive greater understanding.
shakti_gita::118.detailed_meaning: At a moment of clarity, the speaker acknowledges their firm certainty in their own true nature and calls to the divine mother to reveal her full range of divine arts, inviting deeper knowledge and grace.
shakti_gita::118.modern_relevance: You’ve reached a moment of clarity about who you truly are and feel ready to learn more from a higher source.
shakti_gita::118.insight: It encourages moving from personal certainty to open-hearted trust in a higher wisdom beyond oneself.

shakti_gita::119.verse_sanskrit:
येन चानुभवं कर्तुं भवत्याः सर्वथा वयम् ।
शक्नुयाम जगन्मातः ! कलारूपेण सर्वतः ॥
shakti_gita::119.verse_hindi: जिससे हम सर्वत्र कलारूप से आपको अनुभव करने में सर्वथा समर्थ हो सके
shakti_gita::119.english_translation: By which we can fully experience you everywhere in the form of energy.
shakti_gita::119.translation_literal: येन (by which) / च (also) / अनुभवं (experience) / कर्तुं (to do) / भवत्याः (your) / सर्वथा (completely) / वयम् (we) / शक्नुयाम (can) / जगन्मातः (world mother) / कलारूपेण (in the form of energy) / सर्वतः (everywhere)
shakti_gita::119.speaker: Devotees
shakti_gita::119.essence: You can fully experience the divine everywhere as vibrant creative energy.
shakti_gita::119.simple_meaning: We seek the power to experience the divine everywhere as vibrant energy in all things.
shakti_gita::119.simple_insight: There's a deep connection in sensing the divine energy in every part of life.
shakti_gita::119.detailed_meaning: Devotees ask Devi, the world mother, for the ability to experience her presence everywhere as dynamic energy, expressing their longing to connect with her in all forms.
shakti_gita::119.modern_relevance: You pause and notice the energy behind every moment — the hum of life in every detail.
shakti_gita::119.insight: It encourages shifting from seeing the world as separate to feeling the divine energy permeating all things.

shakti_gita::120.verse_sanskrit:
दृश्यमपञ्चजातेऽस्मिन्निखिले सचराचरे।
अभिव्यक्ताऽस्मि भो देवाः ! कलारूपेण सर्वतः ॥
shakti_gita::120.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! मैं ही कलारूप से इस सारे चराचर दृश्य प्रपञ्च समूह में व्यापक रूप से  प्रकट हूँ ।
shakti_gita::120.english_translation: O radiant beings! I am widely manifest in all this moving and unmoving visible world as the form of energy.
shakti_gita::120.translation_literal: दृश्यमपञ्चजातेऽस्मिन् (in the visible moving and unmoving) / अखिले (all) / सचराचरे (moving and unmoving) / अभिव्यक्ताऽस्मि (I am manifest) / भो (O) / देवाः (radiant beings) / कलारूपेण (as the form of energy) / सर्वतः (everywhere)
shakti_gita::120.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::120.essence: The divine manifests as energy pervading all visible moving and still things.
shakti_gita::120.simple_meaning: The divine says she manifests as energy in all visible things, both moving and still, filling everything.
shakti_gita::120.simple_insight: You belong to a vast energy present in every part of existence, seen and unseen.
shakti_gita::120.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses radiant beings, revealing she is present everywhere as energy in all moving and unmoving visible things. This teaching shows her as the creative power pervading all forms of the world.
shakti_gita::120.modern_relevance: You notice energy flowing through your body, nature, and machines—this verse reminds you that energy animates all visible things around you.
shakti_gita::120.insight: It shifts your view from seeing things as separate objects to recognizing the universal energy uniting all visible existence.

shakti_gita::121.verse_sanskrit:
परं दृश्यमपञ्चस्तु नैवास्ते मयि निर्जराः।
मय्यास्ते पूर्णसद्भावः कलाषोडशकान्वितः ॥
shakti_gita::121.verse_hindi: परन्तु मुझमें दृश्यप्रपञ्च नहीं है। मुझमे हे देवगण सोलह कलाओं से पूर्ण सद्भाव
shakti_gita::121.english_translation: But in me, there is no visible world; I alone embody the full essence of the sixteen arts.
shakti_gita::121.translation_literal: परं (supreme) / दृश्यम् (visible) / अपञ्च (not even five) / तु (but) / नै (not) / अस्ते (exists) / मयि (in me) / निर्जराः (without decay) । मयि (in me) / अस्ते (exists) / पूर्ण (full) / सद्भावः (essence, true nature) / कलाषोडशकान्वितः (endowed with sixteen arts) ॥
shakti_gita::121.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::121.essence: True self is complete and unchanged beyond any visible world or change.
shakti_gita::121.simple_meaning: The divine presence contains no visible world or decay but fully embodies perfect essence and all skills within.
shakti_gita::121.simple_insight: You can rest in knowing your true self is whole and untouched by outer changes.
shakti_gita::121.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Devi explains that within her there is no visible or decaying world; she alone embodies the complete essence, including all sixteen arts — symbolizing total completeness and transcendence.
shakti_gita::121.modern_relevance: When everything outside feels unstable or changing, you can find unshakable wholeness inside yourself that no change affects.
shakti_gita::121.insight: It teaches you to look beyond appearances and recognize your untouched, full essence as your true nature.

shakti_gita::122.verse_sanskrit:
चिद्भावानन्दभावौ स्तः कलापूर्णो च मय्यतः।
कलाषोडशकोपेतसच्चिदानन्दमय्यहम् ॥
shakti_gita::122.verse_hindi: सोलह कलाओं से पूर्ण चिद्भाव और सोलह कलाओं से पूर्ण आनन्दभाव विद्यमान है; इसलिये मैं षोडशकलाओं से युक्त सच्चिदानन्द स्वरूप हूँ
shakti_gita::122.english_translation: I embody sixteen aspects of pure consciousness and sixteen aspects of bliss; thus, I am the embodiment of truth, consciousness, and bliss endowed with sixteen perfections.
shakti_gita::122.translation_literal: चिद्भावानन्दभावौ (consciousness and bliss) स्तः (full) कलापूर्णो (perfections complete) च (and) मय्यतः (in me)। कलाषोडशकोपेतसच्चिदानन्दमय्यहम् (sixteen perfections possessed, truth-consciousness-bliss in me) ॥
shakti_gita::122.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::122.essence: Complete consciousness and bliss coexist in you as sixteen perfect qualities united.
shakti_gita::122.simple_meaning: The divine presence is full of sixteen perfect qualities of consciousness and bliss, making her the pure truth and joy itself.
shakti_gita::122.simple_insight: There's a deep completeness in you as pure awareness and joy, beyond any lack.
shakti_gita::122.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals her nature as the fullness of sixteen perfections, embodying pure consciousness (chit), bliss (ananda), and truth (sat). This teaching shows her as the ultimate reality, both creative power and pure awareness.
shakti_gita::122.modern_relevance: When you feel fragmented or incomplete, remember you hold within you the full spectrum of awareness and joy, perfectly whole as you are.
shakti_gita::122.insight: Recognize your inner completeness as the fullness of consciousness and bliss beyond appearances.

shakti_gita::123.verse_sanskrit:
यतोऽहं सचिदानन्दभावैः पूर्णैश्च पूरिता।
अन्तःपूर्णा बहिःपूर्णा पूर्णाऽतोऽस्मि च सर्वथा ॥
shakti_gita::123.verse_hindi: मुझमें पूर्ण सच्चिदानन्दभाव विद्यमान है इसलिये मैं अन्तःपूर्ण बहिःपूर्ण तथा सब प्रकार से पूर्ण हूँ
shakti_gita::123.english_translation: I am filled with complete consciousness, bliss, and existence; I am full within, full without, and completely full in every way.
shakti_gita::123.translation_literal: यतः (from where) अहम् (I) सचिदानन्दभावैः (with consciousness-bliss-existence nature) पूर्णैः (complete) च (and) पूरिता (filled). अन्तःपूर्णा (full inside) बहिःपूर्णा (full outside) पूर्णा (full) अतोऽस्मि (therefore I am) च (and) सर्वथा (in all ways).
shakti_gita::123.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::123.essence: Complete consciousness and bliss make you fully whole inside and out.
shakti_gita::123.simple_meaning: You are completely filled with consciousness, bliss, and existence. Inside and outside, you are whole and complete.
shakti_gita::123.simple_insight: Feel the relief that you lack nothing and are already whole in every way.
shakti_gita::123.detailed_meaning: Devi speaks from her own nature, revealing that she embodies complete consciousness, bliss, and existence. She explains she is full within and without, highlighting the non-dual fullness of her being as the source and essence of all.
shakti_gita::123.modern_relevance: In moments of self-doubt, remember you already hold inner completeness and do not need to seek outside yourself.
shakti_gita::123.insight: Shift your view from scarcity to fullness by recognizing you already embody all that is needed.

shakti_gita::124.verse_hindi: मेरी सद्भाव की एक कला, चिद्भाव की एक कला और आनन्दभाव की एक कलामात्र से ही यह सारा दृश्य प्रपञ्च उत्पन्न हुआ है
shakti_gita::124.english_translation: This entire visible world has arisen from just one aspect each of my existence as consciousness, bliss, and pure being.
shakti_gita::124.translation_literal: सचिदानन्दभावानां (of consciousness-bliss-being feelings) नन्वेकैककलाश्रयः (indeed one-one-art-basis)। दृश्यप्रपञ्चपुञः (visible-world) अयं (this) समुद्भतः (arisen) अखि (indeed) मम (of me) ॥
shakti_gita::124.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::124.essence: All visible creation arises from one unified essence of consciousness, bliss, and being.
shakti_gita::124.simple_meaning: The whole visible world comes from just one creative aspect each of my consciousness, bliss, and pure existence.
shakti_gita::124.simple_insight: You are connected to a single source that creates all experience and joy.
shakti_gita::124.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals that the entire visible universe emerges from her threefold nature: consciousness (chit), bliss (ananda), and pure being (sat). This moment shows her as the singular source of all creation, blending cosmic philosophy with her divine identity.
shakti_gita::124.modern_relevance: When you feel alone or fragmented, remember all your experiences share a single source that unites consciousness, joy, and being.
shakti_gita::124.insight: It shifts perception from seeing separation to recognizing unity as the foundation of all experience.

shakti_gita::125.verse_sanskrit:
एतास्तिस्रास्त्रिभावानां विश्वं व्याश्नुवते कलाः।
आधिदैविकमाध्यात्म रूपं धृत्वाऽधिभौतिकम् ॥
shakti_gita::125.verse_hindi: ये ही तीन कलाएँ अध्यात्म, अधिदैव और अधिभूत रूप धारण करके जगत में व्याप्त हैं
shakti_gita::125.english_translation: These three energies—spiritual, divine, and material—pervade the entire universe.
shakti_gita::125.translation_literal: एतास्ति (these are) त्रिस्त्रा (three types) त्रिभावानां (of three modes) विश्वं (the universe) व्याश्नुवते (pervades) कलाः (energies/arts). आधिदैविकम् (divine) आध्यात्म (spiritual) रूपं (form) धृत्वा (holding) अधिभौतिकम् (material).
shakti_gita::125.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::125.essence: Three fundamental energies—spiritual, divine, and material—underlie and sustain all existence.
shakti_gita::125.simple_meaning: The whole universe exists through three energies: spiritual, divine, and material, each shaping reality.
shakti_gita::125.simple_insight: Feeling surrounded by unseen forces invites awe and trust in a bigger design.
shakti_gita::125.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the universe is sustained by three fundamental energies: spiritual energy that connects to inner being, divine energy linked to higher realms, and material energy that forms everything physical. This sets the foundation for understanding reality's layers.
shakti_gita::125.modern_relevance: When you notice your thoughts, feelings, and the world around you, you're sensing these three energies shaping your experience.
shakti_gita::125.insight: Recognize reality as layered energies; this helps you see beyond surface appearances to deeper connections.

shakti_gita::126.verse_sanskrit:
आध्यात्मिक्या कलाः सर्वा मम षोडशसंख्या काः ।
प्रपूर्य्यन्ते शिवेऽतोऽसौ महादिर्जगद्गुरुः ॥
shakti_gita::126.verse_hindi: मेरी आध्यात्मिक षोड़श कलाओं की पूर्णता शिव में प्रकाशित होने से यह सब ऋषियों के आदि और जगत के गुरु हैं
shakti_gita::126.english_translation: All my sixteen spiritual arts are perfected by Shiva; thus he is the primal sage and the world's teacher.
shakti_gita::126.translation_literal: आध्यात्मिक्या (spiritual) कलाः (arts) सर्वा (all) मम (my) षोडशसंख्या (sixteen in number) काः (are) । पूर्य्यन्ते (are perfected) शिवेऽतः (by Shiva, therefore) असौ (he) महादिः (the primal) जगद्गुरुः (world teacher) ॥
shakti_gita::126.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::126.essence: A primal source perfects all spiritual arts as the universal teacher.
shakti_gita::126.simple_meaning: The sixteen spiritual skills or arts reach their full perfection through Shiva, who is the original sage and teacher of the world.
shakti_gita::126.simple_insight: There is a primal source behind all spiritual mastery, grounding your own growth.
shakti_gita::126.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the full range of sixteen spiritual arts—skills for inner growth and wisdom—are perfected through Shiva, who is recognized as the first great sage and the universal teacher guiding creation.
shakti_gita::126.modern_relevance: When you master different skills or disciplines, it helps to remember they all stem from a deeper source of wisdom beyond yourself.
shakti_gita::126.insight: Recognizing a primal source unifies diverse spiritual skills, helping you see your own learning as part of a greater whole.

shakti_gita::127.verse_sanskrit:
मत्कला आधिदैविक्यः प्रपूयन्ते यतो हरौ।
अतो देवादिदेवोऽयं विश्वस्मिन् विष्णुरुच्यते ॥
shakti_gita::127.verse_hindi: मेरी अधिदैव कलाओं की पूर्णता विष्णु में होने से यह संसार में देवादिदेव कहे जाते हैं
shakti_gita::127.english_translation: The fullness of my supreme divine arts flows into Hari; thus Vishnu is called the lord of all gods in this universe.
shakti_gita::127.translation_literal: मत्कला (my arts) / आधिदैविक्यः (supreme divine) / प्रपूयन्ते (flow into) / यतो (because) / हरौ (into Hari) / अतो (therefore) / देवादिदेवः (lord of gods) / अयम् (this) / विश्वस्मिन् (in the universe) / विष्णुः (Vishnu) / उच्यते (is called)
shakti_gita::127.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::127.essence: The supreme divine power fully manifests as Vishnu, the highest lord in the universe.
shakti_gita::127.simple_meaning: The supreme divine power expressed through the Goddess fully flows into Vishnu, making him the highest lord in the universe.
shakti_gita::127.simple_insight: You can trust that the highest divine power is complete and present in the universe's supreme being.
shakti_gita::127.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that her supreme divine arts flow completely into Hari (Vishnu). This total presence makes Vishnu the acknowledged highest lord among all divine beings in the universe.
shakti_gita::127.modern_relevance: When you recognize that the greatest creative power flows through a presence greater than yourself, you find grounding and trust in life's unfolding.
shakti_gita::127.insight: It teaches you to see the divine power as present and complete within the supreme presence, inspiring trust and devotion.

shakti_gita::128.verse_sanskrit:
ममावतारसङ्घोऽपि विष्ण्वंशैरेव जायते।
विधौ पोड़श पूर्य्यन्ते ह्यधिभूतकला मम ॥
shakti_gita::128.verse_hindi: इसीलिये मेरे अवतारसमूह विष्णु के अंश से ही प्राविर्भूत होते हैं। मेरी अधिभूत कलाओं की पूर्णता ब्रह्मा में है
shakti_gita::128.english_translation: Therefore, my incarnations arise as portions of Vishnu's lineage. The fullness of my manifested powers is realized in Brahma.
shakti_gita::128.translation_literal: ममावतारसङ्घोऽपि (my incarnations group also) विष्ण्वंशैरेव (from Vishnu's lineage only) जायते (are born). विधौ (in power) पोड़श (fullness) पूर्यन्ते (are completed) हि (indeed) अधिभूतकला (manifested powers) मम (my).
shakti_gita::128.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::128.essence: Divine forms arise from a shared lineage, while creative power reaches cosmic completion.
shakti_gita::128.simple_meaning: All my incarnations come as parts of Vishnu’s line, and my manifested powers reach fullness in Brahma.
shakti_gita::128.simple_insight: You carry a power connected to both divine origin and cosmic completeness.
shakti_gita::128.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that her incarnations are not separate but arise as parts of Vishnu’s lineage, while the fullness of her creative power is expressed through Brahma. This unites divine origins with cosmic creation in her identity.
shakti_gita::128.modern_relevance: When you recognize your origins and the full range of your strengths, you see yourself as part of a vast creative flow beyond yourself.
shakti_gita::128.insight: It shifts your view from isolated identity to understanding your powers as expressions of a shared cosmic source.

shakti_gita::129.verse_sanskrit:
अतः मजापतीनाश्चाऽसावस्त्यादिः पितामहः ।
ममाध्यात्मकलानाञ्च पोड़शानां पुराऽमराः ! ॥
shakti_gita::129.verse_hindi: इस कारण ये प्रजापतियों के आदि और पितामह कहे जाते हैं । हे देवगण! मेरी अध्यात्म षोड़श कलाओं का
shakti_gita::129.english_translation: Therefore, these are called the first progenitors and grandfathers. O divine beings! My sixteen spiritual arts...
shakti_gita::129.translation_literal: अतः (therefore) मजापतीनाश्चाऽसावस्त्यादिः (these are the first progenitors) पितामहः (and grandfathers) ममाध्यात्मकलानाञ्च (my spiritual arts) पोड़शानां (sixteen) पुराऽमराः (old immortals)
shakti_gita::129.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::129.essence: The first ancestors embody the sixteen spiritual arts of the divine.
shakti_gita::129.simple_meaning: These beings are called the first ancestors and grandfathers because of their connection to my sixteen spiritual skills.
shakti_gita::129.simple_insight: Recognizing origins brings respect for the spiritual arts shaping existence.
shakti_gita::129.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that certain ancient beings, the Prajapatis, are known as the earliest ancestors and grandfathers because they embody her sixteen spiritual arts, highlighting the spiritual foundation of creation.
shakti_gita::129.insight: It shows how foundational spiritual qualities underlie all creation and lineage.

shakti_gita::130.verse_sanskrit:
भूत्वा सप्तर्षिवर्गेषु विकाशो याति हेतुताम् ।
अनेकेषां महर्षीणां ज्ञानविस्तारकारिणाम् ॥
shakti_gita::130.verse_hindi: विकास प्रथम सप्तर्षियों में होकर ज्ञान के चालक नाना ऋषियों का कारण बनता है
shakti_gita::130.english_translation: The unfolding passes first through the group of seven sages and becomes the cause for many great sages who expand knowledge.
shakti_gita::130.translation_literal: भूत्वा (becoming) सप्तर्षिवर्गेषु (in the group of seven sages) विकाशो (unfolding) याति (passes) हेतुताम् (as the cause) । अनेकेषां (of many) महर्षीणां (great sages) ज्ञानविस्तारकारिणाम् (causing the expansion of knowledge) ॥
shakti_gita::130.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::130.essence: Knowledge unfolds through a primary group, then spreads widely by many sages.
shakti_gita::130.simple_meaning: Unfolding knowledge first spreads through the seven sages, then leads many great sages to expand wisdom further.
shakti_gita::130.simple_insight: Growth in understanding often starts from a few and blossoms through many dedicated seekers.
shakti_gita::130.detailed_meaning: The narrator describes how divine unfolding first moves through the original seven sages, who act as the root cause for many other great sages to develop and spread knowledge widely.
shakti_gita::130.insight: It shows how foundational teachers spark wider learning that shapes generations.

shakti_gita::131.verse_sanskrit:
कलाविशेषमेतासां सन्दधाना वितन्वते ।
अवतीर्य्यर्पयो ज्ञानं लोकानेत्य चतुर्दश ॥
shakti_gita::131.verse_hindi: ऋषियों के अवतार गण मेरी इन कलाओं मे से विशेष विशेष कलाओं को धारण करके चतुर्दश भुवन में ज्ञान का विस्तार करते हैं
shakti_gita::131.english_translation: The incarnations of sages spread knowledge across the fourteen worlds by embodying these special arts.
shakti_gita::131.translation_literal: कलाविशेषमेतासां (these special arts) / सन्दधाना (holding) / वितन्वते (spread) / अवतीर्य्यर्पयो (incarnations) / ज्ञानं (knowledge) / लोकानेत्य (to the worlds) / चतुर्दश (fourteen)
shakti_gita::131.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::131.essence: Special abilities allow incarnations to spread knowledge throughout all worlds.
shakti_gita::131.simple_meaning: Certain incarnations hold special arts that spread knowledge throughout all fourteen realms.
shakti_gita::131.simple_insight: You have unique abilities that can share wisdom far beyond yourself.
shakti_gita::131.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that sages incarnate by embodying special arts, which they use to spread knowledge across the fourteen worlds, showing how divine power manifests as wisdom in many forms.
shakti_gita::131.modern_relevance: You have talents that can influence many people if you use them fully and wisely.
shakti_gita::131.insight: Recognize your unique skills as vehicles to share understanding widely and meaningfully.

shakti_gita::132.verse_sanskrit:
समासाद्याऽधिदैवीमें कलाः पोड़शसङ्ख्यकाः । 
वसवोऽष्टौ यमेन्द्रौ च रुद्रा एकादशामराः ! ॥
shakti_gita::132.verse_hindi: हे । देवगण ! मेरी अधिदैव षोडश कलाश्री को प्राप्त करके अष्टवसु, एकादश रुद्र, यम और इन्द्र
shakti_gita::132.english_translation: O divine beings! Having attained my sixteen divine arts, there are the eight Vasus, the eleven Rudras, Yama, and Indra.
shakti_gita::132.translation_literal: समासाद्याऽधिदैवीमें (having attained the divine) / कलाः (arts) / पोड़शसङ्ख्यकाः (sixteen in number) / वसवोऽष्टौ (eight Vasus) / यमेन्द्रौ (Yama and Indra) / च (and) / रुद्रा (Rudras) / एकादशामराः (eleven immortal ones)
shakti_gita::132.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::132.essence: Lists divine groups embodying Devi's sixteen divine arts.
shakti_gita::132.simple_meaning: Devi lists divine beings associated with her sixteen divine arts, naming groups of powerful celestial entities.
shakti_gita::132.simple_insight: Recognizing divine forces shows the vastness and complexity of cosmic powers.
shakti_gita::132.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses the divine assembly, revealing that her sixteen divine arts are embodied by groups of celestial beings like the eight Vasus, eleven Rudras, and gods Yama and Indra. This verse situates her cosmic power within traditional divine forces.
shakti_gita::132.insight: It highlights the interconnectedness of cosmic powers without teaching a universal principle.

shakti_gita::133.verse_sanskrit:
द्वादशादित्यसम्मिश्रा देवास्त्रिंशत्रयस्तथा ।
प्रादर्भवन्त्यमी सर्वे नित्या नैमित्तिकास्ततः ॥
shakti_gita::133.verse_hindi: द्वादश आदित्य, यह तैंतीस देवता तथा अनेक नित्य, नैमित्तिक देवता प्रकट होकर
shakti_gita::133.english_translation: Twelve Adityas, thirty-three deities, and many eternal and occasional divine beings manifest.
shakti_gita::133.translation_literal: द्वादशादित्यसम्मिश्रा (twelve Adityas-mixed) / देवास्त्रिंशत्रयस्तथा (thirty-three deities-also) / प्रादर्भवन्त्यमी (manifest) / सर्वे (all) / नित्या (eternal) / नैमित्तिकास्ततः (occasional)
shakti_gita::133.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::133.essence: Many divine beings manifest, showing the vastness of divine presence.
shakti_gita::133.simple_meaning: Many divine beings appear, including twelve Adityas, thirty-three deities, and various eternal and occasional ones.
shakti_gita::133.simple_insight: The divine presence is vast and manifests in many forms beyond just one image.
shakti_gita::133.detailed_meaning: This verse narrates how many divine beings, including the twelve Adityas and thirty-three deities, along with eternal and occasional divine entities, manifest in the cosmos as part of the unfolding story.
shakti_gita::133.insight: Recognize the vastness and diversity of divine expression beyond a single form or idea.

shakti_gita::134.verse_sanskrit:
व्यवस्था कर्मराज्यस्य प्रादुर्भूय प्रकुर्वते।
अनेके पितरश्चैवं ये प्रजापतयो दश ॥
shakti_gita::134.verse_hindi: कर्मराज्य की सुव्यवस्था करते हैं। इसी प्रकार दस प्रजापति और नाना पितृगण
shakti_gita::134.english_translation: The realm of action is established with order by many ancestors and the ten Prajapatis.
shakti_gita::134.translation_literal: व्यवस्था (order) / कर्मराज्यस्य (of the realm of action) / प्रादुर्भूय (having appeared) / प्रकुर्वते (establishes) / अनेके (many) / पितरश्चैवं (ancestors likewise) / ये (who) / प्रजापतयो (the Prajapatis) / दश (ten)
shakti_gita::134.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::134.essence: Orderly action arises from many foundational beings working together.
shakti_gita::134.simple_meaning: Many ancestors and ten Prajapatis establish the orderly realm where actions take place.
shakti_gita::134.simple_insight: Order in action comes from many guiding principles and ancestors working together.
shakti_gita::134.detailed_meaning: Suta narrates how the orderly domain of action is set up by multiple ancestors and the ten Prajapatis, foundational figures who govern creation's structure in this teaching.
shakti_gita::134.insight: It shows that complex systems of action depend on many foundational influences working in harmony.

shakti_gita::135.verse_sanskrit:
षोशालम्ब्य कुर्वन्ति तेऽधिभूतकला मम ।
नानावैचित्र्यपूर्णायाः सृष्टेरस्या व्यवस्थितिम् ॥
shakti_gita::135.verse_hindi: मेरी अधिभूत षोड़शकलाओं को अवलम्बन करके प्रकट होकर नाना विचित्रता पूर्ण सृष्टि को सुव्यवस्था करते हैं
shakti_gita::135.english_translation: They support my sixteen elemental powers to manifest and orderly arrange this diverse creation.
shakti_gita::135.translation_literal: षोशालम्ब्य (supporting sixteen powers) कुर्वन्ति (they do) तेऽधिभूतकला (these elemental powers) मम (of mine) । नानावैचित्र्यपूर्णायाः (full of diverse forms) सृष्टेः (of creation) अस्या (this) व्यवस्थितिम् (orderly arrangement) ॥
shakti_gita::135.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::135.essence: A multitude of elemental powers uphold and organize the diverse creation in perfect order.
shakti_gita::135.simple_meaning: The divine uses sixteen fundamental powers to support and organize the vast variety in creation.
shakti_gita::135.simple_insight: You can trust that the complex world around you is held together by unseen forces.
shakti_gita::135.detailed_meaning: Devi explains how her sixteen elemental powers work together to create and maintain the vast diversity and order of the universe, showing her role as both source and organizer of all that exists.
shakti_gita::135.modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic, remember countless unseen forces are working to keep everything in balance and harmony.
shakti_gita::135.insight: It teaches you to see complexity and diversity as expressions of an underlying unified power organizing everything.

shakti_gita::136.verse_sanskrit:
अन्तिकं नृंश्च्  मे नेतुं नितरामग्रगामिनः।
व्याप्ताप्यस्यां कलारूपाजगंर्त्य  सर्वतः सुराः ! ॥
shakti_gita::136.verse_hindi: और मनुष्यों को मेरी ओर निरन्तर अग्रसर करते हैं। हे देवतागण ! मैं कलारूपिणी होकर इस जगत में व्याप्त होने पर भी
shakti_gita::136.english_translation: And humans keep moving constantly toward me. O divine beings! Though I pervade this world as the form of time,
