shakti_gita::136.translation_literal: अन्तिकं (toward) नृंश्च् (humans) मे (my) नेतुं (to lead) नितरामग्रगामिनः (constantly advancing). व्याप्ताप्यस्यां (pervading this) कलारूपा (form of time) जगंर्त्य (in the world) सर्वतः (everywhere) सुराः (divine beings)!
shakti_gita::136.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::136.essence: Life constantly moves toward the divine who pervades all as time.
shakti_gita::136.simple_meaning: Humans are always moving toward me, the divine who pervades the world as time.
shakti_gita::136.simple_insight: You sense an unstoppable force drawing all life toward the divine presence everywhere.
shakti_gita::136.detailed_meaning: Devi describes how humans continuously move toward her, even as she pervades the entire world in her form as time. She calls to the divine beings, emphasizing her omnipresence and the unstoppable flow toward her.
shakti_gita::136.insight: It shows the natural, constant movement of life toward the divine presence embodied as time itself.

shakti_gita::137.verse_sanskrit:
अद्वितीयाऽहमेकास्मि शुद्धा बुद्धा च शाश्वती ।
सीमा नास्त्येव भो देवा ! कलाविश्लेषणस्य मे ॥
shakti_gita::137.verse_hindi: एक अद्वितीय शुद्ध बुद्ध और नित्य हूँ । मेरी कलाओं के विश्लेषण का पार नहीं है
shakti_gita::137.english_translation: I am the unique, pure, eternal wisdom. No gods can define the limits of my powers.
shakti_gita::137.translation_literal: अद्वितीयाऽहम् (unique I am) / एकास्मि (one) / शुद्धा (pure) / बुद्धा (wisdom) / च (and) / शाश्वती (eternal) / सीमा (limit) / नास्ति (is not) / एव (indeed) / भो (O) / देवा (gods) / कलाविश्लेषणस्य (of art's analysis) / मे (my)
shakti_gita::137.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::137.essence: Pure, unique wisdom is eternal and cannot be confined by any limits.
shakti_gita::137.simple_meaning: You are the one pure and eternal wisdom that cannot be limited or fully defined by anything.
shakti_gita::137.simple_insight: Feel the freedom in being boundless and uniquely wise beyond any measure.
shakti_gita::137.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Devi declares her nature as the single unique, pure, and eternal wisdom. She tells that no gods or beings can fully define or limit her powers, emphasizing her infinite nature.
shakti_gita::137.modern_relevance: You may feel pressure to fit into fixed roles or limits, but your true nature is beyond all boundaries.
shakti_gita::137.insight: Recognize your true self as boundless wisdom beyond all external definitions or limits.

shakti_gita::138.verse_sanskrit:
शक्तेर्मव्यवतिष्ठन्ते कलाः षोड़श सर्वदा ।
अतोऽहं सर्वशक्तीनामस्म्याधारस्वरूपिणी ॥
shakti_gita::138.verse_hindi: मुझमें शक्ति की षोडश कला सर्वदा विद्यमान है इसलिये मैं सब शक्तियों की आधारस्वरूप हूँ
shakti_gita::138.english_translation: The sixteen arts always reside in Shakti; therefore, I am the foundation and essence of all powers.
shakti_gita::138.translation_literal: शक्तेः (of Shakti) म (not) अव्यवतिष्ठन्ते (do not cease) कलाः (arts) षोडश (sixteen) सर्वदा (always) । अतोऽहम् (therefore I) सर्वशक्तीनाम् (of all powers) अस्मि (am) आधार (foundation) स्वरूपिणी (essence) ॥
shakti_gita::138.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::138.essence: All powers continuously dwell in you as their essential foundation.
shakti_gita::138.simple_meaning: All sixteen special arts or powers continuously exist in Shakti, making her the basis and form of all powers.
shakti_gita::138.simple_insight: You contain countless abilities within, always present as your inner foundation.
shakti_gita::138.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals that the sixteen arts, symbolic of diverse powers and skills, never leave her. She is not just one power but the grounding essence behind all abilities, affirming her cosmic creative and sustaining role.
shakti_gita::138.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your tasks, remember you have many hidden strengths always supporting you from within.
shakti_gita::138.insight: It teaches you to recognize your inner source of endless potential rather than seeing abilities as separate or external.

shakti_gita::139.verse_sanskrit:
कलारूपैः कलापूर्णा शक्तिः सा मेऽश्नुते जगत् ।
तस्यास्तासां कलानान्तु विच भेदाननेकशः ॥
shakti_gita::139.verse_hindi: कलाओं से पूर्ण वही मेरी शक्ति कलारूप से जगत में परिव्याप्त है। उस शक्ति की उन कलाओं के अनेक भेद हैं सो जानो
shakti_gita::139.english_translation: My power is full of arts and pervades the world in many forms; know that those arts have many distinctions.
shakti_gita::139.translation_literal: कलारूपैः (in forms of arts) कलापूर्णा (full of arts) शक्तिः (power) सा (she) मेऽश्नुते (pervades) जगत् (world) । तस्यास्तासां (of that, those) कलानान्तु (arts indeed) विच (know) भेदाननेकशः (many distinctions) ॥
shakti_gita::139.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::139.essence: One divine power expresses itself through countless unique creative forms across the world.
shakti_gita::139.simple_meaning: The divine power is complete with many creative arts and fills the entire world in diverse forms, each with its own unique qualities.
shakti_gita::139.simple_insight: You can see the divine’s creative energy everywhere, expressed in countless unique ways.
shakti_gita::139.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that her power is the source of all creative arts and that these arts spread throughout the world in many forms, each different yet connected. This reveals the vast richness and variety within the divine energy itself.
shakti_gita::139.modern_relevance: Look around and notice the endless variety in nature, art, and life — all expressions of one creative energy shaping the world uniquely.
shakti_gita::139.insight: It teaches you to recognize the unity behind diverse expressions, seeing all forms as facets of one creative source.

shakti_gita::140.verse_sanskrit:
ममैवैका कला शक्तरुद्भिज्जेषु विकाशते।
स्वेदजेषु कलाद्वैतमण्डजेषु कलात्रयम् ॥
shakti_gita::140.verse_hindi: मेरी शक्ति की एक कला का उद्भिज में, स्वेदज में दो कलाओं का, अण्डज में तीन कलाओं का
shakti_gita::140.english_translation: In me alone, the power manifests as one art in sprouts, two arts in sweat, and three arts in eggs.
shakti_gita::140.translation_literal: ममैवैका (mine alone one) / कला (art/power) / शक्तरुद्भिज्जेषु (in power sprouts) / विकाशते (manifests) / स्वेदजेषु (in sweat-born) / कलाद्वैतम् (two arts) / अण्डजेषु (in egg-born) / कलात्रयम् (three arts)
shakti_gita::140.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::140.essence: A single divine power unfolds in increasing complexity through all life forms.
shakti_gita::140.simple_meaning: The divine power within me appears in different ways: once in sprouts, twice in sweat, and thrice in eggs, showing increasing complexity.
shakti_gita::140.simple_insight: You hold a deep, unfolding power expressed in many forms inside you.
shakti_gita::140.detailed_meaning: The Goddess explains how her power alone manifests differently in stages of life creation: simple in plants, more complex in animals born from sweat, and most complex in egg-born beings, revealing her as the source of all growth.
shakti_gita::140.modern_relevance: Think of how one idea grows into many layers in your work or life, each stage richer and more complex than the last.
shakti_gita::140.insight: It shifts your view to see yourself and life as expressions of a single unfolding power with many forms.

shakti_gita::141.verse_sanskrit:
चतस्रश्च कला भान्ति जरायुजगणेऽखिले।
पञ्चकोषमपूर्णत्वान्मत्र्येषु प्रायशोऽमराः । ॥
shakti_gita::141.verse_hindi: और सब जरायुजों में चार कलाओं का विकास होता है। हे देवगण ! पञ्चकोष के पूर्ण अधिकारी होने के कारण
shakti_gita::141.english_translation: In all beings born of birth and decay, four faculties manifest; immortals usually possess the complete five sheaths.
shakti_gita::141.translation_literal: चतस्रश्च (four and) कला (faculties) भान्ति (shine/manifest) जरायुजगणेऽखिले (in all beings born of birth and decay) / पञ्चकोषमपूर्णत्वात् (due to completeness of five sheaths) मृत्येषु (in mortals) प्रायशः (usually) अमराः (immortals).
shakti_gita::141.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::141.essence: Mortals manifest four faculties; immortals embody complete five sheaths of being.
shakti_gita::141.simple_meaning: All beings born and dying show four faculties, but immortals have the full five layers of being.
shakti_gita::141.simple_insight: You can recognize your limits and the fullness others may embody beyond birth and death.
shakti_gita::141.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that all mortal beings, born and subject to decay, manifest four faculties, but immortals possess complete mastery over the five layers (sheaths) of existence, marking a deeper wholeness beyond the mortal condition.
shakti_gita::141.modern_relevance: You notice how your awareness and capacities feel limited compared to moments when you feel fully alive or connected beyond usual limits.
shakti_gita::141.insight: It teaches you to see beyond current limitations by understanding the deeper layers that define immortal wholeness.

shakti_gita::142.verse_sanskrit:
आकलापञ्चकादष्ट कला नूनं चकासति ।
नवारभ्य कला यावत्षोड़शं ये यथायथम् ॥
shakti_gita::142.verse_hindi: मनुष्यों में पांच कलाओं से लेकर आठ कलाओं तक का विकास होता है और साधारणतः अनेक केन्द्रों से आविर्भूत मेरे अवतारों में नव से लेकर सोलह कलाओं का
shakti_gita::142.english_translation: Humans develop from five to eight arts, while my incarnations manifest from nine to sixteen arts in various forms.
shakti_gita::142.translation_literal: आक्लापञ्चकादष्ट (five to eight arts) कला (arts) नूनं (certainly) चकासति (develop) । नवारभ्य (from nine) कला (arts) यावत्षोड़शं (up to sixteen) ये (those) यथायथम् (in various ways) ॥
shakti_gita::142.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::142.essence: Divine forms manifest a wider range of arts than ordinary humans develop.
shakti_gita::142.simple_meaning: Humans can develop five to eight arts, but divine incarnations show from nine to sixteen arts in many forms.
shakti_gita::142.simple_insight: There is a vast range of creative abilities beyond ordinary human development.
shakti_gita::142.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that ordinary humans develop a limited number of arts, but her divine incarnations appear in many forms, expressing a wider range of arts from nine to sixteen, showing her supreme creative power.
shakti_gita::142.insight: Recognize the broader creative potential in divine manifestations compared to common human skills.

shakti_gita::143.verse_sanskrit:
सम्बिकाश्यावतारेषु नानाकेन्द्रोद्भवेषु च ।
कुत्रचिन्मे प्रपूर्य्यन्तेऽवतारे पूर्णसंज्ञके ॥
shakti_gita::143.verse_hindi: यथा आवश्यक विकास  होकर किसी पूर्णावतार में सोलह कलाएँ पूर्ण विकसित होती हैं
shakti_gita::143.english_translation: Just as all sixteen arts fully develop in a necessary incarnation of Sambika.
shakti_gita::143.translation_literal: सम्बिकाश्यावतारेषु (in Sambika's incarnations) नानाकेन्द्रोद्भवेषु (in many central manifestations) कुत्रचिन्मे (somewhere) प्रपूर्य्यन्तेऽवतारे (are fulfilled in incarnations) पूर्णसंज्ञके (called complete).
shakti_gita::143.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::143.essence: Certain divine incarnations fully embody all aspects of creative mastery.
shakti_gita::143.simple_meaning: In some incarnations of the Goddess Sambika, all sixteen traditional arts become fully realized and complete.
shakti_gita::143.simple_insight: Certain forms of the divine show complete mastery of all arts, reflecting full creative power.
shakti_gita::143.detailed_meaning: The narrator, Suta, describes how the Goddess Sambika manifests in various incarnations, some of which are perfect and complete, embodying all sixteen arts fully developed.
shakti_gita::143.insight: Recognize that some expressions of the divine or your talents manifest in complete, full forms, not partial.

shakti_gita::144.verse_sanskrit:
मच्छक्ते: षोड़शानान्तु कलानामस्ति पूर्णता।
मदाज्ञारूपधर्मेऽतो ज्ञेयो धर्मः सनातनः ॥
shakti_gita::144.verse_hindi: मेरी शक्ति की षोडश कलाओं की पूर्णता मेरी आज्ञारूपी धर्म में विद्यमान है इसी कारण धर्म को सनातन जानना उचित है।
shakti_gita::144.english_translation: The completeness of my sixteen arts resides in my command-like dharma; this is why dharma is rightly known as eternal.
shakti_gita::144.translation_literal: मच्छक्ते: (my power’s) / षोड़शानान्तु (sixteen and more) / कलानामस्ति (of arts is) / पूर्णता (completeness). / मदाज्ञारूपधर्मेऽतो (in my command-form dharma is) / ज्ञेयो (to be known) / धर्मः (dharma) / सनातनः (eternal).
shakti_gita::144.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::144.essence: True purpose is the complete, eternal power expressed through inner command.
shakti_gita::144.simple_meaning: Your true purpose is the complete expression of a powerful inner command that never ends.
shakti_gita::144.simple_insight: Knowing your true purpose connects you with an unbroken source of power and stability.
shakti_gita::144.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Devi reveals that her divine power expresses itself fully through sixteen arts, symbolizing completeness, all embodied in her eternal dharma which is like a perfect command. This shows that true dharma is an unchanging, foundational force.
shakti_gita::144.modern_relevance: When you feel scattered or unsure, remember your core purpose holds a complete and enduring power guiding you steadily.
shakti_gita::144.insight: It shifts focus from fragmented efforts to recognizing your inner command as the source of lasting strength.

shakti_gita::145.verse_sanskrit:
अस्म्यतः सर्वधर्माणामाश्रयस्थलमुत्तमम् ।
स्थूलसूक्ष्मात्मकं विश्वं समस्तं सचराचरम् ॥
shakti_gita::145.verse_hindi: इसीलिये मैं सभी धर्मों की उत्तम आश्रयस्थल हूँ और इसी से मेरी आज्ञा रूपी धर्म ही स्थूल सूक्ष्मात्मक तथा स्थावर जंगमात्मक
shakti_gita::145.english_translation: Therefore, I am the supreme refuge of all dharmas, and my command is the dharma that pervades the gross and subtle, the moving and the unmoving universe.
shakti_gita::145.translation_literal: अस्म्यतः (from me) / सर्वधर्माणाम् (of all dharmas) / आश्रयस्थलम् (refuge/place of shelter) / उत्तमम् (the highest) / स्थूलसूक्ष्मात्मकं (gross-subtle nature) / विश्वं (universe) / समस्तं (entire) / सचराचरम् (moving and unmoving)
shakti_gita::145.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::145.essence: The divine is the supreme refuge supporting all true purpose in every form and motion.
shakti_gita::145.simple_meaning: The divine says she is the highest shelter for all true purposes and rules that govern everything, both visible and invisible.
shakti_gita::145.simple_insight: You have a steady refuge that supports every part of your life, no matter how complex.
shakti_gita::145.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals she is the ultimate shelter for all dharma—the principles and duties that govern existence—covering everything from the gross physical world to subtle energies, and all that moves or stands still. She claims her command as the foundation of cosmic order.
shakti_gita::145.modern_relevance: When life feels scattered between many roles and challenges, you can rest in a single steady source that supports every part of your being.
shakti_gita::145.insight: It shifts your trust from scattered external goals to a single, reliable inner refuge that upholds all your paths.

shakti_gita::146.verse_sanskrit:
मदादेशात्मको धर्मो नियमेव विभर्ति सः।
धर्मशक्तेहि मे पूर्णाः कलाः षोडशसंख्यकाः ॥
shakti_gita::146.verse_hindi: समस्त जगत की सर्वदा धारक है। मेरी धर्म शक्ति की पूरी षोड़श कलाएँ
shakti_gita::146.english_translation: My law is inherently myself; it is always sustained by rules. My dharma powers are complete with sixteen arts.
shakti_gita::146.translation_literal: मदादेशात्मको (My-command-self) / धर्मो (law/duty) / नियमेव (only by rules) / विभर्ति (is sustained) / सः (that). / धर्मशक्तेहि (by dharma powers) / मे (my) / पूर्णाः (complete) / कलाः (arts/skills) / षोडशसंख्यकाः (sixteen in number).
shakti_gita::146.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::146.essence: Your true law is the divine power complete in sixteen sustaining arts.
shakti_gita::146.simple_meaning: The true law that governs everything is inseparable from the divine's power, complete in sixteen distinct arts.
shakti_gita::146.simple_insight: You hold within you a complete set of divine powers guiding your true purpose.
shakti_gita::146.detailed_meaning: Devi declares that her law is inseparable from herself and always upheld by divine rules. She is complete with sixteen divine powers that sustain the cosmic order and dharma.
shakti_gita::146.modern_relevance: When you feel scattered or uncertain, remember your inner strength is complete and firmly grounded in many skills and powers.
shakti_gita::146.insight: Recognize your inner being as the source of a complete and sustaining power that guides your purpose.

shakti_gita::147.verse_sanskrit:
आर्य्यजातीयधर्मेषु विद्यन्ते विवुधर्षभाः.!
आर्यजातिरतोऽन्यासामस्त्याधः शिक्षको गुरु ॥
shakti_gita::147.verse_hindi: आर्य जाति के स्वधर्म में विद्यमान हैं, इसलिये आर्य जाति जगत को अन्यान्य जातियों की आदि शिक्षक तथा गुरु है
shakti_gita::147.english_translation: The noble class excels in their true duties and thus serves as the original teacher and guru to other classes.
shakti_gita::147.translation_literal: आर्य्यजातीयधर्मेषु (in noble class duties) / विद्यन्ते (exist) / विवुधर्षभाः (wise bulls). / आर्यजातिरतः (attached to noble class) / अन्यासाम् (of others) / अस्त्य (is) / अधः (below) / शिक्षको (teacher) / गुरु (guru).
shakti_gita::147.speaker: Shakti
shakti_gita::147.essence: Devotion to your true duty makes you a teacher and guide to others.
shakti_gita::147.simple_meaning: Those devoted to their true purpose naturally become teachers and guides for others.
shakti_gita::147.simple_insight: You feel empowered knowing your dedication can inspire those around you.
shakti_gita::147.detailed_meaning: Shakti describes how people devoted to their own true duties become natural examples and teachers, showing others the way by their commitment and integrity.
shakti_gita::147.modern_relevance: When you focus fully on your real work or calling, you influence and guide those around you without needing to teach explicitly.
shakti_gita::147.insight: It encourages you to embrace your true purpose fully, knowing your example leads others.

shakti_gita::148.verse_sanskrit:
आर्यधर्मोऽन्यधर्माणां जनकः पालकोऽस्ति च ।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विव्रतेऽदितिनन्दनाः !॥
shakti_gita::148.verse_hindi: और आर्य धर्म अन्यान्य धर्मों का जनक तथा पालक है, हे देवतागण ! इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है
shakti_gita::148.english_translation: The noble Dharma is the origin and protector of all other dharmas; there is no doubt about this, O divine beings!
shakti_gita::148.translation_literal: आर्यधर्मोऽन्यधर्माणां (noble Dharma/of other dharmas) जनकः (origin) पालकोऽस्ति (protector is) च (also) । नात्र (there is no) कश्चन (any) सन्देहो (doubt) विव्रतेऽदितिनन्दनाः (O offspring of Aditi/divine beings) !
shakti_gita::148.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::148.essence: Your highest purpose is the origin and protector of all other actions.
shakti_gita::148.simple_meaning: The highest or noble purpose is the foundation and protector of all other purposes or duties without any doubt.
shakti_gita::148.simple_insight: You can trust your true purpose; it supports and embraces all other roles you take.
shakti_gita::148.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Devi declares that the noble Dharma is the source and guardian of all other duties and paths. She addresses divine beings to affirm that this truth is beyond doubt, emphasizing the importance of aligning with the highest purpose.
shakti_gita::148.modern_relevance: When you feel pulled in many directions, remember your core purpose is the foundation that holds everything else together.
shakti_gita::148.insight: It teaches you to recognize your deepest purpose as the guiding force behind all your actions and roles.

shakti_gita::149.verse_sanskrit:
यज्ञो दानं तपश्चेति धर्माङ्गत्रयमेव हि ।
मोक्षदं स्यातत्प्रपूर्ण सदद्धयत् क्रमशः कलाः ॥
shakti_gita::149.verse_hindi: यद्यपि यज्ञ, तप और दान यह ही धर्म के तीन अंग क्रमशः धर्मकलाओ की अभिवृद्धि करते हुए पूर्णता को प्राप्त होकर मुक्तिप्रद होते हैं
shakti_gita::149.english_translation: Sacrifice, charity, and disciplined effort are the three parts of dharma that gradually perfect the arts of virtue and lead to freedom.
shakti_gita::149.translation_literal:
यज्ञो (sacrifice) दानं (charity) तपश्चेति (and disciplined effort) धर्माङ्गत्रयमेव (the three limbs of dharma alone) हि (indeed) ।
मोक्षदं (leading to freedom) स्यात् (becomes) अत् (that) प्रपूर्ण (complete) सदद्धयत् (perfecting well) क्रमशः (gradually) कलाः (arts) ॥
shakti_gita::149.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::149.essence: Sacrifice, charity, and disciplined effort together perfect virtue and lead to freedom.
shakti_gita::149.simple_meaning: The three main parts of true duty are sacrifice, giving, and disciplined effort. Together they gradually improve your virtues and lead to inner freedom.
shakti_gita::149.simple_insight: You can grow your character and freedom step by step through steady practice and generosity.
shakti_gita::149.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Devi explains that the three essential parts of dharma—sacrifice (yajna), charity (dana), and disciplined effort (tapas)—work together to refine a person's virtues. Over time, this process leads one toward freedom from bondage.
shakti_gita::149.modern_relevance: When you consistently give your time, resources, and effort to what matters, you build a foundation that frees you from inner struggle.
shakti_gita::149.insight: It teaches you to see sacrifice, giving, and effort as interconnected steps that gradually cultivate freedom and moral excellence.

shakti_gita::150.verse_sanskrit:
धर्मः किन्तु कलानाञ्च साहाय्यात्सम्बिभज्यते ।
नैकाङ्गोपाङ्गपुंजेषु सम्प्रदायव्रजेष्वपि ॥
shakti_gita::150.verse_hindi: किन्तु धर्म अपनी कलाओं की सहायता से अनेक अंग, उपांग और सम्प्रदायों में विभक्त होकर
shakti_gita::150.english_translation: Dharma is divided into many parts, limbs, and traditions, supported by its various skills.
shakti_gita::150.translation_literal: धर्मः (dharma) किन्तु (but) कलानाञ्च (with arts/skills) साहाय्यात्सम्बिभज्यते (is divided) । नैकाङ्गोपाङ्गपुंजेषु (into many parts and limbs) सम्प्रदायव्रजेष्वपि (even in traditions) ॥
shakti_gita::150.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::150.essence: True purpose is many parts working together through diverse skills and traditions.
shakti_gita::150.simple_meaning: Your true purpose includes many skills and traditions, each part supporting the whole.
shakti_gita::150.simple_insight: You can see your purpose as a living whole made of many connected skills.
shakti_gita::150.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that dharma (true purpose) is not a single thing but spreads across many skills, parts, and traditions, showing a rich, interconnected expression of life and duty.
shakti_gita::150.modern_relevance: Your job, hobbies, and relationships each reflect a part of your purpose, all working together even if they seem separate.
shakti_gita::150.insight: Recognize your purpose as a complex whole made of diverse skills and roles, not just one task.

shakti_gita::151.verse_sanskrit:
विधत्तेऽभ्युदयश्चैप नृणां नानाधिकारिणाम् ।
धारिकाया द्विधा भिन्ना धर्मशक्तेः कलाः सुराः ॥
shakti_gita::151.verse_hindi: विभिन्न प्रकार के अधिकारियों का अभ्युदय करता है । हे देवतागण ! धर्म की धारिका शक्ति की पूर्णकला दो भागों में
shakti_gita::151.english_translation: Different kinds of authorities arise among humans. O divine beings! The full power of dharma is divided into two parts.
shakti_gita::151.translation_literal: विधत्तेऽभ्युदयश्चैप (arises and also the rising) / नृणां (of humans) / नानाधिकारिणाम् (of various authorities) / धारिकाया (of the bearer) / द्विधा (in two ways) / भिन्ना (divided) / धर्मशक्तेः (of the power of dharma) / कलाः (arts/parts) / सुराः (O divine beings)
shakti_gita::151.speaker: Shakti
shakti_gita::151.essence: The power of dharma divides into two parts, giving rise to diverse human authorities.
shakti_gita::151.simple_meaning: Various authorities or powers arise among people. The full power of dharma is split into two parts.
shakti_gita::151.simple_insight: Power and roles among people are diverse but rooted in a common source split in two.
shakti_gita::151.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Devi addresses divine beings explaining that different authorities or powers arise among humans, and that the power supporting dharma is divided into two distinct arts or parts, highlighting the complexity of cosmic order and dharma's functioning.
shakti_gita::151.insight: It reveals that the power sustaining order manifests in different forms and roles, shaping how people act.

shakti_gita::152.verse_sanskrit:
सत्मप्रवृत्त्यात्मकं नूनं निवृत्त्यात्मकमेव च।
नारीधर्म नृधर्मश्च न्यस्यन्तीह पृथक्तया ॥
shakti_gita::152.verse_hindi: विभक्त होकर प्रवृत्ति तथा निवृत्ति मूलक पुरुषधर्म और नारी धर्म को अलग अलग स्थापित करती है।
shakti_gita::152.english_translation: The duties of men and women are distinctly established based on their active and inactive natures.
shakti_gita::152.translation_literal: सत्मप्रवृत्त्यात्मकं (based on the active nature) / नूनं (indeed) / निवृत्त्यात्मकमेव (and based on the inactive nature) / च (also) / नारीधर्म (woman's duty) / नृधर्मश्च (and man's duty) / न्यस्यन्तीह (are established here) / पृथक्तया (separately).
shakti_gita::152.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::152.essence: Men's and women's duties differ based on their inherent active or inactive nature.
shakti_gita::152.simple_meaning: Men's and women's duties are set apart here according to their distinct active and inactive tendencies.
shakti_gita::152.simple_insight: Different roles arise from inherent nature, offering clarity without judgment.
shakti_gita::152.detailed_meaning: The Goddess explains how the natural qualities of activity and inactivity form the basis for assigning separate duties to men and women, reflecting their unique roles within the cosmic order.
shakti_gita::152.insight: Recognize that duties can arise from natural tendencies without implying superiority or limitation.

shakti_gita::153.verse_sanskrit:
प्रवृत्त्यात्मकधर्मस्य संस्थाप्यादर्शमुत्तमम्।
नन्वहं विष्णुरूपेण धर्मान वर्णाश्रमाभिधान् ॥
shakti_gita::153.verse_hindi: मैं ही विष्णुरूप से प्रवृत्तिधर्म का उत्तम आदर्श स्थापित करके मनुष्यों  को स्वर्णाश्रम धर्म का
shakti_gita::153.english_translation: I, in the form of Vishnu, have established the highest ideal of engaged duty, the dharma of the varna and ashrama systems, for humanity.
shakti_gita::153.translation_literal: प्रवृत्त्यात्मकधर्मस्य (of engaged duty) संस्थाप्य (having established) आदर्शम् (ideal) उत्तमम् (highest) नन्व (indeed) अहं (I) विष्णुरूपेण (in Vishnu's form) धर्मान् (duties) वर्णाश्रमाभिधान् (of the varna and ashrama systems)
shakti_gita::153.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::153.essence: Your present duties embody a highest ideal established for your life’s purpose.
shakti_gita::153.simple_meaning: The highest example of acting according to your role and stage in life is established as a guide for humans.
shakti_gita::153.simple_insight: You can trust that your role and duties have a higher purpose, giving your actions meaning.
shakti_gita::153.detailed_meaning: Devi, speaking as the divine power, explains that by taking the form of Vishnu, she has set the highest standard for how people should live according to their social roles and life stages, guiding their actions with purpose.
shakti_gita::153.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by choices, remembering your specific responsibilities can anchor your efforts with clear purpose.
shakti_gita::153.insight: It teaches you to see your current duties as expressions of a greater ideal, giving deeper motivation.

shakti_gita::154.verse_sanskrit:
मानवैः पालयन्तीह मुक्तेस्तानास्पदं नये ।
भूयः शम्भुस्वरूपेण यथावर्णाश्रमं शनैः ॥
shakti_gita::154.verse_hindi: पालन कराती हुई उनको कैवल्यपद की ओर अग्रसर करती हूँ और मैं ही पुनः शिवरूप से वर्णाश्रम धर्म के अनुसार शनैः शनैः
shakti_gita::154.english_translation: I protect those who seek liberation and gently guide them step by step in the form of Shiva according to the duties of varna and ashrama.
shakti_gita::154.translation_literal: मानवैः (by humans) पालयन्तीह (protecting here) मुक्तेः (of liberation) तान् (them) अस्पदं (towards the goal) नये (I lead). भूयः (again) शम्भुस्वरूपेण (in the form of Shambhu/Shiva) यथा (according to) वर्णाश्रमं (varna and ashrama duties) शनैः (slowly) शनैः (step by step).
shakti_gita::154.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::154.essence: Freedom comes gently through steady adherence to your true roles and duties.
shakti_gita::154.simple_meaning: You are protected and slowly guided toward freedom by following your rightful duties and roles.
shakti_gita::154.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing guidance comes gently through your steady responsibilities.
shakti_gita::154.detailed_meaning: Devi promises to protect those seeking freedom and to guide them gradually, embodying Shiva, by helping them follow their societal and spiritual roles called varna and ashrama.
shakti_gita::154.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by big changes, remember steady progress through your daily roles brings true growth.
shakti_gita::154.insight: This teaches you to trust gradual transformation through consistent, responsible action instead of rushing results.

shakti_gita::155.verse_sanskrit:
निवृत्त्यात्मकधर्मस्य सत्यध्वपरिदर्शिका ।
पन्थानं दुगम मुक्तेः कुर्वेऽहं सुगमं द्रुतम् ॥
shakti_gita::155.verse_hindi: निवृत्तिधर्म की पथप्रदर्शक बनकर कठिन मुक्ति पथ को शीघ्र सरल करती हूँ
shakti_gita::155.english_translation: Becoming the guide of the path of renunciation, I swiftly make the difficult path of liberation easy.
shakti_gita::155.translation_literal: निवृत्त्यात्मकधर्मस्य (of the renunciation-based conduct) / सत्यध्वपरिदर्शिका (truth-path revealer) / पन्थानं (path) / दुगम (difficult) / मुक्तेः (of liberation) / कुर्वेऽहं (I make) / सुगमं (easy) / द्रुतम् (swiftly)
shakti_gita::155.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::155.essence: Sincere renunciation guided well turns the difficult path to freedom into an easy one.
shakti_gita::155.simple_meaning: I show the way to renounce attachments, making the hard path to freedom quicker and easier.
shakti_gita::155.simple_insight: There is relief in knowing that surrender can transform struggle into ease.
shakti_gita::155.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that by guiding sincere renunciation, she transforms the difficult journey to liberation into a swift and easy one, offering hope to those seeking freedom.
shakti_gita::155.modern_relevance: When you decide to let go of old burdens, what once felt overwhelming can suddenly seem manageable and fast.
shakti_gita::155.insight: It teaches you that clear guidance and sincere renunciation can speed your progress toward freedom.

shakti_gita::156.verse_hindi: इसी कारण मेरे जगद्गुरुस्वरूप की उपासना और ध्यान इन्हीं विष्णु और शिवरूप में करने की आज्ञा वेद ने दी है
shakti_gita::156.english_translation: Therefore, the Vedas have instructed worship and meditation on my form as the world teacher, in the forms of Shiva and Vishnu.
shakti_gita::156.translation_literal: उपदिष्टे (instructed) अतो (therefore) वेदैः (by the Vedas) रूपास्ति (is worship) ध्यानम् (meditation) अपि (also) अयोः (of these two) शिव (Shiva) विष्णु (Vishnu) स्वरूपयोः (forms) जगद् (world) गुरु (teacher) स्वरूपस्य (form of)
shakti_gita::156.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::156.essence: The Vedas guide worship of the divine as both Shiva and Vishnu, the world teacher.
shakti_gita::156.simple_meaning: The Vedas instruct you to worship and meditate on the divine appearing as both Shiva and Vishnu, the universal teacher.
shakti_gita::156.simple_insight: You can find guidance and connection by honoring the divine in multiple forms.
shakti_gita::156.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the ancient scriptures, the Vedas, guide seekers to focus their devotion and meditation on her cosmic presence expressed as Shiva and Vishnu, representing the totality of divine teaching and power.
shakti_gita::156.modern_relevance: When you feel scattered, remembering that the divine can be seen in different ways helps you connect deeply in your own unique way.
shakti_gita::156.insight: It invites you to embrace diverse expressions of the divine for your spiritual connection and meditation.

shakti_gita::157.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण नारीधर्म के लिये भी मेरे तीन स्वरुप आदर्श रूप से जगत्कल्याण के लिए अवलम्बनीय हैं
shakti_gita::157.english_translation: O divine beings, even for the purpose of woman’s duty, my three forms are to be taken as ideal for the welfare of the world.
shakti_gita::157.translation_literal: नारीधर्मार्थमपि (even for the purpose of woman’s duty) एवम् (thus) मत् (my) स्वरूपत्रयं (three forms) सुराः (divine beings) ग्राह्यम् (to be taken) आदर्शरूपेण (as ideal form) विश्वकल्याणसम्पदे (for world welfare)
shakti_gita::157.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::157.essence: Ideal forms of the divine guide personal duty toward universal welfare.
shakti_gita::157.simple_meaning: The divine three forms act as perfect examples for women’s duties, supporting the well-being of the entire world.
shakti_gita::157.simple_insight: There is strength and guidance in recognizing ideal forms that support both personal duty and universal good.
shakti_gita::157.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses divine beings, explaining that her three forms serve as ideal models even for women’s duties, emphasizing their role in promoting the welfare of all beings.
shakti_gita::157.modern_relevance: You may look to role models who embody your values, guiding your actions toward contributing to greater good beyond personal goals.
shakti_gita::157.insight: This verse shifts focus from isolated duty to seeing personal roles as part of a larger, world-benefiting pattern.

shakti_gita::158.verse_sanskrit:
अहमेव महामाया प्रोच्ये भेदविवज्जिता।
गौरी प्रेमप्रधानाऽहं दुर्गा शक्तिमधानिका ॥
shakti_gita::158.verse_hindi: भेद रहित रूप से मैं ही महामाया, प्रेम प्रधाना, मैं ही गौरी और शक्ति प्रधाना मैं ही दुर्गा कही जाती हूँ
shakti_gita::158.english_translation: I am the great illusion without division, full of love as Gauri, and full of power as Durga.
shakti_gita::158.translation_literal: अहमेव (I alone) महामाया (great illusion) प्रोच्ये (called) भेदविवज्जिता (without division) । गौरी (Gauri) प्रेमप्रधानाऽहं (I am full of love) दुर्गा (Durga) शक्तिमधानिका (full of power) ॥
shakti_gita::158.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::158.essence: The divine is one indivisible presence of love and power within you.
shakti_gita::158.simple_meaning: The divine reveals itself as one without separation, full of love as Gauri and full of power as Durga.
shakti_gita::158.simple_insight: You are not separate from the divine power and love; they are your true nature.
shakti_gita::158.detailed_meaning: The Goddess speaks, declaring she alone is the great illusion without division, embodying both loving Gauri and powerful Durga. She blends compassion and strength as one divine reality with no separation.
shakti_gita::158.modern_relevance: When you feel divided between your gentle kindness and inner strength, remember they are one expression of your true self.
shakti_gita::158.insight: Recognize that love and power coexist within you as inseparable aspects of the true self.

shakti_gita::159.verse_sanskrit:
एतद्रूपत्रयं नूनं सती नारी विभर्त्यहो।
पुण्ये भारतवर्षेऽस्मिन्यायजातौ प्रजायते ॥
shakti_gita::159.verse_hindi: जो सती नारी पवित्र भारतवर्ष और आर्यजाति में उत्पन्न होती है, वह इन तीनो स्वरूपों को अवश्य धारण करती है
shakti_gita::159.english_translation: A virtuous woman born in pure Bharata and noble lineage certainly embodies these three forms.
shakti_gita::159.translation_literal: एतद् (this) रूपत्रयं (triple form) नूनं (indeed) सती (virtuous woman) नारी (woman) विभर्त्य (bearing) अहो (indeed) । पुण्ये (pure) भारतवर्षेऽस्मिन (in Bharata) यायजातौ (in noble lineage) प्रजायते (is born) ॥
shakti_gita::159.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::159.essence: A virtuous woman born in pure land carries three inherent forms.
shakti_gita::159.simple_meaning: A virtuous woman born in pure Bharata and noble lineage carries these three forms.
shakti_gita::159.simple_insight: Virtue and lineage are described as carrying essential qualities in tradition.
shakti_gita::159.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that a virtuous woman born in the pure land of Bharata and noble Aryan lineage naturally carries three essential forms, referring to qualities or principles she embodies.
shakti_gita::159.insight: Recognizing qualities attributed to heritage and virtue requires understanding cultural context.

shakti_gita::160.verse_sanskrit:
आर्यजातौ हि नारीणामादर्शः परमः सती।
जगन्माता महामाया ब्रह्मशक्तिः सनातनी ॥
shakti_gita::160.verse_hindi: आर्यजाति में स्त्रियों की परम आदर्शरूपा जगन्माता महामाया सनातनी ब्रह्मशक्ति सती देवी हैं
shakti_gita::160.english_translation: Among noble women, the supreme ideal is Sati, the eternal great mother, Mahamaya, the Brahman power.
shakti_gita::160.translation_literal: आर्यजातौ (noble class) / हि (indeed) / नारीणाम् (of women) / आदर्शः (ideal) / परमः (supreme) / सती (Sati) / जगन्माता (world mother) / महामाया (great illusion) / ब्रह्मशक्तिः (power of Brahman) / सनातनी (eternal)
shakti_gita::160.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::160.essence: The highest ideal for noble women is the eternal divine mother embodying supreme power.
shakti_gita::160.simple_meaning: The highest example for noble women is the eternal mother figure who is the great divine power behind everything.
shakti_gita::160.simple_insight: You carry a timeless, powerful energy as a source of strength and care.
shakti_gita::160.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Devi declares that the supreme ideal for noble women is Sati, the eternal great mother Mahamaya, who embodies the divine power of Brahman. This teaches reverence for the divine feminine as both creative force and nurturer.
shakti_gita::160.modern_relevance: You can recognize your own inner strength as a timeless source of care and power, beyond fleeting roles or appearances.
shakti_gita::160.insight: It invites you to see yourself as a living expression of the eternal divine force that nurtures and sustains all life.

shakti_gita::161.verse_sanskrit:
परब्रह्मणि सा नित्यमेवं लीना यतोऽस्तिता।
तस्या भाति पृथङ्नातोऽद्वितीयं ब्रह्म निर्गुणम् ॥
shakti_gita::161.verse_hindi: वे इस प्रकार से परब्रह्म में लीन रहती हैं कि, उनका अस्तित्व अलग नहीं विदित होता है इसी कारण ब्रह्म निर्गुण और अद्वितीय हैं
shakti_gita::161.english_translation: She remains eternally absorbed in the supreme reality, so her existence is not separate; thus, the supreme reality is without qualities and unique.
shakti_gita::161.translation_literal: परब्रह्मणि (in the supreme reality) सा (she) नित्यमेवं (eternally so) लीना (absorbed) यतोऽस्तिता (because existing); तस्या (of her) भाति (shines) पृथङ्नात (not separately) अद्वितीयं (unique) ब्रह्म (supreme reality) निर्गुणम् (without qualities).
shakti_gita::161.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::161.essence: Your true self is eternally united with the unique, quality-free supreme reality.
shakti_gita::161.simple_meaning: She is always completely absorbed in the supreme reality so that her existence is not separate from it. This shows the supreme reality is unique and without qualities.
shakti_gita::161.simple_insight: You can rest in knowing your true self is never apart from the supreme reality.
shakti_gita::161.detailed_meaning: The Goddess explains her eternal unity with the supreme reality (parabrahman). Her existence does not stand apart; it is fully merged, revealing the supreme reality as unique and beyond qualities. This teaches non-duality at the deepest level.
shakti_gita::161.modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or fragmented, remember your true self is inseparable from the vast unchanging reality that shines within you.
shakti_gita::161.insight: It shows you how to see yourself not as a separate entity but as inseparable from the supreme reality beyond all attributes.

shakti_gita::162.verse_hindi: शक्तिमान् ब्रह्म और ब्रह्मशक्ति महामाया, इन दोनों में भेद यद्यपि कहा जाता है परन्तु वस्तुतः तत्त्वदर्शी योगी लोग दोनों में अभेद देखते हैं
shakti_gita::162.english_translation: Though power and the empowered are said to be distinct, truly the discerning yogis see no difference between them.
shakti_gita::162.translation_literal: शक्तिशक्तिमर्तोभेदं (power and empowered distinction) / वदन्ति (say) / परमार्थतः (in ultimate truth) / अभेदश्चानुपश्यन्ति (non-difference also see) / योगिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः (yogis discerning reality)
shakti_gita::162.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::162.essence: True insight reveals no difference between the power and the one empowered.
shakti_gita::162.simple_meaning: People often say power and the one with power are different, but wise yogis see they are actually the same.
shakti_gita::162.simple_insight: You can feel the relief of knowing your inner power is not separate from who you truly are.
shakti_gita::162.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that while ordinary speech divides power and the one who has it, yogis who see the truth understand there is no real division between divine energy and the true self.
shakti_gita::162.modern_relevance: When you feel powerless or disconnected from your ability, this teaching reminds you that the power you seek is not outside but within you.
shakti_gita::162.insight: It shifts your understanding from seeing power as external to recognizing it as your own true nature.

shakti_gita::163.verse_sanskrit:
सत्प्रेम्णैव सती नारी यथा ब्रह्मण्यहं तथा।
पत्यौ तन्मयतामेस पुरुषत्वं प्रपद्यते ॥
shakti_gita::163.verse_hindi: जिस प्रकार ब्रह्मशक्ति ब्रह्म में अभेदभाव से लीन रहती है, उसी प्रकार सत्ती स्त्री उत्तम प्रेम के द्वारा पति में तन्मयता प्राप्त होकर पुरुषत्व को प्राप्त हो जाती है
shakti_gita::163.english_translation: Just as the supreme power remains inseparably absorbed in the supreme reality, a devoted wife attains true manhood by becoming fully absorbed in her husband through pure love.
shakti_gita::163.translation_literal: सत्प्रेम्णैव (by true love) / सती (a devoted wife) / नारी (woman) / यथा (just as) / ब्रह्मण्यहं (in the supreme reality) / तथा (thus) / पत्यु (in the husband) / तन्मयताम् (complete absorption) / एष (this) / पुरुषत्वं (true manhood) / प्रपद्यते (attains)
shakti_gita::163.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::163.essence: Pure love merges two beings so fully that it transforms their true nature.
shakti_gita::163.simple_meaning: A devoted wife who loves purely and fully merges her being with her husband, gaining true identity through that union.
shakti_gita::163.simple_insight: There is a deep power in loving fully that transforms your very self.
shakti_gita::163.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that just as her supreme power remains fully absorbed in the supreme reality without separation, a devoted wife who loves purely and fully merges into her husband attains true manhood—meaning she realizes her fullest potential through loving union.
shakti_gita::163.modern_relevance: When you truly dedicate yourself to someone with pure love, your identity and strength grow beyond what you imagined.
shakti_gita::163.insight: It teaches you to see love as a transformative union that reshapes your identity, not just an emotion.

shakti_gita::164.verse_sanskrit:
प्रेम्णोऽस्ति त्रिविधो भेदस्तत्रायः स ममेत्ययम् ।
अहं तस्येत्ययं मध्यः सोऽहमस्मीति चान्तिमः ॥
shakti_gita::164.verse_hindi: प्रेम के तीन भेद हैं। उनमें से पहला " वह मेरे हैं " यह है, "मैं उनकी हूँ  " यह मध्यम अर्थात् द्वितीय है और " वह मैं हूँ " अर्थात् वह और मैं एक ही हूँ  यह अन्तिम है
shakti_gita::164.english_translation: Love has three kinds: 'They belong to me,' 'I belong to them,' and the highest, 'They and I are one.'
shakti_gita::164.translation_literal: प्रेम्णोऽस्ति (of love there is) / त्रिविधो (threefold) / भेदः (distinction) / तत्र (there) / आयः (types) / स (that) / ममेत्ययम् (mine is the first) / अहं (I) / तस्येत्ययं (his/hers is the second) / मध्यः (middle) / सोऽहमस्मीति (I am he/she, the last)
shakti_gita::164.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::164.essence: Love unfolds from possession through belonging to unity with the beloved.
shakti_gita::164.simple_meaning: Love appears in three stages: first, seeing someone as mine; second, feeling I belong to them; and third, realizing we are one.
shakti_gita::164.simple_insight: Love frees you when it shifts from possession to oneness with another.
shakti_gita::164.detailed_meaning: Devi explains three stages of love to the listener: possession ('they are mine'), devotion ('I am theirs'), and unity ('they and I are one'). This reveals deeper devotion beyond ownership or separation.
shakti_gita::164.modern_relevance: You notice how your feelings change from wanting to control someone, to belonging to them, to truly feeling inseparable in connection.
shakti_gita::164.insight: It invites you to shift from holding to merging in love, dissolving boundaries between self and other.

shakti_gita::165.verse_sanskrit:
इहाद्वैतदशायां हि स्वानुभूत्येकगोचरः।
ब्रह्मणस्तस्य शक्तेश्च भेदाभावः प्रसिध्यति ॥
shakti_gita::165.verse_hindi: इस अन्तिम प्रेम में अद्वैत दशा होती है, जिसमें स्वानुभवमात्रगम्य ब्रह्म और उनकी शक्ति का भेदाभाव (अभिन्नता) सिद्ध होता है
shakti_gita::165.english_translation: In this final state of non-duality, Brahman and its power are revealed as inseparable through direct experience.
shakti_gita::165.translation_literal: इहाद्वैतदशायां (in this non-dual state) हि (indeed) स्वानुभूत्येकगोचरः (directly experienced alone) ब्रह्मणः (of Brahman) तस्य (its) शक्तेश्च (and its power) भेदाभावः (difference-nonexistence) प्रसिध्यति (is established).
shakti_gita::165.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::165.essence: The supreme reality and its power are one in direct experience of non-duality.
shakti_gita::165.simple_meaning: When you reach the highest state of oneness, you directly experience that the supreme reality and its power are not separate but one.
shakti_gita::165.simple_insight: There is deep peace in knowing the true self and its creative power are inseparable.
shakti_gita::165.detailed_meaning: Devi describes the ultimate spiritual state where the distinction between the supreme reality (Brahman) and its dynamic power (Shakti) disappears. This non-dual realization comes through direct inner experience, revealing their essential unity.
shakti_gita::165.modern_relevance: In moments of deep clarity, you may sense that your true self and your creative energy are not two but one seamless flow.
shakti_gita::165.insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as divided into static self and separate energy, to recognizing an inseparable unity.

shakti_gita::166.verse_sanskrit:
दाम्पत्यप्रेम्ण एवैषा दशा सर्वोत्तमा मता।
द्वैतसंकुलसंसारे प्रेमाऽयमतिदुर्लभः ॥
shakti_gita::166.verse_hindi: यही दाम्पत्य प्रेम की सर्वोत्तम दशा मानी गई है। द्वैतभावपूर्ण संसार में यह प्रेम अति दुर्लभ है
shakti_gita::166.english_translation: This is considered the highest state of marital love. Such love is very rare in a world full of duality.
shakti_gita::166.translation_literal: दाम्पत्यप्रेम्ण (marital love) एवैषा (this indeed) दशा (state) सर्वोत्तमा (highest) मता (considered). द्वैतसंकुलसंसारे (in duality-filled world) प्रेमाऽयम् (this love) अति (very) दुर्लभः (rare).
shakti_gita::166.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::166.essence: The highest marital love is rare amid a world full of division.
shakti_gita::166.simple_meaning: The highest form of love between partners is very rare in a world full of separation and difference.
shakti_gita::166.simple_insight: You feel the preciousness of a deep, united love amid everyday divisions.
shakti_gita::166.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Devi explains that in a world marked by separateness and duality, the purest form of love between spouses is considered the highest and yet is seldom found.
shakti_gita::166.modern_relevance: You notice how hard it is to maintain deep, united love in relationships amid everyday misunderstandings and differences.
shakti_gita::166.insight: It encourages you to cherish and recognize rare, true marital love despite common conflicts and separations.

shakti_gita::167.verse_sanskrit:
परमज्ञानजननी महामायैव सर्वथा।
सर्वोत्तमपतिप्रेम्ण आदर्शो विद्यते स्वतः ॥
shakti_gita::167.verse_hindi: परमज्ञान की जननी महामाया ही सब प्रकार से सर्वोत्तम पति-प्रेम की स्वतः आदर्शरूपा है
shakti_gita::167.english_translation: The great illusion, mother of supreme knowledge, is naturally the perfect model of highest devoted love for the true self.
shakti_gita::167.translation_literal: परमज्ञानजननी (mother of supreme knowledge) महामायैव (indeed great illusion) सर्वथा (in all ways) । सर्वोत्तमपतिप्रेम्ण (of the highest devoted love) आदर्शो (model) विद्यते (exists) स्वतः (naturally) ॥
shakti_gita::167.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::167.essence: The source of highest knowledge naturally embodies perfect devoted love for the true self.
shakti_gita::167.simple_meaning: The great creative power that gives rise to true knowledge also naturally embodies the highest form of devoted love for the true self.
shakti_gita::167.simple_insight: You are connected to a source that is both wisdom and perfect devoted love naturally.
shakti_gita::167.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the cosmic power called Mahamaya is both the source of supreme knowledge and the natural embodiment of highest devoted love for the true self, showing non-duality between wisdom and devotion.
shakti_gita::167.modern_relevance: When you feel divided between head and heart, know that deep within you, wisdom and love are one and the same.
shakti_gita::167.insight: It shifts your view from seeing knowledge and love as separate to recognizing their inseparable unity in your inner being.

shakti_gita::168.verse_sanskrit:
सती द्वैतदशायां हि शिवहृदासिनी शिवा।
नार्यादर्शोऽस्ति तददुर्गा देवीषु परमा मता ॥
shakti_gita::168.verse_hindi: दाम्पत्य प्रेम में यह ही तीन रीतियाँ प्रेम की सर्वोत्तम कही गई हैं- शिवह्रदयवासिनी सती शिवा, द्वैतदशा में नारी जाति की आदर्श रूपा है, इसी कारण देवियों में दुर्गा श्रेष्ठ मानी गई हैं
shakti_gita::168.english_translation: In the state of duality, Sati Shiva, who dwells in Shiva's heart, is the ideal woman; therefore, Durga is considered the highest among the goddesses.
shakti_gita::168.translation_literal: सती (Sati) / द्वैतदशायां (in the state of duality) / हि (indeed) / शिवहृदासिनी (dwelling in Shiva's heart) / शिवा (Shiva's consort) / नार्यादर्शोऽस्ति (is the ideal of women) / तद् (that) / दुर्गा (Durga) / देवीषु (among goddesses) / परमा (highest) / मता (considered).
shakti_gita::168.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::168.essence: Sati embodies the ideal woman in duality, making Durga supreme among goddesses.
shakti_gita::168.simple_meaning: Sati, who lives in Shiva's heart, is the ideal woman in duality, so Durga is the highest goddess.
shakti_gita::168.simple_insight: The best model for devotion and love is found in the divine feminine's pure form.
shakti_gita::168.detailed_meaning: This verse praises Sati, the consort of Shiva, as the ideal woman during the experience of duality. Because of her example, Durga is regarded as the supreme goddess among all divine feminine beings.
shakti_gita::168.insight: Recognize an ideal of devotion and strength embodied in feminine form as inspiration rather than a fixed standard.

shakti_gita::169.verse_sanskrit:
स ममेत्यहमस्यति परिशुद्धे उभे दशे ।
चरित्रे विमले तस्याः शिवायाः पूर्णतां गते ॥
shakti_gita::169.verse_hindi: " वह मेरे हैं " और " मैं उनकी हूँ " अह  दोनों परिशुद्ध दशाएं उन शिवा के विमल चरित्र में पूर्णता को प्राप्त हुई हैं
shakti_gita::169.english_translation: "'She is mine' and 'I am hers'—both pure states reach perfection in the spotless character of that Shiva."
shakti_gita::169.translation_literal: स (she) ममेत्यहमस्यति ('mine' and 'I am hers') परिशुद्धे (pure) उभे (both) दशे (states) / चरित्रे (in character) विमले (spotless) तस्याः (her) शिवायाः (of Shiva) पूर्णतां (perfection) गये (have reached)
shakti_gita::169.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::169.essence: Perfect belonging arises when mutual love becomes purely flawless and complete.
shakti_gita::169.simple_meaning: The pure feeling of 'she is mine' and 'I am hers' reaches complete perfection in the flawless nature of Shiva.
shakti_gita::169.simple_insight: You can feel perfect belonging that is pure and complete with the divine.
shakti_gita::169.detailed_meaning: Devi describes a state of total mutual belonging between herself and Shiva, where the feelings of possession and surrender both become perfectly pure, uniting in flawless character and complete harmony.
shakti_gita::169.modern_relevance: When you feel deeply connected and fully accepted by someone, the sense of belonging becomes pure and perfect, free of doubt or fear.
shakti_gita::169.insight: It shows that true devotion is a balanced, pure relationship of mutual belonging without ego or confusion.

shakti_gita::170.verse_sanskrit:
अहमस्य भवामीति विज्ञानस्यानुसारतः।
सतीभावे सदा गौरी विद्यारूपैव विद्यते ॥
shakti_gita::170.verse_hindi: "मैं उनकी हूँ " इस विज्ञान के अनुसार सतीभाव में गौरी सदा विद्यारूपा ही है
shakti_gita::170.english_translation: "According to true knowledge, Gauri is always the form of wisdom in the state of being devoted to 'I am theirs'."
shakti_gita::170.translation_literal: अहमस्य (of mine) भवामीति (I am) विज्ञानस्यानुसारतः (according to knowledge) । सतीभावे (in the devoted state) सदा (always) गौरी (Gauri) विद्यारूपैव (in the form of wisdom alone) विद्यते (exists) ॥
shakti_gita::170.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::170.essence: True belonging is the living form of your inner wisdom.
shakti_gita::170.simple_meaning: When you truly feel devoted and connected, your inner being is always the form of wisdom itself.
shakti_gita::170.simple_insight: Feeling deep belonging opens you to the presence of your true wisdom.
shakti_gita::170.detailed_meaning: The Goddess explains that when someone fully embraces the feeling of belonging as 'I am theirs'—complete devotion—the inner being appears as pure wisdom. This teaching reveals how devotion and wisdom are intimately connected in the spiritual path.
shakti_gita::170.modern_relevance: You may feel lost in identity struggles, but when you find a deep sense of belonging, your inner clarity naturally shines.
shakti_gita::170.insight: It invites you to see devotion as a path that reveals your true wisdom, not just an emotion.

shakti_gita::171.verse_sanskrit:
अत एव च सा देवी पतिनिष्ठा पतिव्रता ।
पत्युर्निंन्दां निशम्यैव स्वकीयं वपुरसजत् ॥
shakti_gita::171.verse_hindi: इसी कारण उन पतिनिष्ठा पतिव्रता देवी ने पति की निन्दा सुनते ही अपना शरीर त्याग कर दिया था
shakti_gita::171.english_translation: Therefore, that devoted and faithful goddess, hearing her husband's criticism, immediately gave up her own body.
shakti_gita::171.translation_literal: अत (therefore) एव (indeed) च (also) सा (she) देवी (goddess) पतिनिष्ठा (devoted to husband) पतिव्रता (faithful wife) । पत्युर्निंदां (husband's criticism) निशम्यैव (immediately upon hearing) स्वकीयं (own) वपुरसजत् (gave up body) ॥
shakti_gita::171.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::171.essence: Deep loyalty can prompt immediate and intense self-sacrifice upon hearing criticism.
shakti_gita::171.simple_meaning: The goddess, devoted and faithful to her husband, gave up her body as soon as she heard his criticism.
shakti_gita::171.simple_insight: A strong sense of loyalty can lead to extreme actions when faced with criticism.
shakti_gita::171.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the goddess, known for her faithfulness and devotion to her husband, hears him speak ill of her. Her loyalty is so deep that she chooses to abandon her body immediately, showing the intensity of her commitment.
shakti_gita::171.insight: It shows how attachment to others' opinions can trigger extreme emotional responses and actions.

shakti_gita::172.verse_sanskrit:
अनन्यप्रणयेनैव शिवे ब्रह्ममये शिवा।
विद्यास्वरुपा सा देवी वर्तते विमलाशया ॥
shakti_gita::172.verse_hindi: ब्रह्ममय शिव में अनन्य प्रेम से ही परम पवित्रा विद्यास्वरूपा वह शिवा देवी विद्यमान रहती हैं
shakti_gita::172.english_translation: Devi Shiva, embodying supreme purity and the form of wisdom, dwells in Shiva with exclusive devoted love.
shakti_gita::172.translation_literal: अनन्यप्रणयेनैव (with exclusive devoted love) शिवे (in Shiva) ब्रह्ममये (full of supreme reality) शिवा (Devi Shiva) विद्यास्वरुपा (form of wisdom) सा (she) देवी (goddess) वर्तते (dwells) विमलाशया (with pure heart)
shakti_gita::172.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::172.essence: Pure wisdom arises from exclusive devoted love within the supreme being.
shakti_gita::172.simple_meaning: The Goddess Shiva exists purely as wisdom, living in the supreme being Shiva through exclusive devoted love and pure heart.
shakti_gita::172.simple_insight: Feeling exclusive love connects you to the purest wisdom within the divine.
shakti_gita::172.detailed_meaning: Devi Shiva reveals that she is the pure essence of wisdom, living completely in Shiva, the supreme being, through exclusive devoted love and a spotless heart. This moment teaches the unity of devotion and wisdom as one divine reality.
shakti_gita::172.modern_relevance: When you focus your love on your highest values, your inner wisdom shines clearly and purely.
shakti_gita::172.insight: It teaches you to unite exclusive devotion with wisdom to experience the divine fully.

shakti_gita::173.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वशक्तिमयी दुर्गा स ममास्तीति बोधतः ।
ब्रह्मणो निखिला शक्तिः स्वतस्तत्र प्रकाशते ॥
shakti_gita::173.verse_hindi: "वह मेरे हैं” इस ज्ञान से दुर्गा ब्रह्मशक्तिमयी है। उनमें ब्रह्म की सकल शक्तियां स्वतः प्रकाशित होती हैं।
shakti_gita::173.english_translation: "Durga is mine"—this knowledge reveals her as the embodiment of all divine power; in her, the entire power of Brahman shines forth naturally.
shakti_gita::173.translation_literal: सर्वशक्तिमयी (all-powerful) दुर्गा (Durga) स (she) ममास्तीति (is mine, this knowledge) बोधतः (from awareness) । ब्रह्मणो (of Brahman) निखिला (entire) शक्तिः (power) स्वतः (naturally) तत्र (there) प्रकाशते (shines) ॥
shakti_gita::173.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::173.essence: Believing Durga is yours reveals her as the full power of the supreme reality shining in you.
shakti_gita::173.simple_meaning: When you realize Durga belongs to you, you see she embodies all the power of the supreme reality shining naturally.
shakti_gita::173.simple_insight: Feeling that Durga is truly yours opens the heart to her vast, shining power.
shakti_gita::173.detailed_meaning: Devi Durga explains that the awareness of her belonging to the devotee reveals her as the full power of Brahman, naturally shining from within her essence. This moment connects personal devotion with cosmic power.
shakti_gita::173.modern_relevance: When you feel a deep connection to a source of strength, you begin to sense that power flowing through you naturally, not as something distant.
shakti_gita::173.insight: This verse shifts your view from seeing the divine as separate to feeling its full power alive within your own trust and belonging.

shakti_gita::174.verse_sanskrit:
कार्तिकेयो वलेशोऽतो गणेशो बुद्धयधीश्वरः ।
लक्ष्मीर्घनेश्वरी विद्याधीश्वरी च सरस्वती ॥
shakti_gita::174.verse_hindi: इसी कारण बलाधीश कार्तिकेय, बुद्धयधीश्वर गणेश, धनेश्वरी लक्ष्मी और विद्याधीश्वरी सरस्वती
shakti_gita::174.english_translation: For this reason, Kartikeya is the lord of strength, Ganesha the lord of wisdom, Lakshmi the goddess of wealth, and Saraswati the goddess of knowledge.
shakti_gita::174.translation_literal: कार्तिकेयो (Kartikeya) वलेशः (lord of strength) अतो (therefore) गणेशः (Ganesha) बुद्धयध्-ईश्वरः (lord of wisdom) । लक्ष्मीः (Lakshmi) घनेश्वरी (goddess of wealth) विद्याधीश्वरी (goddess of knowledge) च (and) सरस्वती (Saraswati) ॥
shakti_gita::174.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::174.essence: Strength, wisdom, wealth, and knowledge each have their own guiding power.
shakti_gita::174.simple_meaning: Kartikeya rules strength, Ganesha rules wisdom, Lakshmi rules wealth, and Saraswati rules knowledge.
shakti_gita::174.simple_insight: Different aspects of life have their own guiding forces supporting and inspiring us.
shakti_gita::174.detailed_meaning: The narrator, Suta, explains the special roles of four deities: Kartikeya governs strength, Ganesha governs wisdom, Lakshmi governs wealth, and Saraswati governs knowledge, highlighting their unique divine functions.
shakti_gita::174.insight: Recognize the distinct qualities that support different areas of your life, each requiring its own focus.

shakti_gita::175.verse_hindi: उनकी सन्तान हैं बल, बुद्धि, धन और ज्ञानरूपी अपत्यों के प्रभाव से उनमें सब शक्तियां विराजमान हैं
shakti_gita::175.english_translation: From him come offspring like strength, intellect, wealth, and knowledge; through these descendants, all powers reign within him.
shakti_gita::175.translation_literal: तस्यास्सन्ति (of him are) सुतास्तस्यां (offspring in them) राजन्ते (reign) सर्वशक्तयः (all powers) बलबुद्धिधनज्ञानरूपा (in form of strength, intellect, wealth, knowledge) अपत्यम् (descendants) प्रभावतः (by the influence)
shakti_gita::175.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::175.essence: All powers arise as offspring of fundamental qualities within a source.
shakti_gita::175.simple_meaning: He has children who are strength, intellect, wealth, and knowledge, and through them all powers exist in him.
shakti_gita::175.simple_insight: Powers arise naturally from qualities we inherit or embody.
shakti_gita::175.detailed_meaning: The narrator describes a figure whose qualities manifest as offspring—strength, intellect, wealth, and knowledge—through whom all powers flow and prevail, emphasizing the origin of diverse energies from a source.
shakti_gita::175.insight: It shows how different abilities and resources are interconnected aspects emerging from a single source.

shakti_gita::176.verse_sanskrit:
सती गौरी पृथक् पत्युः सत्ताशून्याऽस्ति तन्मयी।
दुर्गा तु पतिसम्बन्धात् सर्वशक्तिमयी स्थिता ॥
shakti_gita::176.verse_hindi: सती गौरी पति से पृथक अपनी सत्ता नहीं रखतीं, वह तन्मयी हैं अर्थात् पति में तन्मयता को प्राप्त हैं, परन्तु दुर्गा देवी पति के सम्बन्ध से सर्वशक्तिमयी होकर स्थित हैं
shakti_gita::176.english_translation: Sati Gauri does not exist separately from her husband; she is absorbed in him. But Durga, in relation to her husband, remains fully endowed with all power.
shakti_gita::176.translation_literal: सती (Sati) / गौरी (Gauri) / पृथक् (separately) / पत्युः (from husband) / सत्ताशून्या (without existence) / अस्ति (is) / तन्मयी (absorbed in him) / दुर्गा (Durga) / तु (but) / पतिसम्बन्धात् (from husband relationship) / सर्वशक्तिमयी (full of all power) / स्थिता (remains)
shakti_gita::176.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::176.essence: Connection with the beloved does not diminish your complete power and presence.
shakti_gita::176.simple_meaning: True devotion means being united with the beloved without losing your own full power and presence.
shakti_gita::176.simple_insight: You can belong deeply without losing your strength or identity.
shakti_gita::176.detailed_meaning: Devi explains the difference between Sati Gauri, who is absorbed and loses separate existence in her husband, and Durga, who remains fully powerful even in relation to her husband. This highlights the divine feminine's independent strength within loving union.
shakti_gita::176.modern_relevance: You may feel deeply connected in relationships but worry about losing your own voice—this shows you can belong and still be fully yourself.
shakti_gita::176.insight: It teaches you to embrace connection without sacrificing your own fullness or power.

shakti_gita::177.verse_sanskrit:
एषा गौरी च दुर्गा च धर्मादशौ यतस्ततः ।
आर्यनारीगणादर्शो जगन्मान्यो न चान्यथा ॥
shakti_gita::177.verse_hindi: यह ही गौरी और दुर्गा नारी धर्म की आदर्श रूपा हैं इसी कारण आर्यनारियों का आदर्श ही जगत में माननीय है
shakti_gita::177.english_translation: She is both Gauri and Durga, the ideal of feminine virtue, honored by noble women everywhere.
shakti_gita::177.translation_literal: एषा (this) / गौरी (Gauri) / च (and) / दुर्गा (Durga) / च (and) / धर्मादशौ (of feminine virtue) / यतस्ततः (from where and there) / आर्यनारीगणादर्शो (ideal of noble women) / जगन्मान्यो (world honored) / न (not) / चान्यथा (otherwise)
shakti_gita::177.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::177.essence: The highest feminine ideal combines strength and virtue, honored by noble women worldwide.
shakti_gita::177.simple_meaning: She is the embodiment of both Gauri and Durga, representing the ideal qualities noble women aspire to and are respected for worldwide.
shakti_gita::177.simple_insight: You can feel pride in embodying noble qualities admired universally.
shakti_gita::177.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Devi identifies herself as both Gauri and Durga, two revered feminine forms symbolizing virtue and strength. She explains that noble women regard these qualities as the highest ideal, respected globally across cultures.
shakti_gita::177.modern_relevance: When you see women admired for their strength and character, you recognize this timeless ideal reflected in everyday life.
shakti_gita::177.insight: It invites you to see your own virtues as part of a respected, universal ideal of strength and goodness.

shakti_gita::178.verse_sanskrit:
नृणां प्रवृत्तिधर्मस्य गार्हस्थ्ये पूर्णता यथा।
एवं निवृत्तिधर्मस्य सन्न्यासाश्रम उज्ज्वले ॥
shakti_gita::178.verse_hindi: जैसे मनुष्यों के प्रवृत्तिधर्म को पूर्णता गृहस्थाश्रम में और निवृत्ति धर्म की पूर्णता उज्ज्वल सन्यास आश्रम में होती है।
shakti_gita::178.english_translation: Just as active duty finds completeness in the householder stage, so does the path of renunciation find its fullness in the radiant renounced life.
shakti_gita::178.translation_literal: नृणां (of humans) प्रवृत्तिधर्मस्य (active duty's) गार्हस्थ्ये (in the householder) पूर्णता (completeness) यथा (just as) । एवं (thus) निवृत्तिधर्मस्य (renunciation duty's) सन्न्यासाश्रम (renounced life stage) उज्ज्वले (radiant) ॥
shakti_gita::178.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::178.essence: Active duty completes in engaged life; renunciation completes in radiant letting go.
shakti_gita::178.simple_meaning: People fulfill their active responsibilities best during family life, while the path of letting go reaches its full brightness in the renounced life.
shakti_gita::178.simple_insight: There is a right time and place for active doing and for letting go; both have their own fullness.
shakti_gita::178.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that human life has stages: active engagement in family and society, and then renunciation. Each stage completes its purpose fully in its own realm, highlighting that both action and renunciation are necessary parts of life.
shakti_gita::178.modern_relevance: You may feel torn between pushing hard in your career and stepping back to recharge; knowing each phase has its time brings peace.
shakti_gita::178.insight: Recognize when to engage fully in action and when to embrace letting go; honoring both phases creates balance.

shakti_gita::179.verse_sanskrit:
तथैव गृहिणीधर्मे प्रवृत्तेः पूर्णता स्थिता ।
एवं निवृत्तिधर्मस्य नारीणां विधवाव्रते ॥
shakti_gita::179.verse_hindi: वैसे ही गृहिणी धर्म में स्त्रियों के प्रवृत्ति धर्म की पूर्णता स्थित है और स्त्रियों के निवृत्ति धर्म की पूर्णता विधवा व्रत में होती हैं
shakti_gita::179.english_translation: Just as the full completeness for women active in household duties is found in that role, the full completeness for women in their retired phase is found in the vow of widowhood.
shakti_gita::179.translation_literal: तथैव (just so) गृहिणीधर्मे (in household duty) प्रवृत्तेः (being active) पूर्णता (completeness) स्थिता (is established) । एवं (thus) निवृत्तिधर्मस्य (of retired duty) नारीणां (of women) विधवाव्रते (in widow's vow) ॥
shakti_gita::179.speaker: Unknown
shakti_gita::179.essence: Women find completeness in their life roles, active or retired, through dedicated duties.
shakti_gita::179.simple_meaning: Women find their full role and completeness either in household duties or, when retired, in observing the widow's vow.
shakti_gita::179.simple_insight: Different life phases have different full expressions of purpose and duty for women.
shakti_gita::179.detailed_meaning: The verse explains the traditional idea that women engaged in household responsibilities experience completeness in that active role, while those who have retired, especially widows, find their completeness in observing the widow's vow. It reflects a cultural framework defining feminine roles across life stages.
shakti_gita::179.insight: It highlights how different life stages can carry distinct meaningful roles, inviting respect for transitions and changes in purpose.

shakti_gita::180.verse_sanskrit:
न्यूनाधिक्येन सर्वत्र कला यद्यपि मे सुराः।
सर्वेषामेव धर्माणामङ्गोपाङ्गेषु जाग्रति ॥
shakti_gita::180.verse_hindi: हे देवगण यद्यपि मेरी कला थोड़ी बहुत सब धर्मके अङ्गाउपांगो में स्थित है
shakti_gita::180.english_translation: O divine beings, though my power appears in parts of all duties and their branches.
shakti_gita::180.translation_literal: न्यूनाधिक्येन (with less or more) / सर्वत्र (everywhere) / कला (power) / यद्यपि (although) / मे (my) / सुराः (divine beings) / सर्वेषाम् (of all) / एव (indeed) / धर्माणाम् (duties) / अङ्गोपाङ्गेषु (in limbs and branches) / जाग्रति (is awake/active)
shakti_gita::180.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::180.essence: The divine power permeates every aspect of all duties, large or small.
shakti_gita::180.simple_meaning: The divine power is present in every part, big or small, of all duties and their details.
shakti_gita::180.simple_insight: Even small actions carry the presence of the divine power within them.
shakti_gita::180.detailed_meaning: Devi tells divine beings that her creative power, though sometimes subtle, is active within every aspect of all duties, showing she permeates all parts of the cosmic order.
shakti_gita::180.modern_relevance: When you do routine tasks, you might overlook their meaning—but even small efforts carry deeper power and purpose.
shakti_gita::180.insight: Recognize that every part of your duty, no matter how minor, holds significance and presence beyond the obvious.

shakti_gita::181.verse_sanskrit:
तामसेऽङ्गबजे न्यूना राजसे तु ततोऽधिका ।
कला धर्मस्य विद्यन्ते पूर्य्यन्ते सात्विके स्वतः ॥
shakti_gita::181.verse_hindi: किंतु धर्म के तामसिक अंग उपायों में मेरी थोड़ी कला विद्यमान है, राजसिक अंग उपांगो में उससे अधिक कला विद्यमान है और सात्विक अंग उपांगों में
shakti_gita::181.english_translation: My skill is least in the tamasic parts of dharma, more in the rajasic parts, and greatest naturally in the sattvic parts.
shakti_gita::181.translation_literal: तामसेऽङ्गबजे (in the tamasic parts) / न्यूना (least) / राजसे (in the rajasic) / तु (but) / ततोऽधिका (more than that) / कला (skill) / धर्मस्य (of dharma) / विद्यन्ते (are present) / पूर्य्यन्ते (are filled) / सात्विके (in the sattvic) / स्वतः (naturally)
shakti_gita::181.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::181.essence: Your skill in righteous action grows as your nature becomes clearer and purer.
shakti_gita::181.simple_meaning: Skill in doing what is right grows as your nature moves from darkness to clarity and balance.
shakti_gita::181.simple_insight: You feel encouraged knowing your best abilities come from calm and clarity within.
shakti_gita::181.detailed_meaning: Devi explains how her ability to act skillfully varies with the quality of dharma—lowest in tamasic (dark, inert) parts, higher in rajasic (active, restless) parts, and highest in sattvic (pure, clear) parts—revealing how inner nature affects effective action.
shakti_gita::181.modern_relevance: When you face tasks while tired or stressed, your effectiveness dips; when calm and clear, your best skills show naturally.
shakti_gita::181.insight: It shifts your view to notice how your inner state directly influences the quality of your actions.

shakti_gita::182.verse_sanskrit:
पूर्णा धर्मकला नूनं धार्मिकेभ्यो दिवौकसः !।
पुनरातिशून्यं तत्कैवल्यं दातुमीशते ॥
shakti_gita::182.verse_hindi: मेरी पूर्ण षोडशकला पूर्ण होकर धार्मिकों को हे देवगण ! पुनरावृत्तिशून्य मुक्ति देने में अवश्य समर्थ होती है
shakti_gita::182.english_translation: My complete sixteenfold power, perfected, surely grants liberation free from rebirth to the righteous ones, O devas.
shakti_gita::182.translation_literal: पूर्णा (complete) धर्मकला (power of dharma) नूनं (indeed) धार्मिकेभ्यो (to the righteous) दिवौकसः (O devas) पुनरातिशून्यं (free from rebirth) तत्कैवल्यं (that liberation) दातुम् (to give) ईशते (is able)
shakti_gita::182.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::182.essence: Perfected divine power grants liberation beyond all rebirth to the righteous.
shakti_gita::182.simple_meaning: A complete and perfected divine power grants liberation that ends the cycle of rebirth to those who live rightly.
shakti_gita::182.simple_insight: Knowing your true power can free you brings deep hope beyond endless returns.
shakti_gita::182.detailed_meaning: Devi declares that her full sixteenfold power is perfected and able to grant liberation that completely ends rebirth to those who follow righteousness, addressing the devas who witness this cosmic truth.
shakti_gita::182.modern_relevance: Imagine realizing you carry within you a power that can end all repeated struggles and fresh starts, offering true freedom beyond endless cycles.
shakti_gita::182.insight: It reveals that liberation is not distant but available through perfected inner power aligned with righteous living.

shakti_gita::183.verse_sanskrit:
तिथिष्वन्यासु सर्वासु द्वितीयादिपु निर्जराः!।
विवर्द्धयन कलाः स्वीयाः शुक्लपक्षे यथा शशि॥
shakti_gita::183.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! जिस प्रकार शुक्लपक्ष में चन्द्रमा द्वितीया आदि अन्य सब तिथियों में अपनी कलाओं को बढ़ाता हुआ
shakti_gita::183.english_translation: O divine beings! Just as the moon grows its phases during the bright fortnight, increasing its brilliance on the second and other lunar days,
shakti_gita::183.translation_literal: तिथिष्वन्यासु (in lunar days arrangement) / सर्वासु (all) / द्वितीयादिपु (from second and onwards) / निर्जराः (ageless, unfailing) / विवर्द्धयन (growing, increasing) / कलाः (phases, parts) / स्वीयाः (its own) / शुक्लपक्षे (in bright fortnight) / यथा (just as) / शशि (moon)
shakti_gita::183.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::183.essence: Growth unfolds steadily and naturally through phases over time.
shakti_gita::183.simple_meaning: The moon steadily grows its phases during the bright half of the month, increasing its brightness from the second day onward.
shakti_gita::183.simple_insight: Growth and change happen steadily in natural cycles, even when unnoticed.
shakti_gita::183.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses divine beings, explaining how the moon gradually increases its light over the days of the bright fortnight, symbolizing natural growth and movement in cycles.
shakti_gita::183.insight: Recognize that growth is a gradual process unfolding in its own time and rhythm.

shakti_gita::184.verse_sanskrit:
पूर्यते पौर्णमास्यां हि कलाषोडशकेन च। ।
नारीरूपे तथा देवाः ! कला पोडशका मम ॥
shakti_gita::184.verse_hindi: पूर्णिमा के दिन सोलह कलाओं से पूर्ण हो जाता है उसी प्रकार मेरी सोलह कलाएं स्त्रियों में
shakti_gita::184.english_translation: On the full moon day, completeness is achieved by sixteen arts; likewise, my sixteen arts are present in women.
shakti_gita::184.translation_literal: पूर्यते (is fulfilled) / पौर्णमास्यां (on the full moon day) / हि (indeed) / कलाषोडशकेन (by sixteen arts) / च (and). / नारीरूपे (in the form of women) / तथा (likewise) / देवाः (the divine beings) / ! / कला (arts) / पोडशका (sixteen) / मम (my).
shakti_gita::184.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::184.essence: The divine's sixteen qualities make women a complete expression of sacred fullness.
shakti_gita::184.simple_meaning: The divine says her sixteen special qualities complete women just as sixteen arts complete the full moon day.
shakti_gita::184.simple_insight: You can see the divine qualities reflected fully in women as a symbol of completeness.
shakti_gita::184.detailed_meaning: Devi compares the fullness of the full moon, completed by sixteen arts, to the sixteen qualities she embodies that manifest in women, highlighting their sacred completeness.
shakti_gita::184.insight: It invites recognizing the fullness and sacred qualities inherent in women as expressions of the divine.

shakti_gita::185.verse_sanskrit:
विकाशं क्रमशो लब्ध्वा षोड़श्यां हि प्रपूर्यते ।
अस्त्येवं सात्त्विको धर्मों विशिष्टः सर्वशक्तितः ॥
shakti_gita::185.verse_hindi: क्रमशः विकास प्राप्त करती हुई षोडशी में (सोलह वर्ष की स्त्री में) पूर्ण हो जाती हैं सात्त्विक धर्म भी उसी प्रकार समस्त शक्तियों से पूर्ण है।
shakti_gita::185.english_translation: By gradual development, at sixteen the pure qualities fully mature; similarly, the true nature is complete with all powers.
shakti_gita::185.translation_literal: विकाशं (development) क्रमशो (gradually) लब्ध्वा (having obtained) षोड़श्यां (at sixteen) हि (indeed) प्रपूर्यते (is fulfilled) । अस्त्येवं (thus exists) सात्त्विको (pure) धर्मों (qualities) विशिष्टः (distinct) सर्वशक्तितः (from all powers) ॥
shakti_gita::185.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::185.essence: Pure qualities mature naturally over time, completing with all powers united.
shakti_gita::185.simple_meaning: Pure qualities develop gradually and reach full maturity at the right moment, just as true nature is complete with all its powers.
shakti_gita::185.simple_insight: There's peace in trusting that your best qualities grow naturally over time.
shakti_gita::185.detailed_meaning: The Goddess explains that pure qualities (sattvic dharmas) develop step by step and reach full maturity by sixteen years. This natural unfolding reflects how true nature becomes complete when all its powers come together.
shakti_gita::185.modern_relevance: You watch a child slowly grow into their own strength and character, understanding that true maturity takes time and steady development.
shakti_gita::185.insight: It teaches you to trust gradual growth rather than forcing quick change, letting your qualities mature in their own time.

shakti_gita::186.verse_sanskrit:
वर्णधर्मे प्रपूर्णत्वे प्रतिरोधके सति ।
धार्मिकस्वकलानां मे साधिभौतिकशुद्धिकम् ॥
shakti_gita::186.verse_hindi: प्रवृत्ति रोधक वर्णधर्म में मेरी धार्मिक कलाओं का पूर्ण विकास हो जाने पर ब्राह्मणवर्ण में आधिभौतिक शुद्धि के साथ साथ
shakti_gita::186.english_translation: When the duties of each class are fully perfected and the opposition is removed, then in the Brahmin class, my religious arts attain the highest purity related to the higher realm.
shakti_gita::186.translation_literal: वर्णधर्मे (in duties of classes) / प्रपूर्णत्वे (complete perfection) / प्रतिरोधके (removal of opposition) / सति (being) / धार्मिकस्वकलानां (of my religious arts) / मे (my) / साधिभौतिकशुद्धिकम् (purity related to higher realm)
shakti_gita::186.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::186.essence: Fully embracing your role without resistance allows your deeper qualities to purify and mature.
shakti_gita::186.simple_meaning: When you fully perform your rightful duties without resistance, your deeper qualities reach full purity.
shakti_gita::186.simple_insight: There is clarity and power in fully embracing your role without inner conflict.
shakti_gita::186.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that when each social duty (varna dharma) is carried out completely and without opposition, the spiritual arts connected with the Brahmin class become purified and perfected, pointing to the unfolding of higher qualities.
shakti_gita::186.modern_relevance: You feel stuck in your role because of resistance or conflicting priorities. When you clear these, your best skills and values emerge naturally.
shakti_gita::186.insight: It teaches you to identify and remove inner or outer resistance so your true potential can unfold in your role.

shakti_gita::187.verse_sanskrit:
आत्मज्ञानाधिकारित्वं ब्राह्मणेषूपजायते ।
एवमाश्रमधर्मेऽपि निवृत्तेः पोषके शुभे ॥
shakti_gita::187.verse_hindi: आत्मज्ञान का अधिकार प्राप्त हो जाता है। उसी प्रकार निवृत्ति पोषक पवित्र आश्रम धर्म में मेरी षोडश कलाओं का
shakti_gita::187.english_translation: The right to self-knowledge arises among Brahmins; similarly, withdrawal is nurtured by the pure duties of the ashramas.
