shakti_gita::187.translation_literal: आत्मज्ञानाधिकारित्वं (the right to self-knowledge) / ब्राह्मणेषु (among Brahmins) / उपजायते (arises) । / एवम् (similarly) / आश्रमधर्मेऽपि (in ashrama duty also) / निवृत्तेः (of withdrawal) / पोषके (nurturer) / शुभे (pure) ॥
shakti_gita::187.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::187.essence: Self-knowledge arises naturally from living purely and retreating wisely within life’s stages.
shakti_gita::187.simple_meaning: You gain the right to self-knowledge by living a pure, disciplined life and by practicing wise withdrawal in stages of life.
shakti_gita::187.simple_insight: There’s dignity in stepping back and purity in living rightly, both opening the path to knowing yourself.
shakti_gita::187.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that Brahmins traditionally gain the right to self-knowledge through study and purity. Similarly, following the sacred duties of life stages (ashramas) with withdrawal nurtures this knowledge, showing that disciplined living and retreat support inner awakening.
shakti_gita::187.modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by constant demands, but setting clear boundaries and stepping back with integrity helps you reclaim clarity and deeper self-understanding.
shakti_gita::187.insight: It teaches you to see disciplined withdrawal and pure living as essential steps toward awakening your true self.

shakti_gita::188.verse_sanskrit:
विकाशं क्रमशो गत्वा कलापोडशकं मम ।
सत् सन्न्यासाश्रमे पूर्ण योगिनस्तत्त्ववेदिनः ॥
shakti_gita::188.verse_hindi: क्रमशः विकास होते होते अंत में संन्यास आश्रम में जीवन मुक्ति पद को प्राप्त कराकर तत्त्वज्ञानी योगी को
shakti_gita::188.english_translation: By gradually unfolding, ultimately reaching the renunciation stage, the perfected yogi attains the state of true realization.
shakti_gita::188.translation_literal: विकाशं (unfolding) क्रमशः (gradually) गत्वा (going) कलापोडशकम् (to the stage of renunciation) मम (my) । सत् (true) सन्न्यासाश्रमे (in the renunciation hermitage) पूर्ण (perfected) योगिनः (yogis) तत्त्ववेदिनः (knowers of the truth) ॥
shakti_gita::188.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::188.essence: True freedom comes only after a gradual unfolding and renunciation process.
shakti_gita::188.simple_meaning: Growth happens step by step until a yogi reaches renunciation and true understanding of reality.
shakti_gita::188.simple_insight: There’s peace in knowing growth is a gradual journey toward true freedom.
shakti_gita::188.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that spiritual progress unfolds gradually like a process, culminating in the renunciation stage, where the yogi attains true wisdom and inner freedom.
shakti_gita::188.modern_relevance: You’ve experienced small changes over time that prepared you for a big shift in your life’s meaning and freedom.
shakti_gita::188.insight: It teaches you to trust gradual inner growth leading to profound transformation and freedom.

shakti_gita::189.verse_sanskrit:
जीवन्मुक्त्यास्पदं नीत्वा नयते मत्स्वरूपताम् ।
वर्णधर्मे ममैवाथ गौरीदुर्गास्वरूपयोः ॥
shakti_gita::189.verse_hindi: मेरे स्वरूप को प्राप्त करा देता है। वर्ण धर्म में मेरे ही गौरी और दुर्गा के स्वरूपों का
shakti_gita::189.english_translation: Attaining liberation in life leads directly to my true nature, just as the forms of Gauri and Durga are inseparable from their roles in caste and duty.
shakti_gita::189.translation_literal: जीवनम् (life) मुक्त्य (liberation) आस्पदम् (attaining) नीत्वा (leading) नयते (leads) मत् (my) स्वरूपताम् (true nature) । वर्णधर्मे (in caste and duty) मम (my) एव (only) अथ (also) गौरी (Gauri) दुर्गा (Durga) स्वरूपयोः (forms) ॥
shakti_gita::189.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::189.essence: True freedom means living your deepest self fully within your life roles.
shakti_gita::189.simple_meaning: Reaching true freedom in life brings you into your real nature, just like the forms of Gauri and Durga fully express their roles.
shakti_gita::189.simple_insight: You can feel complete when your deeper self shines through your life roles.
shakti_gita::189.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that achieving liberation while alive reveals the true essence of the self. She uses Gauri and Durga—divine forms embodying specific roles—to show that true nature and duty are united.
shakti_gita::189.modern_relevance: When your work or role feels aligned with who you truly are, you experience a sense of freedom and completeness.
shakti_gita::189.insight: It teaches you that true freedom is not separate from living your nature fully in your responsibilities.

shakti_gita::190.verse_sanskrit:
आदर्शः प्रकटीभूय नारीदेहेषु मानवान्।
विधत्ते नितरां देवाः ! कृतकृत्यान्न संशयः॥
shakti_gita::190.verse_hindi: आदर्श नारीरूप में प्रकट होकर मनुष्यों को कृतकृत्य करता है, हे देवगण ! इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
shakti_gita::190.english_translation: The ideal appears in the form of woman and surely makes humans fulfilled, O radiant beings! There is no doubt about this.
shakti_gita::190.translation_literal: आदर्शः (ideal) प्रकटीभूय (manifesting) नारीदेहेषु (in woman bodies) मानवान् (humans) विधत्ते (makes) नितरां (certainly) देवाः (O radiant beings) कृतकृत्यान्न (fulfilled) संशयः (doubt)
shakti_gita::190.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::190.essence: The ideal manifests as woman and surely fulfills humans without doubt.
shakti_gita::190.simple_meaning: The ideal appears as a woman among humans and certainly makes them fulfilled without any doubt.
shakti_gita::190.simple_insight: The presence of the ideal in human form brings undeniable fulfillment.
shakti_gita::190.detailed_meaning: Suta narrates that the ideal principle manifests in the form of a woman among humans, and this presence certainly fulfills them, addressed to radiant beings witnessing this truth.
shakti_gita::190.insight: Recognize how ideals or inspirations appearing in familiar forms can deeply satisfy human longing.

shakti_gita::191.verse_sanskrit:
एवमाश्रमधर्मेऽपि विद्यारूपधरा ह्यहम्।
प्रादुर्भूय प्रयच्छामि शान्ते मानसमन्दिरे ॥
shakti_gita::191.verse_hindi: उसी प्रकार आश्रम धर्म में भी मैं ही विद्यारूप से मनुष्यों के शान्त मानस मंदिर में प्रकट होकर
shakti_gita::191.english_translation: In the duties of the hermitage too, I manifest as knowledge, appearing in the peaceful temple of the mind.
shakti_gita::191.translation_literal: एवमाश्रमधर्मेऽपि (thus in hermitage duty also) / विद्यारूपधरा (knowledge-form bearer) / ह्यहम् (indeed I) / प्रादुर्भूय (manifesting) / प्रयच्छामि (I give/offer) / शान्ते (peaceful) / मानसमन्दिरे (in the temple of the mind)
shakti_gita::191.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::191.essence: The divine manifests as knowledge within the peaceful mind during spiritual duty.
shakti_gita::191.simple_meaning: The divine reveals itself as knowledge within your calm and peaceful mind, even during your spiritual duties.
shakti_gita::191.simple_insight: You are never alone; divine wisdom quietly supports your mind’s peace.
shakti_gita::191.detailed_meaning: Devi states that during the life of spiritual practice in an ashram, she manifests as the form of knowledge inside the tranquil mind, guiding the practitioner inwardly.
shakti_gita::191.modern_relevance: When your mind feels overwhelmed by tasks, remember that quiet wisdom dwells inside you, ready to guide your next step.
shakti_gita::191.insight: It teaches you to recognize the divine knowledge present within your calm mental space during all duties.

shakti_gita::192.verse_sanskrit:
निश्रेयसं मनुष्येभ्योऽभ्युदयश्च निरन्तरम् ।
जीवन्मुक्ता महात्मानः सन्न्यासाश्रमवर्तिनः ॥
shakti_gita::192.verse_hindi: उनको निरन्तर अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस प्रदान करती हूँ । हे देवगण ! सन्यास आश्रम में जीवन्मुक्त
shakti_gita::192.english_translation: I constantly grant the highest good and prosperity to humans; the great souls in the renounced order are liberated while living.
shakti_gita::192.translation_literal: निश्रेयसं (highest good) / मनुष्येभ्योऽभ्युदयश्च (to humans, prosperity also) / निरन्तरम् (constantly) / जीवन्मुक्ता (liberated while living) / महात्मानः (great souls) / सन्न्यासाश्रमवर्तिनः (dwelling in renounced order)
shakti_gita::192.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::192.essence: Pure surrender opens the door to continual highest good and freedom while living.
shakti_gita::192.simple_meaning: The divine continuously bestows the highest well-being and success to those who live in renunciation and have attained liberation while alive.
shakti_gita::192.simple_insight: There is peace in knowing that true surrender continually brings you lasting goodness and freedom.
shakti_gita::192.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Devi declares that those living in the renounced order (sannyasa) and who have attained liberation while alive are continuously blessed with supreme well-being and prosperity by the divine forces, here addressed as devas.
shakti_gita::192.modern_relevance: When you let go of clinging to outcomes and live with trust, you find ongoing success and inner freedom even in difficult times.
shakti_gita::192.insight: It teaches you to embrace surrender as a source of continuous support and freedom in life.

shakti_gita::193.verse_sanskrit:
विश्वमेव स्वरूपं से ज्ञात्वति प्रथमं सुराः ।
सद्भावस्य निमज्जन्ति सम्पूर्णासु कलास्वहो ॥
shakti_gita::193.verse_hindi: महापुरुष प्रथम जगत को ही मेरा स्वरूप, जानकर मेरे सद्भाव की पूर्ण कलाओं में निमजन करता हैं।
shakti_gita::193.english_translation: The great beings first realize that the entire world is my form, then immerse themselves in the complete arts of my true nature.
shakti_gita::193.translation_literal: विश्वमेव (the entire world) स्वरूपं (form) से (thus) ज्ञात्वति (knowing) प्रथमं (first) सुराः (the great beings) । सद्भावस्य (of true nature) निमज्जन्ति (immerse) सम्पूर्णासु (complete) कलास्वहो (in the arts) ॥
shakti_gita::193.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::193.essence: Recognizing the world as the divine invites full immersion in its complete true nature.
shakti_gita::193.simple_meaning: Great beings recognize that the entire world is a form of the divine and fully immerse themselves in its complete true nature.
shakti_gita::193.simple_insight: Feeling the world as sacred invites you to fully live and express its deeper truth.
shakti_gita::193.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that great beings (the suras) first perceive the whole universe as her form. Then they immerse themselves deeply in all the complete expressions of her true nature, symbolizing devoted engagement with the divine presence in everything.
shakti_gita::193.modern_relevance: You meet someone who sees every part of life as connected and sacred, inspiring you to embrace your work and creativity with full presence.
shakti_gita::193.insight: Shift from seeing the world as separate to recognizing it as a unified expression of the divine, inspiring wholehearted devotion.

shakti_gita::194.verse_sanskrit:
विश्वरूपाञ्च मामेव विदित्वा तदनन्तरम् ।
कलाषोड़शकोपेतं परमानन्दसागरम् ॥
shakti_gita::194.verse_hindi: तदन्तर मुझको ही जगद्रप जानकर षोड़शकला पूर्ण परमानन्दसागर में
shakti_gita::194.english_translation: After knowing that I am the cosmic form itself, then the sixteenfold complete vessel of supreme bliss.
shakti_gita::194.translation_literal: विश्व (cosmic) / रूपाञ्च (form also) / मामेव (me alone) / विदित्वा (knowing) / तद् (that) / अनन्तरम् (after) / कलाषः (vessel) / षोडश (sixteen) / कोपेतं (filled) / परमानन्दसागरम् (supreme bliss ocean)
shakti_gita::194.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::194.essence: Recognizing yourself as the cosmic form reveals your fullness as limitless bliss.
shakti_gita::194.simple_meaning: You realize that your true nature is the cosmic form itself, filled completely with supreme bliss.
shakti_gita::194.simple_insight: You feel vast and whole, knowing your true self is infinite joy and cosmic presence.
shakti_gita::194.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals that recognizing oneself as the cosmic form opens the way to experiencing the complete sixteenfold vessel of supreme bliss, symbolizing full divine manifestation and inner joy.
shakti_gita::194.modern_relevance: When you suddenly see yourself as part of the vast universe, you feel connected and deeply joyful beyond ordinary happiness.
shakti_gita::194.insight: It teaches you to recognize your boundless nature as the true self, filled with infinite joy beyond ordinary experience.

shakti_gita::195.verse_sanskrit:
नितान्तमवगाहन्ते सायुज्यं यन्ति मे ततः ।
मत्सायुज्यदशामेत्य पूर्ण चिद्भावमाश्रिताः ॥
shakti_gita::195.verse_hindi: अवगाहन करता रहता है और अन्त में मेरी सायुज्य दशा को प्राप्त करके मेरे पूर्ण चिद्भाव के आश्रय से
shakti_gita::195.english_translation: They fully immerse themselves and finally attain union with me, resting in my complete conscious nature.
shakti_gita::195.translation_literal: नितान्तम् (completely) अवगाहन्ते (immerse) सायुज्यं (union) यन्ति (attain) मे (with me) ततः (then) । मत्-सायुज्य-दशा-एत्-इति (my-union-state-these-come) पूर्ण (complete) चिद्भावम् (conscious nature) आश्रिताः (resting) ॥
shakti_gita::195.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::195.essence: Complete immersion in devotion leads to resting in the divine's full conscious nature.
shakti_gita::195.simple_meaning: Those who completely immerse themselves reach union with the divine and rest in its full conscious nature.
shakti_gita::195.simple_insight: There is peace in fully surrendering and resting in the divine's complete awareness.
shakti_gita::195.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that sincere devotees who immerse themselves deeply in devotion ultimately reach a state of union with her, resting fully in her complete conscious nature, symbolizing the highest devotional attainment.
shakti_gita::195.modern_relevance: When you deeply commit to your inner devotion or love, you can find complete peace resting in that connection beyond all distractions.
shakti_gita::195.insight: It teaches you to deepen your devotion until you rest in the pure conscious essence of the divine.

shakti_gita::196.verse_sanskrit:
सम्पाप्य ब्रह्मसायुज्यं कृतकृसा भवन्ति ते ।
स्वकलानां रहस्यम्बै प्रोक्तं गृढतमं मया ॥
shakti_gita::196.verse_hindi: ब्रह्म सायुज्य को प्राप्त करके कृतकृत्य हो जाता है। हे देवतागण ! मैंने अतिगूढ़ तम अत्यन्त विचित्रतापूर्ण अपनी कलाओं का रहस्य
shakti_gita::196.english_translation: By uniting with the supreme reality, they become fulfilled; I have revealed the profound secret of my powers.
shakti_gita::196.translation_literal: सम्पाप्य (attaining) ब्रह्मसायुज्यं (union with Brahman) कृतकृसा (fulfilled, free from obligation) भवन्ति (they become) ते (those) । स्वकलानां (of my arts/powers) रहस्यम्बै (the secret) प्रोक्तं (spoken) गृढतमं (most profound) मया (by me) ॥
shakti_gita::196.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::196.essence: Complete fulfillment arises from union with the supreme reality beyond all actions.
shakti_gita::196.simple_meaning: When someone unites with the supreme reality, they become completely fulfilled and free from all obligation. The goddess reveals the deepest secret of her powers here.
shakti_gita::196.simple_insight: There is a profound completeness that comes from merging with the highest reality beyond actions.
shakti_gita::196.detailed_meaning: The goddess reveals to her audience, the divine beings, that those who unite with the supreme reality become fully accomplished and free from worldly obligations. She shares the deepest secret of her own mystical powers at this pivotal moment.
shakti_gita::196.modern_relevance: You’ve worked hard to connect with your highest purpose; this connection brings a deep sense of fulfillment beyond success or failure.
shakti_gita::196.insight: It teaches you to seek completeness by aligning deeply with your highest truth rather than chasing external achievements.

shakti_gita::197.verse_sanskrit:
अन्तिके भवतां देवाः ! नानावैचित्र्यसंकुलम्।
अतीव यदि दुयं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं तथा ॥
shakti_gita::197.verse_hindi: आप लोगों के समीप वर्णन किया जो अत्यन्त दुर्ज्ञेय और अत्यन्त गोपनीय है, हे देवगण !
shakti_gita::197.english_translation: Near you, O radiant beings, is a secret complex with many mysteries, even more hidden than the deepest secrets.
shakti_gita::197.translation_literal: अन्तिके (near) भवतां (your) देवाः (divine beings) ! नानावैचित्र्यसंकुलम् (full of various complexities)। अतीव (extremely) यदि (if) दुयं (hidden) गुह्याद् (than the secret) गुह्यतरं (more secret) तथा (thus) ॥
shakti_gita::197.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::197.essence: Some truths near us are deeply hidden and filled with complex mysteries.
shakti_gita::197.simple_meaning: Near you is something very complex and secret, even more hidden than other secrets.
shakti_gita::197.simple_insight: Some truths are deeply hidden and require patience to uncover.
shakti_gita::197.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses the divine beings, telling them that near them lies a profound and mysterious secret, more hidden than any other, setting the stage for a deep teaching.
shakti_gita::197.insight: It prepares you to approach deep knowledge with openness and respect for its complexity.

shakti_gita::198.verse_sanskrit:
भवतस्नेहवशाद्देवाः ! साम्प्रतं सम्प्रकाशितम् ।
एतच्छ्रुत्वा विदित्वा च लप्स्यन्ते सांधकाः शिवम् ॥
shakti_gita::198.verse_hindi: आपके स्नेह से मैंने इस समय इसका प्रकाश किया है। इसको सुन और जानकर साधक परम कल्याण प्राप्त करेंगे
shakti_gita::198.english_translation: By your affection, I have now revealed this. Hearing and understanding it, practitioners will attain supreme well-being.
shakti_gita::198.translation_literal: भवतस्नेहवशाद्देवाः (by your affection, O radiant beings) / साम्प्रतं (now) / सम्प्रकाशितम् (revealed) / एतच्छ्रुत्वा (hearing this) / विदित्वा (knowing) / च (and) / लप्स्यन्ते (will attain) / सांधकाः (practitioners) / शिवम् (supreme well-being)
shakti_gita::198.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::198.essence: Affection opens the door to wisdom that brings true well-being.
shakti_gita::198.simple_meaning: Because of the divine's affection, this teaching is now shared. Those who listen and understand it will gain deep well-being.
shakti_gita::198.simple_insight: You can feel cared for as this teaching opens the way to your true welfare.
shakti_gita::198.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses radiant beings, explaining that because of their affection, she has revealed this knowledge. She promises practitioners that by hearing and understanding it, they will gain supreme well-being, setting a hopeful tone for seekers.
shakti_gita::198.modern_relevance: When someone you trust shares a valuable truth, it feels easier to embrace and brings real relief and hope.
shakti_gita::198.insight: Trust opens you to receive guidance that leads to genuine well-being.

shakti_gita::199.verse_sanskrit:
वेदमातर्जगन्मातर्महायोगेश्वरेश्वरि !।
विज्ञानं ते समाकर्ण्य चित्कलागोचरं ननु ॥
shakti_gita::199.verse_hindi: हे जगन्मातः! हे वेदजननि ! हे महायोगेश्वरी की ईश्वरि ! आपकी चित कला का विज्ञान सुनकर
shakti_gita::199.english_translation: O Mother of the world, O mother of the Vedas, O great sovereign of yoga! Hearing your subtle knowledge of consciousness, indeed,
shakti_gita::199.translation_literal: वेदमातः (mother of the Vedas) / जगन्मातः (mother of the world) / महा (great) / योगेश्वरेश्वरि (sovereign of yoga) / विज्ञानं (knowledge) / ते (your) / समाकर्ण्य (having listened) / चित्कला (art or subtlety of consciousness) / अगोचरं (unseen, subtle) / ननु (indeed)
shakti_gita::199.speaker: Unknown
shakti_gita::199.essence: The divine mother embodies the profound, subtle knowledge of consciousness.
shakti_gita::199.simple_meaning: This verse praises the divine mother as the source of all knowledge and the subtle art of consciousness, acknowledging the profoundness of her teaching.
shakti_gita::199.simple_insight: There is reverence for a deep, subtle wisdom that shapes all understanding.
shakti_gita::199.detailed_meaning: The verse is a respectful invocation addressing the divine mother, recognized as the origin of the Vedas and supreme yogic power, highlighting the profound and subtle nature of her knowledge about consciousness.
shakti_gita::199.insight: It invites recognizing the depth and subtlety behind teachings that may initially seem intangible or hidden.

shakti_gita::200.verse_sanskrit:
दृष्टिरुन्मीलिताऽस्माकं दिव्या दार्शनिको द्रुतम् ।
साम्पतं ते महादेवि ! वाह्याऽभ्यन्तरतो वयम् ॥
shakti_gita::200.verse_hindi: हमारे दार्शनिक नेत्र एकाएक खुल गये हैं। अब हम आपको भीतर और बाहर देखने की इच्छा से
shakti_gita::200.english_translation: Our visionary eyes have suddenly opened. Now we desire to see you both within and without.
shakti_gita::200.translation_literal: दृष्टि (vision) उन्मीलिता (opened) अस्माकं (our) दिव्या (divine) दार्शनिका (visionary) द्रुतम् (quickly) । साम्पतं (desire) ते (your) महादेवि (great goddess) । वाह्या (outside) अभ्यन्तरतो (inside) वयम् (we) ॥
shakti_gita::200.speaker: Unknown
shakti_gita::200.essence: A sudden awakening sparks the desire to see both within and without clearly.
shakti_gita::200.simple_meaning: Our eyes of insight have suddenly opened, and now we want to see you both outside and inside.
shakti_gita::200.simple_insight: There is a sudden awakening that makes you want to understand everything deeply.
shakti_gita::200.detailed_meaning: The speaker expresses a sudden opening of inner perception, a new readiness to observe the divine presence both outwardly and inwardly, marking a moment of awakening in the dialogue.
shakti_gita::200.modern_relevance: You suddenly find yourself curious to explore both your outer world and your inner feelings with fresh eyes.
shakti_gita::200.insight: It encourages shifting from passive perception to active inner and outer awareness simultaneously.

shakti_gita::201.verse_sanskrit:
श्रोतुं दिदृश्येच्छामो वेदकाण्डत्रयस्य वै।
विज्ञानं दुर्गम योग-रहस्य दुर्लभं तथा ॥
shakti_gita::201.verse_hindi: वेद के काण्डत्रय का दुर्गम विज्ञान और योग का दुर्लभ रहस्य सुनने की इच्छा करते हैं
shakti_gita::201.english_translation: I desire to hear the difficult knowledge of the three Vedas and the rare secret of yoga.
shakti_gita::201.translation_literal: श्रोतुं (to hear) दिदृश्येच्छामो (we desire to see/hear) वेदकाण्डत्रयस्य (of the three Vedic sections) वै (indeed) विज्ञानं (knowledge) दुर्गम (difficult) योग-रहस्य (secret of yoga) दुर्लभं (rare) तथा (also)
shakti_gita::201.speaker: Unknown
shakti_gita::201.essence: True seekers long to hear the rare, difficult knowledge behind spiritual practice.
shakti_gita::201.simple_meaning: There is a strong wish to learn the difficult knowledge of the Vedas and the rare secret of yoga.
shakti_gita::201.simple_insight: Yearning for deep wisdom shows a readiness to explore beyond the obvious.
shakti_gita::201.detailed_meaning: In this moment, a speaker expresses a heartfelt desire to receive the profound and rare teachings found in the three parts of the Vedas and the secret of yoga, signaling a readiness to engage with deep spiritual knowledge.
shakti_gita::201.modern_relevance: You feel drawn to uncover the hidden, challenging truths behind complex spiritual teachings.
shakti_gita::201.insight: It highlights the importance of sincere curiosity and openness before receiving deeper knowledge.

shakti_gita::202.verse_sanskrit:
को योगो वेदविज्ञानैस्तत्सम्बन्धश्च कीदृशः।
विस्तरावर्णयित्वैतत्कृतकृत्यान् कुरुष्व नः ॥
shakti_gita::202.verse_hindi: योग किसको कहते हैं ? और 'वेदविज्ञान के साथ उसका क्या सम्बन्ध है ? इसको विस्तार से वर्णन करके हमको कृतकृत्य कीजिये
shakti_gita::202.english_translation: What is yoga? And what is its relation to the knowledge of the Vedas? Please explain this in detail and make us grateful.
shakti_gita::202.translation_literal: को (who) / योगो (yoga) / वेदविज्ञानैः (by Vedic knowledge) / तत्सम्बन्धश्च (and its relation) / कीदृशः (what kind) / विस्तारावर्णयित्वा (explaining in detail) / एतत् (this) / कृतकृत्यान् (grateful) / कुरुष्व (make) / नः (us)
shakti_gita::202.speaker: Unknown
shakti_gita::202.essence: Understanding yoga requires exploring its connection to deep Vedic knowledge.
shakti_gita::202.simple_meaning: Someone asks what yoga is and how it connects with Vedic knowledge, requesting a detailed explanation to feel grateful.
shakti_gita::202.simple_insight: Curiosity about yoga's nature and its sacred ties invites deeper understanding and appreciation.
shakti_gita::202.detailed_meaning: A question is raised about the meaning of yoga and its connection to Vedic wisdom, seeking a thorough explanation that brings gratitude.
shakti_gita::202.modern_relevance: You wonder what true yoga is and how it links to ancient wisdom, hoping to grasp it clearly and appreciate its value.
shakti_gita::202.insight: It invites you to explore yoga beyond practice, connecting it with foundational knowledge to deepen respect and practice.

shakti_gita::203.verse_sanskrit:
अस्म्यहं शक्तिरूपेण योगशक्तिः सुरोत्तमाः ।
सो कर्मोपासनाज्ञान-काण्डत्रयविधानतः ॥
shakti_gita::203.verse_hindi: हे देवश्रेष्ठ गण ! मैं ही शक्तिरूप से योगशक्ति हूँ। त्रिविध अधिकार भेद से कर्म, उपासना और ज्ञानकाण्ड के अनुसार
shakti_gita::203.english_translation: O best among the divine beings! I am the power manifested as yoga power, according to the threefold divisions of karma, worship, and knowledge.
shakti_gita::203.translation_literal: अस्म्यहं (I am) शक्तिरूपेण (in the form of power) योगशक्तिः (yoga power) सुरोत्तमाः (O best of the divine beings) । सो (that) कर्मोपासनाज्ञान-काण्डत्रयविधानतः (according to the threefold divisions of karma, worship, and knowledge)
shakti_gita::203.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::203.essence: The true power manifests simultaneously through action, devotion, and wisdom.
shakti_gita::203.simple_meaning: The divine power expresses itself as yoga power through three ways: action, devotion, and wisdom.
shakti_gita::203.simple_insight: You hold the same power that moves all paths of growth and transformation.
shakti_gita::203.detailed_meaning: The Goddess addresses the divine assembly, declaring herself as the fundamental power behind yoga, appearing through three key approaches: action (karma), devotion (worship), and wisdom (knowledge). This moment reveals her as the source uniting diverse spiritual paths.
shakti_gita::203.modern_relevance: When you face different challenges, remember your inner power expresses through doing, loving, and understanding, all harmonizing your journey.
shakti_gita::203.insight: Recognize your energy manifests in how you act, love, and learn, uniting your whole experience.

shakti_gita::204.verse_sanskrit:
त्रिविधैरधिकारैहि योगशक्तित्रिधा मता।
यदेतल्लक्षणं गीत योगः कर्मसु कौशलम् ॥
shakti_gita::204.verse_hindi: वह योगशक्ति  तीन प्रकार की है। सुकौशल पूर्ण कर्म को योग कहते हैं,
shakti_gita::204.english_translation: Yoga power is understood in three types: yoga is skill in action.
shakti_gita::204.translation_literal: त्रिविधैः (by threefold) अधिकारैः (authorities/means) योगशक्ति (yogic power) त्रिधा (threefold) मता (is considered). यत् (that) एतत् (this) लक्षणं (characteristic) गीत (song) योगः (yoga) कर्मसु (in actions) कौशलम् (skillfulness).
shakti_gita::204.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::204.essence: True yoga is skillful, focused action in everything you do.
shakti_gita::204.simple_meaning: Yoga has three forms, but at its core, it means doing your actions with skill and care.
shakti_gita::204.simple_insight: You feel confident knowing your focused action is a true form of yoga.
shakti_gita::204.detailed_meaning: In the Shakti Gita, Devi explains that her power manifests in three types of yoga, highlighting that the essence of yoga lies in skillful action, teaching that purposeful, careful action itself is a spiritual practice.
shakti_gita::204.modern_relevance: When you focus fully and skillfully on what you do, whether at work or home, you embody yoga in your daily life.
shakti_gita::204.insight: It shifts your view from seeing yoga as only meditation to recognizing everyday skilled action as a path.

shakti_gita::205.verse_sanskrit:
तन्नूनं कर्मकाण्डीय-योगलक्षणमीरितम् ।
चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधो वै योग एताद्ध लक्षणम् ॥
shakti_gita::205.verse_hindi: यह कर्मकाण्ड का लक्षण है; चित्तवृत्ति निरोध करने को योग कहते है।
shakti_gita::205.english_translation: The characteristic of ritualistic action is different; yoga is the restraint of the fluctuations of the mind.
shakti_gita::205.translation_literal: तन्नूनं (that characteristic) कर्मकाण्डीय-योगलक्षणमीरितम् (ritualistic-action-yoga characteristic is said) । चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधो (mind fluctuations restraint) वै (indeed) योग (yoga) एताद्ध (such) लक्षणम् (characteristic) ॥
shakti_gita::205.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::205.essence: Yoga is the inner stilling of the mind, not mere ritual action.
shakti_gita::205.simple_meaning: Yoga is not just performing rituals; it is the practice of stopping the restless movements of the mind.
shakti_gita::205.simple_insight: You can find yoga by calming your mind, not by just doing external rituals.
shakti_gita::205.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the common idea of yoga as ritualistic actions is incomplete. True yoga is the inner discipline of controlling the mind's restless fluctuations. This teaching shifts focus from external acts to inner mastery.
shakti_gita::205.modern_relevance: When your mind races with endless thoughts, yoga means learning to pause and calm those inner waves.
shakti_gita::205.insight: It teaches you to shift your focus from external rituals to calming your mind's activity as the real yoga.

shakti_gita::206.verse_sanskrit:
विज्ञेयं सर्वथोपास्ति-काण्डयोगस्य निर्जराः!।
अज्ञानजनितोपाधि नि:शेषमपनोद्य हि ॥
shakti_gita::206.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण! यह लक्षण सर्वथा उपासना काण्ड का जानो और अज्ञानजनित उपाधि को निःशेष हटाकर
shakti_gita::206.english_translation: Know that the chapter on worship is flawless in every way; it completely removes all impurities born of ignorance.
shakti_gita::206.translation_literal: विज्ञेयं (to be known) / सर्वथा (in every way) / उपास्ति-काण्डस्य (of worship chapter) / निर्जराः (flawless) / अज्ञानजनितोपाधि (impurities born of ignorance) / नि:शेषम् (completely) / अपनोद्य (removes) / हि (indeed)
shakti_gita::206.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::206.essence: True wisdom on worship removes all confusion caused by ignorance.
shakti_gita::206.simple_meaning: This teaching on worship is perfect and completely clears away all confusion caused by ignorance.
shakti_gita::206.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing this wisdom fully clears mental obstacles.
shakti_gita::206.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses her followers, highlighting that this chapter on worship is flawless and removes all impurities caused by ignorance, emphasizing its power to clarify and purify the mind.
shakti_gita::206.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by unclear thoughts or confusion, this teaching promises full clarity and relief from mental clutter.
shakti_gita::206.insight: It shows you that wisdom can completely dissolve the false layers that block clear understanding.

shakti_gita::207.verse_hindi: जीवात्मा और परमात्मा को एकीकरण करने को योग कहते हैं, यह ज्ञानकाण्ड का अद्भुत लक्षण है।
shakti_gita::207.english_translation: Yoga is the unity that merges the true self and supreme being; it is a wondrous mark of knowledge.
shakti_gita::207.translation_literal: एकत्वप्रतिपत्तिर्या (the realization of oneness) / योगः (yoga) / स्याच्छिवजीवयोः (between Shiva and the living being) / अस्त्यतज्ज्ञानकाण्डीय-योगलक्षणमद्भुतम् (is an amazing mark of the knowledge section)
shakti_gita::207.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::207.essence: Yoga is the realization that your true self and the supreme reality are one.
shakti_gita::207.simple_meaning: Yoga is the process of realizing the oneness of your true self and the supreme reality, a profound sign of wisdom.
shakti_gita::207.simple_insight: You can feel the deep connection between who you are and the highest reality.
shakti_gita::207.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that yoga is the profound union of Shiva (the supreme being) and Jiva (the individual self). This teaching highlights the ultimate knowledge that the highest and individual realities are not separate but one.
shakti_gita::207.modern_relevance: When you sense separation between your core identity and a larger purpose, yoga guides you to experience their essential unity.
shakti_gita::207.insight: It shifts your understanding from separation to unity, revealing that your true self and the supreme reality are inseparable.

shakti_gita::208.verse_sanskrit:
त्रयाणामिह काण्डानामुक्तानामनुरोधतः।
त्रैविध्यं धारणायाश्च जानीत सुरसत्तमाः ! ॥
shakti_gita::208.verse_hindi: हे देवश्रेष्ठौ ! इसी कारण इन तीनों काण्डों के अनुसार मेरी धारणा भी तीन प्रकार की जाननी चाहिए
shakti_gita::208.english_translation: O best of the devas! Therefore, according to these three sections, my understanding should also be known in three types.
shakti_gita::208.translation_literal: त्रयाणामिह (of the three here) / काण्डानामुक्तानाम् (of the sections mentioned) / अनुरोधतः (due to the request) । / त्रैविध्यं (threefold) / धारणायाः (of the understanding) / च (and) / जानीत (should be known) / सुरसत्तमाः (O best of the devas) ॥
shakti_gita::208.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::208.essence: Understanding should align with the threefold structure of the teaching.
shakti_gita::208.simple_meaning: The speaker says that because of the three sections, the understanding of the topic should also be divided into three types.
shakti_gita::208.simple_insight: Knowing that knowledge can be organized in different ways helps prepare the mind for deeper learning.
shakti_gita::208.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses the best of the devas, explaining that the teaching is divided into three parts, and accordingly, the understanding or approach should also be threefold. This sets up the framework for the upcoming teachings.
shakti_gita::208.insight: It encourages structuring knowledge into clear categories to grasp complex teachings better.

shakti_gita::209.verse_sanskrit:
भावयन्तः कर्मतत्त्वं पराभक्त्यधिकारिणः।
अस्त्येवतज्जगद्ब्रह्म धारणामी्दृशी मम ॥
shakti_gita::209.verse_hindi: हे देवश्रेष्ठों ! कर्म के तत्वदर्शी मेरी पराभक्ति के अधिकारी कर्मयोगी गण "जगत् ही ब्रह्म है" मेरी ऐसी धारणा
shakti_gita::209.english_translation: O best of the divine beings! The karma yogis who understand the essence of action and are devoted to me hold the view that the entire world is Brahman.
shakti_gita::209.translation_literal: भावयन्तः (contemplating) कर्मतत्त्वं (the essence of action) पराभक्त्यधिकारिणः (those entitled to supreme devotion). अस्त्येवतज्जगद् (indeed that world) ब्रह्म (is Brahman) धारणामी्दृशी (holding such a view) मम (of mine).
shakti_gita::209.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::209.essence: Acting with devoted understanding reveals the whole world as the supreme reality.
shakti_gita::209.simple_meaning: Those who act with devoted understanding see the entire world as a manifestation of the supreme reality.
shakti_gita::209.simple_insight: You feel empowered when your actions connect you deeply to everything around you.
shakti_gita::209.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that karma yogis—those devoted to action with understanding—hold the profound view that the entire cosmos is not separate but united as Brahman. This integrates devotion and action into a single vision.
shakti_gita::209.modern_relevance: When your work is driven by deep care and understanding, you naturally see your environment as connected and meaningful.
shakti_gita::209.insight: It shifts your focus from isolated tasks to acting with devotion that recognizes unity in all things.

shakti_gita::210.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वथा सर्वदा देवाः ! कुर्वते कर्मयोगिनः ।
मत्पराभक्तिनिष्णाता मद्भक्ता योगिनां वराः ॥
shakti_gita::210.verse_hindi: सर्वदा सर्वथा करते हैं, ऐसी धारणा से मेरी पराभक्ति में निष्णात योगिश्रेष्ठ
shakti_gita::210.english_translation: The supreme yogis, devoted to me, always perform Karma Yoga in every way and at all times.
shakti_gita::210.translation_literal: सर्वथा (in every way) / सर्वदा (at all times) / देवाः (gods/devas) / कुर्वते (perform) / कर्मयोगिनः (those practicing action yoga) / मत्पराभक्तिनिष्णाता (expert in devotion to me) / मद्भक्ता (my devotees) / योगिनां (of yogis) / वराः (the best)
shakti_gita::210.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::210.essence: True devotion is perfected through constant, skillful action in every moment.
shakti_gita::210.simple_meaning: Those who are deeply devoted to the divine perform selfless action constantly and in all ways.
shakti_gita::210.simple_insight: Devotion is not passive; it shows through your consistent, engaged action.
shakti_gita::210.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that the highest yogis are not just contemplative but are experts in devoted action, serving the divine continuously and wholeheartedly without separation.
shakti_gita::210.modern_relevance: You keep showing up and doing the work because you believe in something greater, even when no one watches.
shakti_gita::210.insight: It shifts your view of devotion from feeling to doing, making every act an expression of your inner dedication.

shakti_gita::211.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्मैवास्ते जगत्सर्वमिति धारणयाऽनिशम् ।
महात्मानो निरीक्षन्ते विश्वास्मिन सुरसत्तमाः !॥
shakti_gita::211.verse_hindi: महात्मा भक्तगण अहर्निश "ब्रह्म ही जगत् है" इस जगत् में मुझे देखते हैं
shakti_gita::211.english_translation: Great souls constantly perceive that the entire world is Brahman, the supreme reality.
shakti_gita::211.translation_literal: ब्रह्मैवास्ते (Brahman alone exists) / जगत्सर्वमिति (entire world) / धारणयाऽनिशम् (constantly holding) / महात्मानो (great souls) / निरीक्षन्ते (observe) / विश्वास्मिन (in faith) / सुरसत्तमाः (highest devas)
shakti_gita::211.speaker: Shakti
shakti_gita::211.essence: Great souls see the entire world as the supreme reality itself without doubt.
shakti_gita::211.simple_meaning: Great devotees continuously hold the belief that everything in the world is the supreme reality itself.
shakti_gita::211.simple_insight: Trusting the world as sacred brings calm and deep connection.
shakti_gita::211.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Shakti reveals how great devotees perceive the world: they see all existence as Brahman, the supreme reality, with unwavering faith and steady vision.
shakti_gita::211.modern_relevance: You notice the beauty and sacredness in everyday life when you trust everything has deeper meaning.
shakti_gita::211.insight: It teaches you to hold a steady faith that the world you experience is not separate from the divine reality.

shakti_gita::212.verse_sanskrit:
अहं ब्रह्मास्मि' भो देवाः इति या धारणाऽस्ति मे।
जीवन्मुक्ता महात्मानस्तदा तां प्राप्तुमीशते ॥
shakti_gita::212.verse_hindi: "मैं ही ब्रह्म हूँ " ऐसी धारणा को जीवन्मुक्त महापुरुष तब प्राप्त करने में समर्थ होते हैं
shakti_gita::212.english_translation: "The belief 'I am Brahman' is attained by great liberated beings."
shakti_gita::212.translation_literal: अहं (I) ब्रह्मास्मि (am Brahman) भो (O) देवाः (deities) इति (thus) या (which) धारणाऽस्ति (belief exists) मे (in me)। जीवन्मुक्ता (liberated beings) महात्मानः (great souls) तदा (then) तां (that) प्राप्तुम् (to attain) ईशते (desire)
shakti_gita::212.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::212.essence: Complete freedom comes when you realize your true self is the supreme reality.
shakti_gita::212.simple_meaning: Great liberated souls come to fully believe and realize that their true self is the supreme reality.
shakti_gita::212.simple_insight: There is deep freedom in knowing your true self is not separate from all that exists.
shakti_gita::212.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, the Goddess explains that truly great liberated beings reach the understanding 'I am Brahman,' meaning they identify completely with the supreme reality, transcending all separation and illusion.
shakti_gita::212.modern_relevance: When you finally see yourself as part of the vast whole, worries about identity and separation begin to fade.
shakti_gita::212.insight: It shifts your view from feeling isolated to recognizing your unity with the supreme reality.

shakti_gita::213.verse_sanskrit:
यदैकत्वं मया साद्ध लभन्ते ज्ञानयोगतः।
यः प्रति निवृत्तिञ्च द्वे फले सम्प्रयच्छति ॥
shakti_gita::213.verse_hindi: जब ज्ञानयोग से मेरे साथ तदाकार भाव को ग्रहण करते हैं। जो प्रवृत्ति और निवृत्ति फल देनेवाला
shakti_gita::213.english_translation: When through the yoga of wisdom, the unity with me is attained, it grants the fruits of both engagement and withdrawal.
shakti_gita::213.translation_literal: यदैकत्वं (that unity) मया (by me) साद्ध (attained) लभन्ते (they obtain) ज्ञानयोगतः (through yoga of wisdom) । यः (which) प्रति (engagement) निवृत्तिञ्च (and withdrawal) द्वे (both) फले (fruits) सम्प्रयच्छति (grants) ॥
shakti_gita::213.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::213.essence: True wisdom unites you with the divine, offering both active and restful fruits together.
shakti_gita::213.simple_meaning: By practicing the yoga of wisdom, you can unite fully with the divine and receive the benefits of both active involvement and peaceful withdrawal.
shakti_gita::213.simple_insight: You feel balanced knowing you can both engage fully and step back without losing connection.
shakti_gita::213.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that through the disciplined path of wisdom (Jnana Yoga), a practitioner attains a unified state with her essence. This unity naturally rewards both the fruits of action and rest, showing a harmony beyond mere effort or renunciation.
shakti_gita::213.modern_relevance: When you learn to see clearly and deeply, you can both act with purpose and rest without guilt, finding balance in a busy life.
shakti_gita::213.insight: The verse shifts your view from choosing between doing or withdrawing to embracing both as part of your growth through wisdom.

shakti_gita::214.verse_sanskrit:
स द्विधा कर्मयोगोऽयं विभक्तोऽस्ति दिवौकसः !।
अन्तर्ग कर्मयोगस्य हवस्थाद्वयमेव तत् ॥
shakti_gita::214.verse_hindi: कर्मयोग है, हे देवतागण,  वह दो भागों में विभक्त है। दोनों ही अवस्थाएँ कर्मयोग के अन्तर्गत हैं
shakti_gita::214.english_translation: Karma yoga, O divine beings, is divided into two parts; both states belong to karma yoga.
shakti_gita::214.translation_literal: स (that) / द्विधा (in two parts) / कर्मयोगोऽयं (this karma yoga) / विभक्तोऽस्ति (is divided) / दिवौकसः (O divine beings) / अन्तर्ग (within) / कर्मयोगस्य (of karma yoga) / हवस्थाद्वयमेव (two states only) / तत् (that)
shakti_gita::214.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::214.essence: Action unfolds in two forms that together make the complete path of karma yoga.
shakti_gita::214.simple_meaning: Karma yoga, the path of action, has two aspects, but both are part of the same practice.
shakti_gita::214.simple_insight: You can see action as two forms, yet they belong to one unified path.
shakti_gita::214.detailed_meaning: Devi explains to the divine beings that karma yoga, the path of selfless action, is not singular but divided into two stages or forms. Both belong fully to the practice of karma yoga, revealing its layered nature.
shakti_gita::214.modern_relevance: You face tasks that require different approaches—both are part of your ongoing work and growth.
shakti_gita::214.insight: Recognize that different modes of action still belong to one continuous practice of engaged living.

shakti_gita::215.verse_sanskrit:
सकामासक्तिवीजन कर्मयोगेन चैकतः।
जायते जगदश्वत्थ-वृक्षो द्वन्द्वात्मकः क्षयी ॥
shakti_gita::215.verse_hindi: एक सकामासक्ति रूपी बीज से कर्मयोग के द्वारा द्वन्द्व मूलक नाशवान् जगद्वपी अश्वत्थ वृक्ष उत्पन्न करता है
shakti_gita::215.english_translation: From the seed of desire and attachment, the karmayoga alone produces the dualistic, perishable banyan tree of the world.
shakti_gita::215.translation_literal: सकाम (desire) / आसक्ति (attachment) / वीजन (seed) / कर्मयोगेन (by karmayoga) / चैकतः (alone) / जायते (arises) / जगत् (world) / अश्वत्थ-वृक्षः (banyan tree) / द्वन्द्वात्मकः (dualistic) / क्षयी (perishable)
shakti_gita::215.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::215.essence: Desire plants the seed; only action grows the world of duality and decay.
shakti_gita::215.simple_meaning: Desire and attachment plant a seed that karmayoga alone grows into the world of duality and decay.
shakti_gita::215.simple_insight: You realize your desires start the cycle, but your actions feed it.
shakti_gita::215.detailed_meaning: Devi explains how desire and attachment are seeds; karmayoga (the path of action) alone nurtures these seeds into the world’s dualistic and impermanent nature. This reveals how inner tendencies and actions create the experience of division and decay.
shakti_gita::215.modern_relevance: You feel a craving that pulls you toward conflict, and your choices either feed or starve that urge.
shakti_gita::215.insight: It teaches you to see that your desires start problems, but your actions decide their growth.

shakti_gita::216.verse_sanskrit:
यः परीणामशीलोऽपि ददात्यभ्युदयं फलम् ।
निष्कामत्वस्वरूपेण वीजेन कर्मयोगतः ॥
shakti_gita::216.verse_hindi: जो परिणामी होने पर भी अभ्युदय रूपी फल को देता है। दूसरा निष्काम भाव रूपी बीज से कर्मयोग के द्वारा
shakti_gita::216.english_translation: One who remains constant in transformation yet delivers the fruit of progress, sowing the seed of selfless action through karma yoga.
shakti_gita::216.translation_literal: यः (who) परीणामशीलः (constant in transformation) अपि (even) ददाति (gives) अभ्युदयम् (progress) फलम् (fruit) । निष्कामत्वस्वरूपेण (in the form of selflessness) वीजेन (by the seed) कर्मयोगतः (of karma yoga) ॥
shakti_gita::216.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::216.essence: Selfless effort through change naturally produces meaningful progress.
shakti_gita::216.simple_meaning: Even when circumstances change, you can act selflessly and still bring about positive results through karma yoga.
shakti_gita::216.simple_insight: You can trust that your selfless efforts create meaningful progress, no matter how things shift around you.
shakti_gita::216.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that a person who embraces change but acts without craving results plants the seed of karma yoga, which naturally produces progress and success beyond expectation.
shakti_gita::216.modern_relevance: You face shifting demands at work but keep doing your part without craving reward — gradually, real progress follows.
shakti_gita::216.insight: It teaches you to focus on selfless effort regardless of changing outcomes, trusting growth will come.

shakti_gita::217.verse_sanskrit:
परमानन्दभावस्य द्योतकोऽनश्वरोऽन्यतः।
जायते मधुरोदर्कः प्रबोधः कल्पपादपंः ॥
shakti_gita::217.verse_hindi: परमानन्द भाव प्रकाशक अपरिणामी प्रबोध रूपी मधुर कल्पवृक्ष को उत्पन्न करता है,
shakti_gita::217.english_translation: The supreme blissful nature, radiant and eternal, produces the sweet awakening like the wish-fulfilling tree.
shakti_gita::217.translation_literal: परमानन्दभावस्य (of the supreme blissful nature) / द्योतकोऽनश्वरोऽन्यतः (the radiant one, eternal, without other) / जायते (arises/produces) / मधुरोदर्कः (sweet awakening) / प्रबोधः (awakening) / कल्पपादपंः (the wish-fulfilling tree)
shakti_gita::217.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::217.essence: Unchanging bliss naturally brings forth a sweet, awakening clarity.
shakti_gita::217.simple_meaning: The eternal blissful essence shines and brings forth a sweet awakening like a magical tree granting wishes.
shakti_gita::217.simple_insight: You can feel a deep, unchanging joy that gently awakens your true nature.
shakti_gita::217.detailed_meaning: Devi describes how the supreme blissful essence, radiant and eternal, naturally produces a sweet awakening symbolized by the wish-fulfilling tree, representing the emergence of spiritual realization beyond change.
shakti_gita::217.modern_relevance: In moments when you feel a deep, peaceful joy arise from within, it can gently awaken your sense of true purpose and inner freedom.
shakti_gita::217.insight: It teaches you that a stable, radiant joy within can spontaneously awaken your mind to higher understanding.

shakti_gita::218.verse_sanskrit:
यस्मानिःश्रेयसं देवाः ! फलमुत्पद्यतेऽमृतम् ।
कर्मयोगविभागाभ्यामाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां निरन्तरम् ॥
shakti_gita::218.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण !  जिससे निःश्रेयसरूपी अमृत फल की उत्पत्ति होती है। कर्मयोग के इन दो विभागों से निरन्तर
shakti_gita::218.english_translation: O devas, from which the immortal fruit of highest good continuously arises from these two divisions of karma yoga.
shakti_gita::218.translation_literal: यस्मान् (from which) निःश्रेयसं (highest good) देवाः (O devas) फलम् (fruit) उत्पद्यते (arises) अमृतम् (immortal) । कर्मयोगविभागाभ्याम् (from two divisions of karma yoga) अभ्यां (from both) द्वाभ्याम् (two) निरन्तरम् (continuously) ॥
shakti_gita::218.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::218.essence: Lasting highest good arises continuously from two complementary ways of acting.
shakti_gita::218.simple_meaning: Highest lasting benefit, like immortal fruit, comes continuously from two types of karma yoga practice.
shakti_gita::218.simple_insight: You realize lasting good arises when you act through both paths of karma yoga.
shakti_gita::218.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses the devas, explaining that the immortal reward of highest good arises continuously from two key branches of karma yoga, emphasizing the importance of understanding both aspects of action.
shakti_gita::218.modern_relevance: When you balance doing your work with right intention and detachment, lasting benefit naturally follows.
shakti_gita::218.insight: Recognize that lasting fulfillment requires engaging both active and selfless aspects of action.

shakti_gita::219.verse_sanskrit:
द्वै फले फलतो नूनं कैवल्याभ्युदयाविति ।
हित मद्वचनं भूयो देवाः ! सर्वेनिशम्यताम् ॥
shakti_gita::219.verse_hindi: अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयसरूपी दो फल अवश्य प्रकट होते हैं। देवतागण ! पुनः आप लोग मेरी हित की बात सुनो
shakti_gita::219.english_translation: Two fruits surely appear: progress and ultimate freedom. O radiant beings, hear my well-wishing words again.
shakti_gita::219.translation_literal: द्वै (two) फले (fruits) फलतो (appear) नूनं (surely) कैवल्याभ्युदयाविति (ultimate freedom and progress) । हित (well-wishing) मद्वचनं (my words) भूयो (again) देवाः (radiant beings) ! सर्वेनिशम्यताम् (listen attentively) ॥
shakti_gita::219.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::219.essence: True wisdom brings both personal growth and lasting inner freedom together.
shakti_gita::219.simple_meaning: Two results always come from true understanding: progress in life and ultimate inner freedom. The Goddess invites her listeners to hear this important teaching again.
shakti_gita::219.simple_insight: There is hope in knowing your growth and freedom can happen together.
shakti_gita::219.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Devi addresses the radiant beings, declaring that two fruits appear from her teaching: worldly progress and the highest freedom beyond it. She urges attentive listening to her well-wishing words for their lasting benefit.
shakti_gita::219.modern_relevance: You may feel stuck between growing and finding peace. This reminds you both are possible at once.
shakti_gita::219.insight: It shifts your view to see progress and freedom not as opposites, but as coexisting results of following wisdom.

shakti_gita::220.verse_sanskrit:
शक्तौ हि कर्मयोगस्यानुस्यूता सर्वथा सती ।
सकामकर्मयोगिभ्यो नूनमभ्युदयं ददे ॥
shakti_gita::220.verse_hindi: मैं कर्मयोग की शक्ति में सर्वथा अनुस्यूत रहकर सकाम कर्मयोगी को अभ्युदय और
shakti_gita::220.english_translation: The power of Karma Yoga is always present in her; she surely grants success to those attached to action with desire.
shakti_gita::220.translation_literal: शक्तौ (in power) / हि (indeed) / कर्मयोगस्यानुस्यूता (attached to Karma Yoga) / सर्वथा (completely) / सती (being) / सकामकर्मयोगिभ्यो (to those doing desireful Karma Yoga) / नूनम् (certainly) / अभ्युदयं (success) / ददे (gives)
shakti_gita::220.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::220.essence: Sincere action with desire activates a power that ensures success.
shakti_gita::220.simple_meaning: The power connected to action always supports those who act with desire, granting them success.
shakti_gita::220.simple_insight: You can trust that your sincere efforts are supported by a deeper power leading to success.
shakti_gita::220.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that her power is fully aligned with Karma Yoga — the path of action. Those who act with desire and dedication are granted success through this power, showing the importance of wholehearted engagement even in desire-driven action.
shakti_gita::220.modern_relevance: You commit fully to a project that matters to you, and despite uncertainty, you sense an inner momentum pushing you forward.
shakti_gita::220.insight: Recognize that sincere desire and focused action activate a supportive power that helps bring results.

shakti_gita::221.verse_hindi: निष्काम कर्मयोगी को नि:श्रेयस अवश्य प्रदान करती हूँ। यही कर्मकाण्ड योग की सनातनी उपनिषत है।
shakti_gita::221.english_translation: I surely grant the highest good to those devoted to selfless action yoga. This is the eternal Upanishad of ritualistic yoga.
shakti_gita::221.translation_literal: निष्कामकर्मयोगिभ्यः (to selfless action yogis) तथा (also) निःश्रेयसं (highest good) पदम् (abode/status) बोध्यै (to be known) अपि (also) उपनिपत् (Upanishad) कर्म-काण्डयोगस्य (of ritualistic action yoga) शाश्वती (eternal)
shakti_gita::221.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::221.essence: Selfless action yoga is the eternal path to the highest good.
shakti_gita::221.simple_meaning: Those who act without craving the result are granted the highest good. This teaching is the timeless truth behind ritualistic action.
shakti_gita::221.simple_insight: You can trust that acting without desire brings lasting benefit beyond the visible.
shakti_gita::221.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the highest good or inner freedom is granted to those who practice selfless action yoga. This teaching reveals the eternal wisdom behind outward ritualistic actions, showing the path beyond mere ceremony.
shakti_gita::221.modern_relevance: You work tirelessly on tasks without expecting praise or reward, yet deep down you know this selfless effort shapes your growth.
shakti_gita::221.insight: It teaches you to focus on pure action itself rather than on outcomes or recognition.

shakti_gita::222.verse_sanskrit:
प्रतिमूलकं देवाः ! सकामं कर्म वर्तते ।
नानाधिकारभेदेभ्यो बहुशाखासमन्वितम् ॥
shakti_gita::222.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण! प्रवृत्तिमूलक सकाम कर्म अनेकों अधिकार भेद के कारण अनेक शाखाओं से युक्त है।
shakti_gita::222.english_translation: O divine beings! Action driven by desire has many branches due to various differences in rights and roles.
shakti_gita::222.translation_literal: प्रतिमूलकं (root-driven) देवाः (divine beings) ! सकामं (desire-driven) कर्म (action) वर्तते (exists) । नानाधिकारभेदेभ्यो (from many differences in rights) बहुशाखासमन्वितम् (with many branches) ॥
shakti_gita::222.speaker: Shakti
shakti_gita::222.essence: Desire-driven action naturally multiplies into many varied forms based on differing roles.
shakti_gita::222.simple_meaning: Actions that arise from desire are many and varied because people have different roles and rights.
shakti_gita::222.simple_insight: You can feel how your desires shape your choices and create many paths.
shakti_gita::222.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shakti addresses divine beings to explain that desire-driven actions are diverse because each being has different roles and rights, resulting in many branches of activity.
shakti_gita::222.modern_relevance: You notice how your wants pull you in many directions, shaped by your unique responsibilities and freedoms.
shakti_gita::222.insight: Recognize how desire combined with differing roles multiplies the variety of actions you take.

shakti_gita::223.verse_sanskrit:
अत एव च पुण्यानां यथाकालमहं हृदि ।
ऋषीणां सम्पविश्यैव वेदांत्रगुण्यगोचरान् ॥
shakti_gita::223.verse_hindi: इसी कारण मैं समय समय पर पवित्र ऋषियों के अन्तःकरण में प्रवेश करके त्रिगुणात्मक वेदों को
shakti_gita::223.english_translation: That is why, from time to time, I enter the hearts of the pure sages, who perceive the Vedas through the three qualities.
shakti_gita::223.translation_literal: अत (therefore) एव (indeed) च (also) पुण्यानां (of the pure) यथाकाल (at proper times) अहं (I) हृदि (in the heart) । ऋषीणां (of sages) सम्पविश्यैव (entering fully) वेदांत्रगुण्यगोचरान् (those who perceive the Vedas as influenced by the three qualities) ॥
shakti_gita::223.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::223.essence: The divine reveals wisdom in pure hearts at appointed times through the qualities.
shakti_gita::223.simple_meaning: The divine enters the hearts of pure sages at the right time to reveal the Vedas influenced by the three qualities.
shakti_gita::223.simple_insight: There is a sacred timing when divine wisdom touches open hearts.
shakti_gita::223.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that she periodically enters the hearts of pure sages to reveal the Vedas, which are understood through the three qualities (gunas). This illustrates the divine transmission of wisdom aligned with cosmic timing.
shakti_gita::223.insight: Recognize that profound wisdom comes in moments when your inner being is receptive and aligned with natural cycles.

shakti_gita::224.verse_hindi: अनेक शाखाओं में प्रकट करती हूँ  और इसी कारण हे देवतागण ! मैं ही धर्म के अनेक सम्प्रदाय बनकर
shakti_gita::224.english_translation: I manifest through countless branches, and for this reason, O radiant beings, I am the origin of many diverse paths of dharma.
shakti_gita::224.translation_literal: प्रकाशयामि (I manifest) अनेकाभिः (through many) शाखाभिः (branches) समलकृतान् (made perfectly) सम्प्रदायविभिन्नत्वम् (the diversity of traditions) अहम् (I) आश्रित्य (depending on) नैकशः (many)
shakti_gita::224.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::224.essence: The divine reveals itself in many forms, making all paths valid expressions of truth.
shakti_gita::224.simple_meaning: The divine reveals itself through many different branches and traditions, showing that all paths are connected to the same source.
shakti_gita::224.simple_insight: You can trust that the divine is present in all sincere paths and traditions.
shakti_gita::224.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that she manifests through countless branches, representing diverse traditions of dharma. This teaches that the many paths people follow all originate from the one divine source, inviting trust in these varied expressions.
shakti_gita::224.modern_relevance: When you see people following different spiritual or ethical paths, you can feel assured that all sincere ways connect back to the same deeper truth.
shakti_gita::224.insight: It encourages you to embrace diversity in spiritual paths as expressions of the same divine reality, fostering openness and trust.

shakti_gita::225.verse_sanskrit:
नानाधिकारिमृत्येभ्योऽभ्युदयं प्रदेऽमराः! ।
व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकैव वर्तते खलु ॥
shakti_gita::225.verse_hindi: विभिन्न अधिकार के मनुष्यों को अद्भुदय प्रदान करती हूँ। व्ययसायात्मिका (निष्काम कर्मयोग रूपा) बुद्धि एक प्रकार की ही होती है परन्तु
shakti_gita::225.english_translation: I grant wondrous rise to humans with different rights; yet the diligent, selfless intellect is always one.
shakti_gita::225.translation_literal: नानाधिकारि (different rights) मृत्येभ्यः (than mortals) अभ्युदयम् (rise) प्रदे (I grant) अमराः (immortals)! / व्यवसाया-आत्मिका (diligent/selfless) बुद्धि (intellect) एकैव (only one) वर्तते (exists) खलु (indeed)
shakti_gita::225.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::225.essence: Focused, selfless effort is the single source of all true advancement despite diverse roles.
shakti_gita::225.simple_meaning: People have many different roles and rights, but the focused, selfless mind that acts without craving is always the same.
shakti_gita::225.simple_insight: You realize that no matter your role, selfless effort is the one true path forward.
shakti_gita::225.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that although humans have different duties and statuses, the inner quality of dedicated, selfless intellect—acting without desire for results—is one and the same for all, forming the true basis of progress.
shakti_gita::225.modern_relevance: You see coworkers with different jobs and titles, but the focused, selfless effort you bring is what truly moves things forward.
shakti_gita::225.insight: It shifts your view from external roles to inner dedication as the real source of progress.

shakti_gita::226.verse_hindi: सकाम कर्मिमयों की बुद्धि बहु शाखाओं से युक्त अनन्त होती हैं । इसलिए निवृत्ति मूलक निष्काम कर्मयोग
shakti_gita::226.english_translation: The minds of those attached to results are endlessly scattered, but the wisdom rooted in renunciation is singular and devoted to selfless action.
shakti_gita::226.translation_literal: बहुशाखा (many-branched) / हि (indeed) / अनन्ताश्च (endless) / बुद्धयः (minds) / अव्यवसायिनाम् (unsteady) । / निवृत्ति (renunciation) मूलकः (rooted) / एव (alone) / एकः (one) / निष्कामकर्मयोगकः (selfless-action-yoga practitioner) ॥
shakti_gita::226.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::226.essence: Restless minds scatter; selfless action rooted in renunciation brings steady wisdom.
shakti_gita::226.simple_meaning: Minds attached to results are restless and scattered, but selfless action rooted in renunciation brings steady wisdom.
shakti_gita::226.simple_insight: There is calm in acting without craving, even when your thoughts usually wander.
shakti_gita::226.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, the Goddess explains that minds stuck on desires scatter endlessly. Only those who focus on selfless, renunciation-based action find steady wisdom.
shakti_gita::226.modern_relevance: When your mind races through endless worries about outcomes, choosing to act without craving brings clarity and calm.
shakti_gita::226.insight: It teaches you to focus on your action itself, not the results, calming restless thoughts.

shakti_gita::227.verse_hindi: निस्सन्देह एक, अद्वैत, निर्विकार, निर्भय और विकल्परहित है इसमें वासना की चञ्चलता कुछ भी नहीं है
shakti_gita::227.english_translation: The true self is without change, fearless, non-dual, free from doubt and mental fluctuations, and completely beyond restless desires.
shakti_gita::227.translation_literal: निर्विकारोऽभयः (without change, fearless) / अद्वैतः (non-dual) / निर्विकल्पः (without distinctions) / अस्ति (is) / असंशयम् (without doubt) / वासनाया (of desires) / चञ्चलत्वम् (restlessness) / किञ्चित् (any) / नैव (not at all) / अत्र (here) / विद्यते (exists).
shakti_gita::227.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::227.essence: The true self is changeless, fearless, non-dual, and free from restless desires.
shakti_gita::227.simple_meaning: Your true self never changes, has no fear or doubt, and is free from restless desires.
shakti_gita::227.simple_insight: You can find calm knowing your true self is steady and unshaken by confusion or craving.
shakti_gita::227.detailed_meaning: Devi describes the true self as completely fearless and unchanging amid the restless desires and doubts that usually disturb the mind. This teaching comes as she reveals the nature of pure awareness beyond all mental fluctuations.
shakti_gita::227.modern_relevance: When your mind jumps anxiously between worries and cravings, remember your true self is steady, fearless, and beyond that turmoil.
shakti_gita::227.insight: It shifts your view from identifying with restless desires to resting in the unshakable nature of your true self.

shakti_gita::228.verse_sanskrit:
नेहामिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते ।
स्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात् ॥
shakti_gita::228.verse_hindi: इसमें अभिक्रम का नाश भी नहीं है और न कोई प्रत्यवाय ही है, इस धर्म का थोड़ा भी अंश महाभय से रक्षा करता है
shakti_gita::228.english_translation: There is no destruction of this undertaking, nor is there any failure; even a small part of this dharma protects greatly from fear.
shakti_gita::228.translation_literal: नेहामिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति (there is no destruction of undertaking) प्रत्यवायो (failure) न (not) विद्यते (exists) । स्वल्पमप्यस्य (even a small part) धर्मस्य (of this dharma) त्रायते (protects) महतो (greatly) भयात् (from fear) ॥
shakti_gita::228.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::228.essence: Even a small part of your true duty protects deeply from fear without risk of failure.
shakti_gita::228.simple_meaning: Your true duty can never fail or be destroyed; even a small effort in it protects you from great fear.
shakti_gita::228.simple_insight: You can find safety in simply doing what is right, however little it seems.
shakti_gita::228.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the sacred duty one undertakes cannot be undone or fail. Even a small part of acting in alignment with this dharma offers strong protection from fear, encouraging steady commitment despite challenges.
shakti_gita::228.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by anxiety about results, knowing that even small steps toward your true purpose offer real protection can bring calm and strength.
shakti_gita::228.insight: It teaches you to value every small right effort as a powerful shield against fear and doubt.

shakti_gita::229.verse_sanskrit:
यद्यप्यस्मि प्रतिष्ठात्री धर्मयोरुभयोरहम् ।
प्रवृत्तिमूलकस्याथ निवृत्तिमूलकस्य च ॥
shakti_gita::229.verse_hindi: यद्यपि मैं प्रवृत्ति धर्म और निवृत्ति धर्म दोनों की प्रतिष्ठा की स्थान हूँ
shakti_gita::229.english_translation: Although I am the foundation of both the path of action and the path of renunciation.
shakti_gita::229.translation_literal: यद्यपि (although) अस्मि (I am) प्रतिष्ठात्री (foundation) धर्मयोः (of both dharmas) उभयोः (both) अहम् (I) प्रवृत्ति-मूलकस्य (of the path of action) अथ (and) निवृत्ति-मूलकस्य (of the path of renunciation) च (also)
shakti_gita::229.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::229.essence: The inner being grounds both action and renunciation as one unified source.
shakti_gita::229.simple_meaning: You are the foundation behind both the ways of acting and the ways of withdrawing.
shakti_gita::229.simple_insight: You carry within you the power to both act and to release, holding both as one.
shakti_gita::229.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals she is the essential ground for two major spiritual paths: the path of active engagement (Karma Yoga) and the path of renunciation (Jnana Yoga). This teaching shows her as the unified source beyond apparent duality.
shakti_gita::229.modern_relevance: When you face choices between pushing forward or stepping back, remember both come from the same inner source within you.
shakti_gita::229.insight: It teaches you to see action and renunciation as complementary expressions of your true self, not opposing forces.

shakti_gita::230.verse_sanskrit:
मामेव प्राप्नुतो देवाः! द्विविधौ कर्मयोगिनौ।
पार्थक्यं नापि किञ्चिच द्वयोर्वाह्ये प्रतीयते ॥
shakti_gita::230.verse_hindi: और हे देवगण ! दोनो श्रेणी के कर्मयोगि गण मुझको ही प्राप्त होते हैं और बहिःस्वरूप में दोनों की कुछ भी पृथक्ता प्रतीत नहीं होती
shakti_gita::230.english_translation: O divine beings! Both kinds of karma yogis reach only me, and externally there is no difference between the two.
shakti_gita::230.translation_literal: मामेव (to me alone) प्राप्नुतो (attain) देवाः (divine beings)! द्विविधौ (two kinds) कर्मयोगिनौ (karma yogis)। पार्थक्यं (difference) नापि (not even) किञ्चिच (anything) द्वयोः (of the two) बाह्ये (externally) प्रतीयते (appears) ॥
shakti_gita::230.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::230.essence: Different kinds of dedicated action lead to the same divine destination without real external difference.
shakti_gita::230.simple_meaning: Both types of karma yogis, regardless of their external differences, ultimately reach the same divine source.
shakti_gita::230.simple_insight: No matter how your path looks, your true destination is the same and shared.
shakti_gita::230.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses divine beings, explaining that though there are two categories of karma yogis, both attain her. Externally they may appear different, but in essence, they are not separate.
shakti_gita::230.modern_relevance: You see different people taking different approaches to work or service, but all sincere effort connects to the same deeper purpose.
shakti_gita::230.insight: Recognize that outward differences in approach do not change the shared essence of sincere action.

shakti_gita::231.verse_sanskrit:
वासनानोदितः कर्मी यथैव कुरुतेऽवशः।
अधिकारी सकामस्य कर्मयोगस्य कर्म यत् ॥
shakti_gita::231.verse_hindi: क्योंकि सकामी अधिकारी जिस कर्म को वासना की प्रेरणा से अवश होकर करता है,
shakti_gita::231.english_translation: Because the person desiring results performs the action driven by desire,
shakti_gita::231.translation_literal: वासनानुदितः (by desire aroused) / कर्मी (the doer) / यथा (just as) / एव (indeed) / कुरुते (does) / अवशः (compelled) / अधिकारी (the one entitled) / सकामस्य (desiring the result) / कर्मयोगस्य (of action yoga) / कर्म (the action) / यत् (that)
shakti_gita::231.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::231.essence: Acting from desire is compulsion, not true action from the self.
shakti_gita::231.simple_meaning: When you act driven by desire, you are not free but compelled by impulses.
shakti_gita::231.simple_insight: You can notice how desire pushes your actions, limiting your freedom.
shakti_gita::231.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that when someone acts because of personal desire, they lose freedom and become trapped by their impulses. This moment reveals the difference between acting out of inner purpose and being driven by cravings.
shakti_gita::231.modern_relevance: You find yourself chasing rewards at work or in relationships, feeling trapped by wanting outcomes.
shakti_gita::231.insight: It shifts your awareness to see how desire motivates your actions, helping you step back and choose freedom.

shakti_gita::232.verse_sanskrit:
तनिष्कामत्रतस्नातः कर्मयोगी स्वभावतः।
विधत्ते लोकशिक्षार्थ ज्ञानानुस्यूतमानसः ॥
shakti_gita::232.verse_hindi: निष्कामव्रत दीक्षित कर्मयोगी उसी कर्म को स्वाभाविक रूप से ज्ञान में अनुस्यूत रहकर लोक शिक्षा के लिये करता है।
shakti_gita::232.english_translation: A karma yogi, naturally free from desire, performs actions for the world's teaching with a mind united in wisdom.
shakti_gita::232.translation_literal: तनिष्कामत्रतस्नातः (free from desire) / कर्मयोगी (karma yogi) / स्वभावतः (by nature) / विधत्ते (performs) / लोकशिक्षार्थ (for world teaching) / ज्ञानानुस्यूतमानसः (mind united with wisdom)
shakti_gita::232.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::232.essence: Acting without desire while your mind stays united with wisdom benefits all around you.
shakti_gita::232.simple_meaning: You naturally perform your actions without craving results, guided by wisdom to teach others.
shakti_gita::232.simple_insight: You can act freely and still share your wisdom with the world.
shakti_gita::232.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that a true karma yogi naturally acts without desire. Their mind stays connected to wisdom, and their actions serve to teach and benefit others.
shakti_gita::232.modern_relevance: You finish your work calmly, without clinging to praise or reward, letting your clear understanding shape your efforts.
shakti_gita::232.insight: It teaches you to act from your natural state of desirelessness, letting wisdom guide your purpose beyond personal gain.

shakti_gita::233.verse_sanskrit:
भावासक्तिपृथग्भावादत्यन्तात्तु द्वयोरहम् ।
साधारणविशेपाख्यौ धौ संस्थापये क्रमात ॥
shakti_gita::233.verse_hindi: परन्तु उन अधिकारियों में आसक्ति और भाव की अत्यन्त पृथक्ता होने के कारण मैं उनमें यथाक्रम विशेष और साधारण धर्म को स्थापित करती हूँ ॥
shakti_gita::233.english_translation: Because the officials differ greatly in attachment and emotion, I establish special and general duties for them in order.
shakti_gita::233.translation_literal: भावा (attachment/emotion) असक्ति (non-attachment) पृथक् (separate) भावात् (from emotion) अत्यन्तात् (extreme) तु (but) द्वयोः (of two) अहम् (I) साधारण (general) विशेपाख्यौ (special/general named) धौ (in) संस्थापये (establish) क्रमात् (in order)
shakti_gita::233.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::233.essence: Different feelings require tailored duties; general rules alone don’t fit everyone.
shakti_gita::233.simple_meaning: People differ in how attached or emotional they are, so different duties suit them better; both general and special responsibilities exist.
shakti_gita::233.simple_insight: It feels reassuring that your unique feelings and attachments naturally shape your responsibilities.
shakti_gita::233.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that among various officials, attachment and emotion vary greatly. Because of this, she sets both common and special duties for them, fitting their nature and situation.
shakti_gita::233.modern_relevance: At work, some colleagues feel deeply connected to tasks while others stay distant; recognizing this helps assign roles that fit each person's style.
shakti_gita::233.insight: It teaches you to embrace your current feelings as clues to your proper role and responsibilities.

shakti_gita::234.verse_sanskrit:
नैके विशेषधर्मस्य ह्यधिकारा भवन्त्यतः।
नास्ति साधारणे धर्मे त्वधिकारविभिन्नता ॥
shakti_gita::234.verse_hindi: यही कारण है कि विशेष धर्म में अधिकार अनेक हैं और साधारण धर्म में अधिकार विभिन्नता नहीं है
shakti_gita::234.english_translation: The reason is that special duties have many rights, while common duties have no difference in rights.
shakti_gita::234.translation_literal: नैके (many) विशेषधर्मस्य (of special duties) हि (indeed) अधिकार (rights) भवन्ति (are) अतः (therefore) नास्ति (there is not) साधारणे (in common) धर्मे (duties) तु (but) अधिकारविभिन्नता (difference in rights) । (punctuation)
shakti_gita::234.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::234.essence: Special duties carry many rights; common duties share equal rights without difference.
shakti_gita::234.simple_meaning: Some roles or duties have many specific rights and responsibilities, while others share the same rights without difference.
shakti_gita::234.simple_insight: Knowing your unique duties means understanding the special rights that come with them.
shakti_gita::234.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that certain special duties grant many distinct rights, while common duties are equal without differences in rights, highlighting the importance of recognizing specific roles in life.
shakti_gita::234.modern_relevance: At work, your unique role may give you specific freedoms or responsibilities unlike general tasks everyone shares.
shakti_gita::234.insight: It teaches you to recognize when your role carries special authority versus when duties are shared equally.

shakti_gita::235.verse_sanskrit:
यथा रोचेत वो देवाः ! कर्मयोग तथाविधम् ।
निःश्रेयसं समाश्रित्याऽभ्युदयं वाप्यवानुत ॥
shakti_gita::235.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! आपलोगों की जैसी रुचि हो उसी प्रकार के कर्मयोग का आश्रय करके अभ्युदय या निःश्रेयस प्राप्त करें
shakti_gita::235.english_translation: O celestial beings! Pursue the path of action that suits your nature to attain progress or the highest good.
shakti_gita::235.translation_literal: यथा (as) / रोचेत (pleases) / वो (you all) / देवाः (celestial beings) / कर्मयोग (path of action) / तथाविधम् (in that way) / निःश्रेयसं (highest good) / समाश्रित्याऽभ्युदयं (attaining progress) / वापि (also) / आवानुत (may come)
shakti_gita::235.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::235.essence: Progress and highest good come from choosing the action path that suits your nature.
shakti_gita::235.simple_meaning: You should follow the kind of action that feels natural and appealing to you to gain progress or the highest benefit.
shakti_gita::235.simple_insight: You feel empowered when you act in ways true to yourself, leading naturally to growth and well-being.
shakti_gita::235.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses celestial beings, advising them to choose the form of action (karma yoga) that resonates with their nature so they can advance toward well-being or the highest good. This teaching encourages aligning actions with inner disposition for effective spiritual progress.
shakti_gita::235.modern_relevance: You face many choices about how to act—when you pick the way that feels right for you, growth and success come more naturally.
shakti_gita::235.insight: It shifts your focus from copying others to discovering and following your own authentic way of acting.

shakti_gita::236.verse_sanskrit:
तिम्रो यद्यपि जीवानामस्म्यहं गतयो ध्रुवम् ।
कृष्णशुक्ले तथापि स्तः प्रवृत्तिमूलिके गती ॥
shakti_gita::236.verse_hindi: यद्यपि जीवों की त्रिविध गति मैं ही हूँ  तथापि कृष्ण और शुक्ल गति  प्रवृत्तिधर्म मूलक है
shakti_gita::236.english_translation: Though I am the threefold path of living beings, Krishna and Shukla paths are based on active duty.
shakti_gita::236.translation_literal: तिम्रो (of living beings) / यद्यपि (although) / जीवानामस्म्यहं (I am of the living beings) / गतयो (paths) / ध्रुवम् (certain) / कृष्णशुक्ले (Krishna and Shukla) / तथापि (still) / स्तः (are) / प्रवृत्तिमूलिके (rooted in action) / गती (paths)
shakti_gita::236.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::236.essence: Life follows many paths, some rooted in active doing and duty.
shakti_gita::236.simple_meaning: The divine is the source of all three ways life moves, but some paths are based on action and duty.
shakti_gita::236.simple_insight: Life’s directions include active duty and deeper inner currents beyond action.
shakti_gita::236.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that she embodies the three kinds of movements or paths that living beings take. Among these, the Krishna and Shukla paths relate to active, duty-based living, highlighting different qualities of life’s flow.
shakti_gita::236.modern_relevance: You juggle many roles and directions in life; some demand active work while others ask for inner awareness.
shakti_gita::236.insight: Recognize that not all paths you follow are the same—some require active engagement, others deeper reflection.

shakti_gita::237.verse_sanskrit:
सहजाख्यगतेरस्ति ह्यधिकारस्तु केवलम् ।
योगस्थानां सुशान्तानां निष्कामवतशालिनाम् ॥
shakti_gita::237.verse_hindi: और सहजगति के अधिकारी शान्त निष्काम कर्मयोगी ही केवल हो सकते हैं।
shakti_gita::237.english_translation: Only those who have attained natural progression, are established in yoga, peaceful, and act without desire are fit for true authority.
shakti_gita::237.translation_literal: सहजाख्यगतेरस्ति (in natural progression) हि (indeed) अधिकारस्तु (authority) केवलम् (only) । योगस्थानां (of those established in yoga) सुशान्तानां (peaceful) निष्कामवतशालिनाम् (those acting without desire) ॥
shakti_gita::237.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::237.essence: True authority arises only from peaceful, desireless, naturally flowing action.
shakti_gita::237.simple_meaning: Only those who naturally progress, stay calm in yoga, and act without craving can truly have authority.
shakti_gita::237.simple_insight: There’s power in calm, selfless action that doesn’t seek reward.
shakti_gita::237.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that real authority belongs to those who follow the natural flow of their path, are steady in yoga, peaceful in mind, and act without expecting anything back. This moment shows the highest ideal of karma yoga.
shakti_gita::237.modern_relevance: You lead best when your actions come from calm focus, not from chasing results or approval.
shakti_gita::237.insight: It shifts your aim from controlling outcomes to mastering peaceful, selfless action.

shakti_gita::238.verse_sanskrit:
सुखानन्दस्वरूपाभ्यामहमेव निरन्तरम।
निखिलोपासकान देवाः ! कर्मयोगे प्रवर्तये ॥
shakti_gita::238.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! मैं ही सुख और आनन्दरूप से उपासकों को कर्मयोग में निरन्तर प्रवृत्त कराती हूँ
shakti_gita::238.english_translation: O divine beings! I continuously inspire all devotees with the nature of bliss and joy to engage in the yoga of action.
shakti_gita::238.translation_literal: सुखानन्दस्वरूपाभ्या (bliss and joy forms) / अहमेव (I alone) / निरन्तरम (continuously) / निखिल (all) / उपासकान (devotees) / देवाः (divine beings) / कर्मयोगे (in karma yoga) / प्रवर्तये (cause to engage)
shakti_gita::238.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::238.essence: Joy can continuously inspire you to act fully without attachment to outcomes.
shakti_gita::238.simple_meaning: You are continuously inspired by the feeling of joy to act without attachment to results.
shakti_gita::238.simple_insight: You can find ongoing joy that naturally motivates you to act fully and freely.
shakti_gita::238.detailed_meaning: Devi tells the divine beings that she constantly fills all devotees with blissful energy, inspiring them to practice karma yoga — acting with dedication but without attachment to outcomes.
