shakti_gita::238.modern_relevance: You wake up feeling a quiet happiness that pushes you to do your work fully, regardless of recognition or reward.
shakti_gita::238.insight: It teaches you to let joy be the driver of your actions, freeing you from craving results.

shakti_gita::239.verse_sanskrit:
सुस्वमेतद्धि जानीत विपयानन्दमूलकम् ।
आनन्दो विद्यते नूनं मत्स्वरूपं न संशयः ॥
shakti_gita::239.verse_hindi: सुख को विषयानन्दमूलक जानो और आनन्द मेरा ही स्वरुप है इसमें संदेह नहीं
shakti_gita::239.english_translation: Know well that happiness arises from external pleasures; true bliss is my own nature beyond doubt.
shakti_gita::239.translation_literal: सुस्वमेतद्धि (well/clearly this) / जानीत (know) / विपयानन्दमूलकम् (external-pleasure-rooted) / आनन्दो (happiness) / विद्यते (exists) / नूनं (indeed) / मत्स्वरूपं (my-nature) / न (not) / संशयः (doubt)
shakti_gita::239.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::239.essence: True bliss is your unchanging nature, not the fleeting happiness from external things.
shakti_gita::239.simple_meaning: Happiness from outside things is temporary, but true and lasting joy is your own real nature without any doubt.
shakti_gita::239.simple_insight: You can feel peaceful knowing your true self is pure joy, not dependent on outside things.
shakti_gita::239.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that what we often call happiness comes from external pleasures, which are temporary. However, the lasting bliss she embodies is the essential nature of the true self, beyond any doubt or question.
shakti_gita::239.modern_relevance: You chase notifications, praise, or possessions for happiness, but real joy lives inside you, untouched by those things.
shakti_gita::239.insight: Shift your focus from chasing external pleasures to recognizing the joy already present within your true self.

shakti_gita::240.verse_sanskrit:
ये ममोपासकास्सन्तो योगिनो मद्विभूतिषु ।
मच्छक्तिष्वपि मुह्यन्ति दक्षिणास्सन्ति तेऽपि च ॥
shakti_gita::240.verse_hindi: मेरे उपासक योगिगण जो मेरी विभूति और शक्तियों में ही मुग्ध रहते हैं वह भी उदार हैं
shakti_gita::240.english_translation: Those who worship me but become attached to my manifestations and powers are deluded, though they are devoted.
shakti_gita::240.translation_literal: ये (these) मम (my) उपासका: (worshippers) सन्त: (are) योगिन: (yogis) मद्-विभूति-षु (in my manifestations) । मच्छक्ति-षु अपि (in my powers also) मुह्यन्ति (are deluded) दक्षिणा: (devoted) सन्ति (are) तेऽपि च (even those)
shakti_gita::240.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::240.essence: Devotion focused only on divine powers can still be sincere yet confused.
shakti_gita::240.simple_meaning: Some who worship the divine focus only on her powers and forms and get confused, even though they are devoted.
shakti_gita::240.simple_insight: It's comforting to know devotion can be sincere even when caught by appearances.
shakti_gita::240.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that her worshippers, the yogis, sometimes get caught up admiring only her powers and manifestations, which leads to confusion despite their devotion. This shows devotion can be sincere but still incomplete.
shakti_gita::240.modern_relevance: You might deeply admire someone's skills or achievements but miss the deeper person behind them.
shakti_gita::240.insight: It teaches you to look beyond surface qualities in devotion and seek the deeper connection.

shakti_gita::241.verse_sanskrit:
मद्विभूतिमनिच्छंस्तु शक्तिमप्यैश्वरीं मम।
योग साध्यो प्नोति यो नित्यं केवलं मदवाप्तये ॥
shakti_gita::241.verse_hindi: परन्तु जो मेरी विभूति और ऐशी शक्तियों की इच्छा न रख कर केवल मेरी ही प्राप्ति के लिये योगसाधन नियमित करते हैं
shakti_gita::241.english_translation: But those who do not desire my manifestations or my sovereign powers, and practice yoga constantly solely to attain me.
shakti_gita::241.translation_literal: मद्विभूतिम् (my manifestations) अनिच्छंस्तु (not desiring) शक्तिम् (power) अपि (also) ऐश्वरीं (sovereign) मम (of me) योग (yoga) साध्यो (practiced) प्नोति (attains) यो (who) नित्यं (constantly) केवलं (only) मदवाप्तये (for my attainment)
shakti_gita::241.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::241.essence: Only those who seek the source itself, not its powers, achieve true union.
shakti_gita::241.simple_meaning: True devotion means focusing only on connecting with me, not chasing my powers or special forms.
shakti_gita::241.simple_insight: There's peace in wanting only the source, not the many effects it can produce.
shakti_gita::241.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that seekers who avoid craving her various divine powers and manifestations, and instead practice yoga only to unite with her essence, follow the highest devotion.
shakti_gita::241.modern_relevance: You may feel tempted to chase achievements or status, but real fulfillment comes from seeking your deepest source, not its rewards.
shakti_gita::241.insight: Shift your focus from external benefits to the inward connection with your true self.

shakti_gita::242.verse_sanskrit:
निष्कामयोगनिष्ठोऽसौ ज्ञानी स्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
आर्तो जिज्ञामुरार्थी भक्ता मे त्रिविधा इमे ॥
shakti_gita::242.verse_hindi: वह निष्काम योगनिष्ट ज्ञानी मेरी आत्मा ही है। आर्त, जिज्ञासु और अर्थार्थी यह तीन प्रकार के मेरे भक्त
shakti_gita::242.english_translation: The one established in selfless action is the knower, truly my own self; my devotees are of three kinds: the distressed, the seeker, and the desirous.
shakti_gita::242.translation_literal: निष्कामयोगनिष्ठोऽसौ (that one established in selfless action) ज्ञानी (knower) स्वात्मैव (true self) मे (my) मतम् (opinion) । आर्तो (distressed) जिज्ञामुः (seeker) अर्थार्थी (desirous) भक्ता (devotees) मे (my) त्रिविधा (threefold) इमे (these)
shakti_gita::242.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::242.essence: Acting without craving reveals your true self and embraces all kinds of devotion.
shakti_gita::242.simple_meaning: You become truly wise and connected to your true self when you act without wanting personal gain. The divine sees three kinds of devotees: those in pain, those searching, and those who desire.
shakti_gita::242.simple_insight: You can feel deeply connected by acting without craving, regardless of your struggles or desires.
shakti_gita::242.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the highest knower is the one who practices selfless action, identifying that person as her own true self. She acknowledges three types of devotees: those suffering, those seeking understanding, and those with desires, showing a compassionate recognition of different spiritual stages.
shakti_gita::242.modern_relevance: When you work without expecting rewards, you align with your true self. Whether you feel lost, curious, or driven, that openness connects you to deeper meaning.
shakti_gita::242.insight: It teaches you to embrace selfless action as a path to inner knowing and recognize varied devotional states without judgment.

shakti_gita::243.verse_sanskrit:
अध्वनीनाः सकामस्य भक्तियोगस्य सन्ति हि।
चतुर्थो ज्ञानिभक्तस्तु मत्स्वरूपो न संशयः ॥
shakti_gita::243.verse_hindi: सकाम भक्तियोग के पथिक हैं और चतुर्थ ज्ञानी नामक भक्त मेरा ही स्वरूप है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
shakti_gita::243.english_translation: Those who act with desire belong to the path of devotion through action, and the fourth type of devotee called the knower of wisdom is indeed my true form, without doubt.
shakti_gita::243.translation_literal: अध्वनीनाः (acting with desire) सकामस्य (of desire) भक्तियोगस्य (of devotion through action) सन्ति (are) हि (indeed)। चतुर्थो (the fourth) ज्ञानिभक्तस्तु (knower-devotee) मत्स्वरूपो (my form) न (not) संशयः (doubt) ॥
shakti_gita::243.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::243.essence: Devotion appears both as eager action and as wise knowing, each a true form of the divine.
shakti_gita::243.simple_meaning: Some devotees act with desire and follow the path of devoted action. Others, called knowers, embody devotion through wisdom and represent the divine form without doubt.
shakti_gita::243.simple_insight: Devotion can be expressed through both eager action and clear wisdom, each reflecting the divine in you.
shakti_gita::243.detailed_meaning: Devi explains there are different types of devotees: those who follow devotion motivated by desire (bhakti yoga with action), and the highest type, the knower who embodies devotion through wisdom. This highest devotee is inseparable from Devi's true form.
shakti_gita::243.modern_relevance: You may find yourself devoted either by passionately doing or by understanding deeply; both ways connect you to your true nature.
shakti_gita::243.insight: Recognize that devotion isn’t one shape — it can be active desire or quiet wisdom, each valid and divine.

shakti_gita::244.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वास्वभ्युदयस्यापि बीजेपु योगसिद्धिषु।
मत्सायुज्यदशाप्राप्तौ वाधिकास्ता न साधिकाः ॥
shakti_gita::244.verse_hindi: सभी योगसिद्धियां अभ्युदय की मूल होने पर भी वे मेरी सायुज्य दशा प्राप्ति कराने में बाधक हैं साधक नहीं है।
shakti_gita::244.english_translation: Even though all accomplishments arise from their own seeds, they hinder the practitioner's union with me and are not true attainments.
shakti_gita::244.translation_literal: सर्वास्व (all things) अभ्युदयस्य (of arising) अपि (also) बीजेपु (of the seed) योगसिद्धिषु (in accomplishments of yoga) मत् (my) सायुज्यदशा (state of union) अप्राप्तौ (in not attaining) वाधिकास्ता (obstacles are those) न (not) साधिकाः (true practitioners).
shakti_gita::244.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::244.essence: Not all spiritual achievements lead to true union with the divine; some block it.
shakti_gita::244.simple_meaning: Many achievements come from actions, but they can block true union with the divine and are not the real goal.
shakti_gita::244.simple_insight: You may reach many goals yet still feel distant from the deepest connection you seek.
shakti_gita::244.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that even though many spiritual accomplishments arise naturally, they can prevent the practitioner from attaining true union with her, which is the highest goal beyond mere achievements.
shakti_gita::244.modern_relevance: You might rack up successes, certifications, or milestones yet feel something essential is missing—real connection and fulfillment.
shakti_gita::244.insight: It teaches you to look beyond visible achievements and seek deeper union beyond superficial success.

shakti_gita::245.verse_sanskrit:
पराभक्तेविरोधिन्यो विद्यन्तेऽत्यन्तमेव च।
ऐशीनां खलु सिद्धीनां शक्तीनामपि सर्वशः ॥
shakti_gita::245.verse_hindi: और पराभक्ति की अत्यन्त - विरोधिनी हैं। हे देवश्रेष्ठों ! ऐसी सिद्धियों और विभिन्न शक्तियों को
shakti_gita::245.english_translation: And they are utterly opposed to excessive devotion. O best of the divine, such perfections and various powers do not exist at all.
shakti_gita::245.translation_literal: पराभक्ते (excessive devotion) विरोधिन्यः (are opposed) विद्यन्ते (exist) अत्यन्तमेव (completely) च (and) । ऐशीनाम् (of the divine) खलु (indeed) सिद्धीनाम् (perfections) शक्तीनाम् (powers) अपि (also) सर्वशः (at all) ॥
shakti_gita::245.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::245.essence: Excessive devotion actually blocks true spiritual powers and achievements from arising.
shakti_gita::245.simple_meaning: Too much devotion actually blocks the presence of real powers and spiritual achievements.
shakti_gita::245.simple_insight: You feel relief knowing that devotion is healthiest when balanced, not excessive.
shakti_gita::245.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that extreme devotion—going beyond balance—actually prevents genuine spiritual powers and perfections from appearing. She warns the best devotees not to fall into excessive attachment, as it obstructs true grace and strength.
shakti_gita::245.modern_relevance: You’ve ever felt overwhelmed by your own efforts to be perfect or deeply faithful, only to feel stuck or powerless instead.
shakti_gita::245.insight: It shifts your mind to see that healthy devotion includes trust without overwhelming fixation or craving.

shakti_gita::246.verse_sanskrit:
हेतुतवं बहते प्रासः संयमो विबुधर्षभाः!।
मदवाप्तचेकतत्त्वाभ्यासः कारणतां व्रजेत् ॥
shakti_gita::246.verse_hindi: प्राप्त कराने में संयम कारण है और मुझको प्राप्त कराने में एकतत्त्वाभ्यास कारण है
shakti_gita::246.english_translation: Discipline is the cause of attaining causes, and practice of unity is the cause of attaining Me.
shakti_gita::246.translation_literal: हेतुतवं (cause of cause) बहते (flows) प्रासः (effect) संयमो (discipline) विबुधर्षभाः (wise bulls)! मदवाप्तचेकतत्त्वाभ्यासः (practice of unity with Me) कारणतां (cause) व्रजेत् (leads to).
shakti_gita::246.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::246.essence: Discipline creates causes; focused unity practice leads to the divine itself.
shakti_gita::246.simple_meaning: Discipline creates the conditions to reach your goals, and focused practice on unity with the divine brings you to the divine itself.
shakti_gita::246.simple_insight: You feel empowered knowing steady effort and focused unity open the way to the highest goal.
shakti_gita::246.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Devi explains to wise seekers that disciplined effort creates the causes needed to achieve results, while dedicated practice uniting the self with the divine leads directly to experiencing the divine.
shakti_gita::246.modern_relevance: You stick to your daily habits and practices, building momentum that opens new possibilities, while deep focus on your core values or purpose brings profound meaning.
shakti_gita::246.insight: It teaches you to value both consistent discipline for progress and focused unity practice to connect beyond results.

shakti_gita::247.verse_sanskrit:
योगः स्वरूपतो नूनमष्टाङ्गेषु विभज्यते ।
यमश्च नियमश्चैव तथैवासनमेव च ॥
shakti_gita::247.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! योग स्वरूपतः आठ अंगों में ही विभक्त है, यथा-यम, नियम, आसन,
shakti_gita::247.english_translation: O divine beings! Yoga by its nature is divided into eight limbs: restraint, observance, posture, and so on.
shakti_gita::247.translation_literal: योगः (Yoga) स्वरूपतः (by nature) नूनम् (indeed) अष्टाङ्गेषु (in eight limbs) विभज्यते (is divided) । यमः (restraint) च (and) नियमः (observance) च (and) एव (indeed) आसनम् (posture) एव (indeed) च (and) ॥
shakti_gita::247.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::247.essence: Yoga is naturally structured into eight essential limbs guiding disciplined practice.
shakti_gita::247.simple_meaning: Yoga naturally divides into eight parts, including restraint, observance, and posture.
shakti_gita::247.simple_insight: Seeing yoga as a step-by-step practice brings clarity and focus to your effort.
shakti_gita::247.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses the divine assembly, explaining that yoga is fundamentally composed of eight limbs. These include moral restraint, disciplined observance, and physical posture, forming a structured path toward mastery.
shakti_gita::247.modern_relevance: You prepare for a challenging project by breaking it down into clear, manageable steps, just like yoga’s eight limbs guide progress.
shakti_gita::247.insight: It teaches you to approach personal growth as a gradual, disciplined process with distinct stages.

shakti_gita::248.verse_sanskrit:
प्राणायामस्तथा देवाः ! प्रत्याहारश्च धारणा।
ध्यानं समाधिरित्यष्टौ योगस्याङ्गानि सन्ति ह ॥
shakti_gita::248.verse_hindi: प्राणायाम, प्रत्याहार धारणा, ध्यान और समाधि यही योग के आठ अंग है
shakti_gita::248.english_translation: Pranayama, withdrawal of the senses, concentration, meditation, and samadhi are the eight limbs of yoga.
shakti_gita::248.translation_literal: प्राणायाम (breath control) / तथा (also) / देवाः (the deities) / प्रत्याहार (withdrawal of senses) / च (and) / धारणा (concentration) / ध्यानं (meditation) / समाधि (samadhi) / इति (thus) / अष्टौ (eight) / योगस्याङ्गानि (limbs of yoga) / सन्ति (are) / ह (indeed)
shakti_gita::248.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::248.essence: Yoga is a path of eight interlinked practices leading to deep inner mastery.
shakti_gita::248.simple_meaning: Yoga consists of eight parts including breath control, sensory withdrawal, concentration, meditation, and deep absorption.
shakti_gita::248.simple_insight: You can cultivate calm and clarity step-by-step through these practices.
shakti_gita::248.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that yoga is not just physical postures but a comprehensive practice with eight parts, including pranayama and samadhi, guiding the seeker toward mastery over mind and senses.
shakti_gita::248.modern_relevance: When stress floods your mind, slowing your breath and drawing your attention inward can steady your whole day.
shakti_gita::248.insight: It teaches you to build inner control progressively through focused breath and mind exercises.

shakti_gita::249.verse_sanskrit:
एकतत्त्वैकमूलस्सन्नन्यः संयममूलकः।
अयमष्टाङ्गयोगो हि षोड़शाङ्गैः प्रपूर्यते ॥
shakti_gita::249.verse_hindi: यही अष्टांग योगसंयम और एकतत्त्व मूलक होकर षोडश अंगों से पूर्ण होता है
shakti_gita::249.english_translation: This eightfold yoga, based on unity and restraint, is perfected by sixteen limbs.
shakti_gita::249.translation_literal: एकतत्त्व (unity) / एकमूल (one root) / सन्नन्यः (based on restraint) / संयममूलकः (rooted in self-control) / अयम् (this) / अष्टाङ्गयोगः (eightfold yoga) / हि (indeed) / षोड़शाङ्गैः (by sixteen limbs) / प्रपूर्यते (is perfected)
shakti_gita::249.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::249.essence: Discipline unites focus and restraint, perfected by many supporting parts.
shakti_gita::249.simple_meaning: Discipline is a practice rooted in unity and self-control, completed by many interrelated steps.
shakti_gita::249.simple_insight: You feel strength as your focus and restraint deepen together over time.
shakti_gita::249.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the practice of yoga is founded on a single principle of unity combined with restraint, and it matures through sixteen detailed aspects. This teaching highlights disciplined effort as a foundation for transformation.
shakti_gita::249.modern_relevance: When you commit to a new habit, your success depends on steady self-control and integrating many small practices.
shakti_gita::249.insight: It teaches you to build discipline by grounding efforts in unity and expanding through detailed practices.

shakti_gita::250.verse_sanskrit:
मन्त्रो हठो लयो राजयोग एते चतुर्विधाः।
क्रियासिद्धांशभेदा वै सन्ति योगस्य निर्जराः !॥
shakti_gita::250.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! योग के क्रिया सिद्धांश के चार भेद हैं, यथा-मन्त्रयोग, हठयोग, लययोग और राज योग
shakti_gita::250.english_translation: O divine beings! Yoga has four types based on perfected practices: mantra yoga, hatha yoga, laya yoga, and raja yoga.
shakti_gita::250.translation_literal: मन्त्रो (mantra) हठो (hatha) लयो (laya) राजयोग (raja yoga) एते (these) चतुर्विधाः (four types) । क्रियासिद्धांशभेदा (by types of perfected practice) वै (indeed) सन्ति (are) योगस्य (of yoga) निर्जराः (timeless) !
shakti_gita::250.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::250.essence: Yoga divides into four timeless paths based on perfected methods.
shakti_gita::250.simple_meaning: Yoga has four main branches based on different perfected methods: mantra, hatha, laya, and raja yoga.
shakti_gita::250.simple_insight: Different paths of yoga offer varied ways to reach mastery and inner fulfillment.
shakti_gita::250.detailed_meaning: The narrator introduces four distinct types of yoga based on perfected practices to the divine assembly, laying groundwork for deeper teachings on spiritual discipline.
shakti_gita::250.insight: Recognize that spiritual practice can take many forms, each suited to different temperaments and goals.

shakti_gita::251.verse_sanskrit:
निरोधश्चित्तवृत्तीनां नामरूपावलम्बनात् ।
साध्यते साधकैर्यत्र मन्त्रयोगः स उच्यते ॥
shakti_gita::251.verse_hindi: नाम और रूप की सहायता से साधकों के द्वारा चित्त वृत्तियों का निरोध जिसमें किया जाता है उसको मन्त्रयोग कहते हैं
shakti_gita::251.english_translation: Mantra yoga is practiced by seekers to restrain the fluctuations of the mind through support of name and form.
shakti_gita::251.translation_literal: निरोधश्चित्तवृत्तीनां (restraining fluctuations of the mind) नामरूपावलम्बनात् (by support of name and form) । साध्यते (is practiced) साधकैर्यत्र (by seekers where) मन्त्रयोगः (mantra yoga) स (that) उच्यते (is called) ॥
shakti_gita::251.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::251.essence: Focusing on sacred names and forms restrains the restless mind through mantra yoga.
shakti_gita::251.simple_meaning: You can control your restless mind by focusing on specific sounds and images; this practice is called mantra yoga.
shakti_gita::251.simple_insight: Focusing on sacred words and forms brings calm and steadiness to your thoughts.
shakti_gita::251.detailed_meaning: Devi explains how seekers practice mantra yoga by using repeated sounds and forms to restrain the restless mind's constant fluctuations, offering a practical method to gain mental discipline.
shakti_gita::251.modern_relevance: Your mind races with distractions; repeating a meaningful word or focusing on an image can help you regain calm and focus.
shakti_gita::251.insight: It teaches you to anchor your attention on a mantra or form to reduce mental restlessness.

shakti_gita::252.verse_hindi: विभिन्न अध्यात्म भाव युक्त मूर्तियों के द्वारा ध्यान करते हुए मन्त्रयोग में
shakti_gita::252.english_translation: Meditating on various forms united with spiritual essence through the practice of mantra yoga.
shakti_gita::252.translation_literal: नैकासाश्चैव (various) मूर्तीनाम् (forms) अध्यात्मभावसंयुजाम् (united with spiritual essence) आश्रयात् (by relying on) ध्यायमाना (meditating) हि (indeed) मन्त्रयोगविधानतः (by the method of mantra yoga)
shakti_gita::252.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::252.essence: Meditation deepens by uniting mantra practice with spiritually meaningful forms.
shakti_gita::252.simple_meaning: You can meditate using different images or forms that embody spiritual qualities through mantra practice.
shakti_gita::252.simple_insight: Connecting with meaningful forms helps your meditation feel alive and focused.
shakti_gita::252.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that focusing the mind through mantra yoga on various forms embodying spiritual qualities enhances meditation. This moment shows how diverse forms serve as access points to deeper awareness.
shakti_gita::252.modern_relevance: When your mind wanders, focusing on a meaningful image or symbol helps you return to calm and purpose.
shakti_gita::252.insight: It teaches you to use meaningful forms as anchors in your meditation, enriching your focus and presence.

shakti_gita::253.verse_sanskrit:
मन्त्रयोगपरा धीराः साधका मामुपासते ।
साहाय्यात्स्थूलदेहस्य चित्तत्तिनिरोधनम् ॥
shakti_gita::253.verse_hindi: प्रवीण धीर साधक गण मन्त्रयोग की सहायता से मेरी उपासना करते हैं। धीर व्यक्तियों के द्वारा स्थूल शरीर की सहायता से चित्तवृत्तियों का निरोध
shakti_gita::253.english_translation: Skilled and steady practitioners worship me through mantra yoga, using the gross body to control the restless mind.
shakti_gita::253.translation_literal: मन्त्रयोगपरा (devoted to mantra yoga) / धीराः (steady, patient) / साधका (practitioners) / मामुपासते (worship me) / साहाय्यात् (by the aid) / स्थूलदेहस्य (of the gross body) / चित्तत्तिनिरोधनम् (control of the mind's restless movements)
shakti_gita::253.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::253.essence: Steady practice using the body supports controlling the restless mind through mantra yoga.
shakti_gita::253.simple_meaning: Steady and skilled practitioners use mantra yoga and their physical body to calm and control the restless mind.
shakti_gita::253.simple_insight: You can find calm by combining steady practice with focused use of your body.
shakti_gita::253.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that wise, patient practitioners worship her through mantra yoga, relying on their physical body to help restrain the restless mind. This moment reveals how discipline involves using the body as a tool to steady the mind's fluctuations.
shakti_gita::253.modern_relevance: You sit quietly repeating a calming phrase, using your breath and posture to settle your busy thoughts into stillness.
shakti_gita::253.insight: It teaches you to engage your body deliberately as an ally in calming mental restlessness through steady practice.

shakti_gita::254.verse_sanskrit:
यत्र संसाध्यते धीरैर्हठयोगः स ईर्यते । 
ज्योतिर्मयस्य रूपस्य कल्पितस्यावलम्बनात् ॥
shakti_gita::254.verse_hindi: जिसमें किया जाता है उसको हठयोग कहते हैं। हठयोगी गण कल्पित ज्योतिर्मय रूप की सहायता से
shakti_gita::254.english_translation: The forceful yoga is when the steadfast one uses the imagined radiant form as support.
shakti_gita::254.translation_literal: यत्र (where) / संसाध्यते (is effected) / धीरैः (by the steadfast) / हठयोगः (forceful yoga) / स (that) / ईर्यते (is called) / ज्योतिर्मयस्य (of the radiant) / रूपस्य (form) / कल्पितस्य (imagined) / आवलम्बनात् (by support).
shakti_gita::254.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::254.essence: Steady effort uses a created radiant image as a support to focus the mind.
shakti_gita::254.simple_meaning: Steady effort, called forceful yoga, uses an imagined radiant image as support to focus the mind.
shakti_gita::254.simple_insight: There is power in steady effort when you hold a clear inner focus, even if imagined.
shakti_gita::254.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that forceful yoga is the practice of steady effort by holding on to a vivid, imagined radiant form to support concentration and overcome distractions.
shakti_gita::254.modern_relevance: You focus on a clear goal or image to keep your effort steady when distractions try to pull you away.
shakti_gita::254.insight: It teaches you to use a clear mental focus—even imagined—to steady your effort and willpower.

shakti_gita::255.verse_sanskrit:
ध्यायमानाश्च मां सिद्धार्लभन्ते हठयोगिनः । 
शक्तीर्जड़त्वमापन्नाः प्रमुप्तास्ता वियोध्य हि ॥
shakti_gita::255.verse_hindi: मेरा ध्यान करते हुए सिद्धियों को लाभ करते हैं। समष्टि और व्यष्टि शक्तियों की सहायता से
shakti_gita::255.english_translation: Those who meditate on me attain powers; however, those who gain the powers of the collective and individual forces become deluded and fall away.
shakti_gita::255.translation_literal: ध्यायमानाश्च (meditating) मां (on me) सिद्धार्लभन्ते (attain powers) हठयोगिनः (forceful yogis) । शक्तीर्जड़त्वमापन्नाः (powers of inertia gaining) प्रमुप्तास्ता (they fall away) वियोध्य (indeed) हि (certainly) ॥
shakti_gita::255.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::255.essence: Powers gained through effort can cause you to lose true progress if you cling to them.
shakti_gita::255.simple_meaning: Meditating with strong effort can bring special powers, but becoming attached to these powers leads to confusion and loss.
shakti_gita::255.simple_insight: It feels freeing to gain abilities, but holding onto them can trap your true growth.
shakti_gita::255.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that those who meditate on her with intense effort may gain extraordinary powers. Yet, if they cling to these powers born from the natural world’s forces, they lose their way and fall away from true progress.
shakti_gita::255.modern_relevance: You push hard to master a skill and gain recognition, but fixating on that status can cloud your original purpose and stall your growth.
shakti_gita::255.insight: Shift focus from acquiring powers to steady practice without attachment to results or abilities gained.

shakti_gita::256.verse_sanskrit:
समष्टिव्यष्टिशक्तीनां साहाय्यादयत्र साध्यते।
चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधोऽसौ लययोगो निगद्यते ॥
shakti_gita::256.verse_hindi: जड़भाव प्राप्त प्रसुप्त शक्तियों को जगाकर चित्तवृत्ति निरोध करने को लययोग कहते हैं।
shakti_gita::256.english_translation: The practice of awakening dormant and scattered energies to still the fluctuations of the mind is called the yoga of dissolution.
shakti_gita::256.translation_literal: समष्टि (collective) / व्यष्टि (individual) / शक्तीनां (of energies) / साहाय्याद् (by support) / अयत्र (where) / साध्यते (is achieved) / चित्तवृत्ति (mind fluctuations) / निरोधः (cessation) / असौ (that) / लययोगः (yoga of dissolution) / निगद्यते (is said)
shakti_gita::256.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::256.essence: Awakening scattered inner energies stills the restless mind through the yoga of dissolution.
shakti_gita::256.simple_meaning: You awaken both the hidden and scattered energies inside to stop the restless movements of your mind. This quieting practice is called the yoga of dissolution.
shakti_gita::256.simple_insight: You can find calm by bringing together and activating your inner energies.
shakti_gita::256.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that when scattered and dormant energies within a person are awakened and supported together, the restless mind becomes still. This cessation of mental fluctuations is the essence of the yoga called dissolution.
shakti_gita::256.modern_relevance: When your mind races with scattered thoughts, focusing and activating your inner resources can bring deep calm and clarity.
shakti_gita::256.insight: It teaches you to unite fragmented inner energies to quiet the restless mind and access deeper stillness.

shakti_gita::257.verse_sanskrit:
साक्षादाध्यात्मिकं विन्दु-मयं मे रूपमद्भुतम् ।
दृष्ट्वा कृतार्थतां यान्ति तत्क्षणं लययोगिनः ॥
shakti_gita::257.verse_hindi: लययोगी मेरे आध्यात्मिक बिन्दुमय अद्भत रूप का प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन करके उसी समय सफल मनोरथ होते हैं
shakti_gita::257.english_translation: Those absorbed in complete union immediately achieve fulfillment upon directly seeing my wondrous spiritual form composed of the spiritual point.
shakti_gita::257.translation_literal: साक्षाद् (directly) आध्यात्मिकं (spiritual) विन्दु-मयं (point-composed) मे (my) रूपम् (form) अद्भुतम् (wondrous) । दृष्ट्वा (seeing) कृतार्थतां (fulfillment) यान्ति (go) तत्क्षणं (that moment) लययोगिनः (those absorbed in union) ॥
shakti_gita::257.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::257.essence: Directly seeing your divine spiritual core brings instant fulfillment without delay.
shakti_gita::257.simple_meaning: When you directly see the divine spiritual core, you instantly reach your deepest fulfillment.
shakti_gita::257.simple_insight: There is immediate peace and completion when you recognize your true spiritual essence.
shakti_gita::257.detailed_meaning: The Goddess reveals that those who realize her wondrous spiritual form—the core point of consciousness—experience instant success and fulfillment, showing the power of direct spiritual insight at a decisive moment.
shakti_gita::257.modern_relevance: You have a sudden moment of clarity about your true purpose, and everything you long for seems within reach.
shakti_gita::257.insight: It teaches that direct, clear spiritual awareness can bring immediate transformation and fulfillment.

shakti_gita::258.verse_sanskrit:
नित्यानित्यस्वरूपाणां पदार्थानां विवेकतः।
त्रिगुणानां त्रिभावानामपि नित्यं विमर्शतः ॥
shakti_gita::258.verse_hindi: नित्यानित्य-वस्तुविवेक और त्रिगुण तथा त्रिभावों के सर्वदा विचार द्वारा
shakti_gita::258.english_translation: Constantly discern the true nature of eternal and non-eternal things, and reflect on the three qualities and three states.
shakti_gita::258.translation_literal: नित्य (eternal) / अनित्य (non-eternal) / स्वरूपाणां (of nature) / पदार्थानां (of things) / विवेकतः (by discernment) / त्रिगुणानां (of three qualities) / त्रिभावानाम् (of three states) / अपि (also) / नित्यं (constantly) / विमर्शतः (by reflection)
shakti_gita::258.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::258.essence: Wisdom grows by constantly discerning what lasts, what changes, and how qualities shift.
shakti_gita::258.simple_meaning: You should constantly examine what is permanent and what changes, including the three qualities and their three states.
shakti_gita::258.simple_insight: There’s clarity in knowing not everything around you is fixed or one way.
shakti_gita::258.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches to deeply investigate the difference between what lasts forever and what is temporary, and to understand the three qualities and their three corresponding states that shape experience.
shakti_gita::258.modern_relevance: You catch yourself judging situations as fixed or permanent, but then realize feelings and traits also shift constantly.
shakti_gita::258.insight: It encourages you to shift from fixed assumptions to active, ongoing reflection on changing qualities and experiences.

shakti_gita::259.verse_sanskrit:
शक्तिमाध्यात्मिकी यत्र हितां प्राप्नुवतां स्वतः।
निरोधश्चित्तवृत्तीनां जायते योगिनां सताम् ॥
shakti_gita::259.verse_hindi: हितकारिणी आध्यात्मिक शक्ति लाभ करते हुए श्रेष्ठ योगियों की चित्तवृत्तियों का निरोध स्वतः हो जाने को
shakti_gita::259.english_translation: Where the spiritual power that benefits is attained, the fluctuations of the minds of the best yogis are naturally restrained.
shakti_gita::259.translation_literal: शक्तिमाध्यात्मिकी (spiritual power-beneficial) यत्र (where) हितां (beneficial) प्राप्नुवतां (having attained) स्वतः (naturally) निरोधश्चित्तवृत्तीनां (restraining mind-fluctuations) जायते (arises) योगिनां (of yogis) सताम् (best)
shakti_gita::259.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::259.essence: True spiritual power naturally quiets the restless mind without struggle.
shakti_gita::259.simple_meaning: When you gain spiritual power that truly helps, your restless mind naturally becomes calm without force.
shakti_gita::259.simple_insight: You can find natural calm by connecting with beneficial spiritual strength, not by struggling.
shakti_gita::259.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that when a yogi attains a beneficial spiritual power, the restless fluctuations of their mind cease effortlessly, revealing a natural stillness beyond forced control.
shakti_gita::259.modern_relevance: After a hectic day, you might find moments of calm come easiest when you deeply connect with a source of inner strength, not by trying harder.
shakti_gita::259.insight: This verse shifts the mind from forcing calm to allowing stillness to arise through spiritual connection.

shakti_gita::260.verse_sanskrit:
कथितो राजयोगोऽसौ सर्वयोगशिरोमणिः ।
पराभक्त्यधिकारं मे भक्ताश्च ज्ञानिनो गताः ॥
shakti_gita::260.verse_hindi: राजयोग कहते हैं जो सब योगों में शिरोमणि है। मेरी पराभक्ति के अधिकारी राजयोगी ज्ञानी भक्त गण
shakti_gita::260.english_translation: The royal yoga is called the crown jewel of all yogas. Those devoted to me with utmost devotion, the royal yogis, are the wise and the devotees.
shakti_gita::260.translation_literal: कथितो (called) / राजयोगः (royal yoga) / असौ (that) / सर्वयोगशिरोमणिः (crown jewel of all yogas) / पराभक्त्यधिकारं (authority of supreme devotion) / मे (my) / भक्ताश्च (devotees also) / ज्ञानिनो (the wise) / गताः (have attained)
shakti_gita::260.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::260.essence: The highest yoga blends devoted love and wisdom as its crowning achievement.
shakti_gita::260.simple_meaning: The highest yoga is called royal yoga, uniting deep devotion and wisdom in those who follow it.
shakti_gita::260.simple_insight: You can feel honored to walk a path that blends devoted love with clear understanding.
shakti_gita::260.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that royal yoga stands above all yogas as the crown jewel. Those who approach her with supreme devotion and wisdom are truly qualified to follow it. This verse highlights the ideal of combining knowledge and loving devotion.
shakti_gita::260.modern_relevance: You may admire people who balance deep love for their purpose with clear, wise understanding — this path honors both.
shakti_gita::260.insight: It teaches you to value both heartfelt devotion and discerning wisdom as equal parts of your spiritual journey.

shakti_gita::261.verse_sanskrit:
साहाय्याद्राजयोगस्य लभन्ते राजयोगिनः।
ममाध्यात्मस्वरूपं हि साक्षावकृत्यान्ततश्च माम् ॥
shakti_gita::261.verse_hindi: राजयोग की सहायता से मेरे अध्यत्मस्वरूप का साक्षात्कार करके अन्त में मुझको प्राप्त होते हैं
shakti_gita::261.english_translation: By the aid of royal yoga, royal yogis ultimately realize my spiritual nature and attain me.
shakti_gita::261.translation_literal:
साहाय्याद् (by aid) राजयोगस्य (of royal yoga) लभन्ते (attain) राजयोगिनः (royal yogis) ।
मम (my) अध्यात्मस्वरूपं (spiritual nature) हि (indeed) साक्षात् (directly) कृत्यांततः (ultimately) च (and) माम् (me) ॥
shakti_gita::261.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::261.essence: Dedicated yoga practice reveals your true spiritual nature and leads to union with the divine.
shakti_gita::261.simple_meaning: Through the practice of royal yoga, dedicated practitioners directly experience their spiritual nature and ultimately connect with the divine.
shakti_gita::261.simple_insight: There is deep assurance in knowing disciplined practice leads you to your true self and the divine.
shakti_gita::261.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Devi explains that royal yogis who practice with dedication and focus can directly experience her spiritual essence and ultimately unite with her, revealing the highest goal of yoga practice.
shakti_gita::261.modern_relevance: When you commit to a steady inner practice, you discover your truest nature beyond distractions and connect with something greater inside.
shakti_gita::261.insight: It teaches you to trust that disciplined inner work unveils your true spiritual identity and deeper connection.

shakti_gita::262.verse_sanskrit:
एताश्चतुर्विधा एव मोक्ताः साधनरीतयः ।
ममोपास्तेः सदा देवा मूलभित्तय ईरिताः ॥
shakti_gita::262.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! यह ही उक्त चार प्रकार की साधन शैली सदा मेरी उपासना की मूलभित्ति कही गई है
shakti_gita::262.english_translation: O divine beings! These four types of practice are always the foundation of my worship.
shakti_gita::262.translation_literal: एताः (these) चतुर्विधा (four types) एव (surely) मोक्ताः (liberated) साधनरीतयः (paths of practice) ममोपास्तेः (of my worship) सदा (always) देवा (divine beings) मूलभित्तय (the foundation) ईरिताः (are called)
shakti_gita::262.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::262.essence: Four core practices are the steady foundation of true devotion.
shakti_gita::262.simple_meaning: There are four main ways to practice devotion, and they form the foundation of true worship.
shakti_gita::262.simple_insight: Knowing these four paths grounds your devotion in a steady foundation.
shakti_gita::262.detailed_meaning: The divine Goddess addresses celestial beings, explaining that her worship always rests on four specific kinds of spiritual practice, which serve as the stable roots supporting her devotion.
shakti_gita::262.modern_relevance: When you feel scattered in your spiritual effort, remembering these core practices can help you find steady ground.
shakti_gita::262.insight: Recognize that devotion is not random but built on clear, established methods that support steady growth.

shakti_gita::263.verse_sanskrit:
चतुर्णाश्चैव योगानामेतेषां निखिलाः क्रियाः।
विद्यन्ते विबुधश्रेष्ठाः ! योगाङ्गाष्टकमूलकाः ॥
shakti_gita::263.verse_hindi: और हे श्रेष्ठ देवगण ! इन चार योगों की सब क्रियाएँ ही अष्टांग योगमूलक हैं
shakti_gita::263.english_translation: O best of the enlightened beings! All actions of these four yogas are based on the eight limbs of yoga.
shakti_gita::263.translation_literal: चतुर्णाश्चैव (of four types also) योगानामेतेषां (of these yogas) निखिलाः (all) क्रियाः (actions)। विद्यमते (exist) विबुधश्रेष्ठाः (best of enlightened beings) ! योगाङ्गाष्टकमूलकाः (rooted in eight limbs of yoga) ॥
shakti_gita::263.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::263.essence: All four yogas are grounded in the eight fundamental limbs of yoga practice.
shakti_gita::263.simple_meaning: All activities in the four main yogas arise from the foundational eight limbs of yoga.
shakti_gita::263.simple_insight: You realize that every type of yoga practice shares the same essential foundation.
shakti_gita::263.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses enlightened beings, explaining that the diverse practices of the four yogas—action, wisdom, devotion, and meditation—are all rooted in the classical eight limbs of yoga. This connects different paths under one foundational system.
shakti_gita::263.modern_relevance: You notice many approaches aim for growth but find they share basic principles at their core, like habits or mindsets that sustain any deep practice.
shakti_gita::263.insight: It shifts your view to see different spiritual paths as expressions of one underlying framework.

shakti_gita::264.verse_hindi: ये चारों योग संयम और एकतत्त्व से सम्बन्ध युक्त प्रयोगों के विभेद से
shakti_gita::264.english_translation: These four types of practice are connected by restraint and unity of essence, distinguished by their different applications.
shakti_gita::264.translation_literal: संयमश्चैकतत्त्वञ्च (restraint and unity of essence) / द्वयोः (of both) / सम्बन्धसंजुषाम् (connected) / विभेदेन (by distinction) / प्रयोगाणाम् (of practices) / एत (these) / अध्ययोगचतुष्टयम् (fourfold application)
shakti_gita::264.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::264.essence: Different spiritual practices share restraint and unity but differ in their specific applications.
shakti_gita::264.simple_meaning: Four types of spiritual practice share a foundation of self-control and oneness but differ in how you apply them.
shakti_gita::264.simple_insight: You can find common ground in different paths by focusing on restraint and unity.
shakti_gita::264.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that four spiritual approaches share the core of self-restraint and unity but are set apart by how they are practiced, highlighting a unifying principle behind diverse methods.
shakti_gita::264.modern_relevance: You juggle different habits to grow, yet all need self-control and a shared intention to truly transform.
shakti_gita::264.insight: Recognize that restraint and unity are the foundation beneath varied spiritual efforts, simplifying your focus.

shakti_gita::265.verse_sanskrit:
विभुर्त्ते क्षमते देवाः ! कलापोडशकं मम ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यों युष्माभिर्देवसत्तमाः ॥
shakti_gita::265.verse_hindi: मेरी षोडश कलाओं को धारण कर सकते हैं, हे देवश्रेष्ठों ! आप लोगों इसमें कुछ भी आश्चर्य नहीं करना चाहिए
shakti_gita::265.english_translation: O best of the devas, you can embody my sixteen arts; there is nothing here to wonder about.
shakti_gita::265.translation_literal: विभुर्त्ते (embody) क्षमते (can) देवाः (devas) ! कलापोडशकं (sixteen arts) मम (my) । नैवात्र (not here) विस्मयः (wonder) कार्यों (to be done) युष्माभिर्देवसत्तमाः (you best of devas) ॥
shakti_gita::265.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::265.essence: You can naturally embody extraordinary qualities without surprise.
shakti_gita::265.simple_meaning: The devas are told they can manifest the sixteen arts of the speaker and should not be surprised by this.
shakti_gita::265.simple_insight: You can embody qualities that seem extraordinary without surprise or doubt.
shakti_gita::265.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses the devas, telling them that they are capable of holding her sixteen arts without astonishment, emphasizing their inherent power and ability to manifest divine qualities naturally.
shakti_gita::265.insight: It shifts the mind from doubt to acceptance of your own hidden capabilities.

shakti_gita::266.verse_sanskrit:
विकाशो ज्ञानिभक्तेषु कलाषोड़शकस्य मे।
स्वभावसिद्ध एवास्ते ज्ञानिभक्ता: परन्त्वमी ॥
shakti_gita::266.verse_hindi: मेरे ज्ञानिभक्तों में पूर्ण षोड़श कलाओं का विकाश होना स्वभावसिद्ध है परन्तु वे ज्ञानी भक्त
shakti_gita::266.english_translation: Among my wise devotees, the full development of sixteen arts is natural, but they are foremost as wise devotees.
shakti_gita::266.translation_literal: मेरे (my) / ज्ञानिभक्तेषु (among wise devotees) / कलाषोड़शकस्य (of sixteen arts) / मे (in me) / स्वभावसिद्ध (naturally accomplished) / एवास्ते (indeed there are) / ज्ञानिभक्ता: (wise devotees) / परन्त्वमी (foremost)
shakti_gita::266.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::266.essence: Natural talents grow in the wise and devoted, but devotion remains supreme.
shakti_gita::266.simple_meaning: Among those who are both wise and devoted, developing a wide range of skills happens naturally, but their devotion is what makes them exceptional.
shakti_gita::266.simple_insight: You are more than your skills; your heartfelt devotion is what truly defines you.
shakti_gita::266.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that her followers who combine wisdom and devotion naturally develop many refined skills. Despite these talents, their highest quality is their devoted love, which sets them apart.
shakti_gita::266.modern_relevance: You may have many skills or talents that come easily, but what truly stands out is your sincere dedication to what matters most.
shakti_gita::266.insight: It shifts focus from valuing only abilities to honoring devotion as the highest form of excellence.

shakti_gita::267.verse_sanskrit:
अनन्यभक्तियोगन ध्यायन्ते मां सदा ध्रुवम् ।
अतः सदाऽवतिष्ठन्ते वासनारहिता इमे ॥
shakti_gita::267.verse_hindi: मुझमें अनन्य भक्ति युक्त हो सदा ध्यान करते हैं अतः वह सदा वासनाओं से रहित रहते हैं।
shakti_gita::267.english_translation: Those who always meditate on me with exclusive devotion remain forever free from desires.
shakti_gita::267.translation_literal: अनन्यभक्तियोगन (with exclusive devotion) / ध्यायन्ते (meditate) / मां (on me) / सदा (always) / ध्रुवम् (steadily) / अतः (therefore) / सदाऽवतिष्ठन्ते (remain always) / वासनारहिता (free from desires) / इमे (these)
shakti_gita::267.speaker: Shakti
shakti_gita::267.essence: Exclusive devotion to the divine removes all desire and attachment.
shakti_gita::267.simple_meaning: If you meditate on the divine with exclusive devotion, you become free from all desires.
shakti_gita::267.simple_insight: There is peace in knowing devotion can quiet every restless craving inside you.
shakti_gita::267.detailed_meaning: The Goddess Shakti teaches that those who focus their mind solely on her with devoted love naturally become free from all attachments and desires, showing how devotion purifies the heart and mind.
shakti_gita::267.modern_relevance: You keep returning your attention to what truly matters, and slowly the endless wants that trouble you begin to fade away.
shakti_gita::267.insight: It teaches you to steady your attention on devoted love, which weakens desire’s grip and brings calm.

shakti_gita::268.verse_sanskrit:
मच्चिता मद्दतमाणा मदध्याना मत्परायणाः।
मयर्पितात्मसर्वस्वा मद्गतात्मधियोऽमलाः ॥
shakti_gita::268.verse_hindi: वह मुझमें अनुरक्त, मद्तचित्त, मद्गतप्राण, मेरे ध्यान में तत्पर, मत्परायण, मुझ में ही अपना सर्वस्व अर्पित करने वाले
shakti_gita::268.english_translation: Those who are devoted to me, absorbed in me, with minds fixed on me, fully surrendered and pure in understanding, having entrusted their entire self to me.
shakti_gita::268.translation_literal: मच्चिता (mind fixed on me) / मद्दतमाणा (absorbed in me) / मदध्याना (meditating on me) / मत्परायणाः (devoted to me) / मयः (to me) / अर्पित (offered) / आत्मसर्वस्वा (entire self) / मद्गतः (attached to me) / आत्मधियोऽमलाः (pure in understanding)
shakti_gita::268.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::268.essence: Complete surrender in devotion brings a pure and unwavering clarity of mind.
shakti_gita::268.simple_meaning: You become devoted and fully absorbed when your mind and heart are fixed on the divine, surrendering everything with pure understanding.
shakti_gita::268.simple_insight: Devotion transforms your mind into a clear, unwavering focus filled with trust and surrender.
shakti_gita::268.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that those who fix their minds on her, meditate deeply with love, and fully surrender their entire being achieve clarity and purity of understanding, embodying true devotion.
shakti_gita::268.modern_relevance: You find peace when you fully commit to what matters most, letting go of distractions and doubts.
shakti_gita::268.insight: It shifts your focus from scattered thoughts to devoted presence, purifying your understanding through surrender.

shakti_gita::269.verse_sanskrit:
अपि मय्यनुरक्ताश्च जायन्ते सर्वदैव ते ।
ज्ञानिनां मम भक्तानां नास्ति भेदो मया सह ॥
shakti_gita::269.verse_hindi: और मुझ में ही अपनी बुद्धि लगाये हुए सर्वदा निर्मल चित्त होते हैं । मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तों में और मुझ में भेद नहीं है।
shakti_gita::269.english_translation: Those who are devoted to me with wisdom always have pure minds. There is no difference between me and my wise devotees.
shakti_gita::269.translation_literal: अपि (also) मयि (in me) अनुरक्ताः (devoted) च (and) जायन्ते (arise) सर्वदैव (always) ते (they) । ज्ञानिनाम् (of the wise) मम (my) भक्तानाम् (devotees) नास्ति (there is not) भेदः (difference) मया (by me) सह (with) ॥
shakti_gita::269.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::269.essence: Wise devotion creates pure unity with the divine, removing all separation.
shakti_gita::269.simple_meaning: Those who devote themselves to the divine with wisdom keep their minds pure and become inseparable from the divine.
shakti_gita::269.simple_insight: You can feel completely connected to the divine through wise and pure devotion.
shakti_gita::269.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals that wise devotees who dedicate their minds purely to her experience no separation from her. Their devotion is not blind but grounded in knowledge, creating unity between the devotee and the divine.
shakti_gita::269.modern_relevance: When you focus your mind on what truly matters with understanding and love, you feel deeply connected and inseparable from that source.
shakti_gita::269.insight: It teaches you to cultivate devotion with clear understanding, which removes the sense of separation from the divine.

shakti_gita::270.verse_sanskrit:
त एवाहमहो देवाः ! अहमेव च ते मताः।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहः सत्यं सत्यं वदाम्यहम् ॥
shakti_gita::270.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! वह ही मैं और मैं ही वह हूँ। मैं सत्य सत्य कहती हूँ  इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है
shakti_gita::270.english_translation: O divine beings! I am that, and that I am. There is no doubt in this; I speak the truth.
shakti_gita::270.translation_literal: त (that) एवाहम् (indeed I) अहो (oh) देवाः (divine beings) ! अहमेव (I myself) च (and) ते (you) मताः (are that). नात्र (there is no) कश्चन (any) सन्देहः (doubt) सत्यं (truth) सत्यं (truth) वदामि (I speak) अहम् (I).
shakti_gita::270.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::270.essence: You and the divine are fundamentally one without any separation or doubt.
shakti_gita::270.simple_meaning: The divine reveals that it and the beings it addresses are one and the same without any doubt.
shakti_gita::270.simple_insight: You can feel that your true self is inseparable from the divine presence within and around you.
shakti_gita::270.detailed_meaning: The divine addresses the gods, declaring that she and they are one and the same, affirming this without any doubt or hesitation. This statement highlights the unity of all beings with the divine essence.
shakti_gita::270.modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or separate, remember that your true self is deeply connected with everything around you.
shakti_gita::270.insight: It shifts your view from separation to unity, dissolving the feeling of being apart from the divine or others.

shakti_gita::271.verse_sanskrit:
जीवभूमेः समारोढुं ब्रह्मभूमि मुखं सुराः।
अष्टसोपानतुल्यानि योगाङ्गान्यष्ट सन्त्यलम् ॥
shakti_gita::271.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! जीवभूमि से ब्रह्मभूमि पर सुखपूर्वक चढ़ने के लिये अष्टांग योग ही आठ सीढियां हैं
shakti_gita::271.english_translation: O divine beings! The eightfold yoga limbs are the eight steps to ascend from the realm of living beings to the realm of the supreme reality with ease.
shakti_gita::271.translation_literal: जीवभूमेः (from the realm of living beings) / समारोढुं (to ascend) / ब्रह्मभूमि (to the realm of the supreme reality) / मुखं (the gateway) / सुराः (O divine beings) / अष्टसोपानतुल्यानि (like eight steps) / योगाङ्गानि (the limbs of yoga) / अष्ट (eight) / सन्ति (are) / यलम् (indeed)
shakti_gita::271.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::271.essence: The eight limbs of yoga are the essential steps to rise from ordinary life to supreme reality.
shakti_gita::271.simple_meaning: There are eight parts of yoga that act like steps to help you rise from ordinary existence to the highest, unchanging reality.
shakti_gita::271.simple_insight: You can move beyond everyday struggles by progressing step by step through yoga.
shakti_gita::271.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses the divine assembly, explaining that to move from the world of living beings to the supreme reality, one must follow the eight limbs of yoga, which act like steps leading upward to liberation.
shakti_gita::271.modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or overwhelmed, breaking growth into clear, manageable steps can help you reach a higher state of well-being.
shakti_gita::271.insight: It teaches you to see spiritual growth as a gradual, structured process through specific practices.

shakti_gita::272.verse_sanskrit:
समाधिरन्तिमं येषामारोहणमुदाहृतम् ।
सोपानमादिमं देवाः ! येषां हि विद्यते यमः ॥
shakti_gita::272.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! जिनमें अन्तिम सोपान समाधि और प्रथम सोपान यम है
shakti_gita::272.english_translation: O divine beings! For those whose final step is absorption in stillness, the first step is restraint.
shakti_gita::272.translation_literal: समाधिरन्तिमं (final absorption) / येषामारोहणमुदाहृतम् (whose steps are declared) / सोपानमादिमं (the first step) / देवाः (O divine beings) / येषां हि (for those who) / विद्यते (exists) / यमः (restraint)
shakti_gita::272.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::272.essence: Deep inner stillness requires starting with conscious self-restraint.
shakti_gita::272.simple_meaning: Those who reach complete inner stillness begin by practicing restraint over themselves.
shakti_gita::272.simple_insight: You feel empowered knowing that stillness starts with simple self-control.
shakti_gita::272.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses divine beings, explaining that the journey to the highest state of absorbed presence begins with mastering restraint, the foundational step toward deep inner calm and discipline.
shakti_gita::272.modern_relevance: Before you can find deep calm, you first need to pause impulses and set healthy limits in daily choices.
shakti_gita::272.insight: It teaches you to see restraint not as restriction but as the foundation for profound inner peace.

shakti_gita::273.verse_sanskrit:
स्थूलदेहस्य सम्बन्धाच्छुद्धिराध्यात्मिकी तु या।
साध्यते साधकैर्देवाः ! आहुस्तं योगिनो यमम् ॥
shakti_gita::273.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! स्थूल शरीर-सम्बन्ध से साधकों के द्वारा आध्यात्मिक शुद्धि सम्पादन करने को योगीजन यम कहते हैं।
shakti_gita::273.english_translation: O divine beings! The spiritual purity achieved by sages through connection with the gross body is called Yama by yogis.
shakti_gita::273.translation_literal: स्थूलदेहस्य (of the gross body) सम्बन्धात् (from connection) शुद्धि (purity) आध्यात्मिकी (spiritual) तु (indeed) या (which) साध्यते (is attained) साधकैः (by sages) देवान् (to the divine beings) आहुः (call) तं (that) योगिनः (of yogis) यमम् (Yama)
shakti_gita::273.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::273.essence: Disciplining your body is the gateway to spiritual purity and inner transformation.
shakti_gita::273.simple_meaning: Spiritual purity comes when you control and discipline your physical body. Yogis call this practice Yama.
shakti_gita::273.simple_insight: You feel empowered knowing control over your body leads to deeper spiritual clarity.
shakti_gita::273.detailed_meaning: Devi explains to divine beings that sages achieve spiritual purity through managing their gross physical bodies. Yogis name this discipline Yama, highlighting the importance of bodily restraint on the spiritual path.
shakti_gita::273.modern_relevance: When your restless body craves comfort, remembering that control over it deepens your inner clarity can steady your effort.
shakti_gita::273.insight: It teaches you to focus on disciplined control of the body as the foundation for spiritual progress.

shakti_gita::274.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्मचर्य बहि:शौचो ह्याहिंसा सत्यमुत्तमम् ।
सर्वभूतदयाऽस्तेयं मिताहारोऽपरिग्रहः ॥
shakti_gita::274.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! ब्रह्मचर्य, बहिःशौच. अहिंसा, सत्य, सब जीवों पर दया, अस्तेय , मिताहार, अपरिग्रह,
shakti_gita::274.english_translation: O divine beings! Celibacy, external purity, non-harming, truthfulness, compassion for all beings, non-stealing, moderation in eating, and non-possessiveness are the highest virtues.
shakti_gita::274.translation_literal: ब्रह्मचर्य (celibacy) / बहिःशौचो (external purity) / हि (indeed) / अहिंसा (non-harming) / सत्यम् (truth) / उत्तमम् (highest) / सर्वभूतदयाऽस्तेयं (compassion for all beings, non-stealing) / मिताहारः (moderation in eating) / अपरिग्रहः (non-possessiveness)
shakti_gita::274.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::274.essence: True discipline arises from kindness, truth, and moderation in all actions.
shakti_gita::274.simple_meaning: Living with self-control, cleanliness, kindness, honesty, respect for others' possessions, moderate eating, and no greed are the best virtues to follow.
shakti_gita::274.simple_insight: You feel steadiness and respect when you live with kindness, truth, and restraint.
shakti_gita::274.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses divine beings, listing essential virtues like celibacy and non-harming as foundations for spiritual discipline, showing how personal conduct shapes higher practice.
shakti_gita::274.modern_relevance: You notice how small choices—what you eat, how you treat others—shape your calmness and clarity each day.
shakti_gita::274.insight: This verse shifts your focus from external success to cultivating inner virtues through disciplined habits.

shakti_gita::275.verse_sanskrit:
शारीरिकं तपो देवा दानं तु सात्विकन्तथा ।
प्रधानान्येवमादीनि साधनानि यमस्य हि ॥
shakti_gita::275.verse_hindi: शारीरिक तप और सात्विक दान इत्यादि यम के प्रधान साधन हैं
shakti_gita::275.english_translation: Physical austerity and pure giving are the main practices of Yama.
shakti_gita::275.translation_literal: शारीरिकं (physical) तपो (austerity) देवा (the divine beings) दानं (giving) तु (indeed) सात्विकन्तथा (pure, of the nature of sattva) । प्रधानान्येवमादीनि (main and such) साधनानि (means/practices) यमस्य (of Yama) हि (indeed) ॥
shakti_gita::275.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::275.essence: Self-restraint grows strongest through disciplined body and pure giving.
shakti_gita::275.simple_meaning: Self-restraint (Yama) is mainly practiced through physical discipline and pure, sincere giving.
shakti_gita::275.simple_insight: You feel steadier when your body and giving are disciplined and sincere.
shakti_gita::275.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that Yama, the principle of self-restraint and ethical discipline, is chiefly practiced by controlling the body through austerity and by offering pure, selfless gifts. These are foundational steps in shaping character and spiritual progress.
shakti_gita::275.modern_relevance: You decide to take care of your body and give without expecting anything back—these acts strengthen your self-control and integrity.
shakti_gita::275.insight: It teaches you to root ethical discipline in concrete bodily care and sincere generosity, not just abstract ideals.

shakti_gita::276.verse_sanskrit:
नियमो योगसोपानं द्वितीयं सम्प्रकीर्तितम् ।
सूक्ष्मदेहाश्रयायैस्तु साधनैः साधकैध्रुवम् ॥
shakti_gita::276.verse_hindi: नियम योग का दूसरा सोपान कहा गया है। हे देवगण ! सूक्ष्म शरीर के सम्बन्ध से
shakti_gita::276.english_translation: Discipline is declared the second step of yoga, especially for those residing in the subtle body.
shakti_gita::276.translation_literal: नियमो (discipline) योगसोपानं (the step of yoga) द्वितीयं (second) सम्प्रकीर्तितम् (is declared) । सूक्ष्मदेहाश्रयायैस्तु (for those residing in subtle bodies) साधनैः (by practices) साधकैध्रुवम् (certainly for practitioners) ॥
shakti_gita::276.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::276.essence: Discipline is the steady second step that supports progress in yoga practice.
shakti_gita::276.simple_meaning: Discipline is the second important stage in yoga practice, especially for those working with the subtle body.
shakti_gita::276.simple_insight: You can feel steady progress when you embrace disciplined practice as a clear next step.
shakti_gita::276.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, the speaker identifies discipline (niyama) as the second essential step on the yoga path. The focus is on practitioners who work with subtle energies or subtle bodies, showing how discipline supports their spiritual progress.
shakti_gita::276.modern_relevance: You start a new habit and know that consistent daily effort is the key to making it real and lasting.
shakti_gita::276.insight: It teaches you to value steady, disciplined effort as the foundation that supports deeper practice and growth.

shakti_gita::277.verse_sanskrit:
लभ्यतेऽध्यात्मसंशुद्धिस्तमाहुनियमं सुराः ।
अन्तःशौचश्च सन्तोपः स्वाध्यायो मानसं तपः ॥
shakti_gita::277.verse_hindi: आध्यात्मिक-शुद्धि प्राप्ति के साधनो को नियम कहते हैं। अन्तःशौच, सन्तोष, स्वाध्याय, मानसिक तप,
shakti_gita::277.english_translation: The divine beings call the means to attain spiritual purity 'rules': inner cleanliness, contentment, self-study, and mental discipline.
shakti_gita::277.translation_literal: लभ्यतेऽध्यात्मसंशुद्धिस्तमाहुनियमं (attained spiritual-purity means called rules) सुराः (divine beings) । अन्तःशौचश्च (inner-cleanliness and) सन्तोपः (contentment) स्वाध्यायो (self-study) मानसं (mental) तपः (discipline) ॥
shakti_gita::277.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::277.essence: Spiritual purity is achieved by disciplined inner cleanliness, contentment, self-study, and mental effort.
shakti_gita::277.simple_meaning: Spiritual purity comes from following certain practices: keeping your mind clean, being content, studying yourself, and practicing mental discipline.
shakti_gita::277.simple_insight: You feel steady and peaceful when you care for your inner habits and thoughts.
shakti_gita::277.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Devi explains that true spiritual purity arises from disciplined inner practices. She lists four key methods: cleansing the mind, feeling content, studying one's own nature, and applying focused mental effort. These form the foundation for transformation.
shakti_gita::277.modern_relevance: When stress piles up, taking time to calm your mind, appreciate what you have, reflect honestly, and focus deeply can restore your balance.
shakti_gita::277.insight: It teaches you to shape your character by daily inner habits that purify and strengthen your mind and heart.

shakti_gita::278.verse_sanskrit:
आस्तिक्यमार्जवं ह्रीश्च क्षमा चापि धृतिस्तथा ।
देवपिपितृभक्तिश्च नियमस्यापि निर्जराः ॥
shakti_gita::278.verse_hindi: आस्तिकता, आर्जव, लज्जा, क्षमा, धैर्य और देवता ऋषि पितरों में भक्ति इत्यादि नियम के
shakti_gita::278.english_translation: Faith, straightforwardness, modesty, forgiveness, patience, and devotion to divine beings, sages, and ancestors are the timeless rules.
shakti_gita::278.translation_literal: आस्तिक्यमार्जवं (faith and straightforwardness) / ह्रीश्च (modesty) / क्षमा (forgiveness) / चापि (and also) / धृतिस्तथा (patience also) / देवपिपितृभक्तिश्च (devotion to gods, sages, ancestors) / नियमस्यापि (of rules also) / निर्जराः (timeless)
shakti_gita::278.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::278.essence: Steady qualities like faith, modesty, and devotion form timeless discipline.
shakti_gita::278.simple_meaning: Certain qualities like faith, honesty, modesty, forgiveness, patience, and devotion are timeless guidelines to live by.
shakti_gita::278.simple_insight: You feel steady and supported when living by these enduring qualities.
shakti_gita::278.detailed_meaning: Devi lists essential qualities that form the foundation of disciplined living: faith, straightforwardness, modesty, forgiveness, patience, and devotion to divine beings, sages, and ancestors. These timeless rules shape character and conduct.
shakti_gita::278.modern_relevance: When facing difficult people or stressful days, holding on to patience, honesty, and respect keeps you steady and grounded.
shakti_gita::278.insight: It teaches you to cultivate core qualities that sustain consistent, trustworthy action over time.

shakti_gita::279.verse_sanskrit:
प्रधानान्येवमादीनि विद्यन्ते साधनान्यहो ।
तृतीयारोहणं विज्ञा आसनम्परिचक्षते ॥
shakti_gita::279.verse_hindi: प्रधान साधन हैं। विद्वान लोग आसन को तृतीय सोपान कहते हैं
shakti_gita::279.english_translation: The primary practices alone exist as means; the wise call posture the third step.
shakti_gita::279.translation_literal: प्रधानान्येवमादीनि (primary alone and others) / विद्यन्ते (exist) / साधनान्यहो (means are said) । / तृतीयारोहणं (third ascent) / विज्ञा (the wise) / आसनम्परिचक्षते (call posture) ॥
shakti_gita::279.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::279.essence: True spiritual progress begins with fundamental practices before posture or form.
shakti_gita::279.simple_meaning: The main spiritual practices are the most important; sitting posture is only the third step in the process.
shakti_gita::279.simple_insight: You realize that the visible form of practice is just part of a deeper process.
shakti_gita::279.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that among spiritual practices, the most essential (primary) methods are foundational, while sitting posture is recognized by the wise as a later, third stage of practice.
shakti_gita::279.modern_relevance: When you start a new skill, the basics matter most; perfecting posture or form comes only after core habits are in place.
shakti_gita::279.insight: It teaches you to value foundational practices over external appearances or later stages like posture.

shakti_gita::280.verse_sanskrit:
यत्र संस्थापयेदेवं शरीरं सुखपूर्वकम् ।
यतः स्यान्मनसः स्थैर्य वायोश्चापि सुरर्षभाः ! ॥
shakti_gita::280.verse_hindi: हे देवश्रेष्ठौ ! शरीर को इस प्रकार सुखपूर्वक स्थापित किया जाए  जिससे मन और वायु का स्थैर्य उत्पन्न हो
shakti_gita::280.english_translation: O best of the gods, establish the body comfortably so that the mind and vital air become steady.
shakti_gita::280.translation_literal: यत्र (where) संस्थापयेत् (one should establish) एवं (thus) शरीरं (the body) सुखपूर्वकम् (comfortably) । यतः (because) स्यात् (there is) मनसः (of the mind) स्थैर्य (steadiness) वायुश्च (and of the vital air) अपि (also) सुरर्षभाः (best of gods) ॥
shakti_gita::280.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::280.essence: A comfortable body steadies both mind and breath for inner balance.
shakti_gita::280.simple_meaning: You should create a comfortable and steady posture for your body so your mind and breath become calm and steady.
shakti_gita::280.simple_insight: Comfort in your body brings ease and steadiness to your mind and breath.
shakti_gita::280.detailed_meaning: Devi instructs that placing the body comfortably is the foundation for calming the restless mind and the vital breath (prana). This moment teaches that physical ease supports mental and energetic balance essential for spiritual practice.
shakti_gita::280.modern_relevance: You sit down after a long day; your body aches and your mind races. Finding a comfortable posture helps you finally breathe and think clearly.
shakti_gita::280.insight: It teaches you to prioritize physical comfort to naturally steady your mind and breath in practice.

shakti_gita::281.verse_sanskrit:
आसनं तद्विजानीत साधनेषु मुखावहम् ।
आसनस्य वहून्भेदान् योगाचार्याः प्रचक्षते ॥
shakti_gita::281.verse_hindi: और जो साधन में सुखदायी हो उसको आसन कहते हैं । योगवित् आचार्यगण आसन के अनेक भेद बतलाते हैं
shakti_gita::281.english_translation: A seat in practice is what brings comfort; yoga teachers describe many kinds of seats.
shakti_gita::281.translation_literal: आसनं (seat) तद्विजानीत (that should be known) साधनेषु (in practices) मुखावहम् (comfort-giving). आसनस्य (of seat) वहून्भेदान् (many kinds) योगाचार्याः (yoga teachers) प्रचक्षते (describe).
shakti_gita::281.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::281.essence: Comfort in your seat is essential for steady spiritual practice.
shakti_gita::281.simple_meaning: A seat in spiritual practice is one that feels comfortable and steady. Yoga teachers explain many types of such seats.
shakti_gita::281.simple_insight: Feeling comfortable in your posture supports steady practice and inner focus.
shakti_gita::281.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that in spiritual practice, the posture or seat must be comfortable to support meditation or yoga. Yoga masters recognize many forms of seats, each suited to different practitioners and purposes.
shakti_gita::281.modern_relevance: When you sit down to meditate or focus, your seat can make or break your experience—comfort helps you stay present longer.
shakti_gita::281.insight: Choose a posture that supports comfort and steadiness to deepen your practice without distraction.

shakti_gita::282.verse_sanskrit:
निखिलास्तेऽवगन्तव्याः पूज्यन्ग्घ्रे  श्रीगुरोर्मुखात्।
किश्चिदनापि वक्ष्येऽहं श्रूयतां देवपुङ्गवाः !॥
shakti_gita::282.verse_hindi: उन सबको पूज्यपाद श्रीगुरुदेव के मुखसे जानना चाहिये। मैं यहां भी कुछ कहती हूँ, हे देवश्रेष्ठ! आप लोग सुने।
shakti_gita::282.english_translation: All of them must be known through the revered feet of the noble Guru. I also speak something here; listen, O best of the divine beings!
shakti_gita::282.translation_literal: निखिलास्तेऽवगन्तव्याः (all of them must be known) / पूज्यन्ग्घ्रे (through the revered feet) / श्रीगुरोर्मुखात् (of the noble Guru) / किश्चिदनापि (something also) / वक्ष्येऽहं (I speak) / श्रूयतां (listen) / देवपुङ्गवाः (O best of the divine beings)
shakti_gita::282.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::282.essence: True understanding comes through revering and learning from the noble Guru.
shakti_gita::282.simple_meaning: Everything important should be understood through the guidance of the respected Guru. Here, I also say something—please listen carefully.
shakti_gita::282.simple_insight: Trusting the Guru’s guidance opens the way to deeper understanding.
shakti_gita::282.detailed_meaning: The Goddess instructs that all knowledge is to be accessed through the respect and teachings of the revered Guru. She prepares to share more wisdom, addressing the noble divine beings to pay attention.
shakti_gita::282.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by many teachings, returning to a trusted mentor’s guidance clarifies your path.
shakti_gita::282.insight: It shifts attention from scattered knowledge to the focused wisdom of a trusted teacher.

shakti_gita::283.verse_sanskrit:
सिद्धं पद्मासनं देवाः ! स्वस्तिकासनमेव च ।
आसनानि प्रधानानि त्रीण्येतानि नियोधत ॥
shakti_gita::283.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! सिद्धासन, पद्मासन और स्वस्तिकासन, इन्हें प्रधानतः आसन के तीन भेद जानना चाहिए
shakti_gita::283.english_translation: O divine beings! Consider siddhasana, padmasana, and swastikasana as the three principal types of seats.
shakti_gita::283.translation_literal: सिद्धं (perfect) / पद्मासनं (lotus seat) / देवाः (divine beings) / स्वस्तिकासनमेव (indeed swastikasana) / च (and) / आसनानि (seats) / प्रधानानि (principal) / त्रीण्येतानि (these three) / नियोधत (consider)
shakti_gita::283.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::283.essence: Three main seated postures serve as foundational meditation seats.
shakti_gita::283.simple_meaning: There are three main types of seats used for sitting in meditation and yoga: siddhasana, padmasana, and swastikasana.
shakti_gita::283.simple_insight: Knowing key postures helps you prepare your body and mind for deeper practice.
shakti_gita::283.detailed_meaning: Devi instructs divine beings about the three primary meditation postures—siddhasana, padmasana, and swastikasana—which are foundational for seated spiritual practice and inner focus.
shakti_gita::283.insight: It highlights the importance of choosing a stable, appropriate seat to support meditation and discipline.

shakti_gita::284.verse_sanskrit:
प्राणायामश्चतुर्थं वै योगारोहणमुत्तमम् ।
विधारणेन प्राणानां तथा प्रच्छद्यनेन च ॥
shakti_gita::284.verse_hindi: प्राणायाम उत्तम चतुर्थ सोपान है । प्रच्छह्रन और विधारण द्वारा प्राण को
shakti_gita::284.english_translation: The fourth and highest step of yoga is pranayama, controlling the breath through retention and release.
shakti_gita::284.translation_literal: प्राणायाम (breath control) / चतुर्थं (fourth) / वै (indeed) / योगारोहणमुत्तमम् (highest step of yoga) / विधारणेन (by retention) / प्राणानां (of breaths) / तथा (and) / प्रच्छद्यनेन (by release) / च (also)
shakti_gita::284.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::284.essence: Deliberate breath control through holding and releasing is yoga’s highest practice step.
shakti_gita::284.simple_meaning: The highest stage of yoga practice is controlling your breath by holding it and then letting it go.
shakti_gita::284.simple_insight: You feel empowered when you realize breath control is a key step toward mastery.
shakti_gita::284.detailed_meaning: Devi describes pranayama as the fourth and supreme stage of yoga, emphasizing how controlling the breath by holding and releasing it is crucial for spiritual ascent.
shakti_gita::284.modern_relevance: When stress tightens your chest, learning to hold and release your breath calms your whole system.
shakti_gita::284.insight: It teaches you to regulate energy flow through deliberate breath control, deepening your discipline.

shakti_gita::285.verse_sanskrit:
"यदवंशीकरणं नूनं प्राणायामः स उच्यते ।
अनेकभेदसत्त्वेऽपि भेदा अष्ट प्रधानतः ॥
"
shakti_gita::285.verse_hindi: वशीभूत करने का नाम प्राणायाम है। हे देवगण ! प्राणायाम के अनेक भेद होने पर भी योगाचार्यों ने प्रधानतः उसके आठ भेद, किये हैं;
shakti_gita::285.english_translation: Control of the breath is called pranayama. Though there are many types, yogis chiefly recognize eight kinds.
shakti_gita::285.translation_literal: यदवंशीकरणं (control of breath) / नूनं (indeed) / प्राणायामः (pranayama) / स (that) / उच्यते (is called) । / अनेकभेदसत्त्वेऽपि (even with many types) / भेदा (types) / अष्ट (eight) / प्रधानतः (chiefly) ॥
shakti_gita::285.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::285.essence: Breath control has many forms, but eight are essential for disciplined practice.
shakti_gita::285.simple_meaning: Breath control is called pranayama. Though many forms exist, yogis focus on eight main types.
shakti_gita::285.simple_insight: Knowing there are key ways to control your breath helps you focus your practice effectively.
shakti_gita::285.detailed_meaning: Devi explains pranayama as controlling the breath. Though many variations exist, yogis highlight eight primary methods to train and discipline the breath, forming a foundation for deeper yoga practice.
shakti_gita::285.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed, focusing on a few key breathing techniques can bring calm and control.
shakti_gita::285.insight: It teaches you to focus on essential breath control methods to build steady discipline in practice.

shakti_gita::286.verse_sanskrit:
सहितः सूर्यभेदी च तथोज्जायी च शीतली ।
भ्रामरी भस्त्रिका मूर्छा केवली च सुरर्षभा: ! ॥
shakti_gita::286.verse_hindi: यथा-सहित, सूर्यभेदी, उज्जायी, शीतली, भ्रामरी, भस्त्रिका, मूर्छा और केवली।
shakti_gita::286.english_translation: There are seven types of breath: Sahita, Suryabhedi, Ujjayi, Sheetali, Bhramari, Bhastrika, Moorchha, and Kevali.
shakti_gita::286.translation_literal: सहितः (with) / सूर्यभेदी (sun-piercing) / च (and) / तथ (thus) / उज्जायी (victorious) / च (and) / शीतली (cooling) / भ्रामरी (bee-like) / भस्त्रिका (bellows) / मूर्छा (fainting) / केवली (alone) / च (and) / सुरर्षभाः (best of beings)!
shakti_gita::286.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::286.essence: Breath comes in seven forms, each guiding your body's energy and calm.
shakti_gita::286.simple_meaning: There are seven special kinds of breathing techniques that influence your energy and calm.
shakti_gita::286.simple_insight: Breath carries your mood and power; knowing its forms brings control.
shakti_gita::286.detailed_meaning: Devi describes seven distinct pranayama techniques, each with unique effects on the body and mind, teaching how breath shapes inner states and vitality.
shakti_gita::286.modern_relevance: When stress tightens your chest, exploring different breathing styles can quickly shift your mood and focus.
shakti_gita::286.insight: Recognize breath as a tool to influence your energy and mental clarity through varied techniques.

shakti_gita::287.verse_sanskrit:
प्राणायामस्य तत्त्वज्ञैर्योगाचायः कृता इति ।
एतदुक्तं तु योगस्य यमाग्रङ्गचतुष्टयम् ॥
shakti_gita::287.verse_hindi: योग के पूर्वोक्त यमादि चार अङ्ग बहिराज्य से सम्बन्ध रखने वाले हैं।
shakti_gita::287.english_translation: The four limbs starting with Yama, known to the masters of breath control, belong to external disciplines of yoga.
shakti_gita::287.translation_literal: प्राणायामस्य (of breath control) तत्त्वज्ञैर् (by the masters of truth) योगाचायः (of yoga scholars) कृता (made/done) इति (thus). एतदुक्तं (this is said) तु (indeed) योगस्य (of yoga) यमाग्रङ्गचतुष्टयम् (the four limbs starting with Yama).
shakti_gita::287.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::287.essence: Yoga's first four limbs are external disciplines taught by breath-control masters.
shakti_gita::287.simple_meaning: Yoga begins with four outer practices called Yama and others, taught by breath-control masters as foundational steps.
shakti_gita::287.simple_insight: True practice starts with external discipline before deep inner breath mastery.
shakti_gita::287.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that yoga includes four foundational limbs starting with Yama, which are external ethical and behavioral disciplines taught by experts in breath control, marking the start of the yogic path.
shakti_gita::287.modern_relevance: Before mastering your inner calm, you need to establish clear outer habits and rules in daily life.
shakti_gita::287.insight: Recognize that external restraint and ethical practice prepare the ground for deeper inner yoga.

shakti_gita::288.verse_hindi: अब अन्तर राज्य से सम्बन्ध रखनेवाले चार अङ्गों का वर्णन करती हूँ
shakti_gita::288.english_translation: Now I describe the four parts connected with the inner kingdom.
shakti_gita::288.translation_literal: बाह्यराज्यसुसम्बन्धि (external kingdom-related) / वर्तते (exists) / विबुधर्षभाः (best of wise beings) / अन्ताराज्यमुसम्बन्धयोगाङ्गानि (parts related to inner kingdom) / अधुना (now) / ब्रुवे (I speak)
shakti_gita::288.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::288.essence: Four parts connected to the inner kingdom are now introduced.
shakti_gita::288.simple_meaning: The goddess begins to explain four parts related to the inner kingdom she governs.
shakti_gita::288.simple_insight: This moment signals a shift from external to inner teachings.
shakti_gita::288.detailed_meaning: Devi, addressing the wise, shifts focus from the external kingdom to reveal four aspects of the inner kingdom, marking a new teaching phase.
shakti_gita::288.modern_relevance: You prepare to explore deeper aspects of yourself after mastering the outer challenges.
shakti_gita::288.insight: It signals a shift in focus from outer concerns to inner structures shaping experience.

shakti_gita::289.verse_sanskrit:
प्रत्याहारं हि जानीत पञ्चमारोहणं सुराः!।
यथा कूर्मो निजाङ्गानि स्वस्यैव पृष्ठकोटरे ॥
shakti_gita::289.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! प्रत्याहार को पञ्चम सोपान जानो। कछुआ जिस प्रकार अपने अङ्गो को
shakti_gita::289.english_translation: O divine beings, know that withdrawal of the senses is the fifth step, like a tortoise withdrawing its limbs into its shell.
shakti_gita::289.translation_literal: प्रत्याहारं (withdrawal) हि (indeed) जानीत (know) पञ्चमारोहणं (the fifth step) सुराः (O divine beings)! यथा (like) कूर्मो (tortoise) निजाङ्गानि (own limbs) स्वस्यैव (its own) पृष्ठकोटरे (into the back shell)
shakti_gita::289.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::289.essence: Withdrawing the senses inward is a key disciplined step toward self-mastery.
shakti_gita::289.simple_meaning: Pulling back your senses from distractions is an important step, like a tortoise hiding its limbs for protection.
shakti_gita::289.simple_insight: There's strength in calmly retreating your attention to protect your mind.
shakti_gita::289.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Devi instructs divine beings that controlling the senses by withdrawing them is the fifth stage of inner discipline, illustrated by a tortoise drawing its limbs into its shell to stay safe.
shakti_gita::289.modern_relevance: When distractions crowd your mind, you can protect your focus by gently pulling your attention inward like a tortoise withdrawing its limbs.
shakti_gita::289.insight: It teaches you to consciously retreat your senses from external chaos to build inner resilience.

shakti_gita::290.verse_sanskrit:
प्रत्याहरति रक्षार्थे तथैव योगिनो वराः।
अभ्यस्यन्ति समाकष्टु प्रवृत्ति विषयानुगाम् ॥
