shakti_gita::290.verse_hindi: अपनी रक्षा के लिये अपने पृष्ठकोटर में छिपाता है, उसी प्रकार श्रेष्ठ योगिगण अपनी विषयवती प्रवृत्ति को
shakti_gita::290.english_translation: Just as a person withdraws into their shell for protection, the best yogis withdraw from impulses that follow the senses.
shakti_gita::290.translation_literal: प्रत्याहरति (withdraws) / रक्षार्थे (for protection) / तथैव (just so) / योगिनो (yogis) / वराः (best) / अभ्यस्यन्ति (practice) / समाकष्टु (to restrain) / प्रवृत्ति (impulses) / विषयानुगाम् (following the senses)
shakti_gita::290.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::290.essence: Withdrawing from impulsive urges is how the strongest yogis protect themselves.
shakti_gita::290.simple_meaning: To protect yourself, turn your attention inward like a turtle withdrawing its limbs. The best yogis practice restraining urges that follow the senses.
shakti_gita::290.simple_insight: You feel safer and stronger when you pause and hold back impulsive urges.
shakti_gita::290.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that just as a turtle withdraws into its shell for safety, advanced yogis protect their inner being by controlling impulses that arise from sensory attractions.
shakti_gita::290.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by distractions or cravings, taking a moment to step back and resist acting on them shields your focus and peace.
shakti_gita::290.insight: It teaches you to build inner discipline by consciously holding back urges before they lead to reactive action.

shakti_gita::291.verse_sanskrit:
स्त्रीयां यद्विषयान्नूनं प्रत्याहारः स उच्यते ।
एनं वदन्ति विद्वांसो योगपकनभास्करम् ॥
shakti_gita::291.verse_hindi: विषयों से खींचने का अभ्यास करते हैं उसको प्रत्याहार कहते हैं । विषयों में अनर्गल रूप से प्रवृत्त
shakti_gita::291.english_translation: The practice of withdrawing from sensory objects is called withdrawal (pratyahara). Wise ones speak of it as the sun of the yogic path.
shakti_gita::291.translation_literal: स्त्रीयां (from the senses) यद् (that which) विषयान् (objects) नूनं (indeed) प्रत्याहारः (withdrawal) स (that) उच्यते (is called) । एनं (this) वदन्ति (say) विद्वांसः (the wise) योगपकनभास्करम् (the sun of the yogic path) ॥
shakti_gita::291.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::291.essence: Withdrawing attention from distractions is a luminous step on the yogic path.
shakti_gita::291.simple_meaning: You practice pulling your attention away from external distractions; this is called withdrawal or pratyahara.
shakti_gita::291.simple_insight: You feel relief by stepping back from distractions, gaining inner clarity and peace.
shakti_gita::291.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Devi explains that pratyahara means consciously withdrawing the mind from sensory distractions. This is a key step on the yogic path, allowing the practitioner to focus inward and prepare for deeper practice.
shakti_gita::291.modern_relevance: When your phone buzzes endlessly, learning to pause and turn away helps your mind shine with calm focus.
shakti_gita::291.insight: It teaches you to intentionally redirect your attention away from sensory noise towards inner steadiness.

shakti_gita::292.verse_sanskrit:
इन्द्रियाणां विचरतां विषयेषु निरर्गलम् ।
बलादाहरणं तेभ्यः प्रत्याहारोऽभिधीयते ॥
shakti_gita::292.verse_hindi: इन्द्रियों को विषयों से हठात् खींचने का नाम प्रत्याहार है । यह साधन योगपंकज के लिये सूर्य रूप है
shakti_gita::292.english_translation: For the senses that wander over objects, forcibly withdrawing them is called withdrawal (pratyahara). This practice is like the sun for the lotus of yoga.
shakti_gita::292.translation_literal: इन्द्रियाणां (of the senses) विचरतां (wandering) विषयेषु (among objects) निरर्गलम् (forcibly removed) बलात् (by force) आहरणं (withdrawal) तेभ्यः (from them) प्रत्याहारः (withdrawal) अभिधीयते (is called).
shakti_gita::292.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::292.essence: You can forcibly withdraw your senses from distractions to steady your mind.
shakti_gita::292.simple_meaning: When your senses get distracted, you can deliberately pull them back. This controlled withdrawal is a key yoga practice.
shakti_gita::292.simple_insight: There's power in choosing where your attention goes, like turning on your inner light.
shakti_gita::292.detailed_meaning: Devi describes how senses often wander toward tempting objects, causing distraction. She teaches that forcibly withdrawing them—pratyahara—is essential for steady yoga practice, acting like the sun that opens the lotus flower.
shakti_gita::292.modern_relevance: Your phone buzzes with notifications pulling your focus away. You can intentionally step back and reclaim your attention, like drawing your senses inward.
shakti_gita::292.insight: It teaches you to actively redirect your restless senses away from distractions toward calm focus.

shakti_gita::293.verse_sanskrit:
बाह्यालम्बनसाहाय्यात् तथान्तरबलम्बनात ।
प्रत्याहारो द्विधा प्रोक्तो बाह्याऽभ्यन्तरभेदतः ॥
shakti_gita::293.verse_hindi: बहिरबलम्बन और अन्तरबलम्बन भेद से वह प्रत्याहार दो प्रकार का है
shakti_gita::293.english_translation: Withdrawal is explained in two types based on external and internal support.
shakti_gita::293.translation_literal: बाह्यालम्बनसाहाय्यात् (from external support) / तथान्तरबलम्बनात (and from internal support) / प्रत्याहारो (withdrawal) / द्विधा (in two ways) / प्रोक्तो (is explained) / बाह्याऽभ्यन्तरभेदतः (distinguished as external and internal).
shakti_gita::293.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::293.essence: Withdrawal from distractions arises either through outer aid or inner strength.
shakti_gita::293.simple_meaning: Withdrawal, the act of turning the senses away, happens in two ways: by depending on something outside or by relying on your inner strength.
shakti_gita::293.simple_insight: You can pause either by stepping back with help or by steadying yourself within.
shakti_gita::293.detailed_meaning: Devi explains the concept of withdrawal (pratyahara), a key yogic discipline, highlighting it comes from two sources: external support like surroundings or guidance, and internal support like mental control. This distinction guides how one practices self-restraint.
shakti_gita::293.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed, you might take a break by changing your environment or by calming your own restless mind.
shakti_gita::293.insight: Recognize that restraint can be cultivated both by adjusting your surroundings and by strengthening your inner resolve.

shakti_gita::294.verse_sanskrit:
धारणा षष्ठसोपानं योगस्य समुदाहृतम् ।
यदा धृत्या तु भो देवाः योगिनो योगयुक्तया ॥
shakti_gita::294.verse_hindi: धारणा षष्ट सोपान कहा गया है। जब  योगी योग युक्त धृति द्वारा
shakti_gita::294.english_translation: Concentration is described as the sixth step of yoga; when the gods attain steadiness through the yogi's focused determination.
shakti_gita::294.translation_literal: धारणा (concentration) षष्ठसोपानं (sixth step) योगस्य (of yoga) समुदाहृतम् (has been declared). यदा (when) धृत्या (with steadiness) तु (indeed) भो (O) देवाः (gods) योगिनो (of the yogi) योगयुक्तया (with yoga united)
shakti_gita::294.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::294.essence: Steady, concentrated focus is a crucial stage in the path of yoga.
shakti_gita::294.simple_meaning: Focused concentration is the sixth stage of yoga, achieved by steady determination of the practitioner.
shakti_gita::294.simple_insight: Feeling steady focus brings you closer to the heart of your practice.
shakti_gita::294.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that concentration, called Dharana, is the sixth step in yoga. When yogis develop steady determination, even the gods recognize their strength. This highlights the power of disciplined focus on the spiritual path.
shakti_gita::294.modern_relevance: You lock onto a task with calm determination, and everything else fades away, making progress effortless and deep.
shakti_gita::294.insight: It teaches you to cultivate steady inner focus as a disciplined step toward deeper awareness.

shakti_gita::295.verse_sanskrit:
चित्तमान्तरिके राज्ये स्वीयं संयमपूर्वकम् ।
प्रतिष्ठापयितु सम्यगभ्यस्यन्ति निरन्तरम् ॥
shakti_gita::295.verse_hindi: अपने अन्तःकरण को अन्तर राज्य में संयमपूर्वक स्थापित करने का अभ्यास सम्यक्तया निरन्तर करते हैं
shakti_gita::295.english_translation: One who steadily and properly practices establishing their inner being in the inner kingdom achieves continuous control.
shakti_gita::295.translation_literal: चित्तमान्तरिके (in the inner mind) / राज्ये (in the kingdom) / स्वीयं (one's own) / संयमपूर्वकम् (with self-control) / प्रतिष्ठापयितु (to establish) / सम्यग् (properly) / अभ्यस्यन्ति (practice) / निरन्तरम् (continuously)
shakti_gita::295.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::295.essence: Lasting inner control grows from steady, focused practice within your own mind.
shakti_gita::295.simple_meaning: You develop lasting self-control by consistently practicing focused calm within your own inner self.
shakti_gita::295.simple_insight: There's power in steady, patient effort to calm and control your inner world.
shakti_gita::295.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that by consistently practicing self-restraint and focus within the mind's inner domain, one gradually establishes lasting inner calm and control. This discipline shapes the character and stabilizes the restless mind.
shakti_gita::295.modern_relevance: You sit quietly each morning, gently guiding your thoughts instead of reacting, building steady calm over time.
shakti_gita::295.insight: It teaches you to cultivate self-control by gently and consistently focusing inward, shaping lasting calm.

shakti_gita::296.verse_sanskrit:
धारणा सैव विज्ञेया योगाधारस्वरूपिणी।
धारणायास्तु भेदौ द्वौ व्याहतौ योगवित्तमैः ॥
shakti_gita::296.verse_hindi: उसको धारणा कहते हैं। वह योग की आधार स्वरुप है, श्रेष्ठ योगिगण धारणा के दो भेद कहते हैं
shakti_gita::296.english_translation: That is called Dharana, the foundation of yoga; the greatest yogis distinguish two types of Dharana.
shakti_gita::296.translation_literal: धारणा (concentration) / सैव (indeed) / विज्ञेया (is to be known) / योगाधारस्वरूपिणी (the foundation-form of yoga) / धारणा (concentration) / यास्तु (indeed) / भेदौ (two distinctions) / द्वौ (two) / व्याहतौ (are elaborated) / योगवित्तमैः (by the knowledgeable yogis)
shakti_gita::296.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::296.essence: Concentration is yoga’s foundation, and it unfolds in two distinct ways.
shakti_gita::296.simple_meaning: Concentration, called Dharana, is the foundation of yoga, and great yogis recognize two distinct types of it.
shakti_gita::296.simple_insight: Knowing focus has two forms helps you understand and deepen your practice more clearly.
shakti_gita::296.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that Dharana means concentration, the essential base of yoga practice. She reveals that experienced yogis distinguish two different types of Dharana, inviting deeper exploration of focus as a spiritual tool.
shakti_gita::296.modern_relevance: When you try to focus on a task, you might notice two ways your attention can hold steady—this awareness can improve your mental control.
shakti_gita::296.insight: It teaches you to recognize that concentration isn’t one fixed thing but has distinct modes to cultivate.

shakti_gita::297.verse_sanskrit:
विषयालम्विनी ह्येका त्वपरात्मावलम्बिनी।
विषयालम्बनादेवाः ! जायते या तु धारणा ॥
shakti_gita::297.verse_hindi: एक विषयावलम्बन से धारणा और दूसरी आत्मावलम्बन से धारणा। हे देवतागण ! विषयावलम्बन से जो धारणा होती है
shakti_gita::297.english_translation: There are two kinds of support for perception: one based on external objects, and the other based on the true self. O radiant beings, perception that depends on external objects arises from attachment.
shakti_gita::297.translation_literal: विषयालम्विनी (external-object-supported) / हि (indeed) / एका (one) / त्व (but) / अपरात्मावलम्बिनी (true-self-supported) / विषयालम्बना (external-object-support) / देवाः (O radiant beings) / जायते (arises) / या (which) / तु (indeed) / धारणा (perception or grasping)
shakti_gita::297.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::297.essence: Perception arises either from attachment to things or from connection to your true self.
shakti_gita::297.simple_meaning: Perception can arise from attachment to external things or from relying on the true self within you.
shakti_gita::297.simple_insight: You can feel how your mind either clings outside or finds steadiness inside.
shakti_gita::297.detailed_meaning: Devi explains to the radiant beings two ways perception forms: one tied to external objects, causing attachment and instability; the other rooted in the true self, offering steadiness beyond appearances.
shakti_gita::297.modern_relevance: When you notice your feelings shift with every message or opinion, you’re seeing perception cling outside instead of resting in your true self.
shakti_gita::297.insight: It shifts your view from chasing outside causes to grounding perception in your inner being.

shakti_gita::298.verse_sanskrit:
केवलं साधकानां सा भवेत्सिद्धिप्रदायिनी ।
आत्मावलम्बनाया तु धारणोत्पद्यतेऽपरा ॥
shakti_gita::298.verse_hindi: वह साधकों को केवल सिद्धिप्रद है और आत्मावलम्बन से जो दूसरी धारणा होती है
shakti_gita::298.english_translation: She is only the giver of success to sincere practitioners; other beliefs arise from self-dependence.
shakti_gita::298.translation_literal: केवलं (only) साधकानां (to practitioners) सा (she) भवेत् (is) सिद्धिप्रदायिनी (giver of success) । आत्मावलम्बनाया (from self-dependence) तु (but) धारणोत्पद्यतेऽपरा (other belief arises) ॥
shakti_gita::298.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::298.essence: True success arises only from sincere devotion, not from mere self-reliance.
shakti_gita::298.simple_meaning: Only sincere practitioners receive true success from the divine; other ideas come from relying solely on oneself.
shakti_gita::298.simple_insight: You feel relief knowing that success depends on trust beyond your own efforts.
shakti_gita::298.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that genuine success is granted only to those who sincerely practice devotion to her; beliefs based solely on self-dependence are secondary and less reliable.
shakti_gita::298.modern_relevance: You’ve tried to solve a problem alone but found real progress only after asking for help or guidance.
shakti_gita::298.insight: It teaches you to shift from relying just on your own effort to embracing trust in a higher support.

shakti_gita::299.verse_sanskrit:
योगयुंजनचित्तेभ्यो मुक्तिं मा सम्प्रयच्छति ।
सोपानपुंज सत्त्वेऽपि ध्यानदा धारणैव हि ॥
shakti_gita::299.verse_hindi: वह योगाभ्यासियों को मुक्तिप्रद है। अनेक सोपान होने पर भी धारणाभ्यास से ही ध्यान होता है
shakti_gita::299.english_translation: The practice of holding the mind steady grants liberation, even when many stages remain in yoga.
shakti_gita::299.translation_literal: योगयुंजनचित्तेभ्यो (to minds restrained by yoga) / मुक्तिं (liberation) / मा (not) / सम्प्रयच्छति (gives) / सोपानपुंज (many steps) / सत्त्वेऽपि (even in existence) / ध्यानदा (giving meditation) / धारणैव (by holding) / हि (indeed)
shakti_gita::299.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::299.essence: Steady mental holding grants freedom even when many yoga stages remain unfinished.
shakti_gita::299.simple_meaning: Even if you haven't mastered all stages of yoga, steady practice of holding your mind leads toward freedom.
shakti_gita::299.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing steady effort matters more than perfect progress.
shakti_gita::299.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that those practicing yoga do not receive immediate liberation just by having many stages ahead. Instead, steady holding of the mind through sustained practice is what truly grants meditation and freedom.
shakti_gita::299.modern_relevance: You’ve tried to master every step perfectly, but steady focus on your daily practice is what truly moves you forward.
shakti_gita::299.insight: Focus less on reaching all steps perfectly and more on steady, consistent mind-holding practice.

shakti_gita::300.verse_sanskrit:
सोपानं सप्तमं ध्यानं सर्वस्वं योगिनामिदम् ।
ध्येयमात्राश्रयादयत्तु प्रतिष्ठां लब्धुमात्मनि ॥
shakti_gita::300.verse_hindi: योगियों का सर्वस्व सप्तम सोपान ध्यान है । आत्मा में प्रतिष्ठा लाभ करने के लिये जो एकमात्र ध्येय के अवलम्बन से
shakti_gita::300.english_translation: The seventh step for yogis is meditation, their entire being; through focused meditation on a single goal, they attain firm establishment in the true self.
shakti_gita::300.translation_literal: सोपानं (step) सप्तमं (seventh) ध्यानं (meditation) सर्वस्वं (entire being) योगिनामिदम् (of yogis this) । ध्यान (meditation) एव (only) आश्रयात् (by relying) एव (only) प्रतिष्ठां (firm establishment) लब्धुम् (to attain) आत्मनि (in the self) ॥
shakti_gita::300.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::300.essence: Focused meditation on one goal grounds your entire being in the true self.
shakti_gita::300.simple_meaning: Meditation is the seventh and highest step for yogis, focusing on one goal to firmly establish themselves in their true self.
shakti_gita::300.simple_insight: You can find stability and peace by focusing your whole being on a single goal through meditation.
shakti_gita::300.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that for yogis, the path culminates in the seventh step: meditation. This step involves focusing the mind fully on one goal to firmly establish the practitioner in their true self. This teaching comes as a key milestone in the spiritual journey outlined by Devi.
shakti_gita::300.modern_relevance: When distractions pull you in many directions, focusing deeply on one intention helps you find inner stability and clarity.
shakti_gita::300.insight: It teaches you to use concentrated meditation as a tool to root your awareness firmly in your true self.

shakti_gita::301.verse_hindi: चित्त का स्थैर्य उत्पन्न किया जाय उसको ध्यान कहते हैं। ध्यान ही समाधि का एकमात्र कारण है
shakti_gita::301.english_translation: Steadiness of the mind is created; that is called meditation. Meditation alone is the sole cause of absorbed presence.
shakti_gita::301.translation_literal: चित्तस्य (of the mind) यैयै (steadiness) विधीयेत (should be established) तद् (that) अध्यानम् (meditation) अभिधीयते (is called)। समावेध-आर्य- (absorbed presence) एव (only) एदम् (this) एकमात्रन्तु (sole) कारणम् (cause) ॥
shakti_gita::301.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::301.essence: Steadying the mind through meditation is the only cause of deep absorbed presence.
shakti_gita::301.simple_meaning: Meditation means making your mind steady. This steady mind brings about deep absorbed presence.
shakti_gita::301.simple_insight: You can create calm in your restless mind that leads to profound inner stillness.
shakti_gita::301.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that calming and steadying the restless mind (Chitta) is meditation. This steady mind is the only cause that brings about samadhi, a state of complete inner absorption.
shakti_gita::301.modern_relevance: When your mind races among many distractions, practicing steady focus leads to moments of deep calm and clarity.
shakti_gita::301.insight: It teaches you to cultivate mental steadiness as the key to achieving absorbed presence.

shakti_gita::302.verse_sanskrit:
ध्यानसिद्धिं विना योगी न कदाचित्कथञ्चन।
लब्धुम्ह्रति कुत्रापि कृतार्थत्वं कुतश्चन ॥
shakti_gita::302.verse_hindi: ध्यानसिद्धि के बिना योगी कहीं भी, किसी प्रकार, कदापि, कृतकृत्य' नहीं हो सकता
shakti_gita::302.english_translation: Without mastery in meditation, a yogi can never truly feel fulfilled anywhere or in any way.
shakti_gita::302.translation_literal: ध्यानसिद्धिं (meditation-mastery) / विना (without) / योगी (yogi) / न (not) / कदाचित्कथञ्चन (ever/anytime/in any way) / लब्धुम्ह्रति (to attain) / कुत्रापि (anywhere) / कृतार्थत्वं (sense of fulfillment) / कुतश्चन (at all)
shakti_gita::302.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::302.essence: Fulfillment is impossible without mastering meditation and inner discipline.
shakti_gita::302.simple_meaning: True fulfillment for a yogi cannot happen without gaining control through meditation.
shakti_gita::302.simple_insight: Fulfillment depends on quieting and mastering your mind, not just on external achievements.
shakti_gita::302.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Devi explains that without the inner discipline of meditation, even a dedicated yogi cannot experience real completion or success in any aspect of life.
shakti_gita::302.modern_relevance: You might finish many tasks but still feel empty; this shows that without inner calm from meditation, success feels hollow.
shakti_gita::302.insight: It shifts your focus from external results to cultivating steady inner awareness through meditation.

shakti_gita::303.verse_sanskrit:
ध्येयवैचित्र्यतो नूनं ध्यानं ज्ञेयं चतुर्विधम्।
मन्त्रयोगिगणाः स्थूल-ध्यानं हि हठयोगिनः ॥
shakti_gita::303.verse_hindi: ध्येय के वैचित्र्य के विचार से ध्यान चार प्रकार का होता है। मन्त्रयोगी स्थूलध्यान, हठयोगी
shakti_gita::303.english_translation: Due to the diversity of objects of concentration, meditation is of four kinds; mantra yogis practice gross meditation, and hatha yogis practice gross meditation.
shakti_gita::303.translation_literal: ध्येयवैचित्र्यतो (due to the diversity of objects of concentration) / नूनं (indeed) / ध्यानं (meditation) / ज्ञेयं (is to be known) / चतुर्विधम् (fourfold) / मन्त्रयोगिगणाः (mantra yogis) / स्थूल-ध्यानं (gross meditation) / हि (indeed) / हठयोगिनः (hatha yogis)
shakti_gita::303.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::303.essence: Meditation’s form depends on what you focus your mind upon.
shakti_gita::303.simple_meaning: Meditation can take four forms depending on what you concentrate on. Different yogis practice different types based on their methods.
shakti_gita::303.simple_insight: There isn’t one way to meditate; your mind’s focus creates many valid paths.
shakti_gita::303.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that meditation differs based on the object or method used. Mantra yogis use sound-based focus, while hatha yogis focus on the physical body. This teaching introduces the variety within meditation practice.
shakti_gita::303.modern_relevance: When you try to meditate, you might wonder why others do it differently. This verse reminds you that meditation adapts to your focus and method.
shakti_gita::303.insight: It shifts your view from one fixed meditation style to appreciating diverse approaches based on your focus.

shakti_gita::304.verse_sanskrit:
ज्योतिर्धायनं तथा बिन्दु-ध्यानन्तु लययोगिनः ।
राजयोगिगणा देवाः ! ब्रह्मध्यानं प्रकुर्वते ॥
shakti_gita::304.verse_hindi: ज्योतिर्ध्यान, लययोगी बिन्दुध्यान और राजयोगिगण ब्रह्मध्यान के द्वारा
shakti_gita::304.english_translation: Meditators on the light, meditators on the point, and royal yogis perform meditation on the supreme reality.
shakti_gita::304.translation_literal: ज्योतिर्धायनं (light-meditation) / तथा (also) / बिन्दु-ध्यानन्तु (point-meditators) / लययोगिनः (absorption-yogis) / राजयोगिगणा (royal-yogis group) / देवाः (beings) / ब्रह्मध्यानं (supreme-reality meditation) / प्रकुर्वते (perform)
shakti_gita::304.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::304.essence: Meditation can take many forms, all leading toward the supreme reality.
shakti_gita::304.simple_meaning: Meditators use different methods—focusing on light, a point, or the supreme reality—to deepen their practice.
shakti_gita::304.simple_insight: There are many valid ways to meditate, each leading you closer to stillness.
shakti_gita::304.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that advanced practitioners—those who meditate on light, on a focal point, or as royal yogis—engage in meditation on the supreme reality, showing diverse paths to inner clarity.
shakti_gita::304.modern_relevance: When your mind wanders during meditation, choosing a focus like light, a point, or big truth helps steady your attention.
shakti_gita::304.insight: Recognize meditation is flexible; picking a focus aligned with you deepens your inner calm.

shakti_gita::305.verse_sanskrit:
स्वध्येयानां प्रकुर्वाणा ध्यानन्ते विधिपूर्वकम् ।
ध्यायमानास्तु मामेव कृतकृत्या भवन्त्यहो ॥
shakti_gita::305.verse_hindi: अपने अपने ध्येयों का विधिपूर्वक ध्यान करके मेरा ही ध्यान करते हुए कृतार्थता को लाभ करते हैं
shakti_gita::305.english_translation: Those who meditate on their own goals with proper discipline ultimately reach fulfillment by focusing solely on me.
shakti_gita::305.translation_literal: स्वध्येयानां (own goals) / प्रकुर्वाणा (performing) / ध्यानन्ते (meditate) / विधिपूर्वकम् (with proper method) / ध्यायमानास्तु (those meditating) / मामेव (on me alone) / कृतकृत्या (fulfilled) / भवन्ति (become) / अहो (indeed)
shakti_gita::305.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::305.essence: Disciplined meditation on personal goals leads to true fulfillment only when focused on the divine.
shakti_gita::305.simple_meaning: You can meditate on your personal goals in a disciplined way, but true fulfillment comes when your focus rests on the divine.
shakti_gita::305.simple_insight: There is a quiet joy in knowing disciplined focus towards the divine brings lasting fulfillment.
shakti_gita::305.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that individuals who practice meditation on their personal aims using proper methods eventually find true fulfillment by directing their attention exclusively to her, highlighting the power of disciplined devotional focus.
shakti_gita::305.modern_relevance: You set goals and work hard, but lasting satisfaction comes when you connect your efforts to a deeper purpose beyond yourself.
shakti_gita::305.insight: Shift your disciplined focus from just your goals to the divine to achieve true fulfillment.

shakti_gita::306.verse_sanskrit:
समाधिरन्तिमं देवाः ! योगारोहणमष्टमम् ।
एकतश्चित्तवृत्तीनां निरोधोऽशेपतो भवेत् ॥
shakti_gita::306.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! समाधि अष्टम और अन्तिम सोपान है। एक ओर चित्तवृत्ति का पूर्ण निरोध और
shakti_gita::306.english_translation: O divine beings! The eighth and final stage of yoga is samadhi, the complete cessation of all fluctuations of the mind.
shakti_gita::306.translation_literal: समाधिरन्तिमं (samadhi final) / देवाः (divine beings) / योगारोहणमष्टमम् (yoga ascent eighth) / एकतश्चित्तवृत्तीनां (complete of mind fluctuations) / निरोधः (cessation) / अशेपतः (completely) / भवेत् (is)
shakti_gita::306.speaker: Shakti
shakti_gita::306.essence: Ultimate yoga is the complete stillness of the restless mind’s waves.
shakti_gita::306.simple_meaning: The last step in yoga is reaching samadhi, where all mental activity stops completely.
shakti_gita::306.simple_insight: There is peace when your mind's restless waves finally settle and stop.
shakti_gita::306.detailed_meaning: Shakti addresses divine beings, explaining that the highest stage of yoga is samadhi, where the restless mind’s movements end fully, marking ultimate inner stillness and union.
shakti_gita::306.modern_relevance: After endless distractions, you find a moment when your mind is fully silent and peaceful.
shakti_gita::306.insight: It teaches you to recognize and move toward a mental state free from all disturbance.

shakti_gita::307.verse_sanskrit:
द्वितीयतस्तु भो देवाः ! प्रकाशो द्रष्टुरात्मनः ।
यया साधनया नूनं जायते स्वस्वरूपतः ॥
shakti_gita::307.verse_hindi: दूसरी ओर द्रष्टा आत्मा का अपने स्वस्वरूप में प्रकाश जिस साधन के द्वारा हो
shakti_gita::307.english_translation: On the other hand, the seer’s own true self shines forth by a certain means.
shakti_gita::307.translation_literal: द्वितीयतस्तु (on the other hand) भो (O) देवाः (gods) ! प्रकाशो (the light) द्रष्टुरात्मनः (of the seer’s self) । यया (by which) साधनया (means) नूनं (indeed) जायते (arises) स्वस्वरूपतः (in its own nature) ॥
shakti_gita::307.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::307.essence: Your true self shines forth through the right inner spiritual means.
shakti_gita::307.simple_meaning: Your inner true self becomes visible through a proper inner practice or method.
shakti_gita::307.simple_insight: You can discover your true self through the right inner effort.
shakti_gita::307.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the inner seer, the true self, shines forth by using a particular spiritual means or practice. This points to the method that reveals our own nature beyond appearances.
shakti_gita::307.modern_relevance: When you quiet distractions and focus your mind correctly, your deeper self naturally reveals itself.
shakti_gita::307.insight: It teaches you to use disciplined inner practices to witness your true nature clearly.

shakti_gita::308.verse_sanskrit:
प्रचक्षते समाधि त योगतत्वविशारदाः।
सविकल्पः सुपर्वाणः ! निर्विकल्पस्तथैव च ॥
shakti_gita::308.verse_hindi: योगतत्त्वज्ञ उसको समाधि कहते हैं। समाधि के दो भेद योगिश्रेष्ठ कहते हैं, यथा-सविकल्प समाधि और निर्विकल्प समाधि।
shakti_gita::308.english_translation: Those who understand the essence of yoga call that state samadhi. The greatest yogis say there are two types: samadhi with concepts and samadhi without concepts.
shakti_gita::308.translation_literal: प्रचक्षते (speak) समाधि (samadhi) त (that) योगतत्त्वविशारदाः (experts in yoga essence) । सविकल्पः (with concepts) सुपर्वाणः (excellent breath) ! निर्विकल्पः (without concepts) तथैव (likewise) च (also) ॥
shakti_gita::308.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::308.essence: Samadhi can include subtle mental concepts or transcend all concepts entirely.
shakti_gita::308.simple_meaning: Samadhi is the deep yoga state of absorbed presence. There are two kinds: one where the mind still holds subtle concepts, and one where all concepts dissolve.
shakti_gita::308.simple_insight: You can find inner stillness either gently holding thoughts or beyond all thinking.
shakti_gita::308.detailed_meaning: Devi explains the yogic state called samadhi, describing two levels recognized by the highest yogis—one where the mind remains aware with subtle concepts, and a deeper one where all mental concepts vanish into pure presence.
shakti_gita::308.modern_relevance: Sometimes you find calm while still thinking clearly; other times you reach silence beyond thought, both valuable in managing stress and focus.
shakti_gita::308.insight: It teaches you to recognize different depths of mental absorption, easing judgment about your meditation experience.

shakti_gita::309.verse_sanskrit:
समाधोद्विविधो भेदो भण्यते योगकोविदः।
पुनरावर्तते योगी सविकल्पसमाधितः ॥
shakti_gita::309.verse_hindi: सविकल्प समाधि से योगी की पुनरावृत्ति होती है
shakti_gita::309.english_translation: The learned yoga practitioner says there are two kinds of samadhi; the yogi with conceptual absorption repeats.
shakti_gita::309.translation_literal: समाधि (absorption) -उद्विविधो (two types) -भेदो (difference) -भण्यते (is said) -योगकोविदः (learned yoga practitioner) / पुनरावर्तते (repeats) -योगी (yogi) -सविकल्पसमाधितः (with conceptual absorption)
shakti_gita::309.speaker: Unknown
shakti_gita::309.essence: Some mental stillness holds concepts and repeats, not breaking free.
shakti_gita::309.simple_meaning: There are two types of deep meditative absorption: one where the mind still holds concepts, which causes the yogi to repeat the experience.
shakti_gita::309.simple_insight: You realize some mental stillness still traps you in thought patterns.
shakti_gita::309.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, a knowledgeable yogi explains that samadhi, or deep absorption, comes in two forms. One form includes mental concepts and leads to repeated cycles of experience rather than full freedom.
shakti_gita::309.modern_relevance: You sit quietly, thinking you are calm, but your mind keeps replaying the same worries or ideas, trapping you in repetition.
shakti_gita::309.insight: It teaches you to notice when mental stillness is incomplete and to seek deeper awareness beyond concepts.

shakti_gita::310.verse_sanskrit:
अमाधिः शाश्वती मुक्ति निर्विकल्पस्तु यच्छति ।
अतो वदन्ति विद्वांसो योगतत्वानुचिन्तकाः ॥
shakti_gita::310.verse_hindi: परन्तु निर्विकल्प समाधि शाश्वत मुक्ति देने वाली है। इस कारण योगतत्त्वज्ञ विद्वान्
shakti_gita::310.english_translation: But samadhi without distinctions grants eternal freedom; therefore, the wise who contemplate yoga truths say so.
shakti_gita::310.translation_literal: अमाधिः (non-differentiated samadhi) शाश्वती (eternal) मुक्ति (freedom) निर्विकल्पस्तु (without distinctions) यच्छति (gives). अतो (therefore) वदन्ति (say) विद्वांसो (the wise) योगतत्वानुचिन्तकाः (those who contemplate yoga truths).
shakti_gita::310.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::310.essence: Eternal freedom arises when your mind is free of all distinctions in samadhi.
shakti_gita::310.simple_meaning: Complete samadhi without any mental divisions leads to lasting freedom beyond change.
shakti_gita::310.simple_insight: There's peace in resting beyond all mental distinctions and divisions.
shakti_gita::310.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that ultimate liberation is attained through samadhi that transcends all mental differences. Wise yogis who understand yoga philosophy affirm this highest state of unity and stillness.
shakti_gita::310.modern_relevance: When your mind stops splitting into endless thoughts and judgments, you feel a deep, lasting freedom.
shakti_gita::310.insight: It shifts your focus from chasing fragmented experiences to resting in unified, undivided awareness.

shakti_gita::311.verse_sanskrit:
निर्बीजं  निर्विकल्पन्तु सविकल्पं सवीजकम् ।
शुक्लगत्या यया लभ्य ऊर्द्धवलोकव्रजोखिलः॥
shakti_gita::311.verse_hindi: सविकल्प को सबीज और निर्विकल्प को निर्बीज भी कहते है । सब उधर्वलोकों की प्राप्ति
shakti_gita::311.english_translation: Everything with distinctions is called seeded; everything without distinctions is seedless; through pure consciousness, all higher realms are attained.
shakti_gita::311.translation_literal: निर्बीजं (seedless) / निर्विकल्पन्तु (without distinctions) / सविकल्पं (with distinctions) / सवीजकम् (seeded) / शुक्लगत्या (by pure consciousness) / यया (through which) / लभ्य (attained) / ऊर्द्धवलोकव्रजोखिलः (all higher realms)
shakti_gita::311.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::311.essence: Pure awareness beyond distinctions reveals all higher realms.
shakti_gita::311.simple_meaning: Things with distinctions have seeds; things without distinctions do not. Through pure consciousness beyond thought, all higher realms can be reached.
shakti_gita::311.simple_insight: There is freedom in moving beyond mental distinctions into pure awareness.
shakti_gita::311.detailed_meaning: Devi explains how reality appears either with distinctions (seeded) or without (seedless). She shows that by moving beyond mental categories into pure, undivided awareness, one can access all higher realms of existence.
shakti_gita::311.modern_relevance: Your mind labels and divides experience constantly. When you let go of these distinctions, you open to deeper understanding and higher possibilities.
shakti_gita::311.insight: It shifts your focus from conceptual thinking to pure awareness, enabling access to subtler realms of experience.

shakti_gita::312.verse_sanskrit:
सैव शुक्ला गतिर्देवा एति तेषामधीनताम् ।
सविकल्पसमाधौ ये तस्थिवांसो हि योगिनः॥
shakti_gita::312.verse_hindi: जिस शुक्ल गति के द्वारा होती है, वह गति सविकल्प समाधिस्थ योगियों के अधीन है
shakti_gita::312.english_translation: The divine movements that arise through pure consciousness belong to yogis absorbed in meditative samadhi with mental activity.
shakti_gita::312.translation_literal: सैव (that very) शुक्ला (pure/white) गतिः (movement) देवा (divine beings) एति (go) तेषाम् (of them) अधीनताम् (under control) । सविकल्प (with mental activity) समाधौ (in samadhi) ये (those who) तस्थि (remain) वांसः (parts) हि (indeed) योगिनः (yogis) ॥
shakti_gita::312.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::312.essence: Pure movements arise from yogis absorbed in samadhi with subtle mental activity.
shakti_gita::312.simple_meaning: The purest movements or flows come from yogis who remain in samadhi with the mind still active.
shakti_gita::312.simple_insight: You can be deeply absorbed and still have a lively inner awareness guiding your flow.
shakti_gita::312.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that divine movements arise from yogis who dwell in samadhi where the mind is still active with subtle mental activity, showing that pure consciousness includes dynamic awareness, not blank emptiness.
shakti_gita::312.modern_relevance: When you focus deeply yet remain mentally alert, your actions flow with clarity and power rather than dullness or distraction.
shakti_gita::312.insight: It teaches you that deep absorption can include subtle inner mental activity, combining stillness with attentive presence.

shakti_gita::313.verse_sanskrit:
जीवन्मुक्ताः परा भक्ता ज्ञानिनः सहजां गताः।
प्रभवन्यधिकर्तु मे समाधि निर्विकल्पकम ॥
shakti_gita::313.verse_hindi: परन्तु सहजगति प्राप्त जीवन्मुक्त मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त निर्विकल्प समाधि के अधिकारी होते हैं।
shakti_gita::313.english_translation: The liberated beings who have attained natural effortless union are supreme devotees and wise ones qualified for the undifferentiated state of absorbed presence.
shakti_gita::313.translation_literal: जीवन्मुक्ताः (liberated beings) / परा (supreme) / भक्ता (devotees) / ज्ञानिनः (wise ones) / सहजां (natural/effortless) / गताः (attained) / प्रभवन्यधिकर्तु (qualified for absorbed presence) / मे (my) / समाधि (absorbed presence) / निर्विकल्पकम (undifferentiated)
shakti_gita::313.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::313.essence: Effortless liberation blends devotion and wisdom into deep undistracted presence.
shakti_gita::313.simple_meaning: Those who are naturally free and united with the divine are both devoted and wise, able to enter deep absorbed presence without distraction.
shakti_gita::313.simple_insight: There is peace in knowing effortless union and devotion lead to profound stillness.
shakti_gita::313.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that beings who have achieved natural liberation are both supreme devotees and wise seekers. They can enter a state of deep absorbed presence without mental division, embodying the highest spiritual attainment.
shakti_gita::313.modern_relevance: You’ve reached a point where spiritual effort feels natural, and your mind rests deeply without struggle.
shakti_gita::313.insight: It shifts focus from striving to surrendering into natural effortless presence as the highest state.

shakti_gita::314.verse_sanskrit:
स्वदेहं नीचगेहे ते जह्युर्वा जाह्नवीतटे ।
विप्र्भेद्दा विदेहा वा मामेव प्राप्नुवन्ति ते ॥
shakti_gita::314.verse_hindi: वह चाहे नीचों के गृह में शरीर त्याग करें अथवा गङ्गा के तट पर शरीर त्याग करें, वह शरीर रहते भी मुझको प्राप्त है और शरीर त्याग करने पर भी मुझको ही प्राप्त होते हैं
shakti_gita::314.english_translation: Whether someone gives up the body in a lowly home or on the banks of the Ganges, they reach me both while living and after death.
shakti_gita::314.translation_literal: स्व (own) / देहम् (body) / नीचगेहे (in a lowly home) / ते (they) / जह्युर्वा (even if they give up) / जाह्नवीतटे (on the banks of the Ganges) । / विप्र्भेद्दा (regardless of caste distinctions) / विदेहा (without body) / वा (or) / मामेव (me alone) / प्राप्नुवन्ति (they reach) / ते (they) ॥
shakti_gita::314.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::314.essence: Your connection to the divine transcends body, place, and status at all times.
shakti_gita::314.simple_meaning: Wherever and however you leave your body, your true self connects with the divine beyond physical form or place.
shakti_gita::314.simple_insight: There's comfort knowing that the divine connection is not limited by your body or surroundings.
shakti_gita::314.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that whether a person dies in humble or sacred places, or even while alive, their true self remains connected to her. This removes barriers of caste, place, or physical form in reaching the divine.
shakti_gita::314.modern_relevance: You might feel stuck by your current situation or background, but your inner connection to what matters is always beyond those limits.
shakti_gita::314.insight: It shifts focus from external conditions to the inner continuity of connection with the divine, freeing you from attachment to place or status.

shakti_gita::315.verse_sanskrit:
निर्विकल्पसमाधिस्थैयोगिराजै: सहास्ति में।
काचिद्विभिन्नता नैव सत्यमेतद्रवीमि वः ॥
shakti_gita::315.verse_hindi: निर्विकल्प समाधिप्राप्त योगिराजों में और मुझमें कोई भेद नहीं है इसको मैं तुमसे सत्य कहती हूँ
shakti_gita::315.english_translation: There is no difference between the yogic kings in the state of undisturbed absorption and me; this I tell you as truth.
shakti_gita::315.translation_literal: निर्विकल्पसमाधिस्थै (in undisturbed absorption) / योगिराजै: (among yogic kings) / सह (with) / अस्ति (exists) / में (in me) / काचित् (any) / विभिन्नता (difference) / नैव (not at all) / सत्यमेतत् (this truth) / रवीमि (I declare) / वः (to you)
shakti_gita::315.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::315.essence: Complete absorbed presence reveals there is no separation between you and the highest yogic beings.
shakti_gita::315.simple_meaning: In the deepest state of complete stillness, there is no difference between the highest yogis and the divine presence speaking here.
shakti_gita::315.simple_insight: You are fundamentally united with the highest state of yogic absorption, not separate or less.
shakti_gita::315.detailed_meaning: Devi speaks to reveal that in the state of nirvikalpa samadhi—complete, undisturbed absorption—no real difference exists between her and the greatest yogis. This teaches the unity of ultimate experience beyond form or individual identity.
shakti_gita::315.modern_relevance: When you experience moments of complete focus and calm, you touch the same deep unity that great yogis have reached, dissolving separation.
shakti_gita::315.insight: Recognize that the highest states of awareness are accessible and shared, not exclusive or distant.

shakti_gita::316.verse_sanskrit:
संयमश्चैकवत्वं च शक्तिद्वयमलौकिकम् ।
पुरो यो वासुतं देवाः ! मया सम्यकतयाऽनघाः! ॥
shakti_gita::316.verse_hindi: हे निष्पाप देवगण ! मैंने जो पहले संयम और एकतत्त्वरूपी अलौकिक दो शक्तियों का वर्णन तुमसे सम्यक्तया किया है।
shakti_gita::316.english_translation: O sinless gods! I have clearly described to you earlier the two divine powers: restraint and unity.
shakti_gita::316.translation_literal: संयमश्चैकवत्वं (restraint and unity) च (and) शक्तिद्वयमलौकिकम् (two divine powers supernatural) । पुरो (earlier) यो (that) वासुतं (description) देवाः (gods) ! मया (by me) सम्यकतयाऽनघाः (clearly sinless) ! ॥
shakti_gita::316.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::316.essence: Two extraordinary powers, restraint and unity, were clearly explained earlier.
shakti_gita::316.simple_meaning: I have already explained clearly two extraordinary powers: restraint and unity, to you pure divine beings.
shakti_gita::316.simple_insight: Sometimes, understanding comes from recalling what was already taught with clarity.
shakti_gita::316.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses the divine assembly, reminding them she has already explained two important cosmic powers—restraint and unity—to them clearly, emphasizing their purity and significance.
shakti_gita::316.insight: Recognize the importance of disciplined restraint and unified focus as foundational powers previously introduced.

shakti_gita::317.verse_sanskrit:
जायते संयमस्तत्र धारणाभृमितो ध्रुवम् ।
ध्यानभूम्यास्तु भो देवाः ! एकतत्त्वं प्रजायते ॥
shakti_gita::317.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! उनमें संयम धारणाभूमि और एकतत्व ध्यानभूमि से निश्चय प्रकट होता है
shakti_gita::317.english_translation: O divine beings! From restraint arises a steady focus, and from the ground of meditation, unity emerges with certainty.
shakti_gita::317.translation_literal: जायते (arises) / संयमः (restraint) / तत्र (there) / धारणाभृमितः (steady-holding) / ध्रुवम् (certainly) / ध्यानभूम्या (from meditation-ground) / अस्तु (there is) / भो (O) / देवाः (divine beings) / एकतत्त्वं (one essence) / प्रजायते (is born)
shakti_gita::317.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::317.essence: Steady restraint and meditation together bring certain experience of unity.
shakti_gita::317.simple_meaning: When you practice restraint, your focus becomes steady, and through meditation, you realize oneness with certainty.
shakti_gita::317.simple_insight: You can feel calm confidence grow as your inner focus strengthens.
shakti_gita::317.detailed_meaning: Addressing divine beings, Devi teaches that practicing restraint leads to steady concentration, and from the foundation of meditation, a clear experience of unity arises with certainty.
shakti_gita::317.modern_relevance: When you pause distractions and hold steady attention, your mind naturally clarifies, revealing deeper connection and certainty.
shakti_gita::317.insight: It teaches you to use restraint to steady your mind, enabling meditation to reveal unified awareness.

shakti_gita::318.verse_sanskrit:
अयं हि धारणाध्यान-समाधनि क्रियात्मकम् ।
दृश्याश्रयात्मयुक्तं सनिर्जराः ! संयमो भवेत् ॥
shakti_gita::318.verse_hindi: धारणा ध्यान और समाधि इन तीनों की क्रियाएँ जब इस दृश्य के अवलम्बन से प्रयुक्त होती हैं तब उसको संयम कहते हैं
shakti_gita::318.english_translation: When the practices of concentration, meditation, and absorbed presence are united with the support of what is seen, that is called self-restraint.
shakti_gita::318.translation_literal: अयं (this) हि (indeed) धारणाध्यान-समाधनि (of concentration, meditation, and absorbed presence) क्रियात्मकम् (action-related) । दृश्याश्रयात्मयुक्तं (joined with the support of what is seen) सनिर्जराः (called self-restraint) ! संयमो (self-restraint) भवेत् (is) ॥
shakti_gita::318.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::318.essence: Discipline arises when focused inner practices are rooted in what you actually see.
shakti_gita::318.simple_meaning: Discipline means practicing concentration, meditation, and absorbed presence all grounded in what you actually perceive.
shakti_gita::318.simple_insight: Discipline feels like steady attention rooted in what is real and present.
shakti_gita::318.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that self-restraint arises when concentration, meditation, and absorbed presence are united with the actual visible world, showing discipline is not just inner effort but grounded in awareness of what appears.
shakti_gita::318.modern_relevance: When distractions pull you away, discipline is the steady attention you bring back to what’s right in front of you.
shakti_gita::318.insight: It teaches you to anchor your mental practices in present experience, not just abstract effort.

shakti_gita::319.verse_sanskrit:
यदा त्वावत्मानमुद्दिश्य त्रयमेतत् प्रयुज्यते।
एकतत्त्वं तदोदेति ह्योपा वैदान्ति की श्रुतिः ॥
shakti_gita::319.verse_hindi: और जब केवल आत्मा के लक्ष्य से प्रयुक्त होती है तब एकतत्त्व का उदय होता है। यही उपनिषद का रहस्य है
shakti_gita::319.english_translation: When the three are united with the true self alone, then the one essence arises; this is the secret of the Upanishads.
shakti_gita::319.translation_literal: यदा (when) त्व (your) आत्मानम् (true self) उद्दिश्य (towards) त्रयम् (three) एतत् (these) प्रयुज्यते (are joined) । एकतत्त्वं (one essence) तदा (then) उदेति (arises) हि (indeed) उप (Upa) वैदान्ति (Vedic scholars) की (what) श्रुतिः (scripture) ॥
shakti_gita::319.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::319.essence: True unity arises when all parts focus solely on the true self.
shakti_gita::319.simple_meaning: When your mind, body, and inner self are focused on your true self, a single unified essence appears.
shakti_gita::319.simple_insight: You can feel the power of oneness when all parts of you align with your true self.
shakti_gita::319.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that when the three elements of human experience—mind, body, and spirit—are directed solely towards the true self, they merge into a single reality. This teaching reveals the Upanishads' core secret about unity and self-realization.
shakti_gita::319.modern_relevance: When your thoughts, feelings, and actions all focus on your deepest true self, life feels whole and clear.
shakti_gita::319.insight: Shift your attention from fragmented distractions to the unified presence of your true self; this brings clarity and peace.

shakti_gita::320.verse_sanskrit:
प्रोद्धोधयति जीवेषु नानाशक्तीहि संयमः।
ऐशीनैवात्र  सन्देहो नाऽलं मोचयितुं त्वसौ ॥
shakti_gita::320.verse_hindi: संयम अनन्त ऐशी शक्तियों को जीवों में प्रकट करता है यह निःसन्देह है परन्तु
shakti_gita::320.english_translation: Control surely awakens many powers within living beings, but it cannot liberate them.
shakti_gita::320.translation_literal: प्रोद्धोधयति (awakens) जीवेषु (in living beings) नानाशक्तीहि (many powers) संयमः (control) ऐशीनैवात्र (surely here) सन्देहो (doubt) नाऽलं (not at all) मोचयितुं (to liberate) त्वसौ (that)
shakti_gita::320.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::320.essence: Awakening powers through control does not guarantee true freedom.
shakti_gita::320.simple_meaning: Control or discipline can awaken many inner powers, but it alone cannot bring true freedom.
shakti_gita::320.simple_insight: There's relief in seeing that power alone doesn't equal true liberation.
shakti_gita::320.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that although self-discipline can reveal many abilities within beings, it is not enough to free them from deeper bondage or confusion. This moment clarifies the limits of control on the path to liberation.
shakti_gita::320.modern_relevance: You might master new skills or habits, but real inner freedom requires more than just control over yourself.
shakti_gita::320.insight: It shifts the mind from relying on control to seeking deeper freedom beyond powers.

shakti_gita::321.verse_sanskrit:
अविद्यापाशसनंद्धांजीवांस्तान पाशबन्धनात् ।
एकतत्वन्तु शक्नोति भक्तान दृश्यमप्रञ्चतः ॥
shakti_gita::321.verse_hindi: अविद्या-पाशबद्ध जीवों को पाशमुक्त नहीं कर सकता है और एकतत्त्व मेरे भक्तों को दृश्य प्रपञ्च से
shakti_gita::321.english_translation: Ignorance cannot free those bound by its chains, but the one essence can liberate my devotees from the visible illusion.
shakti_gita::321.translation_literal: अविद्या-पाशबद्ध (bound by ignorance's chains) जीवों (living beings) को (to) पाशमुक्त (chain-free) नहीं (not) कर सकता है (can do) और (and) एकतत्त्व (one essence) मेरे (my) भक्तों (devotees) को (to) दृश्य (visible) प्रपञ्च (illusion) से (from)
shakti_gita::321.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::321.essence: Devotion to the one essence frees you from the bondage of ignorance and illusion.
shakti_gita::321.simple_meaning: Ignorance traps living beings in bondage, but the single true essence can liberate devoted ones from all visible illusions.
shakti_gita::321.simple_insight: There's comfort knowing devotion connects you to a power beyond all confusion and binds.
shakti_gita::321.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that beings trapped by ignorance cannot free themselves through the same ignorance. Only by connecting to the one true essence—her divine nature—can devotees be released from the illusions of the visible world.
shakti_gita::321.modern_relevance: When confusion and doubt feel like chains holding you back, remembering a deeper unity can free your heart.
shakti_gita::321.insight: It shifts your trust from trying to fix confusion yourself to surrendering in devoted connection to the one essence.

shakti_gita::322.verse_sanskrit:
हठादाकृष्य तेभ्यो हि शिवत्वं दातुममदभुतम् ।
साधनं संयमोपेतं योगस्याभ्युदयप्रदम् ॥
shakti_gita::322.verse_hindi: हटाकर उनको अद्भुत शिवत्व प्रदान करने में समर्थ है। संयम से युक्त योगसाधन अभ्युदयकारी है
shakti_gita::322.english_translation: Forcefully drawing you towards it, the wondrous state of Shiva-ness is granted. Disciplined yoga practice brings this rise.
shakti_gita::322.translation_literal: हठादाकृष्य (forcefully drawing) तेभ्यो (from them) हि (indeed) शिवत्वं (state of Shiva) दातुम् (to give) अमदभुतम् (wondrous) । साधनं (practice) संयमोपेतं (endowed with restraint) योगस्याभ्युदयप्रदम् (of yoga, giving rise) ॥
shakti_gita::322.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::322.essence: Steadfast discipline in yoga awakens the wondrous true nature within you.
shakti_gita::322.simple_meaning: By applying steady, disciplined effort, you can awaken the amazing true nature within yourself.
shakti_gita::322.simple_insight: There is power in persistent, controlled practice to bring forth your highest self.
shakti_gita::322.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that forceful, disciplined yoga practice, supported by restraint and control, leads to the emergence of the state of Shiva-ness, a wondrous true nature awakening. This teaching guides seekers toward steady self-mastery.
shakti_gita::322.modern_relevance: You commit to a daily routine of self-control and focused effort, even when results seem distant, trusting growth will follow.
shakti_gita::322.insight: It teaches you to use disciplined effort and self-restraint as tools to awaken your highest nature.

shakti_gita::323.verse_sanskrit:
केवलं त्वेकतत्वस्य साहाय्यात् साध्यते तु यन् ।
साधनं तद्धि योगस्य निःश्रेयसकरं ध्रुवम् ॥
shakti_gita::323.verse_hindi: और केवल एकतत्त्व की, सहायता से साधित योग ही निःश्रेयसकारी हो सकता है
shakti_gita::323.english_translation: Only the yoga attained through the support of the one supreme principle surely leads to highest freedom.
shakti_gita::323.translation_literal: केवलं (only) त्वेकतत्वस्य (of the one supreme principle) साहाय्यात् (by the support) साध्यते (is attained) तु (but) यन् (that) । साधनं (the practice) तद्धि (indeed) योगस्य (of yoga) निःश्रेयसकरं (leading to highest freedom) ध्रुवम् (certainly) ॥
shakti_gita::323.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::323.essence: Only yoga rooted in one supreme principle brings guaranteed highest freedom.
shakti_gita::323.simple_meaning: The highest yoga that brings true freedom is only achieved by relying on a single, supreme principle.
shakti_gita::323.simple_insight: There is strength and certainty when your spiritual practice rests on one unwavering truth.
shakti_gita::323.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that among many methods, only yoga founded on the support of the one ultimate principle leads certainly to true freedom. This moment highlights the necessity of singular focus for spiritual success.
shakti_gita::323.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by many options, your deepest growth comes from focusing on one clear guiding truth.
shakti_gita::323.insight: Shift from scattered efforts to anchoring your practice in one foundational truth for steady progress.

shakti_gita::324.verse_sanskrit:
एतदेवास्ति योगस्य रहस्यं श्रुतिमूलकम्।
योगस्य साधकानां हि तत्त्वज्ञानप्रकाशकम् ॥
shakti_gita::324.verse_hindi: यही श्रुति मूलक और साधकों के लिये योग के तत्त्वों को प्रकाश करने वाला योग का रहस्य है
shakti_gita::324.english_translation: The essence of yoga is this secret, rooted in the scriptures, illuminating the true nature for those who practice yoga.
shakti_gita::324.translation_literal: एतत् (this) एव (indeed) अस्ति (is) योगस्य (of yoga) रहस्यं (secret) श्रुतिमूलकम् (rooted in the scriptures) । योगस्य (of yoga) साधकानां (for practitioners) हि (indeed) तत्त्वज्ञानप्रकाशकम् (illumination of true knowledge) ॥
shakti_gita::324.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::324.essence: Yoga’s secret is scripture-rooted and reveals truth to committed practitioners.
shakti_gita::324.simple_meaning: Yoga’s true secret comes from sacred teachings and reveals the real essence to sincere practitioners.
shakti_gita::324.simple_insight: Knowing yoga’s core secret brings clarity and light to your practice and understanding.
shakti_gita::324.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the core secret of yoga is grounded in ancient scriptures and serves to enlighten those who earnestly practice yoga, guiding them to knowledge beyond the surface.
shakti_gita::324.modern_relevance: When you study deeply, yoga stops being just exercise and becomes a clear light guiding your life.
shakti_gita::324.insight: It teaches you to look beyond surface practice to the profound essence that yoga reveals through study and dedication.

shakti_gita::325.verse_sanskrit:
मद्भक्तिरस्ति योगस्य प्राणभूता यतस्त्वतः।
वैयर्थ्यापत्तिमादत्ते नूनं मनक्तिमन्तरा ॥
shakti_gita::325.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! मेरी भक्ति योगसाधन की प्राणभूता है, क्योंकि बिना मेरी भक्ति के
shakti_gita::325.english_translation: O divine beings! My devotion is the life force of yoga; without my devotion, yoga surely fails.
shakti_gita::325.translation_literal: मद्भक्तिरस्ति (my devotion is) योगस्य (of yoga) प्राणभूता (the life force) यतः (because) त्वतः (of you) । वैयर्थ्यापत्तिम् (failure) आदत्ते (takes place) नूनम् (certainly) मनः (mind) अन्तरा (without) ॥
shakti_gita::325.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::325.essence: Devotion is the vital energy that makes yoga effective and alive.
shakti_gita::325.simple_meaning: Devotion is the essential energy that sustains all yoga practice; without it, the practice loses meaning and fails.
shakti_gita::325.simple_insight: You feel how devotion brings life and purpose to your spiritual effort.
shakti_gita::325.detailed_meaning: The Goddess tells divine beings that devotion is the vital breath of yoga. Without devotion, yoga cannot succeed. This moment highlights devotion as the heart of spiritual discipline.
shakti_gita::325.modern_relevance: You show up to meditate or practice but feel empty when your heart isn’t truly engaged; this verse reminds you why feeling connected matters.
shakti_gita::325.insight: It teaches you to prioritize heartfelt devotion to keep your spiritual practice alive and effective.

shakti_gita::326.verse_sanskrit:
शिलाबीजोतिवद्देवाः ! निखिलं योगसाधनम् ।
क्रियासिद्धांशबोधा हि येषां योगस्य केवलम् ॥
shakti_gita::326.verse_hindi: सम्पूर्ण योगसाधन शिला में बीजवपन की भांति अवश्य ही व्यर्थ होता है ।
shakti_gita::326.english_translation: The entire practice of yoga is futile like sowing seeds on a rock.
shakti_gita::326.translation_literal: शिला (rock) बीजोतिवद् (like seed-sowing) देवाः (indeed) निखिलं (whole) योगसाधनम् (yoga practice) क्रियासिद्धान् (accomplishments of action) बोधा (knowers) हि (indeed) येषाम् (of those whose) योगस्य (of yoga) केवलम् (only)
shakti_gita::326.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::326.essence: Yoga without inner readiness is as fruitless as sowing seeds on solid rock.
shakti_gita::326.simple_meaning: Trying to practice yoga without inner transformation is useless, like planting seeds on a rock.
shakti_gita::326.simple_insight: You feel the emptiness when effort lacks the right inner foundation.
shakti_gita::326.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that yoga practice without real inner change is like planting seeds on rock: nothing grows. True yoga demands readiness of the inner being, not just mechanical effort.
shakti_gita::326.modern_relevance: You push through a routine without passion or openness—results never come, no matter how hard you try.
shakti_gita::326.insight: It shifts your view from external effort alone to the importance of internal preparedness in yoga.

shakti_gita::327.verse_sanskrit:
सन्ति वाचनिका एव न यथार्थतया सुराः!।
तत्त्वज्ञानविहीनास्तेऽनुरागवर्जीतां मयि ॥
shakti_gita::327.verse_hindi: मुझमें अनुरागविहीन, तत्वज्ञानहीन और यथार्थतः नहीं केवल वाचनिक रूप से योग के क्रिया सिद्धांशो को
shakti_gita::327.english_translation: They exist only as speakers, not truly among the gods; lacking true knowledge and love for me.
shakti_gita::327.translation_literal: सन्ति (exist) / वाचनिका (speakers) / एव (only) / न (not) / यथार्थतया (truly) / सुराः (gods) / तत्त्वज्ञानविहीनाः (lacking true knowledge) / ते (they) / अनुरागवर्जीतां (without love) / मयि (towards me)
shakti_gita::327.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::327.essence: True devotion arises only from real love and genuine understanding, not empty words.
shakti_gita::327.simple_meaning: Simply speaking about devotion or spiritual knowledge without true love and understanding is empty and not real devotion.
shakti_gita::327.simple_insight: You feel how empty words are without heartfelt love and real understanding.
shakti_gita::327.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that some beings appear as if devoted or knowledgeable, but without genuine love and true understanding of the essence, their words are hollow and lack real connection.
shakti_gita::327.modern_relevance: You might hear someone speak passionately about their beliefs, but without true feeling or understanding, their words don’t inspire or connect deeply.
shakti_gita::327.insight: It shifts your focus from mere verbal expression to cultivating heartfelt love and clear understanding in your spiritual practice.

shakti_gita::328.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञेया अभिनये नूनं शैलूपा इव सन्ततम् ।
गौणीपरेतिभेदाभ्यां भक्ति में द्विविधा मता ॥
shakti_gita::328.verse_hindi: जाननेवाले नाटक में वेशधारी नट के समान है ऐसा सदा समझो। मेरी भक्ति के दो भेद हैं-गौणी और परा।
shakti_gita::328.english_translation: The knower is always like an actor wearing a costume; my devotion is said to have two types—lower and higher.
shakti_gita::328.translation_literal: ज्ञेया (knower) अभिनये (in acting) नूनं (indeed) शैलूपा (like a dancer) इव (as) सन्ततम् (always) । गौणीपरेतिभेदाभ्यां (by the two differences: lower and higher) भक्ति (devotion) में (in) द्विविधा (twofold) मता (is considered) ॥
shakti_gita::328.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::328.essence: Devotion has two forms—surface acting and deep heartfelt connection.
shakti_gita::328.simple_meaning: Understanding the self is like being an actor playing a role; devotion to the divine has two forms: a basic and a higher kind.
shakti_gita::328.simple_insight: You can see your devotion as a journey from surface roles to deeper connection.
shakti_gita::328.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that a true knower acts like a skilled actor in a play, aware of the roles they perform. She teaches that devotion has two distinct kinds—lower (superficial) and higher (profound)—signaling a path from outer practice to inner surrender.
shakti_gita::328.modern_relevance: When you notice yourself playing different roles in life, this can remind you that your devotion or care can deepen beyond surface actions into sincere connection.
shakti_gita::328.insight: It teaches you to recognize the layers in your devotion and to seek the deeper, more authentic engagement.

shakti_gita::329.verse_sanskrit:
विधिभिः साध्यते गौणी वासल्या च प्रवर्द्धते ।
महयादृष्टिपातेन पराभक्तिस्तु साधके ॥
shakti_gita::329.verse_hindi: गौणी भक्ति विधिसाध्यमाना है तथा आसक्ति से चर्चित होती है और पराभक्ति मेरी कृपा से ही साधक में
shakti_gita::329.english_translation: Lesser devotion is achieved by ritual, attachment grows by fondness, but supreme devotion arises in the seeker by my grace.
shakti_gita::329.translation_literal: विधिभिः (by rituals) साध्यते (is achieved) गौणी (lesser) वासल्या (fondness/attachment) च (and) प्रवर्द्धते (increases) । महयादृष्टिपातेन (by my gracious glance) पराभक्तिस्तु (but supreme devotion) साधके (in the seeker) ॥
shakti_gita::329.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::329.essence: True, supreme devotion arises not from effort but through divine grace.
shakti_gita::329.simple_meaning: Some devotion grows from rituals and affection, but the highest devotion in a seeker comes only through the divine's grace.
shakti_gita::329.simple_insight: You can feel the difference between habit and heartfelt devotion blossoming by grace.
shakti_gita::329.detailed_meaning: The Goddess explains that ordinary devotion, which is limited and bound by ritual or affection, can be practiced by anyone. But the highest devotion — complete surrender and love — only arises when the divine bestows grace upon the seeker.
shakti_gita::329.modern_relevance: You may follow routines or feel attached to practices, yet the deepest connection arises when something beyond effort touches your heart.
shakti_gita::329.insight: It teaches you to recognize that true devotion is not just effort but a gift that transforms from within.

shakti_gita::330.verse_sanskrit:
स्वत उत्पद्यते देवाः ! आत्मज्ञानप्रकाशिनी ।
भावविवर्द्धते सा हि परमानन्ददायिनी ॥
shakti_gita::330.verse_hindi: स्वत: उत्पन्न होती है। हे देवगण ! वह आत्म ज्ञान प्रकाशिनी और परमानन्द दायिनी है और भाव से वर्द्धित होती है
shakti_gita::330.english_translation: It arises on its own, O divine beings! It is the light of self-knowledge, and it grows through feeling, giving supreme bliss.
shakti_gita::330.translation_literal: स्वत: (on its own) उत्पद्यते (arises) देवाः (O divine beings) ! आत्मज्ञानप्रकाशिनी (self-knowledge-light) । भावविवर्द्धते (through feeling grows) सा (she/it) हि (indeed) परमानन्ददायिनी (supreme-bliss-giving) ॥
shakti_gita::330.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::330.essence: True self-knowledge arises naturally and grows through feeling, bringing supreme joy.
shakti_gita::330.simple_meaning: True self-knowledge arises naturally within you. It grows through your feelings and brings the highest joy.
shakti_gita::330.simple_insight: You can trust that your inner knowing will emerge and deepen through your feelings.
shakti_gita::330.detailed_meaning: The Goddess tells divine beings that self-knowledge is not forced but arises spontaneously. This knowing shines light within and expands by emotional depth, ultimately giving supreme bliss.
shakti_gita::330.modern_relevance: You’ve felt a quiet understanding grow inside you without planning, deepening as you connect with your feelings.
shakti_gita::330.insight: It teaches you to notice how inner knowing naturally unfolds and deepens as you engage your feelings.

shakti_gita::331.verse_sanskrit:
योगिन्युदेत्त्यसौ गौणी भक्तिः संयमतत्परे।
क्षिप्रं तथा परोदेति ह्योकतत्त्वपरायणे ॥
shakti_gita::331.verse_hindi: संयमपरायण योगी में गौणी भक्ति और एकतत्व परायण योगी में पराभक्ति का शीघ्र उदय हुआ करता है
shakti_gita::331.english_translation: In a yogi devoted to discipline, lesser devotion arises quickly; in one devoted to oneness, supreme devotion arises swiftly.
shakti_gita::331.translation_literal: योगिन्युदेत्त्यसौ (in the yogi devoted) गौणी (lesser) भक्तिः (devotion) संयमतत्परे (devoted to discipline) क्षिप्रं (quickly) तथा (also) परोदेति (arises supreme) हि (indeed) उक्तत्त्वपरायणे (devoted to oneness)
shakti_gita::331.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::331.essence: Devotion grows faster and deeper when rooted in unity rather than mere discipline.
shakti_gita::331.simple_meaning: When you focus on self-discipline, devotion grows slowly, but when you focus on unity with the divine, devotion arises quickly.
shakti_gita::331.simple_insight: You can feel your love deepen faster when you seek connection beyond rules and control.
shakti_gita::331.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that a yogi focused on strict discipline develops a weaker form of devotion, while a yogi devoted to experiencing unity with the divine quickly awakens a stronger, supreme devotion.
shakti_gita::331.modern_relevance: You might follow rules strictly but feel distant, yet when you embrace connection deeply, your motivation and care grow naturally and fast.
shakti_gita::331.insight: It teaches you to shift from rigid control to heartfelt unity to awaken true devotion faster.

shakti_gita::332.verse_sanskrit:
एतद्भक्तिरहस्यं वो वर्णितं सम्मुखे सुराः।
ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यन्ते साधनान्यखिलानि मे ॥
shakti_gita::332.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! आप के सामने मैंने यह भक्ति का रहस्य वर्णन किया है। ज्ञान में सब साधनों की परिसमाप्ति होती है
shakti_gita::332.english_translation: O divine beings, I have revealed the secret of devotion before you. In knowledge, all means come to their end.
shakti_gita::332.translation_literal: एतद्भक्तिरहस्यं (this devotion secret) / वो (to you) / वर्णितं (described) / सम्मुखे (in front) / सुराः (divine beings) /। ज्ञाने (in knowledge) / परिसमाप्यन्ते (come to an end) / साधनानि (means) / अखिलानि (all) / मे (my) / ॥
shakti_gita::332.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::332.essence: True devotion reveals that complete knowledge naturally ends all spiritual effort.
shakti_gita::332.simple_meaning: The secret of devotion has been revealed here: when true knowledge is attained, all practices come to a natural completion.
shakti_gita::332.simple_insight: You feel calm knowing devotion leads you to a place where effort naturally ends.
shakti_gita::332.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses the divine assembly, revealing that the deepest secret of devotion is that when perfect knowledge is achieved, all spiritual practices naturally conclude.
shakti_gita::332.modern_relevance: After years of trying many approaches, you finally reach a clarity where effort feels complete and natural.
shakti_gita::332.insight: It teaches you that devotion and knowledge are connected; full understanding brings natural closure to striving.

shakti_gita::333.verse_sanskrit:
अतएव च भो देवाः ! कर्मवीरशिरोमणिम् ।
कर्त्तव्यनिष्ठमूर्द्धन्यं निष्कामवततत्परम् ॥
shakti_gita::333.verse_hindi: इसी कारण हे देवगण ! निष्कामव्रत परायण कर्त्तव्यनिष्ठो में श्रेष्ठ
shakti_gita::333.english_translation: Therefore, O divine beings, the highest among those devoted to duty is the one steadfast in action without desire for its fruits.
shakti_gita::333.translation_literal: अतएव (therefore) च (also) भो (O) देवाः (divine beings) ! कर्मवीरशिरोमणिम् (hero among actors) । कर्त्तव्यनिष्ठमूर्द्धन्यं (foremost in devotion to duty) निष्कामवततत्परम् (supreme like one without desire for results) ॥
shakti_gita::333.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::333.essence: Acting fully without craving results is the highest form of dedication.
shakti_gita::333.simple_meaning: The highest person is the one who stays devoted to their duty and acts without craving any outcome.
shakti_gita::333.simple_insight: You can be honored by how fully you act, not by what you get.
shakti_gita::333.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses the divine beings, teaching that the greatest among them is the one who dedicates themselves to their duty with firm resolve but without attachment to results. This verse highlights selfless action as the highest ideal.
shakti_gita::333.modern_relevance: You finish your work with full heart, letting go of the need for praise or reward.
shakti_gita::333.insight: It shifts your focus from chasing results to committing to the action itself, making your efforts pure.

shakti_gita::334.verse_sanskrit:
नृसिंह तं महात्मानं ज्ञानिभक्तं स्वतोऽमराः !।
पूर्ण भक्तिरसैस्तूर्णं पीयूषं पाययाम्यहम् ॥
shakti_gita::334.verse_hindi: उस नृसिंह कर्मवीरों में श्रेष्ठ ज्ञानि भक्त महात्मा को मैं स्वत: ही भक्तिरस पूर्ण अमृत का शीघ्र पान कराती हूँ
shakti_gita::334.english_translation: To that great soul Narasimha, the wise and devoted among the brave, I myself swiftly grant the nectar of full devotion.
shakti_gita::334.translation_literal: नृसिंह (Narasimha) / तं (that) / महात्मानं (great soul) / ज्ञानिभक्तं (wise-devoted) / स्वतोऽमराः (by themselves immortals) / पूर्ण (full) / भक्तिरसैः (with devotion-nectar) / तूर्णं (swiftly) / पीयूषं (nectar) / पाययामि (I make drink) / अहम् (I)
shakti_gita::334.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::334.essence: Inner wisdom combined with devoted courage quickly brings deep spiritual joy.
shakti_gita::334.simple_meaning: The Goddess says she quickly grants the highest devotion’s joyful nectar to Narasimha, who is both wise and devoted among the brave.
shakti_gita::334.simple_insight: You can trust that inner wisdom combined with devotion brings you a deep, sweet fulfillment.
shakti_gita::334.detailed_meaning: The Goddess praises Narasimha, a heroic figure known for his wisdom and devoted courage, saying she herself grants him the pure nectar of full devotion quickly. This moment honors the union of knowledge, bravery, and love as a path to divine blessing.
shakti_gita::334.modern_relevance: When your strength is matched by clear understanding and heartfelt devotion, you experience a profound reward beyond effort or outcome.
shakti_gita::334.insight: It teaches you to cultivate both wisdom and devoted courage to access the sweetest spiritual fulfillment.

shakti_gita::335.verse_sanskrit:
तत्त्वज्ञानेन मद्भक्तो मत्स्वरूपं यथार्थतः।
ज्ञात्वा सम्यक ततो देवाः ! अधिगच्छति मामहो ॥
shakti_gita::335.verse_hindi: मेरा भक्त तत्त्वज्ञान द्वारा मेरे यथार्थ स्वरुप को अच्छी तरह जानकर तब मुझको प्राप्त होता है
shakti_gita::335.english_translation: One who truly knows my real nature through true wisdom becomes my devotee and then attains me.
shakti_gita::335.translation_literal: तत्त्वज्ञानेन (by true knowledge) / मद्भक्तो (my devotee) / मत्स्वरूपं (my form) / यथार्थतः (truly) / ज्ञात्वा (knowing) / सम्यक (well) / ततो (then) / देवाः (devotees) / अधिगच्छति (attain) / मामहो (me)
shakti_gita::335.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::335.essence: True understanding of the divine transforms devotion into direct union.
shakti_gita::335.simple_meaning: When you truly understand the divine's real nature through clear wisdom, your devotion to the divine grows and you reach the divine.
shakti_gita::335.simple_insight: Knowing deeply opens your heart to devoted love and connection with the divine.
shakti_gita::335.detailed_meaning: The Goddess teaches that true knowledge of her real form is the foundation of genuine devotion. Devotees who gain this understanding truly connect and attain her presence.
shakti_gita::335.modern_relevance: When you deeply understand someone’s true nature, your love and trust grow beyond surface feelings.
shakti_gita::335.insight: It shifts you from blind devotion to devotion grounded in clear understanding, making your love stronger and more direct.

shakti_gita::336.verse_sanskrit:
अस्म्यहं कर्मयोगस्य मद्भक्तिज्ञानयोगयोः।
प्रतिष्ठास्थानमेवैकं सत्यमेतन्न संशयः ॥
shakti_gita::336.verse_hindi: कर्मयोग, भक्तियोग और ज्ञानयोग इन तीनों का प्रतिष्ठा स्थान मैं ही हूँ  यह सत्य है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
shakti_gita::336.english_translation: I am the very foundation of Karma Yoga, Bhakti Yoga, and Jnana Yoga; this truth is beyond doubt.
shakti_gita::336.translation_literal: अस्म्यहं (I am) / कर्मयोगस्य (of Karma Yoga) / मद्भक्तिज्ञानयोगयोः (of Bhakti Yoga and Jnana Yoga) / प्रतिष्ठास्थानमेवैकं (the sole foundation) / सत्यमेतन्न (this truth) / संशयः (doubt)
shakti_gita::336.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::336.essence: The true self is the single foundation of action, devotion, and wisdom without doubt.
shakti_gita::336.simple_meaning: The foundation of the three main paths—doing, devotion, and wisdom—is the true self within you. This is an unquestionable truth.
shakti_gita::336.simple_insight: You carry the source of all paths inside you, making every approach deeply connected.
shakti_gita::336.detailed_meaning: Devi declares she is the essential base of Karma Yoga (action), Bhakti Yoga (devotion), and Jnana Yoga (wisdom), revealing that all spiritual paths converge in her essence. This moment clarifies that liberation arises from recognizing this unity.
shakti_gita::336.modern_relevance: When you feel torn between what to do, whom to trust, or how to understand, remember your true self includes all these ways without conflict.
shakti_gita::336.insight: It shifts your view from choosing between paths to embracing their unity within yourself.

shakti_gita::337.verse_hindi: यही वेद काण्डत्रय का रहस्य वर्णन किया गया है। हे देव गण ! मैं ही अविद्यारूप से अपने ब्रह्मानन्द को
shakti_gita::337.english_translation: This is the secret explaining the three Vedic sections: the gods truly see Brahman’s bliss as ignorance’s form.
shakti_gita::337.translation_literal: वेदकाण्डत्रयस्य (of the three Vedic sections) / एतत् (this) / रहस्यम् (secret) / उपवर्णितम् (explained) / ब्रह्मानन्दं (Brahman bliss) / निनं (indeed) / नूनम् (surely) / अविद्या (ignorance) / रूपतः (in the form of) / सुराः (the gods)
shakti_gita::337.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::337.essence: What looks like ignorance to the gods is actually Brahman’s bliss in disguise.
shakti_gita::337.simple_meaning: The verse reveals the secret of the three Vedic parts: the gods mistakenly see Brahman’s bliss as ignorance.
shakti_gita::337.simple_insight: Sometimes what seems like confusion hides the deepest joy and truth.
shakti_gita::337.detailed_meaning: Devi explains to the gods the secret behind the three Vedic sections, unveiling that what appears as ignorance actually veils the bliss of Brahman, a profound metaphysical truth.
shakti_gita::337.modern_relevance: When confusion covers a situation, it might mask a deeper joy or understanding you haven't yet seen.
shakti_gita::337.insight: Recognize that apparent ignorance can conceal the pure bliss of ultimate reality, shifting how you perceive challenges.

shakti_gita::338.verse_sanskrit:
विस्तार्य विषयानन्दे तत्र जीवान्निरन्तरम् ।
आवघ्नाम्यहमेवालं तान् विद्यारूपतः पुनः ॥
shakti_gita::338.verse_hindi: विषयानन्द में विस्तार करके उसमें जीवों को निरन्तर आबद्ध करती हूँ और पुनः मैं ही विद्यारूप से
shakti_gita::338.english_translation: Expanding in the joy of the senses, I continuously bind beings, and again I am the form of knowledge.
shakti_gita::338.translation_literal: विस्तार्य (expanding) विषयानन्दे (in sense-pleasure) तत्र (there) जीवान्निरन्तरम् (beings continuously) । आवघ्नामि (I bind) अहमेव (I alone) आलं (them) तान् (these) विद्यारूपतः (in the form of knowledge) पुनः (again) ॥
shakti_gita::338.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::338.essence: The same source creates binding pleasure and liberating knowledge in you.
shakti_gita::338.simple_meaning: The divine expands in sensory pleasure, binding beings, but also appears as the knowledge that can free them.
shakti_gita::338.simple_insight: Even when caught in pleasure, you can recognize the deeper knowing that frees you.
shakti_gita::338.detailed_meaning: Devi explains how she manifests as both the expanding sensory joys that bind living beings and as the pure knowledge that can liberate them from these bindings.
shakti_gita::338.modern_relevance: When you get lost in distractions or pleasures, remember that your deeper awareness can see through and free you.
shakti_gita::338.insight: Shift your attention from being trapped in fleeting pleasures to recognizing the unchanging knowledge within.

shakti_gita::339.verse_sanskrit:
अज्ञानमूलकद्वैत भावोत्पन्नं हि बन्धनम् ।
विच्छिद्योन्मजये चापि ब्रह्मानन्दे निमज्जये ॥
shakti_gita::339.verse_hindi: अज्ञानमूलक द्वैतभाव से उत्पन्न बन्धन को काटकर जीवों को ब्रह्मानन्द में उन्मजन निमजन कराती हूँ
shakti_gita::339.english_translation: I cut the bondage born from the duality rooted in ignorance, immersing beings into the bliss of Brahman.
shakti_gita::339.translation_literal: अज्ञानमूलक (rooted in ignorance) / द्वैत (duality) / भावोत्पन्नं (born from) / हि (indeed) / बन्धनम् (bondage) / विच्छिद्य (cutting) / उन्मजये (immersing upwards) / च (and) / अपि (also) / ब्रह्मानन्दे (in Brahman bliss) / निमज्जये (immersing downwards)
shakti_gita::339.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::339.essence: Cutting through ignorance’s false divisions reveals immersion in supreme bliss.
shakti_gita::339.simple_meaning: You can break free from the bondage created by false division and dive fully into the bliss of the supreme reality.
shakti_gita::339.simple_insight: There’s freedom in letting go of false separations and resting in deep joy.
shakti_gita::339.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the suffering caused by the false sense of separation—born from ignorance—can be cut away, allowing beings to merge deeply into the supreme bliss of Brahman, signaling liberation.
shakti_gita::339.modern_relevance: When confusion and doubt trap your mind, remember you can choose to let go and experience profound peace and joy.
shakti_gita::339.insight: It shifts your view from grasping at separations to embracing unity and bliss.

shakti_gita::340.verse_sanskrit:
केवलं ज्ञानयोगेन पाशज्ञानमूलकम् ।
जीवः शिवस्त्रमासाद्योच्छेत्तुं पारयते ध्रुवम् ॥
shakti_gita::340.verse_hindi: केवल ज्ञानयोग के द्वारा ही जीव शिवत्व प्राप्त करके अपने अज्ञान मूलक बन्धन को काटने में समर्थ होता है
shakti_gita::340.english_translation: Only through the path of wisdom yoga can the living being attain Shiva-nature and surely cut the root of ignorance binding.
shakti_gita::340.translation_literal: केवलं (only) ज्ञानयोगेन (by wisdom yoga) पाशज्ञानमूलकम् (the bond of ignorance root) जीवः (the living being) शिवः (Shiva-nature) त्रमासाद्य (attaining) उच्चेत्तुं (to cut off) पारयते (enables) ध्रुवम् (certainly).
shakti_gita::340.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::340.essence: Only wisdom yoga can sever the root of ignorance and reveal your true divine nature.
shakti_gita::340.simple_meaning: You can only free yourself from deep confusion by following the path of wisdom and realize your true divine nature.
shakti_gita::340.simple_insight: There is hope in knowing that wisdom alone can cut through deep confusion and reveal who you truly are.
