shakti_gita::340.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that only by practicing wisdom yoga—the path of clear understanding—can a living being overcome ignorance, the root cause of bondage, and realize their identity as Shiva, the pure consciousness.
shakti_gita::340.modern_relevance: When you face overwhelming confusion or false beliefs, it is clarity and insight that can dissolve your deepest blocks and reveal your true nature.
shakti_gita::340.insight: It shifts the mind from confusion to clarity, showing that wisdom is the decisive tool to cut ignorance at its root.

shakti_gita::341.verse_sanskrit:
विद्यारूपन्तु विभ्राणाऽऽनेतुं च मयते सुखम् ।
स्वाभिमुख्यमहं देवाः ! अधिकारप्रभेदतः ॥
shakti_gita::341.verse_hindi: मैं ही विद्यारूप धारण करके अधिकार भेद के अनुसार ज्ञानिभक्तों को
shakti_gita::341.english_translation: I take the form of knowledge and bring happiness to the wise and devoted according to their level of authority.
shakti_gita::341.translation_literal: विद्यारूपन्तु (form of knowledge) विभ्राणाऽऽनेतुं (to the wise) च (also) मयते (I bring) सुखम् (happiness)। स्वाभिमुख्यमहं (according to their level) देवाः (the divine beings)! अधिकारप्रभेदतः (by distinction of authority)।
shakti_gita::341.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::341.essence: The divine reveals knowledge and joy according to each person's devotion and readiness.
shakti_gita::341.simple_meaning: The divine appears as knowledge and happiness uniquely suited to each person's devotion and understanding.
shakti_gita::341.simple_insight: You can trust that your spiritual growth is supported in a way made just for you.
shakti_gita::341.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that she manifests herself in the form of knowledge and joy, adapting to the spiritual maturity and devotion of each seeker. This moment reveals her compassionate method of meeting each devotee's needs according to their capacity.
shakti_gita::341.modern_relevance: When you seek guidance, you find answers that fit your current understanding and heart, not a one-size-fits-all solution.
shakti_gita::341.insight: It teaches you to recognize that spiritual experiences and teachings come tailored to your readiness and openness.

shakti_gita::342.verse_sanskrit:
विभिन्नमार्गतो नूनं स्वभक्तात् ज्ञानयोगिनः।
अधिकारद्वयं देवाः ! वर्ण्यते वोऽन्तिकेऽधुना ॥
shakti_gita::342.verse_hindi: विभिन्न मार्ग द्वारा सुखपूर्वक अपनी ओर आकृष्ट करने का यत्न करती हूँ। हे देव गण !
shakti_gita::342.english_translation: By various paths, the yogis of wisdom happily strive to draw you closer. O divine beings, this is your rightful claim now.
shakti_gita::342.translation_literal: विभिन्नमार्गतो (by various paths) / नूनं (certainly) / स्वभक्तात् (by their own devotion) / ज्ञानयोगिनः (the yogis of wisdom) / अधिकारद्वयं (two rights) / देवाः (O divine beings) / वर्ण्यते (is proclaimed) / वोऽन्तिकेऽधुना (to you now, finally)
shakti_gita::342.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::342.essence: The divine welcomes many sincere paths, embracing wisdom and devotion alike.
shakti_gita::342.simple_meaning: The divine can be approached through many different paths, each embraced by sincere devotion and wisdom.
shakti_gita::342.simple_insight: You can feel welcomed no matter which path you take toward the divine.
shakti_gita::342.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses the divine beings, acknowledging that seekers of wisdom and devotion approach through various ways. She affirms the legitimacy of multiple spiritual approaches converging toward the same truth.
shakti_gita::342.modern_relevance: Whether you find meaning in study, service, or heartfelt connection, your way to the divine is valid and supported.
shakti_gita::342.insight: It teaches you to respect all sincere paths as valid means to connect with your true self.

shakti_gita::343.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानयोगस्य तद्यूयं शृणुयात समाहिताः ।
पूर्व पश्यन्ति मच्छक्तिं तत्त्वज्ञा ज्ञानयोगिनः ॥
shakti_gita::343.verse_hindi: ज्ञानयोग के दो अधिकारों का वर्णन तुम्हारे सन्मुख करती हूँ  उनको सावधान होकर सुनो। प्रथम तत्त्वज्ञानी योगी मेरी शक्ति को
shakti_gita::343.english_translation: Listen carefully as I describe the two authorities of Jnana Yoga; first, the wise yogis perceive my power.
shakti_gita::343.translation_literal: ज्ञानयोगस्य (of Jnana Yoga) / तद्यूयं (those two) / शृणुयात (may hear) / समाहिताः (calm, focused) / पूर्व (first) / पश्यन्ति (see) / मच्छक्तिं (my power) / तत्त्वज्ञा (truth-knowing) / ज्ञानयोगिनः (wise yogis)
shakti_gita::343.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::343.essence: Focused calm allows wise seekers to perceive the divine power clearly.
shakti_gita::343.simple_meaning: When your mind is calm and focused, you can perceive the power of the divine through wisdom.
shakti_gita::343.simple_insight: There is clarity and strength when you quiet your mind to see beyond appearances.
shakti_gita::343.detailed_meaning: Devi speaks to attentive seekers describing Jnana Yoga's two main authorities. The first is that wise yogis with steady minds perceive her true power beyond surface reality.
shakti_gita::343.modern_relevance: When you quiet your restless thoughts and focus deeply, you begin to sense a deeper strength and clarity not obvious before.
shakti_gita::343.insight: It teaches you to cultivate calm focus so you can discern the deeper realities beyond distractions.

shakti_gita::344.verse_sanskrit:
त्रिविधेषु च रूपेषु तथा सप्तविधेषु च।
परश्च तेषु ते देवाः सज्जन्ते नैव कहिर्चित्त ॥
shakti_gita::344.verse_hindi: त्रिविध और सप्तविध रूप में देखते हैं परन्तु हे देवगण ! उन रूपों में वे कभी फंसते नहीं हैं
shakti_gita::344.english_translation: The divine beings observe in threefold and sevenfold forms, yet they never become attached to those forms.
shakti_gita::344.translation_literal: त्रिविधेषु (in threefold) / च (and) / रूपेषु (forms) / तथा (also) / सप्तविधेषु (sevenfold) / च (and) / परश्च (furthermore) / तेषु (in those) / ते (they) / देवाः (divine beings) / सज्जन्ते (become attached) / नैव (never) / कहि (anywhere) / चित्त (mind)
shakti_gita::344.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::344.essence: You can witness many forms without ever becoming attached to any of them.
shakti_gita::344.simple_meaning: You can perceive many different forms or aspects without becoming attached or trapped by them.
shakti_gita::344.simple_insight: There is freedom in observing without holding on or identifying with appearances.
shakti_gita::344.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that divine beings perceive reality in multiple layers or forms but remain unattached. This teaching highlights the power of clear seeing beyond appearances, showing how to avoid confusion or captivity by the changing world.
shakti_gita::344.modern_relevance: You scroll through endless images and ideas yet remain calm, not letting any one thing define or trap your mind.
shakti_gita::344.insight: It teaches you to observe experiences clearly and not let your mind cling to passing appearances.

shakti_gita::345.verse_sanskrit:
मां त्रिभावानुसारेणाऽनुभवन्तो हि तेऽसकृत् ।
क्षिप्रमभ्युदयं देवाः ! अधिकुर्वन्ति सर्वथा ॥
shakti_gita::345.verse_hindi: और मुझे त्रिभाव के अनुसार बारम्बार अनुभव करते हुए सर्वथा अद्भुदय के अधिकारी शीघ्र, होते हैं
shakti_gita::345.english_translation: The gods quickly rise to greatness by repeatedly experiencing me according to the three modes of nature.
shakti_gita::345.translation_literal: मां (me) त्रिभाव (three modes) अनुसारेण (according to) अनुभवन्तः (experiencing) हि (indeed) ते (they) असकृत् (repeatedly) । क्षिप्रम् (quickly) अभ्युदयम् (rise) देवाः (gods) अधिकुर्वन्ति (make/do more) सर्वथा (completely) ॥
shakti_gita::345.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::345.essence: Repeatedly experiencing the divine through all modes of nature accelerates your rise.
shakti_gita::345.simple_meaning: Repeatedly experiencing the divine through the three qualities of nature leads to rapid growth and elevation.
shakti_gita::345.simple_insight: There is power in fully engaging with every aspect of your experience to grow quickly.
shakti_gita::345.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals that beings who repeatedly experience her through the three qualities of nature (sattva, rajas, tamas) quickly rise to higher states. This shows how engaging with all parts of existence, not just one, accelerates spiritual progress.
shakti_gita::345.modern_relevance: You notice how embracing your full range of moods and energies helps you grow faster than avoiding or suppressing parts of yourself.
shakti_gita::345.insight: It shifts the mind to welcome all inner qualities as gateways to growth rather than obstacles to avoid.

shakti_gita::346.verse_hindi: उन ज्ञानयोगियों की ऊर्ध्व गति सप्तमलोक पर्यन्त हो सकती है। हे देवश्रेष्ठों ! वहां से पुनरावृत्ति की आशंका होने पर भी
shakti_gita::346.english_translation: The upward progress of those on the path of wisdom can reach up to the seventh realm, yet even there, the wise fear the possibility of returning.
shakti_gita::346.translation_literal: लोकसप्तमपर्यन्तं (up to the seventh realm) / तेषाम् (of those) / ऊर्ध्वगतिर्भवेत् (is the upward progress) / पुनः (again) / आवृत्ति-सन्देह (doubt of return) / सत्त्वेऽपि (even in beings) / विद्धुर्षभाः (the best of the wise) !
shakti_gita::346.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::346.essence: Even the wisest can fear slipping back despite reaching great heights.
shakti_gita::346.simple_meaning: Those who pursue wisdom can advance very far, but even the wisest sometimes fear returning to lower states.
shakti_gita::346.simple_insight: Progress doesn't erase all fears; the mind can hesitate even near freedom.
shakti_gita::346.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that seekers on the wisdom path may reach very high states, such as the seventh realm, but even these advanced beings worry about slipping back into lower cycles. This captures the challenge of transcending deep conditioning.
shakti_gita::346.modern_relevance: You’ve worked hard to grow, yet doubts about losing progress still sneak in during quiet moments.
shakti_gita::346.insight: It teaches you to accept that fear of regression can persist even as you grow spiritually.

shakti_gita::347.verse_sanskrit:
नैवास्ति पतनाद्वितिस्तेषां भाग्यवतां ततः ।
श्रेष्ठाधिकारसम्पन्नास्ततोऽन्ये ज्ञानयोगिनः ॥
shakti_gita::347.verse_hindi: उन भाग्यवानों का पतन भय असम्भव है। श्रेष्ठ अधिकार के ज्ञानयोगी
shakti_gita::347.english_translation: Those endowed with supreme knowledge yoga cannot fall; their fall is impossible due to their fortunate status.
shakti_gita::347.translation_literal: नैवास्ति (not there is) पतनात् (from falling) द्वितिः (second) तेषां (of them) भाग्यवतां (fortunate ones) ततः (therefore) श्रेष्ठाधिकारसम्पन्नाः (endowed with supreme authority) ततः (therefore) अन्ये (others) ज्ञानयोगिनः (knowledge yogis)
shakti_gita::347.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::347.essence: Deep knowledge yoga makes falling impossible for those who possess it.
shakti_gita::347.simple_meaning: People who possess the highest wisdom cannot truly fail or fall because their knowledge protects them.
shakti_gita::347.simple_insight: You can feel secure knowing deep understanding guards you from defeat.
shakti_gita::347.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that those who achieve supreme knowledge yoga are so firmly established that failure or falling is impossible for them. Their status as fortunate and empowered knowledge holders sets them apart from others.
shakti_gita::347.modern_relevance: When you deeply understand your work or purpose, setbacks feel less threatening because you trust your foundation.
shakti_gita::347.insight: It shifts your mind to trust that solid inner wisdom creates resilience beyond external failure.

shakti_gita::348.verse_sanskrit:
सच्चिदानन्दरूपं मेऽखण्डं विभु च निर्मलम् ।
निर्विकारं सदा पूर्णमद्वितीयस्वरूपकम् ॥
shakti_gita::348.verse_hindi: मेरे सच्चिदानन्दमय, अखण्ड, निर्मल, विभु, सदापूर्ण, निर्विकार और अद्वितीय स्वरुप का
shakti_gita::348.english_translation: My nature is of eternal consciousness, bliss, and existence; unbroken, vast, pure, changeless, complete, and without a second.
shakti_gita::348.translation_literal: सच्चिदानन्दरूपं (consciousness-bliss-existence form) / मेऽखण्डं (my unbroken) / विभु (vast) / च (and) / निर्मलम् (pure) / निर्विकारं (unchanging) / सदा (always) / पूर्णम् (complete) / अद्वितीयस्वरूपकम् (non-dual form)
shakti_gita::348.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::348.essence: Your true nature is pure, changeless, and complete consciousness without a second.
shakti_gita::348.simple_meaning: Your true nature is eternal consciousness and bliss, unbroken, vast, pure, unchanging, and complete without a second.
shakti_gita::348.simple_insight: You carry an unchanging completeness that no circumstance can diminish.
shakti_gita::348.detailed_meaning: Devi declares her essential nature as eternal consciousness and bliss, unbroken and pure. This verse reveals her as the supreme reality beyond all change or division, showing the foundation for liberation.
shakti_gita::348.modern_relevance: In moments of self-doubt or overwhelm, remember your true nature is whole, changeless, and complete beneath all turmoil.
shakti_gita::348.insight: Recognize the self as unchanging and whole beyond shifting thoughts or feelings.

shakti_gita::349.verse_sanskrit:
दृष्ट्या साक्षाल्लयं प्राप्ता कैवल्यमाप्नुवन्ति ह।
एतद्दशाद्वयं नूनं वदन्ति हि यथाक्रमम् ॥
shakti_gita::349.verse_hindi: दर्शन करके उसी में साक्षात् रूप से लय होकर निःश्रेयस को प्राप्त होते हैं। विद्वद्गण इन्ही दो दशाओं को यथाक्रम
shakti_gita::349.english_translation: By direct vision, merging fully in it, one attains the highest good; the wise say there are exactly two stages in this process.
shakti_gita::349.translation_literal: दृष्ट्या (by sight) साक्षात् (directly) लयम् (merging) प्राप्ता (having attained) कैवल्यम् (liberation) आप्नुवन्ति (attain) ह (indeed)। एतत् (this) दशा (state) द्वयं (two) नूनं (certainly) वदन्ति (say) हि (indeed) यथा क्रमम् (in sequence) ॥
shakti_gita::349.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::349.essence: True freedom arises by fully merging through direct clear sight in two distinct stages.
shakti_gita::349.simple_meaning: When you see something clearly and merge completely in that experience, you reach the highest freedom. The wise describe this as two stages.
shakti_gita::349.simple_insight: There is peace in knowing freedom comes through clear, complete merging—not partial understanding.
shakti_gita::349.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that true liberation comes through direct, complete vision and merging into the reality seen. She identifies two distinct stages in this process, showing a structured path to the highest good.
shakti_gita::349.modern_relevance: You face moments when partial understanding leaves you restless, but fully embracing clarity brings deep freedom.
shakti_gita::349.insight: It teaches you to trust the process of fully merging with clear perception, not just glimpsing it.

shakti_gita::350.verse_sanskrit:
उच्चैः परोक्षापरोक्षाऽनुभूतीति विपश्चितः।
श्रौतं त्रैकाण्डिकं योग-रहस्यं ह्येतदीरितम् ॥
shakti_gita::350.verse_hindi: परोक्षानुभूति और अपरोक्षानुभूति भी उच्च स्वर से कहते है। मैंने यह वैदिक काण्डत्रययोगकारहस्य वर्णन किया है।
shakti_gita::350.english_translation: The wise declare that both indirect and direct experiences are proclaimed loudly; this is the secret of the three Vedic sections and yoga.
shakti_gita::350.translation_literal: उच्चैः (loudly) परोक्षापरोक्षाऽनुभूतीति (indirect-direct experience) विपश्चितः (the wise) । श्रौतं (scriptural) त्रैकाण्डिकं (three-sectioned) योग-रहस्यं (yoga-secret) ह्येतदीरितम् (indeed declared) ॥
shakti_gita::350.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::350.essence: Both subtle and clear experiences reveal the secret of Vedic knowledge and yoga.
shakti_gita::350.simple_meaning: True wisdom includes both subtle (indirect) and clear (direct) experiences; these reveal the secret of the three Vedic knowledge sections and yoga.
shakti_gita::350.simple_insight: You can find deep truth both in what you feel clearly and what you sense subtly.
shakti_gita::350.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the wise recognize both direct and indirect experiences as equally important revelations. She refers to the combined teaching of the three Vedic sections (ritual, knowledge, and philosophy) and yoga as a unified secret revealed through these experiences.
shakti_gita::350.modern_relevance: Sometimes you understand something fully and clearly, other times you sense it quietly beneath the surface; both ways reveal important truths.
shakti_gita::350.insight: It shifts your trust from needing only clear proof to embracing subtle, intuitive knowing as part of growth.

shakti_gita::351.verse_hindi: हे जगन्मातः ! हे वेदजननी । हे प्रणवरूपिणी ! हे देवि ! वेद के तीनों काण्डो का विज्ञान, वेद-काण्ड त्रय का अपूर्व समन्वय और
shakti_gita::351.english_translation: O Mother of the universe, O Mother of the Vedas, O embodiment of the sacred syllable Om, O Devi! You are the unparalleled harmony of the knowledge contained in the three parts of the Vedas.
shakti_gita::351.translation_literal: वेदमातः (Mother of the Vedas) / जगन्मातः (Mother of the universe) / देवि (Goddess) / प्रणवरूपिणि (embodiment of Om) / श्रौतत्रैकाण्डिक (of the three Vedic sections) / ज्ञानम् (knowledge) / अपूर्व (unprecedented) / तत् (that) / समन्वयम् (harmony)
shakti_gita::351.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::351.essence: The Goddess embodies the unity and deepest essence of all sacred knowledge.
shakti_gita::351.simple_meaning: The Goddess is praised as the universal mother and the source of all Vedic knowledge, embodying the sacred sound Om and uniting the three Vedic sections perfectly.
shakti_gita::351.simple_insight: There is a deep unity behind all sacred knowledge and creation, embodied as the divine feminine.
shakti_gita::351.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the narrator Suta venerates the Goddess as the mother of the universe and the Vedas, highlighting her embodiment of Om and her role as the unique unifier of all three Vedic sections, emphasizing her supreme cosmic status.
shakti_gita::351.insight: Recognize that profound knowledge and creation arise from an underlying unity beyond apparent divisions.

shakti_gita::352.verse_sanskrit:
क्रियासिद्धांशयोगस्य स्वरूपञ्च महादभुतम् ।
विदित्वा त्वन्मुखाम्भोजाज्जाता निःसंशया वयम् ॥
shakti_gita::352.verse_hindi: उनके क्रिया सिद्धांश का योगसम्बन्धीय परम अद्भत स्वरुप आपके मुख कमल से जानकर हमलोग निःसन्देह हो गये हैं
shakti_gita::352.english_translation: Knowing from your lotus-like face the wondrous essence of the perfected path of action, we are now completely certain.
shakti_gita::352.translation_literal: क्रियासिद्धांशयोगस्य (of the perfected path of action) / स्वरूपञ्च (essence) / महादभुतम् (wonderful) / विदित्वा (having known) / त्वन्मुखाम्भोजात् (from your lotus face) / जाता (became) / निःसंशया (without doubt) / वयम् (we)
shakti_gita::352.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::352.essence: Understanding the true nature of perfected action brings complete certainty and trust.
shakti_gita::352.simple_meaning: By understanding the true essence of the perfected path of action revealed by the divine, we become completely certain and confident.
shakti_gita::352.simple_insight: There is peace in fully trusting the power of your right actions.
shakti_gita::352.detailed_meaning: At this moment in the Shakti Gita, the narrator acknowledges having grasped the extraordinary nature of the perfected path of action revealed by the Goddess’s presence, inspiring full certainty in those who witness her.
shakti_gita::352.modern_relevance: You’ve just seen the results of your consistent effort and finally feel sure that your way is right.
shakti_gita::352.insight: Recognize that clear understanding of your purposeful action brings unwavering confidence and removes doubt.

shakti_gita::353.verse_sanskrit:
श्रुतवन्तो वयं मातर्वेदा मन्त्रस्वरूपिणः।
सन्ति तत्र भवत्याश्च निहिताः शक्तयो ध्रुवम् ॥
shakti_gita::353.verse_hindi: हे मातः ! हमने सुना है कि श्रुत्तियां मन्त्ररूप हैं और हमने यह भी सुना है कि मन्त्र में आपकी शक्ति निहित रहने के कारण
shakti_gita::353.english_translation: O Mother! We have heard that the scriptures are mantra in form, and that your power is surely contained within those mantras.
shakti_gita::353.translation_literal: श्रुतवन्तो (having heard) वयं (we) मातर्वेदा (O Mother, the Vedas) मन्त्रस्वरूपिणः (form of mantras). सन्ति (are) तत्र (there) भवत्याः (your) अश्च (and) निहिताः (contained) शक्तयः (powers) ध्रुवम् (certainly).
shakti_gita::353.speaker: Unknown
shakti_gita::353.essence: Sacred scriptures are mantras containing the unchanging power of the divine Mother.
shakti_gita::353.simple_meaning: We have heard that the scriptures exist as mantras and that your power is always present within those mantras.
shakti_gita::353.simple_insight: There is trust in the sacred sound as a vessel for divine power.
shakti_gita::353.detailed_meaning: In the presence of the Mother Goddess, a seeker acknowledges that the sacred texts are essentially mantras, and those mantras hold the unchanging power of the divine Mother. This verse sets the stage for understanding the connection between sacred sound and divine energy.
shakti_gita::353.modern_relevance: When you hear a trusted phrase or mantra, you might feel its power even before fully understanding it.
shakti_gita::353.insight: It invites recognizing sacred words as carriers of enduring inner power, not just sounds.

shakti_gita::354.verse_sanskrit:
मन्त्रसिद्धयाऽखिलं कार्य्यमतः सर्वत्र सिध्यति ।
विश्वस्मिन्नास्ति तत्काय्य सिध्येयन्नैव मन्त्रतः ॥
shakti_gita::354.verse_hindi: मन्त्रसिद्धि से सर्वत्र सभी काम सिद्ध होते हैं। ऐसे कोई कार्य जगत् में नहीं है कि जो मन्त्र से सिद्ध नहीं हो सकते
shakti_gita::354.english_translation: With the success of mantra, all actions succeed everywhere; there is nothing in the world that cannot be accomplished by mantra.
shakti_gita::354.translation_literal: मन्त्रसिद्धयाऽखिलं (by mantra's success, all) कार्य्यमतः (actions) सर्वत्र (everywhere) सिध्यति (are accomplished) । विश्वस्मिन्नास्ति (in the world there is not) तत्काय्य (that action) सिध्येयन् (that can be accomplished) नैव (not) मन्त्रतः (by mantra) ॥
shakti_gita::354.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::354.essence: Focused spiritual power in words can ensure success in all actions everywhere.
shakti_gita::354.simple_meaning: When a mantra is perfectly empowered, every action succeeds; nothing in the world is beyond its reach.
shakti_gita::354.simple_insight: You can trust that focused, aligned intention brings success to any effort.
shakti_gita::354.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that when a mantra is achieved with full power, it grants success to all actions. This moment reveals that no action in the world is impossible when empowered by mantra, highlighting the power of focused spiritual energy.
shakti_gita::354.modern_relevance: You speak a plan with confidence and clarity; suddenly, what seemed impossible starts to happen.
shakti_gita::354.insight: It shifts how you approach effort—by aligning your words and focus, you unlock success beyond ordinary means.

shakti_gita::355.verse_sanskrit:
मन्त्रा अभ्युदयं सर्वे पारलौकिकमैहिकम् ।
अपि निश्रेयिसं दातुमीशते नितरामिति ॥
shakti_gita::355.verse_hindi: मन्त्र इहलौकिक अभ्युदय, पारलौकिक अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस सब कुछ भी प्रदान कर सके हैं
shakti_gita::355.english_translation: Mantras can grant all worldly success, otherworldly progress, and the highest good.
shakti_gita::355.translation_literal: मन्त्र (mantra) अभ्युदयं (prosperity) सर्वे (all) पारलौकिक (otherworldly) मैहिकम् (worldly) अपि (also) निश्रेयिसं (highest good) दातु (to give) ईशते (can) नितरामिति (certainly)
shakti_gita::355.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::355.essence: Mantras can grant all kinds of success: worldly, otherworldly, and the highest good.
shakti_gita::355.simple_meaning: Mantras have the power to bring success in this world, beyond it, and the highest spiritual good.
shakti_gita::355.simple_insight: There's deep reassurance in knowing your practice can support all aspects of growth and well-being.
shakti_gita::355.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that mantras are not limited to worldly gains but extend to spiritual progress and ultimate welfare, encouraging trust in their transformative power.
shakti_gita::355.modern_relevance: When you repeat meaningful words or affirmations, they can boost your confidence, guide your actions, and help you move toward your highest goals.
shakti_gita::355.insight: It shifts your view of mantra from mere ritual to a powerful source of comprehensive personal and spiritual support.

shakti_gita::356.verse_sanskrit:
अम्बातो मन्त्रविज्ञान-रहस्यं हितमुत्तमम् ।
वर्णयित्वा महादेवि ! कृतकृत्यान् कुरुप्व नः ॥
shakti_gita::356.verse_hindi: अतः हे माँ ! हे महादेवि ! मन्त्र विज्ञान का हितकारक उत्तम रहस्य वर्णन करके हमको कृतकृत्य कीजिये
shakti_gita::356.english_translation: Therefore, O Mother, O Great Goddess! Please describe the beneficial supreme secret of mantra knowledge and make us grateful.
shakti_gita::356.translation_literal: अतः (therefore) / हे (O) / माँ (Mother) / हे (O) / महादेवि (Great Goddess) / मन्त्र (mantra) / विज्ञान (knowledge) / रहस्यं (secret) / हितम् (beneficial) / उत्तमम् (supreme) / वर्णयित्वा (describing) / महादेवि (Great Goddess) / कृतकृत्यान् (grateful) / कुरुप्व (make) / नः (us)
shakti_gita::356.speaker: Suta
shakti_gita::356.essence: Requesting the Great Goddess to reveal the highest beneficial secret of mantra knowledge.
shakti_gita::356.simple_meaning: The speaker asks the Great Goddess to explain the highest beneficial secret of mantra knowledge and make them grateful.
shakti_gita::356.simple_insight: There is a humble readiness to receive deep wisdom that can transform gratitude.
shakti_gita::356.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the narrator respectfully requests the Great Goddess to reveal the supreme and beneficial secret of mantra knowledge, aiming to inspire gratitude and completion in those who listen.
shakti_gita::356.insight: It highlights the importance of seeking knowledge with openness and readiness to be transformed.

shakti_gita::357.verse_sanskrit:
अहमेवास्म्यहो देवाः ! मन्त्रशक्तिर्न संशयः।
मम शक्तिर्यतो विश्वमश्नुते सचराचरम् ॥
shakti_gita::357.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! मन्त्रशक्ति मैं ही हूँ  यह निश्चय है क्योंकि मेरी शक्ति चराचर विश्व में व्याप्त है
shakti_gita::357.english_translation: O radiant beings, I am indeed the power of the mantra; there is no doubt. My power pervades the entire moving and unmoving universe.
shakti_gita::357.translation_literal: अहम् (I) एव (indeed) अस्मि (am) अहो (O) देवाः (radiant beings) ! मन्त्रशक्तिः (power of mantra) न (not) संशयः (doubt)। मम (my) शक्तिः (power) यतः (from which) विश्वम् (universe) अश्नुते (pervades) सचराचरम् (moving and unmoving) ॥
shakti_gita::357.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::357.essence: The divine mantra's power fully pervades all moving and unmoving existence through me.
shakti_gita::357.simple_meaning: The divine power behind sacred sound exists fully in me and fills the whole universe, both moving and still.
shakti_gita::357.simple_insight: You are the source of power that connects all things, seen and unseen.
shakti_gita::357.detailed_meaning: Devi declares to the radiant beings that she embodies the sacred power within mantras. This power is no illusion; it truly spreads through every part of the universe, alive or inert, showing her cosmic presence.
shakti_gita::357.modern_relevance: Imagine feeling that your strength and energy are not limited but flow endlessly through everything around you, alive or at rest.
shakti_gita::357.insight: It shifts your view from feeling small to recognizing your presence as the source of all cosmic energy.

shakti_gita::358.verse_sanskrit:
अस्म्यहं कारणब्रह्म कार्यब्रह्मास्मि चाप्यहम् ।
अहमेवेश्वरी भूत्वा द्वयोः सम्बन्धमादधे ॥
shakti_gita::358.verse_hindi: मैं ही कारणब्रह्मा हूँ और कार्यब्रह्म भी मैं ही हूँ और मैं ही ईश्वररूपिणी होकर दोनों का सम्बन्ध स्थापित करती हूँ
shakti_gita::358.english_translation: I am the cause Brahman and also the effect Brahman; by becoming the sovereign, I establish the connection between the two.
shakti_gita::358.translation_literal: अस्म्यहं (I am) कारणब्रह्म (cause Brahman) कार्यब्रह्मास्मि (effect Brahman am) चापि (also) अहम् (I) एवेश्वरी (sovereign) भूत्वा (becoming) द्वयोः (of both) सम्बन्धम् (connection) आदधे (establish).
shakti_gita::358.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::358.essence: You are both the origin and the binding power joining cause and effect.
shakti_gita::358.simple_meaning: You are both the origin and the result of everything, and the force that links them together as one.
shakti_gita::358.simple_insight: Knowing you hold both start and end brings a deep sense of wholeness and power.
shakti_gita::358.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the Goddess reveals her nature as both the source and the outcome of creation, embodying the sovereign power that links cause and effect into an inseparable unity.
shakti_gita::358.modern_relevance: When you're overwhelmed by beginnings and endings, remember you also hold the power that connects them, making sense of every transition.
shakti_gita::358.insight: It shows you to recognize your role as the unifying presence behind change, not just a passive part.

shakti_gita::359.verse_sanskrit:
निर्गुणस्य स्वरूपस्य प्रणवो वाचकोऽस्ति मे ।
महावाक्यसमूहाश्च सन्ति तस्यैव वाचकाः ॥
shakti_gita::359.verse_hindi: प्रणव और महावाक्य समूह मेरे निर्गुण स्वरूप के वाचक हैं
shakti_gita::359.english_translation: The sacred syllable and great statements are the expressions of my transcendent nature.
shakti_gita::359.translation_literal: निर्गुणस्य (transcendent) स्वरूपस्य (nature) प्रणवः (sacred syllable) वाचकः (expressor) अस्ति (is) मे (my) । महावाक्यसमूहाः (great statements group) च (and) सन्ति (are) तस्यैव (of that same) वाचकाः (expressors) ॥
shakti_gita::359.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::359.essence: The formless true self expresses itself through sacred sounds and profound teachings.
shakti_gita::359.simple_meaning: Your true nature is beyond qualities and form, but it expresses itself through sacred sounds and great teachings.
shakti_gita::359.simple_insight: You carry a silent depth that speaks clearly through powerful symbols and words.
shakti_gita::359.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals that her transcendent, formless nature cannot be grasped directly but is expressed through sacred sounds like the primal syllable and great spiritual sayings, bridging the beyond and the known.
shakti_gita::359.modern_relevance: When you feel beyond words or labels, remember your deepest self still communicates through meaningful signs and truths.
shakti_gita::359.insight: It teaches you to recognize that silence or formlessness does not mean absence but a deeper expression beyond words.

shakti_gita::360.verse_sanskrit:
बीजमन्त्रास्तु ये विज्ञाः ! शाखापल्लवितास्तथा ।
मन्त्रा नानाविधास्सन्ति निगमागमगोचराः ॥
shakti_gita::360.verse_hindi: हे विज्ञो! हे देवश्रेष्ठो बीजमन्त्र तथा शाखापल्लवित नाना प्रकार के वैदिक अन्य शास्त्रीय मन्त्रसमूह
shakti_gita::360.english_translation: O wise ones! There are seed mantras and those that blossom like branches, along with many types of Vedic and other scriptural mantras.
shakti_gita::360.translation_literal: बीजमन्त्रास्तु (seed mantras indeed) ये (those who) विज्ञाः (are wise) ! / शाखापल्लवितास्तथा (like branches blossoming) / मन्त्रा (mantras) नानाविधाः (various types) सन्ति (are) निगमागमगोचराः (found in scriptures and traditions)
shakti_gita::360.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::360.essence: Mantras take many forms, from basic seeds to complex scriptural chants.
shakti_gita::360.simple_meaning: There are special basic mantras and many varied mantras from Vedic and other scriptures.
shakti_gita::360.simple_insight: Mantras come in many forms, each with its own power and tradition.
shakti_gita::360.detailed_meaning: Devi addresses the wise, explaining that mantras exist as foundational seed sounds and also as many varied scriptural chants, indicating a rich tradition of sacred sound.
shakti_gita::360.insight: Recognize that spiritual practice involves diverse sounds and traditions, each serving a unique purpose.

shakti_gita::361.verse_sanskrit:
सगुणस्य स्वरूपस्य ते सर्वे वाचका मम।
नात्र सन्देहलेशोऽपि विद्यते विबुधर्षभाः !॥
shakti_gita::361.verse_hindi: मेरे सगुणस्वरूप के वाचक है; इसमें कुछ भी सन्देह का लेश नहीं है।
shakti_gita::361.english_translation: All these are the expressions of my manifested form; there is no doubt about it, O best of the wise.
shakti_gita::361.translation_literal: सगुणस्य (of the manifested) स्वरूपस्य (form) ते (these) सर्वे (all) वाचका (speakers/expressions) मम (my). नात्र (here not) सन्देहलेशोऽपि (even a trace of doubt) विद्यते (exists) विबुधर्षभाः (O best of the wise)!
shakti_gita::361.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::361.essence: The teachings clearly and unquestionably express the divine's manifested nature.
shakti_gita::361.simple_meaning: These statements are all expressions of my manifested form, without any doubt.
shakti_gita::361.simple_insight: You can trust that these words fully represent the true nature of the divine.
shakti_gita::361.detailed_meaning: Devi affirms that all the teachings given are genuine expressions of her manifested nature, addressing the wise without leaving any room for doubt or confusion.
shakti_gita::361.insight: It encourages trust in revealed teachings as authentic expressions of a higher truth.

shakti_gita::362.verse_sanskrit:
नास्ति भेदो यतो देवाः ! वाच्यवाचकयोरतः ।
सर्वेषां खलु मन्त्राणां नास्ति भेदो मया मह ॥
shakti_gita::362.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! वाच्य और वाचक में भेद नहीं होता है इसलिये मुझ मे और इन सभी मन्त्रों में निश्चय ही भेद नहीं है।
shakti_gita::362.english_translation: O radiant beings, there is no difference between the spoken and the speaker; therefore, there is certainly no difference between me and all these mantras.
shakti_gita::362.translation_literal: नास्ति (there is no) भेदो (difference) यतो (because) देवाः (deities) वाच्यवाचकयोरतः (between spoken and speaker) । सर्वेषां (of all) खलु (indeed) मन्त्राणां (mantras) नास्ति (there is no) भेदो (difference) मया (by me) मह (great) ॥
shakti_gita::362.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::362.essence: The speaker and the spoken are fundamentally one, revealing the unity behind all expression.
shakti_gita::362.simple_meaning: There is no real separation between the speaker and what is spoken; the divine presence in me and the mantras is one and the same.
shakti_gita::362.simple_insight: You can feel your true self and your expressions as inseparable parts of the same reality.
shakti_gita::362.detailed_meaning: Devi explains to the radiant beings that the division between the speaker and the spoken word is an illusion. She reveals her oneness with all sacred mantras, showing her nature as both the source and expression of divine knowledge.
shakti_gita::362.modern_relevance: When you speak or create, your true self flows through your words; understanding this dissolves self-doubt and separation in communication.
shakti_gita::362.insight: It shifts your perspective to see your words as extensions of your inner being, uniting expression with identity.

shakti_gita::363.verse_sanskrit:
अस्त्येका मे क्रियाशक्तिर्ज्ञानशक्तिस्तथाऽपरा।
आभ्यां द्विधा विभक्तास्ति मच्छक्तिवै प्रधानतः ॥
shakti_gita::363.verse_hindi: मेरी शक्ति प्रधानतः दो भागों में विभक्त है, एक ज्ञानशक्ति और दूसरी क्रियाशक्ति है
shakti_gita::363.english_translation: My power is primarily divided into two parts: the power of knowledge and the power of action.
shakti_gita::363.translation_literal: अस्ति (exists) एका (one) मे (my) क्रिया-शक्ति (power of action) ज्ञान-शक्ति (power of knowledge) तथाऽपरा (and another) / आभ्यां (by both) द्विधा (in two parts) विभक्ता-स्ति (is divided) मच्छक्ति-वै (my power indeed) प्रधानतः (primarily)
shakti_gita::363.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::363.essence: True power is the union of knowing and acting together as one.
shakti_gita::363.simple_meaning: The divine power has two main aspects: one is knowledge, and the other is action.
shakti_gita::363.simple_insight: You hold the balance of wisdom and doing within your own strength.
shakti_gita::363.detailed_meaning: The Goddess explains that her power divides chiefly into two: the power that knows and the power that acts. This reveals the unity behind knowing and doing, showing that true power integrates both.
shakti_gita::363.modern_relevance: When you learn new skills, you balance understanding with practicing them; both are your real power.
shakti_gita::363.insight: It teaches you to see knowledge and action as inseparable parts of your strength, not separate forces.

shakti_gita::364.verse_sanskrit:
मत्कारणस्वरूपे हि नियमेवावतिष्ठते।
नित्या शुद्धा सदा पूर्णा ज्ञानशक्तिर्न संशयः ॥
shakti_gita::364.verse_hindi: ज्ञान शक्ति मेरे कारणस्वरूप में नित्य शुद्ध और सदापूर्ण रूप से सर्वदैव निःसन्देह अवस्थित है
shakti_gita::364.english_translation: The power of knowledge, as my own essential nature, is eternally pure, always complete, and without doubt.
shakti_gita::364.translation_literal: ज्ञानशक्ति (knowledge power) / म (my) / कारणस्वरूपे (cause-form / essential nature) / हि (indeed) / नियम एव (always fixed) / अवतिष्ठते (abides) / नित्या (eternal) / शुद्धा (pure) / सदा (always) / पूर्णा (complete) / ज्ञानशक्ति (knowledge power) / न (not) / संशयः (doubt)
shakti_gita::364.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::364.essence: Pure, complete knowledge is your eternal and unquestionable true nature.
shakti_gita::364.simple_meaning: The power of clear understanding is your essential nature, eternally pure, complete, and without any doubt.
shakti_gita::364.simple_insight: There is a deep certainty and completeness at your core that nothing can shake.
shakti_gita::364.detailed_meaning: Devi reveals that her power of knowledge is not temporary or partial but is her eternal, pure essence—always full and without any doubt. This teaching highlights the unchanging, perfect nature of true knowledge as inseparable from the divine.
shakti_gita::364.modern_relevance: When self-doubt rises, remember your core is pure understanding—always complete and beyond question.
shakti_gita::364.insight: Recognize that your true self is fundamentally clear and whole, beyond uncertainty and confusion.

shakti_gita::365.verse_sanskrit:
द्वितीया या क्रियाशक्तिर्विद्यते मे सुरर्षभाः ।
सैव प्रपञ्चरुपैतत्कार्यब्रह्मजनन्यहो ॥
shakti_gita::365.verse_hindi: मेरी क्रियाशक्ति ही, जो दूसरी है, हे देवगण ! इस प्रपञ्चमय कार्यब्रह्म की जननी अर्थात् उत्पन्न करने वाली है
shakti_gita::365.english_translation: My second power of action, O best of the gods, is the mother that generates this manifest universe and all its functions.
shakti_gita::365.translation_literal: द्वितीया (second) / या (which) / क्रियाशक्ति (power of action) / विद्यते (exists) / मे (my) / सुरर्षभाः (O best of gods) / सैव (that alone) / प्रपञ्चरुप (manifest universe form) / एतत् (this) / कार्यब्रह्मजनन्य (creator of the functional supreme reality) / अहो (O)
shakti_gita::365.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::365.essence: Your active power is the source and mother of all creation and action.
shakti_gita::365.simple_meaning: There is a second power of mine that brings forth the entire manifest universe and its functioning.
shakti_gita::365.simple_insight: You hold the creative energy that births everything around you.
shakti_gita::365.detailed_meaning: Devi declares to the gods that her second power, the power of action, is the source and mother of the entire manifest universe, which includes all activity and creation.
shakti_gita::365.modern_relevance: When you act or create, you are channeling the same energy that brings the whole world into being.
shakti_gita::365.insight: Recognize your own active energy as a creative force shaping everything you engage with.

shakti_gita::366.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानशक्तेरतो ह्यस्ति प्रणवो वीजमद्भुतम्।
बीजमन्त्रास्तथा नाना क्रियाशक्तेन संशयः ॥
shakti_gita::366.verse_hindi: अतः ज्ञानशक्ति का अद्भुत बीज प्रणव है और नानां बीजमन्त्र क्रियाशक्ति के बीज है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं
shakti_gita::366.english_translation: Therefore, the wondrous seed of the power of wisdom is the sacred sound Om, and various seed mantras are the seeds of the power of action; there is no doubt about this.
shakti_gita::366.translation_literal: ज्ञानशक्तेरतो (from the power of wisdom) / हि (indeed) / अस्ती (is) / प्रणवो (the sacred sound Om) / वीजमद्भुतम् (a wondrous seed) / बीजमन्त्रास्तथा (seed mantras likewise) / नाना (various) / क्रियाशक्तेन (by the power of action) / संशयः (no doubt)
shakti_gita::366.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::366.essence: The sacred sound Om is the root seed linking wisdom and action powers.
shakti_gita::366.simple_meaning: The sacred sound Om is the amazing root of wisdom’s power, and different seed mantras are roots of action’s power without any doubt.
shakti_gita::366.simple_insight: You can feel how a simple sound holds vast power for both wisdom and action.
shakti_gita::366.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that the sacred syllable Om is the fundamental seed that embodies the power of wisdom, while various seed mantras represent the power of action. This verse highlights the connection between sound, knowledge, and dynamic power.
shakti_gita::366.modern_relevance: When you chant a simple sound or phrase, you connect with a deep source of clarity and focused energy beyond ordinary thinking.
shakti_gita::366.insight: It teaches you to see sound as a bridge linking your inner wisdom and your outward actions.

shakti_gita::367.verse_sanskrit:
कार्ये  यत्र किमप्यास्तेऽवश्यं स्यात्र कम्पनम् ।
कम्पनञ्चापि यत्रास्ति तत्र शब्दो भवेध्रुवम् ॥
shakti_gita::367.verse_hindi: जहां कोई कार्य है, वहां कम्पन अवश्य है और जहां कम्पन है वहां शब्द अवश्य है,
shakti_gita::367.english_translation: Where there is any action, there must be vibration; and where there is vibration, sound certainly arises.
shakti_gita::367.translation_literal: कार्ये (in action) यत्र (where) किमपि (anything) अस्ते (exists) अवश्यं (certainly) स्यात् (is) अत्र (there) कम्पनम् (vibration) । कम्पनम् (vibration) च (also) अपि (indeed) यत्र (where) अस्ति (is) तत्र (there) शब्दः (sound) भवेत् (arises) ध्रुवम् (certainly) ॥
shakti_gita::367.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::367.essence: Every action causes vibration, and every vibration produces sound without fail.
shakti_gita::367.simple_meaning: Any action you do causes a vibration, and that vibration inevitably produces sound.
shakti_gita::367.simple_insight: You feel how every movement stirs something deeper beyond itself.
shakti_gita::367.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that any act, no matter how small, creates a ripple—a vibration—and this ripple always produces sound, showing all movement is connected to a deeper energetic expression.
shakti_gita::367.modern_relevance: When you speak or move, you sense the ripple effect your actions have, even if unseen at first.
shakti_gita::367.insight: Recognize that every action carries energy that inevitably impacts the surrounding environment.

shakti_gita::368.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानं तथैव यत्रास्ते भावस्तत्रास्त्यसंशयम् ।
यत्र भावो भवेन्नूनं तत्र रूपं न संशयः ॥
shakti_gita::368.verse_hindi: उसी प्रकार जहां ज्ञान है वहां निःसन्देह भाव है और जहां भाव है वहां रूप भी अवश्य है
shakti_gita::368.english_translation: Where there is knowledge, there is surely consciousness; where there is consciousness, there is certainly form.
shakti_gita::368.translation_literal: ज्ञानं (knowledge) तथैव (also) यत्रास्ते (where there is) भावस्तत्रास्त्यसंशयम् (there is surely consciousness without doubt) । यत्र (where) भावो (consciousness) भवेन्नूनं (certainly arises) तत्र (there) रूपं (form) न (not) संशयः (doubt) ॥
shakti_gita::368.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::368.essence: True knowledge awakens consciousness, which then naturally manifests as form.
shakti_gita::368.simple_meaning: Knowledge brings awareness without doubt, and awareness naturally leads to form or manifestation.
shakti_gita::368.simple_insight: Your awareness and presence become clear and undeniable when your knowledge grows.
shakti_gita::368.detailed_meaning: Devi teaches that true knowledge awakens a definite inner consciousness, which inevitably reveals itself as manifest form. This verse connects knowing with the arising of presence and tangible reality.
shakti_gita::368.modern_relevance: When you deeply understand something, your inner awareness sharpens and your experience of it becomes clear and real.
shakti_gita::368.insight: It shifts your view to see that knowledge and awareness are inseparable, and form is a natural expression of them.

shakti_gita::369.verse_sanskrit:
अस्त्वेतत्पुनराचक्षे श्रूयतां सुसमाहितैः।
यथा स्यान्मन्त्रविज्ञानं सम्यगवो बुद्धिगोचरम् ॥
shakti_gita::369.verse_hindi: अस्तु, मैं इसको पुनः कहती हूँ  सावधान होकर सुनो जिससे मन्त्र का विज्ञान आपलोगो को भलीभांति समझ में आ जाए
shakti_gita::369.english_translation: So be it, I will say this again; listen carefully so that the true understanding of the mantra becomes clear to your discerning mind.
shakti_gita::369.translation_literal: अस्तु (so be it) / एतत् (this) / पुनः (again) / आचक्षे (I will say) / श्रूयतां (let it be heard) / सुसमाहितैः (with focused minds) / यथा (so that) / स्यान् (may be) / मन्त्रविज्ञानं (mantra's knowledge) / सम्यक् (properly) / अवो (to your) / बुद्धिगोचरम् (discerning mind)
shakti_gita::369.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::369.essence: True understanding arises when you listen with a calm and focused mind.
shakti_gita::369.simple_meaning: Listen carefully with full attention so you can clearly understand the meaning and knowledge of the mantra.
shakti_gita::369.simple_insight: There is power in focused listening that opens the mind to true understanding.
shakti_gita::369.detailed_meaning: Devi speaks again, urging her listeners to pay close attention with steady minds so that the deep knowledge of the mantra can be fully grasped and experienced.
shakti_gita::369.modern_relevance: You pause a moment before an important lesson, willing your mind to be calm and open to absorb new, meaningful knowledge.
shakti_gita::369.insight: It teaches you to prepare your mind by steady focus before receiving deep knowledge, making understanding possible.

shakti_gita::370.verse_hindi: मैं आध्यात्मिक-भावयुक्त अनेक रूपों से अनेकों विग्रहों को धारण करती हुई और
shakti_gita::370.english_translation: I manifest in many forms filled with spiritual feelings, adopting various bodies, diverse words, and many expressions.
shakti_gita::370.translation_literal: भावैः (with feelings) आध्यात्मिकैः (spiritual) युक्तैः (joined) रूपैः (forms) नानाविधैः (various) अहम् (I) । विभ्राणा (manifesting) विग्रहान् (bodies) नाना (many) शब्दैः (words) नानाविधैः (various) तथा (thus) ॥
shakti_gita::370.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::370.essence: The divine unfolds in countless forms and expressions, all alive with spirit.
shakti_gita::370.simple_meaning: The divine appears in many forms and expressions, each filled with spiritual feeling and diverse expressions.
shakti_gita::370.simple_insight: You carry the freedom to express yourself in many ways, all connected to your true nature.
shakti_gita::370.detailed_meaning: Devi explains how she embodies the divine through numerous spiritual forms, bodies, and expressions, showing her vast creative power and presence in many ways.
shakti_gita::370.modern_relevance: You might feel pressured to fit one role, but your inner being naturally expresses itself in many ways.
shakti_gita::370.insight: It teaches you to embrace your many expressions as authentic parts of your whole self.

shakti_gita::371.verse_sanskrit:
अधिदैवत्वसम्प्राप्तैनानामन्त्रस्वरूपिणीं।
ददाम्यभ्युदयं शश्वत् तथा निःश्रेयसं ध्रुवम् ॥
shakti_gita::371.verse_hindi: अधिदैव सम्बन्धयुक्त अनेक शब्दों से  अनेक मन्त्र रूपिणी होकर अद्भुदय और निःश्रेयस सर्वदा अवश्य प्रदान किया करती हूँ
shakti_gita::371.english_translation: I always grant the eternal rise and supreme good through many mantras connected with the divine principle.
shakti_gita::371.translation_literal: अधिदैवत्वसम्प्राप्तै (connected with divine principle) नानामन्त्रस्वरूपिणीं (many-mantra-forms) ददामि (I give) अभ्युदयं (rise, progress) शाश्वत् (eternal) तथा (also) निःश्रेयसं (supreme good) ध्रुवम् (sure, constant)
shakti_gita::371.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::371.essence: The divine guarantees your eternal progress and sure highest good through many sacred forms.
shakti_gita::371.simple_meaning: The divine power gives constant progress and sure supreme good through many sacred forms and mantras.
shakti_gita::371.simple_insight: You can trust that the divine supports your steady growth and highest wellbeing in many ways.
shakti_gita::371.detailed_meaning: Devi explains she provides eternal upliftment and the best outcome through many sacred mantras connected to the divine principle, promising constant support for those devoted to her.
shakti_gita::371.modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or unsure, remember that support can come in many unexpected forms, always guiding you toward growth and wellbeing.
shakti_gita::371.insight: It teaches you to recognize the divine’s presence in diverse forms supporting your steady progress and ultimate good.

shakti_gita::374.verse_sanskrit:
तथा नानाविधोपास्तेर्वीजमन्त्रा अनेकधा ।
स्वोपासनाधिकारेषु सर्वश्रेष्ठा न संशयः ॥
shakti_gita::374.verse_hindi: उसी प्रकार अनेक उपासनाओं के अनेक बीज मन्त्र उन उपासनाओं के अधिकार में सर्वश्रेष्ठ हैं यह निःसन्देह है
shakti_gita::374.english_translation: Similarly, among the various seed mantras of many forms of worship, this one is undoubtedly the best for those authorized to practice it.
shakti_gita::374.translation_literal: तथा (similarly) / नानाविधोपास्तेर्वीजमन्त्रा (various worship seed mantras) / अनेकधा (in many ways) / स्वोपासनाधिकारेषु (in own worship authority) / सर्वश्रेष्ठा (the best) / न संशयः (no doubt)
shakti_gita::374.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::374.essence: The authorized practice among many worship methods is unquestionably the most powerful.
shakti_gita::374.simple_meaning: Among many types of worship and their seed mantras, one is clearly the best for those authorized to practice it.
shakti_gita::374.simple_insight: You can feel confident that your sincere practice has the greatest power.
shakti_gita::374.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that although many worship methods exist with various seed mantras, for those genuinely authorized and devoted, one particular practice stands out as supreme and without doubt.
shakti_gita::374.modern_relevance: When you explore different spiritual or personal routines, it's reassuring to trust the one that resonates and feels most authentic to you.
shakti_gita::374.insight: It encourages trusting the specific practice you have the right to follow rather than doubting multiple options.

shakti_gita::376.verse_sanskrit:
उत्पधन्ते यथा बीजदवृक्षाः पञ्चाङ्गसंयुताः।
सम्बन्धो बीजमन्त्राणा मन्त्रैज्ञेयस्तथाऽखिलैः ॥
shakti_gita::376.verse_hindi: जैसे बीज से पंचांग युक्त वृक्ष उत्पन्न होते हैं उसी प्रकार अन्य सब मन्त्रों के साथ बीजमन्त्रों का सम्बन्ध जानना उचित है
shakti_gita::376.english_translation: Just as trees with five parts arise from seeds, similarly, the relationship of seed mantras with all other mantras should be understood.
shakti_gita::376.translation_literal: उत्पधन्ते (arise) / यथा (just as) / बीजदवृक्षाः (seed-trees) / पञ्चाङ्गसंयुताः (with five parts) । सम्बंधो (relationship) / बीजमन्त्राणा (seed mantras) / मन्त्रैज्ञेयस्तथा (should be known with mantras) / अखिलैः (all) ॥
shakti_gita::376.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::376.essence: Every complex mantra arises from a fundamental seed that connects it to all others.
shakti_gita::376.simple_meaning: Mantras grow like trees from seed sounds. To understand all mantras, know how their seed mantras connect with others.
shakti_gita::376.simple_insight: Realizing the seed mantra’s role helps you see deeper layers beneath every chant.
shakti_gita::376.detailed_meaning: Devi explains how complex mantras relate to fundamental seed mantras, just as large trees grow from simple seeds with parts. This shows the importance of understanding the root sounds to grasp the whole mantra system.
shakti_gita::376.modern_relevance: When you learn a complex skill, breaking it down to its core basics helps you understand everything else more clearly.
shakti_gita::376.insight: It teaches you to look for the foundational element behind complex systems, making understanding simpler and more connected.

shakti_gita::377.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्ममन्त्रेषु सर्वेषु गायत्री प्रणवान्विता।
पूर्णा पञ्चभिरस्त्यङ्गैरतोऽसौ मुक्तिदायिनी ॥
shakti_gita::377.verse_hindi: सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्ममन्त्रों में प्रणवयुक्त गायत्रीमन्त्र पंचांगों से पूर्ण है इसी कारण यह मुक्तिदायिनी है
shakti_gita::377.english_translation: Among all Brahman mantras, the Gayatri mantra with the sacred syllable Om is complete with five parts, thus it grants liberation.
shakti_gita::377.translation_literal: ब्रह्ममन्त्रेषु (among Brahman mantras) / सर्वेषु (all) / गायत्री (Gayatri) / प्रणवान्विता (with the sacred syllable Om) / पूर्णा (complete) / पञ्चभिरस्त्यङ्गैर (with five parts) / तोऽसौ (that one) / मुक्तिदायिनी (liberation-giving)
shakti_gita::377.speaker: Devi
shakti_gita::377.essence: The complete fivefold Gayatri mantra with Om alone grants true liberation.
shakti_gita::377.simple_meaning: The Gayatri mantra, including Om and five parts, is complete and brings freedom from limitation.
shakti_gita::377.simple_insight: You can feel the completeness and power in this mantra that leads to freedom.
shakti_gita::377.detailed_meaning: Devi explains that among sacred mantras, the Gayatri is unique for its five parts and the presence of Om, making it fully complete and a source of liberation.
shakti_gita::377.modern_relevance: When you chant the full Gayatri with all its parts, you connect with a profound source of inner freedom.
shakti_gita::377.insight: Recognize that embracing the full practice, not a partial one, leads to deeper spiritual freedom.

shambhu_gita::1.verse_sanskrit:
हे गुरो ! वेदतत्त्वज्ञ ! कलिकल्मपनाशन ! ।
स्वयाऽऽध्यात्मस्य तत्त्वस्य ह्याधिदेवस्य च प्रभो ! ॥
shambhu_gita::1.verse_hindi: हे वेदतत्त्ववेत्ता ! है कलिकल्मषनाशन ! हे गुरो ! हे प्रभो ! आपने अध्यात्म तत्व और अधिदैव तत्त्व की
shambhu_gita::1.english_translation: O wise knower of the Vedas' essence! O destroyer of the dark age! O Guru! O Lord of the true nature of spirituality and the supreme divine!
shambhu_gita::1.translation_literal: हे (O) / गुरो (Guru) / वेदतत्त्वज्ञ (knower of Veda essence) / कलिकल्मपनाशन (destroyer of Kali’s impurity) / स्वयाऽऽध्यात्मस्य (self of spirituality) / तत्त्वस्य (of essence) / ह्याधिदेवस्य (indeed of supreme divine) / च (and) / प्रभो (Lord)
shambhu_gita::1.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::1.essence: Honoring the Guru as the embodiment of spiritual truth and remover of darkness.
shambhu_gita::1.simple_meaning: A respectful address to the Guru who knows the essence of the Vedas, destroys the darkness of this age, and embodies the true nature of spirituality and the supreme divine.
shambhu_gita::1.simple_insight: Respect for the guide who reveals deep spiritual truths offers a sense of trust and reverence.
shambhu_gita::1.detailed_meaning: This is a respectful invocation addressing the Guru as the knower of Vedic essence, the remover of the corruption of the Kali age, and the embodiment of spiritual truth and supreme divinity. It sets a tone of reverence before teaching.
shambhu_gita::1.insight: It highlights the importance of honoring those who reveal profound spiritual wisdom before embarking on a transformative journey.

shambhu_gita::2.verse_sanskrit:
नैकाः प्रकाशिका गीता ज्ञानरत्नैः प्रपूरिताः।
प्रकाशकानि वेदानामर्थस्य च वहृन्यलम् ॥
shambhu_gita::2.verse_hindi: प्रकाशक ज्ञानरत्नों से पूरित अनेक गीताएँ और वेदार्थ प्रकाशक
shambhu_gita::2.english_translation: Many songs filled with jewels of wisdom illuminate and carry the meaning of the Vedas.
shambhu_gita::2.translation_literal: नैकाः (many) प्रकाशिका (illuminating) गीता (songs) ज्ञानरत्नैः (with jewels of wisdom) प्रपूरिताः (filled) । । प्रकाशकानि (illuminating) वेदानाम् (of the Vedas) अर्थस्य (meaning) च (and) वहृन्यलम् (carrying) । ।
shambhu_gita::2.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::2.essence: Many wise songs illuminate and carry the Vedas' meaning.
shambhu_gita::2.simple_meaning: Many songs full of wisdom illuminate and carry the meaning of the Vedas.
shambhu_gita::2.simple_insight: Wisdom shines through many teachings, guiding us with ancient clarity.
shambhu_gita::2.detailed_meaning: Suta describes how many sacred songs, rich with valuable wisdom, reveal and carry the deep meanings of the Vedas, highlighting the enduring power of these teachings.
shambhu_gita::2.insight: Recognize that wisdom comes through many forms, each revealing deeper truths.

shambhu_gita::3.verse_sanskrit:
श्रावयित्वा पुराणानि कृतकृत्यः कृतोऽस्म्यहम ।
भवतैव पुरा प्रोक्तमेकदा माम्पनि स्वयम् ॥
shambhu_gita::3.verse_hindi: अनेक पुराणों को भली भांति सुनाकर मुझे कृतकृत्य किया है। आपने स्वयं ही मुझसे पहले एक बार कहा था
shambhu_gita::3.english_translation: Having listened well to many ancient texts, I feel deeply grateful. You yourself once spoke to me before.
shambhu_gita::3.translation_literal: श्रावयित्वा (having listened) पुराणानि (ancient texts) कृतकृत्यः (deeply grateful) कृतः अस्मि (I have become) । भवतैव (by you alone) पुरा (earlier) प्रोक्तम् (spoken) एकदा (once) माम् (to me) अपि (also) स्वयम् (yourself) ॥
shambhu_gita::3.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::3.essence: True gratitude arises when teachings come from a trusted, familiar source.
shambhu_gita::3.simple_meaning: I am deeply thankful after hearing many ancient stories. You once told me the same yourself.
shambhu_gita::3.simple_insight: Gratitude grows when teachings come from a trusted source with personal connection.
shambhu_gita::3.detailed_meaning: After hearing many ancient teachings, the speaker expresses heartfelt gratitude, recalling that the listener once shared these teachings personally before. This moment reflects respect and recognition of a trusted teacher-student relationship.
shambhu_gita::3.insight: Acknowledging past guidance strengthens trust and opens the mind to deeper learning.

shambhu_gita::4.verse_sanskrit:
आवागमनचक्रस्य गति यश्चावबुध्यते ।
मुक्तः स एव कैवल्यं पदं प्राप्तुमलं त्विति ॥
shambhu_gita::4.verse_hindi: जो आवागमनचक्र की गति को जान जाता है वही उससे मुक्त होकर कैवल्यपद का अधिकारी हो सकता है
shambhu_gita::4.english_translation: One who understands the cycle of coming and going is freed and attains the pure state of complete freedom.
shambhu_gita::4.translation_literal: आवागमनचक्रस्य (cycle of coming and going) गति (movement) यश्च (whoever) अवबुध्यते (understands) । मुक्तः (freed) स (that one) एव (indeed) कैवल्यं (complete freedom) पदं (state) प्राप्तुमलं (attain pure) त्विति (thus) ॥
shambhu_gita::4.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::4.essence: Knowing the cycle of coming and going reveals complete inner freedom beyond it.
shambhu_gita::4.simple_meaning: When you clearly perceive that life moves in endless cycles, you become free and can reach complete inner freedom.
shambhu_gita::4.simple_insight: There is peace in knowing the cycles do not trap your true self.
shambhu_gita::4.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that understanding the endless cycle of birth, death, and rebirth—coming and going—leads to true liberation called kaivalya, the pure state beyond all cycles.
shambhu_gita::4.modern_relevance: You notice how your thoughts and emotions repeat, yet you are not those patterns—they don't define or limit you.
shambhu_gita::4.insight: It shifts your mind from feeling trapped by repetitive patterns to recognizing your freedom beyond them.

shambhu_gita::5.verse_sanskrit:
अतो मां कृपया नाथ ! शाखमेवंविधं हितम् ।
निशामयस्व येनाहं ज्ञातुं शक्नोमि सत्वरम् ॥
shambhu_gita::5.verse_hindi: अतः हे नाथ ! कृपया मुझे ऐसा हितकर शास्त्र इस समय सुनाइए जिससे मैं अवश्य अधिकारी बन सकू
shambhu_gita::5.english_translation: Therefore, O Lord, please kindly reveal to me such beneficial teaching now by which I may quickly become capable of understanding.
shambhu_gita::5.translation_literal: अतः (therefore) / मां (me) / कृपया (kindly) / नाथ (O lord) / शाखम् (teaching/scripture) / एवम् (such) / विधम् (kind) / हितम् (beneficial) / निशामयस्व (reveal now) / येन (by which) / अहं (I) / ज्ञातुं (to know) / शक्नोमि (can) / सत्वरम् (quickly)
shambhu_gita::5.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::5.essence: Asking for clear, beneficial teaching opens the way to quick understanding.
shambhu_gita::5.simple_meaning: Please show me a helpful teaching now that I can quickly understand and benefit from.
shambhu_gita::5.simple_insight: Seeking clear and timely guidance helps you grow faster and with confidence.
shambhu_gita::5.detailed_meaning: Someone, likely a disciple, respectfully asks the teacher for an immediate, clear teaching that will quickly empower understanding and progress. The urgency shows a sincere readiness to learn.
shambhu_gita::5.modern_relevance: You’ve hit a wall and ask a mentor for clear advice that will finally make sense of your confusion.
shambhu_gita::5.insight: It shifts your attitude from confusion to openness, inviting precise guidance that helps you move forward.

shambhu_gita::6.verse_sanskrit:
आवागमनचक्रस्य रहस्यं साम्प्रतं गते: ।
अधिकुर्य्याञ्च मोक्षाख्यं यथा नूनं परम्पदम् ॥
shambhu_gita::6.verse_hindi: आवागमनचक्र की गति के रहस्य को  शीघ्र समझ सकूँ और जिससे मुकिरूप उत्तम पद का अवश्य अधिकारी बन सकू
shambhu_gita::6.english_translation: May I quickly understand the secret of the cycle of coming and going, and thereby certainly become worthy of the highest state called liberation.
shambhu_gita::6.translation_literal: आवागमनचक्रस्य (of the cycle of coming and going) / रहस्यं (the secret) / साम्प्रतं (now) / गते: (of the gone) / अधिकुर्य्याञ्च (may I understand more) / मोक्षाख्यं (called liberation) / यथा (so that) / नूनं (certainly) / परम्पदम् (the highest position)
shambhu_gita::6.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::6.essence: Longing to grasp the mystery that frees from repeated cycles.
shambhu_gita::6.simple_meaning: The speaker wishes to quickly understand the secret of the cycle of birth and death to gain the highest freedom.
shambhu_gita::6.simple_insight: There is a hopeful longing to grasp deep truths and attain ultimate freedom.
shambhu_gita::6.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the speaker expresses a sincere desire to comprehend the mystery of the cycle of life and rebirth, aiming to reach liberation from it. This sets a spiritual intention but does not teach a direct method yet.
shambhu_gita::6.modern_relevance: You may feel eager to understand patterns that keep repeating in your life, hoping for a breakthrough to lasting freedom.
shambhu_gita::6.insight: It encourages cultivating earnest longing and openness to profound understanding as the first step on a spiritual journey.

shambhu_gita::7.verse_sanskrit:
प्रियशिष्य ! प्रसन्नोऽहं तत्र ज्ञानपिपासया ।
जगत्कल्याणसम्पत्त्यै प्रवृत्या चानिशं परम् ॥
shambhu_gita::7.verse_hindi: हे प्रिय शिष्य ! मैं तुम्हारी ज्ञान पिपासा और अहर्निश जगत कल्याण वृद्धि की परम प्रवृत्ति से प्रसन्न हूँ
shambhu_gita::7.english_translation: Dear disciple, I am pleased by your thirst for wisdom and your constant commitment to the welfare of the world.
shambhu_gita::7.translation_literal: प्रियशिष्य (dear disciple) / प्रसन्नोऽहं (I am pleased) / तत्र (there) / ज्ञानपिपासया (with thirst for knowledge) / जगत्कल्याणसम्पत्त्यै (for the world's welfare) / प्रवृत्या (by commitment) / चानिशं (and continuously) / परम् (supreme)
shambhu_gita::7.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::7.essence: Joy arises when deep learning and world welfare unite in constant effort.
shambhu_gita::7.simple_meaning: The speaker expresses joy at the disciple's eagerness to learn and dedication to improving the world without pause.
shambhu_gita::7.simple_insight: Enthusiasm for learning combined with a desire to serve brings deep satisfaction.
shambhu_gita::7.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses his disciple, expressing happiness at the disciple's unending quest for knowledge and unwavering dedication to the welfare of all beings, setting a tone of encouragement for the teaching.
shambhu_gita::7.modern_relevance: You feel recognized when your eagerness to grow and help others is noticed and valued.
shambhu_gita::7.insight: It teaches you that sincere curiosity and selfless commitment are themselves sources of fulfillment.

shambhu_gita::8.verse_sanskrit:
अतस्तुभ्यमहं सूतोपनिषत्साररूपिणीम् ।
अपूर्वो महतीं गीतां श्रावयिप्ये महामते ! ॥
shambhu_gita::8.verse_hindi: अतः हे महामते सूते!. मैं तुमको उपनिषदों की साररूप एक अत्यन्त अपूर्व गीता सुनाऊंगा
shambhu_gita::8.english_translation: Therefore, O great-minded Suta, I will now recite to you a most extraordinary song that embodies the essence of the Upanishads.
shambhu_gita::8.translation_literal: अतः (therefore) तुभ्यम् (to you) अहं (I) सूत: (Suta) उपनिषत् (of the Upanishads) साररूपिणीम् (embodying the essence) अपूर्वः (extraordinary) महतीम् (great) गीताम् (song) श्रावयिपि (will recite) ए (now) महामते (O great-minded)!
shambhu_gita::8.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::8.essence: A unique, profound teaching will now be shared embodying the Upanishads' essence.
shambhu_gita::8.simple_meaning: I will now share a unique and important song that captures the core teachings of the Upanishads.
shambhu_gita::8.simple_insight: A great teaching is about to unfold, carrying deep wisdom from ancient sources.
shambhu_gita::8.detailed_meaning: At the start of the Shambhu Gita, Shiva addresses the bard Suta, preparing to reveal a profound teaching that summarizes the essence of the Upanishads in the form of a remarkable song.
shambhu_gita::8.insight: This moment marks the beginning of a deep teaching by framing it as a rare and essential truth.

shambhu_gita::9.verse_sanskrit:
यथा ज्ञानपिपासा ते शान्ता सामयिकी भवेत् ।
तापतप्तपिपासेव शीतलैगाङ्गिवारिभिः ॥
shambhu_gita::9.verse_hindi: जिससे तुम्हारी इस समय की ज्ञानपिपासा इस प्रकार तृप्त हो जायगी जिस प्रकार ताप से सन्तप्त प्राणी की पिपासा शीतल गंगाजल से तृप्त हो जाती है
shambhu_gita::9.english_translation: Just as a being burning from heat is quenched by cool Ganges water, your current thirst for knowledge will be satisfied.
shambhu_gita::9.translation_literal: यथा (just as) ज्ञानपिपासा (thirst for knowledge) ते (your) शान्ता (quenched) सामयिकी (current) भवेत् (will be) । तापतप्तपिपासेव (like thirst from heat) शीतलैगाङ्गिवारिभिः (by cool Ganges waters) ॥
shambhu_gita::9.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::9.essence: A burning thirst for knowledge will be naturally quenched by the right wisdom.
shambhu_gita::9.simple_meaning: Your current strong desire to understand will be satisfied just like a thirsty, overheated person quenches thirst with cool water.
shambhu_gita::9.simple_insight: There is relief in knowing your urgent search for understanding will find peace.
shambhu_gita::9.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva comforts the seeker whose mind burns with a deep desire for knowledge. Like a parched person cooled by the sacred Ganges, the seeker’s thirst for wisdom will soon be fulfilled.
shambhu_gita::9.modern_relevance: You’ve been restless, craving answers late into the night. Soon, clarity will come and ease that burning need.
shambhu_gita::9.insight: It teaches you to trust that intense yearning for understanding will naturally resolve with patience and openness.

shambhu_gita::10.verse_sanskrit:
पूर्वमेव मया प्रोक्तं तुभ्यं सूत ? महामनः !।
प्रधानसृष्टिरुपिण्या मर्त्यसप्टेर्नियामकः ॥
shambhu_gita::10.verse_hindi: हे महामना ! सृत ! मैंने तुमको  पहले ही कहा है कि प्रधान सृष्टि रूपी मनुष्य सृष्टि का नियामक
shambhu_gita::10.english_translation: O great-minded Suta, I have already told you that the primal creation is the regulator of the sevenfold human creation.
shambhu_gita::10.translation_literal: पूर्वमेव (already before) मया (by me) प्रोक्तं (spoken) तुभ्यं (to you) सूत (O Suta) महामनः (great-minded one) प्रधानसृष्टिरुपिण्या (primal creation form) मर्त्यसप्टेर्नियामकः (regulator of the seven mortal creations)
shambhu_gita::10.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::10.essence: A primal source governs the complex layers of mortal existence.
shambhu_gita::10.simple_meaning: The primal creation controls the sevenfold mortal creation, as previously explained to Suta.
shambhu_gita::10.simple_insight: Understanding the primal source helps clarify the order behind life's complexity.
shambhu_gita::10.detailed_meaning: Shiva reminds Suta that he has already explained how the primal creation governs the multiple aspects of mortal existence, establishing the cosmic order.
shambhu_gita::10.insight: Recognize that underlying complex systems is a fundamental source organizing them.

shambhu_gita::11.verse_sanskrit:
आस्ते वार्णाश्रमो धर्मो नात्र काचिद्विचारणा ।
वर्णाश्रमाणां धर्माणां साहाय्यात पितरोऽखिलाः ॥
shambhu_gita::11.verse_hindi: वर्णाश्रमधर्म है, इसमें कुछ विचारने की बात नहीं है । वर्णाश्रमधर्म की सहायता से
shambhu_gita::11.english_translation: The duty of the social orders and stages of life exists; there is no question about it. All ancestors have supported the duties of the social orders and stages of life.
shambhu_gita::11.translation_literal: आस्ते (exists) वार्णाश्रमो (social orders and life stages) धर्मो (duty) नात्र (not here) काचिद् (any) विचारणा (question) / वर्णाश्रमाणां (of social orders and stages) धर्माणां (duties) साहाय्यात् (by support) पितरः (ancestors) अखिलाः (all)
shambhu_gita::11.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::11.essence: The duties of social orders and life stages are established and supported by all ancestors.
shambhu_gita::11.simple_meaning: The duties assigned by social orders and life stages are established and unquestioned, supported by all ancestors.
shambhu_gita::11.simple_insight: There is a steady foundation in tradition that guides roles without doubt or debate.
shambhu_gita::11.detailed_meaning: This verse acknowledges that the structure of social orders (varna) and life stages (ashrama) forms a set of duties accepted without question, upheld by all ancestors, emphasizing continuity and respect for inherited social roles.
shambhu_gita::11.insight: It shows how inherited social frameworks can provide stability but also warns that unquestioned duties may not always suit individual growth.

shambhu_gita::12.verse_sanskrit:
गतेः क्रमोद्धर्व गामिन्याः मानवानां विधायकाः। 
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मस्य ह्रासे जाते कदाचन ॥
shambhu_gita::12.verse_hindi: मनुष्य की क्रमोद्धर्व गति के विधायक सब पितृगण हैं। किसी समय वर्णाश्रम धर्म में शिथिलता हो जाने से
shambhu_gita::12.english_translation: The ancestors are the makers of the upward progress of human beings. Sometimes, decline occurs in the duties of the caste and stage system.
shambhu_gita::12.translation_literal: गतेः (of progress) क्रमोद्धर्व (upward movement) गामिन्याः (of those going) मानवानां (of humans) विधायकाः (makers). वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मस्य (of the duties called caste and stage system) ह्रासे (decline) जाते (when happens) कदाचन (sometimes).
shambhu_gita::12.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::12.essence: Human progress flows from ancestors, yet social duties can decline over time.
shambhu_gita::12.simple_meaning: Ancestors guide the progress of humanity. Sometimes the traditional social duties weaken or decline.
shambhu_gita::12.simple_insight: Progress depends on the foundation laid by those before, but traditions can weaken over time.
shambhu_gita::12.detailed_meaning: The narrator explains that human progress is shaped by ancestors who set the foundations. However, sometimes the social system of caste and life stages loses its strength, causing decline.
shambhu_gita::12.insight: Recognize that the foundations set by previous generations influence progress, but systems can falter without upkeep.

shambhu_gita::13.verse_sanskrit:
पितृणां लोकसाधिन्यां व्यवस्थायामुपस्थिता ।
बाधना सर्वथा तात! लोकानां मुहृदस्तदा ॥
shambhu_gita::13.verse_hindi: पितरो की लोक हितकर व्यवस्था में सर्वथा बाधा हुई थी। हे तात ! उस समय सर्वलोकसुहृत्
shambhu_gita::13.english_translation: The ancestors' arrangement for the welfare of the world was completely obstructed. O father, at that time, the friend of all worlds was present.
shambhu_gita::13.translation_literal: पितृणां (of ancestors) लोकसाधिन्यां (for the welfare of worlds) व्यवस्थायामुपस्थिता (was present in arrangement) । बाधना (obstruction) सर्वथा (completely) तात (O father) ! लोकानां (of worlds) मुहृदस्तदा (friend at that time) ॥
shambhu_gita::13.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::13.essence: A vital world-supporting order was completely blocked at a critical time.
shambhu_gita::13.simple_meaning: The system set by the ancestors to support the world was fully blocked at that moment.
shambhu_gita::13.simple_insight: Sometimes, even long-standing support structures can be completely stopped.
shambhu_gita::13.detailed_meaning: Suta describes a moment when the ancestral order maintaining world welfare faced total obstruction. This sets a tense scene before the divine intervention or teaching begins.
shambhu_gita::13.insight: Recognize that even strong, established systems can face complete disruption, requiring new understanding.

shambhu_gita::14.verse_sanskrit:
देवर्पेनारदस्यैव सत्परामर्शतश्चिरम्।
तपस्तप्तं हि तैघोरं लोककल्याणकांक्षया ॥
shambhu_gita::14.verse_hindi: देवर्षि नारद जी के ही सत्परामर्श से पितरों ने बहुत दिनों तक लोगों के कल्याण की इच्छा से ही घोर तप किया था
shambhu_gita::14.english_translation: The ancestors performed severe austerities for a long time, inspired by the blessed advice of the sage Narada, desiring the welfare of the world.
shambhu_gita::14.translation_literal: देवर्पेण (by the divine sage) नारदस्यैव (of Narada alone) सत्परामर्शतः (blessed advice) चिरम् (for a long time) तपः (austerity) तप्तं (performed) हि (indeed) तैघोरं (severe) लोककल्याणकांक्षया (with desire for world welfare)
shambhu_gita::14.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::14.essence: Inspired advice can lead to enduring, intense effort for the world's welfare.
shambhu_gita::14.simple_meaning: The ancestors did intense austerities for a long time, motivated by sage Narada's good advice and a wish for the world's welfare.
shambhu_gita::14.simple_insight: True care for the world can inspire great dedication and effort over time.
shambhu_gita::14.detailed_meaning: Suta narrates how the ancestors, encouraged by the sage Narada's wise counsel, undertook severe austerities lasting a long time, driven by their deep wish to benefit all beings.
shambhu_gita::14.insight: It shows how sincere guidance and care can fuel sustained disciplined effort for the greater good.

shambhu_gita::15.verse_sanskrit:
प्रसन्नस्तपसा तेषां शम्भुः श्रीभगवान स्वयम ।
सगुणेनाऽथ रूपेण प्रादुर्भुयोपदिष्टवान् ॥
shambhu_gita::15.verse_hindi: अनन्तर उनके तप से प्रसन्न होकर श्रीभगवान् शम्भु ने उनके सम्मुख स्वयं सगुणरूप में आविभूत होकर जो उपदेश दिया था
shambhu_gita::15.english_translation: Pleased by their disciplined effort, the divine Shambhu himself appeared before them in a manifest form and gave teachings again.
shambhu_gita::15.translation_literal: प्रसन्नस्तपसा (pleased by effort) / तेषां (of them) / शम्भुः (Shambhu) / श्रीभगवान (the divine lord) / स्वयम (himself) / सगुणेनाऽथ (with qualities then) / रूपेण (in form) / प्रादुर्भुयोपदिष्टवान् (appeared and taught)
shambhu_gita::15.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::15.essence: Disciplined effort brings the divine presence to reveal teachings directly.
shambhu_gita::15.simple_meaning: After they showed disciplined effort, the divine Shambhu appeared before them in a visible form and gave teachings.
shambhu_gita::15.simple_insight: Sometimes, disciplined effort invites clear guidance from the divine presence.
shambhu_gita::15.detailed_meaning: The sages performed disciplined spiritual effort that pleased Shiva. In response, Shiva appeared in a visible, manifested form and imparted further teachings to them, continuing the instruction.
shambhu_gita::15.insight: It shows that consistent effort can invite clear guidance or breakthrough moments in your practice.

shambhu_gita::16.verse_sanskrit:
उपदेशं तमेवाद्य त्वामहं वच्मि शाम्भवम् ।
शम्भुगीताभिधानेन ते लोकेषु प्रचारय ॥
shambhu_gita::16.verse_hindi: उसी शाम्भव उपदेश को अभी तुमसे मैं कहता हूँ । तुम जगत में उसको शम्भुगीता, नाम से प्रचार करो
shambhu_gita::16.english_translation: I now speak to you the teaching of Shambhu; spread it in the world as the Shambhu Gita.
shambhu_gita::16.translation_literal: उपदेशं (teaching) तमेव (only that) आद्य (first) त्वाम् (to you) अहं (I) वच्मि (speak) शाम्भवम् (Shambhu) । शम्भुगीताभिधानेन (by the name Shambhu Gita) ते (you) लोकेषु (in the worlds) प्रचारय (spread) ॥
shambhu_gita::16.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::16.essence: The teaching called Shambhu Gita is now given and must be spread.
shambhu_gita::16.simple_meaning: This verse announces the start of the teaching called the Shambhu Gita and instructs to spread it.
shambhu_gita::16.simple_insight: A new teaching is introduced, inviting sharing and transmission.
shambhu_gita::16.detailed_meaning: The narrator Suta addresses the audience, introducing the sacred teaching called Shambhu Gita and calling for its dissemination among people.
shambhu_gita::16.insight: Recognize when important knowledge is beginning and feel invited to share it widely.

shambhu_gita::17.verse_sanskrit:
अस्ति दैवासुरी सृष्टिर्लोकानां सुहृदेकतः।
चर्तुधा भूतसङ्घानां प्राकृती सृष्टिरन्यतः ॥
shambhu_gita::17.verse_hindi: हे लोकसुहृत् ! एक ओर देवासुर-सृष्टि और दूसरी ओर चतुर्विध भूतसंघ की प्राकृत सृष्टि है
shambhu_gita::17.english_translation: O friend of the world, there is on one side the divine and asura creation, and on the other side the natural creation of the fourfold beings.
shambhu_gita::17.translation_literal: अस्ति (there is) दैवासुरी (divine and asura) सृष्टिः (creation) लोकानां (of worlds) सुहृदेकतः (friend alone) । चर्तुधा (fourfold) भूतसङ्घानां (of beings' groups) प्राकृती (natural) सृष्टिः (creation) अन्यतः (on the other side) ॥
shambhu_gita::17.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::17.essence: Existence includes two distinct creations: one divine and one natural fourfold.
shambhu_gita::17.simple_meaning: There are two main creations: one of divine and shadow beings, the other natural, made up of four types of beings.
shambhu_gita::17.simple_insight: Understanding that existence has both divine and natural realms opens perspective beyond what meets the eye.
shambhu_gita::17.detailed_meaning: The bard Suta explains to the sages that the cosmos consists of two main types of creation: one born from divine and asura forces, and the other the natural world formed of four groups of beings. This framing sets the stage for deeper teachings.
shambhu_gita::17.insight: It encourages seeing the world as composed of both spiritual and material dimensions influencing life.

shambhu_gita::18.verse_sanskrit:
स्वाधीना चैतयोर्मध्ये सृष्टिः पूर्णाङ्गसंयुता ।
कर्माधिकारिणी याऽऽस्ते सृष्टिः सैवास्ति मानवी ॥
shambhu_gita::18.verse_hindi: और इन दोनों के बीच में पूर्णा वयच और कर्म की अधिकारिणी जो स्वाधीन सृष्टि है वही मनुष्य सृष्टि है
shambhu_gita::18.english_translation: Among the two, the complete and independent creation that holds the authority of action is the human creation itself.
shambhu_gita::18.translation_literal: स्वाधीना (independent) / चैतयोर्मध्ये (between the two) / सृष्टिः (creation) / पूर्णाङ्गसंयुता (complete and whole) / कर्माधिकारिणी (holder of action's authority) / याऽऽस्ते (which is) / सृष्टिः (creation) / सैवास्ति (indeed is) / मानवी (human)
shambhu_gita::18.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::18.essence: Humans are the complete creation empowered with independent authority to act.
shambhu_gita::18.simple_meaning: Humans are the complete, independent creation that has the right and power to perform actions.
shambhu_gita::18.simple_insight: You carry the freedom and responsibility to act fully in your life.
shambhu_gita::18.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that among all creations, humans uniquely possess full independence and authority to act. This moment sets the stage for understanding human responsibility and freedom in the natural world.
