shambhu_gita::122.english_translation: If you all act with a pure heart devoted to the divine, you will certainly attain the full rights of eternal dharma.
shambhu_gita::122.translation_literal: कुर्युश्चेत् (if you do) कर्मा (actions) मचित्ता (with devoted mind) भावशुद्धिपुरस्सरम् (with pure feelings and devotion) । अधिकुर्युस्तदावश्यं (certainly do that) पूर्ण (complete) धर्म (duty) सनातनम् (eternal) ॥
shambhu_gita::122.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::122.essence: Pure, devoted action leads to complete fulfillment of eternal duty.
shambhu_gita::122.simple_meaning: When you act with a sincere and devoted heart, you fulfill your true, eternal purpose completely.
shambhu_gita::122.simple_insight: You feel empowered knowing pure devotion brings complete fulfillment of your true duty.
shambhu_gita::122.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that when actions come from a place of heartfelt devotion and clarity, they align perfectly with eternal dharma. This guidance comes before a larger discourse on how inner purity empowers action.
shambhu_gita::122.modern_relevance: You take on a task fully committed and sincere, knowing your genuine effort aligns with your deeper purpose.
shambhu_gita::122.insight: It shifts your approach from mechanical doing to sincere, heartfelt action, aligning you with your greater purpose.

shambhu_gita::123.verse_sanskrit:
मन्त्राणां प्रणवः सेतुर्यथा मन्त्रच्युति किल ।
अपनोद्याशु सम्पूर्णो दत्ते मन्त्राधिकारिताम्॥
shambhu_gita::123.verse_hindi: जिस प्रकार प्रणव मन्त्रों का सेतु है, वह मन्त्रों में कोई त्रुटि रहने से उस को शीघ्र ही दूर करके मन्त्र का पूर्णाधिकार प्रदान करता है
shambhu_gita::123.english_translation: Just as the sacred syllable connects mantras, it quickly removes any flaw and grants full mastery over the mantra.
shambhu_gita::123.translation_literal: मन्त्राणां (of mantras) प्रणवः (the sacred syllable) सेतुर्यथा (like a bridge) मन्त्रच्युति (mantra flaw) किल (indeed) । अपनोद्याशु (quickly removing) सम्पूर्णो (complete) दत्ते (gives) मन्त्राधिकारिताम् (authority over mantra) ॥
shambhu_gita::123.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::123.essence: The sacred sound bridges and quickly corrects flaws, granting full mastery.
shambhu_gita::123.simple_meaning: The sacred syllable works like a bridge for mantras, quickly fixing any mistake and giving full control over the mantra.
shambhu_gita::123.simple_insight: You can trust the core essence to fix what feels incomplete or flawed.
shambhu_gita::123.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains how the sacred sound (pranava) acts like a bridge among mantras, swiftly correcting any errors to ensure mastery. This teaches how the essence behind spiritual practice supports and perfects your efforts.
shambhu_gita::123.modern_relevance: When you feel your efforts or intentions fall short, remember the core essence can swiftly restore and complete them.
shambhu_gita::123.insight: It shifts your view from fearing mistakes to trusting the essential power that corrects and completes.

shambhu_gita::124.verse_sanskrit:
तथैव भावसंशुद्ध्या शक्तिधर्मास्य धारिका ।
सन्तिष्ठते सदाऽक्षुण्णा नितरामूर्दध्वगामिनी ॥
shambhu_gita::124.verse_hindi: उसी प्रकार भावशुद्धि द्वारा सदा धर्म की उद्धर्व गामिनी धारिका शक्ति सम्पूर्ण रूप से अक्षुण्ण बनी रहती है
shambhu_gita::124.english_translation: Similarly, by the purity of inner state, the sustaining power of dharma remains ever whole and unbroken.
shambhu_gita::124.translation_literal: तथैव (similarly) भावसंशुद्ध्या (by purity of inner state) शक्तिधर्मास्य (power of dharma) धारिका (that which sustains) सन्तिष्ठते (remains) सदाऽक्षुण्णा (always unbroken) नितरामूर्दध्वगामिनी (ever forward-moving)
shambhu_gita::124.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::124.essence: Pure inner feelings keep your power to fulfill dharma whole and alive.
shambhu_gita::124.simple_meaning: When your feelings and inner state are pure, your power to uphold your true purpose remains steady and unbroken.
shambhu_gita::124.simple_insight: You feel steady and capable when your inner state is clear and pure.
shambhu_gita::124.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that by keeping your inner feelings pure and free from confusion, the power that supports your dharma stays whole and constantly active, enabling you to act with integrity and strength.
shambhu_gita::124.modern_relevance: Before a challenging conversation, your calm and clear feelings keep your resolve strong and steady throughout.
shambhu_gita::124.insight: It teaches you to maintain purity in your emotions to sustain unwavering strength in your actions.

shambhu_gita::125.verse_sanskrit:
कदाचिदत एवाऽलमापद्धर्मस्य निर्णये।
अधर्मेणापि धर्मस्य स्वरूपे परिणम्यते ॥
shambhu_gita::125.verse_hindi: इसी कारण आपद्धर्म के निर्णय करने में कभी कभी अधर्म भी धर्मरूप में ही परिणत हो जाता है
shambhu_gita::125.english_translation: Sometimes, in deciding an emergency duty, what seems wrong transforms into the true nature of right action.
shambhu_gita::125.translation_literal: कदाचिदत (sometimes) एवा (indeed) अलमापद्धर्मस्य (of emergency duty) निर्णये (in the decision) / अधर्मेणापि (even by wrong action) धर्मस्य (of right action) स्वरूपे (in the form) परिणम्यते (transforms).
shambhu_gita::125.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::125.essence: In emergencies, apparent wrongs can embody the true nature of right action.
shambhu_gita::125.simple_meaning: In urgent or emergency situations, actions that normally seem wrong may become the right thing to do.
shambhu_gita::125.simple_insight: You can feel relief knowing that difficult choices can still align with your true purpose.
shambhu_gita::125.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that when faced with sudden emergencies requiring immediate decisions, what usually appears as wrong can actually be the true form of right action, showing the complexity of dharma in crisis.
shambhu_gita::125.modern_relevance: When you face a sudden crisis and must choose quickly, what feels like breaking rules may actually fulfill your deeper responsibilities.
shambhu_gita::125.insight: It teaches you to recognize that moral decisions depend on context, and sometimes unconventional actions serve your true duty.

shambhu_gita::126.verse_sanskrit:
यदा कश्चिद्विशेषस्तु धर्मः शक्तिमवाप्नुयात् ।
अधिकां भावसंशुद्धया कोटिं साधारणस्य सः ॥
shambhu_gita::126.verse_hindi: और जब कोई विशेष धर्म भावशुद्धि के द्वारा अधिक शक्ति लाभ करे तब वह साधारण धर्म की कोटि में पहुंचकर
shambhu_gita::126.english_translation: When someone attains greater power through the purity of their devotion to a particular dharma, they reach a level beyond ordinary dharma.
shambhu_gita::126.translation_literal: यदा (when) कश्चित् (someone) विशेषः (special) तु (but) धर्मः (dharma) शक्ति (power) मवाप्नुयात् (attains) । अधिकां (greater) भावसंशुद्धया (through purity of feeling) कोटिं (a level) साधारणस्य (ordinary) सः (he) ॥
shambhu_gita::126.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::126.essence: Pure, heartfelt commitment to your purpose empowers you beyond ordinary action.
shambhu_gita::126.simple_meaning: When your devotion to your duty becomes pure and sincere, you gain greater power than usual.
shambhu_gita::126.simple_insight: You feel empowered when your commitment is pure and heartfelt.
shambhu_gita::126.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva explains that when someone embraces their dharma with deep purity and sincerity, they gain a special strength that surpasses common practice. This shows how inner clarity and devotion elevate your action.
shambhu_gita::126.modern_relevance: You notice how your work shines and feels stronger when your motivation is clear and truly aligned with your values.
shambhu_gita::126.insight: It teaches you to deepen your commitment with sincerity to unlock greater inner strength and impact.

shambhu_gita::127.verse_sanskrit:
असाधारणधर्मास्याधिकारं लभते वहन् ।
एतावन्ननु दुर्गेयं रहस्यं धर्मगोचरम् ॥
shambhu_gita::127.verse_hindi: असाधारण धर्म के अधिकार को प्राप्त करता है। धर्म का रहस्य इतना दुर्ज्ञेय है कि
shambhu_gita::127.english_translation: Only the extraordinary one attains the right to extraordinary dharma; its secret is so difficult to grasp.
shambhu_gita::127.translation_literal: असाधारणधर्मास्य (extraordinary dharma's) / अधिकारं (right) / लभते (attains) / वहन् (one who carries) / एतावन्ननु (so much indeed) / दुर्गेयं (difficult to penetrate) / रहस्यं (secret) / धर्मगोचरम् (subject of dharma)
shambhu_gita::127.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::127.essence: Only the exceptional can truly claim the highest dharma and its hidden depth.
shambhu_gita::127.simple_meaning: Extraordinary duties and truths are accessible only to those with exceptional qualities.
shambhu_gita::127.simple_insight: Feeling specialness in your responsibility can inspire deeper commitment.
shambhu_gita::127.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the highest dharma is not common or easy; only those who carry exceptional qualities can understand and live it, highlighting the challenge of embracing profound spiritual responsibility.
shambhu_gita::127.modern_relevance: When a complex challenge arises, you sense it’s meant for those ready to rise beyond ordinary effort.
shambhu_gita::127.insight: It shifts your view to see some responsibilities require rare strength and dedication.

shambhu_gita::128.verse_sanskrit:
आस्ते पितृव्रजाः ! कोऽपि यन्न शक्नोति वेदितुम् ।
धर्माधर्मौ सुनिर्णेतुं नैव कश्चिदयथार्थतः ॥
shambhu_gita::128.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! जिसको कोई भी नहीं जान सकता। कोई भी यथार्थ रूप से धर्म अधर्म का निर्णय नहीं कर सकता
shambhu_gita::128.english_translation: O ancestors! No one can truly know or judge what is right and wrong.
shambhu_gita::128.translation_literal: आस्ते (O) / पितृव्रजाः (ancestors) / कोऽपि (anyone) / यन्न (what) / शक्नोति (is able) / वेदितुम् (to know) / धर्माधर्मौ (right and wrong) / सुनिर्णेतुं (to decide well) / नैव (not at all) / कश्चिदयथार्थतः (anyone truly)
shambhu_gita::128.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::128.essence: No one can truly and perfectly judge what is right or wrong.
shambhu_gita::128.simple_meaning: No one can fully understand or rightly decide what is truly right or wrong.
shambhu_gita::128.simple_insight: There is humility in accepting that clear judgment about right and wrong is beyond us.
shambhu_gita::128.detailed_meaning: The narrator addresses the ancestors, stating that no being can perfectly discern true righteousness or wrongness. This highlights human limitation in moral certainty.
shambhu_gita::128.modern_relevance: When faced with complex moral dilemmas, you might realize that clear-cut answers often elude you, inviting careful reflection.
shambhu_gita::128.insight: It encourages acceptance of uncertainty in moral judgments and restraint from absolute conclusions.

shambhu_gita::129.verse_sanskrit:
समीष्टे वा गति वेत्तुं धर्मस्यास्य कथञ्चन ।
ऋते पूर्णावतारं हि भक्तान वा ज्ञानिनो बिना ॥
shambhu_gita::129.verse_hindi: मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त और मेरे पूर्णावतारो के अतिरिक्त न किसी प्रकार धर्म की गति को जानने वाला ही हो सका है
shambhu_gita::129.english_translation: No one except my wise devotees and my complete incarnations can truly know the course of dharma.
shambhu_gita::129.translation_literal: समीष्टे (wise) / वा (or) / गति (course) / वेत्तुं (to know) / धर्मस्यास्य (of this dharma) / कथञ्चन (in any way) / ऋते (except) / पूर्णावतारं (complete incarnations) / हि (indeed) / भक्तान (devotees) / वा (or) / ज्ञानिनो (wise ones) / बिना (without)
shambhu_gita::129.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::129.essence: Only the devoted and fully realized can truly understand dharma’s course.
shambhu_gita::129.simple_meaning: Only my wise followers and full incarnations truly understand how dharma unfolds; others do not.
shambhu_gita::129.simple_insight: Understanding the true course of dharma is rare and reserved for the devoted and enlightened.
shambhu_gita::129.detailed_meaning: Shiva states that the true understanding of dharma’s course is known only by his wise devotees and his complete incarnations, implying that such knowledge is not accessible to ordinary beings.
shambhu_gita::129.insight: It teaches that deep understanding of one’s true purpose requires insight beyond ordinary knowledge, gained through devotion or embodiment.

shambhu_gita::130.verse_sanskrit:
याथार्थ्यान्निर्णय कर्त्तु धर्माधर्मव्यवस्थितेः ।
अतो वेदाः प्रमाणानि तन्मता आगमास्तथा ॥
shambhu_gita::130.verse_hindi: इसी कारण धर्म अधर्म की व्यवस्था के यथार्थ निर्णय करने में वेद और वेदसम्मत शास्त्र ही प्रमाण हैं
shambhu_gita::130.english_translation: Therefore, the Vedas and scriptures accepted by the Vedas are the authority for making true judgments about what is dharma and adharma.
shambhu_gita::130.translation_literal: याथार्थ्यान्निर्णय (true/real judgment) / कर्त्तु (to do) / धर्माधर्मव्यवस्थितेः (in the arrangement of dharma and adharma) / अतो (therefore) / वेदाः (the Vedas) / प्रमाणानि (authorities) / तन्मता (according to the opinion) / आगमास्तथा (and the scriptures)
shambhu_gita::130.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::130.essence: Real judgments about right and wrong come from trusted ancient teachings.
shambhu_gita::130.simple_meaning: True decisions about what is right or wrong should be based on the Vedas and scriptures accepted by them.
shambhu_gita::130.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing trusted teachings guide your moral choices.
shambhu_gita::130.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that when faced with complex decisions about what is right (dharma) or wrong (adharma), one should rely on the Vedas and the scriptures that align with them as the definitive authorities.
shambhu_gita::130.modern_relevance: When you face tough ethical choices, turning to reliable, time-tested principles can help you decide with confidence.
shambhu_gita::130.insight: It teaches you to trust established and respected sources as your foundation for moral decisions.

shambhu_gita::131.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वे विशेषधर्मा स्युः प्रायशोऽभ्युदयप्रदाः।
तथा साधारणो धमों निःश्रेयसकरोऽखिलः ॥
shambhu_gita::131.verse_hindi: साधारणतः सभी विशेषधर्म अभ्युदयप्रद और सभी साधारण धर्म निःश्रेयसप्रद हैं
shambhu_gita::131.english_translation: Generally, all special duties lead to prosperity, and all universal duties lead to ultimate well-being.
shambhu_gita::131.translation_literal: सर्वे (all) विशेषधर्मा (special duties) स्युः (are) प्रायशः (generally) अभ्युदयप्रदाः (prosperity-giving) तथा (and) साधारणो (universal) धमों (duties) निःश्रेयसकरः (ultimate well-being producing) अखिलः (all)
shambhu_gita::131.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::131.essence: Special duties bring success; universal duties lead to lasting well-being.
shambhu_gita::131.simple_meaning: Some duties bring material success, but universal duties lead to true and lasting well-being.
shambhu_gita::131.simple_insight: There’s a deeper value in following broader, universal duties beyond immediate gains.
shambhu_gita::131.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that particular duties tied to roles or situations often bring worldly success, but following universal duties rooted in what is truly beneficial brings ultimate well-being beyond material gains.
shambhu_gita::131.modern_relevance: You might chase tasks that bring quick rewards, but focusing on what benefits everyone creates deeper, lasting fulfillment.
shambhu_gita::131.insight: It shifts focus from short-term achievements to embracing duties that support long-term true welfare for all.

shambhu_gita::132.verse_sanskrit:
किन्तु साधारणो धर्मों दुर्गेयोऽज्ञानिभिः सदा ।
आस्ते विशेषधर्मस्तु सर्वथा भीतिवर्जित: ॥
shambhu_gita::132.verse_hindi: परन्तु अज्ञानियों के निकट साधारण धर्म सदा दुर्ज्ञेय है और विशेष धर्म सर्वथा भयरहित है
shambhu_gita::132.english_translation: For those lost in ignorance, ordinary duties are always hard to follow; special duties are completely free of fear.
shambhu_gita::132.translation_literal: किन्तु (but) साधारणो (ordinary) धर्मों (duties) दुर्गेयोऽज्ञानिभिः (difficult for the ignorant) सदा (always) । आस्ते (exists) विशेषधर्मस्तु (special duty) सर्वथा (completely) भीतिवर्जित: (free from fear) ॥
shambhu_gita::132.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::132.essence: Confusion makes normal duties feel impossible; clear purpose removes fear from special duties.
shambhu_gita::132.simple_meaning: When someone is confused and unaware, regular duties feel very hard to do, but special duties are fearless and clear.
shambhu_gita::132.simple_insight: You can feel stuck by ordinary tasks when your mind is confused, but deeper purpose frees you from fear.
shambhu_gita::132.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that for people trapped in ignorance, everyday duties seem overwhelming and difficult to perform. However, special, higher duties—rooted in clarity and courage—are carried out without fear or hesitation.
shambhu_gita::132.modern_relevance: You face daily tasks that seem impossible when you're overwhelmed or confused, but stepping into clear purpose removes that fear.
shambhu_gita::132.insight: Recognize when ordinary duties feel heavy because of confusion, and shift focus toward fearless, purposeful action.

shambhu_gita::133.verse_sanskrit:
धर्मात्मा वै यदा धर्मे विशेषं पालयन मुहुः।
नूनमस्य पराकाष्ठां धर्मस्य लभते हिताम् ॥
shambhu_gita::133.verse_hindi: विशेष धर्म का पालन करते करते जब धर्मात्मा विशेष धर्म की हितकारी पराकाष्ठा को अवश्य प्राप्त कर लेता है
shambhu_gita::133.english_translation: When a person devoted to dharma repeatedly practices a special righteous duty, they surely attain the highest benefit of that dharma.
shambhu_gita::133.translation_literal: धर्मात्मा (person devoted to dharma) / वै (indeed) / यदा (when) / धर्मे (in dharma) / विशेषं (special) / पालयन (practicing) / मुहुः (repeatedly) / नूनम् (certainly) / अस्य (of this) / पराकाष्ठां (highest degree) / धर्मस्य (of dharma) / लभते (attains) / हिताम् (benefit).
shambhu_gita::133.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::133.essence: Steadily practicing your special duty leads to its highest benefit.
shambhu_gita::133.simple_meaning: By repeatedly performing your specific righteous duty with dedication, you achieve its highest benefit.
shambhu_gita::133.simple_insight: Consistency in your true duty brings deep fulfillment and lasting reward.
shambhu_gita::133.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that when someone committed to dharma keeps practicing their particular righteous role repeatedly and carefully, they reach the fullest good that role can offer, emphasizing steady dedication.
shambhu_gita::133.modern_relevance: You keep showing up for what matters most to you, and gradually, the full value of your efforts becomes clear and rewarding.
shambhu_gita::133.insight: It teaches you to honor your specific responsibilities consistently to unlock their greatest benefits over time.

shambhu_gita::134.verse_sanskrit:
साधारणस्य धर्मस्य निखिलव्यापकं तदा ।
स्वरूपं ज्ञातुमीप्टेऽसौ सर्वजीवहितमदम् ॥
shambhu_gita::134.verse_hindi: तब वह साधारण धर्म के सर्वव्यापक और सर्वजीव हितकारी स्वरूप को समझने में समर्थ होता है
shambhu_gita::134.english_translation: Then one becomes able to understand the universal and all-living beneficial nature of ordinary dharma.
shambhu_gita::134.translation_literal: साधारणस्य (ordinary's) धर्मस्य (dharma's) निखिलव्यापकं (all-pervading) तदा (then) । स्वरूपं (nature) ज्ञातुम् (to know) ईप्टेऽसौ (this one) सर्वजीवहितमदम् (all beings-beneficial) ॥
shambhu_gita::134.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::134.essence: Ordinary dharma is universally beneficial to all living beings.
shambhu_gita::134.simple_meaning: You come to see that ordinary dharma is all-encompassing and benefits every living being.
shambhu_gita::134.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing your everyday duties serve the welfare of all life.
shambhu_gita::134.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that understanding ordinary dharma is more than personal duty; it is a universal principle that sustains and benefits all living beings, revealing the deeper meaning behind common ethical conduct.
shambhu_gita::134.modern_relevance: You hesitate before a small task, doubting its worth, then realize even simple acts contribute to the well-being of everyone.
shambhu_gita::134.insight: This shifts your view from seeing duty as small or isolated to seeing it as a universal force benefiting all life.

shambhu_gita::135.verse_sanskrit:
तदन्तिके तदा सर्वे धर्ममार्गा भजन्सहो ।
वात्सल्यं हि यथा पुत्राः पौत्राश्च सन्निधौ पितुः॥
shambhu_gita::135.verse_hindi: अहो ! तब उसके निकट सब धर्ममार्ग ऐसे ही वात्सल्य को प्राप्त होते हैं जैसे पिता के सम्मुख उसके पुत्र पौत्र वात्सल्य को प्राप्त हुआ करते हैं।
shambhu_gita::135.english_translation: At that moment, all paths of dharma come together like the affection children and grandchildren show before their father.
shambhu_gita::135.translation_literal: तदन्तिके (at that moment) तदा (then) सर्वे (all) धर्ममार्गा (paths of dharma) भजन्सहो (together/assembled) । वात्सल्यं (affection) हि (indeed) यथा (like) पुत्राः (children) पौत्राश्च (and grandchildren) सन्निधौ (in presence of) पितुः (father) ॥
shambhu_gita::135.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::135.essence: True purpose arises naturally where warm affection is present and unites all duties.
shambhu_gita::135.simple_meaning: All paths of true purpose unite naturally when surrounded by loving care like a family's affection for their father.
shambhu_gita::135.simple_insight: You can feel how love naturally brings your purpose and duties together in harmony.
shambhu_gita::135.detailed_meaning: Suta describes a moment when all ways of living rightly come together as naturally as family affection gathers around a father. This shows that devotion and duty are deeply linked through caring relationships.
shambhu_gita::135.modern_relevance: When your loved ones gather around you, you sense how your responsibilities and values come together naturally.
shambhu_gita::135.insight: It shifts your view from isolated duties to seeing them as expressions of love and connection.

shambhu_gita::136.verse_sanskrit:
ममैव ज्ञानिनो भक्ता धर्मे साधारणं किल।
अधिकुर्त्तं क्षमन्ते वै पूर्णतो नात्र संशयः ॥
shambhu_gita::136.verse_hindi: मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त ही साधारण धर्म के पूर्ण अधिकारी निश्चय ही हो सकते हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
shambhu_gita::136.english_translation: Only my wise devotees are truly qualified to fully uphold ordinary dharma; there is no doubt about this.
shambhu_gita::136.translation_literal: ममैव (only my) / ज्ञानिनो (wise) / भक्ता (devotees) / धर्मे (in dharma) / साधारणं (ordinary) / किल (indeed) / अधिकुर्त्तं (fully qualified) / क्षमन्ते (are able) / वै (indeed) / पूर्णतो (completely) / नात्र (there is no) / संशयः (doubt)
shambhu_gita::136.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::136.essence: Only the wise and devoted are fully capable of living ordinary dharma without doubt.
shambhu_gita::136.simple_meaning: Only those who combine wisdom and devoted love to the divine can completely fulfill ordinary righteous duties without doubt.
shambhu_gita::136.simple_insight: You can trust your inner wisdom and devotion to guide your true actions confidently.
shambhu_gita::136.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that ordinary dharma—the everyday righteous conduct—is fully accessible only to those who are both wise and devoted to him, removing any doubt about their qualification.
shambhu_gita::136.modern_relevance: When you feel unsure about your everyday responsibilities, remember that deep understanding combined with heartfelt devotion makes you fully capable.
shambhu_gita::136.insight: Recognize that true wisdom paired with sincere devotion empowers you to act with full confidence in your duties.

shambhu_gita::137.verse_sanskrit:
मद्गता ज्ञानिनो विज्ञाः ! धर्मज्ञानाब्धिपारगाः।
सार्द्ध केनापि धर्मेण विरोध नैव कुर्वते ॥
shambhu_gita::137.verse_hindi: हे विज्ञों! मेरे धर्मज्ञान रूप समुद्र के पारगामी ज्ञानी भक्त किसी भी धर्म के साथ विरोध नहीं करते हैं
shambhu_gita::137.english_translation: Those who have reached me, the wise who have crossed the ocean of dharma knowledge, do not oppose any dharma.
shambhu_gita::137.translation_literal: मद्गता (reached me) / ज्ञानिनो (of the wise) / विज्ञाः (experts) / धर्मज्ञानाब्धिपारगाः (those who crossed the ocean of dharma knowledge) / सार्ध्द (with any) / केनापि (any) / धर्मेण (dharma) / विरोध (opposition) / नैव (not) / कुर्वते (do)
shambhu_gita::137.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::137.essence: True wisdom rooted in the divine accepts all dharmas without opposition.
shambhu_gita::137.simple_meaning: Those who have fully realized the divine and crossed the vast knowledge of dharma do not oppose any righteous way.
shambhu_gita::137.simple_insight: You can feel peace knowing true wisdom accepts all sincere paths without conflict.
shambhu_gita::137.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the wise who have reached deep understanding of dharma, saying that such devotees transcend all divisions and never oppose any dharma, showing harmony among sincere spiritual paths.
shambhu_gita::137.modern_relevance: You see people with different beliefs around you, yet true understanding helps you honor all paths without judgment or conflict.
shambhu_gita::137.insight: It shifts your mind from defending one path to embracing respectful acceptance of all sincere dharmas.

shambhu_gita::138.verse_sanskrit:
साधारणे विशेषे च धर्मेऽसाधारणे तथा ।
सम्प्रदायेषु सर्वेषु भक्ता ज्ञानिन एव मे ॥
shambhu_gita::138.verse_hindi: हे पितरो! मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त ही विशेष धर्म, साधारण धर्म और असाधारण धर्म तथा समस्त धर्मसंप्रदायों में
shambhu_gita::138.english_translation: O ancestors! My devoted wise ones alone are the special, common, and extraordinary dharma in all traditions.
shambhu_gita::138.translation_literal: साधारणे (common) विशेषे (special) च (and) धर्मेऽसाधारणे (extraordinary dharma) तथा (also) सम्प्रदायेषु (in traditions) सर्वेषु (all) भक्ता (devoted) ज्ञानिन (wise) एव (alone) मे (my)
shambhu_gita::138.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::138.essence: Devoted wisdom alone is the true dharma across all spiritual traditions.
shambhu_gita::138.simple_meaning: Devoted wise ones embody the true essence across all kinds of dharma and traditions.
shambhu_gita::138.simple_insight: You hold the special power to unite diverse spiritual paths through your devotion and wisdom.
shambhu_gita::138.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, declaring that those who combine devotion and wisdom uniquely represent all forms of dharma—common, special, and extraordinary—across every tradition, highlighting the unity within diversity.
shambhu_gita::138.modern_relevance: You meet people from different beliefs and practices, yet your sincere devotion and insight connect you deeply beyond labels and differences.
shambhu_gita::138.insight: Recognize that devotion combined with wisdom is the core that transcends all external forms and traditions.

shambhu_gita::139.verse_sanskrit:
ममैवेच्छास्त्ररूपिण्या धर्मशक्तेः स्वधाभुजः!।
सर्वव्यापकमद्वैतं रूपं नन्वीक्षितुं क्षमाः ॥
shambhu_gita::139.verse_hindi: मेरी ही इच्छारूपिणी धर्मशक्ति का एक सर्वव्यापक अद्वैतरूप दर्शन करने में समर्थ होकर
shambhu_gita::139.english_translation: I alone, as the will-shaped power of dharma, pervade all and embody non-duality; none can fully perceive my form.
shambhu_gita::139.translation_literal: ममैव (I alone) इच्छास्त्ररूपिण्या (will-shaped) धर्मशक्तेः (of the power of dharma) स्वधाभुजः (possessing own arms) सर्वव्यापक (all-pervading) अद्वैतं (non-dual) रूपं (form) नन्वीक्षितुं (to fully perceive) क्षमाः (able)
shambhu_gita::139.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::139.essence: The all-pervading will of dharma cannot be fully seen or understood by anyone.
shambhu_gita::139.simple_meaning: The divine power of dharma, shaped by will, pervades everything in a non-dual way, and no one can fully see its true form.
shambhu_gita::139.simple_insight: You carry within you a vast presence that cannot be completely understood or limited by appearances.
shambhu_gita::139.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares that he alone embodies the will-shaped power of dharma, which is everywhere and non-dual. This presence is beyond full human perception, indicating the supreme reality's infinite depth.
shambhu_gita::139.modern_relevance: Sometimes you sense a greater force guiding your life that feels beyond your understanding or control, yet it shapes everything around you.
shambhu_gita::139.insight: Recognize that the true essence behind your actions and life is vast and cannot be fully grasped by the mind.

shambhu_gita::140.verse_sanskrit:
संसारेऽत्राभिधीयन्ते श्रीजगद्गुरवो ध्रुवम् ।
लोकाभ्युदयसिद्धयर्थ कल्याणार्थश्च व सदा ॥
shambhu_gita::140.verse_hindi: इस संसार में निश्चय ही जगद्गुरु नाम से अभिहित होते हैं। मैंने समस्त संसार के अभ्युदय और आप लोगों के सदा कल्याणार्थ
shambhu_gita::140.english_translation: In this world, they are always surely called the world teachers, for the welfare and prosperity of all beings.
shambhu_gita::140.translation_literal: संसारेऽत्राभिधीयन्ते (in the world here are called) / श्रीजगद्गुरवो (the glorious world teachers) / ध्रुवम् (certainly) / लोकाभ्युदयसिद्धयर्थ (for the purpose of the world's prosperity and success) / कल्याणार्थश्च (and for welfare) / व (also) / सदा (always)
shambhu_gita::140.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::140.essence: True teachers exist always to guide and uplift all beings.
shambhu_gita::140.simple_meaning: In this world, the supreme teachers are always known for guiding beings toward their success and well-being.
shambhu_gita::140.simple_insight: The presence of true teachers is constant, aiming for everyone's welfare and progress.
shambhu_gita::140.detailed_meaning: Suta describes how in the world, certain exalted teachers are recognized as shining guides whose purpose is the success and welfare of all beings, setting the context for a teaching focused on universal benefit.
shambhu_gita::140.insight: It highlights the ongoing presence of guiding wisdom dedicated to collective well-being in the world.

shambhu_gita::141.verse_sanskrit:
अंतिगुह्यं रहस्यं वो वेदतात्पर्य्यबोधकम् ।
भवद्भक्त्या प्रसन्नेन पितरो वर्णितं मया ॥
shambhu_gita::141.verse_hindi: वेद के तात्पर्यो का बोधक अतिगुह्य रहस्य आपकी भक्ति से प्रसन्न होकर आपसे वर्णन किया है। हे पितृगण !
shambhu_gita::141.english_translation: The profound secret meaning of the Vedas is revealed to you, described by me pleased with your devotion, O ancestors.
shambhu_gita::141.translation_literal: अंतिगुह्यं (most secret) रहस्यं (secret) वो (to you) वेदतात्पर्य्यबोधकम् (meaning of the Vedas) । भवद्भक्त्या (by your devotion) प्रसन्नेन (pleased) पितरो (ancestors) वर्णितं (described) मया (by me) ॥
shambhu_gita::141.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::141.essence: Devotion reveals the deepest hidden meaning of sacred knowledge.
shambhu_gita::141.simple_meaning: The deepest secret meaning of the Vedas is explained here because of your devoted attitude, shared by me with the ancestors.
shambhu_gita::141.simple_insight: Devotion opens the way to understanding sacred truths that remain hidden without it.
shambhu_gita::141.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, explaining that the very subtle and hidden meaning of the Vedas is being revealed now because of their sincere devotion. This sets the stage for the teachings to come, highlighting devotion as key to understanding.
shambhu_gita::141.insight: It shows that devotion creates a receptive state in which profound wisdom can be shared and understood.

shambhu_gita::142.verse_sanskrit:
संवर्द्धन्तां चिरं विज्ञाः ! भवत्कल्याणसम्पदः ।
धर्मवद्धिश्च संसारे जायतां नितरां मुदे ॥
shambhu_gita::142.verse_hindi: हे विज्ञों ! आप लोगों की कल्याण सम्पत्ति चिरकाल बढ़े और संसार में प्रसन्नता के लिये निरन्तर धर्म की वृद्धि हो
shambhu_gita::142.english_translation: O wise ones! May your wealth of well-being increase forever, and may the growth of dharma in the world bring constant joy.
shambhu_gita::142.translation_literal: संवर्द्धन्तां (may increase) चिरं (long time) विज्ञाः (wise ones) ! भवत् (your) कल्याणसम्पदः (wealth of well-being) । धर्मवद्धिः (growth of dharma) च (and) संसारे (in the world) जायतां (may arise) नितरां (constantly) मुदे (in joy) ॥
shambhu_gita::142.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::142.essence: True well-being and dharma growing together create lasting joy in the world.
shambhu_gita::142.simple_meaning: May the wise ones' well-being grow forever, and may dharma increase in the world bringing continuous happiness.
shambhu_gita::142.simple_insight: Wishing growth in goodness and right living brings a hopeful and uplifting feeling.
shambhu_gita::142.detailed_meaning: Suta offers a blessing to the wise sages, wishing their good fortune and the increase of dharma in the world so that happiness becomes constant everywhere.
shambhu_gita::142.modern_relevance: You hope that the good in yourself and your community grows steadily, bringing lasting happiness to everyone around.
shambhu_gita::142.insight: It encourages seeing well-being and right conduct as sources of lasting joy beyond personal gain.

shambhu_gita::143.verse_sanskrit:
एतद्धर्मरहस्यं हि पुष्णीत हृदये सदा।
एवं कृते मनुष्याणामार्यदृष्टावपि द्रुतम् ॥
shambhu_gita::143.verse_hindi: आप इसी धर्म रहस्य का सदा हृदय में पोषण करो, ऐसा करने पर मनुष्यों की आर्य सृष्टि में भी
shambhu_gita::143.english_translation: Constantly nurture this secret of dharma in your heart; by doing so, even in noble creation, humans advance swiftly.
shambhu_gita::143.translation_literal: एतत् (this) धर्म (duty/righteousness) रहस्यं (secret) हि (indeed) पुष्णीत (nourish) हृदये (in the heart) सदा (always) । एवं (thus) कृते (done) मनुष्याणाम् (of humans) आर्य (noble) दृष्टौ (in creation) अपि (also) द्रुतम् (quickly) ॥
shambhu_gita::143.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::143.essence: Consistently nurturing your inner dharma speeds your growth in any noble pursuit.
shambhu_gita::143.simple_meaning: Always keep the secret of your true duty alive in your heart; this helps you grow quickly even in challenging circumstances.
shambhu_gita::143.simple_insight: There is power in quietly nurturing your purpose that accelerates your progress.
shambhu_gita::143.detailed_meaning: Shiva instructs to constantly nurture the hidden essence of dharma within the heart. This teaching comes as a foundation for humans to rise quickly even among noble beings, emphasizing the importance of inner commitment to purpose.
shambhu_gita::143.modern_relevance: You face a tough challenge, and instead of rushing or losing focus, you quietly remind yourself of your core purpose—this steady inner nourishment fuels your growth.
shambhu_gita::143.insight: It teaches you to nurture your inner sense of purpose consistently, enabling swift progress even amid complexity.

shambhu_gita::144.verse_sanskrit:
रहस्य पुनरेतद्वै प्रकाशं स्वयमेप्यति ।
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मेऽस्मिन प्रायो लुप्ते भवसपि ॥
shambhu_gita::144.verse_hindi: यह रहस्य शीघ्र पुनः स्वयं ही प्रकाशित होगा। वर्णाश्रम धर्म के लुप्तप्राय हो जाने पर भी हे पितृगण!
shambhu_gita::144.english_translation: This secret will soon reveal itself again on its own, even when the duties of caste and stage of life have nearly disappeared, O ancestors!
shambhu_gita::144.translation_literal: रहस्य (secret) / पुनः (again) / एतत् (this) / वै (indeed) / प्रकाशं (manifestation) / स्वयमेपि (by itself) / यति (goes) / वर्णाश्रमाख्य (called caste and stage of life) / धर्मे (in duty) / अस्मिन् (in this) / प्रायः (almost) / लुप्ते (disappeared) / भवसपि (O ancestors)
shambhu_gita::144.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::144.essence: Essential truth reveals itself again even when familiar social duties fade.
shambhu_gita::144.simple_meaning: The core secret of life will reveal itself again naturally, even if traditional social duties nearly disappear.
shambhu_gita::144.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing essential truth returns, regardless of changing social roles.
shambhu_gita::144.detailed_meaning: Shiva tells the ancestors that even if the traditional duties tied to caste and life stages fade away, the profound secret of existence will naturally become clear again.
shambhu_gita::144.modern_relevance: When social structures or roles you relied on change or fade, the deeper truth about your purpose will still find a way to appear.
shambhu_gita::144.insight: It shifts focus from clinging to old roles toward trusting that fundamental truth will emerge on its own.

shambhu_gita::145.verse_sanskrit:
बीजञ्चेद्रक्षितं तर्हि सम्यक् कालप्रभावतः।
अनार्यत्वेन युक्तायां सत्यां सृष्टावपि ध्रुवम् ॥
shambhu_gita::145.verse_hindi: यदि उसका बीज काल प्रभाव से सुरक्षित होगा तो मनुष्य सृष्टि के अनार्यभाव धारण करने पर भी
shambhu_gita::145.english_translation: If its seed is properly protected over time, then even when bearing the qualities of the non-noble, the truth of creation remains firm.
shambhu_gita::145.translation_literal: बीजञ्चेद्रक्षितं (and seed if protected) तर्हि (then) सम्यक् (properly) कालप्रभावतः (by time's influence) अनार्यत्वेन (by non-nobleness) युक्तायां (endowed with) सत्यां (truth) सृष्टावपि (creation also) ध्रुवम् (steady/firm)
shambhu_gita::145.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::145.essence: Protecting your inner seed keeps truth steady despite outer flaws.
shambhu_gita::145.simple_meaning: If the essential core inside you is well protected over time, then even when you have imperfect qualities, your true nature remains stable and truthful.
shambhu_gita::145.simple_insight: There's power in safeguarding your inner foundation despite outer imperfections.
shambhu_gita::145.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that when the essential seed or core of a being is carefully preserved through time, the truth that underlies creation remains steady even if the being carries qualities considered non-noble or flawed. This teaching encourages protecting the vital essence beyond surface changes.
shambhu_gita::145.modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by flaws or mistakes, but by protecting your core values and intentions, your true self stays grounded no matter what shifts around you.
shambhu_gita::145.insight: It teaches you to prioritize safeguarding your core integrity over getting distracted by external imperfections or judgments.

shambhu_gita::146.verse_sanskrit:
कालवेगप्रभावेण मानवानां स्वाभुजः !।
आर्यवीर्यसुरक्षातः प्रजातन्तुः सुरक्षितः ॥
shambhu_gita::146.verse_hindi: सृष्टि के कालवेग के प्रभाव से आर्यवीर्य की सुरक्षा रहने से प्रजातन्तु की सुरक्षा होगी और
shambhu_gita::146.english_translation: The rapid flow of time affects humans, but with the protection of noble strength, the community will be safeguarded.
shambhu_gita::146.translation_literal: कालवेगप्रभावेण (by the influence of time's speed) / मानवानां (of humans) / स्वाभुजः (own nature) / आर्यवीर्यसुरक्षातः (from the protection of noble strength) / प्रजातन्तुः (of the community) / सुरक्षितः (protected)
shambhu_gita::146.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::146.essence: Noble strength shields the community amid time's swift changes.
shambhu_gita::146.simple_meaning: Time moves quickly and affects humans, but if noble strength protects them, the whole community stays safe.
shambhu_gita::146.simple_insight: Protection through noble strength offers security against the swift passing of time.
shambhu_gita::146.detailed_meaning: Suta explains that although humans are influenced by the unstoppable flow of time, the presence of noble strength (Arya Veerya) acts as a safeguard, ensuring the safety of the entire community or lineage.
shambhu_gita::146.modern_relevance: You see how fast time passes and changes things, yet strong values or support can protect your family or community.
shambhu_gita::146.insight: Understand that external forces like time affect everyone, but inner strength or collective integrity can preserve what matters.

shambhu_gita::147.verse_sanskrit:
वर्णाश्रमेण धर्मेण युक्तः शुद्धो भविष्यति ।
यथाकालं यथादेशं यथापात्रं कदाचन ॥
shambhu_gita::147.verse_hindi: वर्णाश्रम धर्मयुक्त शुद्ध प्रजातन्तु की अवश्य सुरक्षा होगी और यथाकाल, यथादेश और यथापात्र किसी समय
shambhu_gita::147.english_translation: One who follows the duties of caste and stage of life, at the right time, place, and with the proper means, will remain pure.
shambhu_gita::147.translation_literal: वर्णाश्रमेण (by caste and stage of life) / धर्मेण (by duty) / युक्तः (joined, connected) / शुद्धो (pure) / भविष्यति (will be) / यथाकालं (at the proper time) / यथादेशं (at the proper place) / यथापात्रं (with the proper means) / कदाचन (at any time)
shambhu_gita::147.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::147.essence: Purity arises when you perform your duties rightly in time, place, and manner.
shambhu_gita::147.simple_meaning: You become pure and steady by performing your duties according to your role, time, place, and means.
shambhu_gita::147.simple_insight: There is calm in knowing that doing your proper part purifies you over time.
shambhu_gita::147.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva instructs that fulfilling the duties assigned by one's caste and stage of life, carefully respecting timing, location, and proper methods, leads to purity and steadiness. This is about living rightly within social and spiritual roles to maintain harmony.
shambhu_gita::147.modern_relevance: You keep your integrity when you handle your responsibilities thoughtfully, respecting context and resources, rather than rushing or forcing outcomes.
shambhu_gita::147.insight: It teaches you to honor the natural order of your responsibilities by timing and method, which grounds your actions and keeps you aligned.

shambhu_gita::148.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वाऽविरुद्धं सर्वेषां मङ्गलायतनं हितम् ।
सार्वभौमं पुनर्लोके धर्मज्ञानं प्रकाशयेत् ॥
shambhu_gita::148.verse_hindi: सर्वाविरुद्ध, सर्वमङ्गलालय हितकर और सार्वभौम धर्मज्ञान का पुनः जगत में प्रकाश होगा
shambhu_gita::148.english_translation: One should reveal universal, auspicious, and beneficial dharma knowledge that opposes nothing and is sovereign in the world.
shambhu_gita::148.translation_literal: सर्वाऽविरुद्धं (opposed to none) / सर्वेषां (of all) / मङ्गलायतनं (source of auspiciousness) / हितम् (beneficial) / सार्वभौमं (sovereign) / पुनः (again) / लोके (in the world) / धर्मज्ञानं (knowledge of dharma) / प्रकाशयेत् (should reveal)
shambhu_gita::148.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::148.essence: True dharma knowledge benefits all and opposes no one universally.
shambhu_gita::148.simple_meaning: You should share knowledge of dharma that benefits everyone and opposes nothing, spreading it widely.
shambhu_gita::148.simple_insight: There is power in sharing truth that helps all without causing harm or division.
shambhu_gita::148.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva advises presenting dharma knowledge that does not conflict with anyone’s interests. The focus is on revealing a universal, beneficial truth that serves as a foundation for all, guiding people without opposition or harm.
shambhu_gita::148.modern_relevance: You have a chance to share ideas or values that bring people together, not push them apart, even in heated discussions.
shambhu_gita::148.insight: It teaches you to communicate with respect and inclusivity, focusing on what benefits everyone rather than creating conflict.

shambhu_gita::149.verse_sanskrit:
भावशुद्धे रहस्यं यत् पुरा युष्मभ्यमुक्तवान् ।
कालप्रभावतो जाते भय आर्यप्रजास्वहो ! ॥
shambhu_gita::149.verse_hindi: मैंने जो भावशुद्धि का रहस्य पहले तुम से कहा है, अहो कालप्रभाव से आर्य प्रजा में
shambhu_gita::149.english_translation: I have previously revealed to you the secret of pure devotion; alas, it has been lost among noble beings due to the power of time.
shambhu_gita::149.translation_literal: भावशुद्धे (in pure devotion) / रहस्यं (secret) / यत् (that) / पुरा (before) / युष्मभ्यमुक्तवान् (to you spoke) / कालप्रभावतो (due to the power of time) / जाते (having gone away) / भय (alas) / आर्यप्रजास्वहो (among noble beings)
shambhu_gita::149.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::149.essence: Even vital spiritual knowledge can fade away under time’s influence.
shambhu_gita::149.simple_meaning: The secret of pure devotion was taught before, but time has caused it to be forgotten even by noble people.
shambhu_gita::149.simple_insight: Even precious truths can be lost over time despite their value.
shambhu_gita::149.detailed_meaning: Shiva laments that the profound teaching about pure devotion he shared earlier has been forgotten or obscured among noble people because of time's effects, highlighting the fragility of spiritual knowledge.
shambhu_gita::149.modern_relevance: You may have learned important truths that fade as life’s distractions and time pull you away from them.
shambhu_gita::149.insight: Recognize that valuable spiritual insights need continual renewal or they risk being lost to time.

shambhu_gita::150.verse_hindi: वर्णाश्रमधर्म की हानि का अत्यन्त महान् भय उत्पन्न होने पर भी हे महानुभावो ! भावशुद्धि द्वारा ही
shambhu_gita::150.english_translation: O noble ones, even when there is great fear of losing the duties of caste and stage of life, the highest are purified only by the absence of support for improper duties.
shambhu_gita::150.translation_literal: वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मस्य (of duties called caste and stage) क्षते-रति-मह-सपि (even great fear of loss) । आपद्धर्मस्य (of improper duties) साहाय्याभावशुद्ध-चैव (absence of support and pure indeed) सत्तमाः (the best) ॥
shambhu_gita::150.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::150.essence: Highest purity comes from refusing to support improper duties despite fear of loss.
shambhu_gita::150.simple_meaning: Even if you deeply fear losing your rightful duties, your highest purity comes from not supporting improper actions.
shambhu_gita::150.simple_insight: True purity arises from avoiding wrong actions, no matter how scared you are to lose your place.
shambhu_gita::150.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that even when people fear losing their social and spiritual responsibilities (varna and ashrama duties), those who are highest remain pure by refusing to support wrong or improper duties, emphasizing moral integrity over fear.
shambhu_gita::150.modern_relevance: You might fear losing your role or status and be tempted to take shortcuts, but true integrity means not supporting what feels wrong.
shambhu_gita::150.insight: It shifts your focus from clinging to roles to maintaining purity by rejecting unethical support.

shambhu_gita::151.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वथा निश्चितं सम्यक् तस्य रक्षा भविष्यति ।
अतः पितृगणाः ! यूयं निर्भयास्तत्पराः खलु ॥
shambhu_gita::151.verse_hindi: आपकी सहायता से उसकी सभी प्रकार से अवश्य सुरक्षा होगी। इस कारण हे पितृगण ! तुम सभी भयरहित और तत्पर होकर ही
shambhu_gita::151.english_translation: With your support, his protection is certain in every way. Therefore, ancestors, be fearless and ready.
shambhu_gita::151.translation_literal: सर्वथा (in every way) निश्चितं (certain) सम्यक् (properly) तस्य (his) रक्षा (protection) भविष्यति (will be). अतः (therefore) पितृगणाः (ancestors)! यूयं (you) निर्भयाः (fearless) तत्पराः (ready) खलु (indeed).
shambhu_gita::151.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::151.essence: Fearless readiness and support assure complete protection.
shambhu_gita::151.simple_meaning: When you support someone fully, their safety is assured. So be fearless and prepared to help.
shambhu_gita::151.simple_insight: You matter deeply; your readiness brings security and peace.
shambhu_gita::151.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, assuring them that with their devoted support, protection is certain. He encourages them to be fearless and vigilant, highlighting their important role in safeguarding through presence and readiness.
shambhu_gita::151.modern_relevance: You stand by a friend in crisis, knowing your steady support is the anchor they need to feel safe.
shambhu_gita::151.insight: It teaches you to embrace your role as a steadfast protector, releasing fear and staying prepared to act.

shambhu_gita::152.verse_sanskrit:
पालयचं निजं नूनं कर्त्तव्यं हितसाधकम् ।
भवतां मंगलं येन लोकस्यापि भविष्यति ॥
shambhu_gita::152.verse_hindi: अपने हितकर कर्तव्य का अवश्य पालन करो जिससे तुम्हारा और समस्त संसार का भी मंगल होगा
shambhu_gita::152.english_translation: Always perform your beneficial duty, which will bring welfare to you and the entire world.
shambhu_gita::152.translation_literal: पालयचं (perform) निजं (your own) नूनं (certainly) कर्त्तव्यं (duty) हितसाधकम् (beneficial) । भवतां (your) मंगलं (welfare) येन (by which) लोकस्यापि (of the world also) भविष्यति (will be).
shambhu_gita::152.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::152.essence: Doing your beneficial duty brings welfare to yourself and the whole world.
shambhu_gita::152.simple_meaning: You should always perform your own duty that benefits both you and the world.
shambhu_gita::152.simple_insight: Fulfilling your duty connects your well-being with the greater good around you.
shambhu_gita::152.detailed_meaning: Shiva instructs to uphold the duty that is beneficial. Acting in this way not only ensures your welfare but also positively impacts the entire world, highlighting the interconnectedness of individual and collective well-being.
shambhu_gita::152.modern_relevance: You choose to complete a task that helps others too, realizing your actions ripple beyond yourself.
shambhu_gita::152.insight: It shifts focus from self-centered action to recognizing how your duty supports wider harmony.

shambhu_gita::153.verse_sanskrit:
पूर्णस्वरूपं धर्मस्य जगत्यां जगदीश्वर !।
सार्वभौम प्रचार्येत लोककल्याणदं कथम् ॥
shambhu_gita::153.verse_hindi: हे जगदीश्वर ! धर्म का लोककल्याणकारी सार्वभौम पूर्ण स्वरुप जगत में कैसे प्रचारित हो सकता है
shambhu_gita::153.english_translation: O Lord of the universe! How can the universal, complete form of dharma that brings welfare to the world be propagated?
shambhu_gita::153.translation_literal: पूर्णस्वरूपं (complete form) धर्मस्य (of dharma) जगत्यां (in the world) जगदीश्वर (O Lord of the universe) ! / सार्वभौम (universal) प्रचार्येत (may be propagated) लोककल्याणदं (welfare of the world) कथम् (how) ॥
shambhu_gita::153.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::153.essence: The question of how to spread universal dharma for the world's benefit.
shambhu_gita::153.simple_meaning: How can the complete, universal form of dharma that benefits all be spread throughout the world?
shambhu_gita::153.simple_insight: There is a deep concern for spreading true dharma for the welfare of all beings.
shambhu_gita::153.detailed_meaning: A speaker addresses the Lord of the universe, questioning how the perfect, universal dharma that ensures the welfare of all can be widely propagated, highlighting the urgency and importance of this teaching.
shambhu_gita::153.insight: It invites reflection on how to effectively share and live by universal principles that benefit everyone.

shambhu_gita::154.verse_sanskrit:
भोः सर्वेश्वर ! भक्तानां जीवानां हे त्रितापहृत् । 
धर्मास्यैवंविधोदारमूर्तेश्च दर्शनं कथम् ॥
shambhu_gita::154.verse_hindi: और हे भक्तजीव त्रितापहारी ! हे सर्वेश्वर ! हे महेश्वर ! धर्म की ऐसी उदार मूर्ति का दर्शन कैसे
shambhu_gita::154.english_translation: O Supreme Lord, remover of the threefold sufferings of devotees, how can one behold the generous embodiment of Dharma?
shambhu_gita::154.translation_literal: भोः (O) सर्वेश्वर (Supreme Lord) ! भक्तानां (of devotees) जीवानां (living beings) हे (O) त्रितापहृत् (remover of three sufferings) । धर्मास्यैवंविधोदारमूर्तेश्च (of Dharma such generous embodiment also) दर्शनं (vision) कथम् (how) ॥
shambhu_gita::154.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::154.essence: A devotee wonders how to behold Dharma's generous form that removes suffering.
shambhu_gita::154.simple_meaning: This verse is a respectful question asking how one can see the generous form of Dharma, who removes the three kinds of suffering from devotees.
shambhu_gita::154.simple_insight: It expresses reverence and wonder at the divine help that frees from suffering.
shambhu_gita::154.detailed_meaning: The verse addresses the Supreme Lord Shiva as the remover of threefold suffering for devotees, asking how one can behold the generous form of Dharma. It reflects a devotional inquiry rather than a direct teaching.
shambhu_gita::154.insight: It invites curiosity about recognizing the generous nature of righteous conduct embodied by the divine.

shambhu_gita::155.verse_sanskrit:
शक्नुयाजीवपिण्डेषु भवितुंवा महेश्वर!।
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मास्य सम्भाव्यताऽथवा कथम् ॥
shambhu_gita::155.verse_hindi: जीव पिण्ड में हो सकता है। अथवा हे शोकविमोचन ! वर्णाश्रम धर्म का यथार्थ प्रचार
shambhu_gita::155.english_translation: O Great Lord, is it possible to exist within the individual living being? Or how is the true teaching of the duties of varna and ashrama possible?
shambhu_gita::155.translation_literal: शक्नुय (able) + अजीवपिण्डेषु (in living bodies) भवितुं (to exist) वा (or) महेश्वर (Great Lord)! वर्णाश्रमाख्य (called varna and ashrama) धर्मास्य (of duty) सम्भाव्यता (possibility) अथवा (or) कथम् (how) ॥
shambhu_gita::155.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::155.essence: Can the true self exist within the body, and how do social duties truly arise?
shambhu_gita::155.simple_meaning: The verse questions whether it is possible for the true self to exist within the living body or how the duties of social order can be truly established.
shambhu_gita::155.simple_insight: It raises curiosity about the relationship between the true self and social duties.
shambhu_gita::155.detailed_meaning: This verse poses a question to the Great Lord, asking if the true self can reside within the individual body or how the prescribed duties of varna and ashrama can be properly upheld, setting the stage for a deeper discussion.
shambhu_gita::155.insight: It encourages questioning how identity relates to social roles and inner reality.

shambhu_gita::156.verse_sanskrit:
यथावत्सम्प्रचारोऽस्मिँलोके शोकविमोचन !।
तास्मिन वर्णाश्रमे धर्मे वाधनोपस्थितौ ननु ॥
shambhu_gita::156.verse_hindi: इस लोक में कैसे सम्भव है और यदि उस वर्णाश्रम धर्म में बाधा पहुंचने लगे तो
shambhu_gita::156.english_translation: How is it possible in this world, and if obstruction arises in the duties of the varna and ashrama system?
shambhu_gita::156.translation_literal: यथा (how) / एव (indeed) / सम्प्रचारः (movement/spread) / अस्मिन् (in this) / लोके (world) / शोकविमोचन (release from grief) / तास्मिन् (therein) / वर्णाश्रमे (in the varna and ashrama) / धर्मे (duty) / वाधन (obstruction) / उपस्थितौ (present) / ननु (surely?)
shambhu_gita::156.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::156.essence: Obstacles in social duties raise doubt about finding relief from grief in this world.
shambhu_gita::156.simple_meaning: It questions how grief can be released in this world, especially if duties based on social order are obstructed.
shambhu_gita::156.simple_insight: Sometimes, social roles and duties feel like barriers to finding relief from suffering.
shambhu_gita::156.detailed_meaning: This verse expresses doubt or questioning about how sorrow can be overcome in the world if the traditional system of varna and ashrama dharma faces obstacles. It reflects concern about the role of social duties in spiritual liberation.
shambhu_gita::156.modern_relevance: You might feel stuck when your expected roles or responsibilities seem to block your personal growth or peace.
shambhu_gita::156.insight: It invites you to question whether rigid social expectations limit your freedom to find ease and meaning.

shambhu_gita::157.verse_sanskrit:
बीजंवा तस्य धर्मस्य रक्षितं स्यात् कथं विभो ।
उपस्थिते सुकालेऽस्य येन वृद्धिर्भवेत्पुनः ॥
shambhu_gita::157.verse_hindi: हे विभो ! उस धर्म की बीजरक्षा कैसे हो सकती है जिससे सुसमय उपस्थित होने पर पुनः उसकी वृद्धि हो सके
shambhu_gita::157.english_translation: O Vibhava! How can the seed of that dharma be protected if, when the right time comes, it can increase again?
shambhu_gita::157.translation_literal: बीजंवा (seed) / तस्य (of that) / धर्मस्य (dharma) / रक्षितं (protected) / स्यात् (can be) / कथं (how) / विभो (O Vibhava) / उपस्थिते (when present) / सुकालेऽस्य (at the right time) / येन (by which) / वृद्धिर्भवेत्पुनः (growth again happens)
shambhu_gita::157.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::157.essence: True dharma’s seed never requires repeated growth at the right time.
shambhu_gita::157.simple_meaning: Real dharma’s seed is safe only if it does not need to grow again when the right moment arrives.
shambhu_gita::157.simple_insight: You feel the power of dharma that remains steady without needing repeated renewal.
shambhu_gita::157.detailed_meaning: Shiva questions how dharma’s true essence can be preserved if it requires regrowth when the right time comes, highlighting the nature of stable and authentic dharma beyond mere cycles.
shambhu_gita::157.modern_relevance: You notice how some values or habits feel shaky because they need constant restarting instead of steady presence.
shambhu_gita::157.insight: It shifts your view from dharma as a temporary effort to dharma as a steady, self-sustaining principle.

shambhu_gita::158.verse_sanskrit:
जीवसृष्टिरहस्ये वा मानवानाञ्च किंविधम् ।
जन्ममृत्युगतं नाथ ! वैलक्षण्यं सुगोपितम् ॥
shambhu_gita::158.verse_hindi: और हे नाथ ! जीव सृष्टि रहस्य में मनुष्यों की जन्ममृत्यु की कैसी विचित्रता रखी गई है
shambhu_gita::158.english_translation: O Lord, what is the mysterious peculiarity placed in the birth and death of humans within the secret of living creation?
shambhu_gita::158.translation_literal: जीवसृष्टिरहस्ये (in the secret of living creation) / वा (or) / मानवानाञ्च (and of humans also) / किंविधम् (what kind of) / जन्ममृत्युगतं (birth and death connected) / नाथ (O Lord) / वैलक्षण्यं (peculiarity) / सुगोपितम् (well hidden)
shambhu_gita::158.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::158.essence: Human birth and death hold a deep mystery hidden within life's secret creation.
shambhu_gita::158.simple_meaning: This asks about the mysterious nature of human birth and death hidden within the secret of life’s creation.
shambhu_gita::158.simple_insight: There is wonder in how life and death are intertwined in human existence beyond obvious understanding.
shambhu_gita::158.detailed_meaning: The verse questions the unique mystery behind human birth and death as part of the living creation, addressing the Lord to reveal this concealed peculiarity.
shambhu_gita::158.insight: It invites curiosity to explore the hidden patterns behind human life cycles beyond surface appearances.

shambhu_gita::159.verse_sanskrit:
सहायकाः कथं स्याम मानवानां क्रमोन्नतौ ।
सामञ्जस्यं भवत्दसृष्टेन रक्षितुमीश्महे ॥
shambhu_gita::159.verse_hindi: मनुष्यों  की क्रमो उन्नति में हम कैसे सहायक हो सक्ते हैं जिससे आपकी सृष्टि का सामञ्जस्य हम रक्षा करने में समर्थ हो
shambhu_gita::159.english_translation: How can we assist humans in their gradual progress to uphold harmony in your creation?
shambhu_gita::159.translation_literal: सहायकाः (helpers) कथं (how) स्याम (can we be) मानवानां (of humans) क्रमोन्नतौ (in gradual progress) । सामञ्जस्यं (harmony) भवत् (your) असृष्टेन (creation) रक्षितुम् (to protect) इश्महे (we wish) ॥
shambhu_gita::159.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::159.essence: Helping steady progress supports the harmony that holds creation together.
shambhu_gita::159.simple_meaning: We seek ways to help humans progress steadily while maintaining harmony in the world.
shambhu_gita::159.simple_insight: You can play a part in fostering growth and protecting balance around you.
shambhu_gita::159.detailed_meaning: Amidst creation's vastness, there is a desire to support human growth step by step, ensuring the world's harmony is not disturbed. This moment expresses a wish to be an effective helper to both progress and order.
shambhu_gita::159.modern_relevance: You notice a team struggling to improve while keeping peace among members—you wonder how best to support both growth and unity.
shambhu_gita::159.insight: It teaches you to balance encouragement of growth with preserving harmony in relationships and systems.

shambhu_gita::160.verse_sanskrit:
भावत्रयगतं ह्येतद्रहस्यं सर्वमुत्तमम्।
उपदिश्य प्रभो ! सम्यगम्मानय कृतार्थय ॥
shambhu_gita::160.verse_hindi: हे प्रभो! इस समय त्रिविध भागवत उक्त सर्वोतम रहस्यों का हमें भलीभांति, उपदेश देकर कृतार्थ कीजिये
shambhu_gita::160.english_translation: O Lord! Please teach us fully and clearly the supreme secrets found in the threefold devotion.
shambhu_gita::160.translation_literal: भावत्रयगतं (in threefold devotion) हि (indeed) एतत् (this) रहस्यं (secret) सर्वम् (all) उत्तमम् (supreme) । उपदिश्य (teaching) प्रभो (O Lord) सम्यग् (well) अमानय (bring) कृतार्थय (make fulfilled) ॥
shambhu_gita::160.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::160.essence: Complete guidance is needed to understand devotion's highest mysteries fully.
shambhu_gita::160.simple_meaning: This verse asks the Lord to clearly teach the highest mysteries within the threefold devotion so the seekers may be fulfilled.
shambhu_gita::160.simple_insight: There is trust that deep guidance is needed to truly understand devotion's highest secrets.
shambhu_gita::160.detailed_meaning: The bard Suta requests the Lord to reveal clearly the supreme mysteries contained in the threefold Bhakti Yoga, so that the listeners may gain complete fulfillment from the teaching.
shambhu_gita::160.insight: It shows the importance of clear guidance to deeply understand complex spiritual devotion.

shambhu_gita::161.verse_sanskrit:
पितरो का शुभाकाङ्क्षां जगत्कल्याणकारिणीम् ।
आलोक्यातिप्रसन्नोऽहं भवन्तो मे प्रिया यतः ॥
shambhu_gita::161.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण! जगत्कल्याणकारिणी आपकी शुभ कामना को देखकर मैं अति प्रसन्न हुआ है क्योंकि आपलोग मेरे प्रिय हैं
shambhu_gita::161.english_translation: O ancestors! Seeing your good wishes for the welfare of the world, I am very pleased because you are dear to me.
shambhu_gita::161.translation_literal: पितरो (ancestors) / का (of) / शुभाकाङ्क्षां (good wishes) / जगत्कल्याणकारिणीम् (world welfare-doing) / आलोक्याति (seeing) / प्रसन्नः (pleased) / अहं (I) / भवन्तः (you all) / मे (my) / प्रिया (dear) / यतः (because)
shambhu_gita::161.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::161.essence: Joy arises from feeling the heartfelt goodwill of those you cherish.
shambhu_gita::161.simple_meaning: The speaker feels happy because the ancestors wish well for the world and they are dear to him.
shambhu_gita::161.simple_insight: Feeling connected and loved by those who wish well brings joy and encouragement.
shambhu_gita::161.detailed_meaning: Shiva acknowledges the ancestors' blessings for the world's welfare and expresses his happiness because they are dear to him, highlighting a moment of gratitude and connection with revered beings.
shambhu_gita::161.insight: It shows how recognizing support and goodwill around you can uplift your spirit and strengthen resolve.

shambhu_gita::162.verse_sanskrit:
सानन्दं पूरयिष्येऽतोऽमिलापं व: शुभावहम ।
नवाधिभौतिकं ज्ञानं कल्याः! स्थूलजगद्दतम् ॥
shambhu_gita::162.verse_hindi: इसलिये मैं आनन्दपूर्वक आपकी शुभकामना को पूर्ण करूंगा। हे पितृगण !जब तक स्थूल जगत सम्बन्धीय आधिभौतिक ज्ञान
shambhu_gita::162.english_translation: Therefore, I will joyfully fulfill your auspicious wishes, O ancestors! Until the knowledge of the nine levels of the physical world and the gross universe is complete.
shambhu_gita::162.translation_literal: सानन्दं (with joy) / पूरयिष्येऽत: (I will fulfill therefore) / अमिलापं (union) / व: (your) / शुभावहम (auspiciousness-bearing) / नवाधिभौतिकं (of nine layers physical) / ज्ञानं (knowledge) / कल्याः (O auspicious ones)! / स्थूलजगद्दतम् (gross world known)
shambhu_gita::162.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::162.essence: Joyful commitment arises from fulfilling auspicious wishes through deep knowledge of the physical world.
shambhu_gita::162.simple_meaning: I will gladly fulfill your auspicious wishes until the complete knowledge of the physical universe is achieved.
shambhu_gita::162.simple_insight: There is joy in fulfilling sincere, auspicious intentions tied to deep knowledge.
shambhu_gita::162.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, expressing his joyous intent to fulfill their auspicious wishes by explaining the complete knowledge of the nine layers of the physical world and the gross universe.
shambhu_gita::162.insight: It shows commitment to fulfilling spiritual wishes through thorough understanding of the physical and cosmic realities.

shambhu_gita::163.verse_sanskrit:
तथाऽऽधिदैविकं ज्ञान सूक्ष्मदैवजगद्गतम ।
अध्यात्मराज्यसम्बद्धमात्मज्ञानं तथैव च ॥
shambhu_gita::163.verse_hindi: सूक्ष्म देवी जगत्सम्बन्धीय अधिदैविक ज्ञान और उसी प्रकार अध्यात्म राज्यसम्बन्धीय आत्मज्ञान
shambhu_gita::163.english_translation: Subtle divine knowledge relates to the world, and similarly, spiritual knowledge pertains to the realm of the true self.
shambhu_gita::163.translation_literal: तथा (thus) / अधिदैविकं (divine-related) / ज्ञान (knowledge) / सूक्ष्मदैवजगद्गतम् (subtle divine-world-pervading) / अध्यात्मराज्यसम्बद्धम् (spiritual-realm-connected) / आत्मज्ञानम् (self-knowledge) / तथैव (similarly) / च (also)
shambhu_gita::163.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::163.essence: Knowledge binds the unseen divine world and the realm of your true self.
shambhu_gita::163.simple_meaning: There are two subtle kinds of knowledge: one that connects to the divine world, and another that connects to understanding your true self.
shambhu_gita::163.simple_insight: You can feel the vastness of both the outer divine and your inner true self through knowledge.
shambhu_gita::163.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains two subtle forms of knowledge: one relates to the divine forces pervading the world, and the other concerns the spiritual realm connected to self-realization. This distinction sets the stage for deeper understanding of reality.
shambhu_gita::163.modern_relevance: You sense the difference between learning facts about the world and truly understanding who you are inside.
shambhu_gita::163.insight: This verse invites you to explore both external divine truths and inner self-awareness as complementary dimensions of wisdom.

shambhu_gita::164.verse_sanskrit:
प्रोक्तमेवं विधं ज्ञानं त्रिविध न प्रकाशते ।
मानवानां समाजेऽलं युगपदयावदेव ह ॥
shambhu_gita::164.verse_hindi: इस प्रकार के उक्त त्रिविधज्ञान का विकास एक ही काल में सम्यक् रूप से मनुष्य समाज मे नहीं होता है तब तक
shambhu_gita::164.english_translation: Such threefold knowledge does not arise fully at the same time in human society.
shambhu_gita::164.translation_literal: प्रोक्तमेवं (thus spoken) / विधं (kind/type) / ज्ञानं (knowledge) / त्रिविध (threefold) / न (not) / प्रकाशते (is revealed) / मानवानां (of humans) / समाजेऽलं (in society) / युगपदयावदेव (simultaneously/at one time) / ह (indeed)
shambhu_gita::164.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::164.essence: Threefold knowledge unfolds gradually, never all at once in society.
shambhu_gita::164.simple_meaning: Three types of knowledge do not fully appear together at the same time in human society.
shambhu_gita::164.simple_insight: Understanding unfolds gradually; all insights do not come at once.
shambhu_gita::164.detailed_meaning: Suta explains that the threefold knowledge, likely referring to distinct kinds or stages of wisdom, does not manifest fully and simultaneously among people. This sets the stage for understanding the gradual development of awareness.
shambhu_gita::164.modern_relevance: You notice different insights in yourself and others appear at different times, never all at once.
shambhu_gita::164.insight: It shifts the mind to accept gradual growth rather than expecting sudden full understanding.

shambhu_gita::165.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानज्योर्तिन जागर्ति तावत्पूर्णञ्च सात्त्विकम् ।
मत्यार्न्त: करणे नूनमिति में दृढनिश्चयः ॥
shambhu_gita::165.verse_hindi: पूर्ण सात्विक ज्ञान की ज्योति मनुष्य अन्तःकरण में प्रतिभासित नहीं ही होती है यह मेरा दृढ़ निश्चय है
shambhu_gita::165.english_translation: The light of complete sattvic knowledge surely does not shine within the human inner instrument; this is my firm conviction.
shambhu_gita::165.translation_literal: ज्ञानज्योर्तिन (knowledge-light) जागर्ति (shines) तावत्पूर्णञ्च (complete) सात्त्विकम् (sattvic) । मत्यार्न्तः (inside the mind) करणे (instrument) नूनमिति (surely) में (in) दृढनिश्चयः (firm conviction) ॥
shambhu_gita::165.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::165.essence: Complete clear knowledge often remains hidden inside the human mind.
shambhu_gita::165.simple_meaning: Complete pure knowledge does not always reveal itself clearly within a person's mind.
shambhu_gita::165.simple_insight: It’s okay if full clarity hasn’t arrived inside you yet.
shambhu_gita::165.detailed_meaning: Shiva asserts that even though pure sattvic knowledge exists, it may not visibly illuminate the human mind (inner instrument). This reflects how deep wisdom can be latent, not yet fully evident to the seeker.
shambhu_gita::165.modern_relevance: You might study or seek truth deeply but still feel the clarity hasn’t fully dawned within your mind.
shambhu_gita::165.insight: Recognize that wisdom often grows unseen inside before it becomes obvious; patience with inner growth matters.

shambhu_gita::166.verse_sanskrit:
यावन्निखिलभूतेष्वविभक्तञ्चैक्यदर्शकम् ।
सदा पूर्ण प्रकाशेताधिकं ज्ञानं न सात्त्विकम् ॥
shambhu_gita::166.verse_hindi: जब तक सर्वभूतों में अविभक्त और सब भूतों में ऐक्यभाव को दिखाने वाला, सब दशा में पूर्ण रहने वाला सात्विक ज्ञान
shambhu_gita::166.english_translation: True wisdom is that which always reveals the undivided unity in all beings, shining fully in every condition; anything beyond this is not pure wisdom.
shambhu_gita::166.translation_literal: यावत् (as long as) / अखिल (all) / भूतेषु (in beings) / अविभक्तम् (undivided) / च (and) / ऐक्यदर्शकम् (unity-seeing) / सदा (always) / पूर्ण (full) / प्रकाशेत् (shines) / अधिकम् (beyond) / ज्ञानम् (knowledge) / न (not) / सात्त्विकम् (pure, sattvic)
shambhu_gita::166.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::166.essence: Wisdom is complete only when it always perceives unity in all beings.
shambhu_gita::166.simple_meaning: True wisdom always sees the oneness that underlies all beings and shines fully in every state.
shambhu_gita::166.simple_insight: There is peace in knowing that all things share a common unity beneath appearances.
shambhu_gita::166.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes the highest wisdom as the constant awareness of the undivided unity present in all beings regardless of their form or condition. This teaching highlights that any knowledge failing this standard is incomplete or impure.
shambhu_gita::166.modern_relevance: When you notice the connection beneath differences—whether at work or in relationships—your understanding deepens beyond surface divisions.
shambhu_gita::166.insight: It shifts your perspective from seeing separation to recognizing oneness in diversity, refining your inner clarity.

shambhu_gita::167.verse_sanskrit:
मानवानां समाजेषु सार्वभौमं विराडलम् ।
नावन्नैवावबुध्येत स्वरूपं धर्मगोचरम् ॥
shambhu_gita::167.verse_hindi: मनुष्य समाज में अधिक रूप से प्रकाशित नहीं होता है तब तक धर्म के सार्वभौम विराट् स्वरुप का सम्यक् अनुभव मनुष्यसमाज नहीं ही कर सकता है
shambhu_gita::167.english_translation: Until humanity fully understands the universal vast form of dharma, it cannot truly experience its essence.
shambhu_gita::167.translation_literal: मानवानां (of humans) / समाजेषु (in societies) / सार्वभौमं (universal) / विराडलम् (vast form) / न (not) / अवन्नैव (yet indeed) / अवबुध्येत (is understood) / स्वरूपं (true nature) / धर्मगोचरम् (of dharma to be experienced)
shambhu_gita::167.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::167.essence: True experience of dharma requires fully seeing its universal vastness.
shambhu_gita::167.simple_meaning: People cannot truly experience dharma’s universal nature until they fully understand its vast and universal form.
shambhu_gita::167.simple_insight: There’s a deeper, universal truth of dharma waiting to be seen and lived by you.
shambhu_gita::167.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that human societies have not yet fully grasped dharma’s universal and vast form, so they cannot truly experience its essence or live by its highest truth.
shambhu_gita::167.modern_relevance: You might follow rules or roles but still feel disconnected until you sense the larger purpose behind them all.
shambhu_gita::167.insight: It shifts your focus from isolated duties to embracing a universal purpose that connects everything.

shambhu_gita::168.verse_sanskrit:
कायविद्या चिकित्सा च शल्यविद्या रसायनम् । 
उद्भित्स्वेदाण्डजानां हि तत्त्वविद्या तथैव च ॥
shambhu_gita::168.verse_hindi: मेरे अधिभौतिक ज्ञान में शारीरिक विद्या, चिकित्सा विद्या, शल्यविद्या, रसायनविद्या, उद्भिज तत्त्वविद्या, स्वेदज तत्वविद्या, अण्डज तत्वविद्या
shambhu_gita::168.english_translation: My superior knowledge includes physical science, medicine, surgery, alchemy, and the knowledge of plant, sweat-born, and egg-born elements.
shambhu_gita::168.translation_literal: कायविद्या (physical science) / चिकित्सा (medicine) / च (and) / शल्यविद्या (surgery) / रसायनम् (alchemy) / उद्भित् (plant-born) / स्वेद (sweat-born) / अण्डजानां (egg-born) / हि (indeed) / तत्त्वविद्या (knowledge of elements) / तथैव (likewise) / च (also)
shambhu_gita::168.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::168.essence: Superior knowledge includes many worldly sciences but is not the ultimate truth alone.
shambhu_gita::168.simple_meaning: The speaker describes various branches of superior, worldly knowledge that he possesses, including physical sciences and medical arts.
shambhu_gita::168.simple_insight: Knowing many practical sciences supports a broad understanding but is distinct from deeper wisdom.
shambhu_gita::168.detailed_meaning: Shiva lists his superior knowledge, encompassing physical science, healing arts, surgery, alchemy, and elemental knowledge of plants and beings, highlighting his mastery over diverse worldly sciences.
shambhu_gita::168.insight: Recognize that mastery of multiple practical sciences enriches understanding but differs from spiritual wisdom.

shambhu_gita::169.verse_sanskrit:
पाशवी तत्वविद्या च तत्त्वाविद्या च मानवी । 
क्षिखपूतेजोमरुदव्योमतत्त्वविद्या तथैव च ॥
shambhu_gita::169.verse_hindi: पशु तत्वविद्या, मनुष्य तत्वविद्या, भूत तत्वविद्या, आकाश तत्त्वविद्या, जल तत्त्वविद्या, वायु तत्त्वविद्या, अग्नि तत्वविद्या
shambhu_gita::169.english_translation: There is knowledge of the nature of beasts, knowledge of the nature of humans, knowledge of the nature of beings, knowledge of the nature of space, water, air, and fire.
shambhu_gita::169.translation_literal: पाशवी (beast-related) / तत्वविद्या (knowledge of nature) / च (and) / तत्त्वाविद्या (knowledge of elements) / च (and) / मानवी (human-related) / क्षिखपूतेजोमरुदव्यो (space, fire, water, air elements) / तत्त्वविद्या (knowledge of nature) / तथैव (likewise) / च (and)
shambhu_gita::169.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::169.essence: Knowledge covers the nature of beings and elements across life and matter.
shambhu_gita::169.simple_meaning: There are different kinds of knowledge about the nature of animals, humans, and the basic elements like air and fire.
shambhu_gita::169.simple_insight: Understanding the various layers of existence helps you see the world as interconnected.
shambhu_gita::169.detailed_meaning: This verse lists different types of knowledge related to the nature of living beings and elemental realities. It sets a foundation for exploring the diversity of existence but does not present a standalone teaching or insight.
shambhu_gita::169.insight: Recognize that knowledge spans many levels—from living beings to natural elements—broadening how you understand existence.

shambhu_gita::170.verse_sanskrit:
नाना पदार्थविद्या मे सन्ति नूनं सहायिकाः ।
आधिभौतीशक्तिविद्या ज्ञानेखल्वाधिभौतिके ॥
shambhu_gita::170.verse_hindi: आधिभौतिक शक्तिविद्या, ये अनेक पदार्थ विद्याएँ अवश्य सहायक हैं
shambhu_gita::170.english_translation: The knowledge of the fundamental material energy is supported by many different material sciences.
shambhu_gita::170.translation_literal: नाना (various) पदार्थविद्या (material sciences) मे (in) सन्ति (are) नूनं (indeed) सहायिकाः (supportive) । आधिभौतीशक्तिविद्या (knowledge of fundamental material energy) ज्ञाने (in knowledge) अखल्व (only) आधिभौतिके (of fundamental material) ॥
shambhu_gita::170.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::170.essence: Deep understanding of fundamental material energy depends on many supporting sciences.
shambhu_gita::170.simple_meaning: Understanding the basic material energy depends on many different material sciences that help explain it.
shambhu_gita::170.simple_insight: Your deep knowledge builds on many smaller pieces working together.
shambhu_gita::170.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the understanding of the primary material force (the basis of the natural world) is not isolated but relies on many supporting sciences that study different substances and phenomena.
shambhu_gita::170.modern_relevance: You might see a complex system at work, like your phone or body, and realize it depends on many smaller fields of knowledge coming together.
shambhu_gita::170.insight: It teaches you to appreciate how broad knowledge supports core understanding, encouraging you to integrate many perspectives.

shambhu_gita::171.verse_sanskrit:
आविष्कारस्तथा ज्ञानलामो वै वर्तते ध्रुवम् ।
आसां पदार्थविद्यानां सुलभो नात्र संशयः ॥
shambhu_gita::171.verse_hindi: इन पदार्थ विद्याओं का आविष्कार और ज्ञान लाभ करना अवश्य ही सहजसाध्य है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
shambhu_gita::171.english_translation: The discovery and gaining of knowledge about material substances is certainly easy and without doubt.
shambhu_gita::171.translation_literal: आविष्कारस्तथा (discovery and also) ज्ञानलामो (knowledge gain) वै (certainly) वर्तते (exists) ध्रुवम् (fixed/undoubted) । आसां (these) पदार्थविद्यानां (material knowledge) सुलभो (easy) नात्र (here not) संशयः (doubt) ॥
shambhu_gita::171.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::171.essence: Understanding material things is naturally easy and free from doubt.
shambhu_gita::171.simple_meaning: Gaining knowledge about the physical world and its substances is straightforward and clear, without confusion.
shambhu_gita::171.simple_insight: You can feel confident that understanding material things is accessible and certain.
shambhu_gita::171.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that learning about material substances and their nature is naturally easy and clear. There is no need to doubt because this knowledge is straightforward and accessible.
shambhu_gita::171.modern_relevance: When you study something concrete, like how your devices work or how food is made, you realize that practical knowledge is usually simpler than it seems.
shambhu_gita::171.insight: This verse shifts your view from fearing complexity to trusting that tangible knowledge is within your grasp.

shambhu_gita::172.verse_sanskrit:
आसाद्यन्ते यतो नून पुरुषार्थेस्तु केवलेः।
लौकिकैरेच लोकेषु विद्या उक्ता इमा द्रुतम् ॥
shambhu_gita::172.verse_hindi: क्योकि उक्त यह सभी विद्याएँ केवल लौकिक पुरुषार्थ से ही संसार में अवश्य ही शीघ्र प्राप्त होती हैं
shambhu_gita::172.english_translation: Because all these knowledges are indeed quickly attained in the world only through worldly effort.
shambhu_gita::172.translation_literal: आसाद्यन्ते (are attained) यतो (because) नून (certainly) पुरुषार्थेः (by effort) केवलेः (only) लौकिकैः (worldly) एव (indeed) च (and) लोकेषु (in worlds) विद्या (knowledge) उक्ता (spoken) इमा (these) द्रुतम् (quickly)
shambhu_gita::172.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::172.essence: Worldly knowledge arises swiftly only through sincere, focused effort.
shambhu_gita::172.simple_meaning: You can only gain worldly knowledge quickly by putting in dedicated effort in this world.
shambhu_gita::172.simple_insight: There’s power in honest effort to gain practical knowledge fast.
shambhu_gita::172.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that in the world, all practical knowledge is quickly attained only through focused, genuine effort. This acknowledges the importance of dedicated action before other states or knowledge can be reached.
shambhu_gita::172.modern_relevance: You’ve studied hard for a certification or skill—your effort is the surest way to get results fast.
shambhu_gita::172.insight: It teaches you to trust that sincere effort directly leads to practical learning and skills.

shambhu_gita::173.verse_sanskrit:
दुर्ज्ञेयैः पितरः ! किन्तु सूक्ष्मराज्यविभूतिभिः । 
पूर्णाऽधिदैवविद्याऽत्तिगुह्या दुर्जेयत्रैभवा ॥
shambhu_gita::173.verse_hindi: परन्तु हे पितृगण! दुर्गेय सूक्ष्म राज्य की विभूतियों से पूर्ण अधिदेव विद्या प्रतिगुह्य और दुर्गेय वैभवा है
