shambhu_gita::329.translation_literal: पुण्येन (by merit) महता (great) लभ्या (obtained) गतिः (course) शुक्ला (bright) स्वधाभुजः (portion of the ancestors) । अग्निज्योर्तिरहः (fire light day) शुक्लः (bright) षण्मासा (six months) उत्तरायणम् (northward movement) ॥
shambhu_gita::329.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::329.essence: Natural cycles divide time into meaningful phases connected to ancestral tradition.
shambhu_gita::329.simple_meaning: The verse describes four parts of a cycle related to ancestors: light, day, the bright half of the lunar month, and the six-month northward path of the sun.
shambhu_gita::329.simple_insight: Cycles of nature guide time and rituals, connecting us with those before us.
shambhu_gita::329.detailed_meaning: Suta explains to the sages the four divisions marking an important cycle in nature and ritual: the light, day, bright lunar half, and the six months when the sun moves north, which relates to ancestral rites.
shambhu_gita::329.insight: It shows how natural cycles shape spiritual and ritual time, grounding human life in cosmic rhythms.

shambhu_gita::330.verse_sanskrit:
चतुर्धा संविभक्तो हि क्रमः शुक्लगतेरयम् ।
अदोऽभिमानिनो देवा जीवाञ्च्छुक्लगतिं गतान् ॥
shambhu_gita::330.verse_hindi: जो शुक्लगति उग्र पुण्य से प्राप्त होती है । इनके अभिमानी देवतागण, इस गतिशील जीवों को स्वर्गलोक से
shambhu_gita::330.english_translation: The divine beings proud of their superior status regard those souls who have attained the white path of intense virtue as moving toward the higher realm.
shambhu_gita::330.translation_literal: चतुर्धा (fourfold) / संविभक्तो (divided) / हि (indeed) / क्रमः (path) / शुक्लगतेरयम् (of the white paths, others) / अदः (below) / अभिमानिनो (proud) / देवा (divine beings) / जीवाञ् (souls) / च (and) / शुक्लगतिं (white path) / गतान् (having gone)
shambhu_gita::330.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::330.essence: Prideful divine beings see virtuous souls as moving upward but remain attached to status.
shambhu_gita::330.simple_meaning: Some divine beings are proud and look at souls who follow the white path of virtue as moving toward the higher realm.
shambhu_gita::330.simple_insight: Pride can shape how beings view others' spiritual progress.
shambhu_gita::330.detailed_meaning: This verse describes how certain divine beings, proud of their status, view souls that have progressed along the white path of virtue, seeing them as moving upward toward a higher realm. It sets a context of hierarchical perspectives on spiritual movement but does not teach a universal principle alone.
shambhu_gita::330.insight: It highlights how pride can influence perception of others' growth, suggesting humility is needed in spiritual judgement.

shambhu_gita::331.verse_sanskrit:
उच्चैः स्वर्लोकतः पूर्व नीत्या लोकाननन्तरम् ।
आवागमनचक्रे हि शान्ते सत्यं नयन्त्यहो ॥
shambhu_gita::331.verse_hindi: उच्च लोकों में प्रथम पहुंचाकर तत्पश्चात् आवागमनचक्र के शान्त होने पर ही अहो ! सत्यलोक में पहुंचाते हैं
shambhu_gita::331.english_translation: After first reaching the highest realms, then, when the cycle of coming and going is at rest, one attains the realm of truth.
shambhu_gita::331.translation_literal: उच्चैः (highest) स्वर्लोकतः (from the heavenly realms) पूर्व (first) नीत्या (by leading) लोकाननन्तरम् (to other worlds after) आवागमनचक्रे (cycle of coming and going) हि (indeed) शान्ते (at rest) सत्यं (truth) नयन्त्यहो (they lead to)
shambhu_gita::331.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::331.essence: Ultimate truth comes only after restless cycles have ceased following higher attainments.
shambhu_gita::331.simple_meaning: One first reaches the highest worlds, then, only after the cycle of returning and going ends, does one enter the true realm.
shambhu_gita::331.simple_insight: True arrival happens only when restless cycles have fully stopped.
shambhu_gita::331.detailed_meaning: Suta describes the soul's journey after death: it first attains higher realms but only reaches the ultimate truth once the cycle of rebirth and return has ceased.
shambhu_gita::331.insight: It highlights that ultimate peace or truth comes only after cycles of reactivity and return end.

shambhu_gita::332.verse_sanskrit:
तत्र ते श्रेष्ठकर्माणः प्राणिनः सूर्य्यमण्डलम्।
विभिद्य प्राप्नुवन्त्येव मत्सायुज्यं न संशयः ॥
shambhu_gita::332.verse_hindi: वहां से सूर्यमण्डल भेदन करके वह श्रेष्ठकर्मा जीव निःसन्देह ही मत्सायुज्य को प्राप्त करते हैं।
shambhu_gita::332.english_translation: From there, beings who perform the highest actions pass through the solar sphere and undoubtedly attain union with the fish-born (Matsayujya).
shambhu_gita::332.translation_literal: तत्र (there) / ते (those) / श्रेष्ठकर्माणः (highest actions) / प्राणिनः (beings) / सूर्य्यमण्डलम् (solar sphere) / विभिद्य (passing through) / प्राप्नुवन्ति (attain) / एव (indeed) / मत्सायुज्यं (union with fish-born) / न (not) / संशयः (doubt)
shambhu_gita::332.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::332.essence: The highest actions lead beyond the solar realm to a certain sacred union.
shambhu_gita::332.simple_meaning: Those who perform the best actions pass beyond the solar sphere and certainly reach a special union called Matsayujya.
shambhu_gita::332.simple_insight: Doing your highest, purest actions opens a path beyond ordinary limits toward lasting connection.
shambhu_gita::332.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that beings who perform supreme actions cross beyond the solar sphere, symbolizing a spiritual boundary, and achieve Matsayujya, a sacred union representing a stage of liberation.
shambhu_gita::332.modern_relevance: When you fully commit to your highest efforts, you move beyond everyday limits toward a deeper sense of unity and purpose.
shambhu_gita::332.insight: It shows that pure, highest action moves you beyond visible limits to an elevated state of being.

shambhu_gita::333.verse_sanskrit:
सहजाया गतेरास्ते गतिरत्यन्तमद्धता ।
कश्चिन्नैवात्र सन्देहो विद्यते विश्वभूतिदाः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::333.verse_hindi: सहज गति की गति अति विलक्षण है हे पितृगण ! इसमें कोई भी सन्देह नहीं है
shambhu_gita::333.english_translation: The natural movement of the effortless path is supremely unique; there is no doubt about it, O ancestors of the world!
shambhu_gita::333.translation_literal: सहजाया (natural, effortless) गतेः (of the movement) रस्ते (path) गति (movement) अति (very) अन्तम् (end) अद्भता (uniqueness) । कश्चि (any) नैव (not at all) अत्र (here) सन्देहो (doubt) विद्यते (exists) विश्वभूतिदाः (O ancestors of the world) !
shambhu_gita::333.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::333.essence: The effortless natural path moves uniquely without any doubt.
shambhu_gita::333.simple_meaning: The natural, effortless way of moving through life is uniquely special and beyond doubt.
shambhu_gita::333.simple_insight: There's trust in the natural flow when effort feels effortless and perfectly right.
shambhu_gita::333.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, affirming that the natural, spontaneous path of progress is uniquely profound and unquestionable in its validity.
shambhu_gita::333.insight: It invites you to trust the effortless flow rather than force progress.

shambhu_gita::334.verse_sanskrit:
गति मे सहजामाप्ता भक्ताः कौलालचक्रवत ।
पिण्डं स्वं ज्ञानिनो नूनं जीवन्मुक्ता हि विभ्रति ॥
shambhu_gita::334.verse_hindi: सहज गति प्राप्त मेरे जीवन्मुक्त ज्ञानीभक्त कुलाल चक्रवत् अपने पिण्ड को निश्चय ही धारण करते हैं
shambhu_gita::334.english_translation: Those naturally established in the supreme path, like devoted potter-wheel workers, surely hold their own embodied self; truly, liberated beings with knowledge wander not.
shambhu_gita::334.translation_literal: गति (path) मे (in) सहजामाप्ता (naturally-attained) भक्ताः (devotees) कौलाल-चक्रवत (like potter's wheel) पिण्डं (embodied self) स्वं (own) ज्ञानिनो (of the knowledgeable) नूनं (certainly) जीवन्मुक्ता (liberated beings) हि (indeed) विभ्रति (wander)
shambhu_gita::334.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::334.essence: Natural devotion keeps the true self steady and free, like a potter's steady wheel.
shambhu_gita::334.simple_meaning: Those who reach devotion naturally hold their true self firmly and do not lose their freedom.
shambhu_gita::334.simple_insight: You gain steady belonging by settling naturally in devoted knowledge and freedom.
shambhu_gita::334.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes how beings who attain the supreme path naturally, like potters steady the wheel, hold their true embodied self firmly. These are liberated, knowledgeable devotees who no longer wander in confusion or reactivity.
shambhu_gita::334.modern_relevance: When your passion and trust flow naturally, like a skilled craft, you keep your sense of self steady amid life's changes.
shambhu_gita::334.insight: It teaches to cultivate devotion and wisdom as a natural, steady state that secures your true self.

shambhu_gita::335.verse_sanskrit:
शक्तेः कौलालचक्रस्य भ्रामिकाया लये सति ।
तद्धि चक्रं यथा सद्यः स्वयमेव प्रशाम्यति ॥
shambhu_gita::335.verse_hindi: जिस प्रकार कुलाल चक्र, भ्रमण कारिणी शक्ति के लय होने पर तत्काल ही स्वयं ही शान्त हो जाता है
shambhu_gita::335.english_translation: Just as the potter's wheel immediately stops spinning when the force that moves it ceases.
shambhu_gita::335.translation_literal: शक्तेः (of the force) कौलाल-चक्रस्य (potter's wheel) भ्रामिकाया (of the spinning) लये (when ceases) सति (exists) । तद्धि (that then) चक्रं (wheel) यथा (just as) सद्यः (immediately) स्वयमेव (by itself) प्रशाम्यति (becomes quiet) ॥
shambhu_gita::335.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::335.essence: Restlessness ends naturally when the driving force within disappears.
shambhu_gita::335.simple_meaning: When the energy or force that drives something stops, the movement also stops naturally without effort.
shambhu_gita::335.simple_insight: There is peace waiting when you release what drives your restless mind.
shambhu_gita::335.detailed_meaning: Shiva uses the example of a potter's spinning wheel, which stops instantly when the energy that turns it is removed, to explain how the mind’s agitation ends when its motivating force ceases.
shambhu_gita::335.modern_relevance: Your mind races like a wheel spinning fast. When you stop fueling anxious thoughts, calm arrives effortlessly.
shambhu_gita::335.insight: It shifts attention from struggling against restlessness to removing the cause of agitation itself.

shambhu_gita::336.verse_sanskrit:
नष्टे प्रारब्धजे पिण्डे जीवन्मुक्तास्तथैव मे ।
लीयन्ते ज्ञानिनो भक्ता ध्रुवं मय्येव भव्यदाः ॥
shambhu_gita::336.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण! उसी प्रकार मेरे जीवन्मुक्त भक्त प्रारब्ध जनित पिण्ड के नाश होने पर समुद्र में
shambhu_gita::336.english_translation: Just as the body born from past karma perishes, so do the liberated beings and devotees merge surely into me.
shambhu_gita::336.translation_literal: नष्टे (perishes) प्रारब्धजे (born of past karma) पिण्डे (body) जीवन्मुक्तास्तथैव (thus also liberated beings) मे (into me) लीयन्ते (merge) ज्ञानिनो (the wise) भक्ता (devotees) ध्रुवं (certainly) मय्येव (into me only) भव्यदाः (are destined)
shambhu_gita::336.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::336.essence: Freed from past karma, the true self merges fully with the divine presence.
shambhu_gita::336.simple_meaning: When the results of past actions end, liberated beings and devoted ones unite completely with Shiva.
shambhu_gita::336.simple_insight: There is freedom and certainty in knowing your true self is never lost but returns to the divine.
shambhu_gita::336.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that just as a body formed by past actions dissolves, similarly those who are liberated or devoted to him transcend past karma and merge fully with Shiva, affirming the final union of the true self with the divine.
shambhu_gita::336.modern_relevance: You’ve let go of old regrets and patterns that once controlled you, and now feel a deep, lasting connection to your true source.
shambhu_gita::336.insight: It teaches you that ending attachment to past consequences lets your true nature rejoin the divine presence.

shambhu_gita::337.verse_sanskrit:
आकाशपतिता वारिबिन्दवो बारिधाविय ।
वस्तुतः सहजामाप्ता जीवन्मुक्ता हि प्राणिनः ॥
shambhu_gita::337.verse_hindi: आकाश पतित वारिबिन्दु की भांति मुझमें ही निश्चय लय हो जाते हैं। वस्तुतः सहजगति प्राप्त ही जीवन्मुक्त जीव
shambhu_gita::337.english_translation: Like a raindrop fallen from the sky, I merge and dissolve within myself; indeed, beings who attain natural flow are truly liberated in life.
shambhu_gita::337.translation_literal: आकाशपतिता (fallen from sky) / वारिबिन्दवो (raindrop) / बारिधाविय (flowing, dissolving) / वस्तुतः (indeed) / सहजामाप्ता (naturally attained) / जीवन्मुक्ता (liberated in life) / हि (indeed) / प्राणिनः (beings)
shambhu_gita::337.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::337.essence: True freedom arises when you flow naturally and dissolve into your deeper being.
shambhu_gita::337.simple_meaning: When you surrender naturally, like a raindrop merging into water, you live freely and fully released.
shambhu_gita::337.simple_insight: There is peace in flowing without resistance into your true nature.
shambhu_gita::337.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that beings who reach effortless natural flow in life become truly liberated. Like a raindrop falling and merging seamlessly into the vast sky or water, surrender to the true self brings freedom.
shambhu_gita::337.modern_relevance: You feel stuck struggling against life’s flow, but letting go and moving with ease reconnects you to freedom.
shambhu_gita::337.insight: It teaches you to release resistance and merge naturally with your deeper self for freedom.

shambhu_gita::338.verse_sanskrit:
वासनायाः क्षये जाते तत्त्वज्ञानोदये सति ।
सार्द्धे मनोविनाशेन विमुक्ताः पूर्वमेव ते ॥
shambhu_gita::338.verse_hindi: वासनाक्षय, तत्त्वज्ञान लाभ और मनोनाश के साथ ही साथ पहले ही मुक्त हैं
shambhu_gita::338.english_translation: When desires have ended and true understanding has arisen, and the mind is also destroyed, then you are already liberated.
shambhu_gita::338.translation_literal: वासनायाः (of desires) क्षये (at destruction) जाते (having arisen) तत्त्वज्ञानोदये (at true knowledge arising) सति (when) । सार्धे (together) मनोविनाशेन (with mind destruction) विमुक्ताः (liberated) पूर्वमेव (already before) ते (you) ॥
shambhu_gita::338.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::338.essence: Freedom is already yours when desires end and the restless mind is stilled by true knowledge.
shambhu_gita::338.simple_meaning: Freedom comes when your desires disappear, your true understanding arises, and your restless mind is quieted.
shambhu_gita::338.simple_insight: There is peace in knowing freedom is already present when craving and mental noise cease.
shambhu_gita::338.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that liberation is not a distant goal but a state already attained when desires vanish, true knowledge arises, and the restless mind is destroyed. This verse reveals the deep link between desirelessness, wisdom, and mental stillness.
shambhu_gita::338.modern_relevance: You realize freedom when you stop chasing wants, gain clarity about what truly matters, and quiet your restless thoughts.
shambhu_gita::338.insight: It shifts the mind from craving and mental turbulence to calm understanding, revealing freedom is already here.

shambhu_gita::339.verse_sanskrit:
सहजां गतिमाप्तानां जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् ।
आवागमनचक्रं वै मृत्युलोके हि शाम्यति ॥
shambhu_gita::339.verse_hindi: आवागमन चक्र की शान्ति सहज गति प्राप्त जीवन्मुक्त के लिये मृत्युलोक में ही निश्चय होती है
shambhu_gita::339.english_translation: For those who have attained natural freedom, the cycle of coming and going ceases in the realm of death itself.
shambhu_gita::339.translation_literal: सहजां (natural) गतिमाप्तानां (having attained movement) जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् (to the great souls liberated in life) / आवागमनचक्रं (cycle of coming and going) वै (indeed) मृत्युलोके (in the realm of death) हि (certainly) शाम्यति (ceases)
shambhu_gita::339.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::339.essence: Natural liberation ends the cycle of rebirth before death arrives.
shambhu_gita::339.simple_meaning: Those who have naturally attained liberation no longer cycle through rebirth; they are free even before death.
shambhu_gita::339.simple_insight: Freedom can be alive in you now, not just after death.
shambhu_gita::339.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that souls who have reached natural, effortless liberation are no longer trapped in the endless cycle of rebirth and death. This freedom is realized here and now, not postponed until after death.
shambhu_gita::339.modern_relevance: You might feel stuck repeating the same struggles, but freedom can come now, breaking the cycle before life ends.
shambhu_gita::339.insight: It teaches you to understand liberation as a present state, not a future event after death.

shambhu_gita::340.verse_sanskrit:
शुक्लां गतिमवाप्तानां सतां प्रारब्धशालिनाम् । 
सूर्यमण्डलसम्भेदकाले चक्रन्तु शाम्यति ॥
shambhu_gita::340.verse_hindi: और शुक्ल गति प्राप्त प्रारब्धवान् महापुरुषों के लिये सूर्यमण्डल भेदन करते समय होती है
shambhu_gita::340.english_translation: For noble beings who have attained the pure path, the sun's passage through the zodiac brings calm.
shambhu_gita::340.translation_literal: शुक्लां (pure) गतिम् (path) अवाप्तानां (attained) सतां (of noble beings) प्रारब्धशालिनाम् (those with ripened fate) । सूर्यमण्डलसम्भेदकाले (at the time of sun crossing zodiac) चक्रन्तु (may they revolve) शाम्यति (calm) ॥
shambhu_gita::340.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::340.essence: The sun's movement calms those whose path is ripened and pure.
shambhu_gita::340.simple_meaning: Noble people who have reached a pure path experience calm when the sun passes through the zodiac.
shambhu_gita::340.simple_insight: Certain moments bring natural calm to those who are ready and steady.
shambhu_gita::340.detailed_meaning: Suta describes a moment when noble beings, whose past actions have matured, experience calmness as the sun moves through the zodiac. This sets a peaceful mood but does not teach a standalone principle.
shambhu_gita::340.insight: Recognize that some periods naturally support inner calm, especially for those prepared by steady effort.

shambhu_gita::341.verse_sanskrit:
पितरो वर्णयित्वैता जीवानां त्रिविधा गती ।
साम्प्रतं जीवपिण्डानां गतीर्वो वर्णयाम्यहम् ॥
shambhu_gita::341.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! इन जीव की विविध गतियों का वर्णन करके अब मैं जीवपिण्ड की गतियां जिनके साथ आपलोगों के अधिकार का
shambhu_gita::341.english_translation: O ancestors, having described the threefold paths of living beings, now I describe the paths of the individual beings over whom you have authority.
shambhu_gita::341.translation_literal: पितरो (ancestors) / वर्णयित्वैता (having described by these) / जीवानां (of living beings) / त्रिविधा (threefold) / गती (paths). / साम्प्रतं (now) / जीवपिण्डानां (of individual beings) / गतीः (paths) / वः (your) / वर्णयामि (I describe) / अहम् (I).
shambhu_gita::341.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::341.essence: A new detailed description of individual beings' paths begins after broad categories.
shambhu_gita::341.simple_meaning: After explaining the three kinds of paths for living beings, now the speaker will explain the paths of individual beings under ancestral authority.
shambhu_gita::341.simple_insight: Introducing a new explanation invites attention to deeper details about individual paths.
shambhu_gita::341.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, having explained the three broad paths of living beings, now beginning to describe the specific paths of individual beings related to them, setting the stage for more detailed teachings.
shambhu_gita::341.insight: This verse signals a shift from general to specific teachings about the nature of individual beings and their paths.

shambhu_gita::342.verse_sanskrit:
मुख्यं सम्बध्यते याभिर्भवतामधिकारिता ।
सावधानैर्भवद्भिस्ताः श्रूयन्तां वै स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::342.verse_hindi: प्रधान सम्बन्ध है उनका वर्णन आप लोगो से करता हूँ, हे पितृगण! आपलोग इनको सावधान होकर ही सुनें
shambhu_gita::342.english_translation: The main connection is described by me to you all, O ancestors! Listen carefully and attentively.
shambhu_gita::342.translation_literal: मुख्यं (main) सम्बध्यते (is connected) याभिः (by which) भवताम् (of you all) अधिकारिता (the chief) । सावधानैः (with care) भवद्भिः (by you) ताः (those) श्रूयन्तां (let them be heard) वै (indeed) स्वधाभुजः (O ancestors) !
shambhu_gita::342.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::342.essence: Important teachings require careful and attentive listening.
shambhu_gita::342.simple_meaning: I am explaining the most important connection to you, respected ancestors. Please listen carefully and attentively.
shambhu_gita::342.simple_insight: There is respect and seriousness in how important teachings are shared.
shambhu_gita::342.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses the assembled ancestors and sages, preparing them for an important teaching by asking them to listen carefully. This sets the tone for a serious discourse.
shambhu_gita::342.insight: It highlights the value of careful attention before receiving important knowledge.

shambhu_gita::343.verse_sanskrit:
जीवानां जीवभावाय जीवपिण्डप्रधानता।
सदसत्कर्मणां भोगो बिना पिण्डं न सम्भवेत् ॥
shambhu_gita::343.verse_hindi: जीवों के जीवत्व के लिये जीवपिण्ड की प्रधानता है क्योंकि बिना पिण्ड के सत् असत् कर्म का फलभोग असम्भव है
shambhu_gita::343.english_translation: For the life of beings, the body is primary because without the body, experiencing the results of true and false actions is impossible.
shambhu_gita::343.translation_literal: जीवानां (of beings) जीवभावाय (for life) जीवपिण्डप्रधानता (priority of body) सदसत्कर्मणां (of true and false actions) भोगो (experience) बिना (without) पिण्डं (body) न (not) सम्भवेत् (possible)
shambhu_gita::343.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::343.essence: Life depends on the body to experience the results of every action.
shambhu_gita::343.simple_meaning: Your physical body is essential for experiencing the consequences of your actions, good or bad.
shambhu_gita::343.simple_insight: You feel grounded knowing your body connects you to your actions’ effects.
shambhu_gita::343.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva explains that living beings rely on their physical bodies to experience the outcomes of their actions, whether positive or negative. Without the body, these experiences cannot happen, highlighting the body’s importance in life’s purpose.
shambhu_gita::343.modern_relevance: When you reflect on a tough decision, your body’s reactions show you the real impact of your choices.
shambhu_gita::343.insight: Recognize your body as the necessary link to understand how your efforts shape your experience.

shambhu_gita::344.verse_sanskrit:
कर्मस्वातन्त्र्यलाभेऽपि यतस्तन्मुख्यताऽस्ति हि ।
जैवैशसहजानां हि सर्वेषामेव कर्मणाम् ॥
shambhu_gita::344.verse_hindi: और कर्म करने की स्वाधीनता प्राप्ति में भी जीवपिण्ड का प्राधान्य है चाहे जैव कर्म हो चाहे ऐश कर्म हो
shambhu_gita::344.english_translation: Even in gaining freedom to act, the living being's prominence is evident in all actions, whether natural or subtle.
shambhu_gita::344.translation_literal: कर्मस्वातन्त्र्यलाभेऽपि (even in gaining freedom of action) यतस्तन्मुख्यताऽस्ति (that to which is the prominence) हि (indeed) । जैवैशसहजानां (of natural and subtle) हि (indeed) सर्वेषामेव (of all) कर्मणाम् (actions) ॥
shambhu_gita::344.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::344.essence: Freedom to act always depends on the living being present in every kind of action.
shambhu_gita::344.simple_meaning: Your ability to act freely still depends on the living being that underlies every action, whether obvious or subtle.
shambhu_gita::344.simple_insight: You feel the living being is always at the heart of your freedom to act.
shambhu_gita::344.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that even when you gain freedom to act, it is the living being—the basic life principle—that remains central to all actions, whether those arise naturally or through subtle influences.
shambhu_gita::344.modern_relevance: You might feel fully independent in your choices, yet your deeper being always shapes how and why you act.
shambhu_gita::344.insight: Recognize that freedom to act is never separate from your deeper life essence guiding those actions.

shambhu_gita::345.verse_sanskrit:
साहाय्याज्जीवपिण्डानामेव भोगः प्रजायते ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यों भवद्भिः पितृपुङ्गवाः !॥
shambhu_gita::345.verse_hindi: और चाहे सहज कर्म हो सबका ही जीव पिण्ड की सहायता से ही भोग होता है, हे पितृगण ! इस विषय में आपलोगों को विस्मय नहीं ही करना चाहिये
shambhu_gita::345.english_translation: Even natural actions produce enjoyment only through the support of the living body; O revered ancestors, you should not be surprised by this.
shambhu_gita::345.translation_literal: साहाय्याज्जीवपिण्डानामेव (only by support of the living body) भोगः (enjoyment) प्रजायते (is produced). नैवात्र (not here) विस्मयः (surprise) कार्यों (in this) भवद्भिः (by you) पितृपुङ्गवाः (O revered ancestors) ।
shambhu_gita::345.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::345.essence: Your experiences arise only through your living body's support; this is natural, not surprising.
shambhu_gita::345.simple_meaning: Everything you experience, even natural actions, happens through the support of your living body. There is no reason to be surprised by this.
shambhu_gita::345.simple_insight: There is calm in knowing your experiences are grounded in your living body’s support.
shambhu_gita::345.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the revered ancestors, explaining that all enjoyment, even from natural actions, arises through the living body’s support. This teaching reassures that nothing unusual or surprising happens beyond this natural dependence.
shambhu_gita::345.modern_relevance: You notice how your feelings and pleasures arise only when your body is alive and functioning—nothing mysterious beyond that.
shambhu_gita::345.insight: It shifts your view to see enjoyment as dependent on physical life’s support, reducing confusion about experience.

shambhu_gita::346.verse_sanskrit:
सहजो मानवो दैवो जीवपिण्डविधा मतः ।
मर्त्येभ्यश्चतरे निम्ना भूतसङ्घाश्चतुर्विधाः ॥
shambhu_gita::346.verse_hindi: सहज मानव और दैव रूप से जीव पिण्ड त्रिविध होता है, सहजपिण्ड वह ही हैं जिनके द्वारा मनुष्यों से इतर निम्न श्रेणी के चतुर्विध भूतसंघ
shambhu_gita::346.english_translation: The living being is naturally threefold: human, divine, and embodied life; among mortals, there are four lower classes of beings.
shambhu_gita::346.translation_literal: सहजो (natural) / मानवो (human) / दैवो (divine) / जीवपिण्डविधा (living being types) / मतः (is considered) / । / मृत्येभ्यः (among mortals) / चतरे (four) / निम्ना (lower) / भूतसङ्घाः (groups of beings) / चतुर्विधाः (four types) / ॥
shambhu_gita::346.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::346.essence: Life naturally divides into human, divine, and lower embodied forms.
shambhu_gita::346.simple_meaning: Living beings exist in three natural categories: human, divine, and embodied forms; within mortals, there are four lower groups of beings.
shambhu_gita::346.simple_insight: Life unfolds in layers from divine to human to lesser forms around us.
shambhu_gita::346.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes the natural classification of all living existence into three main types—human beings, divine beings, and embodied life forms. Among the mortal realm, four lower groups of beings exist, marking a hierarchy of life forms.
shambhu_gita::346.insight: Recognizing multiple levels of life shifts your view from self-centered to broader respect for all forms.

shambhu_gita::347.verse_sanskrit:
यैस्तु कर्मफलं पिण्डैर्भुञ्जते सहजा हि ते ।
मर्त्योपयुक्तपिण्डा हि कथ्यन्ते मानवाभिधाः ॥
shambhu_gita::347.verse_hindi: कर्मफल भोग करते हैं। मनुष्य के उपयोगी पिण्डों को मानवपिण्ड कहते हैं
shambhu_gita::347.english_translation: Those who enjoy the fruits of their actions are naturally so; the bodies useful to mortals are called human bodies.
shambhu_gita::347.translation_literal:
यैः (by whom) तु (indeed) कर्मफलम् (fruits of actions) पिण्डैः (by bodies) भुञ्जते (enjoy) सहजा (naturally) हि (indeed) ते (they) ।
मर्त्य (mortal) उपयुक्त (useful) पिण्डा (bodies) हि (indeed) कथ्यन्ते (are called) मानवाभिधाः (human called) ॥
shambhu_gita::347.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::347.essence: Your human body naturally experiences the results of your actions.
shambhu_gita::347.simple_meaning: You experience the results of your actions naturally through your human body, which is suited for mortal life.
shambhu_gita::347.simple_insight: Your body is the natural place where you experience what your actions bring.
shambhu_gita::347.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the human body is the natural and useful vehicle through which people experience the consequences of their actions, linking physical existence with karma.
shambhu_gita::347.modern_relevance: When you feel tired or joyful, remember your body is where your actions' results show up and shape your experience.
shambhu_gita::347.insight: Recognize your body as the natural medium where the outcomes of your actions unfold without resistance.

shambhu_gita::348.verse_sanskrit:
देवपिण्डाश्च ये व्याप्ता भुवनानि चतुर्दश।
वर्तन्ते पितरो दैव-भोगायतनरूपिणः ॥
shambhu_gita::348.verse_hindi: और हे पितृगण ! चतुर्दश भुवनस्थित देव भोगायतनरूप जो पिण्ड हैं वे देवपिण्ड कहलाते हैं
shambhu_gita::348.english_translation: O ancestors! The divine bodies that pervade the fourteen worlds are called divine bodies and serve as the abode for divine enjoyment.
shambhu_gita::348.translation_literal: देवपिण्डाश्च (divine bodies also) ये (which) व्याप्ता (pervade) भुवनानि (worlds) चतुर्दश (fourteen) । वर्तन्ते (exist) पितरो (ancestors) दैव-भोगायतनरूपिणः (in the form of divine enjoyment abodes) ॥
shambhu_gita::348.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::348.essence: Divine bodies pervade all fourteen worlds as abodes for divine enjoyment.
shambhu_gita::348.simple_meaning: The ancestors explain that the divine bodies pervading the fourteen worlds are forms where divine beings enjoy their existence.
shambhu_gita::348.simple_insight: Recognizing the divine presence throughout all worlds expands connection beyond the visible.
shambhu_gita::348.detailed_meaning: Suta describes to the sages how the ancestors (Pitrs) exist as divine bodies spread through fourteen realms, serving as places for divine enjoyment, revealing cosmological aspects of divine presence.
shambhu_gita::348.insight: It invites seeing all existence as permeated by divine forms, deepening respect for the natural and unseen realms.

shambhu_gita::349.verse_sanskrit:
त्रिविधा एव नन्वेते वर्तन्ते पाञ्चभौतिकाः ।
उपादानेषु किन्त्वेषां प्रभेदो वर्तते महान् ॥
shambhu_gita::349.verse_hindi: यह तीनों पिण्ड ही निश्चय पाञ्चभौतिक हैं परन्तु इनके उपादान में महान् प्रभेद है
shambhu_gita::349.english_translation: These three bodies are indeed composed of the five great elements, but there is a significant difference in their material cause.
shambhu_gita::349.translation_literal: त्रिविधा (threefold) एव (indeed) नन्वेते (are known) वर्तन्ते (exist) पाञ्चभौतिकाः (composed of five elements) । उपादानेषु (in material causes) किन्त्वेषां (however, their) प्रभेदो (difference) वर्तते (exists) महान् (great) ॥
shambhu_gita::349.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::349.essence: Three bodies share elements but differ deeply in their material cause.
shambhu_gita::349.simple_meaning: Three types of bodies all consist of the five elements but differ greatly in what material they are made from.
shambhu_gita::349.simple_insight: Understanding subtle differences in what makes up things reveals deeper truths beyond surface appearances.
shambhu_gita::349.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that though three bodies share the same elemental nature, their fundamental material causes differ greatly, pointing to a profound philosophical distinction in their nature.
shambhu_gita::349.insight: It teaches you to look beyond appearances and recognize important differences in the foundation of things.

shambhu_gita::350.verse_sanskrit:
रातिभिः सहनाभिर्वे पिण्डास्ते सहजाभिधाः।
निर्मीयन्त उपादानैः पार्थिवैरेव केवलैः ॥
shambhu_gita::350.verse_hindi: सहजपिण्ड केवल पार्थिव उपादानो से ही सहज रीति से ही निर्मित होते हैं।
shambhu_gita::350.english_translation: The natural bodies arise simply from earthly elements combined effortlessly.
shambhu_gita::350.translation_literal: रातिभिः (by passions) / सहनाभिः (with endurance) / वे (they) / पिण्डास्ते (bodies) / सहजाभिधाः (naturally named) / निर्मीयन्त (are formed) / उपादानैः (from causes) / पार्थिवैरेव (only earthly enemies) / केवलैः (alone)
shambhu_gita::350.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::350.essence: Physical bodies arise naturally from earthly elements without complexity.
shambhu_gita::350.simple_meaning: Bodies form naturally from earthly materials through basic natural processes.
shambhu_gita::350.simple_insight: The physical form is a simple product of natural elements and forces.
shambhu_gita::350.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that physical bodies arise spontaneously from the combination of earthly elements, emphasizing the natural and effortless process behind bodily existence.
shambhu_gita::350.insight: It shifts focus from mystical origins to the natural world as the basis of physical form.

shambhu_gita::351.verse_sanskrit:
सूक्ष्मैदैवैरुपादानैयथायोग्याधिकारतः।
निर्मीयन्ते न सन्देहो देवाः पिण्डाः पृथग्विधाः ॥
shambhu_gita::351.verse_hindi: नानाविध दैवीपिण्ड सूक्ष्मदैवी उपादानों से यथायोग्य अधिकारानुसार निःसन्देह निर्मित होते हैं
shambhu_gita::351.english_translation: Various subtle divine elements are undoubtedly created from subtler divine components according to their proper function.
shambhu_gita::351.translation_literal: सूक्ष्मैदैवैर् (by subtle divine) उपादानैः (components) यथायोग्य (according to proper) अधिकारतः (function) निर्मीयन्ते (are created) न (not) सन्देहो (doubt) देवाः (divine beings) पिण्डाः (bodies) पृथग्विधाः (various kinds)
shambhu_gita::351.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::351.essence: Subtle divine parts create diverse divine forms without doubt, each by its proper function.
shambhu_gita::351.simple_meaning: The divine forms arise naturally and surely from finer divine parts, each fulfilling its proper role.
shambhu_gita::351.simple_insight: There is assurance in knowing everything arises from fitting causes in perfect order.
shambhu_gita::351.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that all divine forms come from subtle divine components, each created according to its rightful function. This reveals a natural order behind creation, affirming no randomness or doubt in how divine bodies emerge.
shambhu_gita::351.modern_relevance: When you see complex things around you, remember they come from smaller parts working rightly together, offering trust in natural processes.
shambhu_gita::351.insight: It teaches you to recognize the natural, ordered emergence of complexity from subtle causes, reducing confusion about origins.

shambhu_gita::352.verse_sanskrit:
प्रकृत्याऽलौकिकी दैवी शक्तिस्तत्र विराजते ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कश्चित्संशयो वा विधीयताम् ॥
shambhu_gita::352.verse_hindi: क्योंकि उनमें लोकातीत दैवी शक्ति को विकास स्वभाविक रूप से विद्यमान रहता है, इस विषय में कोई विस्मय अथवा संशय नहीं कर सकते
shambhu_gita::352.english_translation: Because in them the transcendental divine power naturally resides, there can be no wonder or doubt about it.
shambhu_gita::352.translation_literal: प्रकृत्या (by nature) / अलौकिकी (transcendental) / दैवी (divine) / शक्तिः (power) / तत्र (there) / विराजते (resides) / नैव (not at all) / अत्र (here) / विस्मयः (wonder) / कश्चित् (anyone) / संशयः (doubt) / वा (or) / विधीयताम् (should arise)
shambhu_gita::352.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::352.essence: Some beings naturally embody a higher power beyond ordinary reality without doubt.
shambhu_gita::352.simple_meaning: Some beings naturally have a special divine power that is beyond the physical world. No one should be surprised or doubtful about this.
shambhu_gita::352.simple_insight: It feels certain and natural that some powers exceed normal experience.
shambhu_gita::352.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that certain beings possess a divine power that transcends normal reality. This power is natural for them, so no one should feel surprise or doubt about its presence.
shambhu_gita::352.insight: It shifts the mind from skepticism to acceptance of extraordinary natural qualities in some beings.

shambhu_gita::353.verse_sanskrit:
भवद्विशिष्टसाहाय्यालब्धानां किन्तु भूतिदाः!।
पिण्डानां मानवीयानां वैलक्षण्यं किमप्यहो ॥
shambhu_gita::353.verse_hindi: परन्तु हे पितृगण ! आपलोगों की विशेष सहायता से प्राप्त जो मानव पिण्ड है अहो ! उनकी विचित्रता कुछ और ही है
shambhu_gita::353.english_translation: But O ancestors, the human embodiment obtained through your special help has a unique distinctiveness indeed.
shambhu_gita::353.translation_literal: भवद् (your) / विशिष्ट (special) / सहाय्य (help) / अलब्धानां (obtained) / किन्तु (but) / भूतिदाः (those who give prosperity) / पिण्डानां (of bodies) / मानवीयानां (human) / वैलक्षण्यं (distinctiveness) / किमपि (some) / अहो (indeed)
shambhu_gita::353.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::353.essence: The human form gained with special help has a unique and remarkable nature.
shambhu_gita::353.simple_meaning: The human body gained through your special support has a remarkable, unique nature.
shambhu_gita::353.simple_insight: There is something special and unusual about the human form that sets it apart.
shambhu_gita::353.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses the ancestors, highlighting that the human body provided through their special aid has a distinct, remarkable quality, setting it apart from others, preparing for deeper explanation.
shambhu_gita::353.insight: It invites reflection on the special potential and uniqueness of human life supported by ancestral and cosmic forces.

shambhu_gita::354.verse_sanskrit:
एते शक्तिविशेषाणां वर्तन्ते पितरो ध्रुवम् ।
आकर्षणोपयोगित्वाचतुर्वर्गफलप्रदाः ॥
shambhu_gita::354.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! वे विशेष शक्तियों के आकर्षण के उपयोगी होने से ही चतुर्वर्गफलप्रद हैं
shambhu_gita::354.english_translation: O ancestors, these special powers exist because their attraction is useful and they grant the fourfold benefits.
shambhu_gita::354.translation_literal: एते (these) शक्तिविशेषाणां (special powers') वर्तन्ते (exist) पितरो (ancestors) ध्रुवम् (certainly) । आकर्षणोपयोगित्वात् (because of attraction's usefulness) चतुर्वर्गफलप्रदाः (giving fourfold benefits) ॥
shambhu_gita::354.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::354.essence: Special powers persist because their attraction benefits the four social groups.
shambhu_gita::354.simple_meaning: Certain special powers exist because their attractive use brings the fourfold benefits to society.
shambhu_gita::354.simple_insight: Special qualities gain value through their usefulness and benefit to others.
shambhu_gita::354.detailed_meaning: Suta explains to the sages that the ancestors possess special powers. These powers endure because their attractive qualities serve a purpose, bringing the benefits of the four social classes.
shambhu_gita::354.insight: Understanding that abilities or qualities are sustained by their usefulness shifts focus from status to service.

shambhu_gita::355.verse_sanskrit:
निःश्रेयंसफलोत्पन्नकारिणो विटपस्य हि। .
मानवीयो हि पिण्डोऽयं बीजमास्ते न संशयः ॥
shambhu_gita::355.verse_hindi: यह मानवपिण्ड ही निःश्रेयस फल उत्पन्नकारी वृक्ष का ही निसन्देह बीजस्वरूप है
shambhu_gita::355.english_translation: This human body is undoubtedly the seed that produces the tree bearing the highest good.
shambhu_gita::355.translation_literal: निःश्रेयंसफलोत्पन्नकारिणो (highest good fruit producing) / विटपस्य (of the tree) / हि (indeed) / मानवीयो (human) / हि (indeed) / पिण्डोऽयं (this body) / बीजमास्ते (is the seed) / न (not) / संशयः (doubt)
shambhu_gita::355.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::355.essence: Your human body is the seed that grows your highest good.
shambhu_gita::355.simple_meaning: Your human body is the essential seed that grows into your highest good or ultimate benefit.
shambhu_gita::355.simple_insight: Your life holds the potential to grow into something truly valuable and meaningful.
shambhu_gita::355.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva reveals that the human body is not just flesh but the seed that can grow into the highest good — the ultimate purpose or benefit. This moment highlights human potential to choose and act toward that highest outcome.
shambhu_gita::355.modern_relevance: You wake up feeling ordinary, but every choice you make plants seeds toward your greatest potential.
shambhu_gita::355.insight: It shifts your view of the body from mere form to a powerful source of potential and purpose.

shambhu_gita::356.verse_sanskrit:
एतनिःश्रेयस नूनं वर्तते देवदुर्लभम् ।
यस्मान्न पुनरावृत्तिस्तन्नि:श्रेयसमुच्यते ॥
shambhu_gita::356.verse_hindi: यह निःश्रेयस देवताओं के लिये भी दुर्लभ है, जिससे पुनरावृत्ति न हो उसको निःश्रेयस कहते हैं
shambhu_gita::356.english_translation: True highest good is indeed rare even for the radiant beings; that from which there is no return is called the highest good.
shambhu_gita::356.translation_literal: एतनिःश्रेयस (this highest good) / नूनं (indeed) / वर्तते (exists) / देवदुर्लभम् (rare even for the radiant beings) / यस्मात् (from which) / न (not) / पुनरावृत्ति (return) / तन्म् (that) / निःश्रेयसम् (highest good) / उच्यते (is called)
shambhu_gita::356.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::356.essence: The highest good means reaching a state with no return to lower existence.
shambhu_gita::356.simple_meaning: The highest good is very rare, even for radiant beings, because it means reaching a state from which you never return.
shambhu_gita::356.simple_insight: There is deep value in reaching a state where you no longer fall back into old patterns.
shambhu_gita::356.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that the highest good is extremely rare, even for divine beings, because it represents a state beyond any return to lesser conditions, emphasizing ultimate freedom.
shambhu_gita::356.modern_relevance: You know a breakthrough is real when it changes you so deeply you don’t fall back into old habits.
shambhu_gita::356.insight: It shifts your aim from temporary gains to lasting transformation with no fallback.

shambhu_gita::357.verse_sanskrit:
पिण्डानां मानवीयानां मुख्यत्वे पितरो ध्रुवम् ।
भवन्तो हेतवस्सन्ति प्रधाना नात्र संशयः ॥
shambhu_gita::357.verse_hindi: मानव पिण्डो के प्राधान्य के विषय में हे पितृगण! आपलोग ही प्रधान कारण हैं, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
shambhu_gita::357.english_translation: O ancestral beings, you are surely the primary cause of the human body’s existence.
shambhu_gita::357.translation_literal: पिण्डानां (of bodies) / मानवीयानां (human) / मुख्यत्वे (in primacy) / पितरो (ancestors) / ध्रुवम् (certainly) / भवन्तो (you are) / हेतवः (causes) / सन्ति (are) / प्रधाना (primary) / नत्र (there is no) / संशयः (doubt)
shambhu_gita::357.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::357.essence: Ancestors are undeniably the primary cause of the human body’s existence.
shambhu_gita::357.simple_meaning: The ancestors are acknowledged as the definite primary cause behind the human body’s existence.
shambhu_gita::357.simple_insight: There is certainty in recognizing the ancestors as the root cause of human life.
shambhu_gita::357.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the narrator addresses the ancestral beings (Pitṛs), affirming their unquestioned role as the primary cause of the human body’s formation and existence within the cosmic order.
shambhu_gita::357.insight: It clarifies the foundational role of lineage and continuity in the formation of human life.

shambhu_gita::358.verse_sanskrit:
महत्वद्योतकं नूनमेतदेवास्ति वो यतः।
अतोऽदास्मरणादेव मनुष्याणां क्रमोन्नतौ ॥
shambhu_gita::358.verse_hindi: क्योंकि यही आपलोगो का निश्चय महत्त्व सूचक है इस कारण इसको स्मरण रखने से ही आपलोग मनुष्यों की क्रमोन्नति में और
shambhu_gita::358.english_translation: Because this is your firm conviction indicating importance, remembering it alone advances humans' progress.
shambhu_gita::358.translation_literal: महत्वद्योतकं (indicating importance) / नूनम् (indeed) / एतत् (this) / एव (alone) / अस्ति (is) / वः (your) / यतः (because) / अतोऽदास्मरणादेव (therefore by remembering only) / मनुष्याणां (of humans) / क्रमोन्नतौ (progress in rank)
shambhu_gita::358.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::358.essence: Firm conviction about what matters drives human progress.
shambhu_gita::358.simple_meaning: Your firm belief about what is important shapes your progress in life.
shambhu_gita::358.simple_insight: Confidence in what matters fuels your steady growth.
shambhu_gita::358.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that a clear, firm conviction about what is important acts as a guide. Remembering this conviction is what helps humans move forward in their development.
shambhu_gita::358.modern_relevance: You face a tough choice; holding firm to what truly matters keeps you moving ahead despite distractions.
shambhu_gita::358.insight: It teaches you to focus on what you deeply believe to be important, making progress natural and steady.

shambhu_gita::359.verse_sanskrit:
सहैतु रक्षितुं सृष्टे: सामञ्जस्यं तथा क्षमाः।
यूयमेवाऽनं कर्तव्ये धन्या भवितुमर्हथ ॥
shambhu_gita::359.verse_hindi: सहेतुक सृष्टि सामज की रक्षा करने में समर्थ होते हुए इस कर्त्तव्य में धन्य हो सकते हैं।
shambhu_gita::359.english_translation: Those who endure and protect harmony in creation become truly blessed in their duty.
shambhu_gita::359.translation_literal: सहैतु (to endure) / रक्षितुं (to protect) / सृष्टे: (of creation) / सामञ्जस्यं (harmony) / तथा (also) / क्षमाः (able) / यूयमेव (you yourselves) / अने (in this) / कर्तव्ये (duty) / धन्या (blessed) / भवितुमर्हथ (deserve to become)
shambhu_gita::359.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::359.essence: Enduring challenges to protect harmony in your duty brings true blessing.
shambhu_gita::359.simple_meaning: You are blessed when you can patiently endure challenges and protect harmony within your duty.
shambhu_gita::359.simple_insight: There's strength and honor in patiently maintaining balance and fulfilling your role.
shambhu_gita::359.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that those who patiently endure difficulties and protect harmony in the created world fulfill their immediate duties well and become blessed for it.
shambhu_gita::359.modern_relevance: You stay calm and steady while resolving conflicts in a team, preserving peace and balance, and feel honored for your effort.
shambhu_gita::359.insight: It teaches you to embrace patience and active protection as noble ways to fulfill your role.

shambhu_gita::360.verse_sanskrit:
जीवसृष्टिरहस्येषु मानवानाञ्च किंविधम् ।
जन्ममृत्युगतं गुह्यं वैलक्षण्यं हि वर्तते ॥
shambhu_gita::360.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण! जीव सृष्टि रहस्यों में मनुष्यों के जन्म मृत्यु की कैसी गुह्य विचित्रता है सो अभी कहता हूँ
shambhu_gita::360.english_translation: O ancestors! Among the mysteries of creation, the secret and wondrous cycle of human birth and death exists.
shambhu_gita::360.translation_literal: जीवसृष्टि (creation of beings) रहस्येषु (among mysteries) मानवानाञ्च (and humans) किंविधम् (what kind) । जन्ममृत्युगतं (birth and death cycle) गुह्यं (secret) वैलक्षण्यं (wonder) हि (indeed) वर्तते (exists) ॥
shambhu_gita::360.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::360.essence: The human cycle of birth and death is a secret wonder within creation.
shambhu_gita::360.simple_meaning: There is a mysterious and unique cycle of human birth and death within the secrets of creation.
shambhu_gita::360.simple_insight: The cycle of life and death holds a hidden wonder beyond ordinary understanding.
shambhu_gita::360.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, revealing that within the mysteries of creation lies a special and secret aspect: the human cycle of birth and death, which carries a unique and wondrous nature.
shambhu_gita::360.insight: It invites you to recognize the profound mystery behind human existence beyond surface appearances.

shambhu_gita::361.verse_sanskrit:
पितरः ! तद्रवीम्यद्य श्रूयतां सुसमाहितै:।
कोष: प्राणमयोऽस्त्यस्य साहाय्यात्पितरो ध्रुवम् ॥
shambhu_gita::361.verse_hindi: सुसमाहित होकर सुनो। हे पितृगण! प्राणमय कोष की सहायता से ही
shambhu_gita::361.english_translation: Listen carefully, ancestors! The vital sheath is always supported by the ancestors.
shambhu_gita::361.translation_literal: पितरः (ancestors) ! तद्रवीम्यद्य (today, carefully) श्रूयतां (listen) सुसमाहितै: (with calm mind) । कोष: (sheath) प्राणमयोऽस्त्यस्य (vital-energy-filled) साहाय्यात्पितरो (by the ancestors' help) ध्रुवम् (certainly) ॥
shambhu_gita::361.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::361.essence: The vital life energy is sustained through ancestral support.
shambhu_gita::361.simple_meaning: The ancestors are addressed to listen carefully, as the vital energy sheath depends on them for support.
shambhu_gita::361.simple_insight: You realize the vital life force connects deeply with those who came before.
shambhu_gita::361.detailed_meaning: The narrator calls the ancestors to attentively hear that the vital sheath of life is sustained by their support, highlighting the connection between life energy and ancestral presence.
shambhu_gita::361.insight: It highlights the subtle support systems sustaining life beyond immediate perception.

shambhu_gita::362.verse_sanskrit:
देव्याः शाक्तेर्विकाशस्य देवानामासनस्य वा।
उपयोगी जायतेऽसावावर्तः पीठ उच्यते ॥
shambhu_gita::362.verse_hindi: दैवीशक्ति के विकास के अथवा देवताओं के आसन के उपयोगी जो आवर्त बनता है उसको पीठ कहते हैं
shambhu_gita::362.english_translation: The seat formed for the development of the divine power or for the resting place of the deities is called the base.
shambhu_gita::362.translation_literal: देव्याः (of the divine power) / शाक्तेः (of Shakti) / विकाशस्य (of development) / देवानाम् (of the deities) / आसनस्य (of seat) / वा (or) / उपयोगी (useful) / जायते (arises) / असौ (that) / आवर्तः (circle, base) / पीठ (seat) / उच्यते (is called)
shambhu_gita::362.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::362.essence: A base is the foundation for divine energy or deities’ resting place.
shambhu_gita::362.simple_meaning: A base or foundation is the place made for the growth of divine power or where the deities rest.
shambhu_gita::362.simple_insight: Foundations support growth and presence, even for powerful energies.
shambhu_gita::362.detailed_meaning: Suta describes the concept of a 'base' as a foundation formed either for the expansion of divine energy or as the resting place for deities, explaining a key term in spiritual practice and symbolism.
shambhu_gita::362.insight: It clarifies that spiritual power and presence need a stable foundation or support to manifest.

shambhu_gita::363.verse_sanskrit:
स्वाभाविक्यस्वभावा वा पाठस्योत्पादनाय या ।
विधीयते क्रिया सम्यक् सत्सकौशलपूरिता ॥
shambhu_gita::363.verse_hindi: पीठ के उत्पन्न करने के लिये जो स्वाभाविक या अस्वाभाविक सत्सुकौशल पूर्ण क्रिया सम्यक रूप से की जाती है
shambhu_gita::363.english_translation: An action performed properly, naturally or unnaturally, with skill and care, leads to the arising of the foundation.
shambhu_gita::363.translation_literal: स्वाभाविक्यस्वभावा (natural or unnatural) / वा (or) / पाठस्योत्पादनाय (for the production of the foundation) / या (which) / विधीयते (is performed) / क्रिया (action) / सम्यक् (properly) / सत्सकौशलपूरिता (full of good skill)
shambhu_gita::363.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::363.essence: Skillful and attentive action builds the foundation for all outcomes.
shambhu_gita::363.simple_meaning: Actions done with skill and care, whether natural or not, create the foundation for what follows.
shambhu_gita::363.simple_insight: There’s strength in knowing that careful attention builds lasting support beneath your efforts.
shambhu_gita::363.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that both natural and deliberate efforts, when done with true skill and care, lay the essential groundwork for growth or progress in life.
shambhu_gita::363.modern_relevance: You prepare a meal or start a project with focus and care; this effort shapes everything that follows.
shambhu_gita::363.insight: It teaches you to value skill and care in every action as the true source of lasting results.

shambhu_gita::364.verse_sanskrit:
चक्रं तदेव सम्प्राहुर्योगतत्त्वविशारदाः।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देवो विद्यते विश्वभूतिदाः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::364.verse_hindi: उसी को योग तत्वज्ञ चक्र कहते हैं, हे पितृगण ! इस विषय में कोई सन्देह नहीं है
shambhu_gita::364.english_translation: The true experts in yoga call that the wheel; there is no doubt about this, O ancestors!
shambhu_gita::364.translation_literal: चक्रं (wheel) तदेव (that indeed) सम्प्राहुः (call) योगतत्त्वविशारदाः (those skilled in yoga principles) । नात्र (here not) कश्चन (anyone) सन्देवः (doubt) विद्यते (exists) विश्वभूतिदाः (O ancestors) !
shambhu_gita::364.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::364.essence: True experts unanimously recognize yoga as the wheel without any doubt.
shambhu_gita::364.simple_meaning: Those who know yoga deeply call it the wheel, and there is no doubt about this among ancestors.
shambhu_gita::364.simple_insight: Clarity comes from trusting the consensus of true experts in a field.
shambhu_gita::364.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the narrator addresses the ancestors, explaining that the concept of yoga is recognized clearly by those who understand its essence, affirming that there is no uncertainty about this truth.
shambhu_gita::364.modern_relevance: When you hear experts agree on something important, trust their clarity instead of doubting.
shambhu_gita::364.insight: Trust the clear understanding of those deeply familiar with a subject, reducing your own uncertainty.

shambhu_gita::365.verse_sanskrit:
पाठोत्पादकसामर्थ्य मपिण्डो विभर्त्युसौ।
आवागमनचंक्रस्याश्रयः स्वाभाविकस्य हि ॥
shambhu_gita::365.verse_hindi: यह मानवपिण्ड पीठ उत्पन्न करने का सामर्थ्य रखता है और यह मानवपिण्ड स्वाभाविक आवागमन चक्र का आश्रय ही है।
shambhu_gita::365.english_translation: This human body has the power to produce knowledge and naturally supports the cycle of coming and going.
shambhu_gita::365.translation_literal: पाठोत्पादकसामर्थ्य (power to produce knowledge) मपिण्डो (this human body) विभर्त्युसौ (supports) आवागमनचंक्रस्याश्रयः (the cycle of coming and going's shelter) स्वाभाविकस्य (natural) हि (indeed)
shambhu_gita::365.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::365.essence: The human body naturally supports life's cycle and the creation of knowledge.
shambhu_gita::365.simple_meaning: The human body naturally supports the cycle of life and death and has the power to generate knowledge.
shambhu_gita::365.simple_insight: Our body holds the natural rhythm of life and the potential for understanding.
shambhu_gita::365.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the human body is not just a physical form but has the inherent ability to produce knowledge and serves as the natural basis for the cycle of birth and death.
shambhu_gita::365.insight: Recognize your body as both the ground for your life's flow and your capacity to learn.

shambhu_gita::366.verse_sanskrit:
अनेकभेदसत्त्वेऽपि पाठस्यास्ति प्रधानतः।
भेदश्चतुर्वियो योऽसौ पोच्यते वः पुरोऽधुना ॥
shambhu_gita::366.verse_hindi: पीठ के भेद अनेक होने पर भी प्रधानतः पीठ जो चार श्रेणी में विभक्त है उसको अभी आप लोगों के सामने कहता हूँ
shambhu_gita::366.english_translation: Although there are many types of seats, primarily the seat is divided into four categories, which I now explain to you.
shambhu_gita::366.translation_literal: अनेकभेदसत्त्वेऽपि (although many types exist) पाठस्यास्ति (of the seat there is) प्रधानतः (primarily). भेदश्चतुर्वियो (and four types) योऽसौ (which he) पोच्यते (explains) वः (to you) पुरोऽधुना (now).
shambhu_gita::366.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::366.essence: Complex things can be organized into a few primary categories for clarity.
shambhu_gita::366.simple_meaning: There are many types of seats, but mainly they are divided into four kinds, which are now being explained.
shambhu_gita::366.simple_insight: Understanding categories can clarify complex teachings step by step.
shambhu_gita::366.detailed_meaning: Shiva is introducing a classification about seats, stating that despite many differences, there are four primary types. This sets the stage for a detailed explanation to follow.
shambhu_gita::366.insight: Recognizing main categories helps organize and focus your learning effectively.

shambhu_gita::367.verse_sanskrit:
प्रथम स्थावर पीठं यथा तीर्थादिगोचरम् ।
द्वितीयं सहज पीठं दम्पतीसङ्गमे यथा ॥
shambhu_gita::367.verse_hindi: प्रथम स्थावरपीठ, यथा-तीर्थादि, द्वितीय सहजपीठ, जैसा कि नर नारी के सक्षम समय में उत्पन्न होता है,
shambhu_gita::367.english_translation: First is the immovable seat, like sacred places; second is the natural seat, like the union of a couple in their fertile time.
shambhu_gita::367.translation_literal: प्रथम (first) स्थावरपीठं (immovable seat) यथा (like) तीर्थादि (sacred places) गोचरम् (visible), द्वितीयं (second) सहजपीठं (natural seat) दम्पतीसङ्गमे (in the union of a couple) यथा (like)
shambhu_gita::367.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::367.essence: Foundations can be steady or arise naturally from intimate union.
shambhu_gita::367.simple_meaning: There are two fundamental seats or bases: one fixed like holy places, and one natural arising from a couple's union.
shambhu_gita::367.simple_insight: Some foundations are stable and external; others arise naturally from life’s intimate connections.
shambhu_gita::367.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes two foundational supports: the first is stable and immovable, like sacred pilgrimage sites; the second arises naturally, like the union of a couple during fertile times, symbolizing life’s spontaneous creativity.
shambhu_gita::367.modern_relevance: You recognize some parts of your life are steady and grounded, while others emerge naturally from your closest relationships.
shambhu_gita::367.insight: It teaches to honor both steady foundations and natural, life-generated connections as essential supports.

shambhu_gita::368.verse_sanskrit:
पीठं तृतीयकं दैवमिन्द्रलोकादिकं यथा ।
चतुर्थ यौगिकं पीठं भगवद्विग्रहोद्भयम् ॥
shambhu_gita::368.verse_hindi: तृतीय दैवी पीठ, यथा इन्द्रलोकादि और चौथा यौगिक पीठ भगवद विग्रह और यन्त्रादि में होता है
shambhu_gita::368.english_translation: The third seat is divine, like Indraloka and others; the fourth seat is yogic, associated with the forms and instruments of the divine.
shambhu_gita::368.translation_literal: पीठं (seat) / तृतीयकं (third) / दैवमिन्द्रलोकादिकं (divine like Indraloka and others) / यथा (like) । / चतुर्थ (fourth) / यौगिकं (yogic) / पीठं (seat) / भगवद्विग्रहोद्भयम् (with divine forms and instruments) ॥
shambhu_gita::368.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::368.essence: Spiritual seats differ between divine realms and yogic forms.
shambhu_gita::368.simple_meaning: There are different types of seats or levels: one divine like the realm of Indra, another yogic related to divine forms and tools.
shambhu_gita::368.simple_insight: Some spiritual levels connect to divine realms, others to yogic practices and divine symbols.
shambhu_gita::368.detailed_meaning: Suta describes spiritual seats or levels, comparing the third to divine realms like Indraloka, and the fourth to yogic seats linked with divine forms and instruments, outlining a classification without deep explanation.
shambhu_gita::368.insight: It introduces a layered view of spiritual states or practices, distinguishing divine realms from yogic symbolism.

shambhu_gita::369.verse_sanskrit:
अथवा यन्त्रसम्भूतं पितरों वर्तते यथा।
अनेकभेदसत्वेऽपि चक्रञ्चास्ते चतुर्विधम् ॥
shambhu_gita::369.verse_hindi: यथा पितृगण! चक्र भी बहु प्रकार के होने पर भी उनकी चार श्रेणी है
shambhu_gita::369.english_translation: Just as the ancestors exist as a mechanism with many differences, yet the wheel they have is of four kinds.
shambhu_gita::369.translation_literal: अथवा (or) यन्त्रसम्भूतं (mechanism-born) पितरों (of ancestors) वर्तते (exists) यथा (just as)। अनेकभेदसत्वेऽपि (though many types exist) चक्रञ्चास्ते (a wheel there is) चतुर्विधम् (four kinds) ॥
shambhu_gita::369.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::369.essence: Complex diversity can be organized into a few fundamental categories.
shambhu_gita::369.simple_meaning: The ancestors are described as having a complex system with many parts, but their guiding wheel has four main types.
shambhu_gita::369.simple_insight: Even complex systems can have a simple underlying structure.
shambhu_gita::369.detailed_meaning: The bard Suta explains that the group of ancestors functions like a complex mechanism with many differences, yet the wheel they use to guide or classify them has four distinct types, showing order within diversity.
shambhu_gita::369.insight: Recognize that complexity often holds simple organizing principles beneath it.

shambhu_gita::370.verse_sanskrit:
आवागमनचक्रादि तत्राद्यं सहजं जगुः ।
द्वितीयं कीर्तितं चक्रं तद्ब्रह्माण्डनामकम् ॥
shambhu_gita::370.verse_hindi: प्रथम सहज चक वह कहलाता है, जैसा आवागमनचक्रादि द्वितीय ब्रह्माण्डचक्र यथा
shambhu_gita::370.english_translation: The first is called the natural cycle, like the cycle of coming and going; the second is called the cosmic cycle.
shambhu_gita::370.translation_literal: आवागमनचक्रादि (cycle of coming and going, etc.) / तत्राद्यं (there, first) / सहजं (natural, innate) / जगुः (called) / द्वितीयं (second) / कीर्तितं (described) / चक्रं (cycle) / तद्ब्रह्माण्डनामकम् (that is called cosmic)
shambhu_gita::370.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::370.essence: Existence unfolds through both natural and cosmic repeating cycles.
shambhu_gita::370.simple_meaning: Two cycles are described: the first is the natural cycle of movement; the second is the cosmic cycle of creation and dissolution.
shambhu_gita::370.simple_insight: Some cycles shape everyday change; others shape the vast universe beyond our sight.
shambhu_gita::370.detailed_meaning: The narrator explains two fundamental cycles: the natural, everyday cycle of coming and going, and the larger cosmic cycle called the universe. This sets a framework for understanding time and existence.
shambhu_gita::370.insight: It introduces the idea that reality operates on multiple levels of cycles, from the personal to the universal.

shambhu_gita::371.verse_hindi: ग्रह उपग्रह नक्षत्रादि का अधिकार स्थान, यह दोनों निःसन्देह स्वाभाविक चक्र कहलाते हैं।
shambhu_gita::371.english_translation: The positions of planets and their satellites are naturally established cycles beyond doubt.
shambhu_gita::371.translation_literal: ग्रह (planet) / उपग्रह (satellite) / आदि (etc.) / नाम (named) / अधिकार (position) / स्थिति (state) / यथा (just as) / ज्ञेयं (to be known) / स्वाभाविकं (natural) / चक्रम् (cycle) / एतत् (this) / वयम् (pair) / असंशयम् (without doubt)
shambhu_gita::371.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::371.essence: Some natural cycles are certain and beyond question.
shambhu_gita::371.simple_meaning: The movements and positions of planets and their satellites follow natural, unquestionable cycles.
shambhu_gita::371.simple_insight: You can trust that some patterns in life unfold naturally without interference.
shambhu_gita::371.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the positions and movements of celestial bodies like planets and their satellites are governed by natural cycles that are certain and unquestionable, highlighting the order in the universe.
shambhu_gita::371.modern_relevance: Watching the predictable rise and set of the moon or sun reminds you that some rhythms in life are steady and reliable.
shambhu_gita::371.insight: Recognize and accept natural patterns instead of resisting what unfolds beyond your control.

shambhu_gita::372.verse_sanskrit:
सगर्भ स्यात्तृतीयं तद्ब्रह्मचक्रादिकं यथा।
अगर्भनामकं चक्रं चतुथै समुदाह्र्म् ॥
shambhu_gita::372.verse_hindi: तृतीयचक्र सगर्भचक्र कहलाता है, यथा-ब्रह्मचक्र शक्तिचक्रादि और चतुर्थ चक्र का नाम अगर्भ है
shambhu_gita::372.english_translation: The third chakra is called the Sagarbha chakra, like the Brahma chakra and Shakti chakra; the fourth chakra is called the Agarbha chakra.
shambhu_gita::372.translation_literal: सगर्भ (with seed) / स्यात् (is) / तृतीयं (third) / तद् (that) / ब्रह्मचक्रादिकं (like Brahma chakra and others) / यथा (as) / अगर्भनामकं (named Agarbha) / चक्रं (chakra) / चतुथै (fourth) / समुदाह्र्म् (called)
shambhu_gita::372.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::372.essence: This verse identifies specific names and order of subtle energy centers called chakras.
shambhu_gita::372.simple_meaning: The verse names the third chakra as Sagarbha and the fourth as Agarbha, comparing them to other well-known chakras.
shambhu_gita::372.simple_insight: Names and order help map the subtle energy centers in spiritual practice.
shambhu_gita::372.detailed_meaning: The verse describes specific chakras in a sequence, identifying the third as Sagarbha chakra, similar to Brahma and Shakti chakras, and the fourth as Agarbha chakra, situating these subtle energy centers in the teaching.
shambhu_gita::372.insight: It clarifies the structure and naming of subtle energy centers, aiding focused meditation or study.

shambhu_gita::373.verse_sanskrit:
मन्त्रशुद्ध्या क्रियाशुद्ध्या रहितश्चैव यद्भवेत् ।
इति वः कीर्तितं चक्र-रहस्यं परमाद्भुतम् ॥
shambhu_gita::373.verse_hindi: जो मन्त्रशुद्धि और क्रियाशुद्धि से रहित ही होता है यह मैंने आप लोगों को परम अदभुत चक्र का रहस्य कहा है।
shambhu_gita::373.english_translation: I have declared to you the supreme wondrous secret of the wheel, which is free from mantra purification and action purification.
shambhu_gita::373.translation_literal: मन्त्रशुद्ध्या (by mantra purification) / क्रियाशुद्ध्या (by action purification) / रहितश्चैव (and indeed free) / यद्भवेत् (which is) / इति (thus) / वः (to you) / कीर्तितं (declared) / चक्र-रहस्यं (wheel-secret) / परमाद्भुतम् (supreme wondrous)
shambhu_gita::373.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::373.essence: The greatest secret transcends all ritual purification and external action.
shambhu_gita::373.simple_meaning: The supreme secret of the cosmic wheel I revealed to you is beyond purification by mantras or actions.
shambhu_gita::373.simple_insight: Some profound truths exist beyond rituals and external practices.
shambhu_gita::373.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Shiva explains that the highest secret of the cosmic order transcends common spiritual purifications like mantras and ritual actions. This points to a deeper, ineffable truth beyond formal practice.
shambhu_gita::373.insight: It shifts focus from external rituals to recognizing subtler, deeper spiritual truths beyond action and words.

shambhu_gita::374.verse_sanskrit:
याथार्थ्यानुष्ठितं चक्रं सगर्भ मुक्तिदं भवेत् ।
अगर्भ पितरः ! तद्वन्ननमभ्युदयप्रदम् ॥
shambhu_gita::374.verse_hindi: सगर्भ चक्र यथार्थ रूप से अनुष्ठित होने पर मुक्तिपद होता है और हे पितृगण! अगर्भचक्र यथार्थ रूप से अनुष्ठित होने पर ही अभ्युदय प्रद होता है
shambhu_gita::374.english_translation: When the manifested cycle of action is truly performed, it leads to liberation; O ancestors, the unmanifested cycle truly performed brings about prosperity.
shambhu_gita::374.translation_literal: याथार्थ्यानुष्ठितं (truly performed) चक्रं (cycle) सगर्भ (manifested) मुक्तिदं (liberation-giving) भवेत् (becomes) । अगर्भ (unmanifested) पितरः (ancestors) ! तद्वन्न (then) अनमभ्युदयप्रदम् (prosperity-giving) ॥
shambhu_gita::374.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::374.essence: True external action frees; true subtle action uplifts your life.
shambhu_gita::374.simple_meaning: Performing clear, conscious actions leads to inner freedom, while deeper unseen actions bring lasting well-being.
shambhu_gita::374.simple_insight: You can trust that both visible efforts and subtle inner work together bring true growth and freedom.
shambhu_gita::374.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that when you genuinely carry out your visible duties (manifested cycle), it leads to liberation. But performing subtle, internal or unseen actions (unmanifested cycle) truly brings upward progress and prosperity. Both visible and invisible actions have distinct but vital roles.
shambhu_gita::374.modern_relevance: You completed a demanding project and felt relief, but the habits and mindset you build quietly shape your lasting success.
shambhu_gita::374.insight: It teaches you to honor both your obvious efforts and your inner growth, seeing both as essential for freedom and prosperity.

shambhu_gita::375.verse_sanskrit:
परन्त्वेवंविधायां हि दशायों चक्रसाधकैः।
भवितव्यं ध्रुवं सम्यगवश्यं मत्परायणः ॥
shambhu_gita::375.verse_hindi: परन्तु ऐसी दशा में चक्रकारी साधकों को अवश्य ही अच्छी तरह मत्परायण होना उचित है
shambhu_gita::375.english_translation: In such a condition, the devotees who work the wheel must certainly be fully devoted to me.
shambhu_gita::375.translation_literal: परन्तु (but) ऐसी (such) दशा में (in condition) चक्रकारी (wheel-worker) साधकों (practitioners) को (to) अवश्य (certainly) ही (indeed) अच्छी तरह (well) मत्परायण (devoted to me) होना (to be) उचित है (is proper)
shambhu_gita::375.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::375.essence: Steadfast devotion is essential when facing difficult conditions.
shambhu_gita::375.simple_meaning: In difficult situations, those devoted to the divine must be completely committed to that devotion.
shambhu_gita::375.simple_insight: You feel steady when your devotion does not waver, even in hard times.
shambhu_gita::375.detailed_meaning: Shiva speaks to practitioners who face challenging states, highlighting that their highest need then is unwavering devotion to him. This moment stresses devotion as the anchor amid difficulty.
shambhu_gita::375.modern_relevance: When life gets overwhelming and uncertain, your deepest commitment to what grounds you can be your strongest support.
shambhu_gita::375.insight: It teaches you to center your focus fully on your devotion during difficult phases, making it your steady foundation.

shambhu_gita::376.verse_sanskrit:
एतचक्रद्वयं जीवैः सत्सुकौशलपूर्णया।
क्रिययाऽनुष्ठितं यस्मादतोऽस्वाभाविकं जगुः ॥
shambhu_gita::376.verse_hindi: ये दोनों चक्र सत्सुकौशल पूर्ण क्रिया से जीवों के द्वारा अनुष्ठित होने के कारण अस्वाभाविक कहलाते हैं
shambhu_gita::376.english_translation: These two cycles are called unnatural because beings perform them with delicate skillfulness.
shambhu_gita::376.translation_literal: एत (these) चक्रद्वयं (two cycles) जीवैः (by beings) सत्सुकौशलपूर्णया (with delicate skillfulness) क्रियया (by action) अनुष्ठितं (performed) यस्मात (because) अतोऽस्वाभाविकं (unnatural) जगुः (are called)
shambhu_gita::376.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::376.essence: Skillful action can still feel unnatural when it is forced or habitual.
shambhu_gita::376.simple_meaning: Some actions are called unnatural because living beings carry them out with careful skill.
shambhu_gita::376.simple_insight: You can feel that even your best efforts sometimes seem forced or out of place.
shambhu_gita::376.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that two particular cycles of action are considered unnatural because beings perform them with excessive carefulness or artificial skill, implying these are not spontaneous or natural behaviors.
shambhu_gita::376.modern_relevance: You might find yourself doing tasks so carefully and deliberately that they start to feel forced or unnatural.
shambhu_gita::376.insight: It shifts your view to notice when your actions, though skillful, do not arise naturally but from habit or pressure.

shambhu_gita::377.verse_sanskrit:
उत्तरोत्तरमुक्तासु सप्तसु ज्ञानभूमिषु ।
क्रमांरोहणकृत्यैव जायते पितरो ध्रुवम् ॥
shambhu_gita::377.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! उक्त सप्त, ज्ञानभूमियों में उत्तरोत्तर क्रमशः आरोहण करते रहने से ही
shambhu_gita::377.english_translation: O ancestors, by steadily ascending through the seven stages of wisdom, the forefathers are surely born.
shambhu_gita::377.translation_literal: उत्तरोत्तरमुक्तासु (step by step) / सप्तसु (in seven) / ज्ञानभूमिषु (stages of wisdom) / क्रमांरोहणकृत्यैव (by ascending in order) / जायते (are born) / पितरो (forefathers) / ध्रुवम् (certainly)
shambhu_gita::377.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::377.essence: True transformation happens by steadily ascending through ordered stages of wisdom.
shambhu_gita::377.simple_meaning: Progress happens by steadily moving through seven stages of understanding and wisdom.
shambhu_gita::377.simple_insight: Growth is a gradual, stepwise journey through deeper understanding.
shambhu_gita::377.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, explaining that their true birth or evolution happens by steadily ascending through seven distinct stages of wisdom, emphasizing gradual and ordered spiritual progress.
shambhu_gita::377.modern_relevance: You face a complex challenge that can’t be rushed — growth requires taking one clear step after another.
shambhu_gita::377.insight: It teaches you to trust gradual, sequential learning rather than seeking sudden leaps.

shambhu_gita::378.verse_hindi: अवागमनचक्र की अध्यात्म शुद्धि सम्पादित होती है इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। अपने अपने अधिकारानुसार वर्णाश्रम धर्म के
shambhu_gita::378.english_translation: There is no doubt that the purification of the inner being occurs through the cycle of coming and going, following the duties prescribed by the social orders and stages of life according to one's own rights.
shambhu_gita::378.translation_literal: आवागमनचक्रस्य (of the cycle of coming and going) / अध्यात्मशुद्धिर्न (no doubt about purification of the inner being) / संशयः (no doubt) / वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्माणां (of the duties called social orders and stages of life) / स्वाधिकारानुसारतः (according to one's own rights)
shambhu_gita::378.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::378.essence: Purification of the inner being happens by faithfully fulfilling your rightful duties through life's cycles.
shambhu_gita::378.simple_meaning: You purify your inner being by following the duties assigned to your social role and life stage without doubt.
shambhu_gita::378.simple_insight: There is calm in trusting that doing your proper duties cleanses your deeper self.
shambhu_gita::378.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the natural cycle of birth and rebirth, when lived by fulfilling the duties of one's social order and life stage, purifies the inner being. This teaching reassures Arjuna that following one's rightful obligations is a clear path to spiritual progress.
shambhu_gita::378.modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by conflicting expectations, but focusing on your own clear responsibilities helps you grow from within.
shambhu_gita::378.insight: It teaches you to trust and engage fully with your own specific duties as a way to deepen your inner clarity and growth.

shambhu_gita::379.verse_sanskrit:
जायते पालनेनाऽस्य शुद्धिः खल्वाधिदैविकी।
पितरो वो दयालब्ध्या शुद्ध्या शोणितशुक्रयोः ॥
shambhu_gita::379.verse_hindi: पालन द्वारा ही उस चक्र की अधिदैव शुद्धि हुआ करती है और हे पितृगण! आपलोगों की कृपा प्राप्त करने से
shambhu_gita::379.english_translation: Purification of this cycle indeed occurs through maintenance, O ancestors! It happens by your compassionate grace through purity of blood and seed.
shambhu_gita::379.translation_literal: जायते (is born) / पालनेनाऽस्य (by the maintenance of this) / शुद्धिः (purification) / खल्वाधिदैविकी (indeed of the higher fate) /। पितरो (ancestors) / वो (you) / दयालब्ध्या (by the grace of compassion) / शुद्ध्या (by purity) / शोणितशुक्रयोः (of blood and seed) /॥
shambhu_gita::379.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::379.essence: Purity of a cycle arises from careful maintenance and blessings rooted in lineage.
shambhu_gita::379.simple_meaning: Purification of this cycle happens through proper care and the compassionate blessing of ancestors, linked to the purity of blood and seed.
shambhu_gita::379.simple_insight: Care and ancestral blessings help maintain the cycle's purity beyond just physical acts.
shambhu_gita::379.detailed_meaning: This verse describes that the purification of a cosmic or life cycle depends on its proper maintenance and the compassionate blessings of ancestors, emphasizing the importance of purity linked to lineage and essence during a sacred process.
shambhu_gita::379.insight: It highlights that preservation and respect for the source or origin sustain deeper purity beyond surface actions.

shambhu_gita::380.verse_sanskrit:
सहजस्यापि पीठस्य क्रमोन्नसा निरन्तरम् ।
आधिभौतिकशुद्धिर्हि नूनमस्य-प्रजायते ॥
shambhu_gita::380.verse_hindi: सहजपीठ की निरन्तर क्रमोन्नति से और रजवीर्य्य की शुद्धि से भी आवागमन चक्र की आधिभौतिक शुद्धि निश्चय सम्पादित हुआ करती है।
shambhu_gita::380.english_translation: Even the natural seat steadily rises; through purification of subtle energy, the cycle of worldly existence is surely purified.
shambhu_gita::380.translation_literal: सहजस्यापि (even of natural) पीठस्य (seat) क्रमोन्नसा (by steady rising) निरन्तरम् (continually) । आधिभौतिकशुद्धिर्हि (indeed, worldly purification) नूनमस्य-प्रजायते (certainly is born) ॥
shambhu_gita::380.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::380.essence: Steady natural growth and subtle purification together cleanse the cycle of existence.
shambhu_gita::380.simple_meaning: Your natural inner foundation grows step by step, and purifying your subtle energies cleanses the cycle of experience.
shambhu_gita::380.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing steady inner growth leads to deep cleansing over time.
shambhu_gita::380.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that even the natural base of your being develops progressively, and as subtle energies purify, the entire cycle of worldly existence becomes cleansed, marking spiritual progress.
shambhu_gita::380.modern_relevance: When daily habits improve slowly but surely, your whole life’s patterns begin to shift and clear.
shambhu_gita::380.insight: It shifts your focus to honoring gradual growth and subtle purification as the true path of transformation.

shambhu_gita::381.verse_sanskrit:
चक्रमेतद्भवन्तो हि कर्तुमुन्नामि सत्त्वरम् ।
सन्ति चक्रेश्वरा नूनं स्मरणीयं सदेति वः ॥
shambhu_gita::381.verse_hindi: इस चक्र को शीघ्र उन्नतिशील करने में आप लोग ही निश्चय चक्रेश्वर हैं, यह सदा आप लोगों को स्मरण रखना चाहिये
shambhu_gita::381.english_translation: You are indeed the lords of the wheel, destined to swiftly advance this cycle; always remember this.
shambhu_gita::381.translation_literal: चक्रमेतद्भवन्तो (this wheel you all) / हि (indeed) / कर्तुम् (to do) / उन्नामि (swift advancement) / सत्त्वरम् (speed) / । / सन्ति (are) / चक्रेश्वरा (lords of the wheel) / नूनं (indeed) / स्मरणीयं (to be remembered) / सदेति (always) / वः (you all) / ॥
shambhu_gita::381.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::381.essence: You are the true masters who can rapidly advance this cycle; never forget your power.
shambhu_gita::381.simple_meaning: You are the ones responsible for quickly advancing this cycle. Always remember your role and power.
shambhu_gita::381.simple_insight: There is strength in knowing you hold the power to move great change forward.
shambhu_gita::381.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Shiva reminds his listeners that they are the true masters of this cosmic cycle. Their role is crucial—they must act with speed and certainty to fulfill this responsibility.
shambhu_gita::381.insight: Recognize your unique power to influence the course of important cycles and act with confidence.

shambhu_gita::382.verse_sanskrit:
एवं सर्वेषु चक्रेषु शुद्धित्रैविध्यमुत्तमम् ।
आवश्यकं भवत्येव नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
shambhu_gita::382.verse_hindi: सब चक्रों में इसी प्रकार उत्तम त्रिविध शुद्धि को आवश्यकता होती ही है, इसमें विचार करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
shambhu_gita::382.english_translation: In all cycles, pure threefold cleansing is absolutely necessary; no debate is needed on this.
shambhu_gita::382.translation_literal: एवं (thus) / सर्वेषु (in all) / चक्रेषु (cycles) / शुद्धि-त्रैविध्यम् (threefold purification) / उत्तमम् (supreme) / आवश्यकं (necessary) / भवति (is) / एव (indeed) / न (no) / अत्र (here) / कार्या (to be done) / विचारणा (consideration)
shambhu_gita::382.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::382.essence: Every cycle requires essential, pure threefold cleansing without question.
shambhu_gita::382.simple_meaning: Every important phase or cycle requires thorough and pure cleansing of body, mind, and spirit without doubt.
shambhu_gita::382.simple_insight: You can trust that purification is always needed for true renewal.
