shambhu_gita::435.essence: Conscious effort in creation results in outcomes matching your highest intentions.
shambhu_gita::435.simple_meaning: Performing conception properly leads to producing offspring as noble and excellent as desired.
shambhu_gita::435.simple_insight: The quality of what we bring forth depends on our conscious intention and effort.
shambhu_gita::435.detailed_meaning: This verse speaks about the act of conception, emphasizing that those who conceive with clear intention and care can bring forth noble and superior offspring. It reflects a belief in intentional creation and the power of purposeful action.
shambhu_gita::435.insight: It highlights how deliberate and mindful effort shapes the quality of what we create or nurture.

shambhu_gita::436.verse_sanskrit:
सम्पाद्य त्रिविधा शुद्धि योगयुक्तौ निरन्तरम् ।
तिष्टतां चेत्तदा तौ हि विमुक्तौ सृष्टिबन्धनात् ॥
shambhu_gita::436.verse_hindi: यदि त्रिविध शुद्धि सम्पादन करके वह सदा योगयुक्त रहे तो सृष्टि बन्धन से मुक्त होकर
shambhu_gita::436.english_translation: When you consistently cultivate the threefold purity and remain united with yoga, you become free from the bonds of creation.
shambhu_gita::436.translation_literal: सम्पाद्य (having accomplished) / त्रिविधा (threefold) / शुद्धि (purity) / योगयुक्तौ (united with yoga) / निरन्तरम् (continuously) / तिष्टतां (let remain) / चेत्तदा (then indeed) / तौ (those two) / हि (certainly) / विमुक्तौ (liberated) / सृष्टिबन्धनात् (from creation's bondage)
shambhu_gita::436.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::436.essence: Consistent threefold purity with yoga leads to freedom from life's bonds.
shambhu_gita::436.simple_meaning: You become free from worldly bonds by continuously practicing purity in three ways and staying connected with yoga.
shambhu_gita::436.simple_insight: There's hope in knowing consistent inner and outer purity leads to true freedom.
shambhu_gita::436.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that by cultivating purity in body, mind, and speech, and remaining dedicated to yoga without interruption, one can break free from the cycle of creation and limitation.
shambhu_gita::436.modern_relevance: After a stressful day, you cleanse your thoughts, words, and actions, and return to your inner calm to feel truly free.
shambhu_gita::436.insight: It teaches you to maintain continuous purity and yoga practice to loosen life's binding patterns.

shambhu_gita::437.verse_sanskrit:
लब्धुं निःश्रेयसं क्षिप्रं शक्नुयातां न संशयः।
यावत्प्रकाशनं लोके ज्ञानस्यास्य भविष्यति ॥
shambhu_gita::437.verse_hindi: शीघ्र निःश्रेयस प्राप्त कर सके हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं। इस ज्ञान का जितना प्रकाश जगत में होगा
shambhu_gita::437.english_translation: There is no doubt that supreme well-being can be attained quickly as long as the illumination of this knowledge remains in the world.
shambhu_gita::437.translation_literal: लब्धुं (to obtain) निःश्रेयसं (supreme well-being) क्षिप्रं (quickly) शक्नुयातां (can be attained) न (not) संशयः (doubt) यावत् (as long as) प्रकाशनं (illumination) लोके (in the world) ज्ञानस्य (of knowledge) अस्य (this) भविष्यति (remains)
shambhu_gita::437.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::437.essence: Supreme well-being can be quickly attained while this knowledge shines in the world.
shambhu_gita::437.simple_meaning: You can quickly reach the highest good as long as the light of this knowledge spreads in the world.
shambhu_gita::437.simple_insight: Knowing this knowledge is shining somewhere offers hope and quick possibility for freedom.
shambhu_gita::437.detailed_meaning: In the midst of teaching, Shiva affirms that as long as this knowledge is alive and known in the world, anyone can quickly achieve supreme well-being, encouraging confidence in the power of wisdom to transform.
shambhu_gita::437.modern_relevance: When you see helpful ideas still shared and alive, you realize your own growth toward freedom can happen sooner than you expect.
shambhu_gita::437.insight: It shifts your view from slow progress to immediate possibility when knowledge is active and spreading.

shambhu_gita::438.verse_sanskrit:
तावान क्रमविकाशः स्यात्सत्त्वाख्यस्य गुणस्य वै ।
पूर्ण ज्ञानश्च धर्मस्य संसारेऽत्र जनिष्यते ॥
shambhu_gita::438.verse_hindi: उतना ही सत्त्वगुण का क्रमविकाश होगा और धर्म का पूर्णज्ञान इस संसार में उत्पन्न होगा
shambhu_gita::438.english_translation: The orderly development of the quality of goodness leads to full understanding of dharma in this world.
shambhu_gita::438.translation_literal: तावान (that much) / क्रमविकाशः (progressive development) / स्यात् (will be) / सत्त्वाख्यस्य (of the quality called goodness) / गुणस्य (of the quality) / वै (indeed) / पूर्ण (complete) / ज्ञानश्च (knowledge also) / धर्मस्य (of dharma) / संसारेऽत्र (in this world) / जनिष्यते (will arise)
shambhu_gita::438.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::438.essence: Growing inner goodness naturally leads to full understanding of your true purpose.
shambhu_gita::438.simple_meaning: When the quality of goodness develops steadily, full knowledge of your true purpose arises in life.
shambhu_gita::438.simple_insight: You feel encouraged knowing that growing goodness naturally leads to deeper understanding.
shambhu_gita::438.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that as the quality called goodness (sattva) unfolds in a person, it brings about complete knowledge of dharma, the true purpose, within the cycle of life and action.
shambhu_gita::438.modern_relevance: You notice small acts of kindness and clarity growing inside you, opening new understanding about why you do what you do.
shambhu_gita::438.insight: It teaches you to nurture goodness patiently, trusting that clear understanding of your purpose will follow.

shambhu_gita::439.verse_sanskrit:
आसुरी शक्तिरप्येव पराभूति समेष्यति ।
भवन्तो निर्भयाः सन्तो लप्स्यन्तेऽभ्युदयं तथा ॥
shambhu_gita::439.verse_hindi: इसी प्रकार असुरों की शक्ति भी पराभूत होगी और आपलोग निर्भय होकर अभ्युदय प्राप्त करोगे
shambhu_gita::439.english_translation: In the same way, the power of the shadow beings will be defeated, and you all will be fearless and attain prosperity.
shambhu_gita::439.translation_literal: आसुरी (of the shadow beings) शक्तिः (power) अपि (also) एव (indeed) पराभूति (defeat) समेष्यति (will happen) । भवन्तो (you all) निर्भयाः (fearless) सन्तः (being) लप्स्यन्ते (will attain) अभ्युदयं (prosperity) तथा (thus) ॥
shambhu_gita::439.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::439.essence: Fear fades as shadow powers lose, opening the way for growth.
shambhu_gita::439.simple_meaning: The power of ego-driven shadow beings will be overcome, and you will become fearless and successful.
shambhu_gita::439.simple_insight: There is assurance that fear and obstacles will fall away, opening space for growth.
shambhu_gita::439.detailed_meaning: Shiva assures that the forces of ego and shadow (Asuras) will be defeated, so the listeners can act fearlessly and achieve progress and well-being.
shambhu_gita::439.modern_relevance: When facing overwhelming challenges or negative influences, trust that these obstacles will fade, allowing you to move forward without fear.
shambhu_gita::439.insight: This verse encourages letting go of fear by trusting that negative forces will be overcome, empowering fearless action.

shambhu_gita::440.verse_sanskrit:
शान्तिमन्दाकिनी दैवे राज्ये नित्यं प्रवक्ष्यति ।
सामञ्जस्यं तथा सृष्टे रक्षितं च भविष्यति ॥
shambhu_gita::440.verse_hindi: दैवराज्य नित्य शान्तिमय होगा और सृष्टि का सामञ्जस्य सुरक्षित होगा
shambhu_gita::440.english_translation: The divine realm will always be peaceful, and the harmony of creation will be preserved.
shambhu_gita::440.translation_literal: शान्तिमन्दाकिनी (peaceful river) / दैवे (divine) / राज्ये (realm) / नित्यं (always) / प्रवक्ष्यति (will be spoken) / सामञ्जस्यं (harmony) / तथा (also) / सृष्टे (in creation) / रक्षितं (protected) / च (and) / भविष्यति (will be).
shambhu_gita::440.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::440.essence: Peace within the divine realm continuously sustains creation's harmony.
shambhu_gita::440.simple_meaning: The divine realm is always peaceful, and this peace protects the harmony of all creation.
shambhu_gita::440.simple_insight: There's comfort in knowing a peaceful divine order quietly preserves everything.
shambhu_gita::440.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes the divine realm as eternally peaceful, assuring that this peace maintains balance and harmony throughout all creation, reassuring those who seek stability amid change.
shambhu_gita::440.modern_relevance: When everything feels chaotic, remember an unshakable peace quietly holds the deeper order of life.
shambhu_gita::440.insight: It invites you to rest in the trust that harmony is sustained beyond visible turmoil.

shambhu_gita::441.verse_sanskrit:
इह सर्वे भविष्यन्ति परानन्दाधिकारिणः।
समृद्धाः सुखसम्पन्नाः सम्पत्स्यन्ते च प्राणिनः ॥
shambhu_gita::441.verse_hindi: इस संसार में सब परमानन्द के अधिकारी होंगे और सब जीवगण समृद्ध और सुखसम्पन्न होंगे
shambhu_gita::441.english_translation: In this world, all beings will attain the right to supreme bliss and become prosperous and fulfilled.
shambhu_gita::441.translation_literal: इह (in this) सर्वे (all) भविष्यन्ति (will become) परानन्द (supreme bliss) अधिकारिणः (entitled)। समृद्धाः (prosperous) सुखसम्पन्नाः (full of happiness) सम्पत्स्यन्ते (will be endowed) च (and) प्राणिनः (living beings) ॥
shambhu_gita::441.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::441.essence: All beings will attain supreme happiness and become prosperous in this world.
shambhu_gita::441.simple_meaning: Everyone in this world will have the right to supreme happiness and will become prosperous and joyful.
shambhu_gita::441.simple_insight: There is a hopeful promise that all life can share in ultimate joy and abundance.
shambhu_gita::441.detailed_meaning: The narrator describes a future where every living being is granted supreme happiness and achieves prosperity, suggesting a universal blessing or destiny for all creatures.
shambhu_gita::441.insight: It encourages holding a vision where all beings are destined for fulfillment and joy, inviting optimism beyond present struggles.

shambhu_gita::442.verse_sanskrit:
हे विन्धनाथ ! सर्वेश ! लोकपालक ! हे विभो !।
त्वदयातो दयासिन्धो ! सर्वलोकहितमदम् ॥
shambhu_gita::442.verse_hindi: हे सर्वेश्वर! हे लोकपालक ! हे विश्वनाथ ! हे विभो ! हे दयासिन्धो! आपकी कृपा से हमने
shambhu_gita::442.english_translation: O Lord of Vindhya! Master of all! Protector of the worlds! O Viśvanātha! Ocean of compassion! By your grace, all beings find welfare.
shambhu_gita::442.translation_literal: हे (O) विन्धनाथ (Lord of Vindhya) ! सर्वेश (Master of all) ! लोकपालक (Protector of the worlds) ! हे (O) विभो (Viśvanātha) ! त्वदयातो (from your grace) दयासिन्धो (Ocean of compassion) ! सर्वलोकहितमदम् (all beings' welfare)
shambhu_gita::442.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::442.essence: The compassionate protector Shiva supports the welfare of all beings through his grace.
shambhu_gita::442.simple_meaning: This verse is a respectful invocation praising Shiva by many of his great names and acknowledges that by his compassion, all beings are cared for.
shambhu_gita::442.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing a compassionate presence cares for all life.
shambhu_gita::442.detailed_meaning: Suta invokes Shiva with grand titles, highlighting his role as protector and compassionate lord. This sets a devotional tone, acknowledging Shiva's care for all worlds and beings before the teaching begins.
shambhu_gita::442.insight: It invites you to remember a compassionate force watches over all existence, providing a foundation for trust.

shambhu_gita::443.verse_sanskrit:
अशृण्म खलु धर्मस्य रहस्यं परमाद्भुतम् ।
पिण्डोत्पत्तेश्च विज्ञानं तन्नियामकमप्यहो ॥
shambhu_gita::443.verse_hindi: धर्म का परम अद्भुत सर्वलोक हितकर रहस्य, पिण्डोत्पत्ति विज्ञान और अहो !
shambhu_gita::443.english_translation: The supreme, wondrous secret of dharma is the knowledge of the origin of the embodied, and even the controller is absent.
shambhu_gita::443.translation_literal: अशृण्म (unheard) / खलु (indeed) / धर्मस्य (of dharma) / रहस्यं (secret) / परमाद्भुतम् (supreme-wondrous) / पिण्डोत्पत्तेश्च (of the origin of the embodied) / विज्ञानं (knowledge) / तन्नियामकमप्यहो (even the controller is absent)
shambhu_gita::443.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::443.essence: The secret of true purpose is the wondrous, uncontrolled origin of embodied life.
shambhu_gita::443.simple_meaning: The deepest secret of dharma is the wondrous knowledge of how embodied life arises, beyond any external controller.
shambhu_gita::443.simple_insight: There is freedom in knowing that the origin of existence is wondrous and beyond control.
shambhu_gita::443.detailed_meaning: Shiva reveals a profound teaching about dharma’s secret: understanding how embodied life (the body and mind) arises is a wondrous mystery that no external controller governs. This challenges the idea of a controlling force behind existence.
shambhu_gita::443.modern_relevance: When things feel out of control, knowing that life’s origin is a wondrous mystery beyond any controller can bring peace and curiosity.
shambhu_gita::443.insight: It shifts your mind from searching for a controller to embracing the mystery of existence’s origin.

shambhu_gita::444.verse_sanskrit:
रहस्यं गहनं वर्णाश्रममूलकमुत्तमम् ।
अद्य नो निश्चयो जातः प्रजोत्पत्त्या विधानतः ॥
shambhu_gita::444.verse_hindi: वर्णाश्रम धर्ममूलक उसका नियामक उत्तम और गहन रहस्य सुना और अब हमें निश्चय हो गया है कि विधिपूर्वक प्रजा की उत्पत्ति होने से
shambhu_gita::444.english_translation: The profound secret rooted in the system of class and stage of life is supreme; today we have certainty that the orderly birth of beings is established by this.
shambhu_gita::444.translation_literal: रहस्यं (secret) गहनं (profound) वर्णाश्रममूलकम् (rooted in class and stage system) उत्तमम् (supreme) । अद्य (today) नो (to us) निश्चयो (certainty) जातः (has arisen) प्रजोत्पत्त्या (by birth of beings) विधानतः (orderly, by rule) ॥
shambhu_gita::444.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::444.essence: A deep secret in life’s social order ensures beings arise in rightful sequence.
shambhu_gita::444.simple_meaning: There is a deep, supreme secret connected to the system of social classes and life stages, and today we are certain it regulates how beings are born in order.
shambhu_gita::444.simple_insight: Knowing a wise order governs life’s unfolding brings steadiness amid change.
shambhu_gita::444.detailed_meaning: The bard Suta reveals to the sages a profound secret about the social system of classes and life stages (varna-ashrama), explaining it as the supreme foundation that governs the orderly birth and continuation of beings, establishing cosmic order.
shambhu_gita::444.insight: It shifts the mind to see social order and life stages as part of a deeper, purposeful natural structure.

shambhu_gita::445.verse_sanskrit:
बाधा नः सुव्यवस्थायां भवेन्नैव कदाचन ।
अज्ञासिष्म वयञ्चैतदिदानी हे जगदगुरो !॥
shambhu_gita::445.verse_hindi: कदापि हमारी सुव्यवस्था में बाधा नहीं ही होगी। हे जगद्गुरो ! अब हमें यह भी विदित हो गया है कि
shambhu_gita::445.english_translation: Obstruction will never arise in our well-ordered state. Now, O world teacher, this is also known to us.
shambhu_gita::445.translation_literal: बाधा (obstruction) नः (our) सुव्यवस्थायां (in well-order) भवेन्नैव (will never arise) कदाचन (at any time) । अज्ञासिष्म (we were ignorant) वयञ्च (and we too) एतदिदानी (this now) हे (O) जगदगुरो (world teacher) ॥
shambhu_gita::445.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::445.essence: No obstacle can disturb a truly well-ordered system.
shambhu_gita::445.simple_meaning: There will never be any obstruction in our well-organized situation. Now we understand this clearly.
shambhu_gita::445.simple_insight: Confidence grows when you see your foundation remains steady without interruption.
shambhu_gita::445.detailed_meaning: In this moment, a speaker reassures that their system or order is flawless and free from obstacles. Addressing the world teacher, the speaker notes their previous ignorance is now replaced by clear understanding.
shambhu_gita::445.insight: It invites you to trust in the stability of your current structure, easing doubt and hesitation.

shambhu_gita::446.verse_sanskrit:
किविध ज्ञानसम्पन्ने जीवपिण्डे समुन्नते । 
स्याद्धर्मसार्वभौमात्मोदारमृतोर्हि दर्शनम् ॥
shambhu_gita::446.verse_hindi: धर्म की सार्वभौम उदार मूर्ति का दर्शन किस प्रकार के उन्नत ज्ञानसम्पन्न जीवपिण्ड मे हो सकता है
shambhu_gita::446.english_translation: How can the universal, generous form of dharma be perceived by a living being endowed with elevated knowledge?
shambhu_gita::446.translation_literal: किविध (how) / ज्ञानसम्पन्ने (knowledge-endowed) / जीवपिण्डे (living being) / समुन्नते (elevated) / स्याद् (can be) / धर्मसार्वभौमात्म (universal nature of dharma) / उदार (generous) / मृतोर्हि (form) / दर्शनम् (perception)
shambhu_gita::446.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::446.essence: Dharma’s universal, generous nature is visible only through elevated knowledge.
shambhu_gita::446.simple_meaning: Only a living being with deeply elevated knowledge can truly perceive the vast and generous nature of dharma.
shambhu_gita::446.simple_insight: You feel inspired knowing that growing your understanding opens you to deeper truths.
shambhu_gita::446.detailed_meaning: Shiva speaks to the challenge of perceiving dharma's universal and generous nature, which only a living being with highly developed knowledge can grasp.
shambhu_gita::446.modern_relevance: When you deepen your understanding beyond surface facts, you begin to see the bigger, generous purpose behind your actions.
shambhu_gita::446.insight: It teaches you to cultivate elevated knowledge as the key to perceiving dharma fully.

shambhu_gita::447.verse_sanskrit:
वर्णाश्रमाणां धर्माणां महत्त्वं हृदयङ्गमम् ।
कीदृशाः प्राणिनः कर्तुं शक्नुयुस्तु समुन्नताः ॥
shambhu_gita::447.verse_hindi: और वर्णाश्चमधर्म का महत्व कैसे उन्नत जीव हृदयंगम कर  सकते हैं
shambhu_gita::447.english_translation: How can elevated beings deeply understand the importance of the duties and duties of the social orders?
shambhu_gita::447.translation_literal: वर्णाश्रमाणां (of social orders and stages of life) / धर्माणां (duties) / महत्त्वं (importance) / हृदयङ्गमम् (heart-penetrating, deeply understood) / कीदृशाः (what kind) / प्राणिनः (beings) / कर्तुं (to do) / शक्नुयुः (can) / तु (indeed) / समुन्नताः (elevated, noble)
shambhu_gita::447.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::447.essence: Deep understanding of duties comes only with noble growth and inner awareness.
shambhu_gita::447.simple_meaning: As you become wiser and more developed, you can deeply understand the true importance of your social and life duties.
shambhu_gita::447.simple_insight: There is growth in recognizing your responsibilities clearly and feeling their true weight.
shambhu_gita::447.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva asks how noble beings come to deeply understand the significance of duties assigned by social order and life stages, pointing to a process of inner growth and clarity about one’s role.
shambhu_gita::447.modern_relevance: When you gain experience in your work or family, you begin to see why your responsibilities truly matter, beyond surface tasks.
shambhu_gita::447.insight: It teaches you that understanding your role deeply requires growth and inner reflection, not just following rules.

shambhu_gita::448.verse_sanskrit:
दिग्दर्शनञ्च धर्मस्य कारितं यद्दयावशात् ।
तेनावश्यं वयं शम्भो ! धर्मास्याभ्युदयाय वै ॥
shambhu_gita::448.verse_hindi: आपने जो कृपा करके हमारे धर्म का दिग्दर्शन कराया है, हे शम्भो ! जिसके द्वारा हम अवश्य ही धर्माभ्युदय के लिये
shambhu_gita::448.english_translation: The guidance of dharma you have graciously shown, O Shambhu, surely leads us to the flourishing of dharma.
shambhu_gita::448.translation_literal: दिग्दर्शनञ्च (guidance) धर्मस्य (of dharma) कारितं (made/done) यद्दयावशात् (by grace) । तेन (by that) अवश्यं (certainly) वयं (we) शम्भो (O Shambhu) ! धर्मास्याभ्युदयाय (for the rising/prosperity of dharma) वै (indeed) ॥
shambhu_gita::448.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::448.essence: Gracious guidance leads to the sure flourishing of dharma.
shambhu_gita::448.simple_meaning: You have kindly shown us the way of dharma, Shambhu, which will surely help dharma to rise and thrive.
shambhu_gita::448.simple_insight: There is trust in receiving guidance that will bring growth and renewal.
shambhu_gita::448.detailed_meaning: Suta praises Shambhu (Shiva) for kindly showing the correct path of dharma. This guidance is recognized as powerful and certain to bring about the flourishing of dharma itself.
shambhu_gita::448.insight: It encourages trust that wise guidance leads to positive growth beyond immediate control.

shambhu_gita::449.verse_sanskrit:
अलं कृतं  हि मानन्याः सृष्टेः साहाय्यमद्भुतम् ।
प्राकृतायास्तथा दैव्याः सृष्टेः सन्तः सहायकाः ॥
shambhu_gita::449.verse_hindi: मानवी सृष्टि की अद्भुत सहायता करने में समर्थ होंगे और साथ ही साथ प्राकृत सृष्टि और देवी सृष्टि के सहायक बनकर
shambhu_gita::449.english_translation: The beings of the human creation are capable of wonderful support, and likewise, the beings of the natural and divine creations are helpers.
shambhu_gita::449.translation_literal: अलं (beings) / कृतं (made) / हि (indeed) / मानन्याः (of the human) / सृष्टेः (creation) / साहाय्यमद्भुतम् (wonderful support) / प्राकृतायाः (of the natural) / तथा (and also) / दैव्याः (divine) / सृष्टेः (creation) / सन्तः (are) / सहायकाः (helpers)
shambhu_gita::449.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::449.essence: Multiple realms of beings all assist creation in wondrous ways.
shambhu_gita::449.simple_meaning: Beings from human, natural, and divine creations all help in supporting the world in remarkable ways.
shambhu_gita::449.simple_insight: Support arises from many sources, seen and unseen, working together.
shambhu_gita::449.detailed_meaning: The verse describes the three realms of creation—human, natural, and divine—and emphasizes that beings from all these realms contribute as helpers in the unfolding world.
shambhu_gita::449.modern_relevance: You notice how your friends, nature around you, and your inner values all support you in different, often surprising ways.
shambhu_gita::449.insight: It encourages recognizing support beyond just what is obvious or human-made, expanding awareness of interconnected help.

shambhu_gita::450.verse_sanskrit:
सामञ्जस्यं भवत्सृष्टिलीलाविस्तारगोचरम् ।
अवन्नस्ते प्रसादस्य हेतवः सम्भवेम च ॥
shambhu_gita::450.verse_hindi: आपकी सृष्टि लीला विस्तार सम्बन्धी सामञ्जस्य की रक्षा करते हुए आपकी प्रसन्नता का कारण हो सकेंगे
shambhu_gita::450.english_translation: Your creation's playful expansion maintains harmony and can be the cause of your delight.
shambhu_gita::450.translation_literal: सामञ्जस्यं (harmony) भवत् (your) सृष्टि-लीला-विस्तार-गोचरम् (creation-play-expansion-visible) अवन्नः (cause) ते (your) प्रसादस्य (delight) हेतवः (reasons) सम्भवेम (can become) च (and)
shambhu_gita::450.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::450.essence: Harmony in creation's unfolding supports and causes delight.
shambhu_gita::450.simple_meaning: The harmony in your playful creation and its unfolding can bring the cause for your happiness.
shambhu_gita::450.simple_insight: Harmony in creative expression can become the source of joy and delight.
shambhu_gita::450.detailed_meaning: Shiva speaks about the harmony sustaining the playful expansion of creation and how this harmony can foster divine delight. This verse reflects on the cosmic balance underlying the unfolding universe and its joyful essence.
shambhu_gita::450.insight: It invites recognizing that harmony in natural growth and creativity supports joy rather than struggle.

shambhu_gita::451.verse_sanskrit:
दैव्याः सृष्टेः समासेन श्रीवयित्वा रहस्यकम् ।
अद्य नस्तर्पय ज्ञानपिपासां हे कृपानिधे ! ॥
shambhu_gita::451.verse_hindi: अब हे कृपानिधे! दैवी सृष्टि का संक्षेप रहस्य हमको सुनाकर हमारी ज्ञान पिपासा को तृप्त कीजिये
shambhu_gita::451.english_translation: O treasure of compassion, please reveal the secret summary of the divine creation today to satisfy our thirst for knowledge.
shambhu_gita::451.translation_literal: दैव्याः (divine) सृष्टेः (of creation) समासेन (in summary) श्रीवयित्वा (having graciously told) रहस्यकम् (the secret) । अद्य (today) नः (our) तर्पय (satisfy) ज्ञानपिपासां (thirst for knowledge) हे (O) कृपानिधे (treasure of compassion) ! ॥
shambhu_gita::451.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::451.essence: A heartfelt request for the secret summary of divine creation to satisfy deep knowledge thirst.
shambhu_gita::451.simple_meaning: We ask the compassionate teacher to share the secret summary of the divine creation to satisfy our deep thirst for knowledge.
shambhu_gita::451.simple_insight: There is a longing to receive deep understanding that can quench our inner curiosity.
shambhu_gita::451.detailed_meaning: The sages assembled request the compassionate teacher to reveal the secret and concise essence of the divine creation to fulfill their eager desire for wisdom at this moment.
shambhu_gita::451.insight: It highlights the importance of asking for clear, essential knowledge when curiosity is strong.

shambhu_gita::452.verse_sanskrit:
प्राकृतायाः समासाद्य सृष्टरेच यथाक्रमम् ।
विकाशं मानवी सृष्टिर्जायते नात्र संशयः ॥
shambhu_gita::452.verse_hindi: प्राकृत सृष्टि से ही क्रमविकाश होकर मानवी सृष्टि उत्पन्न होती है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
shambhu_gita::452.english_translation: Human existence emerges in order from the natural world's unfolding without doubt.
shambhu_gita::452.translation_literal: प्राकृतायाः (of the natural) / समासाद्य (arriving at) / सृष्टरेच (after creation) / यथाक्रमम् (in sequence) / विकाशं (unfolding) / मानवी (human) / सृष्टिर्जायते (creation arises) / नात्र (there is no) / संशयः (doubt).
shambhu_gita::452.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::452.essence: Human life unfolds naturally in sequence from the original creation.
shambhu_gita::452.simple_meaning: Human life develops step-by-step from the natural world's prior creation in a clear sequence.
shambhu_gita::452.simple_insight: Everything you see in human life unfolds naturally from what came before.
shambhu_gita::452.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that human existence is not random but emerges naturally and sequentially from the original creation of the natural world, pointing to a clear order in the process.
shambhu_gita::452.modern_relevance: Your own growth and experiences build gradually from earlier stages, like how nature unfolds in order.
shambhu_gita::452.insight: Recognize that complex outcomes arise only after simpler stages have naturally occurred first.

shambhu_gita::453.verse_sanskrit:
उभयोरेतयोर्ज्ञानं सम्यगस्माकमस्यतः।
अस्मल्लोकादतीतानां देवानां नास्ति किन्त्वलम् ॥
shambhu_gita::453.verse_hindi: इस कारण इन दोनों सृष्टियों का ज्ञान हमको अच्छी तरह ज्ञात है परन्तु हमारे लोक से अतीत जो अन्यान्य देश लोक है
shambhu_gita::453.english_translation: Therefore, we have perfect knowledge of both these worlds, but there is no other beyond our world among the gods.
shambhu_gita::453.translation_literal: उभयोरेतयोः (of both these) ज्ञानं (knowledge) सम्यग् (perfectly) अस्माकम् (our) अस्यतः (from this side). अस्मत् (from us) लोकात् (world) अतीतानां (beyond) देवानां (of gods) नास्ति (there is not) किन्त्व् (but) अलम् (other).
shambhu_gita::453.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::453.essence: Our knowledge covers these two worlds; no gods exist beyond them.
shambhu_gita::453.simple_meaning: We fully understand these two worlds, but there are no gods beyond our known world.
shambhu_gita::453.simple_insight: Knowledge is limited to what is experienced and known within our world.
shambhu_gita::453.detailed_meaning: Suta explains that though there is full understanding of the two realms discussed, no divine beings exist beyond the world known to us, highlighting the boundary of cosmic knowledge.
shambhu_gita::453.insight: It highlights the limits of known existence, inviting humility about what lies beyond perception.

shambhu_gita::454.verse_sanskrit:
स्वरूपं लोकवृन्दानां विदितं नः किमप्यहो।
तदोषान्नः सदा दृष्टिः कैवल्याभ्युदयमदे ॥
shambhu_gita::454.verse_hindi: उनका स्वरूप अहो ! हमको कुछ भी विदित नहीं है, उनका ज्ञान हमें हो जाने से अभ्युदय
shambhu_gita::454.english_translation: Their true nature is unknown to us; our vision has never perceived it, yet freedom arises from this.
shambhu_gita::454.translation_literal: स्वरूपं (form/nature) लोकवृन्दानां (of the worldly assemblies) विदितं (known) नः (to us) किमप्यहो (nothing at all). तदोषान्नः (those faults not) सदा (always) दृष्टिः (vision) कैवल्याभ्युदयम् (freedom's arising) अदे (arises).
shambhu_gita::454.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::454.essence: Not fully knowing the true nature allows freedom to arise unexpectedly.
shambhu_gita::454.simple_meaning: We have never truly seen the real nature of the world or beings, yet this lack of complete knowledge leads to emerging freedom.
shambhu_gita::454.simple_insight: It's okay not to fully understand; this space of not-knowing can bring liberation.
shambhu_gita::454.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that despite all worldly appearances, the true essence of beings remains unknown to us. This very unawareness paradoxically allows freedom (kaivalya) to arise, marking a deep philosophical insight into the limits of perception and knowledge.
shambhu_gita::454.modern_relevance: When you face something mysterious or unclear, the urge to control can fade, opening space for unexpected freedom and growth.
shambhu_gita::454.insight: This verse shifts your focus from demanding certainty to embracing the openness of not fully knowing, which allows inner freedom to emerge.

shambhu_gita::455.verse_sanskrit:
गतिद्वयेऽवतिष्ठेत सर्वथैव यथार्थतः।
वयं शरणमापन्ना यथा स्याच्छं तथा कुरु ॥
shambhu_gita::455.verse_hindi: और निःश्रेयसकारिणी उभयगति पर सब प्रकार से ही हमारी दृष्टि यथार्थतः सदा रहेगी। हम आपके शरणागत हैं, जिससे कल्याण हो  कृपा वैसा कीजिये
shambhu_gita::455.english_translation: Our vision must always remain truly on both paths that lead to highest good. We are surrendered to you; please grant the grace that brings welfare.
shambhu_gita::455.translation_literal:
गति (paths) द्वयेऽवतिष्ठेत (should stand on both) सर्वथैव (in every way) यथार्थतः (truly) ।
वयं (we) शरणमापन्ना (having taken refuge) यथा (as) स्याच्छं (such) तथा (thus) कुरु (do/make) ॥
shambhu_gita::455.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::455.essence: Complete surrender with unwavering trust holds both paths to true welfare.
shambhu_gita::455.simple_meaning: You should keep your focus truly on both ways that lead to well-being. Having taken refuge, ask for the help that brings good.
shambhu_gita::455.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing you are protected when you surrender trust completely.
shambhu_gita::455.detailed_meaning: At a moment of seeking support, Shiva advises keeping firm faith in the paths that lead to true welfare. The speaker calls for full surrender and trust in the grace of the divine to guide and protect.
shambhu_gita::455.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by choices, feeling lost, you lean into trust that both effort and surrender will bring what you truly need.
shambhu_gita::455.insight: It encourages you to hold steady faith in surrender and trust simultaneously, balancing active seeking with peaceful acceptance.

shambhu_gita::456.verse_sanskrit:
कल्याः ! स्थूलजगन्नृनं सूक्ष्मदैवजगतम् । 
सृष्टेरस्त्यधिभूतायाश्चालकं धारकं तथा ॥
shambhu_gita::456.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! स्थूल जगत सूक्ष्म देव जगत के आधार पर ही स्थित है, अधिभूत सृष्टि का चालक और धारक
shambhu_gita::456.english_translation: O ancestors! The gross world stands supported by the subtle divine world; it is the driver and sustainer of the manifested nature.
shambhu_gita::456.translation_literal: कल्याः (O ancestors) / स्थूलजगन्नृनं (the gross world) / सूक्ष्मदैवजगतम् (the subtle divine world) / सृष्टेरस्त्यधिभूतायाः (of the manifested nature) / चालयकं (driver) / धारकं (sustainer) / तथा (also)
shambhu_gita::456.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::456.essence: The physical world exists because of a deeper, sustaining subtle realm.
shambhu_gita::456.simple_meaning: The visible physical world depends on a subtle divine world that supports and governs all creation.
shambhu_gita::456.simple_insight: Everything you see relies on a deeper unseen support holding it together.
shambhu_gita::456.detailed_meaning: Addressing ancestral beings, Shiva explains that the physical world you know is supported and moved by a finer divine realm that sustains all life and creation.
shambhu_gita::456.insight: It invites you to see beyond appearances and recognize the subtle foundation beneath all things.

shambhu_gita::457.verse_sanskrit:
आधिदैविकराज्यं हि नास्ति कोऽप्यत्र संशयः ।
ससमेतन्न सन्देहः कर्त्तव्योऽत्र कदाचन ॥
shambhu_gita::457.verse_hindi: अधिदैवराज्य ही है इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है यह सत्य है इसमें कभी सन्देह न करना चाहिये
shambhu_gita::457.english_translation: There is no doubt that the higher divine kingdom exists; never hesitate to act accordingly here.
shambhu_gita::457.translation_literal: आधिदैविकराज्यं (higher divine kingdom) / हि (indeed) / नास्ति (is not) / कोऽपि (anyone) / अत्र (here) / संशयः (doubt) / ससमेतन्न (with doubt) / सन्देहः (hesitation) / कर्त्तव्योऽत्र (must be done here) / कदाचन (at any time)
shambhu_gita::457.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::457.essence: The higher divine order is certain; hesitation has no place in action.
shambhu_gita::457.simple_meaning: The higher divine order or kingdom truly exists without any doubt, so you should never hesitate to act accordingly.
shambhu_gita::457.simple_insight: You feel confidence knowing the higher truth is certain, freeing you to act decisively.
shambhu_gita::457.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares that the higher divine kingdom—an ultimate reality or order—is undeniably real. This moment urges Arjuna or the listener to act firmly without hesitation, trusting this supreme truth as a foundation for all action.
shambhu_gita::457.modern_relevance: When you face uncertainty about big choices, remember some truths are certain and can guide your steps confidently.
shambhu_gita::457.insight: It teaches you to replace hesitation with trust in a higher order, empowering decisive action.

shambhu_gita::458.verse_sanskrit:
विनाऽधिदेवमाहाय्यं जगतो भवितुं क्षमाः।
न स्थूलहश्यमानस्य सृष्टिस्थितिलयक्रियाः ॥
shambhu_gita::458.verse_hindi: बिना अधिदैव सहायता के स्थूल परिदृश्यमान जगत की न सृष्टि हो सकती है, न स्थिति हो सकती है और न लय हो सकता है
shambhu_gita::458.english_translation: Without the help of the supreme divine, the manifest world cannot be created, sustained, or dissolved.
shambhu_gita::458.translation_literal: विना (without) अधिदेवम् (supreme divine) आहाय्यं (help) जगतो (of the world) भवितुं (to be) क्षमाः (possible) । न (not) स्थूल (gross) हश्यमानस्य (manifest) सृष्टि (creation) स्थिति (sustenance) लय (dissolution) क्रियाः (actions) ॥
shambhu_gita::458.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::458.essence: The manifest world depends entirely on the supreme divine’s sustaining power.
shambhu_gita::458.simple_meaning: The visible world cannot come into being, exist, or disappear without the support of the supreme divine.
shambhu_gita::458.simple_insight: There is deep reliance on a profound source behind all that appears real and lasting.
shambhu_gita::458.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the gross, manifest world you experience cannot be created, maintained, or dissolved without the supreme divine's help, highlighting the essential support beyond physical reality.
shambhu_gita::458.modern_relevance: When life feels unstable, remembering that a deeper source sustains everything can provide calm and perspective.
shambhu_gita::458.insight: It shifts the mind to recognize dependence on an unseen support beyond appearances.

shambhu_gita::459.verse_sanskrit:
विधा विभक्तं पितरः ! देवं राज्यं हि वर्तते ।
आध्यात्मिकाधिदैवाधिभूतरूपं न संशयः ॥
shambhu_gita::459.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! दैवीराज्य अध्यात्म, अधिदैव और अधिभूतरूप से तीन भागों में ही निस्सन्देह विभक्त है
shambhu_gita::459.english_translation: O ancestors! The divine kingdom is undoubtedly divided into three parts: spiritual, divine-ordained, and material.
shambhu_gita::459.translation_literal: विधा (division) / विभक्तं (divided) / पितरः (ancestors) / देवं (divine) / राज्यं (kingdom) / हि (indeed) / वर्तते (exists) / आध्यात्मिक (spiritual) / अधिदैव (divine-ordained) / अधिभूत (material) / रूपं (form) / न (not) / संशयः (doubt)
shambhu_gita::459.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::459.essence: The divine realm naturally divides into spiritual, ordained, and material parts.
shambhu_gita::459.simple_meaning: The divine realm is clearly divided into three parts: spiritual, divine-ordained, and material aspects.
shambhu_gita::459.simple_insight: Understanding the divine as multi-layered opens new ways to relate to existence.
shambhu_gita::459.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses the sages explaining that the divine kingdom is composed of three distinct realms—spiritual, divine-ordained, and material—setting the framework for understanding reality's complex nature.
shambhu_gita::459.insight: It invites you to see reality as multi-dimensional, encouraging a broader perspective beyond the obvious.

shambhu_gita::460.verse_sanskrit:
आधिभौतिककार्यस्य यूयं विश्वस्य चालकाः । 
आध्यात्मिकक्रियायाश्च चालका ऋषयो ध्रुवम् ॥
shambhu_gita::460.verse_hindi: जगत की आधिभौतिक क्रिया के सञ्चालक आप लोग हैं जगत की अध्यात्म क्रिया के सञ्चालक ऋषिगण ही है
shambhu_gita::460.english_translation: You are the directors of all physical activity in the world; the sages are certainly the directors of all spiritual activity.
shambhu_gita::460.translation_literal: आधिभौतिककार्यस्य (of physical activity) / यूयं (you) / विश्वस्य (of the world) / चालकाः (directors) / आध्यात्मिकक्रियायाश्च (and of spiritual activities) / चालका (directors) / ऋषयो (the sages) / ध्रुवम् (certainly)
shambhu_gita::460.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::460.essence: You direct physical action; sages direct spiritual action.
shambhu_gita::460.simple_meaning: You control the physical actions in the world, while sages guide spiritual actions.
shambhu_gita::460.simple_insight: You have responsibility for your actions, but spiritual guidance comes from wise teachers.
shambhu_gita::460.detailed_meaning: Shiva tells that ordinary people are responsible for worldly, physical actions. Meanwhile, sages guide the deeper spiritual practices, showing a division of roles tied to outer life and inner growth.
shambhu_gita::460.modern_relevance: You make decisions and take action in daily life, but you can seek wise guidance for your inner growth and purpose.
shambhu_gita::460.insight: Recognize your role in worldly action while valuing spiritual mentorship for inner development.

shambhu_gita::461.verse_sanskrit:
अधिदैवक्रियायाः सञ्चालकाः सन्ति भूतिदाः!।
देवा नैके न सन्देहो नित्य नैमित्तिकास्तथा ॥
shambhu_gita::461.verse_hindi: और हे पितृगण! जगत की अधिदैव क्रिया के सञ्चालक अनेक नित्य और नैमित्तिक देवतागण ही हैं
shambhu_gita::461.english_translation: And O ancestors! The controllers of the world's higher cosmic functions are many eternal and occasional divine beings.
shambhu_gita::461.translation_literal: अधिदैवक्रियायाः (of higher cosmic functions) सञ्चालकाः (controllers) सन्ति (are) भूतिदाः (divine beings)! / देवा (divine beings) नैके (many) न (not) सन्देहो (doubt) नित्य (eternal) नैमित्तिकास्तथा (occasional as well)
shambhu_gita::461.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::461.essence: Many divine beings govern the world's higher cosmic functions eternally and occasionally.
shambhu_gita::461.simple_meaning: Many eternal and occasional divine beings control the higher cosmic functions of the world.
shambhu_gita::461.simple_insight: The universe operates through many divine forces beyond what we see.
shambhu_gita::461.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses the sages, explaining that numerous divine beings govern the higher cosmic activities sustaining the world, both constantly and at specific times, describing the unseen forces behind worldly processes.
shambhu_gita::461.insight: It reveals that many unseen forces guide the world's functioning, not just one power.

shambhu_gita::462.verse_sanskrit:
देवश्रेण्यो हि मे तिस्त्र एताः सन्ति विभूतयः।
नातः स्याद्रक्षिता सृष्टिरासां साहाय्यमन्तरा ॥
shambhu_gita::462.verse_hindi: यह तीनो ही देवश्रेणी मेरी विभूति हैं, इस कारण इन तीनों ही की सहायता बिना सृष्टि की रक्षा नहीं हो सकती
shambhu_gita::462.english_translation: These three divine qualities are my powers; without their support, the protection of creation is impossible.
shambhu_gita::462.translation_literal: देवश्रेण्यो (divine class) / हि (indeed) / मे (my) / तिस्त्र (these three) / एताः (these) / सन्ति (are) / विभूतयः (powers) / नातः (without them) / स्याद् (would be) / रक्षिता (protected) / सृष्टिः (creation) / आसां (their) / साहाय्यम् (help) / अन्तरा (without)
shambhu_gita::462.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::462.essence: Creation depends on the combined support of three essential divine powers.
shambhu_gita::462.simple_meaning: Three divine powers are essential supports without which the world cannot be sustained or protected.
shambhu_gita::462.simple_insight: You see how everything depends on unseen forces working together to keep life flowing.
shambhu_gita::462.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares that three divine qualities are his fundamental powers. These three together uphold and protect creation; without their combined support, the universe cannot be maintained.
shambhu_gita::462.insight: Recognize that complex systems rely on multiple essential forces working in harmony for stability.

shambhu_gita::463.verse_sanskrit:
देवानामेव किन्त्वस्ति नूनं शक्तिविचारतः। 
सर्वाधिकारतस्तेपामधिकारः समुन्नतः ॥
shambhu_gita::463.verse_hindi: परन्तु शक्ति के विचार से देवतागण का अधिकार ही सब अधिकारों से उन्नत है
shambhu_gita::463.english_translation: Among all beings, only the radiant beings have authority arising from their power, which is higher than all other authorities.
shambhu_gita::463.translation_literal: देवानामेव (of the radiant beings only) किन्त्वस्ति (indeed there is) नूनं (certainly) शक्तिविचारतः (from the consideration of power)। सर्वाधिकारतः (from all authority) तेषाम् (of them) अधिकारः (authority) समुन्नतः (elevated)
shambhu_gita::463.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::463.essence: Real authority is power-based and superior to all other claims of control.
shambhu_gita::463.simple_meaning: Only the radiant beings have authority that comes from their true power, which is higher than any other kind of authority.
shambhu_gita::463.simple_insight: True authority comes from inner power, not just position or title.
shambhu_gita::463.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that among all beings, the radiant beings (devas) hold a unique authority that is derived from their inherent power, making their authority superior to others. This sets a hierarchy based on true power, not mere status.
shambhu_gita::463.modern_relevance: In any group or team, real influence comes from your capability and strength, not just your job title or rank.
shambhu_gita::463.insight: It teaches you to recognize true authority as emerging from genuine power and capability, not superficial roles.

shambhu_gita::464.verse_sanskrit:
अस्त्येतद्धि जगत्सर्वं पितरः ! कर्ममूलकम् ।
जड़त्वात्कर्मवर्गस्य तत्सञ्चालनकर्मणि ॥
shambhu_gita::464.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् कर्म मूलक है, कर्मों के जड़ होने से कर्म के संञ्चालन में देवताओं की
shambhu_gita::464.english_translation: O ancestors, this entire world is rooted in action; due to the inertness of the realm of action, gods carry out those actions.
shambhu_gita::464.translation_literal: अस्ति (is) एतत् (this) हि (indeed) जगत् (world) सर्वं (entire) पितरः (ancestors) कर्ममूलकम् (rooted in action) जड़त्वात् (due to inertness) कर्मवर्गस्य (of the category of action) तत् (that) सञ्चालनकर्मणि (in the acting of actions)
shambhu_gita::464.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::464.essence: All existence is based on action, even divine beings act due to its inert foundation.
shambhu_gita::464.simple_meaning: Everything in the world exists because of action, and even divine beings act because action is fundamental and inert by nature.
shambhu_gita::464.simple_insight: Realizing that action underlies all existence helps you see your role in the world's movement.
shambhu_gita::464.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, explaining that the whole universe depends on action. Since the realm of action is inert, even divine beings must engage in activity to sustain the cosmos.
shambhu_gita::464.modern_relevance: When you notice how every part of your life depends on doing something, you understand that action is the foundation beneath all outcomes.
shambhu_gita::464.insight: It teaches you to recognize that action is the fundamental force behind all change and movement around you.

shambhu_gita::465.verse_sanskrit:
आवश्यकत्वाद्देवानां तत्प्राधान्यं परं स्मृतम।
नैवात्र संशयः कार्यो विस्मयो वा कदाचन ॥
shambhu_gita::465.verse_hindi: आवश्यकता रहने से देवताओं की परम प्रधानता मानी गई है, इसमें सन्देह अथवा  विस्मय कभी नहीं ही करना चाहिये
shambhu_gita::465.english_translation: Because of their necessity, the supreme importance of the deva beings is acknowledged; there is never cause for doubt or surprise about this.
shambhu_gita::465.translation_literal: आवश्यकत्वाद्देवानां (because of necessity of the deva beings) तत्प्राधान्यं (their supreme importance) परं (supreme) स्मृतम (is remembered/acknowledged)। नैवात्र (never there) संशयः (doubt) कार्यो (is to be) विस्मयो (surprise) वा (or) कदाचन (at any time) ॥
shambhu_gita::465.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::465.essence: The supreme importance of the deva beings is never doubtful due to their necessity.
shambhu_gita::465.simple_meaning: The supreme importance of the deva beings is accepted because they are necessary; there is no reason to doubt or be surprised by this.
shambhu_gita::465.simple_insight: Recognizing necessity removes confusion about what truly matters.
shambhu_gita::465.detailed_meaning: Suta explains that the deva beings hold the highest importance due to their essential role, and there should be no doubt or astonishment about this fact.
shambhu_gita::465.insight: It clarifies that accepting the essential role of something removes hesitation or surprise about its status.

shambhu_gita::466.verse_sanskrit:
अहं चतुर्दशानां हि भुवनानां स्वधाभुजः !।
पञ्चानाञ्चैव कोषाणां सम्बन्धादद्य वो ब्रुवे ॥
shambhu_gita::466.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण' ! अब मैं चतुर्दश भुवन और पञ्चकोष के सम्बन्ध से आपको कहता हूँ
shambhu_gita::466.english_translation: O ancestors! Now I will speak to you about the fourteen worlds and the five sheaths.
shambhu_gita::466.translation_literal: अहं (I) / चतुर्दशानां (of fourteen) / हि (indeed) / भुवनानां (worlds) / स्वधाभुजः (possessor of sheaths) / पञ्चानाञ्चैव (and also five) / कोषाणां (sheaths) / सम्बन्धाद्य (relation from) / वो (to you) / ब्रुवे (I speak)
shambhu_gita::466.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::466.essence: Introducing the relation between the fourteen worlds and the five sheaths.
shambhu_gita::466.simple_meaning: I am about to explain the connection between the fourteen worlds and the five sheaths to you.
shambhu_gita::466.simple_insight: This moment marks a transition to deeper teachings about the cosmos and the self.
shambhu_gita::466.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestral beings, preparing to reveal profound knowledge about the fourteen worlds and the five sheaths that cover the true self, signaling a shift to metaphysical teachings.
shambhu_gita::466.insight: It introduces the framework for understanding layers of existence and self beyond the physical.

shambhu_gita::467.verse_sanskrit:
प्राधान्यं देववृन्दस्य श्रूयतां सुसमाहितै: ।
देवसृष्टिरहस्यं स्याज्जातं येन यथार्थतः ॥
shambhu_gita::467.verse_hindi: देवताओं की प्रधानता ध्यान देकर सुनो जिससे आपको देवी संधिशा यशार्थ रहस्य विदित हो जायगा
shambhu_gita::467.english_translation: Listen attentively to the supremacy of the divine assembly, through which the secret of creation is truly revealed.
shambhu_gita::467.translation_literal: प्राधान्यं (supremacy) देववृन्दस्य (of the divine assembly) श्रूयतां (let it be heard) सुसमाहितै: (by the well-focused) । देवसृष्टिरहस्यं (secret of divine creation) स्याज्जातं (may arise) येन (by which) यथार्थतः (truly) ॥
shambhu_gita::467.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::467.essence: Focused attention reveals the true secret behind the divine origin of creation.
shambhu_gita::467.simple_meaning: Listen carefully to the highest status of the divine assembly, through which the true secret of creation is revealed.
shambhu_gita::467.simple_insight: There is value in focused attention to deeper truths beyond ordinary hearing.
shambhu_gita::467.detailed_meaning: Suta invites the sages to attentively hear about the supreme prominence of the divine beings, which holds the secret origin of creation, setting the stage for profound teaching.
shambhu_gita::467.insight: It encourages focused presence to grasp deeper truths that remain hidden without attention.

shambhu_gita::468.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशाख्यं त्रिमूर्ति त्रिगुणात्मकम् ।
यदाऽहं पितरो धृत्वा स्वशक्तेरवलम्बनात् ॥
shambhu_gita::468.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! जब मैं ब्रह्मा विष्णु और महेश रूपी त्रिगुणात्मक त्रिमूर्ती को धारण करके अपनी शक्ति की सहायता से
shambhu_gita::468.english_translation: O ancestors, when I manifested as the threefold form of Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh, embodying the three qualities through my own power.
shambhu_gita::468.translation_literal: ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशाख्यं (called Brahma, Vishnu, Mahesh) / त्रिमूर्ति (three-formed) / त्रिगुणात्मकम् (having three qualities) / यदा (when) / अहं (I) / पितरो (ancestors) / धृत्वा (holding) / स्वशक्तेः (own power) / अवलम्बनात् (with support)
shambhu_gita::468.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::468.essence: One power manifests as many forms embodying fundamental qualities.
shambhu_gita::468.simple_meaning: I took the form of the three divine beings—Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh—through my own power when addressing the ancestors.
shambhu_gita::468.simple_insight: This moment shows how the divine expresses itself in many forms through one power.
shambhu_gita::468.detailed_meaning: Shiva speaks to the ancestors, explaining that he manifested as the triad of Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh, embodying the three fundamental qualities, using his own inherent power to support creation and order.
shambhu_gita::468.insight: It reveals the unity behind diverse forms, showing one source expressing multiple aspects through its power.

shambhu_gita::469.verse_sanskrit:
आददे सगुणं रूपं तिस्रस्ता एव मूर्तयः ।
प्राधान्यं सर्वदेवेषु धरन्योऽलं भवन्ति ते ॥
shambhu_gita::469.verse_hindi: सगुण होता हूँ तो वही मेरी त्रिमूर्ति सर्वदेव प्रधान होकर निस्सन्देह प्रधान देवता कहलाते हैं
shambhu_gita::469.english_translation: When I manifest with qualities, I am the Trimurti—the supreme presence among all deities, undeniably the foremost divine being.
shambhu_gita::469.translation_literal: आददे (I manifest) / सगुणं (with qualities) / रूपं (form) / तिस्रस्ता (threefold) / एव (indeed) / मूर्तयः (forms) / प्राधान्यं (supremacy) / सर्वदेवेषु (among all gods) / धरन्यः (held/considered) / अलं (indeed) / भवन्ति (are) / ते (they)
shambhu_gita::469.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::469.essence: The divine manifests primarily as the three supreme forms recognized above all others.
shambhu_gita::469.simple_meaning: The divine appears in three main forms called the Trimurti, which are recognized as supreme among all radiant beings.
shambhu_gita::469.simple_insight: Your true presence can be seen in many forms, all equally powerful and interconnected.
shambhu_gita::469.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that when manifesting with qualities, he appears as the three principal forms—the Trimurti—who are considered the highest among all radiant beings worshipped by devotees, highlighting the unity behind multiple expressions.
shambhu_gita::469.insight: It helps you see that the divine's many forms are different expressions of the same supreme essence.

shambhu_gita::470.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्माण्डे किल प्रत्येकं मुख्या देवा न संशयः ।
आवहन्तस्त्रिदेवाख्यां प्राशस्त्यं यानि सर्वथा ॥
shambhu_gita::470.verse_hindi: प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड में और त्रिदेव नाम को धारण करके सर्वथा प्रसिद्ध होते हैं।
shambhu_gita::470.english_translation: In every universe, the primary radiant beings, known as the three gods, are entirely celebrated everywhere.
shambhu_gita::470.translation_literal: ब्रह्माण्डे (in the universe) / किल (indeed) / प्रत्येकं (each) / मुख्या (primary) / देवा (divine beings) / न (not) / संशयः (doubt) / आवहन्तः (called) / त्रिदेवाख्यां (by the name of three gods) / प्राशस्त्यं (famous) / यानि (those which) / सर्वथा (completely)
shambhu_gita::470.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::470.essence: Every universe features three main divine beings known everywhere.
shambhu_gita::470.simple_meaning: Each universe has main divine beings called the three gods, who are famous everywhere.
shambhu_gita::470.simple_insight: Recognizing that universal principles appear in many forms can deepen your understanding of the divine.
shambhu_gita::470.detailed_meaning: The narrator describes that in every cosmic realm, there are primary divine beings named the three gods, known and revered universally. This sets a cosmic context but does not teach a specific principle here.
shambhu_gita::470.insight: It highlights the presence of common divine archetypes across different realms but lacks direct practical application.

shambhu_gita::471.verse_sanskrit:
अस्य मूर्तित्रयस्यास्ते प्रतिब्रह्माण्डवर्तिन:।
नैव भेदो मया सार्द्ध वस्तुनः कश्चिदप्यणुः ॥
shambhu_gita::471.verse_hindi: वास्तव में प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड के इन त्रिमूर्तियों में और मुझमें कोई भी भेद नहीं है
shambhu_gita::471.english_translation: Indeed, there is no difference between these three forms of the universe and me.
shambhu_gita::471.translation_literal: अस्य (of this) / मूर्तित्रयस्यास्ते (three forms exist) / प्रतिब्रह्माण्डवर्तिन: (within the universe) / नैव (not) / भेदो (difference) / मया (by me) / सार्ध (along with) / वस्तुनः (of the object) / कश्चिदप्यणुः (anyone at all)
shambhu_gita::471.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::471.essence: The apparent many and the self are fundamentally one without any separation.
shambhu_gita::471.simple_meaning: There is no real separation between the three universal forms and Shiva; all are one in essence.
shambhu_gita::471.simple_insight: You can feel connected deeply because all forms share the same essence as you.
shambhu_gita::471.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares that the three universal forms that manifest within the cosmos are not separate from him. This reveals the non-dual nature of reality where the divine and its manifestations share one essence.
shambhu_gita::471.modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or disconnected, remember that all things and you share the same fundamental nature, dissolving loneliness.
shambhu_gita::471.insight: It shifts your view from separation to unity, helping you see yourself as part of a seamless whole.

shambhu_gita::472.verse_sanskrit:
एतदेवाधिदैवं हि मुख्यं मूर्तित्रयं मम ।
प्रोच्यते पितरो विज्ञै प्रतिब्रह्माण्डमीश्वरः ॥
shambhu_gita::472.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! यह तीनों प्रधान अधिदेव मूर्ति ही प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड में ईश्वर कहलाते हैं
shambhu_gita::472.english_translation: O ancestors, these three principal supreme divine forms are called the rulers of each universe.
shambhu_gita::472.translation_literal: एतदेवाधिदैवं (this indeed supreme divine) / हि (indeed) / मुख्यं (principal) / मूर्तित्रयं (three forms) / मम (my) / प्रोच्यते (are said) / पितरो (ancestors) / विज्ञै (learned) / प्रतिब्रह्माण्डमीश्वरः (the rulers of the universes)
shambhu_gita::472.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::472.essence: Three supreme divine forms govern every universe as cosmic rulers.
shambhu_gita::472.simple_meaning: The three main divine forms mentioned here are recognized as rulers of every universe by the ancestors.
shambhu_gita::472.simple_insight: Recognizing higher principles as governing forces brings respect for universal order.
shambhu_gita::472.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, explaining that the three supreme divine forms he refers to are considered the sovereign powers of all universes, establishing their cosmic authority.
shambhu_gita::472.insight: It shows the importance of acknowledging guiding forces beyond immediate perception in life and the cosmos.

shambhu_gita::473.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रमण्यध्यात्मशक्ति में ह्याधिदैव्यपि भाति वै ।
लोकसष्टत्वतो वोऽयं नायकोऽस्ति तथाप्यहो ॥
shambhu_gita::473.verse_hindi: ब्रह्माजी में मेरी अध्यात्मशक्ति और अधिदेवशक्ति का पूर्ण विकास रहने पर भी वे लोकसृष्टा होने के कारण आपलोगों के नायक कहलाते हैं
shambhu_gita::473.english_translation: Even though Brahma’s spiritual power and divine power are fully developed, he is called your leader because he is the creator of the worlds.
shambhu_gita::473.translation_literal: ब्रमण्य (of Brahma) / अध्यात्मशक्ति (spiritual power) / में (in) / हि (indeed) / अधिदैव्यपि (also divine) / भाति (shines) / वै (certainly) / लोकसष्टत्वतः (because of the creation of worlds) / वोऽयं (he) / नायकः (leader) / अस्ति (is) / तथापि (nevertheless) / अहो (indeed)
shambhu_gita::473.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::473.essence: Being leader depends on the role you play, not just your inner power.
shambhu_gita::473.simple_meaning: Brahma has both spiritual and divine powers fully developed, yet he is called leader because he created the worlds.
shambhu_gita::473.simple_insight: Leadership can come from fulfilling a cosmic role, even amid greater powers.
shambhu_gita::473.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that although Brahma's spiritual and divine powers are fully manifest, Brahma is recognized as leader by others because he is the creator of the worlds, highlighting roles beyond mere power.
shambhu_gita::473.insight: It teaches that leadership or responsibility often comes from the role one plays, not just from personal power or ability.

shambhu_gita::474.verse_sanskrit:
तथा शिवेऽधिभूतायामाधिदैव्याश्च पूर्णतः।
शक्तौ विकाशितायां हि सत्यामपि स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::474.verse_hindi: उसी प्रकार हे पितृगण! शिव में अधिभूतशक्ति और अधिदेव शक्ति का पूर्ण विकास रहने पर भी
shambhu_gita::474.english_translation: Just as in Shiva, even when the power of the natural world and the power of the supreme being are fully manifested, the true self remains unchanged.
shambhu_gita::474.translation_literal: तथा (just as) शिवेऽधिभूतायाम् (in Shiva, the power of the natural world) अधिदैव्याश्च (and the power of the supreme being) पूर्णतः (fully) शक्तौ (in power) विकाशितायां (manifested) हि (indeed) सत्याम् (true) अपि (even) स्वधाभुजः (the true self) ।
shambhu_gita::474.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::474.essence: The true self remains whole and unchanged despite all manifest powers.
shambhu_gita::474.simple_meaning: No matter how fully the powers of the natural world and supreme being show themselves in Shiva, the true self stays unchanged and whole.
shambhu_gita::474.simple_insight: You are more than any power or force that appears around you.
shambhu_gita::474.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that even when the powers of Prakriti (natural world) and the supreme reality are fully expressed, the true self remains untouched and complete, highlighting the unchanging essence beneath all manifestations.
shambhu_gita::474.modern_relevance: When your emotions or circumstances surge intensely, remember your true self stays steady and complete underneath it all.
shambhu_gita::474.insight: Recognize that your essential nature is unmoved by external changes or powerful forces.

shambhu_gita::475.verse_sanskrit:
नायको ज्ञानदातृत्वाद्दपीणामेप मन्यते ।
संविकाशितयौ शक्तयोः पूर्णाऽध्यात्माधिभूतयोः ॥
shambhu_gita::475.verse_hindi: वह ज्ञान दाता होने के कारण ऋषियों के नायक माने जाते हैं। और उसी प्रकार विष्णु में अधिभूत शक्ति और अध्यात्म शक्ति का पूर्ण विकास रहने पर भी
shambhu_gita::475.english_translation: Sages are considered leaders because they grant wisdom; likewise, Vishnu is regarded as complete with the full development of the external and spiritual powers.
shambhu_gita::475.translation_literal: नायकः (leader) ज्ञानदातृत्वात् (because of being a giver of knowledge) अपि (even) ईणाम् (of sages) एपि (also) मन्यते (is considered) । संविकाशित (fully developed) यौ (two) शक्तयोः (powers) पूर्णा (complete) अध्यात्माधिभूतयोः (spiritual and external) ॥
shambhu_gita::475.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::475.essence: True leadership arises from fully developed wisdom and powers together.
shambhu_gita::475.simple_meaning: Sages are respected as leaders because they give wisdom. Similarly, Vishnu is seen as complete when both his spiritual and external powers are fully developed.
shambhu_gita::475.simple_insight: Respect for wisdom and power grows when both inner and outer strengths are fully realized.
shambhu_gita::475.detailed_meaning: Suta explains that sages are called leaders due to their role in imparting wisdom. He draws a parallel with Vishnu, who is revered when both his earthly and spiritual powers reach fullness, highlighting the importance of balanced development.
shambhu_gita::475.insight: It shows the value placed on combining knowledge and power to be truly complete or influential.

shambhu_gita::476.verse_sanskrit:
विष्णौ सत्योस्तथाप्येष वर्त्तते देवनायकः।
देवशक्तिकदम्बस्य केन्द्रीभूतो यतोऽस्त्ययम् ॥
shambhu_gita::476.verse_hindi: वह विष्णु देवी शक्ति समूह के केन्द्र होने से देवताओ के नायक हैं
shambhu_gita::476.english_translation: Vishnu is the leader of the devas because he is the center of the goddess Shakti group.
shambhu_gita::476.translation_literal: विष्णौ (to Vishnu) / सत्यः (truth) / तथा (also) / अपि (indeed) / एष (this) / वर्त्तते (exists) / देवनायकः (leader of devas) / देवशक्ति (goddess Shakti) / कदम्बस्य (of the group) / केन्द्रीभूतो (being the center) / यतः (because) / अस्ति (is) / अयम् (this)
shambhu_gita::476.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::476.essence: Leadership arises from being the center of powerful divine energy.
shambhu_gita::476.simple_meaning: Vishnu is called the leader of the devas because he is the central figure in the goddess Shakti group.
shambhu_gita::476.simple_insight: Leadership comes from being the center of powerful energy and influence.
shambhu_gita::476.detailed_meaning: This verse identifies Vishnu as the leader of the devas, emphasizing his central role in the group of goddess Shakti energies. It shows the connection between divine power and leadership in the cosmic order.
shambhu_gita::476.insight: It highlights that true leadership arises from being the focal point of strength and support.

shambhu_gita::477.verse_sanskrit:
पितरः ! वोऽधिकारोऽस्ति स्थूले जगति केवलम् ।
पिण्डपुञजेऽपि मर्त्र्यानां पिण्डेष्वेव विशेषतः ॥
shambhu_gita::477.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! आप लोगों का अधिकार केवल स्थूल जगत् और पिण्डों में मनुष्य पिण्डों पर ही विशेषरूप से है
shambhu_gita::477.english_translation: O ancestors, your authority exists only in the gross world and especially over the bodies of humans.
shambhu_gita::477.translation_literal: पितरः (ancestors) / वोऽधिकारोऽस्ति (there is authority) / स्थूले (in the gross) / जगति (world) / केवलम् (only) / पिण्डपुञजेऽपि (even in the collection of bodies) / मर्त्र्यानां (of mortals) / पिण्डेष्वेव (over the bodies only) / विशेषतः (especially)
shambhu_gita::477.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::477.essence: Ancestral authority is confined to the physical, especially human bodies.
shambhu_gita::477.simple_meaning: The ancestors’ influence is limited to the physical world and especially over human bodies.
shambhu_gita::477.simple_insight: Power or influence does not extend beyond the physical forms we inhabit.
shambhu_gita::477.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the narrator explains that ancestral forces have authority only within the physical realm, particularly concerning human bodies, setting limits on their influence.
shambhu_gita::477.insight: Recognize that certain influences belong only to the physical world, freeing you from unseen pressures beyond it.

shambhu_gita::478.verse_sanskrit:
केवलं ज्ञानिनीवेषु त्वधिकारस्तथास्यलम् ।
ऋषीणां नात्र सन्देहः किन्तु देवगणस्य वै ॥
shambhu_gita::478.verse_hindi: ऋषियों का अधिकार केवल ज्ञानी जीवों में ही है इसमें सन्देह नहीं परन्तु देवताओं का
shambhu_gita::478.english_translation: Only those who are wise have this right; there is no doubt about this among sages, but it is different for the radiant beings.
shambhu_gita::478.translation_literal: केवलं (only) ज्ञानिनीवेषु (among the wise beings) त्वधिकारः (is the right) तथास्यलम् (of that also) । ऋषीणां (of sages) नात्र (there is no) सन्देहः (doubt) किन्तु (but) देवगणस्य (of the radiant beings) वै (indeed) ॥
shambhu_gita::478.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::478.essence: The right belongs clearly to the wise, but not necessarily the radiant beings.
shambhu_gita::478.simple_meaning: Only the wise have this right, and sages have no doubt about it, but the radiant beings experience it differently.
shambhu_gita::478.simple_insight: Some rights or truths are clear to the wise but may differ for others.
shambhu_gita::478.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that a certain right or authority is unquestionably held by the wise and sages, yet the divine radiant beings have a different experience or claim. This distinction highlights varied perspectives on spiritual authority.
shambhu_gita::478.insight: Recognize that understanding or authority may be clear to some but experienced differently by others.

shambhu_gita::479.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्माण्डानां हि सर्वेषां भागेप्यास्तेऽखिलेषु च ।
अधिकारोऽस्त्यतस्तेषां देवानां सर्वमान्यता ॥
shambhu_gita::479.verse_hindi: अधिकार प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड के सभी विभागों पर होने के कारण वह सर्वमान्य हैं
shambhu_gita::479.english_translation: The divine beings are universally recognized because each has authority over parts of all universes.
shambhu_gita::479.translation_literal: ब्रह्माण्डानां (of universes) / हि (indeed) / सर्वेषां (all) / भागेप्य (over parts also) / अस्ते (there is) / अखिलेषु (in all) / च (and) / अधिकारः (authority) / अस्ति (is) / तस्मात् (therefore) / एषां (of these) / देवानां (of the divine beings) / सर्वमान्यता (universal recognition)
shambhu_gita::479.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::479.essence: Universal respect arises from authority over all parts of existence.
shambhu_gita::479.simple_meaning: Each divine being is acknowledged everywhere because they have authority over parts of every universe.
shambhu_gita::479.simple_insight: Recognition comes from the reach of your influence, not just presence.
shambhu_gita::479.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that divine beings are respected universally because each holds authority over specific parts within all universes, showing their interconnected role in cosmic order.
shambhu_gita::479.modern_relevance: In a team, your unique influence over certain areas earns respect from everyone involved.
shambhu_gita::479.insight: Understand that influence comes from how widely and deeply you engage, not just from presence.

shambhu_gita::480.verse_sanskrit:
पितरः ! पञ्चकोपाश्च भुवनानि चतुर्दश ।
समष्टिव्यष्टिरूपायां पिण्डब्रह्माण्डसंहतौ ॥
shambhu_gita::480.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! पञ्चकोष और चतुर्दश भुवन समष्टि और व्यष्टिरूप ब्रह्माण्ड और पिण्डसमूह में
shambhu_gita::480.english_translation: O ancestors! The five sheaths and fourteen worlds are the collective and individual forms in the cosmic whole and parts.
shambhu_gita::480.translation_literal: पितरः (ancestors) / पञ्चकोष (five sheaths) / च (and) / भुवनानि (worlds) / चतुर्दश (fourteen) / समष्टि (collective) / व्यष्टिरूपायां (individual forms) / पिण्डब्रह्माण्डसंहतौ (cosmic whole and parts)
shambhu_gita::480.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::480.essence: The cosmos is formed of layered selves and multiple worlds, both collective and individual.
shambhu_gita::480.simple_meaning: The ancestors are addressed as the five layers of being and fourteen worlds seen as both collective and individual forms within the cosmic totality.
shambhu_gita::480.simple_insight: Everything that exists has layers and levels, both as a whole and as separate parts.
shambhu_gita::480.detailed_meaning: The bard Suta addresses the ancestors, describing the cosmos as composed of five sheaths (layers of existence) and fourteen worlds, which appear both as a collective total and as many individual forms within the cosmic body and universe.
shambhu_gita::480.insight: It invites seeing reality as a complex system of overlapping layers and scales, both united and diverse.

shambhu_gita::481.verse_sanskrit:
ओतप्रोतस्वरूपेण सन्तिष्ठन्ते न संशयः ।
मम ब्रह्माण्डरूपस्य विराटदेहस्य कल्यदाः !॥
shambhu_gita::481.verse_hindi: निस्सन्देह ओत प्रोत हैं । ब्रह्माण्ड रूपी मेरे विराट् शरीर के,
shambhu_gita::481.english_translation: There is no doubt that all beings are pervaded by my cosmic body.
shambhu_gita::481.translation_literal: ओतप्रोतस्वरूपेण (pervaded-form) / सन्तिष्ठन्ते (dwell) / न (not) / संशयः (doubt) / मम (my) / ब्रह्माण्डरूपस्य (cosmic-form) / विराटदेहस्य (cosmic-body) / कल्यदाः (beings)
shambhu_gita::481.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::481.essence: All beings live within and are inseparable from the cosmic body.
shambhu_gita::481.simple_meaning: Everything exists within and is intimately connected to the vast cosmic body that I embody.
shambhu_gita::481.simple_insight: You are deeply included in the vastness of existence, not separate or apart.
shambhu_gita::481.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares that all beings are completely permeated by his cosmic form. This reveals the unity between the individual and the universe at the moment when cosmic oneness is being taught.
shambhu_gita::481.modern_relevance: When you feel small or isolated, remember you are woven into the vastness of everything around you.
shambhu_gita::481.insight: It shifts your view from separation to belonging within a greater whole.

shambhu_gita::482.verse_sanskrit:
लोकाः सप्तोर्दधवगा नाभिमुपुर्यीरि सन्त्यहाँ ।
अधोऽधः सप्त वर्तन्ते ध्रुवं नाभिश्च संस्थिताः ॥
shambhu_gita::482.verse_hindi: नाभि से ऊपर सात उद्धर्व लोक और नाभि के नीचे सात अधोलोक स्थित है।
shambhu_gita::482.english_translation: Above the navel are seven upper worlds, and below the navel are seven lower worlds.
shambhu_gita::482.translation_literal: लोकाः (worlds) सप्तोः (seven) दधवगा (situated) नाभि (navel) उपरि (above) यीरि (are) सन्त्यहाँ (there are) । अधः (below) अधः (below) सप्त (seven) वर्तन्ते (exist) ध्रुवं (fixed) नाभि (navel) च (and) संस्थिताः (established) ॥
shambhu_gita::482.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::482.essence: Existence is structured in multiple worlds arranged above and below a central point.
shambhu_gita::482.simple_meaning: There are seven worlds above the navel and seven worlds below it, arranged steadily in the body or cosmos.
shambhu_gita::482.simple_insight: The body or cosmos contains multiple layers, both above and below a central point.
shambhu_gita::482.detailed_meaning: The narrator describes the structure of existence as layered in fourteen worlds—seven above and seven below the navel—implying a cosmic or bodily framework of realms without philosophical teaching here.
shambhu_gita::482.insight: It hints at a layered model of existence but does not teach a direct practice or insight.

shambhu_gita::483.verse_sanskrit:
अतः समाष्टरूपेऽस्मिन् ब्रह्माण्डे वै चतुर्दश ।
भुवनानि प्रधानानि विद्यन्ते नात्र संशयः ॥
shambhu_gita::483.verse_hindi: इस कारण समष्टिरूपी ब्रह्माण्ड में चतुर्दश भुवन प्रधान हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं
shambhu_gita::483.english_translation: Therefore, in the collective form of the universe, there are undoubtedly fourteen primary worlds.
shambhu_gita::483.translation_literal: अतः (therefore) समाष्ट (collective) रूपेऽस्मिन् (in form) ब्रह्माण्डे (universe) वै (indeed) चतुर्दश (fourteen) भुवनानि (worlds) प्रधानानि (primary) विद्यन्ते (exist) नात्र (here not) संशयः (doubt)
shambhu_gita::483.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::483.essence: The universe definitely includes fourteen primary worlds forming its structure.
shambhu_gita::483.simple_meaning: The universe as a whole contains fourteen main worlds without any doubt.
shambhu_gita::483.simple_insight: Understanding the universe's structure brings a sense of order and vastness.
shambhu_gita::483.detailed_meaning: The narrator, Suta, explains that the universe is composed of fourteen fundamental worlds, affirming their essential presence without uncertainty, setting the cosmological framework for the teaching.
shambhu_gita::483.insight: Recognize that vast systems have defined layers and components, grounding your view of complexity.

shambhu_gita::484.verse_sanskrit:
पञ्चकोषास्तु तिष्ठन्ति व्याता गौणतयाऽत्र हि।
जीवदेहस्वरूपेषु कोषा: पिण्डेषु पञ्च च ॥
shambhu_gita::484.verse_hindi: और पञ्चकोष उनमें गौणरूप से व्याप्त रहते हैं। और उसी प्रकार जीवदेहरूपी पिण्ड में पञ्चकोष
shambhu_gita::484.english_translation: Five sheaths subtly pervade the embodied living being, existing within the five bodies of the living entity.
shambhu_gita::484.translation_literal: पञ्चकोषास्तु (five sheaths) तिष्ठन्ति (exist) व्याता (pervade) गौणतयाऽत्र (subtly here) हि (indeed)। जीवदेहस्वरूपेषु (in the form of living bodies) कोषा: (sheaths) पिण्डेषु (in the bodies) पञ्च (five) च (also) ॥
shambhu_gita::484.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::484.essence: The living being consists of five subtle sheaths that compose and pervade the embodied self.
shambhu_gita::484.simple_meaning: You are made up of five layers or sheaths that together form your living body and subtle self.
shambhu_gita::484.simple_insight: Knowing you have many layers beyond your body can deepen your sense of who you are.
shambhu_gita::484.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the living being is not just a physical body but includes five subtle sheaths that pervade and compose the embodied self, revealing the complex structure beneath ordinary appearance.
shambhu_gita::484.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your mood or body, remember you are more than one surface—you have layers shaping your experience.
shambhu_gita::484.insight: Recognize the multiple layers of your being to see beyond just your physical or emotional state.

shambhu_gita::485.verse_sanskrit:
प्रधानास्सन्ति तेषां हि सम्बन्धाच्च चतुर्दश ।
भुवनान्यप्रधानानि सन्तिष्ठन्ते निरन्तरम् ॥
shambhu_gita::485.verse_hindi: प्रधान और उन पञ्चकोषों के सम्बन्ध से चतुर्दश भुवनों का सम्बन्ध अप्रधान रहता है।
shambhu_gita::485.english_translation: The fourteen worlds exist continuously, connected to the primary and the five sheaths, while remaining distinct from the non-primary.
shambhu_gita::485.translation_literal: प्रधानास्सन्ति (primary exist) तेषां (of them) हि (indeed) सम्बन्धाच्च (from connection) चतुर्दश (fourteen) । भुवनानि (worlds) प्रधानानि (primary) सन्तिष्ठन्ते (stand) निरन्तरम् (continuously) ॥
shambhu_gita::485.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::485.essence: The fourteen worlds continuously connect with the primary and five sheaths yet remain separate from the non-primary.
shambhu_gita::485.simple_meaning: The fourteen worlds are linked to the primary principle and the five sheaths but remain separate from the non-primary.
shambhu_gita::485.simple_insight: The worlds are connected yet distinct from the secondary layers of existence.
shambhu_gita::485.detailed_meaning: This verse explains the cosmological structure where the fourteen worlds relate to the primary principle and the five koshas (sheaths) but maintain separation from other aspects. It situates the worlds in a continuous, interconnected framework within Hindu cosmology.
shambhu_gita::485.insight: It reveals how complex systems can be interconnected while preserving distinct identities.

shambhu_gita::486.verse_sanskrit:
अतो मे ज्ञानिनो भक्ता ऐसी  शक्ति समाश्रिताः।
स्वपिण्डेष्वपि तिष्ठन्तः सूक्ष्मैर्नानाविधैर्दुतम् ॥
shambhu_gita::486.verse_hindi: हे पितरो! यही कारण है कि मेरी ऐसी  शक्ति प्राप्त करने से मेरा ज्ञानीभक्त अपने पिण्ड में रहकर भी नाना सूक्ष्म
shambhu_gita::486.english_translation: Therefore, my wise devotees, who have attained such power, remain even within their bodies, subtle in many ways.
shambhu_gita::486.translation_literal: अतो (therefore) / मे (my) / ज्ञानिनो (wise devotees) / भक्ता (devotees) / ऐसी (such) / शक्ति (power) / समाश्रिताः (attained) / स्वपिण्डेषु (within the body) / अपि (even) / तिष्ठन्तः (remain) / सूक्ष्मैः (subtle) / नानाविधैः (in many ways) / दुतम् (hidden).
shambhu_gita::486.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::486.essence: Wisdom and devotion create a subtle, hidden power inside you that shapes your being.
shambhu_gita::486.simple_meaning: Devotees who combine wisdom and devotion gain a special power that quietly exists within their own bodies in subtle forms.
shambhu_gita::486.simple_insight: You can hold a deep, quiet strength inside even when nothing seems visible.
shambhu_gita::486.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that his wise devotees who have embraced both knowledge and devotion possess a subtle power that remains within their individual bodies, unseen yet effective in many ways.
shambhu_gita::486.modern_relevance: You might feel ordinary on the outside, but your focused care and understanding build a quiet inner strength that guides your actions.
shambhu_gita::486.insight: Recognize that true power from devotion and wisdom is often hidden within, not flashy or obvious.

shambhu_gita::487.verse_hindi: देवीलोकों के साथ सम्बन्ध स्थापन कर सका है और इसी कारण  अन्यान्य सूक्षम लोकों में रहने पर भी
shambhu_gita::487.english_translation: He must establish connection with the realm of deva, and therefore, even while dwelling in other subtle realms.
shambhu_gita::487.translation_literal: संस्थापयितुमर्हन्ति (must establish) देवलोकैः (with deva realm) सहान्वयम् (connection) । अन्यान्यसूक्ष्मलोकेषु (in other subtle realms) निवसन्तः (dwelling) अपि (even) अतः (therefore) तथाः (thus) ॥
shambhu_gita::487.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::487.essence: Connection to the divine realm sustains presence across subtle worlds.
shambhu_gita::487.simple_meaning: The verse explains that someone must create a connection with the divine realm and thus can remain connected even in other subtle worlds.
shambhu_gita::487.simple_insight: Connection with the divine realm supports presence beyond physical limits.
shambhu_gita::487.detailed_meaning: This verse suggests the importance of establishing connection with the realm of radiant beings (deva loka). Even when one dwells in other subtle worlds, that connection remains active, showing a linkage beyond physical presence.
shambhu_gita::487.insight: It shows how maintaining a strong connection to a higher source anchors you across different states of being or consciousness.

shambhu_gita::488.verse_sanskrit:
संस्थापयितुमर्हन्ति स्वाधिपत्यं स्वधाभुजः !।
देवासुरगणाः सर्वे जीवपिण्डेष्वनुक्षणम् ॥
shambhu_gita::488.verse_hindi: देवतागण अथवा असुरगण भी जीवपिण्डो पर अपना अधिकार स्थापन सर्वदा कर सके हैं
shambhu_gita::488.english_translation: The leaders of divine and shadow beings must always establish their authority over all living entities.
shambhu_gita::488.translation_literal: संस्थापयितुमर्हन्ति (must establish) / स्वाधिपत्यं (authority) / स्वधाभुजः (own leaders) / देवासुरगणाः (divine and shadow groups) / सर्वे (all) / जीवपिण्डेषु (in living entities) / अनुक्षणम् (always)
shambhu_gita::488.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::488.essence: True leaders must continuously uphold their authority over those they are responsible for.
shambhu_gita::488.simple_meaning: Leaders, whether divine or shadow beings, have the constant duty to maintain control over all living beings.
shambhu_gita::488.simple_insight: You hold a steady responsibility to protect and guide what depends on you.
shambhu_gita::488.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva states that leaders of both divine and shadow groups must continuously assert their rightful authority over living beings, emphasizing the ongoing nature of responsible leadership in the cosmic order.
shambhu_gita::488.modern_relevance: When you're responsible for a team or family, steady leadership means consistently maintaining your role and care, not just occasionally.
