shambhu_gita::752.translation_literal: ज्ञानिनामिह (of the wise) मुक्तानां (liberated) प्राणिनां (beings) पितृपुङ्गवाः (forefathers) / पारब्धकर्मणां (past deeds) नाशो (destruction) भोगादेव (only through experience) प्रजायते (happens)
shambhu_gita::752.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::752.essence: Past actions end only by fully experiencing their results, even for the wise.
shambhu_gita::752.simple_meaning: Your past actions, which still affect you, end only by undergoing their results fully.
shambhu_gita::752.simple_insight: There's peace in knowing the past is resolved by facing it, not avoiding it.
shambhu_gita::752.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that even the wise and liberated must experience the fruits of past actions fully. These past deeds, called parābdha karma, are not nullified by knowledge alone but by living through their outcomes.
shambhu_gita::752.modern_relevance: You might wish to avoid the consequences of past choices, but only experiencing them fully frees you from their hold.
shambhu_gita::752.insight: It shifts your approach from evasion to engagement, realizing that completion comes from experiencing results, not denial.

shambhu_gita::753.verse_sanskrit:
यथा कुलालो दण्डेन चक्रं सङ्घर्ण्य घूर्णितम् ।
तत्त्यक्त्वा कुरुते हस्तौ दण्डञ्चैव पृथक् ततः ॥
shambhu_gita::753.verse_hindi: जिस प्रकार कुम्हार अपने कुलालचक्र को लकडी से चलाकर पीछे अपने हाथ और लकड़ी को अलग कर लेता है,
shambhu_gita::753.english_translation: Just as a potter, after spinning his wheel with a stick, releases the stick and his hand separately,
shambhu_gita::753.translation_literal: यथा (just as) कुलालो (potter) दण्डेन (with a stick) चक्रं (wheel) सङ्घर्ण्य (having spun) घूर्णितम् (turned) । तत्त्यक्त्वा (then abandoning that) कुरुते (does) हस्तौ (in the hand) दण्डञ्चैव (and the stick also) पृथक् (separately) ततः (thereafter) ॥
shambhu_gita::753.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::753.essence: You can fully use support and still freely let it go afterward.
shambhu_gita::753.simple_meaning: Like a potter who spins his wheel with a stick then releases both, you can let go of what helped you once your work is done.
shambhu_gita::753.simple_insight: There is freedom in letting go of past supports once they have served their purpose.
shambhu_gita::753.detailed_meaning: Shiva compares a potter spinning his wheel with a stick and then releasing it and his hand. This shows how after using something to act or create, you can freely release your hold; it no longer controls you.
shambhu_gita::753.modern_relevance: You finish a project and stop clutching the tools and worries that pushed you; you feel lighter and free to begin anew.
shambhu_gita::753.insight: It teaches you to recognize when to release aids or habits that served you, freeing your hands and mind for fresh action.

shambhu_gita::754.verse_sanskrit:
पृथग्भूतेऽपि कौलाले चालके शक्तिसञ्चये ।
तच्छक्तिजेन वेगेन कौलालं तत्तु चक्रकम् ॥
shambhu_gita::754.verse_hindi: तत्पश्चात् कुम्हार के अपने चलाने की शक्ति को अलग करने पर भी वह कुलालचक्र पहली प्रयोग की हुई शक्ति से
shambhu_gita::754.english_translation: Even when the potter separates the power that drives the wheel, the potter's wheel continues to turn by the force of that power.
shambhu_gita::754.translation_literal: पृथग्भूतेऽपि (even when separated) / कौलाले (potter's wheel) / चालके (of the driver) / शक्तिसञ्चये (power stored) / तच्छक्तिजेन (by that power) / वेगेन (with force) / कौलालं (the wheel) / तत्तु (that itself) / चक्रकम् (turns)
shambhu_gita::754.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::754.essence: The force that drives action and the action itself are inseparably linked.
shambhu_gita::754.simple_meaning: When the potter removes the force that drives the wheel, the wheel still turns because of that very force.
shambhu_gita::754.simple_insight: You feel how what drives you is inseparable from what moves around you.
shambhu_gita::754.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains using a potter's wheel: even if the driver’s power is conceptually separated, the wheel continues turning due to that force, illustrating how cause and effect are inseparable in action.
shambhu_gita::754.modern_relevance: You notice how your energy behind a project keeps it moving, even when you feel detached from the results.
shambhu_gita::754.insight: It teaches you to see how your inner power and external actions are one continuous flow, not separate parts.

shambhu_gita::755.verse_sanskrit:
तावधूर्णायमानं स्याद्यावद्वेगो न शाम्यति ।
यावन्नैवान्यवस्तूनां योगो वा तत्र जायते ॥
shambhu_gita::755.verse_hindi: अपने आप ही तब तक घूमता रहता है जब तक वह शक्ति क्षय न हो जाय, या अन्य वस्तुओं का उसमें योग (स्पर्श) न हो जाय,
shambhu_gita::755.english_translation: It keeps revolving on its own until its energy is exhausted or it comes into contact with other objects.
shambhu_gita::755.translation_literal: तावत् (until that much) धूर्णायमानं (revolving) स्यात् (it becomes) यावत् (until) वेगः (energy) न (not) शाम्यति (subsides) यावत् (until) न (not) एतानि (these) अवस्तूनां (objects) योगः (contact) वा (or) तत्र (there) जायते (arises)
shambhu_gita::755.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::755.essence: Energy moves freely until it fades or encounters something else.
shambhu_gita::755.simple_meaning: Energy or force continues moving by itself until it either runs out or touches something else.
shambhu_gita::755.simple_insight: You see that your inner energy naturally moves until something changes or ends it.
shambhu_gita::755.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains how energy or force moves on its own until it either exhausts or interacts with other things, showing the natural movement of forces before they change.
shambhu_gita::755.modern_relevance: Your motivation or focus can keep spinning inside you until it wears out or something new grabs your attention.
shambhu_gita::755.insight: It teaches you to notice how energy flows naturally and stops only when conditions change.

shambhu_gita::756.verse_hindi: उसी प्रकार हे विज्ञों ! तत्त्वज्ञानी महात्मा तत्त्वज्ञान द्वारा जीवन्मुक्त दशा को प्राप्त हो जाने पर भी
shambhu_gita::756.english_translation: Similarly, O wise ones, even those great souls who have attained the state of liberation through true knowledge remain established in that liberated state.
shambhu_gita::756.translation_literal: तत्त्वज्ञानिमहात्मानः (true-knowledge great-souls) तत्त्विकज्ञानतस्तथा (through true knowledge likewise) प्राप्तवन्तः अपि (have attained even) भो (O) विज्ञाः (wise ones) जीवन्मुक्तदशाम् (state of living liberation) अलम् (established)
shambhu_gita::756.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::756.essence: True knowledge anchors and sustains lasting freedom beyond initial liberation.
shambhu_gita::756.simple_meaning: Great souls who gain true understanding can reach and stay in the state of freedom from reactivity.
shambhu_gita::756.simple_insight: There is calm strength in knowing freedom deeply, not just reaching it once.
shambhu_gita::756.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that even after achieving liberation through clear understanding, great souls remain firmly established in that state, showing freedom is not just a moment but a lasting presence.
shambhu_gita::756.modern_relevance: You may experience a breakthrough or clarity, yet lasting calm comes from holding onto that insight steadily over time.
shambhu_gita::756.insight: It shifts your view from seeing freedom as a fleeting moment to a stable, lived reality grounded in knowledge.

shambhu_gita::757.verse_sanskrit:
यावस्थूलशरीरं वै भोगं प्रारब्धकर्मणाम् ।
भुञ्जना आसते तादभोगात्तेषां क्षयो यतः ॥
shambhu_gita::757.verse_hindi: अपने स्थूल शरीर-उत्पन्नकारी प्रारब्ध भोग शरीर के अंतपर्यन्त भोगते रहते हैं क्योंकि प्रारब्ध कर्म का केवल भोग से ही क्षय होता है
shambhu_gita::757.english_translation: The gross body enjoys the results of past actions, and those results are exhausted only through enjoyment.
shambhu_gita::757.translation_literal: यावत् (as long as) स्थूलशरीरं (gross body) वै (certainly) भोगं (enjoyment) प्रारब्धकर्मणाम् (of past actions) भुञ्जना (enjoying) आसते (remain) तादभोगात् (from that enjoyment) तेषां (their) क्षयः (exhaustion) यतः (because)
shambhu_gita::757.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::757.essence: Past actions’ effects persist until fully experienced by the body.
shambhu_gita::757.simple_meaning: Your physical body experiences the effects of past actions, and these effects end only by being fully experienced.
shambhu_gita::757.simple_insight: There is a sense of release in knowing that past consequences fade only through living them.
shambhu_gita::757.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the gross physical body continues to experience the fruits of past actions (prarabdha karma). This cycle of experiencing is how these karmic results naturally diminish over time.
shambhu_gita::757.modern_relevance: You feel stuck in patterns or consequences from decisions long past, yet only by facing them fully can they dissolve.
shambhu_gita::757.insight: It teaches you to accept and fully feel past consequences instead of resisting them, allowing natural exhaustion.

shambhu_gita::758.verse_sanskrit:
यथा कुलालचक्रस्य कुम्भकारेण कोऽप्यहो।
सार्द्ध घूर्णायमानस्य सम्बन्धो नास्ति तक्षणम् ॥
shambhu_gita::758.verse_hindi: जिस प्रकार घूमते हुए कुलाल चक्र का उस समय कुलाल के साथ सम्बन्ध नहीं रहता है
shambhu_gita::758.english_translation: Just as a potter has no connection with the spinning potter's wheel during its rotation.
shambhu_gita::758.translation_literal: यथा (just as) कुलालचक्रस्य (of the potter's wheel) कुम्भकारेण (by the potter) कोऽप्यहो (no one has) । सार्ध (together) घूर्णायमानस्य (spinning) सम्बन्धो (connection) नास्ति (is not) तक्षणम् (at the moment) ॥
shambhu_gita::758.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::758.essence: Your true self remains untouched by the restless spinning of life.
shambhu_gita::758.simple_meaning: Your true self is not caught up in the restless changes around you, like a potter separate from the spinning wheel.
shambhu_gita::758.simple_insight: There's freedom in realizing that you are not the ever-changing events around you.
shambhu_gita::758.detailed_meaning: Shiva compares the restless world to a spinning potter's wheel and the true self to the potter who remains unmoved. This helps Arjuna see that although life spins wildly, the inner being remains untouched and free.
shambhu_gita::758.modern_relevance: When chaos whirls around you, like a busy day or stressful news cycle, remember your true self is not caught in the spin.
shambhu_gita::758.insight: It teaches you to separate your steady inner awareness from the restless flow of external events.

shambhu_gita::759.verse_sanskrit:
निःसङ्गरूपतो भोगात्तत्त्वज्ञे भोगजास्तथा ।
संस्काराः क्रियमाणानां जायन्ते नैव कर्मणाम् ॥
shambhu_gita::759.verse_hindi: उसी तरह निःसंग रूप से भोग होने के कारण उन कर्मों के भोग से ज्ञानी में क्रियमाण कर्मसंस्कारों की
shambhu_gita::759.english_translation: Just as the knower remains detached from pleasures, so the impressions of actions arise from the pleasures experienced, not from the actions themselves.
shambhu_gita::759.translation_literal: निःसङ्गरूपतो (detached form) / भोगात्तत्त्वज्ञे (from pleasure in the knower) / भोगजास्तथा (so from pleasures born) / संस्काराः (impressions) / क्रियमाणानां (of actions being done) / जायन्ते (arise) / नैव (not) / कर्मणाम् (of actions).
shambhu_gita::759.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::759.essence: Impressions arise from attachment to pleasure, not from actions themselves.
shambhu_gita::759.simple_meaning: The impressions or tendencies in a wise person arise because of pleasures experienced, not because of the actions themselves, which the wise remain detached from.
shambhu_gita::759.simple_insight: Detachment from actions means your inner impressions come only from what feels pleasurable, not from the actions you do.
shambhu_gita::759.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that a person who truly knows the nature of reality experiences pleasures without attachment, and thus the mental imprints or tendencies (sanskaras) arise from these pleasures, not directly from the actions performed.
shambhu_gita::759.modern_relevance: You might do many tasks without craving their results, but your desires and habits grow from what truly draws your interest or pleasure, not merely from the actions you perform.
shambhu_gita::759.insight: It shifts focus from thinking actions alone create habits to understanding that attachment to pleasure forms deeper impressions.

shambhu_gita::760.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानिनां नैव सम्बन्धः पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ।
विद्यतेऽसंशयं कल्याः ! सार्द्धमागामिकर्मभिः ॥
shambhu_gita::760.verse_hindi: उत्पत्ति नहीं होती है, आगामि कर्मों से ज्ञानियों का कमलदल गत जल के समान सम्बन्ध ही नहीं है
shambhu_gita::760.english_translation: The wise have no connection with future actions, like a lotus leaf has no bond with water on it.
shambhu_gita::760.translation_literal: ज्ञानिनां (of the wise) / नैव (not at all) / सम्बन्धः (connection) / पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा (like lotus leaf and water) / विद्यतेऽसंशयं (there is surely) / कल्याः (auspicious) / सार्धम् (along with) / आगामिकर्मभिः (future actions)
shambhu_gita::760.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::760.essence: True wisdom means not being bound by future actions or their results.
shambhu_gita::760.simple_meaning: The wise do not cling to or get affected by future actions, just as a lotus leaf stays dry despite water touching it.
shambhu_gita::760.simple_insight: You can remain free and untouched by what might happen next.
shambhu_gita::760.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva explains that the truly wise do not bind themselves to the results of future actions. Like a lotus leaf that water touches but does not cling to, the wise remain unaffected by what is yet to occur.
shambhu_gita::760.modern_relevance: You face uncertainty about what tomorrow holds, yet you don’t let those worries stick to your sense of self.
shambhu_gita::760.insight: It teaches you to recognize your inner freedom by mentally separating yourself from outcomes not yet arrived.

shambhu_gita::761.verse_sanskrit:
अतस्तान्यपि नश्यन्ति ज्ञानयोगेन सुव्रताः ।
सर्वाण्यागामिकर्माणि नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
shambhu_gita::761.verse_hindi: इस कारण वह  भी ज्ञान के द्वारा नाश को प्राप्त होते जाते हैं
shambhu_gita::761.english_translation: Therefore, all those who are firmly devoted to the path of wisdom destroy all their past actions; no other actions need to be considered.
shambhu_gita::761.translation_literal: अत: (therefore) तानि (those) अपि (also) नश्यन्ति (are destroyed) ज्ञानयोगेन (by the path of wisdom) सुव्रताः (firmly devoted) । सर्वाणि (all) आगामि (past) कर्माणि (actions) न (not) अत्र (here) कार्या (to be done) विचारणा (considered) ॥
shambhu_gita::761.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::761.essence: Steadfast wisdom alone can erase the burden of all past actions.
shambhu_gita::761.simple_meaning: Those who firmly follow wisdom gradually free themselves from the effects of all past actions, needing no other effort.
shambhu_gita::761.simple_insight: There is freedom in trusting wisdom to cleanse your past without extra effort.
shambhu_gita::761.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva explains that those who commit firmly to the path of wisdom (jnana yoga) gradually dissolve the consequences of all their previous actions. This means they no longer need to worry about or perform other actions to cleanse their past, highlighting the power of clear understanding.
shambhu_gita::761.modern_relevance: You’ve tried repeatedly to fix past mistakes, but consistent clear insight frees you without needing more struggle.
shambhu_gita::761.insight: It teaches you to rely on steady wisdom to naturally dissolve past burdens instead of seeking external fixes.

shambhu_gita::762.verse_sanskrit:
पञ्चकोशा अहं नैव तेषां द्रष्टास्मि केवलम् ।
यदा त्वेवं महात्मानस्तत्त्वज्ञा ज्ञानयोगतः ॥
shambhu_gita::762.verse_hindi: इस प्रकार जब तत्त्वज्ञानी महापुरुष तत्त्वज्ञान के द्वारा यह समझ जाते हैं कि मैं पञ्चकोश नहीं हूँ
shambhu_gita::762.english_translation: When the great souls who know the truth through wisdom realize that I am not the five sheaths, I am only the seer.
shambhu_gita::762.translation_literal: पञ्चकोशा (five sheaths) / अहं (I) / नैव (not at all) / तेषां (of them) / द्रष्टास्मि (am the seer) / केवलम् (only) / यदा (when) / त्वेवं (thus) / महात्मानः (great souls) / तत्त्वज्ञा (knowers of truth) / ज्ञानयोगतः (through the path of wisdom)
shambhu_gita::762.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::762.essence: You are the pure awareness that sees beyond all bodily and mental layers.
shambhu_gita::762.simple_meaning: You are not the body, mind, or emotions; you are the one who observes all these layers.
shambhu_gita::762.simple_insight: There's freedom in knowing you are the awareness behind all your experiences.
shambhu_gita::762.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that great souls who practice wisdom realize they are not the physical, mental, or emotional layers (the five sheaths). Instead, they recognize themselves as the pure observer behind these layers, the true self beyond all appearances.
shambhu_gita::762.modern_relevance: When stress arises, you can pause and recognize that you are not your thoughts or feelings but the awareness watching them.
shambhu_gita::762.insight: It shifts your identity from being caught in changing experiences to resting as the unchanging observer.

shambhu_gita::763.verse_sanskrit:
विदन्ति हि तदा पञ्चकोशरूपवपुः कृता।
वघ्नीयान्नूतना मुक्तानागामिकर्मसन्ततिः ॥
shambhu_gita::763.verse_hindi: मैं पञ्चकोश का द्रष्टा हूँ तो पञ्चकोश रूपी शरीर का किया हुआ नवीन आगामी कर्मसमूह मुक्तात्माओं को बांध नहीं सकता
shambhu_gita::763.english_translation: When one realizes the true self as the five-sheath form, the new upcoming chain of actions cannot bind the liberated beings.
shambhu_gita::763.translation_literal: विदन्ति (they know) हि (indeed) तदा (then) पञ्चकोशरूपवपुः (five-sheath form body) कृता (made). वघ्नीयान्नूतना (not to be broken new) मुक्तानागामिकर्मसन्ततिः (liberated beings' upcoming actions chain).
shambhu_gita::763.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::763.essence: Seeing yourself as five sheaths frees you from binding future actions.
shambhu_gita::763.simple_meaning: Recognizing yourself as the five-layered being means new actions cannot bind your liberated self.
shambhu_gita::763.simple_insight: There's freedom in seeing yourself beyond the continuous flow of actions.
shambhu_gita::763.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva explains that when someone truly understands their identity as composed of five sheaths, they transcend attachment to any future actions, freeing themselves from the cycle of binding consequences.
shambhu_gita::763.modern_relevance: When you understand your deeper self beyond your daily habits and roles, new challenges no longer trap or limit your growth.
shambhu_gita::763.insight: It shifts your view from being caught in reactive actions to recognizing your self beyond those actions.

shambhu_gita::764.verse_sanskrit:
सञ्चितागामिकर्माणि ज्ञानिनां पितृपुङ्गवाः !।
ब्रह्माण्डप्रकृति नूनमाश्रयन्ते न संशयः ॥
shambhu_gita::764.verse_hindi: हे पितृवरो! ज्ञानी के सञ्चित कर्म और आगामी कर्म निस्सन्देह ब्रह्माण्ड प्रकृति को आश्रय करने हैं
shambhu_gita::764.english_translation: O revered ancestors! The past and future actions of the wise surely rest in the cosmic nature.
shambhu_gita::764.translation_literal: सञ्चितागामि (accumulated and coming) / कर्माणि (actions) / ज्ञानिनां (of the wise) / पितृपुङ्गवाः (revered ancestors) / ब्रह्माण्डप्रकृति (cosmic nature) / नूनम् (indeed) / आश्रयन्ते (take refuge) / न (not) / संशयः (doubt)
shambhu_gita::764.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::764.essence: All actions of the wise merge into the cosmic natural order without doubt.
shambhu_gita::764.simple_meaning: The actions already done and those yet to come of wise people rest safely within the universe's natural order.
shambhu_gita::764.simple_insight: There is comfort knowing your actions belong to a vast, unchanging cosmic flow.
shambhu_gita::764.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses revered ancestors, explaining that all past and future actions of wise beings find refuge in the cosmic nature, showing their unity with the supreme natural order beyond individual limitation.
shambhu_gita::764.modern_relevance: You realize your efforts and their consequences are part of a larger natural system beyond your control.
shambhu_gita::764.insight: It shifts your view from isolated deeds to seeing your actions as part of a universal natural process.

shambhu_gita::765.verse_sanskrit:
मुक्तात्मानो न वध्यन्ते सञ्चितागामिकर्मभिः ।
इत्ययं निश्चयो जात उक्तविज्ञानतो ध्रुवम् ॥
shambhu_gita::765.verse_hindi: अतः पूर्वकथित विज्ञान के अनुसार यह निश्चय हुआ कि मुक्त आत्माओं के आगामी और सञ्चित कर्म उनको पुनः बन्धन नहीं कर सकते
shambhu_gita::765.english_translation: According to the prior explained knowledge, it is certain that liberated beings are not bound again by their accumulated past and future actions.
shambhu_gita::765.translation_literal: मुक्तात्मानो (liberated beings) / न (not) / वध्यन्ते (are bound) / सञ्चितागामिकर्मभिः (by accumulated past and future actions) / इत्ययं (thus this) / निश्चयो (certainty) / जात (has arisen) / उक्तविज्ञानतो (according to the explained knowledge) / ध्रुवम् (certain).
shambhu_gita::765.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::765.essence: Liberated beings cannot be bound again by any past or future actions.
shambhu_gita::765.simple_meaning: Liberated beings cannot be tied down again by any actions accumulated before or after liberation.
shambhu_gita::765.simple_insight: Freedom from all karma brings lasting peace beyond all past and future burdens.
shambhu_gita::765.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva confirms that once a being attains liberation, neither past accumulated actions nor future actions can create bondage. This is a pivotal moment affirming ultimate freedom beyond the cycle of karma.
shambhu_gita::765.modern_relevance: You’ve finally let go of old mistakes and future worries; neither can trap you now.
shambhu_gita::765.insight: Recognize that freedom means complete release from the cycle of cause and effect tied to actions.

shambhu_gita::766.verse_sanskrit:
कर्मणां बीजरूपोऽस्ति संस्कारो यत्र सञ्चितः ।
कर्मतश्च फलोत्पत्तेरवश्यं तत्र सम्भवः ॥
shambhu_gita::766.verse_hindi: जहां कर्म-बीजरूप संस्कार है वहां कर्म से फलोत्पत्ति होना अवश्य सम्भव है
shambhu_gita::766.english_translation: Where the seed form of actions, impressions, is stored, the arising of results from actions inevitably happens there.
shambhu_gita::766.translation_literal: कर्मणां (of actions) बीजरूपोऽस्ति (is seed form) संस्कारो (impressions) यत्र (where) सञ्चितः (stored) । कर्मतश्च (from actions also) फलोत्पत्तेरवश्यं (inevitably of result arising) तत्र (there) सम्भवः (happens) ॥
shambhu_gita::766.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::766.essence: Stored impressions within you are the seeds from which action’s results inevitably arise.
shambhu_gita::766.simple_meaning: Your past actions leave impressions inside you, and these impressions cause new results to arise from your actions.
shambhu_gita::766.simple_insight: There’s a deep connection between what you carry inside and the results your actions produce.
shambhu_gita::766.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that inside you are impressions formed by past actions, called samskaras, and these impressions inevitably cause the fruits of your current actions to arise, explaining how karma unfolds naturally.
shambhu_gita::766.modern_relevance: You notice how past habits or experiences shape what happens when you act today, like how old patterns lead to predictable outcomes.
shambhu_gita::766.insight: Understand that your inner impressions are the root causing the results your actions produce, shifting focus from just the action to what’s stored inside.

shambhu_gita::767.verse_sanskrit:
सञ्चितागामिकर्माणि यतो मुक्तमहात्मनाम् ।
नैव स्पृशन्ति मुक्ताँस्तान ब्रह्माण्डप्रकृति ह्यतः ॥
shambhu_gita::767.verse_hindi: इस कारण मुक्त आत्मा के आगामी और सञ्चित कर्म मुक्तात्मा को स्पर्श नहीं कर सकते वह ब्रह्माण्ड प्रकृति को
shambhu_gita::767.english_translation: Because the liberated great soul is free, the accumulated and future actions do not touch that liberated one, for they belong to the cosmic nature.
shambhu_gita::767.translation_literal: सञ्चितागामि (accumulated and future) कर्माणि (actions) यतो (because) मुक्तमहात्मनाम् (of the liberated great souls) नैव (not) स्पृशन्ति (touch) मुक्ताँस्तान (those liberated ones) ब्रह्माण्डप्रकृति (cosmic nature) हि (indeed) अतः (from)
shambhu_gita::767.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::767.essence: Your true self remains untouched by all accumulated and future actions.
shambhu_gita::767.simple_meaning: A truly liberated person is not affected by any past or future actions because those actions belong to the changing cosmic nature, not the true self.
shambhu_gita::767.simple_insight: You can feel free knowing your true self is untouched by your past or future deeds.
shambhu_gita::767.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva explains that a liberated soul stands beyond all accumulated and forthcoming actions. These actions belong only to the cosmic nature, not the liberated true self, showing freedom from the cycle of reaction.
shambhu_gita::767.modern_relevance: When you reflect on your past mistakes or future worries, remember your true self remains untouched and free beyond those concerns.
shambhu_gita::767.insight: It shifts your focus from identifying with your actions to recognizing your unchanging true self beyond them.

shambhu_gita::768.verse_sanskrit:
आश्रयन्ते च भुज्यन्ते समष्टयात्मकतो ध्रुवम् ।
ब्रह्माण्डे शोभने यत्र मुक्तात्माऽसावजायत ॥
shambhu_gita::768.verse_hindi: आश्रय करते हैं। उस ब्रह्माण्ड में समष्टिरूप से वह कर्म भोगे जाते हैं। अर्थात् जिस पवित्र ब्रह्माण्ड में वह मुक्तात्मा
shambhu_gita::768.english_translation: The liberated beings rest and fully experience the collective in the splendid universe where they were born.
shambhu_gita::768.translation_literal: आश्रयन्ते (they rest) / च (and) / भुज्यन्ते (they enjoy/experience) / समष्टयात्मकतो (in a collective manner) / ध्रुवम् (steadily) / ब्रह्माण्डे (in the universe) / शोभने (splendid) / यत्र (where) / मुक्तात्माऽसावजायत (liberated beings are born)
shambhu_gita::768.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::768.essence: Liberated beings rest in and fully experience the radiant collective universe.
shambhu_gita::768.simple_meaning: Liberated beings find steady rest and experience themselves as part of a magnificent collective universe.
shambhu_gita::768.simple_insight: You can feel peace knowing you are part of a larger radiant whole beyond yourself.
shambhu_gita::768.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Shiva explains that liberated beings do not act as isolated selves but rest in and experience the entire universe as a unified whole, highlighting the deep unity that emerges after freedom from separation.
shambhu_gita::768.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by isolation, remember you are part of a vast interconnected whole that supports and sustains you.
shambhu_gita::768.insight: It shifts attention from feeling separate to resting in the collective radiant presence around you.

shambhu_gita::769.verse_sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डस्य नु तस्यैव तानि कर्माणि निश्चितम् ।            समष्टयात्मकमारब्धे सम्मिलन्ति स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::769.verse_hindi: उत्पन्न हुआ था उसी ब्रह्माण्ड के समष्टि प्रारब्ध वह  कर्म सम्मिलित हो जाते हैं
shambhu_gita::769.english_translation: The collective destiny of the universe arises from the sum of individual actions, all joined in their own sphere of influence.
shambhu_gita::769.translation_literal: ब्रह्माण्डस्य (of the universe) नु (indeed) तस्यैव (of the same) तानि (those) कर्माणि (actions) निश्चितम् (fixed) । समष्टयात्मकमारब्धे (in collective destiny) सम्मिलन्ति (join) स्वधाभुजः (own sphere/region) !
shambhu_gita::769.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::769.essence: Individual actions collectively shape the universe's unfolding destiny.
shambhu_gita::769.simple_meaning: The universe's fate is formed by the sum of all individual actions joining together.
shambhu_gita::769.simple_insight: You are part of a larger flow where every action matters in shaping what unfolds.
shambhu_gita::769.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the universe's collective destiny is not separate from individual actions; each person's deeds combine within their own sphere to form the greater cosmic unfolding.
shambhu_gita::769.modern_relevance: Every small choice you make today adds to the bigger patterns shaping your life and those around you.
shambhu_gita::769.insight: It teaches you to see your actions as threads weaving into a vast shared destiny, not isolated events.

shambhu_gita::770.verse_sanskrit:
समष्टि कर्मभिस्तैर्हि तद्ब्रह्माण्डस्य भूतिदाः ।
समष्टिसुखदुःखानि प्राप्यन्ते प्राणिभिर्बुवम ॥
shambhu_gita::770.verse_hindi: उन कर्मों के द्वारा उस ब्रह्माण्ड के समष्टि जीवों को समष्टि सुख दुःख प्राप्त होता है
shambhu_gita::770.english_translation: The collective beings of the universe experience collective joy and sorrow through collective actions.
shambhu_gita::770.translation_literal: समष्टि (collective) / कर्मभिस्तैर्हि (by actions) / तद्ब्रह्माण्डस्य (of that universe) / भूतिदाः (beings) / समष्टिसुखदुःखानि (collective joys and sorrows) / प्राप्यन्ते (are received) / प्राणिभिर्बुवम (by living beings on earth)
shambhu_gita::770.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::770.essence: Collective actions create shared joys and sorrows among all beings in the universe.
shambhu_gita::770.simple_meaning: All beings in the universe share collective happiness and suffering because of their collective actions.
shambhu_gita::770.simple_insight: You’re part of a larger web where every action contributes to shared experience.
shambhu_gita::770.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva explains that the universe’s beings experience happiness and suffering together, shaped by their collective actions, showing how deeply connected all life is through shared consequences.
shambhu_gita::770.modern_relevance: When you decide how to act, remember your choices influence not just you but your community's well-being.
shambhu_gita::770.insight: It teaches you to see your actions as part of a larger whole affecting many lives.

shambhu_gita::771.verse_sanskrit:
सत्यत्रेताद्वापराणां कलेश्चैव समुद्भवे ।
सहायकानि जायन्ते काले तानि भविष्यात ॥
shambhu_gita::771.verse_hindi: एवं भविष्यत् काल में सत्य, त्रेता, द्वापर, कलियुग आदि काल के उत्पन्न होने में वह सहायक होते हैं
shambhu_gita::771.english_translation: In the future, the ages of Satya, Treta, Dvapara, and Kali emerge, each bringing its own challenges.
shambhu_gita::771.translation_literal: सत्यत्रेताद्वापराणां (of Satya, Treta, and Dvapara) / कलेश्चैव (and also troubles) / समुद्भवे (arise) / सहायकानि (that assist) / जायन्ते (are born) / काले (in time) / तानि (those) / भविष्यात (will be in the future)
shambhu_gita::771.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::771.essence: Each age brings its own difficulties that arise naturally over time.
shambhu_gita::771.simple_meaning: The four great ages—Satya, Treta, Dvapara, and Kali—each bring difficulties that arise over time.
shambhu_gita::771.simple_insight: Every era comes with its own struggles that shape how life unfolds.
shambhu_gita::771.detailed_meaning: The bard Suta explains that the great cosmic ages, or yugas, arise sequentially each with their own troubles. These times influence human experience and the unfolding of challenges in the world.
shambhu_gita::771.insight: Recognize that challenges are part of the natural cycles of time and human experience.

shambhu_gita::772.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानिनां मम भक्तानां भोगो भवति कर्मणाम् ।
अन्येनापि प्रकारेण यथाग्रे वो ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥
shambhu_gita::772.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त के कर्मों का प्रकारान्तर से भोग ऐसा भी होता है, जैसा आप लोगों से मैं कहता हूं
shambhu_gita::772.english_translation: For my wise devotees, the results of their actions take a different form, as I have already told you.
shambhu_gita::772.translation_literal: ज्ञानिनां (of the wise) / मम (my) / भक्तानां (devotees) / भोगो (results/enjoyment) / भवति (is/occurs) / कर्मणाम् (of actions) / अन्येनापि (by other also) / प्रकारेण (form/type) / यथाग्रे (as before) / वो (you) / ब्रवीम्यहम् (I speak/tell)
shambhu_gita::772.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::772.essence: The results of devoted wise actions can appear in unexpected, subtle forms.
shambhu_gita::772.simple_meaning: The results of actions performed by wise and devoted people may appear differently than usual, in unexpected ways.
shambhu_gita::772.simple_insight: There is openness in knowing your efforts can bear fruit beyond what you imagine.
shambhu_gita::772.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains to the assembled sages that the outcomes of actions performed by his wise devotees do not always follow ordinary patterns. These results can manifest in different, subtle ways, as he has already explained, inviting trust in a deeper order.
shambhu_gita::772.modern_relevance: You worked hard on a project, but the benefits you receive might come as new opportunities or inner growth, not direct rewards.
shambhu_gita::772.insight: This teaches you to remain open to unexpected outcomes and trust that your action’s value may show differently.

shambhu_gita::773.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानिनो ये भजन्तीह नितरामर्चयन्ति च ।
ज्ञानिभिविहितः पुण्य कर्मशो याति तान्प्रति ॥
shambhu_gita::773.verse_hindi: कि ज्ञानी की जो सेवा और पूजा करते हैं उनको ज्ञानी के किये हुए पुण्यकर्मों का अंश भोग करना पड़ता है
shambhu_gita::773.english_translation: Those who serve and worship the wise must share in the fruits of the wise one's virtuous actions.
shambhu_gita::773.translation_literal: ज्ञानिनो (of the wise) / ये (those who) / भजन्तीह (serve) / नितरामर्चयन्ति (constantly worship) / च (and) / ज्ञानिभि-हितः (due to the wise) / पुण्य (virtuous) / कर्मशः (actions) / याति (goes) / तान्प्रति (to them)
shambhu_gita::773.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::773.essence: Serving the wise links you to the positive effects of their good deeds.
shambhu_gita::773.simple_meaning: If you serve or worship a wise person, you share in the positive results of their good actions.
shambhu_gita::773.simple_insight: You feel connected and benefit naturally by supporting those who act virtuously.
shambhu_gita::773.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that those who honor and serve a wise person participate in the fruits of that person's virtuous deeds. This shows how association with goodness influences your own experience.
shambhu_gita::773.modern_relevance: When you support a mentor or a person of integrity, you often find yourself benefiting from their good influence and actions.
shambhu_gita::773.insight: It teaches you that your association and service to wise people bring positive consequences to your life.

shambhu_gita::774.verse_sanskrit:
दुःखप्रदानं कुर्वन्ति निन्दन्ति ज्ञानिनश्च ये।
ज्ञानिसम्पादितः पाप कर्माशस्तांस्तु गच्छति ॥
shambhu_gita::774.verse_hindi: और जो ज्ञानी की निन्दा करते हैं और उनको दुःख देते हैं उनको ज्ञानी के किये हुए पापकर्मों का अंश भोग करना पड़ता है
shambhu_gita::774.english_translation: Those who insult and cause pain to the wise must share in the consequences of the unwise actions done by the wise.
shambhu_gita::774.translation_literal: दुःखप्रदानं (giving pain) कुर्वन्ति (do) निन्दन्ति (insult) ज्ञानिनः (the wise) च (also) ये (those). ज्ञानिसम्पादितः (done by the wise) पाप (unwise/bad) कर्माः (actions) अश्तांस्तु (must share) गच्छति (go).
shambhu_gita::774.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::774.essence: Hurting the wise makes you share their mistakes' consequences.
shambhu_gita::774.simple_meaning: If you insult or hurt wise people, you share the burden of their wrong actions.
shambhu_gita::774.simple_insight: Hurting those who guide you brings suffering back to you through unseen consequences.
shambhu_gita::774.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that those who cause pain or insult to the wise also inherit the negative results of the wise's mistakes. It warns against disrespecting those who hold knowledge, as it brings shared suffering.
shambhu_gita::774.modern_relevance: When you speak harshly to mentors or those who guide you, you may carry the hidden fallout of their errors as well.
shambhu_gita::774.insight: It shifts responsibility from only the doer to also those who harm the doer, urging respect for the wise.

shambhu_gita::775.verse_sanskrit:
मुच्यन्ते ज्ञानिनो ह्येवं निखिलः कर्मवन्धनैः।
निष्कामा भाग्यवन्तस्ते विचरन्ति महीतले ॥
shambhu_gita::775.verse_hindi: इस प्रकार से ज्ञानी सब कर्मों के बन्धनों से मुक्त हो जाते हैं और वे भाग्यवान् निष्काम होकर पृथिवी पर विचरते हैं
shambhu_gita::775.english_translation: In this way, the wise are freed from all bonds of action and wander the earth as fortunate beings without desire.
shambhu_gita::775.translation_literal: मुच्यन्ते (are freed) ज्ञानिनः (the wise) हि (indeed) एवम् (thus) निखिलः (all) कर्म (actions) बन्धनैः (from bonds) निष्कामा (without desire) भाग्यवन्तः (fortunate) ते (they) विचरन्ति (wander) महीतले (on the earth)
shambhu_gita::775.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::775.essence: Acting without desire frees you from all the bonds that tie your spirit.
shambhu_gita::775.simple_meaning: You become free from all the bonds of action when you act without wanting any result. Such wise people live freely and happily in the world.
shambhu_gita::775.simple_insight: There is freedom in acting without craving outcomes, letting you move through life lightly.
shambhu_gita::775.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that those who have wisdom act without attachment to results. This detachment frees them from the binding consequences of actions, allowing them to live freely on earth as fortunate beings.
shambhu_gita::775.modern_relevance: You finish a hard task and don’t obsess over the reward or recognition. That calm detachment frees your energy for the next moment.
shambhu_gita::775.insight: It teaches you to detach your inner worth from the fruits of your actions, focusing on the action itself.

shambhu_gita::776.verse_hindi: आत्मज्ञानी संसार समुद्र को तर कर यहीं ब्रह्मानन्द को प्राप्त होते हैं
shambhu_gita::776.english_translation: The wise who know the true self cross the ocean of the world and attain the bliss of the supreme reality right here.
shambhu_gita::776.translation_literal: संसारापारपाथोधिमुत्तीर्य्यात्मविदो (those who know the self crossing the ocean of the world) / जनाः (people) / ब्रह्मानन्दमुसन्दोहमत्रैव (supreme reality bliss in this very place) / आसादयन्त्यलम् (attain).
shambhu_gita::776.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::776.essence: Knowing your true self lets you cross all worldly struggles and find bliss right here.
shambhu_gita::776.simple_meaning: Those who truly know their inner self can overcome all worldly challenges and directly experience supreme bliss here and now.
shambhu_gita::776.simple_insight: There’s peace in knowing that crossing life’s struggles leads to joy already available to you.
shambhu_gita::776.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Shiva teaches that those who understand their true self can cross the vast ocean of worldly existence. They do not need to travel elsewhere; supreme bliss is accessible in this very moment through self-knowledge.
shambhu_gita::776.modern_relevance: You’ve faced overwhelming challenges and storms in life, yet the peace you seek isn’t far away — it’s already within reach here.
shambhu_gita::776.insight: It teaches you to realize that the journey through outer difficulties is also an inward process revealing bliss already present.

shambhu_gita::777.verse_sanskrit:
तरन्त्यात्मविदो भक्ता निश्चितं शोकसागरम् ।
सर्वभूतेषु गूढोऽस्ति देव एको न संशयः ॥
shambhu_gita::777.verse_hindi: "आत्मज्ञानी सब शोकों को तर जाता है " "एक ही आत्मदेव सब भूतो में व्यापक है"
shambhu_gita::777.english_translation: Those who truly know the self certainly cross the ocean of sorrow. The one inner divine presence dwells hidden in all beings without doubt.
shambhu_gita::777.translation_literal: तरन्ति (cross) आत्मविदो (self-knowers) भक्ता (devotees) निश्चितं (certainly) शोकसागरम् (ocean of sorrow) । / सर्वभूतेषु (in all beings) गूढः (hidden) अस्ति (is) देव (divine) एकः (one) न (not) संशयः (doubt) ॥
shambhu_gita::777.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::777.essence: True self-knowledge reveals the one divine presence hidden in all, overcoming sorrow.
shambhu_gita::777.simple_meaning: If you truly know your inner self, you can overcome all sorrow because the same divine presence exists within everyone, even if hidden.
shambhu_gita::777.simple_insight: There's comfort knowing your true self is connected to the divine in all, beyond pain and sorrow.
shambhu_gita::777.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that those who have genuine self-knowledge and devotion can cross the vast ocean of suffering. He reveals that a single divine presence dwells secretly within every living being, uniting all beyond visible differences.
shambhu_gita::777.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by grief, remember your inner connection to the divine shared by all beings, which gives strength to endure.
shambhu_gita::777.insight: It shifts your perspective from isolation in pain to recognizing your shared divine essence with all beings.

shambhu_gita::778.verse_hindi: "आत्मज्ञान से हृदय की ग्रंथि खुल जाती है" ये शास्त्रों में कहा है इसलिये जीवन्मुक्त महापुरुष साक्षात् ब्रह्मरूप ही हैं।
shambhu_gita::778.english_translation: "The knot of the heart is untied by self-knowledge," the scriptures say; thus, liberated great beings are directly the form of the supreme reality.
shambhu_gita::778.translation_literal: भिद्यते (is untied) / हृदयग्रन्थि (heart-knot) / इति (thus) / आदिशास्त्रसम्मतेः (according to the scriptures) / जीवन्मुक्ताः (liberated beings) / महात्मानः (great souls) / साक्षात् (directly) / ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणः (form of Brahman)
shambhu_gita::778.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::778.essence: Self-knowledge unties the heart’s knot, revealing the liberated as the supreme reality itself.
shambhu_gita::778.simple_meaning: Knowing your true self unties the deepest knot in your heart, freeing you from inner bondage.
shambhu_gita::778.simple_insight: There is relief in realizing that freedom comes from understanding yourself, not from outside things.
shambhu_gita::778.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the heart’s knot symbolizes deep confusion binding a being. According to scriptures, this knot unties only through self-knowledge, making liberated souls embodiments of the supreme reality itself.
shambhu_gita::778.modern_relevance: When you face overwhelming stress, this teaching reminds you that clarity about who you are frees you from inner tension.
shambhu_gita::778.insight: It teaches you to look within for liberation, shifting focus from external fixes to inner clarity.

shambhu_gita::779.verse_sanskrit:
चिजड़यन्थिसम्बन्धो योऽभूज्जीवदशोद्भवे ।
छिन्नो मुक्तदशायां स भवेज्जीवः शिवो ह्यतः ॥
shambhu_gita::779.verse_hindi: जीवदशा में जड़ और चेतन की जो ग्रन्थि बनी थी वह अन्धि मुक्तदशा में खुल जानेसे जीव शिवरूप हो जाता है
shambhu_gita::779.english_translation: When the knot binding the inert and the conscious in the state of living breaks in the state of liberation, the living being becomes like Shiva.
shambhu_gita::779.translation_literal: चिजड़यन्ति (bind) सम्बन्धः (connection) यः (which) अभूः (was) जीवदशा (state of living) उद्भवे (arising) । छिन्नः (broken) मुक्तदशायां (in the state of liberation) सः (that) भवेत् (becomes) जीवः (living being) शिवः (like Shiva) ह्यतः (indeed) ॥
shambhu_gita::779.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::779.essence: Breaking the inner knot between inertness and consciousness reveals your true divine nature.
shambhu_gita::779.simple_meaning: The inner bond that ties the lifeless and conscious parts breaks in liberation, making you like Shiva.
shambhu_gita::779.simple_insight: You can become free and radiant by releasing what binds your inner being.
shambhu_gita::779.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that living beings are bound by a knot joining the inert and conscious aspects. When this knot breaks in the state of liberation, the living being attains the nature of Shiva, symbolizing ultimate freedom and pure awareness.
shambhu_gita::779.modern_relevance: You’ve felt stuck between your habits and your awareness. Releasing that inner tension frees you to be your fullest self.
shambhu_gita::779.insight: It shifts your view from being trapped in inner conflicts to recognizing freedom through breaking internal bonds.

shambhu_gita::780.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्मेशकोटिभेदेन जीवन्मुक्तो द्विधा मतः।
पारब्धकर्मणां तत्र जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् ॥
shambhu_gita::780.verse_hindi: जीवन्मुक्त महापुरुष दो श्रेणी के होते हैं। एक ब्रह्मकोटि के जीवन्मुक्त और दूसरे ईशकोटि के जीवन्मुक्त।
shambhu_gita::780.english_translation: There are two kinds of liberated great beings: those of the Brahma class and those of the Ishvara class.
shambhu_gita::780.translation_literal: ब्रह्मेशकोटिभेदेन (by difference of Brahma class and Ishvara class) / जीवन्मुक्तो (liberated being) / द्विधा (in two ways) / मतः (opinion) / पारब्धकर्मणां (of past karma) / तत्र (there) / जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् (liberated great souls)
shambhu_gita::780.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::780.essence: Liberation appears in two forms: as pure awareness or as divine embodiment beyond karma.
shambhu_gita::780.simple_meaning: There are two types of liberated beings: one who is free as pure consciousness and another who is free while still connected to divine power.
shambhu_gita::780.simple_insight: Freedom can look different—sometimes quiet awareness, sometimes active divine presence.
shambhu_gita::780.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that among liberated beings, some are of the Brahma class—pure awareness beyond karma—and others of the Ishvara class—still engaged with the divine power governing karmic consequences. This shows liberation is not one single state but two recognized types.
shambhu_gita::780.modern_relevance: You might meet people who seem fully free—some calm and detached, others powerfully engaged yet unaffected. Both are valid forms of freedom.
shambhu_gita::780.insight: It teaches you to recognize liberation as multiple states: quiet inner freedom or empowered presence beyond karma.

shambhu_gita::781.verse_sanskrit:
वैचित्र्यमेव हेतुः स्यात्मभेदे द्विविधे ध्रुवम्।
ब्रह्मकोटि समापन्ना जीवन्मुक्ता भवन्त्यहो ॥
shambhu_gita::781.verse_hindi: मुक्त दशा में मुक्तात्मा के अवशेष रहे हुए प्रारब्ध कर्मों की विचित्रता ही इन दो भेदो का कारण है ।
shambhu_gita::781.english_translation: The difference between the two types of liberated beings arises solely from the variety of remaining past actions in the liberated state.
shambhu_gita::781.translation_literal: वैचित्र्यमेव (variety alone) हेतुः (cause) स्यात् (is) आत्मभेदे (in self-differences) द्विविधे (twofold) ध्रुवम् (certain). ब्रह्मकोटि (highest spiritual level) समापन्ना (having attained) जीवन्मुक्ता (liberated beings) भवन्ति (become) अहो (indeed).
shambhu_gita::781.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::781.essence: Inner freedom can manifest differently because subtle past actions remain after liberation.
shambhu_gita::781.simple_meaning: There are two types of liberated beings because of differences in the subtle effects of past actions that remain after liberation.
shambhu_gita::781.simple_insight: Freedom doesn’t erase all past patterns; some subtle differences linger even in liberation.
shambhu_gita::781.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that even among those who have attained liberation, differences exist. These arise because subtle past actions (prarabdha karma) still influence the liberated beings, causing two distinct types of freedom at the highest spiritual level.
shambhu_gita::781.modern_relevance: You might feel free inside, yet old habits or patterns subtly shape how you show up and behave.
shambhu_gita::781.insight: It teaches you to recognize that inner freedom can coexist with subtle influences from past conditioning.

shambhu_gita::782.verse_sanskrit:
आत्मारामाः सदा मूका जगत्सम्बन्धवर्जिता: ।
ईशकोटि श्रिता ये च जीवन्मुक्ताः स्वदिनः ॥
shambhu_gita::782.verse_hindi: ब्रह्मकोटि के जीवन्मुक्त मूक और आत्माराम होते हैं । जगत के साथ उनका कोई सम्बन्ध पुनः नहीं रहता है और ईशकोटि के जीवन्मुक्त
shambhu_gita::782.english_translation: Liberated beings, delighted in their true self, are always silent and free from all worldly ties; those who dwell in the supreme being are liberated forever.
shambhu_gita::782.translation_literal: आत्मारामाः (delighted in the true self) / सदा (always) / मूका (silent) / जगत्सम्बन्धवर्जिता: (free from worldly ties) / ईशकोटि (in the supreme being) / श्रिता (dwelling) / ये (those who) / जीवन्मुक्ताः (liberated beings) / स्वदिनः (forever).
shambhu_gita::782.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::782.essence: True liberation is silent freedom beyond all worldly attachments.
shambhu_gita::782.simple_meaning: True liberated beings are always quiet and unaffected by worldly connections, living in freedom within the supreme reality.
shambhu_gita::782.simple_insight: You can find deep peace by being silent and free from distractions of the world.
shambhu_gita::782.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva describes those who have attained ultimate liberation. They delight in their true self, remain always silent, and have no connection with worldly attachments. These liberated beings dwell eternally in the supreme reality, free from all bonds.
shambhu_gita::782.modern_relevance: In a world full of constant noise and distractions, this reminds you that true freedom comes from silence and detachment from external chaos.
shambhu_gita::782.insight: It teaches you to cultivate inner silence and release attachment to the outer world to experience true liberation.

shambhu_gita::783.verse_sanskrit:
त ईशप्रतिमाः सन्तो भगवत्कार्य्यरूपतः ।
सरक्ता विश्वकल्याणे सन्तिष्ठन्ते महीतले ॥
shambhu_gita::783.verse_hindi: ईश्वर प्रतिनिधि रूप होकर भगवत कार्यरूप से जगत् कल्याण में रत रहते हैं ।
shambhu_gita::783.english_translation: The divine representatives embody sacred duties and remain engaged in the world's welfare.
shambhu_gita::783.translation_literal: त (they) ईशप्रतिमाः (divine representatives) सन्तः (being) भगवत्कार्य्यरूपतः (form of sacred duties) । सरक्ता (engaged) विश्वकल्याणे (in world welfare) सन्तिष्ठन्ते (remain) महीतले (on the earth) ॥
shambhu_gita::783.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::783.essence: True representatives live fully in their sacred role, devoted to the world's welfare.
shambhu_gita::783.simple_meaning: You are meant to take on your sacred duty and stay engaged in helping the world.
shambhu_gita::783.simple_insight: There is meaning in knowing your role serves a purpose beyond yourself.
shambhu_gita::783.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that those who represent the divine take on sacred duties and remain actively involved in ensuring the welfare of the world, showing that true responsibility is service.
shambhu_gita::783.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your responsibilities, remembering your role as a force for good can renew your purpose.
shambhu_gita::783.insight: It shifts your view of duty from burden to meaningful service, inspiring sustained action for others' benefit.

shambhu_gita::784.verse_sanskrit:
विश्वमेवंविधैरेव ह्योकमात्रं स्वधाभुजः !।
भवन्त्युपकृतं धन्यं जीवन्मुक्तर्महात्मभिः ॥
shambhu_gita::784.verse_hindi: केवलमात्र ऐसे ही जीवन्मुक्त महापुरुषों के उपकार से उपकृत होकर जगत् धन्य होता है
shambhu_gita::784.english_translation: The entire world is blessed solely by the grace of great liberated beings.
shambhu_gita::784.translation_literal: विश्वमेवम् (the world thus) विधैः (by ways) एव (only) हि (indeed) उकमात्रं (solely) स्वधाभुजः (by self-liberated ones) भवन्ति (become) उपकृतं (favored) धन्यम् (blessed) जीवन्मुक्तर्महात्मभिः (by great liberated beings)
shambhu_gita::784.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::784.essence: True freedom in great beings alone brings lasting blessing to the world.
shambhu_gita::784.simple_meaning: The whole world becomes truly blessed only because of the kindness and presence of great liberated people.
shambhu_gita::784.simple_insight: You feel the quiet power of freedom spreading blessings beyond any other force.
shambhu_gita::784.detailed_meaning: In a world filled with struggle, the presence and acts of great liberated beings—those free from all attachments—bring real blessing and benefit to everyone around them. This verse highlights how true freedom uplifts the entire world.
shambhu_gita::784.modern_relevance: You see someone who lives with calm and freedom, and you realize how their peace spreads quietly to everyone they touch, making life better beyond words.
shambhu_gita::784.insight: It shifts your view to value inner freedom as the greatest source of positive influence and blessing for the world.

shambhu_gita::785.verse_sanskrit:
संन्ति भागवता एवं भगवद्भपिणो ध्रुवम् ।
तेषां सततयक्तानां मय्येव पितृपुङ्गवाः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::785.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! इस प्रकार से भागवत गण भगवद्गप ही हो जाते हैं। मुझमें ही सदा युक्त रहने से
shambhu_gita::785.english_translation: O ancestors, those devoted to the divine always unite with me alone.
shambhu_gita::785.translation_literal: संन्ति (exist) / भागवता (by the devotees) / एवं (thus) / भगवद्भपिणो (of the divine) / ध्रुवम् (always) / तेषां (of them) / सततयक्तानां (always united) / मय्येव (in me alone) / पितृपुङ्गवाः (O ancestors)!
shambhu_gita::785.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::785.essence: Steady devotion binds you permanently to the divine presence.
shambhu_gita::785.simple_meaning: Those who are devoted and always connected to the divine remain firmly united with it.
shambhu_gita::785.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing devotion creates an unbreakable bond with the divine.
shambhu_gita::785.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, explaining that those who remain constantly devoted to the divine naturally stay united with it. This moment highlights devotion as a path to permanent connection with the divine presence.
shambhu_gita::785.modern_relevance: When you keep your heart focused on what you truly care about, you feel deeply connected and supported.
shambhu_gita::785.insight: It teaches you to nurture steady devotion as a means to maintain constant inner connection with the divine.

shambhu_gita::786.verse_sanskrit:
चित्ते सर्वज्ञतावीजं भवत्यारोपितं खलु।
मत्कार्यतत्परांस्तांश्च सर्वथा मत्परायणान् ॥
shambhu_gita::786.verse_hindi: सर्वज्ञता का बीज उनके अन्तःकरण में अरोपित हो जाता है। सर्वथा मत्परायण और मेरे कार्य में तत्पर होने से
shambhu_gita::786.english_translation: The seed of omniscience is implanted in the heart of those wholly devoted to me and fully absorbed in my work.
shambhu_gita::786.translation_literal: चित्ते (in the heart) / सर्वज्ञतावीजं (seed of omniscience) / भवत्यारोपितं (is implanted) / खलु (indeed) / मत्कार्यततपरा: (fully absorbed in my work) / तांश्च (and those) / सर्वथा (completely) / मत्परायणान् (devoted to me)
shambhu_gita::786.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::786.essence: Complete devotion and absorption plant the seed of true knowing in your heart.
shambhu_gita::786.simple_meaning: If you are completely devoted and absorbed in the divine's work, deep wisdom naturally arises within your heart.
shambhu_gita::786.simple_insight: There is hope in knowing devotion nurtures wisdom quietly inside you.
shambhu_gita::786.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that those who dedicate themselves fully to his work and devotion have the seed of all knowledge placed in their innermost being, setting the stage for true wisdom to grow.
shambhu_gita::786.modern_relevance: When you commit fully to a purpose or passion, a deep understanding begins to grow inside you, even if you don’t see it immediately.
shambhu_gita::786.insight: It teaches you to trust that wholehearted devotion cultivates inner wisdom beyond effort or intellect.

shambhu_gita::787.verse_sanskrit:
देशकालौ न वाधेते कथञ्चित् किल कहिंचित ।
जीवन्मुक्ता महात्मान ईशकोटिं समाश्रिताः ॥
shambhu_gita::787.verse_hindi: देश और काल उनको किसी प्रकार कभी बाधा नहीं दे सके। ईशकोटि के जीवन्मुक्त
shambhu_gita::787.english_translation: The liberated great souls who belong to the Ishakoti lineage are never obstructed by place or time in any way.
shambhu_gita::787.translation_literal: देश (place) / काल (time) / न (not) / वाधेते (are obstructed) / कथञ्चित् (in any way) / किल (indeed) / कहिंचित् (ever) / जीवन्मुक्ता (liberated beings) / महात्मान (great souls) / ईशकोटिं (Ishakoti lineage) / समाश्रिताः (belonging to)
shambhu_gita::787.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::787.essence: Liberated souls of the Ishakoti group are never limited by place or time.
shambhu_gita::787.simple_meaning: Great liberated beings of the Ishakoti group are never blocked or limited by any place or time.
shambhu_gita::787.simple_insight: Freedom is not confined by where or when you are.
shambhu_gita::787.detailed_meaning: This verse declares that the great liberated souls of the Ishakoti group transcend all limitations of place and time. They exist beyond worldly constraints, indicating their complete freedom through liberation.
shambhu_gita::787.insight: It shows that true freedom means you are not limited by external circumstances like location or era.

shambhu_gita::788.verse_sanskrit:
यत्किञ्चनेह संसारे कार्ये कुर्वन्ति सन्ततम् ।
कार्यं ममैव तत्सर्वं कुर्वते पितृपुङ्गवाः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::788.verse_hindi: इस संसार में जो कुछ कार्य करते हैं सो मेरा ही कार्य करते हैं क्योंकि उस समय
shambhu_gita::788.english_translation: All actions performed in this world are ultimately my actions, for the forefathers act as my instruments.
shambhu_gita::788.translation_literal: यत् (that which) / किंच (anything) / नेह (in this) / संसारे (world) / कार्ये (action) / कुर्वन्ति (do) / सन्ततम् (always) / कार्यं (action) / मम (my) / एव (indeed) / तत् (that) / सर्वं (all) / कुर्वते (do) / पितृपुङ्गवाः (forefathers)
shambhu_gita::788.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::788.essence: Every action in the world is an expression of a singular divine purpose.
shambhu_gita::788.simple_meaning: Everything people do in this world is actually part of a greater purpose that belongs to the divine order.
shambhu_gita::788.simple_insight: You can feel connected knowing your actions have meaning beyond yourself.
shambhu_gita::788.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that all actions performed by beings, here represented by forefathers, are expressions of the divine will. The verse shows that individual acts are part of a larger cosmic purpose, suggesting surrender to that flow.
shambhu_gita::788.modern_relevance: When you feel your work is small or unnoticed, remember it contributes to something bigger than you see.
shambhu_gita::788.insight: It shifts your mindset from isolated effort to alignment with a deeper universal purpose.

shambhu_gita::789.verse_hindi: उनका अन्तःकरण समदर्शिता और निरासक्ति से पूर्ण होकर जैव अहङ्कार से रहित हो जाता है।
shambhu_gita::789.english_translation: Their inner being becomes pure, free from bodily ego, filled with equal vision and detachment.
shambhu_gita::789.translation_literal: यतः (from where) अन्तःकरणं (inner being) तेषां (their) जवाहङ्कारवर्जितम् (bodily ego-free) पूर्यते (is filled) समदर्शित्व- (equal vision) निरासक्तयादिभिस्तदा (detachment and others then)
shambhu_gita::789.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::789.essence: Purity of inner being arises when bodily ego falls away into equal vision and detachment.
shambhu_gita::789.simple_meaning: When your inner being is free of bodily ego and filled with equal vision and detachment, it becomes pure and steady.
shambhu_gita::789.simple_insight: You can find calm by releasing ego and seeing all things equally without attachment.
shambhu_gita::789.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva explains that when a person’s inner being sheds the bodily ego and embraces equal vision and detachment, it becomes pure and undisturbed. This marks a key step toward inner freedom.
shambhu_gita::789.modern_relevance: You notice peace when your reactive ego softens and you stop clinging to outcomes or identities tied to your body.
shambhu_gita::789.insight: It teaches you to cultivate equal vision and detachment to cleanse your inner being from egoic distortions.

shambhu_gita::790.verse_sanskrit:
भगवत्कार्यबुद्धयैव निरीक्ष्यन्ते निरन्तरम् ।
सर्वस्मिन् समये ते च परार्थे केवलं रताः ॥
shambhu_gita::790.verse_hindi: तब वह सभी अवस्थाओं में भगवान का काम समझकर केवल परार्थ कार्य में ही निरन्तर रत देख पड़ते हैं
shambhu_gita::790.english_translation: They constantly observe the divine's work in all situations and remain devoted only to actions for the welfare of others.
shambhu_gita::790.translation_literal: भगवत्कार्यबुद्धयैव (the divine's work understanding only) / निरीक्ष्यन्ते (are observed) / निरन्तरम् (constantly) / सर्वस्मिन् (in all) / समये (times) / ते (they) / च (also) / परार्थे (for others' welfare) / केवलं (only) / रताः (devoted)
shambhu_gita::790.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::790.essence: True devotion means constantly watching the divine's work and serving others alone.
shambhu_gita::790.simple_meaning: You attentively watch the divine's work in every moment and remain dedicated only to helping others.
shambhu_gita::790.simple_insight: You find peace by focusing on serving others through the divine's work at all times.
shambhu_gita::790.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that true devotion means constantly observing the divine's actions in every situation and dedicating oneself solely to the welfare of others, not personal gain.
shambhu_gita::790.modern_relevance: You notice how your efforts affect those around you and choose to act for their benefit, not just your own.
shambhu_gita::790.insight: It teaches you to shift focus from personal desires to selfless service inspired by awareness of the divine.

shambhu_gita::791.verse_sanskrit:
तज्ज्ञानं सर्वभूतेप्ववरोधशून्यतां गतम् ।
अत्रैक्यं खलु संस्थाप्याऽद्वैतभावं प्रपद्यते ॥
shambhu_gita::791.verse_hindi: उनका ज्ञान तब सर्वभूत में अवरोध शून्य होकर सर्वभूतों में एकता स्थापन करके अद्वैतभाव को प्राप्त करता है
shambhu_gita::791.english_translation: That knowledge removes all obstacles in all beings, establishing unity and leading to non-dual awareness.
shambhu_gita::791.translation_literal: तत् (that) ज्ञानम् (knowledge) सर्वभूते (in all beings) अप् (towards) अवरोध (obstacle) शून्यताम् (emptiness) गतम् (gone) । अत्र (here) ऐक्यम् (unity) खलु (indeed) संस्थाप्य (establishing) अद्वैतभावम् (non-dual nature) प्रपद्यते (attains) ॥
shambhu_gita::791.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::791.essence: Removing all inner obstacles reveals the oneness underlying all beings.
shambhu_gita::791.simple_meaning: When knowledge removes all obstacles inside beings, it reveals their essential unity and leads to seeing everything as one without division.
shambhu_gita::791.simple_insight: There is peace in realizing that beneath all differences, everything is connected as one.
shambhu_gita::791.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that true knowledge dissolves all internal blocks within beings, establishing the experience of oneness and non-dual nature, revealing the essential unity beyond apparent separation.
shambhu_gita::791.modern_relevance: When you overcome mental blocks and judgments, you experience connection and unity with others instead of division.
shambhu_gita::791.insight: This teaches you to recognize and remove mental barriers, shifting from separation to oneness in perception.

shambhu_gita::792.verse_sanskrit:
यदाऽहं ज्ञानिभक्तेषु प्रसीदामि तदैव ते ।
जीवन्मुक्तिपदं प्राप्तुं शक्नुवन्ति स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::792.verse_hindi: मैं जब अपने ज्ञानी भक्तों पर प्रसन्न होता हूँ वह जीवन्मुक्ति पदवी को प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
shambhu_gita::792.english_translation: When I am pleased with my wise devotees, they are able to attain the state of freedom while living.
shambhu_gita::792.translation_literal: यदा (when) अहं (I) ज्ञानि (wise) भक्तेषु (devotees) प्रसीदामि (am pleased) तदैव (then indeed) ते (they) जीवन्मुक्तिपदं (state of living freedom) प्राप्तुं (to attain) शक्नुवन्ति (are able) स्वधाभुजः (while living)
shambhu_gita::792.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::792.essence: Wise devotion that pleases the divine enables freedom while still living.
shambhu_gita::792.simple_meaning: If you cultivate wise devotion that pleases the divine, you can gain freedom while still living.
shambhu_gita::792.simple_insight: You can experience true freedom here and now by pleasing the divine with sincere wisdom and devotion.
shambhu_gita::792.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that when a devotee combines wisdom with devotion and pleases him, they can attain living liberation, escaping the cycle of reaction while still embodied. This reveals the power of Bhakti Yoga mixed with knowledge.
shambhu_gita::792.modern_relevance: You’ve sought meaning with both heart and mind; when your devotion aligns with wise understanding, freedom becomes reachable even in daily life.
shambhu_gita::792.insight: It teaches that combining devotion with clear understanding allows you to transcend limitation without waiting for death.

shambhu_gita::793.verse_sanskrit:
यदाऽऽर्ताऽर्थाणिजिज्ञासुभक्ता मच्छरणागताः।
स्युस्तदा प्रकृतिर्मेऽसौ मातृभावं समाश्रिता ॥
shambhu_gita::793.verse_hindi: मेरे आर्त्त जिज्ञासु और अर्थार्थी भक्त जब मेरे शरणागत होते हैं तब मेरी प्रकृति मातृभाव धारण करके
shambhu_gita::793.english_translation: When my devoted seekers and those in need take refuge in me, my nature embraces the feeling of a mother.
shambhu_gita::793.translation_literal: यदा (when) अऽर्ताऽर्थाणि (the distressed and seekers) जिज्ञासुभक्ता (inquiring devotees) मच्छरणागताः (take refuge in me) । स्युस्तदा (then become) प्रकृतिर्मेऽसौ (my nature this) मातृभावं (motherly feeling) समाश्रिता (embracing) ॥
shambhu_gita::793.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::793.essence: The divine responds to sincere seekers with a nurturing, motherly care.
shambhu_gita::793.simple_meaning: When devoted seekers come to Shiva in need, he responds with caring and protective motherly love.
shambhu_gita::793.simple_insight: You can feel safe and cared for like a child when you seek refuge sincerely.
shambhu_gita::793.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that when devoted seekers and those in distress turn to him for refuge, his divine nature takes on a motherly quality, offering nurturing care and protection to those who surrender.
shambhu_gita::793.modern_relevance: When you reach out honestly for help, you can experience genuine care that feels like a protective embrace.
shambhu_gita::793.insight: It teaches you to trust that sincere seeking invites compassionate, nurturing support.

shambhu_gita::794.verse_sanskrit:
तेभ्यो वै बाञ्छिताः सिद्धीर्दत्त्वाऽग्रे सारयेदिमान्।
सर्वतः सर्वथा कल्याः ! नैव कार्योऽत्र विस्मयः ॥
shambhu_gita::794.verse_hindi: उनको वाञ्छित सिद्धियां प्राप्त कराती हुई मेरी ओर सर्वथा अग्रसर करती है इसमें विस्मय नहीं करना चाहिये
shambhu_gita::794.english_translation: The desired perfections arise from them and move fully toward me; there is no need to be surprised by this.
shambhu_gita::794.translation_literal: तेभ्यः (from them) / वै (indeed) / बाञ्छिताः (desired) / सिद्धिः (perfections) / दत्त्वा (giving) / अग्रे (forward) / सारयेत् (moves) / इमान् (these) / सर्वतः (on all sides) / सर्वथा (in every way) / कल्याः (auspicious) / नैव (not at all) / कार्यः (action) / अत्र (here) / विस्मयः (surprise)
shambhu_gita::794.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::794.essence: Desired blessings naturally flow toward the divine without cause for surprise.
shambhu_gita::794.simple_meaning: What you truly desire will come to you completely and naturally; you don't need to be shocked by this.
shambhu_gita::794.simple_insight: There's peace in knowing your heartfelt wishes are already moving toward you.
shambhu_gita::794.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the perfections or blessings people desire come from various sources and naturally move toward him, the divine teacher. This movement is certain and auspicious, so being surprised by their arrival is unnecessary.
shambhu_gita::794.modern_relevance: You’ve worked hard toward your goals, and the results are unfolding steadily—there’s no need to doubt or be startled.
shambhu_gita::794.insight: Trust that your efforts and the universe’s support are aligned, so you can relax into the process.

shambhu_gita::795.verse_sanskrit:
यदा मेऽर्थार्थिनो भक्ताः प्रकृतेर्मे यथार्थतः।
दृष्ट्वा स्वरूपमस्याः स्युरुषास्तौ सिद्धकामनाः ॥
shambhu_gita::795.verse_hindi: जब मेरे अर्थार्थी भक्त मेरी प्रकृति का यथार्थ स्वरूप देखकर उनकी उपासना में सफलकाम होते हैं
shambhu_gita::795.english_translation: When my devoted followers truly see the real nature of my being, they succeed in their devoted practice.
shambhu_gita::795.translation_literal: यदा (when) मेऽर्थार्थिनो (my devoted followers) भक्ताः (devotees) प्रकृतेर्मे (of my nature) यथार्थतः (truly) दृष्ट्वा (seeing) स्वरूपमस्याः (the form of this) स्युः (are) उषास्तौ (in their worship) सिद्धकामनाः (successful in desires)
shambhu_gita::795.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::795.essence: True devotion flourishes only when you clearly see the divine's real nature.
shambhu_gita::795.simple_meaning: Devoted followers who clearly perceive the true nature of the divine succeed in their spiritual practice.
shambhu_gita::795.simple_insight: Clarity about the divine's true nature strengthens your heartfelt devotion and its results.
shambhu_gita::795.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that when his devotees truly understand his real nature beyond appearances, their devoted practice becomes effective and fulfills their heartfelt aspirations.
shambhu_gita::795.modern_relevance: You realize your efforts deepen when you understand the true spirit behind your commitment, not just the surface.
shambhu_gita::795.insight: It teaches you to seek clear understanding of what you devote yourself to, making your practice genuine and effective.

shambhu_gita::796.verse_sanskrit:
तदा मे प्रकृतिनूनं यथा नारी पतिव्रता ।
पत्युः केवलकल्याणानन्दवर्द्धनतत्परा ॥
shambhu_gita::796.verse_hindi: तब जिस प्रकार सती स्त्री अपने पति की एकमात्र कल्याण और आनन्द प्रदायिनी ही होती है
shambhu_gita::796.english_translation: Then, just as a devoted wife is solely focused on her husband's welfare and joy,
shambhu_gita::796.translation_literal: तदा (then) मे (my) प्रकृतिनूनं (nature certainly) यथा (just as) नारी (woman) पतिव्रता (devoted wife) । पत्युः (of husband) केवल (only) कल्याण (welfare) आनन्द (joy) वर्द्धन (increasing) तत्परा (fully dedicated) ॥
shambhu_gita::796.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::796.essence: Devotion means fully focusing on the welfare of the beloved.
shambhu_gita::796.simple_meaning: A devoted wife focuses only on her husband's well-being and happiness.
shambhu_gita::796.simple_insight: Devotion is about caring for the well-being of those we love.
shambhu_gita::796.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes how a devoted wife dedicates herself entirely to her husband's welfare and joy, illustrating an example of focused care and loyalty.
shambhu_gita::796.insight: It shows how deep commitment involves making someone's wellbeing your priority.

shambhu_gita::797.verse_sanskrit:
तानेवाार्थार्थिनो भक्तांस्तथा विश्वविभूतिदाः।
आभिमुख्येन मे नूनं करोत्यग्रेसरान क्रमात् ॥
shambhu_gita::797.verse_hindi: उसी प्रकार मेरी प्रकृति उन उत्तम अर्थार्थी भक्तों को क्रमशः मेरी ओर अग्रसर करती है
shambhu_gita::797.english_translation: Similarly, my nature gradually draws those devoted to the highest meaning closer to me.
shambhu_gita::797.translation_literal: ताने (those) / एव (indeed) / अर्थार्थिनः (seeking meaning) / भक्तान् (devotees) / तथा (also) / विश्वविभूतिदाः (of the universal manifestations) / आभिमुख्येन (by turning towards) / मे (me) / नूनं (certainly) / करोति (does) / अग्रसरान् (advancing) / क्रमात् (gradually)
shambhu_gita::797.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::797.essence: Devotion naturally and gradually draws you closer to the divine presence.
shambhu_gita::797.simple_meaning: Your inner nature naturally leads devoted seekers closer to the divine presence over time.
shambhu_gita::797.simple_insight: There is a gentle, natural pull that draws your devotion deeper without force.
shambhu_gita::797.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Shiva explains how his own nature gently and gradually attracts sincere devotees who seek the deeper meaning of existence to move closer to him, emphasizing the natural flow of devotion.
shambhu_gita::797.modern_relevance: You notice how your genuine care and focus on what matters pulls you steadily toward your goals without strain.
shambhu_gita::797.insight: It teaches you to trust the natural unfolding of devotion and connection rather than forcing progress.

shambhu_gita::798.verse_sanskrit:
केवलं ज्ञानिनो भक्ताः स्वज्ञानोपास्तिपूर्तितः।
लीना मत्प्रकृतौ सम्यङ्नूनमासादयन्ति माम ॥
shambhu_gita::798.verse_hindi: केवले ज्ञानी भक्त ही अपने ज्ञान और उपासना की पूर्णता के प्रभाव से मेरी प्रकृति में सम्यक् लय होकर मुझको प्राप्त करते हैं ।
shambhu_gita::798.english_translation: Only those who are devoted and wise, perfected in their knowledge and worship, truly merge into my nature and attain me.
shambhu_gita::798.translation_literal: केवलं (only) ज्ञानिनो (of the wise) भक्ताः (devotees) स्वज्ञानोपास्तिपूर्तितः (fulfilled by their own knowledge and worship) । / लीन (merged) मत्प्रकृतौ (in my nature) सम्यक्त् (completely) नूनमासादयन्ति (certainly attain) माम (me) ॥
shambhu_gita::798.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::798.essence: Only devotion perfected by knowledge fully unites you with the divine nature.
shambhu_gita::798.simple_meaning: Only those who combine devoted love with deep understanding truly unite with the divine nature and reach it fully.
shambhu_gita::798.simple_insight: You feel the power of devotion and wisdom working together to connect you deeply.
shambhu_gita::798.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that perfect union with the divine nature comes only when devotion is combined with true knowledge and sincere worship. Such complete merging is the highest spiritual attainment.
shambhu_gita::798.modern_relevance: When your heartfelt care meets clear understanding, you connect deeply with what truly matters beyond surface appearances.
shambhu_gita::798.insight: It teaches you to harmonize your heart’s devotion with your mind’s clarity for full spiritual integration.

shambhu_gita::799.verse_sanskrit:
उपास्तेरधिकारस्य त्रिविधस्यैतदेव हि ।
रहस्यं विद्यते कल्याः ! सत्यमेतन्न संशयः ॥
shambhu_gita::799.verse_hindi: यही उपासना विविध अधिकार का रहस्य है । हे पितृगण ! यह सत्य है।
shambhu_gita::799.english_translation: The secret of the threefold right of worship is indeed this; O ancestors, this is the truth beyond doubt.
shambhu_gita::799.translation_literal:
उपास्तेरधिकारस्य (of the right of worship) त्रिविधस्यैतदेव (threefold this indeed) हि (indeed) ।
रहस्यं (secret) विद्यते (exists) कल्याः (auspicious) !
सत्यमेतन्न (this is truth) संशयः (doubt) ॥
shambhu_gita::799.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::799.essence: Worship has a threefold secret right that is a certain, auspicious truth.
shambhu_gita::799.simple_meaning: There is a secret about the three kinds of rights in worship, and this truth is certain and auspicious.
shambhu_gita::799.simple_insight: Knowing that the true essence of worship has layers deepens reverence and confidence.
shambhu_gita::799.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestral beings, revealing that worship involves three distinct rights or claims. He declares this layered secret as an undeniable and auspicious truth, inviting deeper reflection on spiritual practice.
shambhu_gita::799.insight: It invites you to recognize that spiritual practice has nuanced dimensions requiring attentive understanding.

shambhu_gita::800.verse_sanskrit:
पश्यन्तो ज्ञानिनो भक्ता मा सर्वत्रैव सर्वदा ।
दिव्याचारस्य जायन्ते सर्वथैवाधिकारिणः ॥
shambhu_gita::800.verse_hindi: ज्ञानी भक्त ही मुझको सदा सब जगहों में देखते हुए दिव्याचार के अधिकारी बन जाते हैं
shambhu_gita::800.english_translation: The wise devotee always sees me everywhere and thus becomes fully qualified in divine conduct.
shambhu_gita::800.translation_literal: पश्यन्तो (seeing) ज्ञानिनो (wise) भक्ता (devotees) मा (me) सर्वत्रैव (everywhere) सर्वदा (always) । दिव्याचारस्य (of divine conduct) जायन्ते (become) सर्वथैवाधिकारिणः (fully qualified in all respects) ॥
shambhu_gita::800.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::800.essence: Seeing the divine everywhere qualifies you for living with sacred conduct.
shambhu_gita::800.simple_meaning: Those who are wise and devoted see the divine everywhere and naturally embody sacred conduct.
shambhu_gita::800.simple_insight: Feeling the divine presence everywhere invites you to live with dignity and sacredness.
shambhu_gita::800.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that when a wise devotee continually perceives the divine in all places, they naturally become qualified to follow the highest standards of sacred conduct, showing how devotion and wisdom unite to guide behavior.
shambhu_gita::800.modern_relevance: In a world full of distractions, recognizing a sacred presence around you transforms your actions into meaningful conduct.
shambhu_gita::800.insight: It shifts your perspective from separation to seeing sacredness everywhere, inspiring consistent ethical living.

shambhu_gita::801.verse_sanskrit:
जीवन्मुक्तिपदस्यैतद्रहस्यं वित्त सत्तमाः ।
पुरा यद्वणितं कल्याः ! लोककल्याणसम्पदे ॥
shambhu_gita::801.verse_hindi: ही जीवन्मुक्ति पदवी का रहस्य है, मैने लोककल्याण के लिये जिसका वर्णन पहले किया है
shambhu_gita::801.english_translation: This is the secret of the state of liberation that I have previously described for the welfare of the world.
shambhu_gita::801.translation_literal: जीवन्मुक्तिपदस्य (of the state of liberation) एतत् (this) रहस्यं (secret) वित्त (having known) सत्तमाः (the best) । पुरा (earlier) यत् (that) वणितं (described) कल्याः (auspicious) ! लोककल्याणसम्पदे (for the welfare of the world) ॥
shambhu_gita::801.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::801.essence: The secret of liberation is key to the well-being of all beings.
shambhu_gita::801.simple_meaning: This reveals the secret of liberation that was described earlier for the benefit of all beings.
shambhu_gita::801.simple_insight: Understanding the secret of liberation connects you to deeper universal welfare.
shambhu_gita::801.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares that the secret of living liberation, previously explained, is central to the welfare of the world, emphasizing the teaching’s importance beyond personal freedom.
shambhu_gita::801.insight: It shows that true liberation is linked with the well-being of everyone, not just individual freedom.

shambhu_gita::802.verse_sanskrit:
जीवन्मुक्तिपदाऽऽरूढान मद्भक्तान ज्ञानिनो वरान् ।
नालं मे प्रकृतेः सक्तान् कर्तुं किमपि वैभवम् ॥
shambhu_gita::802.verse_hindi: मेरे श्रेष्ठ जीवन्मुक्त पदवी प्राप्त ज्ञानी भक्तों को मेरी प्रकृति का कोई वैभव फंसा नहीं सकता है।
shambhu_gita::802.english_translation: My best devotees and wise ones who have attained liberation are not attached to any grandeur of my nature.
shambhu_gita::802.translation_literal: जीवन-मुक्ति-पदा (liberation-state) / आरूढान (having attained) / मद्-भक्तान् (my devotees) / ज्ञानिनः (wise ones) / वरान् (best) / न (not) / आलं (any) / मे (my) / प्रकृतेः (nature) / सक्तान् (attached) / कर्तुं (to do) / किमपि (anything) / वैभवम् (grandeur)
shambhu_gita::802.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::802.essence: True liberation is freedom from attachment to all displays of divine grandeur.
shambhu_gita::802.simple_meaning: Those who are truly liberated and devoted are not caught by any display or power of the divine nature.
shambhu_gita::802.simple_insight: Freedom feels like being untied from all impressive appearances and powers.
shambhu_gita::802.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that his highest devotees and wise ones who have reached liberation are not attached or bound by his divine nature's grandeur or manifestations. They see beyond appearances and remain free.
shambhu_gita::802.modern_relevance: You may feel trapped by the impressive status or power around you, but true freedom means not being caught by such appearances.
shambhu_gita::802.insight: It teaches you to see beyond surface grandeur and not let external power define your inner freedom.
