shambhu_gita::855.simple_meaning: The mind arises like a sprouted seed, full of confusion, but in a wise devotee, the divine dwells beyond this delusion.
shambhu_gita::855.simple_insight: Even when your mind feels confused, the divine presence within remains calm and steady.
shambhu_gita::855.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the restless mind arises naturally like a sprouted seed, full of illusions. But in a wise devotee who loves the divine, Shiva dwells beyond the mind’s confusions, showing the power of devoted wisdom to transcend mental illusions.
shambhu_gita::855.modern_relevance: When your thoughts spiral and you feel lost in mental noise, remember a calm presence within you that is untouched by confusion.
shambhu_gita::855.insight: It teaches you to recognize the divine presence beyond the restless and confusing patterns of your mind.

shambhu_gita::856.verse_sanskrit:
व्युत्याने मेघजालेन पिडितोऽप्यन्तरान्तरा।
प्रकाशे श्रावणें मामे यथा सोर्य्यो घनावृत्त: ॥
shambhu_gita::856.verse_hindi: मेघजाल से व्युत्थान दशा में ढके जाने पर भी श्रावणमास के घनावृत सूर्य की तरह निरन्तर बीच बीच में प्रकाशित भी होता रहता हूँ
shambhu_gita::856.english_translation: Even when overwhelmed by the stormy clouds of adversity, I shine through intermittently like the sun hidden behind thick clouds in the month of Shravan.
shambhu_gita::856.translation_literal: व्युत्याने (storm/winds) मेघजालेन (by cloud cover) पिडितोऽप्यन्तरान्तरा (though afflicted, at intervals within) । प्रकाशे (in brightness) श्रावणें (in the month of Shravan) मामे (I) यथा (like) सोर्य्यो (the sun) घनावृत्त: (covered by thick clouds) ॥
shambhu_gita::856.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::856.essence: You can intermittently shine through adversity like the sun behind dark clouds.
shambhu_gita::856.simple_meaning: I remain visible like the sun behind dense clouds even when surrounded by difficulties.
shambhu_gita::856.simple_insight: You can still shine even when life covers you with challenges.
shambhu_gita::856.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Shiva describes how despite being overwhelmed by troubles (symbolized by storm clouds), he continues to shine intermittently like the sun behind thick monsoon clouds. It conveys persistence amid hardship.
shambhu_gita::856.modern_relevance: You feel weighed down by constant stress, yet moments of clarity and brightness still break through your struggles.
shambhu_gita::856.insight: It teaches you to recognize your inner light even during tough times, sustaining hope and presence.

shambhu_gita::857.verse_sanskrit:
अस्यामाघदशायां हि जीवन्मुक्ताः स्वधाभुजः!।
परिश्रान्ता भवन्तोऽपि पदे ज्ञानमये परे ॥
shambhu_gita::857.verse_hindi: इस प्रथम अवस्था में जीवन्मुक्त परिश्रान्त रहने पर भी ज्ञानमय
shambhu_gita::857.english_translation: In this first stage, those freed while living remain weary but reside in the supreme state of knowledge.
shambhu_gita::857.translation_literal: अस्याम् (in this) / अझदशायां (first stage) / हि (indeed) / जीवन्मुक्ताः (living liberated beings) / स्वधाभुजः (while alive) / परिश्रान्ता (weary) / भवन्तः (become) / अपि (also) / पदे (in the state) / ज्ञानमये (full of knowledge) / परे (supreme)
shambhu_gita::857.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::857.essence: Living liberation includes phases of weariness even amid supreme knowledge.
shambhu_gita::857.simple_meaning: Living beings who are free remain tired but dwell in a supreme state of wisdom at this first stage.
shambhu_gita::857.simple_insight: Freedom does not mean the absence of fatigue; even the wise may feel weariness.
shambhu_gita::857.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that even those who have attained liberation while still alive experience tiredness initially, yet they abide in a supreme, knowledge-filled state. This teaches that liberation includes phases and is not always free from effort or fatigue.
shambhu_gita::857.modern_relevance: You may feel exhausted despite your inner growth or breakthroughs, and that is part of the process, not a sign of failure.
shambhu_gita::857.insight: It shifts expectations by showing liberation includes stages with effort and rest, not constant ease.

shambhu_gita::858.verse_hindi: परमानन्द रूपी परमपद में ही विश्रान्ति लाभ किया करते हैं। जीवमुक्त की दूसरी अवस्था
shambhu_gita::858.english_translation: The liberated great souls rest in the supreme state of bliss in their second stage of freedom.
shambhu_gita::858.translation_literal: प्राप्नुवन्येव (attain indeed) / विश्रान्ति (rest) / परमानन्दरूपिणि (in supreme bliss form) / द्वितीयायामवस्थायां (in the second state) / जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् (of the liberated great souls)
shambhu_gita::858.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::858.essence: True rest arises in the supreme bliss found in the second stage of liberation.
shambhu_gita::858.simple_meaning: The great souls who are freed experience rest in the highest bliss during their second stage of liberation.
shambhu_gita::858.simple_insight: There is a profound peace that comes after initial freedom, a deeper rest beyond release.
shambhu_gita::858.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes the advanced spiritual state of those liberated beings who have transcended initial freedom and now dwell in supreme bliss, marking a deeper phase of their spiritual journey.
shambhu_gita::858.modern_relevance: After overcoming major struggles, you realize a deeper peace that goes beyond just being free—it is a blissful rest within.
shambhu_gita::858.insight: It teaches you to recognize that freedom has stages, and true rest lies in embracing the highest bliss beyond mere release.

shambhu_gita::859.verse_sanskrit:
चितसचा हि ममोन्मुक्ता मनसः शान्तिशालिनी । 
तमोज्योतिर्गणैमुक्ता राजते व्योमवद्विभुः ॥
shambhu_gita::859.verse_hindi: मन से उन्मुक्त शान्तिशालिनी मेरी चित्सत्ता समस्त तम और समस्त ज्योति से मुक्त होकर विभुव्यापक आकाश की तरह विराजमान रहती है
shambhu_gita::859.english_translation: My consciousness, freed from the mind, peaceful and serene, shines like the vast sky, liberated from all darkness and all light.
shambhu_gita::859.translation_literal: चितसचा (with consciousness) / हि (indeed) / ममोन्मुक्ता (my freed) / मनसः (from mind) / शान्तिशालिनी (peaceful) / तमोज्योतिर्गणैमुक्ता (freed from darkness and light) / राजते (shines) / व्योमवत् (like the sky) / विभुः (all-pervading)
shambhu_gita::859.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::859.essence: Consciousness freed from mind and duality shines peacefully like the infinite sky.
shambhu_gita::859.simple_meaning: Your true consciousness is free from the restless mind, peaceful, and shines widely beyond all darkness and light.
shambhu_gita::859.simple_insight: You can rest in a vast awareness beyond all inner darkness and distractions.
shambhu_gita::859.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes a state where consciousness is freed from the restless mind and all dualities like darkness and light, shining peacefully and broadly like the sky, representing supreme freedom and stillness.
shambhu_gita::859.modern_relevance: When your mind quiets, you experience an inner space that feels limitless and peaceful, no longer pulled by conflicting thoughts or emotions.
shambhu_gita::859.insight: It teaches you to recognize your awareness as spacious and unaffected by mental fluctuations or opposites.

shambhu_gita::860.verse_sanskrit:
अत्र गाढ़सुपुप्तेभै पितरोऽनुभवो यथा ।
पाषाणप्विव काटिन्यमधवा व्योममण्डले ॥
shambhu_gita::860.verse_hindi: इस दशा में गाढ़ सुषुप्ति दशा के अनुभव की तरह अथवा प्रस्तर में कठिनता की तरह अथवा आकाश में
shambhu_gita::860.english_translation: Here, the experience is like deep sleep or hardness like a stone or like the vastness of the sky.
shambhu_gita::860.translation_literal: अत्र (here) / गाढ़ (deep) / सुपुप्तेभै (sleeping) / पितरोऽनुभवो (experience) / यथा (like) / पाषाणप्विव (like stone) / काटिन्यम् (hardness) / अधवा (or) / व्योममण्डले (in the sky)
shambhu_gita::860.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::860.essence: Some states of experience are deeply still, hard to penetrate, and boundlessly vast.
shambhu_gita::860.simple_meaning: The state is described as similar to deep sleep or the hardness of stone or the vast openness of the sky.
shambhu_gita::860.simple_insight: This moment feels vast, unchanging, and impenetrable like deep sleep or stone.
shambhu_gita::860.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains a state of experience that is profoundly still and unresponsive, comparing it to deep sleep, the hardness of stone, or the vast sky, emphasizing the unchanging and ungraspable nature of this state.
shambhu_gita::860.insight: It shows how some inner states feel completely still, solid, and vast beyond usual perception.

shambhu_gita::861.verse_sanskrit:
विभुः शून्या यथा शक्तिबीहान वै विषयान्प्रति ।
स्वभावादुन्मुखत्वस्य परित्यागेन सर्वथा ॥
shambhu_gita::861.verse_hindi: विभु शून्य शक्ति की तरह बाह्य विषय के प्रति उन्मुखता को स्वभाव से परित्याग करके
shambhu_gita::861.english_translation: Just as the supreme being is naturally free from attachment to external objects by renouncing all inclination,
shambhu_gita::861.translation_literal: विभुः (supreme being) / शून्या (empty, free) / यथा (just as) / शक्तिबीहान (devoid of power) / वै (indeed) / विषयान्प्रति (towards external objects) / स्वभावात् (by nature) / उन्मुखत्वस्य (attachment, inclination) / परित्यागेन (by renunciation) / सर्वथा (completely)
shambhu_gita::861.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::861.essence: True freedom arises when you naturally renounce all attraction to external things.
shambhu_gita::861.simple_meaning: You can become naturally free from attachment to outside things by fully giving up all inclination toward them.
shambhu_gita::861.simple_insight: There is a deep ease in seeing desire lose its grip without forcing it.
shambhu_gita::861.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes how the supreme being remains untouched by external attractions, not by force but by naturally letting go of all inward inclination toward them. This teaching reveals the path to freedom through inner renunciation.
shambhu_gita::861.modern_relevance: You find peace when you stop chasing every distraction and let your cravings fade naturally.
shambhu_gita::861.insight: It teaches you to cultivate renunciation as a natural state, not a forced denial.

shambhu_gita::862.verse_sanskrit:
सचिदानन्दभावानां स्वस्वरूपेऽनुभूयते ।
अद्वैतसत्ता नितरां नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
shambhu_gita::862.verse_hindi: स्वस्वरूप में सच्चिदानन्द भाव की अद्वैतसत्ता सर्वथा अनुभूत होती है
shambhu_gita::862.english_translation: In its own nature, the state of existence, consciousness, and bliss is directly experienced as absolute non-dual reality without doubt.
shambhu_gita::862.translation_literal: सचिदानन्दभावानां (existence-consciousness-bliss state) स्वस्वरूपेऽनुभूयते (in own nature is experienced) । अद्वैतसत्ता (non-dual reality) नितरां (completely) नात्र (here not) कार्या (to be done) विचारणा (consideration) ॥
shambhu_gita::862.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::862.essence: Your true nature is directly experienced as complete and beyond all duality.
shambhu_gita::862.simple_meaning: Your true nature is pure existence, consciousness, and bliss experienced as completely non-dual without any need to question.
shambhu_gita::862.simple_insight: There is peace in realizing your inner being is already whole and beyond all duality.
shambhu_gita::862.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that the deepest reality of existence, consciousness, and bliss is directly known in its own nature. This absolute non-dual reality requires no intellectual debate or further investigation because it is self-evident.
shambhu_gita::862.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by confusion or doubt, knowing your true nature is already whole and beyond duality brings calm and clarity.
shambhu_gita::862.insight: It shifts your mind from seeking external validation to resting in the direct experience of your true being as unified existence and bliss.

shambhu_gita::863.verse_sanskrit:
अस्यां द्वितीयावस्थायां जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् ।
अत्यंत जायते स्वल्पा दशा व्युत्थाननामिका ॥
shambhu_gita::863.verse_hindi: जीवन्मुक्त की इस द्वितीय दशा व्युत्थान दशा बहुत कम होती है और साथ ही साथ अन्तःकरण रूपी समुद्र की
shambhu_gita::863.english_translation: In this second stage, the state of the liberated beings is very rare, marked by a condition called Vyutthana.
shambhu_gita::863.translation_literal: अस्यां (in this) / द्वितीयावस्थायां (second stage) / जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् (of liberated great souls) / अत्यंत (extremely) / जायते (arises) / स्वल्पा (rare) / दशा (state) / व्युत्थाननामिका (called Vyutthana)
shambhu_gita::863.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::863.essence: Rare inner states mark the second stage of liberation among great liberated beings.
shambhu_gita::863.simple_meaning: In the second stage of liberation, the rare condition called Vyutthana arises among liberated souls.
shambhu_gita::863.simple_insight: The rare deeper states of freedom come in stages and are not constant.
shambhu_gita::863.detailed_meaning: Suta describes the second stage experienced by liberated beings, called Vyutthana, which is very rare and relates to the inner state of the heart-mind.
shambhu_gita::863.insight: Recognize that even in freedom, rare inner states arise and pass; liberation unfolds progressively.

shambhu_gita::864.verse_sanskrit:
आदावन्ते च प्रत्येकवीचेश्चित्तमहोदधेः।
लभन्ते ज्ञानिभक्ता ये मत्सायुज्यमसंशयम् ॥
shambhu_gita::864.verse_hindi: वृत्तिरूपी प्रत्येक वीचि के आदि अन्त में ही मेरे ज्ञानीभक्त मत्सायुज्य को प्राप्त करते रहते हैं
shambhu_gita::864.english_translation: At the beginning and end of every cycle of the vast inner ocean, my wise devotees surely attain union with me.
shambhu_gita::864.translation_literal: आदावन्ते (beginning and end) / च (and) / प्रत्येकवीच (every cycle) / चित्तमहोदधेः (of the vast inner ocean) / लभन्ते (attain) / ज्ञानिभक्ता (wise devotees) / ये (who) / मत्सायुज्यम् (union with me) / असंशयम् (without doubt)
shambhu_gita::864.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::864.essence: Steadfast devotion and wisdom always lead to certain union with the divine.
shambhu_gita::864.simple_meaning: Every cycle in the vast inner ocean of your mind begins and ends with the wise devotees reaching union with the divine without doubt.
shambhu_gita::864.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing that devoted wisdom inevitably leads you back to connection with the divine.
shambhu_gita::864.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that throughout the endless cycles of change within the mind and life, those who combine wisdom and devoted love steadily reach union with him without any doubt, highlighting the power of bhakti and knowledge together.
shambhu_gita::864.modern_relevance: When life feels like endless ups and downs, your steady devotion and clear understanding can guide you to a deeper connection beyond the chaos.
shambhu_gita::864.insight: It shifts focus to embracing devotion and wisdom together as a reliable way to reach inner union beyond life's cycles.

shambhu_gita::865.verse_sanskrit:
दशां तृतीयां प्राप्तेषु जीवन्मुक्तेषु भूतिदाः!। 
नीरक्षीरसुसम्मेलसन्निमा चित्सवानिका ॥
shambhu_gita::865.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! जीवन्मुक्त भक्त तीसरी दशा को प्राप्त करने पर उसमें नीर क्षीर के सम्मेलन की तरह चित्प्रधान
shambhu_gita::865.english_translation: O ancestors! Devotees who have attained the third stage of liberation are like a union of water and milk, full of consciousness.
shambhu_gita::865.translation_literal: दशां (stage) तृतीयां (third) प्राप्तेषु (those who have attained) जीवन्मुक्तेषु (liberated beings) भूतिदाः (full of consciousness)!। नीरक्षीरसुसम्मेलसन्निमा (like the union of water and milk) चित्सवानिका (full of consciousness)
shambhu_gita::865.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::865.essence: Advanced liberation blends consciousness as perfectly as water and milk unite.
shambhu_gita::865.simple_meaning: Those who reach the third stage of liberation are united and full of consciousness, like water and milk blended perfectly.
shambhu_gita::865.simple_insight: There is a harmonious fullness when liberation progresses beyond the early stages.
shambhu_gita::865.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses the ancestral sages, describing devotees who have reached the third stage of liberation as united and inseparable, like water mixed with milk, symbolizing a complete blending of consciousness.
shambhu_gita::865.insight: It highlights the deep integration and purity of consciousness achieved in advanced liberation stages.

shambhu_gita::866.verse_sanskrit:
सत्ता मे त्रिविधाऽखण्डब्रह्माकारत्वमाश्रिता।
तत्राभिन्नेव संयुक्ता मया सह विराजते ॥
shambhu_gita::866.verse_hindi: मेरी त्रिविधसत्ता अखण्ड ब्रह्माकार भाव को प्राप्त करके मेरे साथ अभेद से बनी रहती है
shambhu_gita::866.english_translation: My threefold existence, rooted in the indivisible supreme reality, abides inseparably united with me.
shambhu_gita::866.translation_literal: सत्ता (existence) / मे (my) / त्रिविधा (threefold) / अखण्ड (indivisible) / ब्रह्माकारत्वम् (supreme reality-form nature) / आश्रिता (rooted) / तत्र (there) / अभिन्नेव (inseparably) / संयुक्ता (joined) / मया (with me) / सह (together) / विराजते (abides).
shambhu_gita::866.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::866.essence: Threefold existence is inseparably united with the indivisible supreme reality and Shiva.
shambhu_gita::866.simple_meaning: My threefold being is inseparably united with the undivided supreme reality and shines with me.
shambhu_gita::866.simple_insight: There is unity beyond apparent divisions, a deep togetherness with what is whole.
shambhu_gita::866.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes his own nature as embodying a threefold existence rooted in the undivided supreme reality, highlighting inseparable union with that ultimate truth.
shambhu_gita::866.insight: It shows that diverse aspects of existence are expressions of one indivisible reality, inviting us to see unity beyond differences.

shambhu_gita::867.verse_sanskrit:
सत्ता तात्कालिकी नामरूपातीततया खलु।
ब्रह्मात्मेसादिसंज्ञाभ्यो ह्यतीता केवलेन च ॥
shambhu_gita::867.verse_hindi: और उस समय की सत्ता नाम रूप से अतीत होने के कारण ब्रहा आत्मा इत्यादि संज्ञाओ से भी अतीत होकर केवल रूप से
shambhu_gita::867.english_translation: Existence at that moment transcends names and forms, surpassing even terms like Brahman and Atman, remaining solely as pure being.
shambhu_gita::867.translation_literal: सत्ता (existence) / तात्कालिकी (momentary) / नामरूपातीततया (beyond name and form) / खलु (indeed). / ब्रह्मात्मेसादिसंज्ञाभ्यो (than the terms Brahman and Atman etc.) / ह्यतीता (surpassed) / केवलेन (only) / च (and).
shambhu_gita::867.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::867.essence: Existence in its purest moment is beyond all names and forms, even sacred ones.
shambhu_gita::867.simple_meaning: At the deepest moment, existence goes beyond all labels like name, form, Brahman, and Atman, remaining just pure being.
shambhu_gita::867.simple_insight: You are not the names or ideas about you but the pure presence beyond them.
shambhu_gita::867.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Shiva reveals that true existence at a certain profound moment is beyond all conceptual labels, including sacred terms like Brahman and Atman. It shows that pure being transcends all names and forms.
shambhu_gita::867.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by your many roles and titles, remember your true self is beyond all labels and concepts.
shambhu_gita::867.insight: It teaches you to stop identifying with names or concepts and rest in pure, unnamed presence.

shambhu_gita::868.verse_sanskrit:
नित्या रूपेण नित्यं सा स्वतः पूर्णाऽवतिष्ठते ।
अवस्थेयं प्रकृत्याश्च स्वतीता देशकालतः ॥
shambhu_gita::868.verse_hindi: नित्य और स्वतः पूर्ण होकर अवस्थान करती है। यह अवस्था देश काल और प्रकृति से अतीत हो
shambhu_gita::868.english_translation: The true self eternally exists in its perfect form, beyond place, time, and nature.
shambhu_gita::868.translation_literal: नित्या (eternal) / रूपेण (in form) / नित्यं (always) / सा (she/it) / स्वतः (by itself) / पूर्णाऽवतिष्ठते (abides completely) / अवस्थेयं (this state) / प्रकृत्याश्च (and beyond nature) / स्वतीता (transcended) / देशकालतः (place and time)
shambhu_gita::868.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::868.essence: The true self exists forever whole beyond all conditions of time, place, and nature.
shambhu_gita::868.simple_meaning: You are always whole and perfect in your true nature, beyond changes of place, time, and the natural world.
shambhu_gita::868.simple_insight: There's comfort in knowing your true self is untouched by any circumstance.
shambhu_gita::868.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the true self remains eternally complete and unaffected by the passing of time, changes in place, or the natural world's fluctuations. This teaching reveals the unchanging essence behind all appearances.
shambhu_gita::868.modern_relevance: When everything around you shifts—your job, your home, your mood—remember your core remains whole and untouched.
shambhu_gita::868.insight: It shifts focus from the changing external world to the eternal inner completeness you already embody.

shambhu_gita::869.verse_sanskrit:
स्वस्वरूपे तुरीयादिदशाभ्योऽपि वहिर्गता।
परभावमयी नित्या जायते परमाद्भुता ॥
shambhu_gita::869.verse_hindi: स्वस्वरूप में तुरीयातीत आदि अवस्था ले भी अतीत होकर अद्भुत परम भावमय हो जाती है।
shambhu_gita::869.english_translation: Even beyond the original state and the fourth stage, the true self transcends and eternally manifests as the supreme wondrous essence.
shambhu_gita::869.translation_literal: स्वस्वरूपे (in own nature) तुरीयादिदशाभ्योऽपि (beyond the fourth and earlier states) वहिर्गता (gone outside) / परभावमयी (composed of supreme essence) नित्या (eternal) जायते (is born) परमाद्भुता (supreme wondrous one)
shambhu_gita::869.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::869.essence: The true self transcends all states to eternally embody supreme wonder.
shambhu_gita::869.simple_meaning: Your true self goes beyond all known states, becoming an eternal and wondrous supreme essence.
shambhu_gita::869.simple_insight: There is awe and peace in realizing you are beyond all changing states, eternal and magnificent.
shambhu_gita::869.detailed_meaning: Shiva reveals that the true self surpasses all ordinary and transcendent states of consciousness, including the fourth (turīya) state. It eternally manifests as the supreme wondrous essence beyond all known forms.
shambhu_gita::869.modern_relevance: In moments when you feel stuck in changing moods or thoughts, remember your true self is beyond all these shifting states and remains steady and magnificent.
shambhu_gita::869.insight: It shifts your view from identifying with changing states to experiencing your unchanging, supreme essence.

shambhu_gita::870.verse_sanskrit:
निखिलेभ्योऽपि मार्गेभ्यः पान्थेभ्यो दूरवर्तिनी ।
विदेहाख्याऽपि यस्मात्सा ततो मत्सन्निभाऽस्यसौ ॥
shambhu_gita::870.verse_hindi: यह तृतीय अवस्था सभी पथ और सभी पथिकों से दूरवर्ती होने से और विदेह कहलाने से मेरे तुल्य है।
shambhu_gita::870.english_translation: This third state is beyond all paths and travelers, and is called bodiless; it is like me.
shambhu_gita::870.translation_literal: निखिलेभ्यः (from all) अपि (also) मार्गेभ्यः (paths) पान्थेभ्यः (travelers) दूरवर्तिनी (being far away) । विदेहाख्या (called bodiless) अपि (also) यस्मात् (because) ततो (therefore) मत्सन्निभः (like me) असौ (that one) ॥
shambhu_gita::870.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::870.essence: There is a state beyond all paths and travelers, like the divine presence itself.
shambhu_gita::870.simple_meaning: The third state is beyond every path and traveler and is described as bodiless, resembling the speaker.
shambhu_gita::870.simple_insight: Some states go beyond all known ways and identities, touching the essence like the divine.
shambhu_gita::870.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares a third state that transcends all spiritual paths and those who follow them; this state is bodiless and akin to Shiva's own nature, indicating a profound transcendence.
shambhu_gita::870.insight: It points to an experience beyond all methods and identities, inviting a recognition of pure being.

shambhu_gita::871.verse_sanskrit:
इयं ह्युपनिषद्विय सर्वथा पितरो हिता।
वेद्या भवद्भिरप्येषा श्रुतिः साध्वी सनातनी ॥
shambhu_gita::871.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! इसी को हितकरी उपनिषद्विद्या और सनातनी श्रुति जानो
shambhu_gita::871.english_translation: O ancestors! Consider this eternal Vedic knowledge and Upanishadic wisdom as truly beneficial for you.
shambhu_gita::871.translation_literal: इयं (this) हि (indeed) उपनिषद्वि (of the Upanishads) य (which) सर्वथा (completely) पितरो (ancestors) हिता (beneficial) वेद्या (to be known) भवत्भिर (by you) अप्येषा (even this) श्रुतिः (scripture) साध्वी (good) सनातनी (eternal)
shambhu_gita::871.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::871.essence: Eternal Vedic knowledge is truly beneficial for the ancestors.
shambhu_gita::871.simple_meaning: This eternal scripture, the Upanishadic knowledge, is meant to be understood as beneficial and good for the ancestors.
shambhu_gita::871.simple_insight: Ancient teachings hold enduring benefit and care for those who come before us.
shambhu_gita::871.detailed_meaning: The bard Suta addresses the assembled sages, emphasizing that the Upanishadic knowledge and Vedic scripture are eternally good and beneficial, particularly honoring the ancestors and their welfare.
shambhu_gita::871.insight: It invites respect and trust in ancient wisdom as a source of lasting benefit beyond immediate time.

shambhu_gita::872.verse_sanskrit:
देवादिदेव ! सर्वात्मन् ! सर्वाधार ! जगद्गुरो ! ।
वयं यद्यपि सर्वेश ! नेशाः सम्यक्तया विभो !॥
shambhu_gita::872.verse_hindi: हे देवादिदेव ! हे सर्वेश्वर ! हे सर्वाधार ! हे सर्वात्मन! हे जगद्गुरो ! हे विभो ! यद्यपि हम सम्यक रूप से
shambhu_gita::872.english_translation: O God of gods, the supreme self, the support of all, world teacher, though we are all lords indeed!
shambhu_gita::872.translation_literal: देवादिदेव (God of gods) / सर्वात्मन् (supreme self) / सर्वाधार (support of all) / जगद्गुरो (world teacher) / वयं (we) / यद्यपि (although) / सर्वेश (all lords) / नेशाः (lords) / सम्यक्तया (with correctness) / विभो (supreme one)
shambhu_gita::872.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::872.essence: The verse names the supreme being with many titles but lacks a completed teaching.
shambhu_gita::872.simple_meaning: Many titles are being addressed with reverence, acknowledging supreme qualities, but the statement remains incomplete and unclear.
shambhu_gita::872.simple_insight: The verse is incomplete and doesn't convey a clear universal teaching.
shambhu_gita::872.detailed_meaning: This verse appears to address the supreme being with multiple lofty titles, but the translation and verse are incomplete, making it hard to extract a clear teaching or philosophical insight.
shambhu_gita::872.insight: The incomplete verse doesn't present a concrete shift in thinking or acting.

shambhu_gita::873.verse_sanskrit:
जीवन्मुक्तिरहस्यं वै विधातुं हृदयङ्गमम् ।
अन्वभूम तथाप्येतत्कृपातो भवतो ध्रुवम् ॥
shambhu_gita::873.verse_hindi: जीवन्मुक्तरहस्य को हृदयङ्गम नहीं कर सके परन्तु हे प्रभो ! इतना अवश्य आपकी परम कृपा से हमारे अनुभव में आ गया है
shambhu_gita::873.english_translation: The secret of liberation of the living being cannot be fully grasped, but by your supreme grace, it has certainly entered our experience.
shambhu_gita::873.translation_literal: जीवन्मुक्तिरहस्यं (liberation-of-living-being-secret) / वै (indeed) / विधातुं (to grasp) / हृदयङ्गमम् (heart-penetrating) / । (punctuation) / अन्वभूम (cannot-be) / तथाप्येतत् (yet-this) / कृपातः (by-grace) / भवतः (your) / ध्रुवम् (certainly) / ॥ (punctuation)
shambhu_gita::873.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::873.essence: The deepest freedom cannot be fully known but can be experienced through grace.
shambhu_gita::873.simple_meaning: The mystery of true freedom is too deep to fully understand, but through the divine's kindness, it has touched us.
shambhu_gita::873.simple_insight: There is hope even when the deepest truths feel beyond reach.
shambhu_gita::873.detailed_meaning: Suta admits that the profound secret of living liberation is too subtle to be fully explained or grasped, yet through Shiva's grace, its essence has entered their hearts, marking a pivotal moment in the teaching.
shambhu_gita::873.modern_relevance: Sometimes the most important truths in life feel beyond your grasp, but moments of grace bring glimpses that sustain you.
shambhu_gita::873.insight: It shifts the mind from needing full understanding to accepting grace as a way to experience truth.

shambhu_gita::874.verse_sanskrit:
शाश्वतस्यास्ति धर्मस्य परशक्तयात्मकस्य ते ।
सर्वजीवहितं नित्यं कुर्वाणस्यान्तिम फलम् ॥
shambhu_gita::874.verse_hindi: कि शाश्वत, सर्वजीव हितकर, आपकी परम शक्ति रूपी धर्म का अन्तिम फल
shambhu_gita::874.english_translation: The eternal dharma of your supreme power always results in the welfare of all beings as its final outcome.
shambhu_gita::874.translation_literal: शाश्वतस्यास्ति (eternal is) धर्मस्य (of dharma) परशक्तयात्मकस्य (of the supreme power) ते (your) । सर्वजीवहितं (welfare of all beings) नित्यं (always) कुर्वाणस्य (doing) अन्तिम (final) फलम् (result) ॥
shambhu_gita::874.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::874.essence: True eternal power expresses itself as universal welfare through dharma.
shambhu_gita::874.simple_meaning: The highest, eternal principle of your power always aims to benefit every living being ultimately.
shambhu_gita::874.simple_insight: There is comfort knowing true strength is rooted in universal care and lasting good.
shambhu_gita::874.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes how the eternal dharma linked to his supreme power naturally leads to the final good of all living beings, showing that ultimate strength is compassionate and universal.
shambhu_gita::874.modern_relevance: When you lead or make choices, remembering that true strength supports everyone can guide decisions beyond personal gain.
shambhu_gita::874.insight: It shifts the focus from power as control to power as a force for universal well-being.

shambhu_gita::875.verse_sanskrit:
जीवन्मुक्तिर्न सन्देहो विद्यते हि सदा प्रभो ।
जीवन्मुक्तिपदं प्राप्य त्वयातो दयानिधे ! ॥
shambhu_gita::875.verse_hindi: निरन्तर जीवन मुक्ति ही है और जीवन्मुक्ति पदवी को प्राप्त करके आपकी कृपा से
shambhu_gita::875.english_translation: There is no doubt that continuous freedom in life exists; having attained this state of liberation, it is by your compassion.
shambhu_gita::875.translation_literal: जीवनम् (life) मुक्तिः (liberation) न (not) सन्देहो (doubt) विद्यते (exists) हि (indeed) सदा (always) प्रभो (O Lord) । जीवनम् (life) मुक्तिपदं (liberation state) प्राप्य (having attained) त्वयातो (from you) दयानिधे (ocean of compassion) ॥
shambhu_gita::875.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::875.essence: Continuous freedom in life is real and sustained by compassionate grace.
shambhu_gita::875.simple_meaning: True freedom in life is always possible and is assured by the compassionate grace of the divine.
shambhu_gita::875.simple_insight: There is deep comfort in knowing your lasting freedom is supported by compassionate care.
shambhu_gita::875.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares that living liberation—freedom beyond all doubt—is real and permanent. He credits this lasting state to the compassionate nature of the divine, emphasizing that liberation is not a distant goal but a continuous reality gifted by grace.
shambhu_gita::875.modern_relevance: When you feel stuck in repeated struggles, knowing that continuous freedom is possible and supported by kindness offers hope beyond your challenges.
shambhu_gita::875.insight: It shifts your perspective from seeing freedom as a final achievement to experiencing it as ongoing, held by compassionate presence.

shambhu_gita::876.verse_sanskrit:
जनो भागवतो नूनं भगवानेव जायते । 
तवाऽपारकृपापुञ्जजज्ञातमस्माभिरित्यपि ॥
shambhu_gita::876.verse_hindi: भागवत जन भगवान् ही हो जाते हैं और यह भी आपकी अपार कृपा से समझ में आ गया कि
shambhu_gita::876.english_translation: People truly become devoted to the divine, and this has come to be known by us because of your boundless compassion.
shambhu_gita::876.translation_literal: जनो (people) / भागवतो (devoted to the divine) / नूनं (certainly) / भगवानेव (only to the divine) / जायते (are born) / तवाऽपारकृपापुञ्जजज्ञातमस्माभिरिति (by your boundless compassion it has been understood by us) / अपि (also)
shambhu_gita::876.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::876.essence: Devotion grows from boundless compassion, not by chance alone.
shambhu_gita::876.simple_meaning: People become devoted to the divine, and this truth is known to us because of your great compassion.
shambhu_gita::876.simple_insight: Devotion arises naturally through compassionate guidance, not by chance.
shambhu_gita::876.detailed_meaning: The narrator acknowledges that devotion to the divine is not accidental but arises through the teacher's vast compassion. This recognition shows the role of grace in awakening devotion.
shambhu_gita::876.insight: It highlights that inspiring devotion or commitment comes from genuine care and compassion, not force or chance.

shambhu_gita::877.verse_sanskrit:
सार्द्ध भेदो भवद्भक्तैर्जीवन्मुक्तिपदङ्गतैः ।
भवतः कोऽपि कुत्रापि कथञ्चिन्नव वर्तते ॥
shambhu_gita::877.verse_hindi: जीवन्मुक्ति पदवी प्राप्त आपके भक्तों में और आपमें कहीं किसी प्रकार कोई भी भेद नहीं है।
shambhu_gita::877.english_translation: There is no difference whatsoever between your devotees who have attained liberation and you anywhere at all.
shambhu_gita::877.translation_literal: सार्ध (together) / भेदो (difference) / भवद्भक्तैः (your devotees) / जीवन्मुक्तिपदङ्गतैः (who have attained liberation) / भवतः (your) / कोऽपि (anyone) / कुत्रापि (anywhere) / कथञ्चिन् (in any way) / नव (not) / वर्तते (exists)
shambhu_gita::877.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::877.essence: Liberated devotees and the divine are completely indistinguishable everywhere.
shambhu_gita::877.simple_meaning: Those who love you deeply and have reached freedom are not different from you in any way.
shambhu_gita::877.simple_insight: Knowing there is no separation with those who share your highest state brings deep belonging.
shambhu_gita::877.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares that his devotees who have reached the state of liberation are not different from him anywhere. This teaching shows the unity between the divine and those fully devoted and freed, dissolving all distinctions.
shambhu_gita::877.modern_relevance: When you see someone who has grown beyond struggle and pain, you realize they're not separate from what you seek.
shambhu_gita::877.insight: It shifts the mind from seeing separation to recognizing unity with those who embody freedom and devotion.

shambhu_gita::878.verse_sanskrit:
निजभक्तैर्भवान् यत्र लिङ्गाकारेऽच्यते प्रभो !।
यथार्थ तत्स्वरूपं नो दर्शयित्वा कृतार्थय ॥
shambhu_gita::878.verse_hindi: हे प्रभो ! अपने भक्तों के द्वारा जिस लिङ्गाकार में आप पूजे जाते हैं उसका यथार्थ स्वरूप क्या है ? सो हमें दिखाकर कृतकृत्य कीजिये
shambhu_gita::878.english_translation: O Lord! Please reveal to us the true nature of the linga form in which you are worshipped by your devotees, so we may be fulfilled.
shambhu_gita::878.translation_literal: निजभक्तैः (by own devotees) भवान् (You) यत्र (where) लिङ्गाकारे (in linga form) अच्यते (are worshipped) प्रभो (O Lord) ! / यथार्थ (true) तत् (that) स्वरूपं (nature) नो (to us) दर्शयित्वा (showing) कृतार्थय (make fulfilled) ॥
shambhu_gita::878.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::878.essence: The true form behind sacred symbols reveals deeper fulfillment to devoted seekers.
shambhu_gita::878.simple_meaning: Devotees ask the Lord to reveal the true form of the linga so they can understand and feel fulfilled.
shambhu_gita::878.simple_insight: Longing to see the true form behind a sacred symbol can deepen your connection and fulfillment.
shambhu_gita::878.detailed_meaning: A devotee respectfully asks Shiva to reveal the true nature behind the linga, the form in which he is worshipped, hoping to realize its deeper reality and feel complete in devotion.
shambhu_gita::878.modern_relevance: You might wonder what lies behind symbols or rituals you follow, seeking a deeper experience beyond surface appearances.
shambhu_gita::878.insight: It invites you to seek beyond symbols to the underlying truth that brings lasting fulfillment.

shambhu_gita::879.verse_sanskrit:
हे वर्णाश्रमधर्माणां रक्षकाः ! पितरोऽखिलाः।
वासनाभिः शुभाभिर्वः प्रसन्नोऽहमतोऽधुना ॥
shambhu_gita::879.verse_hindi: हे वर्णाश्रमधर्म के रक्षक पितृगण ! आपकी शुभ कामना से मैं प्रसन्न हुआ हूँ
shambhu_gita::879.english_translation: O protectors of the duties of the social orders and stages of life, ancestors! I am pleased now by your auspicious wishes.
shambhu_gita::879.translation_literal: हे (O) / वर्णाश्रमधर्माणां (duties of social orders and stages of life) / रक्षकाः (protectors) / पितरोऽखिलाः (ancestors all) / वासनाभिः (by wishes) / शुभाभिः (auspicious) / वः (your) / प्रसन्नः (pleased) / अहम् (I) / अतोऽधुना (now)
shambhu_gita::879.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::879.essence: Acknowledging and receiving blessings from those who uphold social duties brings joy.
shambhu_gita::879.simple_meaning: The speaker expresses gratitude and happiness for the auspicious blessings given by the ancestors who uphold social duties.
shambhu_gita::879.simple_insight: Gratitude opens the heart to the support of those who protect our way of life.
shambhu_gita::879.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Shiva acknowledges the blessings of the ancestral protectors of social order and duties, showing respect and receiving their auspicious wishes with pleasure.
shambhu_gita::879.insight: Recognizing support from those who sustain social and familial duties fosters humility and connectedness.

shambhu_gita::880.verse_sanskrit:
देवदानवमर्त्यानां युष्माकञ्च सुदुर्लभम् ।
दिव्यं ज्ञानमयं चक्षुरदः कालकृते ददे ॥
shambhu_gita::880.verse_hindi: स कारण देव दानव पितृ मनुष्य आदि को दुर्लभ ज्ञान नेत्र इस समय के लिये आपको प्रदान करता हूँ ।
shambhu_gita::880.english_translation: For you, the divine grants a rare, knowledge-filled eye to devas, asuras, ancestors, and humans at this time.
shambhu_gita::880.translation_literal: देवदानवमर्त्यानां (devas, asuras, and humans) / युष्माकञ्च (for you also) / सुदुर्लभम् (rare) / दिव्यं (divine) / ज्ञानमयं (knowledge-filled) / चक्षुरदः (eye given) / कालकृते (at this time) / ददे (gives)
shambhu_gita::880.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::880.essence: Rare, divine knowledge opens your vision beyond ordinary time and perception.
shambhu_gita::880.simple_meaning: You are granted a rare and divine knowledge that lets you see clearly beyond normal limits in this time.
shambhu_gita::880.simple_insight: You can recognize that rare clarity is a precious gift, not something everyone has.
shambhu_gita::880.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Shiva declares that he grants a rare, divine, knowledge-filled vision to beings like devas, asuras, ancestors, and humans, enabling them to see clearly beyond ordinary perception.
shambhu_gita::880.modern_relevance: Sometimes, clarity and understanding come as rare gifts that let you see your situation in a new light.
shambhu_gita::880.insight: This verse invites you to recognize and value the rare moments when your understanding expands beyond everyday limits.

shambhu_gita::881.verse_sanskrit:
चिन्मयस्यास्य लिङ्गस्य स्वरूप मे यथायथम् ।
यूयं पश्यत येनाद्य जायतां का कृतार्थता ॥
shambhu_gita::881.verse_hindi: आप मेरे चिन्मय लिंग का यथार्थ स्वरूप दर्शन करो जिससे आपलोगों की कृतकृत्यता हो
shambhu_gita::881.english_translation: Behold the true form of my conscious divine sign so that your sense of indebtedness may arise.
shambhu_gita::881.translation_literal: चिन्मयस्यास्य (of this conscious) लिङ्गस्य (sign) स्वरूप (form) मे (my) यथायथम् (exact) । यूयं (you all) पश्यत (see) येन (by which) आद्य (today) जायतां (may arise) का (what) कृतार्थता (sense of fulfillment/indebtedness) ॥
shambhu_gita::881.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::881.essence: Seeing the true conscious form awakens heartfelt gratitude.
shambhu_gita::881.simple_meaning: Look at my true conscious form so you can feel grateful and fulfilled.
shambhu_gita::881.simple_insight: Gratitude arises when you truly see the essence of what is before you.
shambhu_gita::881.detailed_meaning: Shiva invites the sages to witness his true conscious form (Chinmaya Linga) to awaken their recognition and gratitude. This moment is a pivotal revelation of divine presence to those who seek understanding.
shambhu_gita::881.modern_relevance: You pause to truly see what matters deeply, and suddenly gratitude fills your heart for things often taken for granted.
shambhu_gita::881.insight: It teaches you to open your perception fully to experience genuine gratitude and fulfillment.

shambhu_gita::882.verse_sanskrit:
अहो विस्मृतात्मान आश्वद्य जाताः
परात्मन् ! वयं नैव विद्योऽत्र हेतुम् ।
भवाँञ्चिन्मयस्येह बीजस्यं दातृ
धरन् लिङ्गरूपं विराइविश्वयोनों ॥
shambhu_gita::882.verse_hindi: हे परमात्मन् ! अहो ! अब हम अपने को भूल गये। हम लोग इसका कारण नहीं समझ रहे हैं। अब हम देखते हैं कि आप चिन्मय बीज दाता लिङ्गरूप होकर विश्वयोनि में
shambhu_gita::882.english_translation: O supreme being! Alas, we have forgotten ourselves and do not understand the cause. Now we see you as the conscious seed-giver in the form of the mark within the world-womb.
shambhu_gita::882.translation_literal: अहो (Alas) विस्मृतात्मान (forgotten-self) आश्वद्य (indeed) जाताः (we have become) परात्मन् (O supreme being) वयं (we) नैव (not) विद्योऽत्र (know here) हेतुम् (cause) भवाँञ्चिन्मयस्येह (you of consciousness here) बीजस्यं (seed's) दातृ (giver) धरन् (holding) लिङ्गरूपं (in form of mark) विराइविश्वयोनों (in the world-womb)
shambhu_gita::882.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::882.essence: Forgetting the true self hides the conscious source within the world from view.
shambhu_gita::882.simple_meaning: We have forgotten our true self and do not understand why. Now we recognize the divine as the conscious source within the universe.
shambhu_gita::882.simple_insight: There is awareness in realizing how far we have lost ourselves and beginning to see the source of all.
shambhu_gita::882.detailed_meaning: The speaker laments their forgetfulness of the true self and ignorance of the cause. They have now started to perceive the supreme as the conscious origin, symbolized as the seed in the cosmic womb.
shambhu_gita::882.insight: It opens the mind to see beyond personal confusion and recognize a conscious source at the foundation of existence.

shambhu_gita::883.verse_sanskrit:
समालोक्यते सम्प्रवेशं प्रकुर्वन्
पुनर्लिङ्गपीठद्वयं दृश्यते च ।
धरन्वेकयुग्मस्वरूपं मनोज्ञं
समाच्छादयविश्वमेतत्समस्तम् ॥
shambhu_gita::883.verse_hindi: प्रवेश करते हो। हम पुनः देखते हैं कि वह लिङ्ग और पीठ दोनों एक युगलरूप को धारण करके सारे विश्व को छा रहा है।
shambhu_gita::883.english_translation: Entering, he is seen again covering the whole universe with the paired forms of lingam and pedestal.
shambhu_gita::883.translation_literal: समालोक्यते (is seen upon looking) / सम्प्रवेशं (entering) / प्रकुर्वन् (making) / पुनः (again) / लिङ्गपीठद्वयं (lingam-pedestal pair) / दृश्यते (is seen) / च (and) / धरन् (holding) / एकयुग्मस्वरूपं (one paired form) / मनोज्ञं (pleasing) / समाच्छादय (covering) / विश्वम् (the universe) / एतत् (this) / समस्तम् (entire)
shambhu_gita::883.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::883.essence: The divine's paired forms unify and cover the entire universe as one presence.
shambhu_gita::883.simple_meaning: The divine appears again, holding the paired symbols of lingam and pedestal, covering the entire universe.
shambhu_gita::883.simple_insight: The divine's presence pervades everything, holding complementary forms that unify all existence.
shambhu_gita::883.detailed_meaning: Suta describes the divine manifestation of Shiva entering and appearing again, holding the lingam and pedestal together as a pleasing form that covers the whole universe, emphasizing Shiva's all-encompassing presence.
shambhu_gita::883.insight: Recognize how seemingly separate forms combine to reveal the unity underlying all things.

shambhu_gita::884.verse_sanskrit:
समालोक्यतेऽस्माभिरित्यत्र भूयो
भवञ्चिन्मयाऽद्वैतलिङ्गादतीतम् ।
अहो नोऽपरं वस्तु कुत्रापि किञ्चित्
कथश्चिन्न चक्षुःपथं नूनमति ॥
shambhu_gita::884.verse_hindi: हम पुनः यहाँ देखते हैं कि अहो ! आपके चिन्मय अद्वितीय लिङ्ग के अतीत और कोई दूसरी वस्तु किसी प्रकार कहीं कुछ भी दिखाई नहीं देती
shambhu_gita::884.english_translation: We again see here that beyond your unique sign of pure consciousness, no other object appears anywhere at all.
shambhu_gita::884.translation_literal: समालोक्यतेऽस्माभिः (is seen by us) / इत्यत्र (here) / भूयः (again) / भवन् (you, being) / चिन्मय (of pure consciousness) / अद्वैतलिङ्गात् (beyond the non-dual sign) / अतीतम् (gone beyond) / अहो (ah!) / नः (our) / अपरम् (other) / वस्तु (object) / कुत्रापि (anywhere) / किञ्चित् (anything) / कथश्चिन् (in any way) / न (not) / चक्षुःपथम् (eye’s path / visible sight) / नूनम् (certainly) / अति (beyond) / ।
shambhu_gita::884.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::884.essence: Only pure consciousness truly appears; nothing else exists beyond it.
shambhu_gita::884.simple_meaning: Only pure consciousness is truly real; beyond it, no other thing appears anywhere.
shambhu_gita::884.simple_insight: You feel the vastness of pure awareness, seeing nothing separate beyond it.
shambhu_gita::884.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Shiva points out that when we observe deeply, only pure consciousness—the true self—remains visible; all other apparent objects or distinctions vanish as illusions beyond this unique sign.
shambhu_gita::884.modern_relevance: In moments of deep focus, everything else fades away, and only your clear, aware presence remains.
shambhu_gita::884.insight: It teaches you to recognize pure awareness as the sole reality behind all appearances.

shambhu_gita::885.verse_sanskrit:
अहो सर्वसाक्षिन् ! विभो !
विश्वयोन्या प्रकृत्या पुनर्विश्वसृष्टेरिहादौ।
त्थार्न्ते भवल्लिङ्गसँल्लीनयैव  परो
द्योत्यते चिन्मयोऽद्वैतभावः ॥
shambhu_gita::885.verse_hindi: हे सर्वसाक्षिन् ! विभो ! सम्पूर्ण सृष्टि के आदि और अन्त में विश्वयोनि प्रकृति पुनः आपके लिंग में ही लय होकर अद्वैत चिन्मयभाव की प्रकाशक बनती है
shambhu_gita::885.english_translation: O all-witnessing sovereign! The universal source, nature in creation and dissolution merges again into your form, shining as the non-dual consciousness.
shambhu_gita::885.translation_literal: अहो (O) / सर्वसाक्षिन् (all-witnessing) / विभो (sovereign) / विश्वयोन्या (from the universal source) / प्रकृत्या (by nature) / पुनः (again) / विश्वसृष्टे (in the world's creation) / इह (here) / आदौ (at the beginning) / त्था (and there) / अन्ते (at the end) / भव (becomes) / लिङ्गसँल्लीनयैव (merged into the form) / पर (indeed) / द्योत्यते (shines) / चिन्मयः (consciousness-filled) / अद्वैतभावः (non-dual nature)
shambhu_gita::885.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::885.essence: All creation arises and dissolves back into one non-dual conscious reality.
shambhu_gita::885.simple_meaning: Everything that exists begins and ends as nature emerging from and merging back into Shiva's non-dual consciousness.
shambhu_gita::885.simple_insight: There is a vast cycle where all arises and dissolves into one shining, unchanging presence.
shambhu_gita::885.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the all-seeing presence, describing how the entire universe arises from the cosmic source, nature, and ultimately merges back into Shiva's non-dual consciousness, reflecting the unity behind creation and dissolution.
shambhu_gita::885.insight: It shifts your view from separate things to the underlying unity behind all change and form.

shambhu_gita::886.verse_sanskrit:
महादेव ! पश्याम आद्यन्तशून्ये
पृथक् तेऽत्र लिङ्गे पृथग् यत्र तत्र ।
अनन्तेषु केन्द्रेषु पार्थक्यतो हि
जगत्सृष्टि-रक्षा-लयान् कुर्वतोऽलम् ॥
shambhu_gita::886.verse_hindi: हे महादेव ! हम देखते हैं कि आपके उस आदि अन्त रहित लिङ्ग में जहां तहां अलग अलग भलीभांति सृष्टि स्थिति और लय का कार्य करते
shambhu_gita::886.english_translation: O Mahadeva! We see that in your limitless, eternal form, creation, preservation, and dissolution happen differently everywhere.
shambhu_gita::886.translation_literal: महादेव (O Mahadeva) / पश्याम (we see) / आद्यन्तशून्ये (without beginning or end) / पृथक् (separately) / तेऽत्र (there of you) / लिङ्गे (in the form) / पृथग् (differently) / यत्र (where) / तत्र (there) / अनन्तेषु (in the infinite) / केन्द्रेषु (centres) / पार्थक्यतो (differently) / हि (indeed) / जगत्सृष्टि-रक्षा-लयान् (creation-preservation-dissolution) / कुर्वतः (doing) / अलम् (variously)
shambhu_gita::886.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::886.essence: The infinite divine manifests creation, preservation, and destruction differently everywhere.
shambhu_gita::886.simple_meaning: In Shiva's endless form, the processes of creation, maintenance, and destruction happen in many different ways everywhere.
shambhu_gita::886.simple_insight: Everything is continuously changing, yet it all flows from the same infinite source.
shambhu_gita::886.detailed_meaning: Suta describes Shiva's infinite form as containing diverse centers where creation, preservation, and destruction occur uniquely. This highlights the vastness and complexity of Shiva's cosmic role.
shambhu_gita::886.insight: It invites seeing the divine as both unified and manifesting in infinite diverse ways simultaneously.

shambhu_gita::887.verse_sanskrit:
अनेकान् विधींश्चैव विष्णून महेशान
निरीक्षामहे विश्वगोलव्रजञ्च।
पुनर्भूषितं विश्वमूर्तेऽत्र लिङ्गे
अनेकैरहो भग्रहोपग्रहैश्च ॥
shambhu_gita::887.verse_hindi: अलग अलग ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश अनन्त स्थानों में दिखाई पड़ते हैं। हे विराटमूर्ते ! उस लिङ्ग पर अनेक तारा नक्षत्र ग्रह उपग्रह आदि से भूषित अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डसमूह आसमान दिखाई पड़ते हैं
shambhu_gita::887.english_translation: We observe Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesha appearing in countless realms; the cosmic form here is adorned by innumerable stars, planets, and satellites across infinite universes.
shambhu_gita::887.translation_literal: अनेकान् (many) विधींश् (forms) च (and) एव (indeed) विष्णून् (Vishnu) महेशान् (Mahesha) निरीक्षामहे (we observe) विश्वगोलव्रजञ्च (the spherical universes). पुनः (again) भूषितं (adorned) विश्वमूर्ते (cosmic form) अत्र (here) लिङ्गे (on the mark) अनेकैः (by many) अहो (ah) भग्रः (stars) उपग्रहैः (satellites) च (and).
shambhu_gita::887.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::887.essence: The cosmic form is infinite, manifesting countless divine aspects and celestial bodies.
shambhu_gita::887.simple_meaning: Different divine forms appear across countless realms, and the cosmic form is decorated with endless stars and planets.
shambhu_gita::887.simple_insight: The vastness and variety of the cosmos reflect the infinite ways the divine manifests.
shambhu_gita::887.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes the infinite cosmic form where Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesha appear in many forms across boundless realms, all adorned with stars, planets, and satellites, emphasizing the boundless scale and diversity of existence.
shambhu_gita::887.insight: It expands your view of existence beyond your immediate world, inviting awe at the vast interconnected cosmic display.

shambhu_gita::888.verse_sanskrit:
अहो ! सर्वसाक्षिन ! कियन्त्यत्र लिङ्गे
समं विश्वगोलानि जायन्त आये ।
कियन्त्यासते च प्रलीयन्त आशु
निमग्नान्यमुष्मिन् कियन्ति प्रभो ! ते ॥
shambhu_gita::888.verse_hindi: हे सर्वसाक्षिन् प्रभो! अहो ! आपके उस लिङ्ग में कितने ही ब्रह्माण्ड एक साथ ही उत्पन्न होते हैं, कितने ही ब्रह्माण्ड स्थित दिखाई पड़ते हैं और कितने ही ब्रह्माण्ड उसमें डूब कर शीघ्र लय होते दिखाई पड़ते हैं
shambhu_gita::888.english_translation: O all-witnessing lord! In your form, countless universes arise, coexist, and dissolve rapidly.
shambhu_gita::888.translation_literal: अहो (oh) / सर्वसाक्षिन (all-witnessing) / कियन्ति (how many) / अत्र (here) / लिङ्गे (in the form) / समं (together) / विश्वगोलानि (universes) / जायन्त (are born) / आये (arise) / कियन्त्य (how many) / असते (remain) / च (and) / प्रलीयन्त (are dissolved) / आशु (quickly) / निमग्नानि (immersed) / अुष्मिन् (in it) / कियन्ति (how many) / प्रभो (lord) / ते (your)
shambhu_gita::888.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::888.essence: Infinite universes coexist and dissolve within the divine form simultaneously.
shambhu_gita::888.simple_meaning: In the form of the divine, countless universes appear, exist together, and quickly dissolve.
shambhu_gita::888.simple_insight: The divine form holds vast cycles beyond ordinary perception, inspiring awe and humility.
shambhu_gita::888.detailed_meaning: A devotee or sage marvels at Shiva's form, perceiving infinite universes continuously born, present, and destroyed within it, revealing Shiva's vast cosmic nature beyond normal human comprehension.
shambhu_gita::888.insight: It invites you to recognize the vast scope of existence beyond immediate experience and to feel connected to a cosmic rhythm.

shambhu_gita::889.verse_sanskrit:
निरीक्षामहेऽनन्त ! भूयो वयं यः
दनेके हि जिज्ञासवो देवसङ्घाः।
महर्षितजास्तस्य लिङ्गस्य चादि ।
प्रत्ताः समन्वेष्टुमन्तं परन्तु ॥
shambhu_gita::889.verse_hindi: हे अनन्त ! हम लोग देखते हैं कि अनेक जिज्ञासु देवतागण और महर्षिगण उस लिंग का आदि और अन्त अन्वेषण करने में प्रवृत्त होते हैं परन्तु
shambhu_gita::889.english_translation: O Infinite One, many curious divine beings and great sages observe the origin and end of that symbol but are still striving to discover its true nature.
shambhu_gita::889.translation_literal: निरीक्षामहेऽनन्त (We observe, O Infinite) / भूयो (again) / वयं (we) / यः (who) / दनेके (many) / हि (indeed) / जिज्ञासवो (curious seekers) / देवसङ्घाः (divine assemblies) / महर्षितजास्तस्य (of the great sage's) / लिङ्गस्य (symbol/mark) / चादि (and beginning) / प्रत्ताः (obtained) / समन्वेष्टुमन्तं (to seek thoroughly) / परन्तु (however)
shambhu_gita::889.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::889.essence: Many seekers observe the symbol but still strive to grasp its true nature.
shambhu_gita::889.simple_meaning: Many divine beings and sages observe and inquire about the origin and end of the symbol, but the complete understanding remains elusive.
shambhu_gita::889.simple_insight: Even the wisest seekers can struggle to fully understand profound mysteries.
shambhu_gita::889.detailed_meaning: Suta narrates how many divine beings and great sages are deeply curious, observing the symbol's origin and end but still engaged in searching for its full meaning. This sets the stage for a deeper teaching.
shambhu_gita::889.insight: It shows that deep truths may require more than observation—they need guidance or revelation.

shambhu_gita::890.verse_sanskrit:
न चादि न चान्तं समासाद्य तस्य
त्वयं वर्तते नूनमायन्तशून्यः।
विराविश्वयोनौ प्रविष्टो हि लिङ्गः
स्वसिद्धान्तमित्येव कुर्वन्ति मुग्धाः ॥
shambhu_gita::890.verse_hindi: वे मूढ़ अन्त में उसस विराट्योनि में प्रविष्ट लिंग का आदि और अन्त न पाकर उसका आदि और अन्त नहीं है ऐसे सिद्धान्त पर उपनीत होते हैं
shambhu_gita::890.english_translation: The mark that has entered the cosmic womb has no beginning or end; it is beyond origin and conclusion, as taught by the wise.
shambhu_gita::890.translation_literal: न (not) चादि (beginning) न (not) चान्तं (end) समासाद्य (attaining) तस्य (of that) त्वयं (you) वर्तते (exist) नूनम् (indeed) आयन्तशून्यः (without origin). विरा (cosmic) विश्वयोनौ (womb of the universe) प्रविष्टो (entered) हि (indeed) लिङ्गः (mark) स्वसिद्धान्तमिति (own doctrine) एव (only) कुर्वन्ति (do) मुग्धाः (fools).
shambhu_gita::890.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::890.essence: The true reality has no beginning or end and is beyond all limits.
shambhu_gita::890.simple_meaning: The true essence behind all existence has no beginning or end. It is beyond any origin or conclusion.
shambhu_gita::890.simple_insight: There's peace in knowing what you truly are was never created and will never be destroyed.
shambhu_gita::890.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva explains that the essential mark (linga) representing the true reality is eternal. It has no starting point or ending point, beyond all worldly concepts of origin and conclusion. Those who fail to understand this are considered confused.
shambhu_gita::890.modern_relevance: You feel caught in stories about where things began or how they must end. This teaching frees you to rest beyond those limits.
shambhu_gita::890.insight: It teaches you to see beyond beginnings and ends, recognizing the timeless nature of your true self.

shambhu_gita::891.verse_sanskrit:
प्रभो ! शब्दजातादतीताखिलात्मन् !
निरीक्षामहे ते पुनस्तत्र लिङ्गे।
विराजत्स्वनेकेषु लोकेषु सिद्धाः
महर्षिबजास्त्वाञ्च शब्दैः प्रणोतुम् ॥
shambhu_gita::891.verse_hindi: हे शब्द समूह से अतीत ! सर्वात्मन् ! प्रभो ! हम देखते हैं कि उस लिङ्ग में विराजमान अनेक लोकों में सिद्ध महर्षिगण वेद और शास्त्रो के शब्दों के द्वारा
shambhu_gita::891.english_translation: O supreme being beyond all words! We observe that in that form, many perfected sages in various worlds manifest and invoke you through the words of the Vedas and scriptures.
shambhu_gita::891.translation_literal: प्रभो (O supreme being) / शब्दजातादतीताखिलात्मन् (beyond all words, all-pervading self) / निरीक्षामहे (we observe) / ते (your) / पुनः (again) / तत्र (there) / लिङ्गे (in the form) / विराजत् (manifesting) / स्वनेकेषु (in many) / लोकेषु (worlds) / सिद्धाः (perfected ones) / महर्षिबजाः (great sages born) / त्वाञ्च (also you) / शब्दैः (by words) / प्रणोतुम् (to invoke)
shambhu_gita::891.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::891.essence: Perfected sages across worlds invoke the supreme beyond words through sacred scriptures.
shambhu_gita::891.simple_meaning: Many perfected sages in different worlds invoke the supreme being beyond words through sacred Vedic words in that form.
shambhu_gita::891.simple_insight: The highest truth is recognized and honored by enlightened sages across many realms through sacred language.
shambhu_gita::891.detailed_meaning: Suta describes an observation directed to the supreme being beyond all words. He notes that many perfected sages across various worlds appear in that form and call upon the supreme through Vedic and scriptural words, emphasizing the divine presence beyond verbal expression.
shambhu_gita::891.insight: It highlights the power of sacred tradition and the recognition of the supreme beyond ordinary language by wise beings.

shambhu_gita::892.verse_sanskrit:
यतन्ते सदा वैदिकैलौकिकैश्च
परञ्चैव वाचस्तथा शब्दपुनात् ।
अतीतो भवान् वर्ततेऽतः स्वयं ते
हवाचः क्षणात्स्युः मुमूकाश्च सन्नाः॥
shambhu_gita::892.verse_hindi: आपकी स्तुति करने का यत्न करते हैं, परन्तु आप वाक् और शब्द से प्रतीत होने के कारण थोड़े ही समय में वह निर्वाक् होकर स्तब्ध और मूकवत् हो जाते हैं।
shambhu_gita::892.english_translation: Many try to praise you with words, but because you transcend speech and sound, their praises quickly become silent and dumb.
shambhu_gita::892.translation_literal: यतन्ते (try) / सदा (always) / वैदिकैः (by Vedic) / लौकिकैः (worldly) / च (and) / परञ्चैः (others) / वाचा (by speech) / तथा (thus) / शब्दपुनात् (by sound) / अतीतः (beyond) / भवान् (you) / वर्तते (exist) / अतः (therefore) / स्वयं (yourself) / ते (your) / हवाचः (praises) / क्षणात् (in moments) / स्युः (become) / मुमूकाश्च (silent/dumb) / सन्नाः (become).
shambhu_gita::892.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::892.essence: The true nature of the divine goes beyond all speech and sound, making verbal praise fleeting.
shambhu_gita::892.simple_meaning: People try to praise the divine with words and sounds, but since the divine is beyond speech, these praises soon fall silent.
shambhu_gita::892.simple_insight: Efforts to capture the divine in words often fall short and become quiet quickly.
shambhu_gita::892.detailed_meaning: In this verse Shiva explains that though many try to offer praise through sacred and worldly words, the divine surpasses all speech and sound, so such praises quickly become mute and powerless.
shambhu_gita::892.modern_relevance: You’ve tried to express something profound, but words fail and silence takes over instead.
shambhu_gita::892.insight: Recognize that some realities transcend language and that silence can hold deeper meaning than words.

shambhu_gita::893.verse_sanskrit:
विभो ! ते महेशान ! लिङ्गं विराज
निमग्ना वयं विस्मयाब्धौ निरीक्ष्य।
अहो दृश्यते ते विराडेष लिङ्गो
दशायां हि सृष्टेर्विभुव्योममध्ये ॥
shambhu_gita::893.verse_hindi: हे महेश्वर ! हम आपके विराट् लिंग को देखकर विस्मयसमुद्र में डूबते हुए चकित होते हैं और देखते हैं कि सृष्टि दशा में वह लिंग विभु आकाश में
shambhu_gita::893.english_translation: O Great Lord! We gaze in wonder, immersed like an ocean, at Your vast form shining in the cosmic space where the worlds exist.
shambhu_gita::893.translation_literal: विभो (O mighty one) / ते (your) / महेशान (Great Lord) / लिङ्गं (form) / विराज (shines) / निमग्ना (immersed) / वयं (we) / विस्मयाब्धौ (in wonder-ocean) / निरीक्ष्य (seeing) / अहो (ah) / दृश्यते (is seen) / ते (your) / विराडेष (vast) / लिङ्गो (form) / दशायां (in the realm) / हि (indeed) / सृष्टेः (of creation) / विभु (vast) / आकाशे (in space) / मध्ये (in the middle)
shambhu_gita::893.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::893.essence: Witnessing the vast cosmic form inspires deep awe and wonder beyond words.
shambhu_gita::893.simple_meaning: We are overwhelmed and amazed as we see the vast cosmic form of the Great Lord shining in the middle of creation's space.
shambhu_gita::893.simple_insight: Some experiences inspire awe that words cannot capture, connecting you to something immense.
shambhu_gita::893.detailed_meaning: The sages or seers express awe as they behold the Great Lord's immense cosmic form shining in the vast space where creation exists, overwhelmed by its grandeur and mystery.
shambhu_gita::893.insight: It invites you to pause in wonder when faced with vastness beyond understanding, cultivating humility and openness.

shambhu_gita::894.verse_sanskrit:
प्रभो ! ओतप्रोतो ह्यनाधन्तभावं
तवाऽऽदय बुद्धिं विधत्ते विमूढाम् ।
सदाऽस्माकमेवं मनो मूच्छितञ्चन्वतो
नो न वाचः स्फुटं निस्सरन्ति ॥
shambhu_gita::894.verse_hindi: हे प्रभो ! ओत प्रोत हो आपका अनादित्व और अनन्तत्व दिखाकर हमारी बुद्धि को थकित करता है और मन को मूर्छित करता है इसलिये हमारी स्पष्ट बातें नहीं निकलती
shambhu_gita::894.english_translation: O Lord! Your endless and eternal nature overwhelms our mind and confuses our intellect, so our clear words do not emerge.
shambhu_gita::894.translation_literal: प्रभो (O Lord) / ओतप्रोतो (overflowing) / हि (indeed) / अनाधन्तभावं (endless nature) / तवाऽऽदय (your) / बुद्धिं (intellect) / विधत्ते (wears out) / विमूढाम् (bewildered) / सदाऽस्माकम् (always ours) / एवम् (thus) / मनः (mind) / मूच्छितं (stupefied) / च (and) / अन्वतः (from) / नो (not) / न (nor) / वाचः (speech) / स्फुटं (clear) / निस्सरन्ति (come out)
shambhu_gita::894.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::894.essence: The infinite nature of the divine can overwhelm mind and intellect, blocking clear speech.
shambhu_gita::894.simple_meaning: The endless and eternal nature of the divine overwhelms the mind and confuses the intellect, making it hard to express clear thoughts.
shambhu_gita::894.simple_insight: You may feel mentally overwhelmed and unable to speak clearly when facing vast truths.
shambhu_gita::894.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the speaker addresses Shiva, acknowledging how his infinite, unending nature exhausts human intellect and clouds the mind, causing difficulty in clear expression.
shambhu_gita::894.modern_relevance: When facing complex or overwhelming ideas, your mind may feel exhausted and your thoughts hard to express clearly.
shambhu_gita::894.insight: Recognize that feeling mentally overwhelmed can block clear communication and understanding.

shambhu_gita::895.verse_sanskrit:
तथेक्षामहे तस्य सृष्टेरतीत
दशायां सदा देशतः कालतश्च ।
अवस्थाऽपरिच्छिन्नभावं गताऽलं
प्रभोऽद्वैतभावं यदा द्योतयेन्नु ॥
shambhu_gita::895.verse_hindi: पुनः वैसे ही जब देखते हैं कि सृष्टि से अतीत अवस्था में उसकी देश काल से अपरिच्छिन्न अवस्था अद्वैतभाव को प्रकट करती है
shambhu_gita::895.english_translation: When we look beyond creation, we see the supreme reality shining timelessly, inseparable from all space and time.
shambhu_gita::895.translation_literal: तथेक्षामहे (there see) / तस्य (its) / सृष्टेरतीत (beyond creation) / दशायां (in space) / सदा (always) / देशतः (in place) / कालतश्च (and time) / अवस्थाऽपरिच्छिन्नभावं (unceasing state) / गताऽलं (gone) / प्रभोऽद्वैतभावं (supreme non-dual nature) / यदा (when) / द्योतयेन्नु (shines).
shambhu_gita::895.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::895.essence: The true self shines timelessly, beyond all space and creation.
shambhu_gita::895.simple_meaning: Beyond all creation, there is a timeless, unchanging reality present everywhere beyond space and time.
shambhu_gita::895.simple_insight: You can rest in knowing the true self is always present beyond changing circumstances.
shambhu_gita::895.detailed_meaning: Shiva reveals that beyond the entire creation and its boundaries of space and time, there exists an unchanging state. This supreme reality, free from all divisions, shines continuously beyond everything we perceive.
shambhu_gita::895.modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic and time slips away, remember there is a part of you untouched by all change and pressure.
shambhu_gita::895.insight: It teaches you to shift focus from fleeting events to the constant presence beyond them.

shambhu_gita::896.verse_sanskrit:
अवस्थां तदेमामवेक्ष्येह नोऽलं
लयं याति शीघ्रं मनः सेन्द्रियं हि ।
तथाऽस्माकमुत्सृज्य बुद्धिः स्वयञ्च
दशां त्रैपुटर्टी सत्त्वरं सँल्लिनाति ॥
shambhu_gita::896.verse_hindi: तो स्वतः ही हमारे मन इन्द्रियों के साथ और हमारी बुद्धि त्रिपुटी दशा को छोड़कर शीघ्र लय हो जाती है
shambhu_gita::896.english_translation: Our mind naturally dissolves quickly along with the senses, and our discerning mind abandons the threefold state of existence.
shambhu_gita::896.translation_literal: अवस्थां (state) तदे (that) इमाम् (this) अवेक्ष्ये (seeing) अ: (not) नोऽलं (quickly) लयं (dissolves) याति (goes) शीघ्रं (fast) मनः (mind) सेन्द्रियं (senses) हि (indeed) । तथा (thus) अस्माकम् (our) उत्सृज्य (abandoning) बुद्धिः (discerning mind) स्वयञ्च (naturally) दशां (state) त्रैपुटर्टी (threefold) सत्त्वरं (existence) सँल्लिनाति (abandons) ॥
shambhu_gita::896.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::896.essence: True wisdom releases attachment, causing mind and senses to dissolve naturally.
shambhu_gita::896.simple_meaning: When wisdom naturally lets go of clinging to the threefold states, the mind and senses quickly quiet and dissolve.
shambhu_gita::896.simple_insight: You can find peace when your mind and senses stop holding on tightly.
shambhu_gita::896.detailed_meaning: In this teaching moment, Shiva explains how the discerning mind, when it releases attachment to the threefold states of existence, causes the mind and senses to dissolve naturally and quickly, revealing deeper inner freedom.
shambhu_gita::896.modern_relevance: After a stressful day, when you stop resisting your feelings and thoughts, your mind naturally calms and quiets without force.
shambhu_gita::896.insight: It teaches you to release mental grip on changing states so your mind and senses relax effortlessly.

shambhu_gita::897.verse_sanskrit:
अहो ! कारणानां प्रभो ! कारणात्मन् !
विभो याति लिङ्गे यदा चिन्मये ते ।
लयं विश्वगोलबजो दीप्यमान
स्तदालोक्यते कौतुकं तत्र चित्रम् ॥
shambhu_gita::897.verse_hindi: हे सर्व कारणकारण ! जब उस विभु चिन्मय लिंग मे भासमान ब्रह्माण्डसमूह लय को प्राप्त होते हैं तो हम देखते हैं कि
shambhu_gita::897.english_translation: O Lord of all causes! When the supreme cause merges into the conscious form, the dissolution of the cosmic sphere is seen as a wondrous, vibrant spectacle.
shambhu_gita::897.translation_literal: अहो (O) ! कारणानां (of causes) प्रभो (lord) ! कारणात्मन् (cause itself) ! विभो (mighty one) याति (goes) लिङ्गे (in form) यदा (when) चिन्मये (conscious) ते (those) । लयं (dissolution) विश्वगोलबजो (cosmic sphere) दीप्यमान (illuminated) स्तदालोक्यते (then is seen) कौतुकं (wonder) तत्र (there) चित्रम् (varied) ॥
shambhu_gita::897.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::897.essence: The cosmic dissolution reveals a wondrous, conscious spectacle beyond ordinary perception.
shambhu_gita::897.simple_meaning: When the all-causing principle merges into the conscious form, the cosmic world dissolves, appearing as a wondrous and vivid spectacle.
shambhu_gita::897.simple_insight: There is awe in witnessing the cosmic cycle’s end as a vivid transformation, beyond ordinary understanding.
shambhu_gita::897.detailed_meaning: This verse reflects on the moment when the supreme cause, the origin of all, merges back into its conscious essence, causing the cosmic universe to dissolve. The scene is described as a colorful and wondrous spectacle, highlighting the mystery of cosmic cycles.
shambhu_gita::897.insight: It invites you to see endings as moments of transformation filled with unexpected beauty and deeper mystery.

shambhu_gita::898.verse_sanskrit:
विभु व्योम भूतान्तरं सर्वमेव
सलीलं स्वलीनं विधाय स्वयश्च।
विलीयाम्बुधौ देशकालस्वरूपे
सदेशं सकालं सदेत्थं निमग्नम् ॥
shambhu_gita::898.verse_hindi: विभु आकाश अन्यान्य सब भूतसंघों को अपने में अनायास लय  करके स्वयं देशकालरूप समुद्र में लय होकर
shambhu_gita::898.english_translation: The all-pervading sky effortlessly absorbs all beings, dissolving itself into the ocean of space and time, merging all place and time into itself.
shambhu_gita::898.translation_literal: विभु (all-pervading) / व्योम (sky/space) / भूतान्तरं (all beings within) / सर्वमेव (all indeed) / सलीलं (effortlessly) / स्वलीनं (merged into itself) / विधाय (having done) / स्वयश्च (by itself) / विलीयाम्बुधौ (dissolving in the ocean) / देशकालस्वरूपे (form of place and time) / सदेशं (all place) / सकालं (all time) / सदेत्थं (all that exists) / निमग्नम् (immersed)
shambhu_gita::898.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::898.essence: All beings and moments dissolve into one vast, timeless space without effort.
shambhu_gita::898.simple_meaning: Everything and everyone merges effortlessly into the vast space-time ocean, losing all separation.
shambhu_gita::898.simple_insight: You are already part of an infinite whole, inseparable from all existence.
shambhu_gita::898.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Shiva explains that the entire universe and every being within it are effortlessly absorbed into the boundless sky—symbolizing space and time—where all distinctions of place and moment vanish into one unified reality.
shambhu_gita::898.modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or fragmented, remember that you are already part of a vast, seamless whole that transcends time and place.
shambhu_gita::898.insight: It invites you to see beyond separateness, embracing that all apparent differences dissolve into one continuous reality.

shambhu_gita::899.verse_sanskrit:
भवत्यस्य लिङ्गस्य कस्मिन् प्रदेशे
यथा तस्य सत्तानुभानः कथचिन ।
न सन्तिष्ठते कापि नूनं कुनश्चित परात्मन !
प्रभो ! नाथ : शम्भो ! दयालो: ॥
shambhu_gita::899.verse_hindi: उनके साथ उस लिंग के कौन से स्थान में इस प्रकार डूब जाता है कि हे परमात्मन् ! हे दयालो नाथ ! हे प्रभो शम्भो ! किसी प्रकार कहीं से उसकी सत्ता का कुछ अनुभव ही नही रहता है
shambhu_gita::899.english_translation: In which place does one become so absorbed in that form that no trace of existence remains anywhere? O supreme being, O compassionate lord Shambhu!
shambhu_gita::899.translation_literal: भवत्यस्य (becomes) / लिङ्गस्य (of the form) / कस्मिन् (in which) / प्रदेशे (place) / यथा (like) / तस्य (of that) / सत्तानुभानः (experience of existence) / कथचिन (somehow) / न (not) / सन्तिष्ठते (remains) / कापि (any) / नूनं (indeed) / कुनश्चित (anywhere) / परात्मन (to supreme being) / प्रभो (O lord) / नाथ (protector) / शम्भो (Shambhu) / दयालोः (compassionate)
shambhu_gita::899.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::899.essence: Complete absorption in the divine form erases all sense of separate existence.
shambhu_gita::899.simple_meaning: It asks where someone can become so absorbed in the divine form that they lose all sense of their own existence.
shambhu_gita::899.simple_insight: True absorption in the divine can dissolve the sense of separate existence completely.
shambhu_gita::899.detailed_meaning: Shiva questions in which place or state a devotee becomes so deeply absorbed in his divine form that no sense of personal existence remains. It describes the ultimate absorption where the ego and self-awareness vanish in the divine presence.
shambhu_gita::899.insight: It invites you to consider a state of complete merging where your separate self fades away in devotion.

shambhu_gita::900.verse_sanskrit:
विभो ! विश्चगोलप्रकाण्टा अनन्नता
अहो चिन्मयं तत्र लिने विराजि।
अनेकैः सहवाग्विलाधाररूप !
पितृवातंदवत्रजप्योवर्हि ॥
shambhu_gita::900.verse_hindi: हे सर्वाधार ! उस चिन्मय विराट् लिङ्ग पर अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डसमूह, अनेक देव, ऋषि,
shambhu_gita::900.english_translation: O sovereign, that vast cosmic form is endless, filled with many divine beings, sages, and all foundations.
shambhu_gita::900.translation_literal: विभो (O sovereign) / विश्चगोलप्रकाण्टा (vast cosmic form) / अनन्नता (endlessness) / अहो (indeed) / चिन्मयं (made of consciousness) / तत्र (there) / लिने (pervading) / विराजि (shining) / अनेकैः (many) / सहवाग् (together) / विलाधाररूप (manifested forms) / पितृ (ancestors) / वातंदव (spirits) / त्रजपि (also chanting) / ओवर्हि (praises)
shambhu_gita::900.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::900.essence: The cosmic form is infinite, conscious, and filled with countless beings and energies.
shambhu_gita::900.simple_meaning: A vast cosmic form filled with many divine beings, sages, and foundations is endless and shines with consciousness.
shambhu_gita::900.simple_insight: The universe is a boundless, living presence made of conscious energy.
shambhu_gita::900.detailed_meaning: Suta describes a magnificent cosmic form that contains countless divine beings, sages, and foundational forces, emphasizing its infinite and conscious nature, setting the stage for deeper teachings.
shambhu_gita::900.insight: It invites you to recognize the infinite and interconnected nature of the cosmos beyond ordinary perception.

shambhu_gita::901.verse_sanskrit:
अनन्तैर्मनुप्यासुरेर्भूतसङ्घ श्रतुर्धा
विभक्तः प्रतीयन्न इत्यम ।
यथा चित्रिता मूर्तयः स्तम्भमध्ये
विचित्रा विचित्रेऽठमभिनिर्मितेऽलम ॥
shambhu_gita::901.verse_hindi: पितृ, असुर, मानव और चतुर्विध भूतसंघ के साथ ऐसे प्रतीत होते हैं जैसा कि किसी पत्थर के खम्बे पर विचित्र मूर्तियां
shambhu_gita::901.english_translation: With ancestors, shadow beings, humans, and the fourfold creatures, they appear like strange forms carved on a stone pillar.
shambhu_gita::901.translation_literal: अनन्तैः (with ancestors) मनु (shadow beings) असुरैः (shadow beings) भूता (creatures) सङ्घैः (groups) श्रतुः (divine beings) धा (with) विभक्तः (divided) प्रतीयन् (appearing) इत्य् (thus) यथा (like) चित्रिता (painted) मूर्तयः (forms) स्तम्भमध्ये (in the pillar) विचित्रा (strange) विचित्रे (strange) अठम (eighth) अभिनिर्मिते (constructed) अलम् (stone pillar)
shambhu_gita::901.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::901.essence: Many diverse beings appear as strange forms unified on a single structure.
shambhu_gita::901.simple_meaning: Various beings like ancestors, shadow beings, humans, and four types of creatures appear like strange statues on a stone pillar.
shambhu_gita::901.simple_insight: You see many forms and beings, but they are all part of a complex whole.
shambhu_gita::901.detailed_meaning: Suta describes a scene where many different beings—ancestors, shadow beings, humans, and others—are compared to strange statues carved on a stone pillar, highlighting diversity and complexity without clear separation.
shambhu_gita::901.insight: It invites you to see diverse beings as part of a shared, intricate existence rather than isolated entities.

shambhu_gita::902.verse_sanskrit:
प्रभो ! सन्ति ता मूर्तयः प्रस्तरेषु
सदाऽऽलेव्यभावं गताः केवलं हि ।
न चान्यत् परं वर्तते तत्र किञ्चिदहो
वस्तुतो ज्ञानसिंधो ! दयालो ! ॥
shambhu_gita::902.verse_hindi: खुदी हुई हो । हे ज्ञान सिन्धो ! हे दयालो ! वह  मूर्तियां भी प्रस्तर खोदित हैं और कुछ नहीं है
shambhu_gita::902.english_translation: O Ocean of Wisdom! Even those idols are carved from stone and nothing else exists there.
shambhu_gita::902.translation_literal: प्रभो (O Lord) / सन्ति (are) / ता (those) / मूर्तयः (idols) / प्रस्तरेषु (in stones) / सदाऽऽलेव्यभावं (always carved form) / गताः (have become) / केवलं (only) / हि (indeed) / न (not) / च (and) / अन्यत् (other) / परं (beyond) / वर्तते (exists) / तत्र (there) / किञ्चिदहो (anything) / वस्तुतो (actually) / ज्ञानसिंधो (Ocean of Wisdom) / दयालो (Compassionate)
shambhu_gita::902.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::902.essence: Revered forms are only shaped matter; true reality lies beyond appearances.
shambhu_gita::902.simple_meaning: Idols, however sacred, are only carved stones without any deeper essence beyond their form.
shambhu_gita::902.simple_insight: You feel how appearances hold no ultimate reality beyond their shape.
shambhu_gita::902.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the Ocean of Wisdom, pointing out that idols, though revered, are merely shaped stones without any true essence beyond their form, highlighting the difference between appearance and reality.
shambhu_gita::902.modern_relevance: You look at objects you revere and realize their value is in your mind, not in the object itself.
shambhu_gita::902.insight: It teaches you to see beyond physical forms, recognizing the limits of outward appearances.

shambhu_gita::903.verse_sanskrit:
अनन्ताऽमिता विश्वगोलव्रजा हि
विराजन्त एवं विधास्तत्र लिंगे।
परं सोऽपि लिङ्गस्तु निर्लिप्त एव
प्रतीयेत तैर्नात्र सन्देहलेशः ॥
shambhu_gita::903.verse_hindi: वास्तव में वैसे ही अनन्तकोटि ब्रह्माण्ड समूह उस लिङ्ग में हैं परन्तु वह लिङ्ग उन सबसे निर्लिप्त ही प्रतीत होता है, इसमें सन्देह का लेश भी नहीं है
shambhu_gita::903.english_translation: Indeed, countless infinite universes reside in that symbol, yet that symbol appears detached from all, without even a trace of doubt.
shambhu_gita::903.translation_literal: अनन्ताऽमिता (countless infinite) / विश्वगोलव्रजा (universes in spheres) / हि (indeed) / विराजन्त (reside) / एवं (thus) / विधास्तत्र (indeed there) / लिंगे (in the symbol) / परं (but) / सोऽपि (that also) / लिङ्गस्तु (symbol indeed) / निर्लिप्त (detached) / एव (only) / प्रतीयेत (appears) / तैर्नात्र (there by them not) / सन्देहलेशः (trace of doubt)
shambhu_gita::903.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::903.essence: A single symbol can contain infinite worlds while remaining completely detached.
shambhu_gita::903.simple_meaning: Infinite countless universes exist within that symbol, yet the symbol itself remains completely detached from them.
shambhu_gita::903.simple_insight: The symbol of the divine can hold everything yet remain untouched and free.
shambhu_gita::903.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes a symbol representing the cosmic whole containing infinite universes yet appearing completely detached from them, highlighting the transcendence and immanence of the divine.
shambhu_gita::903.insight: It shifts your view to see the divine as both the container and beyond all things simultaneously.

shambhu_gita::904.verse_sanskrit:
न चादिर्न चान्तोऽस्ति लिङ्गस्य
तस्य समस्तेश ! सर्वस्वरूप ! प्रभो ! भोः !
भवञ्चिन्मयो वर्चते लिङ्ग एषः।
सदाऽन्तवहिः पूर्ण एवं भवन्वै ॥
shambhu_gita::904.verse_hindi: उस लिङ्ग का न आदि है और न अन्त है। हे सर्वेश्वर समय विभो परमात्मन् ! आपका चिन्मय लिङ्ग बहिः पूर्ण अन्तः पूर्ण और
shambhu_gita::904.english_translation: That symbol has neither beginning nor end. O Lord of all, that conscious symbol shines fully within and without, complete in every way.
shambhu_gita::904.translation_literal: न (not) चादि (beginning) न (nor) च (and) अन्तः (end) अस्ति (is) लिङ्गस्य (of the symbol) तस्य (that) समस्तेषु (in all) सर्वस्वरूप (all-form) प्रभो (O Lord) भोः (O!) भवञ्चिन्मयः (conscious essence) वर्चते (shines) लिङ्गः (symbol) एषः (this) सदा (always) अन्तवहिः (inside and outside) पूर्ण (complete) एव (indeed) भवन्ति (exists).
shambhu_gita::904.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::904.essence: The divine symbol is infinite, complete, and present everywhere without limits.
shambhu_gita::904.simple_meaning: The symbol representing the divine has no start or end and is fully present everywhere, inside and out.
shambhu_gita::904.simple_insight: The divine presence is infinite and complete beyond all limits.
