shambhu_gita::904.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Shiva describes the sacred symbol (linga) as eternal and limitless, fully manifest within and outside all things, emphasizing the infinite and all-encompassing nature of the divine.
shambhu_gita::904.insight: It shows that the divine essence transcends time and space, inviting you to see beyond beginnings and endings.

shambhu_gita::905.verse_sanskrit:
अहो देशकालाऽपरिच्छिन्न आरा
दनाद्यन्तरूपेण पूर्णः परात्मन् !।
निरीक्ष्येत नूनं सदा सर्वतो हि
न चास्तेऽत्र सन्देहलेशः कथञ्चित् ॥
shambhu_gita::905.verse_hindi: देश काल से अपरिच्छिन्न होकर अनादि और अनन्त रूप से सर्व पूर्ण दिखाई पड़ता है, इसमें किसी प्रकार का सन्देह लेश नहीं है
shambhu_gita::905.english_translation: The supreme being appears complete everywhere, beyond limits of place and time, without any doubt.
shambhu_gita::905.translation_literal: अहो (indeed) / देशकालाऽपरिच्छिन्न (without separation of place and time) / आरा (limit) / दनाद्यन्तरूपेण (with no beginning or end form) / पूर्णः (complete) / परात्मन् (the supreme being) / निरीक्ष्येत (should be seen) / नूनं (certainly) / सदा (always) / सर्वतो (from all sides) / हि (indeed) / न (not) / चास्ते (there is) / तत्र (there) / सन्देहलेशः (trace of doubt) / कथञ्चित् (anyhow)
shambhu_gita::905.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::905.essence: The true self is complete and boundless, beyond all limits and doubt.
shambhu_gita::905.simple_meaning: The true self is complete and present everywhere, beyond all limits of place and time, without any doubt.
shambhu_gita::905.simple_insight: You can trust that the true self is always whole and unchanging, no matter where or when.
shambhu_gita::905.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that the supreme being is not confined by place or time but is fully complete everywhere, without any doubt. This teaching invites Arjuna to see beyond appearances and trust in the unchanging wholeness underlying all.
shambhu_gita::905.modern_relevance: When you feel scattered or uncertain about your place or time, remember your true self is whole and present beyond all limits.
shambhu_gita::905.insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as limited by circumstances to recognizing your boundless and complete nature.

shambhu_gita::906.verse_sanskrit:
प्रदर्श प्रदर्श सदा लिङ्गमेनं
विराणमूर्तिभृत् ! ज्ञाननेत्रस्य नोऽलम ।
क्षमत्वं यदा दूरदृष्टविनश्येत्
तदैकापरूपं प्रदृश्येत रूपम् ॥
shambhu_gita::906.verse_hindi: हे विराट मूर्ते ! आपके विराट् लिंग को देखते देखते हमारे ज्ञान नेत्र की दूरदर्शन शक्ति जब थकित होकर नष्ट हो जाती है तब हमें आपका और एक अपरूप रूप दिखाई देने लगता है
shambhu_gita::906.english_translation: O cosmic form! When the power of your knowledge eye to see far fades, another formless form of yours appears.
shambhu_gita::906.translation_literal: प्रदर्श (showing) प्रदर्श (showing) सदा (always) लिङ्गमेनं (by the symbol) विराणमूर्तिभृत् (O bearer of the cosmic form) ज्ञाननेत्रस्य (of the knowledge eye) नोऽलम (our vision) क्षमत्वं (capacity) यदा (when) दूरदृष्टविनश्येत् (the power to see far is destroyed) तदैकापरूपं (that one other form) प्रदृश्येत (is seen) रूपम् (form)
shambhu_gita::906.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::906.essence: When clear perception fades, a deeper, formless reality reveals itself.
shambhu_gita::906.simple_meaning: When our ability to perceive your vast cosmic form with knowledge weakens, another deeper, formless aspect becomes visible.
shambhu_gita::906.simple_insight: There's more to reality than what our direct knowledge can grasp.
shambhu_gita::906.detailed_meaning: In the presence of the cosmic form, the seer’s knowledge eye that perceives far eventually tires. When this happens, an even subtler, formless aspect of the divine becomes visible, revealing layers beyond ordinary perception.
shambhu_gita::906.modern_relevance: Sometimes your understanding of a complex truth feels exhausted, yet a deeper, subtler insight quietly emerges beyond your current awareness.
shambhu_gita::906.insight: It invites you to trust that limits of your current knowledge open space for deeper wisdom beyond visible forms.

shambhu_gita::907.verse_sanskrit:
यदा ते दयासागरैतद्विचित्रं
मनोबुद्धिवाग्वैभवातीतलिङ्गम् ।
समालोक्य किकार्यमूढाः स्वचित्तैः । 
किमप्याश्रयामस्तदेक्षामहेऽन्यत् ॥
shambhu_gita::907.verse_hindi: हे करुणावरुणालय ! जब आपके इस चमत्कार वाङ्मन और बुद्धि से अग्राहा लिङ्ग को देखकर हम अपने अन्तःकरणों के द्वारा किंकर्तव्यविमूढ़ होकर आपके शरणागत होते हैं तो कुछ हम और ही देखने लगते हैं
shambhu_gita::907.english_translation: O ocean of compassion! When your wondrous speech, mind, and intellect reveal the sign beyond desire, we, confused in our own minds, become your refuge and begin to see something else.
shambhu_gita::907.translation_literal: यदा (when) ते (your) दयासागर (ocean of compassion) एतत् (this) विचित्रं (wondrous) मनोबुद्धिवाग् (mind-intellect-speech) वैभवातीतलिङ्गम् (sign beyond desire) समालोक्य (seeing) किकार्यमूढाः (bewildered what to do) स्वचित्तैः (by own minds) किमपि (something) आश्रयामः (we take refuge) तदेक्षामः (thereafter see) अन्यत् (different)
shambhu_gita::907.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::907.essence: Confusion in your mind can lead you to refuge and fresh understanding beyond desire.
shambhu_gita::907.simple_meaning: When your deep compassion and wisdom show a sign beyond craving, we become confused but also seek your refuge and start seeing things differently.
shambhu_gita::907.simple_insight: There is hope in confusion when it leads you toward a higher refuge and fresh understanding.
shambhu_gita::907.detailed_meaning: The verse addresses a divine figure as an ocean of compassion whose wondrous mind, intellect, and speech reveal a sign beyond desire. The seekers, confused in their own minds, turn to this refuge and begin to see beyond their usual doubts and fears.
shambhu_gita::907.modern_relevance: When your mind is overwhelmed by uncertainty, encountering a deeper wisdom can bring surprising clarity and a new perspective.
shambhu_gita::907.insight: It invites you to trust your confusion as a gateway to refuge and fresh insight beyond ego’s limits.

shambhu_gita::908.verse_sanskrit:
लिनातीह शब्देऽखिला स्थूलस्राष्टिः।
स्वराः पड्जनामादयः सप्त चैवम् ।
सदौङ्कारशब्देऽद्वितीये लिनन्ति
अविच्छिन्न आस्ते यथा तैलधारा ॥
shambhu_gita::908.verse_hindi: हम देखते हैं कि सब स्थूल.सृष्टि शब्द में लय होती है, षड्ज आदि सप्तस्वर अद्वितीय प्रणव में लय होते हैं जो तैलधारा की भांति अवच्छिन्न है
shambhu_gita::908.english_translation: All gross creation dissolves into sound; the seven notes merge into the unique primal sound, continuous like a flowing oil.
shambhu_gita::908.translation_literal: लिनति (dissolves) / एतिह (here) / शब्दे (in sound) / अखिला (all) / स्थूलस्राष्टिः (gross creation) / स्वराः (notes) / षड्जनामादयः (from Shadja onwards) / सप्त (seven) / चैवम् (also) / सदौङ्कारशब्दे (in the primal sound) / अद्वितीये (unique) / लिनन्ति (dissolve) / अविच्छिन्न (unbroken) / आस्ते (exists) / यथा (like) / तैलधारा (flow of oil)
shambhu_gita::908.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::908.essence: All creation merges into one continuous primal sound flowing without break.
shambhu_gita::908.simple_meaning: All physical creation ultimately dissolves into sound. The seven musical notes merge into the one unique primal sound that flows endlessly like oil.
shambhu_gita::908.simple_insight: There's a deep unity beneath all forms—everything flows into one continuous vibration.
shambhu_gita::908.detailed_meaning: Shiva reveals that all visible creation merges back into sound. The seven basic musical notes combine into the unique primal sound, which flows continuously like oil, symbolizing the unbroken essence behind all forms.
shambhu_gita::908.modern_relevance: When you listen to music or sounds around you, remember everything visible is part of one continuous flow beneath the surface.
shambhu_gita::908.insight: It shifts your view from seeing separate forms to recognizing a continuous, unified flow beneath appearances.

shambhu_gita::909.verse_sanskrit:
यथा दीर्घघण्टानिनादोऽस्ति यस्तु
सदैकेन भावेन युक्तस्तथैव ।
समुत्पादकोऽस्त्येकतत्त्वस्य सोऽयम
भवानासने प्राणवे तंत्र माति ॥
shambhu_gita::909.verse_hindi: और दीर्घ घंटे के शब्द की भांति एक भावयुक्त होकर एकतत्व उत्पादक है, आप उसी प्रणव आसन पर बैठे हैं।
shambhu_gita::909.english_translation: Just as the long sound of a bell is a unified vibration, you seated on the pranava seat are the source of oneness.
shambhu_gita::909.translation_literal: यथा (just as) दीर्घघण्टानिनादोऽस्ति (long bell sound exists) यः (who) तु (indeed) सदैकेन (with one vibration) भावेन (by feeling) युक्तः (joined) तथैव (likewise). समुत्पादकः (producer/source) अस्ति (is) एकतत्त्वस्य (of one essence) सः (he) अयम् (this) भवनासने (on the seat of the divine) प्राणवे (in the primal sound) तन्त्र (thread/essence) माति (mind).
shambhu_gita::909.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::909.essence: You are the fundamental source from which all unity arises, like one vibration.
shambhu_gita::909.simple_meaning: You are like the single unified vibration of a long bell sound, the source of all oneness seated in the primal sound.
shambhu_gita::909.simple_insight: You can feel connected as the origin of all unity within the primal vibration.
shambhu_gita::909.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva compares the unified sound of a long bell to the essence of oneness. Seated on the primal sound seat, he reveals himself as the source from which all unity arises, illustrating the deep connection between sound, mind, and cosmic essence.
shambhu_gita::909.modern_relevance: When you focus deeply on a single sound or moment, you can access a sense of connectedness as the origin of harmony.
shambhu_gita::909.insight: This verse shifts attention to recognizing yourself as the fundamental source from which unity and essence emerge.

shambhu_gita::910.verse_sanskrit:
अनन्तात्मकस्ते जया दिक्समूहः
त्रिकालात्मकं ते विशालं त्रिनेत्रम् ।
अनन्तो विभुवर्तते ते दयालो !
सुयज्ञोपवीतं पवित्रं मनोज्ञम् ॥
shambhu_gita::910.verse_hindi: हे दयालो! अनन्त रूपधारी दशो दिशाएँ आपकी जटा हैं. त्रिकालरूपी आपके तीन विशाल नेत्र हैं, विभुरूपधारी अनन्तः आपका पवित्र मनोहर यज्ञोपवीत है
shambhu_gita::910.english_translation: O compassionate one! Your matted hair is infinite in all ten directions, your three large eyes span past, present, and future; infinite and all-pervading, your sacred sacred thread is beautiful and pure.
shambhu_gita::910.translation_literal: अनन्तात्मकस्ते (infinite in form your) / जया (by matted hair) / दिक्समूहः (ten directions) / त्रिकालात्मकं (three times - past, present, future) / ते (your) / विशालं (large) / त्रिनेत्रम् (three-eyed) / अनन्तो (infinite) / विभुवर्तते (all-pervading) / ते (your) / दयालो (compassionate one) / सुयज्ञोपवीतं (well-sacred thread) / पवित्रं (pure) / मनोज्ञम् (beautiful)
shambhu_gita::910.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::910.essence: The divine form transcends all directions and time, embodying infinite sacredness.
shambhu_gita::910.simple_meaning: This verse describes the limitless, all-encompassing form of Shiva, highlighting his cosmic aspects like infinite hair, three eyes spanning time, and a pure sacred thread.
shambhu_gita::910.simple_insight: Recognizing the vastness and sacredness of the divine form can inspire awe and reverence.
shambhu_gita::910.detailed_meaning: The bard Suta describes Shiva's cosmic form to the sages, emphasizing his infinite presence in all directions and times, symbolized by matted hair, three eyes, and sacred thread, setting a grand stage for Shiva's teaching.
shambhu_gita::910.insight: It invites seeing the divine as beyond all limits of space and time, encouraging expansive perspective.

shambhu_gita::911.verse_sanskrit:
लयस्थानभूतोऽपि विश्वस्य देव !
भवान भूपिताङ्गो विभूत्या विभाति ।
चतुर्हस्तमध्येऽस्त्यहो खप्परस्ते
त्रिशूलञ्च शृङ्गं डमर्वाख्यवाद्यम् ॥
shambhu_gita::911.verse_hindi: हे देव ! आप संसार के लयस्थान होकर विभूतिभूषिताङ्ग हैं, आपके चारों हाथों में त्रिशुल खप्पर सिंगा और डमरु
shambhu_gita::911.english_translation: O divine being! You are the dissolution point of the universe, radiant with manifestations. In your four hands are the trident, skull, horn, and drum.
shambhu_gita::911.translation_literal: लयस्थानभूतोऽपि (even as the dissolution point) / विश्वस्य (of the universe) / देव (O divine being) / भवान (you are) / भूपिताङ्गो (with limbs adorned) / विभूत्या (with manifestations) / विभाति (radiates) / चतुर्हस्तमध्येऽस्ति (in the middle of your four hands is) / अहो (behold) / खप्परः (a skull) / ते (your) / त्रिशूलं (trident) / च (and) / शृङ्गं (horn) / डमरु (and drum) / अख्यवाद्यम् (are held)
shambhu_gita::911.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::911.essence: The divine is the cosmic center holding many symbolic powers in unity.
shambhu_gita::911.simple_meaning: The divine is the source and end of everything, shining through many forms, holding sacred symbols in four hands.
shambhu_gita::911.simple_insight: The divine presence is vast and mysterious, beyond any single form or symbol.
shambhu_gita::911.detailed_meaning: Suta describes Shiva as the cosmic force where everything ends and begins. Shiva shines through many manifestations and holds powerful symbols like the trident and drum, representing his authority and cosmic functions.
shambhu_gita::911.insight: Recognize that the ultimate reality is beyond form but expresses itself through meaningful symbols you can relate to.

shambhu_gita::912.verse_sanskrit:
परासिद्धिमोक्षस्त्रितापञ्च नूनम्
प्रभो वर्तते खपरश्व त्रिशूलम् ।
निवृत्त्यात्मको धर्म एवास्ति शृङ्गं
डमर्वाख्यवायं चतुर्धाऽर्थ एव ॥
shambhu_gita::912.verse_hindi: त्रिताप, परासिद्धि रूपी मोक्ष, निवृत्तिधर्म और चतर्विध अर्थरूप से शोभायमान हैं,
shambhu_gita::912.english_translation: The supreme accomplishment, freedom like the highest mastery, the path of withdrawal, and the fourfold purposes all shine forth, O Lord, like the trident, horse, and drum.
shambhu_gita::912.translation_literal: परासिद्धिमोक्षस्त्रितापञ्च (supreme accomplishment, liberation, and three pains) / नूनम् (indeed) / प्रभो (O Lord) / वर्तते (exists) / खपरश्व (drum, horse) / त्रिशूलम् (trident) / निवृत्त्यात्मको (withdrawal/self-withdrawal related) / धर्म (duty) / एवास्ति (alone is) / शृङ्गं (the peak) / डमर्वाख्यवायं (drum, horse, trident named) / चतुर्धाऽर्थ (fourfold purpose) / एव (indeed)
shambhu_gita::912.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::912.essence: Mastery, withdrawal, and life's aims unify and shine like sacred symbols of power.
shambhu_gita::912.simple_meaning: The highest success, freedom from suffering, withdrawing the self, and four key life aims are bright and clear like sacred symbols.
shambhu_gita::912.simple_insight: There is a shining clarity when mastery, withdrawal, and purpose align within you.
shambhu_gita::912.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes how supreme accomplishment (parāsiddhi), liberation (moksha), withdrawal from worldly ties (nivṛtti), and the four aims of life (puruṣārtha) are all present and manifest like his sacred trident, horse, and drum. This verse conveys their unity and radiance.
shambhu_gita::912.modern_relevance: When your highest skills, clear purpose, and the ability to step back from distractions come together, you feel a strong, bright force inside.
shambhu_gita::912.insight: Recognize that mastery, purposeful withdrawal, and life’s aims are interconnected aspects of your inner strength.

shambhu_gita::913.verse_sanskrit:
सदैकाऽद्वितीयोऽपि नैजी स्वशक्ति
प्रकृत्यात्मिकां तां स्वतो निर्गमय ।
स्वशक्तया तया श्यामया शोभिताको
भवान् राजतेऽलं धरन् प्रेमतस्ताम् ॥
shambhu_gita::913.verse_hindi: आप एक अद्वितीय होने पर भी अपने ही में से अपनी प्रकृति को बाहर करके अपने काम अङ्क पर अति प्रेम से धारण करते हुए शोभायमान हो
shambhu_gita::913.english_translation: Though you are unique, you manifest your own nature outwardly and shine brilliantly, holding it with deep love.
shambhu_gita::913.translation_literal: सदैका (always unique) / अद्वितीयः (unique) / अपि (even) / नैजि (own) / स्वशक्ति (own power) / प्रकृत्यात्मिकां (nature's essence) / तां (that) / स्वतो (by oneself) / निर्गमय (bring forth) / स्वशक्तया (by own power) / तया (that) / श्यामया (dark/blessed) / शोभिताको (shining) / भवान् (you) / राजते (shine) / अलं (that) / धरन् (holding) / प्रेमतस्ताम् (with loving devotion)
shambhu_gita::913.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::913.essence: You shine brightly by lovingly expressing your unique true nature.
shambhu_gita::913.simple_meaning: You are unique and express your true nature outwardly with love, which makes you shine brightly.
shambhu_gita::913.simple_insight: There is joy in embracing and lovingly expressing your unique true self.
shambhu_gita::913.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that even though you are unique, you can bring forth your inner nature with love and let it shine brilliantly, embodying your true power and presence.
shambhu_gita::913.modern_relevance: You feel most alive when you fully embrace and express your unique qualities with genuine care and pride.
shambhu_gita::913.insight: It teaches you to lovingly accept and express your true nature as your source of radiance.

shambhu_gita::914.verse_sanskrit:
तया श्यामया भूयते पूर्णशक्त्या
सती तद्विधैवाऽस्यसौ पोड़शी च ।
करेणात्तपाशेन जीवाय बन्धं
सविद्याकुशेन प्रदत्ते च मुक्तिम् ॥
shambhu_gita::914.verse_hindi: वह श्यामा पूर्णशक्ति शालिनी होकर षोड़शी है और अपने हाथों में पाश और अंकुश धारण करके जीवों को मायाजाल में फांसती भी है और ज्ञान रूपी अंकुश द्वारा मुक्त भी करती है,
shambhu_gita::914.english_translation: That Shyama, the full-power sixteen-faced one, holds a noose and goad in her hands, ensnaring beings in the web of illusion and also freeing them with the goad of wisdom.
shambhu_gita::914.translation_literal: तया (by that) श्यामया (Shyama) भूयते (becomes) पूर्णशक्त्या (full power) सती (the one who is) तद्विधैवाऽस्यसौ (just like that) पोड़शी (sixteen-faced) च (and) । करेणात्तपाशेन (by the hand, with a noose) जीवाय (to beings) बन्धं (bondage) सविद्याकुशेन (with wisdom-goad) प्रदत्ते (is given) च (and) मुक्तिम् (freedom) ॥
shambhu_gita::914.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::914.essence: The divine can both bind beings in illusion and free them through wisdom.
shambhu_gita::914.simple_meaning: Shyama, a powerful sixteen-faced figure, holds tools that both trap beings in illusion and free them through wisdom.
shambhu_gita::914.simple_insight: The same power that binds can also liberate, showing the dual nature of divine influence.
shambhu_gita::914.detailed_meaning: The bard Suta describes Shyama, a sixteen-faced embodiment of full power, who holds a noose and goad. These symbolize how she traps beings in illusion but also frees them with wisdom, illustrating the paradoxical divine role in bondage and liberation.
shambhu_gita::914.insight: Recognize that forces around you can both limit and free, depending on your understanding and response.

shambhu_gita::915.verse_sanskrit:
अविद्यास्वरूपा सपाशेयमेव
तथा साकुंशा सैव विद्यास्वरूपा।
 सती पाति सृष्टेरलं वैभवं ते
वयं नाथ ! विद्यापते ! त्वां नमामः ॥
shambhu_gita::915.verse_hindi: पाशविधायिनी होकर वही अविद्यारुपी और अंकुश विधायिनी होकर वही  विद्यारूप होती हुई आपके सृष्टि-वैभव की रक्षा करती है, हे विद्यापते स्वामिन् ! आपको नमस्कार है
shambhu_gita::915.english_translation: Ignorance acts like reins, and wisdom like a goad, both protecting the grand splendor of creation; we bow to you, lord of knowledge.
shambhu_gita::915.translation_literal: अविद्या (ignorance) स्वरूपा (in form) स पाशेयं (like reins) एव (indeed) तथा (also) स अकुंशा (like a goad) सैव (indeed) विद्या स्वरूपा (in form of wisdom) । सती (protecting) पाति (maintains) सृष्टेः (of creation) अलं (splendor) वैभवं (the grandeur) ते (your) वयम् (we) नाथ (lord)! विद्यापते (lord of knowledge)! त्वां (you) नमामः (we bow) ॥
shambhu_gita::915.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::915.essence: Ignorance and wisdom both guide and uphold the world’s grand order under the lord of knowledge.
shambhu_gita::915.simple_meaning: Both ignorance and wisdom act as controls, guiding and protecting the vast splendor of creation governed by the lord of knowledge.
shambhu_gita::915.simple_insight: Even opposing forces serve the divine purpose, holding the world in balance under wise guidance.
shambhu_gita::915.detailed_meaning: Shiva praises the dual roles of ignorance and wisdom, describing them as reins and goads that together maintain the magnificent creation under the lord of knowledge's protection.
shambhu_gita::915.modern_relevance: When you face conflicting thoughts, remember both confusion and clarity shape your growth and protect your wider purpose.
shambhu_gita::915.insight: Recognize that both confusion and insight are necessary forces that help steer your life’s unfolding with balance.

shambhu_gita::916.verse_sanskrit:
त्रयाणां गुणानां गुणाधार ! बीजं
तथेशो गुणग्रामिणां वर्तसे त्वम् ।
गुणेभ्योऽप्यतीतस्य तेऽन्के गुणात्मप्रकृत्या
स्थितं सन्नमामो भवन्तम् ॥
shambhu_gita::916.verse_hindi: हे गुणाधार ! आप त्रिगुण के बीजस्वरूप और गुणियों के ईश्वर हो और आप गुणातीत होने पर भी गुणमयी प्रकृति आपके आश्रय से ही आपके अंक पर स्थिता है, आपको नमस्कार है
shambhu_gita::916.english_translation: O support of the three qualities, you are their seed and lord, and though beyond qualities, the quality-filled nature abides in you; I bow to you.
shambhu_gita::916.translation_literal: त्रयाणां (of the three) गुणानां (qualities) गुणाधार (support) ! बीजं (seed) तथेशो (thus lord) गुणग्रामिणां (of the quality-filled) वर्तसे (you are) त्वम् (you) । गुणेभ्यः अपि (from qualities also) अतीतस्य (beyond) तेऽन्के (in your point) गुणात्मप्रकृत्या (by quality-nature) स्थितं (situated) सन्नमामः (I bow) भवन्तम् (to you) ॥
shambhu_gita::916.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::916.essence: The source beyond all qualities contains and sustains them within itself.
shambhu_gita::916.simple_meaning: You are the source and essence of the three qualities. Although you are beyond these qualities, all qualities exist within your nature. I honor that truth.
shambhu_gita::916.simple_insight: There is a deeper presence beyond the qualities that still holds them all within itself.
shambhu_gita::916.detailed_meaning: The narrator addresses the divine as the foundation of the three qualities (sattva, rajas, tamas). Though the divine transcends these qualities, the qualities themselves arise from and remain within this source. This verse frames the divine as both immanent and transcendent.
shambhu_gita::916.insight: Recognizing that all changing qualities arise from a deeper unchanging source shifts perspective from fluctuation to stability.

shambhu_gita::917.verse_sanskrit:
प्रभो ! सिद्धरूपस्तथा सिद्धिबीजं
अहो ! सिद्धराजोऽपि सिद्धलयोऽसि ।
ददभाग्यवद्भयः परासिद्धिमतानितो
मोचयेस्ते नमः सिद्धिनाथ ! ॥
shambhu_gita::917.verse_hindi: हे सिद्धिनाथ ! आप सिद्ध स्वरूप, सिद्धिबीज और सिद्धगण के अधीश्वर होने पर भी आप ही सिद्धि के लय स्थान हो और हे प्रभो ! आप ही परा सिद्धि देकर परमभाग्यशाली जीव को मुक्ति पद प्रदान करते हो, आपको नमस्कार है
shambhu_gita::917.english_translation: O Lord of the perfected ones! You are the perfected form, the seed of perfection, the king of the perfected, and the resting place of perfection. You grant the supreme perfection and liberation to the supremely fortunate beings; salutations to you, Lord of perfection!
shambhu_gita::917.translation_literal: प्रभो (O Lord) / सिद्धरूपः (perfected form) / तथा (also) / सिद्धिबीजं (seed of perfection) /aho (ah!) / सिद्धराजः अपि (also king of perfected) / सिद्धलयोऽसि (you are the resting place of perfection) । ददभाग्यवत् (to the supremely fortunate) भयः (fear) / परासिद्धिमता (by supreme perfection) अनितः (you grant) / मोचयः ते (liberation to you) / नमः (salutations) / सिद्धिनाथ (Lord of perfection) ॥
shambhu_gita::917.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::917.essence: The divine is the ultimate source, embodiment, and shelter of all perfection and liberation.
shambhu_gita::917.simple_meaning: You are the highest source and refuge of all true perfection and you grant supreme liberation to the fortunate.
shambhu_gita::917.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing the divine is both our origin and our final refuge.
shambhu_gita::917.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Shiva is praised as the ultimate perfected being who embodies the essence and origin of all perfection. He is the final resting place for all perfection and the one who grants supreme liberation to the supremely fortunate beings.
shambhu_gita::917.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by imperfection or struggle, remember there is a source of perfect freedom and support beyond your fears.
shambhu_gita::917.insight: It shifts your view from seeking perfection outside to recognizing it as your true source and refuge.

shambhu_gita::918.verse_sanskrit:
स्त्रतेजोमयस्तेजआधाररूपोऽपि
तेजस्मुवीजञ्च तेजस्विनाथः।
तिजः कर्षसि प्राणिनस्तेजसा स्वाभिमुख्येन
तेजोमय ! त्वां नमामः ॥
shambhu_gita::918.verse_hindi: हे तेजोभय ! आप 'तेजाधार तेजबीज तेजस्वरूप और तेजस्विगण के ईश्वर होने पर भी निरन्तर अपने तेज द्वारा तेजस्वी जीवों को अपनी ओर आकर्षण करते रहते हो, आपको नमस्कार है
shambhu_gita::918.english_translation: O Radiant Lord, you are the source, seed, and form of light. You continuously draw all radiant beings toward yourself with your brilliance. Radiant One, we bow to you.
shambhu_gita::918.translation_literal: स्त्रतेजोमयः (radiant like fire) / तेज (light) / आधार (foundation) / रूपः (form) / अपि (also) / तेजस् (light) / मुवीज (seed) / च (and) / तेजस्विनाथः (lord of the radiant beings) / तिजः (you) / कर्षसि (pull, attract) / प्राणिनः (living beings) / तेजसा (with brilliance) / स्वाभिमुख्येन (towards yourself) / तेजोमय (radiant one) / त्वां (you) / नमामः (we bow)
shambhu_gita::918.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::918.essence: The divine radiance naturally pulls all luminous beings toward itself.
shambhu_gita::918.simple_meaning: You are the source and embodiment of radiant energy, constantly attracting all radiant beings toward yourself.
shambhu_gita::918.simple_insight: You can feel drawn to the divine light because it naturally attracts all brilliance.
shambhu_gita::918.detailed_meaning: Shiva, described here as the radiant source and lord of all light-filled beings, is praised for his natural power to attract living beings with brilliance, symbolizing the magnetic pull of the divine on all luminous life.
shambhu_gita::918.modern_relevance: When you feel inspired by someone’s radiant energy, remember that such light naturally draws others toward it, like this verse describes.
shambhu_gita::918.insight: Recognize your own inherent brilliance and how it naturally attracts connection without force.

shambhu_gita::919.verse_sanskrit:
असि ज्ञान्यधीशोऽपि बुद्धेरतीत
स्त्वधिष्ठाय बुद्धिं सतः पाणिनस्त्वम् ।
नयस्येव शश्वद्धिया मोक्षभूमि वयं धीश !
नम्रा नमामो भवन्तम् ॥
shambhu_gita::919.verse_hindi: हे धीश ! ज्ञानिगण के ईश्वर होने पर भी आप बुद्धि से अतीत हो और आप ही बुद्धि में अधिष्ठित होकर बुद्धि द्वारा सदा जीवंगण को मुक्ति भूमि में पहुंचा दिया करते हो, आपको नमस्कार है
shambhu_gita::919.english_translation: O wise lord, though you are the lord of the wise, you transcend intellect. You dwell within intellect and, through it, guide beings to the land of freedom. We humbly bow to you.
shambhu_gita::919.translation_literal: असि (you are) ज्ञान्यधीशः (lord of the wise) अपि (also) बुद्धि-अतीत (beyond intellect) त्वम् (you) अधिष्ठाय (dwelling) बुद्धिम् (in intellect) सतः (of the beings) पाणिनः (lord) त्वम् (you) नयसे (guide) एव (indeed) शश्वत् (always) धिया (by intellect) मोक्ष-भूमि (land of liberation) वयम् (we) धीश (lord) नम्रा (humble) नमामः (bow)
shambhu_gita::919.speaker: Unknown
shambhu_gita::919.essence: The divine transcends intellect yet uses it to guide beings to freedom.
shambhu_gita::919.simple_meaning: You are the master of wisdom who exists beyond intellect yet uses it to guide beings toward freedom.
shambhu_gita::919.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing the divine guides us beyond the limits of our own thinking.
shambhu_gita::919.detailed_meaning: The verse praises the divine as the supreme lord of all wisdom, who transcends the intellect itself but dwells within it. Despite being beyond mind, this divine presence uses intellect to guide beings toward liberation, highlighting the mystery of guidance beyond ordinary understanding.
shambhu_gita::919.modern_relevance: When you feel stuck in overthinking, remember that guidance and freedom can come from beyond your own mind.
shambhu_gita::919.insight: It invites you to trust that true guidance transcends mental limits and leads you beyond confusion.

shambhu_gita::920.verse_sanskrit:
विभो ! सृष्टिरक्षाविनाशकहतो!
परेभ्यः पर! त्वं प्रभो ! वर्तसेऽलम्।
महीयोविराहपक्षस्य बीजं वयं
सर्वशक्तयात्मक ! त्वां नमामः ॥
shambhu_gita::920.verse_hindi: हे सर्वशक्तिमय ! सृष्टि स्थिति और प्रलय के कारण के ईश्वर ! हे परमात्मन् ! हे प्रभो ! आप ही महा विराट रूप तरु के बीज हो, आपको नमस्कार है
shambhu_gita::920.english_translation: O all-powerful one! You are the cause of creation, preservation, and destruction! O supreme being, you are the seed of the great cosmic tree; we bow to you.
shambhu_gita::920.translation_literal: विभो (O all-powerful one) / सृष्टि (creation) / रक्षा (preservation) / विनाशक (destruction) / हतः (cause) / परेभ्यः (from others) / पर (beyond) / त्वं (you) / प्रभो (O lord) / वर्तसेऽलम् (exist) / मही (earth) / यो (of) / विराह (separation) / पक्षस्य (of the side) / बीजं (seed) / वयं (we) / सर्वशक्तयात्मक (all-powerful) / त्वां (you) / नमामः (we bow)
shambhu_gita::920.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::920.essence: The supreme power is the root cause behind all cosmic cycles and forms.
shambhu_gita::920.simple_meaning: You are the source behind creation, preservation, and destruction. You are the seed of the great cosmic form. We honor you.
shambhu_gita::920.simple_insight: Recognition of a vast source beyond all change inspires respect and humility.
shambhu_gita::920.detailed_meaning: Suta describes the supreme power behind the cosmic cycles of birth, sustenance, and dissolution. This power is beyond others and is the root seed of the universe's great form. The sages honor this ultimate force.
shambhu_gita::920.insight: It invites seeing the universe as rooted in one source beyond all changes, deepening reverence for life’s cycles.

shambhu_gita::921.verse_sanskrit:
तवास्याङ्कुरेणैव मूलप्रकृत्या
तथा वर्त्यते विष्णुवेधोमहेशैः।
त्रिभिः स्कन्धरूपैः सुरादिभिस्तै
रनेकैर्हि शाखाप्रशाखास्वरूपैः ॥
shambhu_gita::921.verse_hindi: हे आशुतोष ! हे विश्वनाथ! आपकी मूल प्रकृति अंकुर है, ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश उसके तीन स्कन्ध हैं, ऋषिगण और देवतागण आदि उसकी शाखा प्रशाखा हैं,
shambhu_gita::921.english_translation: O Ashutosh, your original nature is a seed; Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh are its three branches; sages and gods are its many twigs and sub-branches.
shambhu_gita::921.translation_literal: तवास्याङ्कुरेणैव (by your seed alone) मूलप्रकृत्या (original nature) तथा (thus) वर्त्यते (exists) विष्णुवेधोमहेशैः (by Vishnu, Brahma, and Mahesh) त्रिभिः (three) स्कन्धरूपैः (branches-forms) सुरादिभिस्तै (by sages and gods) रनेकैर्हि (indeed many) शाखाप्रशाखास्वरूपैः (branches and sub-branches in form)
shambhu_gita::921.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::921.essence: All cosmic forms arise as branches from the singular seed of the divine’s original nature.
shambhu_gita::921.simple_meaning: The divine’s original nature is a seed that unfolds into many parts, including great beings like Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh, and many sages and radiant beings.
shambhu_gita::921.simple_insight: Everything arises from a single source that grows into many forms connected like branches of a tree.
shambhu_gita::921.detailed_meaning: The bard Suta describes Shiva’s original nature as a seed that sprouts into the three main aspects—Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh—and further into numerous sages and radiant beings, illustrating the unity and diversity of cosmic existence.
shambhu_gita::921.modern_relevance: Like a single idea branching into many projects and teams, your deepest nature can express itself in countless connected ways.
shambhu_gita::921.insight: It invites you to see all diverse forms as expressions of one underlying source, helping you find unity in apparent multiplicity.

shambhu_gita::922.verse_sanskrit:
अहो तस्य वृक्षस्य संसार एव
फलं विद्यते नात्र सन्देहलेशः।
विभो ! विश्वनाथ ! प्रणम्याशुतोष !
वयं सादरं साअलि त्वां नमामः ॥
shambhu_gita::922.verse_hindi: संसार उसका फल है, विभो ! विश्वनाथ ! आपको सादर हाथ जोड़कर नमस्कार है
shambhu_gita::922.english_translation: The fruit of that tree is the cycle of reactivity; there is no doubt about this. O Lord of the universe, O Ashutosh, we respectfully bow to you.
shambhu_gita::922.translation_literal: अहो (ah) / तस्य (of that) / वृक्षस्य (tree) / संसार (cycle of reactivity) / एव (indeed) / फलम् (fruit) / विद्यते (exists) / न (not) / अत्र (here) / सन्देहलेशः (doubt / hesitation) । विभो (O lord) ! विश्वनाथ (lord of the world) ! प्रणम्य (bowing) आशुतोष (Ashutosh) ! वयं (we) सादरं (respectfully) साअलि (to you) त्वां (you) नमामः (bow) ॥
shambhu_gita::922.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::922.essence: The cycle of reaction is the inevitable fruit of action, honored by bowing to the divine source.
shambhu_gita::922.simple_meaning: The endless cycle of reactions and consequences is like the fruit of a tree that cannot be denied. We respectfully honor the divine as the source.
shambhu_gita::922.simple_insight: Cycles of action and reaction are inevitable, yet respect for the divine source brings grounding.
shambhu_gita::922.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the narrator acknowledges that the cycle of Samsara is the inevitable outcome of actions, like the fruit of a tree. He respectfully salutes Shiva, recognizing him as the supreme source beyond this cycle.
shambhu_gita::922.insight: Recognize that consequences naturally arise from actions, and honoring the source brings clarity and respect.

shambhu_gita::923.verse_sanskrit:
अपि त्वं महीयस्तरोस्तस्य बीजं
तदाधार आस्सेऽखिलाधाररूपः।
निराधाररूपोऽपि धर्मात्मना तु
प्रभो ! धर्म मूर्ते! भवन्तं नमामः ॥
shambhu_gita::923.verse_hindi: हे धर्ममूर्ते ! आप उस महान् वृक्ष के वीज होने पर भी उसके आधाररूप हो और स्वयं निराधार होकर भी आप ही धर्मरूप से सबका आधार हो, आपको नमस्कार है
shambhu_gita::923.english_translation: O embodiment of dharma! Though you are the seed of that great tree, you are also its foundation; though formless, you are the support of all as the form of dharma. We bow to you.
shambhu_gita::923.translation_literal: अपि (even) त्वं (you) महीयस्तरोः (of the great tree) तस्य (of that) बीजं (seed) तद् (that) आधार (foundation) आस्से (are) अखिलाधाररूपः (form of support for all)। निराधाररूपः (form without foundation) अपि (also) धर्मात्मना (embodiment of dharma) तु (but) प्रभो (O lord)! धर्म (dharma) मूर्ते (embodiment)! भवन्तं (you) नमामः (we bow)!
shambhu_gita::923.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::923.essence: The ultimate source is also the enduring support of all as dharma's form.
shambhu_gita::923.simple_meaning: You are both the seed and the foundation of the great tree of dharma, formless yet the support of all through your form as dharma.
shambhu_gita::923.simple_insight: The divine can be both the hidden source and the visible support of everything.
shambhu_gita::923.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the speaker praises the divine as the embodiment of dharma, describing it as both the seed that begins the great cosmic tree and its sustaining foundation. The divine is formless yet manifests as the support of all existence.
shambhu_gita::923.insight: It reveals how something can be both the invisible cause and the visible support, inviting a view beyond duality.

shambhu_gita::924.verse_sanskrit:
विहारिन् ! विभो ! भक्तचेतोनिकेते
शरण्यं किलैकान्ततस्त्वां व्रजामः ।
यथा नो भवेदत्र कल्याणमाशु
तदेवाधुना देव ! शम्भो ! विधेहि ॥
shambhu_gita::924.verse_hindi: हे भक्तमनोमन्दिरविहारी ! अब हम आपके एकान्त शरणागत होते हैं, हे देव शम्भो ! जिससे हमारा शीघ्र कल्याण हो ऐसा करिये
shambhu_gita::924.english_translation: O beloved of devoted minds! Now we come as your sole refuge, O divine Shambhu! Please grant us swift welfare here.
shambhu_gita::924.translation_literal: विहारिन् (beloved) ! विभो (divine one) ! भक्तचेतोनि (devoted minds) केते (of the abode) शरण्यं (refuge) किल (indeed) ऐकान्त (sole) तस्मात् (from you) व्रजामः (we come)। यथा (so that) नः (our) भवेत् (may be) अत्र (here) कल्याणम् (welfare) आशु (swiftly) तदेव (that only) अधुना (now) देव (O divine) शम्भो (Shambhu) विधेहि (grant) ॥
shambhu_gita::924.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::924.essence: Complete trust in the divine refuge brings swift well-being and protection.
shambhu_gita::924.simple_meaning: You can fully surrender as the only refuge to the divine and receive quick help and well-being.
shambhu_gita::924.simple_insight: There is comfort in trusting a sacred refuge to bring swift care and protection.
shambhu_gita::924.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the devotee addresses Shiva as the beloved presence dwelling in devoted hearts, asking to become their only refuge and to grant them quick welfare amid their troubles.
shambhu_gita::924.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed, you can turn fully to a trusted source of support and find relief faster than expected.
shambhu_gita::924.insight: It teaches you to surrender your worries completely to a trusted refuge, opening space for quick healing.

shambhu_gita::925.verse_sanskrit:
भवतां सम्प्रसन्नोऽस्मि स्तवेरीभिः स्वधाभुजः ।
कल्याणं त्रिविधं भूयाद्भवद्भयो निश्चितं सदा ॥
shambhu_gita::925.verse_hindi: हे संसारसुखदायी पितृगण ! मैं आपकी इन स्तुतियों से प्रसन्न हूँ, आप लोगों का सदा विविध कल्याण हो
shambhu_gita::925.english_translation: O beings who bring worldly happiness! I am pleased with your praises; may you always have assured threefold welfare.
shambhu_gita::925.translation_literal: भवतां (your) / सम्प्रसन्नः (pleased) / अस्मि (I am) / स्तवेरीभिः (by praises) / स्वधाभुजः (O beings who bring worldly happiness) । / कल्याणं (welfare) / त्रिविधं (threefold) / भूयात् (may it be) / भवत् (your) / भयः (fear) / निश्चितं (assured) / सदा (always) ॥
shambhu_gita::925.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::925.essence: Receiving genuine praise inspires blessings for assured, triple welfare.
shambhu_gita::925.simple_meaning: The divine expresses happiness at the praises and wishes the beings constant assured well-being in three ways.
shambhu_gita::925.simple_insight: Receiving sincere praise can inspire goodwill and blessings for others.
shambhu_gita::925.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Shiva acknowledges and appreciates the praises offered by the beings who bring happiness. He blesses them with lasting and certain welfare in threefold aspects, emphasizing his connection and goodwill toward those who honor him.
shambhu_gita::925.insight: It shows the power of gratitude and appreciation to foster positive relationships and blessings.

shambhu_gita::926.verse_sanskrit:
प्राप्य त्रिविधकल्याणमेवं मुक्तिपदेऽनिशम् ।
अग्रेसरत निर्वाधं सलीलं विश्वभूतिदाः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::926.verse_hindi: और विविध कल्याण प्राप्त करके आप मुक्तिपद में अनायास बेरोक अग्रसर हो
shambhu_gita::926.english_translation: Having attained the threefold welfare, beings effortlessly progress unhindered on the path to liberation, flowing like the source of the universe.
shambhu_gita::926.translation_literal: प्राप्य (having attained) त्रिविध (threefold) कल्याणम् (welfare) एवं (thus) मुक्तिपदे (in the state of liberation) अनिशम् (without interruption) अग्रसरम् (progressing forward) निर्वाधं (unhindered) सलीलम् (like flowing water) विश्वभूतिदाः (source of the universe)
shambhu_gita::926.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::926.essence: Complete well-being opens a smooth, unstoppable path to lasting freedom.
shambhu_gita::926.simple_meaning: After gaining all-round well-being, you move smoothly and without obstacles toward lasting inner freedom.
shambhu_gita::926.simple_insight: There is peace in knowing full well-being leads naturally to liberation.
shambhu_gita::926.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes how once a person achieves three kinds of well-being, they advance effortlessly without any barriers toward liberation, like water flowing from the universe's source. This verse highlights the smooth progress on the spiritual path after essential growth.
shambhu_gita::926.modern_relevance: You’ve worked hard on your health, relationships, and mind. Now progress toward freedom feels natural and unstoppable.
shambhu_gita::926.insight: It teaches that complete welfare in body, mind, and spirit clears the way for effortless spiritual advancement.

shambhu_gita::927.verse_sanskrit:
जैवैशसहजाख्यानां द्रष्टा सन् कर्मणामहम् ।
गया स्वतन्त्रयाऽमीभिस्त्रिभिरेव स्वतन्त्रया ॥
shambhu_gita::927.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! मैं जैव ऐश और सहज कर्म का द्रष्टा होकर इन तीनों के द्वारा ही स्वतन्त्र स्वतन्त्र गति से
shambhu_gita::927.english_translation: O ancestors! I am the witness of natural, essential action and the self; through these three alone, I move freely and independently.
shambhu_gita::927.translation_literal: जैवैशसहजाख्यानां (natural-essential actions) / द्रष्टा (witness) / सन् (being) / कर्मणामहम् (of actions I) / गया (gone) / स्वतन्त्रया (freely) / अमीभिः (by these) / त्रिभिरेव (three only) / स्वतन्त्रया (freely)
shambhu_gita::927.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::927.essence: Freedom arises by witnessing natural action as the true self beyond it.
shambhu_gita::927.simple_meaning: You are the observer who watches natural and essential actions without interference; through this witnessing, you move with true freedom.
shambhu_gita::927.simple_insight: You can rest in the freedom that comes from seeing your actions without becoming them.
shambhu_gita::927.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, identifying himself as the witness of three forms of natural action and the true self; this witnessing grants complete freedom beyond binding effects.
shambhu_gita::927.modern_relevance: When you watch your impulses and choices without judgment, you create space to act freely instead of reactively.
shambhu_gita::927.insight: It teaches you to cultivate the inner observer that lets you act naturally while remaining free from attachment.

shambhu_gita::928.verse_sanskrit:
सम्प्रयच्छामि कैवल्यं त्रिविध वैविशेषतः।
नैव कश्चन सन्देहो विद्यतेऽत्र स्वधाभुनः !॥
shambhu_gita::928.verse_hindi: सम्यक् त्रिविध मुक्ति का विधान करता हूँ, इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है
shambhu_gita::928.english_translation: I now explain the three distinct types of complete freedom; there is no doubt about this.
shambhu_gita::928.translation_literal: सम्प्रयच्छामि (I explain) / कैवल्यं (complete freedom) / त्रिविध (threefold) / वैविशेषतः (distinctly) / नैव (not at all) / कश्चन (anyone) / सन्देहो (doubt) / विद्यते (exists) / अत्र (here) / स्वधाभुनः (of the self)
shambhu_gita::928.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::928.essence: Complete freedom exists in three clear, distinct forms beyond doubt.
shambhu_gita::928.simple_meaning: There are three specific kinds of complete inner freedom, and this teaching explains them clearly without any doubt.
shambhu_gita::928.simple_insight: You can trust that total freedom is achievable in clear, distinct ways.
shambhu_gita::928.detailed_meaning: Shiva begins teaching about the three distinct kinds of complete freedom (moksha) so clearly that there is no uncertainty. This sets the stage for deep exploration of liberation forms in the text.
shambhu_gita::928.modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic, knowing there are clear, distinct ways to find lasting inner freedom can bring calm and direction.
shambhu_gita::928.insight: It shifts your mind to expect clarity and certainty about liberation rather than confusion or doubt.

shambhu_gita::929.verse_sanskrit:
जैवेन कर्मणा दत्त्वा पदं शुक्लपथान्वयि ।
ऐशेन कर्मणा नूनं पदं त्रैमौर्तिकं वरम् ॥
shambhu_gita::929.verse_hindi: ऐश कर्म से त्रिमूर्तिपद और जैव कर्म द्वारा शुक्लपथगामी पद प्रदान करके
shambhu_gita::929.english_translation: By the living being's action, one attains the white path; by the divine's action, surely the supreme place of the three deities is attained.
shambhu_gita::929.translation_literal: जैवेन (by the living being) / कर्मणा (action) / दत्त्वा (giving) / पदं (a path) / शुक्लपथान्वयि (leading to the white path) / ऐशेन (by the divine) / कर्मणा (action) / नूनं (certainly) / पदं (a place) / त्रैमौर्तिकं (of the three deities) / वरम् (supreme)
shambhu_gita::929.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::929.essence: Your choice of action shapes your path beyond this life.
shambhu_gita::929.simple_meaning: What you do shapes where you go after life: ordinary actions lead to a pure path; divine actions lead to the highest realm.
shambhu_gita::929.simple_insight: Knowing your actions guide your journey brings responsibility and hope.
shambhu_gita::929.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains how actions by ordinary beings offer a path of purity after death, while divine or higher actions grant access to the supreme realm of the three deities, marking two distinct outcomes based on karma.
shambhu_gita::929.modern_relevance: When you decide between routine tasks and inspired actions, you shape your future beyond immediate results.
shambhu_gita::929.insight: Recognize that your intentions and the nature of your actions influence your life's long-term direction.

shambhu_gita::930.verse_sanskrit:
जीवन्मुक्तिपदं श्रेष्ठं कर्मणा सहजेन च ।
सार्थकं स्वं त्रिनेत्रत्वं विदधेऽहं स्वधाभुजः ॥
shambhu_gita::930.verse_hindi: और सहज कर्म से श्रेष्ठ जीवन्मुक्त पद प्रदान करके अपने त्रिनेत्र की सार्थकता करता हूँ
shambhu_gita::930.english_translation: I grant the supreme state of liberation in life through natural action and demonstrate the true purpose of my three-eyed form.
shambhu_gita::930.translation_literal: जीवनम् (life) मुक्तिपदम् (liberation state) श्रेष्ठम् (supreme) कर्मणा (by action) सहजेन (natural) च (and) । सार्थकं (meaningful) स्वं (own) त्रिनेत्रत्वं (three-eyed nature) विदधेऽहं (I give) स्वधाभुजः (the one with own arms) ॥
shambhu_gita::930.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::930.essence: Supreme freedom arises through natural, effortless action revealing true meaning.
shambhu_gita::930.simple_meaning: True liberation comes from acting naturally and effortlessly, revealing the deeper meaning behind your actions.
shambhu_gita::930.simple_insight: There's peace in knowing your natural actions can lead to the highest freedom.
shambhu_gita::930.detailed_meaning: Shiva, known as the three-eyed one, explains that the highest freedom in life arises not from forced effort but from spontaneous, natural action that fulfills deeper purpose.
shambhu_gita::930.modern_relevance: You find freedom not by forcing every move but by trusting your natural flow in daily tasks.
shambhu_gita::930.insight: It shifts your focus from controlling results to embracing natural, effortless action as the path to freedom.

shambhu_gita::931.verse_sanskrit:
वर्णाश्रमीयधर्माणां भवन्तो रक्षका यतः।
अतः सहैव सम्बन्धस्त्रिभिर्व: परियुज्यते ॥
shambhu_gita::931.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! वर्णाश्रमधर्म के रक्षक होने के कारण तीनों से ही आपका सम्बन्ध है,
shambhu_gita::931.english_translation: O ancestors, as protectors of the duties of the four classes and stages of life, you have a relationship with all three.
shambhu_gita::931.translation_literal: वर्णाश्रमीयधर्माणां (of duties of the four classes and stages of life) / भवन्तो (being) / रक्षका (protectors) / यतः (because) / अतः (therefore) / सहैव (with also) / सम्बन्धः (relationship) / त्रिभिः (with three) / वः (you) / परियुज्यते (is connected)
shambhu_gita::931.speaker: Suta
shambhu_gita::931.essence: Protecting social duties links you to diverse groups simultaneously.
shambhu_gita::931.simple_meaning: The ancestors have connections with all three groups because they protect the duties of the four social classes and life stages.
shambhu_gita::931.simple_insight: Guardians of duty have ties across many roles and groups.
shambhu_gita::931.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses the sages, explaining that the ancestors maintain relationships with three groups because they uphold the duties related to the social and spiritual divisions known as the four classes and life stages.
shambhu_gita::931.insight: Recognize how fulfilling your role creates connections beyond immediate circles.

shambhu_gita::932.verse_sanskrit:
यत्राग्रगामिभावस्य वर्त्ततेच्छात्र वो मुदा।
तदग्रेसरतां लव्धुं भवन्तः शक्नुवन्ति च ॥
shambhu_gita::932.verse_hindi: जिसकी ओर आप अग्रसर होना चाहते हो, हो सकते हो
shambhu_gita::932.english_translation: You can become what you want to move toward.
shambhu_gita::932.translation_literal: यत्र (where) अग्रगामी (moving forward) भावस्य (of the feeling/state) वर्त्तते (exists) छात्र (you) वो (you) मुदा (joy). तद् (that) अग्रसरतां (advancement) लव्धुं (to obtain) भवन्तः (you all) शक्नुवन्ति (are able) च (also).
shambhu_gita::932.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::932.essence: You have the ability to become what your heart truly desires.
shambhu_gita::932.simple_meaning: You can become what you want to move toward if you have the desire and willingness.
shambhu_gita::932.simple_insight: You hold the power to move toward your true calling and potential.
shambhu_gita::932.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Shiva encourages moving toward the feelings and states you desire. If your heart is set on a goal or higher purpose, you have the capacity to achieve it.
shambhu_gita::932.modern_relevance: You feel drawn to a new career or passion, unsure if you can change — this reminds you that your desire itself is the first step toward becoming.
shambhu_gita::932.insight: Recognize that your intentions and desires empower you to progress; focus your energy on what you want to become.

shambhu_gita::933.verse_sanskrit:
भवन्तो धर्ममाश्रित्य कर्तव्यज्ञानतत्पराः ।
पितरः ! स्वीयकार्येषु निरता भवत ध्रुवम् ॥
shambhu_gita::933.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! आप धर्म का आश्रय करके कर्तव्यबुद्धिपरायण होकर अपने कार्य में तत्पर हो
shambhu_gita::933.english_translation: O ancestors! Rely on your dharma and be devoted to understanding your duty, firmly engaged in your own work.
shambhu_gita::933.translation_literal: भवन्तो (you all) / धर्ममाश्रित्य (relying on dharma) / कर्तव्यज्ञानतत्पराः (devoted to knowledge of duty) / पितरः (ancestors) / स्वीयकार्येषु (in your own works) / निरता (engaged) / भवत (be) / ध्रुवम् (firmly)
shambhu_gita::933.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::933.essence: Firmly focus on your own duty by relying on your true purpose and understanding.
shambhu_gita::933.simple_meaning: You should rely on your true purpose and be deeply focused on understanding and performing your own duties.
shambhu_gita::933.simple_insight: There is power in trusting your own responsibility and fully engaging with it.
shambhu_gita::933.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses the ancestors, encouraging them to anchor themselves in their dharma—righteous purpose—and to devote their attention to understanding and performing their own duties with full commitment.
shambhu_gita::933.modern_relevance: When distractions pull you in many directions, grounding yourself in your own responsibilities helps you stay steady and effective.
shambhu_gita::933.insight: It teaches you to anchor your energy in your own responsibilities rather than comparing or wandering aimlessly.

shambhu_gita::934.verse_sanskrit:
तथा जगति धर्माणां पूर्णरूपप्रकाशने ।
सहायकाः सदा यूयं भवत द्रागतन्द्रिताः ॥
shambhu_gita::934.verse_hindi: और जगत में धर्म का पूर्ण स्वरूप प्रकाश करने में आलस्य रहित होकर सदा सहायक हो
shambhu_gita::934.english_translation: And always be diligent helpers in fully illuminating the true nature of dharma in the world.
shambhu_gita::934.translation_literal: तथा (and) जगति (in the world) धर्माणां (of dharmas) पूर्णरूपप्रकाशने (in full-form illumination) । सहायकाः (helpers) सदा (always) यूयं (you) भवत (be) द्रागतन्द्रिताः (without laziness) ॥
shambhu_gita::934.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::934.essence: Helping fully reveal dharma requires steady, eager participation without laziness.
shambhu_gita::934.simple_meaning: You should always support the complete revelation of what true dharma is without laziness.
shambhu_gita::934.simple_insight: There's strength in steady, eager help to bring dharma’s fullness to light.
shambhu_gita::934.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Shiva urges his followers to be active and eager helpers in revealing the full truth of dharma to the world, emphasizing the importance of consistent effort without laziness.
shambhu_gita::934.modern_relevance: You show up every day ready to share what matters, even when the task feels big or tiring.
shambhu_gita::934.insight: It teaches you to stay consistently engaged without delaying or avoiding your role in supporting what is right.

shambhu_gita::935.verse_sanskrit:
मत्परायणतां सेवातत्परत्वञ्च मे बिना ।
ऋते मद्युक्तचित्तत्वं साफल्यं वो न सम्भवेत् ॥
shambhu_gita::935.verse_hindi: परन्तु मत्सेवापरोयण, मद्गतचित्त और मत्परायण हुए बिना  आप सफल काम नहीं हो सकेंगे।
shambhu_gita::935.english_translation: Without devoted service to me, a mind absorbed in me, and complete surrender to me, your success cannot be achieved.
shambhu_gita::935.translation_literal: मत्परायणतां (devotion to me) / सेवातत्परत्वञ्च (service as supreme) / मे (to me) / बिना (without) / ऋते (without) / मद्युक्तचित्तत्वं (mind absorbed in me) / साफल्यं (success) / वो (your) / न (not) / सम्भवेत् (can happen)
shambhu_gita::935.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::935.essence: True success requires devotion, selfless service, and full surrender to the divine.
shambhu_gita::935.simple_meaning: You cannot achieve true success without fully dedicating yourself through devotion, selfless service, and surrender to the divine.
shambhu_gita::935.simple_insight: There is peace in knowing complete commitment to the divine brings true success.
shambhu_gita::935.detailed_meaning: Shiva teaches that success depends on fully embracing three qualities: devotion to him, selfless service, and a mind absorbed in him. Without these, efforts lack the needed spiritual foundation to truly succeed.
shambhu_gita::935.modern_relevance: You gave your all to a project, but real success came only when you fully committed yourself beyond just action.
shambhu_gita::935.insight: It teaches you to align your heart, service, and surrender as a unified path toward success.

shambhu_gita::936.verse_sanskrit:
उच्यते सुगमोपायः श्रूयतां विश्वभूतिदाः।
वरिष्ठं यं समालम्ब्य कृच्छ्राव कृच्छ्रतरेप्वपि ॥
shambhu_gita::936.verse_hindi: उसके लिये आपको उपाय बताता हूँ, सुनो। उस श्रेष्ठ उपाय को अवलम्बन करने पर आप कठिन से कठिन कर्म में रत रहने पर भी
shambhu_gita::936.english_translation: I reveal an easy method; hear it. By relying on this supreme method, even in the hardest tasks you remain steady.
shambhu_gita::936.translation_literal: उच्यते (is said) सुगमोपायः (an easy method) श्रूयतां (let it be heard) विश्वभूतिदाः (bestowers of all beings) वरिष्ठं (supreme) यं (which) समालम्ब्य (relying on) कृच्छ्राव (in difficulties) कृच्छ्रतरेपि (even in harder ones)
shambhu_gita::936.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::936.essence: Relying on the supreme method keeps you steady even in extreme hardship.
shambhu_gita::936.simple_meaning: You can endure even the toughest challenges if you rely on the best and easiest method given.
shambhu_gita::936.simple_insight: There is strength in knowing a supreme method can carry you through hardship.
shambhu_gita::936.detailed_meaning: Shiva addresses those facing difficult challenges, offering them a supreme, easy method to rely on that helps maintain steadiness even in the hardest efforts.
shambhu_gita::936.modern_relevance: When work overwhelms you and every step feels harder, knowing a steady approach can carry you through makes all the difference.
shambhu_gita::936.insight: It teaches you to anchor your effort in a proven supreme approach, making tough tasks manageable.

shambhu_gita::937.verse_sanskrit:
सक्ताः कार्येषु मद्भक्तेर्विमुखा न भविष्यथ । 
नूनमेकोऽद्वितीयोऽपि स्वभक्तेभ्यो निरन्तरम् ॥
shambhu_gita::937.verse_hindi: मेरी उपासना से च्युत नहीं हो सकोगे । हे पितरो! मैं एक और अद्वितीय होने पर भी
shambhu_gita::937.english_translation: Those devoted to me will never turn away from their duties; even the unique one remains constant in devotion.
shambhu_gita::937.translation_literal: सक्ताः (devoted) कार्येषु (in actions) मद्भक्तेः (to me, the devotee) विमुखा (turned away) न (not) भविष्यथ (will become). नूनम् (indeed) एकः (one) अद्वितीयः (unique) अपि (also) स्वभक्तेभ्यः (from their devotees) निरन्तरम् (always).
shambhu_gita::937.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::937.essence: True devotion anchors you firmly in your duties without turning away.
shambhu_gita::937.simple_meaning: If you are devoted to the divine, you will not abandon your responsibilities. Even the one who is unique stays true to their devotion.
shambhu_gita::937.simple_insight: Knowing your devotion keeps you grounded brings calm and confidence in your actions.
shambhu_gita::937.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Shiva reassures that those who devote themselves to him will remain committed to their duties. Even the supreme unique being never turns away from devotion, showing its unbreakable power.
shambhu_gita::937.modern_relevance: When you feel tempted to give up your commitments, remember your deeper devotion can keep you steady and true.
shambhu_gita::937.insight: This verse teaches you to rely on your inner devotion as a steady guide that prevents wavering in your actions.

shambhu_gita::938.verse_sanskrit:
नानाविभूतिरूपेण दत्त्वा दर्शनमद्भुतम् ।
तन्मनोरथसाफल्यं विदधेऽहं स्वधाभुजः ॥
shambhu_gita::938.verse_hindi: नाना विभूतिरूप से अपने भक्तो को हर समय दर्शन देकर सफल मनोरथ किया करता हूँ
shambhu_gita::938.english_translation: I grant my devotees wondrous visions in many forms and fulfill their heartfelt desires.
shambhu_gita::938.translation_literal: नानाविभूतिरूपेण (in many wondrous forms) / दत्त्वा (giving) / दर्शनमद्भुतम् (wondrous visions) / तन्मनोरथसाफल्यं (fulfilling their heartfelt desires) / विदधेऽहं (I grant) / स्वधाभुजः (to my devotees)
shambhu_gita::938.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::938.essence: Devotion invites wondrous experiences and fulfillment beyond ordinary understanding.
shambhu_gita::938.simple_meaning: The divine reveals amazing forms to those devoted and fulfills the true desires of their hearts.
shambhu_gita::938.simple_insight: You can feel deeply seen and cared for, as your sincere wishes are honored.
shambhu_gita::938.detailed_meaning: Shiva speaks to his devotees, explaining that he appears in many wondrous forms to grant them visions and fulfills their heartfelt desires, showing the intimate care in devotion.
shambhu_gita::938.modern_relevance: When you feel unseen or unheard, remember that devotion opens a connection where your true wishes are recognized and fulfilled.
shambhu_gita::938.insight: It invites you to trust that genuine devotion brings a response beyond ordinary expectations, deepening your connection.

shambhu_gita::939.verse_sanskrit:
दिव्यानां मे विभूतीनां नान्तो यद्यपि विद्यते ।
जनन्यो वः पराभक्तेः कियत्यस्तु विभूतयः ॥
shambhu_gita::939.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! यद्यपि मेरी दिव्य विभूतियों के बाहुल्य का अन्त नहीं है तब भी मैं तुम्हारे में परा भक्ति की उत्पादक कुछ विभूतियों का
shambhu_gita::939.english_translation: O ancestors, though my divine manifestations have no end, I create some manifestations that produce supreme devotion in you.
shambhu_gita::939.translation_literal: दिव्यानां (of the divine) मे (my) विभूतीनां (manifestations) नान्तो (no end) यद्यपि (though) विद्यते (exists) । जनन्यो (producing) वः (your) पराभक्तेः (supreme devotion) कियत्यस्तु (some) विभूतयः (manifestations) ॥
shambhu_gita::939.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::939.essence: Some divine manifestations exist solely to awaken your highest devotion.
shambhu_gita::939.simple_meaning: The divine has countless forms, but some arise especially to inspire your highest devotion.
shambhu_gita::939.simple_insight: Knowing that some divine forms exist just to inspire you brings a warm connection.
shambhu_gita::939.detailed_meaning: Shiva speaks to the ancestors, explaining that although his divine manifestations are infinite, certain forms specifically arise to awaken the deepest devotion in beings.
shambhu_gita::939.modern_relevance: When you notice certain experiences or people stirring your heartfelt devotion, you glimpse how some things exist just to open your heart.
shambhu_gita::939.insight: It teaches you to recognize and cherish moments or forms that deepen your devoted love and connection.

shambhu_gita::940.verse_sanskrit:
सङ्केपतः प्रवक्ष्यन्ते श्रूयन्तां ताः समाहितैः।
भूतेषु चेतनः सृष्टिीस्थतिसंहाररूपकः ॥
shambhu_gita::940.verse_hindi: संक्षेप से वर्णन करता हूँ, सुनो । भूतगण के भीतर मैं चेतना हूँ । भूतो का सृष्टि स्थिति और संहा ररूपी
shambhu_gita::940.english_translation: I will briefly explain: Among beings, I am the consciousness that manifests as creation, preservation, and destruction.
shambhu_gita::940.translation_literal: सङ्केपतः (briefly) / प्रवक्ष्यन्ते (will be spoken) / श्रूयन्तां (let them hear) / ताः (those) / समाहितैः (by the focused) । / भूतेषु (among beings) / चेतनः (consciousness) / सृष्टिीस्थतिसंहाररूपकः (form of creation, preservation, destruction) ॥
shambhu_gita::940.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::940.essence: Consciousness within beings is the force of creation, preservation, and destruction.
shambhu_gita::940.simple_meaning: I am the consciousness within all beings that takes the form of creating, sustaining, and dissolving the world.
shambhu_gita::940.simple_insight: There is a guiding awareness behind all change and life you see around you.
shambhu_gita::940.detailed_meaning: In the midst of the many forms of life and matter, Shiva declares himself as the conscious presence that underlies the entire cycle of creation, maintenance, and destruction, revealing his cosmic role.
shambhu_gita::940.insight: Recognize the consciousness behind all change as the constant presence within everything.

shambhu_gita::941.verse_sanskrit:
परिणामो भवेत्तेपां यश्च सोऽस्म्यहमेव भोः। 
प्रतिब्रह्माण्डमध्येऽस्मि त्रिमूर्तिश्च स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::941.verse_hindi: जो परिणाम होता है सो मैं ही हूँ। प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड में मैं त्रिमूर्ति हूँ
shambhu_gita::941.english_translation: I am the result of all actions. In every universe, I am the three forms and the support of the self.
shambhu_gita::941.translation_literal: परिणामो (result) भवेत्तेपां (of the effect is) यश्च (who) सोऽस्म्यहमेव (that I am indeed) भोः (am). / प्रतिब्रह्माण्डमध्येऽस्मि (within every universe I am) त्रिमूर्तिश्च (the three forms also) स्वधाभुजः (and the support of the self)!
shambhu_gita::941.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::941.essence: The supreme presence is both the cause and effect, embodying all forms everywhere.
shambhu_gita::941.simple_meaning: The divine identifies as the source and result of all things, present as the three forms in every universe.
shambhu_gita::941.simple_insight: The divine's presence in all forms can feel overwhelming without clear understanding.
shambhu_gita::941.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares that he is not only the origin but also the outcome of everything, manifesting as the trinity within every universe, revealing his all-pervading nature.
shambhu_gita::941.insight: Recognize that what seems separate as cause and effect is one unified presence beyond duality.

shambhu_gita::942.verse_sanskrit:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं देवानाञ्च पुरन्दरः ।
अधिभताभुष्वत्र भवत्स्वस्म्यहमर्यमा ॥
shambhu_gita::942.verse_hindi: देवताओं में मैं इन्द्र हूँ । महर्षियों में मैं भृगु हूँ और अधिभूतेश्वर आप लोगों में मैं अयशा हूँ ।
shambhu_gita::942.english_translation: Among the gods, I am Indra; among sages, I am Bhrigu; among rulers, I am Ayasa among you.
shambhu_gita::942.translation_literal: महर्षीणां (among sages) / भृगु (Bhrigu) / अहं (I) / देवानां (among gods) / च (and) / पुरन्दरः (Indra) / अधिभता (among rulers) / भूष्वत्र (here) / भवत् (your) / स्वस्म्यहम् (I am) / अर्यमा (Ayasa)
shambhu_gita::942.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::942.essence: The supreme self manifests uniquely in each revered role and group.
shambhu_gita::942.simple_meaning: I am the leader among gods as Indra, the foremost sage as Bhrigu, and the chief ruler Ayasa among you.
shambhu_gita::942.simple_insight: Recognizing the divine in many forms reveals the unity behind diverse roles.
shambhu_gita::942.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares his presence in various exalted forms: as Indra among gods, Bhrigu among sages, and Ayasa among rulers, emphasizing his supreme presence through recognized figures in each group.
shambhu_gita::942.insight: It shifts your view to see the true self expressed in many roles and forms around you.

shambhu_gita::943.verse_sanskrit:
मानवानामहं राजा शासकेषु यमोऽस्म्यहम् ।
इन्द्रियेषु मनश्चास्मि जहनुकन्या नदीषु च ॥
shambhu_gita::943.verse_hindi: मनुष्यों में राजा हूं और शासकोंमें यम हूँ। इन्द्रियों में मन हूँ । मैं नदियों में गंगा हूँ
shambhu_gita::943.english_translation: Among humans, I am the king; among rulers, I am Yama. Among the senses, I am the mind; among rivers, I am the Ganges.
shambhu_gita::943.translation_literal: मानवानामहं (among humans I am) राजा (king) शासकेषु (among rulers) यमोऽस्म्यहम् (I am Yama) । इन्द्रियेषु (among senses) मनश्चास्मि (I am the mind) जहनुकन्या (among rivers) नदीषु (in rivers) च (also) ॥
shambhu_gita::943.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::943.essence: The divine is the highest principle expressed in every realm of existence.
shambhu_gita::943.simple_meaning: The divine identifies with the highest or most important aspect in every category: leader among humans, judge among rulers, mind among senses, and sacred river among waters.
shambhu_gita::943.simple_insight: Recognizing the divine within all key roles and forces invites seeing unity in diversity.
shambhu_gita::943.detailed_meaning: Shiva speaks in metaphor, describing how the divine essence manifests as the greatest or most significant principle in various domains: the king among humans, the regulator of death among rulers, the mind that guides the senses, and the holy Ganges among rivers. This illustrates the divine's pervasive presence.
shambhu_gita::943.modern_relevance: You see leaders, judges, your thoughts, and sacred places as distinct, but this verse invites you to feel the unified source behind all roles and forces shaping your world.
shambhu_gita::943.insight: It encourages seeing beyond surface differences to the singular essence expressed in many forms.

shambhu_gita::944.verse_sanskrit:
जलाशयेषु जलधिर्मन्त्रेषु प्रणवोऽस्म्यहम् ।
वर्णेप्वोंकाररूपोऽहं यज्ञेषु जपयज्ञकः ॥
shambhu_gita::944.verse_hindi: और जलशयों में सागर हूं। मन्त्रों में प्रणव हूं और अक्षरों में ओंकार हूँ । यशों में जपयज्ञ हूँ
shambhu_gita::944.english_translation: I am the ocean among lakes, the sacred syllable among mantras, the sound Om among letters, and the chanting sacrificial rite among sacrifices.
shambhu_gita::944.translation_literal: जलाशयेषु (among lakes) जलधि (the ocean) मन्त्रेषु (among mantras) प्रणवः (the sacred syllable) अस्मि (I am) अहम् (I) । वर्णे (in letters) अपि (also) ओंकाररूपः (form of Om) अहम् (I am) यज्ञेषु (among sacrifices) जपयज्ञकः (the chanting sacrifice) ॥
shambhu_gita::944.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::944.essence: A supreme presence pervades all sacred forms and elements as their unifying core.
shambhu_gita::944.simple_meaning: I am the greatest and most essential presence in all things — the ocean among waters, the sacred sound in mantras, the syllable Om in letters, and the chant in sacrifices.
shambhu_gita::944.simple_insight: There is a core essence that underlies and unifies everything you experience.
shambhu_gita::944.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares his supreme presence by comparing himself to the greatest and most sacred elements in nature and ritual: the ocean among waters, the sacred syllable among mantras, the Om sound in letters, and the vital chant in rituals. This moment reveals his cosmic identity.
shambhu_gita::944.insight: Recognize the underlying unity behind all diverse forms and practices, inviting respect and awe.

shambhu_gita::945.verse_sanskrit:
आकर्षकेषु देशोऽस्मि काल: कलयतामहम् ।
पृज्येषु विग्रहप्वस्मि शिवलिङ्गः स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::945.verse_hindi: मैं वश करनेवालों में काल हूँ और आकर्षण करनेवालों में देश हूँ। हे पितृगण ! पूजा उपयोगी विग्रह में मैं शिवलिङ्ग हूँ
shambhu_gita::945.english_translation: Among those who control, I am time; among those who attract, I am the realm. O ancestors, in the form suitable for worship, I am the Shiva linga.
shambhu_gita::945.translation_literal: आकर्षकेषु (among those who attract) देशोऽस्मि (I am the realm) काल: (time) कलयतामहम् (among those who control) । पृज्येषु (among worshippers) विग्रहप्वस्मि (I am the form) शिवलिङ्गः (Shiva linga) स्वधाभुजः (suitable for worship) ॥
shambhu_gita::945.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::945.essence: The divine manifests as time, realm, and sacred form beyond ordinary perception.
shambhu_gita::945.simple_meaning: I am the force of time among controllers and the realm among attractors; in worship, I appear as the Shiva linga.
shambhu_gita::945.simple_insight: The divine expresses power as time, presence as realm, and devotion as sacred form.
shambhu_gita::945.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares his cosmic aspects: as time that controls all, as the realm that draws beings, and as the sacred form for worship. This reveals his all-encompassing nature beyond ordinary limits.
shambhu_gita::945.insight: It invites recognizing the divine influence in forces shaping control, attraction, and sacred presence.

shambhu_gita::946.verse_sanskrit:
भक्तिक्रियाम् भक्तानां चक्ररूपोऽहमस्मि च ।
देवपीठसमूहेषु निश्चितं पितृपुङ्गवाः ॥
shambhu_gita::946.verse_hindi: भक्तगण के भक्तिक्रिया में मैं चक्र हूँ। देवपीठ समूह में मैं
shambhu_gita::946.english_translation: In the devoted actions of devotees, I am the wheel; among the assembly of divine seats, I am the foremost ancestor.
shambhu_gita::946.translation_literal: भक्तिक्रियाम् (in devoted actions) भक्तानां (of devotees) चक्ररूपोऽहमस्मि (I am in the form of the wheel) च (and) । देवपीठसमूहेषु (among the group of divine seats) निश्चितं (certainly) पितृपुङ्गवाः (foremost ancestor) ॥
shambhu_gita::946.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::946.essence: The divine is the central force in devotion and honored leader among sacred assemblies.
shambhu_gita::946.simple_meaning: The divine identifies as the central force within the devoted acts of believers, also honored as the chief ancestor among sacred assemblies.
shambhu_gita::946.simple_insight: There is a sacred center guiding devotion and ancestral presence within spiritual gatherings.
shambhu_gita::946.detailed_meaning: Shiva speaks of his presence as the core force—the wheel—in the devoted actions of his followers, also recognized as the leading ancestor among divine assemblies, emphasizing his integral role in devotion and spiritual lineage.
shambhu_gita::946.insight: It reveals how the divine presence sustains devotion and connection within sacred communities.

shambhu_gita::947.verse_sanskrit:
नूनं सहजपीठात्मा पीठोऽस्मि मिथुनाह्वयः ।
उपासनायाः स्थानं तु प्रासादप्रमुखेष्वहम् ॥
shambhu_gita::947.verse_hindi: सहजपीठ रूपी मिथुन पीठ हूँ । प्रासादादि में मैं उपासनास्थान हूँ
shambhu_gita::947.english_translation: I am the natural seat, the twin seat; among grand halls, I am the place of worship.
shambhu_gita::947.translation_literal: नूनं (indeed) सहजपीठात्मा (natural-seat-being) पीठोऽस्मि (seat-I am) मिथुनाह्वयः (called twin) । उपासनायाः (of worship) स्थानं (place) तु (but) प्रासादप्रमुखेष्वहम् (among grand-halls-I am) ॥
shambhu_gita::947.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::947.essence: The divine is the natural seat and sacred place within grand spaces of worship.
shambhu_gita::947.simple_meaning: I am the natural seat called the twin seat, and among grand halls, I am the place where worship happens.
shambhu_gita::947.simple_insight: Recognizing the divine presence in sacred places offers rootedness and reverence.
shambhu_gita::947.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes himself metaphorically as the natural, twin seat and as the sacred space within grand halls where worship occurs, emphasizing his immanence in places of devotion.
shambhu_gita::947.insight: This verse invites you to sense the divine presence in the places you honor and return to for connection.

shambhu_gita::948.verse_sanskrit:
नमस्येषु हि दृश्येपु नूनमस्मि स्वधाभुजः !।
बटुकश्च कुमारी च दम्पती शव एव च ॥
shambhu_gita::948.verse_hindi: नमस्य दृश्यों में मैं बटुक कुमारी दम्पती और शव हूँ
shambhu_gita::948.english_translation: Among the objects to be worshipped, I am the boy, the girl, the couple, and even the corpse.
shambhu_gita::948.translation_literal: नमस्येषु (among worshippable) हि (indeed) दृश्ये (objects/visions) अपि (also) नूनम् (certainly) अस्मि (I am) स्वधाभुजः (a boy) / बटुकः (boy) / च (and) कुमारी (girl) / च (and) दम्पती (couple) / शवः (corpse) / एव (indeed) च (also)
shambhu_gita::948.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::948.essence: The divine dwells equally in all beings, from youth to death.
shambhu_gita::948.simple_meaning: The divine is present in all forms, from children and couples to even the dead body.
shambhu_gita::948.simple_insight: Everything you see to revere includes all stages and forms of life and death.
shambhu_gita::948.detailed_meaning: Shiva declares that the divine presence pervades all beings and forms worthy of respect — from innocent children to married couples and even lifeless bodies, emphasizing the unity behind appearances.
shambhu_gita::948.modern_relevance: You meet people every day in all states of life and loss, and the divine spark is present in all.
shambhu_gita::948.insight: It teaches you to recognize the sacred in every form, not just what seems holy or alive.

shambhu_gita::949.verse_hindi: नमस्य क्रियाओं में मैं उपासनाक्रिया शिक्षाक्रिया, दीक्षाक्रिया और कामोन्मादरहित मैथुन क्रिया हूँ
shambhu_gita::949.english_translation: Among respectful actions, I am worship, teaching, initiation, and the act of union free from desire and madness.
shambhu_gita::949.translation_literal: नमस्यासु (among respectful) क्रियास्वस्मि (actions I am) शिक्षादीक्षाक्रियात्मकः (teaching-initiation-action-like) । तथोपास्तिमैथुनश्च (and also worship-union) कामोन्मादविवजितम (desire-madness-free) ॥
shambhu_gita::949.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::949.essence: True respectful actions are devoted teaching and desire-free union.
shambhu_gita::949.simple_meaning: Among respectful actions, true spiritual acts are worship, teaching, initiation, and union free of desire or madness.
shambhu_gita::949.simple_insight: You can engage in actions that are clear, devoted, and free from craving or confusion.
shambhu_gita::949.detailed_meaning: Shiva explains that among all respectful actions, the highest are worship, imparting knowledge, formal initiation, and pure union without desire or obsession. These represent refined, conscious action aligned with the divine.
shambhu_gita::949.modern_relevance: You can choose to engage in your tasks as acts of devotion, learning, or clear connection, without getting caught in distractions or craving.
shambhu_gita::949.insight: It teaches you to see some actions as sacred and free from attachment, transforming everyday acts into purposeful offerings.

shambhu_gita::950.verse_sanskrit:
नमस्येषु च शब्देषु वेदपाठः स्तुतिर्मम।
धर्मोपदेशो वै झिल्लीरवश्चाऽस्मि समाधिदः ॥
shambhu_gita::950.verse_hindi: नमस्य शब्दों में मैं वेदपाठ, धर्मोंपदेश, मेरी स्तुतिपाठ और समाधिप्रद झिल्लीरव हूँ
shambhu_gita::950.english_translation: In salutations and words, I am the chanting of the Vedas, the teaching of dharma, my praise, and the veil that grants absorbed presence.
shambhu_gita::950.translation_literal: नमस्येषु (in salutations) च (and) शब्देषु (in words) वेदपाठः (Vedic chanting) स्तुतिर्मम (my praise) धर्मोपदेशः (teaching of dharma) वै (indeed) झिल्लीरवश्चाऽस्मि (I am also the veil) समाधिदः (of absorbed presence)
shambhu_gita::950.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::950.essence: The divine manifests through words, teachings, devotion, and the veil of deep absorption.
shambhu_gita::950.simple_meaning: I am present in sacred chants, teachings of duty, prayers, and the veil that leads to deep meditation.
shambhu_gita::950.simple_insight: The divine expresses through sound, teaching, devotion, and the mystery beyond words.
shambhu_gita::950.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes how his presence permeates rituals, sacred sounds, moral teachings, devotional praise, and the subtle veil that allows deep meditative absorption, revealing his all-encompassing role beyond forms.
shambhu_gita::950.insight: It shows the divine manifests in ritual, wisdom, devotion, and the hidden essence behind experience.

shambhu_gita::951.verse_sanskrit:
प्रेम्णा स्नेहेन भक्तया च श्रद्धयाऽपि प्रपूरितम् ।
 स्पर्शेषु तु नमस्येष्वालिङ्गनं पितृपुङ्गवाः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::951.verse_hindi: नमस्य स्पर्शों में मैं स्नेह प्रेम श्रद्धा और भक्तिपूर्ण आलिङ्गन हूँ
shambhu_gita::951.english_translation: In my greetings and touches, I am filled with love, affection, trust, and devoted embraces.
shambhu_gita::951.translation_literal: प्रेम्णा (with love) / स्नेहेन (with affection) / भक्तया (with devotion) / च (and) / श्रद्धयाऽपि (also with trust) / प्रपूरितम् (filled) / स्पर्शेषु (in touches) / तु (but) / नमस्येषु (in greetings) / आलिङ्गनं (embracing) / पितृपुङ्गवाः (noble fathers)
shambhu_gita::951.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::951.essence: Love and devoted trust fill your every greeting and touch.
shambhu_gita::951.simple_meaning: Love, affection, trust, and devotion fill the ways you greet and touch others.
shambhu_gita::951.simple_insight: You can express deep care and trust through simple, heartfelt gestures.
shambhu_gita::951.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes how greetings and physical gestures like touching or embracing can be full of love, trust, and devotion, especially when honoring noble ancestors or elders.
shambhu_gita::951.modern_relevance: A warm handshake or hug can convey more than words — it can carry your care and trust deeply.
shambhu_gita::951.insight: It teaches you to infuse even small acts like greetings with genuine love and devoted attention.

shambhu_gita::952.verse_sanskrit:
घ्राणेष्वस्मि नमस्येषु यज्ञधूमोऽन्नगन्धकः ।
दिव्यगन्धसमूहश्च पुष्पाणां सौरभं तथा ॥
shambhu_gita::952.verse_hindi: नमस्य घ्राणों में मैं यज्ञ, धूम्र, पुष्पसौरभ, अन्नगन्ध और दिव्यगन्ध समूह हूँ
shambhu_gita::952.english_translation: In the scents of reverence, I am the sacrifice, smoke, flower fragrance, food aroma, and divine scents combined.
shambhu_gita::952.translation_literal: घ्राणेषु (in the scents) अस्मि (I am) नमस्येषु (in the reverences) यज्ञधूमः (sacrifice smoke) अन्नगन्धकः (food aroma) दिव्यगन्धसमूहः (divine scent group) अपि (also) पुष्पाणां (of flowers) सौरभं (fragrance) तथा (also)
shambhu_gita::952.speaker: Shiva
shambhu_gita::952.essence: The divine dwells within all sacred fragrances of reverence.
shambhu_gita::952.simple_meaning: I am present in all scents offered during reverence, like sacrifice smoke, flower fragrance, food aroma, and divine smells.
shambhu_gita::952.simple_insight: The divine pervades even the smallest acts of reverence and offerings.
shambhu_gita::952.detailed_meaning: Shiva describes how his presence fills all the fragrant elements used in acts of worship: the smoke of sacrifice, the scent of flowers, the aroma of food, and all divine fragrances, showing his intimate involvement in devotional rituals.
shambhu_gita::952.insight: Recognize the sacred in ordinary acts of offering and reverence, connecting your devotion to the divine presence everywhere.

shambhu_gita::953.verse_sanskrit:
विद्यास्वध्यात्मविद्याऽस्मि मृत्युः संहारकारिषु ।
तेजो नरेषु नारीषु पवित्रा श्रीः स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
shambhu_gita::953.verse_hindi: हे पितृगण ! मैं विद्याओं में अध्यात्मविद्या; संहार को मृत्यु, पुरुषों में तेज और स्त्रियों में पवित्र श्री हूँ
shambhu_gita::953.english_translation: O ancestors! Among all knowledge, I am the knowledge of the true self; death that ends things; the brilliance in men; and sacred prosperity in women.
