vishnu_gita::8.translation_literal: दैवे (in divine) जगति (world) लिप्सन्ते (desire) प्रभुत्वम् (dominance) अति-यत्नतः (with great effort) । सुरा (radiant beings) असुर (shadow beings) विरोधः (conflict) तत् (that) सूक्ष्मे (subtle) जगति (world) सर्वदा (always) ॥
vishnu_gita::8.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::8.essence: Hidden desire for control fuels constant subtle conflict between opposing forces.
vishnu_gita::8.simple_meaning: In the divine realm, everyone wants to be in control, so the subtle world always has a conflict between radiant and shadow beings.
vishnu_gita::8.simple_insight: Desire for control naturally creates ongoing conflict beneath the surface.
vishnu_gita::8.detailed_meaning: This verse describes a subtle cosmic tension: divine beings and their opposites constantly struggle for dominance, reflecting an underlying conflict in the deeper layers of existence.
vishnu_gita::8.modern_relevance: You feel tension when people around you compete quietly for influence, even when it’s not obvious.
vishnu_gita::8.insight: Recognize that hidden struggles for power shape the subtle dynamics around you.

vishnu_gita::9.verse_sanskrit:
देवराज्ये यदा देवाः प्राधान्यं यान्ति सर्वथा ।
धर्मपूर्णत्वतः सृष्टेः सामञ्जस्यं तदाऽनघं ॥
vishnu_gita::9.verse_hindi: दैवराज्य में जब देवताओं का सर्वथा प्राधान्य हो जाता है तब धर्म की पूर्णता हो जाने से सृष्टि में निर्दोष सामञ्जस्य होता है
vishnu_gita::9.english_translation: When the divine beings completely dominate the divine realm, perfect dharma arises, bringing flawless harmony to creation.
vishnu_gita::9.translation_literal: देवराज्ये (in the divine realm) यदा (when) देवाः (divine beings) प्राधान्यं (domination/priority) यान्ति (go) सर्वथा (completely) । धर्मपूर्णत्वतः (from the fullness of dharma) सृष्टेः (of creation) सामञ्जस्यं (harmony) तदा (then) अनघं (faultless) ॥
vishnu_gita::9.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::9.essence: Complete dharma leadership creates perfect harmony throughout creation.
vishnu_gita::9.simple_meaning: When divine beings fully lead their realm, perfect dharma brings complete harmony to the world.
vishnu_gita::9.simple_insight: You feel the peace that comes when everything aligns under a shared rightness.
vishnu_gita::9.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes a state where divine beings hold full authority in their realm. This leads to perfect dharma, which ensures that creation exists in a faultless, harmonious order.
vishnu_gita::9.modern_relevance: Imagine a team where everyone follows shared values fully; the work flows effortlessly and harmony prevails.
vishnu_gita::9.insight: It teaches that shared commitment to rightness creates natural harmony beyond force or control.

vishnu_gita::10.verse_sanskrit:
कालप्रभावान्जीवानां प्रारब्धाच समष्टितः।
शैथिल्यं देवसाम्राज्यं यदा प्राप्नोति सर्वथा ॥
vishnu_gita::10.verse_hindi: काल के प्रभाव से अथवा जीवों के समष्टि प्रारब्ध के कारण देवताओं का आधिपत्य जब पूर्णत: शिथिल हो जाता है
vishnu_gita::10.english_translation: When the divine beings' reign is completely weakened by the influence of time or the collective destiny of living beings.
vishnu_gita::10.translation_literal: काल (time) / प्रभावान् (influences) / जीवनाां (of living beings) / प्रारब्धाच (due to destiny) / समष्टितः (collective) / शैथिल्यं (weakening) / देवसाम्राज्यं (divine beings' reign) / यदा (when) / प्राप्नोति (attains) / सर्वथा (completely)
vishnu_gita::10.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::10.essence: Even supreme reigns weaken completely under time and collective destiny.
vishnu_gita::10.simple_meaning: The power of the divine beings weakens completely due to the effects of time or the collective destiny of living beings.
vishnu_gita::10.simple_insight: Even the highest powers face decline under the unstoppable passage of time and collective fate.
vishnu_gita::10.detailed_meaning: This verse describes how, under the influence of time and the accumulated destiny (karma) of living beings, the authority or reign of divine beings diminishes fully. It reflects the impermanence that even transcendent forces experience.
vishnu_gita::10.insight: It teaches that all powers and states, no matter how exalted, are subject to change and decline over time.

vishnu_gita::11.verse_sanskrit:
प्राधान्यममुराणान्तु वृद्धिमेति तदा ध्रुवम् ।
देवक्रियासु वैषम्यात्सृष्टौ नाना विपर्ययः ॥
vishnu_gita::11.verse_hindi: तब असुरों का प्राधान्य बढ जाता है यह निश्चित है और दैवक्रिया में वैषम्य हो जाने से सृष्टि में नाना विपर्याय होते हैं
vishnu_gita::11.english_translation: Then the dominance of shadow beings increases for sure, and imbalance in divine workings causes many distortions in creation.
vishnu_gita::11.translation_literal: प्राधान्यम् (dominance) अमुराणाम् (of shadow beings) अन्तु (indeed) वृद्धिम् (growth) एति (comes) तदा (then) ध्रुवम् (certainly) । देवक्रियासु (in divine workings) वैषम्यात् (imbalance) सृष्टौ (in creation) नाना (various) विपर्ययः (distortions) ॥
vishnu_gita::11.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::11.essence: Growth of ego causes imbalance that distorts the entire creation.
vishnu_gita::11.simple_meaning: When beings of ego and shadow grow dominant, the divine processes become unbalanced, leading to many distortions in the world.
vishnu_gita::11.simple_insight: You can see how imbalance inside leads to confusion and disorder all around.
vishnu_gita::11.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains how an increase in shadow beings (Asuras) causes imbalance in divine actions, resulting in various distortions throughout creation, highlighting the cosmic consequences of inner disorder.
vishnu_gita::11.modern_relevance: When selfishness and ego take over in your actions, your relationships and projects start to feel chaotic and out of control.
vishnu_gita::11.insight: It teaches you to recognize that inner imbalance affects everything you do and see around you.

vishnu_gita::12.verse_sanskrit:
क्षीणे तपसि देवानामसुरा यान्ति मुख्यताम् ।
तेषां तपःक्षये देवा लभन्ते प्रभुतां पुनः ॥
vishnu_gita::12.verse_hindi: देवताओं के तप का क्षय हो जाने पर असुर मुख्यता को प्राप्त होते हैं और असुरों के तप का क्षय हो जाने पर देवता पुनः प्रभुता को प्राप्त हो जाते हैं
vishnu_gita::12.english_translation: When the austerity of the radiant beings declines, the shadow beings gain supremacy; when the shadow beings' austerity declines, the radiant beings regain authority.
vishnu_gita::12.translation_literal: क्षीणे (when diminished) तपसि (in austerity) देवानाम् (of radiant beings) असुरा (shadow beings) यान्ति (go) मुख्यताम् (to supremacy) । तेषां (their) तपःक्षये (when austerity ends) देवा (radiant beings) लभन्ते (obtain) प्रभुतां (authority) पुनः (again) ॥
vishnu_gita::12.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::12.essence: Effort sustains power; when effort fades, opposing forces rise in dominance.
vishnu_gita::12.simple_meaning: When the radiant beings lose their disciplined effort, the shadow beings take over; when the shadow beings lose their power, the radiant beings regain control.
vishnu_gita::12.simple_insight: Power shifts between forces depending on who maintains discipline and effort.
vishnu_gita::12.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains the cyclical struggle between radiant beings (devas) and shadow beings (asuras). When the radiant beings' disciplined effort wanes, the shadow beings rise to dominance, and vice versa. This reflects a cosmic balance of power sustained by effort.
vishnu_gita::12.modern_relevance: In any group or system, when the focused effort of one side fades, opposing forces fill the gap—like teams losing momentum and others gaining ground.
vishnu_gita::12.insight: It teaches that maintaining steady effort preserves positive influence; losing it invites opposing forces to gain control.

vishnu_gita::13.verse_sanskrit:
आधिदैवे सदा राज्य इत्थं यान्ति सुरासुराः।
प्रभुत्वं निससंग्रामरहस्यं हि तयोरिदम् ॥
vishnu_gita::13.verse_hindi: सदा ही इस प्रकार अधिदैवराज्य में देवता और असुर समय समय पर प्रभुता को प्राप्त होते रहते हैं यही देवता और असुरों के परस्पर के नित्य संग्राम का रहस्य है
vishnu_gita::13.english_translation: The gods and demons always attain sovereignty in the higher realm; this is the secret behind their eternal conflict.
vishnu_gita::13.translation_literal: आधिदैवे (in the higher realm) / सदा (always) / राज्य (sovereignty) / इत्थं (thus) / यान्ति (attain) / सुरासुराः (gods and demons) / प्रभुत्वं (sovereignty) / निससंग्रामरहस्यं (secret of constant conflict) / हि (indeed) / तयोरिदम् (of these two)
vishnu_gita::13.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::13.essence: The constant power struggle of divine forces reflects a cycle in the higher realm.
vishnu_gita::13.simple_meaning: The divine beings and their opposites continuously gain power in the higher realm, which explains their endless conflict.
vishnu_gita::13.simple_insight: Endless struggle between forces reflects a deeper cycle beyond the visible world.
vishnu_gita::13.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains how gods and demons cyclically gain dominance in the higher realm, revealing the cosmic reason for their endless battles.
vishnu_gita::13.insight: Recognize that some conflicts are part of larger cycles beyond personal control or resolution.

vishnu_gita::14.verse_sanskrit:
सुराणाममुराणाञ्च सर्वदेवत्थमुत्कटः।
ब्रह्माण्डेऽपि च पिण्डेऽपि संग्रामो जायते महान् ॥
vishnu_gita::14.verse_hindi: सर्वदाही देवता और असुरों का इस प्रकार ब्रह्माण्ड में भी और पिण्ड में भी उत्कट महान् संग्राम होता है
vishnu_gita::14.english_translation: There is a fierce great battle between the radiant beings and the shadow beings in the universe and in every particle.
vishnu_gita::14.translation_literal: सुराणाम् (of the radiant beings) अमुराणाञ्च (and of the shadow beings) सर्व-देवत्थम् (all divine beings) उत्कटः (fierce) ब्रह्माण्डेऽपि (in the universe also) च (and) पिण्डेऽपि (in the particle also) संग्रामः (battle) जायते (arises) महान् (great)
vishnu_gita::14.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::14.essence: Conflict between radiant and shadow beings pervades all scales of existence.
vishnu_gita::14.simple_meaning: The verse describes a fierce battle between radiant and shadow beings happening everywhere, in the cosmos and in the smallest parts.
vishnu_gita::14.simple_insight: Conflict exists everywhere, from the vast universe to the tiniest particle.
vishnu_gita::14.detailed_meaning: Suta narrates a cosmic scene where radiant beings (devas) and shadow beings (asuras) engage in a fierce battle that spans both the vast universe and the smallest particles, showing the pervasive nature of conflict.
vishnu_gita::14.insight: It highlights how struggle and opposition can be found everywhere, not just in visible places.

vishnu_gita::15.verse_sanskrit:
बहून्येव निमित्तानि समाश्रिय प्रवर्त्तते ।
सुरासुरेषु संग्रामो नैमित्तिक इहाऽमितः ॥
vishnu_gita::15.verse_hindi: और बहुत से निमित्त कारणों का प्राश्रय लेकर इस संसार में देवता और असुरो का असाधारण नैमित्तिक संग्राम भी प्रवृत्त होता है।
vishnu_gita::15.english_translation: Many causes arise, leading to an extraordinary but temporary conflict between radiant beings and shadowy forces in this world.
vishnu_gita::15.translation_literal: बहूनि (many) एव (indeed) निमित्तानि (causes) समाश्रिय (taking refuge) प्रवर्त्तते (arise) । सुरासुरेषु (among gods and demons) संग्रामो (battle) नैमित्तिक (occasional/temporary) इह (here) अमितः (extraordinary) ॥
vishnu_gita::15.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::15.essence: Many causes combine to start a special, temporary battle between radiant and shadowy forces.
vishnu_gita::15.simple_meaning: Many causes come together to start a special, temporary battle between radiant and shadowy beings in this world.
vishnu_gita::15.simple_insight: The world’s conflicts often arise from many small causes, not just one big reason.
vishnu_gita::15.detailed_meaning: The narrator describes how numerous causes come together to trigger a notable but temporary war between the radiant beings (Devas) and shadowy forces (Asuras). This sets the stage but does not teach a standalone principle.
vishnu_gita::15.insight: Recognize that complex conflicts usually have many underlying reasons, not a single cause.

vishnu_gita::16.verse_sanskrit:
पुरा यदा सुराः सर्वे भोगद्ध्या तपःक्षयम् ।
कुर्वन्तो बहुधा ह्यासन भीतभीताः प्रमादिनः ॥
vishnu_gita::16.verse_hindi: पूर्वकाल में जब ही देवता भोग के द्वारा तपःक्षम करते हुए अनेक प्रकार से अत्यन्त भयभीत और प्रमादी हो गये
vishnu_gita::16.english_translation: Long ago, the devas exhausted their spiritual power through indulgence, becoming fearful and negligent in many ways.
vishnu_gita::16.translation_literal: पुरा (long ago) यदा (when) सुराः (devas) सर्वे (all) भोगद्ध्या (through enjoyment) तपःक्षयम् (loss of tapas) कुर्वन्तो (doing) बहुधा (in many ways) हि (indeed) आसन् (were) भीतभीताः (very fearful) प्रमादिनः (negligent)
vishnu_gita::16.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::16.essence: Even the mighty lose strength when distracted by indulgence and fear.
vishnu_gita::16.simple_meaning: In the past, the devas lost their spiritual power by indulging in pleasures, which made them fearful and careless.
vishnu_gita::16.simple_insight: Even powerful beings can lose their strength through distraction and fear.
vishnu_gita::16.detailed_meaning: The devas, radiant beings responsible for cosmic order, once misused their spiritual power by indulging excessively. This led them to become fearful and careless, showing how even divine forces can falter through attachment and neglect.
vishnu_gita::16.insight: It reminds you that losing focus on your inner discipline can weaken your confidence and lead to carelessness.

vishnu_gita::17.verse_sanskrit:
प्राप्याऽवसरमुत्कृष्टमसुरा बलशालिनः।
राज्यविस्तृतये तीव्र यतमानाः सदाऽभवन् ॥
vishnu_gita::17.verse_hindi: तब अपने लिये इस उत्तम अवसर को प्राप्त कर बलशाली असुर सदा राज्यविस्तार के लिए तीव्र यत्न करने लगे
vishnu_gita::17.english_translation: Having gained this excellent opportunity, powerful Asuras always exerted intense efforts to expand their kingdom.
vishnu_gita::17.translation_literal: प्राप्याऽवसरम् (having obtained opportunity) उत्कृष्टम् (excellent) असुरा (Asuras) बलशालिनः (powerful) राज्यविस्तृतये (for kingdom expansion) तीव्र (intense) यतमानाः (making efforts) सदाऽभवन् (always were)
vishnu_gita::17.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::17.essence: Powerful beings use rare chances to fiercely pursue growth and expansion.
vishnu_gita::17.simple_meaning: Powerful Asuras seized a great chance and constantly worked hard to extend their kingdom.
vishnu_gita::17.simple_insight: Sometimes, ambition drives persistent effort to grow and expand influence.
vishnu_gita::17.detailed_meaning: In this scene, powerful Asuras have found a rare opportunity. Motivated by their strength and ambition, they dedicate themselves intensely to expanding their realm, setting the stage for upcoming conflict or transformation.
vishnu_gita::17.insight: Recognize how seizing opportunities fuels intense focused effort toward expansion or change.

vishnu_gita::18.verse_hindi: और बलशाली असुरों ने देवताओं की स्वाभाविक वासभूमि स्वर्गराज्य के बहुत से अंश सम्यक् प्रकार से क्रमशः अधिकार में कर लिये
vishnu_gita::18.english_translation: Many parts of the natural realm of the devas were gradually taken over by powerful asuras with great force.
vishnu_gita::18.translation_literal: सिद्धानां (of the perfected) देवराज्यानामंशास्तु (parts of the kingdom of the devas) बहवोऽभवन् (many there were) । क्रमशः (gradually) अधिकृताः (were taken over) सम्यग् (properly) असुरैः (by the asuras) बृलशालिभिः (with great strength) ॥
vishnu_gita::18.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::18.essence: Powerful forces can gradually seize what rightly belongs to others.
vishnu_gita::18.simple_meaning: The powerful asuras gradually seized many parts of the devas' natural domain.
vishnu_gita::18.simple_insight: Powerful forces can take over what was once peaceful and orderly.
vishnu_gita::18.detailed_meaning: The narrator describes how the powerful asuras began to gradually take control over many parts of the natural domain that rightly belonged to the devas. This sets the stage for conflict and the need for restoration.
vishnu_gita::18.insight: It shows how unchecked force can disrupt natural order and rightful balance.

vishnu_gita::19.verse_sanskrit:
नारदस्यैव देवर्षेस्तदा सदुपदेशतः ।
भयदुःखे निराकृस चक्रुस्तीत्र तपः सुराः ॥
vishnu_gita::19.verse_hindi: उस समय देवर्षि नारद के सदुपदेश देने पर भय और दुःख का परित्याग करके देवताओं ने तीव्र तपस्या की
vishnu_gita::19.english_translation: At that time, following the wise counsel of the divine sage Narada, the deities abandoned fear and sorrow and undertook intense austerity.
vishnu_gita::19.translation_literal: नारदस्यैव (of Narada only) / देवर्षेस्तदा (then of the divine sage) / सदुपदेशतः (by good instruction) / भयदुःखे (fear and sorrow) / निराकृस (abandoned) / चक्रुस्तीत्र (did there) / तपः (austerity) / सुराः (the deities)
vishnu_gita::19.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::19.essence: Fear and sorrow disappear when wise guidance inspires dedicated practice.
vishnu_gita::19.simple_meaning: The divine beings stopped feeling fear and sorrow after receiving Narada's advice and began intense spiritual practice.
vishnu_gita::19.simple_insight: Relief comes when wise guidance helps you leave behind fear and pain.
vishnu_gita::19.detailed_meaning: The divine sage Narada advises the gods, who respond by letting go of fear and sorrow to engage in rigorous austerity, showing a turning point toward spiritual discipline.
vishnu_gita::19.insight: It shows how wise counsel can dissolve emotional obstacles and inspire committed action.

vishnu_gita::20.verse_sanskrit:
प्रसन्नस्तपसा तेषां तत्त्वातीतः परात्परः ।
चिन्मयस्सन् महाविष्णुराविरासीत्पुरुः स्वतः ॥
vishnu_gita::20.verse_hindi: उनकी तपस्या से प्रसन्न होकर तत्त्वातीत परात्पर श्री महाविष्णु भगवान् स्वयं चिन्मय रूप से उनके सम्मुख आविर्भूत हुए
vishnu_gita::20.english_translation: Pleased by their austerity, the supreme beyond all principles, great Vishnu, appeared before them in pure consciousness.
vishnu_gita::20.translation_literal: प्रसन्नस्तपसा (pleased by austerity) / तेषां (of them) / तत्त्वातीतः (beyond principles) / परात्परः (the supreme beyond) / चिन्मयस्सन् (being of pure consciousness) / महाविष्णुः (great Vishnu) / आविरासीत् (appeared) / पुरुः (before)
vishnu_gita::20.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::20.essence: Deep dedication brings forth the supreme presence beyond all concepts.
vishnu_gita::20.simple_meaning: Great Vishnu, pleased by their deep practice, appeared to them in a pure conscious form beyond all principles.
vishnu_gita::20.simple_insight: Sometimes, deep dedication invites presence far beyond what words can capture.
vishnu_gita::20.detailed_meaning: After intense austerities by sages, the supreme Vishnu, who transcends all principles, manifested before them in a form of pure consciousness, marking a profound divine appearance.
vishnu_gita::20.insight: It shows that deep commitment can reveal realities beyond ordinary understanding.

vishnu_gita::21.verse_sanskrit:
चिन्मयोऽपि बभौ ज्योतिर्जितकोटिरविप्रभः ।
तेनाऽऽहतानि नेत्राणि तेषां संकोचमाप्नुवन् ॥
vishnu_gita::21.verse_hindi: वे यद्यपि चिन्मय है, परन्तु उस समय वह करोडों सूर्यो की प्रभा को जीतने वाली ज्योति से शोभायमान होने लगे और उस ज्योति से देवताओं के नेत्र अभिभूत होकर सङ्कचित हो गये
vishnu_gita::21.english_translation: Though made of pure consciousness, that light shone brighter than millions of suns, dazzling the gods' eyes and causing them to shrink back.
vishnu_gita::21.translation_literal: चिन्मय (made of pure consciousness) / अपि (also) / बभौ (became) / ज्योति (light) / जित (conquering) / कोटि (crores/millions) / अप्रभः (of brilliance) / तेन (by that) / आहतानि (were struck) / नेत्राणि (eyes) / तेषां (their) / संकोचम् (shrinkage/fear) / आप्नुवन् (attained)
vishnu_gita::21.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::21.essence: Pure consciousness can shine with overwhelming brilliance that humbles even radiant beings.
vishnu_gita::21.simple_meaning: A being made of pure consciousness shone with a light brighter than millions of suns, so bright that the gods' eyes were overwhelmed and they recoiled.
vishnu_gita::21.simple_insight: Even pure consciousness can manifest in a way that astonishes and humbles the radiant beings.
vishnu_gita::21.detailed_meaning: In the scene, a luminous entity composed of pure consciousness radiates light surpassing countless suns. This overwhelming brilliance astonishes the gods (devas), whose eyes are struck with awe and shrink back, showing the power of inner radiance.
vishnu_gita::21.insight: It shows that inner true nature can shine with a power that surprises even the highest beings, inspiring humility and awe.

vishnu_gita::22.verse_sanskrit:
तज्ज्योतिः सूक्ष्मतां भेजे द्रुतमत्यन्तमद्भुतम् ।
चिव्याप्तं देवहृव्योम स्वत आकृष्टतां गतम् ॥
vishnu_gita::22.verse_hindi: और वह अत्यन्त अद्भुत ज्योति तत्काल सूक्ष्मत्व को प्राप्त हुई और चिन्मयत्व से व्याप्त देवताओं के हृदयाकाश का स्वतः आकर्षण हुआ
vishnu_gita::22.english_translation: That light swiftly attained extreme subtlety and, pervaded by pure consciousness, was naturally drawn to the heart-space of the devas.
vishnu_gita::22.translation_literal: तज्ज्योतिः (that light) / सूक्ष्मतां (subtlety) / भेजे (attained) / द्रुतम् (swiftly) / अत्यन्तम् (extremely) / अद्भुतम् (wonderful) / चिव्याप्तं (pervaded by pure consciousness) / देवहृव्योम (devas' heart-sky) / स्वत (naturally) / आकृष्टतां (attraction) / गतम् (went)
vishnu_gita::22.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::22.essence: Pure subtle consciousness naturally draws itself toward radiant beings' heart-spaces.
vishnu_gita::22.simple_meaning: A divine light quickly became extremely subtle and filled with pure consciousness, naturally attracting the heart-space of radiant beings.
vishnu_gita::22.simple_insight: The subtle presence of pure consciousness naturally draws the attention of higher beings.
vishnu_gita::22.detailed_meaning: In a mystical moment, a divine light quickly refines to an extraordinary subtlety, permeated by pure consciousness, naturally attracting the spiritual heart-spaces of the devas. This reveals a cosmic process of spiritual refinement and attraction.
vishnu_gita::22.insight: It shows that deep refinement and inner clarity naturally attract higher states of awareness and connection.

vishnu_gita::23.verse_sanskrit:
बाह्यबोधस्तदा देवाः शून्या आनन्दसागरे ।
सुखं निमज्जनं प्राप्ता मूच्छिता इव चाऽभवन् ॥
vishnu_gita::23.verse_hindi: उस समय देवता बहिर्ज्ञान शून्य होकर आनन्दसागर में सुखपूर्वक डूब गये और मूर्छितों के समान हो गये
vishnu_gita::23.english_translation: At that time, the radiant beings’ outer awareness vanished, and they blissfully immersed in the ocean of joy, becoming like those unconscious.
vishnu_gita::23.translation_literal: बाह्यबोधः (outer awareness) तदा (then) देवाः (divine beings) शून्या (empty) आनन्दसागरे (in ocean of bliss) सुखं (pleasure) निमज्जनं (immersed) प्राप्ता (obtained) मूच्छिता (unconscious) इव (like) च (also) अभवन् (became)
vishnu_gita::23.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::23.essence: Complete joy can dissolve outer awareness into peaceful absorption.
vishnu_gita::23.simple_meaning: The radiant beings lost their outer awareness and joyfully immersed themselves in bliss, appearing like unconscious beings.
vishnu_gita::23.simple_insight: Sometimes total immersion in joy feels like losing yourself completely and peacefully.
vishnu_gita::23.detailed_meaning: The radiant beings, or devas, at a moment of supreme bliss, lose their usual outer awareness and become as if unconscious, deeply absorbed in joy's ocean. This depicts a state of overwhelming delight.
vishnu_gita::23.insight: Shows how deep joy can quiet the mind to the point of losing external awareness.

vishnu_gita::24.verse_sanskrit:
तदा सुराणां मुग्धानां विद्यारूपा शुभप्रदा ।
विष्णुप्रिया महामाया हृद्याविर्भावयाप ह ॥
vishnu_gita::24.verse_hindi: तब मुग्ध देवताओं के हृदयों में विद्यारूपा शुभदायिनी विष्णुप्रिया महामाया आविर्भूत हुईं
vishnu_gita::24.english_translation: Then, for the innocent devas, the auspicious great illusion, beloved of Vishnu and embodying knowledge, appeared in their hearts.
vishnu_gita::24.translation_literal: तदा (then) / सुराणां (of the devas) / मुग्धानां (innocent) / विद्यारूपा (in the form of knowledge) / शुभप्रदा (auspicious giver) / विष्णुप्रिया (beloved of Vishnu) / महामाया (great illusion) / हृद्याविर्भावयाप (appeared in the hearts)
vishnu_gita::24.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::24.essence: A divine knowledge awakens within innocent hearts as a great auspicious power.
vishnu_gita::24.simple_meaning: A divine, auspicious power embodying knowledge appeared in the hearts of innocent devas.
vishnu_gita::24.simple_insight: A special presence can awaken within when conditions are pure and open.
vishnu_gita::24.detailed_meaning: In a moment of spiritual significance, a radiant force symbolizing knowledge and beloved by Vishnu emerges within the hearts of the innocent devas, signaling a turning point in the narrative.
vishnu_gita::24.insight: It shows how openness and purity of heart can allow profound wisdom to arise naturally.

vishnu_gita::25.verse_sanskrit:
निवृत्तायामविद्यायां मूछायां तत्समागमात् ।
देवैरधिगता सर्वै:  सम्पूर्णा प्रकृतिस्थता ॥
vishnu_gita::25.verse_hindi: बहिर्ज्ञानशून्य अवस्था में विद्या के समागम द्वारा अविद्या के निवृत्त होने पर सब देवता पूर्ण प्रकृतिस्थ हुए
vishnu_gita::25.english_translation: When ignorance is removed through the arrival of true understanding in a withdrawn state, all radiant beings become fully established in the natural world.
vishnu_gita::25.translation_literal: निवृत्तायामविद्यायां (in the withdrawn state/by true knowledge) / मूछायां (in ignorance/confusion) / तत्समागमात् (due to its arrival) / देवैरधिगता (attained by all radiant beings) / सर्वै: (all) / सम्पूर्णा (complete/fully) / प्रकृतिस्थता (established in the natural world)
vishnu_gita::25.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::25.essence: Clarity arising in quiet removes confusion, grounding all radiant beings in nature.
vishnu_gita::25.simple_meaning: When deep confusion ends through true understanding in a quiet state, all radiant beings become fully grounded in the natural world.
vishnu_gita::25.simple_insight: You can feel peaceful when clear understanding removes your confusion completely.
vishnu_gita::25.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that when true knowledge arises within a withdrawn, quiet state, it removes the veil of deep confusion. At that moment, all radiant beings become fully established in the natural world, no longer disturbed by ignorance.
vishnu_gita::25.modern_relevance: You’ve paused your busy mind and finally understood a complex problem. That clarity ends your confusion and grounds you in reality.
vishnu_gita::25.insight: It teaches you to withdraw from mental noise so true understanding can dissolve confusion.

vishnu_gita::26.verse_sanskrit:
ततः स्वच्छहृदो देवा ददृशुः सम्मुखस्थितम्।
कमप्यदृष्टपूर्वं हि पुरुषं परमाद्भुतम् ॥
vishnu_gita::26.verse_hindi: तदनन्तर स्वच्छहृदय देवताओं ने सम्मुख स्थित अदृष्टपूर्व परम अद्भुत किसी पुरुष को देखा
vishnu_gita::26.english_translation: Then the gods with pure hearts saw before them a supreme being unlike any seen before.
vishnu_gita::26.translation_literal: ततः (then) स्वच्छहृदो (pure-hearted) देवा (the gods) ददृशुः (saw) सम्मुखस्थितम् (standing in front) । कमपि (any) अदृष्टपूर्वं (never before seen) हि (indeed) पुरुषं (being) परमाद्भुतम् (supreme wonderful) ॥
vishnu_gita::26.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::26.essence: Pure-hearted beings recognize a supreme presence never seen before.
vishnu_gita::26.simple_meaning: Pure-hearted gods saw a supreme and wondrous being they had never seen before.
vishnu_gita::26.simple_insight: Some moments reveal something utterly new and awe-inspiring beyond past experience.
vishnu_gita::26.detailed_meaning: The gods, characterized by their purity of heart, witnessed a supreme being standing before them, a presence so extraordinary it had never been seen before. This marks a pivotal moment in the narrative, introducing a remarkable divine figure.
vishnu_gita::26.insight: Recognize moments when something truly extraordinary appears, shifting your perspective beyond the familiar.

vishnu_gita::27.verse_hindi: वह पुरुष सर्वसौन्दर्य की शोभा से पूर्ण हैं, शान्त ज्योति से प्रकाशमान हैं, अनेक विस्मय और अनेक आनन्द को देने वाले और देखने में मनो हर हैं
vishnu_gita::27.english_translation: That being is full of all beauty, radiant with peaceful light, bestowing wonder and joy, and enchanting to behold.
vishnu_gita::27.translation_literal: सर्वसौन्दर्यशोभाढयं (full of all-beauty's splendour) / शान्तज्योतिःसमुज्ज्वलम् (peaceful light shining brightly) / विस्मयानन्दसन्दोहप्रद (wonder-joy heap giving) / दृष्टिमनोहरम् (view enchanting)
vishnu_gita::27.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::27.essence: The divine shines with peaceful beauty that fills the heart with wonder and joy.
vishnu_gita::27.simple_meaning: The divine being shines with peaceful light, is full of beauty, and inspires wonder and joy when seen.
vishnu_gita::27.simple_insight: There is awe and delight in recognizing the divine's radiant presence.
vishnu_gita::27.detailed_meaning: Describing Vishnu’s majestic form, the verse highlights his complete beauty, calm radiant light, and the joy and amazement he inspires in those who see him.
vishnu_gita::27.insight: Seeing the divine as radiant and soothing can deepen your feeling of connection and reverence.

vishnu_gita::28.verse_hindi: जिनके चारों हाथ शङ्ख चक्र गदा और पद्म से सुशोभित है, मानों भक्तो को प्रेमपूर्वक चतुर्वर्ग (धर्म अर्थ काम मोक्ष) देने को आये हैं
vishnu_gita::28.english_translation: The one whose four hands are adorned with conch, discus, mace, and lotus appears to come to lovingly grant devotees the fourfold aims of life.
vishnu_gita::28.translation_literal: शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मसुशोभितचतुर्भुजम् (conch-discuss-mace-lotus-adorned-four-armed) / भक्तेभ्यः (to devotees) / चतुर्वर्ग (four classes) / प्रेम्णा (with love) / दातुम् (to give) / इव (as if) / आगतम् (arrived)
vishnu_gita::28.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::28.essence: The divine lovingly offers all four aims of life to devoted seekers.
vishnu_gita::28.simple_meaning: The divine being with four symbolic arms comes lovingly to grant devotees the four aims: duty, prosperity, desire, and freedom.
vishnu_gita::28.simple_insight: You can feel loved and supported in all aspects of your life by the divine.
vishnu_gita::28.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Vishnu is described with his four arms holding symbolic items. He is portrayed as coming to devotees with love, ready to grant them the fourfold goals of life: duty, wealth, desire, and liberation, promising comprehensive care.
vishnu_gita::28.modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed by life's demands, but this reminds you that love supports you in balancing all your goals—purpose, success, passion, and freedom.
vishnu_gita::28.insight: It shows you how devotion connects you to a source that lovingly supports your complete life journey.

vishnu_gita::29.verse_sanskrit:
दिव्यश्यामाकृति कान्तं कौस्तुभेन विभूषितम् ।
अनन्तरूपेऽनन्ताख्ये पर्यङ्के शायिनं विभुम् ॥
vishnu_gita::29.verse_hindi: दिव्य श्याम जिनका वर्ण है, अनन्त रूप धारी अनन्त जिनका पर्याङ्क है, कौस्तुभमणि से विभूषित हैं
vishnu_gita::29.english_translation: The divine one has a dark blue form, adorned with the Kaustubha gem, infinite in form and infinite in name, reclining on the infinite serpent.
vishnu_gita::29.translation_literal: दिव्यश्यामाकृति (divine dark blue form) / कान्तं (beautiful) / कौस्तुभेन (with Kaustubha) / विभूषितम् (adorned) / अनन्तरूपेऽनन्ताख्ये (of infinite form and infinite name) / पर्यङ्के (on the serpent) / शायिनं (reclining) / विभुम् (the lord)
vishnu_gita::29.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::29.essence: The divine is infinite, beautiful, and eternally supported beyond all limits.
vishnu_gita::29.simple_meaning: The divine being Vishnu is described as having a dark blue form, adorned with the Kaustubha gem, infinite in form and reclining on the infinite serpent.
vishnu_gita::29.simple_insight: You sense vastness and mysterious beauty beyond ordinary limits in the divine presence.
vishnu_gita::29.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the narrator Suta describes Vishnu’s cosmic form: dark blue skin symbolizing depth, the Kaustubha jewel as a mark of supreme radiance, infinite form and name expressing boundlessness, and reclining on the cosmic serpent representing eternal support.
vishnu_gita::29.insight: It invites you to imagine the divine as boundless and majestic, beyond human scale or limits.

vishnu_gita::30.verse_hindi: कोटि सूर्य-ग्रहों की ज्योति से सेवित प्रकाशमान शरीर वाले हैं, केयूर, और कुण्डल को धारण करने वाले हैं, वनमाला से विभूषित हैं
vishnu_gita::30.english_translation: He has a radiant form illuminated by the light of millions of suns and planets, adorned with armlets, earrings, and a garland of forest flowers.
vishnu_gita::30.translation_literal: कोटिमूर्यग्रहज्योतिः (millions suns and planets light) / सेवितोज्ज्वलविग्रहम् (served radiant form) / वनमालालसद्गात्रं (forest garland adorned body) / विभ्रतकेयूरकुण्डलम् (wearing armlets, earrings)
vishnu_gita::30.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::30.essence: A radiant figure shines with the light of countless suns, adorned with nature’s ornaments.
vishnu_gita::30.simple_meaning: The description shows a brilliant, radiant figure adorned with shining ornaments and a garland of forest flowers.
vishnu_gita::30.simple_insight: There is awe in witnessing a form that shines with the light of countless suns.
vishnu_gita::30.detailed_meaning: Suta describes a majestic figure whose radiant body shines like millions of suns and planets, decorated with armlets, earrings, and a forest flower garland, setting a vivid scene of divine grandeur.
vishnu_gita::30.insight: This verse invites you to see beyond ordinary appearances and appreciate brilliance that inspires awe.

vishnu_gita::31.verse_hindi: उनके नख मानों निष्कलङ्क चन्द्र हैं उनकी कौमुदी से वह शोभायमान हैं, लक्ष्मी के द्वारा सुसेवित हैं, कमलनेत्र है, मन्दहास्य से मुखकमल जिनका शोभायमान है
vishnu_gita::31.english_translation: Their nails are spotless moonlight, shining like the moon's glow; served by Lakshmi, with lotus-like eyes and a smiling lotus-like face.
vishnu_gita::31.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::31.essence: Radiant purity and grace characterize the divine form served by prosperity.
vishnu_gita::31.simple_meaning: The verse describes Vishnu's radiant and beautiful appearance, illuminated like the pure moonlight and served by the divine Lakshmi.
vishnu_gita::31.simple_insight: Beauty and grace can reflect the presence of the divine in form.
vishnu_gita::31.detailed_meaning: This verse paints a vivid picture of Vishnu’s divine form, emphasizing the purity and radiance of his nails like spotless moonlight, his lotus-like eyes, and his smiling face, all attended by Lakshmi, the goddess of prosperity.
vishnu_gita::31.insight: Acknowledge the presence of radiance and grace in the world as reflections of higher qualities.

vishnu_gita::32.verse_sanskrit:
स्थानं निःशेषशोभानां सौन्दर्यनिकराकरम्।
भगवन्तं रमानाथं प्रसन्नं पुण्यदर्शनम् ॥
vishnu_gita::32.verse_hindi: अखिल शोभा के स्थान हैं, सब प्रकार के सौन्दर्य के आकर भगवान् रमानाथ प्रसन्न और पुण्य दर्शन हैं
vishnu_gita::32.english_translation: The divine Ramānātha is the abode of all splendors, the embodiment of every beauty, ever serene and the vision of virtue.
vishnu_gita::32.translation_literal: स्थानं (abode) निःशेषशोभानां (of all splendors) सौन्दर्यनिकराकरम् (embodiment of beauty) । भगवन्तं (the divine) रमानाथं (Ramānātha) प्रसन्नं (serene) पुण्यदर्शनम् (vision of virtue) ॥
vishnu_gita::32.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::32.essence: The divine presence is the calm, perfect home of all beauty and virtue.
vishnu_gita::32.simple_meaning: The divine Ramānātha is the home of every kind of beauty and splendor, always calm and the sight of virtue.
vishnu_gita::32.simple_insight: You feel the steady calm and perfect beauty that the divine presence holds.
vishnu_gita::32.detailed_meaning: Suta describes Ramānātha as the radiant divine whose abode holds all forms of beauty and splendor. This verse sets the tone of reverence, showing Ramānātha as the source of serene virtue and perfect appearance.
vishnu_gita::32.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by chaos or ugliness, remembering a calm and beautiful presence can center your heart and mind.
vishnu_gita::32.insight: It invites you to remember that divine calm and true beauty are always accessible beyond worldly distractions.

vishnu_gita::33.verse_sanskrit:
दिव्यदृष्टयाऽथ ते देवा दृष्ट्वा विस्मितचेतसः।
अपूर्वदर्शनं देवमाविभूतं प्रतुष्टुवुः ॥
vishnu_gita::33.verse_hindi: अनन्तर देवगण अपूर्व जिनका दर्शन है ऐसे आविर्भूत देवादि देव के दिव्य दृष्टि के द्वारा दर्शन करके विस्मित चित्त होकर स्तुति करने लगे
vishnu_gita::33.english_translation: Then the divine beings, amazed in mind, saw the unprecedented vision of the manifest divine and praised it.
vishnu_gita::33.translation_literal: दिव्यदृष्टयाऽथ (by divine visions) ते (then) देवा (the gods) दृष्ट्वा (having seen) विस्मितचेतसः (with amazed minds) अपूर्वदर्शनं (unprecedented vision) देवम (of the divine) आविभूतं (manifested) प्रतुष्टुवुः (praised)
vishnu_gita::33.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::33.essence: Profound visions of the divine inspire amazement and heartfelt praise.
vishnu_gita::33.simple_meaning: The divine beings saw a new, amazing vision of the divine and responded with amazement and praise.
vishnu_gita::33.simple_insight: Witnessing something truly extraordinary can fill you with awe and reverence.
vishnu_gita::33.detailed_meaning: After a significant event, the divine beings witness a rare and extraordinary form of the divine. Their minds fill with astonishment, and they offer praise, marking a moment of profound spiritual recognition.
vishnu_gita::33.insight: It highlights how encountering profound truths naturally invites awe and appreciation.

vishnu_gita::34.verse_sanskrit:
देवादिदेव ! हे नाथ ! विश्वेश्वर ! जगत्पते ।
सच्चिदानन्दरूपस्त्वमपरिच्छेदतो विभुः ॥
vishnu_gita::34.verse_hindi: हे देवादिदेव ! हे नाथ ! हे विश्वेश्वर ! हे जगत्पते ! आप सच्चिदानन्दरूप, व्यवधानरहित, विभु अर्थात् व्यापक,
vishnu_gita::34.english_translation: O lord of lords, master of the universe, you are the form of truth, consciousness, and bliss, vast and without division.
vishnu_gita::34.translation_literal: देवादिदेव (lord of lords) / हे (O) / नाथ (lord) / विश्वेश्वर (master of the universe) / जगत्पते (lord of the world) / सच्चिदानन्दरूप (form of truth-consciousness-bliss) / त्वम् (you) / अपरिच्छेदतः (without division) / विभुः (vast, pervasive)
vishnu_gita::34.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::34.essence: The supreme being is infinite, indivisible truth, consciousness, and bliss.
vishnu_gita::34.simple_meaning: You are the all-encompassing divine being, embodying truth, consciousness, and bliss without any division or limitation.
vishnu_gita::34.simple_insight: There is a vast and indivisible presence beyond all appearances and names.
vishnu_gita::34.detailed_meaning: This verse is a reverential address to Vishnu, praising him as the supreme, all-pervasive being who embodies pure existence, awareness, and joy without fragmentation or boundary.
vishnu_gita::34.insight: It invites you to see the divine as an infinite, undivided presence beyond ordinary distinctions.

vishnu_gita::35.verse_sanskrit:
एक एवाऽद्वितीयोऽसि विश्वात्मा विश्वपालकः।
अनादिश्चाऽप्यनन्तोऽसि विश्वसेव्य ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::35.verse_hindi: अद्वितीय, एक, विश्वात्मा,विश्वपालक, अनादि और अनन्त हैं, हे विश्वसेव्य! आपको प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::35.english_translation: You are the one without a second, the universal self, the protector of all, without beginning and endless, O servant of the universe! I bow to you.
vishnu_gita::35.translation_literal: एक (one) एव (only) अद्वितीय (without second) असि (are) विश्वात्मा (universal self) विश्वपालकः (protector of the universe) अनादि (without beginning) च (and) अपि (also) अनन्तः (endless) असि (are) विश्वसेव्य (servant of the universe) नमः (bow) अस्तु (let it be) ते (to you)
vishnu_gita::35.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::35.essence: One infinite presence protects and pervades all without beginning or end.
vishnu_gita::35.simple_meaning: There is only one true self who is universal, eternal, and the protector of everything. This being has no beginning and no end.
vishnu_gita::35.simple_insight: Recognizing the infinite presence that supports all gives a deep sense of awe and connection.
vishnu_gita::35.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Suta honors the supreme universal self as the singular reality beyond all duality. This presence is timeless, infinite, and the protector of the universe, establishing a foundation for devotion and reverence.
vishnu_gita::35.modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or overwhelmed, remembering that an infinite presence supports all can bring comfort and belonging.
vishnu_gita::35.insight: This verse invites you to see beyond separation and realize an unbroken, timeless support beneath all appearances.

vishnu_gita::36.verse_sanskrit:
त्वमेवासि प्रभो ! कार्य त्वमेव कारणं सदा ।
कार्यकारणरूपस्त्वं सर्वात्मक ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::36.verse_hindi: हे प्रभो ! सदा आप ही कार्य और आप ही कारण हैं, आप कार्य कारण रूप हैं, हे सर्वात्मक ! आपको प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::36.english_translation: O Lord! You alone are always the action and the cause; you are the form of both action and cause, O all-pervading one! I bow to you.
vishnu_gita::36.translation_literal: त्वमेव (You alone) असि (are) प्रभो (O Lord)! कार्य (action) त्वमेव (you alone) कारणं (cause) सदा (always) । कार्यकारणरूपः (form of action and cause) त्वं (you) सर्वात्मक (all-pervading) ! नमः (salutation) अस्तु (be) ते (to you) ॥
vishnu_gita::36.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::36.essence: The true self is always both the cause and the action in all things.
vishnu_gita::36.simple_meaning: You alone are the cause behind everything that happens and the action itself, always present everywhere.
vishnu_gita::36.simple_insight: You can rest in the presence that is both the source and the movement of all things.
vishnu_gita::36.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the speaker offers reverence to the divine as the ultimate source and executor of all actions. It emphasizes that the divine is not separate from the world’s workings but is simultaneously the cause and the effect, present everywhere.
vishnu_gita::36.modern_relevance: When you feel powerless, remember that the source of every action and its unfolding is present within and around you.
vishnu_gita::36.insight: Recognize that the true self is both the origin and the force behind all actions, dissolving separation.

vishnu_gita::37.verse_sanskrit:
भवानेव जगन्नूनं जगदेव भवान् विभो !।
भवत्येव जगद् भाति जगद्रूप ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::37.verse_hindi: हे विभो! आप अवश्य ही जगत् हैं और जगत् ही आप हैं एवं आपमें ही जगत भासमान होता है, हे जगद्रूप! आपको प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::37.english_translation: O Vibo! You alone are the entire universe, and the universe is you; in you alone the universe shines. Salutations to you, the form of the universe!
vishnu_gita::37.translation_literal: भवानेव (You alone) जगन्नूनं (the entire universe) जगदेव (indeed the universe) भवान् (are) विभो (O Vibo) !। भवत्येव (You alone) जगद् (the universe) भाति (shines) जगद्रूप (form of the universe) ! नमोऽस्तु (salutations) ते (to you) ॥
vishnu_gita::37.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::37.essence: The divine and the universe are one, inseparably shining together.
vishnu_gita::37.simple_meaning: The divine being is the whole universe and the universe exists and radiates through that being.
vishnu_gita::37.simple_insight: Everything you see is a reflection of the divine presence within all things.
vishnu_gita::37.detailed_meaning: This verse is a reverent declaration that the divine is not separate from the universe but is its very substance and form. It expresses the unity of the cosmic form and the universe itself as inseparable.
vishnu_gita::37.insight: It shifts your view from seeing the universe as separate to recognizing all as one manifestation of the divine.

vishnu_gita::38.verse_sanskrit:
जगदभूयो भवत्येव वर्तते किन्तु तत्त्वतः।
न वर्त्तते भवाँस्तत्र विश्वाधार ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::38.verse_hindi: पुनः आपमें ही जगत् स्थित है परन्तु तत्त्वतः आप उसमें नहीं हैं, हे विश्वाधार ! आपको प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::38.english_translation: The world appears to exist in you, but in truth, you do not exist in it, O Supporter of the Universe! I bow to you.
vishnu_gita::38.translation_literal: जगत् (world) अभूयः (more than) भवति (exists) एव (indeed) वर्तते (is present) किन्तु (but) तत्त्वतः (in essence) न (not) वर्तते (exists) भवाँः (you) तत्र (there) विश्वाधार (Supporter of the Universe) नमः (salutations) अस्तु (let it be) ते (to you)
vishnu_gita::38.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::38.essence: You can contain the world yet remain beyond it at the same time.
vishnu_gita::38.simple_meaning: Everything that exists appears within you, but you are not truly contained by the world.
vishnu_gita::38.simple_insight: There is freedom in knowing you are not limited by what surrounds you.
vishnu_gita::38.detailed_meaning: This verse reveals a profound insight: though the entire universe seems to exist within your presence, your true self transcends it. The speaker honors the Supporter of the Universe, recognizing that while the world depends on this divine foundation, that foundation itself is beyond worldly existence.
vishnu_gita::38.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by tasks and worries, remember that your true self is untouched by external chaos and pressures.
vishnu_gita::38.insight: It shifts your view from being defined by external life to recognizing your independent, unbounded essence.

vishnu_gita::39.verse_hindi: आप ही की अव्यक्ता प्रकृति भी व्यक्ता होकर बुद्धि अहङ्कार तन्मात्रा पञ्चभूत और इन्द्रियरूप से सदा
vishnu_gita::39.english_translation: Your unmanifest nature also becomes manifest as intellect, ego, subtle elements, the five elements, and senses always.
vishnu_gita::39.translation_literal: तवैव (your own) / प्रकृतिस्त्वत् (nature of you) / अव्यक्ताऽपि (unmanifest also) / व्यक्तिमागता (manifest becomes) / बुद्धि (intellect) / अहङ्कार (ego) / तन्मात्रा (subtle elements) / भूतेन्द्रियया (five elements and senses) / सदा (always)
vishnu_gita::39.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::39.essence: The mind, ego, and senses emerge from your unseen natural essence.
vishnu_gita::39.simple_meaning: Your unseen natural essence becomes the mind, ego, subtle energies, physical elements, and senses you experience.
vishnu_gita::39.simple_insight: You are more than your mind and senses—they arise from a deeper source within you.
vishnu_gita::39.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Vishnu explains that the unmanifest, or unseen, nature within you transforms into the intellect, ego, subtle energies, the five physical elements, and your senses. This shows how all mental and physical experiences come from a deeper, hidden essence.
vishnu_gita::39.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your thoughts or emotions, remember they arise from a deeper, unseen part of you beyond the noise.
vishnu_gita::39.insight: Recognize that your mind and ego are expressions of a deeper natural source, helping you detach from identifying completely with them.

vishnu_gita::40.verse_sanskrit:
स्थूलसूक्ष्मात्मकं विश्वमुत्पादयति सर्वथा ।
मूलशून्य ! जगन्मूलमूलभूत ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::40.verse_hindi: स्थूल सूक्ष्मात्मक विश्व को सर्वथा उत्पन्न करती है, हे प्रभो! आप जगत् की मूल जो प्रकृति उसके भी मूल हो और स्वयं मूलशून्य हो, आप को प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::40.english_translation: You create the gross and subtle worlds completely; you are the root of the world's root, fundamentally empty; salutations to you.
vishnu_gita::40.translation_literal: स्थूलसूक्ष्मात्मकं (gross-subtle-combined) / विश्वमुत्पादयति (creates the world) / सर्वथा (completely) / मूलशून्य (root-empty) / जगन्मूलमूलभूत (root of world's root) / नमोऽस्तु (salutations be) / ते (to you)
vishnu_gita::40.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::40.essence: The origin of all worlds is an empty root that creates everything fully.
vishnu_gita::40.simple_meaning: Everything visible and invisible arises fully from you, who are the fundamental root beyond all things and empty in essence.
vishnu_gita::40.simple_insight: There's awe in knowing the deepest source of all is empty yet the origin of everything.
vishnu_gita::40.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares that he is the source of all worlds, both gross and subtle. Though he is the fundamental root of all existence, his nature is emptiness itself. This paradox points to the cosmic origin beyond form and substance.
vishnu_gita::40.modern_relevance: When feeling overwhelmed by complexity, remember that the source of all things is simple emptiness, not chaos or confusion.
vishnu_gita::40.insight: It shifts the mind from seeing complexity as separate to recognizing a single empty root behind all forms.

vishnu_gita::41.verse_sanskrit:
कोषेणाऽनमयेन त्वं स्थूलविश्वमयो भवन्।
जीवान् विमोहयस्येव मोहहेतो ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::41.verse_hindi: अन्नमयकोष से आप स्थूल विश्वमय होते हुए जीवों को मोहित करते हैं, हे मोह हेतो ! आपको प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::41.english_translation: You become the gross physical world through the sheath of food and thus delude living beings; salutations to you, cause of delusion.
vishnu_gita::41.translation_literal: कोषेणाऽनमयेन (by the food sheath) / त्वं (you) / स्थूलविश्वमयो (become the gross world) / भवन् (being) / जीवाः (living beings) / विमोहयसि (delude) / एव (indeed) / मोहहेतो (cause of delusion) / नमः (salutations) / अस्तु (be) / ते (to you)
vishnu_gita::41.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::41.essence: The physical body veil causes confusion that hides the true nature of living beings.
vishnu_gita::41.simple_meaning: You take the form of the physical world through the food sheath, causing living beings to be confused and deluded.
vishnu_gita::41.simple_insight: There is confusion hidden in the body’s form that blocks seeing the true self.
vishnu_gita::41.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that through the annamaya kosha, or food sheath, the divine manifests as the gross physical world, which causes living beings to be deluded about their true nature. This moment reveals the origin of confusion and the veil covering reality.
vishnu_gita::41.modern_relevance: When you identify fully with your body and needs, it’s easy to lose sight of who you truly are beneath.
vishnu_gita::41.insight: It teaches you to distinguish between the physical body and the deeper true self behind it.

vishnu_gita::42.verse_sanskrit:
स्थूलो वै मृत्युलोकोऽस्ति सूक्ष्मो लोकोऽस्ति वैबुधः।
भवान् प्राणमयः कोषो भूत्वा स्थापयति स्वतः ॥
vishnu_gita::42.verse_hindi: स्थूल मृत्युलोक और सूक्ष्म दैवलोक इन दोनों लोकों में आप प्राणमयकोष होकर स्वतः स्थापन करते हैं
vishnu_gita::42.english_translation: There is a gross mortal world and a subtle divine world; you establish yourself naturally as the vital sheath in both.
vishnu_gita::42.translation_literal: स्थूलो (gross) वै (indeed) मृत्युलोकोऽस्ति (there is a mortal world) सूक्ष्मो (subtle) लोकोऽस्ति (there is a world) वैबुधः (divine) भवान् (you) प्राणमयः (vital-breath composed) कोषो (sheath) भूत्वा (having become) स्थापयति (establish) स्वतः (naturally)
vishnu_gita::42.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::42.essence: You naturally exist as the vital life force connecting both gross and subtle worlds.
vishnu_gita::42.simple_meaning: You naturally exist as the vital life force connecting the physical mortal world and the subtle divine world.
vishnu_gita::42.simple_insight: You carry life’s energy bridging what is visible and what is beyond, naturally and effortlessly.
vishnu_gita::42.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that existence spans two realms: the gross mortal world and the subtle divine world. You embody the vital life energy (pranamaya kosha) that naturally sustains and connects both realms, revealing your role beyond mere physicality.
vishnu_gita::42.modern_relevance: You feel split between your daily physical struggles and your inner spiritual longings, yet your true being is the vital life force connecting both.
vishnu_gita::42.insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself only as a physical body to recognizing your subtle life force bridging two realities.

vishnu_gita::43.verse_sanskrit:
परस्परं सुसम्बन्धमनयोर्लोकयोः सतोः।
सम्बन्धस्थापनाकम्मदक्षताभाक् ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::43.verse_hindi: इन दोनों लोकों परस्पर सम्बन्ध हे सम्बन्ध स्थापन के कर्म में परम दक्ष ! आपको प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::43.english_translation: You are supremely skilled in the action that establishes connections between these two worlds; I bow to you.
vishnu_gita::43.translation_literal: परस्परं (mutually) / सुसम्बन्धम् (good connection) / अनयोः (of these two) / लोकयोः (worlds) / सतोः (of the beings) / सम्बन्धस्थापनाकम् (in establishing connection) / मदक्षताभाक् (perfectly skilled) / नमोऽस्तु (I bow) / ते (to you)
vishnu_gita::43.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::43.essence: Skillful action creates and sustains vital connections between separate worlds.
vishnu_gita::43.simple_meaning: You have great skill in performing actions that create and maintain connections between different realms or worlds.
vishnu_gita::43.simple_insight: You can feel respect and confidence in how your efforts link wider realities.
vishnu_gita::43.detailed_meaning: In a conversation praising the skill of one who acts to establish connections between two worlds, the speaker acknowledges mastery in the delicate work of maintaining balance across realms.
vishnu_gita::43.modern_relevance: When you build bridges between different people or ideas, your skill creates unity where there was separation.
vishnu_gita::43.insight: It teaches you to see your actions as powerful bridges that connect beyond what is immediately visible.

vishnu_gita::44.verse_sanskrit:
मनोमयेन कोषेणाविद्यायाः परमादभुतम्।
विज्ञानमयकोषेण विद्यायाश्च निकेतनम् ॥
vishnu_gita::44.verse_hindi: मनो-मय कोष से परम अद्भुत अविद्या निकेतन को बना कर और विज्ञानमय कोष से विद्या के निकेतन को
vishnu_gita::44.english_translation: The supreme wonder of ignorance arises from the mind-filled sheath, while the abode of knowledge is formed by the intellect-filled sheath.
vishnu_gita::44.translation_literal: मनोमयेन (by the mind-filled) / कोषेण (sheath) /avidyायाः (of ignorance) / परमादभुतम् (supreme wonder) / विज्ञानमयकोषेण (by intellect-filled sheath) / विद्यायाश्च (of knowledge) / निकेतनम् (abode)
vishnu_gita::44.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::44.essence: Confusion lives in the restless mind; true knowledge dwells in the clear intellect.
vishnu_gita::44.simple_meaning: Ignorance arises from the restless mind, while true knowledge lives in the discerning intellect within you.
vishnu_gita::44.simple_insight: You can feel both confusion and clarity in your mind at once.
vishnu_gita::44.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that ignorance is rooted in the mind's restless and fluctuating nature, while real knowledge dwells in the stable and discerning intellect, showing two inner layers that shape experience.
vishnu_gita::44.modern_relevance: When your thoughts overwhelm you, confusion grows; but when your clear thinking guides you, understanding blossoms.
vishnu_gita::44.insight: It teaches you to notice whether your mind is clouded by restless thoughts or led by clear discrimination.

vishnu_gita::45.verse_sanskrit:
सृष्टवाऽऽनन्दमये कोषे निसानन्दो विराजसे।
सृष्टिशोभादिनैपुण्यकुलगेह ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::45.verse_hindi: बनाकर आनन्दमयकोष में आप नित्यानन्दरूप से विराजमान रहते हैं, आप सृष्टि की शोभादि के नैपुण्य में मुख्याधिष्ठाता हैं, आपको प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::45.english_translation: Having created the blissful sheath, you reside eternally as pure bliss, the chief guide of creation's excellence; I bow to you.
vishnu_gita::45.translation_literal: सृष्टवाऽऽनन्दमये (having created in blissful) / कोषे (sheath) / निसानन्दो (eternal bliss) / विराजसे (you reside) / सृष्टिशोभादि (creation's excellence etc.) / नैपुण्यकुलगेह (chief guide of excellence lineage) / नमोऽस्तु (be my salutations) / ते (to you)
vishnu_gita::45.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::45.essence: The divine dwells eternally as bliss, guiding the excellence of creation.
vishnu_gita::45.simple_meaning: You dwell eternally as bliss within the blissful sheath and oversee the excellence of creation. I honor you.
vishnu_gita::45.simple_insight: There is reverence in recognizing the divine presence as the source of bliss and order.
vishnu_gita::45.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the narrator Suta praises Vishnu, who dwells eternally as pure bliss within the blissful sheath (anandamaya kosa). Vishnu is recognized as the supreme guide overseeing the splendor and perfection of creation, and the verse expresses deep reverence.
vishnu_gita::45.insight: It invites seeing the source of all creation as a presence of joy and mastery beyond appearances.

vishnu_gita::46.verse_sanskrit:
वैचित्र्यं भवतोऽपूर्व भवान् सन् हि भवानसन्।
सदसद्भ्यामतीतोऽपि भवान् भाति नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::46.verse_hindi: आपका अपूर्व वैचित्र्य है, आप सत् भी हैं और असत् भी हैं एवं आप सत् असत् से अतीत भी प्रतीत होते हैं, आपको प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::46.english_translation: Your uniqueness is unprecedented; you are both real and unreal, and appear beyond reality and unreality. I bow to you.
vishnu_gita::46.translation_literal:
वैचित्र्यं (uniqueness) भवतोऽपूर्व (of you unprecedented) भवान् (you) सन् (being) हि (indeed) भवानसन् (you are) ।
सदसद्भ्यामतीतोऽपि (beyond real and unreal) भवान् (you) भाति (appear) नमोऽस्तु (salutations) ते (to you) ॥
vishnu_gita::46.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::46.essence: True uniqueness transcends the boundaries of real and unreal existence.
vishnu_gita::46.simple_meaning: You are unlike anything else, existing beyond simple categories of real and unreal. Your presence goes beyond ordinary understanding.
vishnu_gita::46.simple_insight: There is awe in recognizing something that cannot be confined by usual limits or labels.
vishnu_gita::46.detailed_meaning: The verse expresses reverence toward a being whose nature defies normal categories of existence. It honors someone who is simultaneously real, unreal, and beyond both, inspiring wonder and devotion.
vishnu_gita::46.modern_relevance: You meet someone whose character or presence feels impossible to define—beyond any label or category you know.
vishnu_gita::46.insight: It invites you to hold space for mystery and uniqueness beyond fixed concepts of reality.

vishnu_gita::47.verse_hindi: आपकी ही अर्धाङ्गिनी विश्वमोहिनी तुरीया शक्ति कारण सूक्ष्म और स्थूलरूप को प्राप्त होकर अनेक प्रकार से
vishnu_gita::47.english_translation: Your half-consort is the supreme power, the threefold energy that continuously manifests the universe in both subtle and gross forms.
vishnu_gita::47.translation_literal: तव (your) एव (indeed) अर्धाङ्गिनी (half-consort) शक्तिः (power) तुरियाः (threefold) विश्वमोहिनी (world-enchanting) कारण (cause) स्थूल (gross) सूक्ष्मत्वम् (subtlety) अधिगच्छ (attains) निरन्तरम् (continuously)
vishnu_gita::47.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::47.essence: The divine threefold energy continuously manifests all subtle and gross forms of existence.
vishnu_gita::47.simple_meaning: The divine energy, described as your half-consort, is the continuous force that creates and sustains all subtle and gross aspects of the universe.
vishnu_gita::47.simple_insight: Recognizing the divine energy as the source behind all forms brings awe for the unity behind diversity.
vishnu_gita::47.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Vishnu describes the divine feminine energy as his half-consort, the threefold power that continuously manifests the universe's many forms, both subtle and gross, highlighting the cosmic creative force behind existence.
vishnu_gita::47.insight: It reveals the cosmic energy behind all appearances, inviting a deeper sense of connection with the universe's unfolding.

vishnu_gita::48.verse_sanskrit:
ब्रह्माण्डं बहुधाऽनन्तं प्रसूते पाति च स्वतः।
विचित्रशक्ते ! शक्तीश ! निसशक्त ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::48.verse_hindi: अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डो को निरन्तर उत्पन्न करती हैं और रक्षा करती हैं, हे विचित्रशक्ति ! हे शक्तीश! हे नित्यशक्त ! आपको प्रणाम है।
vishnu_gita::48.english_translation: The infinite cosmos continuously arises and is sustained by you, O wondrous power! O energy! O eternal strength! I bow to you.
vishnu_gita::48.translation_literal: ब्रह्माण्डं (cosmos) / बहुधा (in many ways) / अनन्तं (infinite) / प्रसूते (arises) / पाति (sustains) / च (and) / स्वतः (by itself) / विचित्रशक्ते (O wondrous power) / शक्तीश (O energy) / निसशक्त (O eternal strength) / नमोऽस्तु (I bow) / ते (to you)
vishnu_gita::48.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::48.essence: A wondrous force continuously creates and sustains the infinite cosmos.
vishnu_gita::48.simple_meaning: The infinite universe keeps coming into being and is maintained by a mysterious, powerful energy to whom respect is given.
vishnu_gita::48.simple_insight: There is a vast, sustaining power behind everything that continuously supports all existence.
vishnu_gita::48.detailed_meaning: The verse honors a mysterious, powerful energy that continuously creates and preserves the infinite universe, expressing reverence for this sustaining force behind all things.
vishnu_gita::48.insight: It invites seeing the universe as alive and supported by a constant, dynamic power beyond ordinary perception.

vishnu_gita::49.verse_sanskrit:
भवानेव महाविष्णुस्त्वत्तोऽसंख्या निरन्तरम् ।
ब्रह्माणो विष्णवो रुद्रा आविर्भाव परं गताः ॥
vishnu_gita::49.verse_hindi: आप ही महाविष्णु हैं आपसे असंख्य ब्रह्मा विष्णु और रुद्र निरन्तर आविर्भाव को प्राप्त होकर
vishnu_gita::49.english_translation: You alone are the great Vishnu; from you countless Brahmas, Vishnus, and Rudras continuously emerge.
vishnu_gita::49.translation_literal: भवानेव (You alone) महाविष्णुस्त्वत्तः (are the great Vishnu) असंख्या (countless) निरन्तरम् (continuously) ब्रह्माणः (Brahmas) विष्णवः (Vishnus) रुद्रा (Rudras) आविर्भाव (emergence) परं (supreme) गताः (have attained)
vishnu_gita::49.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::49.essence: Countless divine manifestations continuously emerge from the one supreme Vishnu.
vishnu_gita::49.simple_meaning: The supreme being Vishnu is the source from whom countless creators, preservers, and transformers arise continuously.
vishnu_gita::49.simple_insight: Everything that appears is a continuous expression of the one supreme reality.
vishnu_gita::49.detailed_meaning: Suta describes the cosmic principle Vishnu as the origin of all divine manifestations—Brahma the creator, Vishnu the preserver, and Rudra the transformer—who emerge endlessly from that singular source.
vishnu_gita::49.insight: It shifts focus from separate divine forms to their shared origin, encouraging seeing unity beneath diversity.

vishnu_gita::50.verse_sanskrit:
स्वस्वब्रह्माण्डसवानां सृष्टिस्थितिलयानलम् ।
सम्पादयन्ति नियतं सर्वधातर्नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::50.verse_hindi: अपने अपने ब्रह्माण्डसंघों के सृष्टि स्थिति और प्रलयों को नियतरूप से सम्पादन करते हैं, हे सर्वधातः! आपको प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::50.english_translation: The lords of their own universes constantly perform creation, preservation, and dissolution; salutations to you, all elemental beings.
vishnu_gita::50.translation_literal: स्वस्वब्रह्माण्डसवानां (of their own universes) / सृष्टिस्थितिलयानलम् (creation-preservation-dissolution-fire) / सम्पादयन्ति (perform) / नियतं (regularly) / सर्वधातर्नमः (salutations to all elemental beings) / अस्तु (may it be) / ते (to you)
vishnu_gita::50.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::50.essence: Cosmic lords continuously manage creation, preservation, and dissolution in their realms.
vishnu_gita::50.simple_meaning: Different cosmic lords regularly carry out cycles of creation, preservation, and destruction, and all elemental beings are honored.
vishnu_gita::50.simple_insight: There is a continuous, orderly process behind the vast cycles of change in existence.
vishnu_gita::50.detailed_meaning: Suta describes how various cosmic lords govern their own universes, maintaining the cycles of creation, preservation, and destruction, acknowledging the fundamental forces at work.
vishnu_gita::50.insight: Recognize the ongoing natural cycles beyond individual control that sustain the universe’s flow.

vishnu_gita::51.verse_sanskrit:
जड़े सच्चेन चित्त्वेन चेतने तु द्वयोस्तयोः।
आनन्दत्वेन भासि त्वं सच्चिदानन्द ! ते नमः ॥
vishnu_gita::51.verse_hindi: जड़ में सत्सत्तारूप से और चेतन में चित्सत्तारूप से और सत् चित् इन दोनों में आनन्द सत्ता रूप से आप भासमान होते हैं, हे सञ्चिदानन्द ! आपको प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::51.english_translation: In the inanimate, you appear as the essence of existence; in the conscious, as the essence of awareness; and in both existence and awareness, you shine as the essence of bliss, O Satchidananda! Salutations to you.
vishnu_gita::51.translation_literal: जड़े (in the inanimate) / सच्चेन (by the essence of existence) / चित्त्वेन (in the conscious) / चेतने (in awareness) / तु (but) / द्वयोः (of the two) / तयोः (of these) / आनन्दत्वेन (by the essence of bliss) / भासि (you shine) / त्वं (you) / सच्चिदानन्द (existence-awareness-bliss) / ते (to you) / नमः (salutations)
vishnu_gita::51.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::51.essence: Your true self shines as existence, awareness, and bliss everywhere in all things.
vishnu_gita::51.simple_meaning: You are the presence behind all things: in the lifeless as pure being, in the conscious as awareness, and in both combined as bliss.
vishnu_gita::51.simple_insight: You can feel connected to everything because your true self is the source of all existence, awareness, and joy.
vishnu_gita::51.detailed_meaning: Vishnu reveals how the true self pervades all reality: present in the lifeless natural world as existence, within living beings as awareness, and ultimately as pure bliss uniting both.
vishnu_gita::51.modern_relevance: When you pause to notice, you realize your true self is not just your thoughts or body but the deep presence shining as life, awareness, and joy everywhere.
vishnu_gita::51.insight: This verse invites you to recognize your identity beyond separation—as the underlying reality of being, knowing, and happiness.

vishnu_gita::52.verse_sanskrit:
विष्णोः सूर्य्यस्य शक्तेश्च गणेशस्य शिवस्य च।
रूपेण सगुणं रम्यं गृहीत्वा मूर्तिपञ्चकम् ॥
vishnu_gita::52.verse_hindi: हे देव ! विष्णु सूर्य शक्ति गणेश और शिवके स्वरूप से मङ्गलकर सगुण पञ्चमूर्ति को ग्रहण करके
vishnu_gita::52.english_translation: O divine one, embracing the five beautiful manifested forms of Vishnu, Surya, Shakti, Ganesha, and Shiva.
vishnu_gita::52.translation_literal: विष्णोः (of Vishnu) / सूर्य्यस्य (of Surya) / शक्तेश्च (and Shakti) / गणेशस्य (of Ganesha) / शिवस्य (of Shiva) / च (also) / रूपेण (in form) / सगुणं (with qualities) / रम्यं (beautiful) / गृहीत्वा (having taken) / मूर्तिपञ्चकम् (five forms)
vishnu_gita::52.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::52.essence: The divine embraces many beautiful forms together as one.
vishnu_gita::52.simple_meaning: The verse describes taking up five beautiful forms representing Vishnu, Surya, Shakti, Ganesha, and Shiva together.
vishnu_gita::52.simple_insight: The divine can appear in many beautiful, connected forms without losing unity.
vishnu_gita::52.detailed_meaning: This verse narrates a moment where the divine embraces five distinct, beautiful forms representing major deities, symbolizing unity among diverse divine aspects.
vishnu_gita::52.insight: It shows that the divine can encompass many forms, highlighting unity in diversity.

vishnu_gita::53.verse_sanskrit:
भवानेकोऽद्वितीयः सन्नुपास्तिपदवीं हिताम् ।
करोति सुगमा देव ! भक्तिहतो ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::53.verse_hindi: आप एक और अद्वितीय होने पर भी हितकारक उपासना की शैली को सुगम करते हैं, हे भक्तिहेतो ! आपको प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::53.english_translation: Even as the unique supreme being, you make the path of beneficial worship easy, O devoted one! I bow to you.
vishnu_gita::53.translation_literal: भवानेकोऽद्वितीयः (To the one unique supreme being) / सन्नुपास्तिपदवीं (the mode of worship) / हिताम् (beneficial) / करोति (makes) / सुगमा (easy) / देव (O divine one) / भक्तिहतो (O devoted one) / नमोऽस्तु ते (I bow to you)
vishnu_gita::53.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::53.essence: The unique supreme being makes beneficial devotion easy and approachable.
vishnu_gita::53.simple_meaning: You are uniquely supreme yet you make worship that benefits others easy and accessible.
vishnu_gita::53.simple_insight: Devotion can be both unique and welcoming, inviting anyone to connect.
vishnu_gita::53.detailed_meaning: This verse praises the unique supreme being who, despite singularity, makes the practice of worship clear and easy for devotees. It honors the one who removes barriers for sincere devotion.
vishnu_gita::53.modern_relevance: When spiritual practices feel too complex or distant, this reminds you that true devotion is accessible and welcoming.
vishnu_gita::53.insight: It shifts your view from seeing devotion as difficult to seeing it as a simple, heartfelt connection.

vishnu_gita::54.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वेश्वर ! भवानव स्वयं यज्ञेशरूपतः ।
मोक्षदां कर्मकाण्डीयां गति पासि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::54.verse_hindi: हे सर्वेश्वर ! आप स्वयं ही यज्ञेश्वर रूप से मोक्षदायिनी कर्म काण्डीय गति की रक्षा करते हैं आपको प्रणाम है
vishnu_gita::54.english_translation: O Lord of all, you yourself, in the form of the lord of sacrifice, protect the path of liberation through ritual actions; I bow to you.
vishnu_gita::54.translation_literal: सर्वेश्वर (Lord of all) / भवानव (you) / स्वयं (yourself) / यज्ञेशरूपतः (in the form of the lord of sacrifice) / मोक्षदां (giving liberation) / कर्मकाण्डीयां (ritual actions-related) / गति (path) / पासि (protect) / नमोऽस्तु (I bow) / ते (to you)
vishnu_gita::54.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::54.essence: The supreme protector guards the path of liberation through sacred actions.
vishnu_gita::54.simple_meaning: The verse praises the divine as the protector of the path to liberation through rituals, offering respectful obeisance.
vishnu_gita::54.simple_insight: There is reassurance in knowing a higher power safeguards your spiritual journey through disciplined practices.
vishnu_gita::54.detailed_meaning: The verse addresses the divine as the supreme lord who manifests as the master of sacred rituals and protects the path of spiritual freedom offered through these ritualistic actions. It is an expression of reverence acknowledging this protection.
vishnu_gita::54.insight: It highlights trusting a greater guiding force that supports disciplined practice as a way to freedom.

vishnu_gita::55.verse_sanskrit:
त्वं चिद्गावमयो विष्णुः सद्भावात्ममयः शिवः ।
तेजोभावमयः मूर्यो गणेशो ज्ञानितामयः ॥
vishnu_gita::55.verse_hindi: आप चिद्भावमय विष्णु सद्भावमय शिव, तेजोभावमय सूर्य, ज्ञान भावमय गणेश और
vishnu_gita::55.english_translation: You are the conscious essence like Vishnu, the embodiment of goodness like Shiva, radiant like the Sun, and the embodiment of wisdom like Ganesha.
vishnu_gita::55.translation_literal: त्वं (you) चिद्गावमयो (conscious essence) विष्णुः (Vishnu) सद्भावात्ममयः (embodiment of goodness) शिवः (Shiva) । तेजोभावमयः (embodiment of radiance) मूर्यो (Sun) गणेशो (Ganesha) ज्ञानितामयः (embodiment of wisdom) ॥
vishnu_gita::55.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::55.essence: Your true self embodies consciousness, goodness, radiance, and wisdom together.
vishnu_gita::55.simple_meaning: You embody the essence of consciousness, goodness, radiance, and wisdom represented by Vishnu, Shiva, the Sun, and Ganesha respectively.
vishnu_gita::55.simple_insight: You carry many divine qualities within you, blending awareness, goodness, light, and wisdom.
vishnu_gita::55.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares that the true self shares qualities with major divine figures: conscious awareness like Vishnu, goodness like Shiva, radiance like the Sun, and wisdom like Ganesha, showing the multifaceted nature of the inner being.
vishnu_gita::55.modern_relevance: You may feel fragmented, but recognizing your inner qualities as unified can bring strength and clarity.
vishnu_gita::55.insight: It teaches you to recognize your inner being as a blend of conscious awareness, goodness, energy, and wisdom.

vishnu_gita::56.verse_sanskrit:
शक्तिभावमयी देवी भूत्वाऽभ्याऽन्याऽधिकारिणः ।
बोधयत्यात्मबोधं सगुणोपास्तौ नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
vishnu_gita::56.verse_hindi: शक्तिभावमयी देवी होकर अन्यान्य अधिकारियों को सगुणोपासना में आत्मज्ञान का उपदेश देते हैं, आपको प्रणाम है।
vishnu_gita::56.english_translation: Becoming the embodiment of power, the goddess teaches self-knowledge to other authorities in qualified worship; salutations to you.
vishnu_gita::56.translation_literal: शक्तिभावमयी (embodiment of power) / देवी (goddess) / भूत्वाऽभ्याऽन्याऽधिकारिणः (having become other authorities) / बोधयति (teaches) / आत्मबोधं (self-knowledge) / सगुणोपास्तौ (in qualified worship) / नमोऽस्तु (be salutations) / ते (to you)
vishnu_gita::56.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::56.essence: Powerful leadership teaches self-awareness through devoted practice.
vishnu_gita::56.simple_meaning: A powerful goddess teaches self-knowledge through worship to other leaders, and she is respectfully honored.
vishnu_gita::56.simple_insight: Respect comes from sharing deep understanding with others who lead.
vishnu_gita::56.detailed_meaning: The verse describes a divine feminine figure who, embodying power, instructs other authorities in the practice of worship with qualities to realize self-knowledge. This highlights a teaching moment where wisdom is passed among spiritual leaders.
vishnu_gita::56.insight: It shows that true authority grows by guiding others toward understanding beyond mere power.

vishnu_gita::57.verse_sanskrit:
हे सर्वशक्तिमन् ! शक्त ! हे सर्वात्मन् ! कृपानिधे ।
तवैव शक्तितो नूनं भवामश्चालिता वयम् ॥
vishnu_gita::57.verse_hindi: हे सर्वशक्तिमन् ! हे शक्त ! हे सर्वात्मन् ! हे कृपानिधे! आपकी ही शक्ति से हम सब देवतागण चालित होते हैं यह निश्चय है।
vishnu_gita::57.english_translation: O all-powerful one! O source of strength! O all-pervading one! O ocean of compassion! It is certain that by your power alone we beings are moved and active.
vishnu_gita::57.translation_literal: हे (O) सर्वशक्तिमन् (all-powerful one) ! शक्त (source of strength) ! हे (O) सर्वात्मन् (all-pervading one) ! कृपानिधे (ocean of compassion) । तवैव (by you alone) शक्तितो (by power) नूनं (certainly) भवाम् (we beings) अश्चालिता (moved/active) वयम् (we) ॥
vishnu_gita::57.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::57.essence: All action and movement arise solely through the power of the compassionate, all-pervading divine.
vishnu_gita::57.simple_meaning: We move and act only because of the power of the divine, who is compassionate and all-pervading.
vishnu_gita::57.simple_insight: Recognizing that your energy flows from a greater source brings trust and humility.
vishnu_gita::57.detailed_meaning: The speaker calls out to the divine as the all-powerful and compassionate source of all energy. They acknowledge that all beings are moved and active only because of this divine power, showing dependence and reverence in a moment of realization.
vishnu_gita::57.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed or stuck, remembering that your strength comes from a greater source can relieve pressure and renew motivation.
vishnu_gita::57.insight: It shifts the mind from self-reliance to grateful acknowledgment of the greater power energizing all action.

vishnu_gita::58.verse_sanskrit:
तवैव सत्तया देव ! सत्तावन्तो वयं तव ।
आश्रिता आपि मूढास्त्वां विस्मरामो हि मायया ॥
vishnu_gita::58.verse_hindi: आप की ही सत्ता से हे देव ! हम सत्तावान् हैं, आपके आश्रित होने पर भी हम मूढ़ माया के द्वारा आपको भूल जाते हैं
vishnu_gita::58.english_translation: By your power alone, O divine! We exist, yet even as your dependents, we foolishly forget you due to illusion.
vishnu_gita::58.translation_literal: तवैव (by your alone) / सत्तया (power) / देव (O divine) / सत्तावन्तो (having existence) / वयं (we) / तव (your) / आश्रिता (dependent) / आपि (even) / मूढास्त्वां (foolish you) / विस्मरामो (forget) / हि (indeed) / मायया (by illusion)
vishnu_gita::58.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::58.essence: You exist because of the divine, yet illusion causes you to forget this truth.
vishnu_gita::58.simple_meaning: Your existence depends entirely on the divine, yet even as your dependents, we foolishly forget you because of illusion.
vishnu_gita::58.simple_insight: There is a humble confusion within us despite our deep connection to the divine.
vishnu_gita::58.detailed_meaning: In this moment, a speaker acknowledges that all beings exist solely by the power of the divine. Still, despite this dependence, they admit how illusion causes them to forget and lose awareness of this fundamental truth.
vishnu_gita::58.modern_relevance: You rely on support and connection daily, yet distractions and confusion often make you forget that foundation.
vishnu_gita::58.insight: Recognizing illusion’s power to disconnect you helps you return to trust and presence with the divine.

vishnu_gita::59.verse_sanskrit:
त्वाद्विस्मृतिमतां मोहमस्माकं हरसि प्रभो!।
विपच्छासनतो नूनमहो ते महती दया ॥
vishnu_gita::59.verse_hindi: हे प्रभो! आपको भूलने वाले हम लोगों को मोह को आप विपत्ति रूप शासन के द्वारा अवश्य हरण करते हैं, अहो ! आपकी महती दया है
vishnu_gita::59.english_translation: O Lord! You remove the delusion of those who forget you by governing calamity; your compassion is immense.
vishnu_gita::59.translation_literal: त्वात् (from you) विस्मृति-मताम् (of those who forget) मोहम् (delusion) अस्माकम् (our) हरसि (you remove) प्रभो (O Lord) । विपच्छासन-तो (by ruling calamity) नूनम् (surely) अहः (ah) ते (your) महती (great) दया (compassion) ॥
vishnu_gita::59.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::59.essence: Life’s hardships are compassionate acts that remove confusion from those who forget the divine.
vishnu_gita::59.simple_meaning: When we forget the divine, life’s hardships help remove our confusion through divine compassion.
vishnu_gita::59.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing difficulties can awaken us from confusion with gentle care.
vishnu_gita::59.detailed_meaning: The speaker acknowledges that forgetting the divine leads to delusion. The divine, through governing challenges and hardships, removes this confusion with great compassion, showing how difficulties serve a higher purpose of awakening.
vishnu_gita::59.modern_relevance: You face unexpected setbacks that shake your certainty, but these moments gently guide you back to deeper understanding and care.
vishnu_gita::59.insight: It teaches you to see hardships as compassionate guidance clearing confusion, not just random suffering.

vishnu_gita::60.verse_sanskrit:
वयं शरणमापन्नाः शरणागतवत्सल !।
भयं नो मोहजं येन विनश्यति तथा कुरु ॥
vishnu_gita::60.verse_hindi: हे शरणागतवत्सल ! हम आपके शरण आये हैं जिससे हमारा मोहजनित भय नाश हो जाय ऐसा आप करें
vishnu_gita::60.english_translation: O protector of those who seek refuge, we have come to you so that the fear born of delusion may be destroyed; please make it so.
vishnu_gita::60.translation_literal: वयं (we) / शरणमापन्नाः (having taken refuge) / शरणागतवत्सल (protector of those seeking refuge) / भयं (fear) / नो (our) / मोहजं (born of delusion) / येन (by which) / विनश्यति (is destroyed) / तथा (thus) / कुरु (do)
vishnu_gita::60.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::60.essence: Seeking refuge opens the way for fears born of confusion to be gently removed.
vishnu_gita::60.simple_meaning: You come seeking protection so that the fear caused by confusion and false beliefs can be removed.
vishnu_gita::60.simple_insight: There is comfort in surrendering your fears to a caring refuge beyond your doubts.
vishnu_gita::60.detailed_meaning: In this moment, those who feel lost and confused seek refuge in a protector who cares deeply for them. They ask for their fears, which arise from misunderstanding and attachment, to be removed through that refuge.
vishnu_gita::60.modern_relevance: You’ve been carrying worries that twist your mind. When you find a safe space or person to turn to, those fears begin to lose their grip.
