vishnu_gita::503.simple_meaning: If someone loses the path of yoga, they still reach good worlds and are reborn in pure, wealthy families after enjoying long lives.
vishnu_gita::503.simple_insight: There is hope and continuity even when the highest path is lost temporarily.
vishnu_gita::503.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that a person who strays from the disciplined spiritual path of yoga does not fall into ruin but attains the realms of virtuous beings and enjoys long, comfortable lives before being reborn in pure and prosperous families. This highlights the compassionate order of cosmic justice and the consequences of spiritual failure.
vishnu_gita::503.modern_relevance: You might lose your way in a personal goal but still find opportunities to grow and return stronger.
vishnu_gita::503.insight: It shifts the mind to see spiritual setbacks as temporary, encouraging continued effort without despair.

vishnu_gita::504.verse_sanskrit:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम् ।
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम् ॥
vishnu_gita::504.verse_hindi: अथवा ज्ञानी योगियों के वंश मे वह जन्म ग्रहण करता है ऐसा जन्म होना जगत में निश्चय ही दुर्लभतर है
vishnu_gita::504.english_translation: Or else, the wise yogi is born into that lineage; such a birth is indeed the rarest in the world.
vishnu_gita::504.translation_literal: अथवा (or else) योगिनामेव (of yogis only) कुले (in the lineage) भवति (is born) धीमताम् (of the wise) । एतद्धि (this indeed) दुर्लभतरं (rarer) लोके (in the world) जन्म (birth) यदीदृशम् (such as this) ॥
vishnu_gita::504.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::504.essence: Being born into a wise yogi lineage is among the rarest and most precious births.
vishnu_gita::504.simple_meaning: Being born into a family of wise yogis is a very rare and valuable occurrence in life.
vishnu_gita::504.simple_insight: You carry the rare opportunity of wise heritage; that itself is a gift.
vishnu_gita::504.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that among all births, being born in a lineage of enlightened yogis is exceptionally rare and precious, highlighting the special chance to pursue wisdom granted by such a birth.
vishnu_gita::504.modern_relevance: Imagine realizing your family or background offers you access to wisdom that many never find — it's a chance to honor and build on that rare foundation.
vishnu_gita::504.insight: Recognize and value the unique opportunity your background gives to seek deeper understanding and practice.

vishnu_gita::505.verse_sanskrit:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोग लभते पौर्वदहिकम ।
यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ विबुधर्षभाः ॥
vishnu_gita::505.verse_hindi: हे देव गण ! वह उक्त दोनों प्रकार के जन्मों में ही पूर्वजन्म में उत्पन्न ब्रह्म विषयक बुद्धि-संयोग को प्राप्त करता है और मोक्ष के विषय में अधिक प्रयत्न करता है
vishnu_gita::505.english_translation: O divine beings! In both kinds of birth, the highest sages regain the wisdom connection from past lives and strive more for liberation.
vishnu_gita::505.translation_literal: तत्र (there) तं (that) बुद्धि-संयोग (connection with wisdom) लभते (attain) पौर्वदहिकम (born before/in previous life) । यतते (strive) च (and) ततो (thereafter) भूयः (more) संसिद्धौ (complete perfection) विबुधर्षभाः (best of sages) ॥
vishnu_gita::505.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::505.essence: Renewed effort is strengthened by wisdom gained from past lives.
vishnu_gita::505.simple_meaning: The highest sages regain the wisdom from their past lives and then work even harder to achieve full liberation.
vishnu_gita::505.simple_insight: You can build on past clarity to deepen your journey toward freedom.
vishnu_gita::505.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses the divine beings, explaining that the greatest sages who have lived before regain their earlier wisdom connection and then increase their efforts to reach complete inner freedom.
vishnu_gita::505.modern_relevance: You remember lessons from past experiences and push yourself harder when seeking real personal growth.
vishnu_gita::505.insight: It teaches you to recognize and build upon past inner clarity to strengthen your spiritual efforts.

vishnu_gita::506.verse_sanskrit:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव हियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः ।
जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्त्तते ॥
vishnu_gita::506.verse_hindi: पूर्वजन्म का अभ्यास ही उसको अवश करके ब्रह्मनिष्ठ बना देता है क्योकि योग के स्वरूप को जानने की इच्छा करनेवाला व्यक्ति भी वेद के शब्दसम्बन्धी स्वरूप को अतिक्रमण कर जाता है
vishnu_gita::506.english_translation: Repeated practice from past lives compels one to become established in the supreme reality, because even a seeker of yoga surpasses the word-bound nature of the Vedas.
vishnu_gita::506.translation_literal: पूर्वाभ्यासेन (by previous practice) तेनैव (by the same) हियते (is compelled) हि (indeed) अवशः (necessarily) अपि (even) सः (he) । जिज्ञासुः (seeker) अपि (also) योगस्य (of yoga) शब्दब्रह्माति (beyond the word-Brahman) वर्त्तते (transcends) ॥
vishnu_gita::506.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::506.essence: Long practice compels you beyond words into the true experience of yoga.
vishnu_gita::506.simple_meaning: Long-standing practice, even from past lives, shapes you deeply and helps you go beyond just words to experience the true nature of yoga.
vishnu_gita::506.simple_insight: You carry unseen strength from your past efforts that supports your deeper growth.
vishnu_gita::506.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that continuous practice over many lifetimes impresses a deep tendency in the seeker, so much so that even the desire to understand yoga goes beyond the literal words of scripture.
vishnu_gita::506.modern_relevance: After years of committing to a skill or habit, you find yourself naturally moving beyond just instructions to a deeper understanding and embodiment.
vishnu_gita::506.insight: Recognize that persistent practice builds an inner momentum that transcends intellectual learning and brings direct experience.

vishnu_gita::507.verse_sanskrit:
प्रयत्नादयतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्विषः।
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
vishnu_gita::507.verse_hindi: और प्रयत्नपूर्वक साधन करने वाला योगी पाप रहित होकर अनेक जन्मों में योगसिद्ध होकर तत्पश्चात् परम गति को प्राप्त होता है।
vishnu_gita::507.english_translation: A yogi who practices diligently becomes free from faults, attains perfection over many lifetimes, and then reaches the highest state.
vishnu_gita::507.translation_literal: प्रयत्नात् (by effort) अयतमानः (engaged) तु (indeed) योगी (the yogi) संशुद्ध (pure) किल्विषः (free from faults) अनेकजन्म (many births) संसिद्ध (perfected) तः (thereafter) याति (goes) परां (supreme) गतिम् (state)
vishnu_gita::507.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::507.essence: Persistent, sincere effort purifies and leads to the highest state across time.
vishnu_gita::507.simple_meaning: With steady and sincere effort, a yogi becomes free from faults and gradually perfects their practice, eventually reaching the highest state.
vishnu_gita::507.simple_insight: There's hope in steady effort: transformation unfolds patiently and leads to true freedom.
vishnu_gita::507.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that a dedicated yogi, practicing with consistent effort over many lives, overcomes faults and gradually attains mastery, culminating in reaching the supreme state beyond worldly limitations.
vishnu_gita::507.modern_relevance: You keep returning to your practice despite setbacks, trusting that consistent effort will bring lasting change over time.
vishnu_gita::507.insight: It teaches you to value steady, persistent effort as the true path to transformation and freedom.

vishnu_gita::508.verse_sanskrit:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन् मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् ।
यः प्रयाति स मभावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥
vishnu_gita::508.verse_hindi: शरीरान्त के समय मुझको स्मरण करते करते जो देह त्याग करता है वह मेरे भाव को प्राप्त होता है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
vishnu_gita::508.english_translation: At the time of leaving the body, whoever remembers me and departs attains my essence; there is no doubt about this.
vishnu_gita::508.translation_literal: अन्तकाले (at the time of death) / च (and) / मामेव (me alone) / स्मरन् (remembering) / मुक्त्वा (leaving) / कलेवरम् (the body) / यः (who) / प्रयाति (departs) / स (he) / मभावं (my essence) / याति (attains) / नास्ति (there is not) / अत्र (here) / संशयः (doubt)
vishnu_gita::508.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::508.essence: Remembering the divine at death ensures reaching its essence without doubt.
vishnu_gita::508.simple_meaning: If you remember the divine at the moment of death and leave your body, you will reach that divine essence without doubt.
vishnu_gita::508.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing your final focus guides your deepest connection beyond life.
vishnu_gita::508.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that as a person dies, focusing on the divine presence leads to union with that presence. This moment decides the soul's direction beyond the body.
vishnu_gita::508.modern_relevance: When life feels fragile, remembering your deepest values in your hardest moments can bring peace and clarity.
vishnu_gita::508.insight: It teaches you to cultivate devotion so your final moments naturally align with your highest truth.

vishnu_gita::509.verse_sanskrit:
यं यं वापि स्मरन् भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्।
तं तमेवेति भो देवाः ! सदा तद्भावभावितः ॥
vishnu_gita::509.verse_hindi: देहान्त के समय जिस जिस भाव का स्मरण करते करते वह योगी देहत्याग करता है, हे देवतागण ! सर्वदा उसी उसी भावना में चित्त के स्थित रहने के कारण उसी भाव को ही प्राप्त होता है
vishnu_gita::509.english_translation: At death, the yogi departs with the mind fixed on whatever state they remember, and the divine beings say, 'They always remain absorbed in that very state.'
vishnu_gita::509.translation_literal: यं (whichever) यं (whichever) वापि (also) स्मरन् (remembering) भावं (state) त्यजत्यन्ते (leaves at end) कलेवरम् (the body) । तं (that) तमेवेति (only that) भो (O) देवाः (divine beings) ! सदा (always) तद्भावभावितः (absorbed in that state) ॥
vishnu_gita::509.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::509.essence: Your final remembered state at death shapes what you become next.
vishnu_gita::509.simple_meaning: At the moment of death, the state you remember most deeply is the one you carry forward beyond the body.
vishnu_gita::509.simple_insight: Your last mental state matters deeply — it sets the course after death.
vishnu_gita::509.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains to the divine beings that a yogi's final remembered state at death determines their next experience, emphasizing how continuous mental absorption shapes the soul’s journey beyond the physical body.
vishnu_gita::509.modern_relevance: When you fall asleep after a long day, the last thoughts you hold can influence your dreams and mood on waking.
vishnu_gita::509.insight: This verse teaches to cultivate steady, positive states of mind so they become your lasting focus at life's end.

vishnu_gita::510.verse_sanskrit:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः।
कम्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्मादभवत योगिनः ॥
vishnu_gita::510.verse_hindi: मेरी सम्मति में योगी तपस्वियों से भी श्रेष्ठ है, ज्ञानियों भी श्रेष्ठ है और कर्मनिष्ठ व्यक्तियों से भी श्रेष्ठ है, अत: आप सभी को योगत्व की इच्छा ही रखनी चाहिए
vishnu_gita::510.english_translation: In my view, the yogi is superior to ascetics, wiser than scholars, and greater than those devoted to action; therefore, everyone should aspire to be a yogi.
vishnu_gita::510.translation_literal: तपस्विभ्योऽधिको (to ascetics superior) / योगी (yogi) / ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि (also to scholars) / मतोऽधिकः (in opinion superior) / कम्मिभ्यश्चाधिको (to those devoted to action superior) / योगी (yogi) / तस्मादभवत (therefore became) / योगिनः (yogis)
vishnu_gita::510.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::510.essence: Living as a yogi surpasses being only an ascetic, scholar, or dedicated actor.
vishnu_gita::510.simple_meaning: Being a yogi is considered superior to being just a renunciate, a scholar, or a person focused on action. You should aim to live as a yogi.
vishnu_gita::510.simple_insight: You can feel confident that embracing the yogi path brings a greater wholeness than limiting yourself to just renunciation, knowledge, or work.
vishnu_gita::510.detailed_meaning: In a teaching moment, Vishnu explains that the yogi path transcends other spiritual ways like asceticism, scholarship, and karma-focused living. This encourages seekers to aim for yoga as the highest ideal.
vishnu_gita::510.modern_relevance: You balance learning, doing, and discipline but wonder which path leads to the fullest life. This reminds you the yogi way integrates all these qualities.
vishnu_gita::510.insight: It teaches you to unify disciplines—renunciation, wisdom, and action—into a single integrated path of yoga.

vishnu_gita::511.verse_sanskrit:
कम्मण्येवाधिकारो वो मा फलेषु कदाचन ।
न कर्मफलहेतुत्वं न वः सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्माणि ॥
vishnu_gita::511.verse_hindi: कर्म करने में ही आपलोगों का अधिकार है, फल इन इच्छा आप लोगों को कभी नहीं होनी चाहिए  आपको  कर्मफल की प्राप्ति के कारण भी नहीं होना चाहिए और न ही सकाम कर्मों में आपलोगों की प्रवृत्ति होनी चाहिये
vishnu_gita::511.english_translation: Your right is to act only, never to the fruit of action; never let the fruit be your motive, nor let your attachment be to inaction.
vishnu_gita::511.translation_literal: कम्मण्येवाधिकारो (right only in action) वो (your) मा (not) फलेषु (in fruits) कदाचन (ever). न (not) कर्मफलहेतुत्वं (cause of fruit of action) न (not) वः (your) सङ्गोऽस्तु (attachment be) अकर्माणि (to inaction).
vishnu_gita::511.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::511.essence: You only control your action, not its results or avoidance.
vishnu_gita::511.simple_meaning: You have the right to do your work, but not to control the results. Don't act because of desire for outcomes, nor avoid action out of fear.
vishnu_gita::511.simple_insight: Relief comes from focusing on your effort, not on winning or losing.
vishnu_gita::511.detailed_meaning: On the battlefield of life, Vishnu teaches that Arjuna must act according to his duty without craving the results or avoiding action. This frees him from anxiety and attachment, urging wholehearted effort without expectation.
vishnu_gita::511.modern_relevance: You send that important email, but can’t control the reply. Focusing on your effort frees you from stress over responses.
vishnu_gita::511.insight: It shifts your focus from chasing results to giving your best effort regardless of outcome.

vishnu_gita::512.verse_sanskrit:
वदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम् ।
अत् ति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा योगी परं  स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम् ॥
vishnu_gita::512.verse_hindi: वेदपाठ करने से, यज्ञ करने से, तपस्या करने से और दान करने से जो पुण्य कहा गया है, इस कर्मयोग के रहस्य को जान लेने से योगी उन सब पुण्यफलो को प्राप्त कर लेता है और जगत के मूलभूत परमपद को प्राप्त करता है
vishnu_gita::512.english_translation: By knowing the secret of karmayoga, a yogi attains all the fruits of Vedic study, sacrifices, austerities, and charity, and reaches the supreme foundation of the world.
vishnu_gita::512.translation_literal: वदेषु (in Vedic recitations) यज्ञेषु (in sacrifices) तपःसु (in austerities) चैव (also) दानेषु (in charity) यत्पुण्यफलं (whatever is the fruit of merit) प्रदिष्टम् (described) । अत् ति (that) तत् सर्वम् (all this) इदं (this) विदित्वा (knowing) योगी (the yogi) परं (the supreme) स्थानम् (foundation/position) उपैति (attains) च (and) आद्यम् (first/primary) ॥
vishnu_gita::512.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::512.essence: Knowing selfless action’s secret surpasses all ritual merit and leads to the highest state.
vishnu_gita::512.simple_meaning: Understanding the true practice of selfless action gives you the benefits of all rituals and leads you to the highest state.
vishnu_gita::512.simple_insight: You realize that true spiritual progress comes not from outer rituals but from how you act with awareness.
vishnu_gita::512.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that the merit gained from Vedic study, sacrifices, austerities, and charity is ultimately surpassed by understanding the essence of karmayoga. This knowledge leads the yogi to the highest foundation of existence.
vishnu_gita::512.modern_relevance: You might work hard on tasks, hoping for rewards, but true success comes from acting with mindful purpose beyond seeking outcomes.
vishnu_gita::512.insight: Shift focus from external rituals to inner understanding of action’s essence, transforming how you engage with life.

vishnu_gita::513.verse_sanskrit:
हृन्मान्दराविहारिन् ! भो भक्तानां भक्तवत्सल !।
भवतः प्राप्तये देवा ऋषयो मानवास्तथा ॥
vishnu_gita::513.verse_hindi: हे भक्तवत्सल ! हे भक्त मनोमन्दिर विहारी ! हे नाथ ! आपको प्राप्त करने के लिये साधनमार्गगामी सब ऋषि, देवता, मनुष्य और
vishnu_gita::513.english_translation: O beloved of devotees, O dweller in the heart of devotees, O Lord! To attain you, sages, deities, and humans all follow the path of spiritual practice.
vishnu_gita::513.translation_literal: हृन्मान्दराविहारिन् (dweller in the heart of devotees) / भो (O) / भक्तानां (of devotees) / भक्तवत्सल (beloved of devotees) / भवतः (your) / प्राप्तये (to attain) / देवा (deities) / ऋषयः (sages) / मानवास्तथा (and humans also)
vishnu_gita::513.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::513.essence: All sincere seekers pursue the divine who dwells lovingly within their hearts.
vishnu_gita::513.simple_meaning: You are deeply loved and present in the hearts of all devotees. Sages, divine beings, and humans all strive to reach you on their spiritual path.
vishnu_gita::513.simple_insight: You are the common goal of every sincere seeker, close and loving at the core.
vishnu_gita::513.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses himself as the beloved presence within the hearts of devotees. He explains that all beings—sages, deities, and humans—seek to attain him through spiritual practices, highlighting his universal accessibility and importance.
vishnu_gita::513.modern_relevance: When you feel alone or distant, remember you are held deeply in the hearts of those who seek connection and love.
vishnu_gita::513.insight: It teaches you to recognize the divine presence within yourself and others as a shared spiritual goal.

vishnu_gita::514.verse_sanskrit:
पितरश्चैव हे नाथ : सर्वे साधनमार्गगाः।
कीदृशं मार्गमालम्ब्य भवेयुः सफलाशयाः ॥
vishnu_gita::514.verse_hindi: पितृगण किस प्रकार के पथ को अवलम्बन करके सफल काम होंगे
vishnu_gita::514.english_translation: O Lord, what kind of path should the ancestors follow to achieve success in their endeavors?
vishnu_gita::514.translation_literal: पितरश्चैव (and ancestors) / हे (O) / नाथ (Lord) / सर्वे (all) / साधनमार्गगाः (means-paths-followers) / कीदृशं (what kind) / मार्गमालम्ब्य (by adopting the path) / भवेयुः (would be) / सफलाशयाः (successful-intentions)
vishnu_gita::514.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::514.essence: Success depends on choosing the right path to follow.
vishnu_gita::514.simple_meaning: The verse asks what kind of path the ancestors should follow to achieve their goals successfully.
vishnu_gita::514.simple_insight: Wondering about the right path to success invites reflection on purpose and method.
vishnu_gita::514.detailed_meaning: This verse is a question posed regarding which paths the ancestors should adopt to be successful, showing concern for guidance on how to proceed rightly.
vishnu_gita::514.insight: It encourages asking about the proper approach before acting, highlighting the importance of clarity in direction.

vishnu_gita::515.verse_sanskrit:
कथं विभुर्गुणातीतो भवन्नपि सदा भवान् ।
जीवोपकारकरणे प्रत्तो भवति स्वयं ॥
vishnu_gita::515.verse_hindi: आप विभु और गुणातीत होने पर भी किस प्रकार जीवो के उपकार में सदा स्वयं प्रवृत्त होते हैं
vishnu_gita::515.english_translation: How do you, the all-pervading and beyond all qualities, still always engage yourself in benefiting living beings?
vishnu_gita::515.translation_literal: कथं (how) विभुः (all-pervading) गुणातीतः (beyond qualities) भवन् (being) अपि (also) सदा (always) भवान् (you) जीव (living beings) उपकारकरणे (in the act of helping) प्रत्तः (engaged) भवति (are) स्वयं (yourself)
vishnu_gita::515.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::515.essence: Being beyond qualities does not prevent you from always acting to help others.
vishnu_gita::515.simple_meaning: You are beyond all qualities but still choose to act continuously to help others.
vishnu_gita::515.simple_insight: There is deep care in being beyond traits yet fully present for others.
vishnu_gita::515.detailed_meaning: In this verse, a devotee wonders how Vishnu, who is beyond all qualities and attributes, remains always engaged in actively benefiting living beings. It highlights the divine paradox of transcendence combined with compassionate action.
vishnu_gita::515.modern_relevance: You might feel disconnected from the world’s noise yet find yourself instinctively helping a friend in need without thinking.
vishnu_gita::515.insight: It shifts your view to see true care as something that can exist beyond personal traits or conditions.

vishnu_gita::516.verse_sanskrit:
कस्मात्साधनतो लभ्यं भवत्सानिध्यमीप्सितम् ।
तत्सर्वे  कृपया नूनमुपदिश्यमाहि प्रभो !॥
vishnu_gita::516.verse_hindi: किस साधन से अभिलषित आपका सान्निध्य प्राप्त हो सकता है, हे प्रभो ! कृपया अवश्य आप हम लोगों को इन सब बातों का उपदेश करें
vishnu_gita::516.english_translation: By what practice can the desired proximity to you be attained? Please, O Lord, surely teach us all these things by your grace!
vishnu_gita::516.translation_literal: कस्मात्साधनतो (by what practice) / लभ्यं (is attainable) / भवत्सानिध्यमीप्सितम् (your desired proximity) / तत्सर्वे (all these) / कृपया (by grace) / नूनम् (surely) / उपदिश्यमाहि (please teach) / प्रभो (O Lord)
vishnu_gita::516.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::516.essence: Trustful asking invites grace and clear guidance to reach the divine.
vishnu_gita::516.simple_meaning: You ask what practice can bring you close to the divine and request clear guidance by grace.
vishnu_gita::516.simple_insight: There is hope and warmth in sincerely asking for help and guidance.
vishnu_gita::516.detailed_meaning: The narrator asks the divine by what practice the desired closeness to the divine can be attained, requesting that this guidance be given through grace.
vishnu_gita::516.modern_relevance: You feel lost and want to find a clear path to what matters most, hoping someone will kindly show you the way.
vishnu_gita::516.insight: It encourages you to openly seek guidance with trust, opening space for learning through grace.

vishnu_gita::517.verse_sanskrit:
देवाः ! मम यदा भक्ता मत्स्वरूपस्य तत्त्वतः ।
ज्ञातारः स्युस्तदा सर्वे ज्ञानिनस्तेऽधिकारिणः ॥
vishnu_gita::517.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! मेरे भक्तगण जब मेरे स्वरूप को ठीक ठीक जान लेते हैं, तब वे सब ज्ञानी भक्त
vishnu_gita::517.english_translation: O radiant beings! When my devotees truly understand my nature, they become all wise and qualified.
vishnu_gita::517.translation_literal: देवाः (O radiant beings) ! मम (my) यदा (when) भक्ता (devotees) मत् (my) स्वरूपस्य (nature) तत्त्वतः (truly) । ज्ञातारः (knowers) स्युस्तदा (then become) सर्वे (all) ज्ञानिनः (wise) तेऽधिकारिणः (qualified) ॥
vishnu_gita::517.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::517.essence: Devotees who truly understand the divine’s nature become wise and capable.
vishnu_gita::517.simple_meaning: When devotees genuinely understand the true nature of the divine, they become wise and capable.
vishnu_gita::517.simple_insight: True understanding of the divine’s nature brings a deep sense of wisdom and readiness.
vishnu_gita::517.detailed_meaning: Vishnu speaks to the radiant beings, explaining that his devotees who grasp his true nature become wise and qualified, highlighting the link between devotion grounded in clear knowledge and spiritual maturity.
vishnu_gita::517.modern_relevance: You’ve met someone or something that changed how you see the world—this deep understanding grows your confidence and clarity.
vishnu_gita::517.insight: It shifts your focus from mere devotion to gaining clear knowledge, showing that wisdom grows from understanding the divine’s true nature.

vishnu_gita::518.verse_sanskrit:
पराभक्तर्भवेयुर्हि मां तदैव समीशते।
देशे काले च सर्वस्मिन पात्रे द्रष्टुं न संशयः ॥
vishnu_gita::518.verse_hindi: पराभक्ति के अधिकारी होते हैं और तब ही मुझको सब देश काल और पात्र में देखने में समर्थ होते हैं, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
vishnu_gita::518.english_translation: Only those truly devoted can perceive me in every place, time, and person without doubt.
vishnu_gita::518.translation_literal: पराभक्ति (supreme devotion) / के (of) / अधिकारी (worthy) / होते (are) / हैं (are) / मं (me) / तदैव (then only) / समीशते (perceive) / देशे (in place) / काले (in time) / च (and) / सर्वस्मिन (in all) / पात्रे (in person) / द्रष्टुं (to see) / न (no) / संशयः (doubt)
vishnu_gita::518.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::518.essence: Supreme devotion alone allows clear, unwavering perception of the divine in all contexts.
vishnu_gita::518.simple_meaning: Only those with supreme devotion can truly perceive the divine everywhere and at all times without doubt.
vishnu_gita::518.simple_insight: Devotion clears the heart’s vision, revealing the divine in every moment and place.
vishnu_gita::518.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that only those who cultivate supreme devotion become capable of perceiving the divine’s presence in every place, time, and person, without any doubt or confusion.
vishnu_gita::518.modern_relevance: When your heart is fully open and trusting, you start to notice the deeper presence in everyday moments and people around you.
vishnu_gita::518.insight: It shifts your awareness from doubt and separation to confident recognition of the divine in all contexts.

vishnu_gita::519.verse_sanskrit:
पराभक्तेः किन्तु यावन्न ते स्युरधिकारिणः।
तावन्मे सगुणस्यैव रूपस्योपासनां सदा ॥
vishnu_gita::519.verse_hindi: परन्तु जब तक भक्त, पराभक्ति के अधिकारी न हो तब तक मेरे सगुण रूप की ही उपासना करते हुए निष्पाप होकर सदा
vishnu_gita::519.english_translation: But until devotees become eligible for supreme devotion, they should always worship my manifested form without fault.
vishnu_gita::519.translation_literal: पराभक्तेः (of supreme devotion) किन्तु (but) यावन्न (until) ते (you) स्युः (are) अधिकारिणः (eligible). तावन (then) मे (my) सगुणस्यैव (manifested form only) रूपस्य (form's) उपासनां (worship) सदा (always).
vishnu_gita::519.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::519.essence: Sincere worship of the divine’s visible form is the foundation before higher devotion arises.
vishnu_gita::519.simple_meaning: You should always worship the divine’s manifested form sincerely until your devotion grows fully mature.
vishnu_gita::519.simple_insight: There’s grace in starting where you are, honoring what you can understand now.
vishnu_gita::519.detailed_meaning: Vishnu advises that until a devotee attains the highest level of devotion, sincere worship of his visible, manifested form is the proper practice. This supports beginners who cannot yet grasp deeper formless devotion.
vishnu_gita::519.modern_relevance: You might not fully grasp the bigger picture yet, but committing sincerely to what you can connect with is a powerful step forward.
vishnu_gita::519.insight: It encourages devotion as a process, allowing your practice to evolve naturally from form to deeper experience.

vishnu_gita::520.verse_sanskrit:
कुर्वन्तः कृतकृत्यत्वं विन्दन्ति गतकल्मषाः।
रागात्मिकाया भक्तेर्मे ये भक्ता अधिकारिणः ॥
vishnu_gita::520.verse_hindi: कृतकृत्यता लाभ करते हैं। हे देवतागण! मेरी रागात्मिका भक्ति के अधिकारी भक्त
vishnu_gita::520.english_translation: Those who act find a sense of accomplishment; my devotees who are devoted with attachment are entitled to this.
vishnu_gita::520.translation_literal: कुर्वन्तः (acting) कृतकृत्यत्वं (sense of accomplishment) विन्दन्ति (find) गतकल्मषाः (free from impurities). रागात्मिकाया (of attachment) भक्तेर्मे (my devotees) ये (who) भक्ता (devotees) अधिकारिणः (entitled).
vishnu_gita::520.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::520.essence: Acting with devoted attachment brings a genuine sense of accomplishment.
vishnu_gita::520.simple_meaning: When you act, you find a feeling of completion and fulfillment. Those devoted with attachment to the divine receive this sense of accomplishment.
vishnu_gita::520.simple_insight: There is satisfaction in knowing your actions and devotion bring meaningful results.
vishnu_gita::520.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that those who engage in action experience a sense of achievement. Specifically, devotees whose love includes attachment to the divine are recognized as having a right to this fulfillment, framing devotion as both emotional and active.
vishnu_gita::520.modern_relevance: You stayed late finishing a project you truly care about. That effort brings a deep, satisfying feeling beyond just the outcome.
vishnu_gita::520.insight: It teaches you to appreciate how earnest effort combined with heartfelt devotion leads to genuine fulfillment.

vishnu_gita::521.verse_sanskrit:
लीलामयाऽवतारस्य मम ते प्रायशः सुराः ।
विविधायां हि लीलायामासक्ता विग्रहस्य मे ॥
vishnu_gita::521.verse_hindi: प्रायः मेरे लीलामय अवतारों की विविध लीलाओं में आसक्त होकर मेरे, लीलामय विग्रह की
vishnu_gita::521.english_translation: The celestial beings are often attached to my playful incarnations and the diverse pastimes of my form.
vishnu_gita::521.translation_literal: लीलामयाऽवतारस्य (of the playful incarnation) / मम (my) / ते (your) / प्रायशः (often) / सुराः (celestial beings) । / विविधायां (various) / हि (indeed) / लीलायाम् (in pastimes) / आसक्ता (attached) / विग्रहस्य (of the form) / मे (my) ॥
vishnu_gita::521.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::521.essence: Attachment to the divine's playful forms can limit seeing the true self beyond appearances.
vishnu_gita::521.simple_meaning: Divine beings often become attached to the various playful forms and pastimes of the divine.
vishnu_gita::521.simple_insight: Attachment to the divine's playful forms can distract from deeper understanding.
vishnu_gita::521.detailed_meaning: Vishnu reveals that celestial beings frequently become absorbed in his diverse divine incarnations and their playful actions, which can lead to attachment rather than true realization.
vishnu_gita::521.modern_relevance: You might get caught up admiring personalities or roles instead of seeing the deeper truths behind them.
vishnu_gita::521.insight: It teaches you to look beyond surface attractions and pastimes to grasp the essence beneath appearances.

vishnu_gita::522.verse_sanskrit:
लीलामयस्य चोपास्त्या लभन्ते मां सुनिश्चितम् ।
मम यन्निगुणं रूपं सगुणं तहदेव हि ॥
vishnu_gita::522.verse_hindi: उपासना करके मुझको निश्चय प्राप्त करते हैं। मेरे निर्गुण रूप, मेरे सगुण रूप और
vishnu_gita::522.english_translation: By devoted worship, people surely attain me—both my formless and my with-form aspects.
vishnu_gita::522.translation_literal: लीलामयस्य (full of divine play) चोपास्त्या (by worship) लभन्ते (attain) मां (me) सुनिश्चितम् (certainly) । मम (my) यन्निगुणं (formless) रूपं (form) सगुणं (with form) तहदेव (indeed both) हि (indeed) ॥
vishnu_gita::522.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::522.essence: Devotion reliably connects you with both the formless and formed aspects of the divine.
vishnu_gita::522.simple_meaning: Devoted worship leads to certain connection with the divine, whether you focus on the formless or the with-form aspect.
vishnu_gita::522.simple_insight: You can trust your devotion to reach the divine in whatever way feels true to you.
vishnu_gita::522.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that through sincere worship, seekers can reliably connect with him in both his formless (nirguna) and with-form (saguna) aspects. This teaching reassures those on devotional paths that all sincere approaches are valid.
vishnu_gita::522.modern_relevance: When you pause in your busy day to connect with something bigger, you realize your way of relating—through feeling or form—both lead you inward.
vishnu_gita::522.insight: It teaches you to trust your personal devotional approach without needing to pick a single 'correct' way to relate to the divine.

vishnu_gita::523.verse_sanskrit:
लीलामयं विग्रहश्च सर्वमेकमुदीरितम् ।
अधिकारस्य भेदन भक्ता एव हि केवलं ॥
vishnu_gita::523.verse_hindi: मेरे लीलामय विग्रह सब एक ही हैं। हे देवगण ! केवल अधिकार भेद से भक्तों को ही
vishnu_gita::523.english_translation: My playful form and all manifestations are one; only my devotees perceive differences in roles.
vishnu_gita::523.translation_literal: लीलामयं (playful) / विग्रहश्च (form and) / सर्वमेकमुदीरितम् (all as one declared) / अधिकारस्य (of role) / भेदन (difference) / भक्ता (devotees) / एव (only indeed) / हि (surely) / केवलं (alone)
vishnu_gita::523.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::523.essence: The divine’s many forms are one; only devoted love sees role differences.
vishnu_gita::523.simple_meaning: All the divine forms and expressions are fundamentally one, but only devotees notice differences based on roles or appearances.
vishnu_gita::523.simple_insight: Devotion reveals unity where others see separateness.
vishnu_gita::523.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that his many playful forms and manifestations are essentially one reality. However, this unity is understood only by his devotees, who perceive differences merely as roles or aspects, not true separations.
vishnu_gita::523.modern_relevance: When you hold on to surface differences in people or situations, devotion can help you see the underlying unity instead.
vishnu_gita::523.insight: It teaches you to look beyond superficial roles and see the oneness beneath through devotion.

vishnu_gita::524.verse_sanskrit:
तारतम्यं निरीक्षन्त एषु रूपेषु मेऽमराः ।
पूर्णाशाऽऽवेशरूपादिरूपैर्हि विविधैः खलु ॥
vishnu_gita::524.verse_hindi: इन मेरे रूपों में नारतम्य दिखाई पड़ता है । हे देवतागण ! पूर्ण, अंश और आवेश आदि विभिन्न रूपों से समय समय पर
vishnu_gita::524.english_translation: Among these my forms, the immortals observe a hierarchy; indeed, they vary as whole, partial, and influenced forms.
vishnu_gita::524.translation_literal: तारतम्यं (hierarchy) / निरीक्षन्त (observe) / एषु (in these) / रूपेषु (forms) / मेऽमराः (my immortals) / । / पूर्णाशाऽऽवेशरूपादिरूपैर्ः (whole, partial, influenced forms) / विविधैः (varied) / खलु (indeed) ॥
vishnu_gita::524.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::524.essence: The divine's many forms exist in a clear, layered hierarchy of completeness and influence.
vishnu_gita::524.simple_meaning: The divine beings see a clear order among my various forms, which appear in many kinds like whole, partial, and influenced.
vishnu_gita::524.simple_insight: There's a natural order even in diversity, making complexity approachable and meaningful.
vishnu_gita::524.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses the divine assembly, explaining that his many forms do not appear randomly but follow a clear hierarchy, including complete, partial, and influenced manifestations.
vishnu_gita::524.insight: Recognize that differences and variety often follow an underlying order, helping you to see complexity without confusion.

vishnu_gita::525.verse_sanskrit:
अहं हि लोके मायातोऽवतीर्य समये सुराः।
भक्तिं ददामि भक्तेभ्यो येन नन्दन्ति ते सदा ॥
vishnu_gita::525.verse_hindi: मैं ही जगत में मायावलम्बन से अवतीर्ण होकर भक्तों को भक्ति प्रदान करता हूँ जिससे वे सदा आनन्दित रहते हैं
vishnu_gita::525.english_translation: I descend into the world wrapped in the veil of illusion to give devoted love to those who rejoice eternally.
vishnu_gita::525.translation_literal: अहं (I) / हि (indeed) / लोके (in the world) / मायातः (from illusion) / अवतीर्य (descending) / समये (at the proper time) / सुराः (divine beings) / भक्तिं (devotion) / ददामि (I give) / भक्तेभ्यः (to devotees) / येन (by which) / नन्दन्ति (they rejoice) / ते (they) / सदा (always)
vishnu_gita::525.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::525.essence: The divine appears within illusion to grant devoted love that brings unending joy.
vishnu_gita::525.simple_meaning: The divine comes into the world wrapped in illusion to give devoted love to those who find joy in it.
vishnu_gita::525.simple_insight: You can find constant joy through the devoted love given by the divine presence.
vishnu_gita::525.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares that he takes form within the world veiled by illusion to offer devoted love to followers, enabling their continuous joy and connection.
vishnu_gita::525.modern_relevance: When life feels confusing or overwhelming, you can remember you are supported by a love that transcends all challenges and brings lasting happiness.
vishnu_gita::525.insight: It teaches you to open your heart to devoted love as a source of enduring joy beyond appearances.

vishnu_gita::526.verse_sanskrit:
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यः सन्देहो वा कथञ्चन।
धर्मसंरक्षणं देवाः ! रोचते मे निरन्तरम् ॥
vishnu_gita::526.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! धर्म की निरन्तर रक्षा करना मुझको अत्यंत प्रिय है, इनमे किसी प्रकार कुछ भी संदेह या विस्मय नहीं करना चाहिए
vishnu_gita::526.english_translation: O radiant beings! I continuously cherish the protection of dharma; there should be no doubt or astonishment about this.
vishnu_gita::526.translation_literal: नैवात्र (not here) विस्मयः (astonishment) कार्यः (a task) सन्देहो (doubt) वा (or) कथञ्चन (at all) । धर्मसंरक्षणं (protection of dharma) देवाः (O radiant beings) ! रोचते (is dear) मे (to me) निरन्तरम् (continuously) ॥
vishnu_gita::526.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::526.essence: Protecting what is right is a clear, unwavering duty you must cherish.
vishnu_gita::526.simple_meaning: You should always value protecting what is right without any hesitation or doubt.
vishnu_gita::526.simple_insight: There is strength and clarity in committing fully to your true purpose without second thoughts.
vishnu_gita::526.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Vishnu addresses radiant beings, emphasizing that preserving dharma—the natural order and righteousness—is a constant and beloved duty without any confusion or surprise.
vishnu_gita::526.modern_relevance: You face choices where doing the right thing is clear; trusting this clarity lets you act with steady confidence.
vishnu_gita::526.insight: It guides you to embrace your responsibility firmly, removing hesitation or uncertainty about your role.

vishnu_gita::527.verse_sanskrit:
अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन् ।
प्रकृति स्वामधिष्टाय सम्भवाम्यात्ममायया ॥
vishnu_gita::527.verse_hindi: जन्मरहित अविनश्वर और प्राणि मात्र का ईश्वर होकर भी मैं अपनी प्रकृति पर अधिष्ठान करके अपनी माया के द्वारा उत्पन्न होता हूँ
vishnu_gita::527.english_translation: Though unborn and imperishable, the lord of beings, I manifest through my nature by my illusion.
vishnu_gita::527.translation_literal: अजः (unborn) अपि (also) सन् (being) अविनश्य (imperishable) आत्मा (self) भूतानाम् (of beings) ईश्वरः (lord) अपि (also) सन् (being) प्रकृति (nature) स्वाम् (own) अधिष्ठाय (residing) सम्भवामि (I manifest) आत्मम् (self) माया (illusion) अयया (by)
vishnu_gita::527.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::527.essence: The eternal self appears in the world through nature and illusion without losing its true nature.
vishnu_gita::527.simple_meaning: Your true self never undergoes birth or death and is the lord of all beings, but it appears in the world through nature and illusion.
vishnu_gita::527.simple_insight: There’s comfort in knowing your essence is unchanging even as life changes around you.
vishnu_gita::527.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Vishnu reveals that although the true self is eternal and the ruler of all beings, it appears in diverse forms through nature and the veil of illusion, explaining the origin of the manifest world.
vishnu_gita::527.modern_relevance: When life feels confusing and ever-changing, remembering your core self is untouched by all this helps you find steadiness.
vishnu_gita::527.insight: It teaches you to see beyond appearances and recognize your timeless essence beneath change.

vishnu_gita::528.verse_sanskrit:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति निर्जराः!।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::528.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! जब जब धर्मपर ग्लानि और अधर्म का आधिक्य होता है उसी समय मैं आविर्भूत होता हूँ
vishnu_gita::528.english_translation: Whenever there is a decline in dharma and a rise of adharma, I manifest myself.
vishnu_gita::528.translation_literal: यदा (whenever) यदा (whenever) हि (indeed) धर्मस्य (of dharma) ग्लानि (decline) भवति (happens) निर्जराः (decay/weakness)! अभ्युत्थानम् (rise) अधर्मस्य (of adharma) तदा (then) आत्मानं (myself) सृजाम्यहम् (I manifest).
vishnu_gita::528.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::528.essence: The divine manifests whenever righteousness declines and unrighteousness grows.
vishnu_gita::528.simple_meaning: Whenever the natural order weakens and wrongdoing grows, the divine manifests to restore balance.
vishnu_gita::528.simple_insight: There's comfort knowing the divine intervenes when things fall apart.
vishnu_gita::528.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Vishnu assures that whenever righteousness declines and unrighteousness rises, he manifests to re-establish order, offering hope amid chaos.
vishnu_gita::528.modern_relevance: When everything feels out of control and values falter, remember unseen forces work to bring things back on track.
vishnu_gita::528.insight: This verse shifts focus from despair to trust that restorative forces activate during crisis.

vishnu_gita::529.verse_sanskrit:
परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम् ।
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे ॥
vishnu_gita::529.verse_hindi: साधुओं की रक्षा के लिये, दुष्कर्म कारियों के नाश के लिये और धर्म के संस्थापन के लिये मैं युग युग में अवतार धारण करता हूँ
vishnu_gita::529.english_translation: To protect the virtuous, to destroy wrongdoers, and to establish dharma, I manifest in every age.
vishnu_gita::529.translation_literal: परित्राणाय (for protection) साधूनां (of the virtuous) विनाशाय (for destruction) च (and) दुष्कृताम् (of wrongdoers) । धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय (for the establishment of dharma) सम्भवामि (I manifest) युगे (in the age) युगे (in every age) ॥
vishnu_gita::529.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::529.essence: The divine manifests repeatedly to protect good and restore dharma across time.
vishnu_gita::529.simple_meaning: The divine appears in every age to protect good people, destroy wrongdoing, and restore dharma.
vishnu_gita::529.simple_insight: You can trust that the divine supports justice and protection whenever needed.
vishnu_gita::529.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that whenever dharma declines and evil rises, he incarnates to protect the virtuous, eliminate wrongdoers, and reestablish righteousness in the world.
vishnu_gita::529.modern_relevance: When you face injustice or feel overwhelmed by wrongdoing, remember that forces beyond you work to restore balance and protect what is right.
vishnu_gita::529.insight: This teaching shifts your view from helplessness to trust in a recurring cosmic support for justice.

vishnu_gita::530.verse_sanskrit:
जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।
त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽमराः! ॥
vishnu_gita::530.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! जो मेरे इस प्रकार के अलौकिक जन्म और कर्मको यथार्थरूप से जानता है वह देहत्याग करके फिर जन्म ग्रहण नहीं करता है और मुझ को प्राप्त होता है
vishnu_gita::530.english_translation: O divine beings, whoever truly understands my transcendental birth and actions, after leaving the body, does not take birth again and attains me.
vishnu_gita::530.translation_literal: जन्म (birth) / कर्म (actions) / च (and) / मे (my) / दिव्यम् (divine, transcendental) / एवम् (thus) / यो (who) / वेत्ति (knows) / तत्त्वतः (truly) / त्यक्त्वा (having abandoned) / देहं (the body) / पुनः (again) / जन्म (birth) / नैति (does not go) / माम् (to me) / एति (reaches) / सः (he) / अमराः (immortal)
vishnu_gita::530.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::530.essence: True understanding of divine birth and action frees you from rebirth and leads to union.
vishnu_gita::530.simple_meaning: If you truly understand the divine nature of my birth and actions, you will not be reborn after death and will unite with me.
vishnu_gita::530.simple_insight: There is freedom in deeply knowing the divine beyond birth and death.
vishnu_gita::530.detailed_meaning: Vishnu tells divine beings that true knowledge of his transcendental birth and actions frees one from the cycle of rebirth, leading to union with him after the body is left behind.
vishnu_gita::530.modern_relevance: When you grasp the deeper meaning behind your life's purpose and actions, fear of failure or loss loses its hold on you.
vishnu_gita::530.insight: It teaches you to see beyond appearances of birth and death, embracing a timeless connection with the divine.

vishnu_gita::531.verse_sanskrit:
वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः।
बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः ॥
vishnu_gita::531.verse_hindi: अनुराग, क्रोध्शून्य एवं मुझमें एकाग्रचित, मेरे आश्रित और ज्ञानरूपी तप से पवित्र अनेक साधक मेरे भाव को प्राप्त हुए हैं अर्थात् मुक्त हो गये हैं
vishnu_gita::531.english_translation: Those free from attachment, fear, and anger, absorbed in me, purified by the penance of knowledge, have attained my nature.
vishnu_gita::531.translation_literal: वीतराग (free from attachment) / भय (fear) / क्रोधा (anger) / मन्मया (absorbed in me) / मामुपाश्रिताः (taking refuge in me) / बहवः (many) / ज्ञानतपसा (by knowledge's penance) / पूता (purified) / मद्भावमागताः (have attained my nature)
vishnu_gita::531.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::531.essence: Letting go of fear, anger, and attachment reveals the divine nature within you.
vishnu_gita::531.simple_meaning: Those who let go of attachment, fear, and anger, focus their minds on the divine, and purify themselves through knowledge, realize the divine nature within.
vishnu_gita::531.simple_insight: Freedom comes when you stop clinging and calm your fears and anger in devotion.
vishnu_gita::531.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes how many seekers, free from attachment, fear, and anger, who fully focus on him and purify themselves with knowledge and disciplined practice, attain his divine nature. This teaching encourages devotion combined with wisdom and emotional discipline.
vishnu_gita::531.modern_relevance: You’ve felt overwhelmed by fear or anger, but when you center your attention on what truly matters and learn deeply, you find peace and connection beyond those emotions.
vishnu_gita::531.insight: It teaches you to combine emotional balance with focused devotion and knowledge to embody the divine nature.

vishnu_gita::532.verse_sanskrit:
ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्।
मम वानुवर्तन्ते साधकाः सर्वशः सुराः ॥
vishnu_gita::532.verse_hindi: जो मुझको जिस भाव से आश्रय करते हैं उनको मैं उसी भाव से आश्रय में रखता हूँ अर्थात् फल प्रदान करता हूँ। हे देवगण ! साधक लोग सब प्रकार से मेरे मार्ग का ही अनुसरण करते हैं
vishnu_gita::532.english_translation: I reciprocate the devotion shown to me in the same manner; all sincere seekers follow my path in every way.
vishnu_gita::532.translation_literal: ये (those who) / यथा (in the manner) / मां (to me) / प्रपद्यन्ते (take refuge) / तां (them) / तथैव (in the same way) / भजाम्यहम् (I honor) / मम (my) / वानुवर्तन्ते (follow) / साधकाः (sincere seekers) / सर्वशः (in all ways) / सुराः (divine beings)
vishnu_gita::532.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::532.essence: The divine meets your devotion in the exact form you offer it.
vishnu_gita::532.simple_meaning: The divine responds to your devotion exactly as you express it; sincere seekers follow this path wholeheartedly.
vishnu_gita::532.simple_insight: Knowing your way of devotion shapes how you are supported brings a sense of personal connection.
vishnu_gita::532.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that the way you approach the divine determines how you experience support. Devotees who sincerely follow the path receive responses matching their attitude, highlighting a dynamic relationship rather than one-sided grace.
vishnu_gita::532.modern_relevance: When you invest genuine care and openness in a relationship, it naturally reflects back to you in kind, shaping your experience.
vishnu_gita::532.insight: It teaches you to recognize how your attitude toward the divine influences what you receive in return.

vishnu_gita::533.verse_sanskrit:
काङ्कन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः।
क्षिप्रं लोके साधकानां सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा ॥
vishnu_gita::533.verse_hindi: कर्म की सिद्धि चाहनेवाले साधक देवताओं की उपासना करते हैं । इस संसार में साधकों को कर्म सम्बन्धी सिद्धि शीघ्र प्राप्त होती है
vishnu_gita::533.english_translation: Those who desire success in their actions worship the deities here; in this world, success from action comes quickly to such practitioners.
vishnu_gita::533.translation_literal: काङ्कन्तः (desiring) कर्मणां (of actions) सिद्धिं (success) यजन्त (worship) इह (here) देवताः (deities) । क्षिप्रं (quickly) लोके (in the world) साधकानां (of practitioners) सिद्धिर्भवति (success happens) कर्मजा (born of action) ॥
vishnu_gita::533.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::533.essence: Seeking success through devotion brings swift results in action.
vishnu_gita::533.simple_meaning: If you want success in your work, honoring higher beings helps. Those who do so find their efforts succeed quickly.
vishnu_gita::533.simple_insight: Trusting something greater in your efforts makes achievements come sooner.
vishnu_gita::533.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that those who desire to succeed in their actions turn towards worship of divine beings. This act of devotion supports their efforts, resulting in quicker success in the world.
vishnu_gita::533.modern_relevance: You prepare for an important project by mentally committing and seeking support beyond yourself. That trust helps your efforts succeed faster.
vishnu_gita::533.insight: It teaches you to combine focused action with respectful devotion to support your goals.

vishnu_gita::534.verse_hindi: परमात्मा में जिनके बुद्धि और चित्त लगे हुए हैं, उन्हीं में जिनकी निष्ठा है और उन्ही में जो परायण हैं एवं ज्ञान से जिनके पाप नष्ट हो गये हैं वह मोक्ष को प्राप्त होते हैं
vishnu_gita::534.english_translation: Those whose mind and intellect are fixed on the supreme self, who are devoted and free from stains of ignorance by knowledge, attain freedom from rebirth.
vishnu_gita::534.translation_literal: तबह् (then) बुद्धयः (intellects) तदात्मानः (on that self) तनीष्ठाः (fixed) तत्परायणाः (devoted to that) गच्छन्ति (go) अपुनरावृत्तिं (no return) ज्ञाननिधूतकल्मषाः (whose stains are wiped by knowledge)
vishnu_gita::534.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::534.essence: Steady devotion and clear knowledge of the true self end the cycle of rebirth.
vishnu_gita::534.simple_meaning: You reach freedom from rebirth when your mind and intellect focus steadily on the true self with devotion and knowledge that removes confusion.
vishnu_gita::534.simple_insight: There's peace in steady devotion and clear understanding that frees you from repeating old patterns.
vishnu_gita::534.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that when a person’s intellect and mind are firmly fixed on the supreme self, devoted and cleansed of ignorance by knowledge, they break free from the cycle of rebirth, reaching lasting freedom.
vishnu_gita::534.modern_relevance: When you focus deeply on your true nature with devotion and clear understanding, you escape repetitive harmful habits and find lasting peace.
vishnu_gita::534.insight: It shifts your effort from scattered distractions to focused devotion and wisdom, ending the cycle of reactivity.

vishnu_gita::535.verse_sanskrit:
मम प्राप्त्यै सदा भक्ता आश्रयन्ति दिवौकसः! ।
भक्तिं भवमयीं योग क्रियात्मकमपि ध्रुवम् ॥
vishnu_gita::535.verse_hindi: हे देवतागण ! मुझको प्राप्त करने के लिये उपासक सदा भावमयी भक्ति और क्रियामय योग का भी आश्रय अवश्य लेते हैं
vishnu_gita::535.english_translation: The divine beings always take refuge in heartfelt devotion and active yoga to reach me.
vishnu_gita::535.translation_literal: मम (my) / प्राप्त्यै (to reach) / सदा (always) / भक्ता (devotees) / आश्रयन्ति (take refuge) / दिवौकसः (divine beings) / भक्तिं (devotion) / भवमयीं (full of feeling) / योग (yoga) / क्रियात्मकमपि (even active/practical) / ध्रुवम् (certain/steady)
vishnu_gita::535.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::535.essence: Sincere devotion and active practice together reliably connect you to the divine.
vishnu_gita::535.simple_meaning: Those who seek the divine take refuge in deep devotion and consistent active practice.
vishnu_gita::535.simple_insight: You feel supported knowing devotion and action together reliably connect you to the divine.
vishnu_gita::535.detailed_meaning: Vishnu speaks to divine beings explaining that sincere devotion combined with active yoga practice is the sure path to connect with the divine presence.
vishnu_gita::535.modern_relevance: When you struggle to connect with something greater, combining heartfelt care with steady effort opens the way.
vishnu_gita::535.insight: It teaches you to blend loving devotion with practical action for a steady connection.

vishnu_gita::536.verse_sanskrit:
वैध्या रागात्मिका वै भक्तेरधिगमो मत:।
वैधी सा साधनाल्लभ्या श्रीगुरोरुपदेशतः ॥
vishnu_gita::536.verse_hindi: वैधी भक्ति से ही रोगात्मिका भक्ति की प्राप्ति मानी गई है, वह वैधी भक्ति श्रीगुरूपदेश के अनुसार साधन करने से प्राप्त होती है
vishnu_gita::536.english_translation: According to the revered teacher's instruction, disciplined devotion is the means to attain passionate devotion.
vishnu_gita::536.translation_literal: वैध्या (by disciplined) / रागात्मिका (passionate) / वै (indeed) / भक्तेरधिगमो (attainment of devotion) / मत: (opinion) / वैधी (disciplined) / सा (that) / साधनाल्लभ्या (attained by practice) / श्रीगुरोरुपदेशतः (according to revered teacher's instruction)
vishnu_gita::536.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::536.essence: Disciplined practice is the gateway to deep, passionate devotion.
vishnu_gita::536.simple_meaning: Passionate, heartfelt devotion is reached by first practicing disciplined, steady devotion as taught by a trusted teacher.
vishnu_gita::536.simple_insight: You feel encouraged knowing deep love grows from consistent effort, not sudden emotion.
vishnu_gita::536.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that intense, emotional devotion develops only after one follows disciplined devotional practice guided by the revered teacher’s instructions, highlighting the importance of steady effort before heartfelt connection.
vishnu_gita::536.modern_relevance: You spend time each day practicing kindness or gratitude, and over weeks, your feelings deepen beyond habit into true caring.
vishnu_gita::536.insight: It teaches you to trust the process of steady devotional practice as the foundation for genuine love.

vishnu_gita::537.verse_sanskrit:
यदा चित्तलयं कर्तुमभ्यासो माय जायते ।
रागात्मिकायां भक्तौ हि तदा मज्जात सत्वरम् ॥
vishnu_gita::537.verse_hindi: जब मुझमें चित्त लीन करने का अभ्यास हो जाता है तब मेरी रागात्मिका भक्ति में वह
vishnu_gita::537.english_translation: When the mind becomes absorbed through practice, then devotion born of attachment quickly leads to immersion.
vishnu_gita::537.translation_literal: यदा (when) चित्तलयं (mind absorption) कर्तुमभ्यासो (to do practice) माय (by) जायते (arises) । रागात्मिकायां (of attachment-born) भक्तौ (in devotion) हि (indeed) तदा (then) मज्जात (immersed) सत्वरम् (quickly) ॥
vishnu_gita::537.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::537.essence: Attachment-based devotion leads the mind to quick and deep absorption through practice.
vishnu_gita::537.simple_meaning: When you practice deeply focusing your mind, devotion born from attachment quickly draws you fully in.
vishnu_gita::537.simple_insight: You notice how heartfelt attachment can deepen your experience and focus in devotion.
vishnu_gita::537.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that when one's mind learns to concentrate deeply through repeated practice, the kind of devotion that arises from attachment quickly immerses the practitioner fully in the experience.
vishnu_gita::537.modern_relevance: You find yourself completely absorbed when your passion for something comes from a genuine emotional connection.
vishnu_gita::537.insight: It shows how attachment can be a powerful force that brings your mind to full immersion in devotion through practice.

vishnu_gita::538.verse_sanskrit:
उन्मज्जति मुहुस्तद्वत् भाग्यवान साधकोत्तमः।
भक्तिरेषा पराभक्तेजननी वर्त्तते सुराः ! ॥
vishnu_gita::538.verse_hindi: भाग्यवान् श्रेष्ठ साधक शीघ्र उन्मज्जन और निमज्जन बार बार करने लगता है। हे देवतागण ! यह भक्ति परामक्ति को उत्पन्न करने वाली है
vishnu_gita::538.english_translation: The fortunate best practitioner repeatedly immerses and emerges; this devotion generates supreme devotion, O devas.
vishnu_gita::538.translation_literal: उन्मज्जति (emerges) मुहुः (repeatedly) तद्वत् (like that) भाग्यवान् (fortunate) साधकोत्तमः (best practitioner) । भक्तिरेषा (this devotion) पराभक्ते (supreme devotion) जननी (mother of) वर्त्तते (exists) सुराः (O devas) ।
vishnu_gita::538.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::538.essence: Devotion deepens through repeated immersion and emergence, growing stronger over time.
vishnu_gita::538.simple_meaning: A fortunate and excellent practitioner repeatedly immerses themselves in devotion, which leads to the highest form of devoted love.
vishnu_gita::538.simple_insight: There's power in returning to devotion again and again, deepening your connection each time.
vishnu_gita::538.detailed_meaning: Vishnu speaks to the devas, explaining that the best spiritual practitioners repeatedly immerse and emerge in devotion. This continuous engagement with devotion is what births supreme devoted love, showing that devotion is a growing, dynamic process.
vishnu_gita::538.modern_relevance: You come back to your practice or passion many times, each return making your connection stronger and more meaningful.
vishnu_gita::538.insight: It teaches you to embrace devotion as an ongoing cycle of engagement, not a one-time event.

vishnu_gita::539.verse_sanskrit:
उपास्तेः प्राणरूपास्ति भक्तिर्हि मामकी सुराः।
क्रियायोगः शरीरं स्याचतुर्धा स प्रकीर्तितः ॥
vishnu_gita::539.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! मेरी भक्ति उपासनाकी प्राणरूपा और क्रिया योग शरीररूप है। हे देवश्रेष्ठो! क्रियायोग के भी
vishnu_gita::539.english_translation: O gods, my devotion is the life force of worship, and Karma Yoga is its embodiment in the body, described as fourfold.
vishnu_gita::539.translation_literal: उपास्तेः (of worship) प्राणरूपास्ति (is the life principle) भक्तिर्हि (devotion indeed) मामकी (mine) सुराः (O gods) । क्रियायोगः (Karma Yoga) शरीरं (the body) स्याच (is) चतुर्धा (fourfold) स (that) प्रकीर्तितः (is described) ॥
vishnu_gita::539.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::539.essence: Devotion is the living spirit of worship; action is its bodily form.
vishnu_gita::539.simple_meaning: Devotion is the vital energy in worship, and Karma Yoga is how that devotion expresses itself in action through the body.
vishnu_gita::539.simple_insight: You feel devotion come alive when your actions become its clear expression.
vishnu_gita::539.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses the gods, explaining that devotion is the essential life within worship, and Karma Yoga is its physical expression in four ways, showing how inner feelings become outer acts.
vishnu_gita::539.modern_relevance: When your heartfelt intentions turn into deliberate actions, you see devotion as a living force, not just a feeling.
vishnu_gita::539.insight: Recognize that devotion must be embodied through your actions to be real and transformative.

vishnu_gita::540.verse_sanskrit:
नाम्ना मन्त्रहठावेतौ लयराजौ तथैव च ।
आधिकारस्य भेदेन विज्ञेयास्ते सुरोत्तमाः !॥
vishnu_gita::540.verse_hindi: अधिकार भेद से चार भेद हैं, वह  मन्त्र, हठ  लय और राज नाम से जाने जाते हैं।
vishnu_gita::540.english_translation: By the distinction of authority, four types are known: mantra, hatha, laya, and raja.
vishnu_gita::540.translation_literal: नाम्ना (by name) मन्त्रहठावेतौ (mantra, hatha, and laya) लयराजौ (and raja) तथैव (likewise) च (also) । अधिकारस्य (of authority) भेदेन (by distinction) विज्ञेयास्ते (are known) सुरोत्तमाः (best of the gods) !॥
vishnu_gita::540.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::540.essence: Spiritual practices classify into four distinct types based on authority and method.
vishnu_gita::540.simple_meaning: There are four types distinguished by authority: mantra, hatha, laya, and raja.
vishnu_gita::540.simple_insight: Understanding spiritual methods requires knowing their different types and levels.
vishnu_gita::540.detailed_meaning: This verse explains that spiritual disciplines are divided into four categories—mantra, hatha, laya, and raja—based on different levels of authority or approach, introducing a classification of yogic paths.
vishnu_gita::540.insight: Recognizing distinct methods helps you choose the right practice aligned with your capacity and goals.

vishnu_gita::541.verse_sanskrit:
गुरोर्वै कृपयेमानि लभ्यते साधकैर्धवम् ।
म्त्प्राप्तिसाधनानीति प्रवदन्ति मनीषिण: ॥
vishnu_gita::541.verse_hindi: गुरुकृपा से ही मेरी प्राप्ति के इन साधनों को साधक निश्चय लाभ करते हैं, इस बात को पण्डितगण कहते हैं
vishnu_gita::541.english_translation: By the grace of the Guru, seekers surely attain these means of realization, as the wise declare.
vishnu_gita::541.translation_literal:
गुरोः (of the Guru) वै (indeed) कृपया (by grace) एमानि (these) लभ्यते (are obtained) साधकैः (by seekers) धवम् (certainly) ।
म्त्प्राप्ति (attainment) साधनानि (means) इति (thus) प्रवदन्ति (say) मनीषिणः (the wise) ॥
vishnu_gita::541.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::541.essence: The teacher’s grace is essential for seekers to gain means for realization.
vishnu_gita::541.simple_meaning: The grace of the teacher makes it certain that seekers will obtain the means to reach realization.
vishnu_gita::541.simple_insight: Trusting your teacher's support brings hope and steady progress on your path.
vishnu_gita::541.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Vishnu highlights how the mercy and kindness of a Guru are essential for seekers to attain the tools needed for spiritual progress, as wise people affirm.
vishnu_gita::541.modern_relevance: When you feel stuck, remember that support and guidance from someone wiser can open doors you cannot open alone.
vishnu_gita::541.insight: It teaches you to rely on the teacher’s kindness as a vital support, not just your own effort.

vishnu_gita::542.verse_sanskrit:
स्पर्शान कृत्वा बहिर्वाधान चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः।
प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ ॥
vishnu_gita::542.verse_hindi: रूप रसादि बाह्य विषयों को बाहर ही रखकर दृष्टि को दोनों भवों के बीच में रखकर नासिका के भीतर विचरण करने वाले प्राण और अपान वायु को समान करके अर्थात् समभाव से चलने वाला बना कर
vishnu_gita::542.english_translation: Keep your eyes focused between the eyebrows, setting aside external sights and sensations; balance the inward-moving life breaths through the nostrils with equal steadiness.
vishnu_gita::542.translation_literal: स्पर्शान (touches) / कृत्वा (having done) / बाहि: (outside) / वाधान (sights) / चक्षुः (eye) / चैव (also) / अंतरे (between) / भ्रुवोः (the eyebrows) / प्राणापानौ (the inward and outward breaths) / समौ (equal) / कृत्वा (having made) / नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ (moving inside the nostrils)
vishnu_gita::542.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::542.essence: Steady your gaze inward and balance your breath to calm body and mind.
vishnu_gita::542.simple_meaning: Turn your attention away from outside distractions and keep your eyes focused between your eyebrows. Balance your inward and outward breath evenly through the nose.
vishnu_gita::542.simple_insight: Calming your breath and focus helps steady your mind and body in the present moment.
vishnu_gita::542.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Vishnu instructs how to prepare the body and senses for deeper practice by withdrawing from external distractions. The eyes focus between the eyebrows while the life breaths (prana and apana) flowing through the nostrils are balanced, creating internal harmony.
vishnu_gita::542.modern_relevance: When your mind races and distractions crowd your vision, pausing to steady your gaze and balance your breath can ground your awareness instantly.
vishnu_gita::542.insight: It teaches you to use physical focus and balanced breathing to calm restless thoughts and enter a centered state.

vishnu_gita::543.verse_sanskrit:
यतेन्द्रिययमनोबूधिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायण: ।
विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो य: सदा मुक्त एव स: ॥
vishnu_gita::543.verse_hindi: इन्द्रिय मन और बुद्धिका संयम करने वाला, मोक्षपरायण और इच्छा भय एवं क्रोधशून्य जो मुनि है वही सदा मुक्त है
vishnu_gita::543.english_translation: The sage who controls the senses, mind, and intellect, who seeks freedom, and who is free from desire, fear, and anger, is always liberated.
vishnu_gita::543.translation_literal: यत (who controls) इन्द्रिय (senses) मन (mind) बुद्धि (intellect) मुनी (sage) मोक्षपरायणः (freedom-seeking) विगतेच्छा (free from desire) भय (fear) क्रोध (anger) यः (who) सदा (always) मुक्त (liberated) एव (indeed) सः (he)
vishnu_gita::543.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::543.essence: True freedom arises from mastering senses, mind, and releasing desire, fear, and anger.
vishnu_gita::543.simple_meaning: You become free when you control your senses, mind, and intellect, and release desire, fear, and anger.
vishnu_gita::543.simple_insight: Freedom feels possible when you calm inner storms and stop chasing wants.
vishnu_gita::543.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Vishnu describes the sage who has mastered the restless mind, senses, and intellect. This person aims for freedom and has overcome desires, fears, and anger, thus living in constant liberation.
vishnu_gita::543.modern_relevance: When frustration or fear rises inside you, remembering to steady your mind and release anger can bring lasting calm and freedom.
vishnu_gita::543.insight: It teaches you to steady your inner faculties and let go of harmful emotions to live freely.

vishnu_gita::544.verse_sanskrit:
भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वभूतमहेश्वरम।
सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति ॥
vishnu_gita::544.verse_hindi: मुझे यज्ञों और तपस्या का भोक्ता, सकल लोकों का महान् ईश्वर और सकल प्राणिमात्र का सुहद् समझकर साधक मोक्ष को प्राप्त होता है
vishnu_gita::544.english_translation: Knowing me as the enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities, the great lord of all beings, and the friend of all living creatures, the practitioner attains peace.
vishnu_gita::544.translation_literal: भोक्तारं (enjoyer) / यज्ञतपसां (of sacrifices and austerities) / सर्वभूतमहेश्वरम (great lord of all beings) / सुहृदं (friend) / सर्वभूतानां (of all beings) / ज्ञात्वा (knowing) / मां (me) / शान्तिमृच्छति (attains peace)
vishnu_gita::544.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::544.essence: Recognizing the divine as friend and lord of all brings deep peace.
vishnu_gita::544.simple_meaning: When you recognize the divine as the one who enjoys offerings and is friend to all beings, you attain inner peace.
vishnu_gita::544.simple_insight: Feeling the divine as a caring friend brings deep calm and belonging.
vishnu_gita::544.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that understanding him as the enjoyer of sacrifices and the friend of all beings helps the seeker overcome separation and find peace during spiritual practice.
vishnu_gita::544.modern_relevance: You pause in a busy day and feel a quiet support that all life is connected and cared for, calming your restless heart.
vishnu_gita::544.insight: It shifts focus from seeing the divine as distant to experiencing it as a close, supportive friend, opening the heart to peace.

vishnu_gita::545.verse_sanskrit:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् ।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ॥
vishnu_gita::545.verse_hindi: आत्मा के द्वारा अर्थात् बुद्धि के द्वारा आत्मा का अर्थात् मन का उद्धार करना चाहिये, आत्मा को अर्थात् मन को नीचे नहीं गिरने दिया जान चाहिए क्योंकि मेरी ओर खिंचा हुआ आत्मा अर्थात् मन ही अपना अर्थात् साधक का बन्धु है और नीचे की ओर अर्थात् इन्द्रियादिक में खिंचा हुआ आत्मा अर्थात् मन हीं अपना अर्थात् साधक का शत्रु है
vishnu_gita::545.english_translation: You must uplift the self by the self and never let the self fall; the self alone is the friend of the self, and the self alone is the enemy of the self.
vishnu_gita::545.translation_literal: उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं (should uplift by self the self) / न (not) / आत्मानमवसादयेत् (let the self fall) / आत्मैव (by self alone) / हि (indeed) / आत्मनो (of self) / बन्धुर् (friend) / आत्मैव (by self alone) / रिपुरात्मनः (enemy of self)
vishnu_gita::545.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::545.essence: Your true self is both your greatest friend and your greatest enemy depending on how you treat it.
vishnu_gita::545.simple_meaning: You must use your own inner strength to raise yourself and not let yourself sink. Your true self can be your closest friend or your greatest enemy.
vishnu_gita::545.simple_insight: You feel empowered knowing your true self can both help and harm you depending on your actions.
vishnu_gita::545.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that the mind or self can either elevate itself through wisdom or drag itself down through distraction. The self is uniquely responsible for its own bondage or freedom, making this moment critical for Arjuna's inner struggle.
vishnu_gita::545.modern_relevance: When your thoughts pull you toward doubt or distraction, you alone can choose to steady and uplift your mind toward clarity.
vishnu_gita::545.insight: It teaches you to recognize your mind’s power to be your ally or adversary and choose to strengthen it.

vishnu_gita::546.verse_sanskrit:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनैवात्मात्मना जितः ।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्जेतात्मैव शत्रुवत् ॥
vishnu_gita::546.verse_hindi: जिस उपासक ने अपनी आत्मा अर्थात् बुद्धि के द्वारा मन को वशीभूत कर लिया है उसी की आत्मा अर्थात् मन अपना अर्थात् उपासक का बन्धु है; परन्तु अजितेन्द्रिय व्यक्ति की आत्मा अर्थात् बुद्धि ही शत्रुता में शत्रुवत् प्रवृत्त हुआ करती है।
vishnu_gita::546.english_translation: The devotee who has conquered the mind by the true self sees the mind as a friend; but the unconquered intellect turns the mind into an enemy.
vishnu_gita::546.translation_literal: बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य (friend is of the true self) / येनैवात्मात्मना (by whom himself with true self) / जितः (conquered) / अनात्मनस्तु (but of non-self) / शत्रुत्वे (in hostility) / वर्जेतात्मैव (is avoided by the true self) / शत्रुवत् (like an enemy)
vishnu_gita::546.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::546.essence: Mastering your mind from the true self turns it from enemy into friend.
vishnu_gita::546.simple_meaning: When you control your restless mind using your true self, the mind becomes your friend. Without this control, the mind acts like an enemy.
vishnu_gita::546.simple_insight: You feel relief knowing that mastering your mind turns it from foe to friend.
vishnu_gita::546.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that when a devotee uses their true self to control the restless mind, the mind acts as a loyal friend. But if the intellect is not disciplined, the mind behaves like a hostile enemy, causing inner conflict.
vishnu_gita::546.modern_relevance: When stress overwhelms you and your thoughts fight each other, gaining control over your mind brings peace and turns inner turmoil into cooperation.
vishnu_gita::546.insight: This verse teaches you to use your true self to tame the restless mind, shifting it from opposition to harmony.

vishnu_gita::547.verse_sanskrit:
योगी युन्जीत सतत्तमात्मानं रहसी स्थित: ।
एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः ॥
vishnu_gita::547.verse_hindi: योगी को उचित है कि सब समय एकान्त में अवस्थित रहकर एकाकी, संयतचित्त, संयतात्मा, इच्छाशून्य और परिग्रह शन्य होकर मन को समाहित करे
vishnu_gita::547.english_translation: The yogi should always remain in solitude, alone, with a controlled mind and self, free from desire and attachment.
vishnu_gita::547.translation_literal: योगी (yogi) / युन्जीत (should engage) / सतत्तमात्मानं (always the self) / रहसी (in secrecy/solitude) / स्थित: (being) / एकाकी (alone) / यतचित्तात्मा (controlled mind and self) / निराशीर (without desire) / परिग्रहः (without attachment)
vishnu_gita::547.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::547.essence: True strength grows in solitude with a calm, desireless, and unattached mind.
vishnu_gita::547.simple_meaning: You should spend time alone with a steady mind and self, free from desires and attachments.
vishnu_gita::547.simple_insight: There’s peace in being alone with a quiet mind and no clinging.
vishnu_gita::547.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that the yogi must cultivate solitude and inner control. By withdrawing from distractions and desires, the yogi stabilizes the mind and self, preparing for deeper spiritual progress.
vishnu_gita::547.modern_relevance: When life feels noisy and overwhelming, stepping back alone helps you regain focus without craving or clinging.
vishnu_gita::547.insight: It teaches you to cultivate inner stability by withdrawing into solitude and calming restless desires.

vishnu_gita::548.verse_sanskrit:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः ।
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् ॥
vishnu_gita::548.verse_hindi: पवित्र स्थान में कुशासन के ऊपर मृगचर्म और उसके ऊपर रेशम का वस्त्र रखकर न बहुत ऊंचा और न बहुत नीचा आसन स्थिर करके और
vishnu_gita::548.english_translation: In a pure place, place a seat made of kusa grass, topped with deer skin and silk cloth, neither too high nor too low, and sit steadily.
vishnu_gita::548.translation_literal: शुचौ (in pure) देशे (place) प्रतिष्ठाप्य (establishing) स्थिरमासनम् (steady seat) आत्मनः (for oneself) । नात्युच्छ्रितं (not too high) नातिनीचं (not too low) चैला (deer skin) जिनकुशोत्तरम् (on kusa grass and above) ॥
vishnu_gita::548.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::548.essence: A steady, balanced seat supports steady mind and practice.
vishnu_gita::548.simple_meaning: Choose a clean, balanced seat made of natural materials and sit steadily to prepare for practice.
vishnu_gita::548.simple_insight: A steady body supports a steady mind; your setting matters.
vishnu_gita::548.detailed_meaning: Vishnu instructs choosing a clean, stable seat of kusa grass, deer skin, and silk, placed neither too high nor too low, to help steady the body and mind for spiritual practice.
vishnu_gita::548.modern_relevance: You arrange your chair and environment before a meditation or deep focus session to help your mind settle.
vishnu_gita::548.insight: Setting a balanced physical foundation helps your mind remain steady and focused during practice.

vishnu_gita::549.verse_sanskrit:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यताचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः ।
उपविश्यासने युज्यादयोगमात्मविशुद्धये ॥
vishnu_gita::549.verse_hindi: उस आसन पर बैठकर मन को एकाग्र करके चित्त और इन्द्रियों की क्रिया को वशीभूत करते हुए उपासक को चित्तशुद्धि के निमित्त योगाभ्यास करना उचित है
vishnu_gita::549.english_translation: Sitting on that seat, focus your mind, control the mind and senses, and practice yoga for purifying the inner state.
vishnu_gita::549.translation_literal: तत्र (there) / एकाग्रं (one-pointed) / मनः (mind) / कृत्वा (having made) / यताचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः (controlled mind and senses) / उपविश्यासने (sitting on the seat) / युज्याद (should practice) / योगमात्मविशुद्धये (yoga for purification of the self)
vishnu_gita::549.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::549.essence: Steady sitting and controlled mind form the foundation for purifying the inner state.
vishnu_gita::549.simple_meaning: You should sit steadily with your mind focused and senses under control to practice yoga that purifies your inner being.
vishnu_gita::549.simple_insight: You feel more peaceful and clear when your mind and senses are steady and focused.
vishnu_gita::549.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Vishnu advises the practitioner to sit calmly on a seat, focus the mind single-pointedly, and bring the restless mind and senses under control to practice yoga aimed at purifying the inner state. This moment marks the start of disciplined inner work.
vishnu_gita::549.modern_relevance: You sit quietly in your chair, pushing away distractions from your phone and thoughts, preparing to focus fully on your task.
vishnu_gita::549.insight: This verse teaches you to establish steady focus and self-control as the foundation for inner purification.

vishnu_gita::550.verse_sanskrit:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः।
सम्प्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन् ॥
vishnu_gita::550.verse_hindi: देह का मध्यभाग मस्तक और ग्रीवा देशः सरल और निश्चल भाव से रखकर, स्थिर होकर अपनी नासिका के अग्रभाग का अवलोकन करते हुए एवं अन्य ओर का देखना छोड़कर
vishnu_gita::550.english_translation: Keeping the body upright and steady, the head and neck held straight, calmly focusing on the tip of the nose and not looking elsewhere.
vishnu_gita::550.translation_literal: समं (upright) / कायशिरोग्रीवं (body-head-neck) / धारयन् (holding) / अचलं (steady) / स्थिरः (still) / सम्प्रेक्ष्य (looking intently) / नासिकाग्रं (tip of the nose) / स्वं (own) / दिशश्च (directions) / अनवलोकयन् (not looking)
vishnu_gita::550.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::550.essence: Steady body and focused gaze quiet the restless mind.
vishnu_gita::550.simple_meaning: You keep your body straight and still, focusing your eyes gently on the tip of your nose without looking around.
vishnu_gita::550.simple_insight: A calm steady gaze can bring your scattered mind to rest.
vishnu_gita::550.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches a fundamental yogic posture: standing or sitting with body, head, and neck aligned and steady. The practitioner gently fixes the gaze on the nose tip, avoiding distraction, to cultivate concentration and calm the restless mind.
vishnu_gita::550.modern_relevance: When your mind races, try sitting quietly with your spine straight and eyes softly fixed on one point to find calm.
vishnu_gita::550.insight: It teaches you how steady physical posture combined with focused gaze stabilizes your mental state.

vishnu_gita::551.verse_sanskrit:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीब्रह्मचारित्रते स्थितः।
मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः ॥
vishnu_gita::551.verse_hindi: प्रशान्तचित्त भयरहित  और ब्रह्मचर्य में अवस्थित होकर मन का दमन करते हुए मुझमें ही चित्त समर्पण करके मत्परायण होते हुए युक्त होकर अवस्थान करना उचित है
vishnu_gita::551.english_translation: One should be calm, free from fear, steady in celibacy, control the mind, and be devoted with the mind fixed on me.
vishnu_gita::551.translation_literal: प्रशान्तात्मा (calm-minded) / विगतभीब्रह्मचारित्रते (free-from-fear, in celibacy) / स्थितः (being) / मनः (mind) / संयम्य (controlling) / मच्चित्तो (mind fixed on me) / युक्त (joined) / आसीत (should be) / मत्परः (devoted to me)
vishnu_gita::551.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::551.essence: Calm, fearless self-control rooted in devotion steadies the restless mind.
vishnu_gita::551.simple_meaning: You should remain calm and fearless, live with self-restraint, control your restless mind, and fix your attention devotedly on the divine.
vishnu_gita::551.simple_insight: Peace and devotion come from calming your mind and steadying your focus.
vishnu_gita::551.detailed_meaning: Vishnu instructs practicing calmness, fearlessness, and celibacy as foundations for controlling the mind. This steadiness supports deep devotion by fixing the mind fully on the divine, a necessary discipline before higher spiritual progress.
vishnu_gita::551.modern_relevance: When overwhelm hits and distractions pull you every way, grounding yourself with calm focus and clear priorities helps you stay steady and connected to what matters.
vishnu_gita::551.insight: It teaches you to cultivate calmness and self-restraint as a stable base for devoted focus and effective action.

vishnu_gita::552.verse_sanskrit:
युजन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतमानसः।
शांति निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति ॥
vishnu_gita::552.verse_hindi: उक्त रूप से सदा मन को दमन करने वाला संयतचित्त योगी निर्वाण मुक्ति देने वाली एवं मुझमें रहने वाली शान्ति को प्राप्त करता है
vishnu_gita::552.english_translation: A yogi who thus always controls the mind and is free from mental distractions attains the supreme peace of liberation abiding in me.
vishnu_gita::552.translation_literal: युजन्नेवं (thus uniting) सदात्मानं (true self) योगी (yogi) विगतमानसः (free from mind) शांति (peace) निर्वाणपरमां (supreme liberation) मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति (in me abiding attains)
vishnu_gita::552.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::552.essence: Calming your restless mind leads you to the highest peace abiding within.
