vishnu_gita::552.simple_meaning: You can reach the highest peace by always calming your mind and staying steady within yourself.
vishnu_gita::552.simple_insight: There is comfort knowing that steady calm opens the door to deep peace inside you.
vishnu_gita::552.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes a yogi who consistently controls and calms the restless mind. Freed from distractions, the yogi attains the supreme peace of liberation, which is present within Vishnu himself. This teaching urges steady inner discipline leading to profound tranquility.
vishnu_gita::552.modern_relevance: You sit quietly after a hectic day, letting go of racing thoughts, and feel a deep calm settle inside you.
vishnu_gita::552.insight: It teaches you to focus inward steadily, calming the restless mind to experience true peace.

vishnu_gita::553.verse_sanskrit:
नात्यशंतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकांतमंश्न्त: ।
न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चामराः ! ॥
vishnu_gita::553.verse_hindi: परन्तु हे देवतागण ! अधिक भोजन करने वाले को योग की प्राप्ति नहीं होती और न निरन्तर उपवास करने वाले को ही योग की प्राप्ति होती है, उसी प्रकार बहुत सोने वाले को भी योग की प्राप्ति नहीं होती है और न बहुत जागने वाले को ही योग की प्राप्ति होती है
vishnu_gita::553.english_translation: But, O divine beings, one who overeats does not attain yoga, nor does one who fasts continually; similarly, one who sleeps excessively does not attain yoga, nor does one who stays awake continuously.
vishnu_gita::553.translation_literal: नाति (excessively) अशन्तः (overeating) तु (but) योगः (yoga) अस्ति (exists) न (not) च (and) एकान्तम् (continually) अंशन्तः (fasting) न (not) च (and) अति (excessively) स्वप्नशीलस्य (sleeping one) जाग्रतः (awake one) नैव (not) च (and) आमराः (those who remain awake)
vishnu_gita::553.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::553.essence: Yoga cannot be attained through extreme or unbalanced habits of eating or sleeping.
vishnu_gita::553.simple_meaning: Yoga is not gained by eating too much or fasting all the time, nor by sleeping excessively or staying awake constantly. Balance is key.
vishnu_gita::553.simple_insight: You feel relief knowing yoga comes from steady balance, not extremes.
vishnu_gita::553.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Vishnu addresses divine beings, explaining that extreme habits like overeating, continuous fasting, excessive sleeping, or constant wakefulness do not lead to yoga. The lesson is about finding a balanced approach to discipline.
vishnu_gita::553.modern_relevance: After binge eating or pulling an all-nighter, you realize true growth doesn’t come from extremes but from steady balance.
vishnu_gita::553.insight: It teaches you to cultivate moderate habits, avoiding extremes that block steady progress in practice.

vishnu_gita::554.verse_sanskrit:
युक्ता विहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु ।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥
vishnu_gita::554.verse_hindi: जो साधक नियमित आहार और विहार करते हैं और कर्मों को भी नियमाधीन होकर करते हैं, नियम के साथ निद्रित होते हैं और नियम के साथ जागते हैं उनका योगाभ्यास दुःख का नाश करने वाला होता है
vishnu_gita::554.english_translation: Those who regulate their food and activities, perform actions with discipline, and maintain regular sleep and wakefulness have a yoga practice that destroys suffering.
vishnu_gita::554.translation_literal: युक्ता (regulated) / विहारस्य (of recreation) / युक्तचेष्टस्य (with disciplined actions) / कर्मसु (in deeds) / युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य (disciplined in sleep and wakefulness) / योगो (yoga) / भवति (becomes) / दुःखहा (destroyer of suffering)
vishnu_gita::554.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::554.essence: Discipline in daily life creates a yoga that ends suffering.
vishnu_gita::554.simple_meaning: Following a balanced routine for eating, activity, work, and sleep leads to a practice that ends suffering.
vishnu_gita::554.simple_insight: You feel relief knowing steady habits bring lasting ease and reduce pain.
vishnu_gita::554.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that when a seeker maintains discipline in daily habits—balanced eating, controlled movement, mindful action, and regulated sleep—their yoga practice naturally overcomes suffering. This guidance comes as a foundation for steady progress on the spiritual path.
vishnu_gita::554.modern_relevance: You wake up, eat on time, work with focus, and sleep regularly—this order quietly eases your stress and pain.
vishnu_gita::554.insight: It shifts your focus from chasing results to cultivating steady, wholesome habits that protect your well-being.

vishnu_gita::555.verse_sanskrit:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते ।
निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा ॥
vishnu_gita::555.verse_hindi: जब चित्त विशेषरूप से संयत होकर आत्मा मे ही अवस्थान करता है तब सभी प्रकार की कामनाओं से निःस्पृह व्यक्ति युक्त कहलाता है
vishnu_gita::555.english_translation: When the mind is fully controlled and rests in the true self, free from all desires, one is called united.
vishnu_gita::555.translation_literal: यदा (when) विनियतं (controlled) चित्तम् (mind) आत्मनि (in the self) एव (only) अवतिष्ठते (rests) । निःस्पृहः (without desire) सर्वकामेभ्यः (from all desires) युक्तः (united) इति (thus) उच्यते (is said) तदा (then) ॥
vishnu_gita::555.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::555.essence: True union happens when the mind rests silently in the true self, free from desire.
vishnu_gita::555.simple_meaning: When your mind is firmly focused and stays on your true self without distraction, and you no longer crave desires, you are considered united and steady.
vishnu_gita::555.simple_insight: There is calm and strength in being free from endless wanting and resting in who you truly are.
vishnu_gita::555.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Vishnu explains that when a person masters their restless mind and keeps it fixed on the true self, they become free from all desires. This state of desirelessness marks a union with the inner being and is a key step toward spiritual clarity.
vishnu_gita::555.modern_relevance: You notice how your mind races chasing likes, achievements, or approval. This verse invites you to let go and simply be with yourself without craving more.
vishnu_gita::555.insight: It teaches you to settle your mind steadily on your true self, reducing distraction from desires.

vishnu_gita::556.verse_sanskrit:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेग्नते सोमपा स्मृता।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युन्ज्य्तो योगमात्मन: ॥
vishnu_gita::556.verse_hindi: जैसे वायुरहित स्थान में दीप विचलित नहीं हुआ करता, आत्मा के उद्देश्य से योग का अभ्यास करने वाले संयतात्मा योगी के अचञ्चल चित्त को ऐसा ही समझना चाहिये
vishnu_gita::556.english_translation: Just as a lamp in a windless place does not flicker, the mind of a yogi focused on the true self remains steady.
vishnu_gita::556.translation_literal: यथा (just as) दीपो (lamp) निवातस्थो (in windless place) नेग्नते (does not flicker) सोमपा (so) स्मृता (remembered) । योगिनो (of the yogi) यतचित्तस्य (whose mind) युन्ज्य्तो (engaging) योगम् (yoga) आत्मन: (of the self) ॥
vishnu_gita::556.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::556.essence: A mind focused on the true self remains as steady as a lamp without wind.
vishnu_gita::556.simple_meaning: When you practice yoga focused on your true self, your mind becomes steady like a lamp in a place without wind.
vishnu_gita::556.simple_insight: You can feel calm and unshaken even when challenges arise by steadying your mind.
vishnu_gita::556.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that just as a lamp placed where there is no wind remains steady, a yogi who practices with focused mind attuned to the true self maintains inner steadiness despite outer disturbances.
vishnu_gita::556.modern_relevance: When your thoughts race before a big decision, remember how a steady lamp stays calm without wind and find your inner quiet.
vishnu_gita::556.insight: It encourages shifting your attention inward to keep mental calm instead of reacting to external distractions.

vishnu_gita::557.verse_sanskrit:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवसा ।
यत्र चैवात्मनातमाँ पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति ॥
vishnu_gita::557.verse_hindi: जिस अवस्था में योगाभ्यास द्वारा संयत चित्त उपरति को प्राप्त होता है और जिस अवस्था में आत्मज्ञान द्वारा आत्मा को देखते हुए आत्मा मे ही उपासक संतुष्ट हो जाता है वही योगावस्था है
vishnu_gita::557.english_translation: The state where the mind is restrained through yoga practice, and the practitioner, seeing the true self within, is satisfied in that self, is the state of yoga.
vishnu_gita::557.translation_literal: यत्रोपरमते (where rises) चित्तं (the mind) निरुद्धं (restrained) योगसेवसा (by yoga practice) । यत्र (where) चैव (also) आत्मनातमाँ (of the self) पश्यन्न (seeing) आत्मनि (in the self) तुष्यति (is satisfied) ॥
vishnu_gita::557.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::557.essence: Yoga is the calm mind that sees and finds joy in the true self.
vishnu_gita::557.simple_meaning: Yoga is the state where your restless mind becomes calm through practice, and you see and feel satisfied with your true self within.
vishnu_gita::557.simple_insight: You can feel deeply content when your mind is still and you connect with your true self.
vishnu_gita::557.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that yoga is achieved when the mind, often restless, becomes controlled by consistent practice, and the practitioner sees the true self within and finds satisfaction there. This moment is not just calm but a profound inner contentment.
vishnu_gita::557.modern_relevance: After a long day of distractions, when your mind finally quiets and you notice your own steady presence, a deep calm naturally arises.
vishnu_gita::557.insight: It teaches you to steady your mind through practice and rest in the satisfaction of your inner self.

vishnu_gita::558.verse_sanskrit:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तबुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् ।
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ॥
vishnu_gita::558.verse_hindi: जिस अवस्थाविशेष में युक्त व्यक्ति उस अनिर्वचनीय अतीन्द्रिय और केवल बुद्धि से ग्रहण करने योग्य परम सुख का अनुभव करता है और जिस अवस्था में स्थित होने पर ही यथार्थरूप से वह अविचलित रहता है उसी अवस्था को योग कहते हैं
vishnu_gita::558.english_translation: Yoga is the state where a person experiences supreme, indescribable bliss beyond the senses, grasped only by the discerning mind, and remains truly unshaken in that state.
vishnu_gita::558.translation_literal: सुखमात्यन्तिकं (supreme bliss) यत् (which) बुद्धिग्राह्यम् (intellect-grasped) अतीन्द्रियम् (beyond senses) वेत्ति (knows) यत्र (where) न (not) चैव (also) अयं (this) स्थितः (situated) चलति (moves) तत्त्वतः (truly)
vishnu_gita::558.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::558.essence: True yoga is lasting inner steadiness born from bliss beyond the senses.
vishnu_gita::558.simple_meaning: Yoga is being in a state of deep, indescribable happiness that only a wise mind can understand, where you stay completely steady and unshaken.
vishnu_gita::558.simple_insight: You can rest in a joy so profound it keeps your mind completely calm and steady.
vishnu_gita::558.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes yoga as the experience of a bliss that goes beyond the senses, something only the intellect can grasp. This bliss steadies the person completely, making them truly unshaken amid life’s changes.
vishnu_gita::558.modern_relevance: When your excitement or anxiety fades into a calm joy that your mind alone senses, you discover a steadiness that no distraction can shake.
vishnu_gita::558.insight: It teaches you to recognize the difference between fleeting sensory pleasure and a profound, steady joy known only through clear inner awareness.

vishnu_gita::559.verse_sanskrit:
यं लब्ध्या चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः ।
यस्मिन् स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते ॥
vishnu_gita::559.verse_hindi: जिस अवस्था में अन्य सब अवस्थाओं के लाभ को उस अवस्था से अधिक न समझा जाय और जिस अवस्था में रहने से महादुःख भी विचलित न कर सके उस अवस्था को योग कहते हैं
vishnu_gita::559.english_translation: The state in which no other gain is considered greater and where even great sorrow cannot disturb is called yoga.
vishnu_gita::559.translation_literal: यं (which) लब्ध्या (by gain) च (and) अपरं (other) लाभं (gain) मन्यते (is considered) नाधिकं (not greater) ततः (than that). यस्मिन् (in which) स्थितो (situated) न (not) दुःखेन (by sorrow) गुरुणा (great) अपि (even) विचाल्यते (is disturbed).
vishnu_gita::559.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::559.essence: Yoga is an unshakable calm beyond all gains and pains.
vishnu_gita::559.simple_meaning: Yoga is the state where no other achievement seems better, and even great suffering cannot shake your calm.
vishnu_gita::559.simple_insight: You can find a calm so steady that nothing, not even pain, can disturb you.
vishnu_gita::559.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains yoga as a state of inner stability where no other success feels more valuable and even deep sorrow fails to unsettle you. This teaching comes as guidance to hold steady beyond fleeting gains or losses.
vishnu_gita::559.modern_relevance: You face a crisis that would normally upset you deeply, but you notice a quiet center inside that remains calm no matter what happens.
vishnu_gita::559.insight: It teaches you to cultivate an inner stability that remains unshaken by external gains or losses, even intense suffering.

vishnu_gita::560.verse_sanskrit:
तं विद्याद्दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् ।
स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगो निर्विण्णचेतसा ॥
vishnu_gita::560.verse_hindi: जिस अवस्थाविशेष में दुःख का सम्पर्क नहीं रहता है वही अवस्था योगशब्दवाच्य है और निर्विषण चित्त उसी ही योग का अभ्यास करना उचित है
vishnu_gita::560.english_translation: The state where there is no contact with suffering is called yoga; one should practice yoga with a mind free from agitation.
vishnu_gita::560.translation_literal: तं (that) / विद्याद् (should be known) / दुःखसंयोगवियोगं (separation from contact with suffering) / योगसंज्ञितम् (called yoga) / स (that) / निश्चयेन (certainly) / योक्तव्यो (should be practiced) / योगो (yoga) / निर्विण्णचेतसा (with a mind free from agitation)
vishnu_gita::560.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::560.essence: Yoga is the calm mind free from suffering's contact.
vishnu_gita::560.simple_meaning: Yoga means reaching a state where suffering no longer touches you, practiced with a calm, untroubled mind.
vishnu_gita::560.simple_insight: You can find deep calm by distancing yourself from suffering and steadying your mind.
vishnu_gita::560.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that yoga is not just physical practice but a mental state where suffering loses its hold. The teaching comes as guidance to maintain a steady, unagitated mind to truly practice yoga.
vishnu_gita::560.modern_relevance: When painful news strikes, and your mind races with worry, this verse reminds you to steady your thoughts and find calm beyond that pain.
vishnu_gita::560.insight: It teaches you to approach yoga as calming the mind beyond emotional disturbance, not just physical effort.

vishnu_gita::561.verse_sanskrit:
संकल्पप्रभवान् कामान् त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः।
मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः ॥
vishnu_gita::561.verse_hindi: संकल्प से उत्पन्न होने वाली सभी इच्छाओ को विशेष रूप से त्याग कर, मन के ही द्वारा इन्द्रियगण को सब विषयसमूह से
vishnu_gita::561.english_translation: Completely renounce all desires born from resolve; by the mind itself, control all the senses from every direction.
vishnu_gita::561.translation_literal: संकल्पप्रभवान् (born from resolve) / कामान् (desires) / त्यक्त्वा (having renounced) / सर्वानशेषतः (all completely) / मनसैव (by the mind itself) / इन्द्रियग्रामं (the group of senses) / विनियम्य (controlling) / समन्ततः (from all directions)
vishnu_gita::561.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::561.essence: You can fully give up desires and govern your senses solely through your mind.
vishnu_gita::561.simple_meaning: Let go completely of all desires that arise from your intentions, and use your mind to regulate all your senses.
vishnu_gita::561.simple_insight: There is freedom in consciously releasing desires and calmly guiding your senses with your mind.
vishnu_gita::561.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that when desires arise from mental resolutions, you must completely renounce them. This moment calls for inner control, where the mind itself disciplines all the senses, preventing distractions from all around.
vishnu_gita::561.modern_relevance: You notice your mind chasing after every impulse and craving. This verse shows you how to pause, let go, and gently steer your attention away.
vishnu_gita::561.insight: It teaches you to use your mind actively to regulate senses, shifting focus from satisfying desires to self-mastery.

vishnu_gita::562.verse_sanskrit:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद्बद्धया धृतिगृहीतया।
आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत् ॥
vishnu_gita::562.verse_hindi: विशेषरूप से रोक करके धारणा से वशीभूत की हुई बुद्धि द्वारा मन को आत्मा में  निश्चलरूप से स्थापन करके क्रमशः उपराम को प्राप्त हो और कोई चिन्ता न रक्खे
vishnu_gita::562.english_translation: Gradually, steadily restrain the mind with focused determination, establish it firmly in the true self, and do not entertain any worries.
vishnu_gita::562.translation_literal: शनैः (slowly) शनैः (slowly) उपरमेत् (restrain) बद्धया (with binding) धृतिगृहीतया (with firm determination) आत्मसंस्थं (established in the self) मनः (mind) कृत्वा (making) न (not) किञ्चिदपि (anything) चिन्तयेत् (worry).
vishnu_gita::562.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::562.essence: Steadily restrain your mind and fix it firmly in your true self without worry.
vishnu_gita::562.simple_meaning: You should gradually and firmly restrain your restless mind, fixing it steadily in your true self without letting any worries arise.
vishnu_gita::562.simple_insight: There's peace in gently guiding your mind away from distraction and worry toward steady presence.
vishnu_gita::562.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Vishnu advises focusing the restless mind with firm determination, gradually restraining its distractions and establishing it deeply in the true self. This moment comes amid instruction to Arjuna on mastering inner discipline before action.
vishnu_gita::562.modern_relevance: You sit quietly after a stressful day, gently bringing your scattered thoughts back to yourself, refusing to spiral into anxiety.
vishnu_gita::562.insight: It teaches you to patiently and steadily hold your attention in the true self, reducing mental turbulence.

vishnu_gita::563.verse_sanskrit:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् ।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ॥
vishnu_gita::563.verse_hindi: स्वभाव से चञ्चल और संयम करने पर भी चलायमान होने वाला मन जिस जिस विषय में जावे उस उस विषय से उसको खींच कर आत्मा मे ही स्थिर करना चाहिये
vishnu_gita::563.english_translation: Whenever the restless and unsteady mind wanders, it should be controlled and drawn back to the true self alone.
vishnu_gita::563.translation_literal: यतो (whenever) यतो (whenever) निश्चरति (wanders) मनश्चञ्चलम् (mind restless) अस्थिरम् (unsteady) । ततः (then) ततो (thereupon) नियम्य (controlling) एतत् (this) आत्मन्येव (to the self alone) वशं (under control) नयेत् (should lead) ॥
vishnu_gita::563.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::563.essence: A restless mind should be gently controlled and consistently redirected to the true self.
vishnu_gita::563.simple_meaning: When your restless mind moves away, you should gently control it and bring it back to your true self.
vishnu_gita::563.simple_insight: You can gently guide your wandering mind home without harshness or frustration.
vishnu_gita::563.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that the mind is naturally restless and often wanders across many distractions. The key is to patiently control and redirect it inward, focusing on the true self as a stable center.
vishnu_gita::563.modern_relevance: Your mind jumps from one notification to another, but you can pause and gently bring your focus back to yourself.
vishnu_gita::563.insight: This verse teaches you to notice when your mind drifts and patiently redirect your attention inward without judgment.

vishnu_gita::564.verse_sanskrit:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं मुखमुत्तमम्।
उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम् ॥
vishnu_gita::564.verse_hindi: क्योंकि उक्त प्रकार से रजोगुण से रहित प्रशान्तचित्त, निष्पाप और ब्रह्मभाव को प्राप्त योगी को परमसुख प्राप्त होता है
vishnu_gita::564.english_translation: Because a yogi who is free from the mode of passion, whose mind is peaceful, and who is pure and established in the supreme reality attains supreme bliss.
vishnu_gita::564.translation_literal: प्रशान्तमनसं (peaceful mind) / ह्येनं (indeed this) / योगिनं (yogi) / मुखमुत्तमम् (the best state) / उपैति (attains) / शान्तरजसं (free from passion mode) / ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम् (pure, established in Brahman, without impurity)
vishnu_gita::564.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::564.essence: Calm, pure awareness free from desire brings the highest joy.
vishnu_gita::564.simple_meaning: A yogi who has a calm mind, free from passion and impurity, and who is established in the supreme reality experiences the highest happiness.
vishnu_gita::564.simple_insight: You can find deep happiness by calming your restless mind and letting go of desire.
vishnu_gita::564.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that when a yogi transcends the restless and passionate mind, becoming pure and rooted in the supreme reality, they reach the highest state of bliss. This moment marks a key stage in spiritual progress where inner calm leads to profound joy.
vishnu_gita::564.modern_relevance: After a hectic day filled with craving and stress, you finally find a moment of calm and clarity, feeling a deep contentment arise from within.
vishnu_gita::564.insight: It teaches you to cultivate a peaceful, desire-free mind to experience true joy beyond external circumstances.

vishnu_gita::565.verse_sanskrit:
युन्ज्न्नेव सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः।
मुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते ॥
vishnu_gita::565.verse_hindi: इस प्रकार से सदा मन को ब्रह्म में युक्त करता हुआ निष्पाप योगी अनायास ब्रह्म संस्पर्श रूपी सर्वोत्कृष्ट सुख को प्राप्त कर लेता है
vishnu_gita::565.english_translation: By always uniting the mind with the supreme reality, the yogi free from all faults effortlessly attains the supreme bliss of contact with the supreme reality.
vishnu_gita::565.translation_literal: युन्ज्नेव (uniting) सदात्मानं (the true self) योगी (the yogi) विगतकल्मषः (free from faults) । मुखेन (by the face/mouth) ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शम् (contact with the supreme reality) अत्यन्तं (extremely) सुखम् (bliss) अश्नुते (attains) ॥
vishnu_gita::565.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::565.essence: Effortless union of mind with the supreme reality frees you and brings supreme bliss.
vishnu_gita::565.simple_meaning: If you always keep your mind connected to the supreme reality, you become free from faults and easily experience the highest bliss.
vishnu_gita::565.simple_insight: There's a quiet joy in steady, effortless union with what truly is.
vishnu_gita::565.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that a yogi who continually unites their mind with the supreme reality becomes free from inner faults and naturally experiences supreme bliss without struggle.
vishnu_gita::565.modern_relevance: When your mind settles naturally on what truly matters, peace and joy come without forcing or striving.
vishnu_gita::565.insight: It teaches you to rest your mind steadily on the true self, dissolving inner obstacles effortlessly.

vishnu_gita::566.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि ।
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ॥
vishnu_gita::566.verse_hindi: योग के द्वारा समाहित चित्त और सर्वत्र समदर्शन करने वाला वह योगी आत्मा को सर्वभूतों में अवस्थित देखता है और सर्वभूतों को आत्मा में देखता है
vishnu_gita::566.english_translation: The yogi with a focused mind sees the true self dwelling in all beings and all beings within the true self, perceiving equality everywhere.
vishnu_gita::566.translation_literal: सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं (the true self residing in all beings) / सर्वभूतानि (all beings) / चात्मनि (in the true self) / ईक्षते (sees) / योगयुक्तात्मा (the yogi united with yoga) / सर्वत्र (everywhere) / समदर्शनः (equal vision)
vishnu_gita::566.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::566.essence: The true self is equally present in all beings, and all beings exist within the true self.
vishnu_gita::566.simple_meaning: A person who practices yoga with a calm mind sees the true self inside all beings and sees all beings as part of the true self, feeling equal to everything.
vishnu_gita::566.simple_insight: Feeling connected and equal to all beings brings peace and reduces separation.
vishnu_gita::566.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that when the mind is steady in yoga, the yogi perceives the true self present in every living being and simultaneously sees all beings within that true self. This vision removes division and reveals equality everywhere.
vishnu_gita::566.modern_relevance: When you stop judging others and see them as part of yourself, conflicts soften and empathy grows naturally.
vishnu_gita::566.insight: It teaches you to shift from seeing yourself as separate to seeing unity with others, fostering compassion and balance.

vishnu_gita::567.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्त्तते ॥
vishnu_gita::567.verse_hindi: जो सर्वभूत में अवस्थित मुझको अद्वितीय रूप से आश्रय करके मेरी उपासना करता है, संसार में वर्तमान रहने पर भी वह योगी सर्वथा मुझमे ही अवस्थान करता है।
vishnu_gita::567.english_translation: Whoever worships me, dwelling in all beings as the one without a second, remains always in me, even while living in the world.
vishnu_gita::567.translation_literal: सर्वभूतस्थितं (dwelling in all beings) / यो (who) / मां (me) / भजति (worships) / एकत्वम् (oneness) / अस्तितः (established) / सर्वथा (in every way) / वर्तमानः (existing) / अपि (also) / स (he) / योगी (a yogi) / मयि (in me) / वर्त्तते (remains)
vishnu_gita::567.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::567.essence: Worshiping the unity within all beings keeps you always connected to the divine.
vishnu_gita::567.simple_meaning: If you worship the divine as the one present in all beings, you remain connected to the divine even while living in the world.
vishnu_gita::567.simple_insight: You can feel deeply connected to the divine while fully engaged in life.
vishnu_gita::567.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that worshiping him as the singular presence within all beings keeps the devotee firmly rooted in the divine, even while physically living in the world. This verse reveals the essence of Bhakti Yoga, blending worldly engagement with spiritual unity.
vishnu_gita::567.modern_relevance: You can stay spiritually connected even amid daily chaos by recognizing the divine presence in everyone you meet.
vishnu_gita::567.insight: It shifts your focus from separation to unity, allowing you to stay devoted while active in the world.

vishnu_gita::568.verse_sanskrit:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽमराः ।
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ॥
vishnu_gita::568.verse_hindi: हे देवगण! जो अपनी उपमा से सब भूतो को समान देखता हैं और सुख दुःख को समान देखता है वह योगी श्रेष्ठ है, यही मेरी सम्मति है
vishnu_gita::568.english_translation: The highest yogi sees all beings as equal to their own self and views pleasure and pain as the same.
vishnu_gita::568.translation_literal: आत्मौपम्येन (by self-similarity) / सर्वत्र (everywhere) / समं (equal) / पश्यति (sees) / योऽमराः (who, O immortal ones) / सुखं (pleasure) / वा (or) / यदि (if) / वा (or) / दुःखं (pain) / स (that) / योगी (yogi) / परमो (highest) / मतः (opinion)
vishnu_gita::568.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::568.essence: Seeing yourself in all and feeling pleasure and pain equally is supreme yoga.
vishnu_gita::568.simple_meaning: You reach the highest yogic state when you see all beings as yourself and treat pleasure and pain equally.
vishnu_gita::568.simple_insight: You feel calm knowing others' joys and sorrows reflect your own nature equally.
vishnu_gita::568.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses the immortal beings, teaching that the supreme yogi does not separate their own self from others. This yogi views pleasure and pain without preference, embracing an equal vision of all life.
vishnu_gita::568.modern_relevance: In moments of conflict or joy, you pause and recognize others experience what you do; this softens reactions and deepens your calm.
vishnu_gita::568.insight: It teaches you to dissolve separation between self and others, balancing emotional responses to pleasure and pain.

vishnu_gita::569.verse_sanskrit:
असंशयं सुपर्वाणः ! मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् ।
अभ्यासेन तु भो देवाः ! वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥
vishnu_gita::569.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! मन दुर्निग्रह और चञ्चल है इसमें सन्देह नहीं; किन्तु हे देवगण ! अभ्यास और वैराग्य द्वारा मन का निग्रह किया जाता है
vishnu_gita::569.english_translation: Undoubtedly, the mind is restless and hard to control; but through practice and dispassion, the divine beings control the mind.
vishnu_gita::569.translation_literal: असंशयं (undoubtedly) सुपर्वाणः (very restless) ! मनो (mind) दुर्निग्रहं (hard to control) चलम् (restless) । अभ्यासेन (by practice) तु (but) भो (O) देवाः (divine beings) ! वैराग्येण (by dispassion) च (and) गृह्यते (is controlled) ॥
vishnu_gita::569.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::569.essence: Restless minds can be disciplined through steady practice and letting go.
vishnu_gita::569.simple_meaning: The mind is naturally restless and difficult to control. But with consistent practice and detachment, it can be disciplined.
vishnu_gita::569.simple_insight: There's hope knowing that your restless mind can be calmed through steady effort and letting go.
vishnu_gita::569.detailed_meaning: Speaking to divine beings, Vishnu explains that the mind is naturally restless and hard to control. Yet, with persistent practice (abhyasa) and dispassion (vairagya), even the most restless mind can be brought under control. This teaching encourages disciplined action.
vishnu_gita::569.modern_relevance: When your thoughts keep jumping around during work or study, regular practice and stepping back from attachments help you regain focus.
vishnu_gita::569.insight: It teaches you to use steady effort and detachment as tools to master your restless mind.

vishnu_gita::570.verse_sanskrit:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्पाप इति मे मतिः।
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः ॥
vishnu_gita::570.verse_hindi: जिसका चित्त संयत नहीं है मेरा मत है कि उसके लिये योग दुष्प्राप्य है; किन्तु गुरूपदिष्ट उपाय द्वारा संयतचित्त व्यक्ति यदि प्रयत्नशील हो तो योग को प्राप्त कर सकता है
vishnu_gita::570.english_translation: I believe that yoga is very difficult for one whose mind is uncontrolled; but one with a controlled mind can attain yoga through disciplined effort and proper methods.
vishnu_gita::570.translation_literal: असंयतात्मना (with uncontrolled mind) योगो (yoga) दुष्पाप (hard to obtain) इति (thus) मे (my) मतिः (opinion)। वश्यात्मना (with controlled mind) तु (but) यतता (through effort) शक्योऽवाप्तुम् (possible to attain) उपायतः (by proper methods) ॥
vishnu_gita::570.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::570.essence: Yoga is nearly impossible with an uncontrolled mind but attainable through steady effort and discipline.
vishnu_gita::570.simple_meaning: Yoga is very hard to achieve if your mind is uncontrolled, but with control and effort, it becomes possible.
vishnu_gita::570.simple_insight: You feel encouraged knowing steady effort and mind control can open the path to yoga.
vishnu_gita::570.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that a restless, uncontrolled mind makes yoga almost impossible, but if someone disciplines their mind and applies proper methods, yoga can be achieved. This sets the stage for disciplined practice.
vishnu_gita::570.modern_relevance: You keep trying to focus but your mind jumps around. Yet with patience and steady effort, you find calm and progress.
vishnu_gita::570.insight: It teaches you to channel restless energy into disciplined effort to unlock yoga’s fruits.

vishnu_gita::571.verse_sanskrit:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना ।
श्रद्धावान भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः ॥
vishnu_gita::571.verse_hindi: सब योगियों में से भी जो श्रद्धावान् व्यक्ति मद्गतचित्त से मेरी उपासना करता है वह अतिश्रेष्ठ योगी है, यह मेरा मत है।
vishnu_gita::571.english_translation: Among all yogis, the one who worships me with faith and inner devotion is the highest yogi, in my view.
vishnu_gita::571.translation_literal: योगिनामपि (among yogis also) सर्वेषां (of all) मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना (with mind absorbed in me) श्रद्धावान (having faith) भजते (worships) यो (who) मां (me) स (that one) मे (my) युक्ततमो (most united) मतः (opinion/view)
vishnu_gita::571.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::571.essence: True spiritual excellence comes from faithful, heartfelt worship of the divine.
vishnu_gita::571.simple_meaning: The best yogi is the one who worships the divine with sincere faith and an inner focused heart.
vishnu_gita::571.simple_insight: Faithful devotion connects you deeply and marks true spiritual excellence.
vishnu_gita::571.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that among all seekers practicing yoga, the one who worships him with unwavering faith and inner absorption is considered the highest yogi. This emphasizes devotion as the supreme spiritual attainment.
vishnu_gita::571.modern_relevance: When you fully trust and focus your heart in what you believe, you stand out as truly dedicated and connected.
vishnu_gita::571.insight: It shifts focus from external practices to inner faith and heartfelt devotion as the true measure of spiritual success.

vishnu_gita::572.verse_sanskrit:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढा:  प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः।
माययाऽपहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः॥
vishnu_gita::572.verse_hindi: पापशील विवेकहीन नराधम व्यक्ति माया के द्वारा हतज्ञान होकर आसुरीभाव को प्राप्त होते हुए मुझको प्राप्त नहीं होते हैं
vishnu_gita::572.english_translation: Those who perform evil deeds and lack discernment, the lowest among humans, do not seek me; they are lost in ignorance stolen by illusion and take on a shadowed nature.
vishnu_gita::572.translation_literal: न (not) / मां (me) / दुष्कृतिनः (evil-doers) / मूढाः (fools) / प्रपद्यन्ते (seek) / नराधमाः (lowest of humans) / मायया (by illusion) / अपहृत (stolen) / ज्ञान (knowledge) / आसुरं (shadowed/egoic) / भावम् (nature) / आश्रिताः (relying on/attached)
vishnu_gita::572.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::572.essence: Ignorance and illusion block the lowest from reaching the true self.
vishnu_gita::572.simple_meaning: People who do wrong and lack clear understanding do not come to the true self; they are trapped by illusion and ego.
vishnu_gita::572.simple_insight: There’s distance between you and those clouded by ignorance and illusion.
vishnu_gita::572.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that those who act wrongly and lack discernment are the lowest humans. Because illusion steals their clear understanding, they adopt an ego-driven nature and fail to connect with the true self.
vishnu_gita::572.modern_relevance: You notice people caught in patterns of harmful behavior and confusion who resist deeper connection or clarity about themselves.
vishnu_gita::572.insight: It shows that ignorance and illusion create barriers to devotion and connection with the true self.

vishnu_gita::573.verse_sanskrit:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनो ननु।
आतॊ जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च विबुधर्षभाः ॥
vishnu_gita::573.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! आर्त्त, जिज्ञासु, अर्थार्थी और ज्ञानी, यह चार प्रकार के पुण्यात्मा व्यक्ति मेरी उपासना करते हैं
vishnu_gita::573.english_translation: O divine beings! Four types of noble people worship me: the distressed, the seekers, the aim-driven, and the wise.
vishnu_gita::573.translation_literal: चतुर्विधा (four types) / भजन्ते (worship) / मां (me) / जनाः (people) / सुकृतिनो (noble) / ननु (indeed) / आतॊ (the distressed) / जिज्ञासु (seekers) / अर्थार्थी (aim-driven) / ज्ञानी (wise) / च (and) / विबुधर्षभाः (the best among the learned)
vishnu_gita::573.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::573.essence: Devotion takes many forms—pain, inquiry, purpose, and wisdom all lead inward.
vishnu_gita::573.simple_meaning: People approach devotion in four ways: through pain, seeking answers, pursuing goals, or through deep wisdom.
vishnu_gita::573.simple_insight: Devotion is personal; your way to connect with the divine is valid as you are.
vishnu_gita::573.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Vishnu explains to divine listeners that noble souls worship him in four distinct ways—those in distress, those curious about deeper truths, those pursuing worldly aims, and the wise who understand deeply. This shows devotion's diverse expressions.
vishnu_gita::573.modern_relevance: Whether you're suffering, searching, chasing goals, or reflecting deeply, your way of devotion is real and honored.
vishnu_gita::573.insight: It shifts your view to accept multiple valid paths of spiritual connection, freeing you from needing a single 'right' way.

vishnu_gita::574.verse_sanskrit:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिविशिष्यते।
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः ॥
vishnu_gita::574.verse_hindi: इनमे से ज्ञानी सर्वदा मुझमें निष्ठावान् और एकमात्र मुझमें ही भक्ति रखने वाला होने से श्रेष्ठ है, क्योंकि मैं  ज्ञानी भक्त का अतिप्रिय हूँ और वह भी मेरा प्रिय है।
vishnu_gita::574.english_translation: Among them, the wise one who is always devoted to me alone is superior, for I am exceedingly dear to the wise devotee, and he is dear to me.
vishnu_gita::574.translation_literal: तेषां (among them) / ज्ञानी (the wise one) / नित्ययुक्त (always united) / एकभक्तिविशिष्यते (is especially devoted to one) / प्रियो (dear) / हि (indeed) / ज्ञानिनः (of the wise) / अति-अर्थ (exceedingly dear) / अहं (I) / स (he) / च (and) / मम (to me) / प्रियः (dear)
vishnu_gita::574.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::574.essence: Steady, exclusive devotion creates a mutual, deep love between you and the divine.
vishnu_gita::574.simple_meaning: The person who is always devoted to the divine alone is the highest because the divine loves that devoted person greatly, and that person loves the divine.
vishnu_gita::574.simple_insight: There is warmth and confidence in knowing steady devotion makes you deeply loved by the divine.
vishnu_gita::574.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that among many types of seekers, the one who maintains constant, exclusive devotion to him stands highest. This mutual love between the devotee and the divine shows the power of focused Bhakti.
vishnu_gita::574.modern_relevance: When you remain consistently loyal and true in your care for something or someone, that bond deepens and becomes a source of genuine love and connection.
vishnu_gita::574.insight: It teaches you to value unwavering devotion as a path that nurtures mutual love between you and the divine.

vishnu_gita::575.verse_sanskrit:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् ॥
vishnu_gita::575.verse_hindi: ये सब ही महान हैं परन्तु ज्ञानी मेरा ही स्वरूप है, यह मेरा मत है; क्योंकि वह ज्ञानी भक्त मुझमें एक चित्त होकर सर्वोत्तम गतिस्वरूप मुझको ही आश्रय करता है
vishnu_gita::575.english_translation: All these are noble, but the true knower is my form; the united soul attains the highest state in me.
vishnu_gita::575.translation_literal: उदाराः (noble) सर्व (all) एवैते (indeed these) ज्ञानी (knowers) त्वात्मैव (true self alone) मे (my) मतम् (opinion) । आस्थितः (established) स (he) हि (indeed) युक्तात्मा (united soul) मामेवानुत्तमां (my alone highest) गतिम् (state) ॥
vishnu_gita::575.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::575.essence: True knowledge arises when your soul unites fully with the divine presence.
vishnu_gita::575.simple_meaning: Among all noble beings, the true knower is one whose soul is united with the divine and attains the highest state.
vishnu_gita::575.simple_insight: Feeling one with the divine brings a deep sense of highest belonging and purpose.
vishnu_gita::575.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that while many are noble, the highest knower is the one whose inner self is united with him, attaining the supreme state of union and peace.
vishnu_gita::575.modern_relevance: When you feel fully connected with your deepest values or purpose, you experience a calm that surpasses all external achievements.
vishnu_gita::575.insight: It shifts your focus from external knowledge to inner unity as the true mark of wisdom.

vishnu_gita::576.verse_sanskrit:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान मां प्रपद्यते ।
परमात्मा सर्वमिति स महात्मा मुर्लभः ॥
vishnu_gita::576.verse_hindi: बहुत जन्म ग्रहण करनेके बाद ज्ञानवान् व्यक्ति “यह चराचरः विश्व ही परमात्मस्वरूप है " ऐसा अनुभव करके मुझको प्राप्त होता है, ऐसा महात्मा जगत में दुर्लभ है
vishnu_gita::576.english_translation: After many births, a wise person understands that I am the supreme self who pervades all beings; such a great soul is rare in the world.
vishnu_gita::576.translation_literal: बहूनां (many) जन्मनामन्ते (after births) ज्ञानवान (wise) मां (me) प्रपद्यते (attains) । परमात्मा (supreme self) सर्वमिति (all indeed) स (that) महात्मा (great soul) मुर्लभः (rare) ॥
vishnu_gita::576.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::576.essence: Only after many lifetimes does one realize the supreme self pervades all existence.
vishnu_gita::576.simple_meaning: After many lifetimes, a wise person realizes that the supreme self is present in everything and attains this rare understanding.
vishnu_gita::576.simple_insight: There's a profound rarity and value in truly seeing unity beyond appearances.
vishnu_gita::576.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that it takes many lifetimes of experience and learning for a wise person to realize that the supreme self pervades all things; such deep understanding is rare and marks a great soul.
vishnu_gita::576.modern_relevance: You’ve lived through many challenges and lessons before finally recognizing that your true self connects deeply with everything around you.
vishnu_gita::576.insight: It teaches you to recognize the unity behind all diversity, shifting from separation to oneness.

vishnu_gita::577.verse_sanskrit:
कामैस्तैस्तैहिनज्ञानाः पद्यन्ते किलेतरान् ।
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ॥
vishnu_gita::577.verse_hindi: सांसारिक अनेक प्रकार की कामनाओ से हतज्ञान व्यक्ति अनेक प्रकार के नियमों का अवलम्बन करके अपनी प्रकृति को नियमित करते हुए ही औरों की (देवतादि की) उपासना करते रहते हैं।
vishnu_gita::577.english_translation: People lacking true wisdom follow various rules and regulate their nature through many desires, while worshipping others.
vishnu_gita::577.translation_literal: कामैस्तै (by desires such) / तैस्तै (such) / अहिनज्ञानाः (those without true knowledge) / पद्यन्ते (are bound) / किल (indeed) / अन्यतरान् (others) / तं (that) / तं (that) / नियमम् (rule) / आस्थाय (having adopted) / प्रकृत्या (by nature) / नियताः (regulated) / स्वया (by themselves)
vishnu_gita::577.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::577.essence: Following many rules driven by desires lacks true wisdom and fails to bring real guidance.
vishnu_gita::577.simple_meaning: Without true wisdom, people get caught in many desires and follow various rules to control themselves, but this does not lead to real understanding.
vishnu_gita::577.simple_insight: It's unsettling to realize that following many rules isn't the same as truly knowing yourself.
vishnu_gita::577.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that people caught in ignorance and many desires adopt numerous rules to regulate their nature. Despite their efforts, this approach lacks true wisdom and leads them to worship others without grasping deeper truth.
vishnu_gita::577.modern_relevance: You might follow countless habits or rules to manage your life, but without clarity, these efforts leave you feeling stuck and confused.
vishnu_gita::577.insight: It teaches you to see that real wisdom comes before rules; otherwise, desire-driven actions only create more confusion.

vishnu_gita::578.verse_sanskrit:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयाऽर्चितुमिच्छति ।
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::578.verse_hindi: जो जो भक्त जिस जिस मूर्ति की श्रद्धापूर्वक उपासना करने की इच्छा करता है, मैं उस उस भक्त की उस उस मूर्ति में वैसी ही दृढ़श्रद्धा विधान करता हूँ
vishnu_gita::578.english_translation: For every devotee wishing to worship a form with faith, I establish that devotee's firm faith in that very form.
vishnu_gita::578.translation_literal: यो (whoever) यो (whoever) यां (form) यां (form) तनुं (body) भक्तः (devotee) श्रद्धया (with faith) अर्चितुम् (to worship) इच्छति (wants) । तस्य (of that) तस्य (of that) अचलां (firm) श्रद्धां (faith) ताम् (that) एव (indeed) विदधामि (I establish) अहम् (I) ॥
vishnu_gita::578.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::578.essence: Sincere devotion to any form is met by the divine strengthening your faith in it.
vishnu_gita::578.simple_meaning: When you truly wish to worship a form with faith, that faith is firmly established within you by the divine.
vishnu_gita::578.simple_insight: You feel supported because your sincere devotion is strengthened by the divine itself.
vishnu_gita::578.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that whenever a devotee sincerely wishes to worship any form with faith, he strengthens that devotee's unwavering faith in that form. This verse comes as a reassurance that sincere longing to connect is met with support from the divine.
vishnu_gita::578.modern_relevance: You may feel uncertain when you choose how to express your devotion or spirituality; this reminds you that sincere intent alone deepens your inner trust.
vishnu_gita::578.insight: It shifts your trust inward, showing that faith grows as a response to your honest desire to connect.

vishnu_gita::579.verse_sanskrit:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते ।
लभते च ततः कामान् मयैव विहितान हितान् ॥
vishnu_gita::579.verse_hindi: वह भक्त उस श्रद्धा से युक्त होकर उस मूर्ति की आराधना करता है और तदनन्तर मेरे ही द्वारा सम्पादित हितकारी उन सकल कामनाओं का लाभ करता है
vishnu_gita::579.english_translation: One who worships the form with faith obtains by me the fulfillment of all beneficial desires.
vishnu_gita::579.translation_literal: स (he) / तया (with that) / श्रद्धया (faith) / युक्तः (endowed) / तस्य (his) / आराधनं (worship) / ईहते (performs) / लभते (obtains) / च (and) / ततः (thereafter) / कामान् (desires) / मया (by me) / एव (indeed) / विहितान् (appointed) / हितान् (beneficial)
vishnu_gita::579.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::579.essence: Faithful devotion invites the divine to fulfill all your true and beneficial desires.
vishnu_gita::579.simple_meaning: If you worship with genuine faith, the divine grants you all beneficial desires destined for your well-being.
vishnu_gita::579.simple_insight: Trusting fully in your devotion brings relief that your good wishes are cared for.
vishnu_gita::579.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that a devotee who worships with sincere faith will receive the fulfillment of all beneficial desires that have been ordained by the divine. This verse highlights the power of shraddha (trust) in devotion.
vishnu_gita::579.modern_relevance: You pray or dedicate your efforts wholeheartedly, then feel comforted knowing the universe supports your true well-being.
vishnu_gita::579.insight: It teaches you to surrender outcomes with full trust, shifting focus from effort to faith.

vishnu_gita::580.verse_sanskrit:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् ।
अन्यानन्ययजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि ॥
vishnu_gita::580.verse_hindi: परन्तु उन क्षुद्रबुद्धि व्यक्तियों का वह फल विनाशशील है क्योकि औरो की उपासना करने वाले अन्य लोको को प्राप्त होते हैं और मेरे भक्त मुझको प्राप्त होते हैं
vishnu_gita::580.english_translation: But the result of the small-minded is destruction; those who worship others go to other realms, while my devotees come to me.
vishnu_gita::580.translation_literal: अन्तवत्तु (but the end) फलं (result) तेषां (of them) तद्भवति (is) अल्पमेधसाम् (of small-intelligence persons) । अन्यअन्नयजो (others worship) यान्ति (go) मद्भक्ता (my devotees) यान्ति (go) मामपि (to me also) ॥
vishnu_gita::580.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::580.essence: Devotion to the true self leads to connection; scattered worship leads to loss.
vishnu_gita::580.simple_meaning: Those with limited understanding who worship others face destruction, but devoted followers reach the divine.
vishnu_gita::580.simple_insight: Devotion brings connection and refuge; scattered worship leads to loss.
vishnu_gita::580.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Vishnu explains that people with narrow vision who worship other beings lose their way, while those devoted to him find true refuge and connection with the supreme being.
vishnu_gita::580.modern_relevance: When your focus and loyalty are scattered, your efforts often lead nowhere, but dedicated commitment brings you closer to what truly matters.
vishnu_gita::580.insight: It shifts your focus from chasing many distractions to committing fully to one true path of devotion.

vishnu_gita::581.verse_sanskrit:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापनं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम् ॥
vishnu_gita::581.verse_hindi: अल्पबुद्धि व्यक्ति मेरे नित्य सर्वोत्तम और परमस्वरूप को न जानकर, मैं अव्यक्त अर्थात् मायातीत हूँ, तब भी मुझको व्यक्तिभाव को प्राप्त समझते हैं
vishnu_gita::581.english_translation: Those with little understanding mistake me for the manifest form, not knowing my imperishable supreme nature beyond manifestation.
vishnu_gita::581.translation_literal: अव्यक्तं (unmanifest) व्यक्तिम् (manifest) आपनं (reaching / attaining) मन्यन्ते (think) माम् (me) अबुद्धयः (the unenlightened). परं (supreme) भावम् (nature) अजानन्तो (not knowing) मम (my) अव्ययम् (imperishable) अनुत्तमम् (unsurpassed).
vishnu_gita::581.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::581.essence: The true self is beyond all visible forms and is eternally supreme.
vishnu_gita::581.simple_meaning: People with limited understanding see only the visible form and miss the deeper, unchanging supreme reality beyond it.
vishnu_gita::581.simple_insight: Feeling limited by appearances fades when you sense a greater, unchanging presence within.
vishnu_gita::581.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Vishnu explains that those who lack deep insight mistake his supreme, imperishable nature for just a visible form. They do not grasp that the highest reality transcends all appearances and is eternal and beyond change.
vishnu_gita::581.modern_relevance: You might judge yourself or others by surface traits, missing the deeper qualities that truly define a person.
vishnu_gita::581.insight: It teaches you to look beyond external appearances and recognize the unchanging essence beneath.

vishnu_gita::582.verse_sanskrit:
तस्मात् सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मरतामराः ।
मप्यर्पितमतिस्वान्ता मामसंशयमेष्यथ ॥
vishnu_gita::582.verse_hindi: इस कारण हे देवतागण ! सर्वदा मुझको स्मरण करना चाहिए, मुझमें मन और बुद्धि को अर्पण करने पर निःसन्देह आपलोग मुझको प्राप्त होगे
vishnu_gita::582.english_translation: Therefore, O radiant beings, always remember me; by dedicating your mind and discernment to me, you will surely attain me without doubt.
vishnu_gita::582.translation_literal: तस्मात् (therefore) / सर्वेषु (in all) / कालेषु (times) / माम् (me) / अनुस्मरताम् (remembering) / अमराः (radiant beings) / मय् (to me) / अर्पितम् (dedicated) / अतिस्वान्ता (with mind and intellect) / माम् (me) / संशयम् (doubt) / एष्यथ (you will attain)
vishnu_gita::582.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::582.essence: Remembering the divine fully with mind and wisdom removes doubt and ensures connection.
vishnu_gita::582.simple_meaning: You should always remember the divine and dedicate your mind and wisdom to that remembrance to truly connect and reach the true self.
vishnu_gita::582.simple_insight: There is power and certainty in remembering the divine with full attention and devotion.
vishnu_gita::582.detailed_meaning: Vishnu instructs radiant beings (devas) to remember him at all times. By offering their mind and intellect fully to him, they remove all doubts and attain him. This verse highlights the importance of devoted focus and trust in the divine presence to achieve connection.
vishnu_gita::582.modern_relevance: When your mind wanders in distraction, simply bringing your focus back to your core purpose or belief can restore calm and clarity.
vishnu_gita::582.insight: It teaches you to cultivate continuous mindful devotion as a way to overcome doubt and deepen connection.

vishnu_gita::583.verse_sanskrit:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना ।
परमं पूरुषं दिव्यं भक्तो यात्यनुचिन्तयन् ॥
vishnu_gita::583.verse_hindi: अभ्यास योग द्वारा एकाग्र और अनन्यगामी चित्त से चिन्ता करते करते साधक दिव्य परमपुरुष को प्राप्त होता है
vishnu_gita::583.english_translation: Through disciplined practice with a focused and single-minded mind, the devotee attains the divine supreme being by constant contemplation.
vishnu_gita::583.translation_literal: अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन (by disciplined practice joined) / चेतसा (with mind) / नान्यगामिना (without wandering elsewhere) / परमं (supreme) / पूरुषं (being) / दिव्यं (divine) / भक्तो (devotee) / याति (attains) / अनुचिन्तयन् (by constant contemplation)
vishnu_gita::583.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::583.essence: Steady, focused practice and mind lead the devotee to the divine supreme being.
vishnu_gita::583.simple_meaning: By practicing with a concentrated and unwavering mind, you gradually reach the divine supreme being through devoted contemplation.
vishnu_gita::583.simple_insight: A steady, focused mind opens the way to profound spiritual connection.
vishnu_gita::583.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that when a devotee practices yoga diligently with a steady, undistracted mind, constant reflection leads them to realize the supreme divine being beyond distractions.
vishnu_gita::583.modern_relevance: When you keep your attention fixed on a meaningful goal without distraction, you move steadily toward deep fulfillment.
vishnu_gita::583.insight: It teaches you to cultivate unwavering focus and disciplined practice to connect deeply with your higher purpose.

vishnu_gita::584.verse_sanskrit:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितार मणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेदयः।
सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूपमादित्यवर्ण तमसः परस्तात् ॥
vishnu_gita::584.verse_hindi: कवि (सर्वज्ञ )पुराण (अनादि ) अनुशासिता (नियन्ता) सूक्ष्म से भी सूक्ष्मतम, सबका पालन करने वाला, अचिन्त्यरूप, प्रकृति से परे स्थित, सूर्य के समान वर्ण वाले
vishnu_gita::584.english_translation: Remember the ancient supreme seer, the subtle controller, the nourisher of all, whose form is beyond thought and beyond darkness, radiant like the sun.
vishnu_gita::584.translation_literal: कविं (seer) पुराण (ancient) अनुशासितार (controller) मणोरणीयांस (most subtle) अनु स्मरेदयः (remember) । सर्वस्य (of all) धातारम् (nourisher) अचिन्त्यरूपम् (beyond thought form) आदित्यवर्ण (sun-colored) तमसः परस्तात् (beyond darkness) ॥
vishnu_gita::584.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::584.essence: A radiant, ancient presence nourishes all beyond thought and darkness.
vishnu_gita::584.simple_meaning: This verse describes the supreme seer as ancient, subtle, the nourisher of all, beyond thought and darkness, radiant like the sun.
vishnu_gita::584.simple_insight: There is a vast, radiant presence beyond what the mind can grasp or darkness can touch.
vishnu_gita::584.detailed_meaning: Suta describes the supreme seer as ancient and all-knowing, the subtle controller beyond mind's reach, who sustains everything and shines beyond darkness like the sun. This sets the stage for understanding the divine as beyond ordinary perception.
vishnu_gita::584.insight: It invites recognizing a nourishing presence beyond all limitations and mental grasp.

vishnu_gita::585.verse_sanskrit:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव ।
भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक् स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम् ॥
vishnu_gita::585.verse_hindi: पुरुष का, शरीरत्याग के समय भकियुक्त होकर स्थिर चित्र से योगबल द्वारा भ्रूयुगल के मध्य में प्राणवायु को भलीभांति स्थिर करके जो ध्यान करता है वह उस दिव्य परमात्मस्वरुप पुरुष को प्राप्त होता है
vishnu_gita::585.english_translation: At the time of leaving the body, one who with steady mind and devotion, by the power of yoga, firmly holds the life force between the eyebrows attains that supreme divine being.
vishnu_gita::585.translation_literal: प्रयाणकाले (at the time of leaving) मनसाऽचलेन (with mind unmoving) भक्त्या (with devotion) युक्तो (joined) योगबलेन (by the power of yoga) चैव (also) भ्रुवोर्मध्ये (between the eyebrows) प्राणमावेश्य (inserting the life force) सम्यक् (properly) स (he) तं (that) परं (supreme) पुरुषमुपैति (attains the being) दिव्यम् (divine)
vishnu_gita::585.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::585.essence: Steady devotion and focused life force at departure reveal the supreme divine.
vishnu_gita::585.simple_meaning: At death, focusing your calm mind with devotion and steady yoga power on the life force between your eyebrows helps you reach the supreme divine being.
vishnu_gita::585.simple_insight: There is power in steady devotion and focus to guide you beyond physical limits.
vishnu_gita::585.detailed_meaning: As the body is about to die, the practitioner calmly concentrates with devoted steadiness, using yoga to hold the vital life force (prana) between the eyebrows. This focused practice leads to union with the supreme divine being beyond the physical.
vishnu_gita::585.modern_relevance: When facing big endings or transitions, steady focus and heartfelt devotion can help you move beyond fear and uncertainty toward peace.
vishnu_gita::585.insight: It teaches you to stabilize your inner energy with devotion at critical moments to connect with your higher self.

vishnu_gita::586.verse_sanskrit:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः।
यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्य चरान्ति तद्वः पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये ॥
vishnu_gita::586.verse_hindi: ब्रह्मागण जिसको अक्षर कहते हैं, वीतराग यतिगण जिसमें प्रवेश करते हैं और जिसको जानने की इच्छा करके साधक ब्रह्मचर्य व्रत धारण करते हैं मैं आपलोगों को वह पद संक्षेप से कहता हूँ
vishnu_gita::586.english_translation: I will briefly describe the state that the learned call imperishable, the detached ascetics enter, and which seekers attain through celibacy.
vishnu_gita::586.translation_literal: यदक्षरं (that imperishable) / वेदविदो (the knowers of the Vedas) / वदन्ति (say) / विशन्ति (enter) / यद्यतयो (that which the ascetics) / वीतरागाः (detached) / यदिच्छन्तो (that which those desiring) / ब्रह्मचर्य (celibacy) / चरान्ति (observe) / तद्वः (that state) / पदं (state/position) / संग्रहेण (in summary) / प्रवक्ष्ये (I will explain)
vishnu_gita::586.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::586.essence: Detachment and disciplined celibacy lead seekers into the imperishable state of freedom.
vishnu_gita::586.simple_meaning: There is a special state beyond change that wise, detached people enter and seekers reach by practicing celibacy. This verse introduces that state briefly.
vishnu_gita::586.simple_insight: You feel encouraged knowing there is a clear, disciplined way to reach lasting freedom.
vishnu_gita::586.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses the sages, explaining a supreme state described by Vedic scholars. This state is characterized as imperishable, entered by detached ascetics, and reached by seekers who practice celibacy, setting the stage for describing renunciation.
vishnu_gita::586.modern_relevance: You’ve faced moments when giving up distractions and desires felt necessary to find lasting clarity and calm.
vishnu_gita::586.insight: It teaches that disciplined renunciation leads to an unchanging inner state beyond the restless mind.

vishnu_gita::587.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हदि निरुध्य च ।
मून्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणम् ॥
vishnu_gita::587.verse_hindi: सब इन्द्रियो को उनके विषयो से प्रत्याहरण करके मन को हृदय में  स्थिर करके और मूर्द्धा अर्थात् सहस्रार में अपने प्राण को रखकर योगधारणा में स्थिर होता हुआ और
vishnu_gita::587.english_translation: Withdrawing all the senses from their objects, fixing the mind in the heart, and placing the life force in the crown, one remains steady in yoga concentration.
vishnu_gita::587.translation_literal: सर्वद्वाराणि (all portals) / संयम्य (restraining) / मनो (mind) / हदि (in the heart) / निरुध्य (restraining) / च (and) / मून्याधायात्मनः (placing in the crown the self) / प्राणम् (life force) / आस्थितो (established) / योगधारणम् (yoga concentration)
vishnu_gita::587.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::587.essence: Steady concentration arises by withdrawing senses and centering life force within.
vishnu_gita::587.simple_meaning: You control your senses by turning them away from distractions, focus your mind inside your heart, and stabilize your life energy at the crown to hold steady in meditation.
vishnu_gita::587.simple_insight: You feel calm and steady when your attention is fully gathered inward and senses are quiet.
vishnu_gita::587.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches how to steady the yogi’s mind by withdrawing all the senses from outer objects, fixing attention deeply in the heart space, and placing the life force (prana) at the crown, enabling firm concentration on yoga.
vishnu_gita::587.modern_relevance: When your phone, noise, and thoughts pull you every way, you quiet the chaos by turning your focus inward and holding your breath steady.
vishnu_gita::587.insight: It teaches you to actively still your senses and center your vital energy to hold concentration without distraction.

vishnu_gita::588.verse_sanskrit:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन् मामनुस्मरन् ।
यः प्रयाति सजन देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥
vishnu_gita::588.verse_hindi: ॐ इस एकाक्षर ब्रह्मस्वरूप मन्त्र का  उच्चारण करता हुआ मुझको स्मरण करके स्थूल देह को त्याग करके जाता है वह परमगति रूपी मुक्तिपद को प्राप्त करता है।
vishnu_gita::588.english_translation: Whoever utters the one-syllable Om, remembering me, leaves the physical body and attains the supreme state.
vishnu_gita::588.translation_literal: ओमित्येकाक्षरं (Om—the one-syllable) / ब्रह्म (supreme reality) / व्याहरन् (uttering) / मामनुस्मरन् (remembering me) / यः (whoever) / प्रयाति (leaves) / सजन (physical body) / देहं (body) / स (he) / याति (attains) / परमां (supreme) / गतिम् (state).
vishnu_gita::588.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::588.essence: Remembering the divine with Om frees your true self beyond the physical form.
vishnu_gita::588.simple_meaning: Saying the sacred syllable Om while remembering the divine leads your true self beyond the physical body to the highest freedom.
vishnu_gita::588.simple_insight: You can reach the supreme state simply by heartfelt remembrance and the sacred sound Om.
vishnu_gita::588.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that uttering the sacred one-syllable Om while consciously remembering him allows the true self to leave the physical body and attain the highest state of freedom beyond worldly existence.
vishnu_gita::588.modern_relevance: When life feels overwhelming, quietly recalling a sacred sound and your connection to the divine can help you feel grounded and move beyond stress.
vishnu_gita::588.insight: It teaches you to use remembrance and the sacred syllable Om as a simple, powerful practice to transcend physical limits.

vishnu_gita::589.verse_sanskrit:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरात नित्यशः।
तस्याहं सुलभो देवाः ! निसयुक्तस्य योगिनः ॥
vishnu_gita::589.verse_hindi: अनन्य चित्त होकर जो मेरा सब समय नियमित रूप से चिन्तन करता है, हे देवतागण ! नित्ययुक्त उस योगी के लिये मैं सुलभ हूँ
vishnu_gita::589.english_translation: I am easily reached by the yogi who constantly remembers me with focused mind alone.
vishnu_gita::589.translation_literal: अनन्यचेताः (with undivided mind) / सततं (constantly) / यो (who) / मां (me) / स्मरात (remembers) / नित्यशः (always) / तस्याहं (to him I) / सुलभो (easily accessible) / देवाः (O devas) / निसयुक्तस्य (to one united) / योगिनः (yogi)
vishnu_gita::589.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::589.essence: Focused, constant remembrance opens a direct path to the divine presence.
vishnu_gita::589.simple_meaning: If you constantly remember the divine with full focus and no distractions, the divine becomes easily accessible to you.
vishnu_gita::589.simple_insight: You can feel the divine close simply by keeping your attention steady and undivided.
vishnu_gita::589.detailed_meaning: Vishnu tells that a yogi who always remembers him with a focused, undistracted mind becomes easily connected to him. This teaching encourages devoted love through constant remembrance as a path to closeness with the divine.
vishnu_gita::589.modern_relevance: You find peace when you return your full attention to what truly matters, cutting through daily distractions.
vishnu_gita::589.insight: It teaches you to cultivate constant, focused remembrance, making connection effortless.

vishnu_gita::590.verse_sanskrit:
मामुपेय पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् ।
नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः॥
vishnu_gita::590.verse_hindi: महात्मागण मुझको प्राप्त करके पुनः त्रिताप के आलयरूप अनित्य जन्म को प्राप्त नहीं होते क्योंकि वह परासिद्धि रूपी मोक्ष को प्राप्त हुए हैं
vishnu_gita::590.english_translation: Great beings who have attained me do not take rebirth in the transient world of suffering; they have reached supreme perfection.
vishnu_gita::590.translation_literal: मामुपेय (attain me) पुनर्जन्म (rebirth) दुःखालयम् (world of suffering) अशाश्वतम् (transient) । न (not) आप्नुवन्ति (attain) महात्मानः (great beings) संसिद्धिम् (supreme perfection) परम् (highest) गताः (gone).
vishnu_gita::590.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::590.essence: Those who reach the divine no longer return to suffering and rebirth.
vishnu_gita::590.simple_meaning: Those who have reached the divine do not return to the endless cycle of painful rebirth; they have attained ultimate freedom.
vishnu_gita::590.simple_insight: Knowing you can be free from endless suffering brings deep relief and hope.
vishnu_gita::590.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes how great beings who have realized the divine do not return to the transient world of suffering. Having reached supreme perfection, they transcend the cycle of rebirth and pain forever.
vishnu_gita::590.modern_relevance: When you feel trapped by repeated failures or hardships, remember freedom from these cycles is possible by realizing your true nature.
vishnu_gita::590.insight: This verse shifts focus from fearing repeated hardship to seeking lasting freedom through inner realization.

vishnu_gita::591.verse_sanskrit:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽमराः।
मामुपेत्य तु गीर्वाणाः ! पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ॥
vishnu_gita::591.verse_hindi: हे अमरगण ! ब्रह्मलोक से भी आकर सब लोग पुनः पुनः जन्म ग्रहण करते हैं परन्तु हे देवतागण ! मुझको प्राप्त करके पुनर्जन्म की प्राप्ति नहीं होती है
vishnu_gita::591.english_translation: All beings of the higher realms return again and again to birth; but those who reach me do not take birth again.
vishnu_gita::591.translation_literal: आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः (from Brahma's world) / पुनरावर्तिनः (returning repeatedly) / अमराः (immortals) / मामुपेत्य (having attained me) / तु (but) / गीर्वाणाः (O divine beings) / पुनर्जन्म (rebirth) / न (not) / विद्यते (exists)
vishnu_gita::591.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::591.essence: Reaching the divine ends the endless cycle of rebirth.
vishnu_gita::591.simple_meaning: Even beings from the highest realms are born again, but those who reach the divine avoid rebirth forever.
vishnu_gita::591.simple_insight: There is hope beyond endless cycles—reaching the divine means freedom from repeated birth.
vishnu_gita::591.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses immortal beings who cycle through many realms, explaining that even they return to birth. However, those who reach Vishnu transcend this cycle and are freed from rebirth, highlighting ultimate liberation.
vishnu_gita::591.modern_relevance: When you feel trapped in repeated struggles or patterns, this shows reaching a deeper center can free you from repeating old cycles.
vishnu_gita::591.insight: It shifts the mind from fearing endless repetition toward seeking a state beyond cycles through connection with the divine.

vishnu_gita::592.verse_sanskrit:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढाः सगुणां तनुमाश्रितम् ।
परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् ॥
vishnu_gita::592.verse_hindi: मूर्ख व्यक्तिगण सर्वभूतों के महेश्वररूपी मेरे परमभाव को न जानकर मुझको सगुण देहधारी देखकर
vishnu_gita::592.english_translation: Fools mistake me, the great lord of all beings, for merely a being with qualities, not knowing my supreme reality.
vishnu_gita::592.translation_literal: अवजानन्ति (do not know) / मां (me) / मूढाः (fools) / सगुणां (with qualities) / तनुमाश्रितम् (body assumed) / परं (supreme) / भावमजानन्तो (not knowing the nature) / मम (my) / भूतमहेश्वरम् (great lord of beings)
vishnu_gita::592.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::592.essence: Your true nature is beyond the qualities and form others see.
vishnu_gita::592.simple_meaning: People who see only the body with qualities do not understand the supreme and true nature behind it.
vishnu_gita::592.simple_insight: There is peace in knowing you are more than the surface others see.
vishnu_gita::592.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that many fail to recognize his supreme reality and see only his form with qualities. This verse stresses the difference between the outer appearance and the deeper truth of divine essence.
vishnu_gita::592.modern_relevance: When others judge you by your role or appearance, remember your deeper true self remains untouched and vast.
vishnu_gita::592.insight: It shifts your view from identifying with your external traits to recognizing your eternal true nature.

vishnu_gita::593.verse_sanskrit:
मोघाश मोघकर्मणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतस: ।
राक्षसीमासुरीश्चैव प्रकृति मोहिनीं श्रिताः ॥
vishnu_gita::593.verse_hindi: बुद्धिभ्रंशकारी आसुरी और राक्षसी प्रकृति को धारण करने वाले, विफलाशाकारी, विफल कर्मा, अध्यात्मज्ञानरहित, विषय से चंचल चित्त मूर्ख मुझको सगुण देहधारी देखकर मेरी अवज्ञा करते हैं
vishnu_gita::593.english_translation: Those who are deluded, engaged in fruitless actions and knowledge, and who embody a demonic and cruel nature, become captivated by the illusion of the manifested divine form and disrespect me.
vishnu_gita::593.translation_literal: मोघाश (fruitless) / मोघकर्मणो (in actions that are fruitless) / मोघज्ञाना (fruitless knowledge) / विचेतसः (mindless) / राक्षसीम् (demonic) / आसुरीश्चैव (and cruel nature) / प्रकृति (nature) / मोहिनीं (bewitching) / श्रिताः (dependent)
vishnu_gita::593.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::593.essence: Empty knowledge and actions born of confusion cause disrespect and blindness to the divine reality.
vishnu_gita::593.simple_meaning: People who act without true understanding, who pursue useless knowledge and actions, and who have a harsh, confused nature, become trapped by illusions and disrespect the divine form.
vishnu_gita::593.simple_insight: There's a trap in confusing mere action and knowledge for true understanding of the divine.
vishnu_gita::593.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes those who, lacking true spiritual insight, perform empty actions and hold misguided knowledge. Their harsh, cruel nature blinds them, causing disrespect toward the divine manifested form, showing the dangers of illusion and confusion.
vishnu_gita::593.modern_relevance: You may work hard or seek knowledge but still feel lost, disrespected, or disconnected when your efforts lack true clarity or purpose.
vishnu_gita::593.insight: This verse teaches you to discern the difference between meaningful wisdom and empty knowledge, freeing your mind from illusions.

vishnu_gita::594.verse_sanskrit:
महात्मानस्तु मां देवा:! दैवीं प्रकृतिमिश्रता: ।
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम् ॥
vishnu_gita::594.verse_hindi: परन्तु हे देवतागण ! दैवीप्रकृतियुक्त महात्मागण अनन्यचित्त होकर मुझको जगत कारण और नित्य स्वरूप जानकार मेरी उपासना किया करते हैं
vishnu_gita::594.english_translation: But the great souls among the radiant beings, united with the divine nature, worship me with single-hearted devotion, knowing me as the cause of the world and the eternal reality.
vishnu_gita::594.translation_literal: महात्मानः (great souls) तु (indeed) मां (me) देवा: (the radiant beings) दैवीं (divine) प्रकृति (nature) मिश्रता: (united) भजन्ति (worship) अनन्यमनसः (single-hearted) ज्ञात्वा (knowing) भूत (beings) आदिम् (cause) अव्ययम् (eternal)
vishnu_gita::594.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::594.essence: Devoted love arises from knowing the eternal source behind all that exists.
vishnu_gita::594.simple_meaning: Great souls connected to the divine nature worship the source of all things with devoted single-heartedness.
vishnu_gita::594.simple_insight: Devotion arises naturally when you recognize the eternal cause within and beyond yourself.
vishnu_gita::594.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses the radiant beings, explaining that those with divine nature who understand him as the eternal cause of the universe worship him with focused devotion. This highlights the path of devoted love grounded in deep knowledge.
vishnu_gita::594.modern_relevance: When you recognize the deeper cause behind your life’s challenges and successes, your heart naturally opens to sincere devotion and trust.
vishnu_gita::594.insight: It teaches you to unify your heart around the inner source, turning knowledge into devoted action.

vishnu_gita::595.verse_sanskrit:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः।
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भत्तया नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ॥
vishnu_gita::595.verse_hindi: उनमें से कोई कोई सर्वदा मेरा कीर्तन करते हैं, कोई कोई दृढ़निमय से युक्त होकर प्रयत्नशील होते हैं, कोई कोई भक्ति के साथ प्रणाम करते हैं और कोई कोई नित्य युक्त होकर मेरी उपासना करते हैं।
vishnu_gita::595.english_translation: Some constantly sing my praise, some firmly strive with vows, some bow with devoted love, and some always worship me with dedication.
vishnu_gita::595.translation_literal: सततं (constantly) कीर्तयन्तो (singing praise) मां (me) यतन्तश्च (and striving) दृढव्रताः (with firm vows) । नमस्यन्तश्च (and bowing) मां (me) भत्तया (with devoted love) नित्ययुक्ता (always united) उपासते (worship) ॥
vishnu_gita::595.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::595.essence: Devotion to the divine flows through many sincere, personal expressions.
vishnu_gita::595.simple_meaning: Different people express their devotion in various ways—some sing praises, some make firm vows and strive, some bow with love, and others worship continuously with dedication.
vishnu_gita::595.simple_insight: There’s no single way to connect with the divine; your devotion is valid as it is.
vishnu_gita::595.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that devotees express their connection in diverse ways—through constant singing, committed effort, respectful bowing, or steady worship. This shows devotion is personal and multifaceted, not confined to one practice or form.
vishnu_gita::595.modern_relevance: You might see friends honoring their beliefs through music, disciplined practice, respectful rituals, or quiet daily dedication—each path is genuine and meaningful.
vishnu_gita::595.insight: It teaches you to honor your own authentic way of devotion without comparing or doubting your practice.

vishnu_gita::596.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते।
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् ॥
vishnu_gita::596.verse_hindi: अन्य कोई कोई ज्ञानयज्ञ द्वारा भी पूजा करके मेरी उपासना करते हैं, उनमेंसे कोई कोई अभेदभाव से, कोई कोई दासभाव से और कोई कोई मुझे सनात्मक जानकर नाना प्रकार से पासना करते हैं
vishnu_gita::596.english_translation: Others worship me through the sacrifice of knowledge; some with unity, some with separation, and some in many ways, all facing different directions.
vishnu_gita::596.translation_literal: ज्ञानयज्ञेन (by the sacrifice of knowledge) / च (also) / अपि (indeed) / अन्ये (others) / यजन्तः (worship) / माम् (me) / उपासते (serve) / एकत्वेन (with unity) / पृथक्त्वेन (with separation) / बहुधा (in many ways) / विश्वतः (from all directions) / मुखम् (facing)
vishnu_gita::596.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::596.essence: Devotion to the divine can take many valid forms, unified or diverse.
vishnu_gita::596.simple_meaning: People worship the divine through knowledge in many ways: with unity, separation, or diverse approaches from all around.
vishnu_gita::596.simple_insight: Your way of devotion is valid, whether focused or varied, close or broad.
vishnu_gita::596.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that devotees approach him through the sacrifice of knowledge, but their ways differ: some see oneness, some see difference, and many worship in varied directions, highlighting diversity in devotion.
vishnu_gita::596.modern_relevance: You might see people praying or meditating differently—some quietly focused, some broadly inclusive—but all their sincere efforts connect to the divine.
vishnu_gita::596.insight: Accept that devotion can express itself in diverse ways without losing its sincerity or connection.

vishnu_gita::597.verse_sanskrit:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेम वहाम्यहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::597.verse_hindi: अन्य देवताओं की उपासना करके मुझे ही स्मरण करते हुए जो उपासना करते हैं, उन नित्य मत्परायण आवश् विषयों  को मैं वहन करता हूँ
vishnu_gita::597.english_translation: Those who always think of me alone and worship me with exclusive devotion, I protect the yoga practice and well-being of such steadfast beings.
vishnu_gita::597.translation_literal: अनन्याश्च (exclusively) / चिन्तयन्तः (thinking) / मां (of me) / ये (those who) / जनाः (people) / पर्युपासते (worship) / तेषां (of them) / नित्याभियुक्तानां (always devoted) / योगक्षेम (yoga and welfare) / वहामि (I bear/protect) / अहम् (I)
vishnu_gita::597.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::597.essence: Exclusive devotion invites the divine’s care and protection for your spiritual wellbeing.
vishnu_gita::597.simple_meaning: If you worship the divine alone with constant devotion, the divine supports and protects your spiritual practice and wellbeing.
vishnu_gita::597.simple_insight: You feel safe knowing your steady devotion invites care and sustenance from the divine.
vishnu_gita::597.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses those who worship him exclusively, promising to safeguard their spiritual discipline and welfare. The moment honors unwavering devotion amid worldly distractions, showing the divine’s role as protector of sincere seekers.
vishnu_gita::597.modern_relevance: When you commit to a practice or belief fully, without distraction, you gain support and strength to continue, no matter the challenges.
vishnu_gita::597.insight: It teaches you to commit your attention completely, trusting that this focus brings protection and sustains your path.

vishnu_gita::598.verse_sanskrit:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति ।
तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥
vishnu_gita::598.verse_hindi: जो मुझको भक्तिपूर्वक पत्र पुष्प फल और जल अर्पण करता है मैं उस संयतात्मा द्वारा भक्ति पूर्वक अर्पित वे पत्र पुष्पादि ग्रहण करता हूँ
vishnu_gita::598.english_translation: Whoever offers me leaves, flowers, fruit, and water with devoted love, I accept those offerings made with devotion by the self-controlled.
vishnu_gita::598.translation_literal: पत्रं (leaf) पुष्पं (flower) फलं (fruit) तोयं (water) यो (who) मे (to me) भक्त्या (with devotion) प्रयच्छति (offers) । तदहं (that I) भक्त्युपहृतम् (offered with devotion) अश्नामि (accept) प्रयतात्मनः (by the self-controlled) ॥
vishnu_gita::598.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::598.essence: Devotion and self-control make every offering accepted by the divine.
vishnu_gita::598.simple_meaning: The divine accepts any simple offering given with devotion and self-control.
vishnu_gita::598.simple_insight: Your sincere devotion makes even small gifts sacred and accepted.
vishnu_gita::598.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that devotion matters more than the value of what is offered. Even simple things like leaves or water are accepted when offered with love by a disciplined person.
vishnu_gita::598.modern_relevance: You might think your small acts of kindness or care go unnoticed, but sincere devotion makes them meaningful and received fully.
vishnu_gita::598.insight: It shifts your focus from the size of the gift to the sincerity behind it.

vishnu_gita::599.verse_sanskrit:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः ।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या माये ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::599.verse_hindi: मैं सकल भूतों में समानरूप से अवस्थित हूँ अतः मेरा प्रिय और द्वेष्य कोई नहीं है किन्तु जो मेरी भक्तिपूर्वक उपासना करते हैं वह मुझमें स्थित हैं और मैं भी उनमें स्थित हूँ
