vishnu_gita::599.english_translation: I am equally present in all beings; I have no favorite or enemy. Those who worship me with devotion are in me, and I am in them.
vishnu_gita::599.translation_literal: समोऽहं (equal am I) / सर्वभूतेषु (in all beings) / न (not) / मे (my) / द्वेष्योऽस्ति (enemy is) / न (not) / प्रियः (beloved) / ये (those who) / भजन्ति (worship) / तु (indeed) / मां (me) / भक्त्या (with devotion) / माये (by me) / ते (they) / तेषु (in them) / च (also) / अपि (indeed) / अहम् (I).
vishnu_gita::599.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::599.essence: The divine is equally present in all beings and intimately present with devoted ones.
vishnu_gita::599.simple_meaning: The divine is equally present in every being without preference or dislike. When you worship with devotion, you and the divine dwell within each other.
vishnu_gita::599.simple_insight: You can feel connected and accepted by the divine no matter who you are.
vishnu_gita::599.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that he is present impartially in all beings, without favor or hatred. Those devoted to him enter a mutual presence where he dwells in them and they dwell in him, highlighting a reciprocal bond of devotion.
vishnu_gita::599.modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or judged, remember that the divine sees all equally and is accessible through sincere devotion, creating a shared presence beyond differences.
vishnu_gita::599.insight: It invites you to see devotion as a relationship where you and the divine truly coexist, dissolving separation.

vishnu_gita::600.verse_sanskrit:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक् ।
साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यगव्यवसितो हि सः॥
vishnu_gita::600.verse_hindi: यदि अत्यन्त दुराचारी व्यक्ति भी अनन्य-भक्तियुक्त होकर मेरी उपासना करे तो उसको भी साधु ही मानना चाहिये क्योंकि वह उत्तम यत्न कर रहा है
vishnu_gita::600.english_translation: Even a very wrongdoer who worships me with exclusive devotion should be considered a good person because they are truly focused.
vishnu_gita::600.translation_literal: अपि (even) चेत् (if) सुदुराचारो (very wrongdoer) भजते (worships) माम् (me) अनन्यभाक् (with exclusive devotion) । साधुरेव (only good person) स (he) मन्तव्यः (should be considered) सम्यग् (truly) व्यवसितः (focused) हि (indeed) सः (he) ॥
vishnu_gita::600.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::600.essence: Pure devotion transforms even the worst past into goodness.
vishnu_gita::600.simple_meaning: If someone with a bad past sincerely worships with exclusive devotion, they should be seen as good because their focus is true.
vishnu_gita::600.simple_insight: You are accepted for your sincere devotion, not your past mistakes.
vishnu_gita::600.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that even a person who has done many wrongs can be considered good if they worship with pure, exclusive devotion. This moment highlights the power of heartfelt focus over past faults.
vishnu_gita::600.modern_relevance: You might judge yourself harshly for past mistakes, but wholehearted sincerity in what you truly care for changes everything.
vishnu_gita::600.insight: It shifts your view from judging by past actions to valuing the sincerity of your current devotion.

vishnu_gita::601.verse_sanskrit:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति ।
हे देवाः ! खलु जानीत न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥
vishnu_gita::601.verse_hindi: अत्यन्त दुराचारी व्यक्ति भी मेरी उपसना करने पर शीघ्र धर्मात्मा हो जाता है और निरंतर शांति को प्राप्त  करता है हे देवगण ! मेरा भक्त नाशको नहीं प्राप्त होता है, यह तुम निश्चय जानो
vishnu_gita::601.english_translation: Even a deeply unrighteous person quickly becomes righteous and attains steady peace by worshipping me; know for certain, my devotee never perishes.
vishnu_gita::601.translation_literal: क्षिप्रं (quickly) भवति (becomes) धर्मात्मा (righteous) शश्वच्छान्तिं (constant peace) निगच्छति (attains) । हे (O) देवाः (divine beings) ! खलु (indeed) जानीत (know) न (not) मे (my) भक्तः (devotee) प्रणश्यति (perishes) ॥
vishnu_gita::601.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::601.essence: Sincere devotion transforms even the most unrighteous into steady peace and righteousness.
vishnu_gita::601.simple_meaning: Anyone, no matter how unrighteous, can become good and find lasting peace by worshipping the divine. A true devotee never loses their way.
vishnu_gita::601.simple_insight: There is hope and transformation even in the darkest moments through sincere devotion.
vishnu_gita::601.detailed_meaning: Vishnu assures that even deeply flawed people who turn to him with devotion quickly become righteous and find lasting peace. This promise is made to the divine beings, emphasizing the power of devotion to transform any inner state.
vishnu_gita::601.modern_relevance: When you feel lost in mistakes or bad choices, know that sincere devotion can quickly bring you back to steadiness and peace.
vishnu_gita::601.insight: It teaches you to trust that sincere devotion can swiftly change your inner state, no matter your past.

vishnu_gita::602.verse_sanskrit:
मां हि देवाः ! व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः ।
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥
vishnu_gita::602.verse_hindi: क्योंकि हे देवगण ! पापयोनि सम्भूत स्त्रियां वैश्य और शूद्र चाहे कोई भी हो मेरा आश्रय लेकर परम गति को प्राप्त होते हैं
vishnu_gita::602.english_translation: Because, O radiant beings, even those born in sinful families — women, merchants, and laborers — attain the highest state by taking refuge in me.
vishnu_gita::602.translation_literal: मां (me) हि (indeed) देवाः (O radiant beings) ! व्यपाश्रित्य (taking refuge) येऽपि (even those who) स्युः (are) पापयोनयः (born in sinful families) । स्त्रियो (women) वैश्यास्तथा (merchants also) शूद्रास्तेऽपि (and laborers too) यान्ति (attain) परां (highest) गतिम् (state) ॥
vishnu_gita::602.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::602.essence: Sincere refuge in the divine allows anyone to reach the highest spiritual state.
vishnu_gita::602.simple_meaning: Anyone, regardless of birth or social status, who takes refuge in the divine attains the highest spiritual state.
vishnu_gita::602.simple_insight: There is inclusion and hope for everyone who sincerely turns to the divine.
vishnu_gita::602.detailed_meaning: Vishnu speaks to radiant beings, explaining that no matter one's social class or origin—even women, merchants, or laborers considered born in sinful families—taking refuge in the divine leads to the highest spiritual attainment.
vishnu_gita::602.modern_relevance: You might feel limited by your background or status, but true transformation is available to anyone who sincerely seeks support beyond themselves.
vishnu_gita::602.insight: It shifts the mind from exclusion based on identity to inclusion based on sincere devotion.

vishnu_gita::603.verse_sanskrit:
किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा ।
अनित्यमसुखं लोकं भजध्वामिममेत्य माम् ॥
vishnu_gita::603.verse_hindi: सुकृतिशाली ब्राह्मण और भक्तिमान् राजर्षिगण की तो बात ही क्या है अतः तुम इस कष्टप्रद और अनित्य लोक को प्राप्त होकर मेरी उपासना करो
vishnu_gita::603.english_translation: What need is there to speak of virtuous Brahmins and devoted royal sages? Therefore, come to this painful and temporary world and worship me.
vishnu_gita::603.translation_literal: किं (what) पुनः (again) ब्राह्मणाः (Brahmins) पुण्या (virtuous) भक्ता (devoted) राजर्षयः (royal sages) तथा (also) । अनित्यम् (temporary) असुखं (painful) लोकं (world) भजध्वाम् (worship) इमम् (this) एत्म (me) माम् (me) ॥
vishnu_gita::603.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::603.essence: You don't need to be perfect to worship the divine in this temporary world.
vishnu_gita::603.simple_meaning: You don't have to be a perfect Brahmin or sage to worship the divine; come as you are to this temporary and difficult world and offer your devotion.
vishnu_gita::603.simple_insight: You can approach the divine without needing to be perfect or accomplished first.
vishnu_gita::603.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses the listener, saying that even the most virtuous Brahmins and devoted royal sages are not the point; instead, anyone can come to this transient, difficult world and worship the divine directly.
vishnu_gita::603.modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by not being 'spiritual enough' or perfect but still want to connect with something greater; this invites you to begin now without waiting.
vishnu_gita::603.insight: It removes the barrier of needing achievement before devotion, encouraging immediate heartfelt connection.

vishnu_gita::604.verse_sanskrit:
मन्मनस्काः स्त मे भक्ता याजिनो नमताऽमराः!।
मामेवैष्यथ युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणाः ॥
vishnu_gita::604.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! आपलोग मद्गतचित्त, मेरे भक्त और मेरे उपासक होकर और मुझे नमस्कार करो, इस प्रकार मत्परायण होकर मन को मुझ में ही युक्त करने से मुझको ही प्राप्त होगे
vishnu_gita::604.english_translation: O radiant beings! Devote yourselves to me with focused minds, bow in reverence, and you will surely reach me by dedicating your hearts to me alone.
vishnu_gita::604.translation_literal: मन्मनस्काः (minds-focused) / स्त (are) / मे (to me) / भक्ता (devotees) / याजिनः (worshippers) / नमताऽमराः (bowing immortals)! / मामेवैष्यथ (to me alone come) / युक्त्वैवम् (uniting thus) / आत्मानं (the self) / मत्परायणाः (dedicated to me).
vishnu_gita::604.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::604.essence: Complete devotion focused inward leads directly to union with the divine.
vishnu_gita::604.simple_meaning: You become devoted and connected to the divine by focusing your mind and heart fully on it.
vishnu_gita::604.simple_insight: There is power in focusing your whole heart on what you truly seek.
vishnu_gita::604.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses the radiant beings, urging them to become devoted worshippers by focusing their minds and hearts exclusively on him. This dedication is the surest way to reach the divine presence.
vishnu_gita::604.modern_relevance: When your attention and care are fully committed to what matters most, you find deeper connection and fulfillment.
vishnu_gita::604.insight: It teaches you to center your mind and heart fully on your chosen devotion, making that focus your true path.

vishnu_gita::605.verse_sanskrit:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् ।
कथयन्तश्च मां निसं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥
vishnu_gita::605.verse_hindi: जिनका चित्त केवल मुझ में ही रत है और जिनका प्राण केवल मेरे में ही अर्पित है, ऐसे व्यक्ति परस्पर मेरे स्वरूप का ज्ञान कराते हुए एवं सदा मेरा कीर्तन करते हुए सन्तोष और शान्ति को प्राप्त होते हैं
vishnu_gita::605.english_translation: Those whose mind is fixed on me and whose life force is dedicated to me, they teach each other about my nature, sing my praise, and find lasting joy and peace.
vishnu_gita::605.translation_literal: मच्चित्ता (mind on me) मद्गतप्राणा (life-force dedicated to me) बोधयन्तः (teaching) परस्परम् (to each other) कथयन्तश्च (speaking) मां (me) निसं (unceasingly) तुष्यन्ति (are satisfied) च (and) रमन्ति (rejoice) च (also)
vishnu_gita::605.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::605.essence: Shared devotion creates joyful connection and lasting peace among those devoted.
vishnu_gita::605.simple_meaning: People who keep their mind and life dedicated to the divine teach and remind each other of that connection, creating happiness and peace together.
vishnu_gita::605.simple_insight: There's warmth and fulfillment in sharing devotion with others who feel the same.
vishnu_gita::605.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes a group whose minds and life energies are devoted to him. They share knowledge about his true nature, sing his praises together, and through this mutual devotion, they experience deep contentment and joy.
vishnu_gita::605.modern_relevance: You connect deeply with friends who share your passion and values, lifting each other up in shared purpose and joy.
vishnu_gita::605.insight: It teaches you to nurture your spiritual focus by engaging in loving, joyful community with others.

vishnu_gita::606.verse_sanskrit:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ।
ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ॥
vishnu_gita::606.verse_hindi: सदा मुझ में अर्पित चित्त एवं प्रीतिपूर्वक मेरी उपासना करने वाले उन भक्तो को मैं उस बुद्धियोग ज्ञान को प्रदान करता हूँ जिससे वह मुझ को प्राप्त हो जाते हैं।
vishnu_gita::606.english_translation: I give the wisdom of discriminating yoga to those who always worship me with devoted love, by which they come to me.
vishnu_gita::606.translation_literal: तेषां (of those) सततयुक्तानां (always united/attached) भजतां (worshiping) प्रीतिपूर्वकम् (with love/devotedly) । ददामि (I give) बुद्धियोगं (discriminating yoga) तं (that) येन (by which) माम् (me) उपयान्ति (reach) ते (they) ॥
vishnu_gita::606.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::606.essence: Devoted love grants the wisdom that leads directly to the divine.
vishnu_gita::606.simple_meaning: If you continuously worship with genuine love, you receive the wisdom that guides you to the divine.
vishnu_gita::606.simple_insight: Love opens the door to wisdom that connects you deeply with the divine.
vishnu_gita::606.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that those who maintain constant, loving worship receive a special wisdom—discerning yoga—that helps them reach the divine presence he embodies.
vishnu_gita::606.modern_relevance: When you dedicate yourself with sincere care and love, you naturally gain the insight that guides you through confusion.
vishnu_gita::606.insight: It teaches you that devoted love is the key that unlocks deeper understanding and connection.

vishnu_gita::607.verse_hindi: उनके हित के अर्थ ही मैं उनकी बुद्धिवृत्ति में अवस्थित होकर प्रकाशमान तत्त्वज्ञानरूप दीप द्वारा उनके अज्ञान रुपी अन्धकार का नाश करता हूँ
vishnu_gita::607.english_translation: For their benefit, I, abiding in their intellect, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the bright lamp of true knowledge.
vishnu_gita::607.translation_literal: तेषाम् (their) एव (indeed) अनुकम्पा-अर्थम् (for compassion's purpose) अहम् (I) अज्ञान-जम् (born of ignorance) तमः (darkness) नाशयामि (destroy) आत्म-भावस्थः (abiding in the self-state) ज्ञान-दीपेन (with lamp of knowledge) भास्वता (shining).
vishnu_gita::607.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::607.essence: True knowledge inside you destroys the darkness born of ignorance.
vishnu_gita::607.simple_meaning: The divine dwells in your mind, shining the light of true knowledge to remove your ignorance and confusion.
vishnu_gita::607.simple_insight: You can feel supported by a light inside that clears your doubts and darkness.
vishnu_gita::607.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that for the sake of those who seek, he dwells within their intellect, illuminating it with clear knowledge to dispel the darkness of ignorance that clouds their understanding.
vishnu_gita::607.modern_relevance: When confusion clouds your decisions, imagine a steady light within your mind clearing away doubt and fear.
vishnu_gita::607.insight: It teaches you to trust the inner clarity that can dissolve confusion from within your own awareness.

vishnu_gita::608.verse_sanskrit:
मय्यावश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ।
श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः ॥
vishnu_gita::608.verse_hindi: मुझमें मन को एकाग्र करके, सर्वदा मुझमें  युक्त रहकर एवं परम श्रद्धान्वित होकर जो मेरी उपासना करते हैं वे मेरी सम्मति में युक्ततम अर्थात् प्रधान योगी हैं
vishnu_gita::608.english_translation: Those who always fix their mind on me, remain devoted, and worship me with supreme trust are considered my highest yogis.
vishnu_gita::608.translation_literal: मयि (in me) आवश्य (fixed) मनः (mind) ये (those who) मां (me) नित्ययुक्ताः (always united) उपासते (worship) । श्रद्धया (with trust) परयः (supreme) उपेताः (endowed) ते (they) मे (my) युक्ततमा (highest united) मताः (considered) ॥
vishnu_gita::608.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::608.essence: Deep, constant focus combined with supreme trust makes you the highest devotee.
vishnu_gita::608.simple_meaning: If you keep your mind focused on the divine, stay devoted, and trust deeply, you become the highest kind of devotee.
vishnu_gita::608.simple_insight: Feeling connected through steady focus and deep trust brings you into the closest relationship with the divine.
vishnu_gita::608.detailed_meaning: Vishnu speaks to those who dedicate their minds fully to him, emphasizing constant devotion combined with supreme trust. This teaching highlights the ideal devotee as one whose mind never wanders and whose faith is unwavering.
vishnu_gita::608.modern_relevance: When your thoughts stay calm and focused on what truly matters, and you trust the process deeply, you find your strongest inner alignment.
vishnu_gita::608.insight: It teaches you to cultivate continuous mental focus and heartfelt trust to deepen your devotion.

vishnu_gita::609.verse_sanskrit:
ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते ।
सर्वत्रगमाचन्त्यञ्च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम् ॥
vishnu_gita::609.verse_hindi: जो व्यक्ति अनिर्वचनीय, रूपादिविहीन, सर्वव्यापी, अचिन्त्य, स्थिर,नित्य, अविनाशी कूटस्थ की उपासना करते हैं
vishnu_gita::609.english_translation: Those who meditate on the imperishable, indefinable, formless, all-pervading, unthinkable, unmoving, eternal, and unchanging reality.
vishnu_gita::609.translation_literal: ये (those who) त्वक्षरम् (imperishable) अनिर्देश्यम् (indefinable) अव्यक्तम् (formless) पर्युपासते (meditate) । सर्वत्रगम (all-pervading) अचन्त्यञ्च (unthinkable) कूटस्थम् (unmoving) अचलम् (immovable) ध्रुवम् (unchanging) ॥
vishnu_gita::609.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::609.essence: True meditation is on the timeless, formless reality beyond all appearances.
vishnu_gita::609.simple_meaning: You can meditate on the true reality that is formless, eternal, and unchanging beyond all description.
vishnu_gita::609.simple_insight: There is peace in focusing on what never changes beyond fleeting appearances.
vishnu_gita::609.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes the nature of the ultimate reality as beyond all forms and concepts. Meditating on this unchanging and all-pervading essence leads to clarity beyond the restless mind's grasp.
vishnu_gita::609.modern_relevance: When your thoughts overwhelm you, turning attention to something steady and unchanging calms your mind and restores balance.
vishnu_gita::609.insight: It shifts your mind from chasing fleeting forms to resting in the steady reality beneath all change.

vishnu_gita::610.verse_sanskrit:
सनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः ।
ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥
vishnu_gita::610.verse_hindi: किन्तु सर्वत्र समबुद्धियुक्त इन्द्रियों को अच्छी तरह से संयत करके सकलभूतों के हितकारी वह व्यक्ति मुझे ही प्राप्त होते हैं।
vishnu_gita::610.english_translation: But those who control all their senses everywhere, with equal intellect, devoted to the welfare of all beings, attain only me.
vishnu_gita::610.translation_literal: सनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं (controlling the senses) / सर्वत्र (everywhere) / समबुद्धयः (with equal intellect) / ते (they) / प्राप्नुवन्ति (attain) / मामेव (only me) / सर्वभूतहिते (for the welfare of all beings) / रताः (devoted)
vishnu_gita::610.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::610.essence: Balanced self-control combined with care for all leads directly to the divine.
vishnu_gita::610.simple_meaning: By mastering all your senses with steady intellect and focusing on the good of everyone, you connect with the divine.
vishnu_gita::610.simple_insight: You feel empowered knowing self-control and care bring you closer to what truly matters.
vishnu_gita::610.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that those who keep their senses disciplined and balanced everywhere, guided by clear intellect and devoted to the welfare of all beings, truly reach the divine presence. This moment shows how self-restraint combined with compassion leads to spiritual attainment.
vishnu_gita::610.modern_relevance: You face distractions pulling you every way, but when you hold steady and care beyond yourself, you feel grounded and connected.
vishnu_gita::610.insight: It shifts focus from indulging the senses to balancing them with intellect and universal care, transforming action into devotion.

vishnu_gita::611.verse_hindi: अव्यक्त में जिनका चित्त आसक्त हुआ है उनको अधिक परिश्रम करना पड़ता है क्योंकि मेरे अव्यक्तरूप में निष्ठा प्राणियों को कठिनता से प्राप्त
vishnu_gita::611.english_translation: Those whose minds are attached to the unmanifested face many troubles, but the unmanifested state is the difficult-to-reach refuge for the life-bearers.
vishnu_gita::611.translation_literal: क्लेशः (trouble) अधिकतरः (more) तेषाम् (of them) अव्यक्ता (unmanifested) असक्तचेतसाम् (whose minds are attached) । अव्यक्ता (unmanifested) हि (indeed) गति: (refuge) दुःखं (pain) प्राणभृद्भि: (by life-beings) अवाप्यते (is obtained with difficulty) ॥
vishnu_gita::611.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::611.essence: Clinging to the unseen increases struggle because reaching that hidden state is difficult.
vishnu_gita::611.simple_meaning: When your mind clings to what is unseen and unclear, you face more difficulties because reaching that hidden state is very hard.
vishnu_gita::611.simple_insight: There's a quiet struggle in holding on to what you cannot fully grasp or see.
vishnu_gita::611.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that those who fix their minds on the unmanifested, the invisible reality, experience more troubles. The unmanifested is a subtle state, difficult for living beings to truly reach or understand, causing their minds to suffer in attachment.
vishnu_gita::611.modern_relevance: You’ve tried to hold onto unclear feelings or vague hopes, only to find yourself more stressed and restless.
vishnu_gita::611.insight: It teaches you to notice when your mind clings to unclear things and how that increases your struggle.

vishnu_gita::612.verse_sanskrit:
ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मायि सन्न्यस्य मत्पराः ।
अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते ॥
vishnu_gita::612.verse_hindi: किन्तु जो एकान्त भक्ति योग द्वारा सब कर्म मुझमें अर्पण करके मत्परायण होकर मेरा ध्यान करते हुए उपासना करते हैं
vishnu_gita::612.english_translation: But those who dedicate all their actions to me with exclusive devotion and meditate on me with focused love.
vishnu_gita::612.translation_literal: ये (these) / तु (but) / सर्वाणि (all) / कर्माणि (actions) / मायि (in me) / सन्न्यस्य (having surrendered) / मत्पराः (devoted to me) / अनन्येनैव (with exclusive) / योगेन (yoga) / मां (me) / ध्यायन्त (meditate) / उपासते (worship)
vishnu_gita::612.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::612.essence: Complete devotion turns every action into a meditation on the divine presence.
vishnu_gita::612.simple_meaning: You can offer every action to the divine with exclusive, loving focus and devotion.
vishnu_gita::612.simple_insight: Devotion transforms ordinary acts into a sacred connection with the divine.
vishnu_gita::612.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that those who surrender all their actions to him with exclusive devotion and meditate on him with focused love turn every act into an act of worship, deepening their connection beyond ritual.
vishnu_gita::612.modern_relevance: When you fully commit your work or care for others with loving focus, your actions become expressions of devotion, not just tasks.
vishnu_gita::612.insight: It teaches you to unify your daily actions by dedicating them wholeheartedly to your true inner focus.

vishnu_gita::613.verse_sanskrit:
तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात् ।
भवामि नचिरादेवाः ! मय्यावेशितचेतसाम ॥
vishnu_gita::613.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! मैं मृत्युयुक्त संसार समुद्र से मुझमें निवेशित चित्त उन भक्तों का शीघ्र उद्धार करता हूँ
vishnu_gita::613.english_translation: O divine beings! I swiftly rescue those devoted whose minds are immersed in me from the ocean of death and rebirth.
vishnu_gita::613.translation_literal: तेषाम् (of them) अहम् (I) समुद्धर्ता (the rescuer) मृत्युसंसारसागरात् (from the ocean of death and rebirth) भवामि (become) नचिरातेवाः (very soon) मयि (in me) आवेशितचेतसाम् (of those with minds immersed)
vishnu_gita::613.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::613.essence: Devoted minds receive swift rescue from the cycle of rebirth and death.
vishnu_gita::613.simple_meaning: The divine says they quickly save those whose minds are focused on them from the endless cycle of life and death.
vishnu_gita::613.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing devoted attention brings swift support beyond hardship.
vishnu_gita::613.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses the divine beings, assuring that those who immerse their minds in him are rescued promptly from the cycle of death and rebirth, highlighting the power of devoted focus in liberation.
vishnu_gita::613.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by repeated struggles, focusing your heart deeply on what grounds you brings rapid relief and rescue.
vishnu_gita::613.insight: It teaches you to trust that sincere devotion activates swift support beyond your struggles.

vishnu_gita::614.verse_sanskrit:
मय्येव मन आधद्ध्वं माय बुद्धिर्निवेश्यताम्।
निवसिष्यथ मय्येव अत ऊर्दध्वं न संशयः ॥
vishnu_gita::614.verse_hindi: मुझ में ही मन स्थिर करो और मुझ में ही बुद्धिसंनिवेश करो तो इससे आगे मुझमे ही निवास करोगे इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
vishnu_gita::614.english_translation: Fix your mind in me alone; let your intellect dwell in me alone. There is no doubt you will then reside in me alone beyond.
vishnu_gita::614.translation_literal: मयि (in me) एव (alone) मन (mind) आधद्ध्वं (fix) मयि (in me) बुद्धि (intellect) निवेश्यताम् (let dwell) निवसिष्यथ (you will reside) मयि (in me) एव (alone) अत (beyond) ऊर्दध्वं (further) न (no) संशयः (doubt)
vishnu_gita::614.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::614.essence: Fixing your mind and intellect on the divine leads to unwavering spiritual residence.
vishnu_gita::614.simple_meaning: You should steady your mind and intellect by focusing them on the divine. Doing this lets you live fully connected to the divine without doubt.
vishnu_gita::614.simple_insight: Feeling centered in the divine brings a steady, unwavering sense of belonging and peace.
vishnu_gita::614.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Vishnu instructs that by fixing your mind and intellect exclusively on the divine, you establish a deep bond. This connection allows you to dwell fully in the divine beyond all doubt, reflecting true devotional trust.
vishnu_gita::614.modern_relevance: When your thoughts and decisions are fully focused on what truly matters, you find a calm sense of belonging beyond distractions.
vishnu_gita::614.insight: Focus your restless mind and discerning intellect exclusively on the divine to steady your inner state.

vishnu_gita::615.verse_sanskrit:
अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नुथ मयि स्थिरम् ।
अभ्यासयोगेन तत इच्छताप्तुं सुराः ! हि माम् ॥
vishnu_gita::615.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! यदि मुझमें चित्त को स्थिर न रख सको तो अभ्यास योग द्वारा मुझे प्राप्त करने की इच्छा करो
vishnu_gita::615.english_translation: O divine beings, if you cannot keep your mind steady on me, then desire to attain me through the practice of yoga.
vishnu_gita::615.translation_literal: अथ (now) चित्तं (mind) समाधातुं (to steady) न (not) शक्नुथ (can) मयि (on me) स्थिरम् (steady) । अभ्यासयोगेन (through disciplined practice of yoga) तत् (that) इच्छत् (desire) आप्तुं (to attain) सुराः (divine beings) । हि (indeed) माम् (me) ॥
vishnu_gita::615.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::615.essence: Steady focus on the divine grows through disciplined practice, even if it feels impossible.
vishnu_gita::615.simple_meaning: If you can’t keep your mind steady on the divine, then practice yoga regularly to develop that steadiness.
vishnu_gita::615.simple_insight: There’s hope in persistent effort even when focus feels impossible.
vishnu_gita::615.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses divine beings who struggle to steady their minds on him. He encourages them to keep practicing yoga until their mind becomes steady, highlighting disciplined effort as the path.
vishnu_gita::615.modern_relevance: When your mind keeps jumping between tasks and distractions, the only way forward is steady, consistent practice.
vishnu_gita::615.insight: It shifts your mindset from expecting instant focus to valuing disciplined, gradual improvement.

vishnu_gita::616.verse_sanskrit:
अभ्यासेऽप्यसमथर्मे भूयतां कर्म्मतत्परैः।
मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुद्भिः सिद्धिरेष्यते ॥
vishnu_gita::616.verse_hindi: यदि अभ्यास करने में भी असमर्थ हो तो मेरे कर्मों में निरत हो, केवल मेरे लिये ही सब कर्मों को करते हुए भी सिद्धि को प्राप्त होगे
vishnu_gita::616.english_translation: If you cannot even practice, then be devoted to my actions; by performing all actions for me alone, you will attain success.
vishnu_gita::616.translation_literal: अभ्यासेऽपि (even in practice) असमथर्मे (unable) भूयतां (let there be) कर्म्मतत्परैः (by those devoted to action) / मदर्थमपि (even for me) कर्माणि (actions) कुद्भिः (by what cause) सिद्धिरेष्यते (will success come)
vishnu_gita::616.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::616.essence: Devotion to purposeful action brings success even when steady practice fails.
vishnu_gita::616.simple_meaning: If you find it hard to keep up practice, dedicate yourself to doing actions for the divine alone to achieve success.
vishnu_gita::616.simple_insight: You can find success by focusing your efforts on serving the greater purpose, even when practice feels impossible.
vishnu_gita::616.detailed_meaning: Vishnu advises that when someone struggles to maintain steady practice, they should instead immerse themselves in performing all actions as offerings to the divine. This focused devotion ensures success even without perfect discipline.
vishnu_gita::616.modern_relevance: You feel burnt out trying to maintain daily habits. Instead, redirect your energy to meaningful work dedicated to a cause bigger than yourself.
vishnu_gita::616.insight: It shifts your effort from self-focused discipline to purpose-driven action, making success more attainable.

vishnu_gita::617.verse_sanskrit:
अथैतदप्यशक्ताः स्थ क मदद्योगमाश्रिताः।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं यतात्मानो विधत्त वै ॥
vishnu_gita::617.verse_hindi: यदि इसके करने में भी असमर्थ हो तो एकमात्र मेरे शरणागत और संयतचित्त होकर सब कर्मों के फलों का त्याग करों
vishnu_gita::617.english_translation: If you are still unable, then take refuge in me alone with controlled mind and renounce the fruits of all actions.
vishnu_gita::617.translation_literal: अथैतदपि (if even this) अशक्ताः (unable) स्थ (then) क (some) मदद्योगमाश्रिताः (having taken refuge in concentrated yoga) सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं (renunciation of all action fruits) यतात्मानो (one who has subdued self) विधत्त (does) वै (indeed)
vishnu_gita::617.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::617.essence: When struggling, steady your mind and renounce attachment to all action results.
vishnu_gita::617.simple_meaning: If you feel powerless, take refuge in steady focus and give up attachment to all results of your actions.
vishnu_gita::617.simple_insight: There is freedom in surrendering the need to control every outcome with a calm, steady mind.
vishnu_gita::617.detailed_meaning: Vishnu advises that if you cannot maintain control or balance in action, then rely on complete surrender with a steady mind and give up attachment to outcomes to find peace.
vishnu_gita::617.modern_relevance: When everything feels overwhelming and you can't control results, grounding yourself and releasing expectations brings relief.
vishnu_gita::617.insight: Shift from struggling to control outcomes to steady trust and renouncing results, calming your efforts.

vishnu_gita::618.verse_sanskrit:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां भैत्रः करुण एव च ।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥
vishnu_gita::618.verse_hindi: समस्त प्राणियों का, अद्वेष्टा, मित्र और कृपालु, ममताहीन, निरहङ्कार, सुख दुःख में समता समझने वाला, क्षमावान,
vishnu_gita::618.english_translation: One who harbours no hatred towards any being, is a friend and compassionate, free from attachment and ego, equal in sorrow and joy, and forgiving.
vishnu_gita::618.translation_literal: अद्वेष्टा (one who has no hatred) / सर्वभूतानां (towards all beings) / भैत्रः (friend) / करुण (compassionate) / एव (indeed) / च (and) / निर्ममो (without attachment) / निरहङ्कारः (without ego) / समदुःखसुखः (equal in sorrow and joy) / क्षमी (forgiving)
vishnu_gita::618.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::618.essence: True friendship and compassion arise when you release hatred and ego.
vishnu_gita::618.simple_meaning: You can be a true friend to all by dropping hate, ego, and attachment, staying calm through highs and lows, and forgiving others.
vishnu_gita::618.simple_insight: Peace grows when you choose kindness without ego or hatred.
vishnu_gita::618.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes qualities of the true self: being free from hatred for others, acting as a friend with compassion, releasing attachment and ego, maintaining balance in joy and sorrow, and embracing forgiveness.
vishnu_gita::618.modern_relevance: You meet frustration and stress at work or home, but choosing kindness without ego helps you stay steady and forgiving.
vishnu_gita::618.insight: It teaches shifting from reactive hatred and ego to steady compassion and forgiveness.

vishnu_gita::619.verse_sanskrit:
सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः।
मय्यार्पतमनोबुद्धियों मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
vishnu_gita::619.verse_hindi: सदा सन्तुष्ट, संयतचित्त योगी मेरी ओर स्थिर लक्ष्य रखने वाला, और मुझमें मन और बुद्धि को समर्पण करने वाला जो मेरा भक्त है वह मेरा प्रिय है
vishnu_gita::619.english_translation: The yogi who is always content, disciplined, firmly resolved, and who surrenders mind and intellect to me with devotion is dear to me.
vishnu_gita::619.translation_literal: सन्तुष्टः (content) सततं (always) योगी (yogi) यतात्मा (disciplined) दृढनिश्चयः (firmly resolved) मयि (to me) अर्पित (offered) मनः (mind) बुद्धयः (intellects) मद्भक्तः (my devotee) स (he) मे (to me) प्रियः (dear)
vishnu_gita::619.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::619.essence: Firm contentment and surrendered devotion make you dear to the divine.
vishnu_gita::619.simple_meaning: You become dear by being always content, steady in discipline, and offering your mind and intellect with devoted love.
vishnu_gita::619.simple_insight: There is warmth in knowing steady devotion and contentment make you deeply valued.
vishnu_gita::619.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes the qualities of a beloved devotee: constant contentment, disciplined self-control, firm resolve, and complete surrender of mind and intellect. This teaching comes as a guide to those seeking closeness through Bhakti Yoga.
vishnu_gita::619.modern_relevance: You feel most connected when you calmly accept what is, stay steady in your practice, and trust deeply with your whole mind.
vishnu_gita::619.insight: You learn to steady your mind and offer it fully in loving devotion, strengthening your connection.

vishnu_gita::620.verse_sanskrit:
यस्मानोद्विजते लोको लोकानोद्विजने च यः।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः म च मे प्रियः ॥
vishnu_gita::620.verse_hindi: जिसके द्वारा संसार उद्विग्न नहीं होता है, जो संसार से उद्विग्न नहीं होता है और जो हर्ष अमर्ष (अन्य को लाभ होनेसे कातर होना ) भय और चित्तक्षोभ से रहित है वह मेरा प्रिय है
vishnu_gita::620.english_translation: He by whom the world is not disturbed, who is not disturbed by the world, and who is free from joy, anger, fear, and agitation, is dear to me.
vishnu_gita::620.translation_literal: यस्मात् (by whom) उद्विजते (is disturbed) लोको (the world) लोकात् (from the world) उद्विजने (being disturbed) च (and) यः (who) हर्ष (joy) अमर्ष (anger) भय (fear) उत्पेगैः (by agitations) मुक्त (free) यः (who) म (to me) च (also) मे (my) प्रियः (dear)
vishnu_gita::620.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::620.essence: Being undisturbed by the world and free from emotional upheaval makes you truly dear.
vishnu_gita::620.simple_meaning: You are dear when you neither disturb others nor are disturbed by them, staying free from strong emotions.
vishnu_gita::620.simple_insight: Peace comes when you stop reacting both inwardly and outwardly to the world’s ups and downs.
vishnu_gita::620.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that a person loved by him remains steady and undisturbed by external turmoil or internal emotional swings like joy, anger, or fear. This steadiness makes one dear and stable in the midst of change.
vishnu_gita::620.modern_relevance: In a noisy room where people argue, you remain quietly steady, unaffected by their turmoil or your own shifting feelings.
vishnu_gita::620.insight: It teaches you to hold an inner balance that neither provokes nor is shaken by others, creating true emotional freedom.

vishnu_gita::621.verse_sanskrit:
अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दन उदासीनो गतव्यथः ।
सर्बारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
vishnu_gita::621.verse_hindi: सकल विषयों में निःस्पृह, शुचि, चतुर, उदासीन, जिसको व्यथा नहीं होती, और सब सङ्कल्पों का त्याग करने वाला जो मेरा भक्त है वह मेरा प्रिय है
vishnu_gita::621.english_translation: One who is unattached to all things, pure, wise, indifferent, without pain, and who has renounced all intentions is dear to me as my devotee.
vishnu_gita::621.translation_literal: अनपेक्षः (unattached) / शुचिः (pure) / दन् (wise) / उदासीनः (indifferent) / गतव्यथः (without pain) / सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी (renouncing all undertakings) / यो (who) / मद्भक्तः (my devotee) / सः (he) / मे (to me) / प्रियः (dear)
vishnu_gita::621.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::621.essence: Devotion rooted in purity, calm, and freedom from attachment is deeply beloved.
vishnu_gita::621.simple_meaning: You become dear through devotion by being pure, wise, calm, unattached, free from pain, and by giving up all selfish intentions.
vishnu_gita::621.simple_insight: You feel loved and accepted when your devotion is steady and free from clinging or pain.
vishnu_gita::621.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes who is truly dear to him: a devotee who remains pure, wise, indifferent to disturbances, free from suffering, and renounces all selfish desires and plans. This defines devotion beyond emotion, as steady inner freedom.
vishnu_gita::621.modern_relevance: You find peace when you care deeply but don’t cling or get hurt by daily ups and downs.
vishnu_gita::621.insight: It teaches you to cultivate calm detachment within devotion, freeing your heart from pain and craving.

vishnu_gita::622.verse_sanskrit:
यो न हृष्यति न दृष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान यः स मे प्रियः ॥
vishnu_gita::622.verse_hindi: जो प्रसन्न नहीं होता है, द्वेष नहीं करता है, शोक नहीं करता है, आकांशा नहीं करता है, पाप पुण्यों का परित्याग करने वाला है और मुझमें भक्तिमान् है वह मेरा प्रिय है
vishnu_gita::622.english_translation: He who neither rejoices nor hates, neither grieves nor desires, who has renounced good and bad and is devoted to me, is dear to me.
vishnu_gita::622.translation_literal: यो (he who) / न (not) / हृष्यति (rejoices) / न (nor) / दृष्टि (hates) / न (nor) / शोचति (grieves) / न (nor) / काङ्क्षति (desires) / शुभाशुभ (good-bad) / परित्यागी (renouncing) / भक्तिमान (devoted) / यः (who) / स (that) / मे (to me) / प्रियः (dear)
vishnu_gita::622.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::622.essence: True devotion is steady love beyond all emotional extremes and judgments.
vishnu_gita::622.simple_meaning: You are dear when you neither get excited nor upset, neither grieve nor desire, and you give up judging things as good or bad while staying devoted.
vishnu_gita::622.simple_insight: Peace grows when you stop reacting and just love with openness.
vishnu_gita::622.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes the nature of true devotion: a person who remains calm without emotional extremes, renounces attachment to outcomes, and lovingly dedicates themselves is truly dear to the divine.
vishnu_gita::622.modern_relevance: When your emotions swing wildly through joy and frustration, you lose focus; steady devotion lets you connect deeply without being tossed by feelings.
vishnu_gita::622.insight: It shifts your focus from emotional reactivity to steady loving dedication, freeing you from distractions.

vishnu_gita::623.verse_sanskrit:
समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः ॥
vishnu_gita::623.verse_hindi: जो शत्रु और मित्र में एवं मान और अपमान में एकरूप रहता है, शीत उष्ण और सुख दुःखों में विकारहीन है, निःसंग है,
vishnu_gita::623.english_translation: One who remains equal to friend and enemy, and to honor and insult, is free from attachment amid cold, heat, pleasure, and pain.
vishnu_gita::623.translation_literal: समः (equal) शत्रौ (to enemy) च (and) मित्रे (to friend) च (and) तथा (also) मानापमानयोः (honor and insult) । शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु (in cold, heat, pleasure, pain) समः (equal) सङ्गविवर्जितः (free from attachment) ॥
vishnu_gita::623.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::623.essence: True balance comes from treating friends and enemies, praise and blame, as the same.
vishnu_gita::623.simple_meaning: You can remain calm and unaffected whether someone is your friend or enemy, or whether you receive praise or insult.
vishnu_gita::623.simple_insight: There is peace in not letting others’ opinions shake your inner calm.
vishnu_gita::623.detailed_meaning: Vishnu instructs that true steadiness comes from treating friends and enemies alike, and accepting honor and insult without reacting. This teaching guides overcoming emotional swings to find balance.
vishnu_gita::623.modern_relevance: When someone criticizes you on social media or praises you at work, you can keep your calm and not let their words disturb your peace.
vishnu_gita::623.insight: It teaches you to observe emotional ups and downs without clinging or aversion, maintaining inner balance.

vishnu_gita::624.verse_sanskrit:
तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिौनी सन्तुष्टो येन केनचित्।
अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान मे प्रियो हि सः ॥
vishnu_gita::624.verse_hindi: निन्दा और प्रशंसा में समभावापन्न है, मौनी (मन को दमन करनेवाला) है, जो कुछ मिल जाए  उससे सन्तुष्ट है, वासस्थानहीन है, स्थिरचित्त है और भक्तिमान् है वह मेग प्रिय है
vishnu_gita::624.english_translation: He who is equal in blame and praise, silent, satisfied with whatever he gets, homeless, steady-minded, and devoted is dear to me.
vishnu_gita::624.translation_literal: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिौनी (equal in blame and praise) / सन्तुष्टो (satisfied) / येन (by whom) / केनचित् (whatever) / अनिकेतः (homeless) / स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान (steady-minded and devoted) / मे (to me) / प्रियो (dear) / हि (indeed) / सः (he)
vishnu_gita::624.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::624.essence: Being steady, content, and devoted makes you beloved to the divine.
vishnu_gita::624.simple_meaning: You become dear to the divine by being steady in mind, content with what you have, silent, and devoted without a fixed home.
vishnu_gita::624.simple_insight: There is peace in being steady and content no matter what people say or where you are.
vishnu_gita::624.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes the qualities of a person beloved to him: someone who treats praise and blame equally, remains silent and peaceful, accepts whatever comes with satisfaction, has no fixed home, maintains a steady mind, and is devoted. This shows devotion beyond conditions.
vishnu_gita::624.modern_relevance: You feel calm sitting quietly after a long day, unbothered by praise or criticism, simply content with what you have.
vishnu_gita::624.insight: It teaches you to cultivate even-mindedness and devotion regardless of external ups and downs.

vishnu_gita::625.verse_sanskrit:
ये तु धर्मामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते । 
श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः॥
vishnu_gita::625.verse_hindi: जो लोग इस उक्त अमृतरूप धर्म का अनुष्ठान करते हैं, वह श्रद्धाशील मत्परायण भक्तगण मेरे अतिप्रिय हैं
vishnu_gita::625.english_translation: Those who faithfully practice this nectar-like dharma with devotion to me are very dear to me.
vishnu_gita::625.translation_literal: ये (those) / तु (indeed) / धर्मामृतमिदं (this nectar-like dharma) / यथोक्तं (as told) / पर्युपासते (faithfully practice) / श्रद्धधाना (with trust) / मत्परमा (devoted to me) / भक्तास्ते (those devotees) / अतीव (very) / मे (to me) / प्रियाः (dear)
vishnu_gita::625.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::625.essence: Faithful, trustful devotion to the divine makes you deeply beloved and precious.
vishnu_gita::625.simple_meaning: You are very dear when you practice this sacred path with trust and devotion to the divine.
vishnu_gita::625.simple_insight: Trustful devotion connects you deeply to what truly matters.
vishnu_gita::625.detailed_meaning: Vishnu tells that those who follow the pure, nectar-like dharma with sincere faith and devotion toward him are exceptionally dear. This verse highlights the value of heartfelt dedication in the spiritual path.
vishnu_gita::625.modern_relevance: When you commit fully to a path or purpose with trust and open heart, you create bonds that matter deeply.
vishnu_gita::625.insight: It teaches you to value devotion grounded in trust as the highest form of connection with the divine.

vishnu_gita::626.verse_sanskrit:
निशम्य नितरां नाथ ! पराराव्य ! जगद्गुरो!।
रहस्यं भक्तियोगस्योपासनायास्तथादभूतम् ॥
vishnu_gita::626.verse_hindi: नाथ ! पराराव्य ! आराध्य और उपासना का अद्भुत रहस्य अविच्छिन्न रूप से सुनकर
vishnu_gita::626.english_translation: O Lord, Pararavya, the wondrous secret of devotion's practice and worship has been heard completely.
vishnu_gita::626.translation_literal: निशम्य (having heard) / नितरां (completely) / नाथ (O Lord) / पराराव्य (Pararavya) / जगद्गुरो (world teacher) / रहस्यं (secret) / भक्तियोगस्य (of devotion's yoga) / उपासनायाः (of worship/practice) / तथा (thus) / अद्भुतम् (wondrous)
vishnu_gita::626.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::626.essence: The full, wondrous secret of devoted practice can be completely known by sincere listening.
vishnu_gita::626.simple_meaning: You have completely heard the wonderful secret behind devoted practice and worship.
vishnu_gita::626.simple_insight: There is a special secret in devotion that unfolds when you listen deeply.
vishnu_gita::626.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses Pararavya, the revered world teacher, announcing that the entire secret of devotion and its practice has been fully shared, marking a pivotal moment in understanding Bhakti Yoga.
vishnu_gita::626.modern_relevance: You just finished a deep talk that opened your heart to what true devotion really is.
vishnu_gita::626.insight: It invites you to trust the process of devotion as a living, wondrous secret rather than a fixed formula.

vishnu_gita::627.verse_sanskrit:
कृतार्था: स्मो वयं सम्यक करुणावरुणालय!।
भूयोऽपि श्रोतुमिच्छामस्त्वत्तो ज्ञानमयीं गिरम् ॥
vishnu_gita::627.verse_hindi: हम लोग अच्छी तरह कृतकृत्य हुए। हम फिर भी ज्ञानवार्ता को आप से सुनना चाहते हैं
vishnu_gita::627.english_translation: We have fulfilled our duties well. Yet, we still wish to hear from you the knowledge-filled speech.
vishnu_gita::627.translation_literal: कृतार्था: (fulfilled) स्मो (we) वयं (indeed) सम्यक (well) करुणावरुणालय (O abode of compassion and storm)! भूयोऽपि (again also) श्रोतुम् (to hear) इच्छामः (we wish) त्वत्तः (from you) ज्ञानमयीं (knowledge-filled) गिरम् (speech).
vishnu_gita::627.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::627.essence: Completion does not end the desire to receive deeper wisdom.
vishnu_gita::627.simple_meaning: They express having completed their tasks well but still want to listen to the wise teachings from the speaker.
vishnu_gita::627.simple_insight: Sometimes even after completing what we must, we seek deeper understanding and guidance.
vishnu_gita::627.detailed_meaning: The speakers acknowledge that they have fulfilled their obligations and are grateful. Despite this, they express a sincere desire to continue learning from the wise teacher, showing humility and eagerness for knowledge.
vishnu_gita::627.modern_relevance: After finishing a project, you still crave insight from a mentor to deepen your understanding beyond just completion.
vishnu_gita::627.insight: It teaches the value of ongoing learning and humility, even after completing expected duties.

vishnu_gita::628.verse_sanskrit:
श्रूयते हि जगन्नाथ ! ज्ञानमेवास्ति कारणम् ।
मुक्तेरतो दयासिन्धो ! सादरं प्रार्थयामहे ॥
vishnu_gita::628.verse_hindi: हे जगन्नाथ ! हमने सुना है कि ज्ञान ही मुक्ति का कारण है, इस कारण हे दयासिन्धो! हम सविनय प्रार्थना करते हैं कि
vishnu_gita::628.english_translation: O Lord of the universe! We have heard that knowledge alone is the cause of liberation; therefore, O ocean of compassion, we humbly pray.
vishnu_gita::628.translation_literal: श्रूयते (is heard) हि (indeed) जगन्नाथ (O Lord of the universe) ! ज्ञानमेवास्ति (knowledge alone is) कारणम् (the cause) । मुक्तेरतो (of liberation) दयासिन्धो (O ocean of compassion) ! सादरं (respectfully) प्रार्थयामहे (we pray) ॥
vishnu_gita::628.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::628.essence: Freedom arises from gaining true knowledge, not from external efforts.
vishnu_gita::628.simple_meaning: Knowledge alone leads to true freedom from bondage. This verse expresses a humble request to receive that knowledge.
vishnu_gita::628.simple_insight: There is hope and trust in the power of knowledge to bring freedom.
vishnu_gita::628.detailed_meaning: In this verse, the narrator addresses the Lord of the universe, acknowledging that knowledge is known to be the cause of liberation. They humbly ask for this knowledge, emphasizing its importance in the path to freedom.
vishnu_gita::628.modern_relevance: You feel stuck in old patterns and realize that learning a new perspective can free you from them.
vishnu_gita::628.insight: It shifts focus from seeking external help to valuing inner clarity as the path to freedom.

vishnu_gita::629.verse_sanskrit:
गूढं ज्ञानस्वरूपं यद्रहस्यञ्चापि दुर्गमम् ।
वैदिकज्ञानकाण्डस्य ज्ञानाज्ञानविनिर्णयम् ॥
vishnu_gita::629.verse_hindi: ज्ञान का गूढ़ स्वरूप, वेद के ज्ञानकाण्ड का दुर्गम रहस्य, ज्ञान और अज्ञान का लक्षण
vishnu_gita::629.english_translation: The profound nature of knowledge, the difficult secret of the Vedic knowledge section, distinguishing knowledge and ignorance.
vishnu_gita::629.translation_literal: गूढ़ं (profound) / ज्ञानस्वरूपं (nature of knowledge) / यद् (that) / रहस्यं (secret) / च (and) / अपि (also) / दुर्गमम् (difficult to access) / वैदिकज्ञानकाण्डस्य (of the Vedic knowledge section) / ज्ञानाज्ञानविनिर्णयम् (distinguishing knowledge and ignorance)
vishnu_gita::629.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::629.essence: True knowledge is a hidden secret that distinguishes wisdom from ignorance.
vishnu_gita::629.simple_meaning: True knowledge is subtle and hidden; it reveals how to tell real understanding from ignorance.
vishnu_gita::629.simple_insight: It feels like uncovering a secret that changes how you see what you thought you knew.
vishnu_gita::629.detailed_meaning: Vishnu reveals a profound teaching on knowledge as a hidden truth within the Vedas. This teaching explains how to distinguish real knowledge from ignorance, a difficult secret accessible only through deep insight.
vishnu_gita::629.modern_relevance: You’ve faced moments when what you thought was clear suddenly feels confusing—this teaching helps you see the difference between real understanding and illusion.
vishnu_gita::629.insight: It teaches you to recognize the subtle difference between true insight and superficial belief.

vishnu_gita::630.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानिनां लक्षणञ्चैव प्रतिपाद्य प्रभोऽधुना ।
आत्मज्ञानोपदेशेन चित्ते शान्ति विधत्स्व नः ॥
vishnu_gita::630.verse_hindi: और ज्ञानी का लक्षण भी कहकर तथा हे प्रभो! आत्मज्ञान का उपदेश देकर हमारे चित्त में अब शान्ति प्रदान कीजिए
vishnu_gita::630.english_translation: And now, O Lord, by explaining the marks of the wise and teaching self-knowledge, grant peace to our minds.
vishnu_gita::630.translation_literal: ज्ञानिनां (of the wise) लक्षणञ्चैव (the marks also) प्रतिपाद्य (to be explained) प्रभोऽधुना (O Lord, now) । आत्मज्ञानोपदेशेन (by teaching self-knowledge) चित्ते (in the mind) शान्ति (peace) विधत्स्व (please grant) नः (to us) ॥
vishnu_gita::630.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::630.essence: Peace in the mind comes from understanding wisdom and self-knowledge clearly.
vishnu_gita::630.simple_meaning: Understanding what makes someone truly wise and learning about the true self brings calmness to your mind.
vishnu_gita::630.simple_insight: Peace grows naturally when your mind grasps wisdom and self-knowledge.
vishnu_gita::630.detailed_meaning: Suta, speaking to the sages, asks the Lord to reveal the qualities of the wise and to teach self-knowledge so that their restless minds may become peaceful, setting the stage for deeper wisdom.
vishnu_gita::630.modern_relevance: After struggling with anxiety and confusion, you seek clear guidance that calms your mind and helps you find steady peace.
vishnu_gita::630.insight: It shows you how learning clear signs of wisdom and self-understanding directly soothes mental unrest.

vishnu_gita::631.verse_sanskrit:
तटस्थञ्च स्वरूञ्च द्विविधं ज्ञानमीरितम् ।
ज्ञानं यद्धि स्वरूपाख्यं स्वरूपं तन्ममैव वै ॥
vishnu_gita::631.verse_hindi: ज्ञान दो प्रकार का कहा गया है, स्वरूपज्ञान और तटस्थज्ञान। स्वरूपज्ञान मेरा ही स्वरूप है
vishnu_gita::631.english_translation: Two types of knowledge are described: impartial knowledge and true form knowledge. True form knowledge is my own true nature.
vishnu_gita::631.translation_literal: तटस्थञ्च (impartial) / स्वरूञ्च (true form) / द्विविधं (two kinds) / ज्ञानमीरितम् (knowledge is said) / ज्ञानं (knowledge) / यद्धि (which indeed) / स्वरूपाख्यं (called true form) / स्वरूपं (true nature) / तन्ममैव (mine alone) / वै (indeed)
vishnu_gita::631.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::631.essence: The deepest knowledge is recognizing the divine as your own true nature.
vishnu_gita::631.simple_meaning: There are two kinds of knowledge: one that is detached and one that reveals the deepest truth of who you are, which is the true nature of the divine within you.
vishnu_gita::631.simple_insight: You can feel connected and grounded by recognizing that the deepest knowledge is your own true nature.
vishnu_gita::631.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that knowledge is not one-dimensional but has two forms: detached observation and the knowledge that reveals the divine as your own essential self. This teaching invites Arjuna to see beyond surface appearances to the true reality within.
vishnu_gita::631.modern_relevance: When you face confusing choices or inner conflict, knowing your true nature helps you find clarity beyond distractions.
vishnu_gita::631.insight: It shifts your mind from seeing knowledge as external facts to recognizing it as a direct awareness of your own true self.

vishnu_gita::632.verse_sanskrit:
पराभक्तिप्रवीणेन समाधौ निर्विकल्पके ।
ज्ञानिना शान्तचित्तेन यद्भक्तेनानुभूयते ॥
vishnu_gita::632.verse_hindi: जो निर्विकल्प समाधि में पराभक्ति में प्रवीण, शान्तचित्त ज्ञानी भक्त के अनुभव में आता है
vishnu_gita::632.english_translation: That which is experienced by a devotee skilled in supreme devotion, in undisturbed absorption, and by a serene-minded wise person.
vishnu_gita::632.translation_literal: पराभक्तिप्रवीणेन (by one skilled in supreme devotion) / समाधौ (in absorption) / निर्विकल्पके (undisturbed) / ज्ञानिना (by the wise) / शान्तचित्तेन (with a calm mind) / यत् (that which) / भक्तेन (by a devotee) / अनुभूयते (is experienced)
vishnu_gita::632.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::632.essence: The deepest experience arises when devotion, clear wisdom, and calmness unite fully.
vishnu_gita::632.simple_meaning: Deep experience happens when devotion is complete, the mind is calm, and wisdom is clear.
vishnu_gita::632.simple_insight: There is a profound peace when love, wisdom, and calm come together inside you.
vishnu_gita::632.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that the highest experience of the divine comes to those who master supreme devotion, enter undisturbed absorption, and have a peaceful, wise mind. This blends Bhakti Yoga with wisdom and stillness.
vishnu_gita::632.modern_relevance: When you’re deeply focused, loving, and mentally calm, you can access a powerful, peaceful experience beyond distraction.
vishnu_gita::632.insight: It teaches you that true spiritual experience arises not from just one quality, but from devotion, wisdom, and calmness combined.

vishnu_gita::633.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानं तद्धि स्वरूपाख्यं सच्चिदानन्दरूपकम् ।
देवाः ! जानीत तन्नूनमवाङ्मनसगोचरम् ॥
vishnu_gita::633.verse_hindi: वह स्वरूप ज्ञान सच्चिदानन्दमय है। हे देवगण ! उसको अवश्य मन वचन से अतीत जानना चाहिए
vishnu_gita::633.english_translation: True knowledge is the awareness of the true self, made of existence, consciousness, and bliss; O radiant beings, it must be known beyond mind and speech.
vishnu_gita::633.translation_literal: ज्ञानं (knowledge) / तद्धि (that is) / स्वरूपाख्यं (called true nature) / सच्चिदानन्दरूपकम् (made of existence-consciousness-bliss) / देवाः (O radiant beings) / जानीत (should be known) / तन्नूनम् (indeed that) / अवाङ्मनसगोचरम् (beyond speech and mind accessible)
vishnu_gita::633.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::633.essence: True knowledge is experiencing your self beyond mind and speech as pure being and bliss.
vishnu_gita::633.simple_meaning: True knowledge is realizing your true self as pure existence, consciousness, and bliss beyond mind and speech.
vishnu_gita::633.simple_insight: There is a peace in knowing you are more than your thoughts and words.
vishnu_gita::633.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses divine beings, teaching that true knowledge is not intellectual but an experience of the self as pure being, awareness, and joy, beyond mental concepts or language.
vishnu_gita::633.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by thoughts and labels, this reminds you your true self is beyond those noisy layers.
vishnu_gita::633.insight: Shift your focus from mental chatter to the direct experience of being aware and joyful presence.

vishnu_gita::634.verse_sanskrit:
द्वारीकृत्य तटस्थाख्यं ज्ञानमेव तु केवलम् ।
जिज्ञासुर्लभते नूनं योगयुन्जानमानसः ॥
vishnu_gita::634.verse_hindi: केवल तटस्थज्ञान के द्वारा ही योगाभ्यासनिरत जिज्ञासु
vishnu_gita::634.english_translation: Only through impartial wisdom does the mind engaged in yoga practice surely attain inquiry.
vishnu_gita::634.translation_literal: द्वारीकृत्य (having made a gate) / तटस्थाख्यं (called impartial) / ज्ञानमेव (only knowledge) / तु (but) / केवलम् (alone) / जिज्ञासुः (the seeker) / लभते (attains) / नूनं (certainly) / योगयुन्जानमानसः (mind practicing yoga)
vishnu_gita::634.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::634.essence: Only an impartial, steady mind practicing yoga can truly awaken deep inquiry.
vishnu_gita::634.simple_meaning: A mind that stays balanced and free from bias, focused through yoga practice, gains true understanding by inquiry.
vishnu_gita::634.simple_insight: You can trust that steady, unbiased wisdom will naturally lead you to deeper questions.
vishnu_gita::634.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that the seeker who practices yoga with a steady, impartial mind gains true wisdom. This moment highlights the need for balance and detachment to awaken genuine questioning.
vishnu_gita::634.modern_relevance: When your mind stops swinging between extremes and stays calm, your curiosity naturally deepens and meaningful insights arise.
vishnu_gita::634.insight: It teaches you to cultivate balanced, unbiased attention to invite genuine inquiry in your practice.

vishnu_gita::635.verse_sanskrit:
आत्मानात्मविवेकं हि कुर्वाणो मामसंशयम् ।
तटस्थाख्यं हि यज्ज्ञानं तत्र यद्यपि वर्तते ॥
vishnu_gita::635.verse_hindi: आत्मा और अनात्मा का विचार करता हुआ ही निसन्देह मुझको प्राप्त होता है । हे देवगण !
vishnu_gita::635.english_translation: By discerning the self from what is not self, one undoubtedly attains me. That knowledge, even if it appears detached, is true wisdom.
vishnu_gita::635.translation_literal: आत्मानात्मविवेकं (discerning self and not-self) / हि (indeed) / कुर्वाणो (doing) / माम् (me) / असंशयम् (without doubt) / तटस्थाख्यं (detached-named) / हि (indeed) / यत् (that) / ज्ञानं (knowledge) / तत्र (there) / यद्यपि (even if) / वर्तते (exists)
vishnu_gita::635.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::635.essence: Clear discernment between self and non-self leads to certain knowledge of the true self.
vishnu_gita::635.simple_meaning: Understanding the difference between your true self and what is not yourself leads you without doubt to the deeper reality.
vishnu_gita::635.simple_insight: There's clarity and confidence in knowing what truly belongs to you and what does not.
vishnu_gita::635.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that by carefully discerning the true self (Atman) from everything else (non-self), one attains certainty and connection to the deeper reality. This wisdom, even when it feels detached or abstract, is the key to liberation.
vishnu_gita::635.modern_relevance: When you pause and clearly notice which thoughts or feelings are really 'you' and which are just passing, your confusion starts to lift.
vishnu_gita::635.insight: It teaches you to actively distinguish your true self from transient experiences, shifting your awareness from identification to clear witnessing.

vishnu_gita::636.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञातुर्ज्ञानस्य सम्बन्धो ज्ञेयस्यापि दिवौकस:।
तत्तथापि समाख्यातं स्वरूपज्ञानकारणम ॥
vishnu_gita::636.verse_hindi: ज्ञाता ज्ञान ज्ञेय रूपी त्रिपुटि से युक्त होने पर भी स्वरूपज्ञान-प्राप्ति का कारण कहा गया है
vishnu_gita::636.english_translation: The knower, the knowledge, and the known together form a triad, yet the knower is called the cause of the knowledge of true nature.
vishnu_gita::636.translation_literal: ज्ञातुः (knower) ज्ञानस्य (of knowledge) सम्बन्धः (relation) ज्ञेयस्यापि (and of the known also) दिवौकसः (triad) तथापि (still) समाख्यातं (declared together) स्वरूपज्ञानकारणम् (cause of true nature knowledge)
vishnu_gita::636.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::636.essence: You, as the knower, are the cause of realizing your true nature beyond knowledge and objects.
vishnu_gita::636.simple_meaning: Knowing, knowledge, and what is known form a triad, but the knower is the cause behind realizing the true nature.
vishnu_gita::636.simple_insight: You can feel empowered knowing you are the source of your deepest understanding.
vishnu_gita::636.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains how the triad of knower, knowledge, and known includes a deeper truth: the knower causes the realization of true nature, highlighting awareness as foundational beyond objects or concepts.
vishnu_gita::636.modern_relevance: When you reflect on your experiences, you see that your awareness shapes how deeply you understand yourself and the world.
vishnu_gita::636.insight: It shifts your view from seeing knowledge as external to recognizing your role as the source of insight.

vishnu_gita::637.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानस्यास्य तटस्थस्य तिस्रो भूम्यः प्रकीर्तिताः ।
आद्यायां भूमिकायान्तु तत्त्वज्ञानी दिवौकसः ! ॥
vishnu_gita::637.verse_hindi: इस तटस्थज्ञान की तीन भूमिकाएँ कही गई हैं। हे देवगण ! प्रथम भूमिका में तत्वज्ञानी जगत
vishnu_gita::637.english_translation: The detached knowledge has three roles. O divine beings! In the first role, the knower of truth is the world.
vishnu_gita::637.translation_literal: ज्ञानस्यास्य (of this knowledge) / तटस्थस्य (detached) / तिस्रो (third) / भूम्यः (roles) / प्रकीर्तिताः (are declared) / आद्यायां (in the first) / भूमिकायान्तु (roles indeed) / तत्त्वज्ञानी (knower of truth) / दिवौकसः (O divine beings) !
vishnu_gita::637.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::637.essence: Detached knowledge functions through three distinct roles, beginning with the knower as the world.
vishnu_gita::637.simple_meaning: Detached knowledge has three roles, and the first role is that the knower of truth is the world.
vishnu_gita::637.simple_insight: Understanding knowledge can have different aspects helps you see its depth.
vishnu_gita::637.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Vishnu explains that detached knowledge functions in three distinct ways, introducing the first role where the knower of truth embodies the world itself, addressing the divine assembly.
vishnu_gita::637.insight: It invites you to recognize that knowledge and its roles vary, shaping how you understand reality.

vishnu_gita::638.verse_sanskrit:
जगतश्च जगाग्तातुर्ज्ञानं लब्ध्वानुमानिकम।
ज्ञानभूम्यां विशालकायां स्र्त्यग्रे न संशय: ॥
vishnu_gita::638.verse_hindi: और जगत्कर्ता का अनुमानिक ज्ञान प्राप्त करके  विशाल ज्ञानभूमि में नि:संदेह अग्रसर होता है।
vishnu_gita::638.english_translation: One who attains inferential knowledge of the creator of the universe advances without doubt into the vast realm of knowledge.
vishnu_gita::638.translation_literal: जगतश्च (and the world) / जगाग्तातुर्ज्ञानं (of the world-creator, knowledge) / लब्ध्वा (having attained) / अनुमानिकम (inferential) / ज्ञानभूम्यां (knowledge realm) / विशालकायां (vast-bodied) / स्र्त्यग्रे (advances forward) / न (not) / संशय: (doubt)
vishnu_gita::638.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::638.essence: Clear, reasoned knowledge of the cosmic source removes doubt and opens vast understanding.
vishnu_gita::638.simple_meaning: By understanding the creator of the universe through reasoning, you confidently move forward into deeper knowledge.
vishnu_gita::638.simple_insight: You can feel certain and steady when your understanding is based on clear reasoning.
vishnu_gita::638.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that gaining inferential knowledge of the universe's creator removes doubt, allowing the seeker to advance confidently into broad, profound wisdom.
vishnu_gita::638.modern_relevance: When you research and understand the root cause of a problem, your confidence to solve it grows without hesitation.
vishnu_gita::638.insight: It shifts your mind from uncertainty to confidence by anchoring knowledge in reason and inference.

vishnu_gita::639.verse_sanskrit:
अत्रव ज्ञानभूमौ ही योगी भोगपरागमुख ।
वैराग्यं विषयान्नूनं लभते च विषोपमात् ॥
vishnu_gita::639.verse_hindi: इसी ज्ञानभूमि में योगी भोगपराङ्मुख होकर विषतुल्य विषयो से वैराग्य को भी निःसन्देह ही प्राप्त होता है
vishnu_gita::639.english_translation: In this field of wisdom, the yogi, turning away from pleasure, surely attains detachment even from pleasures as poisonous as poison.
vishnu_gita::639.translation_literal: अत्रव (here) / ज्ञानभूमौ (in the field of knowledge) / ही (indeed) / योगी (the yogi) / भोगपरागमुख (turned toward intense pleasure) / वैराग्यं (detachment) / विषयान्नूनं (certainly from objects) / लभते (attains) / च (also) / विषोपमात् (like poison)
vishnu_gita::639.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::639.essence: Detachment arises naturally when you turn away from pleasure, even from desires as poisonous as poison.
vishnu_gita::639.simple_meaning: When a yogi turns away from seeking pleasure, they naturally gain detachment even from things as harmful as poison.
vishnu_gita::639.simple_insight: Relief comes from realizing true detachment means not being harmed by even the most tempting desires.
vishnu_gita::639.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that in the realm of wisdom, a yogi who turns away from indulgence gradually attains detachment, even from desires that seem as toxic as poison. This verse shows detachment is not just avoiding pleasure but overcoming its hidden harms.
vishnu_gita::639.modern_relevance: You might resist small temptations, yet still feel trapped by deeper cravings that poison your peace without you noticing.
vishnu_gita::639.insight: It shifts your view from just avoiding pleasure to recognizing and releasing the hidden toxicity in all desires.

vishnu_gita::640.verse_sanskrit:
योगी भूमौ द्वितीयायां क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोस्तथा ।
सम्यगज्ञानमवाप्नोति नास्त्यत्र प्रच्युतर्भयम् ॥
vishnu_gita::640.verse_hindi: दूसरी भूमि के क्षेत्र और क्षेत्रज्ञ का सम्यक ज्ञान प्राप्त करता है और इस भूमि में योगी के लिए पतन का भय नहीं है
vishnu_gita::640.english_translation: On the second plane, the yogi attains correct knowledge of the field and the knower of the field, and there is no fear of falling there.
vishnu_gita::640.translation_literal: योगी (yogi) / भूमौ (on the plane) / द्वितीयायां (second) / क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोः (of the field and the knower of the field) / तथा (also) / सम्यगज्ञानम् (correct knowledge) / अवाप्नोति (attains) / नास्ति (there is not) / अत्र (here) / प्रच्युता (falling) / भयम् (fear)
vishnu_gita::640.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::640.essence: True knowledge of self and world removes the fear of falling on the higher plane.
vishnu_gita::640.simple_meaning: The yogi who understands both the changing world and the unchanging observer deeply has no fear of failure on this higher plane.
vishnu_gita::640.simple_insight: Knowing what you truly are frees you from fear of losing ground.
vishnu_gita::640.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes a yogi who, on the second plane of realization, clearly perceives the distinction between the outer world (field) and the inner witness (knower). This clarity removes the fear of slipping or failure in spiritual progress.
vishnu_gita::640.modern_relevance: When you clearly understand your role and your true self beyond changing circumstances, you stop fearing setbacks at work or in life.
vishnu_gita::640.insight: It shifts attention from being caught in outcomes to steady awareness of what is stable and real.

vishnu_gita::641.verse_sanskrit:
भूमिकायां तृतीयायां योगी योगसमुन्नतः ।
मदीयाद्वैतसत्तां हि ज्ञानेनानुभवन् किल ॥
vishnu_gita::641.verse_hindi: तीसरी भूमि में योगसमुन्नत योगी मेरी अद्वैत  सत्ता का ज्ञान के द्वारा ही अनुभव करता हुआ निष्पाप होक
vishnu_gita::641.english_translation: On the third plane, the elevated yogi experiences my non-dual reality through knowledge, becoming pure.
vishnu_gita::641.translation_literal: भूमिकायां (on the plane) तृतीयायां (third) योगी (yogi) योगसमुन्नतः (yoga-elevated) मदीयाद्वैतसत्तां (my non-dual reality) हि (indeed) ज्ञानेनानुभवन् (through knowledge experiencing) किल (certainly)
vishnu_gita::641.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::641.essence: True wisdom reveals the pure, non-dual reality within and transforms the yogi profoundly.
vishnu_gita::641.simple_meaning: An advanced yogi on the third spiritual level experiences the divine non-dual reality through knowledge, becoming pure and free from faults.
vishnu_gita::641.simple_insight: There's clarity and purity when you truly know the deepest reality beyond duality.
vishnu_gita::641.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Vishnu describes the third spiritual plane where a yogi, elevated through disciplined practice, experiences Vishnu’s non-dual reality directly through wisdom, thus becoming pure and free from error or impurity.
vishnu_gita::641.modern_relevance: When you deeply understand your true self beyond everyday distractions, clarity and purity naturally arise.
vishnu_gita::641.insight: It teaches you to seek direct knowledge of your true nature, which purifies your experience and being.

vishnu_gita::642.verse_sanskrit:
मत्स्वरूपाग्रगो देवाः ! भवन् विगतकिल्विषः।
भूत्वा योगपदारूढो लभते कृतकृत्यताम् ॥
vishnu_gita::642.verse_hindi: हे देवगण !  मेरे स्वस्वरूप की ओर अग्रसर होता हुश्रा योगारूढ़ होकर कृतकृत्यता को प्राप्त करता है
vishnu_gita::642.english_translation: O radiant beings! Advancing toward my true nature, one who ascends the path of yoga attains freedom from regret.
vishnu_gita::642.translation_literal: मत् (my) स्वरूप (true nature) अग्रगो (foremost) देवाः (divine beings) ! भवन् (become) विगतकिल्विषः (free of blame) । भूत्वा (having become) योगपदारूढः (ascended the path of yoga) लभते (attains) कृतकृत्यताम् (freedom from regret) ॥
vishnu_gita::642.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::642.essence: Advancing on yoga’s path toward your true self ends regret and self-blame.
vishnu_gita::642.simple_meaning: When you follow the path of yoga toward your true self, you become free from regret and blame.
vishnu_gita::642.simple_insight: There is relief in knowing that connecting with your true nature ends remorse and self-blame.
vishnu_gita::642.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses radiant beings, explaining that progressing toward his essential nature by practicing yoga leads to complete freedom from feelings of regret and guilt.
vishnu_gita::642.modern_relevance: You’ve tried hard and made peace with your choices; now you can let go of self-judgment and move forward.
vishnu_gita::642.insight: It teaches you to focus on inner growth through yoga to dissolve regret and blame.

vishnu_gita::643.verse_sanskrit:
एतदेव फलं भूमेस्तृतीयाया दिवौकसः।
अन्तिमं हिं विनिर्दिष्टं तत्त्वज्ञानविशारदः ॥
vishnu_gita::643.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! इस तीसरी भूमि का यही अंतिम फल तत्वज्ञान विशारदों ने कहा है
vishnu_gita::643.english_translation: O divine beings! This third land is its ultimate fruit, as declared by experts in true knowledge.
vishnu_gita::643.translation_literal: एतदेव (this indeed) फलं (fruit/result) भूमेः (of the land) तृतीयाया (third) दिवौकसः (divine beings) अन्तिमं (ultimate) हि (indeed) विनिर्दिष्टं (declared) तत्त्वज्ञानविशारदः (experts in true knowledge)
vishnu_gita::643.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::643.essence: Experts in true knowledge define the ultimate fruit of this third land.
vishnu_gita::643.simple_meaning: The divine beings say that the final result or essence of this third land is what the experts in true knowledge have declared.
vishnu_gita::643.simple_insight: Knowing the ultimate result of a place or effort gives clarity and direction.
vishnu_gita::643.detailed_meaning: The divine assembly listens as the narrator states that learned experts in true knowledge have identified the ultimate fruit or outcome of the third land. It is a report of a conclusion, not a teaching itself.
vishnu_gita::643.insight: It shows the importance of respecting expert knowledge but does not itself teach a principle.

vishnu_gita::644.verse_sanskrit:
द्विधा मत्प्रकृतिभिन्ना विद्ययाऽविद्यया तथा।
अविद्या कारणं सृष्टेबन्धनस्यापि जायते ॥
vishnu_gita::644.verse_hindi: मेरी प्रकृति के दो भेद हैं, विद्या और अविद्या। अविद्या सिष्टि और बंधन का कारण होती है
vishnu_gita::644.english_translation: My nature has two aspects, wisdom and deep confusion; deep confusion causes creation and bondage.
vishnu_gita::644.translation_literal: द्विधा (twofold) मत् (my) प्रकृतिः (nature) भिन्ना (distinct) विद्यया (by wisdom) अविद्यया (by deep confusion) तथा (also). अविद्या (deep confusion) कारणं (cause) सृष्टेः (of creation) बन्धनस्य (of bondage) अपि (also) जायते (arises).
vishnu_gita::644.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::644.essence: Two forces in nature — wisdom and confusion — shape creation and bondage.
vishnu_gita::644.simple_meaning: Your nature has two parts: clear understanding and deep confusion. Confusion causes the cycle of creation and binding.
vishnu_gita::644.simple_insight: It feels hopeful to know confusion is part of nature and not permanent.
vishnu_gita::644.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that within his nature exist two distinct forces: wisdom, which is clear understanding, and deep confusion, which causes the ongoing cycle of creation and bondage. This teaching reveals the root of suffering and the possibility of freedom.
vishnu_gita::644.modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or overwhelmed, this reminds you that confusion is natural but not the whole truth within you.
vishnu_gita::644.insight: Recognize confusion as a natural force causing struggle; seek wisdom to loosen its grip.

vishnu_gita::645.verse_sanskrit:
साहाय्येन तु विद्याया योगी मुक्तोऽथ बन्धनात् ।
देवाः ! सृष्टेलयं कुर्वन् क्षिप्रं मामेति निश्चितम् ॥
vishnu_gita::645.verse_hindi: और विद्या की सहायता से योगी बन्धन से मुक्त होकर हे देवगण ! सृष्टि का विलय करता हुआ शीघ्र मुझको ही प्राप्त होता है
vishnu_gita::645.english_translation: With the help of knowledge, the yogi is freed from bondage and quickly merges with creation, surely reaching me, O radiant beings!
vishnu_gita::645.translation_literal: साहाय्येन (with help) तु (indeed) विद्यया (by knowledge) योगी (the yogi) मुक्तः (freed) अथ (then) बन्धनात् (from bondage) । देवाः (O radiant beings) ! सृष्टेलयं (this creation) कुर्वन् (making) क्षिप्रं (quickly) माम् (me) एति (reaches) निश्चितम् (certainly) ॥
vishnu_gita::645.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::645.essence: Knowledge frees the yogi from bondage and swiftly brings reunion with the whole creation.
vishnu_gita::645.simple_meaning: Using knowledge, a yogi frees themselves from bonds and quickly merges with the entire creation.
vishnu_gita::645.simple_insight: There is hope and certainty in knowing that understanding leads to freedom and reunion.
vishnu_gita::645.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that with knowledge as a guide, the yogi overcomes all ties that bind them. This moment promises swift liberation and union with the cosmic whole, assuring the yogi will reach the divine source.
vishnu_gita::645.modern_relevance: When you gain clear understanding, you can let go of what traps you and feel a quick return to your true nature.
vishnu_gita::645.insight: It shifts your view from being stuck in limitations to seeing that knowledge can rapidly free you.

vishnu_gita::646.verse_sanskrit:
अमानित्य मद्म्भित्वमहिंसा क्षन्तिर्राजवम ।
आचार्योपासनं शौच स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः ॥
vishnu_gita::646.verse_hindi: आत्मश्लाघाराहित्य, दम्भहीनता, परपीड़ात्याग, सहिष्णुता, सरलता, गुरुसेवा, अन्तःशुचिता और बहिःशुचिता, स्थिरता, मनः संयम
vishnu_gita::646.english_translation: Humility without self-praise, freedom from hypocrisy, non-violence, patience, simplicity, service to the teacher, inner and outer purity, steadiness, and self-restraint.
vishnu_gita::646.translation_literal: अमानित्य (without pride) / मद्भित्वम् (self-praise) / अहिंसा (non-violence) / क्षन्ति (patience) / रजवम् (simplicity) / आचार्योपासनम् (service to the teacher) / शौच (purity) / स्थैर्यम् (steadiness) / आत्मविनिग्रहः (self-restraint)
vishnu_gita::646.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::646.essence: True discipline is a steady practice of humility, patience, purity, and self-control.
vishnu_gita::646.simple_meaning: You should cultivate qualities like humility, patience, non-violence, simplicity, respect for your teacher, purity inside and out, steadiness, and self-control.
vishnu_gita::646.simple_insight: You feel grounded and steady when living with humility and patience.
vishnu_gita::646.detailed_meaning: Vishnu outlines key virtues that form a disciplined character: humility without pride, avoiding hypocrisy, practicing non-violence and patience, simplicity, honoring the teacher, maintaining inner and outer purity, keeping steady, and exercising self-restraint.
vishnu_gita::646.modern_relevance: You stay calm and clear when tensions rise, choosing patience, humility, and self-control over reaction.
vishnu_gita::646.insight: It teaches you to build lasting inner strength through steady humility and disciplined self-restraint.

vishnu_gita::647.verse_hindi: विषयों में वैराग्य, अहङ्कारराहित्य, जन्म मृत्यु जरा और व्याधि दुःख और दोष का अनुदर्शन अर्थात् स्पष्ट उपलब्धि,
vishnu_gita::647.english_translation: Detachment from sensory objects, freedom from ego, and clear seeing of birth, death, aging, disease, pain, and faults.
vishnu_gita::647.translation_literal: इन्द्रियार्थेषु (in sensory objects) / वैराग्यम् (detachment) / अनहङ्कार (without ego) / एव (indeed) / च (and) / जन्म (birth) / मृत्युः (death) / जरा (aging) / व्याधि (disease) / दुःख (pain) / दोषान् (faults) / अनु-दर्शनम् (clear seeing)
vishnu_gita::647.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::647.essence: True detachment arises by dissolving ego and clearly seeing life’s unavoidable sufferings.
vishnu_gita::647.simple_meaning: You become detached from desires and the ego, clearly understanding the realities of birth, death, aging, sickness, pain, and faults.
vishnu_gita::647.simple_insight: There is peace in seeing life’s inevitable changes without ego’s interference.
vishnu_gita::647.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes the wisdom of withdrawing attachment from sensory pleasures and dissolving ego, while fully recognizing the unavoidable realities of life’s cycle: birth, death, aging, sickness, pain, and faults.
vishnu_gita::647.modern_relevance: When you face illness or loss, releasing ego and seeing these as natural helps you stay calm and centered.
vishnu_gita::647.insight: It teaches you to observe life’s challenges objectively, without ego, fostering true detachment and clarity.

vishnu_gita::648.verse_hindi: पुत्र स्त्री गृह आदि में अनासक्ति और उनके सुख दुःख में सुखी दुःखी न होना, इष्ट और अनिष्ट की प्राप्ति होने पर सर्वदा चित्त की समानता,
vishnu_gita::648.english_translation: Be unattached to sons, wives, and homes; remain always steady in mind through pleasure and pain, through gain and loss.
