vishnu_gita::790.insight: It shifts your view from trying to grasp everything to accepting the infinite presence beyond mind’s limits.

vishnu_gita::791.verse_sanskrit:
गुरो ! जगत्कारण ! ते शरीरा द्वैतरूपात्तव शक्तिराया।
याऽचिन्तनीया प्रकटत्वमेति ब्रह्माण्डमेषा तनुते ह्यनन्तम् ॥
vishnu_gita::791.verse_hindi: हे जगत्कारण ! हे गुरो! अद्वैतरूप आपके शरीर से जो आपकी अचिन्तनीया आद्या शक्ति प्रकट होती है वही अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डो का विस्तार करती है
vishnu_gita::791.english_translation: O cause of the world, O teacher! From your twofold body arises your inconceivable primal power that manifests and expands into the infinite universe.
vishnu_gita::791.translation_literal: गुरो (O teacher) / जगत्कारण (cause of the world) / ते (your) / शरीरा (body) / द्वैतरूपात् (twofold form) / तव (your) / शक्तिराया (power) / या (which) / अचिन्तनीया (inconceivable) / प्रकटत्वमेति (manifests) / ब्रह्माण्डम् (universe) / एषा (this) / तनुते (expands) / हि (indeed) / अनन्तम् (infinite)
vishnu_gita::791.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::791.essence: The infinite universe unfolds from an inconceivable primal power in the twofold body.
vishnu_gita::791.simple_meaning: Your twofold body reveals a primal power that brings forth and spreads the infinite universe.
vishnu_gita::791.simple_insight: The vast universe unfolds from a power beyond ordinary thought connected to the divine.
vishnu_gita::791.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses the cosmic teacher, describing how from the teacher's twofold body arises a primal, inconceivable power. This power manifests and extends as the infinite cosmos itself, highlighting the divine source behind all creation.
vishnu_gita::791.insight: It shifts the view from seeing the universe as separate to seeing it as an unfolding power within the divine source.

vishnu_gita::792.verse_sanskrit:
पूर्व महत्तत्त्ववराभिमानी जातस्ततोऽहतितत्त्वमानी।
देवस्ततो मानसतत्त्वमानी निर्माति चोत्लद्य विचित्रदृश्यम् ॥
vishnu_gita::792.verse_hindi: पहले श्रेष्ठ महत्तत्त्वका अभिमानी देवता प्रकट होता है, अनन्तर अहङ्कार तत्त्व का अभिमानी देवता और उसके पश्चात् मानस तत्त्व का अभिमानी देवता प्रकट होकर विचित्र दृश्य की रचना करते हैं
vishnu_gita::792.english_translation: First appears the proud great principle, then the proud principle of ego, followed by the proud principle of mind, creating a wondrous vision.
vishnu_gita::792.translation_literal: पूर्व (first) महत्तत्त्ववराभिमानी (proud of the great principle) जात (born) ततः (then) अहतितत्त्वमानी (proud of ego principle) देव (deva) ततः (then) मानसतत्त्वमानी (proud of mind principle) निर्माति (creates) च (and) उत्त्लद्य (wonderful) विचित्रदृश्यम् (strange vision)
vishnu_gita::792.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::792.essence: Your mind and ego proudly create the confusing illusions you take as reality.
vishnu_gita::792.simple_meaning: Your mind and ego create complex illusions that feel real, shaping how you see the world.
vishnu_gita::792.simple_insight: There’s wonder and confusion in how your mind and ego fabricate your experience.
vishnu_gita::792.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes how cosmic principles emerge in sequence: first the great principle, then ego, then mind, each proud and active, together crafting the complex, bewildering world we perceive.
vishnu_gita::792.modern_relevance: When you replay worries or stories in your head, you’re watching how mind and ego invent confusing realities.
vishnu_gita::792.insight: It teaches you to see your mental stories as constructed illusions, not absolute truths.

vishnu_gita::793.verse_sanskrit:
ततः क्रमेणैव सुरा इमे सदा तन्मात्रतत्त्वस्य किलाभिमानिन: ।
ज्ञानेन्द्रियाणामथ येऽभिमानिनः कर्मेन्द्रियाणामाप येऽभिमानिनः ॥
vishnu_gita::793.verse_hindi: उसी क्रम से ही पञ्चतन्मात्रा के अभिमानी देवता, पञ्चज्ञानेन्द्रिय और पञ्चकम्मेन्द्रिय के अभिमानी देवता और
vishnu_gita::793.english_translation: In that same order are the gods proud of the five subtle elements, the senses of knowledge, and the senses of action.
vishnu_gita::793.translation_literal: ततः (then) क्रमेणैव (in that very order) सुरा (gods) इमे (these) सदा (always) तन्मात्रतत्त्वस्य (of the subtle elements) किलाभिमानिन: (indeed proud) । ज्ञानेन्द्रियाणाम् (of the senses of knowledge) अथ (and) येऽभिमानिन: (those proud) कर्मेन्द्रियाणाम् (of the senses of action) आप (also) येऽभिमानिन: (proud) ॥
vishnu_gita::793.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::793.essence: Pride arises sequentially in subtle elements, knowledge senses, and action senses.
vishnu_gita::793.simple_meaning: Certain divine beings take pride in the five subtle elements, the senses of knowledge, and the senses of action, in that order.
vishnu_gita::793.simple_insight: Pride arises even in subtle aspects of our nature, like senses and elements.
vishnu_gita::793.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes how various divine beings take pride sequentially in foundational aspects of existence: first the subtle elements, then the senses of knowledge, and finally the senses of action, revealing layers of identification and ego even among divine forces.
vishnu_gita::793.insight: It reveals how identification with subtle faculties can cause pride, affecting behavior and perception.

vishnu_gita::794.verse_sanskrit:
य पञ्चभूतैकपराभिमानिन स्त त्वच्छरीरादभिजायमानाः।
नास्तिस्वरूपाजगतोऽस्तिभावं प्रकुर्वते ते गहनप्रभावः ॥
vishnu_gita::794.verse_hindi: पञ्चमहाभूतों के परम अभिमानी देवता यह सभी सदा आपके शरीर से प्रकट होते हुए जगत को नास्ति रूप से आस्ति रूप में कर देते हैं; आपका प्रभाव गहन अर्थात महान है
vishnu_gita::794.english_translation: The lord who is the supreme controller of the five great elements manifests all from your body, transforming nothingness into existence; your influence is profound and vast.
vishnu_gita::794.translation_literal: य (who) / पञ्चभूत (five elements) / ऐकपराभिमानिन (supreme controller) / स्त (is) / त्वच्छरीरात् (from your body) / अभिजायमानाः (manifested) । नास्ति (non-existence) / स्वरूपा (true form) / जगतः (of the world) / अस्ति (existence) / भावं (state) / प्रकुर्वते (make) / ते (your) / गहनप्रभावः (profound influence) ॥
vishnu_gita::794.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::794.essence: All existence emerges from a profound source beyond visible form.
vishnu_gita::794.simple_meaning: The supreme controller of the five great elements shows all creation appearing from your body, turning non-existence into existence through your deep power.
vishnu_gita::794.simple_insight: There is awe in the vast power that brings all existence from the unseen.
vishnu_gita::794.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes the supreme being as the controller of the five elements, manifesting creation from the divine body, turning nothingness into the world, highlighting the immense mysterious power behind existence.
vishnu_gita::794.insight: It reveals that everything visible arises from a deep hidden source beyond form or shape.

vishnu_gita::795.verse_sanskrit:
शक्तिस्तवाचिन्सविभावशालिनी स्वस्यां तनौ सर्वलयं प्रकुर्वती ।
त्वय्येव ने विलयं वितन्वती प्रपातयत्यत्र विचित्रतासु नः ॥
vishnu_gita::795.verse_hindi: आपकी अचिन्त्य प्रभावशालिनी शक्ति अपने शरीर में सभी का लय करती हुई अपना विलय आप ही में करती हुई हमको यहां विचित्रता में गिरा रही है अर्थात् हमको आश्चर्य में डुबा रही है
vishnu_gita::795.english_translation: Your inconceivable, powerful energy dissolves all within itself in your own form, yet by you alone it does not vanish and instead casts us into wonder here.
vishnu_gita::795.translation_literal: शक्तिस्तवाचिन् (power of you) / सविभावशालिनी (all-nature-possessing) / स्वस्यां (within itself) / तनौ (body) / सर्वलयं (all dissolution) / प्रकुर्वती (causing) / त्वय्येव (by you alone) / ने (not) / विलयं (disappearance) / वितन्वती (spreading) / प्रपातयति (causes to fall) / अत्र (here) / विचित्रतासु (in wonders) / नः (us)
vishnu_gita::795.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::795.essence: The divine power absorbs all without disappearing, inspiring wonder within us.
vishnu_gita::795.simple_meaning: The divine's immense power dissolves everything within itself but does not disappear; instead, it fills us with awe in this strange world.
vishnu_gita::795.simple_insight: There is awe in recognizing a power that contains all yet remains present.
vishnu_gita::795.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes how his unfathomable power pervades and dissolves all forms within his own being, yet this power does not vanish but causes wonder and amazement among beings caught in the world's mysteries.
vishnu_gita::795.insight: It reveals that true power transcends disappearance and instead invites curiosity and wonder about existence.

vishnu_gita::796.verse_sanskrit:
कुर्वन्ति सम्भूय जनि स्थिति लयम् ।
ब्रह्माण्डकस्याप्यमितस्य सर्वथा चराचरस्यागतचित्रताजुषः॥
vishnu_gita::796.verse_hindi: आपसे ही अनन्त ब्रह्मा विष्णु और महेश प्रकट होकर आश्चर्ययुक्त विचित्रतापूर्ण चराचरमय अनंत ब्रह्मांडों की उत्पत्ति, स्थिति और लय का भी सर्वथा विधान करते हैं
vishnu_gita::796.english_translation: From you alone, infinite Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh emerge, governing the creation, maintenance, and dissolution of countless wondrous moving and unmoving universes.
vishnu_gita::796.translation_literal: कुर्वन्ति (do) / सम्भूय (arising from) / जनि (birth/origin) / स्थिति (maintenance) / लयम् (dissolution) / ब्रह्माण्डकस्य (of universes) / अप्यमितस्य (countless) / सर्वथा (completely) / चराचरस्य (moving and unmoving) / आगतचित्रताजुषः (wondrous and full of variety)
vishnu_gita::796.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::796.essence: All creation and dissolution arise from one supreme source manifesting as cosmic functions.
vishnu_gita::796.simple_meaning: The divine beings Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh come from the supreme source and fully control the endless creation, sustaining, and destruction of all that moves and does not move.
vishnu_gita::796.simple_insight: Everything you see, all creation and endings, flow from one supreme source beyond ordinary understanding.
vishnu_gita::796.detailed_meaning: Suta describes how from the supreme being arise the three great divine forms: Brahma (creator), Vishnu (sustainer), and Mahesh (destroyer). They oversee all the endless universes, each full of countless living and non-living beings, guiding their birth, existence, and dissolution.
vishnu_gita::796.insight: Recognize that the vast cycles of change and stability around you reflect a deeper source beyond appearances.

vishnu_gita::797.verse_sanskrit:
केचिद्यथा वालगणा रजोगृहं निर्मान्त्यवन्त्यन्य इदं तथाऽपरे ।
विनाशयन्तीति वयं तवाधुना पश्याम इत्थं वपुषि ध्रुवं प्रभो ! ॥
vishnu_gita::797.verse_hindi: हे प्रभो ! जैसे कोई बालक धूलिका घर बनाते हैं, कोई उसकी रक्षा करते हैं और अन्य कोई उसको नष्ट कर देते हैं; उसी प्रकार हम निश्चय इस समय आपके शरीर में ब्रह्मांडों की उत्पत्ति,  स्थिति और लयके विषय को देख रहे हैं
vishnu_gita::797.english_translation: O Lord! Just as children build, protect, and destroy a sandcastle, we now surely see the creation, preservation, and dissolution of universes within your body.
vishnu_gita::797.translation_literal: केचिद्यथा (some like) / वालगणा (children) / रजोगृहं (sandcastle) / निर्मान्त्यन्ति (build) / अन्ये (others) / इदं (this) / तथाऽपरे (thus others) / विनाशयन्ति (destroy) / इति (thus) / वयं (we) / तवाधुना (by your presence) / पश्याम (see) / इत्थं (like this) / वपुषि (in the body) / ध्रुवं (certainly) / प्रभो (O Lord)
vishnu_gita::797.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::797.essence: The cosmos cycles like children building and destroying a sandcastle inside the divine.
vishnu_gita::797.simple_meaning: We observe the universe's creation, maintenance, and destruction occurring within the divine body, like children building and destroying a sandcastle.
vishnu_gita::797.simple_insight: The vast cosmic cycles are like a child's play — temporary and ever-changing.
vishnu_gita::797.detailed_meaning: The speaker marvels at witnessing cosmic cycles of creation and destruction inside the divine form, comparing this vast process to children playing with a sandcastle, highlighting impermanence.
vishnu_gita::797.insight: It shifts perspective from seeing the universe as fixed to understanding it as transient and playful.

vishnu_gita::798.verse_sanskrit:
रुद्राश्च सर्वे वसवश्च निर्जरा आदित्यसंघा मघवा प्रजापतिः।
विश्वेसरा वायुगसंख्यकामरा दैत्या ह्यनन्ताः पितरस्तथर्षयः ॥
vishnu_gita::798.verse_hindi: एकादश रूद्र गण, द्वादश आदित्यगण, अष्ट वसुदेवता गण, इन्द्र, प्रजापति, विश्वेदेवा, वायु, ये सब असंख्य देवंगण, अनन्त ऋषि एवं पितृगण और अनन्त असुरगण सभी
vishnu_gita::798.english_translation: All eleven Rudras, twelve Adityas, eight Vasus, Indra, Prajapati, Vishvedevas, Vayu, countless divine beings, infinite sages, ancestors, and countless shadow beings.
vishnu_gita::798.translation_literal: रुद्राश्च (and Rudras) सर्वे (all) वसवश्च (and Vasus) निर्जरा (countless) आदित्यसंघा (groups of Adityas) मघवा (Māghavas) प्रजापतिः (Prajapati) विश्वेसरा (all-lords) वायुगसंख्यकामरा (Vayu and countless Asuras) दैत्या (Daityas) हि (indeed) अनन्ताः (infinite) पितरस्तथर्षयः (ancestors and sages)
vishnu_gita::798.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::798.essence: A vast assembly of cosmic beings, sages, and ancestors surrounds great events.
vishnu_gita::798.simple_meaning: This verse lists many divine and cosmic beings, sages, ancestors, and shadow beings gathered or present.
vishnu_gita::798.simple_insight: Great forces beyond count surround the cosmic story, shaping the world in countless ways.
vishnu_gita::798.detailed_meaning: Suta narrates a grand scene where countless divine groups like Rudras, Adityas, Vasus, and others, along with infinite sages and ancestors, are all present, emphasizing the vast cosmic assembly.
vishnu_gita::798.insight: Recognize the vast, interconnected presence behind any great moment or teaching.

vishnu_gita::799.verse_sanskrit:
त्वतकायजास्त्वां बहुधा यतन्ते ज्ञातुं परन्ते न हि पारयन्ते।
अतो विमुग्धास्तव मायया ते पुनर्विशन्त्येत्य तवैव काये ॥
vishnu_gita::799.verse_hindi: आपके शरीर से प्रकट होकर आपको जानने के लिये अनेक प्रकार से यत्न करते हैं परन्तु वह पार नहीं पाते हैं इसलिये आपकी माया से विमुग्ध होकर वह  फिर भी जाकर आपके ही शरीर में प्रवेश कर जाते हैं।
vishnu_gita::799.english_translation: Many strive in various ways to know you through your body but cannot cross beyond; thus, bewildered by your illusion, they re-enter your own body again.
vishnu_gita::799.translation_literal: त्वतकायजाः (from your body) त्वां (you) बहुधा (in many ways) यतन्ते (strive) ज्ञातुं (to know) परन्ते (beyond) न (not) हि (indeed) पारयन्ते (cross). अतः (therefore) विमुग्धाः (bewildered) तव (your) मायया (illusion) ते (they) पुनः (again) विशन्ति (enter) एत (this) तवैव (your own) काये (body).
vishnu_gita::799.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::799.essence: Apparent forms cannot reveal the true self; illusion causes repeated confusion and return.
vishnu_gita::799.simple_meaning: Many try to understand you by your body but cannot reach beyond it; confused by illusion, they fall back into the same form.
vishnu_gita::799.simple_insight: It feels like something essential always slips beyond grasp, despite all efforts to know it.
vishnu_gita::799.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that many beings attempt to understand the true self by focusing on the physical form but fail to transcend it. Bewildered by maya, or illusion, they keep returning to the same limited understanding, trapped in the cycle of confusion.
vishnu_gita::799.modern_relevance: You seek to understand someone's true nature but get stuck judging by appearances, missing the deeper reality beneath.
vishnu_gita::799.insight: It teaches to look beyond physical forms and illusions to perceive what is truly ungraspable by surface means.

vishnu_gita::800.verse_sanskrit:
कारणं कारणानां त्वमेवाक्षरं ब्रह्म विज्ञेयमेकं त्वमेवास्यहो।
आश्रयस्थानमेकं निधानं परं विश्वसङ्घस्य जानन्ति ते कोविदाः ॥
vishnu_gita::800.verse_hindi: अहो ! आप ही कारणों के कारण हैं, आप ही अक्षर (अविनाशी) परब्रह्म हैं और एक आप ही जानने के योग्य हैं, एक आप ही विश्वसमूह के आश्रय स्थान और परम रक्षा स्थान हैं, इस बात को प्रसिद्ध पण्डितगण जानते हैं
vishnu_gita::800.english_translation: You are the cause of all causes, the imperishable supreme reality, the sole one worthy of knowledge, the refuge and ultimate shelter of the entire universe, as wise scholars understand.
vishnu_gita::800.translation_literal: कारणं (cause) कारणानां (of causes) त्वमेवाक्षरं (you alone imperishable) ब्रह्म (supreme reality) विज्ञेयम् (to be known) एकं (one) त्वमेव (you alone) अस्य (of this) अहो (ah!) आश्रयस्थानम् (refuge) एकं (one) निधानं (ultimate shelter) परं (supreme) विश्वसङ्घस्य (of the universe) जानन्ति (know) ते (those) कोविदाः (wise scholars)
vishnu_gita::800.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::800.essence: Everything originates and rests in one imperishable supreme source known by the wise.
vishnu_gita::800.simple_meaning: You are the origin of all causes, the unchanging supreme reality, and the ultimate refuge for the entire universe, known by wise scholars.
vishnu_gita::800.simple_insight: There is a deep reassurance in knowing everything ultimately rests in one unchanging source.
vishnu_gita::800.detailed_meaning: Vishnu reveals that he alone is the primal cause behind all causes, the eternal supreme reality beyond decay, and the sole refuge for everything. Wise sages recognize this foundational truth during this cosmic teaching.
vishnu_gita::800.modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic and uncertain, recognizing a single unshakable source beneath it all can bring profound calm and clarity.
vishnu_gita::800.insight: It invites you to see beyond surface causes and rest your understanding in an unchanging foundation.

vishnu_gita::801.verse_sanskrit:
त्वमव्यय: शाश्वतधर्म गोप्ता सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो नः।
प्रभोऽतितेजोमयमादिहीन मनन्तमप्येकमनेकवर्णम् ॥
vishnu_gita::801.verse_hindi: आप विकार रहित हैं, सनातन धर्म के रक्षक हैं और आप सनातन पुरुष है, यह हमारा मत है । हे प्रभो ! आप के अतितेजोमय, आदिहीन, अनन्त होने पर भी एक, अनेकवर्ण
vishnu_gita::801.english_translation: You are imperishable, the eternal guardian of the timeless dharma, the eternal being as we understand. O Lord! Though infinite, without origin, and beyond brilliance, you manifest in many forms.
vishnu_gita::801.translation_literal: त्वम् (you) अव्ययः (imperishable) शाश्वतधर्म (eternal-dharma) गोप्ता (protector) सनातनः (eternal) त्वम् (you) पुरुषः (being) मतः (opinion) नः (our) । प्रभो (lord) अतितेजोमयम् (beyond brilliance) आदिहीन (without origin) मनन्तम् (endless) अपि (also) एकम् (one) अनेकवर्णम् (many forms) ॥
vishnu_gita::801.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::801.essence: The eternal being is beyond time yet manifests as many forms in unity.
vishnu_gita::801.simple_meaning: You are the eternal protector of the timeless dharma, an imperishable being manifesting in many forms beyond origin and brilliance.
vishnu_gita::801.simple_insight: There is awe in the infinite presence that is both one and many beyond time and change.
vishnu_gita::801.detailed_meaning: The verse praises the divine as the eternal protector of the timeless dharma and the eternal being beyond change. It acknowledges the paradox of this being manifesting in many forms while remaining one and without origin, highlighting cosmic mystery.
vishnu_gita::801.insight: It invites holding the paradox of unity and multiplicity in the divine, expanding how you see identity beyond limits.

vishnu_gita::802.verse_sanskrit:
अचिन्तनीय हवितर्कणीयं किलामिनैरङ्गभरैः सुपूर्णम् ।
पश्यंत आश्चर्यकर प्रदीप्त विराटशरीरं तब विस्मिताः स्मः ॥
vishnu_gita::802.verse_hindi: अचिन्त्य, अवितर्कय, अगणित अवयवों से पूर्ण, विस्मयकर और देदीप्यमान विराट् शरीर को देखते हुए हम विस्मित हो रहे हैं
vishnu_gita::802.english_translation: Seeing the supreme body, inconceivable and beyond reasoning, complete with countless limbs, wondrous and radiant, we stand amazed.
vishnu_gita::802.translation_literal: अचिन्तनीय (inconceivable) / हवितर्कणीयं (beyond reasoning) / किलामिनैः (with countless) / अङ्गभरैः (limbs) / सुपूर्णम् (complete) / पश्यंत (seeing) / आश्चर्यकर (wondrous) / प्रदीप्त (radiant) / विराटशरीरं (supreme body) / तब (then) / विस्मिताः (amazed) / स्मः (we are)
vishnu_gita::802.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::802.essence: Encountering the inconceivable cosmic form inspires deep amazement.
vishnu_gita::802.simple_meaning: We are amazed to see a supreme, radiant body that is beyond thought and filled with countless limbs.
vishnu_gita::802.simple_insight: Some experiences overwhelm the mind and spark awe beyond explanation.
vishnu_gita::802.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the speaker and others witness a cosmic form that defies normal understanding. It is vast, radiant, and composed of innumerable parts, evoking deep amazement and wonder.
vishnu_gita::802.insight: It shows how encountering something truly vast and complex can humble and expand your sense of reality.

vishnu_gita::803.verse_sanskrit:
धृतिन्न विन्दाम इह त्वदीये कायेऽमितॉस्तान्प्रसमीक्ष्य लोकान् ।
प्रसीद देवेश ! जगनिवास ! त्वमेव नः सम्मत आदिदेवः॥
vishnu_gita::803.verse_hindi: हे जगन्निवास! हे देवेश ! इस आपके विराट्  शरीर में उन अगणित लोको को देखकर हम धृति को लाभ नहीं कर रहे हैं, इसलिये आप प्रसन्न हो, हमारा मत है कि आप ही आदिदेव हैं
vishnu_gita::803.english_translation: O Lord of the universe, seeing countless worlds in your vast body, we lack the courage; please be pleased, for we believe you are the primal divine.
vishnu_gita::803.translation_literal: धृतिन्न (courage not found) / विन्दाम (we find) / इह (here) / त्वदीये (in your) / कायेऽमितः (vast body) / तान् (those) / प्रसमीक्ष्य (seeing) / लोकान् (worlds) / प्रसीद (be pleased) / देवेश (Lord of gods) / जगनिवास (Lord of the world) / त्वमेव (you alone) / नः (our) / सम्मत (opinion) / आदिदेवः (primal divine)
vishnu_gita::803.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::803.essence: Trust in the divine begins even when your courage is not yet found.
vishnu_gita::803.simple_meaning: Seeing the vastness of the divine's form, we feel weak and lack courage, so we ask for kindness and affirm our faith in the primal divine.
vishnu_gita::803.simple_insight: It’s okay to feel small and uncertain; trust can come before strength.
vishnu_gita::803.detailed_meaning: At this moment, sages witness Vishnu's cosmic form displaying countless worlds. Overwhelmed, they admit their fear and ask Vishnu to be pleased, expressing their faith that he is the primal divine who sustains everything.
vishnu_gita::803.modern_relevance: You face a challenge so big it shakes your confidence; admitting doubt opens space for trust and support.
vishnu_gita::803.insight: It teaches you to embrace vulnerability and place trust even when courage is absent.

vishnu_gita::804.verse_sanskrit:
अहो किमाश्चर्यमिदं विभाति क्षुद्रात समारभ्य तृणादसीम्नः ।
ब्रह्माण्ड पर्यंतविशालसृष्टे: सृष्टिस्थितिप्रत्यवहारहेतोः॥
vishnu_gita::804.verse_hindi: अहो ! यह क्या चमत्कार शोभायमान हो रहा है । एक क्षुद्र तृण से लेकर ब्रह्माण्डपर्यन्त जो असीम विशाल सृष्टि है उसकी उत्पत्ति, स्थिति और लय के लिये
vishnu_gita::804.english_translation: Wow! What a wonder appears — from a tiny blade of grass to the vast universe, the cause of creation, preservation, and dissolution unfolds.
vishnu_gita::804.translation_literal: अहो (Wow) / किमाश्चर्यमिदं (what a wonder this) / विभाति (appears) / क्षुद्रात (from a tiny) / समारभ्य (beginning) / तृणादसीम्नः (blade of grass to limitless) / ब्रह्माण्ड (universe) / पर्यंतविशालसृष्टेः (extending vast creation) / सृष्टिस्थितिप्रत्यवहारहेतोः (cause of creation, preservation, and dissolution)
vishnu_gita::804.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::804.essence: The vast universe and its cycles arise from the smallest beginnings in a wondrous way.
vishnu_gita::804.simple_meaning: Amazement arises seeing how the entire vast universe unfolds from something as small as a blade of grass, covering creation, maintenance, and destruction.
vishnu_gita::804.simple_insight: The vastness of existence emerges from the smallest beginnings, inspiring awe.
vishnu_gita::804.detailed_meaning: The verse expresses wonder at the cosmic scale, highlighting how everything from the smallest grass blade to the immense universe is involved in the cycle of creation, preservation, and dissolution. It sets a grand scene rather than teaching a specific principle.
vishnu_gita::804.insight: It invites you to see the extraordinary in the ordinary and recognize the vast processes behind everyday life.

vishnu_gita::805.verse_sanskrit:
यथार्भकाः क्रीडनसक्तचित्ता विमोहितास्तन्मयतामुपेताः।
अनेकथाऽनेकविधस्वरूपा स्तथा पृथक् देवगणा नियुक्ताः ॥
vishnu_gita::805.verse_hindi: अनेक प्रकार से अनेक प्रकार के रूप वाले देवतागण ऐसे मोहित और तन्मय होकर पृथक् पृथक् नियुक्त हैं जैसे खेल में आसक्तचित्त बालकगण तन्मय और विमोहित रहते हैं
vishnu_gita::805.english_translation: Like children absorbed and enchanted in play, many divine beings of various forms are separately appointed, absorbed and enchanted in many ways.
vishnu_gita::805.translation_literal: यथा (like) अर्भकाः (children) क्रीडनसक्तचित्ता (play-attached-minded) विमोहिताः (enchanted) तन्मयतामुपेताः (absorbed) । अनेकथा (in many ways) अनेकविधस्वरूपा (of many kinds of forms) तथा (thus) पृथक् (separately) देवगणा (divine beings) नियुक्ताः (appointed) ॥
vishnu_gita::805.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::805.essence: Absorbed like playing children, many divine beings act in varied, devoted forms.
vishnu_gita::805.simple_meaning: Many divine beings of different forms are each absorbed and enchanted in their own way, like children lost in play.
vishnu_gita::805.simple_insight: Sometimes being fully absorbed feels like innocent enchantment, like children at play.
vishnu_gita::805.detailed_meaning: This verse describes divine beings who appear in many forms, each fully absorbed in their own roles, just as children are deeply involved and enchanted when playing. It shows their focused devotion and involvement in their tasks.
vishnu_gita::805.insight: It reveals how absorption can lead to focused dedication, whether in divine roles or human tasks.

vishnu_gita::806.verse_sanskrit:
स्थूलात्स्थूलतरं नित्यं ज्ञानलोचनगोचरम् ।
अनाद्यन्तं विरारूपं दृष्ट्वा ते विभुमदभुतम् ॥
vishnu_gita::806.verse_hindi: ज्ञानदृष्टि से देखने योग्य, स्थूलातिस्थूल, अनादि, अनन्त, नित्य, अद्भुत और व्यापक आपके विराट रूप का दर्शन करके
vishnu_gita::806.english_translation: Seeing your vast, eternal, and wondrous cosmic form with the eye of wisdom reveals something beyond all grossness.
vishnu_gita::806.translation_literal: स्थूलात्स्थूलतरं (gross beyond gross) / नित्यं (eternal) / ज्ञानलोचनगोचरम् (visible to the eye of wisdom) / अनाद्यन्तं (without beginning or end) / विरारूपं (cosmic form) / दृष्ट्वा (seeing) / ते (your) / विभुमदभुतम् (vast and wondrous)
vishnu_gita::806.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::806.essence: Wisdom reveals a vast, eternal cosmic reality beyond gross appearances.
vishnu_gita::806.simple_meaning: With clear wisdom, you can perceive a vast, eternal, and wondrous cosmic form beyond the ordinary.
vishnu_gita::806.simple_insight: There is awe and wonder in seeing beyond appearances with wisdom.
vishnu_gita::806.detailed_meaning: In this moment, Vishnu reveals to the listener a cosmic form that is more than just physical; it is vast, eternal, and beyond ordinary perception, showing the limitless nature of reality through the eye of wisdom.
vishnu_gita::806.modern_relevance: When you pause and look deeper than surface appearances, you experience something vast and timeless beyond your everyday view.
vishnu_gita::806.insight: It teaches you to shift perception from surface to a profound, limitless reality seen through wisdom.

vishnu_gita::807.verse_sanskrit:
अपिचत् परमानन्दो जातो नश्चेतसि प्रभो ! ।
न तथापि वयं दृष्टुं शक्नुयाम बहुक्षणम् ॥
vishnu_gita::807.verse_hindi: हे प्रभो ! यदि हम लोगों के चित्त में परमानन्द की प्राप्ति हुई है परन्तु हमलोग बहुत देर तक इस रूप का दर्शन नहीं कर सकते हैं
vishnu_gita::807.english_translation: O Lord! Even if supreme bliss arises in our mind, we cannot perceive it for long.
vishnu_gita::807.translation_literal: अपि (even) चत् (though) परम (supreme) आनन्दः (bliss) जातः (arises) न (not) अश्चेतसि (in the mind) प्रभो (O Lord) । न (not) तथा (thus) अपि (even) वयम् (we) दृष्टुम् (to see) शक्नुयाम (can) बहुक्षणम् (for long) ॥
vishnu_gita::807.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::807.essence: Supreme bliss can arise in the mind but cannot be sustained or clearly seen for long.
vishnu_gita::807.simple_meaning: Sometimes, even when deep joy arises in your mind, it doesn't stay visible or clear for long.
vishnu_gita::807.simple_insight: There is a gentle sadness in knowing that joy can be fleeting, even when it touches you deeply.
vishnu_gita::807.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the speaker addresses the Lord, noting that supreme bliss can arise in the mind. Yet this joy is elusive and cannot be sustained or clearly perceived for long, highlighting the transient nature of inner happiness.
vishnu_gita::807.modern_relevance: You experience a sudden wave of happiness, but before you can savor it fully, it slips away, leaving you wanting more.
vishnu_gita::807.insight: Recognize that bliss often arises briefly; learning not to cling lets you appreciate its true nature.

vishnu_gita::808.verse_sanskrit:
जीवानां मनसो बुद्धचिोऽगोचरमिन्यहो ।
अपूर्व भवतो रूपमालोक्याश्चर्यमङकुलम् ॥
vishnu_gita::808.verse_hindi: अहो! जीवों के वाणी, मन और बुद्धि से अगोचर इस अपूर्व आप के आश्चर्यमय रूप को देखकर
vishnu_gita::808.english_translation: Wow! Seeing your wondrous form, beyond speech, mind, and intellect, fills me with awe.
vishnu_gita::808.translation_literal: जीवानां (of living beings) मनसो (mind's) बुद्धचिोऽगोचरमिन्यहो (beyond intellect and speech) अपूर्व (unprecedented) भवतो (your) रूपमालोक्य (seeing form) आश्चर्यमङकुलम् (full of wonder)
vishnu_gita::808.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::808.essence: Some truths are beyond speech, mind, and intellect, inspiring pure wonder.
vishnu_gita::808.simple_meaning: Seeing this extraordinary form that no words, mind, or intellect can grasp fills the speaker with deep wonder.
vishnu_gita::808.simple_insight: Some experiences are beyond what words or thoughts can capture, inspiring awe.
vishnu_gita::808.detailed_meaning: The speaker stands before a divine form so extraordinary that it surpasses the limits of speech, mind, and intellect, leaving them amazed and overwhelmed by its wonder.
vishnu_gita::808.insight: Recognize that some realities can only be felt, not fully understood by thinking or speaking.

vishnu_gita::809.verse_sanskrit:
मनो नो मूर्छितं बुद्धिः स्थगिता भवति प्रभो!।
शैथिल्यं यान्ति हे स्वामिनिन्द्रियाण्यखिलानि नः ॥
vishnu_gita::809.verse_hindi: हे स्वामी ! हे प्रभो ! हमारी सभी इन्द्रियां शिथिल. मन मूर्छित और बुद्धि शिथिल होती है
vishnu_gita::809.english_translation: O Lord! Our mind becomes faint, intellect inactive, and all our senses grow weak.
vishnu_gita::809.translation_literal: मनो (mind) नो (our) मूर्छितं (faint) बुद्धिः (intellect) स्थगिता (inactive) भवति (becomes) प्रभो (O Lord)! शैथिल्यं (weakness) यान्ति (go) हे (O) स्वामिन (master) इन्द्रियाणि (senses) अखिलानि (all) नः (our).
vishnu_gita::809.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::809.essence: Mental dullness and sensory weakness signal a need to pause and regain clarity.
vishnu_gita::809.simple_meaning: Your mind becomes dull, your intellect slows, and your senses lose energy when you are overwhelmed or exhausted.
vishnu_gita::809.simple_insight: You recognize the signs when your inner faculties weaken and need care.
vishnu_gita::809.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the speaker addresses the lord, describing how the mind becomes faint, the intellect stops working actively, and all the senses become weak, illustrating a state of inner fatigue or confusion.
vishnu_gita::809.modern_relevance: After hours of nonstop work or stress, you notice your focus slips and your energy fades, making decisions feel harder.
vishnu_gita::809.insight: It teaches you to notice when mental and sensory exhaustion dulls your clarity, signaling the need to pause and restore.

vishnu_gita::810.verse_sanskrit:
अतो वयं हि विश्वात्मन् ! विनीतं प्रार्थयामहे ।
त्वद्विभूतिस्वरूपेषु यद्वन्तं वयं विभो ! ॥
vishnu_gita::810.verse_hindi: इस कारण हे विश्वात्मन् ! हम लोगों की यह विनीत प्रार्थना है कि हे विभो जिसमें हम आपको
vishnu_gita::810.english_translation: Therefore, O universal self, we humbly pray that you reveal yourself in the forms of your divine manifestations in which we reside.
vishnu_gita::810.translation_literal: अतो (therefore) / वयं (we) / हि (indeed) / विश्वात्मन् (universal self) / विनीतं (humble) / प्रार्थयामहे (we pray) / त्वद्विभूतिस्वरूपेषु (in your divine manifestations/forms) / यद्वन्तं (in which we exist) / वयं (we) / विभो (O lord)
vishnu_gita::810.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::810.essence: Humbly asking the universal self to reveal itself in its divine forms where we exist.
vishnu_gita::810.simple_meaning: We humbly ask the universal self to appear in the divine forms where we exist.
vishnu_gita::810.simple_insight: There is a deep longing to connect with the divine presence within all forms.
vishnu_gita::810.detailed_meaning: The speaker addresses the universal self, expressing a humble request to reveal itself through its divine manifestations, acknowledging the presence of the divine in all forms that encompass the speaker and others.
vishnu_gita::810.modern_relevance: You might find yourself quietly asking for clarity or support from a greater presence that feels part of everything around you.
vishnu_gita::810.insight: It encourages opening your heart with humility to perceive the divine presence within all aspects of life.

vishnu_gita::811.verse_sanskrit:
देशे काले च सर्वत्र पात्रे द्रष्टुं यथेशमहे ।
उपदिश्यामहे नाथ ! तथोपायं वयं स्वयम् ॥
vishnu_gita::811.verse_hindi: हे नाथ ! आपकी विभूतियों के रूप में प्रत्येक देश काल पात्र में दर्शन करने में समर्थ हो सकें आप ऐसे उपाय को स्वयं उपदेश दीजिये
vishnu_gita::811.english_translation: O Lord! Please teach us the method by which we can perceive your manifestations everywhere, at all times, and in all beings.
vishnu_gita::811.translation_literal: देशे (in the land) / काले (at the time) / च (and) / सर्वत्र (everywhere) / पात्रे (in the beings) / द्रष्टुं (to see) / यथेशमहे (we can) / उपदिश्यामहे (we shall teach) / नाथ (O Lord) / तथोपायं (such a method) / वयं (we) / स्वयम् (ourselves)
vishnu_gita::811.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::811.essence: Knowing how to see the divine everywhere requires direct teaching and practice.
vishnu_gita::811.simple_meaning: We ask for guidance to recognize the divine presence everywhere, at all times, and in everyone around us.
vishnu_gita::811.simple_insight: You long for a way to see the divine in every moment and every being.
vishnu_gita::811.detailed_meaning: The speaker humbly requests the Lord to teach a means to perceive the divine manifestations universally—in every place, at every time, and in every person—seeking a practical method for such vision.
vishnu_gita::811.modern_relevance: You want to notice the deeper meaning and presence behind everyday people and moments but don’t know how to open your eyes to it.
vishnu_gita::811.insight: It invites shifting perception to recognize divinity beyond form, time, and place.

vishnu_gita::812.verse_sanskrit:
आनन्दः सर्वजीवेषु प्रभाऽस्मि शशिमूर्ययोः ।
प्रणवः सर्व्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे चास्मि निर्जरा ॥
vishnu_gita::812.verse_hindi: समस्त जीवों में मैं आनन्द हूँ, चन्द्रमा और सूर्य में प्रभा हूँ, हे देवगण ! मैं सब वेदों में प्रणव और आकाश में शब्द हूँ
vishnu_gita::812.english_translation: I am the bliss in all living beings, the radiance in the moon and sun, the primal sound in all Vedas, and the word in the sky.
vishnu_gita::812.translation_literal: आनन्दः (bliss) / सर्वजीवेषु (in all living beings) / प्रभाऽस्मि (I am the radiance) / शशिमूर्ययोः (in the moon and sun) / प्रणवः (the primal sound) / सर्व्ववेदेषु (in all Vedas) / शब्दः (the word) / खे (in the sky) / चास्मि (and I am) / निर्जरा (undecaying)
vishnu_gita::812.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::812.essence: Bliss and radiant sound pervade all beings and cosmic elements as their true essence.
vishnu_gita::812.simple_meaning: The divine is the bliss inside all living beings, the shining light of the sun and moon, the sacred sound in ancient knowledge, and the eternal word in the sky.
vishnu_gita::812.simple_insight: You are connected to a vast, radiant presence that shines and sings through all things.
vishnu_gita::812.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares his presence as bliss within every living being, the glowing light in the sun and moon, the primal sacred sound found in the Vedas, and the eternal word that fills the sky. This reveals his all-pervading, radiant nature.
vishnu_gita::812.modern_relevance: When you feel small or alone, remember you carry the same radiant bliss and light that shines in the sun, moon, and ancient wisdom.
vishnu_gita::812.insight: Recognize your true self as the source of joy and radiant presence in all things, beyond physical form.

vishnu_gita::813.verse_sanskrit:
वायो स्पर्शोऽस्मि भो देवाः ! रूपं हुतवहे तथा ।
अप्सु चाहं रसो नूनं सत्यमेतन्न संशयः॥
vishnu_gita::813.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! मैं वायु में स्पर्श, अग्नि में रूप और जल में रस हूँ, यह सत्य ही है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
vishnu_gita::813.english_translation: O radiant beings! I am the touch in the wind, the form in the fire, and the taste in the water; this truth is beyond doubt.
vishnu_gita::813.translation_literal: वायो (in the wind) / स्पर्शोऽस्मि (I am the touch) / भो (O) / देवाः (radiant beings) / रूपं (form) / हुतवहे (in the fire) / तथा (also) / अप्सु (in the water) / चाहं (I am) / रसो (taste) / नूनं (indeed) / सत्यमेतन्न (this is truth) / संशयः (doubt)
vishnu_gita::813.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::813.essence: The divine pervades all elements through touch, form, and taste without doubt.
vishnu_gita::813.simple_meaning: I am present as the touch you feel in the wind, the visible form in the fire, and the taste in water. This is an undeniable truth.
vishnu_gita::813.simple_insight: Everything you experience has the divine's presence in it, always near and real.
vishnu_gita::813.detailed_meaning: Vishnu is revealing his presence within fundamental elements: wind, fire, and water. By expressing this, he shows how the divine pervades all natural phenomena, uniting the seen and felt world as manifestations of one reality.
vishnu_gita::813.insight: Recognize the sacred presence within everyday sensations and natural elements around you.

vishnu_gita::814.verse_sanskrit:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्याञ्च तेजश्चाऽस्मि विभावसौ ।
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चाऽस्मि तपस्विषु ॥
vishnu_gita::814.verse_hindi: पृथिवी में पवित्र गन्ध, अग्नि में तेज, सब भूतों में जीवन और तपस्वियों में तपोरूप हूँ
vishnu_gita::814.english_translation: I am the pure fragrance in the earth, the radiance in fire, life in all beings, and the austerity in ascetics.
vishnu_gita::814.translation_literal: पुण्यो (pure) / गन्धः (fragrance) / पृथिव्याञ्च (in the earth) / तेजश्चाऽस्मि (and radiance I am) / विभावसौ (in fire) / जीवनं (life) / सर्वभूतेषु (in all beings) / तपश्चाऽस्मि (and austerity I am) / तपस्विषु (in ascetics)
vishnu_gita::814.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::814.essence: The sacred essence manifests as life, light, and strength within all aspects of existence.
vishnu_gita::814.simple_meaning: The divine presence is expressed as pure fragrance in earth, brightness in fire, life in every creature, and spiritual strength in those who practice austerity.
vishnu_gita::814.simple_insight: You are connected with the sacred essence that animates everything around you.
vishnu_gita::814.detailed_meaning: Vishnu reveals his presence in the world’s vital elements: the earth’s pure scent, the fire’s radiance, the life force in all beings, and the disciplined austerity of ascetics. This shows his immanence and the sacred essence within natural and spiritual realms.
vishnu_gita::814.modern_relevance: You can feel the sacred in simple things around you — the fresh soil, a glowing flame, the breath of life, and the quiet strength of focused effort.
vishnu_gita::814.insight: Recognize your own inner presence as part of the sacred essence that flows through all nature and discipline.

vishnu_gita::815.verse_sanskrit:
वर्णेषु ब्राह्मणो वर्ण आश्रमेष्वन्तिमाश्रमः ।
सतीत्वमार्य्यनारीषु तथास्मि पौरुषं नृषु ॥
vishnu_gita::815.verse_hindi: वर्णों में ब्राह्मण वर्ण, आश्रमों में अन्तिम आश्रम अर्थात् सन्यास आश्रम, आर्य नारियों में सतीत्व और पुरुषों में पौरुष अर्थात् पुरुषार्थ हूँ
vishnu_gita::815.english_translation: Among classes, I am the Brahmin; among stages of life, I am the renunciate; among noble women, I am chastity; among men, I am manly strength.
vishnu_gita::815.translation_literal: वर्णेषु (among classes) ब्राह्मणो (the Brahmin) वर्ण (class) आश्रमेषु (among stages of life) अन्तिमाश्रमः (the last stage) सतीत्वम् (chastity) आर्य्यनारीषु (among noble women) तथा (thus) अस्मि (I am) पौरुषं (manly strength) नृषु (among men)
vishnu_gita::815.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::815.essence: The highest ideals of each role and stage reveal your true nature.
vishnu_gita::815.simple_meaning: You represent the best qualities in each social role: wisdom in teachers, renunciation in the final stage of life, chastity in noble women, and strength in men.
vishnu_gita::815.simple_insight: Recognizing your highest qualities in every role brings confidence and purpose.
vishnu_gita::815.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares his presence as the highest ideal in every social class and stage: the Brahmin among classes, the renunciate in life's final stage, chastity among noble women, and strength among men. This shows the divine pervades all roles through their highest qualities.
vishnu_gita::815.modern_relevance: When you face the demands of your role—whether at work, in family, or community—remember your highest qualities give you strength and clarity.
vishnu_gita::815.insight: This verse teaches you to identify and embody the noblest qualities appropriate to your role and stage in life.

vishnu_gita::816.verse_sanskrit:
यावद्देवगणाः सर्वे सात्त्विक्यो मे विभृतयः ।
यावन्तस्तेऽसुराश्चैव तामस्यो मे विभूतयः ॥
vishnu_gita::816.verse_hindi: जितने देवता हैं वे मेरी सात्त्विक विभूतियां हैं और जितने ही असुर हैं वे मेरी तामसिक विभूतियां हैं
vishnu_gita::816.english_translation: All the gods are my sattvic manifestations, and all the asuras are my tamasic manifestations.
vishnu_gita::816.translation_literal: यावद् (as many as) देवगणाः (gods) सर्वे (all) सात्त्विक्यः (sattvic) मे (my) विभृतयः (manifestations) / यावन्तः (as many as) ते (those) असुराः (asuras) च (and) ऐव (indeed) तामसिक्यः (tamasic) मे (my) विभूतयः (manifestations)
vishnu_gita::816.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::816.essence: Both light and shadow qualities arise as manifestations of the same divine source.
vishnu_gita::816.simple_meaning: The radiant gods represent my pure, sattvic qualities, while the darker asuras represent my tamasic qualities.
vishnu_gita::816.simple_insight: You contain both bright and dark qualities as natural parts of yourself.
vishnu_gita::816.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that all divine beings called gods embody his sattvic (pure, harmonious) qualities, while all asuras embody his tamasic (darker, inertia-bound) qualities. This shows the divine includes both light and shadow within its expression.
vishnu_gita::816.modern_relevance: You notice both your best intentions and your darker impulses — both come from the same inner source.
vishnu_gita::816.insight: It teaches you to accept all parts of yourself as expressions of the same underlying reality.

vishnu_gita::817.verse_sanskrit:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां वित्त देवाः ! सनातनम् ।
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::817.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! सब भूतों का सनातन बीज मुझको जानों मैं बुद्धिमानों में बुद्धि और तेजस्वियों में तेज हूँ
vishnu_gita::817.english_translation: O radiant beings! Know that I am the eternal seed of all beings; among the wise, I am wisdom, and among the radiant, I am brilliance.
vishnu_gita::817.translation_literal: बीजं (seed) मां (me) सर्वभूतानां (of all beings) वित्त (eternal) देवाः (O radiant beings) सनातनम् (eternal) बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि (I am wisdom among the wise) तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् (I am brilliance among the brilliant)
vishnu_gita::817.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::817.essence: The eternal source within you is the root of all wisdom and brilliance.
vishnu_gita::817.simple_meaning: You are the eternal source from which all life springs. Among those who are wise and radiant, you embody wisdom and brilliance.
vishnu_gita::817.simple_insight: You carry within you the timeless power of wisdom and shining energy.
vishnu_gita::817.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Vishnu reveals to the radiant beings that he is the eternal origin of all life. He identifies himself as the core intelligence among the wise and the shining force among the radiant, emphasizing his supreme and timeless nature.
vishnu_gita::817.modern_relevance: When you face moments of doubt or low energy, remember that deep inside you is an unchanging source of wisdom and radiant strength.
vishnu_gita::817.insight: Recognize that your true nature includes timeless wisdom and inner brilliance beyond surface fluctuations.

vishnu_gita::818.verse_sanskrit:
बलं बलवतामस्मि कामरागविवर्जितम्।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि विवुधर्षभाः ! ॥
vishnu_gita::818.verse_hindi: हे देवश्रेष्ठो ! बलवानों में मैं काम और राग से रहित बल हूँ और भूतों में धर्माविरुद्ध अर्थात् धर्म के अनुकूल काम हूँ
vishnu_gita::818.english_translation: O best of the gods! Among the powerful, I am strength free from desire and attachment; among beings, I am desire aligned with dharma.
vishnu_gita::818.translation_literal: बलं (strength) बलवतामस्मि (among the powerful I am) कामरागविवर्जितम् (desire-attachment-free) । धर्माविरुद्धो (contrary to dharma) भूतेषु (among beings) कामः (desire) अस्मि (I am) विवुधर्षभाः (the best among the wise) ॥
vishnu_gita::818.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::818.essence: True strength is desire free and desire aligned with what is right.
vishnu_gita::818.simple_meaning: True strength is acting without desire or attachment, and true desire supports what is right and just.
vishnu_gita::818.simple_insight: You can be powerful without craving, focusing your energy on what truly matters.
vishnu_gita::818.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains to the divine hero that real strength is not boastful desire but calm power free from craving. Among all beings, the highest desire is the one that follows dharma, not opposes it. This reframes power as disciplined purpose.
vishnu_gita::818.modern_relevance: When you face pressure to want more or compete, remember your real power grows when you act without craving and align desires with your values.
vishnu_gita::818.insight: It teaches you to separate craving from true strength and to align desire with your deeper purpose.

vishnu_gita::819.verse_sanskrit:
अहं ऋतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम् ।
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम् ॥
vishnu_gita::819.verse_hindi: मैं क्रतु (श्रौत अग्निष्टोमादि यज्ञ ) हूँ, मैं यज्ञ (पञ्चमहायज्ञादि) हूँ, मैं स्वधा हूँ, मैं औषध हूँ, मैं मन्त्र हूँ, मैं आज्य (घृत) हूँ, मैं अग्नि हूँ और मैं बाहुति हूँ
vishnu_gita::819.english_translation: I am the sacred rite, the sacrifice, the offering to ancestors, the healing herb, the mantra, the clarified butter, the fire, and the oblation.
vishnu_gita::819.translation_literal: अहं (I am) / ऋतुरहं (the sacred rite) / यज्ञः (sacrifice) / स्वधाः (offering to ancestors) / अहमौषधम् (I am the healing herb) / मन्त्रोऽहम् (I am the mantra) /aham एव (indeed I) / आज्यम् (the clarified butter) / अहम् (I am) / अग्निः (the fire) / अहं (I am) / हुतम् (the oblation)
vishnu_gita::819.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::819.essence: All sacred rituals and elements are expressions of the one divine presence.
vishnu_gita::819.simple_meaning: The divine expresses itself as all sacred elements in rituals, showing unity behind many forms.
vishnu_gita::819.simple_insight: You carry the sacred essence in all acts of devotion and healing.
vishnu_gita::819.detailed_meaning: Vishnu reveals that he is present as every essential element in Vedic rituals—fire, offerings, mantras, medicines—showing the unity behind diverse sacred acts.
vishnu_gita::819.modern_relevance: When you light a candle, say a prayer, or heal someone, you touch the same sacred essence Vishnu describes here.
vishnu_gita::819.insight: Recognize the sacred in all your acts, seeing them as expressions of the divine whole.

vishnu_gita::820.verse_sanskrit:
पिताऽह्मस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामह: ।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक साम यजुरेव च ॥
vishnu_gita::820.verse_hindi: इस विश्व का मैं पिता, माता, धाता (धारण और पोषण करने वाला) और पितामह हूँ। मैं ही जानने के योग्य हूँ,  पवित्र ओंकार मैं ही हूँ तथा ऋक् यजुः और साम मैं ही हूँ
vishnu_gita::820.english_translation: I am the father, mother, sustainer, and grandfather of this world. I am the knower, the pure Om, and the Rig, Yajur, and Sama Vedas themselves.
vishnu_gita::820.translation_literal: पिताऽह्मस्य (father of the) / जगतो (world) / माता (mother) / धाता (sustainer) / पितामह: (grandfather) / वेद्यं (to be known) / पवित्रमोंकार (pure Om) / ऋक (Rig) / साम (Sama) / यजुरेव (and Yajur) / च (also)
vishnu_gita::820.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::820.essence: The divine is the source, essence, and sacred foundation of all existence and wisdom.
vishnu_gita::820.simple_meaning: The divine being says that it is the source and support of all existence, the sacred sound Om, and the essence of the Vedic knowledge.
vishnu_gita::820.simple_insight: Recognizing the divine as the origin and essence of all can inspire awe and trust in the universe's design.
vishnu_gita::820.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares his cosmic role as the parent and protector of the entire universe, embodying the pure sacred sound Om and the core Vedic hymns, establishing his foundational presence in all existence.
vishnu_gita::820.insight: It invites you to see the divine as the root and support behind everything you experience and know.

vishnu_gita::821.verse_sanskrit:
ज्योतिषामंशुमान् सूर्यो वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम्।
मरीचिर्मरुतामास्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी ॥
vishnu_gita::821.verse_hindi: ज्योतियों में मैं किरणमाली सूर्य हूँ, यक्ष रक्षोगण में वित्तेश (कुबेर) हूँ, मरुतों में मरीचि हूँ और नक्षत्रों में मैं शशी (चन्द्रमा) हूँ
vishnu_gita::821.english_translation: Among the lights, I am the radiant sun; among the yakshas and rakshasas, I am Kubera; among the winds, I am Marichi; and among the stars, I am the moon.
vishnu_gita::821.translation_literal: ज्योतिषामंशुमान् (among the lights, radiant) / सूर्यो (sun) / वित्तेशो (lord of wealth) / यक्षरक्षसाम् (of yakshas and rakshasas) / मरीचिः (Marichi) / मरुतामास्मि (among the winds, I am) / नक्षत्राणाम् (of stars) / अहम् (I) / शशी (moon)
vishnu_gita::821.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::821.essence: The true self shines as the sun, moon, and all radiant cosmic powers.
vishnu_gita::821.simple_meaning: The divine presence expresses itself as the sun, the lord of wealth, a wind deity, and the moon among stars.
vishnu_gita::821.simple_insight: You are connected deeply to the shining forces that energize the world around you.
vishnu_gita::821.detailed_meaning: Vishnu identifies himself with key luminous and powerful beings: the sun among lights, Kubera among yakshas and rakshasas, Marichi among winds, and the moon among stars, showing his presence in cosmic forces.
vishnu_gita::821.modern_relevance: When you feel small or lost, remember you share the same energy as the sun and moon lighting the sky.
vishnu_gita::821.insight: Recognize your inner being as part of the vast radiant forces that support life and order.

vishnu_gita::822.verse_sanskrit:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः ।
इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चाऽस्मि भूतानामम्मि चेतना ॥
vishnu_gita::822.verse_hindi: वेदों में सामवेद हूँ, देवताओं में इन्द्र हूँ, इन्द्रियों में मन हूँ और प्राणियों में चेतना हूँ
vishnu_gita::822.english_translation: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama Veda; among the deities, Indra; among the senses, the mind; and among living beings, consciousness.
vishnu_gita::822.translation_literal: वेदानां (of the Vedas) / सामवेदः (Sama Veda) / अस्मि (I am) / देवानाम् (of the deities) / अस्मि (I am) / वासवः (Indra) / इन्द्रियाणां (of the senses) / मनः (mind) / च (and) / अस्मि (I am) / भूतानाम् (of beings) / अम्मि (I am) / चेतना (consciousness)
vishnu_gita::822.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::822.essence: The true self is the pure consciousness behind mind, senses, and all life.
vishnu_gita::822.simple_meaning: You are not just your mind or senses. At your core, you are pure consciousness, the essence behind all experience.
vishnu_gita::822.simple_insight: There is a deep part of you that is untouched by change and senses—a calm awareness at your core.
vishnu_gita::822.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares his cosmic presence as the essence behind the Vedas, the chief deity Indra among gods, the mind behind senses, and consciousness in all beings. This reveals the true self as the unchanging awareness beyond physical and mental layers.
vishnu_gita::822.modern_relevance: When distractions overwhelm you, remember you are not your busy mind or shifting feelings but the silent awareness behind them.
vishnu_gita::822.insight: Shift your identity from the restless mind and senses to the steady awareness that witnesses experience.

vishnu_gita::823.verse_sanskrit:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुः वसूनामस्मि पावकः ।
रूद्राणां शङ्करश्चाऽस्मि मेहः शिखरिणामहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::823.verse_hindi: द्वादश आदित्यों में मैं विष्णु हूँ, अष्ट वसुओं में पावक हूँ, एकादश रुद्रों में शङ्कर हूँ और पर्वतों में मैं मेरु हूँ
vishnu_gita::823.english_translation: Among the twelve Adityas I am Vishnu, among the eight Vasus I am the fire, among the eleven Rudras I am Shankara, and among mountains, I am Meru.
vishnu_gita::823.translation_literal: आदित्यानामहं (Among the Adityas I am) / विष्णुः (Vishnu) / वसूनामस्मि (Among the Vasus I am) / पावकः (fire) / रूद्राणां (Among the Rudras) / शङ्करः (Shankara) / च (and) / अस्मि (I am) / मेहः (mountain) / शिखरिणामहम् (among the peaks)
vishnu_gita::823.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::823.essence: The supreme reality reveals itself as the essence within all great cosmic powers and forms.
vishnu_gita::823.simple_meaning: The divine is present as the highest aspect in all great cosmic forces and beings, manifesting as Vishnu, fire, Shiva, and the sacred mountain.
vishnu_gita::823.simple_insight: The divine is not separate but expresses itself as many powerful forms all around you.
vishnu_gita::823.detailed_meaning: Vishnu reveals his presence as the essence within cosmic forces: as one of the solar deities (Adityas), the elemental fire among the Vasus, the form of Shiva among the Rudras, and as the sacred mountain Meru, symbolizing supreme stability and power.
vishnu_gita::823.insight: Recognizing the divine as the core essence in diverse forms invites seeing unity beyond apparent differences.

vishnu_gita::824.verse_sanskrit:
पुरोधसाच मुख्यं मां वित्त देवाः ! वृहस्पतिम्।
सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः ॥
vishnu_gita::824.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! मुझको पुरोहितों में श्रेष्ठ पुरोहित बृहस्पति जानो, सेनानायकों में मैं स्कन्द (कार्तिकेय) हूँ और जलाशयों में मैं सागर हूँ
vishnu_gita::824.english_translation: O celestial beings, among priests I am the chief priest Brihaspati, among commanders I am Skanda, and among waters I am the ocean.
vishnu_gita::824.translation_literal: पुरोधसाच (among priests) मुख्यं (chief) मां (me) वित्त (know) देवाः (O gods) / वृहस्पतिम् (Brihaspati) सेनानीनामहं (among commanders I am) स्कन्दः (Skanda) सरसामस्मि (among waters I am) सागरः (ocean)
vishnu_gita::824.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::824.essence: The true self embodies the highest form in every essential role and domain.
vishnu_gita::824.simple_meaning: The speaker identifies himself with the highest priest, the greatest commander, and the vast ocean, showing his supreme presence in many roles.
vishnu_gita::824.simple_insight: Recognizing your highest expression in many forms helps you see your vast potential.
vishnu_gita::824.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares to the celestial beings that among priests he is Brihaspati, the chief priest; among warriors he is Skanda, the commander; and among waters, he is the ocean. This verse emphasizes Vishnu's supreme and multifaceted nature.
vishnu_gita::824.insight: It teaches you to recognize the multiple roles and powers within yourself beyond any single identity.

vishnu_gita::825.verse_sanskrit:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम् ।
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः ॥
vishnu_gita::825.verse_hindi: महर्षियों में मैं भृगु और वाणियों में मैं एक अक्षर अर्थात् ॐकार हूँ, यज्ञों में जपयज्ञ हूँ और स्थावरों में हिमालय हूँ
vishnu_gita::825.english_translation: Among sages, I am Bhrigu; among sounds, the imperishable syllable; among sacrifices, the chanting sacrifice; among immovables, the Himalaya.
vishnu_gita::825.translation_literal: महर्षीणां (among sages) भृगु (Bhrigu) अहं (I) गिराम् (in voices) अस्मि (am) एकम् (one) अक्षरम् (imperishable syllable) । यज्ञानां (among sacrifices) जपयज्ञः (chanting sacrifice) अस्मि (am) स्थावराणां (among immovables) हिमालयः (Himalaya) ॥
vishnu_gita::825.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::825.essence: The divine essence is present as the highest exemplar in every domain of existence.
vishnu_gita::825.simple_meaning: I am the greatest among sages, the sacred sound among all voices, the chanting sacrifice among rituals, and the Himalaya among immovable things.
vishnu_gita::825.simple_insight: You can find the divine essence reflected in many forms, from sages to mountains to sacred sounds.
vishnu_gita::825.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes his presence in the world by identifying with supreme examples in various categories: the sage Bhrigu among sages, the sacred syllable ॐ among sounds, the chanting sacrifice among rituals, and the Himalaya among mountains, highlighting his all-pervading nature.
vishnu_gita::825.insight: It invites seeing the divine presence in the highest expression of all aspects of life and nature around you.

vishnu_gita::826.verse_sanskrit:
अश्वत्थः सर्वक्षाणां देवर्षीणाञ्च नारदः।
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः ॥
vishnu_gita::826.verse_hindi: समस्त  वृक्षों में अश्वत्थ अर्थात् पीपल का वृक्ष हूँ, देवर्षियों में नारद हूँ, गन्धवों में चित्ररथ और सिद्धों में कपिल मुनि हूँ
vishnu_gita::826.english_translation: Among all trees I am the Ashvattha (peepal) tree; among divine sages, I am Narada; among gandharvas, I am Chitraratha; and among siddhas, I am Kapila muni.
vishnu_gita::826.translation_literal: अश्वत्थः (Ashvattha) / सर्वक्षाणां (of all trees) / देवर्षीणां (of divine sages) / च (and) / नारदः (Narada) / गन्धर्वाणां (of gandharvas) / चित्ररथः (Chitraratha) / सिद्धानां (of siddhas) / कपिलो (Kapila) / मुनिः (sage)
vishnu_gita::826.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::826.essence: The divine essence manifests as the highest example in every revered group.
vishnu_gita::826.simple_meaning: The divine says he is present as the most important example in many groups: the sacred peepal tree, the sage Narada, the gandharva Chitraratha, and the sage Kapila.
vishnu_gita::826.simple_insight: You can see the divine reflected in powerful symbols across nature and beings.
vishnu_gita::826.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares his presence as the supreme essence in various forms: the sacred tree among all trees, the knowledgeable sage Narada among divine sages, the chief gandharva Chitraratha among celestial musicians, and the sage Kapila among perfected beings. This highlights his all-pervading nature.
vishnu_gita::826.insight: Recognize that the divine essence permeates diverse forms and roles, inviting reverence for the unity behind variety.

vishnu_gita::827.verse_sanskrit:
उच्चैःश्रवसमवानां वित्त माममृतोद्भवम् ।
ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणाञ्च नराधिपम् ॥
vishnu_gita::827.verse_hindi: अश्वों में मुझको अमृत अर्थात् अमृत जिससे उत्पन्न हुआ है ऐसे समुद्र से उत्पन्न उच्चैःश्रवा जानो, गजेन्द्रों में ऐरावत और मनुष्यों में नराधिप अर्थात् प्रजाओं को प्रसन्न रखनेवाला नृप जानो
vishnu_gita::827.english_translation: Among horses, I am Uchhaishravas born from the nectar ocean; among elephants, I am Airavata; among humans, I am the king who pleases his subjects.
vishnu_gita::827.translation_literal: उच्चैःश्रवसमवानां (among horses called Uchhaishravas) / वित्त (born) / माम् (me) / अमृतोद्भवम् (from the nectar ocean) / ऐरावतं (Airavata) / गजेन्द्राणां (among elephants) / नराणां च (and among humans) / नराधिपम् (the king)
vishnu_gita::827.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::827.essence: The divine manifests as the highest exemplar in every category of beings.
vishnu_gita::827.simple_meaning: The divine identifies as the best example in each category: the finest horse, elephant, and human king.
vishnu_gita::827.simple_insight: Recognizing the highest form in every category reveals the divine's presence everywhere.
vishnu_gita::827.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes his presence in different forms: Uchhaishravas is the supreme horse born from the nectar ocean, Airavata the chief elephant, and among humans, the ideal king who governs with care.
vishnu_gita::827.insight: It teaches to see the divine excellence manifest in different realms and roles around you.

vishnu_gita::828.verse_sanskrit:
अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः ।
प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम् ॥
vishnu_gita::828.verse_hindi: मैं वैश्वानर नामक अग्नि होकर प्राणियों के देह को आश्रय करके प्राण और अपान वायुयों से युक्त होता हुआ चतुर्विध (लेह्य, चूष्य, पेय आदि) अन्नों को पचाता हूँ
vishnu_gita::828.english_translation: I am the cosmic fire residing in beings, digesting all four types of food with the life and outgoing breaths.
vishnu_gita::828.translation_literal: अहं (I) वैश्वानरो (cosmic fire) भूत्वा (being) प्राणिनां (of beings) देहमाश्रितः (residing in the body) । प्राणापानसमायुक्तः (joined with incoming and outgoing breaths) पचाम्यन्नं (digest food) चतुर्विधम् (four types) ॥
vishnu_gita::828.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::828.essence: A cosmic fire within you digests all nourishment using life’s vital breaths.
vishnu_gita::828.simple_meaning: Inside every living being, there is a cosmic fire that, combined with breath, digests all kinds of food.
vishnu_gita::828.simple_insight: You contain a powerful inner process transforming everything you consume into energy.
vishnu_gita::828.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes himself as the cosmic fire (Vaishvanara) present inside all creatures, working with the life breaths to digest the four types of food, showing the divine presence in natural bodily processes.
vishnu_gita::828.modern_relevance: When you eat a meal, your body’s unseen inner fire is hard at work transforming that food into energy you can use.
vishnu_gita::828.insight: This verse teaches you to recognize the sacredness in ordinary body functions and see your connection to cosmic processes.

vishnu_gita::829.verse_sanskrit:
यदादित्य गतं तेजो जगाद्भास्य्तेऽखिलम ।
यचन्द्रमसि यचाऽग्नौ तत्तेजो वित्त मामकम् ॥
vishnu_gita::829.verse_hindi: जो सूर्य्गन तेज सम्पूर्ण जगत को प्रकाशित करता है और जो तेज चन्द्र और अग्नि में है, उस तेज को मेरा तेज समझो
vishnu_gita::829.english_translation: The light that moves as the sun and illuminates the entire world, and the light present in the moon and fire—that light is my light.
vishnu_gita::829.translation_literal: यदादित्य (that sun) गतं (moving) तेजो (light) जगात् (from the world) भास्यते (illuminates) अखिलम् (entire) । यचन्द्रमसि (and in the moon) यच (and) अग्नौ (in fire) तत् (that) तेजो (light) ममकम् (mine) ॥
vishnu_gita::829.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::829.essence: The light illuminating everything is the very light of your true self.
vishnu_gita::829.simple_meaning: The light that shines from the sun, moon, and fire is the same light that belongs to the true self.
vishnu_gita::829.simple_insight: You carry the universal light within you, connecting you to all around.
vishnu_gita::829.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that the brilliance illuminating the sun, moon, and fire is not separate but the same radiance that belongs to the true self. This reveals the unity of all light and life sources.
vishnu_gita::829.modern_relevance: When you see sunlight or a candle’s flame, recognize that the same light shines within you, connecting you to the world.
vishnu_gita::829.insight: It teaches you to see yourself as inseparable from the universal presence shining through all forms of light.

vishnu_gita::830.verse_sanskrit:
गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा।
पुषणामि चौषधी: सर्वा: सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मक: ॥
vishnu_gita::830.verse_hindi: मैं पृथ्वी में प्रवेश करके ( अपने) बल से भूतो को धारण करता हूँ और रसात्मक सोम होकर सब ओषधियों को पुष्ट करता हूँ
vishnu_gita::830.english_translation: Entering the earth, I sustain all beings with my strength and become the nourishing Soma that enriches all plants.
vishnu_gita::830.translation_literal: गामाविश्य (entering the earth) / च (and) / भूतानि (beings) / धारयामि (I sustain) / अहम् (I) / ओजसा (with strength) / पुषणामि (I nourish) / च (and) / औषधयः (plants) / सर्वाः (all) / सोमः (Soma) / भूत्वा (becoming) / रसात्मकः (nourishing)
vishnu_gita::830.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::830.essence: The divine sustains and nurtures all life through unseen strength and nourishment.
vishnu_gita::830.simple_meaning: The divine enters the earth, supports all living beings with power, and nourishes all plants as a life-giving force.
vishnu_gita::830.simple_insight: Everything you see is supported and nourished by a hidden sustaining power.
vishnu_gita::830.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes his cosmic role sustaining life by entering the earth and becoming the nourishing energy (Soma) that supports all plants and beings, highlighting his all-pervading presence vital for existence.
vishnu_gita::830.insight: Recognize the unseen support that sustains life beneath every form you encounter.

vishnu_gita::831.verse_sanskrit:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् ।
प्रजनश्चाऽस्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः ॥
vishnu_gita::831.verse_hindi: मैं आयुधों में धज्र और धेनुओं में कामधेनु हूँ, प्रजाओं की उत्पत्ति का हेतु काम हूँ और सर्पों में वासुकि हूँ
vishnu_gita::831.english_translation: Among weapons, I am the thunderbolt; among cows, the wish-fulfilling cow; among beings, I am desire; and among serpents, I am Vasuki.
vishnu_gita::831.translation_literal: आयुधानामहं (among weapons I am) / वज्रं (thunderbolt) / धेनूनामस्मि (among cows I am) / कामधुक् (wish-fulfilling cow) / प्रजनश्चाऽस्मि (among beings I am) / कन्दर्पः (desire) / सर्पाणामस्मि (among serpents I am) / वासुकिः (Vasuki)
vishnu_gita::831.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::831.essence: The divine manifests as the supreme example in many forms across existence.
vishnu_gita::831.simple_meaning: The divine identifies with powerful and significant symbols in different forms, showing presence in many important aspects of existence.
vishnu_gita::831.simple_insight: The divine is present in many forms, showing a connection to all parts of life and nature.
vishnu_gita::831.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares his presence as the most powerful or significant representative in various categories—thunderbolt among weapons, Kamadhenu among cows, desire among beings, and Vasuki among serpents—highlighting his all-pervasive nature.
vishnu_gita::831.insight: Recognize the interconnectedness of diverse forces and qualities as expressions of a greater whole.

vishnu_gita::832.verse_sanskrit:
अनन्नश्वाऽस्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम् ।
प्रहलादश्वाऽस्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::832.verse_hindi: नागों में अनन्त हूँ, जलचरों में मैं ( उनका अधिपति ) वरुण हूँ, दैत्यों में प्रहलाद हूँ और वशीभूत करने वालों में मैं काल हूँ
vishnu_gita::832.english_translation: Among the nagas, I am infinite; among the aquatic beings, I am Varuna; among the daityas, I am Prahlada; and among the controllers, I am Kala.
vishnu_gita::832.translation_literal: अनन्नश्वाऽस्मि (I am infinite) / नागानां (among the nagas) / वरुणो (Varuna) / यादसामहम् (among the aquatic beings) / प्रहलादश्वाऽस्मि (I am Prahlada) / दैत्यानां (among the daityas) / कालः (Kala) / कलयतामहम् (among the controllers)
vishnu_gita::832.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::832.essence: The true self manifests uniquely across diverse beings and forces.
vishnu_gita::832.simple_meaning: I am present in many forms and beings, embodying infinite power and influence across different groups.
vishnu_gita::832.simple_insight: Power and presence take many forms beyond what we usually see.
vishnu_gita::832.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares his cosmic presence by naming his manifestations among various beings: infinite in nagas, as Varuna among water beings, Prahlada among daityas, and Kala as the force controlling time and fate.
vishnu_gita::832.insight: Recognize that the divine or true self appears in many forms and roles, beyond a single identity.

vishnu_gita::833.verse_sanskrit:
मृगाणाश्च मंगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् ।
पवनः पवनामस्मि दानेप्वभयदानकम् ॥
vishnu_gita::833.verse_hindi: पशुओं में मैं मृगेन्द्र हूँ , पक्षियों में गरुड़, वेगशालियों में पवन और दानों में अभयदान हूँ
vishnu_gita::833.english_translation: Among animals, I am the lion; among birds, the Garuda; among the swift, the wind; and among the generous, the giver of fearlessness.
vishnu_gita::833.translation_literal: मृगाणाम् (of animals) अश्च (and) मंगेन्द्रः (lion among animals) अहम् (I am) वैनतेयः (Garuda) अश्च (and) पक्षिणाम् (of birds) पवनः (wind) पवनम् (among the swift) अस्मि (am) दानेषु (among the generous) अभयदानकम् (giver of fearlessness)
vishnu_gita::833.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::833.essence: The divine manifests as the highest or most noble in every category of life.
vishnu_gita::833.simple_meaning: The divine identifies with the highest or most powerful in each group: lion among animals, Garuda among birds, wind among the fast, and fearlessness among the generous.
vishnu_gita::833.simple_insight: Recognizing the divine in the greatest qualities of all things invites you to see greatness everywhere.
vishnu_gita::833.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares his presence in the most noble or distinguished beings and qualities across nature, symbolizing his all-pervading power and connection to the highest expressions in every realm.
vishnu_gita::833.insight: It invites you to find the divine's presence in the best qualities around you, deepening respect and awareness.

vishnu_gita::834.verse_sanskrit:
झषाणां मकरश्चाऽस्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी ।
पितृणामळमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::834.verse_hindi: मत्स्यों में मकर, नदियों में गंगाजी, पितरों में अयर्मा और शासकों में  यम हूँ
vishnu_gita::834.english_translation: Among fish, I am the crocodile; among rivers, the Ganges; among ancestors, Yama; and among rulers, I am the controller.
vishnu_gita::834.translation_literal: झषाणां (among fish) मकरश्चाऽस्मि (I am the crocodile) / स्रोतसामस्मि (among rivers I am) जाह्नवी (the Ganges) / पितृणाम् (among ancestors) अयर्मा (Yama) चास्मि (I am) / यमः (Yama) संयमतामहम् (the controller)
vishnu_gita::834.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::834.essence: The supreme being manifests as the most powerful presence in all domains.
vishnu_gita::834.simple_meaning: I am the greatest or most powerful example in every group: crocodile among fish, Ganges among rivers, Yama among ancestors, and the controller among rulers.
vishnu_gita::834.simple_insight: Recognizing the divine presence as supreme in every category can inspire awe and respect.
vishnu_gita::834.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares his supreme presence in various domains: the crocodile is the strongest fish, the Ganges is the holiest river, Yama is the lord of ancestors and death, and the controller is the ultimate ruler, showing his all-encompassing power.
vishnu_gita::834.insight: It teaches you to see the underlying supreme force behind familiar figures and natural elements.

vishnu_gita::835.verse_sanskrit:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यञ्चैवाहमुत्तमाः ।
अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::835.verse_hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ देवगण ! सृष्टि का आदि, अन्त और मध्य में ही हूँ , विद्याओं में अध्यात्मविद्या और वादियों में वाद हूँ
vishnu_gita::835.english_translation: O supreme radiant beings! I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of creation; among sciences I am spiritual wisdom and among debaters, the art of debate.
vishnu_gita::835.translation_literal: सर्गाणामादि (of creations, the beginning) / अन्तः (the end) / च (and) / मध्यं (the middle) / चैव (also) / अहम् (I) / उत्तमाः (the best) । / अध्यात्मविद्या (spiritual knowledge) / विद्याः (sciences) / विद्यानाम् (of knowledge) / वादः (debate) / प्रवदताम् (of debaters) / अहम् (I) ।
vishnu_gita::835.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::835.essence: You are the whole of creation and the highest spiritual wisdom combined.
vishnu_gita::835.simple_meaning: You exist as the entire span of creation—from start to end—and represent the highest spiritual wisdom and skillful reasoning.
vishnu_gita::835.simple_insight: There is a deep power in knowing you are the center and source of all understanding and existence.
vishnu_gita::835.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses radiant beings, revealing that he is not just part but the whole of creation’s timeline and the essence of spiritual knowledge and debate. This moment highlights his comprehensive cosmic presence and supreme wisdom.
vishnu_gita::835.modern_relevance: In moments of self-doubt, remember you are not just a small part but connected to the entire process of growth and understanding.
vishnu_gita::835.insight: Recognize your presence as integral to all phases of life and that true wisdom comes from seeing your unity with the whole.

vishnu_gita::836.verse_sanskrit:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि इन्द्रः सामासिकस्य च ।
अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखः ॥
vishnu_gita::836.verse_hindi: अक्षरों में अकार हूँ, समासों में द्वन्द्र समास हूँ, मैं ही अविनाशी काल हूँ और विश्वतोमुख धाता अर्थात् सर्वकर्मफलप्रदाता हूँ
vishnu_gita::836.english_translation: Among imperishable elements, I am the sound 'A'; among compound words, I am the dual compound. I am the imperishable time and the creator facing all directions, the giver of all results of actions.
vishnu_gita::836.translation_literal: अक्षराणाम् (of imperishable elements) अक (sound A) अस्मि (I am) इन्द्रः (Indra) सामासिकस्य (of compound words) च (and) । अहम् (I) एव (indeed) अक्षयः (imperishable) कालः (time) धाता (creator) अहम् (I) विश्वतः (all sides) मुखः (facing) ॥
vishnu_gita::836.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::836.essence: You are rooted in the eternal, infinite source that generates and sustains all results.
vishnu_gita::836.simple_meaning: The divine says it is the eternal source behind all sounds, compounds, time, and the creator of everything, giving results to every action.
vishnu_gita::836.simple_insight: You belong to a vast, timeless source beyond change or end.
vishnu_gita::836.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares his cosmic identity as the fundamental sound 'A' among all imperishable sounds, the essence of compound words, the endless time that destroys all, and the all-facing creator who distributes all results of actions.
vishnu_gita::836.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by endless tasks or change, remember you share the same timeless source that supports all outcomes and transformations.
vishnu_gita::836.insight: It shifts your view from isolated action to seeing yourself as part of a universal, timeless creative force.

vishnu_gita::837.verse_sanskrit:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्वाऽहमुवश्च भविष्यताम् ।
कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक् च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ॥
vishnu_gita::837.verse_hindi: मैं सर्वहारी मृत्यु हूँ, उत्पन्न होने वालो का उत्पत्तिस्थान हूँ और नारियों में कीर्ति, श्री और वाक् मैं हूँ एवं स्मृति, मेधा, धृति तथा क्षमारूप हूँ
vishnu_gita::837.english_translation: I am death that takes all away, the source of all beings' birth; among women, I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, determination, and forgiveness.
vishnu_gita::837.translation_literal: मृत्युः (death) सर्वहरश् (all-taking) अश्वाऽहम् (I am) उवश्च (said) भविष्यताम् (of beings that will be) । कीर्तिः (fame) श्रीः (prosperity) वाक् (speech) च (and) नारीणाम् (among women) स्मृतिर्मेधा (memory, intelligence) धृतिः (determination) क्षमा (forgiveness) ॥
vishnu_gita::837.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::837.essence: The divine pervades endings, beginnings, and human virtues alike.
vishnu_gita::837.simple_meaning: The divine says: I am death that ends all and the source where beings are born. Among women, I am qualities like fame, wealth, speech, memory, intelligence, willpower, and forgiveness.
vishnu_gita::837.simple_insight: You can see the divine in endings and beginnings and in essential qualities beyond physical form.
vishnu_gita::837.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares his cosmic roles: as death that claims all, the origin of all life, and in women, the embodiment of key virtues like fame, prosperity, and forgiveness. This verse highlights his all-encompassing presence in life, death, and human qualities.
vishnu_gita::837.insight: Recognizing that endings and beginnings are part of one cycle helps you embrace change and see deeper qualities in people.

vishnu_gita::838.verse_sanskrit:
वृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम् ।
मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः ॥
vishnu_gita::838.verse_hindi: मैं सामवेद की शाखाओं में वृहत्साम, छन्दों में गायत्री छन्द, मासों में मार्गशीर्ष मास और ऋतुओं में वसंत ऋतु हूँ
vishnu_gita::838.english_translation: I am the Vrhat-Sama among the branches of Sama Veda, the Gayatri meter among the meters, Margashirsha month among the months, and the spring season among the seasons.
vishnu_gita::838.translation_literal: वृहत्साम (Vrhat-Sama) / तथा (and) / साम्नां (of Sama Veda) / गायत्री (Gayatri) / छन्दसामहम् (among the meters) / मासानां (of months) / मार्गशीर्षोऽहम् (I am Margashirsha) / ऋतूनां (of seasons) / कुसुमाकरः (spring)
vishnu_gita::838.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::838.essence: The divine presence is found in the highest expressions of sacred knowledge and natural cycles.
vishnu_gita::838.simple_meaning: The divine says that within sacred texts, time, and nature, they embody the most excellent parts like the best Veda, meter, month, and season.
vishnu_gita::838.simple_insight: Recognizing the divine in the highest and most revered forms in nature and wisdom brings a sense of connection and reverence.
vishnu_gita::838.detailed_meaning: Here, Vishnu identifies himself with the finest elements of Vedic scripture and natural cycles. By naming the Vrhat-Sama, Gayatri meter, Margashirsha month, and spring season, he shows his presence in the most esteemed and life-giving parts of tradition and nature.
vishnu_gita::838.modern_relevance: When you notice the best parts of your daily routine or your favorite moments, you connect to something greater within the ordinary.
vishnu_gita::838.insight: It invites you to see the divine essence within the highest expressions of culture and nature, inspiring respect and deeper awareness.

vishnu_gita::839.verse_sanskrit:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम् ।
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः ॥
vishnu_gita::839.verse_hindi: छलियों मे द्युत (जुआ) हूँ, पराक्रमियों मे सत्व अर्थात् पराक्रम हूँ, मुनियों में मैं व्यास हूँ और कवियों में मैं उशना कवि अर्थात् शुक्र हूँ
vishnu_gita::839.english_translation: Among gamblers, I am the game; among the powerful, I am strength; among sages, I am Vyasa; among poets, I am Ushana, the poet.
vishnu_gita::839.translation_literal: द्यूतं (gambling) छलयतामस्मि (among deceivers I am) सत्त्वं (strength) सत्त्ववतामहम् (among the strong I am) । मुनीनामप्यहं (among sages also I) व्यासः (Vyasa) कवीनामुशना (among poets Ushana) कविः (poet) ॥
vishnu_gita::839.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::839.essence: The divine manifests as the essential force within every group and identity.
vishnu_gita::839.simple_meaning: I embody the essence of each group: the game among gamblers, strength among the powerful, Vyasa among sages, and Ushana among poets.
vishnu_gita::839.simple_insight: You recognize the divine presence in every role and realm, even in unexpected forms.
