vishnu_gita::839.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares his presence as the core essence within various groups: in gamblers as the game, in the mighty as strength, in sages as Vyasa the great seer, and in poets as Ushana, a renowned poet. This verse shows his omnipresence across diverse realms.
vishnu_gita::839.insight: It teaches you to see the essence behind every role and recognize the true self manifesting in many forms.

vishnu_gita::840.verse_sanskrit:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरास्मि जिगीषताम् ।
मौनं चैवाऽस्मि गुयानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::840.verse_hindi: दमनकारियों में मैं दण्ड हूँ, जय की इच्छा करने वालों में नीति हूँ, गुह्यों में मौन हूँ और मैं ज्ञानियों का ज्ञान हूँ
vishnu_gita::840.english_translation: Among those who restrain, I am discipline; among those who desire victory, I am wise counsel; among secrets, I am silence; and among the wise, I am knowledge.
vishnu_gita::840.translation_literal: दण्डो (punishment/discipline) / दमयतामस्मि (among those who restrain) / नीतिरास्मि (I am wise counsel) / जिगीषताम् (of those who desire victory) / मौनं (silence) / चैव (also) / अस्मि (I am) / गुयानां (among secrets) / ज्ञानं (knowledge) / ज्ञानवतामहम् (among the wise)
vishnu_gita::840.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::840.essence: Discipline, wise counsel, silence, and knowledge are the true powers within your striving.
vishnu_gita::840.simple_meaning: You represent discipline when controlling impulses, wisdom when seeking success, silence in mysteries, and knowledge among the wise.
vishnu_gita::840.simple_insight: You carry the strength of restraint and the wisdom of silence within you.
vishnu_gita::840.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes his presence as the inner force behind self-control, wise strategies for victory, the quiet of hidden truths, and the knowledge held by the enlightened.
vishnu_gita::840.modern_relevance: When you resist distractions, plan wisely, pause in silence, and seek knowledge, you embody these timeless powers in daily life.
vishnu_gita::840.insight: Recognize that discipline, wise counsel, silence, and knowledge are expressions of your true strength in action.

vishnu_gita::841.verse_sanskrit:
यच्चाऽपि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमस्मि वै।
न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥
vishnu_gita::841.verse_hindi: समस्त प्राणियों का जो बीज है वह मैं ही हूँ, ऐसा चराचर भूत कोई नहीं है जो मेरे बिना हो अर्थात् मैं सर्वत्र व्यापक हूँ
vishnu_gita::841.english_translation: I am the seed of all living beings; nothing moving or unmoving exists without me.
vishnu_gita::841.translation_literal: यत् (that) च (also) अपि (indeed) सर्व (all) भूतानाम् (beings) बीजं (seed) तत् (that) अहम् (I) अस्मि (am) वै (indeed) । न (not) तत् (that) अस्ति (exists) विना (without) यत् (that) स्यान् (would be) मया (by me) भूतं (being) चराचरम् (moving and unmoving) ॥
vishnu_gita::841.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::841.essence: You are the fundamental seed from which all beings, moving and still, arise.
vishnu_gita::841.simple_meaning: You are the origin from which all living and non-living things arise; nothing exists without you.
vishnu_gita::841.simple_insight: There is a deep connection between you and everything that exists, alive or not.
vishnu_gita::841.detailed_meaning: Vishnu reveals to the listener that he is the fundamental source or seed from which all beings, moving or still, emerge; nothing can exist apart from this essential presence, showing the unity behind all forms.
vishnu_gita::841.modern_relevance: When you look at nature or people, you can feel the same essential life force that connects everything around you, including yourself.
vishnu_gita::841.insight: It shifts perspective to see yourself as the root source behind all that exists, deepening your sense of unity with the world.

vishnu_gita::842.verse_sanskrit:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां सुरर्षभाः।
एष तृदेशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया ॥
vishnu_gita::842.verse_hindi: हे देवश्रेष्ठो! मेरी दिव्य विभूतियों का अन्त नहीं है, यह बिभूति विस्तार तो मैंने संक्षेप से कहा है
vishnu_gita::842.english_translation: O best of the radiant beings! My divine manifestations have no end; I have only briefly described their vastness.
vishnu_gita::842.translation_literal: नान्तः (no end) अस्ति (is) मम (my) दिव्यानां (divine) विभूतीनां (manifestations) सुरर्षभाः (best of radiant beings)। एष (this) तृदेशतः (in three directions) प्रोक्तः (spoken) विभूतेः (of manifestations) विस्तारः (expansion) मया (by me) ॥
vishnu_gita::842.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::842.essence: The divine manifestations are infinite and only partially described here.
vishnu_gita::842.simple_meaning: The divine manifestations of the speaker are limitless, and only a brief overview has been given here.
vishnu_gita::842.simple_insight: Some truths are vast beyond words, inviting awe rather than full explanation.
vishnu_gita::842.detailed_meaning: Vishnu speaks to the best of radiant beings, explaining that his divine manifestations are infinite and that what has been described so far is only a small part.
vishnu_gita::842.insight: It teaches humility before the vastness of the divine and encourages openness to mystery beyond explanation.

vishnu_gita::843.verse_sanskrit:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमर्जितमेव वा ।
नत्तदेव तु जानीत मम तेजोऽशसम्भवम् ॥
vishnu_gita::843.verse_hindi: जो जो विभूति युक्त, श्रीमान् अथवा समुन्नत सत्त्व (प्राणी) है उस उस को ही मेरे तेज के अंश से उत्पन्न जानो
vishnu_gita::843.english_translation: Know that whatever magnificent being or elevated life exists, it is born from a part of my brilliance.
vishnu_gita::843.translation_literal: यद्यत् (whatever) विभूतिमत् (magnificent being) सत्त्वं (living being) श्रीमर्जितम् (glorious) एव (indeed) वा (or) न (not) तदेव (that only) तु (but) जानीत (know) मम (my) तेजः (brilliance) अशसम्भवम् (born from a part)
vishnu_gita::843.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::843.essence: All noble living beings arise from a part of divine brilliance.
vishnu_gita::843.simple_meaning: Every magnificent or noble living being comes from a part of the divine brilliance within Vishnu.
vishnu_gita::843.simple_insight: There is a hidden connection between all elevated life and the divine brilliance that created it.
vishnu_gita::843.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that all splendid or noble beings in existence originate from portions of his radiant energy. This reveals his cosmic role as the source of all elevated life forms and their qualities.
vishnu_gita::843.insight: Recognizing your excellence as a reflection of a greater source shifts your sense of identity and pride.

vishnu_gita::844.verse_sanskrit:
अथवा बहुनतेन किं ज्ञातेन हि वोऽमराः ।
विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत् ॥
vishnu_gita::844.verse_hindi: अथवा हे अमरगण ! आपलोगो को इसके बहुत जानने से क्या, मैं एक अंश से इस सम्पूर्ण जगत को धारण करता हूँ
vishnu_gita::844.english_translation: O immortal beings, what use is your much knowledge? I uphold the entire world by a single part of Myself.
vishnu_gita::844.translation_literal: अथवा (or) / बहुनतेन (by much knowledge) / किं (what) / ज्ञातेन (known) / हि (indeed) / वोऽमराः (you immortals) / । (punctuation) / विष्टभ्यः (upholding) / अहम् (I) / इदम् (this) / कृत्स्नम् (entire) / एकांशेन (by one part) / स्थितः (situated) / जगत् (world) / ॥ (punctuation)
vishnu_gita::844.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::844.essence: A single part of your true self sustains the entire universe beyond knowledge.
vishnu_gita::844.simple_meaning: You sustain the entire universe through just a small part of your being, beyond what much knowledge can grasp.
vishnu_gita::844.simple_insight: There's awe in knowing your true self holds far more than you realize.
vishnu_gita::844.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses immortal beings, emphasizing that despite their vast knowledge, he alone supports the entire universe through just a fraction of his being, revealing his supreme cosmic role.
vishnu_gita::844.modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by what you must handle, remember your essential self holds far more than you can see.
vishnu_gita::844.insight: It shifts your perspective from relying on external knowledge to trusting your inherent, vast capacity.

vishnu_gita::845.verse_sanskrit:
अहमात्मा सुपर्वाणः ! सर्वभूताशयस्थितः ।
अहमादिश्च मध्यञ्च भूतानामन्त एव च ॥
vishnu_gita::845.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! मैं सब प्राणियों के अन्तः करण में स्थित आत्मा हूँ और मैं ही प्राणियों का आदि, अन्त तथा मध्य भी हूँ
vishnu_gita::845.english_translation: O divine beings! I am the true self residing in the heart of all beings; I am their beginning, middle, and end.
vishnu_gita::845.translation_literal: अहमात्मा (I am the true self) सुपर्वाणः (O exalted ones) ! सर्वभूताशयस्थितः (residing in the hearts of all beings) । अहमादिश्च (I am the beginning) मध्यञ्च (the middle) भूतानामन्त (and the end of beings) एव (indeed) च (also) ॥
vishnu_gita::845.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::845.essence: The true self indwells all beings as their origin, presence, and conclusion.
vishnu_gita::845.simple_meaning: The true self dwells at the core of every being and is their origin, presence, and conclusion.
vishnu_gita::845.simple_insight: You are deeply connected to all life as its ever-present source and essence.
vishnu_gita::845.detailed_meaning: Vishnu speaks to divine beings, revealing that the true self is present inside every creature, being their beginning, center, and end. This teaching shows the unity of all life through the indwelling presence of the true self.
vishnu_gita::845.modern_relevance: When you feel alone or separate, remember the true self within you connects you to all life as its enduring source.
vishnu_gita::845.insight: It shifts your view from isolation to recognizing the shared inner essence in all beings.

vishnu_gita::846.verse_sanskrit:
गतिर्भर्त्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् ।
प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् ॥
vishnu_gita::846.verse_hindi: गति, भर्ता (पालक), प्रभु (नियन्ता), साक्षी (द्रष्टा), निवास (भोग स्थान), शरण (रक्षक), सुहृत् (हितकर्ता),  प्रभव (स्रष्टा), प्रलय(संहर्ता), स्थान (आधार), और निधान (लयस्थान), तथा अविकारी बीजरूप हूँ
vishnu_gita::846.english_translation: I am the mover, the sustainer, the lord, the witness, the dwelling, the refuge, the friend, the origin, the dissolution, the basis, the resting place, and the imperishable seed.
vishnu_gita::846.translation_literal: गतिर्भर्त्ता (mover and sustainer) / प्रभुः (lord) / साक्षी (witness) / निवासः (dwelling) / शरणं (refuge) / सुहृत् (friend) / प्रभवः (origin) / प्रलयः (dissolution) / स्थानं (basis) / निधानं (resting place) / बीजम् (seed) / अव्ययम् (imperishable)
vishnu_gita::846.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::846.essence: You embody every role in the cycle of existence while remaining unchanged within.
vishnu_gita::846.simple_meaning: You are at once the force behind movement, the observer, the home, the protector, the friend, the origin, and the eternal seed that never changes.
vishnu_gita::846.simple_insight: You can feel steady knowing you are both observer and source of all life’s flow.
vishnu_gita::846.detailed_meaning: In this verse, Vishnu reveals his all-encompassing nature as the mover, protector, observer, and eternal seed that underlies creation and dissolution, showing the unity behind all roles and changes.
vishnu_gita::846.modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic and roles pull you every way, remember you are the steady presence supporting all change within and around you.
vishnu_gita::846.insight: It teaches you to recognize your inner being as both the silent witness and the active source beneath all experience.

vishnu_gita::847.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनञ्च ।
वेदैश्च सर्बेरहमेव वेद्यो वेदान्तकृवेदविदेव चाहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::847.verse_hindi: मैं सबके हृदय में सन्निविष्ट हूँ, मुझसे  स्मृति, ज्ञान और इन दोनों का विलय होता है, सभी वेदों से जानने योग्य मै ही हूँ, वेदान्तकृत् अर्थात् ज्ञान देने वाला गुरु और वेदो को जानने वाला मैं ही हूँ
vishnu_gita::847.english_translation: I dwell in the heart of all; from me comes memory, knowledge, and their union. I am the knower of all the Vedas, the teacher of Vedanta, and the one who understands the Vedas.
vishnu_gita::847.translation_literal: सर्वस्य (of all) चाहं (I) हृदि (in the heart) सन्निविष्टो (reside) मत्तः (from me) स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनञ्च (memory, knowledge and their union) । वेदैश्च (by the Vedas also) सर्बे (all) अहमेव (indeed I) वेद्यो (to be known) वेदान्तकृवेदविदेव (Vedanta-maker and knower of the Vedas) चाहम् (am)
vishnu_gita::847.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::847.essence: The divine dwells within every heart as the source of all knowledge and memory.
vishnu_gita::847.simple_meaning: The divine presence lives in every heart and is the source of all memory and knowledge, including the deep understanding of sacred texts.
vishnu_gita::847.simple_insight: You can feel connected to a source of wisdom and memory that resides within you.
vishnu_gita::847.detailed_meaning: Vishnu reveals he is present inside every being’s heart as the origin of memory and knowledge. He is the ultimate teacher and knower of the sacred Vedas and Vedanta philosophy, emphasizing the inner source of spiritual wisdom.
vishnu_gita::847.modern_relevance: When you pause quietly, you might sense a deeper knowing rising from within—your own inner source of wisdom and memory.
vishnu_gita::847.insight: Recognize that wisdom and memory arise from within you, not just from outside learning.

vishnu_gita::848.verse_sanskrit:
मनोयोगेन मां देवाः ! मद्विभूतिषु पश्यत ।
धीयोगेन निरीक्षध्वं विरारूपेऽथवा बुधाः ! ॥
vishnu_gita::848.verse_hindi: हे विज्ञ देवतागण ! मनोयोग से मेरी विभूतियों में मेरा दर्शन करो तथा बुद्धि योग से विराट रूप में मेरा दर्शन करो अथवा हे सुरश्रेष्ठो !
vishnu_gita::848.english_translation: O divine beings, perceive me in my manifestations through focused mind, and by discerning wisdom, behold my cosmic form or my true essence.
vishnu_gita::848.translation_literal: मनोयोगेन (by mind-focused yoga) मां (me) देवाः (divine beings) ! मद्विभूतिषु (in my manifestations) पश्यत (see) । धीयोगेन (by wisdom-yoga) निरीक्षध्वं (examine) विरारूपेऽथवा (in cosmic form or) बुधाः (wise ones) !
vishnu_gita::848.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::848.essence: The divine can be perceived through focused mind or through discerning wisdom as cosmic form or essence.
vishnu_gita::848.simple_meaning: Use your focused mind to see the divine in everyday forms and your discerning wisdom to perceive the divine's vast cosmic presence or true essence.
vishnu_gita::848.simple_insight: You feel empowered knowing your mind and wisdom can reveal the divine everywhere and beyond appearances.
vishnu_gita::848.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses divine beings, inviting them to perceive him both through mental focus on his manifestations and through deep wisdom to see his universal cosmic form or true essence. It teaches two ways to experience the divine reality.
vishnu_gita::848.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by complexity, you can choose to focus on details or step back to see the bigger picture clearly.
vishnu_gita::848.insight: It teaches you to shift between focused attention on details and broad wisdom to understand deeper truths.

vishnu_gita::849.verse_sanskrit:
ममैवात्मस्वरूपं हि समाधिद्वारतोऽथवा ।
ब्रह्मानन्दप्रपूर्ण तल्लभध्वं सुरसत्तमाः ! ॥
vishnu_gita::849.verse_hindi: समाधि के द्वारा मेरे ब्रह्मानन्दपूर्ण आत्मस्वरूप को प्राप्त हो ।
vishnu_gita::849.english_translation: Through samadhi, attain my true self, full of the supreme bliss of Brahman, O best of the gods!
vishnu_gita::849.translation_literal: ममैव (my own) / आत्मस्वरूपं (true self form) / हि (indeed) / समाधिद्वारतः (through samadhi) / अथवा (or) / ब्रह्मानन्दप्रपूर्ण (full of supreme bliss) / तल्लभध्वं (attain that) / सुरसत्तमाः (O best of gods)
vishnu_gita::849.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::849.essence: Deep absorbed stillness reveals your blissful true self beyond all appearances.
vishnu_gita::849.simple_meaning: By entering deep absorbed presence (samadhi), you can realize your true self that is full of supreme bliss.
vishnu_gita::849.simple_insight: There is a profound bliss waiting within you when you find complete inner stillness.
vishnu_gita::849.detailed_meaning: Vishnu speaks to the best of the radiant beings, inviting them to enter samadhi, a state of complete absorbed presence, to experience the true self filled with the bliss of the supreme reality.
vishnu_gita::849.modern_relevance: When your mind quiets in deep focus or meditation, you touch a joyful part of yourself beyond everyday stress.
vishnu_gita::849.insight: It teaches you to seek deep inner stillness as a gateway to experiencing your blissful true nature.

vishnu_gita::850.verse_sanskrit:
येन केन च योगेन पश्यद्गयो मां निरन्तरम् ।
दातुं वः परमां शान्तिं सर्वथैवोद्यतोऽस्म्यहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::850.verse_hindi: जिस किसी प्रकार से निरन्तर मेरा दर्शन करने वाले तुम लोगों को मैं सर्वथा ही परम शान्ति देने को प्रस्तुत हूँ
vishnu_gita::850.english_translation: By whichever yoga you constantly behold me, I am fully prepared to grant you supreme peace.
vishnu_gita::850.translation_literal: येन (by which) / केन (which) / च (and) / योगेन (yoga) / पश्यत् (seeing) / माम् (me) / निरन्तरम् (continuously) । दातुम् (to give) / वः (you) / परमां (supreme) / शान्तिम् (peace) / सर्वथैव (in every way) / उद्यतः (prepared) / अस्मि (I am) / अहम् (I) ॥
vishnu_gita::850.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::850.essence: Steady focus on the divine invites complete peace without fail.
vishnu_gita::850.simple_meaning: By focusing on the divine through any kind of yoga continuously, you open yourself to receiving supreme peace fully offered to you.
vishnu_gita::850.simple_insight: You can feel hope and calm knowing that sincere devotion always meets you with peace.
vishnu_gita::850.detailed_meaning: Vishnu tells seekers that no matter what yoga or practice they use to keep their focus on him, he is fully ready to give them the highest peace. This arises in a teaching moment encouraging steady devotion as a path to calm.
vishnu_gita::850.modern_relevance: When you pause in your busy day to remember your deeper connection, peace is already waiting to fill you.
vishnu_gita::850.insight: It teaches you to approach your spiritual practice with steady, sincere focus, knowing peace is the natural response.

vishnu_gita::851.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वधान परित्यज्य शरणं यात मां ध्रुवम् ।
अहं वः सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि नो भयम् ॥
vishnu_gita::851.verse_hindi: सब धर्मों को छोड़कर निश्चय एकमात्र मेरी शरणागत हो जाओ कुछ भय नहीं है, मैं आपलोगों को सब पापों से मुक्त कर दूंगा
vishnu_gita::851.english_translation: Abandon all other duties and take firm refuge in me; I will free you from all wrongdoing without fear.
vishnu_gita::851.translation_literal: सर्वधान (all duties) / परित्यज्य (abandoning) / शरणं (refuge) / यात (go) / मां (to me) / ध्रुवम् (firmly) / अहं (I) / वः (you all) / सर्वपापेभ्यो (from all wrongdoings) / मोक्षयिष्यामि (will liberate) / नो (no) / भयम् (fear)
vishnu_gita::851.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::851.essence: Complete surrender to the divine frees you from all wrongdoing and fear.
vishnu_gita::851.simple_meaning: Give up all other duties and take firm refuge in the divine. There is no need to fear because you will be freed from all wrongdoing.
vishnu_gita::851.simple_insight: You can feel safe and completely supported by surrendering fully to the divine.
vishnu_gita::851.detailed_meaning: Vishnu tells seekers to leave behind all other obligations and take complete refuge in him. This moment invites total surrender as the path to freedom from all wrongdoing and fear.
vishnu_gita::851.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by many responsibilities and fears, you can choose to let go and trust a steady support that frees you from guilt and worry.
vishnu_gita::851.insight: It shifts your focus from trying to manage everything alone to trusting complete refuge as the source of freedom.

vishnu_gita::852.verse_sanskrit:
अहं हि सर्वभूतानां तिष्ठामि हृदयेऽमराः ।
भ्रामयन सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूदानि मायया ॥
vishnu_gita::852.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! मैं ही यन्त्रारूढ़ सब प्राणियों को माया से नचाता हुआ उनके हृदय में स्थित रहता हूँ
vishnu_gita::852.english_translation: I dwell in the heart of all beings, the immortal, guiding all beings like machines controlled by illusion.
vishnu_gita::852.translation_literal: अहं (I) हि (indeed) सर्वभूतानां (of all beings) तिष्ठामि (I dwell) हृदयेऽमराः (in the heart, the immortal) । भ्रामयन (causing to wander) सर्वभूतानि (all beings) यन्त्रारूदानि (like machines controlled) मायया (by illusion) ॥
vishnu_gita::852.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::852.essence: The divine dwells within all beings, guiding them through the veil of illusion.
vishnu_gita::852.simple_meaning: The divine being resides at the core of all living beings and moves them as if controlling machines through illusion.
vishnu_gita::852.simple_insight: There is a powerful presence within you that guides your actions beyond your awareness.
vishnu_gita::852.detailed_meaning: Vishnu reveals that he exists within every living being's heart as the immortal presence, controlling their actions like a driver of machines using the force of illusion, highlighting divine control behind life.
vishnu_gita::852.modern_relevance: You feel like a passenger as your habits and instincts often lead your actions, unaware of the deeper force guiding you.
vishnu_gita::852.insight: It invites shifting from feeling fully in control to recognizing the subtle unseen forces that shape your choices.

vishnu_gita::853.verse_sanskrit:
मामेव शरणं यात सर्वभावेन निर्जराः ।
मत्प्रसादात्परां शान्ति स्थान प्राप्स्यथ शाश्वतम् ॥
vishnu_gita::853.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! आपलोग सब भावों से मेरी ही शरण को प्राप्त हो, मेरी कृपा से परम शान्ति को और सनातन स्थान को प्राप्त करोगे
vishnu_gita::853.english_translation: O divine beings! Fully surrender to me with all your feelings; by my grace, you will attain supreme peace and eternal abode.
vishnu_gita::853.translation_literal: मामेव (to me alone) / शरणं (refuge) / यात (may you go) / सर्वभावेन (with all feelings) / निर्जराः (without aging) / मत्प्रसादात् (by my grace) / परां (supreme) / शान्ति (peace) / स्थान (abode) / प्राप्स्यथ (you will attain) / शाश्वतम् (eternal)
vishnu_gita::853.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::853.essence: Complete surrender to the divine brings eternal peace and lasting refuge.
vishnu_gita::853.simple_meaning: When you surrender completely with all your feelings to the divine, you receive supreme peace and eternal refuge through divine grace.
vishnu_gita::853.simple_insight: You can feel safe and deeply peaceful by trusting fully in the divine's care.
vishnu_gita::853.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses divine beings, urging them to surrender completely with all their feelings. This surrender grants them divine grace, leading to supreme peace and an eternal, unchanging spiritual home.
vishnu_gita::853.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by life’s chaos, offering your whole self in trust can bring deep and lasting peace.
vishnu_gita::853.insight: It teaches you to let go of control and fully trust, opening the way to inner peace.

vishnu_gita::854.verse_sanskrit:
देवादिदेव : सर्वात्मन् ! महाविष्णो ! दयानिधे !!
जगनिवास ! ते स्वामिन्नपारकृपयाऽधुना ॥
vishnu_gita::854.verse_hindi: हे देवादिदेव ! हे जगनिवास ! हे सर्वात्मन् ! हे महाविष्णो! हे दयानिधे हे स्वामिन् ! अब आपकी अपार कृपासे
vishnu_gita::854.english_translation: O God of gods! O inner being of all! O great Vishnu! O treasure of compassion! O Lord! Now, by your boundless compassion...
vishnu_gita::854.translation_literal: देवादिदेव (God of gods) : सर्वात्मन् (inner being of all) ! महाविष्णो (great Vishnu) ! दयानिधे (treasure of compassion) !! जगनिवास (world's shelter) ! ते (your) स्वामिन् (lord) अपारकृपयाऽधुना (by boundless compassion) ॥
vishnu_gita::854.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::854.essence: Vishnu is invoked as the compassionate inner being and protector of all.
vishnu_gita::854.simple_meaning: This is a respectful invocation praising Vishnu's boundless compassion, calling him the inner being and protector of the world.
vishnu_gita::854.simple_insight: There is a feeling of humble reverence and trust in the divine's infinite care.
vishnu_gita::854.detailed_meaning: This verse is a devotional invocation addressing Vishnu with many exalted titles, recognizing his infinite compassion and role as protector. It sets a tone of reverence but does not contain a standalone teaching.
vishnu_gita::854.insight: It invites you to open to compassion as a source of support and trust beyond yourself.

vishnu_gita::855.verse_sanskrit:
मोहतापविनिर्मुक्ताः सन्तश्च निर्भया वयम् ।
वीतसन्देहसन्दोहाः कृतकृत्या अभूम ह ॥
vishnu_gita::855.verse_hindi: हम लोग मोह रहित तापरहित और भयरहित तथा सर्वसंशयरहित होकर कृतकृत्य हुए हैं।
vishnu_gita::855.english_translation: We have become free from delusion, suffering, and fear, completely fulfilled and free of all doubt.
vishnu_gita::855.translation_literal: मोहतापविनिर्मुक्ताः (free from delusion and suffering) सन्तः (being) च (and) निर्भया (fearless) वयम् (we) । वीता (gone) संदेहसन्दोहाः (all doubts and confusion) कृतकृत्या (completely fulfilled) अभूम (we have become) ह (indeed) ॥
vishnu_gita::855.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::855.essence: Freedom from fear, doubt, and suffering reveals complete inner fulfillment.
vishnu_gita::855.simple_meaning: You can become free from confusion, suffering, and fear, feeling completely fulfilled and certain.
vishnu_gita::855.simple_insight: There is peace in knowing you have left behind fear and doubt for true fulfillment.
vishnu_gita::855.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares that those who have transcended confusion, suffering, and fear reach a state of complete fulfillment, free of all doubts. This moment captures the calm assurance of inner clarity after overcoming mental turmoil.
vishnu_gita::855.modern_relevance: You face a moment when fears and doubts that once held you captive begin to dissolve, leaving you peaceful and confident within.
vishnu_gita::855.insight: It teaches you to recognize freedom from inner turmoil as true fulfillment, anchoring your mind in clarity.

vishnu_gita::856.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वे हि साम्प्रतं विश्वं भाति नः स्वकुटुम्बवत् ।
राक्षसासुरमाश्च सन्त्यात्मीया हि नोऽधुना ॥
vishnu_gita::856.verse_hindi: अब समस्त विश्व ही कुटुम्बवत् हम लोगों को प्रतीत होता है, इस समय असुर राक्षस और मनुष्य हमारे आत्मीय हैं
vishnu_gita::856.english_translation: Now the entire world appears like family to us; demons, asuras, and humans alike feel like our own.
vishnu_gita::856.translation_literal: सर्वे (all) / हि (indeed) / साम्प्रतं (now) / विश्वं (world) / भाति (appears) / नः (to us) / स्वकुटुम्बवत् (like own family) / राक्षसासुरमाश्च (demons, asuras, and also) / सन्ति (are) / आत्मीया (intimate) / हि (indeed) / नोऽधुना (to us now)
vishnu_gita::856.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::856.essence: Everything appears like family, even those once seen as enemies.
vishnu_gita::856.simple_meaning: Right now, everything in the world feels like one big family, including beings often seen as enemies or strangers.
vishnu_gita::856.simple_insight: You may notice a sudden sense of connection even with those you usually see as different or opposed.
vishnu_gita::856.detailed_meaning: In this moment, the speaker observes a profound shift where all beings—humans, demons, and asuras—feel close and familial, dissolving usual boundaries of friend and foe.
vishnu_gita::856.modern_relevance: You might feel unexpectedly connected to people you usually avoid or dislike, as if everyone around you suddenly belongs together.
vishnu_gita::856.insight: It softens the mind's division between self and other, inviting a broader sense of belonging.

vishnu_gita::857.verse_sanskrit:
साम्यबुद्धौ प्रजातायामेवं नाथ ! प्रतीयते ।
अत एवमिवधेदानीमिच्छा नो जायते स्वत: ॥
vishnu_gita::857.verse_hindi: हे नाथ ! साम्यबुद्धि उत्पन्न होने से हमलोगों को ऐसा प्रतीत होने लगा है इस कारण ही अब हम लोगों की स्वतः ऐसी इच्छा हो रही है
vishnu_gita::857.english_translation: O Lord! From the arising of equal-mindedness, it seems so to us; therefore, now such a desire arises in us naturally.
vishnu_gita::857.translation_literal: साम्यबुद्धौ (in equal-mindedness) / प्रजातायामेवं (thus appearing) / नाथ (O lord) / प्रतीयते (is perceived) / अत (therefore) / एवम् (so) / इव (like) / अधे (now) / न (not) / इच्छा (desire) / नो (in us) / जायते (arises) / स्वत: (naturally)
vishnu_gita::857.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::857.essence: Balanced mind naturally reveals fresh desires and perceptions.
vishnu_gita::857.simple_meaning: When your mind becomes balanced, certain desires naturally arise because of this new clarity.
vishnu_gita::857.simple_insight: You notice new feelings emerging when your mind finds calm balance.
vishnu_gita::857.detailed_meaning: The speaker addresses the Lord, explaining that as their mind attains equal calmness, certain desires or intentions naturally appear. This moment marks a shift in their inner experience, showing the effect of balanced perception.
vishnu_gita::857.modern_relevance: You notice fresh motivations or clarity emerging when your thoughts settle evenly after stress.
vishnu_gita::857.insight: It shows how mental balance naturally brings new, clearer desires without force.

vishnu_gita::858.verse_sanskrit:
यज्ज्ञानमुपदिष्टं नस्त्वयापारदयावशात् ।
तस्य सर्वेषु लोकेषु प्रचारोऽस्तु निरन्तरम् ॥
vishnu_gita::858.verse_hindi: कि आपने अपार कृपावश जो हम लोगों को ज्ञानोउपदेश देय है उसका निरंतर प्रचार सब लोकों में हो जाए
vishnu_gita::858.english_translation: May the boundless teaching of knowledge You have graciously given continue to spread endlessly in all worlds.
vishnu_gita::858.translation_literal: यत् (that) ज्ञानम् (knowledge) उपदिष्टम् (taught) न (not) त्वय् (by you) अपार (boundless) दयावशात् (due to compassion) । तस्य (of that) सर्वेषु (in all) लोकेषु (worlds) प्रचारः (spread) अस्तु (let there be) निरन्तरम् (continuous) ॥
vishnu_gita::858.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::858.essence: True wisdom, born of compassion, is meant to spread endlessly and touch all lives.
vishnu_gita::858.simple_meaning: The vast wisdom kindly shared should keep spreading everywhere without stopping.
vishnu_gita::858.simple_insight: There is hope and trust in wisdom's power to reach and transform all places.
vishnu_gita::858.detailed_meaning: Vishnu expresses a heartfelt wish that the vast knowledge He has compassionately taught will never cease to spread across all realms, ensuring everyone benefits from this wisdom.
vishnu_gita::858.modern_relevance: You just learned something valuable and wish it could inspire everyone you know, everywhere, without end.
vishnu_gita::858.insight: It encourages seeing knowledge as alive, meant to be shared endlessly beyond personal limits.

vishnu_gita::859.verse_sanskrit:
कर्मभूमौ भवेन्नूनं मर्त्यलोके विशेषतः ।
प्रचारः सर्वथा नाथ ! ज्ञानस्यास्य दयाम्बुधे ! ॥
vishnu_gita::859.verse_hindi: हे नाथ ! हे दयाम्बुधे! विशेषतः कर्मभूमि मनुष्यलोक में इस ज्ञान का प्रचार सब प्रकार से अवश्य होना चाहिए
vishnu_gita::859.english_translation: O Lord, especially in the field of action and the human realm, this knowledge must be spread in every way.
vishnu_gita::859.translation_literal: कर्मभूमौ (in the field of action) भवेन्नूनं (indeed will be) मर्त्यलोके (in the mortal world) विशेषतः (especially) । प्रचारः (the spreading) सर्वथा (in all ways) नाथ (O Lord) ! ज्ञानस्यास्य (of this knowledge) दयाम्बुधे (O ocean of compassion) ! ॥
vishnu_gita::859.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::859.essence: True knowledge must be actively spread through meaningful action in the human world.
vishnu_gita::859.simple_meaning: This knowledge should be spread especially through actions in the human world, by all means possible.
vishnu_gita::859.simple_insight: You realize that sharing wisdom depends on what you do, not just what you say.
vishnu_gita::859.detailed_meaning: Suta speaks to the compassionate Lord, emphasizing that the teaching of wisdom must be actively spread, especially in the human realm where action shapes reality.
vishnu_gita::859.modern_relevance: You find that the best way to influence others is not just by words but by how you live and act every day.
vishnu_gita::859.insight: It shifts focus to using your actions as the main way to communicate and embody wisdom.

vishnu_gita::860.verse_sanskrit:
यतो मनुष्यलोको नः सम्वृद्धेर्मुख्यकारणम् ।
इदानीं करुणासिंधो ! बुर्द्धिन समता गता ॥
vishnu_gita::860.verse_hindi: क्योंकि मनुष्यलोक हीं हमलोगों के संवर्द्धन का प्रधान कारण है। हे करुणा सिन्धो ! अब हमलोगों की बुद्धि समता में पहुंच गई है
vishnu_gita::860.english_translation: Because the human realm is the primary cause of our growth; O ocean of compassion, now our intellect has reached equanimity.
vishnu_gita::860.translation_literal: यतः (because) मनुष्यलोको (human realm) नः (our) सम्वृद्धेः (growth) मुख्यम् (primary) कारणम् (cause) । इदानीं (now) करुणा-सिंधो (ocean of compassion) बुद्धिः (intellect) समता (equanimity) गता (has reached) ॥
vishnu_gita::860.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::860.essence: Your steady mind arises from growth through human experience.
vishnu_gita::860.simple_meaning: Our development depends mainly on experiences in the human world. Now, your mind has become steady and balanced.
vishnu_gita::860.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing that your steady mind grew through your human experiences.
vishnu_gita::860.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that the human realm is the key factor in our growth and learning. Addressing a compassionate being, he notes that the intellect has now achieved balance, marking a turning point in understanding.
vishnu_gita::860.modern_relevance: After many challenges in daily life, you finally feel your mind settling, steady and balanced from everything you've faced.
vishnu_gita::860.insight: It teaches you to see human experience as the foundation for mental balance and growth.

vishnu_gita::861.verse_sanskrit:
इच्छामो हि वयश्चानो भतसझं चतुर्विधम् ।
आरभ्य निखिला जीवा देवतासुरमानवाः ॥
vishnu_gita::861.verse_hindi: इस कारण हम इच्छा करते हैं कि चतुर्विध भूतसंघ से लेकर मनुष्य, देवता और असुर तथा
vishnu_gita::861.english_translation: For this reason, I desire that the fourfold beings—from the elemental groups to humans, devas, and asuras—begin.
vishnu_gita::861.translation_literal: इच्छामो (desire we) / हि (indeed) / वयश्चानो (we and you) / भतसझं (from the group of beings) / चतुर्विधम् (fourfold) / आरभ्य (beginning) / निखिला (all) / जीवा (living beings) / देवतासुरमानवाः (devas, asuras, humans)
vishnu_gita::861.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::861.essence: A desire to explain the four types of beings begins the teaching.
vishnu_gita::861.simple_meaning: The speaker expresses a wish to start discussing the four groups of beings: elemental forces, gods, demons, and humans.
vishnu_gita::861.simple_insight: There's anticipation for explaining the diverse living beings and their nature.
vishnu_gita::861.detailed_meaning: Vishnu is about to begin a teaching concerning the fourfold classification of beings, including elemental forces, gods, demons, and humans, setting the stage for a deeper discourse.
vishnu_gita::861.insight: It introduces the scope of the teaching, preparing you to understand the diverse aspects of existence.

vishnu_gita::862.verse_sanskrit:
वर्तन्तेऽन्ये च ये जीवास्ते सर्वे ने समानतः ।
लब्ध्वाऽसीमदयाराशि कृतकृत्या भवन्त्वलम् ॥
vishnu_gita::862.verse_hindi: अन्यान्य जो जीव है वे सब आपको अपार कृपापुंज को समान रूप से प्राप्त करके सम्यक् कृतकृत्य हो जाएँ।
vishnu_gita::862.english_translation: Other beings exist who, having received your boundless compassion equally, become fully content.
vishnu_gita::862.translation_literal: वर्तन्तेऽन्ये (exist other) च (and) ये (who) जीवास्ते (beings those) सर्वे (all) ने (not) समानतः (equally) लब्ध्वा (having obtained) असीमदयाराशि (boundless compassion) कृतकृत्या (fully content) भवन्त्वलम् (become)
vishnu_gita::862.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::862.essence: Equal compassion from you fills others completely with gratitude and contentment.
vishnu_gita::862.simple_meaning: Many beings receive your limitless compassion equally and become fully satisfied and grateful.
vishnu_gita::862.simple_insight: You can fill others with peace simply by sharing your kindness without partiality.
vishnu_gita::862.detailed_meaning: Vishnu speaks of how countless beings exist who, through receiving his infinite compassion equally, become truly fulfilled and free of want. This verse highlights the power of universal, impartial care in inspiring contentment.
vishnu_gita::862.modern_relevance: When you share kindness openly and equally, people around you feel genuinely supported and satisfied without competition or comparison.
vishnu_gita::862.insight: It teaches to extend compassion impartially, which transforms how others feel and respond to life.

vishnu_gita::863.verse_sanskrit:
ज्ञानमस्याश्च गीतायाः प्राप्य मोदं वहन्तु ते ।
एषैव प्रार्थनाऽसमाकमेतदेवाभिवंछितम ॥
vishnu_gita::863.verse_hindi: और वे इस गीता का ज्ञान पाकर आनन्दित होकर, यही हम लोगों की प्रार्थना और यही अभिलाषा है
vishnu_gita::863.english_translation: And may you be joyful having attained the knowledge of this Gita; this alone is our prayer and desire.
vishnu_gita::863.translation_literal: ज्ञानमस्याश्च (of this knowledge) गीतायाः (of the Gita) प्राप्य (having attained) मोदं (joy) वहन्तु (may carry) ते (you). एषैव (this alone) प्रार्थनाऽसमाकम् (prayer of us) एते (this) एव (only) अभिवंछितम (desired).
vishnu_gita::863.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::863.essence: True joy comes from gaining deep understanding, and sharing this wish connects us.
vishnu_gita::863.simple_meaning: May you feel joy after gaining the knowledge shared here; this is our heartfelt wish.
vishnu_gita::863.simple_insight: There is happiness in receiving wisdom, and wishing this for others connects us.
vishnu_gita::863.detailed_meaning: The speaker expresses a heartfelt wish that those who receive the Gita's teachings find true joy, emphasizing the value placed on this knowledge and the shared desire for others to benefit.
vishnu_gita::863.modern_relevance: You hope someone close to you finds joy and meaning in the lessons you've shared or learned together.
vishnu_gita::863.insight: It encourages valuing the joy that comes from understanding and wishing that joy for others.

vishnu_gita::864.verse_sanskrit:
नथाऽस्तु भवतां देवाः ! यथाभिलषितं वरम् ।
प्रार्थितं सर्वलोकानां यतो मंगलहेतवे ॥
vishnu_gita::864.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! आपका अभिलषित वर जैसा है वैसा हो क्योंकि आपने सभी लोकों के मंगलार्थ प्रार्थना की है
vishnu_gita::864.english_translation: May your desired boon be granted, O radiant beings, for you have prayed for the welfare of all worlds.
vishnu_gita::864.translation_literal: नथाऽस्तु (may there not be a denial) भवतां (of you all) देवाः (radiant beings) ! यथा (as) अभिलषितं (desired) वरम् (boon) । प्रार्थितं (prayed) सर्वलोकानां (all worlds') यतः (because) मंगलहेतवे (for the cause of welfare) ॥
vishnu_gita::864.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::864.essence: Those who pray for all receive their own wishes fulfilled.
vishnu_gita::864.simple_meaning: May you receive the boon you desire, because you have wished for the well-being of all worlds.
vishnu_gita::864.simple_insight: Wishing well for everyone invites blessings for yourself too.
vishnu_gita::864.detailed_meaning: Suta addresses the radiant beings (devas), acknowledging their prayer for universal welfare and wishing that their desired boon be fulfilled. This verse is a respectful benediction rather than a teaching.
vishnu_gita::864.insight: Recognizing others' good intentions encourages mutual support and harmony.

vishnu_gita::865.verse_sanskrit:
मत्परायणया धृत्या सात्विक्या भवतां सुराः ।
ज्ञानगर्भिता चैव सात्विकक्या धर्म्युक्त्या ॥
vishnu_gita::865.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! आप लोगो की  मत्परायण सात्त्विक वृत्ति से और सात्त्विकी, ज्ञानसम्पन्ना, धर्म युक्ता,
vishnu_gita::865.english_translation: O divine beings, your nature should be devoted to Me, pure and steadfast, full of wisdom and aligned with righteousness.
vishnu_gita::865.translation_literal: मत्परायणया (devoted to Me) / धृत्या (with steadfastness) / सात्विक्या (pure/noble) / भवतां (of you all) / सुराः (divine beings) / ज्ञानगर्भिता (full of wisdom) / चैव (also) / सात्विकक्या (pure/noble) / धर्म्युक्त्या (with righteousness/virtue)
vishnu_gita::865.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::865.essence: True devotion combines steadfastness, wisdom, and alignment with what is right.
vishnu_gita::865.simple_meaning: Your attitude should be devoted to the divine, steady, pure, wise, and aligned with what is right.
vishnu_gita::865.simple_insight: Devotion grounded in steady wisdom brings clarity and strength to your spirit.
vishnu_gita::865.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses the divine beings, encouraging them to cultivate a devoted nature that is steadfast, pure, full of knowledge, and guided by righteous behavior.
vishnu_gita::865.modern_relevance: When you commit deeply to your values with clear understanding and consistency, your focus and resolve strengthen naturally.
vishnu_gita::865.insight: It teaches you to combine heartfelt devotion with steady wisdom and ethical alignment for lasting inner strength.

vishnu_gita::866.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वलोकहितैषिण्या विनीतोदारया तथा।
प्रार्थनया प्रसन्नोऽस्मि तथेत्यस्तु पुन वे ॥
vishnu_gita::866.verse_hindi: सर्वलोकहितकरी, विनीत और उदार प्रार्थना से मैं प्रसन्न हुआ हूँ। मैं पुनः कहता हूँ कि ऐसा ही हो
vishnu_gita::866.english_translation: I am pleased by the humble and generous prayer made for the welfare of all beings. Therefore, I say again, may it be so.
vishnu_gita::866.translation_literal: सर्वलोकहितैषिण्या (for the welfare of all worlds) / विनीतोदारया (with humble and generous) / तथा (thus) / प्रार्थनया (prayer) / प्रसन्नोऽस्मि (I am pleased) / तथेत्यस्तु (therefore, indeed) / पुन (again) / वे (may it be)
vishnu_gita::866.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::866.essence: Humble prayers for all beings please the divine and invite fulfillment.
vishnu_gita::866.simple_meaning: The divine is pleased by a humble, generous prayer for the good of all beings and affirms that it will be so.
vishnu_gita::866.simple_insight: Offering goodwill with humility opens the heart and invites a positive response.
vishnu_gita::866.detailed_meaning: After hearing a prayer made with humility and generosity for the welfare of all beings, Vishnu expresses his pleasure and reaffirms that such prayers are powerful and effective.
vishnu_gita::866.modern_relevance: When you sincerely wish well for everyone with a humble heart, it brings a sense of peace and positive momentum.
vishnu_gita::866.insight: Recognize that prayers or intentions offered with humility and generosity invite a benevolent response from the inner being.

vishnu_gita::867.verse_sanskrit:
गीतेयं विष्णुगीतेति नाम्ना ग्न्याता भविष्यति ।
मर्त्यलोके पुनश्चास्याः कृष्णरूपेण वै सुराः ॥
vishnu_gita::867.verse_hindi: हे देवगण ! यह गीता विष्णुगीता नाम से प्रख्यात होगी और इस गीता के उत्तम ज्ञान को मैं पुनः
vishnu_gita::867.english_translation: O celestial beings! This song will be known as the Vishnu Gita, and its supreme wisdom will again appear in the mortal world as Krishna's form.
vishnu_gita::867.translation_literal:
गीतेयं (this song) विष्णुगीतेति (as Vishnu Gita) नाम्ना (by the name) ग्न्याता (known) भविष्यति (will be) ।
मर्त्यलोके (in mortal world) पुनश्चास्याः (again of this) कृष्णरूपेण (in Krishna form) वै (indeed) सुराः (celestial beings) ॥
vishnu_gita::867.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::867.essence: The supreme teaching will reappear in the mortal world as Krishna.
vishnu_gita::867.simple_meaning: This song will be called the Vishnu Gita and its supreme knowledge will again appear in the mortal realm as Krishna.
vishnu_gita::867.simple_insight: Great wisdom returns in forms we recognize, connecting divine and mortal worlds.
vishnu_gita::867.detailed_meaning: The narrator explains that this sacred song is known as the Vishnu Gita, and its highest knowledge will manifest again in the mortal world as Krishna, linking the eternal teaching with a revered form.
vishnu_gita::867.insight: It reminds you that timeless wisdom can return in ways that feel familiar and accessible.

vishnu_gita::868.verse_sanskrit:
द्वापरान्तेऽवतीाह गीताया ज्ञानमुत्तमम् ।
प्रचार्य पूरयिष्यामि भवनां शुभकामनाः ॥
vishnu_gita::868.verse_hindi: द्वापर के अन्त में मनुष्यलोक में कृष्ण रूप से अवतीर्ण होकर प्रचारित करके आपकी शुभ कामनाओं को पूर्ण करूंगा
vishnu_gita::868.english_translation: At the end of Dvapara, I will incarnate as Krishna to spread the highest knowledge and fulfill your good wishes.
vishnu_gita::868.translation_literal: द्वापरान्तेऽवतीाह (at the end of Dvapara incarnate) गीताया (by the song) ज्ञानमुत्तमम् (the highest knowledge) । प्रचार्य (by spreading) पूरयिष्यामि (I will fulfill) भवनां (of your) शुभकामनाः (good wishes) ॥
vishnu_gita::868.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::868.essence: Divine wisdom will manifest through Krishna when the time is right.
vishnu_gita::868.simple_meaning: I will appear as Krishna at the end of the Dvapara age to share the highest wisdom and fulfill your best wishes.
vishnu_gita::868.simple_insight: The divine promises to come and guide when the time is right.
vishnu_gita::868.detailed_meaning: Vishnu announces that at the end of the Dvapara Yuga, he will incarnate as Krishna in the human world to spread supreme knowledge and fulfill the hopes of those who seek it.
vishnu_gita::868.insight: It shows that guidance and wisdom come at the right moment for those ready to receive it.

vishnu_gita::869.verse_sanskrit:
सर्वोपनिषदां सारो वेदनिष्कर्ष एव च ।
योगयुन्ज्यांनचित्तानां गीतेयं ज्ञानवर्तिका ॥
vishnu_gita::869.verse_hindi: यह गीता सब वेदों का निष्कर्ष, उपनिषदों का सार और योगाभ्यास निरत व्यक्तियों के लिये ज्ञानप्रदीप है
vishnu_gita::869.english_translation: This Gita is the essence of all Upanishads, the summary of the Vedas, and a lamp of knowledge for those engaged in yoga practice.
vishnu_gita::869.translation_literal: सर्वोपनिषदां (of all Upanishads) / सारो (essence) / वेदनिष्कर्ष (summary of Vedas) / एव (indeed) / च (also) / योगयुन्ज्यांनचित्तानां (for those engaged in yoga practice) / गीतेयं (this Gita) / ज्ञानवर्तिका (lamp of knowledge)
vishnu_gita::869.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::869.essence: A single teaching can embody the core of all ancient spiritual knowledge for sincere practitioners.
vishnu_gita::869.simple_meaning: This teaching combines the core wisdom of all the Upanishads and Vedas into a clear guide for those practicing yoga.
vishnu_gita::869.simple_insight: You can find all essential spiritual knowledge distilled into this one source, guiding your practice.
vishnu_gita::869.detailed_meaning: Vishnu declares that this Gita captures the fundamental essence of the vast Upanishads and Vedas, serving as a clear guide and source of knowledge for those devoted to yoga practice.
vishnu_gita::869.modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by countless teachings and advice, this reminds you that a single clear guide can hold the heart of all wisdom.
vishnu_gita::869.insight: It teaches you to trust a focused, distilled source of wisdom rather than chasing endless teachings.

vishnu_gita::870.verse_sanskrit:
त्रितापतापितानाच मीवानां परमामृतम् ।
संसारापारपाथोधौ मन्जतां तरणिः परा ॥
vishnu_gita::870.verse_hindi: त्रितापतापित जीवों के लिये यह परम अमृतरूपा है। संसार महासागर में डूबने वालों के लिये उत्तम नौका है
vishnu_gita::870.english_translation: For beings tormented by the threefold suffering, this is the supreme nectar; for those drowning in the vast ocean of existence, it is the highest boat of crossing.
vishnu_gita::870.translation_literal: त्रितापतापित (tormented by three sufferings) जीवों (beings) के लिये (for) यह (this) परम (supreme) अमृतरूपा (nectar-like) है (is) । संसार (world/existence) अपार (vast) पाथोधौ (in ocean) मन्जतां (drowning) तरणिः (boat/raft) परा (highest) ॥
vishnu_gita::870.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::870.essence: The divine is the supreme rescue for those overwhelmed by life's vast suffering.
vishnu_gita::870.simple_meaning: This teaching says that for those suffering deeply, the divine presence is like the highest nectar and the best boat to cross the vast sea of existence.
vishnu_gita::870.simple_insight: You can feel relief knowing the divine is always a rescue when life feels overwhelming.
vishnu_gita::870.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes the suffering of beings overwhelmed by life's threefold pains. To these beings, the divine is the supreme nectar and a perfect boat to cross the endless ocean of existence, offering hope and refuge.
vishnu_gita::870.modern_relevance: When stress feels like drowning in an endless sea, you can find a lifeline in trust that something greater supports you.
vishnu_gita::870.insight: It shifts your view from isolation in suffering to seeing the divine as a reliable refuge and rescue.

vishnu_gita::871.verse_hindi: इसके अध्ययन अध्यापन द्वारा अवश्य आध्यात्मिक ताप शीघ्र नष्ट होता है और इसके द्वारा हे देवगण !
vishnu_gita::871.english_translation: By studying and teaching it, spiritual suffering is quickly destroyed; this is certain, O radiant beings!
vishnu_gita::871.translation_literal: क्षिप्रमाध्यात्मिकस्तापो (quickly spiritual suffering) / पठानात्पाठनद्पि (by studying and by teaching) / नश्यत्यस्या (is destroyed) / न (not) / सन्देहस्त (doubt) / तथ (thus) / एत (this) / इवारतः (certainly) / अमराः (O immortals/radiant beings)
vishnu_gita::871.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::871.essence: Actively studying and teaching spiritual wisdom swiftly ends inner suffering without doubt.
vishnu_gita::871.simple_meaning: Studying and teaching this knowledge quickly ends spiritual suffering without doubt.
vishnu_gita::871.simple_insight: There is hope in knowing that sharing wisdom heals your inner struggles swiftly.
vishnu_gita::871.detailed_meaning: Vishnu assures radiant beings that the spiritual suffering caused by inner turmoil is quickly removed by both learning and teaching this sacred wisdom, emphasizing the power of active engagement with spiritual knowledge.
vishnu_gita::871.modern_relevance: You feel stuck in a painful mental loop until you explain what you’ve learned to someone else—suddenly, relief arrives.
vishnu_gita::871.insight: It teaches you to engage actively in both learning and sharing wisdom to dissolve inner suffering.

vishnu_gita::872.verse_hindi: विश्वम्भरयाग करनेसे आधिदैविक ताप और इसके पाठ करने और कराने से आधिभौतिक ताप नष्ट होता है
vishnu_gita::872.english_translation: Performing the Vishwambhara sacrifice destroys the suffering caused by higher beings, and learning or teaching it removes suffering caused by the natural world.
vishnu_gita::872.translation_literal: विश्वम्भराख्ययागस्य (of the sacrifice called Vishwambhara) / विधानेन (by its performance) / अधिदैविकः (the suffering caused by higher beings) / आधिभौतिकतापश्च (and the suffering caused by the natural world) / पाठादस्याः (by learning or teaching it) / प्रणश्यति (is destroyed)
vishnu_gita::872.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::872.essence: Sacred acts remove cosmic suffering; their study removes worldly suffering.
vishnu_gita::872.simple_meaning: Doing the Vishwambhara sacrifice ends suffering caused by divine forces, and learning or teaching it ends suffering caused by worldly factors.
vishnu_gita::872.simple_insight: Certain sacred acts and their study can relieve deep layers of suffering.
vishnu_gita::872.detailed_meaning: The narrator explains that performing a specific ritual called Vishwambhara yajna removes suffering caused by higher cosmic forces, and studying or teaching this ritual removes suffering caused by worldly elements, highlighting the power of sacred action and knowledge.
vishnu_gita::872.insight: Recognize that both meaningful action and learning can release different kinds of burdens in life.

vishnu_gita::873.verse_sanskrit:
अस्याश्च विष्णुगीताया माहात्म्यं महदद्भुतम् ।
गीतेयञ्च मुमुक्षूणामान्मज्ञानमभीप्सताम् ॥
vishnu_gita::873.verse_hindi: इस विष्णुगीता का माहात्म्य महान् अद्भुत है, यह गीता संसार से वैराग्यवान आत्मज्ञानेच्छु मुमुक्षु
vishnu_gita::873.english_translation: The greatness of this Vishnu Gita is wondrously profound; it is the Gita desired by seekers who wish for detachment and self-knowledge.
vishnu_gita::873.translation_literal: अस्याश्च (of this) / विष्णुगीताया (Vishnu Gita) / माहात्म्यं (greatness) / महदद्भुतम् (greatly wonderful) / गीतेयञ्च (and this Gita) / मुमुक्षूणाम् (of seekers) / आन्मज्ञानम् (self-knowledge) / अभीप्सताम् (desired)
vishnu_gita::873.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::873.essence: This scripture’s greatness lies in guiding seekers toward detachment and self-knowledge.
vishnu_gita::873.simple_meaning: This Vishnu Gita is very great and wonderful. It is especially valued by those seeking detachment and knowledge of the true self.
vishnu_gita::873.simple_insight: You feel drawn to teachings that promise freedom through knowing your true self.
vishnu_gita::873.detailed_meaning: Suta praises the Vishnu Gita's greatness, highlighting it as a text especially sought after by those yearning for detachment and self-knowledge, setting the stage for the sacred teachings to follow.
vishnu_gita::873.insight: It reminds you that some teachings are especially meaningful when you seek deeper understanding and freedom.

vishnu_gita::874.verse_sanskrit:
मन्न्यस्तानां विरक्तानां गुरुरूपा च मुक्तिदा।
गीतेयं ब्रह्मचारिभ्यो गृहस्थेभ्यस्तथैव च ॥
vishnu_gita::874.verse_hindi: सन्यासियों के लिये गुरुरूप और मुक्तिप्रद है, ब्रह्मचारी और गृहस्थों के लिये यह गीता
vishnu_gita::874.english_translation: For those renounced, it is the guru and giver of freedom; for celibates and householders, it is the Gita.
vishnu_gita::874.translation_literal: मन्न्यस्तानां (to those renounced) / विरक्तानां (detached) / गुरुरूपा (like a guru) / च (and) / मुक्तिदा (giver of freedom) / गीतेयं (this Gita) / ब्रह्मचारिभ्यो (to celibates) / गृहस्थेभ्यस्तथैव (and also to householders) / च (and)
vishnu_gita::874.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::874.essence: This teaching is both a liberating guru and a guiding scripture for all life paths.
vishnu_gita::874.simple_meaning: For those who have renounced worldly desires, the teaching acts as a wise teacher and liberator; for celibates and householders, it serves as the scripture to follow.
vishnu_gita::874.simple_insight: You can rely on this teaching as a trusted guide, no matter your life stage.
vishnu_gita::874.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains how this teaching serves different roles: for renounced seekers, it is like a guru who grants freedom; for celibates and householders, it is the scripture that supports their path. It shows the teaching's universal support.
vishnu_gita::874.modern_relevance: Whether you're stepping back from life or fully engaged, this wisdom can be your steady guide and source of freedom.
vishnu_gita::874.insight: It shifts how you view teachings—from rigid scripture to a living guide tailored to your path.

vishnu_gita::875.verse_sanskrit:
धर्मार्थकामरूपो यस्त्रिवर्गस्तं हि यच्छति ।
गीतामेताच यः प्राणी स्वाध्यायविधिना पठेत् ॥
vishnu_gita::875.verse_hindi: धर्म अर्थ और कामरूपी त्रिवर्ग प्रदान करनेवाली है, जो प्राणी इसका पाठ स्वाध्याय विधि से करे
vishnu_gita::875.english_translation: Dharma, wealth, and desire are the three goals one attains; anyone who studies this song by the method of self-study gains them.
vishnu_gita::875.translation_literal: धर्म (dharma) / अर्थ (wealth) / कामरूपो (desire-formed) / यः (who) / त्रिवर्ग (three goals) / तं (that) / हि (indeed) / यत् (which) / छति (attains) / गीताम् (song) / एताच् (this) / यः (who) / प्राणी (being) / स्वाध्यायविधिना (by self-study method) / पठेत् (reads/studies)
vishnu_gita::875.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::875.essence: Dedicated study of this teaching brings the three key goals of life within reach.
vishnu_gita::875.simple_meaning: By studying this teaching carefully and sincerely, you can achieve your true purpose, material wellbeing, and desires.
vishnu_gita::875.simple_insight: There is power in sincere, disciplined study to fulfill your life's aims.
vishnu_gita::875.detailed_meaning: Vishnu explains that the three human goals—dharma (purpose), artha (wealth), and kama (desire)—can be attained by anyone who studies this sacred song through dedicated self-study, emphasizing the transformative value of disciplined learning.
vishnu_gita::875.modern_relevance: You pick up a book or course hoping it will help you build a meaningful life, financial stability, and personal satisfaction—and it can, if you truly commit to learning.
vishnu_gita::875.insight: It teaches you to approach spiritual knowledge with discipline, unlocking practical benefits alongside inner growth.

vishnu_gita::876.verse_sanskrit:
विदध्याद्विष्णुयज्ञम्बा चैतया विष्णुगीतया ।
मर्वव्याधिविनिर्मुक्तः स सुरवी सत्त्वरं भवेत् ॥
vishnu_gita::876.verse_hindi: और इसके द्वारा विष्णुयज्ञ का अनुष्ठान करे तो वह सब प्रकार की व्याधियों से मुक्त होकर शीघ्र सुखी होता है
vishnu_gita::876.english_translation: One who performs the Vishnu yajna with this knowledge becomes free from all diseases and quickly attains happiness.
vishnu_gita::876.translation_literal: विदध्याद्विष्णुयज्ञम् (should perform Vishnu yajna) बा (by) चैतया (this) विष्णुगीतया (Vishnu Gita) । मर्वव्याधिविनिर्मुक्तः (free from all diseases) स (that person) सुरवी (quickly) सत्त्वरं (happy) भवेत् (becomes) ॥
vishnu_gita::876.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::876.essence: Devotion practiced with wisdom quickly frees you from suffering and brings happiness.
vishnu_gita::876.simple_meaning: Performing the Vishnu yajna with this teaching frees you from all illnesses and brings quick happiness.
vishnu_gita::876.simple_insight: Devotion practiced with understanding can heal and uplift you swiftly.
vishnu_gita::876.detailed_meaning: This verse teaches that performing the sacred ritual of Vishnu yajna, guided by the knowledge of the Vishnu Gita, liberates a person from all illnesses and brings rapid happiness and well-being.
vishnu_gita::876.modern_relevance: You feel burdened by stress or health issues, but sincere spiritual practice can help restore your well-being and peace faster than you expect.
vishnu_gita::876.insight: It teaches you to combine devotion with understanding to experience true healing and joy.

vishnu_gita::877.verse_sanskrit:
यश्वाक्षरमयीमेनां विष्णुगीतां प्रयच्छति ।
मत्पात्रेभ्यः कुलीनेभ्यो विद्वदन्या हि यथाविधि ॥
vishnu_gita::877.verse_hindi: जो अक्षरमयी (पुस्तकरूप) इस विष्णुगीता को सत्पात्र कुलीन तथा विद्वानो को यथाविधि दान करता है
vishnu_gita::877.english_translation: He who gives this lettered Vishnu Gita to worthy, noble, and learned recipients as appropriate is blessed.
vishnu_gita::877.translation_literal: यश्वाक्षरमयीमेनां (this lettered) / विष्णुगीतां (Vishnu Gita) / प्रयच्छति (gives) / मत्पात्रेभ्यः (to my worthy recipients) / कुलीनेभ्यो (to noble ones) / विद्वदन्या (to learned ones) / हि (indeed) / यथाविधि (appropriately)
vishnu_gita::877.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::877.essence: Giving sacred knowledge respectfully to worthy recipients is a virtuous act.
vishnu_gita::877.simple_meaning: Offering this written Vishnu Gita to the right noble and learned people is a blessed act.
vishnu_gita::877.simple_insight: Sharing sacred knowledge with worthy people spreads blessings and respect.
vishnu_gita::877.detailed_meaning: The narrator, Suta, explains that giving the Vishnu Gita in written form to deserving, noble, and learned individuals according to proper ways is a virtuous act.
vishnu_gita::877.insight: It teaches the value of sharing wisdom respectfully with those ready to receive it.

vishnu_gita::878.verse_sanskrit:
स्वर्गप्राप्तिस्सदा तस्य स्वहस्तामलकायते ।
एषा यस्य गृहे तिष्ठेद्विष्णुगीता सुरप्रभा: ! ॥
vishnu_gita::878.verse_hindi: उसके लिये स्वर्ग प्राप्ति सदा स्वाधीन है, हे देवश्रेष्ठो! यह विष्णुगीता जिसके घर में रहती है
vishnu_gita::878.english_translation: For the one in whose home the Vishnu Gita dwells, attaining the higher realm is always assured, O best of the deities!
vishnu_gita::878.translation_literal: स्वर्गप्राप्तिस्सदा (attainment of higher realm always) तस्य (of that one) स्वहस्तामलकायते (by own hand is achieved) । एषा (this) यस्य (whose) गृहे (in the house) तिष्ठेद्विष्णुगीता (dwells Vishnu Gita) सुरप्रभा: (O best of deities) ! ॥
vishnu_gita::878.speaker: Suta
vishnu_gita::878.essence: Sacred wisdom present in a home assures access to the higher realm.
vishnu_gita::878.simple_meaning: Having the Vishnu Gita in your home is said to always secure your place in the higher realm.
vishnu_gita::878.simple_insight: There is comfort in knowing sacred wisdom brings lasting protection and upliftment.
vishnu_gita::878.detailed_meaning: Suta declares that the presence of the Vishnu Gita in a household guarantees the family's access to the higher realm, symbolizing spiritual protection and blessings from the divine realm.
vishnu_gita::878.modern_relevance: Keeping inspiring teachings close can feel like a shield in hard times, assuring you a better outcome.
vishnu_gita::878.insight: Recognize that surrounding yourself with nourishing wisdom creates a foundation for lasting well-being.

vishnu_gita::879.verse_sanskrit:
आसुरी भौतिकी तस्य कापि बाधा न जायते ।
यत्रासौ भक्तिभावेन भवने रक्षिता भंवत् ॥
vishnu_gita::879.verse_hindi: कोई भी आसुरी और भौतिकी बाधा उसको नहीं होती है , जिस घरमें यह विष्णुगीता भक्तिभाव से सदा सुरक्षित रहती है
vishnu_gita::879.english_translation: No hostile or material obstacle can affect the home where the Vishnu Gita is always protected with devoted love.
vishnu_gita::879.translation_literal: आसुरी (hostile) / भौतिकी (material) / तस्य (to that) / कापि (any) / बाधा (obstacle) / न (not) / जायते (arises) / यत्र (where) / आसौ (that) / भक्तिभावेन (with devoted love) / भवने (in the home) / रक्षिता (protected) / भंवत् (is).
vishnu_gita::879.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::879.essence: Devoted love creates an unbreakable protection around where it dwells.
vishnu_gita::879.simple_meaning: No harmful or worldly trouble can affect a home protected by devoted love for the divine.
vishnu_gita::879.simple_insight: You feel safe when your love for the divine shields your surroundings.
vishnu_gita::879.detailed_meaning: In this teaching, Vishnu explains that any hostile or material barrier cannot harm a home where the sacred text is kept with devoted love, showing how Bhakti Yoga creates a protective spiritual atmosphere.
vishnu_gita::879.modern_relevance: You keep a cherished object or photo in your home as a reminder of love and safety; devotion works similarly, creating a protective feeling in your life.
vishnu_gita::879.insight: It shifts your perspective to see devotion as a powerful protector, not just an internal feeling but a guardian of your space.

vishnu_gita::880.verse_sanskrit:
नित्यमायतनं तद्धि लक्ष्मीनैव विमुञ्चति ।
जानीत निश्चयं देवाः ! सत्यं मन्यं वदाम्यहम् ॥
vishnu_gita::880.verse_hindi: उस घर को लक्ष्मी कभी नहीं छोड़ती है, हे देवगण! यह तुम निश्चय जानो, मैं यह सत्य सत्य कहता हूँ
vishnu_gita::880.english_translation: The divine wealth of Lakshmi never abandons that abode; O devas, know this with certainty, I speak the truth.
vishnu_gita::880.translation_literal: नित्यमायतनं (always-abode) तद्धि (therein) लक्ष्मीनैव (Lakshmi alone) विमुञ्चति (does not leave) । जानीत (know) निश्चयं (certainty) देवाः (O devas) ! सत्यं (truth) मन्यं (I consider) वदाम्यहम् (I speak) ॥
vishnu_gita::880.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::880.essence: Lasting abundance stays where care and devotion are constant.
vishnu_gita::880.simple_meaning: True wealth, symbolized by Lakshmi, never leaves a home that is cared for and nurtured with devotion.
vishnu_gita::880.simple_insight: You feel assured that caring and devotion attract lasting abundance and presence.
vishnu_gita::880.detailed_meaning: Vishnu addresses the devas, affirming that Lakshmi, representing lasting divine prosperity, never abandons a home that is consistently cared for and respected. This moment emphasizes trust in the sustaining power of devotion.
vishnu_gita::880.modern_relevance: You see a home where love and attention are constant; no matter challenges, the sense of true abundance remains steady.
vishnu_gita::880.insight: It teaches you to recognize that devotion and care create a stable foundation where abundance naturally remains.

vishnu_gita::881.verse_sanskrit:
आस्तिको गुरुभक्तश्च देवश्रद्धापरायणः ।
शास्त्रेषु दृढ़विश्वासः पवित्रात्मा महामनाः॥
vishnu_gita::881.verse_hindi: जो आस्तिक गुरुभक्त और देवताओ में श्रद्धालु हैं, जिसका शास्त्रों में दृढ़ विश्वास है, जो पवित्रात्मा महामना है
vishnu_gita::881.english_translation: A true believer is devoted to the Guru and the divine, firmly trusts the scriptures, and possesses a pure and great mind.
vishnu_gita::881.translation_literal: आस्तिको (a believer) / गुरुभक्तश्च (and devoted to the Guru) / देवश्रद्धापरायणः (devoted to the divine) / शास्त्रेषु (in scriptures) / दृढ़विश्वासः (firm faith) / पवित्रात्मा (pure soul) / महामनाः (great-minded)
vishnu_gita::881.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::881.essence: Deep devotion and firm trust in teachings cultivate a pure and noble mind.
vishnu_gita::881.simple_meaning: Being devoted to your teacher and the divine, having strong faith in sacred teachings, makes your mind pure and noble.
vishnu_gita::881.simple_insight: You feel steadiness and clarity when your heart trusts deeply.
vishnu_gita::881.detailed_meaning: Vishnu describes a person who is devoted both to their Guru and the divine, whose firm faith in sacred texts purifies their mind and elevates their spirit, marking a key quality for spiritual progress.
vishnu_gita::881.modern_relevance: You feel grounded when your mentors and guiding principles inspire unwavering trust, giving your mind steadiness amid chaos.
vishnu_gita::881.insight: This verse teaches you to anchor your heart in devotion and trust, which purifies your thoughts and strengthens your inner resolve.

vishnu_gita::882.verse_sanskrit:
न धर्मसम्प्रदायांश्च योऽन्यान द्वेष्टि कदाचन ।
महोदारः स एवात्र लब्धं केवलमर्हति ॥
vishnu_gita::882.verse_hindi: और जो अन्य धर्म सम्प्रदायों से कभी द्वेष नहीं करता है एवं जो परमोदार है केवल वही
vishnu_gita::882.english_translation: Only the great-hearted person who never hates other paths or traditions truly deserves all.
vishnu_gita::882.translation_literal: न (not) / धर्मसम्प्रदायांश्च (other religious paths/traditions) / योऽन्यान (others) / द्वेष्टि (hates) / कदाचन (ever) / महोदारः (great-hearted) / स (that one) / एवात्र (alone here) / लब्धं (obtains) / केवलम् (only) / अर्हति (deserves).
vishnu_gita::882.speaker: Vishnu
vishnu_gita::882.essence: True greatness means never hating other spiritual paths or traditions.
vishnu_gita::882.simple_meaning: You are truly great when you never hate or reject other spiritual paths or traditions.
vishnu_gita::882.simple_insight: Peace comes from embracing all paths without hatred or judgement.
vishnu_gita::882.detailed_meaning: Vishnu teaches that true greatness arises in those who never despise other faiths or traditions. This inclusive attitude opens the way to receiving the highest blessings.
vishnu_gita::882.modern_relevance: You notice how conflicts arise when people reject others' beliefs. Choosing respect instead frees you from this burden.
vishnu_gita::882.insight: It shifts your mind from division to acceptance, opening space for compassion and unity.

vishnu_gita::883.verse_sanskrit:
विष्णोरुपनिषन्मय्यां गीतायामधिकारिताम् ।
ध्रुवमस्याः तापचारेण लोके शान्तिर्भविष्यति ॥
vishnu_gita::883.verse_hindi: इस उपनिषन्मयी विष्णुगीता का अधिकारी हो सकता है। इस विष्णुगीता के प्रचारसे संसार में अवश्य शान्ति होगी
vishnu_gita::883.english_translation: One who teaches this Vishnu Gita filled with Upanishadic wisdom will surely bring peace to the world through disciplined effort.
vishnu_gita::883.translation_literal: विष्णोरुपनिषन्मय्यां (Vishnu filled with Upanishads) / गीतायामधिकारिताम् (of the Gita authorized) / ध्रुवमस्याः (certainly by this) / तापचारेण (by disciplined effort) / लोके (in the world) / शान्तिर्भविष्यति (peace will be)
vishnu_gita::883.speaker: Unknown
vishnu_gita::883.essence: Disciplined teaching of deep wisdom inevitably brings peace to the world.
vishnu_gita::883.simple_meaning: Teaching this sacred Vishnu Gita with steady, disciplined effort will bring peace to the world.
vishnu_gita::883.simple_insight: You feel hopeful knowing that your focused sharing of wisdom can truly calm the world.
vishnu_gita::883.detailed_meaning: This verse states that anyone who authoritatively teaches the Vishnu Gita, which is filled with deep Upanishadic wisdom, will bring peace to the world through consistent, disciplined action.
vishnu_gita::883.modern_relevance: When you patiently share your knowledge or values with care, even amidst chaos, you help create calm and understanding around you.
vishnu_gita::883.insight: It teaches you to persistently and patiently share wisdom, knowing your efforts ripple outward into peace.

yoga_sutras::1.verse_hindi: Yoga is the stilling of the fluctuations of the mind.
yoga_sutras::1.english_translation: Yoga is the stilling of the fluctuations of the mind.
yoga_sutras::1.speaker: Patanjali
yoga_sutras::1.essence: Quiet the mind — that is the whole practice.
yoga_sutras::1.simple_meaning: Yoga, in its deepest definition, has nothing to do with physical postures. It is the state that arises when the constant churning of thoughts, reactions, memories, and projections — the vrittis — settle into stillness. All practices are in service of this.
yoga_sutras::1.simple_insight: We are not used to the idea that the primary problem is the mind's noise. This sutra says: that is exactly the problem, and stilling it is the entire project.
yoga_sutras::1.detailed_meaning: Chitta is more than 'mind' in the colloquial sense — it is the entire field of consciousness, including memory (smriti), ego-sense (ahamkara), intellect (buddhi), and sense-mind (manas). Vritti means 'whirlpool' or 'fluctuation' — each thought, each reaction, each identification creates a ripple in this field. Nirodhah does not mean suppression — it means the natural settling that occurs when the mechanisms generating fluctuation are addressed. This is the most precise definition of yoga in existence: not a method, but its fruit.
yoga_sutras::1.modern_relevance: The mind's default mode is wandering — research suggests we spend 47% of waking hours not present to what we're doing. The distress associated with mind-wandering is well-documented. The entire wellness industry — from meditation apps to breathwork — is groping toward what Patanjali stated in four words: still the mind. The depth of this sutra is that it identifies the problem with a precision most modern frameworks lack.
yoga_sutras::1.insight: The mind in motion creates a distorted picture of reality. The still mind sees what is actually there. All of yoga is the journey between those two states.

yoga_sutras::2.verse_hindi: Then the seer abides in their own true nature.
yoga_sutras::2.english_translation: Then the seer abides in their own true nature.
yoga_sutras::2.translation_literal: tada (then/at that point) + drashtuh (of the seer/witness) + svarupe (in own true nature/own form) + avasthanam (abiding/resting/establishment)
yoga_sutras::2.speaker: Patanjali
yoga_sutras::2.essence: Still the noise; find what was always watching.
yoga_sutras::2.simple_meaning: When the fluctuations of the mind settle (as described in the previous sutra), the pure witnessing awareness — which was always present but obscured — naturally becomes apparent. This is not an achievement but a revelation of what was already the case.
yoga_sutras::2.simple_insight: You are not what your mind says you are. The mind's content changes constantly; you — the one watching — do not. This sutra points to that watcher.
yoga_sutras::2.detailed_meaning: The 'seer' (drashtuh) is pure awareness — not the ego, not the intellect, not any psychological structure. Svarupe means 'in its own form' — that is, in its true nature rather than identified with the fluctuations of the mind. Avasthanam means abiding or resting — not a state that comes and goes, but a recognition of what is always already the case. The sequence matters: first the fluctuations still (YS 1.2), then what was always present is recognized (YS 1.3). The second sutra reveals the goal that the first sutra was pointing toward.
yoga_sutras::2.modern_relevance: Contemporary mindfulness traditions often speak of 'observer perspective' — the ability to notice thoughts without being identified with them. Patanjali is pointing to something deeper: the awareness that observes is not just a perspective but your fundamental nature. The difference between watching your thoughts and knowing yourself as the awareness that watches is the difference between a technique and a recognition.
yoga_sutras::2.insight: You have spent your life identifying with the contents of the mind. This sutra says: look at who is doing the identifying. That is where you actually are.

yoga_sutras::3.verse_hindi: The fluctuations of the mind are fivefold; they are either painful or not painful.
yoga_sutras::3.english_translation: The fluctuations of the mind are fivefold; they are either painful or not painful.
yoga_sutras::3.translation_literal: vrittayah (the fluctuations/modifications) + pancatayyah (fivefold/of five kinds) + klishta (painful/afflicted) + aklishta (not painful/non-afflicted)
yoga_sutras::3.speaker: Patanjali
yoga_sutras::3.essence: Know which thoughts bind you and which set you free.
yoga_sutras::3.simple_meaning: The mind's activities fall into five categories: correct cognition, error, conceptualization, sleep, and memory. Each of these can either increase suffering or not — and recognizing this distinction is the beginning of practice.
yoga_sutras::3.simple_insight: We are not taught to examine the quality of our mental activity — only its content. This sutra introduces a different metric: does this mental motion bind or release?
yoga_sutras::3.detailed_meaning: The five vrittis Patanjali identifies are: pramana (valid cognition), viparyaya (misconception), vikalpa (imagination/conceptualization), nidra (sleep), and smriti (memory). Each can be either klishta (rooted in the kleshas — afflictions like ignorance, ego, attachment, aversion, clinging to life) or aklishta (not rooted in affliction). This taxonomy is not academic — it is a diagnostic map. When you recognize which vritti is operating and whether it is klishta or not, you can respond with appropriate practice rather than blanket suppression.
yoga_sutras::3.modern_relevance: Modern cognitive science distinguishes between adaptive and maladaptive rumination, productive imagination and avoidant fantasy, accurate perception and cognitive distortion. Patanjali's framework is more comprehensive and more actionable: it classifies not just by content but by whether the movement is rooted in suffering-generating tendencies. Metacognition — thinking about thinking — is now recognized as a core skill in psychological flexibility. This sutra is a master class in it.
yoga_sutras::3.insight: Most people try to control what they think. The sutras suggest something prior: recognize how you are thinking, and whether that mode is binding you.

yoga_sutras::4.verse_hindi: Concentration (dharana) is the binding of the mind to a single place.
yoga_sutras::4.english_translation: Concentration (dharana) is the binding of the mind to a single place.
yoga_sutras::4.translation_literal: desha (place/location) + bandhah (binding/fixing/tethering) + chittasya (of the mind/consciousness) + dharana (concentration/holding)
yoga_sutras::4.speaker: Patanjali
yoga_sutras::4.essence: Hold the mind still; depth begins here.
yoga_sutras::4.simple_meaning: Dharana is the practice of holding the mind to a single point — a sound, an object, the breath, a concept. The mind will wander; dharana is the discipline of returning it, repeatedly, until the binding becomes effortless.
yoga_sutras::4.simple_insight: The capacity to pause and stay with something is now rare and valuable. This sutra names that capacity as the foundation of all deeper practice.
yoga_sutras::4.detailed_meaning: Desha can mean a physical location, a point on the body, or an internal focal object. Bandha means binding or tethering — suggesting that the scattered, wandering mind is gently but firmly held. This is the first of three sutras that define the inner limbs of yoga: dharana (concentration), dhyana (meditation), and samadhi (absorption). Each depends on the preceding. Dharana is not a subtle or advanced practice — it is the ground-level work of training the mind's basic capacity to stay. Without it, what we call 'meditation' is mostly drift.
yoga_sutras::4.modern_relevance: The average human attention span has measurably declined as information environment fragmentation has increased. Dharana as a practice — single-tasking, sustained attention, the discipline of not switching — is now a competitive and psychological advantage. Organizations that train concentrated attention outperform those that don't. What Patanjali identified as a spiritual prerequisite turns out to be a life prerequisite.
yoga_sutras::4.insight: You cannot go deep into anything — a conversation, a problem, a relationship, a practice — without first being able to stay. Dharana trains that capacity.

yoga_sutras::5.verse_hindi: Sustained, unbroken attention to that single point is meditation (dhyana).
yoga_sutras::5.english_translation: Sustained, unbroken attention to that single point is meditation (dhyana).
yoga_sutras::5.translation_literal: tatra (there/in that) + pratyaya (content of mind/cognition/attention-movement) + ekatanata (unbroken flow/continuity/single-streamedness) + dhyanam (meditation)
yoga_sutras::5.speaker: Patanjali
yoga_sutras::5.essence: When concentration flows unbroken, meditation begins.
yoga_sutras::5.simple_meaning: If dharana is tethering the mind to a point, dhyana is when that tethering becomes a continuous flow — attention that no longer needs to be re-applied because it has settled into a stream. This is genuine meditation, not an effort but an emergence.
yoga_sutras::5.simple_insight: Meditation is not something you do — it is something that happens when concentration matures. Effort becomes effortlessness.
yoga_sutras::5.detailed_meaning: Pratyaya is the specific content or 'wave' of cognition flowing toward the object. Ekatanata literally means 'single-stranded flow' — the continuity of attention without the breaks and wanderings that characterize dharana. The transition from dharana to dhyana is not about trying harder; it is about repeated return until the returns become unnecessary. The object and the attention become seamlessly joined. This sutra defines what people often claim to be practicing when they sit quietly — but also clarifies that most 'meditation' is actually dharana, and that is fine. Dharana is the proper preparation.
yoga_sutras::5.modern_relevance: Researchers studying flow states describe a point at which skilled, focused engagement tips from effortful attention into absorbed, effortless action. Patanjali is describing the same tipping point in contemplative practice. The practical implication: do not rush to 'emptiness' or special experiences. Practice the sustained return. Dhyana emerges from that practice, not from seeking it directly.
yoga_sutras::5.insight: You cannot force meditation. You can only practice concentration with fidelity until meditation shows up on its own.

yoga_sutras::6.verse_hindi: When consciousness shines only as the object, as if empty of its own form, that is absorption (samadhi).
yoga_sutras::6.english_translation: When consciousness shines only as the object, as if empty of its own form, that is absorption (samadhi).
